articles.title: Superconductivity in the Metallic Wigner Crystals of Rhombohedral Graphene: Possible Realization of an Electronic Supersolid
articles.title_zh: 菱面体石墨烯金属维格纳晶体的超导性：电子超固体的可能实现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.10117v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent experiments on rhombohedral multilayer graphene have reported metallic Wigner crystals (MWCs), in which spontaneously broken translational symmetry coexists with mobile charge carriers. Their proximity to time-reversal-symmetry-breaking superconductivity raises the intriguing possibility that collective excitations of the electron crystal mediate pairing among the residual itinerant carriers, giving rise to a superconducting Wigner crystal---an electronic analog of a supersolid. Here we investigate this possibility using a realistic model of electron-doped rhombohedral multilayer graphene with spin and valley polarization, whose low symmetry removes the usual Cooper instability. We use self-consistent and time-dependent Hartree-Fock theory to map the evolution of the self-doping fraction and characterize the collective-mode spectrum of the MWCs, followed by a multiband linearized Eliashberg analysis of pairing. Upon increasing density, we find an instability of the MWC, triggered by a weakly dispersing unoccupied band approaching the chemical potential. Pairing remains weak deep in the stable MWC. However, on approaching the instability, we identify a collective mode composed of interband electron-hole excitations that softens. We show that this mode drives pairing at experimentally relevant temperatures. The leading pairing instability is at finite momentum and combines Fermi surface states with states in the incipient band, making a Fermi surface or single-band pairing analysis inadequate. Our results establish collective-mode-mediated superconductivity in MWCs as a viable scenario for rhombohedral graphene and motivate experimental searches for coexisting electronic charge order in its superconducting phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 最近关于菱面体多层石墨烯的实验报道了金属维格纳晶体（MWC），其中自发破缺的平移对称性与移动电荷载流子共存。它们接近时间反转对称性破缺的超导性，提出了一种有趣的可能性，即电子晶体的集体激发介导剩余流动载流子之间的配对，从而产生超导维格纳晶体——超固体的电子模拟。在这里，我们使用具有自旋和谷极化的电子掺杂菱面体多层石墨烯的现实模型来研究这种可能性，其低对称性消除了通常的库珀不稳定性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 最近关于菱面体多层石墨烯的实验报道了金属维格纳晶体（MWC），其中自发破缺的平移对称性与移动电荷载流子共存。它们接近时间反转对称性破缺的超导性，提出了一种有趣的可能性，即电子晶体的集体激发介导剩余流动载流子之间的配对，从而产生超导维格纳晶体——超固体的电子模拟。在这里，我们使用具有自旋和谷极化的电子掺杂菱面体多层石墨烯的现实模型来研究这种可能性，其低对称性消除了通常的库珀不稳定性。我们使用自洽和时间相关的 Hartree-Fock 理论来绘制自掺杂分数的演化图，并表征 MWC 的集体模式频谱，然后进行多频带线性化 Eliashberg 配对分析。随着密度的增加，我们发现 MWC 不稳定，这是由接近化学势的弱分散未占据带引发的。在稳定的 MWC 深处，配对仍然很弱。然而，在接近不稳定性时，我们发现了一种由带间电子空穴激发组成的集体模式，该模式会软化。我们证明这种模式可以在实验相关温度下驱动配对。主要的配对不稳定性处于有限动量，并将费米表面状态与初始能带中的状态结合起来，使得费米表面或单能带配对分析不充分。我们的研究结果确立了 MWC 中集体模式介导的超导性作为菱面体石墨烯的可行方案，并激发了在其超导相中共存电子电荷顺序的实验研究。

articles.title: Mimicry of d-wave Andreev Signatures by Interlayer Pairing
articles.title_zh: 通过层间配对模拟 d 波 Andreev 签名
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.10130v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The recent discovery of high-Tᵣₘ c superconductivity in bilayer nickelates has attracted enormous attention. Despite dominant theoretical studies pointing to interlayer pairing, the pairing symmetry is strongly debated due to conflicting evidence on nodeless bulk gaps and d-wave-like transport signatures. Here, we demonstrate that a nodeless interlayer pairing can naturally mimic d-wave Andreev signatures when the point contact is not evenly coupled to the two layers. The phenomenon can be understood by recognizing how a contact potential, which is odd under the layer-exchanging mirror symmetry, acts like an effective Zeeman field on the layer pseudospin. This pseudo field then binds in-gap Andreev states that sweep through the gap with the width and strength of the barrier. We further demonstrate in a realistic model for La₃Ni₂O₇ that the simulated subgap conductance for a top-layer barrier can reproduce the orientation dependent ZBCP usually interpreted as a fingerprint of d-wave pairing. By revealing this mirror-selective Andreev response from an interlayer pairing state, our work offers a natural scenario to reconcile the conflicting experimental evidence in bilayer nickelates and advances our understanding of unconventional superconductivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 最近在双层镍酸盐中发现的高Tᵣₘc超导性引起了极大的关注。尽管主流理论研究指向层间配对，但由于无节点体间隙和类 d 波输运特征的证据相互矛盾，配对对称性仍存在激烈争论。在这里，我们证明，当点接触未均匀耦合到两层时，无节点层间配对可以自然地模拟 d 波 Andreev 特征。通过认识在层交换镜像对称下奇数的接触电势如何在层赝自旋上像有效塞曼场一样起作用，可以理解这种现象。然后，这个赝场结合带隙内的安德列夫态，这些态以势垒的宽度和强度扫过带隙。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 最近在双层镍酸盐中发现的高Tᵣₘc超导性引起了极大的关注。尽管主流理论研究指向层间配对，但由于无节点体间隙和类 d 波输运特征的证据相互矛盾，配对对称性仍存在激烈争论。在这里，我们证明，当点接触未均匀耦合到两层时，无节点层间配对可以自然地模拟 d 波 Andreev 特征。通过认识在层交换镜像对称下奇数的接触电势如何在层赝自旋上像有效塞曼场一样起作用，可以理解这种现象。然后，这个赝场结合带隙内的安德列夫态，这些态以势垒的宽度和强度扫过带隙。我们在 La₃Ni2O₇ 的现实模型中进一步证明，顶层势垒的模拟子间隙电导可以重现通常被解释为 d 波配对指纹的方向相关 ZBCP。通过揭示层间配对态的镜像选择性安德烈夫响应，我们的工作提供了一个自然的场景来调和双层镍酸盐中相互矛盾的实验证据，并增进我们对非常规超导性的理解。

articles.title: Hidden memory above the Neel temperature programs antiferromagnetic order in Cr2O3
articles.title_zh: 高于尼尔温度的隐藏记忆在 Cr2O3 中编程反铁磁顺序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.10173v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Control of antiferromagnetic order is central to magnetoelectric and antiferromagnetic spintronic devices. In the prototypical magnetoelectric antiferromagnet Cr2O3, domains are conventionally selected by simultaneous application of electric and magnetic fields during cooling through the Neel temperature (T_N) or at a fixed temperature below T_N. Here, we show that antiferromagnetic order can instead be programmed by electric-field conditioning entirely in the paramagnetic state above T_N. By measuring the magnetoelectric coefficient (alpha_zz) of bulk Cr2O3 crystals under different thermal and field histories, we find that a sufficiently large electric field above T_N establishes a reversible state that persists after the field is removed. Subsequent magnetic-field cooling with no applied electric field produces a single-domain state with the opposite Neel-vector orientation from conventional magnetoelectric field cooling. The electrically induced state can be reversibly written, erased, and allowed to relax at high temperatures, demonstrating a long-lived internal electric bias that governs domain selection. The observed behavior is consistent with a metastable surface-associated polar state that may generate this internal bias. These results reveal an unexpected coupling between electrically programmed memory and antiferromagnetic domain formation in Cr2O3.
articles.abstract_zh: 反铁磁序的控制是磁电和反铁磁自旋电子器件的核心。在原型磁电反铁磁体 Cr2O3 中，通常通过在冷却至尼尔温度 (T_N) 或低于 T_N 的固定温度期间同时施加电场和磁场来选择磁畴。在这里，我们证明反铁磁序可以通过完全在 T_N 以上的顺磁状态下的电场调节来编程。通过测量块状 Cr2O3 晶体在不同热历史和场历史下的磁电系数 (alpha_zz)，我们发现 T_N 以上足够大的电场建立了可逆状态，该状态在电场移除后仍然存在。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 反铁磁序的控制是磁电和反铁磁自旋电子器件的核心。在原型磁电反铁磁体 Cr2O3 中，通常通过在冷却至尼尔温度 (T_N) 或低于 T_N 的固定温度期间同时施加电场和磁场来选择磁畴。在这里，我们证明反铁磁序可以通过完全在 T_N 以上的顺磁状态下的电场调节来编程。通过测量块状 Cr2O3 晶体在不同热历史和场历史下的磁电系数 (alpha_zz)，我们发现 T_N 以上足够大的电场建立了可逆状态，该状态在电场移除后仍然存在。随后在不施加电场的情况下进行磁场冷却，产生与传统磁电场冷却相反的尼尔矢量方向的单畴态。电感应状态可以可逆地写入、擦除，并可以在高温下松弛，从而证明了控制域选择的长寿命内部电偏压。观察到的行为与可能产生这种内部偏差的亚稳态表面相关极性状态一致。这些结果揭示了电编程存储器与 Cr2O3 中反铁磁畴形成之间的意外耦合。

articles.title: Optimizing one-dimensional lithographically defined nanowires in semiconducting heterostructures
articles.title_zh: 优化半导体异质结构中的一维光刻定义的纳米线
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.10177v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: One-dimensional nanowires can host remarkable electronic properties and are central to studying quantum transport. Although heterostructure-defined confinement combined with gate-defined potentials can greatly reduce the effects of impurities as measured via electron mobilities, the realization and interpretation of novel effects at this scale are complicated by disorder. Experiments on lithographically defined one-dimensional nanowires therefore do not exhibit ideal behavior. Using theoretical and computational models, we predict that optimizing the geometry of split gates in semiconducting heterostructures will lead to higher-quality channels for transport measurements. Further, we show that this optimization is essential for resolving features of interest such as the Rashba-induced spin gap. This new approach to lithographically defined conduction channels provides better energy resolution and is less susceptible to disorder.
articles.abstract_zh: 一维纳米线可以具有显着的电子特性，是研究量子传输的核心。尽管异质结构定义的限制与栅极定义的电势相结合可以大大减少通过电子迁移率测量的杂质的影响，但这种规模的新效应的实现和解释由于无序而变得复杂。因此，对光刻定义的一维纳米线的实验并未表现出理想的行为。使用理论和计算模型，我们预测优化半导体异质结构中分裂栅极的几何形状将导致用于传输测量的更高质量的通道。此外，我们表明这种优化对于解决感兴趣的特征（例如 Rashba 引起的自旋间隙）至关重要。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 一维纳米线可以具有显着的电子特性，是研究量子传输的核心。尽管异质结构定义的限制与栅极定义的电势相结合可以大大减少通过电子迁移率测量的杂质的影响，但这种规模的新效应的实现和解释由于无序而变得复杂。因此，对光刻定义的一维纳米线的实验并未表现出理想的行为。使用理论和计算模型，我们预测优化半导体异质结构中分裂栅极的几何形状将导致用于传输测量的更高质量的通道。此外，我们表明这种优化对于解决感兴趣的特征（例如 Rashba 引起的自旋间隙）至关重要。这种光刻定义的传导通道的新方法提供了更好的能量分辨率并且不易受到紊乱的影响。

articles.title: Temperature-Driven Evolution of Magnetization Dynamics in Cobalt-Doped Fe₅GeTe₂
articles.title_zh: 钴掺杂 Fe₅GeTe2 中磁化动力学的温度驱动演化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.10225v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding magnetization dynamics in metallic van der Waals ferromagnets is essential to uncover their magnetic interactions and evaluate their potential for high-frequency spintronics applications. In this study, we investigate the temperature-dependent magnetization dynamics of a single crystal of cobalt-doped Fe₅GeTe₂ (CFGT) using broadband ferromagnetic resonance (FMR) spectroscopy. At high temperatures, the FMR response is dominated by a single broad resonance that shifts toward lower magnetic fields upon cooling. Fits to the frequency dependence of the resonance field and linewidth yield an effective g factor of approximately 2.45 and an effective Gilbert damping parameter of approximately 0.15 near room temperature. The effective magnetic anisotropy evolves strongly with temperature, with an increasingly pronounced easy-plane contribution upon cooling toward 200 K. Below approximately 200 K, an additional resonance emerges and evolves into a distinct two-mode response that persists to the lowest measured temperature of 25 K. The two branches exhibit different temperature dependences of their resonance fields and linewidths, and the emergence of the additional mode is not accompanied by a comparably pronounced anomaly in the static magnetization. These results reveal a dynamical crossover in CFGT that is not readily apparent from bulk magnetometry and highlight the sensitivity of FMR to the magnetic behavior of chemically substituted van der Waals ferromagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 了解金属范德华铁磁体的磁化动力学对于揭示其磁相互作用并评估其高频自旋电子学应用的潜力至关重要。在这项研究中，我们使用宽带铁磁共振（FMR）光谱研究了钴掺杂 Fe₅GeTe2（CFGT）单晶的温度依赖性磁化动力学。在高温下，FMR 响应主要由单一宽共振主导，该共振在冷却时转向较低磁场。拟合谐振场和线宽的频率依赖性可得到约 2.45 的有效 g 因子和接近室温的约 0.15 的有效吉尔伯特阻尼参数。有效磁各向异性随温度强烈变化，在冷却至 200 K 时，易平面贡献越来越明显。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 了解金属范德华铁磁体的磁化动力学对于揭示其磁相互作用并评估其高频自旋电子学应用的潜力至关重要。在这项研究中，我们使用宽带铁磁共振（FMR）光谱研究了钴掺杂 Fe₅GeTe2（CFGT）单晶的温度依赖性磁化动力学。在高温下，FMR 响应主要由单一宽共振主导，该共振在冷却时转向较低磁场。拟合谐振场和线宽的频率依赖性可得到约 2.45 的有效 g 因子和接近室温的约 0.15 的有效吉尔伯特阻尼参数。有效磁各向异性随温度强烈变化，在冷却至 200 K 时，易平面贡献越来越明显。在大约 200 K 以下，出现附加共振，并演变成持续到最低测量温度 25 K 的独特双模响应。这两个分支表现出不同的共振场和线宽的温度依赖性，并且附加模式的出现并不伴随静态磁化强度中相对明显的异常。这些结果揭示了 CFGT 中的动态交叉，而这种动态交叉在体磁力测量中并不明显，并且突出了 FMR 对化学取代范德华铁磁体的磁性行为的敏感性。

articles.title: Discovery of Kondo-Kramers Nodal Line Topological State in strongly correlated material CeAuAl₃
articles.title_zh: 强关联材料 CeAuAl₃ 中近藤-克莱默节点线拓扑态的发现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.10368v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Kramers nodal lines (KNLs) are predicted in all achiral, non-centrosymmetric crystal structures, and yet there are very few experimental realizations of KNLs, only in weakly correlated systems. Especially, their realization in strongly correlated systems remains unexplored. Here we investigate KNL topology in the non-centrosymmetric, achiral Kondo lattice CeAuAl₃, using magnetotransport, thermodynamic measurements, density functional theory (DFT), and tight-binding toy model calculations. We find that CeAuAl₃ hosts KNLs in the Γ-Z and X-P directions, protected by time-reversal and mirror symmetries. Breaking of these crystalline symmetries, along with time-reversal symmetry via spin polarization, lifts the KNL degeneracy, which, in turn, generates Berry curvature resulting in an intrinsic anomalous Hall effect (AHE). More importantly, CeAuAl₃ shows large AHE not only below the magnetic ordering temperature T_N but rather below the Kondo temperature. This underscores the role of the Kondo correlations in bringing the KNLs at the Fermi surface rather than at accidental energies, as would be expected without correlations. Our work identifies a new topological state, Kondo-Kramers Nodal Line, with CeAuAl₃ being the first compound explicitly identified to host this new correlated topological state, and demonstrating the expected AHE associated with it. More generally, our work outlines the pathway for finding Kondo-KNL systems in all compounds that combine achiral, non-centrosymmetric structure with Kondo correlations.
articles.abstract_zh: 克莱默节线 (KNL) 在所有非手性、非中心对称晶体结构中均被预测，但 KNL 的实验实现非常少，仅在弱相关系统中实现。特别是，它们在强相关系统中的实现仍有待探索。在这里，我们利用磁输运、热力学测量、密度泛函理论 (DFT) 和紧束缚玩具模型计算，研究非中心对称、非手性近藤晶格 CeAuAl₃ 中的 KNL 拓扑。我们发现 CeAuAl₃ 在 Γ-Z 和 X-P 方向上具有 KNL，并受到时间反转和镜像对称的保护。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 克莱默节线 (KNL) 在所有非手性、非中心对称晶体结构中均被预测，但 KNL 的实验实现非常少，仅在弱相关系统中实现。特别是，它们在强相关系统中的实现仍有待探索。在这里，我们利用磁输运、热力学测量、密度泛函理论 (DFT) 和紧束缚玩具模型计算，研究非中心对称、非手性近藤晶格 CeAuAl₃ 中的 KNL 拓扑。我们发现 CeAuAl₃ 在 Γ-Z 和 X-P 方向上具有 KNL，并受到时间反转和镜像对称的保护。这些晶体对称性的打破，以及通过自旋极化实现的时间反转对称性，提升了 KNL 简并性，进而产生贝里曲率，从而产生内在的反常霍尔效应 (AHE)。更重要的是，CeAuAl₃不仅在磁有序温度T_N以下而且在近藤温度以下都表现出较大的AHE。这强调了近藤相关性在将 KNL 带到费米表面而不是像没有相关性时所预期的那样以偶然能量产生的作用。我们的工作确定了一种新的拓扑状态，Kondo-Kramers 节点线，CeAuAl₃ 是第一个明确确定为这种新的相关拓扑状态的化合物，并证明了与之相关的预期 AHE。更一般地说，我们的工作概述了在所有将非手性、非中心对称结构与近藤相关性相结合的化合物中寻找近藤-KNL 系统的途径。

articles.title: Transverse quasiparticle heat transport in p-wave magnetic Josephson junctions
articles.title_zh: p 波磁约瑟夫森结中的横向准粒子热传输
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.10442v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study transverse heat currents carried by Bogoliubov quasiparticles in p-wave magnetic Josephson junctions under a longitudinal temperature bias. We find that such a junction supports a transverse spin heat current while the net transverse heat current vanishes. This effect stems from the p-wave magnetism, which shifts the two spin sectors oppositely in transverse momentum space and thereby causes them to carry opposite heat currents. A weak Zeeman field lifts the compensation between the two spin-sector contributions, thereby generating a finite net transverse heat current. The directions of both currents can be switched by reversing the sign of the p-wave magnetic splitting or tuning the superconducting phase difference, while both currents vanish in the absence of p-wave magnetism. These findings highlight p-wave magnetic Josephson junctions as a versatile platform for switchable transverse heat transport and controllable spin caloritronics.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了纵向温度偏置下 p 波磁性约瑟夫森结中 Bogoliubov 准粒子携带的横向热流。我们发现这样的结支持横向自旋热流，而净横向热流消失。这种效应源于 p 波磁力，它使两个自旋扇区在横向动量空间中反向移动，从而使它们携带相反的热流。弱塞曼场提升了两个自旋扇区贡献之间的补偿，从而产生有限的净横向热流。可以通过反转 p 波磁分裂的符号或调整超导相位差来切换两个电流的方向，而在没有 p 波磁力的情况下，两个电流都会消失。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了纵向温度偏置下 p 波磁性约瑟夫森结中 Bogoliubov 准粒子携带的横向热流。我们发现这样的结支持横向自旋热流，而净横向热流消失。这种效应源于 p 波磁力，它使两个自旋扇区在横向动量空间中反向移动，从而使它们携带相反的热流。弱塞曼场提升了两个自旋扇区贡献之间的补偿，从而产生有限的净横向热流。可以通过反转 p 波磁分裂的符号或调整超导相位差来切换两个电流的方向，而在没有 p 波磁力的情况下，两个电流都会消失。这些发现凸显了 p 波磁性约瑟夫森结作为可切换横向热传输和可控自旋热电子学的多功能平台。

articles.title: Pseudogap in hole doped cuprates: a status report
articles.title_zh: 空穴掺杂铜酸盐中的赝能隙：状态报告
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.10473v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The pseudogap state, an anomalous momentum dependent partial suppression of low energy electronic excitations persisting well above the superconducting critical temperature in underdoped cuprates, remains one of the most profound enigmas in condensed physics today. This review summarizes over three decades of experimental and theoretical progress. It appears that pseudogap is not a mere precursor to superconductivity, but a distinct, intertwined state of matter characterized by a complex interplay of competing and cooperating electronic orders. We critically examine the bulk probes like resistivity and magnetic susceptibility and the surface hallmark spectroscopic signatures observed via angle resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) in this review. ARPES reveals a Fermi surface truncated into disconnected segments and scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) visualizes a spatially heterogeneous energy gap around the Fermi level. These observations are contextualized alongside transport anomalies, including resistivity and bulk magnetic susceptibility, to construct a phenomenological portrait of a phase that violates conventional Fermi liquid theory. By mapping the electronic phase diagram, we highlight the abrupt transition at above optimal doping. We conclude with open questions still to be answered. This review underscores the role of the pseudogap as a key to unlocking the unconventional pairing mechanism of hole doped cuprates and the broader physics of strongly correlated electron systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 赝能隙态是低能电子激发的反常动量依赖性部分抑制，其持续远高于未掺杂铜氧化物的超导临界温度，仍然是当今凝聚态物理学中最深刻的谜团之一。这篇综述总结了三十多年来的实验和理论进展。赝能隙似乎不仅仅是超导性的前身，而是一种独特的、相互交织的物质状态，其特征是竞争和合作电子秩序的复杂相互作用。在这篇综述中，我们严格检查了电阻率和磁化率等体探针以及通过角度分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）观察到的表面特征光谱特征。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 赝能隙态是低能电子激发的反常动量依赖性部分抑制，其持续远高于未掺杂铜氧化物的超导临界温度，仍然是当今凝聚态物理学中最深刻的谜团之一。这篇综述总结了三十多年来的实验和理论进展。赝能隙似乎不仅仅是超导性的前身，而是一种独特的、相互交织的物质状态，其特征是竞争和合作电子秩序的复杂相互作用。在这篇综述中，我们严格检查了电阻率和磁化率等体探针以及通过角度分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）观察到的表面特征光谱特征。 ARPES 揭示了费米表面被截断为不连续的片段，扫描隧道显微镜 (STM) 可视化了费米能级周围的空间异质能隙。这些观察结果与输运异常（包括电阻率和体磁化率）结合在一起，构建了违反传统费米液体理论的相的现象学肖像。通过绘制电子相图，我们突出显示了上述最佳掺杂下的突变。最后，我们提出仍有待回答的开放性问题。这篇综述强调了赝能隙作为解锁空穴掺杂铜酸盐的非常规配对机制和强相关电子系统的更广泛物理学的关键的作用。

articles.title: Dopant Cluster Engineering for Tunable Room-Temperature Ferromagnetism in 2D Transition Metal Dichalcogenides
articles.title_zh: 二维过渡金属二硫化物中可调谐室温铁磁性的掺杂团簇工程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.10480v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-dimensional transition metal dichalcogenides (2D-TMDs) offer a promising platform for realizing dilute magnetic semiconductors. However, simultaneously achieving large magnetic anisotropy energy (MAE) and high Curie temperature (T_c) remains a major challenge. In this work, we employ DFT+U to systematically investigate the thermodynamic stability and magnetic properties of 2D-MoSe₂ and 2D-WSe₂ doped with transition metal atoms. We found that the paired dopant configurations are more stable than previously attributed isolated dopants. Despite their nearly identical crystal structures, 2D-MoSe₂ and 2D-WSe₂ show contrasting properties upon doping. All paired dopants in 2D-MoSe₂ exhibit long-range ferromagnetic coupling (FMC) primarily due to carrier-mediated exchange interactions, whereas those in 2D-WSe₂ show weak exchange coupling. Interestingly, 2Mn₂W shows a transition from less stable antiferromagnetic coupling (AFMC) in the short range to highly stable FMC in the long-range. The combined effect of spin-orbit coupling, exchange interactions, and orbital hybridization gives rise to a large MAE with maximum in-plane values of -3.5 meV for 2V₂Mo and -3.2 meV for 2Mn₂W. Monte Carlo simulations estimate T_c simeq 440 K for 2Fe₂Mo and ensure its high-temperature stability in 2D-MoSe₂. Our results establish dopant clustering as an effective route to engineer high-temperature ferromagnetism in 2D-TMDs and highlight their potential for nano-spintronic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 二维过渡金属二硫属化物（2D-TMD）为实现稀磁半导体提供了一个有前途的平台。然而，同时实现大磁各向异性能量（MAE）和高居里温度（T_c）仍然是一个主要挑战。在这项工作中，我们采用DFT+U系统地研究了掺杂过渡金属原子的2D-MoSe2和2D-WSe2的热力学稳定性和磁性能。我们发现成对的掺杂剂构型比之前归因的孤立掺杂剂更稳定。尽管 2D-MoSe2 和 2D-WSe2 的晶体结构几乎相同，但它们在掺杂时表现出截然不同的特性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 二维过渡金属二硫属化物（2D-TMD）为实现稀磁半导体提供了一个有前途的平台。然而，同时实现大磁各向异性能量（MAE）和高居里温度（T_c）仍然是一个主要挑战。在这项工作中，我们采用DFT+U系统地研究了掺杂过渡金属原子的2D-MoSe2和2D-WSe2的热力学稳定性和磁性能。我们发现成对的掺杂剂构型比之前归因的孤立掺杂剂更稳定。尽管 2D-MoSe2 和 2D-WSe2 的晶体结构几乎相同，但它们在掺杂时表现出截然不同的特性。 2D-MoSe2 中的所有成对掺杂剂均表现出长程铁磁耦合 (FMC)，这主要是由于载流子介导的交换相互作用，而 2D-WSe2 中的掺杂剂则表现出弱交换耦合。有趣的是，2Mn2W 显示出从短程中不太稳定的反铁磁耦合 (AFMC) 到长程中高度稳定的 FMC 的转变。自旋轨道耦合、交换相互作用和轨道杂化的综合作用产生了较大的 MAE，2V2Mo 的最大面内值为 -3.5 meV，2Mn2W 的最大面内值为 -3.2 meV。蒙特卡洛模拟估计 2Fe 2 Mo 的 T_c simeq 为 440 K，并确保其在 2D-MoSe 2 中的高温稳定性。我们的研究结果表明，掺杂剂团簇是在 2D-TMD 中设计高温铁磁性的有效途径，并强调了它们在纳米自旋电子应用中的潜力。

articles.title: Quartet ferromagnetism in the small-exchange limit
articles.title_zh: 小交换极限下的四重铁磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.10512v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rare-earth magnets are often regarded as classical owing to their large angular momentum J, but this picture breaks down when exchange is smaller than the crystalline electric-field (CEF) energy scale, allowing the degeneracy of low-lying CEF manifolds to dictate the emergent quantum phases. Here, we uncover such a regime in the RV6Sn6 (R = rare-earth) kagome metals with strong magnetic anisotropy. Thermodynamic and neutron-diffraction measurements reveal successive axial and tilted ferromagnetic (FM) phases in DyV6Sn6, arising from independent ordering of the axial Mz and transverse Mx dipolar components enabled by a rare quasi-quartet ground state. On the other hand, HoV6Sn6 has a similar tilted magnetic anisotropy, but remains axial down to 0.03 K. This discrepancy can be traced back to the non-Kramers nature of Ho3+ where the CEF lifts the quartet degeneracy, leaving a quasi-triplet ground state. Unlike quartets or higher multiplets, we find that the effective spin-1 triplet does not allow independent dipolar ordering without strong quadrupolar (nematic) interactions that act to break rotational symmetry, revealing an essential multipolar prerequisite for tilted magnetic ground states. These results establish a quartet CEF manifold as the minimal degeneracy required for dipolar-driven independent ordering. Mapping the surrounding CEF parameter space further reveals competing magnetic, non-magnetic singlet, and potential quadrupolar phases, driven by multifold ground state degeneracies. These results establish CEF tuning as a versatile route to unconventional quantum phases across the broader RT6X6 (T = transition metal; X = Sn, Ge) family.
articles.abstract_zh: 稀土磁体由于角动量 J 大，通常被认为是经典磁体，但当交换小于晶体电场 (CEF) 能量尺度时，这种情况就会崩溃，从而允许低位 CEF 流形的简并性决定出现的量子相。在这里，我们在具有强磁各向异性的 RV6Sn6（R = 稀土）kagome 金属中发现了这种状态。热力学和中子衍射测量揭示了 DyV6Sn6 中连续的轴向和倾斜铁磁 (FM) 相，这是由罕见的准四重基态实现的轴向 Mz 和横向 Mx 偶极分量的独立排序引起的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 稀土磁体由于角动量 J 大，通常被认为是经典磁体，但当交换小于晶体电场 (CEF) 能量尺度时，这种情况就会崩溃，从而允许低位 CEF 流形的简并性决定出现的量子相。在这里，我们在具有强磁各向异性的 RV6Sn6（R = 稀土）kagome 金属中发现了这种状态。热力学和中子衍射测量揭示了 DyV6Sn6 中连续的轴向和倾斜铁磁 (FM) 相，这是由罕见的准四重基态实现的轴向 Mz 和横向 Mx 偶极分量的独立排序引起的。另一方面，HoV6Sn6 具有类似的倾斜磁各向异性，但在低至 0.03 K 时仍保持轴向。这种差异可以追溯到 Ho3+ 的非克莱默性质，其中 CEF 提升了四重态简并性，留下了准三重态基态。与四重态或更高的多重态不同，我们发现有效的自旋1三重态不允许独立的偶极排序，除非强四极（向列）相互作用破坏旋转对称性，揭示了倾斜磁性基态的基本多极先决条件。这些结果建立了四重 CEF 流形作为偶极驱动独立排序所需的最小简并性。映射周围的 CEF 参数空间进一步揭示了由多重基态简并驱动的竞争性磁性、非磁性单线态和潜在的四极相。这些结果确立了 CEF 调谐作为跨更广泛的 RT6X6（T = 过渡金属；X = Sn、Ge）系列的非常规量子相的通用途径。

articles.title: Dipolar Exchange and Emergent Electric-Dipole-Carrying Quasiparticles in Electronic Ferroelectrics
articles.title_zh: 电子铁电体中的偶极交换和新兴电偶极子携带准粒子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.10513v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electronic correlations underpin diverse spontaneously ordered states in matter, whose collective excitations emerge as quasiparticles that encode the underlying order. While spin exchange interactions give rise to magnetic order and its quasiparticle excitations known as magnons, their counterparts in electronic ferroelectrics remain poorly understood. Here, we derive an analogous quantum dipolar-pseudospin exchange model for electronic ferroelectricity and identify the associated bosonic quasiparticles that carry intrinsic electric dipole moments. Unlike ferrons in conventional lattice-based ferroelectrics, these dipolar quasiparticles arise entirely from collective electronic dynamics without involving lattice vibrations. Their excitation spectrum exhibits a linear Stark shift under a static electric field, while coupling to an oscillating electric field enables their coherent excitation, leading to colossal, resonantly enhanced second-harmonic generation and optical rectification in the terahertz regime. These dipolar quasiparticles offer promising opportunities for electrically tunable nonlinear optics and open a route toward extending the paradigm of transport in electronic systems beyond conventional charge currents to electric dipole currents.
articles.abstract_zh: 电子相关性支撑着物质中多种自发有序状态，其集体激发表现为编码潜在顺序的准粒子。虽然自旋交换相互作用产生磁序及其称为磁振子的准粒子激发，但它们在电子铁电体中的对应物仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们推导了电子铁电性的类似量子偶极-赝自旋交换模型，并识别了携带固有电偶极矩的相关玻色准粒子。与传统晶格铁电体中的铁子不同，这些偶极准粒子完全由集体电子动力学产生，不涉及晶格振动。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电子相关性支撑着物质中多种自发有序状态，其集体激发表现为编码潜在顺序的准粒子。虽然自旋交换相互作用产生磁序及其称为磁振子的准粒子激发，但它们在电子铁电体中的对应物仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们推导了电子铁电性的类似量子偶极-赝自旋交换模型，并识别了携带固有电偶极矩的相关玻色准粒子。与传统晶格铁电体中的铁子不同，这些偶极准粒子完全由集体电子动力学产生，不涉及晶格振动。它们的激发光谱在静电场下表现出线性斯塔克位移，而与振荡电场的耦合使它们能够相干激发，从而在太赫兹范围内产生巨大的、共振增强的二次谐波和光学整流。这些偶极准粒子为电可调非线性光学提供了有希望的机会，并开辟了一条将电子系统中的传输范式从传统充电电流扩展到电偶极电流的途径。

articles.title: Markov-Shielded Typicality for Thermal Quantum States
articles.title_zh: 热量子态的马尔可夫屏蔽典型性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.10593v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pure states of quantum many-body systems at thermal equilibrium are known to be typical, in a sense that a randomly chosen pure state from an appropriate energy shell reproduces the Gibbs-state expectation values of most observables acting on a small subsystem. However, such typical states are intrinsically stochastic, conventionally generated from the random high-temperature state, suffer from statistical fluctuations, and do not provide a continuous connection to the ground state. Here, we introduce a deterministic variational framework for constructing a Markov-Shielded Typical (MST) state, a unique thermal pure-state representative whose local reduced density matrices closely approximate those of the Gibbs state, from the ground state up to infinite-temperature limit. Our approach reformulates free-energy minimization by replacing the nonlocal von Neumann entropy with a local, computationally tractable Markov entropy, where we establish rigorous upper and lower bounds of MST free energy to lie in the very vicinity of the thermal free energy. This framework extends the concept of typicality to deterministic pure-state representations of thermal equilibrium, offering a scalable wave-function approach with potential applications to both classical and quantum computing.
articles.abstract_zh: 已知热平衡时的量子多体系统的纯态是典型的，从某种意义上说，从适当的能量壳中随机选择的纯态再现了作用于小子系统的大多数可观测量的吉布斯态期望值。然而，这种典型的状态本质上是随机的，通常是由随机高温状态生成的，受到统计波动的影响，并且不提供与基态的连续连接。在这里，我们引入了一个确定性变分框架，用于构造马尔可夫屏蔽典型（MST）态，这是一种独特的热纯态代表，其局部约简密度矩阵非常接近吉布斯态，从基态到无限温度极限。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 已知热平衡时的量子多体系统的纯态是典型的，从某种意义上说，从适当的能量壳中随机选择的纯态再现了作用于小子系统的大多数可观测量的吉布斯态期望值。然而，这种典型的状态本质上是随机的，通常是由随机高温状态生成的，受到统计波动的影响，并且不提供与基态的连续连接。在这里，我们引入了一个确定性变分框架，用于构造马尔可夫屏蔽典型（MST）态，这是一种独特的热纯态代表，其局部约简密度矩阵非常接近吉布斯态，从基态到无限温度极限。我们的方法通过用局部的、可计算处理的马尔可夫熵替换非局部冯·诺依曼熵来重新表述自由能最小化，其中我们建立了严格的 MST 自由能上限和下限，使其位于热自由能的附近。该框架将典型性的概念扩展到热平衡的确定性纯态表示，提供了一种可扩展的波函数方法，具有在经典计算和量子计算中的潜在应用。

articles.title: Ferromagnetic resonance signatures of edge states for distinguishing chiral and helical p-wave superconductors
articles.title_zh: 用于区分手性和螺旋 p 波超导体的边缘态铁磁共振特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.10623v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We theoretically investigate ferromagnetic resonance (FMR) modulation at interfaces between ferromagnetic insulators and two-dimensional chiral and helical p-wave superconductors. We evaluate the surface dynamical spin susceptibility, including both edge and bulk quasiparticle excitations. For momentum-conserving interfacial exchange at zero temperature, the edge contribution to the Gilbert damping exhibits distinct frequency scalings for the excitation energies well above the spectral broadening, hbarωgg2δ: δ/(hbarω)² for the chiral state and 1/hbarω for the helical state. For a clean superconducting boundary, edge-induced Ising spin anisotropy persists even when interfacial exchange disorder randomizes momentum transfer. The low-energy edge response is suppressed when the magnetization aligns with the edge-state spin axis. These results establish FMR modulation as a probe complementary to existing methods for distinguishing the chiral and helical states and constraining their d-vector directions.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们从理论上研究了铁磁绝缘体与二维手性和螺旋 p 波超导体之间界面的铁磁共振 (FMR) 调制。我们评估表面动态自旋敏感性，包括边缘和体准粒子激发。对于零温度下的动量守恒界面交换，吉尔伯特阻尼的边缘贡献表现出远高于光谱展宽的激发能量的明显频率缩放，hbarωgg2δ：手性态为 δ/(hbarω)2，螺旋态为 1/hbarω。对于干净的超导边界，即使界面交换无序使动量传递随机化，边缘引起的伊辛自旋各向异性仍然存在。当磁化强度与边缘态自旋轴对齐时，低能边缘响应被抑制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们从理论上研究了铁磁绝缘体与二维手性和螺旋 p 波超导体之间界面的铁磁共振 (FMR) 调制。我们评估表面动态自旋敏感性，包括边缘和体准粒子激发。对于零温度下的动量守恒界面交换，吉尔伯特阻尼的边缘贡献表现出远高于光谱展宽的激发能量的明显频率缩放，hbarωgg2δ：手性态为 δ/(hbarω)2，螺旋态为 1/hbarω。对于干净的超导边界，即使界面交换无序使动量传递随机化，边缘引起的伊辛自旋各向异性仍然存在。当磁化强度与边缘态自旋轴对齐时，低能边缘响应被抑制。这些结果将 FMR 调制确立为一种探针，与现有方法互补，用于区分手性和螺旋态并限制其 d 向量方向。

articles.title: Identifying Contributions to the Superconducting Diode Effect through Nonreciprocal Superconducting Properties
articles.title_zh: 通过不可逆超导特性确定对超导二极管效应的贡献
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.10669v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nonreciprocal superconducting responses provide a sensitive probe of superconducting states in systems where inversion and time-reversal symmetries are broken. However, in the superconducting diode effect (SDE), where the critical current differs for opposite current directions, nonreciprocity can also arise from vortex-induced contributions caused by minute magnetic field misalignment, complicating its interpretation. Here, we investigate a noncentrosymmetric [Nb/V/Ta]₄₀ superlattice and demonstrate nonreciprocity in all three fundamental superconducting properties: the critical current, critical field, and superconducting transition temperature. By measuring the angular dependence of the nonreciprocal critical field Δ Bc ₂, we separate the contribution of misalignment-induced out-of-plane vortices from the in-plane response. We identify a sharply enhanced SDE emerging near Bc ₂, accompanied by nonreciprocal responses in Tc. These observations exhibit phenomenology similar to that reported in layered superconductors, where an orbital-FFLO state with finite-momentum Cooper pairing has been reported. Our results establish a protocol for assessing out-of-plane vortex contributions to the superconducting diode effect and demonstrate that nonreciprocal responses provide complementary probes of unconventional superconducting states.
articles.abstract_zh: 不可逆超导响应为反演和时间反转对称性被破坏的系统中的超导状态提供了灵敏的探测。然而，在超导二极管效应（SDE）中，相反电流方向的临界电流不同，微小磁场失准引起的涡流感应贡献也可能产生非互易性，从而使其解释变得复杂。在这里，我们研究了非中心对称的 [Nb/V/Ta]40 超晶格，并证明了所有三个基本超导特性的非互易性：临界电流、临界场和超导转变温度。通过测量不可逆临界场 Δ Bc 2 的角度依赖性，我们将未对准引起的面外涡流的贡献与面内响应分开。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 不可逆超导响应为反演和时间反转对称性被破坏的系统中的超导状态提供了灵敏的探测。然而，在超导二极管效应（SDE）中，相反电流方向的临界电流不同，微小磁场失准引起的涡流感应贡献也可能产生非互易性，从而使其解释变得复杂。在这里，我们研究了非中心对称的 [Nb/V/Ta]40 超晶格，并证明了所有三个基本超导特性的非互易性：临界电流、临界场和超导转变温度。通过测量不可逆临界场 Δ Bc 2 的角度依赖性，我们将未对准引起的面外涡流的贡献与面内响应分开。我们发现在 Bc 2 附近出现了急剧增强的 SDE，并伴随着 Tc 中的不可逆响应。这些观察结果表现出与层状超导体中报道的现象类似的现象，其中报道了具有有限动量库珀配对的轨道-FFLO状态。我们的结果建立了一个用于评估平面外涡流对超导二极管效应的贡献的协议，并证明非互易响应提供了非常规超导状态的互补探针。

articles.title: Probing Chern Topology through Hall-Sensitive Photonic Spin Hall Shifts in a d-wave Altermagnet
articles.title_zh: 通过 d 波交替磁体中的霍尔敏感光子自旋霍尔位移探测陈拓扑
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.10706v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this paper, we investigate the photonic spin Hall effect in a two-dimensional Rashba-coupled d-wave altermagnetic Chern system subjected to a uniform out-of-plane exchange field. We first analyze the energy-band structure and the Dirac mass distribution at the high-symmetry points, where mΓ=m_M=Δₓ, m_X=Δₓ-4 t_J, and m_Y=Δₓ+4 t_J. Band inversions at high-symmetry points generate both a topologically trivial regime (C=0) and Chern-insulating phases (C= ± 1). Employing the Kubo formalism for the optical conductivity together with the reflection matrix for a substrate-supported conducting sheet, we compute helicity-dependent finite-waist displacements of a reflected Gaussian beam. The resulting optical response exhibits a minimum interband absorption threshold, a Van Hove-type spectral feature, and distinct transitions at the X and Y points arising from the momentum dependence of the exchange field. Under the specified Hall-tensor and polarization sign conventions, the longitudinal helicity half-separation is odd upon reversal of the optical Hall conductivity and correspondingly changes sign between opposite-Chern phases, whereas the transverse half-separation is even in the Hall response. The maximal spin-dependent splitting occur in the vicinity of the pseudo-Brewster reflectance minimum. The longitudinal spin splitting reverses sign between opposite Chern phases, reflecting the exchange-controlled optical Hall response, while its pronounced spectral variations reveal the influence of inequivalent interband transitions induced by the d-wave altermagnetic exchange. These findings establish polarization-resolved photonic beam shifts as a sensitive probe of Hall-active topological phases and their characteristic optical spectra.
articles.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们研究了受到均匀面外交换场影响的二维 Rashba 耦合 d 波交磁 Chern 系统中的光子自旋霍尔效应。我们首先分析高对称点处的能带结构和狄拉克质量分布，其中mΓ=m_M=Δₓ，m_X=Δₓ-4 t_J，m_Y=Δₓ+4 t_J。高对称点处的能带反转会产生拓扑平凡状态 (C=0) 和陈绝缘相 (C= ± 1)。采用 Kubo 形式来计算光导率，并结合基底支撑的导电片的反射矩阵，我们计算反射高斯光束的螺旋性相关的有限腰位移。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在本文中，我们研究了受到均匀面外交换场影响的二维 Rashba 耦合 d 波交磁 Chern 系统中的光子自旋霍尔效应。我们首先分析高对称点处的能带结构和狄拉克质量分布，其中mΓ=m_M=Δₓ，m_X=Δₓ-4 t_J，m_Y=Δₓ+4 t_J。高对称点处的能带反转会产生拓扑平凡状态 (C=0) 和陈绝缘相 (C= ± 1)。采用 Kubo 形式来计算光导率，并结合基底支撑的导电片的反射矩阵，我们计算反射高斯光束的螺旋性相关的有限腰位移。由此产生的光学响应表现出最小带间吸收阈值、范霍夫型光谱特征以及由于交换场的动量依赖性而在 X 和 Y 点处产生的明显跃迁。在指定的霍尔张量和偏振符号约定下，纵向螺旋半分离在光学霍尔电导率反转时是奇数，并且相应地在相反的陈相位之间改变符号，而横向半分离在霍尔响应中是偶数。最大的自旋相关分裂发生在伪布儒斯特反射率最小值附近。纵向自旋分裂使相反的陈相之间的符号反转，反映了交换控制的光学霍尔响应，而其明显的光谱变化揭示了由 d 波交磁交换引起的不等价带间跃迁的影响。这些发现将偏振分辨光子束位移确立为霍尔活性拓扑相及其特征光谱的敏感探针。

articles.title: Ising model on Calandre lattice
articles.title_zh: Calandre 格子上的 Ising 模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.10834v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this paper, we proposed to consideration a noval (not yet exploited) planar lattice --- Calandre lattice with the Ising model applied to it. In the framework of an exact analytical Kramers--Wannier transfer-matrix approach and using an extension of the combinatorial Vdovichenko--Feynman method, we have obtained exact solution for Helmholtz free energy and consequent expression for the principal eigenvalue of the Kramers--Wannier transfer-matrix. In addition, we derived the exact expression for spontaneous magnetization. The usage of both expressions made it possible to perform the comprehensive studies of thermodynamic and magnetic properties of the Calandre lattice itself and a wide variety of its affiliated lattices. Among them, diversified interrelations between Calandre lattice and already known and even some novel lattices. These lattices have also revealed such effects as magnetic frustrations, multiple phase transitions and magnetic reentrancy.
articles.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们建议考虑一种新颖的（尚未开发的）平面晶格——Calandre 晶格，并应用伊辛模型。在精确解析的 Kramers-Wannier 传递矩阵方法的框架下，并使用组合 Vdovichenko-Feynman 方法的扩展，我们获得了亥姆霍兹自由能的精确解以及 Kramers-Wannier 传递矩阵主特征值的后续表达式。此外，我们还导出了自发磁化的精确表达式。这两种表达式的使用使得对卡兰德雷晶格本身及其各种附属晶格的热力学和磁性质进行全面研究成为可能。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在本文中，我们建议考虑一种新颖的（尚未开发的）平面晶格——Calandre 晶格，并应用伊辛模型。在精确解析的 Kramers-Wannier 传递矩阵方法的框架下，并使用组合 Vdovichenko-Feynman 方法的扩展，我们获得了亥姆霍兹自由能的精确解以及 Kramers-Wannier 传递矩阵主特征值的后续表达式。此外，我们还导出了自发磁化的精确表达式。这两种表达式的使用使得对卡兰德雷晶格本身及其各种附属晶格的热力学和磁性质进行全面研究成为可能。其中，Calandre格子与已知的甚至一些新颖的格子之间存在多样化的相互关系。这些晶格还揭示了磁挫败、多相变和磁重入等效应。

articles.title: A Geometry-Guided Feature-Space Framework for Interpretable Unsupervised 4D-STEM Analysis of Complex Multiphase Materials
articles.title_zh: 用于复杂多相材料的可解释无监督 4D-STEM 分析的几何引导特征空间框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.10853v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rapid, high-fidelity analysis of four-dimensional scanning transmission electron microscopy (4D-STEM) datasets from heterogeneous materials remains challenging because coexisting phases, orientation variants, local strain gradients, and intrinsic TEM thin-foil effects produce complex, overlapping diffraction signatures. Here, we present a machine-learning (ML) framework that combines physics-informed geometric descriptors with weighted high-dimensional embeddings to identify latent structural patterns with minimal prior knowledge. By constructing a regularized descriptor space before embedding and density-based clustering, the method improves cluster stability, suppresses noise-driven fragmentation, and reduces sensitivity to embedding hyperparameters. Spatial weighting produced the largest stability gain, increasing median cluster persistence from 0.04 to 0.55 while reducing the noise fraction from approximately 22% to 0%. Rotation weighting increased DBCV from 0.80 to 0.92, although the noise fraction rose from 0.2% to 1.0%, highlighting a trade-off between improved density separation and noise rejection. We validate the framework on two benchmark systems: Si/SiₓGe₁₋ₓ epitaxial layers with continuous lattice variation and deformation, and multiphase Ti-Nb alloys containing distinct phases and orientation variants. Comparisons with a pretrained vanilla autoencoder and model-free pattern vectorization show that the physics-informed geometric descriptor provides higher cluster fidelity, greater interpretability, and substantially lower dimensionality.
articles.abstract_zh: 对异质材料的四维扫描透射电子显微镜 (4D-STEM) 数据集进行快速、高保真分析仍然具有挑战性，因为共存相、方向变化、局部应变梯度和固有的 TEM 薄箔效应会产生复杂、重叠的衍射特征。在这里，我们提出了一个机器学习（ML）框架，它将物理信息的几何描述符与加权高维嵌入相结合，以最少的先验知识识别潜在的结构模式。通过在嵌入和基于密度的聚类之前构建正则化描述符空间，该方法提高了聚类稳定性，抑制了噪声驱动的碎片，并降低了对嵌入超参数的敏感性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对异质材料的四维扫描透射电子显微镜 (4D-STEM) 数据集进行快速、高保真分析仍然具有挑战性，因为共存相、方向变化、局部应变梯度和固有的 TEM 薄箔效应会产生复杂、重叠的衍射特征。在这里，我们提出了一个机器学习（ML）框架，它将物理信息的几何描述符与加权高维嵌入相结合，以最少的先验知识识别潜在的结构模式。通过在嵌入和基于密度的聚类之前构建正则化描述符空间，该方法提高了聚类稳定性，抑制了噪声驱动的碎片，并降低了对嵌入超参数的敏感性。空间加权产生了最大的稳定性增益，将中值簇持久性从 0.04 增加到 0.55，同时将噪声分数从大约 22% 降低到 0%。旋转加权将 DBCV 从 0.80 增加到 0.92，尽管噪声分数从 0.2% 增加到 1.0%，凸显了改进的密度分离和噪声抑制之间的权衡。我们在两个基准系统上验证了该框架：具有连续晶格变化和变形的 Si/SiₓGe₁₋ₓ 外延层，以及包含不同相和取向变化的多相 Ti-Nb 合金。与预训练的普通自动编码器和无模型模式矢量化的比较表明，基于物理的几何描述符提供了更高的聚类保真度、更大的可解释性和显着降低的维度。

articles.title: A data-driven approach for systematic correction of electronic bandgaps
articles.title_zh: 电子带隙系统校正的数据驱动方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.10889v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate that a single machine-learning correction, applied to bandgaps from density functional theory calculations with two of the most frequently used energy functionals, results in bandgaps that are close to the experimental values. This solves a classical problem of computationally efficient electronic structure methods, to give reliable bandgaps that can be compared to experiments. The employed approach relies on materials specific feature engineering of machine learning models, and is shown to have close accuracy to that of much more expensive calculations based on the GW-approximation or hybrid functionals. The findings reported here open the possibility to use efficient calculations in materials design workflows that need reliable bandgaps, with implications for investigations targeting large computational databases or for investigations that are entirely predictive in nature.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们证明，将单个机器学习校正应用于使用两种最常用的能量泛函的密度泛函理论计算的带隙，会产生接近实验值的带隙。这解决了计算高效的电子结构方法的经典问题，给出了可以与实验进行比较的可靠带隙。所采用的方法依赖于机器学习模型的材料特定特征工程，并且被证明与基于 GW 近似或混合泛函的更昂贵的计算具有接近的准确性。这里报告的研究结果开启了在需要可靠带隙的材料设计工作流程中使用高效计算的可能性，这对针对大型计算数据库的研究或本质上完全预测的研究具有影响。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们证明，将单个机器学习校正应用于使用两种最常用的能量泛函的密度泛函理论计算的带隙，会产生接近实验值的带隙。这解决了计算高效的电子结构方法的经典问题，给出了可以与实验进行比较的可靠带隙。所采用的方法依赖于机器学习模型的材料特定特征工程，并且被证明与基于 GW 近似或混合泛函的更昂贵的计算具有接近的准确性。这里报告的研究结果开启了在需要可靠带隙的材料设计工作流程中使用高效计算的可能性，这对针对大型计算数据库的研究或本质上完全预测的研究具有影响。

articles.title: Three-dimensional multipole states of the Bose-Einstein condensate of polar molecules in a shallow two-dimensional trapping potential
articles.title_zh: 浅二维俘获势中极性分子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚的三维多极态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.10896v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the formation, stability, and dynamics of three-dimensional (3D) elongated multipole quantum droplets (QDs) in a Bose-Einstein condensate (BEC) of polar molecules with long-range interactions between molecular electric dipoles. The condensate is confined by a 2D trapping potential, which is a combination of the harmonic-oscillator potential and a central Gaussian potential hill. The system is modeled by an extended Gross-Pitaevskii (GP) equation, incorporating the dipole-dipole interactions and beyond-mean-field Lee-Huang-Yang (LHY) correction, which play a crucial role in stabilizing self-bound QD structures. In regimes of weak and strong confinement, stable multipole states with the number of lobes n=2S are created by means of the imaginary-time-propagation (ITP) method from inputs with vorticity S≤ 2. The so created multipole QDs carry no angular momentum. Stable higher-order multipole states can be produced by the ITP method from inputs with S≥ 3 up to S=6 (i.e., 2S=12 lobes) only under strong confinement and when the molecule number N exceeds a threshold value. We analyze the dependence of the chemical potential, energy per particle, and peak density on N and S in the weak- and strong-confinement regimes. A noteworthy fact is that, below another threshold value of N, the minimum-energy (ground) state is created by the input with S=1, rather than S=0. Simulations of perturbed evolution reveal that, despite satisfying energetic stability criteria, only a subset of the multipole QDs are truly stable, with higher-order ones tending to develop instabilities or relax toward lower-order states. These results highlight the essential roles of the trapping potential, anisotropy of the dipole-dipole interactions, and LHY-induced repulsion in the formation and structural stability of multipole QDs.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了极性分子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体 (BEC) 中三维 (3D) 细长多极量子液滴 (QD) 的形成、稳定性和动力学，以及分子电偶极子之间的长程相互作用。冷凝物受到二维捕获势的限制，该势是谐波振荡器势和中心高斯势山的组合。该系统通过扩展的 Gross-Pitaevskii (GP) 方程进行建模，结合了偶极-偶极相互作用和超平均场 Lee-Huang-Yang (LHY) 校正，这在稳定自束缚 QD 结构中发挥着至关重要的作用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了极性分子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体 (BEC) 中三维 (3D) 细长多极量子液滴 (QD) 的形成、稳定性和动力学，以及分子电偶极子之间的长程相互作用。冷凝物受到二维捕获势的限制，该势是谐波振荡器势和中心高斯势山的组合。该系统通过扩展的 Gross-Pitaevskii (GP) 方程进行建模，结合了偶极-偶极相互作用和超平均场 Lee-Huang-Yang (LHY) 校正，这在稳定自束缚 QD 结构中发挥着至关重要的作用。在弱约束和强约束的情况下，通过虚数时间传播（ITP）方法从涡度 S≤ 2 的输入创建波瓣数 n=2S 的稳定多极态。如此创建的多极量子点不携带角动量。仅在强约束下且当分子数 N 超过阈值时，ITP 方法才能从 S≥ 3 至 S=6（即 2S=12 瓣）的输入产生稳定的高阶多极态。我们分析了弱约束和强约束条件下化学势、每个粒子的能量和峰值密度对 N 和 S 的依赖性。值得注意的事实是，低于 N 的另一个阈值时，最小能量（基态）状态是由 S=1（而不是 S=0）的输入创建的。扰动演化的模拟表明，尽管满足能量稳定性标准，但只有一部分多极量子点是真正稳定的，高阶量子点往往会发展出不稳定性或松弛到低阶状态。这些结果强调了捕获势、偶极-偶极相互作用的各向异性以及 LHY 诱导的排斥在多极量子点的形成和结构稳定性中的重要作用。

articles.title: 2D coherent spectroscopy of topological insulators
articles.title_zh: 拓扑绝缘体的二维相干光谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.10905v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multidimensional coherent spectroscopy probes the response of a system to a sequence of time-separated light pulses, and has attracted significant interest in recent years. In the frequency space, it generates multidimensional spectra, in which information about different degrees of freedom of the system is generically disentangled. In this work, we develop a quantum geometric formulation of multidimensional optical susceptibilities in insulating systems. Focusing on a two-pulse setup and working in the velocity gauge, we derive analytical expressions for second-order and third-order two-dimensional coherent spectra (2DCS). We focus on the third-order ABB response, which remains finite in centrosymmetric systems where the second-order susceptibility vanishes by inversion symmetry. Its paramagnetic contribution supports an echo signal that probes products of four interband Berry-connection matrix elements, which reduce in two-band systems to bilinear combinations of the quantum geometric tensor of the occupied band. Using continuum and square-lattice models of two-dimensional Chern insulators, we show how the echo resolves the momentum-space sign structure of these geometric quantities. For the xxyx response of the models considered, the number of nodes in the echo signal is related to the band topology. Our results extend the quantum-geometric interpretation of multidimensional spectroscopy to higher-order responses, showing that third-order 2DCS provides access to geometric structures beyond those probed at lower orders.
articles.abstract_zh: 多维相干光谱探测系统对一系列时间分离的光脉冲的响应，近年来引起了人们的极大兴趣。在频率空间中，它生成多维谱，其中系统不同自由度的信息通常被解开。在这项工作中，我们开发了绝缘系统中多维光学磁化率的量子几何公式。着眼于双脉冲设置并在速度计中工作，我们推导了二阶和三阶二维相干谱（2DCS）的解析表达式。我们关注三阶 ABB 响应，该响应在中心对称系统中仍然是有限的，其中二阶磁化率因反演对称性而消失。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多维相干光谱探测系统对一系列时间分离的光脉冲的响应，近年来引起了人们的极大兴趣。在频率空间中，它生成多维谱，其中系统不同自由度的信息通常被解开。在这项工作中，我们开发了绝缘系统中多维光学磁化率的量子几何公式。着眼于双脉冲设置并在速度计中工作，我们推导了二阶和三阶二维相干谱（2DCS）的解析表达式。我们关注三阶 ABB 响应，该响应在中心对称系统中仍然是有限的，其中二阶磁化率因反演对称性而消失。它的顺磁性贡献支持回波信号，该信号探测四个带间贝里连接矩阵元素的乘积，该矩阵元素在两带系统中减少为占用带的量子几何张量的双线性组合。使用二维陈绝缘体的连续体和方格模型，我们展示了回波如何解析这些几何量的动量空间符号结构。对于所考虑模型的 xxyx 响应，回波信号中的节点数量与频带拓扑相关。我们的结果将多维光谱的量子几何解释扩展到高阶响应，表明三阶 2DCS 提供了对低阶探测之外的几何结构的访问。

articles.title: Imaging spin entanglement with a scanning tunneling microscope
articles.title_zh: 使用扫描隧道显微镜对自旋纠缠进行成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.10946v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Artificial spin arrays assembled on surfaces enable atomic-scale studies of quantum correlations. Here we establish a hierarchy of connections between spin inelastic electron tunneling spectroscopy (IETS) and entanglement in spin-1/2 systems. We first show that the number of spectroscopically active transitions in a spin-1/2 dimer serves as an entanglement witness. Using the leading-order tunneling conductance for the tip placed on spin i, dI(i)/dV, we then relate spectral moments M⁽ⁿ⁾(i)=int Vⁿ(d²I(i)/dV²),dV to quantum correlations. The zeroth moment probes the one-tangle in systems with a gapped, nondegenerate ground state. For rotationally invariant Heisenberg systems, the first moment yields thermal spin correlators langleboldsymbol S(i)·boldsymbol S(j)rangle, enabling reconstruction of nearest-neighbor concurrence and spatial imaging of entanglement in spin chains. It also provides access to the internal energy and magnetic specific heat, both usable as entanglement witnesses. Applying this approach to experimental IETS data from nanographene spin chains, we find good agreement with theory. We further discuss how the second moment probes longer-range correlations and the inverse moment relates to local spin susceptibility. For spin-1/2 trimers, we connect inter-multiplet inelastic spectral weight to genuine tripartite entanglement quantified by the concurrence fill. Finally, we reconcile the local character of IETS with its sensitivity to nonlocal entanglement through an analogy with digital quantum circuits, where Hamiltonian evolution implements multiqubit operations. These results establish IETS as a tool for quantifying and imaging entanglement in engineered on-surface spin systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 在表面组装的人工自旋阵列可以实现量子相关性的原子尺度研究。在这里，我们在自旋非弹性电子隧道光谱 (IETS) 和自旋 1/2 系统中的纠缠之间建立了一个层次结构的连接。我们首先证明自旋 1/2 二聚体中光谱活跃跃迁的数量可以作为纠缠见证。使用放置在自旋 i 上的尖端的前阶隧道电导，dI(i)/dV，然后我们将谱矩 M⁽ⁿ⁾(i)=int Vⁿ(d²I(i)/dV²),dV 与量子相关性联系起来。零阶矩探测具有带隙、非简并基态的系统中的单缠结。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在表面组装的人工自旋阵列可以实现量子相关性的原子尺度研究。在这里，我们在自旋非弹性电子隧道光谱 (IETS) 和自旋 1/2 系统中的纠缠之间建立了一个层次结构的连接。我们首先证明自旋 1/2 二聚体中光谱活跃跃迁的数量可以作为纠缠见证。使用放置在自旋 i 上的尖端的前阶隧道电导，dI(i)/dV，然后我们将谱矩 M⁽ⁿ⁾(i)=int Vⁿ(d²I(i)/dV²),dV 与量子相关性联系起来。零阶矩探测具有带隙、非简并基态的系统中的单缠结。对于旋转不变的海森堡系统，一阶矩产生热自旋相关器 langleboldsymbol S(i)·boldsymbol S(j)rangle，从而能够重建最近邻并发和自旋链中纠缠的空间成像。它还提供了对内部能量和磁比热的访问，两者都可用作纠缠见证。将这种方法应用于纳米石墨烯自旋链的实验 IETS 数据，我们发现与理论有很好的一致性。我们进一步讨论二阶矩如何探测更远距离的相关性以及反矩如何与局部自旋敏感性相关。对于自旋 1/2 三聚体，我们将多重态间非弹性谱权重与通过并发填充量化的真正三方纠缠连接起来。最后，我们通过与数字量子电路的类比，协调了 IETS 的局域特征及其对非局域纠缠的敏感性，其中哈密顿演化实现了多量子位运算。这些结果使 IETS 成为一种对工程表面自旋系统中的纠缠进行量化和成像的工具。

articles.title: Learning Electronic Band Structures Across the s, p, d Blocks with an Empirical Pseudopotential Network
articles.title_zh: 使用经验赝势网络学习跨 s、p、d 块的电子能带结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.11070v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electronic band structures govern how crystals conduct electrons and absorb light. Density-functional theory (DFT) computes them through costly self-consistent iterations, while existing machine-learning models either predict isolated scalar properties or output Hamiltonians that still require DFT solvers. Here we present EpNet, a learned empirical pseudopotential for crystals spanning 63 elements across the s, p and d blocks. An equivariant neural network builds its Hamiltonian from physics-motivated local potentials and nonlocal projectors. Trained solely on band energies, EpNet predicts complete band structures directly from atomic coordinates. On unseen chemical systems, its median errors are winAll eV for band energies and gapAll eV for band gaps. On 600,000 structures from an independent database, its band-gap errors are overall less than half those of existing models, at about 1% of DFT cost. EpNet thus enables fast screening of electronic properties for materials discovery and electronic-structure simulations of large systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 电子能带结构控制晶体传导电子和吸收光的方式。密度泛函理论 (DFT) 通过成本高昂的自洽迭代来计算它们，而现有的机器学习模型要么预测孤立的标量属性，要么输出仍需要 DFT 求解器的哈密顿量。在这里，我们提出了 EpNet，这是一种学习的晶体经验赝势，跨越 s、p 和 d 块的 63 个元素。等变神经网络根据物理驱动的局部势和非局部投影构建其哈密顿量。 EpNet 仅根据能带能量进行训练，直接从原子坐标预测完整的能带结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电子能带结构控制晶体传导电子和吸收光的方式。密度泛函理论 (DFT) 通过成本高昂的自洽迭代来计算它们，而现有的机器学习模型要么预测孤立的标量属性，要么输出仍需要 DFT 求解器的哈密顿量。在这里，我们提出了 EpNet，这是一种学习的晶体经验赝势，跨越 s、p 和 d 块的 63 个元素。等变神经网络根据物理驱动的局部势和非局部投影构建其哈密顿量。 EpNet 仅根据能带能量进行训练，直接从原子坐标预测完整的能带结构。在不可见的化学系统中，其中值误差对于带能来说是 winAll eV ，对于带隙来说是gapAll eV 。在来自独立数据库的 600,000 个结构上，其带隙误差总体上不到现有模型的一半，约为 DFT 成本的 1%。因此，EpNet 能够快速筛选电子特性，用于材料发现和大型系统的电子结构模拟。

articles.title: Spin Conductivity: Insight From Perturbation Theory
articles.title_zh: 自旋电导率：微扰理论的见解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.11077v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The investigation on the spin conductivity has now been blooming in burgeoning altermagnetic materials. Here, an alternative and elementary derivation for the spin conductivity expression is presented. This is done within the context of perturbation theory. It indicates that our derived expression for the T-even (T for time reversal) spin conductivity agrees exactly with those derived from the Kubo linear response theory and quantum kinetic theory. In addition, the expression for the T-odd spin conductivity in the clean limit is exactly consistent with those presented previously. We show that the T-odd (T-even) spin conductivity arises from the contribution of zeroth-order (first-order) wave function correction. Our work provides some physical insight into the spin conductivity from the perturbation theory and shines more light on the charge-to-spin conversion mechanism in magnetic materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋电导率的研究现已在新兴的交流磁材料中蓬勃发展。这里，提出了自旋传导表达式的另一种基本推导。这是在微扰理论的背景下完成的。这表明我们导出的 T-even（T 为时间反转）自旋电导率表达式与 Kubo 线性响应理论和量子动力学理论导出的表达式完全一致。此外，清洁极限下的T奇自旋电导率的表达式与之前提出的完全一致。我们证明了 T 奇（T 偶）自旋电导率是由零阶（一阶）波函数校正的贡献产生的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋电导率的研究现已在新兴的交流磁材料中蓬勃发展。这里，提出了自旋传导表达式的另一种基本推导。这是在微扰理论的背景下完成的。这表明我们导出的 T-even（T 为时间反转）自旋电导率表达式与 Kubo 线性响应理论和量子动力学理论导出的表达式完全一致。此外，清洁极限下的T奇自旋电导率的表达式与之前提出的完全一致。我们证明了 T 奇（T 偶）自旋电导率是由零阶（一阶）波函数校正的贡献产生的。我们的工作从微扰理论中提供了对自旋电导率的一些物理见解，并为磁性材料中的电荷到自旋转换机制提供了更多线索。

articles.title: Coherent Conversion of an Interacting Dark-State-Polariton Condensate into a Photonic Bose-Einstein Condensate
articles.title_zh: 相互作用的暗态极化子凝聚态到光子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚态的相干转换
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.11180v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: An interacting condensate can retain an observable imprint of its preparation after the interactions are switched off. For light, accessing this regime requires separating the formation of a photon condensate from the material medium that redistributes its energy. We investigate a multimode-cavity scheme in which an interacting dark-state-polariton condensate is coherently converted into a confined photonic Bose-Einstein condensate as the atom-cavity coupling is removed. The polariton mass, matter fraction, and particle number control the condensate occupation during preparation. Remarkably, changing the mass also modifies the condensate's response to repulsion through the spatial overlap of its orbitals, even when the entire single-particle spectrum is held fixed. Ideal mode-preserving conversion conserves the full natural-orbital occupation spectrum, while finite-time few-body calculations show that additional occupation changes during transfer are much smaller than those established during interacting preparation. Once decoupled from matter, the photons evolve under the free cavity Hamiltonian while retaining correlations acquired in the interacting gas. Interference between cavity modes produces oscillations in the photon density, while resonant pair correlations persist after interaction removal and distinguish the resulting photon state from a quadratic thermal state with the same one-body density matrix.
articles.abstract_zh: 在相互作用关闭后，相互作用的冷凝物可以保留其制备过程中可观察到的印记。对于光来说，进入这种状态需要将光子凝聚体的形成与重新分配其能量的材料介质分开。我们研究了一种多模腔方案，其中当原子腔耦合被消除时，相互作用的暗态极化子凝聚态相干地转换为受限光子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚态。极化激元质量、物质分数和颗粒数控制制备过程中冷凝物的占据。值得注意的是，即使整个单粒子光谱保持固定，改变质量也会通过其轨道的空间重叠来改变凝聚体对排斥的响应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在相互作用关闭后，相互作用的冷凝物可以保留其制备过程中可观察到的印记。对于光来说，进入这种状态需要将光子凝聚体的形成与重新分配其能量的材料介质分开。我们研究了一种多模腔方案，其中当原子腔耦合被消除时，相互作用的暗态极化子凝聚态相干地转换为受限光子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚态。极化激元质量、物质分数和颗粒数控制制备过程中冷凝物的占据。值得注意的是，即使整个单粒子光谱保持固定，改变质量也会通过其轨道的空间重叠来改变凝聚体对排斥的响应。理想的保模转换保留了完整的自然轨道占据谱，而有限时间少体计算表明，转移过程中的额外占据变化远小于相互作用准备过程中建立的变化。一旦与物质解耦，光子就会在自由腔哈密顿量下演化，同时保留在相互作用的气体中获得的相关性。腔模式之间的干扰会产生光子密度的振荡，而共振对相关性在相互作用消除后仍然存在，并将所得的光子态与具有相同单体密度矩阵的二次热态区分开来。

articles.title: Engineering ferroelectric nanocapacitors through interfacial phonon bias
articles.title_zh: 通过界面声子偏置设计铁电纳米电容器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.11256v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As ferroelectric devices approach the nanometer scale, their behavior becomes increasingly sensitive to boundary conditions. In perovskite oxide nanocapacitors, epitaxial strain and electrostatic screening are well-established control parameters. Then, while expected to contribute to the epitaxial stabilization of ferroelectric ultrathin films, the lattice-dynamical state of the electrodes has not been isolated as an independent tuning knob. Here we call this poorly explored coupling interfacial phonon bias, whereby the electrodes' phonon energy landscape reshapes that of the adjacent ferroelectric across their shared interface. Using first-principles-accurate machine-learned interatomic potentials and molecular-dynamics simulations, we examine this mechanism in symmetric BiFeO{}₃ nanocapacitors in contact with a metallic perovskite oxide. By independently controlling the orientatio and amplitude of the electrodes' octahedral-tilt landscape, while keeping conventional elastic and electric boundary conditions fixed, we show that the electrodes' phonon energy landscape can modify the stability of competing BiFeO{}₃ phases. In particular, this allows us to shift the ferroelectric transition temperature and even induce antiferroelectric-like switching at ambient conditions. We thus showcase interfacial phonon bias as a complementary and powerful strategy to modify and optimize the properties of ultrathin epitaxial films.
articles.abstract_zh: 随着铁电器件接近纳米尺度，它们的行为对边界条件变得越来越敏感。在钙钛矿氧化物纳米电容器中，外延应变和静电屏蔽是公认的控制参数。然后，虽然预计有助于铁电超薄膜的外延稳定，但电极的晶格动力学状态尚未被隔离为独立的调谐旋钮。在这里，我们将这种探索不足的耦合界面声子偏置称为耦合界面声子偏置，电极的声子能量景观通过其共享界面重塑相邻铁电体的声子能量景观。利用第一原理精确的机器学习原子间势和分子动力学模拟，我们研究了与金属钙钛矿氧化物接触的对称 BiFeO{}₃ 纳米电容器中的这种机制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 随着铁电器件接近纳米尺度，它们的行为对边界条件变得越来越敏感。在钙钛矿氧化物纳米电容器中，外延应变和静电屏蔽是公认的控制参数。然后，虽然预计有助于铁电超薄膜的外延稳定，但电极的晶格动力学状态尚未被隔离为独立的调谐旋钮。在这里，我们将这种探索不足的耦合界面声子偏置称为耦合界面声子偏置，电极的声子能量景观通过其共享界面重塑相邻铁电体的声子能量景观。利用第一原理精确的机器学习原子间势和分子动力学模拟，我们研究了与金属钙钛矿氧化物接触的对称 BiFeO{}₃ 纳米电容器中的这种机制。通过独立控制电极八面体倾斜景观的方向和振幅，同时保持传统的弹性和电边界条件固定，我们表明电极的声子能量景观可以改变竞争的 BiFeO{}₃ 相的稳定性。特别是，这使我们能够改变铁电转变温度，甚至在环境条件下诱导类似反铁电的切换。因此，我们展示了界面声子偏置作为一种补充且强大的策略来修改和优化超薄外延膜的性能。

articles.title: A Rule That's Made to be Broken? Reframing the Arrhenius Law for Ionic Transport
articles.title_zh: 一条注定要被打破的规则？重新构建离子输运的阿伦尼乌斯定律
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.11302v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Arrhenius law is ubiquitous in the physical sciences. It describes how an observable property scales with temperature, T, as exp(± E_A/k_BT) for a constant E_A, the 'activation energy'. Fitting to the Arrhenius law is a common procedure for both experimental and computational data. However, the physical significance of any 'activation energy' calculated is unclear. Here we focus on self-diffusion coefficients for potential solid electrolytes, and by identifying the individual 'diffusive steps' within the system, show how a physically significant activation energy can be extracted. There are also many examples of non-Arrhenius behaviour including `super-Arrhenius' curvature, where the effective activation energy appears to increase with decreasing temperature. We demonstrate how it is still possible to extract the underlying Arrhenius law, by quantifying self-correlations such as back-and-forth motion. The methodology described here is material-agnostic and can be utilised to analyse the molecular dynamics trajectories of both ordered and disordered materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 阿伦尼乌斯定律在物理科学中无处不在。它描述了可观察属性如何随温度 T 变化，对于常数 E_A（“活化能”）为 exp(± E_A/k_BT)。拟合阿伦尼乌斯定律是实验和计算数据的常见过程。然而，计算出的任何“活化能”的物理意义尚不清楚。在这里，我们重点关注潜在固体电解质的自扩散系数，并通过识别系统内的各个“扩散步骤”，展示如何提取物理上重要的活化能。还有许多非阿累尼乌斯行为的例子，包括“超阿累尼乌斯”曲率，其中有效活化能似乎随着温度的降低而增加。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 阿伦尼乌斯定律在物理科学中无处不在。它描述了可观察属性如何随温度 T 变化，对于常数 E_A（“活化能”）为 exp(± E_A/k_BT)。拟合阿伦尼乌斯定律是实验和计算数据的常见过程。然而，计算出的任何“活化能”的物理意义尚不清楚。在这里，我们重点关注潜在固体电解质的自扩散系数，并通过识别系统内的各个“扩散步骤”，展示如何提取物理上重要的活化能。还有许多非阿累尼乌斯行为的例子，包括“超阿累尼乌斯”曲率，其中有效活化能似乎随着温度的降低而增加。我们演示了如何通过量化自相关性（例如来回运动）来提取潜在的阿累尼乌斯定律。这里描述的方法与材料无关，可用于分析有序和无序材料的分子动力学轨迹。

articles.title: Crystal and magnetic structures of MnSi in zero magnetic field: Neutron diffraction and symmetry analysis
articles.title_zh: 零磁场下 MnSi 的晶体和磁结构：中子衍射和对称性分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.11353v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Combining high-resolution wide-angle neutron powder diffraction with magnetic-superspace symmetry analysis, we refine the crystal structure and present, to our knowledge, the first systematic refinement of cubic P2₁₃ MnSi's zero-field magnetic structure across multiple magnetic satellite families. We compare single-arm rhombohedral 3+1D and cubic four-arm 3+4D magnetic superspace-group (MSSG) descriptions with propagation vectors along langle111rangle. Simultaneous extinction of the two satellite groups around 100 dictates a transverse circular-helix model. This suppression and refinements of 18 separately varied satellite-group intensities support this ideal limit with only one adjustable magnetic amplitude. In the ideal single-arm model with MSSG R3.1'(0,0,g)ts, the moment has constant magnitude 0.535(3) μ_B per Mn. An explicit four-arm 3+4D cubic superspace construction presented here combines four interpenetrating helices and, for the illustrated phase choice, has moments ranging from zero to 0.874(5) μ_B per Mn, with the same root-mean-square moment as the 3+1D structure. Their identical powder profiles prevent the present measurements from distinguishing them. The average crystal structure remains cubic within experimental resolution, providing structural motivation for the cubic magnetic model. The mean lattice parameter, determined with formal relative precision σₐ/a lesssim 10⁻⁵, exhibits nonmonotonic temperature dependence below the Néel temperature.
articles.abstract_zh: 将高分辨率广角中子粉末衍射与磁超空间对称性分析相结合，我们细化了晶体结构，并据我们所知，首次系统地细化了跨多个磁性卫星族的立方 P2₁₃ MnSi 的零场磁结构。我们将单臂菱面体 3+1D 和立方四臂 3+4D 磁超空间群 (MSSG) 描述与沿 langle111rangle 的传播向量进行比较。 100 颗左右的两个卫星群同时灭绝表明了横向圆形螺旋模型。这种对 18 个独立变化的卫星组强度的抑制和细化仅用一个可调节的磁振幅来支持这一理想极限。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 将高分辨率广角中子粉末衍射与磁超空间对称性分析相结合，我们细化了晶体结构，并据我们所知，首次系统地细化了跨多个磁性卫星族的立方 P2₁₃ MnSi 的零场磁结构。我们将单臂菱面体 3+1D 和立方四臂 3+4D 磁超空间群 (MSSG) 描述与沿 langle111rangle 的传播向量进行比较。 100 颗左右的两个卫星群同时灭绝表明了横向圆形螺旋模型。这种对 18 个独立变化的卫星组强度的抑制和细化仅用一个可调节的磁振幅来支持这一理想极限。在具有 MSSG R3.1'(0,0,g)ts 的理想单臂模型中，力矩的恒定大小为 0.535(3) μ_B/Mn。这里提出的显式四臂 3+4D 立方超空间结构结合了四个互穿螺旋，对于所示的相位选择，每 Mn 的矩范围为 0 到 0.874(5) μ_B，与 3+1D 结构具有相同的均方根矩。它们相同的粉末轮廓使得目前的测量无法区分它们。平均晶体结构在实验分辨率内保持立方结构，为立方磁模型提供结构动力。平均晶格参数由形式相对精度 σₐ/a lesssim 10⁻⁵ 确定，在尼尔温度以下表现出非单调温度依赖性。

articles.title: Industrial RPCVD growth of high-purity 28Si epilayers with 29Si content below 30 ppm for high-fidelity electron spin qubits
articles.title_zh: 高保真电子自旋量子位的 29Si 含量低于 30 ppm 的高纯度 28Si 外延层的工业 RPCVD 生长
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.11405v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Silicon quantum-dot spin qubits are among the most promising routes to large-scale quantum computation, but the residual 29Si nuclear spins in natural silicon impose a hyperfine dephasing limit that must be overcome by isotopic purification. Here, we report the epitaxial growth of high-purity 28Si on float-zone silicon using an industrial reduced-pressure chemical vapor deposition (RPCVD) system. Secondary-ion mass spectrometry (SIMS) confirms an 28Si isotopic purity of 99.997%, with the 29Si concentration below 30 ppm. Through a systematic vacuum annealing matrix (850-1150 C), combined with atomic force microscopy and SIMS, we investigate the defect-mediated decomposition of the native oxide and the injection of non-equilibrium vacancies. We identify a thermal-budget window below 950 C within which the thin-layer structure of 28Si remains intact. At 1.5 K, magnetotransport measurements reveal a peak Hall mobility of 12,858 cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹ and a quantum scattering lifetime of 0.659 ps, corresponding to a single-particle level broadening of 499 micro-eV. A double quantum dot fabricated on this platform exhibits a T2* of 0.62 us, a Hahn-echo coherence time of 28.8 us, and single-qubit gate fidelities of up to 99.9% measured by randomized benchmarking. Our results establish industrial RPCVD as a promising route toward high-coherence, high-fidelity silicon spin qubits.
articles.abstract_zh: 硅量子点自旋量子位是大规模量子计算最有前途的途径之一，但天然硅中残留的 29Si 核自旋施加了超精细相移限制，必须通过同位素纯化来克服。在这里，我们报告了使用工业减压化学气相沉积 (RPCVD) 系统在浮法硅上外延生长高纯度 28Si。二次离子质谱 (SIMS) 证实 28Si 同位素纯度为 99.997%，29Si 浓度低于 30 ppm。通过系统的真空退火矩阵（850-1150 C），结合原子力显微镜和 SIMS，我们研究了缺陷介导的原生氧化物分解和非平衡空位的注入。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 硅量子点自旋量子位是大规模量子计算最有前途的途径之一，但天然硅中残留的 29Si 核自旋施加了超精细相移限制，必须通过同位素纯化来克服。在这里，我们报告了使用工业减压化学气相沉积 (RPCVD) 系统在浮法硅上外延生长高纯度 28Si。二次离子质谱 (SIMS) 证实 28Si 同位素纯度为 99.997%，29Si 浓度低于 30 ppm。通过系统的真空退火矩阵（850-1150 C），结合原子力显微镜和 SIMS，我们研究了缺陷介导的原生氧化物分解和非平衡空位的注入。我们确定了低于 950 C 的热预算窗口，在此窗口内 28Si 的薄层结构保持完整。在 1.5 K 时，磁传输测量显示峰值霍尔迁移率为 12,858 cm2 V⁻1 s⁻1 和量子散射寿命为 0.659 ps，对应于 499 微 eV 的单粒子能级展宽。在此平台上制造的双量子点的 T2* 为 0.62 us，哈恩回波相干时间为 28.8 us，通过随机基准测试测得的单量子位门保真度高达 99.9%。我们的研究结果表明，工业 RPCVD 是实现高相干、高保真硅自旋量子位的一条有前途的途径。

articles.title: Orbital texture of valence band and interband transitions of the type-II multiferroic van der Waals NiI₂
articles.title_zh: II 型多铁范德华 NiI2 的价带和带间跃迁的轨道结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.11425v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: NiI₂ is a van der Waals semiconductor characterized by complex electronic and magnetic phases, holding promise towards functional applications. For this purpose, a detailed understanding of its band structure and its excitations is essential to elucidate the electronic and transport properties. We present a comprehensive description of the band structure and of the lowest valence-to-conduction band transition in bulk NiI₂, by means of time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy supported by first-principles calculations. We describe the orbital character of Ni and I manifolds, and identify the main momentum-resolved features of the valence band and the shallow minima of the conduction band. With this study, we provide a foundational understanding of the electronic structure of NiI₂ and its single-particle interband electronic excitation, a benchmark for theoretical models, and a framework for future investigations on this material.
articles.abstract_zh: NiI2 是一种范德华半导体，具有复杂的电子相和磁相，有望实现功能应用。为此，详细了解其能带结构及其激发对于阐明电子和传输特性至关重要。我们通过第一性原理计算支持的时间和角度分辨光电子能谱，对块状 NiI2 中的能带结构和最低价态到导带的跃迁进行了全面的描述。我们描述了 Ni 和 I 流形的轨道特征，并确定了价带和导带浅极小值的主要动量分辨特征。
articles.abstract_zh_full: NiI2 是一种范德华半导体，具有复杂的电子相和磁相，有望实现功能应用。为此，详细了解其能带结构及其激发对于阐明电子和传输特性至关重要。我们通过第一性原理计算支持的时间和角度分辨光电子能谱，对块状 NiI2 中的能带结构和最低价态到导带的跃迁进行了全面的描述。我们描述了 Ni 和 I 流形的轨道特征，并确定了价带和导带浅极小值的主要动量分辨特征。通过这项研究，我们对 NiI2 的电子结构及其单粒子带间电子激发有了基本的了解，为理论模型奠定了基准，并为该材料的未来研究提供了框架。

articles.title: Giant gas permeance through a nanoporous crystalline 2D polymer
articles.title_zh: 纳米多孔结晶二维聚合物的巨大气体渗透性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.11518v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chemical separation processes represent one of the largest contributors to industrial energy consumption, underscoring the need for the most efficient separation strategies. Many separation processes rely on selective transport through porous media. In this context, two-dimensional (2D) materials offer a promising route to atomically precise porosity beyond the reach of traditional top-down fabrication, with the potential to enhance separation performance by increasing flow. Here we report measurements of gas transport through a one-molecule-thick layer of suspended, nanoporous poly(carboxyfantrip), a 2D polymer that has identical, nanometer-sized pores that cover nearly a quarter of the surface. This combination of ultimate thinness with high areal pore density gives normalized gas flows (permeances) that approach the effusion limit, three to four orders of magnitude above gas-sieving graphene membranes. We find that gases spanning nearly two orders of magnitude in molecular weight (H₂, He, N₂, CO₂, and SF₆) obey Graham's law and approach the ideal limit of non-interacting ballistic transport, despite strong, species-dependent gas-pore interactions. Simulations reproduce the measured permeances within experimental uncertainty and provide an atomistic picture of the transport process. This work demonstrates the potential of synthetic crystalline 2D polymers for chemical separation, water filtration, and quantum sensing.
articles.abstract_zh: 化学分离过程是工业能源消耗的最大贡献者之一，这凸显了对最有效分离策略的需求。许多分离过程依赖于通过多孔介质的选择性传输。在这种情况下，二维（2D）材料提供了一条有前途的途径，以达到原子级精确的孔隙率，超出了传统自上而下制造的范围，并有可能通过增加流量来增强分离性能。在这里，我们报告了通过单分子厚的悬浮纳米多孔聚（羧基凡特里普）层的气体传输测量，这是一种二维聚合物，具有相同的纳米尺寸孔，覆盖了近四分之一的表面。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 化学分离过程是工业能源消耗的最大贡献者之一，这凸显了对最有效分离策略的需求。许多分离过程依赖于通过多孔介质的选择性传输。在这种情况下，二维（2D）材料提供了一条有前途的途径，以达到原子级精确的孔隙率，超出了传统自上而下制造的范围，并有可能通过增加流量来增强分离性能。在这里，我们报告了通过单分子厚的悬浮纳米多孔聚（羧基凡特里普）层的气体传输测量，这是一种二维聚合物，具有相同的纳米尺寸孔，覆盖了近四分之一的表面。极限薄度与高面积孔隙密度的结合使标准化气体流量（渗透率）接近流出极限，比气体筛分石墨烯膜高出三到四个数量级。我们发现，分子量跨越近两个数量级的气体（H2、He、N2、CO2 和 SF6）遵守格雷厄姆定律，并且接近非相互作用弹道输运的理想极限，尽管存在强烈的、依赖于物种的气体-孔隙相互作用。模拟在实验不确定性范围内再现了测量的渗透性，并提供了传输过程的原子图。这项工作展示了合成结晶二维聚合物在化学分离、水过滤和量子传感方面的潜力。

articles.title: Overcoming speed-accuracy trade-offs with medium-sized interatomic potentials
articles.title_zh: 克服中等原子间势的速度与精度的权衡
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.11544v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Current machine-learned interatomic potentials offer a choice between small, fast models and large, expressive networks. This study demonstrates how an intermediate potential can approach the limit of transferable accuracy at the cost of the cheapest existing formalisms. Specifically, we model He-bearing W-Ta-Hf-Cr-V-Ti alloys with an atomic cluster expansion that learns the radial components of each polynomial as independent linear transforms and embeds numerous densities with learned exponents. While (near-)training loss appears largely a function of model size, the error on a distinct validation set is close to that of leading potentials with ten times more parameters. Taking advantage of the new structure, we develop optimized implementations that run more than an order of magnitude faster than the larger models and many times faster than smaller models with equivalent polynomials. The potential is trained on systematically enumerated small structures but generalizes to point and planar defects and can be extended to even more complex chemistries. As a demonstration, we simulate radiation-damage cascades in billion-atom systems for hundreds of thousands of timesteps.
articles.abstract_zh: 当前的机器学习原子间势提供了小型、快速模型和大型、富有表现力的网络之间的选择。这项研究展示了中间势如何以最便宜的现有形式主义为代价接近可转移精度的极限。具体来说，我们使用原子团簇展开对含氦 W-Ta-Hf-Cr-V-Ti 合金进行建模，该原子团簇展开将每个多项式的径向分量学习为独立的线性变换，并使用学习的指数嵌入大量密度。虽然（接近）训练损失很大程度上取决于模型大小，但不同验证集上的误差接近于参数多十倍的领先潜力的误差。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 当前的机器学习原子间势提供了小型、快速模型和大型、富有表现力的网络之间的选择。这项研究展示了中间势如何以最便宜的现有形式主义为代价接近可转移精度的极限。具体来说，我们使用原子团簇展开对含氦 W-Ta-Hf-Cr-V-Ti 合金进行建模，该原子团簇展开将每个多项式的径向分量学习为独立的线性变换，并使用学习的指数嵌入大量密度。虽然（接近）训练损失很大程度上取决于模型大小，但不同验证集上的误差接近于参数多十倍的领先潜力的误差。利用新结构，我们开发了优化的实现，其运行速度比较大模型快一个数量级以上，比具有等效多项式的较小模型快许多倍。这种潜力是针对系统枚举的小型结构进行训练的，但可以推广到点和平面缺陷，并且可以扩展到更复杂的化学物质。作为演示，我们模拟了十亿个原子系统中数十万个时间步长的辐射损伤级联。

articles.title: Ballistic transport through 3D flat bands in rhombohedral graphene in an in-plane magnetic field
articles.title_zh: 面内磁场中菱面体石墨烯中 3D 平带的弹道传输
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.11603v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We explore how an in-plane magnetic field reshapes the transmitting channels of a finite slab of rhombohedral multilayer graphene and redistributes the current across its thickness. The two-terminal conductance counts these channels, while the voltage at each surface reflects the relative spectral weights of right- and left-moving states on the contacted layer. In sufficiently thick slabs or at sufficiently strong fields, the nearly flat bulk zeroth Landau level gives rise to a three-dimensional Hall effect with a plateau in the four-terminal Hall resistance.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们探索面内磁场如何重塑菱形多层石墨烯有限板的传输通道，并在其厚度上重新分布电流。两端电导对这些通道进行计数，而每个表面的电压反映了接触层上左右移动状态的相对光谱权重。在足够厚的平板或足够强的场中，几乎平坦的零朗道能级会产生三维霍尔效应，并在四端霍尔电阻中出现平台。
