articles.abstract_zh: 机械信号的动态处理对于软机器人和机械传感至关重要，但经典的粘弹性材料缺乏固有的可调性和定量设计规则。我们表明，内部双稳态提供了一种简单而强大的机制来定制机械（元）材料中的响应和信号衰减。在我们的模型中，双稳态元件以固有时间尺度在不同于势能、平衡长度Δ l和弹簧常数Δ k的状态之间离散地切换。我们将布朗动力学模拟与速率为ν的离散泊松切换和宏观应变弛豫的非线性连续体（场）理论相结合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 机械信号的动态处理对于软机器人和机械传感至关重要，但经典的粘弹性材料缺乏固有的可调性和定量设计规则。我们表明，内部双稳态提供了一种简单而强大的机制来定制机械（元）材料中的响应和信号衰减。在我们的模型中，双稳态元件以固有时间尺度在不同于势能、平衡长度Δ l和弹簧常数Δ k的状态之间离散地切换。我们将布朗动力学模拟与速率为ν的离散泊松切换和宏观应变弛豫的非线性连续体（场）理论相结合。该模型为线性响应和空间穿透深度提供了闭式解，揭示了两种互补的现象：当驱动频率超过内部松弛速率时，强烈降低信号穿透的通用筛选机制（类似于静电“皮肤效应” ） ，以及由时间尺度分离引起的频率不敏感响应平台。由筛选长度表示的衰减强度主要由构象长度变化Δ l控制，而衰减状态和平台位置可通过ν进行调整。一项参数研究揭示了一个基本的设计权衡：较大的Δ l加强了耗散，但也提高了状态转换的弹性能量屏障，最终导致阻尼消失的状态锁定。因此，最佳衰减来自显着的双稳态和可逾越的障碍之间的妥协。由于其分析易处理性和通用配方，我们的框架产生了适用于从生物聚合物到合成捕获键和超材料的系统的明确设计规则，使具有频率选择性机械响应的软材料的设计成为可能。

articles.title: Quantum-classical crossover in finite spin-1/2 rings with Dzyaloshinsky-Moriya interaction
articles.title_zh: 带有Dzyaloshinsky-Moriya相互作用的有限自旋-1/2环中的量子经典交叉
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.13572v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study finite spin-tfrac12 rings with nearest-neighbor Heisenberg exchange, Dzyaloshinsky-Moriya interaction, and an external magnetic field. We introduce a phenomenological interpolation parameter between the fully quantum Hamiltonian and a state-dependent mean-field description. Using dissipative Gisin-Schrödinger dynamics, we analyze the resulting quantum-classical crossover through local magnetization, connected spin correlations, single-site entropy, and the saturation field of the fully polarized state.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了具有最近邻Heisenberg交换、Dzyaloshinsky-Moriya相互作用和外部磁场的有限自旋tfrac12环。我们在完全量子汉密尔顿和状态相关平均场描述之间引入了一个现象学插值参数。使用耗散Gisin-Schrödinger动力学，我们通过局部磁化、连通自旋相关、单位熵和完全极化状态的饱和场来分析所得到的量子经典交叉。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了具有最近邻Heisenberg交换、Dzyaloshinsky-Moriya相互作用和外部磁场的有限自旋tfrac12环。我们在完全量子汉密尔顿和状态相关平均场描述之间引入了一个现象学插值参数。使用耗散Gisin-Schrödinger动力学，我们通过局部磁化、连通自旋相关、单位熵和完全极化状态的饱和场来分析所得到的量子经典交叉。

articles.title: Stoner transitions beyond mean-field in two-dimensional electronic systems: a diagrammatic Monte Carlo study
articles.title_zh: 二维电子系统中斯通纳超越均值场的转变：蒙特卡洛示意性研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.13675v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Stoner instabilities for fermions with repulsive interaction have been well studied within the mean-field (ladder) approximation. In this study, we consider two-dimensional electronic systems with one or two valleys and discuss a Stoner transition beyond the ladder approximation. At weak coupling, the corrections to the ladder approximation come predominantly from the renormalization of the particle-hole vertex in the particle-particle channel, and the lowest-order corrections are logarithmically singular in the low-density limit. To investigate the problem beyond the lowest order, we apply the diagrammatic Monte Carlo algorithm and treat ladder and non-ladder renormalizations on equal footing. We find that in a one-valley system, a Stoner transition to a ferromagnetism occurs at low density only if there is a cutoff on the momentum transfer carried by the interaction. In a two-valley system, the restriction is less severe. Here we find either a direct Stoner transition into a spin- and valley-polarized state, or a set of two Stoner transitions via an intermediate valley-polarized state. The pathway is controlled by the anisotropy of the fermionic dispersion.
articles.abstract_zh: 具有排斥相互作用的费米子的斯通纳不稳定性已经在平均场（阶梯）近似中得到了很好的研究。在本研究中，我们考虑了具有一个或两个山谷的二维电子系统，并讨论了超越阶梯近似的斯通纳跃迁。在弱耦合时，对阶梯近似的修正主要来自粒子-粒子通道中粒子-孔顶点的重新归一化，最低阶修正在低密度极限中是对数奇异的。为了研究超出最低阶的问题，我们应用示意性蒙特卡罗算法，并在平等的基础上处理梯形图和非梯形图重整。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 具有排斥相互作用的费米子的斯通纳不稳定性已经在平均场（阶梯）近似中得到了很好的研究。在本研究中，我们考虑了具有一个或两个山谷的二维电子系统，并讨论了超越阶梯近似的斯通纳跃迁。在弱耦合时，对阶梯近似的修正主要来自粒子-粒子通道中粒子-孔顶点的重新归一化，最低阶修正在低密度极限中是对数奇异的。为了研究超出最低阶的问题，我们应用示意性蒙特卡罗算法，并在平等的基础上处理梯形图和非梯形图重整。我们发现，在一个单谷系统中，只有当相互作用携带的动量转移存在截止点时，斯通纳转变为铁磁性才会在低密度下发生。在双谷系统中，限制不太严重。在这里，我们可以找到斯通纳直接转变为自旋和谷极化状态，或者通过中间谷极化状态的一组两个斯通纳转变。该途径由费米子分散体的各向异性控制。

articles.title: Exact quantum geometry from sublattice symmetry: Closed-form solution of the quarter-flux Harper-Hofstadter model
articles.title_zh: 亚晶格对称的精确量子几何：四分之一通量Harper-Hofstadter模型的闭式解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26099v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum geometry has emerged as a guiding principle across atomic and condensed-matter physics, shaping the topological responses of Bloch bands and the stability of the correlated phases they host. Sublattice symmetry, though common among bipartite lattice models, has not yet been exploited to obtain closed-form quantum geometry in multiband systems. For this purpose, we derive a general expression for the QGT of sublattice-symmetric systems in terms of contributions from the individual sublattice sectors, and show that this symmetry renders the Bloch Hamiltonian of a paradigmatic four-band model, the quarter-flux Harper-Hofstadter model, anti-block-diagonal, analytically yielding the spectrum, eigenstates, and full quantum geometric tensor (QGT), including the Berry curvature and quantum metric, for all four bands. The model, describing charged particles on a two-dimensional square lattice subjected to a uniform magnetic field, has recently been realized experimentally with ultracold atoms, photons, and superconducting circuits. Finally, we evaluate fractional-Chern-insulator stability criteria analytically and quantify the lowest band of the quarter-flux Harper-Hofstadter model to be a nearly ideal Chern band. Our approach opens a route for studying also the quantum geometry of other sublattice-symmetric multiband systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子几何已经成为原子和凝聚态物理学的指导原则，塑造了布洛赫波段的拓扑响应以及它们所承载的相关相位的稳定性。亚晶格对称性虽然在二部晶格模型中很常见，但尚未被利用来获得多频带系统中的闭式量子几何。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子几何已经成为原子和凝聚态物理学的指导原则，塑造了布洛赫波段的拓扑响应以及它们所承载的相关相位的稳定性。亚晶格对称性虽然在二部晶格模型中很常见，但尚未被利用来获得多频带系统中的闭式量子几何。为此，我们从单个亚晶格扇区的贡献方面推导了亚晶格对称系统QGT的一般表达式，并表明这种对称性渲染了范式四波段模型的Bloch Hamiltonian ，四分之一通量Harper-Hofstadter模型，反块对角线，解析地产生了所有四个波段的谱，本征态和全量子几何张量（ QGT ） ，包括Berry曲率和量子度量。该模型描述了经受均匀磁场的二维正方形晶格上的带电粒子，最近已通过超冷原子、光子和超导电路进行了实验实现。最后，我们分析评估了分数-车臣绝缘子稳定性标准，并将四分之一通量Harper-Hofstadter模型的最低频带量化为接近理想的车臣频带。我们的方法也为研究其他亚晶格对称多频带系统的量子几何学开辟了道路。

articles.title: Liquid-liquid phase transitions in dipolar liquids. Insights into Supercooled Water
articles.title_zh: 双极性液体中的液-液相转变。对过冷水的见解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02666v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Dipolar liquids combine two coupled degrees of freedom, translational and dipolar. Intriguingly, these two sectors can reside in distinct thermodynamic states, with the state of one sector possibly favouring a specific state of the other. The onset of ferroelectric order in dipolar liquids is an example of this mutual stabilization. Since this coupling is often encoded in interaction potentials, projecting out one sector to derive an effective interaction for the other can uncover the microscopic mechanism underlying this phenomenon. A coarse-grained theory, solved in the large-dimensional limit, in which the distance between nearest-neighbour particles depends on their dipolar interaction through a density-dependent mechanical compliance shows that a ferroelectric transition can trigger a liquid-liquid transition. It also predicts a first-order liquid-liquid transition within the paraelectric phase that, in turn, can promote ferroelectric ordering. The anisotropic dipolar-dependent soft-core interaction is shown to lead to an effective Jagla-like isotropic two-length-scale interaction, known to support liquid-liquid phase transitions. Here, however, the two-length-scale pattern depends on density and dipolar configuration, and is therefore sensitive to dipolar order. Analysis of supercooled TIP4P/Ice water molecular dynamics simulations shows that first-coordination-shell features of the pair correlation functions are sensitive to dipolar interaction, supporting the foundations of the coarse-grained theory. Comparison of low- and high-density liquid water reveals enhanced spatial anisotropy of the first coordination shell in the low-density liquid, associated, within the theory, with increased effective excluded volume, showing that the liquid-liquid transition involves structural changes within the first shell, beyond reorganization of the interstitial region and tetrahedral order.
articles.abstract_zh: 双极性液体结合了两个耦合的自由度，平移和双极性。有趣的是，这两个部门可以处于不同的热力学状态，其中一个部门的状态可能有利于另一个部门的特定状态。双极液体中铁电有序的发生是这种相互稳定的一个例子。由于这种耦合通常编码在相互作用电位中，因此投射出一个扇区以获得另一个扇区的有效相互作用可以揭示这种现象背后的微观机制。在大维极限中求解的粗粒度理论，其中最近邻粒子之间的距离取决于它们通过密度依赖性机械顺应性的偶极相互作用，这表明铁电跃迁可以触发液-液跃迁。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 双极性液体结合了两个耦合的自由度，平移和双极性。有趣的是，这两个部门可以处于不同的热力学状态，其中一个部门的状态可能有利于另一个部门的特定状态。双极液体中铁电有序的发生是这种相互稳定的一个例子。由于这种耦合通常编码在相互作用电位中，因此投射出一个扇区以获得另一个扇区的有效相互作用可以揭示这种现象背后的微观机制。在大维极限中求解的粗粒度理论，其中最近邻粒子之间的距离取决于它们通过密度依赖性机械顺应性的偶极相互作用，这表明铁电跃迁可以触发液-液跃迁。它还预测了准电相内的一阶液-液转变，这反过来又可以促进铁电有序化。各向异性双极依赖性软核相互作用显示出导致有效的Jagla样各向同性双长度尺度相互作用，已知支持液-液相变。然而，在这里，双长度图案取决于密度和偶极子配置，因此对偶极子顺序敏感。过冷TIP4P/冰水分子动力学模拟分析表明，对相关函数的一坐标-壳特征对偶极相互作用敏感，支持粗粒度理论的基础。低密度液态水和高密度液态水的比较揭示了低密度液体中第一配位壳的空间各向异性增强，在理论上与增加的有效排除体积相关联，表明液-液转变涉及第一壳内的结构变化，超出了间隙区域和四面体秩序的重组。

articles.title: Unraveling hidden Raman modes in α-MnTe: Effects of long-range dipole-dipole interactions on phonon bands
articles.title_zh: 揭开α-MnTe中隐藏的拉曼模式：远距离偶极子-偶极子相互作用对声子带的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.08221v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this study, we address the seemingly open question of disparity between the experimentally and theoretically observed Raman spectra for the altermagnetic α-MnTe. We establish that the consideration of long range (LR) dipole-dipole interaction is crucial to accurately estimate the phonon band structure and thereby capturing each of the experimentally observed Raman signatures. The LR correction brings about substantial changes to the high-frequency optical modes and their group-theoretical representations. Specifically, for the highly debated Raman peak around 175 cm⁻¹, alongside the Raman silent B₁ᵤ mode, the LR corrections introduce Raman-active longitudinal optical Aprⁱme and A₁, and transverse optical A₁ modes. Overall, the calculated Raman spectra suggest that the intensity of these modes is weak in the pristine system, while certain prescribed distortions can increase their intensity. The Raman peak around 140 cm⁻¹, as observed experimentally, is identified to be emerging from a higher-order Raman process due to zone off-center contributions, while the other debated 120 cm⁻¹ peak has both the zone center and off-center contributions.
articles.abstract_zh: 在这项研究中，我们解决了altermagnetic α-MnTe在实验和理论上观察到的拉曼光谱之间的差异这一看似悬而未决的问题。我们确定，考虑远程（ LR ）偶极子-偶极子相互作用对于准确估计声子带结构从而捕获每个实验观察到的拉曼特征至关重要。LR校正给高频光学模式及其群理论表示带来了实质性变化。具体来说，对于175厘米左右备受争议的拉曼峰，除了拉曼静音模式B ， LR校正引入了拉曼活性纵向光学Aprme和A ，以及横向光学A模式。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这项研究中，我们解决了altermagnetic α-MnTe在实验和理论上观察到的拉曼光谱之间的差异这一看似悬而未决的问题。我们确定，考虑远程（ LR ）偶极子-偶极子相互作用对于准确估计声子带结构从而捕获每个实验观察到的拉曼特征至关重要。LR校正给高频光学模式及其群理论表示带来了实质性变化。具体来说，对于175厘米左右备受争议的拉曼峰，除了拉曼静音模式B ， LR校正引入了拉曼活性纵向光学Aprme和A ，以及横向光学A模式。总体而言，计算的拉曼光谱表明，这些模式的强度在原始系统中较弱，而某些规定的扭曲会增加其强度。实验观察到，由于区域偏离中心的贡献，拉曼峰值约为140厘米，被确定为从高阶拉曼过程中出现，而另一个有争议的120厘米峰值同时具有区域中心和偏离中心的贡献。

articles.title: Controlled spin-torque driven domain wall motion using staggered magnetic nanowires
articles.title_zh: 使用交错磁性纳米线的受控自旋扭矩驱动畴壁运动
articles.abstract: arXiv:1908.09304v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The growing demand for storage, due to big data applications, cannot be met by hard disk drives. Domain wall (DW) memory devices such as racetrack memory offer an alternative route to achieve high capacity storage. In DW memory, control of domain wall positions and their motion using spin-transfer torque are important challenges. In this paper, we demonstrate controlled domain wall motion using spin-transfer torque in staggered magnetic nanowires. The devices, fabricated using electron-beam lithography, were tested using a magneto-optical Kerr microscopy and electrical transport measurements. The depinning current, pinning potential and thermal stability were found to depend on the device dimensions of the staggering nanowires. Thus, the proposed staggering configuration helps to fine-tune the properties of domain wall devices for memory applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 硬盘驱动器无法满足大数据应用带来的日益增长的存储需求。赛道存储器等域壁（ DW ）存储器设备提供了实现高容量存储的替代途径。在DW存储器中，使用自旋转移扭矩控制畴壁位置及其运动是重要的挑战。在本文中，我们演示了使用自旋转移扭矩在交错磁性纳米线中的受控畴壁运动。使用电子束光刻制造的器件使用磁光克尔显微镜和电传输测量进行了测试。发现衰减电流、钉扎电位和热稳定性取决于惊人的纳米线的器件尺寸。因此，所提出的交错配置有助于微调用于内存应用的域壁设备的属性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 硬盘驱动器无法满足大数据应用带来的日益增长的存储需求。赛道存储器等域壁（ DW ）存储器设备提供了实现高容量存储的替代途径。在DW存储器中，使用自旋转移扭矩控制畴壁位置及其运动是重要的挑战。在本文中，我们演示了使用自旋转移扭矩在交错磁性纳米线中的受控畴壁运动。使用电子束光刻制造的器件使用磁光克尔显微镜和电传输测量进行了测试。发现衰减电流、钉扎电位和热稳定性取决于惊人的纳米线的器件尺寸。因此，所提出的交错配置有助于微调用于内存应用的域壁设备的属性。

articles.title: Universal Hamiltonian learning with rotational and basis equivariance
articles.title_zh: 具有旋转和基方差的通用哈密顿学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2401.17015v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Deep learning has the potential to transform computational materials research by making electronic-structure calculations more efficient and scalable. The Hamiltonian matrix in the localized atomic-orbital basis is a promising target for deep-learning electronic structure, yet enforcing rotational equivariance can be computationally costly, and the matrix depends on the choice of basis set. Here we introduce DeepH-2, a physics-guided neural-network framework that reduces the computational cost of enforcing rotational equivariance through a local-coordinate formulation and incorporates basis equivariance by mapping a shared latent Hamiltonian to the target atomic-orbital basis. DeepH-2 achieves sub-meV test-set error on a diverse materials dataset and demonstrates transferability across material dimensions. These results highlight the value of encoding physics priors into deep-learning electronic structure models, and pave the way for developing the electronic-structure foundation models.
articles.abstract_zh: 深度学习有可能通过提高电子结构计算的效率和可扩展性来改变计算材料的研究。局部原子轨道基中的哈密顿矩阵是深度学习电子结构的一个有希望的目标，但实施旋转等方差可能在计算上花费很大，并且矩阵取决于基集的选择。在这里，我们引入了DeepH-2 ，这是一个物理引导的神经网络框架，通过局部坐标公式降低了执行旋转等方差的计算成本，并通过将共享的潜在哈密顿函数映射到目标原子轨道基，结合了基方差。DeepH-2在不同的材料数据集上实现了亚meV测试集误差，并展示了跨材料尺寸的可转移性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 深度学习有可能通过提高电子结构计算的效率和可扩展性来改变计算材料的研究。局部原子轨道基中的哈密顿矩阵是深度学习电子结构的一个有希望的目标，但实施旋转等方差可能在计算上花费很大，并且矩阵取决于基集的选择。在这里，我们引入了DeepH-2 ，这是一个物理引导的神经网络框架，通过局部坐标公式降低了执行旋转等方差的计算成本，并通过将共享的潜在哈密顿函数映射到目标原子轨道基，结合了基方差。DeepH-2在不同的材料数据集上实现了亚meV测试集误差，并展示了跨材料尺寸的可转移性。这些结果凸显了将物理先验编码到深度学习电子结构模型中的价值，为开发电子结构基础模型铺平了道路。

articles.title: Learning State Preparation Circuits for Quantum Phases of Matter
articles.title_zh: 物质量子相的学习状态准备电路
articles.abstract: arXiv:2410.23544v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Many-body ground state preparation is an important subroutine used in the simulation of physical systems. In this paper, we introduce a flexible and efficient framework for obtaining a state preparation circuit for a large class of many-body ground states. We introduce polynomial-time classical algorithms that take reduced density matrices over O(1)-sized balls as inputs, and output a circuit that prepares the global state. We introduce algorithms applicable to (i) short-range entangled states (e.g., states prepared by shallow quantum circuits in any number of dimensions, and more generally, invertible states) and (ii) long-range entangled ground states (e.g., the toric code on a disk). Both algorithms can provably find a circuit whose depth is asymptotically optimal. Our approach uses a variant of the quantum Markov chain condition that remains robust against constant-depth circuits. The robustness of this condition makes our method applicable to a large class of states, whilst ensuring a classically tractable optimization landscape.
articles.abstract_zh: 多体基态准备是物理系统仿真中使用的重要子程序。在本文中，我们引入了一个灵活有效的框架，用于获得一大类多体基态的状态准备电路。我们引入了多项式时间经典算法，该算法以O （ 1 ）大小的球上的减小密度矩阵作为输入，并输出准备全局状态的电路。我们介绍了适用于（ i ）短程纠缠态（例如，由浅量子电路在任何维度上准备的状态，更一般地说，可逆状态）和（ ii ）长程纠缠基态（例如，磁盘上的环面代码）的算法。这两种算法都可以证明找到深度渐近最优的电路。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多体基态准备是物理系统仿真中使用的重要子程序。在本文中，我们引入了一个灵活有效的框架，用于获得一大类多体基态的状态准备电路。我们引入了多项式时间经典算法，该算法以O （ 1 ）大小的球上的减小密度矩阵作为输入，并输出准备全局状态的电路。我们介绍了适用于（ i ）短程纠缠态（例如，由浅量子电路在任何维度上准备的状态，更一般地说，可逆状态）和（ ii ）长程纠缠基态（例如，磁盘上的环面代码）的算法。这两种算法都可以证明找到深度渐近最优的电路。我们的方法使用量子马尔可夫链条件的变体，该条件对恒定深度电路保持鲁棒性。这种条件的鲁棒性使我们的方法适用于大量的状态，同时确保了经典的可处理的优化景观。

articles.title: A Machine Learning study of the two-dimensional antiferromagnetic Q-state Potts model on the square lattice
articles.title_zh: 方格上二维反铁磁Q状态Potts模型的机器学习研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.06762v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The critical phenomena of 2D antiferromagnetic Q-state Potts model on the square lattice with Q=2,3,4,5 and 6 are investigated using supervised neural networks (NN). Conventional supervised and unsupervised NNs either fail or have difficulty in identifying the correct critical behaviors of these models. Remarkably, despite the fact that the NNs employed here are trained with a particular fixed type training set which contains no information about the considered models (except for Q=2), they correctly compute the critical temperatures for the studied physical systems. Particularly, the NN outcomes suggest convincingly that the Q=3 model is critical only at zero temperature and Q=4,5,6 models remain disordered at all temperatures. Apart from the studied models, our NNs trained with exactly the same training set have successfully determined the critical temperature(s) and the nature of the associated phase transition(s) of another physical system differing dramatically from those considered here. Therefore, our NN has the potential to be a universally applicable NN model in studying phase transitions.
articles.abstract_zh: 利用监督神经网络（NN）研究了 Q=2、3、4、5 和 6 方格上二维反铁磁 Q 态 Potts 模型的临界现象。传统的监督和无监督神经网络要么失败，要么难以识别这些模型的正确关键行为。值得注意的是，尽管这里使用的神经网络是用特定的固定类型训练集进行训练的，该训练集不包含有关所考虑模型的信息（Q = 2 除外），但它们正确地计算了所研究的物理系统的临界温度。特别是，NN 结果令人信服地表明，Q=3 模型仅在零温度下至关重要，而 Q=4,5,6 模型在所有温度下都保持无序。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 利用监督神经网络（NN）研究了 Q=2、3、4、5 和 6 方格上二维反铁磁 Q 态 Potts 模型的临界现象。传统的监督和无监督神经网络要么失败，要么难以识别这些模型的正确关键行为。值得注意的是，尽管这里使用的神经网络是用特定的固定类型训练集进行训练的，该训练集不包含有关所考虑模型的信息（Q = 2 除外），但它们正确地计算了所研究的物理系统的临界温度。特别是，NN 结果令人信服地表明，Q=3 模型仅在零温度下至关重要，而 Q=4,5,6 模型在所有温度下都保持无序。除了研究的模型之外，我们使用完全相同的训练集训练的神经网络已成功确定了另一个物理系统的临界温度和相关相变的性质，该系统与此处考虑的系统显着不同。因此，我们的神经网络有潜力成为研究相变的普遍适用的神经网络模型。

articles.title: AutoREC: A reinforcement learning platform for equivalent circuit model generation
articles.title_zh: AutoREC：用于生成等效电路模型的强化学习平台
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.27266v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: This paper introduces AutoREC, an open-source Python platform for developing, training and evaluating reinforcement learning (RL) agents that automatically generate equivalent circuit models (ECMs) from electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) data. Although ECMs are widely used to interpret EIS measurements, their identification typically relies on manual trial-and-error, requiring domain expertise and limiting scalability, particularly in autonomous experimental pipelines such as self-driving laboratories. In AutoREC, ECM generation is formulated as a Markov decision process in which an RL agent sequentially modifies a circuit topology based on the current state, available actions and feedback from the resulting model. The platform supports an end-to-end workflow encompassing EIS preprocessing with selectable impedance representations, agent setup and training, ECM generation for new measurements and visualization-based evaluation and analysis of agent decision-making. AutoREC implements a configurable Double Deep Q-Network agent with prioritized experience replay and a dedicated deadloop mitigation strategy for navigating the complex circuit-generation action space efficiently. To demonstrate the platform, we trained a representative agent on 1350 synthetic spectra from five reference circuit families, evaluated it on 150 held-out synthetic spectra and applied it to 32 previously unseen experimental spectra from battery, corrosion, oxygen evolution reaction and CO2 reduction systems. These case studies illustrate the end-to-end capabilities of AutoREC while revealing challenges associated with experimental complexity and limited training-data coverage. The demonstrated agent serves as a reference implementation; AutoREC provides an extensible foundation through which users can develop and evaluate agents tailored to their specific electrochemical systems and research objectives.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了 AutoREC，这是一个开源 Python 平台，用于开发、训练和评估强化学习 (RL) 代理，这些代理可以根据电化学阻抗谱 (EIS) 数据自动生成等效电路模型 (ECM)。尽管 ECM 广泛用于解释 EIS 测量，但它们的识别通常依赖于手动试错，需要领域专业知识并限制可扩展性，特别是在自动驾驶实验室等自主实验管道中。在 AutoREC 中，ECM 生成被表述为马尔可夫决策过程，其中 RL 代理根据当前状态、可用操作和结果模型的反馈顺序修改电路拓扑。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文介绍了 AutoREC，这是一个开源 Python 平台，用于开发、训练和评估强化学习 (RL) 代理，这些代理可以根据电化学阻抗谱 (EIS) 数据自动生成等效电路模型 (ECM)。尽管 ECM 广泛用于解释 EIS 测量，但它们的识别通常依赖于手动试错，需要领域专业知识并限制可扩展性，特别是在自动驾驶实验室等自主实验管道中。在 AutoREC 中，ECM 生成被表述为马尔可夫决策过程，其中 RL 代理根据当前状态、可用操作和结果模型的反馈顺序修改电路拓扑。该平台支持端到端工作流程，包括具有可选阻抗表示的 EIS 预处理、代理设置和培训、用于新测量的 ECM 生成以及基于可视化的代理决策评估和分析。 AutoREC 实现了可配置的 Double Deep Q-Network 代理，具有优先的经验回放和专用的死循环缓解策略，可有效地导航复杂的电路生成操作空间。为了演示该平台，我们使用来自 5 个参考电路系列的 1350 个合成光谱训练了一个代表性代理，在 150 个保留的合成光谱上对其进行了评估，并将其应用于来自电池、腐蚀、析氧反应和 CO2 还原系统的 32 个以前未见过的实验光谱。这些案例研究说明了 AutoREC 的端到端功能，同时揭示了与实验复杂性和有限的训练数据覆盖范围相关的挑战。演示的代理作为参考实现； AutoREC 提供了一个可扩展的基础，用户可以通过该基础开发和评估适合其特定电化学系统和研究目标的试剂。

articles.title: Electron Coherence and Dephasing by Quasi-Static Coulomb Fluctuations in Classical Ionic Media
articles.title_zh: 经典离子介质中准静态库仑涨落的电子相干性和相移
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.18187v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We develop a microscopic theory of quantum-particle propagation through quasi-static electrostatic fluctuations of a classical one-component plasma. The RPA potential is Gaussian but has an unscreened 1/r correlation tail, which makes the disorder-averaged retarded Green function infrared sensitive. Its eikonal attenuation scale is ellᵣₘ w=k²/G for g=G/k³ll1, with the formal strong-saddle asymptote ellᵣₘ ₛ=(4sqrt[3]2/3)G⁻¹/³ for ggg1. For a slab of thickness d, the retarded--advanced mutual-coherence kernel is infrared finite: the coherence decays algebraically for λ_Dllρll d and saturates at larger transverse separation. Thus equilibrium ionic-density fluctuations constitute a distinct quasi-static dephasing channel with a nonexponential coherence law. A finite coherence radius exists only when the saturation threshold is crossed. Relativistic paraxial reduction gives aᵣₘ ᵣₑₗ=1/(hbar v) and the finite high-energy limit 1/(hbar c). The ionic contribution is very small at conventional TEM energies for a 100,nm water-like layer. Within the quasi-static model it grows for thicker samples and lower-energy electrons, while sub-keV transmission through liquid water is strongly limited by inelastic scattering.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们通过经典单组分等离子体的准静态静电涨落开发了量子粒子传播的微观理论。 RPA 势为高斯分布，但具有未屏蔽的 1/r 相关尾部，这使得无序平均延迟格林函数对红外敏感。对于 g=G/k³ll1，其 ekonal 衰减尺度为 ellᵣₘ w=k²/G，对于 ggg1，其形式强鞍渐近线为 ellᵣₘ ₛ=(4sqrt[3]2/3)G⁻¹/³。对于厚度为 d 的平板，延迟-高级互相干核是红外有限的：相干性对于 λ_Dllρll d 进行代数衰减，并在较大的横向间隔处饱和。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过经典单组分等离子体的准静态静电涨落开发了量子粒子传播的微观理论。 RPA 势为高斯分布，但具有未屏蔽的 1/r 相关尾部，这使得无序平均延迟格林函数对红外敏感。对于 g=G/k³ll1，其 ekonal 衰减尺度为 ellᵣₘ w=k²/G，对于 ggg1，其形式强鞍渐近线为 ellᵣₘ ₛ=(4sqrt[3]2/3)G⁻¹/³。对于厚度为 d 的平板，延迟-高级互相干核是红外有限的：相干性对于 λ_Dllρll d 进行代数衰减，并在较大的横向间隔处饱和。因此，平衡离子密度涨落构成了具有非指数相干律的独特准静态移相通道。仅当超过饱和阈值时才存在有限相干半径。相对论近轴约简给出 aᵣₘ ᵣₑₗ=1/(hbar v) 和有限高能极限 1/(hbar c)。对于 100 nm 的水状层，在传统 TEM 能量下，离子贡献非常小。在准静态模型中，它随着较厚的样品和较低能量的电子而增长，而通过液态水的亚keV传输受到非弹性散射的强烈限制。

articles.title: Reconstruction of Global Groundwater Storage Anomaly from GRACE Satellite Gravimetry Using a Physics-Constrained Decomposition LSTM
articles.title_zh: 使用物理约束分解 LSTM 通过 GRACE 卫星重力测量重建全球地下水储量异常
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08567v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Groundwater is the largest accessible store of freshwater on Earth, yet its depletion has been difficult to quantify globally, because satellite gravimetry senses total water storage rather than groundwater alone, the record is coarse and interrupted, and the models used to isolate groundwater underestimate the largest trends. Here, a continuous and physically bounded record of global groundwater storage change was reconstructed for April 2002 to December 2022 at half-degree resolution. Total water storage from the GRACE and GRACE-FO missions was separated from its land-surface components, and a physics-constrained decomposition network learned the groundwater signal as the sum of a trend, a seasonal cycle, and a residual. The trend of every cell was held within the net moisture that the atmosphere can supply, and the mass balance of each river basin was enforced during training, so the learned field could not violate water availability. The reconstruction reproduced withheld observations with a root mean squared error of 6.97 centimeters and a Nash-Sutcliffe efficiency of 0.69, and against an independent network of monitoring wells it achieved a lower trend error than an independent hydrological model and a data-assimilation product at every aggregation scale tested. Gross groundwater depletion over significantly declining cells was estimated at 358 +/- 12 cubic kilometers per year, while net storage change across all land cells was -36 +/- 18 cubic kilometers per year, equivalent to 0.10 +/- 0.05 millimeters per year of sea-level rise. The associated mass redistribution implies a drift of the Earth's rotational pole of 6.9 centimeters per year toward 68.6 degrees East, within 4.5 degrees of the direction inferred in an earlier study.
articles.abstract_zh: 地下水是地球上最大的可用淡水储存，但其消耗量在全球范围内很难量化，因为卫星重力测量检测的是总水储存量，而不是单独的地下水，记录粗糙且断断续续，而且用于分离地下水的模型低估了最大的趋势。在这里，以半度分辨率重建了 2002 年 4 月至 2022 年 12 月全球地下水储存变化的连续且有物理限制的记录。 GRACE 和 GRACE-FO 任务的总水储存与其地表成分分离，物理约束分解网络将地下水信号学习为趋势、季节周期和残差的总和。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 地下水是地球上最大的可用淡水储存，但其消耗量在全球范围内很难量化，因为卫星重力测量检测的是总水储存量，而不是单独的地下水，记录粗糙且断断续续，而且用于分离地下水的模型低估了最大的趋势。在这里，以半度分辨率重建了 2002 年 4 月至 2022 年 12 月全球地下水储存变化的连续且有物理限制的记录。 GRACE 和 GRACE-FO 任务的总水储存与其地表成分分离，物理约束分解网络将地下水信号学习为趋势、季节周期和残差的总和。每个单元的趋势都保持在大气可以提供的净湿度范围内，并且在训练过程中强制执行每个流域的质量平衡，因此学习场不会违反可用水量。重建再现了保留观测值，均方根误差为 6.97 厘米，Nash-Sutcliffe 效率为 0.69，并且针对独立的监测井网络，它在每个测试的聚合尺度上实现了比独立水文模型和数据同化产品更低的趋势误差。显着下降的单元的地下水消耗总量估计为每年 358 +/- 12 立方公里，而所有陆地单元的净储存变化为每年 -36 +/- 18 立方公里，相当于海平面每年上升 0.10 +/- 0.05 毫米。相关的质量重新分布意味着地球自转极点每年向东经 68.6 度方向漂移 6.9 厘米，与早期研究推断的方向偏差在 4.5 度以内。

articles.title: Differential chiral sensing at exceptional points in intrinsically chiral metastructures
articles.title_zh: 本质手性超结构中特殊点的差分手性传感
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08822v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Discriminating opposite enantiomers through their weak chiroptical responses remains a fundamental challenge in optical sensing. Exceptional points (EPs), non-Hermitian singularities at which eigenvalues and eigenvectors coalesce, offer a route to enhanced spectral responses through their characteristic square-root eigenvalue splitting. However, their potential for chiral discrimination remains largely unexplored. We demonstrate exceptional points in an intrinsically chiral hybrid metamaterial and reveal strongly asymmetric responses to enantiomeric perturbations. The interplay between intrinsic chirality and non-Hermitian degeneracy is realized through the coupling of a chiral plasmonic nanoantenna array to a photonic crystal slab. We observe characteristic complex-square-root scaling, with both resonance frequencies and loss-rates exhibiting pronounced handedness dependence. Remarkably, opposite enantiomers produce complex mode splittings that differ by more than an order of magnitude. Our findings establish intrinsic chirality as a new degree of freedom in non-Hermitian physics and reveal a fundamental route toward topological singularities enhanced discrimination of chiral matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 通过弱手性光学响应区分相反的对映体仍然是光学传感中的基本挑战。异常点 (EP) 是特征值和特征向量合并的非厄米奇点，通过其特征平方根特征值分裂提供了增强光谱响应的途径。然而，它们的手性歧视潜力在很大程度上仍未被探索。我们展示了本质手性混合超材料的特殊点，并揭示了对对映体扰动的强烈不对称响应。固有手性和非厄米简并性之间的相互作用是通过手性等离子体纳米天线阵列与光子晶体板的耦合来实现的。我们观察到特征复数平方根缩放，共振频率和损耗率都表现出明显的旋手依赖性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通过弱手性光学响应区分相反的对映体仍然是光学传感中的基本挑战。异常点 (EP) 是特征值和特征向量合并的非厄米奇点，通过其特征平方根特征值分裂提供了增强光谱响应的途径。然而，它们的手性歧视潜力在很大程度上仍未被探索。我们展示了本质手性混合超材料的特殊点，并揭示了对对映体扰动的强烈不对称响应。固有手性和非厄米简并性之间的相互作用是通过手性等离子体纳米天线阵列与光子晶体板的耦合来实现的。我们观察到特征复数平方根缩放，共振频率和损耗率都表现出明显的旋手依赖性。值得注意的是，相反的对映体产生复杂的模式分裂，其差异超过一个数量级。我们的研究结果将内在手性确立为非厄米物理学的新自由度，并揭示了通向拓扑奇点增强手性物质辨别力的基本途径。

articles.title: Redetermination of the second-order nonlinear optical coefficients of BaMgF4
articles.title_zh: BaMgF4二阶非线性光学系数的重新测定
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09250v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: BaMgF4 (BMF) has the potential to serve as a platform material for vacuum-ultraviolet (VUV) nonlinear optics owing to its ferroelectricity and high UV transparency down to 130 nm. However, the second-order nonlinear optical coefficients reported for BMF span approximately one order of magnitude, hindering a reliable assessment of its potential for nonlinear optical applications. Here, we redetermined these coefficients by combining Maker fringe, wedge, and single-pass second-harmonic-generation measurements at a fundamental wavelength of 1064 nm. Our results establish that all the second-order nonlinear optical coefficients of BMF lie in the range of 0.01-0.04 pm/V. We determined d31 to be 0.035 pm/V, which is among the largest coefficients of BMF, while it has been underestimated relative to the other coefficients in previous studies. Although d31 is not the largest coefficient, the use of its long corresponding coherence length is beneficial for quasi-phase matching, particularly for VUV generation, where the fabrication of lower-order quasi-phase-matching structures is crucial.
articles.abstract_zh: BaMgF4 (BMF) 由于其铁电性和低至 130 nm 的高紫外透明度，有潜力作为真空紫外 (VUV) 非线性光学的平台材料。然而，BMF 报道的二阶非线性光学系数跨度约为一个数量级，阻碍了对其非线性光学应用潜力的可靠评估。在这里，我们通过结合 1064 nm 基波波长下的 Maker 条纹、楔形和单通二次谐波产生测量来重新确定这些系数。我们的结果表明，BMF 的所有二阶非线性光学系数都在 0.01-0.04 pm/V 范围内。
articles.abstract_zh_full: BaMgF4 (BMF) 由于其铁电性和低至 130 nm 的高紫外透明度，有潜力作为真空紫外 (VUV) 非线性光学的平台材料。然而，BMF 报道的二阶非线性光学系数跨度约为一个数量级，阻碍了对其非线性光学应用潜力的可靠评估。在这里，我们通过结合 1064 nm 基波波长下的 Maker 条纹、楔形和单通二次谐波产生测量来重新确定这些系数。我们的结果表明，BMF 的所有二阶非线性光学系数都在 0.01-0.04 pm/V 范围内。我们确定 d31 为 0.035 pm/V，这是 BMF 的最大系数之一，但相对于之前的研究中的其他系数，它被低估了。尽管 d31 不是最大的系数，但使用其较长的相应相干长度有利于准相位匹配，特别是对于 VUV 生成，其中低阶准相位匹配结构的制造至关重要。

articles.title: Role of E-F Coupling on Low-latitude Ingression of Mid-latitude MSTIDs over the Indian Subcontinent
articles.title_zh: E-F耦合对印度次大陆上空中纬度MSTID低纬度侵入的作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09310v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This study provides the first observational evidence that E-F region electrodynamic coupling regulates the southernmost latitudinal extent of nighttime mid-latitude medium-scale traveling ionospheric disturbances (MSTIDs) over the Indian subcontinent. We have analyzed multiple MSTID events using total electron content (TEC) measurements from a dense network of dual-frequency GNSS receivers across India, GNSS radio occultation (RO) profiles, and ionosonde observations from New Delhi during May-July 2025, a high solar activity period. The lowest geographic latitude, at which MSTIDs wavefronts reached, varied between 17degN and 25degN. Their low-latitude extension showed no significant correlation with background TEC, but was positively correlated with the geomagnetically mapped southernmost latitude of sporadic-E (Es) layers identified from GNSS-RO measurements. These events occurred during high solar activity, when F-region MSTID growth is generally suppressed. Therefore, our results suggest that electrodynamic coupling with the underlying Es-layers is essential for sustaining MSTIDs and enabling their low-latitude penetration during solar maxima.
articles.abstract_zh: 这项研究提供了第一个观测证据，证明 E-F 区域电动力耦合调节印度次大陆上空夜间中纬度中尺度移动电离层扰动 (MSTID) 的最南纬度范围。我们使用印度各地双频 GNSS 接收器密集网络的总电子含量 (TEC) 测量值、GNSS 无线电掩星 (RO) 剖面以及 2025 年 5 月至 7 月太阳活动高峰期期间新德里的电离探空仪观测结果分析了多个 MSTID 事件。 MSTID 波前到达的最低地理纬度在 17 度到 25 度之间变化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 这项研究提供了第一个观测证据，证明 E-F 区域电动力耦合调节印度次大陆上空夜间中纬度中尺度移动电离层扰动 (MSTID) 的最南纬度范围。我们使用印度各地双频 GNSS 接收器密集网络的总电子含量 (TEC) 测量值、GNSS 无线电掩星 (RO) 剖面以及 2025 年 5 月至 7 月太阳活动高峰期期间新德里的电离探空仪观测结果分析了多个 MSTID 事件。 MSTID 波前到达的最低地理纬度在 17 度到 25 度之间变化。它们的低纬度延伸与背景 TEC 没有显着相关性，但与 GNSS-RO 测量确定的零星 E (Es) 层的地磁映射最南纬度呈正相关。这些事件发生在太阳活动高峰期间，此时 F 区 MSTID 的增长普遍受到抑制。因此，我们的结果表明，与底层 Es 层的电动耦合对于维持 MSTID 并使其在太阳活动极大期期间实现低纬度穿透至关重要。

articles.title: Complex Hyperspin Machine and Symmetry Quenching: Benchmark and scaling up to millions of degrees of freedom
articles.title_zh: 复杂的超自旋机和对称淬火：基准测试并扩展到数百万自由度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09324v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Driven-dissipative oscillator networks have been proposed to simulate spin models on physical hardware, mostly focusing on systems of binary (Ising) spins, or systems of spin vectors in low dimensions. The equalized hyperspin machine was recently introduced to provide a single platform to simulate general models of N coupled spin vectors with tunable dimension D, realizing dynamical annealing protocols to vary the spin dimensionality in time. These schemes are limited to real spins coupled via real coupling matrices. We propose a generalization of the hyperspin machine that works with complex fields and deals with complex Hermitian coupling matrices, implementing an amplitude equalization scheme. This system, which we name complex hyperspin machine, can work on optimization problems with complex valued hyperspins that can be cast on complex D-vector Hamiltonians. We benchmark the machine against a differential evolution (DE) algorithm on complex D=2 hyperspins up to N=80, showing that the fraction of instances where a lower-energy solution is found grows with system size and coupling density, reaching 92.5% at the largest considered sizes. When the DE finds a lower-energy solution, the machine still reaches a median relative energy deviation that lies between 10⁻¹⁵ and 10⁻¹² while running at substantially lower computational cost. Using the complex nature of the field, we introduce a new dimensional reduction protocol that we name symmetry quenching, which collapses complex variables that map to XY spins onto real Ising spins by switching on the parametric pump. We show on Max-Cut instances with known ground states that symmetry quenching outperforms a fixed-pump Ising machine, reaching exact ground states in the presence of equalization. We scale the system to N=10⁶ hyperspins, or 8×10⁶ dynamical variables, on a Hermitian sparse two-dimensional lattice.
articles.abstract_zh: 驱动耗散振荡器网络已被提出来模拟物理硬件上的自旋模型，主要关注二元（Ising）自旋系统或低维自旋向量系统。最近推出的均衡超自旋机提供了一个单一平台来模拟具有可调维度 D 的 N 个耦合自旋向量的通用模型，实现动态退火协议以及时改变自旋维度。这些方案仅限于通过实耦合矩阵耦合的实自旋。我们提出了超自旋机的推广，该机适用于复杂场并处理复杂的埃尔米特耦合矩阵，实现幅度均衡方案。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 驱动耗散振荡器网络已被提出来模拟物理硬件上的自旋模型，主要关注二元（Ising）自旋系统或低维自旋向量系统。最近推出的均衡超自旋机提供了一个单一平台来模拟具有可调维度 D 的 N 个耦合自旋向量的通用模型，实现动态退火协议以及时改变自旋维度。这些方案仅限于通过实耦合矩阵耦合的实自旋。我们提出了超自旋机的推广，该机适用于复杂场并处理复杂的埃尔米特耦合矩阵，实现幅度均衡方案。我们将这个系统命名为复杂超自旋机，它可以解决具有复值超自旋的优化问题，这些超自旋可以投射到复杂的 D 向量哈密顿量上。我们在复杂的 D=2 超自旋（最多 N=80）上针对差分进化 (DE) 算法对机器进行了基准测试，结果表明，找到较低能量解决方案的实例比例随着系统尺寸和耦合密度的增加而增长，在最大考虑尺寸下达到 92.5%。当DE找到较低能量的解决方案时，机器仍然达到介于10 -15 和10 -12 之间的中值相对能量偏差，同时以低得多的计算成本运行。利用场的复杂性质，我们引入了一种新的降维协议，我们将其命名为对称淬灭，它通过打开参数泵将映射到 XY 自旋的复杂变量折叠到真实伊辛自旋上。我们在已知基态的最大切割实例上证明，对称淬火优于固定泵伊辛机，在存在均衡的情况下达到精确的基态。我们在埃尔米特稀疏二维晶格上将系统缩放到 N=10⁶ 超自旋，或 8×10⁶ 动态变量。

articles.title: TwinLight: A Multi-Timescale Physical-Layer-Aware T-API-Compliant Optical Domain Controller Digital Twin
articles.title_zh: TwinLight：多时间尺度物理层感知、符合 T-API 的光域控制器数字孪生
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09359v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate TwinLight, an open-source optical-network digital twin acting as an optical domain controller. Its T-API REST and telemetry streaming interfaces expose a physical-layer engine that combines a GNPy steady-state baseline with four analytical transients.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们演示了 TwinLight，这是一种充当光域控制器的开源光网络数字孪生。其 T-API REST 和遥测流接口公开了一个物理层引擎，该引擎将 GNPy 稳态基线与四个分析瞬态相结合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们演示了 TwinLight，这是一种充当光域控制器的开源光网络数字孪生。其 T-API REST 和遥测流接口公开了一个物理层引擎，该引擎将 GNPy 稳态基线与四个分析瞬态相结合。

articles.title: SmartBloch-Agent: An Agentic Framework for Automated MRI Sequence Design and Optimization
articles.title_zh: SmartBloch-Agent：自动化 MRI 序列设计和优化的代理框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09413v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) pulse sequences organize radiofrequency excitation, gradient encoding, and signal acquisition, determining magnetization evolution and image formation. Sequence research requires translating imaging objectives into executable protocols meeting physical and acquisition constraints, refined via physical simulation, signal reconstruction, and scientific evaluation. Sequence construction, physical verification, parameter search, and assessment involve many tools and manual decisions, limiting automation from objective to verifiable sequence. We develop SmartBloch-Agent, an integrated framework for automated MRI sequence design and optimization. Given objectives and scientific constraints in natural language, an AI agent interprets goals, plans tasks, orchestrates tools, and makes feedback-informed decisions, drawing on a construction module and optimizers for structural design and parameter search. Our GPU-accelerated SmartBloch engine supplies physical computation for both stages, so the framework configures, per sequence and objective, event validation, Full-Bloch magnetization evolution, signal acquisition, image reconstruction, and scientific evaluation, and closes the loop without external MRI simulators. Results return to the agent to guide sequence revision, parameter optimization, and candidate selection, and the design files carry simulation, reconstruction, and evaluation evidence, forming an output package for a real-scanner workflow. Experiments show the framework automatically designs and optimizes MRI sequences for varied objectives and constraints, refines candidates with physical feedback, and improves several parameter-estimation metrics and downstream quantitative reconstruction. SmartBloch-Agent unifies objectives, design, physical execution, and evaluation into a continuous workflow for end-to-end automation of MRI sequence research.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁共振成像 (MRI) 脉冲序列组织射频激励、梯度编码和信号采集，确定磁化演化和图像形成。序列研究需要将成像目标转化为满足物理和采集约束的可执行协议，并通过物理模拟、信号重建和科学评估进行完善。序列构建、物理验证、参数搜索和评估涉及许多工具和手动决策，限制了从客观序列到可验证序列的自动化。我们开发了 SmartBloch-Agent，这是一个用于自动化 MRI 序列设计和优化的集成框架。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁共振成像 (MRI) 脉冲序列组织射频激励、梯度编码和信号采集，确定磁化演化和图像形成。序列研究需要将成像目标转化为满足物理和采集约束的可执行协议，并通过物理模拟、信号重建和科学评估进行完善。序列构建、物理验证、参数搜索和评估涉及许多工具和手动决策，限制了从客观序列到可验证序列的自动化。我们开发了 SmartBloch-Agent，这是一个用于自动化 MRI 序列设计和优化的集成框架。给定自然语言的目标和科学约束，人工智能代理可以解释目标、计划任务、编排工具并做出基于反馈的决策，利用构建模块和优化器进行结构设计和参数搜索。我们的 GPU 加速的 SmartBloch 引擎为两个阶段提供物理计算，因此该框架可以按序列和目标配置事件验证、Full-Bloch 磁化演化、信号采集、图像重建和科学评估，并在无需外部 MRI 模拟器的情况下关闭循环。结果返回给代理以指导序列修改、参数优化和候选选择，设计文件携带模拟、重建和评估证据，形成真实扫描仪工作流程的输出包。实验表明，该框架可以针对不同的目标和约束自动设计和优化 MRI 序列，通过物理反馈完善候选序列，并改进多个参数估计指标和下游定量重建。 SmartBloch-Agent 将目标、设计、物理执行和评估统一到连续的工作流程中，以实现 MRI 序列研究的端到端自动化。

articles.title: Different exact-law formulations to calculate the energy cascade rate in magnetohydrodynamic turbulence with and without mean magnetic fields
articles.title_zh: 用不同的精确定律公式计算有和没有平均磁场的磁流体动力湍流中的能量级联率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09437v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: At scales much larger than the ion inertial length and ion-gyroscale, space-plasma turbulence is often described within the framework of incompressible magnetohydrodynamics (MHD). Using high-resolution direct numerical simulations with 1024³ grid points, we perform the first systematic numerical comparison of three exact-law formulations for the total energy cascade in homogeneous, but not necessarily isotropic, MHD turbulence: the Yaglom-Monin (YM), Banerjee-Galtier (BG), and two-point correlator formulations. Despite directional variations, the angle-averaged energy transfer rates for all three formulations show excellent agreement for zero, moderate, and strong background magnetic fields. These results clearly suggest the usefulness of alternative BG and correlator formulations for estimating the energy cascade rates in turbulent space plasmas when the required spatial derivatives are accessible through multi-spacecraft measurements. We also argue that the isotropic Politano-Pouquet (PP) formulation does not provide a true directional transfer rate and therefore its application as a single-direction energy transfer rate estimator leads to inaccurate values, especially under anisotropic conditions. Decomposing the exact formulations into RMHD and non-RMHD contributions, we also show that the RMHD cascade rates cannot be obtained merely by increasing the strength of the mean magnetic field in incompressible magnetohydrodynamic turbulence. Finally, a term-by-term analysis of different formulations reveals how different nonlinear interaction channels coexist and collaborate with each other to maintain the same energy cascade rate across the inertial scales.
articles.abstract_zh: 在比离子惯性长度和离子陀螺尺度大得多的尺度上，空间等离子体湍流通常在不可压缩磁流体动力学（MHD）的框架内描述。使用具有 1024³ 网格点的高分辨率直接数值模拟，我们对均匀但不一定是各向同性 MHD 湍流中总能量级联的三个精确定律公式进行了首次系统数值比较：Yaglom-Monin (YM)、Banerjee-Galtier (BG) 和两点相关器公式。尽管存在方向变化，所有三种配方的角平均能量转移率在零、中等和强背景磁场下都表现出极好的一致性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在比离子惯性长度和离子陀螺尺度大得多的尺度上，空间等离子体湍流通常在不可压缩磁流体动力学（MHD）的框架内描述。使用具有 1024³ 网格点的高分辨率直接数值模拟，我们对均匀但不一定是各向同性 MHD 湍流中总能量级联的三个精确定律公式进行了首次系统数值比较：Yaglom-Monin (YM)、Banerjee-Galtier (BG) 和两点相关器公式。尽管存在方向变化，所有三种配方的角平均能量转移率在零、中等和强背景磁场下都表现出极好的一致性。这些结果清楚地表明，当通过多航天器测量可以获得所需的空间导数时，替代 BG 和相关器公式对于估计湍流空间等离子体中的能量级联速率是有用的。我们还认为，各向同性 Politano-Pouquet (PP) 公式不能提供真正的方向传输率，因此将其用作单向能量传输率估计器会导致值不准确，尤其是在各向异性条件下。将精确公式分解为 RMHD 和非 RMHD 贡献，我们还表明，仅通过增加不可压缩磁流体动力湍流中的平均磁场强度无法获得 RMHD 级联速率。最后，对不同公式的逐项分析揭示了不同的非线性相互作用通道如何共存并相互协作以在惯性尺度上保持相同的能量级联速率。

articles.title: Interface-driven second harmonic generation in indium tin oxide/gold nanolayers: density and mass discontinuities matter
articles.title_zh: 氧化铟锡/金纳米层中界面驱动的二次谐波产生：密度和质量不连续性很重要
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09471v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Second harmonic generation from transparent conductive oxides and metals is traditionally attributed to Coulomb, magnetic Lorentz, and convective sources. We show that this picture is incomplete in deeply subwavelength indium tin oxide/gold bilayers. Measurements reveal two robust spectral features, a broad maximum near 1000 nm and an epsilon-near-zero peak near 1350 nm, that persist across wide variations in material and excitation parameters. Hydrodynamic-Maxwell simulations identify an interface-specific convective mechanism activated by freeelectron density and effective-mass discontinuities at the oxide-metal boundary. As electronic homogenization develops across the bilayer, the response evolves toward one described by conventional Coulomb, Lorentz, and leading convective terms. These results establish second harmonic generation as a sensitive probe of interface-driven nonlinearities and suggest a broader role for electronic discontinuities in shaping nonlinear optical processes at surface and buried material interfaces.
articles.abstract_zh: 透明导电氧化物和金属产生的二次谐波传统上归因于库仑、磁洛伦兹和对流源。我们证明这张图片在深亚波长氧化铟锡/金双层中是不完整的。测量揭示了两个强大的光谱特征，即 1000 nm 附近的宽最大值和 1350 nm 附近的 epsilon 近零峰值，这些特征在材料和激发参数的广泛变化中持续存在。流体动力学-麦克斯韦模拟确定了由氧化物-金属边界处的自由电子密度和有效质量不连续性激活的界面特定对流机制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 透明导电氧化物和金属产生的二次谐波传统上归因于库仑、磁洛伦兹和对流源。我们证明这张图片在深亚波长氧化铟锡/金双层中是不完整的。测量揭示了两个强大的光谱特征，即 1000 nm 附近的宽最大值和 1350 nm 附近的 epsilon 近零峰值，这些特征在材料和激发参数的广泛变化中持续存在。流体动力学-麦克斯韦模拟确定了由氧化物-金属边界处的自由电子密度和有效质量不连续性激活的界面特定对流机制。随着电子均匀化在双层上的发展，响应逐渐向传统库仑、洛伦兹和主要对流项所描述的方向发展。这些结果确立了二次谐波生成作为界面驱动非线性的敏感探针，并表明电子不连续性在塑造表面和掩埋材料界面的非线性光学过程中发挥更广泛的作用。

articles.title: The PICO-40L detector
articles.title_zh: PICO-40L 探测器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09517v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The PICO collaboration has designed and constructed a novel bubble chamber to search for evidence of Weakly Interacting Massive Particles, a leading dark matter candidate. The PICO-40L detector is the successor to PICO-60, and uses a fully redesigned system for pressurization of the active volume after a bubble nucleation event. Pressure in PICO-40L is transferred to the target fluid through a set of two nested synthetic quartz vessels connected by bellows below the active volume. This is in contrast to the design of earlier detectors in which the pressure was transferred through a buffer fluid atop the target fluid, within a single synthetic quartz vessel connected to a bellows above the active volume. Removing the buffer fluid removes the potential for backgrounds arising from the interface between the two fluids, and moving the bellows below the target fluid suppresses potential backgrounds from particulates originating from the bellows. The newly designed detector concept of PICO-40L is referred to as the Right-Side-Up (RSU) design and requires a dedicated thermal system to keep the lower region of the detector cold while the upper region is stably superheated. The main goal of PICO-40L is to establish the performance characteristics of the RSU detector concept, which will inform the operating configuration of the final generation PICO dark matter detector, PICO-500, which is currently under construction at SNOLAB. This paper reviews the design, installation, and performance of the PICO-40L detector.
articles.abstract_zh: PICO 合作设计并建造了一个新颖的气泡室，以寻找弱相互作用大质量粒子（一种主要的暗物质候选者）的证据。 PICO-40L 探测器是 PICO-60 的后继产品，采用完全重新设计的系统，用于在气泡成核事件后对活动体积进行加压。 PICO-40L 中的压力通过一组两个嵌套的合成石英容器传输到目标流体，这两个容器通过活动体积下方的波纹管连接。这与早期探测器的设计形成鲜明对比，在早期探测器中，压力通过目标流体顶部的缓冲流体传递，在单个合成石英容器内连接到有效体积上方的波纹管。
articles.abstract_zh_full: PICO 合作设计并建造了一个新颖的气泡室，以寻找弱相互作用大质量粒子（一种主要的暗物质候选者）的证据。 PICO-40L 探测器是 PICO-60 的后继产品，采用完全重新设计的系统，用于在气泡成核事件后对活动体积进行加压。 PICO-40L 中的压力通过一组两个嵌套的合成石英容器传输到目标流体，这两个容器通过活动体积下方的波纹管连接。这与早期探测器的设计形成鲜明对比，在早期探测器中，压力通过目标流体顶部的缓冲流体传递，在单个合成石英容器内连接到有效体积上方的波纹管。去除缓冲液可以消除两种流体之间的界面产生的潜在背景，而将波纹管移动到目标流体下方可以抑制来自波纹管的颗粒的潜在背景。 PICO-40L 新设计的探测器概念被称为右侧向上 (RSU) 设计，需要专用的热系统来保持探测器下部区域低温，同时上部区域稳定过热。 PICO-40L 的主要目标是建立 RSU 探测器概念的性能特征，这将为目前正在 SNOLAB 建造的最后一代 PICO 暗物质探测器 PICO-500 的操作配置提供信息。本文回顾了 PICO-40L 探测器的设计、安装和性能。

articles.title: Portable Glass-RPC Telescope for Muography and Future Applications at Laser Wake Field Accelerators
articles.title_zh: 用于激光尾流场加速器的 Muography 和未来应用的便携式玻璃-RPC 望远镜
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09541v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report a 2025 beam test at ELBA, the multi-GeV laser wakefield accelerator at ELI Beamlines, using a Resistive Plate Chamber (RPC) telescope with an active area of 16 * 16 cm2. The portable design sup- ports autonomous operation in challenging environments. Previous cosmic-ray measurements established its tracking capability for muography. During the campaign at ELBA, 30 f s long, 0.5 PW laser pulses in- teracted with a plasma target at a 0.2 Hz repetition rate, where a tungsten converter upstream of the beam dump enhanced muon production. This was the first deployment of an RPC telescope in a high-power laser environment. The detector remained operational in the presence of radiation and electromagnetic interference. Although parasitic running and limited statistics prevented definitive identification of beam- induced muons, the measurements offered insight into background activity and showed evidence of re- constructed tracks. They establish the feasibility of a dedicated campaign with controlled beam conditions and improved muon sensitivity. This contribution forms part of the International Muography Workshop 2026 proceedings.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们报告了 ELBA 的 2025 年光束测试，ELBA 是 ELI Beamlines 的多 GeV 激光尾场加速器，使用有效面积为 16 * 16 cm2 的电阻板室 (RPC) 望远镜。便携式设计支持在充满挑战的环境中自主操作。之前的宇宙射线测量建立了其追踪 Muography 的能力。在 ELBA 的活动期间，30 f s 长、0.5 PW 的激光脉冲以 0.2 Hz 的重复频率与等离子体目标相互作用，其中束流收集器上游的钨转换器增强了 μ 介子的产生。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了 ELBA 的 2025 年光束测试，ELBA 是 ELI Beamlines 的多 GeV 激光尾场加速器，使用有效面积为 16 * 16 cm2 的电阻板室 (RPC) 望远镜。便携式设计支持在充满挑战的环境中自主操作。之前的宇宙射线测量建立了其追踪 Muography 的能力。在 ELBA 的活动期间，30 f s 长、0.5 PW 的激光脉冲以 0.2 Hz 的重复频率与等离子体目标相互作用，其中束流收集器上游的钨转换器增强了 μ 介子的产生。这是 RPC 望远镜首次在高功率激光环境中部署。探测器在存在辐射和电磁干扰的情况下仍保持运行。尽管寄生运行和有限的统计数据阻碍了对束诱导μ子的明确识别，但测量结果提供了对背景活动的深入了解，并显示了重建轨道的证据。他们确立了通过控制光束条件和提高μ子灵敏度进行专门活动的可行性。本文是 2026 年国际 Muography 研讨会论文集的一部分。

articles.title: Layer-Peeling Inversion of Temporal Refractive Index Profiles from Noisy Data
articles.title_zh: 噪声数据的时间折射率分布的分层反演
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09630v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce a direct method for reconstructing the temporal evolution of a medium from electromagnetic field measurements. A sequence of temporal refractive-index changes splits an incident wave into forward- and backward-propagating components, producing a emphspatial response of finite extent. We show that this finite support, together with causality, enables sequential reconstruction of the temporal interfaces through a time-domain extension of layer peeling. For continuously varying media, we introduce a time-adjusted Goupillaud medium and, through space-time duality, establish the corresponding momentum-conservation and admissibility conditions. The method remains robust under incomplete and noisy measurements, providing a general framework for the metrology, characterization, and design of time-varying electromagnetic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们介绍了一种根据电磁场测量重建介质时间演化的直接方法。一系列时间折射率变化将入射波分成向前和向后传播的分量，产生有限范围的强调空间响应。我们证明，这种有限支持与因果关系一起，可以通过层剥离的时域扩展来顺序重建时间界面。对于连续变化的介质，我们引入时间调整的古皮洛介质，并通过时空对偶性，建立相应的动量守恒和容许条件。该方法在不完整和噪声测量下仍然保持鲁棒性，为时变电磁系统的计量、表征和设计提供了通用框架。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们介绍了一种根据电磁场测量重建介质时间演化的直接方法。一系列时间折射率变化将入射波分成向前和向后传播的分量，产生有限范围的强调空间响应。我们证明，这种有限支持与因果关系一起，可以通过层剥离的时域扩展来顺序重建时间界面。对于连续变化的介质，我们引入时间调整的古皮洛介质，并通过时空对偶性，建立相应的动量守恒和容许条件。该方法在不完整和噪声测量下仍然保持鲁棒性，为时变电磁系统的计量、表征和设计提供了通用框架。

articles.title: Are the tearing and the Weibel instabilities the same?
articles.title_zh: 撕裂和 Weibel 不稳定性相同吗？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09639v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The tearing instability, which extracts free energy from a magnetic field gradient, and the Weibel instability, which draws free energy from temperature anisotropies, appear at first glance to be fundamentally distinct. However, the magnetic field gradient in the tearing instability requires a current, and the resulting plasma drift leads to an effective temperature anisotropy, so that the plasma is hotter along the direction of the current flow. This anisotropy can play an essential role in driving the instability. We demonstrate, using semi-implicit particle-in-cell simulations, a smooth transition between the tearing regime for thick current sheets, where the anisotropy has little influence, and a thin-current-sheet regime better described by Weibel physics. We find that for current sheet thicknesses less than the ion Larmor radius, where standard assumptions of the tearing instability break down, the growth rate of the mode commonly identified as the tearing instability agrees remarkably well with the growth rate predicted by ion-cyclotron theory, which is essentially the magnetized counterpart of the Weibel instability.
articles.abstract_zh: 从磁场梯度中提取自由能的撕裂不稳定性和从温度各向异性中提取自由能的韦贝尔不稳定性乍一看似乎本质上是不同的。然而，撕裂不稳定性中的磁场梯度需要电流，由此产生的等离子体漂移导致有效的温度各向异性，使得等离子体沿着电流流动的方向更热。这种各向异性在驱动不稳定方面发挥着重要作用。我们使用半隐式单元内粒子模拟证明了厚电流片的撕裂状态（各向异性几乎没有影响）和由 Weibel 物理学更好地描述的薄电流片状态之间的平滑过渡。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 从磁场梯度中提取自由能的撕裂不稳定性和从温度各向异性中提取自由能的韦贝尔不稳定性乍一看似乎本质上是不同的。然而，撕裂不稳定性中的磁场梯度需要电流，由此产生的等离子体漂移导致有效的温度各向异性，使得等离子体沿着电流流动的方向更热。这种各向异性在驱动不稳定方面发挥着重要作用。我们使用半隐式单元内粒子模拟证明了厚电流片的撕裂状态（各向异性几乎没有影响）和由 Weibel 物理学更好地描述的薄电流片状态之间的平滑过渡。我们发现，对于当前片材厚度小于离子拉莫尔半径的情况，撕裂不稳定性的标准假设不成立，通常被认为是撕裂不稳定性的模式的增长率与离子回旋加速器理论预测的增长率非常吻合，离子回旋加速器理论本质上是韦贝尔不稳定性的磁化对应物。

articles.title: Multipole Decomposition of Moving Sources
articles.title_zh: 动源的多极分解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09654v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cartesian multipole moments are widely used to analyze and engineer radiation, but the usual relations for their radiated fields assume a wavevector-independent source frequency. For moving sources, Doppler shifts make the frequency depend on the wavevector, so the radiated fields predicted from the moments generally carry errors proportional to v/c. From charge conservation in the laboratory frame, we derive a multipole decomposition of moving sources that retains the usual moments but evaluates their contributions at Doppler-shifted wavenumbers and adds a convection-current term. Requiring no rest frame, it applies to moving matter and to excitation patterns in synthetic motion through media at rest, including superluminal ones. The decomposition also extends to nonuniform translation and to nonrigid patterns with curved spectral supports. Exact calculations for moving electric, magnetic, and toroidal dipoles confirm the decomposition and attribute the different radiation of a dipole in moving matter and in synthetic motion to the laboratory moments that each kind of motion induces. For an anapole, these moments decide whether it radiates. An anapole carried by uniformly moving matter remains nonradiating, whereas an excitation pattern with the same electric and toroidal dipoles radiates in synthetic motion. The decomposition thus makes multipolar analysis available for moving matter and for excitation patterns in synthetic motion, and it opens the way to designing their radiation.
articles.abstract_zh: 笛卡尔多极矩广泛用于分析和工程辐射，但其辐射场的通常关系假设与波矢量无关的源频率。对于移动源，多普勒频移使频率取决于波矢，因此根据时刻预测的辐射场通常带有与 v/c 成比例的误差。根据实验室框架中的电荷守恒，我们得出了移动源的多极分解，该分解保留了通常的矩，但评估了它们在多普勒频移波数上的贡献，并添加了对流项。它不需要静止框架，适用于移动物质以及通过静止介质（包括超光速介质）进行合成运动的激发模式。分解还扩展到非均匀平移和具有弯曲光谱支撑的非刚性图案。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 笛卡尔多极矩广泛用于分析和工程辐射，但其辐射场的通常关系假设与波矢量无关的源频率。对于移动源，多普勒频移使频率取决于波矢，因此根据时刻预测的辐射场通常带有与 v/c 成比例的误差。根据实验室框架中的电荷守恒，我们得出了移动源的多极分解，该分解保留了通常的矩，但评估了它们在多普勒频移波数上的贡献，并添加了对流项。它不需要静止框架，适用于移动物质以及通过静止介质（包括超光速介质）进行合成运动的激发模式。分解还扩展到非均匀平移和具有弯曲光谱支撑的非刚性图案。对移动电偶极子、磁偶极子和环形偶极子的精确计算证实了分解，并将偶极子在移动物质和合成运动中的不同辐射归因于每种运动引起的实验室力矩。对于阿纳波来说，这些时刻决定了它是否辐射。由均匀运动的物质携带的阿纳极子保持非辐射，而具有相同电偶极子和环形偶极子的激发模式在合成运动中辐射。因此，分解使得多极分析可用于移动物质和合成运动中的激发模式，并为设计其辐射开辟了道路。

articles.title: Radiation-driven melting and porous flow in the near-surface layer of an ice sheet
articles.title_zh: 冰盖近地表层的辐射驱动融化和多孔流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09660v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The ablation area of an ice sheet can undergo melting both directly at the surface and in the metre or so below the surface, due to the penetration and absorption of shortwave radiation. The fate of the meltwater has important implications for the mass balance of the ice sheet; some of it runs off into surface streams and eventually to the ocean, while some is stored in the porous `weathering crust', and can refreeze. We present a fluid-mechanical model to analyse the downward percolation and lateral drainage of the meltwater in the crust, and its influence on porosity, saturation, temperature and melting rate. Previous models have either ignored the possibility for lateral drainage, in which case the crust is always saturated with water, or have made ad-hoc assumptions about where and how the meltwater runs off. Through a series of analytical and numerical solutions to the model, we find that lateral drainage has the effect of controlling the water table within the weathering crust, which separates an unsaturated region near the surface from a saturated aquifer beneath. Under fluctuating weather conditions that induce melting and refreezing, the lateral drainage can result in the near-surface ice being more porous and also colder than is the case without lateral drainage. The model is able to predict the partitioning of the meltwater between surface and subsurface runoff, and refreezing, and has potential to be incorporated within larger-scale models of the ice-sheet mass balance.
articles.abstract_zh: 由于短波辐射的穿透和吸收，冰盖的消融区域可以直接在表面融化，也可以在表面以下一米左右的地方融化。融水的命运对于冰盖的质量平衡具有重要影响。其中一些流入地表溪流，最终流入海洋，而另一些则储存在多孔的“风化壳”中，并且可以重新冻结。我们提出了一个流体力学模型来分析地壳中融水的向下渗透和侧向排水及其对孔隙度、饱和度、温度和熔化速率的影响。以前的模型要么忽略了横向排水的可能性（在这种情况下，地壳总是充满水），要么对融水流失的地点和方式做出了临时假设。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由于短波辐射的穿透和吸收，冰盖的消融区域可以直接在表面融化，也可以在表面以下一米左右的地方融化。融水的命运对于冰盖的质量平衡具有重要影响。其中一些流入地表溪流，最终流入海洋，而另一些则储存在多孔的“风化壳”中，并且可以重新冻结。我们提出了一个流体力学模型来分析地壳中融水的向下渗透和侧向排水及其对孔隙度、饱和度、温度和熔化速率的影响。以前的模型要么忽略了横向排水的可能性（在这种情况下，地壳总是充满水），要么对融水流失的地点和方式做出了临时假设。通过对模型的一系列分析和数值解，我们发现侧向排水具有控制风化壳内地下水位的作用，它将地表附近的不饱和区域与下面的饱和含水层分开。在引起融化和再冻结的波动天气条件下，侧向排水可能会导致近地表冰比没有侧向排水的情况更加多孔且温度更低。该模型能够预测融水在地表和地下径流之间的分配以及重新冻结，并且有可能被纳入更大规模的冰盖质量平衡模型中。

articles.title: Cavity-QED Molecular Dynamics: An eT-i-PI Interface for Ab Initio Cavity Born-Oppenheimer Dynamics and Joint Nuclear-Photon Path-Integral Sampling
articles.title_zh: 腔-QED 分子动力学：用于从头算腔玻恩-奥本海默动力学和联合核光子路径积分采样的 eT-i-PI 接口
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09667v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Simulating molecules in quantum electrodynamic (QED) cavities requires a consistent description of electronic response, nuclear motion, and electromagnetic-field fluctuations. Here, I present Cavity-QED Molecular Dynamics, an interface connecting eT and i-PI for atomistic simulations of finite molecular systems coupled to a single photon mode. The code evaluates a self-consistent cavity Born-Oppenheimer Hartree-Fock (CBO-HF) energy surface and supports classical-nuclei dynamics under canonical (NVT) and microcanonical (NVE) ensembles, as well as canonical joint nuclear-photon path-integral sampling including nuclear quantum effects (NQEs). A fixed-displacement gradient correction provides nuclear and photon forces consistent with the same energy surface as the photon coordinate evolves independently. OpenMP threading, concurrent bead evaluations, and analysis utilities support practical simulations. Water-monomer benchmarks assess both dynamical propagation and equilibrium sampling. Energy-derivative checks and NVE timestep tests demonstrate consistent force evaluation and integration, while path integral molecular dynamics (PIMD) simulations with PILE-L thermostatting reproduce analytic finite-bead photon second moments, including their centroid and internal contributions, within sampling uncertainties. At the tested parameters, cavity coupling produces a small but statistically resolved increase in photon fluctuations, while changes in mean molecular geometry remain within sampling uncertainty. The resulting Cavity-QED Molecular Dynamics framework enables controlled investigations of how coupled quantum fluctuations of matter and the electromagnetic field influence molecular equilibrium properties within the CBO-HF approximation, providing a foundation for future studies of cavity-modified hydrogen bonding, vibrational spectra, and molecular polaritonic phenomena.
articles.abstract_zh: 模拟量子电动力学 (QED) 腔中的分子需要对电子响应、核运动和电磁场波动进行一致的描述。在这里，我介绍 Cavity-QED 分子动力学，这是一个连接 eT 和 i-PI 的接口，用于耦合到单光子模式的有限分子系统的原子模拟。该代码评估自洽腔 Born-Oppenheimer Hartree-Fock (CBO-HF) 能量面，并支持规范 (NVT) 和微规范 (NVE) 系综下的经典核动力学，以及包括核量子效应 (NQE) 在内的规范联合核光子路径积分采样。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 模拟量子电动力学 (QED) 腔中的分子需要对电子响应、核运动和电磁场波动进行一致的描述。在这里，我介绍 Cavity-QED 分子动力学，这是一个连接 eT 和 i-PI 的接口，用于耦合到单光子模式的有限分子系统的原子模拟。该代码评估自洽腔 Born-Oppenheimer Hartree-Fock (CBO-HF) 能量面，并支持规范 (NVT) 和微规范 (NVE) 系综下的经典核动力学，以及包括核量子效应 (NQE) 在内的规范联合核光子路径积分采样。当光子坐标独立演化时，固定位移梯度校正提供与相同能量表面一致的核力和光子力。 OpenMP 线程、并发珠评估和分析实用程序支持实际模拟。水单体基准评估动态传播和平衡采样。能量导数检查和 NVE 时间步长测试证明了一致的力评估和积分，而使用 PILE-L 恒温的路径积分分子动力学 (PIMD) 模拟在采样不确定性范围内再现了分析有限珠光子二阶矩，包括它们的质心和内部贡献。在测试参数下，腔耦合会产生小幅但统计上已解决的光子波动增加，而平均分子几何形状的变化仍保持在采样不确定性范围内。由此产生的腔-QED 分子动力学框架能够对物质和电磁场的耦合量子涨落如何影响 CBO-HF 近似内的分子平衡特性进行受控研究，为未来研究腔修改氢键、振动光谱和分子极化现象奠定了基础。

articles.title: Magnon-polaritons in terahertz resonators based on antiferromagnets with weak ferromagnetism
articles.title_zh: 基于弱铁磁性反铁磁体的太赫兹谐振器中的磁振子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09673v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Terahertz magnon-polaritons in antiferromagnets with weak ferromagnetism are theoretically investigated using YFeO₃ as an example. Dispersion relations are obtained for the quasi-ferromagnetic and quasi-antiferromagnetic modes. It is shown that the intrinsic Fabry--Perot resonances of the magnetic slab provide strong coupling, but their low quality factor limits the cooperativity. The photonic crystal cavity increases the cooperativity of the quasi-antiferromagnetic mode from Csim6 to Csim41 at 300K and to 2.2×10³ at 63K.
articles.abstract_zh: 以YFeO₃为例，从理论上研究了弱铁磁性反铁磁体中的太赫兹磁振子极化子。获得了准铁磁和准反铁磁模式的色散关系。结果表明，磁板固有的法布里-珀罗共振提供了强耦合，但其低品质因数限制了协同性。光子晶体腔将准反铁磁模式的协同性从 Csim6 提高到 Csim41（在 300K 时）和在 63K 时提高到 2.2×10³。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 以YFeO₃为例，从理论上研究了弱铁磁性反铁磁体中的太赫兹磁振子极化子。获得了准铁磁和准反铁磁模式的色散关系。结果表明，磁板固有的法布里-珀罗共振提供了强耦合，但其低品质因数限制了协同性。光子晶体腔将准反铁磁模式的协同性从 Csim6 提高到 Csim41（在 300K 时）和在 63K 时提高到 2.2×10³。

articles.title: Bathyspheres, dust devils, lunar plumes and Martian drones: a generalised mathematical model for particle-fluid flow fields generated by static particle bed entrainment across macroscopic scales
articles.title_zh: 深海球、尘暴、月球羽流和火星无人机：宏观尺度上静态颗粒床夹带生成的颗粒流体流场的广义数学模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09766v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We consider a recently derived mathematical model for the mechanism by which a wind driven flow entrains particles into a fluid from an otherwise static particle bed, a process that is fundamental in initiating and driving the phenomenon of particle cloud formation. This model was previously applied to the "helicopter brownout" problem, in which, as a helicopter descends towards a bed of sand, the downwash and swirling flow from the rotors entrain particles into the air, forming a high-velocity particle-laden cloud around the helicopter. Here, we define a new measure of particle cloud formation potential, outline how the model can be incorporated into existing Computational Fluid Dynamics software, and extend the model to scenarios including: formation of particle clouds in the absence of swirl, such as those caused by a bathysphere descending to the ocean bed, or a rocket landing on the lunar surface, in which case we can precisely predict the critical height above the surface at which particle cloud formation is initiated; generation of dust clouds by less powerful downwash and swirling flows caused by drones or other smaller rotorcraft, such as NASA's Ingenuity Mars helicopter, in which case gravitational effects are included in the model; formation of dust devils (dust clouds formed within and around an upwardly circulating columnar air flow), in which case downwash is replaced by updraft. In each case, predictive models are derived through minor adaptations to key modelling assumptions.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们考虑了最近推导出的数学模型，该模型描述了风驱动的流动将颗粒从静态颗粒床夹带到流体中的机制，这一过程对于启动和驱动颗粒云形成现象至关重要。该模型之前曾应用于“直升机灯火管制”问题，即当直升机下降到沙床时，来自旋翼的下洗流和旋流将颗粒夹带到空气中，在直升机周围形成高速的充满颗粒的云。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们考虑了最近推导出的数学模型，该模型描述了风驱动的流动将颗粒从静态颗粒床夹带到流体中的机制，这一过程对于启动和驱动颗粒云形成现象至关重要。该模型之前曾应用于“直升机灯火管制”问题，即当直升机下降到沙床时，来自旋翼的下洗流和旋流将颗粒夹带到空气中，在直升机周围形成高速的充满颗粒的云。在这里，我们定义了一种新的粒子云形成潜力的测量方法，概述了如何将模型纳入现有的计算流体动力学软件中，并将模型扩展到以下场景：在没有漩涡的情况下形成粒子云，例如由深海球下降到海床或火箭登陆月球表面引起的粒子云，在这种情况下，我们可以精确预测粒子云形成开始的表面上方的临界高度；由无人机或其他小型旋翼飞行器（例如 NASA 的 Ingenuity 火星直升机）引起的较弱的下洗流和旋流产生尘埃云，在这种情况下，模型中包含了重力效应；形成尘暴（在向上循环的柱状气流内部和周围形成尘云），在这种情况下，下洗流被上升气流取代。在每种情况下，预测模型都是通过对关键建模假设进行细微调整而得出的。

articles.title: Effects of a Nuclear Detonation in Low Earth Orbit
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09827v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: More than 13,000 satellites operate in low Earth orbit (LEO), and concern has grown that nuclear weapons could be used in space to target them. Beyond the initial X-ray burst, electrons released by radioactive fission products can become trapped in Earth's magnetic field, repeatedly exposing satellites as an artificial radiation belt. Here we couple prompt radiation, electron trapping and belt evolution to satellite failures, collisions and atmospheric drag. For a 1-Mt detonation at 500km over the South Atlantic, repeated belt exposure disables approximately 98% of modeled satellites within one week in our central case. Tripling the assumed radiation tolerance delays widespread failure by only days: approximately 97% are still disabled within two weeks. The loss of maneuverability sharply increases collision risk, with approximately 20 collisions expected within two years. Drag removes many disabled spacecraft from lower altitudes, but replacement satellites could remain exposed to radiation and debris for years. These findings show how a single detonation could devastate orbital infrastructure and support efforts to prevent the deployment and use of nuclear weapons in space.

articles.title: A Quantum Mechanical Description of Active Matter
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09861v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The natural environments habitable to life are inseparable from dissipative and entropic forces, which mandate active matter to operate on constant fluxes of energy and momentum to survive and propagate through spacetime. In contrast to fundamental particles which are characterized by energy and momentum, we postulate that energy expenditure rate and momentum generation rate are the fundamental dynamical quantities driving this evolution of swimming active matter and accordingly construct the corresponding Lagrangian and Hamiltonian of motion of the active matter. Furthermore, living systems broadly employ periodic, non-repeating motion for both locomotion and various biological functions, with meaningful information stored in the periods of these functions. Consequently, analyzing these dynamics in the Fourier space lands us at the familiar tools of the operator based, quantum mechanics. This is accomplished by introducing a complex field to describe the evolving probability distribution of a single unit, as well as the population density of mutually non-interacting active particles under the constraint of scarce resources. The resulting single-unit wavefunction evolves analogously to the Dirac equation with minimal coupling, wherein gauge symmetry reflects the generality of the governing equations across arbitrary resource landscapes. Additionally, we present a Schrödinger-like equation where the effective potential term represents the environmentally mandated, non-motile base metabolic rate. Finally, we formalize the bidirectional coupling between active swimmers and the surrounding fluid via a multipole expansion of the active force with an emphasis on force monopoles and dipoles, where each pole corresponds to a distinct mode of active motility.

articles.title: TitanMPAS - a new global and regional Titan atmospheric circulation model. Part I: Global model results
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08700v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We developed TitanMPAS, a new Titan global and regional climate model, to simulate atmospheric dynamics and methane cycles. It integrates the non-hydrostatic MPAS dynamical core and TitanWRF physics parameterizations, with corrections to relax the thin-atmosphere assumptions on the gravity and curvature terms. TitanMPAS improves upon TitanWRF by incorporating a better moist convection parameterization and the observed surface properties. Long-term simulations (>100 Titan years) with a high resolution of 1^circ and the realistic topography show that TitanMPAS is able to produce the stratospheric superrotation with typical equatorial wind speed over rm 120,ms⁻¹ and the maximum zonal wind speed exceeding rm 170,ms⁻¹ . Besides the good match of temperature profiles to the Cassini CIRS observations, the simulated wind, temperature and methane abundance in the troposphere match well with Huygens probe in-situ measurements. TitanMPAS also captures the major features of seasonal methane precipitation distribution patterns inferred from the observed cloud activities, as well as the vertical and latitudinal variations of methane abundance in the reanalysis of Cassini VIMS data. Resolution sensitivity studies show that higher resolution produces faster stratospheric superrotation, as well as stronger near-surface wind due to better resolved terrain variations. We further demonstrate that, despite the weak solar insolation, the near-surface temperature, pressure, wind magnitude and methane abundance all exhibit diurnal variations. Lastly, we show potential impacts of topography on methane transport and eddy momentum flux in both troposphere and stratosphere, which should be investigated in a future study.

articles.title: From spectroscopy to quantum dynamics: assessing reduced models of a NaCs molecular gate
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08844v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate how spectroscopic calibration and basis selection affect predictions for a dipolar-exchange gate between two optically trapped ²³Na¹³³Cs molecules. We construct a 128-state molecular Hamiltonian restricted to the N=0,1 rotational manifold, fit two effective optical parameters to three bright microwave transitions, and compare the resulting spectrum with four additional lines. In the coherent pair model, changing the optical polarization angle by +0.1^circ reduces the calculated gate fidelity from 94.64% to 1.09% at fixed carrier frequencies. Retuning the carriers and restoring the target Rabi frequencies recovers 89.31%. The remaining sensitivity reflects changes in the multilevel pair dynamics that are not removed by target-frequency and target-Rabi recalibration. Enlarging the molecular basis produces nonmonotonic changes in fidelity, although the 11-state and 25-state calculations give closely agreeing logical maps after phase alignment. Two controls with isolated transfer probabilities near 98.45% yield complete-gate fidelities differing by more than 11 percentage points. We relate these comparisons to a sufficient bound on the error of a projected propagator. The numerical tests quantify agreement among selected bases for a specified coherent Hamiltonian.

articles.title: Existence of Distinct Strong and Weak Shear Regimes of Self-Generated Turbulent Magnetic Reconnection
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09354v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Magnetic reconnection can become fast in three-dimensional turbulent layers. However, the parameters and mechanisms that control the fast state are not yet fully clear. Existing guide-field simulations of self-generated turbulent reconnection show locally coherent flux-rope structures embedded in a stochastic layer, motivating a flux-rope-mediated picture, with reconnection rates of order Vᵣₘ ᵣₑc/V_A sim 0.01 in MHD. Here, we test whether and how magnetic shear changes the reconnection regime, using 3D resistive-MHD simulations at S_L=10⁵. We vary the guide field while keeping the initial reconnecting field strength and rate normalization fixed, comparing a guide-field, weaker-shear configuration with the anti-parallel, strong-shear limit. We find that the strong-shear regime is qualitatively distinct from the flux-rope-mediated guide-field regime. Rather than retaining a narrow layer and locally coherent flux-rope structures, the current layer develops short-wavelength corrugations that broaden it substantially, and the reconnection layer electric field is sustained by fluctuation EMF. The reconnection rate increases to Vᵣₘ ᵣₑc/V_A sim 0.03, about three times the guide-field value. These results indicate that magnetic shear can select the mechanism controlling fast 3D turbulent reconnection, shifting the system from a guide-field regime consistent with flux-rope mediation toward a very fast turbulence-broadened regime. This transition provides a novel explanation for the sudden switch-on of fast reconnection in eruptive solar flares.

articles.title: Scalable Unitary State-Encoding for Generic Large Data
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09760v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Efficient encoding of data into quantum states remains a fundamental bottleneck in many quantum computing protocols, which would otherwise offer advantages over their classical counterparts. Here, we introduce deterministic and scalable amplitude-encoding methods with low two-qubit gate costs and tunable trade-offs between circuit depth and encoding fidelity. Our approaches require no amplitude amplification or mid-circuit measurement and are capable of encoding arbitrary complex data or queryable functions by using tensor-networks to go beyond what can be held in classical memory. Our principle contributions are two complementary algorithms for simplifying fully controlled multiplexer circuits to one- and two-qubit gates. In the first, we formally map the elimination of redundant gate controls to a Boolean logic minimization problem, while in the second we utilize a single ancilla qubit to map the multi-controlled rotation gates to a sequence of one- and two-qubit operations via the Walsh-Hadamard spectrum of the gate angles. We benchmark these methods across a broad range of function classes, characterizing their total depth in an all-to-all connectivity graph against system size and target fidelity. Hybridizing our methods gives up to orders of magnitude improvement in circuit depth at equivalent state fidelity compared to the default state-preparation method in the Qiskit package. We furthermore demonstrate our method on IQM hardware with a square lattice connectivity, finding excellent fidelity, even with minimal noise mitigation. By significantly reducing gate depth for encoding, this work enables the experimental execution of applications on current and near-term hardware which would otherwise be reduced to noise before the first calculation step, shortening the time horizon to robust quantum utility.

articles.title: Active learning and explicit electrostatics enable accurate modeling of electrolytes
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.03479v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) combine near-ab initio accuracy with the computational efficiency of classical force fields, making them promising tools for modeling molecular liquids and electrolytes. Their predictive accuracy depends strongly on the diversity of the training set, while the explicit treatment of electrostatics is increasingly recognized as an important factor in improving their performance. In this work, we assess the impact of incorporating explicit electrostatics and environment-dependence of atomic charges by comparing short-ranged Moment Tensor Potentials (MTPs) with electrostatics-augmented MTPs, including fixed-charge and environment-dependent charge models. To this end, we employ D-optimality-based active learning (AL) to train short-ranged MTPs and extend the AL procedure, previously unavailable for long-range electrostatics-augmented MTPs, to these models, enabling largely automated generation of diverse training sets for pure ethylene carbonate (EC) and ethyl methyl carbonate (EMC), their mixtures, and LiPF6 solutions. For EC, EMC, and their mixtures, electrostatics-augmented MTPs achieve accuracy comparable to or better than that of their short-ranged counterparts while requiring fewer machine-learned parameters. For LiPF6 solutions, however, a notable improvement in accuracy is achieved only with environment-dependent charges, which also enhance stability in large-scale molecular dynamics simulations, unlike the fixed-charge model. The resulting short-ranged MTPs and environment-dependent-charge models reproduce experimental densities with mean absolute deviations of 0.2-6% and ionic conductivities with deviations of 11-15%, while capturing the experimentally observed temperature dependence of conductivity.

articles.title: A Low-Complexity 200 Mbit/s Full-Duplex Digital Link Over a Single Coaxial Cable for Laboratory Instrumentation
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.18848v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Modern full-duplex communication systems, such as Gigabit Ethernet, enable high data rates over challenging transmission media but require sophisticated circuitry and non-trivial digital interfaces. For laboratory instrumentation, the objective may instead be to achieve moderate-bandwidth full-duplex communication over short, well-controlled coaxial cables with minimal circuit and interface complexity. We present a low-complexity bidirectional digital interconnect that enables simultaneous transmission and reception of baseband logic signals over a single coaxial cable. The circuit combines a discrete passive resistive hybrid providing line termination and directional separation, a single logic gate as line driver, and a commercial differential receiver used as a comparator. No modulation, transformer coupling, adaptive calibration, or active analog or digital echo cancellation is required. The design target is full-duplex operation at 200 MBit/s over 10 m of standard RG-178 cable. An analytical treatment of the hybrid network determines the system parameter that maximizes the differential signal amplitude at the receiver, while circuit simulations predict the deterministic timing errors resulting from imperfect directional separation. Experimental measurements confirm the predicted deterministic jitter and show good agreement with the simulation results. For typical laboratory coaxial cables up to 10 m, the measured peak-to-peak edge timing error remains below 1.2 ns. A bidirectional transmission experiment with randomized data demonstrates a clearly open eye diagram. It was found that the transceiver inherently provides loopback functionality when the transmission line is left open. The proposed approach provides a simple, protocol-independent bidirectional physical link which may be useful in laboratory instrumentation where cable routing is constrained.

articles.title: A phase space electronic structure theory beyond Born-Oppenheimer: Geometric forces and Moody-Shapere-Wilczek revisited
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.27053v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We revisit the three-body problem in quantum mechanics in two and three dimensions, generating both exact eigenvalues and eigenvectors of the Hamiltonian and a series of approximate solutions as calculated with a variety of different schemes to separate heavy ("nuclear") and light ("electronic") particles. We show that, with minimal extra cost, one can go beyond the Born-Oppenheimer approximation by performing electronic structure calculations parameterized by both the nuclear position (mathbf X) and the nuclear momentum (P), a so-called phase space theory of electronic structure. In particular, we demonstrate that such phase space electronic structure calculations correctly incorporate the non-inertial Coriolis and centrifugal forces felt by electrons in a moving nuclear frame, thus leading to far more accurate eigenenergies and electronic angular momenta than has been possible before. We also demonstrate that our approach naturally incorporates and generalizes the Moody-Shapere-Wilczek magnetic monopole for the non-abelian Berry curvature (now allowing for vibrational motion rather than a diatomic of fixed length). We argue that the resulting approach should be extremely useful for propagating dynamics where angular momentum flows between nuclei and electrons; in particular, if extended to include spin degrees of freedom, the present approach will offer a practical means to study chiral induced spin selectivity through the lens of chiral phonons and coupled nuclear-electronic motion.

articles.title: Influence of DFT Functionals on Low-Energy Electron Scattering Cross Sections of Nitric Oxide
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.06006v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Nitric oxide (NO) is important in biological, atmospheric, plasma, industrial, and astrophysical environments, where reliable electron-collision data support modelling charged-particle interactions with matter. Its well-known experimental properties make it suitable for assessing how the target electronic-structure description affects low-energy electron scattering calculations. In this work, NO properties were evaluated using B3LYP, M06-2X, PBE0, and ωB97X-D3, with basis sets ranging from minimal to quadruple-zeta quality. Bond length, dipole moment, ionisation potential, and polarisability were compared with experiment to assess the sensitivity of the target description to the functional and basis set. The aug-cc-pVQZ basis set was then used to generate target models for ab initio R-matrix calculations over 0.1--20 eV.
