Special attention is paid to the geometrically consistent adaptation of the update formula for the vector play model. The anhysteretic part of the model is also given an angular dependency. The model is compared to measurements taken from a NdFeB magnet and reproduces the measured loops for field inclinations of up to 30deg from the easy axis.
articles.abstract_zh: 对永磁体的各向异性磁滞行为进行建模需要能够表示首选（简单）磁化方向的矢量磁滞模型。这项工作通过用椭球代替每个粒子的球形钉扎区域，将基于能量的矢量发挥模型扩展到各向异性材料，椭球的半轴代表方向相关的钉扎力。特别注意矢量游戏模型更新公式的几何一致适应。模型的非滞后部分还具有角度依赖性。该模型与 NdFeB 磁体的测量结果进行比较，并再现与易轴成 30 度磁场倾角的测量环路。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对永磁体的各向异性磁滞行为进行建模需要能够表示首选（简单）磁化方向的矢量磁滞模型。这项工作通过用椭球代替每个粒子的球形钉扎区域，将基于能量的矢量发挥模型扩展到各向异性材料，椭球的半轴代表方向相关的钉扎力。特别注意矢量游戏模型更新公式的几何一致适应。模型的非滞后部分还具有角度依赖性。该模型与 NdFeB 磁体的测量结果进行比较，并再现与易轴成 30 度磁场倾角的测量环路。

articles.title: Agnostic and efficient detection of Z₂ symmetry-protected topological phases in projected entangled-pair states
articles.title_zh: 对投影纠缠对态中 Z2 对称性保护的拓扑相进行不可知且高效的检测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07030v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Symmetry-protected topological (SPT) phases are the simplest example of quantum phases that cannot be detected by local order parameters. Their classification is by now well-established from multiple perspectives, a prominent one being via tensor network states. The practical question, however, is not mere classification, but detection: given the ground state of an interacting Hamiltonian and a symmetry group G along with its representation, is there an efficient way to tell if the state is in a SPT phase with respect to G? While there exist such practical tests in one spatial dimension (1D), methods in 2D have so far been restricted to finite-size systems or require an explicit form of virtual symmetries of the tensor networks representing the ground state. Here, we develop an agnostic and efficient method to detect interacting Z₂ 2D SPT phases, using an infinite projected entangled-pair (PEPS) representation of the ground state. The method is agnostic to the symmetry representation in the virtual space of the PEPS tensor and applicable independent of the bond dimension of the tensors. Moreover, it is efficient as it does not require finite-size scalings: it works directly in the thermodynamic limit. We numerically demonstrate the procedure by mapping out phase boundaries away from fixed-point wavefunctions. We extract the SPT label cocycle data explicitly from the PEPS tensor.
articles.abstract_zh: 对称保护拓扑（SPT）相是无法通过局域序参数检测的量子相的最简单示例。到目前为止，他们的分类已经从多个角度得到了完善，其中一个突出的分类是通过张量网络状态。然而，实际问题不仅仅是分类，而是检测：给定相互作用的哈密顿量和对称群 G 的基态及其表示，是否有一种有效的方法来判断状态是否处于相对于 G 的 SPT 相？虽然在一个空间维度（1D）中存在这样的实际测试，但迄今为止，2D 中的方法仅限于有限大小的系统，或者需要表示基态的张量网络的虚拟对称性的显式形式。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对称保护拓扑（SPT）相是无法通过局域序参数检测的量子相的最简单示例。到目前为止，他们的分类已经从多个角度得到了完善，其中一个突出的分类是通过张量网络状态。然而，实际问题不仅仅是分类，而是检测：给定相互作用的哈密顿量和对称群 G 的基态及其表示，是否有一种有效的方法来判断状态是否处于相对于 G 的 SPT 相？虽然在一个空间维度（1D）中存在这样的实际测试，但迄今为止，2D 中的方法仅限于有限大小的系统，或者需要表示基态的张量网络的虚拟对称性的显式形式。在这里，我们开发了一种不可知且有效的方法来检测相互作用的 Z2 2D SPT 相，使用基态的无限投影纠缠对 (PEPS) 表示。该方法与 PEPS 张量虚拟空间中的对称表示无关，并且独立于张量的键维数而适用。此外，它是高效的，因为它不需要有限尺寸的缩放：它直接在热力学极限下工作。我们通过绘制远离定点波函数的相边界来数值演示该过程。我们从 PEPS 张量中明确提取 SPT 标签 cocycle 数据。

articles.title: Universal Negative Correlation between Nonreciprocity and Superconducting Transition Width in FeTe-Based Heterostructures
articles.title_zh: FeTe 基异质结构中非互易性与超导转变宽度之间的普遍负相关性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07116v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nonreciprocal charge transport in noncentrosymmetric superconductors probes broken symmetries and superconducting fluctuations and underpins the superconducting diode effect. Despite extensive studies, the factors governing its magnitude remain unclear. In this work, we use molecular beam epitaxy (MBE) to synthesize a broad family of FeTe-based superconducting heterostructures with top layers spanning topologically trivial versus nontrivial, layered versus nonlayered, and magnetic versus nonmagnetic materials. Through systematic first- and second-harmonic transport measurements, we find that the magnetochiral anisotropy coefficient γ is insensitive to the top-layer crystal structure, lattice constant, thickness, topology, and magnetism, but exhibits a negative correlation with the superconducting transition width Δ T. Control measurements on superconducting stoichiometric FeTe films reveal much weaker nonreciprocity, confirming the essential role of interfacial inversion-symmetry breaking. Combined with a disorder-based theoretical model, our results establish a universal relationship: for comparable inversion-symmetry breaking, reduced interfacial disorder sharpens the superconducting transition and strongly enhances nonreciprocal transport in the Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless (BKT) transition regime. These findings identify Δ T as a unifying parameter governing nonreciprocity across FeTe-based heterostructures, reconcile previously disparate observations, and establish a general framework for engineering enhanced nonreciprocal superconducting responses and exploring superconducting diode effects in nonlinear quantum devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 非中心对称超导体中的非互易电荷传输探测对称性破缺和超导涨落，并支撑超导二极管效应。尽管进行了广泛的研究，但控制其大小的因素仍不清楚。在这项工作中，我们使用分子束外延 (MBE) 来合成一系列基于 FeTe 的超导异质结构，其顶层涵盖拓扑平凡与非平凡、层状与非层状以及磁性与非磁性材料。通过系统的一次和二次谐波输运测量，我们发现磁手性各向异性系数γ对顶层晶体结构、晶格常数、厚度、拓扑和磁性不敏感，但与超导跃迁宽度ΔT呈负相关。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非中心对称超导体中的非互易电荷传输探测对称性破缺和超导涨落，并支撑超导二极管效应。尽管进行了广泛的研究，但控制其大小的因素仍不清楚。在这项工作中，我们使用分子束外延 (MBE) 来合成一系列基于 FeTe 的超导异质结构，其顶层涵盖拓扑平凡与非平凡、层状与非层状以及磁性与非磁性材料。通过系统的一次和二次谐波输运测量，我们发现磁手性各向异性系数γ对顶层晶体结构、晶格常数、厚度、拓扑和磁性不敏感，但与超导跃迁宽度ΔT呈负相关。超导化学计量FeTe薄膜的控制测量揭示了更弱的非互易性，证实了界面反演对称性破缺的重要作用。结合基于无序的理论模型，我们的结果建立了一种普遍的关系：对于可比较的反演对称性破缺，界面无序的减少会加剧超导转变，并强烈增强Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless (BKT)转变体系中的非互易输运。这些发现将 Δ T 确定为控制 FeTe 基异质结构非互易性的统一参数，协调了之前不同的观察结果，并建立了工程增强非互易超导响应和探索非线性量子器件中超导二极管效应的通用框架。

articles.title: Exact magnetic ground states and competing interlayer exchanges in layered kagome magnets
articles.title_zh: 层状戈薇磁体中的精确磁基态和竞争性层间交换
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07131v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetic ground states in layered kagome magnets are investigated using a Heisenberg model with six interlayer exchange interactions. For isotropic two-sublattice models with identical diagonal Fourier exchange functions, a coplanar single-wave-vector ground state is shown to exist for arbitrary exchange ranges. Extending the three-exchange model of Rosenfeld and Mushnikov reveals that longer-range interactions can change the preferred magnetic order from spiral to ferromagnetic and back to spiral, rather than merely modifying the spiral period. The analysis includes ground-state phase diagrams, harmonic stability, magnetic-field response, and sensitivity to individual exchange interactions. The propagation vector, internal layer angle, saturation field, and planar susceptibility are also found to be insufficient to determine all six exchange constants uniquely. These results provide a basis for predicting noncollinear magnetic order from first-principles exchange interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 使用具有六个层间交换相互作用的海森堡模型研究了层状戈薇磁体中的磁基态。对于具有相同对角傅立叶交换函数的各向同性双子晶格模型，表明在任意交换范围内都存在共面单波矢量基态。扩展罗森菲尔德和穆什尼科夫的三交换模型表明，长程相互作用可以将首选磁序从螺旋变为铁磁，然后返回螺旋，而不仅仅是修改螺旋周期。分析包括基态相图、谐波稳定性、磁场响应以及对各个交换相互作用的敏感性。还发现传播矢量、内层角、饱和场和平面磁化率不足以唯一地确定所有六个交换常数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 使用具有六个层间交换相互作用的海森堡模型研究了层状戈薇磁体中的磁基态。对于具有相同对角傅立叶交换函数的各向同性双子晶格模型，表明在任意交换范围内都存在共面单波矢量基态。扩展罗森菲尔德和穆什尼科夫的三交换模型表明，长程相互作用可以将首选磁序从螺旋变为铁磁，然后返回螺旋，而不仅仅是修改螺旋周期。分析包括基态相图、谐波稳定性、磁场响应以及对各个交换相互作用的敏感性。还发现传播矢量、内层角、饱和场和平面磁化率不足以唯一地确定所有六个交换常数。这些结果为根据第一原理交换相互作用预测非共线磁序提供了基础。

articles.title: Barlow Packings All Have Maximum Packing Fraction: Why it is so Hard to Find Barlow Structures Other than fcc or hcp?
articles.title_zh: Barlow 填料均具有最大堆积分数：为什么很难找到除 fcc 或 hcp 之外的 Barlow 结构？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07197v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We apply lattice theory to periodic Barlow packings (X₁X₂dots XN)ᵢₙfₜy where XᵢinA,B,C and Xᵢ≠ Xᵢ₊₁, formed by stacking two-dimensional hexagonal close-packed layers, interacting via generalized (n,m)-Lennard-Jones potentials. The cohesive energies of all packings lie between those of hexagonal close-packed (hcp, (AB)) and face-centered cubic (fcc, (ABC)) structure and vary almost linearly with the fcc stacking fraction. The equilibrium lattice constant, bulk modulus, Einstein frequency, and vibrational entropy show similarly near-linear trends. For the standard (12,6) potential, fcc has the highest vibrational entropy and hcp the lowest, with other Barlow packings falling between them, consistent with previous sticky-hard-sphere Monte Carlo simulations and supported by phonon dispersion calculations. These trends imply an approximately linear dependence of free energy on fcc stacking fraction, with hcp and fcc as endpoints. This provides a simple thermodynamic explanation for why intermediate Barlow stackings are rare in nature: near-linearity offers little driving force to favor them. Exceptions may arise when hcp and fcc are nearly degenerate in energy or when many-body interactions, absent from the present model, favor another stacking. Density-functional calculations including dispersion forces for argon Barlow packings with periods N=2,3,4, and 12 corroborate the predicted near-linear cohesive energy dependence.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们将晶格理论应用于周期性巴洛堆积 (X₁X2dots XN)ᵢₙfₜy，其中 XᵢinA,B,C 和 Xᵢ≠ Xᵢ₊₁，由堆叠二维六角密堆积层形成，通过广义 (n,m)-Lennard-Jones 势相互作用。所有填料的内聚能介于六方密堆积 (hcp, (AB)) 和面心立方 (fcc, (ABC)) 结构之间，并且与 fcc 堆积分数几乎呈线性变化。平衡晶格常数、体积模量、爱因斯坦频率和振动熵显示出类似的近线性趋势。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们将晶格理论应用于周期性巴洛堆积 (X₁X2dots XN)ᵢₙfₜy，其中 XᵢinA,B,C 和 Xᵢ≠ Xᵢ₊₁，由堆叠二维六角密堆积层形成，通过广义 (n,m)-Lennard-Jones 势相互作用。所有填料的内聚能介于六方密堆积 (hcp, (AB)) 和面心立方 (fcc, (ABC)) 结构之间，并且与 fcc 堆积分数几乎呈线性变化。平衡晶格常数、体积模量、爱因斯坦频率和振动熵显示出类似的近线性趋势。对于标准 (12,6) 势，fcc 具有最高的振动熵，hcp 最低，其他 Barlow 填料位于它们之间，这与之前的粘性硬球蒙特卡罗模拟一致，并得到声子色散计算的支持。这些趋势意味着自由能对 fcc 堆积分数的近似线性依赖性，以 hcp 和 fcc 作为端点。这为为什么中间巴洛堆叠在自然界中很少见提供了一个简单的热力学解释：近线性几乎没有提供有利于它们的驱动力。当 hcp 和 fcc 的能量几乎简并时，或者当前模型中不存在的多体相互作用有利于另一种堆叠时，可能会出现例外。密度泛函计算（包括周期 N=2、3、4 和 12 的氩巴洛填料的色散力）证实了预测的近线性内聚能依赖性。

articles.title: A High-Dimensional Lab-Frame Model of Markovian Dynamics in Alanine Dipeptide
articles.title_zh: 丙氨酸二肽马尔可夫动力学高维实验室框架模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07200v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a high-dimensional coarse-grained model of alanine dipeptide that explicitly incorporates global translation and rotation alongside internal conformational dynamics. Using atomistic molecular dynamics trajectories, we construct a 10-bead Markovian Langevin model with a 24-dimensional internal potential of mean force and a full matrix of site-specific friction coefficients. The equilibrium landscape is represented by a Gaussian mixture model, while a rotational-entropy correction accounts for the coupling between internal conformation and global molecular motion. Friction coefficients are obtained using a generalized Einstein relation based on time-correlation functions. We show that the rotational-entropy correction is essential for obtaining a physically admissible friction matrix and significantly affects the inferred dynamics. Without fitting to coarse-grained dynamical observables, the resulting model reproduces a broad range of atomistic auto- and cross-correlation functions. The result is a compact and interpretable dynamical representation of the entire peptide at the chosen CG resolution, which explicitly preserves distinctions between energetic and dissipative coupling over a wide range of motions, including those between conformational fluctuations and global translational and rotational diffusion.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了丙氨酸二肽的高维粗粒度模型，该模型明确地将全局平移和旋转以及内部构象动力学结合起来。使用原子分子动力学轨迹，我们构建了一个 10 珠马尔可夫朗之万模型，具有 24 维平均力内势和特定位点摩擦系数的完整矩阵。平衡景观由高斯混合模型表示，而旋转熵校正则解释了内部构象和全局分子运动之间的耦合。摩擦系数是使用基于时间相关函数的广义爱因斯坦关系获得的。我们表明，旋转熵校正对于获得物理上允许的摩擦矩阵至关重要，并且会显着影响推断的动力学。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了丙氨酸二肽的高维粗粒度模型，该模型明确地将全局平移和旋转以及内部构象动力学结合起来。使用原子分子动力学轨迹，我们构建了一个 10 珠马尔可夫朗之万模型，具有 24 维平均力内势和特定位点摩擦系数的完整矩阵。平衡景观由高斯混合模型表示，而旋转熵校正则解释了内部构象和全局分子运动之间的耦合。摩擦系数是使用基于时间相关函数的广义爱因斯坦关系获得的。我们表明，旋转熵校正对于获得物理上允许的摩擦矩阵至关重要，并且会显着影响推断的动力学。在不拟合粗粒度动态可观测量的情况下，所得模型再现了广泛的原子自相关函数和互相关函数。其结果是在选定的 CG 分辨率下对整个肽进行紧凑且可解释的动态表示，它明确保留了各种运动中能量耦合和耗散耦合之间的区别，包括构象波动与全局平移和旋转扩散之间的区别。

articles.title: Confinement-induced bound state and effective potential for microwave-shielded ultracold molecules
articles.title_zh: 微波屏蔽超冷分子的约束诱导束缚态和有效势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07230v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the bound state and effective potential of microwave-shielded ultracold molecules under longitudinal confinement, which effectively creates a quasi-two-dimensional (q2D) geometry. We find that the longitudinal confinement facilitates bound-state formation in both bosonic and fermionic molecules, leading to confinement-induced bound states that are absent in free space. To describe these bound states, we establish an effective 2D potential by incorporating the full interaction effect along the longitudinal direction. Compared with other simplified 2D potentials, the effective potential accurately predicts the binding energies of ultracold molecules over a much broader parameter regime of microwave coupling and confinement strength. Remarkably, it can even predict deep bound states with binding energies well exceeding the confinement frequency. By establishing this effective potential, our work paves the way for efficiently exploring the rich low-dimensional physics of microwave-shielded ultracold molecules.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了微波屏蔽超冷分子在纵向约束下的束缚态和有效势，这有效地创建了准二维（q2D）几何形状。我们发现纵向限制促进了玻色子和费米子分子中束缚态的形成，从而导致自由空间中不存在的限制诱导的束缚态。为了描述这些束缚态，我们通过结合沿纵向的完整相互作用效应来建立有效的二维势。与其他简化的二维势相比，有效势可以在更广泛的微波耦合和限制强度参数范围内准确预测超冷分子的结合能。值得注意的是，它甚至可以预测结合能远远超过限制频率的深度束缚态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了微波屏蔽超冷分子在纵向约束下的束缚态和有效势，这有效地创建了准二维（q2D）几何形状。我们发现纵向限制促进了玻色子和费米子分子中束缚态的形成，从而导致自由空间中不存在的限制诱导的束缚态。为了描述这些束缚态，我们通过结合沿纵向的完整相互作用效应来建立有效的二维势。与其他简化的二维势相比，有效势可以在更广泛的微波耦合和限制强度参数范围内准确预测超冷分子的结合能。值得注意的是，它甚至可以预测结合能远远超过限制频率的深度束缚态。通过建立这种有效的潜力，我们的工作为有效探索微波屏蔽超冷分子丰富的低维物理铺平了道路。

articles.title: Nanoscale Inclined Four-electrode Ion Traps: Finite-Element Modelling, Floquet Stability, and Surface-Potential Response
articles.title_zh: 纳米级倾斜四电极离子阱：有限元建模、Floquet 稳定性和表面电位响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07260v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Developing miniaturised trapped-ion systems requires electrode architectures that provide controlled radio-frequency (RF) confinement while accounting for nanoscale features and surface-induced perturbations. Here, we present a finite-element investigation of an inclined four-blade RF ion-trap architecture for 171Yb+, combining pseudopotential characterisation, matrix Mathieu analysis, Floquet stability assessment, and localised surface-potential modelling. The architecture incorporates exposed electrode-face features of approximately 99-150 nm within an opposing-electrode separation of 20 um. At an electrode inclination of 6 degrees, an RF amplitude of 150 V, and a drive frequency of 15 MHz, the calculated pseudopotential exhibits directional in-plane barriers of 3.430 and 3.389 meV along the principal diagonal paths. The full RF-potential Hessian, including off-diagonal coupling terms, is used to construct the matrix Mathieu equation. Numerical propagation over one RF period identifies two dominant motional branches with secular-frequency estimates of 1.8137 and 1.8181 MHz. A third, predominantly axial branch exhibits a nominal frequency near 7.90 kHz, although its quantitative resolution is limited by the residual Hessian trace and phase-return drift. Additionally, a four-source electrostatic model is developed to investigate the effects of localised surface potentials on modal electric-field responses. Parametric analysis reveals correlation-dependent suppression and enhancement of normalised response coefficients, with multipliers ranging from approximately 0.5 to 1.5. This study establishes a computational framework for investigating nanoscale inclined blade-electrode architectures, their motional characteristics, and surface-potential responses, while highlighting numerical convergence requirements for reliable three-dimensional trap characterisation.
articles.abstract_zh: 开发小型化捕获离子系统需要电极架构能够提供受控射频 (RF) 限制，同时考虑纳米级特征和表面引起的扰动。在这里，我们结合了赝电势表征、矩阵 Mathieu 分析、Floquet 稳定性评估和局部表面电势建模，对 171Yb+ 的倾斜四叶片射频离子阱架构进行了有限元研究。该架构在 20 微米的相对电极间距内结合了大约 99-150 纳米的暴露电极面特征。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 开发小型化捕获离子系统需要电极架构能够提供受控射频 (RF) 限制，同时考虑纳米级特征和表面引起的扰动。在这里，我们结合了赝电势表征、矩阵 Mathieu 分析、Floquet 稳定性评估和局部表面电势建模，对 171Yb+ 的倾斜四叶片射频离子阱架构进行了有限元研究。该架构在 20 微米的相对电极间距内结合了大约 99-150 纳米的暴露电极面特征。在电极倾角为 6 度、射频幅度为 150 V、驱动频率为 15 MHz 时，计算出的赝电势沿主对角线路径呈现出 3.430 和 3.389 meV 的定向面内势垒。完整的 RF 势 Hessian 矩阵（包括非对角线耦合项）用于构造矩阵 Mathieu 方程。一个 RF 周期内的数值传播确定了两个主要运动分支，其长期频率估计值为 1.8137 和 1.8181 MHz。第三个主要是轴向分支，其标称频率接近 7.90 kHz，尽管其定量分辨率受到残余 Hessian 迹线和相返回漂移的限制。此外，还开发了四源静电模型来研究局部表面电势对模态电场响应的影响。参数分析揭示了归一化响应系数的相关性抑制和增强，乘数范围约为 0.5 至 1.5。这项研究建立了一个计算框架，用于研究纳米级倾斜刀片电极结构、其运动特性和表面电位响应，同时强调可靠的三维陷阱表征的数值收敛要求。

articles.title: Dark-State Coherent Control of Excitons in TMD Monolayers: A Reduced Intravalley Lindblad Framework for WSe₂
articles.title_zh: TMD 单层激子的暗态相干控制：WSe2 的简化谷内 Lindblad 框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07315v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Dark-state coherence in driven three-level systems underlies electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT) and stimulated Raman adiabatic passage (STIRAP). Their performance depends on the coupling topology: in a ladder (Ξ) scheme the coherence can bypass a lossy intermediate state, whereas in a V scheme it is carried by two excited states that both decay. We develop a topology-resolved Lindblad framework for driven three-level excitonic manifolds at fixed center-of-mass momentum, in which a single exciton couples to phonons, the radiation field and a dilute exciton gas. The Ξ and V manifolds are selected from the exciton spectrum by systematically screening optical brightness, intra-excitonic dipole strength and state compactness, making the selection reproducible and transferable to other materials. Within this framework, in the Ξ manifold of hBN-encapsulated WSe₂, a weak optical pulse, preceded by a terahertz pulse in the counterintuitive STIRAP order, converts the excitation it creates into an optically dark exciton by dark-state following, while the lossy bright intermediate exciton stays nearly empty. The conversion is limited by emission from that intermediate state rather than by non-adiabatic coupling, and is controlled by a single adiabaticity parameter of the terahertz leg. The exchange mean field of the exciton gas shifts the two-photon resonance by more than the conversion tolerates at moderate densities; the center of the cascade transparency window provides an in situ calibration, and we identify the control strengths at which it is true EIT rather than Autler--Townes splitting. The V manifold loses its coherence on the radiative timescale and serves as the unprotected reference. These results provide a minimal, material-specific baseline for dark-state coherent control of excitons in two-dimensional semiconductors in the radiative limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 驱动三能级系统中的暗态相干性是电磁感应透明（EIT）和受激拉曼绝热通道（STIRAP）的基础。它们的性能取决于耦合拓扑：在梯形 (Ξ) 方案中，相干性可以绕过有损中间态，而在 V 方案中，它由两个都衰减的激发态承载。我们开发了一种拓扑解析的 Lindblad 框架，用于固定质心动量驱动的三能级激子流形，其中单个激子与声子、辐射场和稀激子气体耦合。通过系统地筛选光学亮度、激子内偶极子强度和态致密性，从激子光谱中选择 Ξ 和 V 流形，使选择可重复并可转移到其他材料。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 驱动三能级系统中的暗态相干性是电磁感应透明（EIT）和受激拉曼绝热通道（STIRAP）的基础。它们的性能取决于耦合拓扑：在梯形 (Ξ) 方案中，相干性可以绕过有损中间态，而在 V 方案中，它由两个都衰减的激发态承载。我们开发了一种拓扑解析的 Lindblad 框架，用于固定质心动量驱动的三能级激子流形，其中单个激子与声子、辐射场和稀激子气体耦合。通过系统地筛选光学亮度、激子内偶极子强度和态致密性，从激子光谱中选择 Ξ 和 V 流形，使选择可重复并可转移到其他材料。在此框架内，在 hBN 封装的 WSe2 的 Ξ 流形中，一个弱光脉冲（前面是违反直觉的 STIRAP 顺序的太赫兹脉冲）通过暗态跟踪将其产生的激发转换为光学暗激子，而有损的明亮中间激子几乎保持为空。该转换受到中间态发射的限制，而不是非绝热耦合的限制，并且由太赫兹腿的单个绝热参数控制。激子气体的交换平均场使双光子共振移动超过中等密度下的转换容忍度；级联透明窗口的中心提供了原位校准，我们确定了真正的 EIT 而不是 Autler-Townes 分裂的控制强度。 V 流形在辐射时间尺度上失去了相干性并充当未受保护的参考。这些结果为二维半导体中激子在辐射极限下的暗态相干控制提供了最小的、特定于材料的基线。

articles.title: Observable-Based Learning of Effective Entanglement Hamiltonians
articles.title_zh: 有效纠缠哈密顿量的基于可观察的学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07353v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Determining the entanglement Hamiltonian (EH) of an interacting quantum many-body system remains a fundamental challenge beyond special analytically tractable cases. Here we develop an observable-matching framework for learning effective EHs, which we demonstrate using response estimates from quantum Monte Carlo. As applications of this framework, we first calibrate the overall prefactor of the lattice Bisognano--Wichmann (LBW) construction using equal-time correlations and then learn spatially resolved couplings beyond its prescribed profile, without assuming a specific functional form for their spatial dependence. Trained solely on local correlations, the learned EHs reproduce benchmarked von Neumann and second Rényi entropies in 1D and second Rényi entropies in 2D. For a strong-bond cut associated with special surface criticality at the (2+1)D O(3) Wilson--Fisher critical point, free-form learning outperforms the calibrated LBW ansatz in predicting the second Rényi entropy and reveals spatially nonuniform coupling renormalizations. Importantly, the learned EH also provides access to the von Neumann entropy in this setting, revealing a negative subleading correction and extending previous Rényi entropy findings to the von Neumann case. Directly evaluating the von Neumann entropy in such (2+1)D interacting quantum many-body systems remains challenging for conventional numerical methods. These results establish observable-based learning as a route to constructing effective entanglement Hamiltonians beyond prescribed spatial profiles in higher-dimensional interacting systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 除了特殊的分析易处理情况之外，确定相互作用的量子多体系统的纠缠哈密顿量（EH）仍然是一个基本挑战。在这里，我们开发了一个用于学习有效 EH 的可观察匹配框架，我们使用量子蒙特卡罗的响应估计来演示该框架。作为该框架的应用，我们首先使用等时间相关性校准晶格 Bisognano-Wichmann (LBW) 结构的整体前因子，然后学习超出其规定轮廓的空间解析耦合，而不假设其空间依赖性的特定函数形式。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 除了特殊的分析易处理情况之外，确定相互作用的量子多体系统的纠缠哈密顿量（EH）仍然是一个基本挑战。在这里，我们开发了一个用于学习有效 EH 的可观察匹配框架，我们使用量子蒙特卡罗的响应估计来演示该框架。作为该框架的应用，我们首先使用等时间相关性校准晶格 Bisognano-Wichmann (LBW) 结构的整体前因子，然后学习超出其规定轮廓的空间解析耦合，而不假设其空间依赖性的特定函数形式。仅根据局部相关性进行训练，学习到的 EH 重现一维中的基准冯诺依曼熵和第二 Rényi 熵以及二维中的第二 Rényi 熵。对于与 (2+1)D O(3) Wilson-Fisher 临界点处的特殊表面临界相关的强键切割，自由形式学习在预测第二个 Rényi 熵方面优于校准的 LBW ansatz，并揭示了空间非均匀耦合重正化。重要的是，学习到的 EH 还提供了在这种情况下访问冯·诺依曼熵的方法，揭示了负的次领先修正并将之前的 Rényi 熵发现扩展到冯·诺依曼的情况。对于传统的数值方法来说，直接评估此类 (2+1)D 相互作用的量子多体系统中的冯诺依曼熵仍然具有挑战性。这些结果建立了基于可观察的学习作为在高维交互系统中构建超出规定空间轮廓的有效纠缠哈密顿量的途径。

articles.title: Extensions of the Haldane gap proof: higher dimensions, near degeneracy, fermions and tensor-network states
articles.title_zh: Haldane 间隙证明的扩展：更高维度、近简并性、费米子和张量网络状态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07400v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A recent remarkable paper by OpenAI showed that the spin-one Heisenberg chain with periodic boundary conditions has a spectral gap in the thermodynamic limit. The proof elegantly deduces this gap from the Hamiltonian's spectrum on a finite system. This basic idea is an inequality involving the purity of the original Gibbs state and a dual Gibbs state that is defined via space-time rotation. Here we consider a few generalizations of this purity bootstrap argument. We first extend it to arbitrary spatial dimensions. Our main result uses the space-time duality between symmetry generators and symmetry twists to obtain upper bounds on the splitting of nearly degenerate low-energy states, together with a nonzero gap above them, from finite-system information. As applications, we show that finite-system calculations for the 2+1-D toric code in a field and the 2+1-D transverse-field Ising model establish parameter regimes with four and two low-lying states whose splittings are bounded from above by e⁻cL and e⁻cL^² respectively for arbitrarily large system size L, while the gap above these states remains nonzero in the thermodynamic limit. Next, we extend it to fermionic systems and use a finite calculation to establish a symmetric mass generation phase in a 2+1-D fermionic model. Finally, we apply the bootstrap to tensor-network states and establish exponential decay of connected correlations of all local operators in the symmetric square-lattice spin-one state introduced by Jian and Zaletel.
articles.abstract_zh: OpenAI 最近发表的一篇引人注目的论文表明，具有周期性边界条件的自旋一海森堡链在热力学极限上存在光谱间隙。该证明从有限系统上的哈密顿量谱优雅地推导出了这个差距。这个基本思想是涉及原始吉布斯状态的纯度和通过时空旋转定义的对偶吉布斯状态的不等式。在这里，我们考虑这个纯度引导论证的一些概括。我们首先将其扩展到任意空间维度。我们的主要结果利用对称生成器和对称扭曲之间的时空对偶性，从有限系统信息中获得近简并低能态分裂的上限，以及它们上方的非零间隙。
articles.abstract_zh_full: OpenAI 最近发表的一篇引人注目的论文表明，具有周期性边界条件的自旋一海森堡链在热力学极限上存在光谱间隙。该证明从有限系统上的哈密顿量谱优雅地推导出了这个差距。这个基本思想是涉及原始吉布斯状态的纯度和通过时空旋转定义的对偶吉布斯状态的不等式。在这里，我们考虑这个纯度引导论证的一些概括。我们首先将其扩展到任意空间维度。我们的主要结果利用对称生成器和对称扭曲之间的时空对偶性，从有限系统信息中获得近简并低能态分裂的上限，以及它们上方的非零间隙。作为应用，我们证明了场中 2+1-D 环面码和 2+1-D 横向场 Ising 模型的有限系统计算建立了具有四个和两个低位态的参数范围，对于任意大的系统尺寸 L，其分裂分别由 e⁻cL 和 e⁻cL^² 从上方限制，而这些状态之上的间隙在热力学极限中保持非零。接下来，我们将其扩展到费米子系统，并使用有限计算在 2+1-D 费米子模型中建立对称质量生成相。最后，我们将自举法应用于张量网络状态，并在Jian和Zaletel引入的对称方格自旋一状态下建立所有局部算子的连通相关性的指数衰减。

articles.title: Prediction of antimagnon-polarons with intrinsic momentum-space level attraction
articles.title_zh: 具有内在动量空间水平吸引力的反磁振子极化子的预测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07434v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Propagating hybrid quasiparticles formed by magnons and phonons (magnon-polarons) or photons (magnon-polaritons) typically exhibit level repulsion in momentum space. Level attraction, by contrast, requires an anti-phase channel and has so far been restricted to zero-dimensional systems mediated by dissipative baths. Here we predict the antimagnon-polaron in a continuous magnetoelastic medium, which inherently exhibits momentum-space level attraction. The spin-orbit-torque (SOT)-stabilized antimagnon precesses with opposite handedness, directly reversing the magnetoelastic coupling without requiring an external environment. This intrinsic attraction yields a distinctive 0/π phase-locked simultaneous growth. Micromagnetic simulations confirm this picture, revealing that the SOT-controlled balance between gain and damping drives a collective instability. This ultimately enables a continuously tunable, dc-pumped, single-frequency phonon laser, establishing a novel route for coherent acoustic emission.
articles.abstract_zh: 由磁振子和声子（磁振子极化子）或光子（磁振子极化子）形成的传播混合准粒子通常在动量空间中表现出水平排斥。相比之下，能级吸引力需要反相通道，并且迄今为止仅限于由耗散浴介导的零维系统。在这里，我们预测连续磁弹性介质中的反磁子极化子，它本质上表现出动量空间水平吸引力。自旋轨道扭矩（SOT）稳定的反磁子进动具有相反的旋向，无需外部环境即可直接反转磁弹性耦合。这种内在的吸引力产生了独特的 0/π 锁相同步生长。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由磁振子和声子（磁振子极化子）或光子（磁振子极化子）形成的传播混合准粒子通常在动量空间中表现出水平排斥。相比之下，能级吸引力需要反相通道，并且迄今为止仅限于由耗散浴介导的零维系统。在这里，我们预测连续磁弹性介质中的反磁子极化子，它本质上表现出动量空间水平吸引力。自旋轨道扭矩（SOT）稳定的反磁子进动具有相反的旋向，无需外部环境即可直接反转磁弹性耦合。这种内在的吸引力产生了独特的 0/π 锁相同步生长。微磁模拟证实了这一点，揭示了 SOT 控制的增益和阻尼之间的平衡导致了集体不稳定。这最终实现了连续可调、直流泵浦、单频声子激光器，为相干声发射建立了一条新途径。

articles.title: Supermoiré Formation and Robust Topological Edge State in Helical Trilayer Graphene
articles.title_zh: 螺旋三层石墨烯中的超级云纹形成和鲁棒拓扑边缘态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07435v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When two materials with nearly matched lattice constants meet, they form commensurate domains separated by incommensurate domain walls that absorb the mismatch. Recently, this picture has been extended to moiré lattices: when two moiré superlattices have nearly equal periodicities, they can form a "supermoiré" consisting of commensurate moiré domains separated by domain walls. Helical trilayer graphene (HTG) is a particularly interesting example: theory predicts that its commensurate domains are distinct topological insulators, separated by a network of conducting domain walls. Here, we use scanning tunneling microscopy and spectroscopy to visualize supermoiré domains and their electronic properties in HTG at a twist angle of sim1.7^circ. We find atomic-scale evidence of relaxation into supermoiré domains, each hosting flat bands separated from remote bands by large gaps of sim40 meV. Domain walls exhibit spectrally uniform edge states along their length, in excellent agreement with calculations for valley-protected topological edge modes. The topological character of the flat bands is intimately tied to wavefunction localization on a graphene sublattice, and we reveal the topological change across a domain boundary by imaging the reversal of sublattice polarization.
articles.abstract_zh: 当两种具有几乎匹配的晶格常数的材料相遇时，它们会形成由不相称的畴壁分隔开的相称的域，吸收不匹配。最近，这一图景已扩展到莫尔晶格：当两个莫尔超晶格具有几乎相等的周期性时，它们可以形成由由畴壁分隔的相称莫尔域组成的“超级莫尔条纹”。螺旋三层石墨烯（HTG）是一个特别有趣的例子：理论预测其相应的域是不同的拓扑绝缘体，由导电域壁网络分隔开。在这里，我们使用扫描隧道显微镜和光谱学以 sim1.7^circ 的扭转角来可视化 HTG 中的超摩尔纹域及其电子特性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 当两种具有几乎匹配的晶格常数的材料相遇时，它们会形成由不相称的畴壁分隔开的相称的域，吸收不匹配。最近，这一图景已扩展到莫尔晶格：当两个莫尔超晶格具有几乎相等的周期性时，它们可以形成由由畴壁分隔的相称莫尔域组成的“超级莫尔条纹”。螺旋三层石墨烯（HTG）是一个特别有趣的例子：理论预测其相应的域是不同的拓扑绝缘体，由导电域壁网络分隔开。在这里，我们使用扫描隧道显微镜和光谱学以 sim1.7^circ 的扭转角来可视化 HTG 中的超摩尔纹域及其电子特性。我们发现了超莫尔域弛豫的原子尺度证据，每个域都有平坦的能带，与遥远的能带以 sim40 meV 的大间隙分开。畴壁沿其长度表现出光谱均匀的边缘状态，与谷保护拓扑边缘模式的计算非常一致。平带的拓扑特征与石墨烯亚晶格上的波函数定位密切相关，我们通过对亚晶格极化的反转进行成像来揭示跨域边界的拓扑变化。

articles.title: Probing Non-Abelian Topology through Quench Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 通过淬火动力学探索非阿贝尔拓扑
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07456v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quench dynamics offer valuable insights to topological matter, wherein the emergent topological phenomena serve as a dynamic probe to the topology of static Hamiltonians. While such a practice has been widely applied to detect the Abelian band topology or the Euler-class topology of band nodes, little is known regarding the quench dynamics of non-Abelian topological insulators in multiband systems, where the intertwining geometry of all eigenstates necessitates the description of noncommutative topological charges. Here we propose a quench protocol for non-Abelian topological insulators, so that the underlying topology can be systematically probed using dynamic signatures. Specifically, we develop a band-projection scheme to extract the gap-resolved topology from dynamic skyrmions in the emergent quasimomentum--time manifolds of the quench processes. These skyrmions are characterized by a series of gap-resolved dynamic Chern numbers, which enable us to reconstruct the full non-Abelian topology of the post-quench Hamiltonian, including the global non-Abelian topological charge and edge-state patterns under the open-boundary condition. Our proposal offers dynamical access to non-Abelian topology in multiband systems, and can be readily implemented using photons or cold atoms.
articles.abstract_zh: 淬火动力学为拓扑物质提供了有价值的见解，其中出现的拓扑现象可以作为静态哈密顿量拓扑的动态探针。虽然这种做法已广泛应用于检测阿贝尔带拓扑或带节点的欧拉级拓扑，但对于多带系统中非阿贝尔拓扑绝缘体的失超动力学知之甚少，其中所有本征态的交织几何结构需要描述非交换拓扑电荷。在这里，我们提出了一种用于非阿贝尔拓扑绝缘体的淬灭协议，以便可以使用动态签名系统地探测底层拓扑。具体来说，我们开发了一种能带投影方案，从淬灭过程中出现的拟动量时间流形中的动态斯格明子中提取间隙解析拓扑。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 淬火动力学为拓扑物质提供了有价值的见解，其中出现的拓扑现象可以作为静态哈密顿量拓扑的动态探针。虽然这种做法已广泛应用于检测阿贝尔带拓扑或带节点的欧拉级拓扑，但对于多带系统中非阿贝尔拓扑绝缘体的失超动力学知之甚少，其中所有本征态的交织几何结构需要描述非交换拓扑电荷。在这里，我们提出了一种用于非阿贝尔拓扑绝缘体的淬灭协议，以便可以使用动态签名系统地探测底层拓扑。具体来说，我们开发了一种能带投影方案，从淬灭过程中出现的拟动量时间流形中的动态斯格明子中提取间隙解析拓扑。这些斯格明子的特征是一系列能隙解析的动态陈数，这使我们能够重建淬火后哈密顿量的完整非阿贝尔拓扑，包括开放边界条件下的全局非阿贝尔拓扑电荷和边缘态模式。我们的建议提供了对多带系统中非阿贝尔拓扑的动态访问，并且可以使用光子或冷原子轻松实现。

articles.title: Electrical conductivity of a two-dimensional two-component medium: discretization and effective medium approximation
articles.title_zh: 二维双组分介质的电导率：离散化和有效介质近似
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07491v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The effective conductivity of a two-dimensional two-component medium is studied within a discretization scheme and the effective-medium approximation (EMA). A square lattice is superimposed on a random isotropic medium; each cell is assigned the conductivity of its majority component, and the cell is replaced by a star of four resistors. Neighboring cells are connected by an equivalent resistor whose conductivity is σ₁, σ₂, or the harmonic mean σ₁₂=2σ₁σ₂/(σ₁+σ₂), with probabilities (1-p)², p², and 2p(1-p), respectively. Applying Foster's theorem and the EMA yields a closed equation for the dimensionless effective conductivity x and, after transformation, a cubic equation whose coefficients depend on p and the conductivity ratio r. The EMA predictions are compared with direct calculations on a 200×200 resistor network with periodic lateral boundary conditions and Dirichlet conditions on the top and bottom. For uncorrelated disorder, good agreement is found. For correlated disorder, when resistor conductivities are assigned according to the discretization rule from the colors of adjacent nodes, significant deviations appear and the percolation-like inflection point shifts to the right of 1/2. The results question the validity of the correlated-disorder EMA approach and help explain discrepancies previously reported for random nanowire networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 在离散化方案和有效介质近似 (EMA) 内研究二维双组分介质的有效电导率。方形晶格叠加在随机各向同性介质上；每个单元都被分配了其主要成分的电导率，并且该单元被四个星形电阻器所取代。相邻单元通过等效电阻连接，其电导率为 σ1、σ2 或调和平均值 σ12=2σ1σ2/(σ1+σ2)，概率分别为 (1-p)2、p2 和 2p(1-p)。应用福斯特定理和 EMA 可得出无量纲有效电导率 x 的闭合方程，并在变换后生成其系数取决于 p 和电导率比 r 的三次方程。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在离散化方案和有效介质近似 (EMA) 内研究二维双组分介质的有效电导率。方形晶格叠加在随机各向同性介质上；每个单元都被分配了其主要成分的电导率，并且该单元被四个星形电阻器所取代。相邻单元通过等效电阻连接，其电导率为 σ1、σ2 或调和平均值 σ12=2σ1σ2/(σ1+σ2)，概率分别为 (1-p)2、p2 和 2p(1-p)。应用福斯特定理和 EMA 可得出无量纲有效电导率 x 的闭合方程，并在变换后生成其系数取决于 p 和电导率比 r 的三次方程。将 EMA 预测与在具有周期性横向边界条件和顶部和底部狄利克雷条件的 200×200 电阻网络上的直接计算进行比较。对于不相关的无序，发现了良好的一致性。对于相关无序，当电阻器电导率根据相邻节点的颜色的离散化规则分配时，出现显着的偏差，并且渗滤式拐点向右移动1/2。结果质疑相关无序 EMA 方法的有效性，并有助于解释先前报道的随机纳米线网络的差异。

articles.title: Interfacial polarity control of anomalous Hall effect in LaCoO3-SrIrO3 heterostructures
articles.title_zh: LaCoO3-SrIrO3 异质结构中反常霍尔效应的界面极性控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07501v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Interfacial polarity in oxide heterostructures can drive robust charge redistribution across the interface, yet its role in tailoring topological transport phenomena like the anomalous Hall effect (AHE) remains largely unexplored. Here, we control the sign of polarity-induced charge in SrIrO3-LaCoO3 interfaces by independently engineering the layer stacking sequence and the atomic termination. In-situ angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy directly confirms the sign reversal of the induced charge in SrIrO3 through the contrasting electronic band shifts between different interfacial configurations. Magneto-transport measurements across a systematic matrix of four distinct heterostructures reveal that the AHE can be cleanly toggled on and off: it emerges exclusively under electron-doped conditions, while remaining suppressed for hole-doped SrIrO3. Our results establish that this response originates from an intrinsic, Berry-curvature-driven mechanism governed by polarity-controlled band filling of SrIrO3. These findings shift interfacial polarity from a passive structural consequence to an active design variable for engineering topological quantum states in oxide heterostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 氧化物异质结构中的界面极性可以驱动界面上强大的电荷重新分布，但其在调节异常霍尔效应（AHE）等拓扑传输现象中的作用仍然很大程度上未被探索。在这里，我们通过独立设计层堆叠顺序和原子终止来控制 SrIrO3-LaCoO3 界面中极性感应电荷的符号。原位角分辨光电子能谱通过不同界面结构之间的对比电子带移动直接证实了 SrIrO3 中感应电荷的符号反转。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 氧化物异质结构中的界面极性可以驱动界面上强大的电荷重新分布，但其在调节异常霍尔效应（AHE）等拓扑传输现象中的作用仍然很大程度上未被探索。在这里，我们通过独立设计层堆叠顺序和原子终止来控制 SrIrO3-LaCoO3 界面中极性感应电荷的符号。原位角分辨光电子能谱通过不同界面结构之间的对比电子带移动直接证实了 SrIrO3 中感应电荷的符号反转。对四个不同异质结构的系统矩阵的磁输运测量表明，AHE 可以干净地打开和关闭：它仅在电子掺杂条件下出现，同时对空穴掺杂 SrIrO3 保持抑制。我们的结果表明，这种响应源于一种内在的贝里曲率驱动机制，该机制由 SrIrO3 的极性控制带填充控制。这些发现将界面极性从被动结构结果转变为主动设计变量，用于工程氧化物异质结构中的拓扑量子态。

articles.title: Chiral-vibration-induced magnetism and circular dichroism in organic molecules
articles.title_zh: 有机分子中手性振动诱导的磁性和圆二色性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07511v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the vibrational inverse Faraday effect and transient vibrational circular dichroism in benzene, coronene, and methane at the single-molecule level. We combine density-functional tight-binding calculations with damped normal-mode dynamics. Circularly polarized light excites suitable degenerate infrared-active modes, driving chiral nuclear motion that produces effective magnetic moments. Reversing the pump helicity reverses the vibrational chirality and the sign of the transient dichroic response. These results support a writing-readout scheme in which circularly polarized pumping prepares a chiral vibrational state and transient vibrational circular dichroism probes its handedness. We further examine how molecular symmetry shapes the light-induced chiral response across the three molecular systems. This work provides a valuable platform for exploring all-optical control of magnetism and chiroptical probing at the molecular scale.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们在单分子水平上研究了苯、晕苯和甲烷的振动反法拉第效应和瞬态振动圆二色性。我们将密度泛函紧束缚计算与阻尼简正模动力学相结合。圆偏振光激发合适的简并红外活性模式，驱动产生有效磁矩的手性核运动。反转泵螺旋性会反转振动手性和瞬态二向色响应的符号。这些结果支持一种写入-读出方案，其中圆偏振泵浦准备手性振动状态，瞬态振动圆二色性探测其旋向性。我们进一步研究分子对称性如何影响三个分子系统的光诱导手性响应。这项工作为探索分子尺度的磁性全光学控制和手性光学探测提供了一个有价值的平台。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们在单分子水平上研究了苯、晕苯和甲烷的振动反法拉第效应和瞬态振动圆二色性。我们将密度泛函紧束缚计算与阻尼简正模动力学相结合。圆偏振光激发合适的简并红外活性模式，驱动产生有效磁矩的手性核运动。反转泵螺旋性会反转振动手性和瞬态二向色响应的符号。这些结果支持一种写入-读出方案，其中圆偏振泵浦准备手性振动状态，瞬态振动圆二色性探测其旋向性。我们进一步研究分子对称性如何影响三个分子系统的光诱导手性响应。这项工作为探索分子尺度的磁性全光学控制和手性光学探测提供了一个有价值的平台。

articles.title: Nonequilibrium orientational bistability of a magnetically-driven slender particle
articles.title_zh: 磁驱动细长粒子的非平衡取向双稳态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07538v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Externally driven systems are non-equilibrium but accessible to stationary states. By combining theoretical calculations and particle-based simulations, we investigate the orientational configuration of a transversely-magnetized slender particle in a rotating magnetic field. Our results reveal nonequilibrium orientational bistability in both regimes that the particle rotates synchronously and asynchronously with the field. The relative populations of standing and lying orientations depend strongly on the driving frequency in the synchronous regime, whereas they are primarily controlled by the magnetic field strength in the asynchronous regime. Effective free-energy approximations further capture the principal features of the steady-state orientational distributions in both regimes. Our work aims to give a statistical-thermodynamic description of orientational bistability in magnetically-driven slender particles, paving the way for relevant experimental designs and advanced applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 外部驱动系统是非平衡的，但可以达到静止状态。通过结合理论计算和基于粒子的模拟，我们研究了旋转磁场中横向磁化细长粒子的取向配置。我们的结果揭示了粒子与场同步和异步旋转两种状态下的非平衡取向双稳态。站立和躺着方向的相对数量很大程度上取决于同步区域中的驱动频率，而它们主要由异步区域中的磁场强度控制。有效的自由能近似进一步捕捉了两种状态下稳态取向分布的主要特征。我们的工作旨在对磁驱动细长颗粒中的取向双稳定性进行统计热力学描述，为相关实验设计和高级应用铺平道路。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 外部驱动系统是非平衡的，但可以达到静止状态。通过结合理论计算和基于粒子的模拟，我们研究了旋转磁场中横向磁化细长粒子的取向配置。我们的结果揭示了粒子与场同步和异步旋转两种状态下的非平衡取向双稳态。站立和躺着方向的相对数量很大程度上取决于同步区域中的驱动频率，而它们主要由异步区域中的磁场强度控制。有效的自由能近似进一步捕捉了两种状态下稳态取向分布的主要特征。我们的工作旨在对磁驱动细长颗粒中的取向双稳定性进行统计热力学描述，为相关实验设计和高级应用铺平道路。

articles.title: Majorana corner modes and tunable braiding in an altermagnet-superconductor heterostructure
articles.title_zh: 交流磁体-超导体异质结构中的马约拉纳角模式和可调编织
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07645v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Zeeman fields are usually required for realizing and manipulating Majorana corner modes at the cost of suppressed superconducting pairing. Altermagnetism offers a new route toward realizing Majorana corner modes under zero net external magnetic fields. Here we propose a theoretical scheme to host Majorana corner modes in a honeycomb-lattice altermagnet-superconductor heterostructure. In contrast to previous studies on square lattices, altermagnetism yields distinct effective low-energy edge masses on various inequivalent edges of the honeycomb lattice. Within a low-energy edge-theory framework, we establish the conditions under which Majorana corner modes emerge for both bearded and zigzag edge terminations. We further explicitly construct a complete set of Clifford gates by tuning the altermagnetic anisotropy and chemical potential of the heterostructure. Our results provide a promising platform for the realization and manipulation of Majorana corner modes.
articles.abstract_zh: 通常需要塞曼场来实现和操纵马约拉纳角模式，但代价是抑制超导配对。交变磁学为在零净外部磁场下实现马约拉纳角模式提供了一条新途径。在这里，我们提出了一种在蜂窝晶格交替磁体-超导体异质结构中承载马约拉纳角模式的理论方案。与之前对方形晶格的研究相反，交变磁力在蜂窝晶格的各种不等价边缘上产生明显的有效低能边缘质量。在低能量边缘理论框架内，我们建立了胡须边缘和锯齿形边缘终端出现马约拉纳角模式的条件。我们通过调整异质结构的交变磁各向异性和化学势进一步明确构建了一套完整的克利福德门。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通常需要塞曼场来实现和操纵马约拉纳角模式，但代价是抑制超导配对。交变磁学为在零净外部磁场下实现马约拉纳角模式提供了一条新途径。在这里，我们提出了一种在蜂窝晶格交替磁体-超导体异质结构中承载马约拉纳角模式的理论方案。与之前对方形晶格的研究相反，交变磁力在蜂窝晶格的各种不等价边缘上产生明显的有效低能边缘质量。在低能量边缘理论框架内，我们建立了胡须边缘和锯齿形边缘终端出现马约拉纳角模式的条件。我们通过调整异质结构的交变磁各向异性和化学势进一步明确构建了一套完整的克利福德门。我们的结果为马约拉纳角模式的实现和操纵提供了一个有前景的平台。

articles.title: Ground-state properties of uniaxial magnetic model for antiferromagnetic 1/1 periodic approximants to icosahedral quasicrystals
articles.title_zh: 二十面体准晶反铁磁1/1周期近似的单轴磁模型的基态特性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07660v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The ground-state properties of the uniaxial magnetic model in the 1/1 periodic approximant to the icosahedral quasicrystal with antiferromagnetic interactions for the nearest-neighbor bond J₁ and the next-nearest-neighbor bond J₂ are analyzed theoretically. By performing numerically-exact calculation, we have determined the ground-state phase diagram for the interaction strength J₂/J₁ and the magnetic anisotropy defined within the mirror plane reflecting the effect of the crystalline electric field. We have discovered non-collinear magnetic structures, whose magnetic space groups are identified as the antiferromagnetic orders Iᵣₘ Pm'bar3' and Rᵣₘ Rbar3 with the magnetic propagation vector (111) as well as the antiferromagnetic orders Im'm'm' and Rbar3' with the magnetic propagation vector (000) and the ferrimagnetic orders Im'm'2, I2'2'2, P2'/m', and Pbar1. By analyzing each ground state with degeneracy, we have revealed the magnetic as well as topological properties, which are useful to analyze experimental observations of rare-earth-based 1/1 approximants considering the effect of magnetic domains.
articles.abstract_zh: 对近邻键J₁和次近邻键J2具有反铁磁相互作用的二十面体准晶1/1周期近似的单轴磁模型的基态特性进行了理论分析。通过进行精确的数值计算，我们确定了相互作用强度 J2/J1 的基态相图以及反映晶体电场效应的镜面内定义的磁各向异性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对近邻键J₁和次近邻键J2具有反铁磁相互作用的二十面体准晶1/1周期近似的单轴磁模型的基态特性进行了理论分析。通过进行精确的数值计算，我们确定了相互作用强度 J2/J1 的基态相图以及反映晶体电场效应的镜面内定义的磁各向异性。我们发现了非共线磁结构，其磁空间群被识别为具有磁传播矢量（111）的反铁磁阶 Iᵣₘ Pm'bar3' 和 Rᵣₘ Rbar3，以及具有磁传播矢量（000）的反铁磁阶 Im'm'm' 和 Rbar3' 以及亚铁磁阶 Im'm'2、I2'2'2、P2'/m' 和Pbar1。通过分析简并基态，我们揭示了磁性和拓扑性质，这对于分析考虑磁畴影响的稀土基 1/1 近似值的实验观察非常有用。

articles.title: Solvable macroscopic models for populations of type I excitability neurons with Gaussian noise
articles.title_zh: 具有高斯噪声的 I 型兴奋性神经元群体的可解宏观模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07714v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The dynamics of type I excitability neurons near the bifurcation point are governed by the model of quadratic integrate-and-fire neuron (QIF). The model of QIF subject to white Gaussian noise is abundant in statistical physics, since it not only reasonably reproduces the dynamics of some biological systems but also emerges in the problems of stochastic stability and in quantum mechanics of one-dimensional systems with quenched disorder. We derive the solution for the mean interspike interval of a QIF subject to additive Gaussian noise in terms of analytic functions, from the first passage time problem. On the basis of this solution, we construct analytical expressions for the firing rate and population-mean membrane potential in terms of the real and imaginary parts of a certain universal analytic function. With this function, we generalize theoretical results to heterogeneous populations with Lorentzian-distributed parameters. Implementation of theoretical results is demonstrated and examined for two problems: the interplay between chemical and electrical synapses, and the emergence of effective endogenous noise in sparse inhibitory networks. For the latter case, it is possible to cover the scenarios where the effective noise intensity depends on Lorentzian-distributed parameters, which is not feasible directly with the diffusion approximation.
articles.abstract_zh: 分叉点附近的 I 型兴奋性神经元的动力学由二次积分激发神经元 (QIF) 模型控制。受高斯白噪声影响的QIF模型在统计物理学中非常丰富，因为它不仅合理地再现了一些生物系统的动力学，而且还出现在随机稳定性问题和具有猝灭无序的一维系统的量子力学问题中。我们根据第一个通过时间问题，以解析函数的形式推导出受加性高斯噪声影响的 QIF 的平均峰间间隔的解。在此解决方案的基础上，我们根据某个通用解析函数的实部和虚部构建了放电率和群体平均膜电位的解析表达式。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 分叉点附近的 I 型兴奋性神经元的动力学由二次积分激发神经元 (QIF) 模型控制。受高斯白噪声影响的QIF模型在统计物理学中非常丰富，因为它不仅合理地再现了一些生物系统的动力学，而且还出现在随机稳定性问题和具有猝灭无序的一维系统的量子力学问题中。我们根据第一个通过时间问题，以解析函数的形式推导出受加性高斯噪声影响的 QIF 的平均峰间间隔的解。在此解决方案的基础上，我们根据某个通用解析函数的实部和虚部构建了放电率和群体平均膜电位的解析表达式。通过这个函数，我们将理论结果推广到具有洛伦兹分布参数的异质总体。理论结果的实现针对两个问题进行了论证和检验：化学突触和电突触之间的相互作用，以及稀疏抑制网络中有效内源噪声的出现。对于后一种情况，可以覆盖有效噪声强度取决于洛伦兹分布参数的场景，而直接使用扩散近似是不可行的。

articles.title: Nonlinear Interaction and Topological Selection Rules in two Skyrmion Merging: Emergence of Skyrmionium Textures
articles.title_zh: 两个斯格明子合并中的非线性相互作用和拓扑选择规则：斯格明子纹理的出现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07807v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The nonlinear interaction of closely spaced magnetic skyrmions remains poorly understood, particularly the conditions governing their merger into a single skyrmion or a stable skyrmionium. Here, we investigate the merging dynamics of two Néel skyrmions using analytical modelling and micromagnetic simulations based on Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert dynamics. We examine the effects of exchange, Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction, anisotropy, and magnetostatic energies by varying the initial separation, polarity, winding number, and skyrmion size. Our results reveal a topological selection rule: skyrmions with identical polarity and opposite winding numbers form a stable skyrmionium at intermediate overlap, while all other configurations relax into a single skyrmion. We also identify a critical radius below which the skyrmionium collapses, showing that its formation requires both the appropriate topology and a minimum size. Energy analysis reveals that the transition involves cooperative relaxation of exchange frustration and redistribution of Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya and magnetostatic energies, leading to a double-domain-wall structure. The resulting skyrmionium exhibits persistent breathing oscillations around an equilibrium radius, confirming its dynamical stability as a metastable state. These findings establish a predictive framework for controlling skyrmion merging and provide design guidelines for engineering skyrmionium textures in chiral magnetic nanostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 紧密间隔的磁性斯格明子的非线性相互作用仍然知之甚少，特别是控制它们合并成单个斯格明子或稳定的斯格明子的条件。在这里，我们使用基于朗道-利夫希茨-吉尔伯特动力学的分析模型和微磁模拟来研究两个尼尔斯格明子的合并动力学。我们通过改变初始分离、极性、缠绕数和斯格明子尺寸来研究交换、Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用、各向异性和静磁能的影响。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 紧密间隔的磁性斯格明子的非线性相互作用仍然知之甚少，特别是控制它们合并成单个斯格明子或稳定的斯格明子的条件。在这里，我们使用基于朗道-利夫希茨-吉尔伯特动力学的分析模型和微磁模拟来研究两个尼尔斯格明子的合并动力学。我们通过改变初始分离、极性、缠绕数和斯格明子尺寸来研究交换、Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用、各向异性和静磁能的影响。我们的结果揭示了拓扑选择规则：具有相同极性和相反缠绕数的斯格明子在中间重叠处形成稳定的斯格明子，而所有其他配置松弛成单个斯格明子。我们还确定了一个临界半径，低于该半径，斯格明离子就会塌陷，这表明它的形成需要适当的拓扑结构和最小尺寸。能量分析表明，该转变涉及交换挫败的协同松弛以及 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 和静磁能的重新分配，从而形成双畴壁结构。由此产生的斯格米离子在平衡半径周围表现出持续的呼吸振荡，证实了其作为亚稳态的动态稳定性。这些发现建立了控制斯格明子合并的预测框架，并为手性磁性纳米结构中的斯格明子纹理工程提供了设计指南。

articles.title: Signature of chiral anomaly in a graphene-based heterostructure
articles.title_zh: 石墨烯异质结构中手性异常的特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07841v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chiral anomaly is a fundamental manifestation of topological matter caused by chirality imbalance. It can be of great practical value by providing a mechanism for dissipationless transport. The phenomenon is highly sensitive to the system dimensionality, disappearing in the 2D limit. Different schemes have been proposed to observe the chiral anomaly in graphene-based systems but experimental evidence has been lacking. Here, we synthesized two types of the Gr/Sr/SiC nanostructure - with 2D and 3D, bulk-like, layers of Sr - the difference being the amount of Sr intercalated under graphene. In contrast to the 2D material, 3D Gr/Sr/SiC exhibits a signature of the chiral anomaly - quadratic negative magnetoresistance in parallel magnetic and electric fields. Also, the functional form of the temperature dependence of the magnetoresistance agrees with the chiral anomaly. In addition, the 3D heterostructure exhibits suppressed conductivity and quantum oscillations in graphene. These effects may be associated with the graphene layer incorporated into a complex 3D heterostructure. Hopefully, the discovered signature of chiral anomaly in the built-in graphene would spur research on the phenomenon in topological nanomaterials.
articles.abstract_zh: 手性异常是由手性失衡引起的拓扑物质的基本表现。通过提供无耗散传输机制，它具有很大的实用价值。该现象对系统维数高度敏感，在二维极限下消失。人们提出了不同的方案来观察基于石墨烯的系统中的手性异常，但缺乏实验证据。在这里，我们合成了两种类型的 Gr/Sr/SiC 纳米结构 - 具有 2D 和 3D 块状 Sr 层 - 区别在于石墨烯下插入的 Sr 量。与 2D 材料相比，3D Gr/Sr/SiC 表现出手性异常的特征 - 平行磁场和电场中的二次负磁阻。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 手性异常是由手性失衡引起的拓扑物质的基本表现。通过提供无耗散传输机制，它具有很大的实用价值。该现象对系统维数高度敏感，在二维极限下消失。人们提出了不同的方案来观察基于石墨烯的系统中的手性异常，但缺乏实验证据。在这里，我们合成了两种类型的 Gr/Sr/SiC 纳米结构 - 具有 2D 和 3D 块状 Sr 层 - 区别在于石墨烯下插入的 Sr 量。与 2D 材料相比，3D Gr/Sr/SiC 表现出手性异常的特征 - 平行磁场和电场中的二次负磁阻。此外，磁阻温度依赖性的函数形式与手性异常一致。此外，3D异质结构在石墨烯中表现出抑制的电导率和量子振荡。这些效应可能与纳入复杂 3D 异质结构的石墨烯层有关。希望在内置石墨烯中发现的手性异常特征能够促进对拓扑纳米材料现象的研究。

articles.title: Half-integer quantum anomalous Hall effect in MnBi₂Te₄ via non-magnetic extension
articles.title_zh: 通过非磁延伸研究 MnBi2Te₄ 中的半整数量子反常霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07844v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Within an ab-initio approach, we study the electronic structure and Hall response of the antiferromagnetic topological insulator film of MnBi₂Te₄ in contact with non-magnetic GeBi₂Te₄ (Bi₂Te₃) overlayer. The proposed junction design eliminates the exchange splitting one of the Dirac cones of the MnBi₂Te₄ (0001) thus manifesting a half-integer quantum anomalous Hall phase. The described recipe allows to enlarge temperature of the effect observation, enriches the diversity of topological properties of the MnBi₂Te₄ compound and is appropriate for other layered antiferromagnetic topological insulators. Applying the proposed heterostructure design, the half-quantized Hall phase can be established with employing other overlayer and magnetic topological insulator films.
articles.abstract_zh: 在从头开始的方法中，我们研究了与非磁性 GeBi2Te4 (Bi2Te3) 覆盖层接触的 MnBi2Te4 反铁磁拓扑绝缘体薄膜的电子结构和霍尔响应。所提出的结设计消除了 MnBi2Te4 (0001) 狄拉克锥之一的交换分裂，从而表现出半整数量子反常霍尔相。所描述的配方可以扩大效应观察的温度，丰富了MnBi2Te4化合物拓扑性质的多样性，并且适用于其他层状反铁磁拓扑绝缘体。应用所提出的异质结构设计，可以通过采用其他覆盖层和磁性拓扑绝缘体薄膜来建立半量子化霍尔相。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在从头开始的方法中，我们研究了与非磁性 GeBi2Te4 (Bi2Te3) 覆盖层接触的 MnBi2Te4 反铁磁拓扑绝缘体薄膜的电子结构和霍尔响应。所提出的结设计消除了 MnBi2Te4 (0001) 狄拉克锥之一的交换分裂，从而表现出半整数量子反常霍尔相。所描述的配方可以扩大效应观察的温度，丰富了MnBi2Te4化合物拓扑性质的多样性，并且适用于其他层状反铁磁拓扑绝缘体。应用所提出的异质结构设计，可以通过采用其他覆盖层和磁性拓扑绝缘体薄膜来建立半量子化霍尔相。

articles.title: Anisotropic g-tensor and strong spin-orbit interaction of holes in hexagonal germanium nanowires
articles.title_zh: 六方锗纳米线空穴的各向异性 g 张量和强自旋轨道相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07846v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hexagonal germanium combines direct-gap optical activity with the low-nuclear-spin environment of a group-IV material, making it a candidate platform for spin qubits and spin-photon interfaces. Using a ten-band kcdotp model, we study the response of confined hole states in hexagonal germanium nanowires to magnetic and electric fields. We show that, by symmetry, the top valence band of the bulk crystal has a vanishing g factor in the plane perpendicular to the c axis, in analogy with the in-plane g factor of heavy holes in two-dimensional hole gases. In nanowires, confinement induces only small transverse g-tensor components, so the g tensor remains strongly anisotropic. A transverse electric field strongly reduces the nanowire band gap, providing a gate-tunable optical signature and limiting the usable field range. The same field induces a Rashba spin-orbit interaction that is markedly stronger for fields perpendicular to the c axis and depends nonlinearly on the field strength. In narrow wires at strong fields, the spin-orbit length reaches a few tens of nanometers, comparable to hole devices in cubic silicon. We identify the microscopic origin of the Rashba coupling as a second-order process mediated by a few intermediate subbands with distinct symmetry selection rules. Our results provide guidance for the design of electrically controlled hole-spin qubits in hexagonal germanium nanowires.
articles.abstract_zh: 六方锗将直接带隙光学活性与 IV 族材料的低核自旋环境相结合，使其成为自旋量子位和自旋光子界面的候选平台。使用十带 kcdotp 模型，我们研究了六方锗纳米线中的受限空穴态对磁场和电场的响应。我们通过对称性证明，块状晶体的顶价带在垂直于 c 轴的平面上具有消失的 g 因子，类似于二维空穴气体中重空穴的面内 g 因子。在纳米线中，限制仅引起小的横向 g 张量分量，因此 g 张量保持强烈的各向异性。横向电场极大地减小了纳米线带隙，提供了栅极可调的光学特征并限制了可用的场范围。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 六方锗将直接带隙光学活性与 IV 族材料的低核自旋环境相结合，使其成为自旋量子位和自旋光子界面的候选平台。使用十带 kcdotp 模型，我们研究了六方锗纳米线中的受限空穴态对磁场和电场的响应。我们通过对称性证明，块状晶体的顶价带在垂直于 c 轴的平面上具有消失的 g 因子，类似于二维空穴气体中重空穴的面内 g 因子。在纳米线中，限制仅引起小的横向 g 张量分量，因此 g 张量保持强烈的各向异性。横向电场极大地减小了纳米线带隙，提供了栅极可调的光学特征并限制了可用的场范围。相同的场会引起 Rashba 自旋轨道相互作用，对于垂直于 c 轴的场，这种相互作用明显更强，并且与场强呈非线性关系。在强场的窄线中，自旋轨道长度达到几十纳米，与立方硅中的空穴器件相当。我们将 Rashba 耦合的微观起源确定为由几个具有不同对称选择规则的中间子带介导的二阶过程。我们的结果为六方锗纳米线中电控空穴自旋量子位的设计提供了指导。

articles.title: Contrasting fate of holes introduced by Fe or In in kagome metal CoSn
articles.title_zh: Kagome 金属 CoSn 中 Fe 或 In 引入的空穴的对比命运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07848v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: CoSn is a kagome metal with well-defined flat bands 0.2 eV below the Fermi level EF. Moving them across EF would offer a rare opportunity to investigate their impact on electronic properties. Using angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) and X-ray absorption at the Co K-edge, we examine two routes to introduce holes in this compound, through Co/Fe or Sn/In substitutions. Substituting In for Sn produces an almost rigid upward shift of the bands toward EF, as expected for hole doping, whereas substituting Fe for Co leads to an unexpected downward shift. Density functional theory calculations reproduce these opposite trends and trace the unusual behavior of Fe to its local magnetic moment. The moment keeps the hole on the Fe impurity and imposes an attractive electrostatic potential on neighboring Co atoms. Overall, both substitutions bring weakly dispersing states close to EF, the flat bands of the Co kagome lattice upon In substitution and partly localized states around magnetic Fe impurities upon Fe substitution.
articles.abstract_zh: CoSn 是一种 Kagome 金属，具有清晰的平带，比费米能级 EF 低 0.2 eV。将它们转移到 EF 上将为研究它们对电子特性的影响提供难得的机会。利用角分辨光电子能谱 (ARPES) 和 Co K 边缘的 X 射线吸收，我们研究了通过 Co/Fe 或 Sn/In 取代在该化合物中引入空穴的两种途径。用 In 代替 Sn 会产生几乎刚性的能带向 EF 方向的向上移动，正如空穴掺杂所预期的那样，而用 Fe 代替 Co 会导致意想不到的向下移动。
articles.abstract_zh_full: CoSn 是一种 Kagome 金属，具有清晰的平带，比费米能级 EF 低 0.2 eV。将它们转移到 EF 上将为研究它们对电子特性的影响提供难得的机会。利用角分辨光电子能谱 (ARPES) 和 Co K 边缘的 X 射线吸收，我们研究了通过 Co/Fe 或 Sn/In 取代在该化合物中引入空穴的两种途径。用 In 代替 Sn 会产生几乎刚性的能带向 EF 方向的向上移动，正如空穴掺杂所预期的那样，而用 Fe 代替 Co 会导致意想不到的向下移动。密度泛函理论计算重现了这些相反的趋势，并将 Fe 的异常行为追溯到其局部磁矩。该力矩使空穴保持在 Fe 杂质上，并对邻近的 Co 原子施加吸引的静电势。总体而言，两种取代都带来了接近 EF 的弱分散态、In 取代时 Co kagome 晶格的平带以及 Fe 取代时磁性 Fe 杂质周围的部分局域态。

articles.title: Non-Perturbative Resolution of Luttinger's Theorem Violations in Strongly Correlated Systems
articles.title_zh: 强相关系统中 Luttinger 定理违规的非微扰求解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07933v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Many-body physics faces an apparent paradox concerning violations of Luttinger's theorem in strongly correlated systems. The theorem relates the electron number to the Luttinger count -- the monodromy of the logarithm of the imaginary-frequency Green's function G(iϵ) -- and, at finite magnetic field, connects the Hall conductivity to the magnetic-field derivative of the Luttinger count via the Streda formula. Here, we provide a non-perturbative solution to this paradox. We demonstrate that the reported violations of Luttinger's theorem do not require a breakdown of the skeleton diagram representation of physical quantities, thereby resolving a long-standing point of contention in many-body theory. Furthermore, we show that the Luttinger integral, which accounts for the mismatch between the particle number and the Luttinger count, is itself a genuine topological invariant directly tied to the Luttinger-Ward functional Φ[G] rather than to the Green's function alone. We demonstrate that this invariant, like the monodromy of ln G(iϵ) itself, stems exclusively from the zero-frequency discontinuity of the Matsubara trajectory.
articles.abstract_zh: 多体物理学面临着一个明显的悖论，即在强相关系统中违反鲁廷格定理。该定理将电子数与路廷格计数（虚频格林函数 G(iϵ) 的对数单调）联系起来，并且在有限磁场下，通过 Streda 公式将霍尔电导率与路廷格计数的磁场导数联系起来。在这里，我们为这个悖论提供了一个非扰动的解决方案。我们证明了所报告的对卢廷格定理的违反不需要对物理量的骨架图表示进行分解，从而解决了多体理论中长期存在的争论点。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多体物理学面临着一个明显的悖论，即在强相关系统中违反鲁廷格定理。该定理将电子数与路廷格计数（虚频格林函数 G(iϵ) 的对数单调）联系起来，并且在有限磁场下，通过 Streda 公式将霍尔电导率与路廷格计数的磁场导数联系起来。在这里，我们为这个悖论提供了一个非扰动的解决方案。我们证明了所报告的对卢廷格定理的违反不需要对物理量的骨架图表示进行分解，从而解决了多体理论中长期存在的争论点。此外，我们表明，解释粒子数和路廷格计数之间不匹配的路廷格积分本身就是一个真正的拓扑不变量，直接与路廷格-沃德函数 Φ[G] 相关，而不是单独与格林函数相关。我们证明这个不变量，就像 ln G(iϵ) 本身的单调一样，完全源于松原轨迹的零频率不连续性。

articles.title: Splay ostracism on ferroelectric nematic shells
articles.title_zh: 铁电向列壳上的张开排斥
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08027v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ostracism was the practice in use in Athens and other ancient Greek cities to send into exile citizens whose influence was deemed to be dangerous. Quite similarly, splay ostracism is here the approximation that bans splay distortion from thin films of ferroelectric nematic liquid crystals on a curved shell in space. This reduces to a mere geometric problem the quest for equilibria of director vortexes and the walls isolating them, as splay ostracism requires the director field lines to be everywhere orthogonal to systems of geodesics on the shell. Consequences of this theorem are explored for shells with Gaussian curvature of either sign. The resulting quasi static dynamics reveals both cases where walls escape from the shell and cases where they are trapped on it, with possibly different reflections on the vortex dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 放逐是雅典和其他古希腊城市用来流放影响被认为是危险的公民的做法。非常相似，这里的张开排斥是禁止空间弯曲壳上的铁电向列液晶薄膜张开变形的近似。这将对导向涡旋和隔离它们的壁的平衡的追求简化为纯粹的几何问题，因为张开排斥要求导向场线在任何地方都与壳上的测地线系统正交。对于具有任一符号的高斯曲率的壳，探索了该定理的结果。由此产生的准静态动力学揭示了壁从壳逸出的情况和它们被困在壳上的情况，对涡动力学可能有不同的反映。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 放逐是雅典和其他古希腊城市用来流放影响被认为是危险的公民的做法。非常相似，这里的张开排斥是禁止空间弯曲壳上的铁电向列液晶薄膜张开变形的近似。这将对导向涡旋和隔离它们的壁的平衡的追求简化为纯粹的几何问题，因为张开排斥要求导向场线在任何地方都与壳上的测地线系统正交。对于具有任一符号的高斯曲率的壳，探索了该定理的结果。由此产生的准静态动力学揭示了壁从壳逸出的情况和它们被困在壳上的情况，对涡动力学可能有不同的反映。

articles.title: Galois conjugation, droplet growth, and the differential transcendence of the Ising model in nonzero field
articles.title_zh: 非零场中伽罗瓦共轭、液滴生长和伊辛模型的微分超越
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08033v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The square-lattice Ising model is exactly solvable in zero magnetic field, but the scope of exact solutions at nonzero field remains unresolved. We show that, at every fixed dimensionless field H=h/(k_BT)ne 0, its free energy and magnetization obey no algebraic differential equation in the coupling K=J/(k_BT). This excludes Onsager-type formulas and broad classes of special-function expressions. Previous work left open a countable set of fields with algebraic-integer fugacities. We eliminate these exceptions using Galois conjugation and the large-order growth of droplets of reversed spins. At conjugate fugacities outside the unit circle, nearly square droplets produce coefficient growth incompatible with an algebraic differential equation. We prove that cancellations cannot remove this growth in the full pressure series. The free-energy result also holds for the Lieb lattice and square lattices with equal-length chain decorations and uniform coupling and field. In every dimension dge2, we additionally resolve fields for which e⁻²|H| has a real algebraic conjugate greater than one.
articles.abstract_zh: 方晶格伊辛模型在零磁场下精确可解，但在非零磁场下精确解的范围仍未解决。我们证明，在每个固定的无量纲场 H=h/(k_BT)ne 0 处，其自由能和磁化强度不服从耦合 K=J/(k_BT) 中的代数微分方程。这不包括 Onsager 类型的公式和广泛的特殊函数表达式。之前的工作留下了一组具有代数整数逸度的可数域。我们使用伽罗瓦共轭和反向自旋液滴的大阶生长消除了这些例外。在单位圆外的共轭逸度处，接近方形的液滴产生与代数微分方程不相容的系数增长。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 方晶格伊辛模型在零磁场下精确可解，但在非零磁场下精确解的范围仍未解决。我们证明，在每个固定的无量纲场 H=h/(k_BT)ne 0 处，其自由能和磁化强度不服从耦合 K=J/(k_BT) 中的代数微分方程。这不包括 Onsager 类型的公式和广泛的特殊函数表达式。之前的工作留下了一组具有代数整数逸度的可数域。我们使用伽罗瓦共轭和反向自旋液滴的大阶生长消除了这些例外。在单位圆外的共轭逸度处，接近方形的液滴产生与代数微分方程不相容的系数增长。我们证明取消不能消除全压力系列的增长。自由能结果也适用于具有等长链装饰和均匀耦合和场的利布晶格和方晶格。在每个维度 dge2 中，我们还解析了 e⁻²|H| 的字段具有大于 1 的实代数共轭。

articles.title: When Molecular Dimerization Induces Magnetic Bi-Stability at the Metal-Organic Interface
articles.title_zh: 当分子二聚化引起金属有机界面的磁双稳定性时
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08049v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a method to create metal-organic dimer complexes by on-surface assembly on a metal substrate using low-temperature scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) and spectroscopy (STS). We demonstrate that a dimer of Mn-Phthalocyanine (MnPc)2 on a Ag(111) surface can be switched between two stable configurations upon a small conformational change controlled by STM manipulation. By means of density-functional theory calculations, it is found that the two conformations correspond to an antiferromagnetic (AFM) and a ferromagnetic (FM) state respectively. Directly coordinated Mn atoms of the dimer lead to an AFM-coupling whereas indirectly coordinated (shifted) Mn atoms lead to a FM-coupling. Rarely seen in a molecular- dimers with transition-metal atoms, the FM-AFM-FM transition is thus readily on-surface accessible. Furthermore, the two configurations of the switch are easily identified by their Kondo states, opening interesting routes in terms of both, writing (FM versus AFM states) and reading. These results pave the experimental route toward dimer-based materials with complex magnetic structures of potential interest for application in spintronics, logics and computing.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种使用低温扫描隧道显微镜（STM）和光谱学（STS）在金属基底上进行表面组装来创建金属有机二聚体复合物的方法。我们证明，Ag(111) 表面上的 Mn-酞菁 (MnPc)2 二聚体可以通过 STM 操作控制的微小构象变化在两种稳定构型之间切换。通过密度泛函理论计算，发现这两种构象分别对应于反铁磁（AFM）态和铁磁（FM）态。二聚体的直接配位 Mn 原子导致 AFM 偶联，而间接配位（移位）Mn 原子则导致 FM 偶联。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种使用低温扫描隧道显微镜（STM）和光谱学（STS）在金属基底上进行表面组装来创建金属有机二聚体复合物的方法。我们证明，Ag(111) 表面上的 Mn-酞菁 (MnPc)2 二聚体可以通过 STM 操作控制的微小构象变化在两种稳定构型之间切换。通过密度泛函理论计算，发现这两种构象分别对应于反铁磁（AFM）态和铁磁（FM）态。二聚体的直接配位 Mn 原子导致 AFM 偶联，而间接配位（移位）Mn 原子则导致 FM 偶联。 FM-AFM-FM 转变在具有过渡金属原子的分子二聚体中很少见，因此很容易在表面上实现。此外，开关的两种配置可以通过其 Kondo 状态轻松识别，从而在写入（FM 与 AFM 状态）和读取方面开辟有趣的路线。这些结果为具有复杂磁性结构的二聚体材料铺平了实验路线，该材料在自旋电子学、逻辑和计算领域具有潜在的应用前景。

articles.title: Ferroelectric control of magnetic coupling in a Cr dimer adsorbed on α-In₂Se₃
articles.title_zh: α-In2Se₃ 上吸附的 Cr 二聚体磁耦合的铁电控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08055v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ferroelectric substrates offer a route to controlling magnetic interactions in low-dimensional systems through polarization-dependent changes in local bonding and electronic structure. Here, using first-principles calculations, we investigate the adsorption of 3d transition-metal atoms and dimers on monolayer α-In₂Se₃ and identify Cr as a stable dimer configuration on both polar surfaces. Reversing the ferroelectric polarization drives a pronounced change in its magnetic coupling: the AFM state is favored for one polarization, whereas the FM and AFM configurations become nearly degenerate for the opposite one. Analysis of the spin density, projected electronic states, and Wannier Hamiltonians reveals concomitant changes in the direct Cr-Cr hopping and in the interaction with the bridging Se atom. In particular, enhanced Cr-Se hybridization and Se spin polarization, together with a strong reduction of the direct two-center Cr-Cr hopping, point to a polarization-dependent balance between direct and substrate-mediated exchange contributions. These results show how ferroelectric polarization can tune magnetic interactions in an atomically defined 2D hybrid system.
articles.abstract_zh: 铁电基板提供了一种通过局部键合和电子结构中极化相关的变化来控制低维系统中磁相互作用的途径。在这里，我们利用第一性原理计算，研究了 3d 过渡金属原子和二聚体在单层 α-In2Se3 上的吸附，并将 Cr 确定为两个极性表面上的稳定二聚体构型。反转铁电极化会导致其磁耦合发生显着变化：一种极化有利于 AFM 状态，而相反的极化则使 FM 和 AFM 配置几乎退化。对自旋密度、投影电子态和万尼尔哈密顿量的分析揭示了直接 Cr-Cr 跳跃以及与桥接 Se 原子相互作用的伴随变化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 铁电基板提供了一种通过局部键合和电子结构中极化相关的变化来控制低维系统中磁相互作用的途径。在这里，我们利用第一性原理计算，研究了 3d 过渡金属原子和二聚体在单层 α-In2Se3 上的吸附，并将 Cr 确定为两个极性表面上的稳定二聚体构型。反转铁电极化会导致其磁耦合发生显着变化：一种极化有利于 AFM 状态，而相反的极化则使 FM 和 AFM 配置几乎退化。对自旋密度、投影电子态和万尼尔哈密顿量的分析揭示了直接 Cr-Cr 跳跃以及与桥接 Se 原子相互作用的伴随变化。特别是，增强的 Cr-Se 杂化和 Se 自旋极化，以及直接两中心 Cr-Cr 跳跃的强烈减少，表明直接和底物介导的交换贡献之间存在极化依赖的平衡。这些结果表明铁电极化如何调节原子定义的二维混合系统中的磁相互作用。

articles.title: Key role of orbital exchange in CoO magnetism
articles.title_zh: 轨道交换在 CoO 磁性中的关键作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08065v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Co ions in the antiferromagnetic phase of CoO are known to possess a substantial orbital moment, making this material promising for orbitronic applications. However, intersite exchange interactions involving these orbital degrees of freedom remain poorly quantified, and their role in CoO magnetism is unclear. Here, we derive a full low-energy effective Hamiltonian for CoO, including orbital exchange terms, using an ab initio force-theorem approach based on DFT+dynamical mean-field theory. We find sizable orbital interactions, with quadrupolar orbital exchange emerging as the dominant nearest-neighbor term. The collinear antiferromagnetic order obtained from the effective Hamiltonian features magnetic moments tilted away from the pseudocubic <001> direction and an orbital contribution amounting to about one-third of the total moment, in agreement with experimental estimates. We show that the moment tilting originates from the combined effect of orbital and spin-orbital exchange interactions. The same interactions also produce a prominent splitting of the lowest excitation band. By directly modeling the inelastic neutron scattering (INS) intensity, we further show that the characteristic column-like structures previously observed in CoO INS provide a clear fingerprint of orbital exchange. We also discuss possible impact of our findings for further advances in the field of complex collective excitations, their transport properties and applications in the realm of orbitronics.
articles.abstract_zh: 众所周知，CoO 反铁磁相中的 Co 离子拥有相当大的轨道矩，使这种材料有望用于轨道电子学应用。然而，涉及这些轨道自由度的位点间交换相互作用仍然很少被量化，并且它们在 CoO 磁性中的作用尚不清楚。在这里，我们使用基于 DFT+动态平均场理论的从头算力定理方法推导了 CoO 的完整低能有效哈密顿量，包括轨道交换项。我们发现了相当大的轨道相互作用，其中四极轨道交换成为主要的最近邻项。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 众所周知，CoO 反铁磁相中的 Co 离子拥有相当大的轨道矩，使这种材料有望用于轨道电子学应用。然而，涉及这些轨道自由度的位点间交换相互作用仍然很少被量化，并且它们在 CoO 磁性中的作用尚不清楚。在这里，我们使用基于 DFT+动态平均场理论的从头算力定理方法推导了 CoO 的完整低能有效哈密顿量，包括轨道交换项。我们发现了相当大的轨道相互作用，其中四极轨道交换成为主要的最近邻项。从有效哈密顿量获得的共线反铁磁序特征是磁矩远离赝立方方向倾斜，轨道贡献约为总矩的三分之一，与实验估计一致。我们表明，力矩倾斜源于轨道和自旋轨道交换相互作用的综合效应。相同的相互作用也会产生最低激发带的显着分裂。通过直接模拟非弹性中子散射（INS）强度，我们进一步表明，先前在 CoO INS 中观察到的特征柱状结构提供了轨道交换的清晰指纹。我们还讨论了我们的发现对复杂集体激发领域、其输运特性以及在轨道电子学领域的应用的进一步进展可能产生的影响。

articles.title: Experimental Evidence for Type-I Superconductivity in OsB₂
articles.title_zh: OsB2 中 I 型超导性的实验证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08239v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Since the discovery of superconductivity in MgB₂, metal diborides have attracted significant attention. Among these, osmium diboride (OsB₂), crystallizing in an orthorhombic structure (space group Pmmn) with puckered boron layers, has been classified as a low-κ Type-II superconductor (T_c approx 2.1~K). Here, we report experimental evidence establishing that OsB₂ is in fact a rare nonelemental Type-I superconductor. Our identification is supported by three primary experimental hallmarks: (i) a pronounced Differential Paramagnetic Effect (DPE) peak in AC susceptibility (χₐc) measurements under static DC magnetic fields, signaling the intermediate state; (ii) a field-induced crossover to a divergent first-order phase transition in specific heat (C/T); and (iii) pronounced magnetic hysteresis in field-ramped transitions indicative of supercooling.
articles.abstract_zh: 自从发现 MgB2 超导性以来，金属二硼化物引起了人们的广泛关注。其中，二硼化锇（OsB2）结晶为具有褶皱硼层的斜方结构（空间群Pmmn），被归类为低κII型超导体（T_c约2.1~K）。在这里，我们报告了实验证据，证明 OsB2 实际上是一种罕见的非元素 I 型超导体。我们的鉴定得到了三个主要实验标志的支持：（i）在静态直流磁场下的交流磁化率（χₐc）测量中存在明显的微分顺磁效应（DPE）峰值，表明中间状态； (ii) 场诱导交叉到比热 (C/T) 发散的一级相变；
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自从发现 MgB2 超导性以来，金属二硼化物引起了人们的广泛关注。其中，二硼化锇（OsB2）结晶为具有褶皱硼层的斜方结构（空间群Pmmn），被归类为低κII型超导体（T_c约2.1~K）。在这里，我们报告了实验证据，证明 OsB2 实际上是一种罕见的非元素 I 型超导体。我们的鉴定得到了三个主要实验标志的支持：（i）在静态直流磁场下的交流磁化率（χₐc）测量中存在明显的微分顺磁效应（DPE）峰值，表明中间状态； (ii) 场诱导交叉到比热 (C/T) 发散的一级相变； (iii) 磁场斜坡转变中存在明显的磁滞现象，表明过冷。

articles.title: Finite-element reconstruction of molten-zone dynamics and chemical segregation in optical floating-zone grown Ni--Mn--Ga
articles.title_zh: 光学浮区生长 Ni--Mn--Ga 熔区动力学和化学偏析的有限元重建
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08250v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Homogeneous single-crystal growth of Ni--Mn--Ga magnetic shape-memory alloys is limited by incongruent melting, Mn reactivity, and longitudinal composition segregation. We report a modified optical floating-zone method in which growth is performed inside a transparent sapphire crucible, stabilising the molten zone while preserving optical heating and visual monitoring. The resulting crystals show improved growth reproducibility and controlled macroscopic geometry. To interpret the measured segregation profiles, a transient finite-element heat-transfer model in COMSOL Multiphysics was coupled to an effective molten-zone mass-balance calculation. The model reveals that the local solidification velocity is not fixed by the imposed translation speed but varies strongly as the molten-zone geometry evolves. The calculated solidification-front geometry is independently supported by EBSD analysis of a quenched growth interface, while the coupled mass-balance calculation reproduces the dominant features of the measured composition profiles. These results show that deviations from ideal Scheil--Pfann behaviour arise from the evolving molten-zone geometry and solidification conditions. The experimentally constrained model therefore provides a practical means of reconstructing otherwise inaccessible growth conditions and a basis for optimisation of sapphire-confined floating-zone growth of incongruently melting alloys.
articles.abstract_zh: Ni-Mn-Ga磁性形状记忆合金的均匀单晶生长受到不均匀熔化、Mn反应性和纵向成分偏析的限制。我们报告了一种改进的光学浮区方法，其中在透明蓝宝石坩埚内进行生长，稳定熔融区，同时保留光学加热和视觉监控。所得晶体显示出改进的生长再现性和受控的宏观几何形状。为了解释测得的偏析曲线，将 COMSOL Multiphysics 中的瞬态有限元传热模型与有效的熔融区质量平衡计算相结合。该模型表明，局部凝固速度并不由施加的平移速度决定，而是随着熔融区几何形状的演变而剧烈变化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Ni-Mn-Ga磁性形状记忆合金的均匀单晶生长受到不均匀熔化、Mn反应性和纵向成分偏析的限制。我们报告了一种改进的光学浮区方法，其中在透明蓝宝石坩埚内进行生长，稳定熔融区，同时保留光学加热和视觉监控。所得晶体显示出改进的生长再现性和受控的宏观几何形状。为了解释测得的偏析曲线，将 COMSOL Multiphysics 中的瞬态有限元传热模型与有效的熔融区质量平衡计算相结合。该模型表明，局部凝固速度并不由施加的平移速度决定，而是随着熔融区几何形状的演变而剧烈变化。计算的凝固前沿几何形状由淬火生长界面的 EBSD 分析独立支持，而耦合的质量平衡计算再现了测量的成分分布的主要特征。这些结果表明，与理想 Scheil-Pfann 行为的偏差是由不断变化的熔融区几何形状和凝固条件引起的。因此，实验约束模型提供了重建原本无法达到的生长条件的实用方法，并为优化不均匀熔化合金的蓝宝石限制浮区生长提供了基础。

articles.title: Spin supersolid in triangular lattice easy-axis spin-1/2 antiferromagnet: a fermionic parton perspective
articles.title_zh: 三角晶格易轴自旋 1/2 反铁磁体中的自旋超固体：费米子帕子视角
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08270v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the supersolid order of the spin-1/2 easy-axis XXZ antiferromagnet on the triangular lattice using a fermionic parton mean-field theory built on the π-flux Dirac spin liquid, with the mean-field order generated by an on-site spinon interaction term and nearest-neighbor (anisotropic) spin couplings. The collective modes are obtained using the random-phase approximation (RPA). In a finite parameter region, we find the Y state as a self-consistent solution, together with the competing Y' state, which is a 90^circ-rotated Y state inside the order plane. The mean-field energy favors Y', even though the two states are exactly degenerate in the classical limit. However, the Y state can become lower in energy when higher-order corrections due to the fluctuations of the collective modes are considered. The Y state can also be stabilized on the mean-field level by applying small external fields, which we do in two different ways: moment-aligned local field and uniform field along the easy axis. In both cases, the RPA calculation for the stabilized Y state gives a roton minimum at the M point in the excitation spectrum. A gapped pseudo-Goldstone mode above the gapless Goldstone mode is obtained as well, which has also been observed experimentally. Furthermore, we investigate the effects of tuning the spinon interaction strength and the anisotropy in spin couplings in our phenomenological model. Comparison with the recent numerical and experimental results is also discussed.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们使用基于 π 通量狄拉克自旋液体的费米子部分子平均场理论研究三角晶格上自旋 1/2 易轴 XXZ 反铁磁体的超固体序，平均场序由现场自旋相互作用项和最近邻（各向异性）自旋耦合生成。集体模式是使用随机相位近似（RPA）获得的。在有限参数区域中，我们发现 Y 状态作为自洽解，以及竞争 Y' 状态，这是有序平面内 90^circ 旋转的 Y 状态。平均场能量有利于 Y'，即使这两个状态在经典极限下完全简并。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用基于 π 通量狄拉克自旋液体的费米子部分子平均场理论研究三角晶格上自旋 1/2 易轴 XXZ 反铁磁体的超固体序，平均场序由现场自旋相互作用项和最近邻（各向异性）自旋耦合生成。集体模式是使用随机相位近似（RPA）获得的。在有限参数区域中，我们发现 Y 状态作为自洽解，以及竞争 Y' 状态，这是有序平面内 90^circ 旋转的 Y 状态。平均场能量有利于 Y'，即使这两个状态在经典极限下完全简并。然而，当考虑由于集体模式的波动而进行的高阶校正时，Y 态的能量可能会变得更低。 Y 态也可以通过施加小的外部场在平均场水平上稳定，我们以两种不同的方式做到这一点：力矩对齐的局部场和沿易轴的均匀场。在这两种情况下，稳定 Y 状态的 RPA 计算给出了激发光谱中 M 点处的旋转最小值。还获得了高于无间隙戈德斯通模式的有隙伪戈德斯通模式，这也在实验中被观察到。此外，我们研究了在唯象模型中调整自旋相互作用强度和自旋耦合各向异性的影响。还讨论了与最近的数值和实验结果的比较。

articles.title: Multimagnon bound states in the polarized phase of anisotropic antiferromagnets
articles.title_zh: 各向异性反铁磁体极化相中的多磁振子束缚态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08349v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate single-ion bound magnon states in the high-field polarized phase of uniaxial antiferromagnets. By solving the two-particle problem exactly, we determine the dispersion of bound magnon pairs both below and above the continuum. We also obtain rigorous bounds on their binding energies by using the Gershgorin circle theorem. For spin-1 easy-axis systems, two-magnon bound states with zero total momentum emerge as low-energy excitations once the ratio of single-ion anisotropy to exchange exceeds a threshold value. As the field decreases, magnon pairs condense, driving a transition into a spin-nematic phase. Beyond the two-magnon problem, we develop a general strong-coupling approach that describes n-magnon single-ion bound states (n≤ 2S) in large-S easy-axis antiferromagnets. The Bose-Einstein condensation of these multi-magnon excitations yields a rich hierarchy of field-induced multipolar phases stabilized by single-ion anisotropy. Comparisons with recent experiments on Na₂BaNi(PO₄)₂ and Sr₂CoGe₂O₇ illustrate the quantitative power of our theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究单轴反铁磁体高场极化相中的单离子束缚磁振子态。通过精确求解双粒子问题，我们确定了连续体下方和上方的束缚磁振子对的色散。我们还通过使用格什戈林圆定理获得了它们的结合能的严格界限。对于自旋 1 易轴系统，一旦单离子各向异性与交换的比率超过阈值，总动量为零的双磁振子束缚态就会作为低能激发出现。随着磁场减弱，磁振子对凝聚，驱动转变为自旋向列相。除了双磁振子问题之外，我们还开发了一种通用的强耦合方法，用于描述大 S 易轴反铁磁体中的 n 磁振子单离子束缚态 (n≤ 2S)。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究单轴反铁磁体高场极化相中的单离子束缚磁振子态。通过精确求解双粒子问题，我们确定了连续体下方和上方的束缚磁振子对的色散。我们还通过使用格什戈林圆定理获得了它们的结合能的严格界限。对于自旋 1 易轴系统，一旦单离子各向异性与交换的比率超过阈值，总动量为零的双磁振子束缚态就会作为低能激发出现。随着磁场减弱，磁振子对凝聚，驱动转变为自旋向列相。除了双磁振子问题之外，我们还开发了一种通用的强耦合方法，用于描述大 S 易轴反铁磁体中的 n 磁振子单离子束缚态 (n≤ 2S)。这些多磁振子激发的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚产生了由单离子各向异性稳定的场致多极相的丰富层次结构。与最近的 Na2BaNi(PO4)2 和 Sr2CoGe2O7 实验的比较说明了我们理论的定量能力。

articles.title: Anisotropy lifts topological protection of transport in pumped spin chains
articles.title_zh: 各向异性提升了泵浦自旋链中输运的拓扑保护
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08385v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the prospect of topological spin pumping and transport in a dimerized spin-frac12 anisotropic XY chain with tunable in-plane anisotropy. Through a Jordan-Wigner transformation, the system maps onto an extended Rice-Mele-type fermionic model whose momentum-space band structure exhibits gapped regions characterized by nonzero Chern numbers (± 1) as well as trivial and gapless regimes. Conventional momentum-space analysis therefore predicts quantized Thouless-type spin pumping in parts of the Chern number diagram. However, real-space time evolution under open boundary conditions reveals that the spin transport is generally not quantized away from the isotropic limit. In the anisotropic regime, eigen-energy states within the transporting subspace hybridize during the driving cycle, leading to a transport that depends on details of the driving protocol. Quantized pumping and transport survive only in the isotropic limit, where the Hamiltonian reduces to decoupled Rice-Mele sectors and the transported spin component is conserved. Our results demonstrate that momentum-space topological invariants alone do not guarantee quantized spin transport in anisotropic spin chains. More broadly, they show that the conventional Thouless-pumping framework does not straightforwardly extend to situations where the transported quantity is not conserved, highlighting the importance of real-space diagnostics in topological transport phenomena.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了具有可调面内各向异性的二聚化自旋-frac12各向异性 XY 链中拓扑自旋泵浦和输运的前景。通过 Jordan-Wigner 变换，该系统映射到扩展的 Rice-Mele 型费米子模型，其动量空间能带结构表现出以非零陈数 (± 1) 为特征的带隙区域以及平凡且无带隙的区域。因此，传统的动量空间分析预测了陈数图部分中的量子化 Thouless 型自旋泵浦。然而，开放边界条件下的真实时空演化表明，自旋输运通常不会被量子化远离各向同性极限。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了具有可调面内各向异性的二聚化自旋-frac12各向异性 XY 链中拓扑自旋泵浦和输运的前景。通过 Jordan-Wigner 变换，该系统映射到扩展的 Rice-Mele 型费米子模型，其动量空间能带结构表现出以非零陈数 (± 1) 为特征的带隙区域以及平凡且无带隙的区域。因此，传统的动量空间分析预测了陈数图部分中的量子化 Thouless 型自旋泵浦。然而，开放边界条件下的真实时空演化表明，自旋输运通常不会被量子化远离各向同性极限。在各向异性状态下，传输子空间内的本征能量状态在驾驶循环期间混合，导致取决于驾驶协议细节的传输。量子化的泵浦和传输仅在各向同性极限中存在，其中哈密顿量减少为解耦的莱斯-梅勒扇区，并且传输的自旋分量是守恒的。我们的结果表明，动量空间拓扑不变量本身并不能保证各向异性自旋链中的量子化自旋输运。更广泛地说，他们表明传统的无意识泵浦框架不能直接扩展到传输量不守恒的情况，这凸显了拓扑传输现象中实空间诊断的重要性。

articles.title: Synaptic Multi-Weight Wafer-Scale Domain Wall Magnetic Tunnel Junctions Driven by Spin Orbit Torque
articles.title_zh: 自旋轨道扭矩驱动的突触多重量晶圆级畴壁磁隧道结
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08405v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spintronic synaptic devices based on magnetic random access memory (MRAM) are a rapidly evolving class within the analog neuromorphic architecture. However, obtaining the multi-weight or analog behavior desired for improved neural network inference accuracy in scaled MRAM remains a challenge. In this study, we demonstrate and tune up to eight distinct resistance levels in 300 mm wafer-scale magnetic tunnel junction artificial synapses driven by spin orbit torque. By varying the applied in-plane field, multi-weight resistance states emerge through domain wall nucleation and pinning. These multi-weight states appear stochastically and can be addressed with an iterative programming algorithm to program a specific resistance. Electromagnetic simulations indicate the multiple states are due to domain wall nucleation mediated by in-plane field and applied voltage. Implementation of the measured multi-weight devices in a neural network yields a 96.1% inference accuracy using the MNIST dataset if all devices provide the same number of multi-weight states. When experimental device-to-device variation is included, the accuracy is 48.6%. Overall, this work demonstrates a route towards multi-weight artificial synapse MRAM, establishing a path towards scalable neuromorphic systems based on spintronics.
articles.abstract_zh: 基于磁性随机存取存储器 (MRAM) 的自旋电子突触设备是模拟神经形态架构中快速发展的一类。然而，在缩放 MRAM 中获得提高神经网络推理精度所需的多权重或模拟行为仍然是一个挑战。在这项研究中，我们展示并调整了由自旋轨道扭矩驱动的 300 毫米晶圆级磁性隧道结人工突触中多达八个不同的电阻水平。通过改变所施加的面内场，通过磁畴壁成核和钉扎出现多重量电阻状态。这些多权重状态随机出现，并且可以通过迭代编程算法来解决，以对特定电阻进行编程。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于磁性随机存取存储器 (MRAM) 的自旋电子突触设备是模拟神经形态架构中快速发展的一类。然而，在缩放 MRAM 中获得提高神经网络推理精度所需的多权重或模拟行为仍然是一个挑战。在这项研究中，我们展示并调整了由自旋轨道扭矩驱动的 300 毫米晶圆级磁性隧道结人工突触中多达八个不同的电阻水平。通过改变所施加的面内场，通过磁畴壁成核和钉扎出现多重量电阻状态。这些多权重状态随机出现，并且可以通过迭代编程算法来解决，以对特定电阻进行编程。电磁模拟表明，多种状态是由面内场和施加电压介导的畴壁成核造成的。如果所有设备提供相同数量的多权重状态，则使用 MNIST 数据集在神经网络中实现测量的多权重设备可产生 96.1% 的推理精度。当包括实验性设备间差异时，准确度为 48.6%。总的来说，这项工作展示了一条通往多权重人工突触 MRAM 的道路，建立了一条通往基于自旋电子学的可扩展神经形态系统的道路。

articles.title: Direct transition from a fractional Chern insulator to a topological superconductor
articles.title_zh: 从分数陈绝缘体到拓扑超导体的直接转变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08475v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We find numerical evidence for a direct continuous transition from a Laughlin fractional Chern insulator (FCI) to a c₋=3/2 topological superconductor (TSC), driven by increasing bandwidth at filling ν=1/3 in a repulsively interacting Chern band. At the critical point, the electron correlation length diverges at momentum away from the reference Fermi surface. We develop a generalized theory of superconducting-vortex proliferation for this transition. Magnetic translation organizes the vortices into six valleys, so translation-preserving proliferation requires additional gauge fields.
