The resulting theory reproduces the momentum structure of the critical spectrum and captures the divergent electron correlation. Upon doping away from commensurate filling, the theory gives rise to a superconducting dome. These results are consistent with an anyonic origin of the topological superconductivity in the absence of a weak-coupling Fermi-surface instability.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们发现了从 Laughlin 分数陈绝缘体 (FCI) 到 c₋=3/2 拓扑超导体 (TSC) 直接连续转变的数值证据，这是由排斥相互作用陈能带中填充 ν=1/3 时增加的带宽驱动的。在临界点，电子相关长度在动量上发散远离参考费米面。我们为这种转变发展了超导涡扩散的广义理论。磁平移将漩涡组织成六个谷，因此保持平移的扩散需要额外的规范场。由此产生的理论再现了临界光谱的动量结构并捕获了发散电子相关性。当掺杂远离相应的填充时，该理论产生了超导圆顶。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们发现了从 Laughlin 分数陈绝缘体 (FCI) 到 c₋=3/2 拓扑超导体 (TSC) 直接连续转变的数值证据，这是由排斥相互作用陈能带中填充 ν=1/3 时增加的带宽驱动的。在临界点，电子相关长度在动量上发散远离参考费米面。我们为这种转变发展了超导涡扩散的广义理论。磁平移将漩涡组织成六个谷，因此保持平移的扩散需要额外的规范场。由此产生的理论再现了临界光谱的动量结构并捕获了发散电子相关性。当掺杂远离相应的填充时，该理论产生了超导圆顶。这些结果与在不存在弱耦合费米表面不稳定性的情况下拓扑超导性的任意子起源一致。

articles.title: SteelAgent: LLM-Orchestrated, Physics-Informed Steel Property Prediction with Audited Generalization and Calibrated Uncertainty
articles.title_zh: SteelAgent：法学硕士精心策划、基于物理的钢铁性能预测，具有经过审计的概括和校准的不确定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06953v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Steel property models can perform well on random test splits even when they extrapolate poorly to unfamiliar alloys. SteelAgent couples metallurgical descriptors and machine-learning models with a language-model interface for property prediction, uncertainty reporting and inverse design. We examine how the choice of held-out unit changes the conclusions drawn from SteelBench tensile-strength evaluations. For gradient boosting, pooled out-of-fold R² fell from 0.859 on a random split to 0.113 when steel families were held out. Empirical coverage of nominal 90% prediction intervals ranged from 91.0% under random splitting to 37.6% on held-out sources. The effect of physics-derived features depended on the evaluation. They increased gradient-boosting R² by 0.2534 in a 17-family holdout analysis and decreased it by 0.358 in a separate four-grade laboratory analysis. We report group-level errors and a synthetic regression experiment illustrating how calibration can deteriorate on held-out groups. These results motivate reporting the evaluation population alongside a property estimate or compliance score.
articles.abstract_zh: 钢铁性能模型在随机测试分割上可以表现良好，即使它们对不熟悉的合金的推断效果不佳。 SteelAgent 将冶金描述符和机器学习模型与语言模型接口结合起来，用于性能预测、不确定性报告和逆向设计。我们研究了固定单元的选择如何改变 SteelBench 拉伸强度评估得出的结论。对于梯度增强，合并的非折叠 R² 从随机分割时的 0.859 下降到保留钢族时的 0.113。标称 90% 预测区间的经验覆盖范围为随机分割下的 91.0% 到保留源下的 37.6%。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 钢铁性能模型在随机测试分割上可以表现良好，即使它们对不熟悉的合金的推断效果不佳。 SteelAgent 将冶金描述符和机器学习模型与语言模型接口结合起来，用于性能预测、不确定性报告和逆向设计。我们研究了固定单元的选择如何改变 SteelBench 拉伸强度评估得出的结论。对于梯度增强，合并的非折叠 R² 从随机分割时的 0.859 下降到保留钢族时的 0.113。标称 90% 预测区间的经验覆盖范围为随机分割下的 91.0% 到保留源下的 37.6%。物理衍生特征的效果取决于评估。他们在 17 个家庭的保留分析中将梯度增强 R2 增加了 0.2534，并在单独的四级实验室分析中将其减少了 0.358。我们报告了组级误差和综合回归实验，说明了保留组的校准如何恶化。这些结果促使报告评估群体以及财产估计或合规分数。

articles.title: FNO-Based Inverse Co-Design of Semiconducting Quantum-Dot Devices
articles.title_zh: 基于 FNO 的半导体量子点器件逆向协同设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06994v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Gate-defined semiconductor quantum dots are promising building blocks for scalable spin-based quantum processors, however their operational properties depend on several fabrication and control parameters, such as lithographic gate layout and applied voltages. Existing device architectures have been refined through repeated fabrication and experimental testing, producing layouts that support reliable device operation. However, this process does not exhaustively explore the design space, limiting the ability to obtain qubits with targeted properties. We address these challenges by presenting a differentiable inverse co-design framework for electrostatically defined quantum dots that jointly optimises gate voltages and the gate electrode layout. A semiclassical Thomas--Fermi electrostatic simulator provides reference data for a Fourier neural operator (FNO) surrogate, which predicts the two-dimensional charge-density field. The desired spatial distribution of the confined charge defines the target quantum-dot geometry for inverse design. The FNO reproduces charge densities with a relative L² test error of just 0.6% and enables millisecond-scale differentiable evaluations. Relative to the CPU-based physics simulator, the FNO achieves a 17,000-fold speed-up on GPU for a single design, with further performance gains enabled by batched inference. When embedded in a gradient-based design loop with fabrication constraints, the FNO can produce both vertically and horizontally elongated double-dot confinement geometries from the same initial conditions. The ability to engineer these distinct confinement configurations demonstrates control over quantum-dot shape and position, providing a route towards designing devices with distinct qubit-relevant operating properties prior to fabrication.
articles.abstract_zh: 栅极定义的半导体量子点是可扩展的基于自旋的量子处理器的有前途的构建模块，但是它们的操作特性取决于几个制造和控制参数，例如光刻栅极布局和施加的电压。现有的器件架构已通过重复制造和实验测试进行了改进，产生了支持可靠器件运行的布局。然而，这个过程并没有详尽地探索设计空间，限制了获得具有目标属性的量子位的能力。我们通过为静电定义的量子点提出可微逆协同设计框架来解决这些挑战，该框架共同优化栅极电压和栅极布局。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 栅极定义的半导体量子点是可扩展的基于自旋的量子处理器的有前途的构建模块，但是它们的操作特性取决于几个制造和控制参数，例如光刻栅极布局和施加的电压。现有的器件架构已通过重复制造和实验测试进行了改进，产生了支持可靠器件运行的布局。然而，这个过程并没有详尽地探索设计空间，限制了获得具有目标属性的量子位的能力。我们通过为静电定义的量子点提出可微逆协同设计框架来解决这些挑战，该框架共同优化栅极电压和栅极布局。半经典托马斯-费米静电模拟器为傅立叶神经算子 (FNO) 替代项提供参考数据，该替代项可预测二维电荷密度场。受限电荷所需的空间分布定义了逆向设计的目标量子点几何形状。 FNO 能够以仅为 0.6% 的相对 L² 测试误差再现电荷密度，并实现毫秒级可微分评估。相对于基于 CPU 的物理模拟器，FNO 在单一设计的 GPU 上实现了 17,000 倍的加速，并通过批量推理实现了进一步的性能提升。当嵌入到具有制造约束的基于梯度的设计循环中时，FNO 可以在相同的初始条件下产生垂直和水平拉长的双点限制几何形状。设计这些独特的限制配置的能力证明了对量子点形状和位置的控制，为在制造之前设计具有独特的量子位相关操作特性的设备提供了一条途径。

articles.title: Nonlocal magic of fermions is bounded by entanglement fluctuations and is logarithmic for free fermions
articles.title_zh: 费米子的非局域魔力受到纠缠涨落的限制，并且对于自由费米子来说是对数的
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07003v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Free-fermion states are classically simulable, yet, written as qubits, they typically carry extensive magic, the quantum resource that stabilizer circuits lack. Part of this magic is nonlocal: local unitaries acting separately on two parts of the system cannot remove it. If these local unitaries are restricted to Gaussian ones, the nonlocal magic grows linearly with the number m of partially entangled fermion pairs. We show that this growth is an artifact of the Gaussian restriction: local Gaussian unitaries minimize the nonlocal stabilizer Rényi entropy for up to three pairs, but not from four pairs on. General local non-Gaussian unitaries that respect fermion parity take m free-fermion pairs to fermionic Bell pairs with a fidelity that decays at most as 1/sqrt m compared to exponential decay with Gaussian unitaries, so the nonlocal magic drops from linear to logarithmic in m. The reason is statistical --- Bell pairs have equal Schmidt weights, that is, a fully degenerate entanglement spectrum, and a state can stay far from them only if its Schmidt weights are spread over many orders of magnitude. This spread is measured by the capacity of entanglement C_E, the variance of the entanglement Hamiltonian, and the nonlocal magic of any fermionic state grows at most logarithmically with C_E. Free-fermion pairs add to C_E independently, so C_E grows only linearly in m, and this leads to the stabilizer fidelity decreasing at most as 1/sqrt m. Almost all the magic of free fermions, including Hartree--Fock and BCS mean-field states, is therefore local.
articles.abstract_zh: 自由费米子态在经典上是可模拟的，然而，以量子位的形式编写，它们通常具有广泛的魔力，这是稳定器电路所缺乏的量子资源。这种魔力的一部分是非局域的：分别作用于系统的两个部分的局域酉无法消除它。如果这些局部幺正被限制为高斯，则非局部魔力随着部分纠缠费米子对的数量 m 线性增长。我们证明这种增长是高斯限制的产物：局部高斯幺正最小化最多三对的非局部稳定器 Rényi 熵，但不会从四对开始。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自由费米子态在经典上是可模拟的，然而，以量子位的形式编写，它们通常具有广泛的魔力，这是稳定器电路所缺乏的量子资源。这种魔力的一部分是非局域的：分别作用于系统的两个部分的局域酉无法消除它。如果这些局部幺正被限制为高斯，则非局部魔力随着部分纠缠费米子对的数量 m 线性增长。我们证明这种增长是高斯限制的产物：局部高斯幺正最小化最多三对的非局部稳定器 Rényi 熵，但不会从四对开始。尊重费米子宇称的一般局部非高斯酉矩阵将 m 个自由费米子对转换为费米子贝尔对，与高斯酉矩阵的指数衰减相比，其保真度最多衰减 1/sqrt m，因此非局部魔力从 m 的线性下降到对数。原因是统计上的——贝尔对具有相等的施密特权重，即完全简并的纠缠谱，并且只有当其施密特权重分布在多个数量级时，状态才能远离它们。这种扩展是通过纠缠容量 C_E、纠缠哈密顿量的方差来衡量的，任何费米子态的非定域魔力最多与 C_E 成对数增长。自由费米子对独立地添加到 C_E，因此 C_E 仅在 m 中线性增长，这导致稳定器保真度最多下降 1/sqrt m。因此，自由费米子的几乎所有魔力，包括 Hartree-Fock 和 BCS 平均场态，都是局域的。

articles.title: On Entanglement Dynamics in Holographic Theories
articles.title_zh: 全息理论中的纠缠动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07010v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Entanglement entropy (EE) is central to modern theoretical physics, yet its calculation in interacting theories with nontrivial time dependence remains challenging. In this thesis, we investigate the real-time dynamics of EE in strongly coupled quantum field theories (QFTs) using the Anti-de Sitter/Conformal Field Theory (AdS/CFT) correspondence. We first examine EE evolution in an exactly solvable two-dimensional conformal field theory (CFT) with an inhomogeneous sine-square deformation (SSD). We argue that the unconventional time evolution driven by the SSD Hamiltonian can be viewed as a change in spacetime foliation, producing new horizons in the dual three-dimensional bulk. Holographic EE calculations agree with CFT results in all comparable cases. We then study entanglement dynamics in generic chaotic quantum many-body systems. In the limit of late time and large regions, these dynamics are believed to admit an effective entanglement membrane description. In 2d CFTs, a degenerate membrane tension reproduces several entropy dynamics results, unlike the non-degenerate tension in higher dimensions. Using holography, we show that capturing reflected entropy in 2d CFT requires an additional degree of freedom in the membrane description. We further show that a conventional non-degenerate tension emerges when the CFT undergoes a relevant deformation, holographically dual to a planar Banados-Teitelboim-Zanelli (BTZ) black hole with scalar hair and an interior Kasner universe. We then develop a membrane effective theory for reflected entropy dynamics in higher dimensions. Finally, we apply the membrane theories for reflected entropy to study the time evolution of multipartite entanglement signals. We found that scrambling dynamics generate multipartite entanglement with rich structures.
articles.abstract_zh: 纠缠熵 (EE) 是现代理论物理学的核心，但其在具有非平凡时间依赖性的相互作用理论中的计算仍然具有挑战性。在本论文中，我们使用反德西特/共形场论 (AdS/CFT) 对应研究强耦合量子场论 (QFT) 中 EE 的实时动力学。我们首先在具有不均匀正弦平方变形 (SSD) 的精确可解二维共形场论 (CFT) 中研究 EE 演化。我们认为，SSD 哈密顿量驱动的非常规时间演化可以被视为时空叶状结构的变化，在双三维体中产生新的视野。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 纠缠熵 (EE) 是现代理论物理学的核心，但其在具有非平凡时间依赖性的相互作用理论中的计算仍然具有挑战性。在本论文中，我们使用反德西特/共形场论 (AdS/CFT) 对应研究强耦合量子场论 (QFT) 中 EE 的实时动力学。我们首先在具有不均匀正弦平方变形 (SSD) 的精确可解二维共形场论 (CFT) 中研究 EE 演化。我们认为，SSD 哈密顿量驱动的非常规时间演化可以被视为时空叶状结构的变化，在双三维体中产生新的视野。在所有可比较的情况下，全息 EE 计算与 CFT 结果一致。然后我们研究通用混沌量子多体系统中的纠缠动力学。在晚期时间和大区域的限制下，这些动力学被认为允许有效的缠结膜描述。在 2d CFT 中，简并膜张力再现了多个熵动力学结果，这与更高维度中的非简并张力不同。使用全息术，我们表明在 2d CFT 中捕获反射熵需要膜描述中的额外自由度。我们进一步表明，当 CFT 经历相关变形时，会出现传统的非简并张力，该变形与具有标量毛发和内部 Kasner 宇宙的平面 Banados-Teitelboim-Zanelli (BTZ) 黑洞全息对偶。然后，我们开发了一种用于更高维度反射熵动力学的膜有效理论。最后，我们应用反射熵的膜理论来研究多部分纠缠信号的时间演化。我们发现置乱动力学会产生具有丰富结构的多部分纠缠。

articles.title: Chern-Simons Interfaces and Minimal Models from Quantum Groups
articles.title_zh: 陈-西蒙斯接口和量子群的最小模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07012v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Coupling two-dimensional fundamental Dirac fermions to SU(N)ₖ Chern-Simons theory produces non-chiral interfaces that in the infrared flow to a compact boson and a W_N minimal model. We propose a description of these interfaces as continuum limits of q-deformed fermion chains. The q-deformation is achieved by coupling a chain of one-dimensional fundamental complex fermions to SU(N)ₖ Chern-Simons theory, keeping the underlying topological gauge field continuous. The operator algebra is controlled by quantum groups, which provide an algebraic perspective on the usual categorical formulation of anyon chains. As an application, we derive a Lieb-Schultz-Mattis constraint involving baryon-number and lattice translation, obstructing a unique symmetric gapped ground state. At unit filling, we gap out the compact boson sector with a Mott term and obtain standard anyon chain Hamiltonians previously studied in the literature. This provides an anomaly argument for the existence of N copies of minimal model sectors permuted by lattice translation in the infrared.
articles.abstract_zh: 将二维基本狄拉克费米子与 SU(N)ₖ Chern-Simons 理论耦合产生非手性界面，该界面在红外中流向紧致玻色子和 W_N 最小模型。我们建议将这些界面描述为 q 变形费米子链的连续极限。 q 变形是通过将一维基本复费米子链耦合到 SU(N)ₖ Chern-Simons 理论来实现的，从而保持基础拓扑规范场连续。算子代数由量子群控制，量子群为任意子链的通常分类公式提供了代数视角。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 将二维基本狄拉克费米子与 SU(N)ₖ Chern-Simons 理论耦合产生非手性界面，该界面在红外中流向紧致玻色子和 W_N 最小模型。我们建议将这些界面描述为 q 变形费米子链的连续极限。 q 变形是通过将一维基本复费米子链耦合到 SU(N)ₖ Chern-Simons 理论来实现的，从而保持基础拓扑规范场连续。算子代数由量子群控制，量子群为任意子链的通常分类公式提供了代数视角。作为一个应用，我们推导了一个涉及重子数和晶格平移的 Lieb-Schultz-Mattis 约束，阻碍了独特的对称带隙基态。在单位填充时，我们用莫特项间隙出紧致玻色子扇区，并获得先前在文献中研究的标准任意子链哈密顿量。这为存在由红外晶格平移排列的最小模型扇区的 N 个副本提供了一个反常的论据。

articles.title: Constraint Variance Identity and the Matter-Geometry Fluctuation Relation
articles.title_zh: 约束方差恒等式与物质-几何涨落关系
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07015v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The quantum Hamiltonian constraint vanishes for physical states. For separable Hamiltonians in minisuperspace, its vanishing variance yields a fundamental identity. Under the Born-Oppenheimer approximation, we derive the Matter-Geometry Fluctuation Relation, dynamically linking spacetime clock fluctuations to matter fluctuations. This establishes a quantitative stability condition for the clock against total quantum noise. Finally, we obtain an uncertainty relation between matter energy and relational time. The stable existence of spacetime thus demands quantum fluctuations in matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 对于物理状态，量子哈密顿约束消失。对于微型超空间中的可分离哈密顿量，其方差消失产生了一个基本恒等式。在玻恩-奥本海默近似下，我们推导出物质-几何涨落关系，动态地将时空时钟涨落与物质涨落联系起来。这为时钟建立了针对总量子噪声的定量稳定性条件。最后，我们得到了物质能量与关系时间之间的不确定性关系。因此，时空的稳定存在需要物质的量子涨落。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对于物理状态，量子哈密顿约束消失。对于微型超空间中的可分离哈密顿量，其方差消失产生了一个基本恒等式。在玻恩-奥本海默近似下，我们推导出物质-几何涨落关系，动态地将时空时钟涨落与物质涨落联系起来。这为时钟建立了针对总量子噪声的定量稳定性条件。最后，我们得到了物质能量与关系时间之间的不确定性关系。因此，时空的稳定存在需要物质的量子涨落。

articles.title: The 2d Ising Model on Hyperbolic Lattices and the Role of Boundary Conditions
articles.title_zh: 双曲晶格的二维伊辛模型和边界条件的作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07045v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate the role of boundary conditions in the critical behaviour of the ferromagnetic Ising model on regular hyperbolic tessellations. Using worm and Metropolis simulations, we compare open boundaries with wired boundaries implemented through a common auxiliary spin. For open boundaries, the susceptibility exhibits volume-based finite-size scaling with non-mean-field scaling exponents that are approximately stable across four tessellations, supporting the possibility of a common universality class. Comparisons with Binder crossings and susceptibility peaks reveal substantial finite-size effects. For wired boundaries, the central-to-auxiliary spin correlator exhibits radial scaling consistent with a mean-field magnetization exponent. The central-spin response to a uniform magnetic field provides a further consistency test of δ=3. Layer-resolved responses to a weak boundary field also reveal an enhancement of the induced magnetization towards the interior. Our results highlight the importance of boundary conditions and the distinction between interior and whole-system observables in characterizing critical phenomena on non-amenable lattices.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了边界条件在规则双曲镶嵌铁磁伊辛模型关键行为中的作用。使用蠕虫和大都会模拟，我们将开放边界与通过公共辅助旋转实现的有线边界进行比较。对于开放边界，磁化率表现出基于体积的有限尺寸缩放，具有非平均场缩放指数，在四个曲面细分中近似稳定，支持共同普遍性类别的可能性。与 Binder 交叉和磁化率峰值的比较揭示了显着的有限尺寸效应。对于有线边界，中心到辅助自旋相关器表现出与平均场磁化指数一致的径向缩放。对均匀磁场的中心自旋响应提供了 δ=3 的进一步一致性测试。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了边界条件在规则双曲镶嵌铁磁伊辛模型关键行为中的作用。使用蠕虫和大都会模拟，我们将开放边界与通过公共辅助旋转实现的有线边界进行比较。对于开放边界，磁化率表现出基于体积的有限尺寸缩放，具有非平均场缩放指数，在四个曲面细分中近似稳定，支持共同普遍性类别的可能性。与 Binder 交叉和磁化率峰值的比较揭示了显着的有限尺寸效应。对于有线边界，中心到辅助自旋相关器表现出与平均场磁化指数一致的径向缩放。对均匀磁场的中心自旋响应提供了 δ=3 的进一步一致性测试。对弱边界场的层分辨响应也揭示了内部感应磁化强度的增强。我们的结果强调了边界条件的重要性以及内部和整个系统可观测量之间的区别在表征不服从晶格上的临界现象时的重要性。

articles.title: Embodied physical learning: a trained bacterial cell wall can guide organism behavior
articles.title_zh: 具身物理学习：经过训练的细菌细胞壁可以指导生物体行为
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07112v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Physical learning studies how physical systems themselves can be trained to perform learning tasks using physical laws. For instance, disordered spring networks can be trained by local rules to route a mechanical signal from one site in the network to another. Disordered spring networks play key roles in many facets of cell biology, not just in terms of mechanics, but also in terms of motility. How then can training on the substrate itself impact the action of an organism, such as a bacterium? Here, we train a spring-network model of the bacterial cell wall and embed it in a motile agent. The stimulus is the load the cell generates by colliding with a surface. The trained wall routes that load across the body to distant flagellar motors, where it drives stator release, and the resulting turn biases the cell toward escape and delays subsequent surface contacts. On the first near-wall tumble after entrapment, the trained cell recovers 89% of the advantage an ideal side-resolved controller provides. We call this arrangement embodied physical learning: the stimulus, the actuator, and the consequences all belong to the agent, and the training force scale is inherited from the agent's own sensing rather than imposed. An actuator with its own kinetics imposes a second, tighter constraint: the routed signal must switch the actuator within the stimulus window. We also find that behavior converges within a few hundred wall encounters, comparable to what a cell in sustained contact with structure experiences in a single generation, and that the routing survives continuous crosslink remodeling provided crucial, tension-bearing bonds are protected. Experimental tests of embodied physical learning are discussed.
articles.abstract_zh: 物理学习研究如何训练物理系统本身以利用物理定律执行学习任务。例如，无序的弹簧网络可以通过本地规则进行训练，将机械信号从网络中的一个站点路由到另一个站点。无序的弹簧网络在细胞生物学的许多方面发挥着关键作用，不仅在力学方面，而且在运动方面。那么，对基质本身的训练如何影响有机体（例如细菌）的行为呢？在这里，我们训练细菌细胞壁的弹簧网络模型并将其嵌入运动代理中。刺激是细胞通过与表面碰撞而产生的负载。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 物理学习研究如何训练物理系统本身以利用物理定律执行学习任务。例如，无序的弹簧网络可以通过本地规则进行训练，将机械信号从网络中的一个站点路由到另一个站点。无序的弹簧网络在细胞生物学的许多方面发挥着关键作用，不仅在力学方面，而且在运动方面。那么，对基质本身的训练如何影响有机体（例如细菌）的行为呢？在这里，我们训练细菌细胞壁的弹簧网络模型并将其嵌入运动代理中。刺激是细胞通过与表面碰撞而产生的负载。经过训练的壁路线将负载穿过身体传递到远处的鞭毛马达，在那里它驱动定子释放，由此产生的转向使细胞偏向逃逸并延迟随后的表面接触。在被困后的第一次近壁翻滚中，经过训练的细胞恢复了理想侧面分辨控制器所提供的 89% 的优势。我们将这种安排称为体现物理学习：刺激、执行器和后果都属于智能体，并且训练力规模是从智能体自身的感知继承而不是强加的。具有自身动力学的执行器施加了第二个更严格的约束：路由信号必须在刺激窗口内切换执行器。我们还发现，行为在几百次墙壁遭遇中收敛，相当于与结构持续接触的细胞在一代中经历的行为，并且只要关键的、承受张力的键受到保护，路由就能在持续的交联重塑中幸存下来。讨论了具身物理学习的实验测试。

articles.title: Data-Driven Modeling of Molten Chloride Corrosion Using Static Test Data
articles.title_zh: 使用静态测试数据进行熔融氯化物腐蚀的数据驱动建模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07125v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Molten chloride corrosion has been studied for decades, yet reliable prediction across different alloys, salts, and test conditions remains difficult. In this work, 291 static molten chloride corrosion experiments reported in the literature were compiled into a structured dataset and used to develop an interpretable machine-learning framework for corrosion-rate predictions. To better represent the differences in salt condition across studies, a Chloride Salt Preparation Index (CSPI) was introduced to bring the reported salt-treatment method, atmosphere control, and pre-exposure impurity condition on a common numerical scale. A blended tree-based ensemble provided the most consistent predictive performance, achieving a cross-validated (R²) of 0.85 and an MAE of 0.41 mg cm(⁻²) day(⁻¹). The graded CSPI retained more useful information than a simple purified/unpurified classification and emerged as the dominant model descriptor. Global sensitivity and SHAP analyses further identified exposure time, temperature, and alloy chemistry as important contributors to the model predictions, with several observed trends consistent with the established molten-chloride corrosion behavior. The conformal prediction intervals were well calibrated, providing an estimate of prediction uncertainty in addition to the point prediction. Overall, the framework demonstrates that historical corrosion data can support quantitative, interpretable, and uncertainty-aware prediction when experimental context is represented explicitly, while also highlighting where more consistent reporting and targeted experiments are needed to improve future molten-salt corrosion models.
articles.abstract_zh: 熔融氯化物腐蚀的研究已经有几十年了，但对不同合金、盐和测试条件的可靠预测仍然很困难。在这项工作中，文献中报道的 291 个静态熔融氯化物腐蚀实验被编译成结构化数据集，并用于开发用于腐蚀速率预测的可解释的机器学习框架。为了更好地表示研究中盐条件的差异，引入了氯化物盐制备指数（CSPI），将报告的盐处理方法、气氛控制和曝光前杂质条件纳入通用的数值范围。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 熔融氯化物腐蚀的研究已经有几十年了，但对不同合金、盐和测试条件的可靠预测仍然很困难。在这项工作中，文献中报道的 291 个静态熔融氯化物腐蚀实验被编译成结构化数据集，并用于开发用于腐蚀速率预测的可解释的机器学习框架。为了更好地表示研究中盐条件的差异，引入了氯化物盐制备指数（CSPI），将报告的盐处理方法、气氛控制和曝光前杂质条件纳入通用的数值范围。基于混合树的集成提供了最一致的预测性能，实现了 0.85 的交叉验证 (R²) 和 0.41 mg cm(⁻²) day(⁻¹) 的 MAE。分级 CSPI 比简单的纯化/未纯化分类保留了更多有用的信息，并成为主要的模型描述符。全局灵敏度和 SHAP 分析进一步确定了暴露时间、温度和合金化学成分是模型预测的重要因素，其中一些观察到的趋势与已建立的熔融氯化物腐蚀行为一致。共形预测区间得到了很好的校准，除了点预测之外，还提供了预测不确定性的估计。总体而言，该框架表明，当明确表示实验背景时，历史腐蚀数据可以支持定量、可解释和不确定性感知的预测，同时还强调需要更一致的报告和有针对性的实验来改进未来的熔盐腐蚀模型。

articles.title: The lattice Boltzmann machine
articles.title_zh: 格子玻尔兹曼机
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07139v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The lattice Boltzmann (LB) method is widely regarded as a very flexible and efficient solver for a broad class of transport phenomena in fluids, soft matter and related fields. In this paper, we posit that such flexibility is a direct result of its generative nature as a rule-driven information-processing machine. Its update, a relaxation toward a local target followed by a shift along the lattice, belongs to the same class of iterated relaxation dynamics as residual networks and transformers, with the difference that in LB the operators are fixed by conservation and symmetry rather than learned from data. We show that three properties of this update are sufficient to promote the emergence of closed macroscopic laws from the underlying iteration process, the physical content of the target deciding the specific law in question. A machine whose target is drawn at random generates the transport law predicted from its moments. A network given the same three properties on a graph, where there is no lattice, is trained on a traffic process and generates a conservation law of its own. The mechanism has a precise limit, where the damping of the non-conserved modes fails, and on the lattice the macroscopic law gives no warning of it. In this reading, LB is a lattice Boltzmann machine whose informing rules are supplied by physics rather than by training. Its three properties then state what a new ingredient should preserve when it enters an LB model, whether it comes from physics or from data.
articles.abstract_zh: 格子玻尔兹曼 (LB) 方法被广泛认为是一种非常灵活且高效的求解器，适用于流体、软物质及相关领域中的广泛输运现象。在本文中，我们认为这种灵活性是其作为规则驱动的信息处理机器的生成性质的直接结果。它的更新是向局部目标松弛，然后沿着晶格移动，与残差网络和变压器属于同一类迭代松弛动力学，不同之处在于 LB 中的算子是通过守恒和对称性固定的，而不是从数据中学习。我们证明，这种更新的三个属性足以促进从底层迭代过程中出现封闭的宏观定律，目标的物理内容决定所讨论的具体定律。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 格子玻尔兹曼 (LB) 方法被广泛认为是一种非常灵活且高效的求解器，适用于流体、软物质及相关领域中的广泛输运现象。在本文中，我们认为这种灵活性是其作为规则驱动的信息处理机器的生成性质的直接结果。它的更新是向局部目标松弛，然后沿着晶格移动，与残差网络和变压器属于同一类迭代松弛动力学，不同之处在于 LB 中的算子是通过守恒和对称性固定的，而不是从数据中学习。我们证明，这种更新的三个属性足以促进从底层迭代过程中出现封闭的宏观定律，目标的物理内容决定所讨论的具体定律。随机抽取目标的机器会生成根据其时刻预测的传输定律。在没有格的图上给出相同三个属性的网络在流量过程上进行训练并生成自己的守恒定律。该机制有一个精确的极限，其中非守恒模式的阻尼失效，并且在晶格上宏观定律没有给出任何警告。在本文中，LB 是一个格子玻尔兹曼机，其通知规则是由物理而不是训练提供的。然后，它的三个属性说明了新成分在进入 LB 模型时应保留哪些内容，无论它来自物理还是来自数据。

articles.title: Thermally-driven quantum reservoir computing
articles.title_zh: 热驱动量子水库计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07187v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Heat generation limits computation, classical and quantum, from single logic gates to entire data centers. However, an in principle limiting physical factor can sometimes be turned into a resource. In reservoir computing, energy dissipation is what gives a reservoir its fading memory. Here, we introduce a paradigm where the data injection itself is encoded on the time-dependent temperature of a thermal bath. We derive an exact expression for the nonlinear response of any fixed readout, and prove a rigorous memory-nonlinearity trade-off which turns out to be a structural necessity, rather than a tunable dynamical regime, since the same coupling that injects data also enforces equilibration. We illustrate both results with a driven qubit, using a single free parameter, and with a pair of coupled qubits, where the breaking of a discrete symmetry opens a fifteen-dimensional space to a single observable, yet that observable alone recovers just over half of it. This refutes the misconception that large Hilbert spaces guarantee computational power. Our results relocate the memory-nonlinearity trade-off from the reservoir's dynamics to its measurement channel, pointing to observable choice and bath engineering (instead of Hamiltonian control) as the physical levers for a thermally-native quantum reservoir computer.
articles.abstract_zh: 从单个逻辑门到整个数据中心，热量的产生限制了经典和量子计算。然而，原则上限制性的物理因素有时可以转化为资源。在水库计算中，能量耗散是水库记忆衰退的原因。在这里，我们引入了一种范例，其中数据注入本身是根据热浴的时间相关温度进行编码的。我们推导了任何固定读数的非线性响应的精确表达式，并证明了严格的记忆非线性权衡，结果证明这是结构上的必要性，而不是可调的动态机制，因为注入数据的相同耦合也强制平衡。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 从单个逻辑门到整个数据中心，热量的产生限制了经典和量子计算。然而，原则上限制性的物理因素有时可以转化为资源。在水库计算中，能量耗散是水库记忆衰退的原因。在这里，我们引入了一种范例，其中数据注入本身是根据热浴的时间相关温度进行编码的。我们推导了任何固定读数的非线性响应的精确表达式，并证明了严格的记忆非线性权衡，结果证明这是结构上的必要性，而不是可调的动态机制，因为注入数据的相同耦合也强制平衡。我们用一个驱动量子位（使用单个自由参数）和一对耦合量子位来说明这两个结果，其中离散对称性的破缺为单个可观察量打开了 15 维空间，但仅该可观察量就恢复了一半以上。这驳斥了大希尔伯特空间保证计算能力的误解。我们的结果将记忆非线性权衡从储层动力学重新定位到其测量通道，指出可观察选择和浴工程（而不是哈密顿控制）作为热原生量子储层计算机的物理杠杆。

articles.title: Frustration-freeness is decidable but unprovable
articles.title_zh: 无挫败感是可判定的，但无法证明
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07337v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The frustration-free property is valuable in quantum many-body systems, which states that its ground states simultaneously minimize all local interaction terms, even when these terms act on overlapping degrees of freedom. Prominent examples include the AKLT model and Kitaev's toric code model, which serve as paradigmatic models of symmetry-protected topological phases and topological order, respectively. A fundamental question is whether a given Hamiltonian is frustration-free for all system sizes. Here we establish two seemingly contradictory results concerning this decision problem. First, we prove that frustration-freeness is decidable for any fixed local Hilbert space dimension. Specifically, there exists a finite, Hamiltonian-independent system-size cutoff such that frustration-freeness at this cutoff size guarantees frustration-freeness at all system sizes. Second, on the other hand, we also show that there exists a frustration-free Hamiltonian whose frustration-freeness cannot be proved within the standard axioms of mathematics (ZFC). We reconcile these seemingly contradictory results by showing that the cutoff, although finite for each local Hilbert space dimension, is uncomputable as a function of that dimension. Our findings reveal an unexpected fundamental distinction between decidability and provability arising in quantum many-body physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 无挫折特性在量子多体系统中很有价值，它表明其基态同时最小化所有局部相互作用项，即使这些项作用于重叠的自由度。突出的例子包括 AKLT 模型和 Kitaev 的环面码模型，它们分别作为对称保护拓扑相和拓扑序的范例模型。一个基本问题是给定的哈密顿量是否对于所有系统规模都是无挫败感的。在这里，我们针对这个决策问题建立了两个看似矛盾的结果。首先，我们证明对于任何固定的局部希尔伯特空间维度，无挫败性是可判定的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 无挫折特性在量子多体系统中很有价值，它表明其基态同时最小化所有局部相互作用项，即使这些项作用于重叠的自由度。突出的例子包括 AKLT 模型和 Kitaev 的环面码模型，它们分别作为对称保护拓扑相和拓扑序的范例模型。一个基本问题是给定的哈密顿量是否对于所有系统规模都是无挫败感的。在这里，我们针对这个决策问题建立了两个看似矛盾的结果。首先，我们证明对于任何固定的局部希尔伯特空间维度，无挫败性是可判定的。具体来说，存在一个有限的、与哈密顿量无关的系统尺寸截止，使得该截止尺寸的无挫败性保证了所有系统尺寸的无挫败性。其次，另一方面，我们还证明存在一个无挫败哈密顿量，其无挫败性无法在数学标准公理（ZFC）内得到证明。我们通过证明截止虽然对于每个局部希尔伯特空间维度是有限的，但作为该维度的函数是不可计算的，从而调和了这些看似矛盾的结果。我们的研究结果揭示了量子多体物理学中可判定性和可证明性之间出现的意想不到的根本区别。

articles.title: Spectral symmetry fingerprints in equivariant representations
articles.title_zh: 等变量表示中的光谱对称指纹
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07410v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Symmetry governs the organization of physical structures, while symmetry breaking reveals their transformations. In geometric deep learning, symmetry imposes rank constraints on equivariant representations, limiting the expressive capacity of equivariant graph neural networks (GNNs). Here we show that these constraints can instead be exploited: the singular-value spectra of equivariant representations provide a unified fingerprint of structural symmetry. We introduce spectral symmetry fingerprints (SymFP), which enable discrete point-group identification through rank-template matching and continuous symmetry analysis by quantifying spectral energy beyond target rank constraints. SymFP is orientation invariant and architecture agnostic, enabling a parameter-free GNN implementation. Its spectra can be reused across multiple target groups, and the resulting leakage scores satisfy subgroup monotonicity. Across synthetic structures, molecules, coordination complexes and large biological assemblies, SymFP accurately identifies point groups, tracks controlled symmetry breaking and reveals local and degree-resolved symmetry changes that can be obscured by global geometric measures. These results establish the spectral structure of equivariant representations as a general framework for characterizing symmetry across physical systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 对称性支配着物理结构的组织，而对称性的破坏揭示了它们的转换。在几何深度学习中，对称性对等变量表示施加了秩约束，限制了等变量图神经网络（ GNN ）的表达能力。在这里，我们表明这些约束可以被利用：等变表示的奇异值谱提供了结构对称的统一指纹。我们引入了光谱对称指纹（ SymFP ） ，通过等级模板匹配和连续对称分析，通过量化超出目标等级约束的光谱能量，实现离散点群识别。SymFP是定向不变的，与架构无关，实现了无参数的GNN实现。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对称性支配着物理结构的组织，而对称性的破坏揭示了它们的转换。在几何深度学习中，对称性对等变量表示施加了秩约束，限制了等变量图神经网络（ GNN ）的表达能力。在这里，我们表明这些约束可以被利用：等变表示的奇异值谱提供了结构对称的统一指纹。我们引入了光谱对称指纹（ SymFP ） ，通过等级模板匹配和连续对称分析，通过量化超出目标等级约束的光谱能量，实现离散点群识别。SymFP是定向不变的，与架构无关，实现了无参数的GNN实现。其光谱可以在多个靶组中重复使用，由此产生的泄漏评分满足亚组单调性。在合成结构、分子、配位复合物和大型生物组件中， SymFP准确识别点群，跟踪受控对称性破坏，并揭示局部和程度分辨的对称性变化，这些变化可能被全局几何测量所掩盖。这些结果建立了等变表示的光谱结构，作为表征物理系统对称性的一般框架。

articles.title: Equivariant Deep Learning in Direct-Product Space for Electronic-Structure Hamiltonian Prediction
articles.title_zh: 用于电子结构哈密顿预测的直接积空间中的等变量深度学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07695v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Most existing equivariant architectures for Hamiltonian prediction propagate features in direct-sum spaces of irreducible spherical tensors, whereas the target Hamiltonian is naturally an operator block in a direct-product representation over local orbital and spin bases. This representation mismatch fragments contiguous Hamiltonian blocks, obscures direct manipulation of orbital couplings, and organizes features into irregular angular-momentum components that require numerous transformations and are poorly aligned with efficient hardware execution and memory management. To address both the representation mismatch and computational bottleneck, we propose DP-Learner, an equivariant learning framework that performs message passing directly on Hamiltonian-like operator blocks in the direct-product space. Theoretically, we propose Lie-generator-based directional embedding and invariantly weighted left--right products and contractions that preserve equivariance to SO(3), SU(2), and spatial inversions, without explicit Clebsch--Gordan decomposition or inverse reconstruction. Methodologically, we instantiate this principle as a Transformer architecture, in which Hamiltonian-like feature matrices or tensors evolve through equivariant operators in the direct-product space, while non-linear invariant scalar routing controls structured gating over matrix units, directional propagation, attention, and environment-embedded context interactions. We further construct MP-HAM-110K, a large-scale Hamiltonian dataset comprising more than 110,000 material structures covering 68 elements with both Hamiltonian and wavefunction data. Experiments on MP-HAM-110K and Materials-HAM-SOC demonstrate that DP-Learner dramatically improves Hamiltonian prediction accuracy and inference efficiency over the state-of-the-art method.
articles.abstract_zh: 大多数现有的汉密尔顿预测等变量架构在不可约球面张量的直和空间中传播特征，而目标汉密尔顿变量自然是局部轨道和自旋基的直接乘积表示中的算子块。这种表示不匹配分割了相邻的哈密顿块，模糊了轨道耦合的直接操作，并将特征组织成不规则的角动量组件，这些组件需要许多变换，并且与有效的硬件执行和内存管理不协调。为了解决表示不匹配和计算瓶颈，我们提出了DP-Learner ，这是一个等变学习框架，直接在直接乘积空间中的类汉密尔顿算子块上执行消息传递。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 大多数现有的汉密尔顿预测等变量架构在不可约球面张量的直和空间中传播特征，而目标汉密尔顿变量自然是局部轨道和自旋基的直接乘积表示中的算子块。这种表示不匹配分割了相邻的哈密顿块，模糊了轨道耦合的直接操作，并将特征组织成不规则的角动量组件，这些组件需要许多变换，并且与有效的硬件执行和内存管理不协调。为了解决表示不匹配和计算瓶颈，我们提出了DP-Learner ，这是一个等变学习框架，直接在直接乘积空间中的类汉密尔顿算子块上执行消息传递。从理论上讲，我们提出了基于Lie-generator的定向嵌入和不变加权左-右积和收缩，这些积和收缩保留了与SO （ 3 ） ， SU （ 2 ）和空间反演的等方差，而没有显式的Clebsch-Gordan分解或反重建。在方法论上，我们将此原理实例化为变换器架构，其中类似哈密顿的特征矩阵或张量通过直积空间中的等变量运算符演化，而非线性不变标量路由控制矩阵单元、方向传播、注意力和环境嵌入式上下文交互的结构化门控。我们进一步构建MP-HAM-110K ，这是一个大规模的汉密尔顿数据集，由超过110,000个材料结构组成，涵盖68个元素，同时包含汉密尔顿和波函数数据。在MP-HAM-110K和Materials-HAM-SOC上的实验表明，与最先进的方法相比， DP-Learner显著提高了哈密顿预测的准确性和推理效率。

articles.title: Continuum Photonic Axion Insulators
articles.title_zh: Continuum光子轴子绝缘子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07893v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Here, I study the conditions for realizing an axion topology in a homogeneous inversion-symmetric electromagnetic continuum, in the absence of a crystalline lattice. I introduce a continuum inversion invariant expressed solely in terms of the spectral properties of the material response in the zero- and infinite-wave-vector limits. Surprisingly, it is found that standard gyrotropic-type material responses are strongly constrained and, under fairly general conditions, cannot open an axion gap within first-order perturbation theory. Based on an analogy between the effective response of crystalline photonic axion insulators and the optical response of centrosymmetric altermagnets, a class of spatially dispersive odd magnetoelectric couplings that can open an axion gap is identified. These findings suggest an interesting hierarchy of nonreciprocal mechanisms in electromagnetic continua: while uniform gyrotropy relates to Chern phases, odd magnetoelectric coupling relates to axion phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 在这里，我研究了在没有晶格的情况下，在齐次反向对称电磁连续体中实现轴子拓扑的条件。我引入了一个连续反演不变量，仅用零和无限波矢量极限中材料响应的光谱特性来表示。令人惊讶的是，发现标准陀螺型材料响应受到强烈约束，并且在相当一般的条件下，在一阶扰动理论中不能打开轴子间隙。基于晶体光子轴子绝缘子的有效响应和中心对称变磁体的光响应之间的类比，确定了一类可以打开轴子间隙的空间色散奇数磁电耦合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这里，我研究了在没有晶格的情况下，在齐次反向对称电磁连续体中实现轴子拓扑的条件。我引入了一个连续反演不变量，仅用零和无限波矢量极限中材料响应的光谱特性来表示。令人惊讶的是，发现标准陀螺型材料响应受到强烈约束，并且在相当一般的条件下，在一阶扰动理论中不能打开轴子间隙。基于晶体光子轴子绝缘子的有效响应和中心对称变磁体的光响应之间的类比，确定了一类可以打开轴子间隙的空间色散奇数磁电耦合。这些发现表明，电磁连续体的非互易机制存在一个有趣的层次结构：虽然均匀陀螺与Chern相位有关，但奇数磁电耦合与轴子相位有关。

articles.title: A Passive Intelligent Metasurface: A Network Model
articles.title_zh: 被动智能元表面：网络模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07894v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Intelligent metasurfaces enable advanced wave manipulation, including negative refraction, focusing, beam splitting and beam steering, with significant potential for practical applications. However, conventional approaches often rely on active metamaterials with gain, or demand computationally intensive solutions of inverse problems to find the optimal configuration. In this work, we use the scattering framework of quantum graph theory to derive an exact, analytic expression for configuration of a passive metasurface that produces a prescribed reflected wave field. The metasurface terminates a periodic lattice of waveguides and consists of an array of channels, each a tube of length ellₘ ending in a vertex whose scattering parameter λₘ sets how much of the wave is lost to the wall. For any prescribed incident and reflected field, the exact lengths and scattering parameters follow channel by channel, in closed form, from the ratio of the wave amplitudes returning to and leaving the lattice, and the metasurface is passive whenever this ratio does not exceed unity in modulus. We demonstrate the construction for both a one-dimensional and a two-dimensional metasurface. The one-dimensional metasurface terminates a two-dimensional lattice and steers, splits or perfectly absorbs Gaussian beams. The two-dimensional metasurface terminates a three-dimensional lattice and generates a prescribed image in a plane inside the lattice. In each case, we obtain the exact boundary properties that produce the effect.
articles.abstract_zh: 智能元表面可实现高级波操作，包括负折射、聚焦、光束分裂和光束转向，具有巨大的实际应用潜力。然而，传统方法通常依赖于具有增益的有源超材料，或者需要逆问题的计算密集型解决方案来找到最佳配置。在这项工作中，我们使用量子图理论的散射框架来导出产生规定反射波场的被动元表面配置的精确解析表达式。元表面终止波导的周期性晶格，并由一系列通道组成，每个通道都是以顶点结束的长度为e l l的管，其散射参数λ l设置有多少波浪丢失到壁上。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 智能元表面可实现高级波操作，包括负折射、聚焦、光束分裂和光束转向，具有巨大的实际应用潜力。然而，传统方法通常依赖于具有增益的有源超材料，或者需要逆问题的计算密集型解决方案来找到最佳配置。在这项工作中，我们使用量子图理论的散射框架来导出产生规定反射波场的被动元表面配置的精确解析表达式。元表面终止波导的周期性晶格，并由一系列通道组成，每个通道都是以顶点结束的长度为e l l的管，其散射参数λ l设置有多少波浪丢失到壁上。对于任何规定的入射场和反射场，精确的长度和散射参数以闭合形式逐通道跟随波幅返回和离开晶格的比率，并且当该比率不超过模量的统一性时，元表面是被动的。我们演示了一维元表面和二维元表面的构造。一维元表面终止二维晶格，引导、分裂或完美吸收高斯光束。二维元表面终止三维晶格，并在晶格内的平面中生成规定的图像。在每种情况下，我们都会获得产生效果的确切边界属性。

articles.title: Monopoles, Scattering and Generalized Symmetries on a Quantum Computer
articles.title_zh: 量子计算机上的单极子、散射和广义对称
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07960v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum computers have advanced to the stage that interesting many-body quantum phenomena can be observed. A striking example is the magnetic monopole paradox, a problem that was only solved recently using the language of generalized symmetries. Here we demonstrate a quantum spin chain analogue of magnetic monopole scattering on Quantinuum System Model H2. We implement a novel protocol for preparing a localized quasiparticle wavepacket on top of the ground state. By combining this protocol with time evolution across a duality defect, we efficiently convert local particles into non-local string-like excitations. We demonstrate this particle-to-string conversion in the transverse-field Ising model and a symmetry-protected topological (SPT) phase of the cluster model. Our results establish duality defects and generalized symmetries as practical resources for preparing and probing non-local excitations on quantum hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子计算机已经发展到可以观察到有趣的多体量子现象的阶段。一个引人注目的例子是磁单极子悖论，这个问题最近才使用广义对称语言解决。在这里，我们展示了量子空间系统模型H2上磁单极散射的量子自旋链类似物。我们实现了一种新颖的协议，用于在基态之上准备局部化准粒子波包。通过将该协议与跨对偶缺陷的时间演化相结合，我们有效地将局部粒子转换为非局部弦状激发。我们在横向场Ising模型和聚类模型的对称保护拓扑（ SPT ）相位中演示了这种粒子到串的转换。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子计算机已经发展到可以观察到有趣的多体量子现象的阶段。一个引人注目的例子是磁单极子悖论，这个问题最近才使用广义对称语言解决。在这里，我们展示了量子空间系统模型H2上磁单极散射的量子自旋链类似物。我们实现了一种新颖的协议，用于在基态之上准备局部化准粒子波包。通过将该协议与跨对偶缺陷的时间演化相结合，我们有效地将局部粒子转换为非局部弦状激发。我们在横向场Ising模型和聚类模型的对称保护拓扑（ SPT ）相位中演示了这种粒子到串的转换。我们的结果建立了对偶性缺陷和广义对称性，作为在量子硬件上准备和探测非局部激发的实用资源。

articles.title: Towards Multiscale Molecular Representation Learning through Geometry-Based Fragmentation for Polymer Property Prediction
articles.title_zh: 基于几何碎片的多尺度分子表示学习用于聚合物性质预测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07998v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: It is well established that molecular substructures can contribute unequally to chemical and physical properties, with specific motifs or side chains often playing dominant roles. Fragment-based representations have therefore emerged as an effective strategy for incorporating chemically meaningful inductive biases, as exemplified by molecular fingerprints and fragment-based attention mechanisms. However, many existing fragmentation-based machine learning methods rely on predefined chemical rules, which may yield suboptimal fragmentation for previously unseen or chemically unfamiliar structures and often overlook the importance of multiscale molecular representations. To address these limitations, we formulate molecular fragmentation as a radius-constrained optimization problem inspired by the k-center formulation, where the number of clusters is not fixed a priori but emerges from the specified radius, and propose a geometry-based fragmentation method that partitions arbitrary molecular or material structures using largely geometric information, without relying on predefined chemical fragmentation rules. The method provides flexible control over fragment size, enabling the construction of multiscale fragment representations for scale-adaptive modeling. Building on this framework, we develop a geometric fragment-based attention mechanism that integrates multiscale structural information and incorporate it into a multimodal machine learning model combining p-SMILES representations with three-dimensional (3D) conformational information. Experiments on a benchmark polymer dataset show that incorporating 3D conformational information improves prediction accuracy for several properties over models based exclusively on p-SMILES representations. Explainable artificial intelligence analyses further provide insights into the physical relevance of the learned representations.
articles.abstract_zh: 众所周知，分子亚结构对化学和物理性质的贡献不均匀，特定基序或侧链通常起主导作用。因此，基于片段的表示已成为整合化学上有意义的诱导偏差的有效策略，例如分子指纹和基于片段的注意机制。然而，许多现有的基于碎片的机器学习方法依赖于预定义的化学规则，这对于以前看不见的或化学上不熟悉的结构可能产生次优的碎片，并且经常忽略多尺度分子表示的重要性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 众所周知，分子亚结构对化学和物理性质的贡献不均匀，特定基序或侧链通常起主导作用。因此，基于片段的表示已成为整合化学上有意义的诱导偏差的有效策略，例如分子指纹和基于片段的注意机制。然而，许多现有的基于碎片的机器学习方法依赖于预定义的化学规则，这对于以前看不见的或化学上不熟悉的结构可能产生次优的碎片，并且经常忽略多尺度分子表示的重要性。为了解决这些局限性，我们将分子碎裂公式化为受k中心公式启发的半径约束优化问题，其中簇的数量不是先验固定的，而是从指定的半径出现的，并提出了一种基于几何的碎裂方法，该方法主要使用几何信息来划分任意分子或材料结构，而不依赖于预先定义的化学碎裂规则。该方法提供了对片段大小的灵活控制，从而能够构建用于规模自适应建模的多尺度片段表示。在此框架的基础上，我们开发了一种基于几何片段的注意力机制，该机制集成了多尺度结构信息，并将其整合到将p-SMILES表示与三维（ 3D ）构象信息相结合的多模态机器学习模型中。在基准聚合物数据集上的实验表明，与完全基于p-SMILES表示的模型相比，结合3D构象信息提高了多个属性的预测精度。可解释的人工智能分析进一步提供了对已学习表示的物理相关性的见解。

articles.title: Coupling between molecular exchange qubits
articles.title_zh: 分子交换量子位之间的耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08058v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Spin triangles are promising systems for defining and manipulating scalar degrees of freedom, such as chirality, partial spin sums, or combinations between the two. Here we extend this analysis to dimers formed by pairs of spin triangles, coupled by exchange or dipolar interactions. We show that the weak-coupling limit warrants the introduction of an effective two-qubit picture, and derive the expressions of the related Hamiltonians as a function of the underlying physical interaction between the triangles. We benchmark this two-qubit Hamiltonian against the microscopic one, and discuss the observable effects of the inter-triangle coupling on the spin-electric transitions between states with different chiralities or partial-spin sums.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋三角形是定义和操纵标量自由度的有希望的系统，例如手性、部分自旋和或两者之间的组合。在这里，我们将这种分析扩展到由自旋三角对形成的二聚体，这些二聚体通过交换或偶极相互作用耦合。我们证明了弱耦合极限保证了引入有效的双量子位图，并推导出相关哈密顿函数作为三角形之间潜在物理相互作用的函数的表达式。我们将这个双量子比特哈密顿量与微观哈密顿量进行基准比较，并讨论了三角间耦合对不同手性或部分自旋和状态之间自旋-电跃迁的可观察影响。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋三角形是定义和操纵标量自由度的有希望的系统，例如手性、部分自旋和或两者之间的组合。在这里，我们将这种分析扩展到由自旋三角对形成的二聚体，这些二聚体通过交换或偶极相互作用耦合。我们证明了弱耦合极限保证了引入有效的双量子位图，并推导出相关哈密顿函数作为三角形之间潜在物理相互作用的函数的表达式。我们将这个双量子比特哈密顿量与微观哈密顿量进行基准比较，并讨论了三角间耦合对不同手性或部分自旋和状态之间自旋-电跃迁的可观察影响。

articles.title: Non-Unitary Quantum Butterfly Effect: Theory and Experiment
articles.title_zh: 非统一量子蝴蝶效应：理论与实验
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08152v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present a generalization of the out of time order correlator (OTOC) for non-unitary systems. For a Haar-random brickwork qudit-circuit, peppered with local, projective measurement, we calculate the infinite-temperature, ensemble-average OTOC. Utilizing transfer matrix machinery, we find that the OTOC asymptotically decays exponentially and that the decay depends on the rate of measurement. In the thermodynamic limit, with sparse measurement, the OTOC approximately exhibits a Gaussian shape. Phenomenologically, this corresponds to the development of a causal scrambling front where unlike the unitary case, the signal decays in the bulk of the causal cone. We develop a Monte Carlo framework to compute the OTOC. We then estimate the OTOC directly via quantum simulation and on Quantinuum's trapped-ion quantum computer. We resolve the unitary and non-unitary OTOC phenomenology despite the presence of hardware noise. Our analytic results characterize how local nonunitary channels affect OTOC decay, providing a quantitative benchmark for the cumulative effects of a broad class of hardware noise on many-body dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了非统一系统的无序相关器（ OTOC ）的推广。对于哈尔随机砖结构qudit电路，加上局部投影测量，我们计算无限温度，集成平均OTOC。利用传递矩阵机制，我们发现OTOC呈指数渐近衰减，衰减取决于测量速率。在热力学极限中，通过稀疏测量， OTOC近似呈现高斯形状。在现象学上，这对应于因果加扰锋的发展，其中与单一情况不同，信号在因果锥的大部分中衰减。我们开发了一个蒙特卡洛框架来计算OTOC。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了非统一系统的无序相关器（ OTOC ）的推广。对于哈尔随机砖结构qudit电路，加上局部投影测量，我们计算无限温度，集成平均OTOC。利用传递矩阵机制，我们发现OTOC呈指数渐近衰减，衰减取决于测量速率。在热力学极限中，通过稀疏测量， OTOC近似呈现高斯形状。在现象学上，这对应于因果加扰锋的发展，其中与单一情况不同，信号在因果锥的大部分中衰减。我们开发了一个蒙特卡洛框架来计算OTOC。然后，我们直接通过量子模拟和Quantinuum的陷阱离子量子计算机来估计OTOC。尽管存在硬件噪声，我们还是解决了单一和非单一OTOC现象。我们的分析结果表征了局部非单一通道如何影响OTOC衰减，为广泛的硬件噪声对多体动力学的累积影响提供了定量基准。

articles.title: Dualities in one-dimensional quantum lattice models: Lie groups, Schur-Weyl duality and symmetry breaking
articles.title_zh: 一维量子格模型中的对偶性：李群、Schur-Weyl对偶性和对称性破缺
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08293v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present a systematic framework for gauging continuous symmetries, and show that the Schur-Weyl duality arises naturally as a realization of this construction with open boundary conditions. Restricting to compact Lie group symmetries, we construct dual models for one-dimensional quantum lattice models exhibiting those symmetries. We demonstrate that matrix product operators enable the explicit construction of intertwiners between the dual theories and their (non-invertible) symmetries. With closed boundary conditions, we can relate the full spectrum of these dual theories by considering all possible twisted boundary conditions.We illustrate how the Peter-Weyl transform appears when the duality acts on the boundary Hilbert space of a G-symmetric model. The presented framework generalizes previous work on dualities for unitary fusion category symmetric models. It exemplifies how dualities for both finite and continuous symmetries rely on the relation between a bond algebra and a representation of the symmetry in the lattice as double centralizers. We argue that dual non-invertible spontaneous symmetry breaking is the mechanism that underlies symmetric tensor network algorithms. We illustrate these results for U(1)- and SU(2)-symmetric quantum lattice models.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个用于测量连续对称性的系统框架，并证明Schur-Weyl对偶性作为这种具有开放边界条件的构造的实现而自然产生。局限于紧李群对称性，我们为表现出这些对称性的一维量子晶格模型构建对偶模型。我们证明了矩阵乘积算子能够在对偶理论和它们的（不可逆的）对称性之间显式构造孪生体。在闭边界条件下，我们可以通过考虑所有可能的扭曲边界条件来关联这些对偶理论的全部谱。我们说明了当对偶性作用于G对称模型的边界希尔伯特空间时， Peter-Weyl变换是如何出现的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一个用于测量连续对称性的系统框架，并证明Schur-Weyl对偶性作为这种具有开放边界条件的构造的实现而自然产生。局限于紧李群对称性，我们为表现出这些对称性的一维量子晶格模型构建对偶模型。我们证明了矩阵乘积算子能够在对偶理论和它们的（不可逆的）对称性之间显式构造孪生体。在闭边界条件下，我们可以通过考虑所有可能的扭曲边界条件来关联这些对偶理论的全部谱。我们说明了当对偶性作用于G对称模型的边界希尔伯特空间时， Peter-Weyl变换是如何出现的。提出的框架概括了先前关于单一融合类别对称模型对偶性的工作。它举例说明了有限对称性和连续对称性的对偶性如何依赖于键代数和晶格中的对称性表示之间的关系作为双重集中器。我们认为，对偶非可逆自发对称断裂是对称张量网络算法的基础机制。我们说明了U (1) -和SU (2) -对称量子晶格模型的这些结果。

articles.title: A Simple Approach to the Complexity of Mean Field Ising Spin Glasses
articles.title_zh: 解决平均场Ising旋转玻璃复杂性的简单方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08374v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The geometry of spherical spin glasses is relatively well understood, thanks in large part to the Kac-Rice formula. However, this formula does not directly apply to discrete spin systems, and much less is known mathematically about the geometry of Ising spin glasses. In this paper, we present a simple method for counting local optima and gapped states in a broad class of discrete spin glasses. To illustrate its scope, we compute the annealed complexities ("configurational entropies," in the physics language) of mixed Ising spin glasses with potentials, such as external fields, and of the Ghatak-Sherrington model. These computations recover several existing results in the mathematics and physics literature as special cases. We can also compute energy-constrained complexity, finding a critical energy threshold analogous to the spherical case, but for gapped states of pure Ising spin glasses. Finally, we use our method to establish a form of disorder persistence for gapped states, identifying a transition between 3-spin and 4-spin glasses.
articles.abstract_zh: 球形旋转玻璃的几何形状相对较好，这在很大程度上要归功于Kac-Rice公式。然而，该公式并不直接适用于离散自旋系统，并且在数学上对Ising自旋玻璃的几何形状知之甚少。在本文中，我们提出了一种简单的方法来计算广泛的离散自旋玻璃中的局部最优状态和间隙状态。为了说明其范围，我们计算了具有电势的混合Ising自旋玻璃（如外部场）和Ghatak-Sherrington模型的退火复杂性（物理语言中的“配置熵” ）。这些计算作为特殊情况恢复了数学和物理文献中的几个现有结果。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 球形旋转玻璃的几何形状相对较好，这在很大程度上要归功于Kac-Rice公式。然而，该公式并不直接适用于离散自旋系统，并且在数学上对Ising自旋玻璃的几何形状知之甚少。在本文中，我们提出了一种简单的方法来计算广泛的离散自旋玻璃中的局部最优状态和间隙状态。为了说明其范围，我们计算了具有电势的混合Ising自旋玻璃（如外部场）和Ghatak-Sherrington模型的退火复杂性（物理语言中的“配置熵” ）。这些计算作为特殊情况恢复了数学和物理文献中的几个现有结果。我们还可以计算能量受限的复杂性，找到类似于球形情况的临界能量阈值，但适用于纯Ising自旋玻璃的间隙状态。最后，我们使用我们的方法为间隙状态建立一种无序持续的形式，识别3自旋和4自旋玻璃之间的过渡。

articles.title: Magnetism modulation in Co3Sn2S2 by current-assisted domain wall motion
articles.title_zh: 电流辅助畴壁运动对Co3Sn2S2中的磁性调制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2011.08391v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The efficiency of spintronic devices can be improved by generating higher effective magnetic fields with lower working currents. Spin-transfer torques can drive magnetic domain wall motion in a device composed of a single material, but a high threshold current density is typically required to move the domain wall and improving the effective magnetic field in common itinerant ferromagnets is difficult. Here we report magnetism modulation in Co₃Sn₂S₂, a magnetic Weyl semimetal, via spin-transfer-torque-driven domain wall motion. We examine the effect of d.c. current on magnetic reversal using anomalous Hall resistance measurements and domain wall motion using time-of-flight measurements. At 160 K, the threshold current density for driving domain wall motion is less than 5.1×10⁵ A cm⁻² at zero external field and less than 1.5×10⁵ A cm⁻² at a moderate external field (0.2 kOe). The spin-transfer-torque effective field can reach as high as 2.4 to 5.6 kOe MA⁻¹ cm² at 150 K.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋电子器件的效率可以通过以较低的工作电流产生更高的有效磁场来提高。自旋转移矩可以驱动由单一材料组成的器件中的磁畴壁运动，但通常需要高阈值电流密度来移动磁畴壁，并且提高普通巡回铁磁体中的有效磁场很困难。在这里，我们报告了通过自旋转移力矩驱动的磁畴壁运动对 Co₃Sn2S2（一种磁性韦尔半金属）进行磁调制。我们检查 d.c. 的影响。使用反常霍尔电阻测量来测量磁反转电流，并使用飞行时间测量来测量磁畴壁运动。

articles.title: Thermodynamics of the q-deformed Kittel--Shore model
articles.title_zh: q 变形 Kittel--Shore 模型的热力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.15216v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The Kittel--Shore Hamiltonian characterizes N spins with identical long-range interactions, and the mathfraksu(2) coalgebra has been proven to be a symmetry of this model, which can be exactly solved. By using quantum groups and, in particular, mathfraksuq(2), this Hamiltonian was deformed. In this work, we study the thermodynamic properties of this deformed model for spin-1/2 particles. In particular, we discuss how this deformation affects the specific heat, magnetic susceptibility, magnetisation, and phase transitions as a function of the parameter q of the deformation and compare them with those of the undeformed model. Deformation was found to shift the thermodynamic behaviours to higher temperatures and alter the phase transitions. Additionally, we extend the framework to complex deformations on the unit circle, q = eⁱθ, for q not being a root of unity. For an N=4 tetrahedral cluster, this phase establishes a thermodynamic equivalence between a second-neighbor spin-Hamiltonian and the q-deformed quantum model. At least, we have found experimental compounds well reproduced by the Kittel--Shore model for N=4. Validating our effective algebraic model against exact diagonalisation data for the Cu₂Te₂O₅X₂ (X=Cl, Br) compound family demonstrates that θ accurately reproduces the structural anisotropy.
articles.abstract_zh: Kittel--Shore 哈密顿量表征了具有相同长程相互作用的 N 个自旋，并且 mathfraksu(2) 余代数已被证明是该模型的对称性，并且可以精确求解。通过使用量子群，特别是 mathfraksuq(2)，这个哈密顿量被变形了。在这项工作中，我们研究了自旋 1/2 粒子的变形模型的热力学性质。特别是，我们讨论了这种变形如何影响比热、磁化率、磁化强度和相变作为变形参数 q 的函数，并将它们与未变形模型的参数进行比较。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Kittel--Shore 哈密顿量表征了具有相同长程相互作用的 N 个自旋，并且 mathfraksu(2) 余代数已被证明是该模型的对称性，并且可以精确求解。通过使用量子群，特别是 mathfraksuq(2)，这个哈密顿量被变形了。在这项工作中，我们研究了自旋 1/2 粒子的变形模型的热力学性质。特别是，我们讨论了这种变形如何影响比热、磁化率、磁化强度和相变作为变形参数 q 的函数，并将它们与未变形模型的参数进行比较。人们发现变形可以将热力学行为转移到更高的温度并改变相变。此外，我们将框架扩展到单位圆上的复杂变形，q = eⁱθ，因为 q 不是单位根。对于 N=4 四面体簇，该相在第二邻域自旋哈密尔顿模型和 q 变形量子模型之间建立了热力学等价关系。至少，我们发现 N=4 的 Kittel-Shore 模型可以很好地再现实验化合物。根据 Cu2Te2O5X2 (X=Cl, Br) 化合物族的精确对角化数据验证我们的有效代数模型，表明 θ 准确地再现了结构各向异性。

articles.title: Sparse Statistical Modeling in Condensed Matter Physics
articles.title_zh: 凝聚态物理中的稀疏统计建模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.14184v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this work we explore the possibility of using sparse statistical modeling in condensed matter physics. The procedure is employed to two well known problems: elemental superconductors and heavy fermions, and was shown that in most cases performs better than other AI methods, such as machine or deep learning. More importantly, sparse modeling has two major advantages over other methods: the ability to deal with small data sets and in particular its interpretabilty. Namely, sparse modeling can provide insight into the calculation process and allow the users to give physical interpretation of their results. We argue that many other problems in condensed matter physics would benefit from these properties of sparse statistical modeling.
articles.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们探索在凝聚态物理中使用稀疏统计模型的可能性。该过程用于解决两个众所周知的问题：元素超导体和重费米子，并且结果表明，在大多数情况下，其性能优于其他人工智能方法，例如机器或深度学习。更重要的是，稀疏建模比其他方法有两大优势：处理小数据集的能力，特别是其可解释性。也就是说，稀疏建模可以深入了解计算过程，并允许用户对其结果进行物理解释。我们认为凝聚态物理中的许多其他问题将受益于稀疏统计模型的这些特性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这项工作中，我们探索在凝聚态物理中使用稀疏统计模型的可能性。该过程用于解决两个众所周知的问题：元素超导体和重费米子，并且结果表明，在大多数情况下，其性能优于其他人工智能方法，例如机器或深度学习。更重要的是，稀疏建模比其他方法有两大优势：处理小数据集的能力，特别是其可解释性。也就是说，稀疏建模可以深入了解计算过程，并允许用户对其结果进行物理解释。我们认为凝聚态物理中的许多其他问题将受益于稀疏统计模型的这些特性。

articles.title: Unifying Dirac Spin Liquids on Square and Shastry-Sutherland Lattices via Fermionic Deconfined Criticality
articles.title_zh: 通过费米子解域临界统一方格和 Shastry-Sutherland 晶格上的狄拉克自旋液体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.19980v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a fermionic gauge theory for deconfined quantum criticality on the Shastry-Sutherland lattice and reveal its shared low-energy field-theoretic structure with the square lattice. Starting from an SU(2) π-flux parent state, we construct a continuum theory of Dirac spinons coupled to an SU(2) gauge field and adjoint Higgs fields whose condensates drive transitions to a staggered-flux U(1) spin liquid and a gapless Z₂ Dirac spin liquid. While the Shastry-Sutherland lattice permits additional symmetry-allowed fermion bilinears compared to the square lattice, the quantum field theories are identical up to additional irrelevant terms. Consequently, the Higgs potential structure and the leading low-energy theory coincide with the square-lattice case at the quantum critical point. The SO(5) critical point is expected to realize conformal deconfined criticality: we analyze it in a large-flavor expansion, calculate its critical exponents, and identify the Yukawa coupling between the fermions and Higgs fields as the relevant perturbation that destabilizes it, consistent with pseudocritical behavior observed in recent Monte Carlo studies. We show that the emergent SO(5) order parameter acquires a large anomalous dimension at the critical point, leading to strongly enhanced Néel and VBS susceptibilities-a hallmark of fermionic deconfined quantum criticality consistent with numerical studies. Our results place recent numerical evidence for a gapless Z₂ Dirac spin liquid on the Shastry-Sutherland lattice within a controlled field-theoretic framework and demonstrate that fermionic deconfined criticality on the square lattice-including critical exponents and stability-extends to frustrated lattices with reduced symmetry.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种费米子规范理论，用于解禁 Shastry-Sutherland 晶格上的量子临界点，并揭示了其与方晶格共享的低能场论结构。从 SU(2) π 通量母态开始，我们构建了耦合到 SU(2) 规范场和伴随希格斯场的狄拉克自旋子的连续介质理论，其凝聚驱动转变为交错通量 U(1) 自旋液体和无间隙 Z2 狄拉克自旋液体。虽然与方晶格相比，Shastry-Sutherland 晶格允许额外的对称性费米子双线性，但量子场论在附加不相关项之前是相同的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种费米子规范理论，用于解禁 Shastry-Sutherland 晶格上的量子临界点，并揭示了其与方晶格共享的低能场论结构。从 SU(2) π 通量母态开始，我们构建了耦合到 SU(2) 规范场和伴随希格斯场的狄拉克自旋子的连续介质理论，其凝聚驱动转变为交错通量 U(1) 自旋液体和无间隙 Z2 狄拉克自旋液体。虽然与方晶格相比，Shastry-Sutherland 晶格允许额外的对称性费米子双线性，但量子场论在附加不相关项之前是相同的。因此，希格斯势结构和领先的低能理论与量子临界点的方晶格情况一致。 SO(5) 临界点有望实现共形去限制临界点：我们在大风味展开中对其进行分析，计算其临界指数，并将费米子和希格斯场之间的汤川耦合识别为使其不稳定的相关扰动，这与最近蒙特卡罗研究中观察到的伪临界行为一致。我们表明，新兴的 SO(5) 有序参数在临界点获得了大的反常尺寸，导致 Néel 和 VBS 敏感性大大增强——这是与数值研究一致的费米子解限域量子临界性的标志。我们的研究结果在受控场论框架内提供了 Shastry-Sutherland 晶格上无间隙 Z2 狄拉克自旋液体的最新数值证据，并证明了方形晶格上的费米子解除限制临界性（包括临界指数和稳定性）扩展到对称性降低的受抑晶格。

articles.title: Conductivity of charge-neutral multicomponent 2D electron-hole system
articles.title_zh: 电荷中性多组分二维电子空穴系统的电导率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.07846v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The interplay between distinct carrier species in systems with broken Galilean invariance can give rise to a rich landscape of interaction-driven transport phenomena. Here, we develop a comprehensive theory of the electrical conductivity of a two-dimensional mixture of massless Dirac and massive fermions, a system realized in HgTe quantum wells tuned to the charge-neutrality point. In this regime, all carriers are thermally activated, enabling a self-consistent, temperature-dependent interplay between the two species. Crucially, the charge-neutrality condition ensures that the chemical potential is not externally pinned but is determined self-consistently, thereby making the system's transport response an intrinsic probe of inter-species quantum friction. We demonstrate that the conductivity changes with temperature : at low temperatures, transport is dominated by massless Dirac carriers, yielding a nearly temperature-independent conductivity reminiscent of the charge-neutrality point in pristine graphene. As the temperature rises, massive holes become thermally excited, and their mutual scattering with Dirac carriers induces a specific nonmonotonic temperature dependence of the conductivity in both clean and disordered structures. In particular, in nearly clean structures with strong screening modeled by a short-range interparticle interaction potential, the system's conductivity can exhibit an inverse-quadratic temperature dependence. Conversely, in disordered structures with a long-range interparticle interaction, it varies quadratically with temperature. Our findings establish HgTe quantum wells at charge neutrality as a clean, highly tunable platform for isolating and quantitatively studying interaction-driven transport in the absence of Galilean invariance, offering a direct pathway to explore regimes where interparticle collisions dominate over disorder.
articles.abstract_zh: 在伽利略不变性被破坏的系统中，不同载体物种之间的相互作用可以产生丰富的相互作用驱动的传输现象。在这里，我们开发了无质量狄拉克和大质量费米子的二维混合物的电导率的综合理论，这是一个在调谐到电荷中性点的 HgTe 量子阱中实现的系统。在这种情况下，所有载流子都被热激活，从而在两种物质之间实现自洽、依赖于温度的相互作用。至关重要的是，电荷中性条件确保化学势不是外部固定的，而是自洽确定的，从而使系统的传输响应成为物种间量子摩擦的内在探针。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在伽利略不变性被破坏的系统中，不同载体物种之间的相互作用可以产生丰富的相互作用驱动的传输现象。在这里，我们开发了无质量狄拉克和大质量费米子的二维混合物的电导率的综合理论，这是一个在调谐到电荷中性点的 HgTe 量子阱中实现的系统。在这种情况下，所有载流子都被热激活，从而在两种物质之间实现自洽、依赖于温度的相互作用。至关重要的是，电荷中性条件确保化学势不是外部固定的，而是自洽确定的，从而使系统的传输响应成为物种间量子摩擦的内在探针。我们证明电导率随温度变化：在低温下，传输由无质量狄拉克载流子主导，产生几乎与温度无关的电导率，让人想起原始石墨烯中的电荷中性点。随着温度升高，大量空穴被热激发，它们与狄拉克载流子的相互散射导致干净结构和无序结构中电导率的特定非单调温度依赖性。特别是，在具有由短程粒子间相互作用势建模的强屏蔽的近乎干净的结构中，系统的电导率可以表现出反二次温度依赖性。相反，在具有长程粒子间相互作用的无序结构中，它随温度呈二次方变化。我们的研究结果将电荷中性的 HgTe 量子阱建立为一个干净、高度可调的平台，用于在缺乏伽利略不变性的情况下隔离和定量研究相互作用驱动的输运，为探索粒子间碰撞主导无序的状态提供了直接途径。

articles.title: Singlet-only always-on gapless exchange (SAGE) spin qubits: Charge noise effects and two-qubit gates
articles.title_zh: 仅单态始终在线无间隙交换 (SAGE) 自旋量子位：电荷噪声效应和双量子位门
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.15419v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Singlet-only always-on gapless exchange (SAGE) spin qubits are an alternative type of exchange-only (EO) qubits that encode a single qubit in the spins of four electrons located in four tunnel-coupled quantum dots. While conventional EO qubits are susceptible to local magnetic field gradients caused by local nuclear environments and g-factor variations, the SAGE qubit subspace is inherently protected from magnetic-gradient-induced Pauli errors by virtue of the singlet-only encoding, which is invariant under magnetic field gradients, and the always-on exchange couplings, which provide energetic leakage protection. However, the always-on operation simultaneously increases the qubit's sensitivity to charge noise. Here, starting from a Hubbard model describing the underlying electronic structure of the coupled quantum dots, we characterize the performance of SAGE qubits in the presence of 1/f charge noise that induces fluctuations in both the dot chemical potentials and the interdot tunnel couplings. We calculate SAGE idle coherence times and show that realistic CPMG-like pulse sequences can be used to significantly extend SAGE single-qubit coherence times for experimentally relevant charge noise strengths. We likewise study the fidelity of SAGE two-qubit gates in the presence of charge and magnetic noise and again propose a simple refocusing strategy to mitigate the noise, while increased ramp times of the entangling pulse suppress leakage into noncomputational states.
articles.abstract_zh: 单重态始终在线无间隙交换 (SAGE) 自旋量子位是另一种类型的仅交换 (EO) 量子位，它在位于四个隧道耦合量子点中的四个电子的自旋中编码单个量子位。虽然传统的 EO 量子位容易受到局部核环境和 g 因子变化引起的局部磁场梯度的影响，但 SAGE 量子位子空间凭借在磁场梯度下不变的单重态编码和提供能量泄漏保护的始终在线交换耦合，本质上免受磁梯度引起的泡利误差的影响。然而，始终开启的操作同时增加了量子位对电荷噪声的敏感性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 单重态始终在线无间隙交换 (SAGE) 自旋量子位是另一种类型的仅交换 (EO) 量子位，它在位于四个隧道耦合量子点中的四个电子的自旋中编码单个量子位。虽然传统的 EO 量子位容易受到局部核环境和 g 因子变化引起的局部磁场梯度的影响，但 SAGE 量子位子空间凭借在磁场梯度下不变的单重态编码和提供能量泄漏保护的始终在线交换耦合，本质上免受磁梯度引起的泡利误差的影响。然而，始终开启的操作同时增加了量子位对电荷噪声的敏感性。在这里，从描述耦合量子点的基础电子结构的哈伯德模型开始，我们描述了在存在 1/f 电荷噪声的情况下 SAGE 量子位的性能，该噪声会引起点化学势和点间隧道耦合的波动。我们计算了 SAGE 空闲相干时间，并表明现实的类似 CPMG 的脉冲序列可用于显着延长 SAGE 单量子位相干时间，以获得实验相关的电荷噪声强度。我们同样研究了 SAGE 双量子位门在存在电荷和磁噪声的情况下的保真度，并再次提出了一种简单的重新聚焦策略来减轻噪声，同时增加纠缠脉冲的斜坡时间抑制泄漏到非计算状态。

articles.title: Ground state of the Hubbard model with spin-dependent linear potential
articles.title_zh: 具有自旋相关线性势的哈伯德模型的基态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.24068v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the competition between attractive spin-spin interactions and spin-separating external forces in the ground state of a one-dimensional Fermi-Hubbard model. We consider a lattice with open boundary conditions, subject to a linear external potential whose gradient is opposite for the two spin components, so that each spin species sees a potential minimum at a different end of the lattice. Using density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG) simulations, we map the ground-state density distributions and the number of doubly occupied sites as a function of the potential gradient β and interaction strength. We identify three distinct regimes separated by critical threshold gradients: (i) a small-β regime where fermion pairing remains robust against the external potential; (ii) an intermediate-β phase-separated regime characterized by a staircase-like decrease in the doublon number, corresponding to the successive, one-by-one breaking of bound pairs; and (iii) a large-β regime where the two spin components are completely spatially separated. We complement the numerical results with a phenomenological model and a local-density approximation analysis, from which we derive closed-form analytical estimates for these critical threshold values. We also verify that the staircase structure persists under additional harmonic confinement. Our results are directly testable in cold-atom experiments, and demonstrate that a spin-dependent linear potential enables precise, integer-level control of the number of bound fermion pairs.

articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了一维费米-哈伯德模型基态下自旋-自旋相互作用和自旋分离外力之间的竞争。我们考虑具有开放边界条件的晶格，受到线性外部电势的影响，其梯度对于两个自旋分量而言是相反的，因此每个自旋物种在晶格的不同端看到电势最小值。使用密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）模拟，我们将基态密度分布和双占据位点数量绘制为势梯度 β 和相互作用强度的函数。我们确定了由临界阈值梯度分隔的三种不同的状态：（i）小β状态，其中费米子配对对外部电势保持鲁棒性； (ii) 中间β相分离状态，其特征是双布朗数呈阶梯式下降，对应于束缚对的连续、一一断裂； （iii）大β状态，其中两个自旋分量在空间上完全分离。我们用现象学模型和局部密度近似分析来补充数值结果，从中我们得出这些临界阈值的封闭式分析估计。我们还验证了楼梯结构在额外的谐波限制下仍然存在。我们的结果可以直接在冷原子实验中进行测试，并证明自旋相关的线性势能够对束缚费米子对的数量进行精确的整数级控制。

articles.title: Dynamic Eikonal Attenuation and Mutual Coherence of Quantum Particles due to Equilibrium Coulomb Fluctuations
articles.title_zh: 平衡库仑涨落引起的量子粒子的动态程程衰减和相互相干性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.18196v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We develop a dynamic theory of eikonal attenuation and mutual coherence for a quantum particle propagating through equilibrium Coulomb fluctuations. The one-particle length ell is the attenuation length of the ensemble-averaged retarded propagator, not an Anderson localization length or a transport mean free path. For a collisionless classical one-component plasma (OCP), the potential spectrum follows from the fluctuation--dissipation theorem and the RPA dielectric function. In suitable plasma parameter windows, both fast and slow probe regimes are physically meaningful. Fast probes recover the Coulomb logarithm with the dynamical infrared length v/ωᵣₘ ₚ. Slow probes yield G(v)propto v and, in the controlled weak branch, ellpropto k. We derive an exact finite-thickness mutual-coherence expression and a closed slow-regime transverse scaling function. Within the controlled slow-OCP and thick-slab window, the logarithmic two-ray visibility scales as v⁻¹ at fixed transverse separation, in contrast to the v⁻² dependence for frozen finite-slab fluctuations. For a symmetric diffusive electrolyte, linearized stochastic density functional theory gives the exact on-shell result Gᵣₘ ₑₗ(v)=(m²C/hbar⁴)arsinh[v/(2Dκ)], where C=kₘₐₜₕᵣₘ BTq₀²/(4πε_b). For ordinary liquid electrolytes, the slow diffusive limit is inaccessible within the spatial eikonal regime and is therefore a formal asymptote. The physically relevant electrolyte limit is instead that of a fast probe, vgg Dκ, where the diffusive charge relaxation generates an intrinsic infrared length v/(Dκ²) absent from the quasi-static theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们为通过平衡库仑涨落传播的量子粒子开发了一种关于 eikonal 衰减和相互相干性的动态理论。单粒子长度 ell 是系综平均延迟传播器的衰减长度，而不是安德森定位长度或传输平均自由程。对于无碰撞经典单组分等离子体 (OCP)，电势谱由涨落耗散定理和 RPA 介电函数得出。在合适的等离子体参数窗口中，快速和慢速探测方式都具有物理意义。快速探头利用动态红外长度 v/ωᵣₘ ₚ 恢复库仑对数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们为通过平衡库仑涨落传播的量子粒子开发了一种关于 eikonal 衰减和相互相干性的动态理论。单粒子长度 ell 是系综平均延迟传播器的衰减长度，而不是安德森定位长度或传输平均自由程。对于无碰撞经典单组分等离子体 (OCP)，电势谱由涨落耗散定理和 RPA 介电函数得出。在合适的等离子体参数窗口中，快速和慢速探测方式都具有物理意义。快速探头利用动态红外长度 v/ωᵣₘ ₚ 恢复库仑对数。慢速探针产生 G(v)propto v，并且在受控的弱分支中产生 ellpropto k。我们推导出精确的有限厚度互相关表达式和封闭的慢域横向尺度函数。在受控的慢速 OCP 和厚板层窗口内，对数两射线可见度在固定横向间隔处缩放为 v⁻1，这与冻结有限板层波动的 v⁻2 依赖性相反。对于对称扩散电解质，线性化随机密度泛函理论给出了精确的壳上结果 Gᵣₘ ₑₗ(v)=(m²C/hbar⁴)arsinh[v/(2Dκ)]，其中 C=kₘₐₜₕᵣₘ BTq₀²/(4πε_b)。对于普通液体电解质，慢扩散极限在空间映射范围内是无法达到的，因此是形式上的渐近线。物理相关的电解质极限是快速探针 vgg Dκ 的极限，其中扩散电荷弛豫产生准静态理论中不存在的固有红外长度 v/(Dκ²)。

articles.title: Coexistence of Donor and Acceptor Hydrogen States in n-Type InN
articles.title_zh: n 型 InN 中供体和受体氢态的共存
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.17401v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Hydrogen often exhibits amphoteric behavior in semiconductors, but its role is in n-type InN remains unresolved. Wurtzite InN is a narrow-gap semiconductor with high electron mobility and is therefore attractive for high-speed electronics and optoelectronic applications. Here we use hard x-ray photoemission spectroscopy (HAXPES) to probe hydrogen-related electronic structure in as-grown and post-annealed InN thin films prepared at different grown temperatures. Post annealing, which reduces the concentration of hydrogen impurities in the films, shifts the core-level spectra toward lower binding energy, consistent with a chemical-potential shift associated with the passivation of electron carriers. In the valence-band spectra, an acceptor-like in-gap feature near the valence-band maximum is suppressed after annealing. Together with the established donor-like behavior of hydrogen in InN, these results suggest that acceptor H- states coexist with donor H+ states in InN. The coexistence of these opposite hydrogen charge states provides a microscopic picture of hydrogen-driven compensation in InN and highlights the amphoteric nature of hydrogen even in a highly n-type semiconductor.
articles.abstract_zh: 氢在半导体中经常表现出两性行为，但其在 n 型 InN 中的作用仍未解决。纤锌矿InN是一种具有高电子迁移率的窄带隙半导体，因此对高速电子和光电应用具有吸引力。在这里，我们使用硬 X 射线光电子能谱 (HAXPES) 来探测在不同生长温度下制备的生长态和退火后 InN 薄膜中与氢相关的电子结构。后退火降低了薄膜中氢杂质的浓度，使核心能级光谱向较低结合能方向移动，这与电子载流子钝化相关的化学势变化一致。在价带光谱中，退火后，价带最大值附近的类似受体的带隙内特征被抑制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 氢在半导体中经常表现出两性行为，但其在 n 型 InN 中的作用仍未解决。纤锌矿InN是一种具有高电子迁移率的窄带隙半导体，因此对高速电子和光电应用具有吸引力。在这里，我们使用硬 X 射线光电子能谱 (HAXPES) 来探测在不同生长温度下制备的生长态和退火后 InN 薄膜中与氢相关的电子结构。后退火降低了薄膜中氢杂质的浓度，使核心能级光谱向较低结合能方向移动，这与电子载流子钝化相关的化学势变化一致。在价带光谱中，退火后，价带最大值附近的类似受体的带隙内特征被抑制。结合 InN 中氢的已确定的类供体行为，这些结果表明 InN 中受体 H- 态与供体 H+ 态共存。这些相反的氢电荷态的共存提供了 InN 中氢驱动补偿的微观图景，并强调了氢的两性性质，即使在高度 n 型半导体中也是如此。

articles.title: Specific absorption rate of uniaxial single-domain nanomagnets: stochastic spin dynamics versus linear response theory
articles.title_zh: 单轴单畴纳米磁体的比吸收率：随机自旋动力学与线性响应理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27351v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We compute the specific absorption rate of a uniaxial single-domain nanomagnet driven by an alternating magnetic field by two methods: i) direct numerical integration of the stochastic (Langevin) Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert equation (the LLL approach), and ii) linear response theory (LRT) based on the Debye susceptibility with the Néel relaxation time ta. We first analytically show that both methods are equivalent for small magnetic field amplitude, and then compute their deviation ΛequivSARLLL/SARLRT-1 as a function of the magnetic field amplitude for two temperatures chosen on opposite sides of the Debye resonance. One of the main results is that the sign and magnitude of Λ are governed by the dimensionless product omta, in addition to the linearity parameter ξ=μₛB₀/kBT for the easy-axis geometry considered here. Indeed, below resonance (omta<1), linear response theory overestimates the specific absorption rate, whereas above resonance (omta>1, the regime typical of blocked nanoparticles) linear response theory can underestimate the specific absorption rate by up to sim70% at ξsim2. We expect this work to provide a quantitative guidance for the use of linear response theory in magnetic hyperthermia and related nanoscale heat-transport problems, and to serve as a single-particle benchmark for extensions to many-spin and interacting systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们通过两种方法计算由交变磁场驱动的单轴单畴纳米磁体的比吸收率：i) 随机 (Langevin) Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert 方程的直接数值积分（LLL 方法），以及 ii）基于德拜磁化率和尼尔弛豫时间 ta 的线性响应理论 (LRT)。我们首先分析表明这两种方法对于小磁场幅度是等效的，然后计算它们的偏差 ΛequivSARLLL/SARLRT-1 作为在德拜共振相对侧选择的两个温度的磁场幅度的函数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过两种方法计算由交变磁场驱动的单轴单畴纳米磁体的比吸收率：i) 随机 (Langevin) Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert 方程的直接数值积分（LLL 方法），以及 ii）基于德拜磁化率和尼尔弛豫时间 ta 的线性响应理论 (LRT)。我们首先分析表明这两种方法对于小磁场幅度是等效的，然后计算它们的偏差 ΛequivSARLLL/SARLRT-1 作为在德拜共振相对侧选择的两个温度的磁场幅度的函数。主要结果之一是，除了这里考虑的易轴几何的线性参数 xi=μₛB₀/kBT 之外，Λ 的符号和大小还受无量纲乘积 omta 控制。事实上，低于共振（omta1，受阻纳米颗粒的典型状态）线性响应理论可能会低估 xisim2 处的比吸收率高达 sim70%。我们希望这项工作能够为线性响应理论在磁热疗和相关纳米级热传输问题中的使用提供定量指导，并作为扩展到多自旋和相互作用系统的单粒子基准。

articles.title: Inference Limits of Routine Cement Characterization for CEM I Performance: Evidence From a Multi-Producer Dataset
articles.title_zh: CEM I 性能的常规水泥表征的推断极限：来自多生产商数据集的证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.22512v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: This study evaluates the prediction of 28-day compressive strength from routine cement characterization across independent producers. Industrial records from 23 European producers cover nearly three decades of testing in a single laboratory, encompassing 476 samples. The archive includes CEM I, CEM II, CEM III, and other blended cements, with the main analysis focused on CEM I. Chemistry and fineness descriptors were evaluated using linear and nonlinear models. Strength class and water demand were also examined as performance labels from standardized testing. Mean absolute errors in 28-day strength prediction were approximately 3 MPa, with linear models performing comparably to nonlinear models. Producer holdout tests assessed transfer to cements from producers excluded from training and yielded absolute errors of the same order. Equivalent alkali showed a consistent negative association with 28-day strength, with K₂O carrying most of this signal. Together, these results highlight the value of industrial data collected under common laboratory conditions for interpretable 28-day strength prediction, with potential to inform cement design targeting lower production costs and CO₂ emissions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究评估了独立生产商的常规水泥表征对 28 天抗压强度的预测。 23 个欧洲生产商的工业记录涵盖了单个实验室近三十年的测试，包含 476 个样本。该档案包括 CEM I、CEM II、CEM III 和其他混合水泥，主要分析集中在 CEM I。使用线性和非线性模型评估化学和细度描述符。强度等级和需水量也作为标准化测试的性能标签进行了检查。 28 天强度预测的平均绝对误差约为 3 MPa，线性模型的表现与非线性模型相当。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本研究评估了独立生产商的常规水泥表征对 28 天抗压强度的预测。 23 个欧洲生产商的工业记录涵盖了单个实验室近三十年的测试，包含 476 个样本。该档案包括 CEM I、CEM II、CEM III 和其他混合水泥，主要分析集中在 CEM I。使用线性和非线性模型评估化学和细度描述符。强度等级和需水量也作为标准化测试的性能标签进行了检查。 28 天强度预测的平均绝对误差约为 3 MPa，线性模型的表现与非线性模型相当。生产商坚持测试评估了从培训之外的生产商向水泥的转移，并产生了相同数量级的绝对误差。当量碱与 28 天强度呈一致的负相关，其中 K2O 携带了大部分信号。总之，这些结果凸显了在常见实验室条件下收集的工业数据对于可解释的 28 天强度预测的价值，有可能为旨在降低生产成本和二氧化碳排放的水泥设计提供信息。

articles.title: Dimensional crossover in ultradilute Bose-Bose liquid mixtures
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25558v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study ultradilute ³⁹K Bose-Bose bulk mixtures and droplets in an external harmonic potential that confines them in one spatial direction towards the two-dimensional (2D) limit. Equations of state for several confinements are obtained with quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) at T=0, using interaction potentials that include information on the s-wave scattering length a and the effective range rᵣₘ ₑff. Performing the calculations using two different interaction potential models we have determined the range of confinements for which equations of state are universal in terms of a and rᵣₘ ₑff. Based on the QMC equation of state, we develop a 2D QMC density functional for each confinement strength and use it together with the local density approximation to determine properties of the self-bound drops. For moderate squeezing, energies and droplet profiles obtained using the 2D QMC functional agree well with those obtained using 3D functionals, while offering a substantial reduction in computational cost, and a consistent approach in crossover to 2D. Noticeably, our results approach 2D mean-field (MF) + Lee-Huang-Yang (LHY) predictions only for the most strongly confined systems for which universality in terms of a and rᵣₘ ₑff is observed. This implies a very narrow range of confinements for which 2D LHY functionals are applicable, which affects the study of vortices using 2D functionals.

articles.title: Updated Tkatchenko Scheffler method and assessment of dispersion methods for alkali-containing systems
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.01501v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The Tkatchenko-Scheffler (TS) pairwise method to calculate dispersion interactions is a widely used approach to incorporate missing long-range van der Waals contributions in semilocal and hybrid density functional calculations. Despite subsequent many-body extensions, this formulation remains widely used. In 2018, Fedorov et al. reported updated van der Waals radii to the seminal work published in 2009. The present work examines the accuracy of the TS method with updated van der Waals radii (TS₂₀₁₈), coupled with the semilocal Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof density functional, for structural predictions of semiconducting and insulating materials. Special attention is paid to materials containing alkali elements, for which the TS₂₀₀₉ method exhibits a large overbinding, associated with potentially large errors in predicted atomic structures. We also consider a narrower reformulation (TS_alkali) where only the the alkali atoms are corrected, so the method remains otherwise compatible with TS₂₀₀₉. We compare these methods with a broader set of dispersion corrections--the DFT-D3 method, the exchange-hole dipole moment method, and the beyond-pairwise, nonlocal many-body dispersion method--for ionic and alkali-containing systems more generally. We examine equilibrium geometry predictions for 45 inorganic solid compounds as well as three Cs-containing halide perovskites, CsPbX₃ (X = Cl, Br, I). Our results show that the updated van der Waals radii in the TS₂₀₁₈ and TS_alkali methods resolve the overbinding that is present with TS₂₀₀₉ in alkali-containing systems, bringing predictions into closer agreement with other dispersion methods. For the halide perovskites, method-dependent differences in predicted cell volumes and shapes persist, and no approach performs with perfect accuracy on all metrics for all three materials.

articles.title: Spin-Chirality-Driven Bulk Photovoltaic Effect in van der Waals Magnet CrSBr
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03492v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The bulk photovoltaic effect (BPVE) manifests with remarkable diversity in magnetic materials. Here, we establish vector spin chirality as a tunable knob for generating an unconventional time-reversal-even magnetic BPVE, comprising the chiral shift current (CSC) and chiral injection current (CIC). Using bilayer antiferromagnetic (AFM) CrSBr as a prototype, we theoretically demonstrate the emergence of CSC and CIC. Compared with conventional photovoltaic currents arising from noncentrosymmetric crystal structures or collinear magnetic orderings, CSC and CIC not only possess comparable magnitudes but also exhibit exceptional tunability. Specifically, they can be switched on and off by magnetic-field-induced spin canting, reversed in direction upon canting-direction reversal, and continuously modulated in intensity via canting-angle variation. Furthermore, we reveal an unusual optical transition channel governing both currents in CrSBr. Our work establishes an unconventional magnetic BPVE with remarkable controllability, offering opportunities for optoelectronic and magnetic-sensing applications in noncollinear magnets.

articles.title: Transport-Noise and Optical Witnesses of Electronic Multipartite Entanglement
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.16028v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Entanglement among particles distinguishes correlated quantum materials from conventional metals and semiconductors. Experimentally certifying intrinsic entanglement among interacting electrons in materials is important not only for classifying states of matter, but also for developing material-based quantum technologies. Here, we introduce a transport protocol for witnessing multipartite entanglement from the equilibrium current-noise spectrum, measured directly or reconstructed from optical conductivity. The appropriately integrated, symmetrized, and projected noise spectrum obeys an upper bound derived from microscopic model parameters. Unlike witnesses based on localized spins, our framework applies to general electronic states without requiring magnetic moments and remains invariant under single-particle basis transformations. We benchmark it in twisted bilayer graphene, twisted bilayer MoTe₂, and Hubbard models, and demonstrate entanglement certification in a fractional Chern insulator. This approach extends recently developed scattering-based entanglement witnesses to ultralow-temperature conditions, where many candidate entangled phases emerge.

articles.title: Multicomponent anyons in one-dimensional optical lattices
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.36554v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the ground-state and dynamical properties of multicomponent interacting anyons confined in a one-dimensional (1D) optical lattice. Adopting the Anyon-Hubbard model, we explore spin and charge correlations as functions of interaction strength and the anyonic statistical parameter.
