Irradiation at 0.7 J/cm2 increases Vickers hardness by 30%, from 648 ± 52 HV0.05 to 839 ± 68 HV0.05, and reduces the specific wear rate from 2.94×10− 4 to 8.42×10− 5 mm3·N− 1·m− 1, while at 1.5 J/cm2 both hardness and wear resistance approach the as-cast values. The results demonstrate that HIPIB irradiation is an effective tool for surface modification of high-entropy alloys, enabling phase transformation and significant tribological improvement.

articles.title: Combined application of PRP gel and low-intensity pulsed ultrasound enhances early tendon-to-bone interface healing after acute rotator cuff repair in rats
articles.abstract: Objective This study evaluated the effects of combined platelet-rich plasma (PRP) gel and low‑intensity pulsed ultrasound (LIPUS) on early tendon–bone interface healing after acute rotator cuff repair in rats, using histological, micro-CT and biomechanical assessments to inform postoperative rehabilitation.Methods Ninety SPF-grade male Sprague-Dawley rats (8–9 weeks old, 300–350 g) were used: 80 underwent left-sided rotator cuff injury and repair and were randomly allocated into four groups (n = 20 each: CON, LIPUS, PRP, P + L), and the remaining 10 served as blood donors for PRP preparation. Within each group, 10 animals were euthanized at postoperative week 4 and 10 at week 8. At each time point, 5 animals per group were processed for micro-CT and histological analysis and the other 5 for biomechanical testing.Results At both time points, the combined group showed significantly higher bone volume fraction, trabecular thickness and number, fibrocartilage layer thickness, collagen fibre organization, ultimate load and stiffness than the other three groups (P < 0.05). LIPUS and PRP alone also improved these parameters over controls, but the combined regimen produced the most pronounced enhancement.Conclusion Collectively, the combined application of PRP gel and LIPUS further promotes early tendon-to-bone healing after acute rotator cuff repair, substantially improving local tissue structure and biomechanical properties.

articles.title: Influence of bioactive glass particle size in resin-based fissure sealants on the remineralization of adjacent enamel: an in vitro study
articles.abstract: Background Bioactive glass (BAG)-modified fissure sealants may promote enamel remineralization, but the influence of BAG particle size remains unclear. This study aimed to compare the effects of micro-sized, nano-sized, and hybrid BAG particles incorporated into a resin-based fissure sealant on the remineralization of adjacent enamel using nanoindentation and SEM–EDS.Methods Forty-five sound human enamel specimens were randomly assigned to five groups (n = 9): unsealed negative control, conventional sealant, micro-BAG (15 wt%), nano-BAG (15 wt%), and hybrid BAG (7.5 wt% micro + 7.5 wt% nano). All specimens underwent artificial demineralization before the sealants were applied. Enamel adjacent to the sealant was assessed by nanoindentation (nanohardness, elastic modulus) before and after a 7-day pH-cycling regimen, and surface hardness recovery (%SHR) was calculated. Scanning electron microscopy with energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (SEM–EDS) was performed descriptively on one specimen per group. Data were analyzed using paired t tests (within groups) and one-way ANOVA with Duncan's post hoc test (between groups) (α = 0.05).Results Mean nanohardness increased in all groups after pH cycling, but the increase was statistically significant only in the nano-BAG group (P = 0.036). Nanohardness differed among groups after demineralization (P = 0.044) and after pH cycling (P = 0.031), with the unsealed negative control showing the highest values at both stages. No significant differences were found among groups in elastic modulus (P = 0.106 and 0.056) or %SHR (P = 0.820). SEM–EDS showed higher calcium content and Ca/P ratios in BAG-containing groups, with the highest values in the nano-BAG group; no statistical comparison was performed.Conclusions Within the limitations of this in vitro study, only the nano-BAG group showed a significant increase in enamel nanohardness after pH cycling, with no significant differences among the sealant groups. These preliminary findings support further investigation of nano-BAG–modified sealants, including larger samples, characterized fillers, and mechanical and ion-release testing.

articles.title: Structural Relationships, Petrographic Characteristics and Bulk Geochemistry of Chromite Mineralization in the Balıköy–Tavşanlı Ophiolitic Rocks, NW Türkiye
articles.abstract: Chromitites hosted by ophiolitic ultramafic rocks record melt–rock interaction and mantle processes, yet their present-day geometry may be substantially modified by tectonic deformation and serpentinization. This study documents the Balıköy–Tavşanlı chromite occurrence in northwestern Türkiye through integrated field mapping, structural observations, petrography, ore microscopy and bulk X-ray fluorescence (XRF) geochemistry. The mineralization is hosted predominantly by variably serpentinized dunite and is concentrated in three approximately parallel NW–SE-trending zones that dip about 45° northwestward and broadly parallel the regional thrust architecture. Chromite occurs as disseminated, spotted/leopard, banded–lenticular and massive aggregates. Fracturing, fragmentation, brecciation and cataclastic textures are common, while the host-rock matrix contains serpentine, talc and locally secondary carbonate, albite and Fe-oxide phases. Nine bulk-ore samples contain 27.79–41.18 wt% Cr, 40.62–60.19 wt% Cr₂O₃ and 4.50–9.44 wt% Fe; reported Cr/Fe ratios range from 3.31 to 7.95. The spatial correspondence between mineralized zones and thrust-related structures documents a strong structural relationship, but does not demonstrate syn-thrust chromite formation. The most conservative interpretation is that deformation modified the present geometry and textures of pre-existing chromite-bearing bodies. The study provides a field-based framework for exploration while distinguishing observed surface relationships from unverified subsurface continuities and unresolved genetic interpretations.

articles.title: Dual-modal sensor for dopamine detection based on In 2 O 3 @FeMoSe 2 heterojunctions with excellent photoelectrochemical and peroxidase-like properties
articles.abstract: In this work, the indium oxide and iron molybdenum selenide (In2O3@FeMoSe2) heterojunctions were synthesized using a simple hydrothermal method. The morphological and structural properties of the obtained heterojunctions were comprehensively characterized. In-situ functionalization of the hierarchical micro-flowers of FeMoSe2 with In2O3 nanoparticles dramatically boosts electrical conductivity, photocatalytic activity and peroxidase-like activity. Benefiting from the band gap matching of In2O3 and FeMoSe2, and dopamine (DA) as electron donors, and realizing photocurrent signals amplification. In the presence of H2O2, In2O3@FeMoSe2 catalyzes the oxidation of 3,3',5,5'-tetramethylhydrogen dioxide (TMB) to a blue product. DA capture hydroxyl radicals, thereby inhibiting the oxidation of TMB, which leads to a lighter blue color and a subsequent decrease in absorbance. Here, a photoelectrochemical and colorimetric dual-mode sensor for dopamine assay based on In2O3@FeMoSe2 was constructed. The detection limits were 14.7 nM and 0.19 µM (S/N = 3), respectively. The sensor was successfully applied to the detection of dopamine (DA) in human serum and urine samples, exhibiting high sensitivity, excellent reproducibility, and reliable stability. To the best of our knowledge, this strategy for DA detection has not been previously reported.

articles.title: A Sequential EnergyPlus–DSSAT Framework for Assessing Energy Use, Environmental Control and Wheat Production in Vertical Farming
articles.abstract: Purpose Engineering assessment of vertical wheat farming requires coordinated evaluation of energy use, environmental control and crop production. This study develops a sequential framework linking independent EnergyPlus and DSSAT CERES-Wheat simulations.Methods The interface translates lighting and thermal inputs, reconciles crop-cycle outputs with annual facility energy, and applies crop-input-state equivalence checks to determine when crop simulations require re-execution or conditional reuse. A hypothetical five-tier wheat facility in Timimoun, Algeria, provides a computational demonstration, including a matched-envelope LED-efficiency comparison, output verification, crop plausibility assessment and plant-load sensitivities.Results The reference crop simulation predicted 4,999 kg ha⁻¹ of grain over 72 days. Increasing LED photon efficacy from 2.7 to 3.5 µmol J⁻¹ reduced simulated annual electricity use from 6.806 to 5.331 GWh (21.7%) in a matched-envelope comparison, but annual hours above 60% relative humidity increased from four to 224. Daily maximum and minimum crop-zone temperatures agreed at DSSAT input precision (0.1°C) on all 72 days of the tested window. In a separate load sensitivity, increasing prescribed latent load from 80 to 547 W m⁻² raised annual site energy by 19.0% and cooling electricity by 69.1%.Conclusion The sequential interface enables traceable comparative building–crop assessment and reveals energy–humidity-control trade-offs. Crop-output reuse is conditional on unchanged remaining crop inputs and cannot be assumed across untested annual cycles. The hypothetical facility has not been experimentally validated, and the approach is not dynamic crop–building co-simulation.

articles.title: The Mesh-Insensitive Structural Stress Method: Current State and Prospects for Additively Manufactured Components
articles.abstract: Fatigue failure in welded structures is strongly influenced by stress concentration, which in turn depends on plate thickness, loading mode, weld geometry, among others. Traditional fatigue assessment approaches, such as nominal stress, hot-spot stress, and effective notch stress methods, have been applied in design codes and engineering practice, but they can become difficult to apply consistently to complex welded structures. One major issue is how to suppress mesh-size sensitivity in finite element models. The mesh-insensitive structural stress method has been shown as an effective alternative method since its adoption by the ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code since 2007. The method leads to the master S–N curve approach, which correlates fatigue data from a wide range of welded joint types using a unified fatigue curve and scatter band. This paper reviews the mechanics foundation, finite-element implementation, current engineering applications, advantages, limitations, and on-going development in the area of low cycle fatigue, and applications for fatigue evaluation of additively manufactured metal components.

articles.title: Topological Transitions of Evanescent Waves
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07038v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the band structure of evanescent waves, that is, the decaying or growing solutions that live within the gaps of tight-binding Hamiltonians. Although the underlying Hamiltonian is Hermitian, these modes carry complex wavevectors and therefore exhibit a non-Hermitian dispersion. Using the transfer matrix formalism in one dimension, we show that, in addition to the standard exceptional points that appear at the band edges, a different type of exceptional point can arise inside the gap, protected by spinless time-reversal symmetry. Tuning model parameters drives a topological transition where such in-gap exceptional points are nucleated in pairs, mediated by a crossing between purely imaginary momentum branches. We show that this spectral structure is diagnosed by a Z₂ index assigned to every energy inside the gap, with the in-gap exceptional points arising as its domain walls. A generic bound state in the system has a tail that is purely exponential when its energy lies between a band edge and the nearest exceptional point, but becomes oscillatory - with a wavevector differing from the band-edge momentum - when its energy lies between the pair of in-gap exceptional points. We illustrate these results using continuum and tight-binding models, as well as an anisotropic photonic crystal.

articles.title: Autotaxis of a Run-and-Tumble Agent via Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07531v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the run-tumble motion of a single autochemotactic agent that secretes and senses chemical cues using a reinforcement learning (RL) framework. In a chemical environment that changes dynamically via secretion, diffusion, and degradation of attractant chemicals, we study the effectiveness of RL for a successful navigation strategy. We show that RL enhances chemotactic performance. Starting from a random initial position, the probability of finding the agent in the favorable region (near the attractant peak) increases faster with time and reaches a higher value in the long time limit when RL is used, compared to the case when the agent performs usual run-tumble chemotaxis without using RL. We also characterize the chemotactic performance of the agent by varying different parameters like rates of secretion, degradation, and diffusion. Importantly, we observe a non-monotonic dependence of the chemotactic performance on the learning and exploration rates, indicating the existence of an optimal RL strategy for the most efficient navigation. We explain these observations as a result of the interplay between the pre-existing attractant environment and the agent-generated attractant profile.

articles.title: Health-Promoting Potential of Novel Dunaliella salina A4F_Ma115 Extracts: Antioxidant and Antigenotoxic Evaluation
articles.abstract: Microalgae represent a promising yet underexplored reservoir of bioactive compounds with potential applications in human health. In this study, we investigated the antioxidant and antigenotoxic potential of a newly characterized Dunaliella salina strain (A4F_Ma115), comparing extracts obtained from its green and orange physiological phases. Biochemical assays revealed pronounced antioxidant activity, particularly in the hexane and ethyl acetate fractions, which scavenged up to 83.03% of ABTS radicals and 52.29% of nitric oxide radicals. Pigment and fatty acid profiling revealed distinct biochemical signatures between the two phases, with unexpectedly higher pigment levels in green-phase extracts. Beyond antioxidant activity, the extracts exhibited protective effects against camptothecin-induced genotoxic stress in Schizosaccharomyces pombe. Notably, flow cytometry supported the protective activity of ethyl acetate fractions, revealing improved cell viability and favorable effects on cell cycle progression under genotoxic challenge. By integrating biochemical characterization with a cellular model of genotoxic stress, this study provides evidence that the bioactive potential of D. salina extends beyond conventional antioxidant properties. These findings identify strain A4F_Ma115 as a promising source of natural bioactive compounds for further investigation in nutraceutical and functional food development.

articles.title: Carboxymethyl cellulose aerogels with Laponite, halloysite or kaolin: effect of clay type on shrinkage, compressive and heat-transfer behavior
articles.abstract: Freeze-dried carboxymethyl cellulose aerogels are light but can shrink during drying and are mechanically weak. This study examined how the type of clay changes the structure and properties of these aerogels, comparing the synthetic smectite Laponite (2:1 layered discs) with the 1:1 aluminosilicates halloysite (nanotubes) and kaolin (platelets). A 0.8% (w/v) carboxymethyl cellulose solution was mixed in equal volumes with clay dispersions of 0.4–2.0% (w/v) and freeze-dried. Compressive behavior was assessed by uniaxial compression, heat transfer by infrared thermography on a 200°C hot plate, and polymer–clay interactions by Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy. Aerogels containing Laponite retained about 37% of their cast volume, compared with about 20% for those containing halloysite or kaolin. Because the compression tests ended at very different strains, the composites were compared at 10% strain. At this strain, the Laponite composites carried 2.6–10.3 kPa, 2.0–7.7 times more than the halloysite and kaolin composites, and the stress increased with Laponite concentration, whereas the halloysite and kaolin composites, which have nearly the same composition but different shapes, behaved similarly (1.2–1.6 kPa). After 30 min on the hot plate, the lowest top-surface temperatures (81.6–82.9°C, compared with 90.1°C for the neat aerogel) were recorded for 2.0% halloysite and 1.2–1.6% kaolin. The results suggest that Laponite forms a continuous network with the polymer that limits shrinkage and stiffens the aerogel, whereas halloysite and kaolin act mainly as fillers. As thermal conductivity and porosity were not measured and heights and densities were estimated, the results describe comparative trends.

articles.title: Acid leaching reorganizes hierarchical nanoporous alteration layers on borosilicate glass
articles.abstract: Aqueous corrosion of silicate glass produces surface alteration layers whose formation may involve both leaching/in situ reorganization and interface-coupled dissolution–precipitation (ICDP). Here, selective acid leaching combined with focused ion beam scanning electron microscopy tomography, transmission electron microscopy–energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy, and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy was used to probe aluminum in a hierarchical nanoporous layer formed on borosilicate glass. Acid leaching removed aluminum almost completely while retaining a continuous porous silicate layer, consistent with an acid-soluble hydroxylated Al-containing secondary phase located outside, rather than incorporated into, the silicate network. Its removal thinned the segmented solid phase and altered the depth-dependent porosity. Associated shifts in optical reflectance and water-droplet spreading were consistent with changes in layer thickness and pore structure. These findings support contributions from both ICDP-type and leaching/in situ reorganization processes and identify aluminum speciation as an important factor governing alteration-layer structure and response.

articles.title: Simulation of the urban drainage system of Itanagar township using the Storm Water Management Model 5.2 (SWMM 5.2)
articles.abstract: The existing drainage network of C Sector, Itanagar (Arunachal Pradesh, India), was analysed using the Storm Water Management Model version 5.2 (SWMM 5.2), a dynamic rainfall–runoff simulation model developed by the United States Environmental Protection Agency for the analysis, design and management of urban stormwater drainage systems. Daily rainfall data for the period 1986–2022 were obtained from the India Meteorological Department, Pune, and intensity–duration–frequency (IDF) curves were developed by Gumbel's method for return periods of 5, 10, 30, 50 and 100 years. The model simulates the hydrological and hydraulic processes within the urban catchment, including surface runoff generation and flow routing through the drainage network. The results show that the number of flooding nodes increases with increasing rainfall intensity: no node floods for the 5-year return period, whereas 2, 3, 6 and 7 nodes flood for the 10-, 30-, 50- and 100-year return periods respectively, with the total flood volume rising from 2.278 × 10⁶ to 15.683 × 10⁶ L. Two low impact development (LID) measures, namely rain barrels and permeable pavements, and their combination were then implemented to quantify their effect on runoff and flooding. Rain barrels reduced the total flood volume by up to 67.38% and permeable pavements by up to 32.84%, while the combined LID eliminated node flooding entirely for the 5- and 10-year return periods. The effectiveness of LID decreased as the return period increased. The study is useful for assessing future floods and for reducing the likelihood of urban flooding in hilly townships of the Eastern Himalaya.

articles.title: Robust Iron-based Fischer-Tropsch Catalysts by Direct Joule Synthesis
articles.abstract: Converting CO2 into gasoline- and jet-fuel-range hydrocarbons offers an elegant approach to sustainable fuels compatible with existing infrastructure. However, widely applied iron-based syngas Fischer-Tropsch catalysts deactivate in CO2-rich feeds due to oxidation of active carbides in oxidising CO2 environments and the doubled H2O byproduct. Herein, we demonstrate Direct Joule Synthesis (DJS) coupled with mechanochemical treatment as an effective method to prepare metal-rich Fe-Co-Na precursors, which reconstruct during CO2 hydrogenation into carbide-containing active structures. The optimised FeCoNa sample attains 57.3% CO2 conversion, 24.1% C5+ yield, 43.7% C2+ yield, and space-time-yields of 0.40 gC₅₊ h−1 gcat−1 and 0.68 gC2₊ h−1 gcat−1 at 350°C and 30 bar, exceeding reported systems. Even more intriguing, stable operation for at least 500 h on stream is achieved due to retention of Fe5C2 as a dominant phase, stabilised by residual metallic FeCo acting as a reduction promoter, limiting carbide re-oxidation, in addition to enhancing olefin release and supply of adsorbed intermediates. These findings demonstrate the activity and stability advantages of metal-derived Fe-based CO2 hydrogenation catalysts, establishing DJS as a rapid non-equilibrium synthesis method for versatile multimetallic catalysts.

articles.title: Performance Analysis of a Low-Complexity Hybrid DF–SIR Protocol for Coded Cooperative Hybrid Satellite–Terrestrial Networks
articles.title_zh: 用于编码协作混合星地网络的低复杂度混合 DF-SIR 协议的性能分析
articles.abstract: Hybrid satellite-terrestrial cooperative networks (HSTCNs) are a key enabler of sixth-generation (6G) non-terrestrial networks, providing resilient wide-area coverage under heterogeneous propagation conditions. This paper proposes a low-complexity hybrid decode-and-forward and soft-information-relaying (HDF-SIR) protocol for coded cooperative HSTCNs operating over mixed satellite-terrestrial fading channels. In the proposed scheme, each relay adaptively switches between decode-and-forward (DF) and soft-information-relaying (SIR) modes according to its decoding reliability, allowing unreliable relays to forward reliability-weighted soft symbols instead of being excluded from cooperation. The satellite-relay and satellite-destination links are modeled by shadowed-Rician fading, while the relay-destination hop follows a Nakagami-m distribution, capturing both satellite shadowing effects and terrestrial channel variability. To enable analytical tractability, a moment-based statistical model is developed for the soft symbols generated at the output of the relay’s soft-input soft-output decoder, leading to an equivalent soft-channel representation. Based on this model, closed-form and semi-analytical expressions are derived for the end-to-end signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), outage probability, and symbol error rate (SER) with opportunistic relay selection. Monte Carlo simulations validate the analysis and demonstrate that the proposed hybrid DF-SIR protocol preserves cooperative diversity while significantly improving reliability compared with conventional DF-only and SIR-only relaying, particularly in the mid-SNR regime where decoding reliability is uncertain. Owing to its direct reuse of decoder-generated log-likelihood ratios without additional re-encoding or iterative processing, the proposed scheme achieves a favorable performance-complexity trade-off, making 1 it a practical and energy-efficient solution for future 6G hybrid satellite-terrestrial communication systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 混合卫星地面协作网络 (HSTCN) 是第六代 (6G) 非地面网络的关键推动者，可在异构传播条件下提供弹性广域覆盖。本文提出了一种低复杂度的混合解码转发和软信息中继（HDF-SIR）协议，用于在混合卫星地面衰落信道上运行的编码协作 HSTCN。在所提出的方案中，每个中继根据其解码可靠性在解码转发（DF）和软信息中继（SIR）模式之间自适应切换，允许不可靠的中继转发可靠性加权软符号而不是被排除在合作之外。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 混合卫星地面协作网络 (HSTCN) 是第六代 (6G) 非地面网络的关键推动者，可在异构传播条件下提供弹性广域覆盖。本文提出了一种低复杂度的混合解码转发和软信息中继（HDF-SIR）协议，用于在混合卫星地面衰落信道上运行的编码协作 HSTCN。在所提出的方案中，每个中继根据其解码可靠性在解码转发（DF）和软信息中继（SIR）模式之间自适应切换，允许不可靠的中继转发可靠性加权软符号而不是被排除在合作之外。卫星中继和卫星目的地链路通过阴影莱斯衰落进行建模，而中继目的地跳跃遵循 Nakagami-m 分布，捕获卫星阴影效应和地面信道变化。为了实现分析的易处理性，针对继电器软输入软输出解码器输出处生成的软符号开发了基于矩的统计模型，从而产生等效的软通道表示。基于该模型，导出了具有机会中继选择的端到端信噪比（SNR）、中断概率和符号错误率（SER）的封闭式和半解析表达式。蒙特卡洛模拟验证了分析结果，并证明所提出的混合 DF-SIR 协议保留了协作多样性，同时与传统的仅 DF 和仅 SIR 中继相比显着提高了可靠性，特别是在解码可靠性不确定的中 SNR 状态下。由于直接重用解码器生成的对数似然比，无需额外的重新编码或迭代处理，该方案实现了良好的性能与复杂性权衡，使其成为未来6G混合星地通信系统的实用且节能的解决方案。

articles.title: MILES: a learnable multiscale materials language for corrosion science and beyond
articles.title_zh: MILES：一种用于腐蚀科学及其他领域的可学习的多尺度材料语言
articles.abstract: Machine learning (ML) models continue to accelerate materials design and discovery. They rely on atomic/molecular-scale descriptors that represent entities used for training at the corresponding scale. However, as scales increase, descriptors must also span scales, creating the “multiscale modelling dilemma". Here, we introduce Material Input Line Entry System (MILES) for encoding descriptors that span the micro-to-macro scales. MILES encapsulates a nested series of descriptors for a range of metrics from materials, characterization, performance, or mechanical data. MILES tokens begin with a two-letter code that designates a property followed by its value(s). Tokens are arranged in levels in a modular structure to capture information in a MILES string. We demonstrate a transformer-based encoder that, when trained on ExCorr corrosion inhibitor database-derived MILES strings, learns latent representations capturing material-, inhibitor-, and performance-dependent organization. A model trained on MILES predicts inhibitor performance on untested alloys. These results highlight MILES’s potential as a materials language for ML. We also describe the software tool milescoder (https://pypi.org/project/milescoder/) that simplifies MILES encoding and decoding as well as demonstrate automated extraction of literature information for constructing MILES strings using MILES-GPT (https://miles.hereon.de/miles-gpt). We furthermore describe an ablation study showing improved latent-space organization when MILES strings are augmented with literature-mined information.
articles.abstract_zh: 机器学习 (ML) 模型继续加速材料设计和发现。它们依赖于原子/分子尺度描述符，这些描述符代表用于相应尺度训练的实体。然而，随着尺度的增加，描述符也必须跨越尺度，从而造成“多尺度建模困境”。在这里，我们介绍材料输入线输入系统（MILES），用于编码跨越微观到宏观尺度的描述符。 MILES 封装了一系列嵌套的描述符，用于材料、特性、性能或机械数据的一系列指标。 MILES 令牌以两个字母的代码开头，该代码指定一个属性，后跟其值。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 机器学习 (ML) 模型继续加速材料设计和发现。它们依赖于原子/分子尺度描述符，这些描述符代表用于相应尺度训练的实体。然而，随着尺度的增加，描述符也必须跨越尺度，从而造成“多尺度建模困境”。在这里，我们介绍材料输入线输入系统（MILES），用于编码跨越微观到宏观尺度的描述符。 MILES 封装了一系列嵌套的描述符，用于材料、特性、性能或机械数据的一系列指标。 MILES 令牌以两个字母的代码开头，该代码指定一个属性，后跟其值。令牌按模块化结构分层排列，以捕获 MILES 字符串中的信息。我们演示了一种基于变压器的编码器，当使用 ExCorr 腐蚀抑制剂数据库派生的 MILES 字符串进行训练时，它可以学习捕获材料、抑制剂和性能相关组织的潜在表示。在 MILES 上训练的模型可以预测未经测试的合金的抑制剂性能。这些结果凸显了 MILES 作为 ML 材料语言的潜力。我们还描述了软件工具 Milescoder (https://pypi.org/project/milescoder/)，它简化了 MILES 编码和解码，并演示了使用 MILES-GPT (https://miles.hereon.de/miles-gpt) 自动提取文献信息以构建 MILES 字符串。我们还描述了一项消融研究，显示当 MILES 字符串通过文献挖掘信息进行增强时，潜在空间组织得到了改善。

articles.title: Efficient uncertainty quantification in FDEM inversion using an adjusted Bayesian information criterion
articles.title_zh: 使用调整后的贝叶斯信息准则对 FDEM 反演中的不确定性进行高效量化
articles.abstract: Frequency-domain electromagnetic (FDEM) inversion is non-unique. The resulting inversion represents only one preferred solution under the chosen parameterization and regularization. Bayesian approaches characterize such uncertainty but often require millions of forward evaluations. This study develops a framework for layer-count assessment and model-averaged uncertainty quantification using an effective-degrees-of-freedom-adjusted Bayesian information criterion (EDF-BIC). EDF-BIC replaces the nominal parameter count with the effective degrees of freedom so that the penalty reflects the data-fitting flexibility retained after regularization. Criterion differences among evaluated candidate layer counts are converted into relative-support weights. Layer-count model averaging (LCMA), combined with a Laplace approximation, propagates candidate-conditional parameter uncertainty and uncertainty among layer counts into the resistivity structure. For the five-layer U05 model, the EDF adjustment increased the weighted mean layer count from 4.06 to 5.15 and reduced the low-layer-count preference of nominal BIC. In the G02 and G05 experiments, EDF-BIC support varied spatially near layer pinch-outs, disappearing layers, and interface variations, while between-model uncertainty was concentrated in transition zones. Across 50 noise realizations with the candidate sets, error model, and regularization fixed, mean empirical coverage of the P10–P90 intervals was 87.57% for G02 and 83.66% for G05. Application to the Yemaquan L52 and L53 field data recovered consistent principal electrical structures, whereas interface positions and geometries were more sensitive to layer-count choice. EDF calculation and uncertainty analysis added less than 1% to candidate-inversion time. The framework provides a computationally tractable approach to layer-count assessment and uncertainty propagation.
articles.abstract_zh: 频域电磁（FDEM）反演不是唯一的。所得到的反演仅代表所选参数化和正则化下的一种优选解决方案。贝叶斯方法描述了这种不确定性，但通常需要数百万次前向评估。本研究使用有效自由度调整贝叶斯信息准则（EDF-BIC）开发了层数评估和模型平均不确定性量化的框架。 EDF-BIC 用有效自由度代替标称参数计数，以便惩罚反映正则化后保留的数据拟合灵活性。评估的候选层计数之间的标准差异被转换为相对支持权重。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 频域电磁（FDEM）反演不是唯一的。所得到的反演仅代表所选参数化和正则化下的一种优选解决方案。贝叶斯方法描述了这种不确定性，但通常需要数百万次前向评估。本研究使用有效自由度调整贝叶斯信息准则（EDF-BIC）开发了层数评估和模型平均不确定性量化的框架。 EDF-BIC 用有效自由度代替标称参数计数，以便惩罚反映正则化后保留的数据拟合灵活性。评估的候选层计数之间的标准差异被转换为相对支持权重。层数模型平均 (LCMA) 与拉普拉斯近似相结合，将候选条件参数不确定性和层数之间的不确定性传播到电阻率结构中。对于五层U05模型，EDF调整将加权平均层数从4.06增加到5.15，并减少名义BIC的低层数偏好。在 G02 和 G05 实验中，EDF-BIC 支持在空间上变化的近层尖灭、消失层和界面变化，而模型间的不确定性集中在过渡区域。在候选集、误差模型和正则化固定的 50 个噪声实现中，P10-P90 区间的平均经验覆盖率对于 G02 为 87.57%，对于 G05 为 83.66%。应用野马泉 L52 和 L53 现场数据恢复了一致的主要电结构，而界面位置和几何形状对层数选择更敏感。 EDF 计算和不确定性分析使候选反演时间增加了不到 1%。该框架提供了一种计算上易于处理的方法来进行层数评估和不确定性传播。

articles.title: Multidisciplinary Screening of a 178 kN Class Geared Turbofan with Explicit Mission Auditing and Independent Uncertainty Checks
articles.title_zh: 通过明确的任务审核和独立的不确定性检查对 178 kN 级齿轮传动涡轮风扇发动机进行多学科筛选
articles.abstract: A computational audit examines cycle matching, hot-section protection, parallel rotor screening, and uncertainty for a 177.93 kN geared turbofan. Constant-property cycle balances, analytic component maps, fixed nozzle areas, a three-node transient thermal network, and a conceptual flexible rotor are used. The selected static point has bypass ratio 12.99, overall pressure ratio 45.18, turbine-inlet temperature 1450 K, and thrust-specific fuel consumption 22.67 kg/(kN h). Reproduction exposes an inherited input in the historical Monte Carlo loop and thermal boundary conditions disconnected from matched mission states. An independent 10000-draw static holdout records six temperature exceedances and 414 nozzle-pressure-margin failures, with 95% Wilson intervals of 0.028–0.131% and 3.767–4.548%. Matched thermal coupling raises the original-cooling peak to 1255 K. One revised global law reduces the nominal peak to 1230 K at 11.50% takeoff cooling. A separate 5000-draw full-mission thermal analysis with that law frozen records 210 exceedances of 1250 K (4.20%; 95% interval 3.68–4.79%) and no numerical failures. Thus nominal recovery does not establish a mission thermal reliability claim. All eight phases converge, remain within analytic coordinate bounds, and satisfy nozzle forward-flow checks. Compressor surge margins remain undefined because instability boundaries are unavailable. Rotor response is screened over an independent speed sweep, not a recovered mission shaft-speed trajectory. The results support a reproducible conditional screening audit; full compressor operability and hardware performance remain unvalidated. The cooling result remains conditional because detailed cooling-system pressure losses and film-cooling aerodynamics are not resolved.
articles.abstract_zh: 计算审核检查 177.93 kN 齿轮传动涡轮风扇发动机的循环匹配、热段保护、平行转子筛选和不确定性。使用恒定特性循环平衡、分析组件图、固定喷嘴面积、三节点瞬态热网络和概念性柔性转子。选定的静态点涵道比为12.99，总压比为45.18，涡轮入口温度为1450 K，推力比油耗为22.67 kg/(kN·h)。再现暴露了历史蒙特卡罗循环中继承的输入以及与匹配任务状态断开的热边界条件。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 计算审核检查 177.93 kN 齿轮传动涡轮风扇发动机的循环匹配、热段保护、平行转子筛选和不确定性。使用恒定特性循环平衡、分析组件图、固定喷嘴面积、三节点瞬态热网络和概念性柔性转子。选定的静态点涵道比为12.99，总压比为45.18，涡轮入口温度为1450 K，推力比油耗为22.67 kg/(kN·h)。再现暴露了历史蒙特卡罗循环中继承的输入以及与匹配任务状态断开的热边界条件。独立的 10000 次拉伸静态保持记录了 6 次温度超标和 414 次喷嘴压力裕度故障，95% Wilson 间隔为 0.028–0.131% 和 3.767–4.548%。匹配的热耦合将原始冷却峰值提高到 1255 K。一项修订后的全球法律将起飞冷却 11.50% 时的标称峰值降低到 1230 K。根据该定律进行的单独 5000 次全任务热分析记录了 210 次超过 1250 K 的情况（4.20%；95% 区间 3.68–4.79%），并且没有数值故障。因此，标称回收率并不能建立任务热可靠性声明。所有八个相都会收敛，保持在解析坐标范围内，并满足喷嘴前向流检查。由于不稳定边界不可用，压缩机喘振裕度仍未定义。转子响应是通过独立的速度扫描来筛选的，而不是通过恢复的任务轴速度轨迹来筛选的。结果支持可重复的条件筛选审核；完整的压缩机可操作性和硬件性能尚未经过验证。冷却结果仍然是有条件的，因为详细的冷却系统压力损失和薄膜冷却空气动力学尚未解决。

articles.title: Shapiro spikes in driven quantum fluids
articles.title_zh: 夏皮罗在驱动量子流体中的峰值
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05477v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Periodic driving of a Josephson junction produces resonant transport signatures known as Shapiro spikes, conventionally described by effective circuit models. Here, we demonstrate Shapiro spikes in a neutral quantum fluid using simulations of a potential-biased atomic Josephson junction. The dc-current resonances follow the expected Bessel-function scaling, including the suppression and revival of individual resonances with increasing modulation strength. We uncover their microscopic mechanism by showing that the phase-winding frequency develops finite plateaus at integer multiples of the drive frequency. These phase-locked states are sustained by quantized-vortex nucleation and the associated 2π phase slips. Remarkably, within a locking plateau, the dc current and density transfer can reverse direction while the phase-winding frequency remains locked to the drive, giving rise to negative-mobility transport. Our results establish a microscopic link between vortex-mediated phase slips, Shapiro resonances, and anomalous transport in a neutral quantum fluid, revealing how quantized vortices convert resonant transport into phase-locked dynamics with negative mobility.
articles.abstract_zh: 约瑟夫森结的周期性驱动会产生称为夏皮罗尖峰的共振传输特征，通常由有效电路模型来描述。在这里，我们通过模拟电位偏置原子约瑟夫森结来演示中性量子流体中的夏皮罗尖峰。直流电流谐振遵循预期的贝塞尔函数缩放，包括随着调制强度的增加而抑制和恢复各个谐振。我们通过证明相绕组频率在驱动频率的整数倍处形成有限平台来揭示其微观机制。这些锁相状态由量子化涡旋成核和相关的 2π 相滑维持。值得注意的是，在锁定平台内，直流电流和密度传输可以反转方向，而相绕组频率保持锁定到驱动器，从而引起负迁移率传输。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 约瑟夫森结的周期性驱动会产生称为夏皮罗尖峰的共振传输特征，通常由有效电路模型来描述。在这里，我们通过模拟电位偏置原子约瑟夫森结来演示中性量子流体中的夏皮罗尖峰。直流电流谐振遵循预期的贝塞尔函数缩放，包括随着调制强度的增加而抑制和恢复各个谐振。我们通过证明相绕组频率在驱动频率的整数倍处形成有限平台来揭示其微观机制。这些锁相状态由量子化涡旋成核和相关的 2π 相滑维持。值得注意的是，在锁定平台内，直流电流和密度传输可以反转方向，而相绕组频率保持锁定到驱动器，从而引起负迁移率传输。我们的结果建立了涡旋介导的相滑、夏皮罗共振和中性量子流体中的反常输运之间的微观联系，揭示了量子化涡旋如何将共振输运转化为具有负迁移率的锁相动力学。

articles.title: Quasicrystals are Functionally Graded Materials
articles.title_zh: 准晶体是功能梯度材料
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05478v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quasicrystals exhibit long-range order without translational periodicity, posing challenges to compute their electronic properties. Here we show that a quasicrystal can be represented exactly as a periodic approximant with a spatially graded phason, establishing a connection to functionally graded materials. Building on this connection, we develop a controlled quantum theory of quasicrystals. We derive a state-dependent control parameter governed by the quantum metric of local Bloch states, determining when finite approximations are reliable. We further construct a Hamiltonian that correctly predicts Bragg gap positions, quasimomentum equivalence, and quasiperiodic eigenstates to all orders in phason strain within a finite Fourier window. We verify the theory numerically and propose a diffraction-based experimental test of the gap shift induced by phason strain. Our framework opens a route to predicting the electronic structure and functional properties of quasicrystals using methods developed for functionally graded materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 准晶体表现出长程有序，没有平移周期性，这对计算其电子特性提出了挑战。在这里，我们证明准晶体可以精确地表示为具有空间梯度相子的周期性近似，从而建立与功能梯度材料的联系。在此基础上，我们发展了准晶体的受控量子理论。我们推导了一个由局部布洛赫态的量子度量控制的状态相关控制参数，确定有限近似何时可靠。我们进一步构造了一个哈密顿量，它可以正确预测有限傅里叶窗口内相子应变中所有阶的布拉格间隙位置、准动量等价和准周期本征态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 准晶体表现出长程有序，没有平移周期性，这对计算其电子特性提出了挑战。在这里，我们证明准晶体可以精确地表示为具有空间梯度相子的周期性近似，从而建立与功能梯度材料的联系。在此基础上，我们发展了准晶体的受控量子理论。我们推导了一个由局部布洛赫态的量子度量控制的状态相关控制参数，确定有限近似何时可靠。我们进一步构造了一个哈密顿量，它可以正确预测有限傅里叶窗口内相子应变中所有阶的布拉格间隙位置、准动量等价和准周期本征态。我们通过数值验证了该理论，并提出了一种基于衍射的相子应变引起的间隙位移的实验测试。我们的框架开辟了一条利用为功能梯度材料开发的方法来预测准晶体的电子结构和功能特性的途径。

articles.title: Resonantly interacting 2e/3 anyons: a controlled microscopic theory of anyon superconductivity
articles.title_zh: 共振相互作用 2e/3 任意子：任意子超导的受控微观理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05529v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a microscopic theory of anyon superconductivity that connects electronic interactions in a lightly doped Laughlin state to the universal physics of a resonantly interacting anyon gas. Using geometric quantization of Laughlin quasiholes, we derive the effective many-body Hamiltonian of dilute charge-2e/3 anyons, including their valley structure, dispersion, and statistical and short-range interactions, together with an explicit map between anyon and electron observables. This reduces the dilute many-body problem to a few parameters fixed by data computable from few anyon numerics. In analogy with resonant Fermi and Bose gases, we organize the dilute anyon problem around a two-body binding resonance and its relevant and marginal perturbations. For a three-valley gas of charge-2e/3 anyons, we identify a resonance whose long-distance theory is governed by an Aharonov-Casher anyon Hamiltonian whose magnetic field is the statistical Chern-Simons field and whose ground state is exactly solvable. Using the ground state wavefunction, we demonstrate Cooper-pair off-diagonal long-range order directly in electron coordinates and determine the pairing symmetry and vortex-lattice structure. The leading perturbations at the fixed point are a relevant pair detuning and a marginal three-body contact in the valley-singlet channel, which determine the compressibility and sound velocity. A repulsive three-body coupling is marginally irrelevant, allowing the fixed point to control a parametrically broad dilute regime near pair resonance, while attractive three-body interactions instead generate charge-2e trimers. More broadly, our results show that binding thresholds between competing anyon composites host universal resonant regimes that are not captured by the lowest-energy anyon species alone, providing a new setting for controlled theories of anyon matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们开发了一种任意子超导的微观理论，该理论将轻掺杂劳克林态中的电子相互作用与共振相互作用的任意子气体的普遍物理联系起来。利用劳克林准空穴的几何量子化，我们推导了稀电荷 2e/3 任意子的有效多体哈密顿量，包括它们的谷结构、色散、统计和短程相互作用，以及任意子和电子可观测量之间的显式映射。这将稀释多体问题减少为由可从几个任意数值计算的数据固定的几个参数。与共振费米和玻色气体类似，我们围绕二体结合共振及其相关和边际扰动组织稀释任意子问题。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们开发了一种任意子超导的微观理论，该理论将轻掺杂劳克林态中的电子相互作用与共振相互作用的任意子气体的普遍物理联系起来。利用劳克林准空穴的几何量子化，我们推导了稀电荷 2e/3 任意子的有效多体哈密顿量，包括它们的谷结构、色散、统计和短程相互作用，以及任意子和电子可观测量之间的显式映射。这将稀释多体问题减少为由可从几个任意数值计算的数据固定的几个参数。与共振费米和玻色气体类似，我们围绕二体结合共振及其相关和边际扰动组织稀释任意子问题。对于电荷为 2e/3 任意子的三谷气体，我们确定了一个共振，其长距离理论由阿哈罗诺夫-卡舍尔任意子哈密顿量控制，其磁场是统计 Chern-Simons 场，其基态是完全可解的。利用基态波函数，我们直接在电子坐标中证明了库珀对非对角长程有序，并确定了配对对称性和涡晶格结构。固定点处的主要扰动是谷单通道中的相关对失谐和边缘三体接触，它们决定了可压缩性和声速。排斥性三体耦合几乎不相关，允许固定点控制对共振附近的参数宽稀释区域，而吸引性三体相互作用则产生电荷 2e 三聚体。更广泛地说，我们的结果表明，竞争性任意子复合材料之间的结合阈值具有普遍的共振机制，而这些共振机制不能被最低能量的任意子物种单独捕获，从而为任意子物质的受控理论提供了新的设置。

articles.title: DefectSkills: Guiding AI agents through first-principles calculations for point defects in semiconductors and insulators
articles.title_zh: DefectSkills：指导人工智能代理通过半导体和绝缘体点缺陷的第一原理计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05654v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: First-principles defect calculations can now be performed autonomously by AI agents, enabled by established computational methods and open-source Python toolkits. However, reliable and repeatable defect calculations require clear scientific and technical guidance that helps agents resolve ambiguities and avoid errors in calculation setup, execution, postprocessing, and analysis. Here, we present DefectSkills, a set of structured prompts that provides human-in-the-loop guidance to AI agents performing first-principles calculations of point defects in semiconductors and insulators using the Vienna Ab initio Simulation Package (VASP). The prompts encode human expertise and guide agents through unit-cell relaxation, electronic-structure and dielectric calculations, phase-stability and chemical-potential analysis, charged-defect supercell generation and calculations, finite-size corrections, formation-energy calculations and thermodynamic analysis, and data backup. By packaging this expertise as reusable agent skills, DefectSkills supports consistent workflow execution across agentic AI systems and reproducible defect calculations.
articles.abstract_zh: 第一原理缺陷计算现在可以由 AI 代理自主执行，并通过已建立的计算方法和开源 Python 工具包实现。然而，可靠且可重复的缺陷计算需要明确的科学和技术指导，帮助代理解决歧义并避免计算设置、执行、后处理和分析中的错误。在这里，我们展示了 DefectSkills，这是一组结构化提示，为人工智能代理使用维也纳从头算仿真包 (VASP) 执行半导体和绝缘体点缺陷的第一性原理计算提供人机交互指导。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 第一原理缺陷计算现在可以由 AI 代理自主执行，并通过已建立的计算方法和开源 Python 工具包实现。然而，可靠且可重复的缺陷计算需要明确的科学和技术指导，帮助代理解决歧义并避免计算设置、执行、后处理和分析中的错误。在这里，我们展示了 DefectSkills，这是一组结构化提示，为人工智能代理使用维也纳从头算仿真包 (VASP) 执行半导体和绝缘体点缺陷的第一性原理计算提供人机交互指导。这些提示对人类专业知识进行编码，并指导代理完成晶胞弛豫、电子结构和介电计算、相稳定性和化学势分析、带电缺陷超级晶胞生成和计算、有限尺寸校正、地层能量计算和热力学分析以及数据备份。通过将这种专业知识打包为可重用的代理技能，DefectSkills 支持跨代理 AI 系统和可重复的缺陷计算的一致工作流程执行。

articles.title: Ni ordering in the van der Waals gap of Ni-intercalated 2H-NbS₂: from disorder through 2×2 and sqrt3×sqrt3 order to stripe order
articles.title_zh: Ni插层2H-NbS2范德华间隙中的Ni排序：从无序到2×2和sqrt3×sqrt3有序到条纹有序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05699v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report a synchrotron x-ray diffraction study of Ni-intercalated 2H-NbS₂ over the range 0.18 le x le 0.57, with Ni contents measured by energy-dispersive x-ray spectroscopy. Powder diffraction on the whole series shows that the NbS₂ host is preserved, while the Ni ions in the van der Waals gap evolve from a disordered arrangement to 2×2 order at x=1/4 and sqrt3×sqrt3 order at x=1/3, through a range where both motifs coexist, to an orthorhombic stripe-type order at x=0.57. The in-plane lattice parameter increases with Ni content, whereas the interlayer spacing remains nearly constant except for a pronounced minimum at x=1/4, which density-functional calculations reproduce for the ordered structure. Single-crystal diffraction on the two commensurate phases shows that the x=1/4 structure, with Ni on a single site and a trimerized Nb lattice, is free of stacking faults, whereas the chiral x=1/3 structure contains Ni on the nominally empty site, inversion twins and stacking faults of the Ni layers. The comparison between powders and crystals shows that grinding mainly degrades the stacking of the Ni layers. These results establish the structural phase diagram of NiₓNbS₂ and the intercalant disorder to be taken into account in the interpretation of its magnetic properties.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们报告了在 0.18 le x le 0.57 范围内插层 Ni 的 2H-NbS2 的同步加速器 X 射线衍射研究，并通过能量色散 X 射线光谱测量了 Ni 含量。整个系列的粉末衍射表明，NbS2主体被保留，而范德华间隙中的Ni离子从无序排列演变为x=1/4处的2×2有序和x=1/3处的sqrt3×sqrt3有序，经过两个图案共存的范围，演变为x=0.57处的正交条纹型有序。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了在 0.18 le x le 0.57 范围内插层 Ni 的 2H-NbS2 的同步加速器 X 射线衍射研究，并通过能量色散 X 射线光谱测量了 Ni 含量。整个系列的粉末衍射表明，NbS2主体被保留，而范德华间隙中的Ni离子从无序排列演变为x=1/4处的2×2有序和x=1/3处的sqrt3×sqrt3有序，经过两个图案共存的范围，演变为x=0.57处的正交条纹型有序。面内晶格参数随着 Ni 含量的增加而增加，而层间距几乎保持恒定，除了 x=1/4 处的明显最小值之外，密度泛函计算再现了有序结构。两个相应相的单晶衍射表明，x=1/4 结构（在单个位点上具有 Ni 和三聚 Nb 晶格）没有堆垛层错，而手性 x=1/3 结构在标称空位点上含有 Ni、反转孪晶和 Ni 层的堆垛层错。粉末和晶体之间的比较表明，研磨主要降低了镍层的堆积。这些结果建立了 NiₓNbS2 的结构相图以及在解释其磁性时要考虑的插层无序。

articles.title: Exact Mirror-Parity Selection Rule for Electron-Phonon Coupling in Two-Dimensional Crystals
articles.title_zh: 二维晶体中电子声子耦合的精确镜宇称选择规则
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05710v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The electron--phonon (e-ph) interaction underlies conventional superconductivity and plays a central role in transport and other many-body phenomena in solids. Here, we derive a symmetry selection rule for e-ph scattering in two-dimensional crystals possessing a horizontal mirror plane, σₕ. For electronic states of mirror parity sₙ(k) and sₘ(k+q), and a phonon mode of parity χ_ν(q), we show that the e-ph matrix element gₘₙ,ν(k,q) vanishes identically unless sₙ(k),χ_ν(q), sₘ(k+q)=+1. The rule follows from the covariance of the phonon-induced deformation potential under σₕ, constitutes the Cₛ case of the general group-theoretical selection rule for matrix elements, and partitions the e-ph interaction throughout the Brillouin zone into symmetry-allowed and symmetry-forbidden scattering channels. Consequently, mirror-even phonons couple electronic states of the same mirror parity, either even--even or odd--odd, whereas mirror-odd phonons couple only states of opposite mirror parity, for both intra- and interband processes. We illustrate the selection rule through first-principles calculations for the two-dimensional superconductor Sc₂BCH₄, where mirror parity is well defined throughout the entire Brillouin zone and symmetry-forbidden matrix elements vanish up to numerical precision. We then extend the analysis to bulk MgB₂, where the rule applies exactly only on mirror-invariant planes of the three-dimensional Brillouin zone. Moving away from these planes removes the exact mirror constraint and activates scattering channels that are symmetry forbidden when the mirror eigenvalues are well defined. Our results establish horizontal mirror symmetry as an exact and practical filter of e-ph scattering processes.
articles.abstract_zh: 电子-声子 (e-ph) 相互作用是传统超导性的基础，在固体输运和其他多体现象中发挥着核心作用。在这里，我们推导了具有水平镜面 σₕ 的二维晶体中 e-ph 散射的对称性选择规则。对于镜像宇称 sₙ(k) 和 sₘ(k+q) 的电子态以及宇称 χ_ν(q) 的声子模，我们证明 e-ph 矩阵元素 gₘₙ,ν(k,q) 相同消失，除非 sₙ(k),χ_ν(q), sₘ(k+q)=+1。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电子-声子 (e-ph) 相互作用是传统超导性的基础，在固体输运和其他多体现象中发挥着核心作用。在这里，我们推导了具有水平镜面 σₕ 的二维晶体中 e-ph 散射的对称性选择规则。对于镜像宇称 sₙ(k) 和 sₘ(k+q) 的电子态以及宇称 χ_ν(q) 的声子模，我们证明 e-ph 矩阵元素 gₘₙ,ν(k,q) 相同消失，除非 sₙ(k),χ_ν(q), sₘ(k+q)=+1。该规则遵循 σₕ 下声子引起的变形势的协方差，构成了矩阵元素的一般群论选择规则的 Cₛ 情况，并将整个布里渊区的 e-ph 相互作用划分为对称允许和对称禁止的散射通道。因此，对于带内和带间过程，镜像偶声子耦合相同镜像奇偶校验的电子态，偶-偶或奇-奇，而镜像奇声子仅耦合相反镜像奇偶校验的状态。我们通过二维超导体 Sc2BCH4 的第一原理计算来说明选择规则，其中镜像宇称在整个布里渊区中得到了很好的定义，并且对称禁止矩阵元素在达到数值精度时消失。然后，我们将分析扩展到块体 MgB2，其中该规则仅适用于三维布里渊区的镜面不变平面。远离这些平面会消除精确的反射镜约束，并激活当反射镜特征值明确定义时对称性禁止的散射通道。我们的结果将水平镜像对称性确立为 e-ph 散射过程的精确且实用的滤波器。

articles.title: Emergent Incompressibility in Polariton Condensates for Scalable XY Spin Simulation
articles.title_zh: 用于可扩展 XY 自旋模拟的极化子凝聚体中的突现不可压缩性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05782v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Driven-dissipative polariton networks offer a powerful analog platform for simulating continuous-spin Hamiltonians. However, their practical scalability is fundamentally limited by amplitude-phase coupling and metastable trapping in highly frustrated energy landscapes. Here, we present an in situ dual-enhancement mechanism to address these bottlenecks without requiring external site-specific fine-tuning. First, a renormalization-group analysis based on density rescaling shows that higher-order nonlinear loss drives the condensates toward an incompressible regime, intrinsically suppressing amplitude fluctuations and enforcing phase-only dynamics. For macroscopic XY networks (up to 10,000 spins), this phase-amplitude decoupling yields a more than 50-fold reduction in energy, while simultaneously shrinking the standard deviation by a factor of six. More generally, it restores the extensive scaling of the optimized XY energy with system size. Second, to navigate the rugged, nonconvex energy landscape, we introduce weak Hermitian pulses. When implemented through a multistage protocol, these pulses enable repeated escapes from local minima and drive the system to deeper energy minima. Benchmarking shows an increasing advantage with system size, with the polariton simulator outperforming the classical Monte Carlo-SQP baseline in every sampled macroscopic realization. Our work provides a physical framework for scalable polariton analog computing.
articles.abstract_zh: 驱动耗散极化子网络提供了一个强大的模拟平台，用于模拟连续自旋哈密顿量。然而，它们的实际可扩展性从根本上受到高度沮丧的能源景观中的幅相耦合和亚稳态捕获的限制。在这里，我们提出了一种原位双重增强机制来解决这些瓶颈，而不需要外部特定于站点的微调。首先，基于密度重新缩放的重正化群分析表明，高阶非线性损耗将凝聚体推向不可压缩状态，本质上抑制振幅波动并强制仅相位动力学。对于宏观 XY 网络（最多 10,000 次自旋），这种相位幅度解耦可将能量减少 50 倍以上，同时将标准偏差缩小六倍。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 驱动耗散极化子网络提供了一个强大的模拟平台，用于模拟连续自旋哈密顿量。然而，它们的实际可扩展性从根本上受到高度沮丧的能源景观中的幅相耦合和亚稳态捕获的限制。在这里，我们提出了一种原位双重增强机制来解决这些瓶颈，而不需要外部特定于站点的微调。首先，基于密度重新缩放的重正化群分析表明，高阶非线性损耗将凝聚体推向不可压缩状态，本质上抑制振幅波动并强制仅相位动力学。对于宏观 XY 网络（最多 10,000 次自旋），这种相位幅度解耦可将能量减少 50 倍以上，同时将标准偏差缩小六倍。更一般地说，它恢复了优化的 XY 能量随系统尺寸的广泛缩放。其次，为了驾驭崎岖的非凸能量景观，我们引入了弱埃尔米特脉冲。当通过多级协议实施时，这些脉冲能够反复逃离局部最小值并驱动系统达到更深的能量最小值。基准测试显示系统尺寸的优势越来越大，极化子模拟器在每个采样的宏观实现中都优于经典的 Monte Carlo-SQP 基线。我们的工作为可扩展的极化子模拟计算提供了一个物理框架。

articles.title: Predictions of superconducting properties from chemical bonding interactions
articles.title_zh: 从化学键相互作用预测超导特性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05784v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The need for rapid estimates of superconducting critical temperatures, Tc s, is becoming increasingly urgent as first-principles and artificial intelligence based methods enable the exploration of ever-larger and more chemically complex materials spaces. In this context, chemical bonding based quantities have emerged as promising descriptors for predicting superconductivity. To date, these approaches have mainly been developed for hydride superconductors, notably through the networking value, a descriptor based upon the electron localization function, whose topological properties have been found to correlate with Tc . In this perspective, we review and consolidate the method's theory, and we discuss how the estimate of the Tc is achievable within a real-space view. We conclude by proposing a framework that enables Tc prediction for the broad family of conventional superconductors from easily computable intermediate physical quantities.
articles.abstract_zh: 随着基于第一原理和人工智能的方法能够探索更大、化学更复杂的材料空间，快速估计超导临界温度 Tc 的需求变得越来越迫切。在这种背景下，基于化学键的量已成为预测超导性的有希望的描述符。迄今为止，这些方法主要是针对氢化物超导体开发的，特别是通过网络值（一种基于电子局域化函数的描述符），其拓扑特性已被发现与 Tc 相关。从这个角度来看，我们回顾并巩固了该方法的理论，并讨论了如何在真实空间视图中实现 Tc 的估计。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 随着基于第一原理和人工智能的方法能够探索更大、化学更复杂的材料空间，快速估计超导临界温度 Tc 的需求变得越来越迫切。在这种背景下，基于化学键的量已成为预测超导性的有希望的描述符。迄今为止，这些方法主要是针对氢化物超导体开发的，特别是通过网络值（一种基于电子局域化函数的描述符），其拓扑特性已被发现与 Tc 相关。从这个角度来看，我们回顾并巩固了该方法的理论，并讨论了如何在真实空间视图中实现 Tc 的估计。最后，我们提出了一个框架，可以根据易于计算的中间物理量对广泛的传统超导体进行 Tc 预测。

articles.title: Ferroelectricity and Peierls transition in MOI₂ (M=Ta, Nb): a first-principle analysis
articles.title_zh: MOI2 (M=Ta, Nb) 中的铁电性和 Peierls 转变：第一原理分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05836v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The van der Waals ferroelectric NbOI₂ hosts a polar distortion that is commonly attributed to the Peierls dimerization of its Nb chains. Here we show, using first-principles calculations and a Landau-type energy, that the polar instability is in fact a distinct order parameter that does not stem from the Peierls mode condensation and that three main distinct modes are important in the whole MOI₂ family. They are a polar mode P, an antipolar mode η, and a Peierls mode δ, whose stabilities and couplings strongly depend on the nature of the M metal element, as evidenced by the fact that the isostructural, TaOI₂ system is not polar while possessing Peirls distortions.
articles.abstract_zh: 范德华铁电 NbOI2 具有极性畸变，这通常归因于其 Nb 链的 Peierls 二聚化。在这里，我们使用第一性原理计算和朗道型能量表明，极性不稳定性实际上是一个独特的有序参数，并非源于 Peierls 模式凝聚，并且三个主要的不同模式在整个 MOI2 系列中很重要。它们是极性模式 P、反极性模式 η 和 Peierls 模式 δ，其稳定性和耦合很大程度上取决于 M 金属元素的性质，同构 TaOI2 系统在具有 Peirls 畸变的同时不是极性的，这一事实证明了这一点。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 范德华铁电 NbOI2 具有极性畸变，这通常归因于其 Nb 链的 Peierls 二聚化。在这里，我们使用第一性原理计算和朗道型能量表明，极性不稳定性实际上是一个独特的有序参数，并非源于 Peierls 模式凝聚，并且三个主要的不同模式在整个 MOI2 系列中很重要。它们是极性模式 P、反极性模式 η 和 Peierls 模式 δ，其稳定性和耦合很大程度上取决于 M 金属元素的性质，同构 TaOI2 系统在具有 Peirls 畸变的同时不是极性的，这一事实证明了这一点。

articles.title: Interplay between Spin Stripes and Pairing Crossover in the Bilayer Hubbard Model
articles.title_zh: 双层哈伯德模型中旋转条纹与配对交叉之间的相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05840v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Whether d-wave or s_±-wave pairing prevails in the bilayer nickelate ceLa3Ni2O7 remains unresolved, and how its observed spin order and magnetic excitations relate to the pairing mechanism is unclear. Here, we use finite-temperature determinant quantum Monte Carlo simulations of a minimal bilayer Hubbard model to investigate pairing competition at strong interlayer coupling, where intralayer and interlayer antiferromagnetic correlations have comparable strengths. We find that spin stripes develop spontaneously with increasing hole doping, accompanied by a crossover of the dominant pairing symmetry from d-wave to s_±-wave. The crossover tracks the changing relative strengths of the spin correlations, with the interlayer correlations overtaking their intralayer counterparts in magnitude. Concomitantly, the dynamical spin structure factor exhibits a momentum-dependent reorganization of the magnetic excitations, consistent with fluctuating spin stripes. Our results identify the structure of spin fluctuations as a key link between spin stripes and pairing competition, offering a minimal-model perspective for understanding ceLa3Ni2O7.
articles.abstract_zh: 双层镍酸盐 ceLa3Ni2O7 中是否存在 d 波或 s_± 波配对仍未解决，并且其观察到的自旋顺序和磁激发与配对机制之间的关系尚不清楚。在这里，我们使用最小双层哈伯德模型的有限温度行列式量子蒙特卡罗模拟来研究强层间耦合下的配对竞争，其中层内和层间反铁磁相关性具有相当的强度。我们发现，随着空穴掺杂的增加，自旋条纹会自发形成，并伴随着主要配对对称性从 d 波到 s_± 波的交叉。交叉跟踪自旋相关性相对强度的变化，层间相关性在幅度上超过了层内相关性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 双层镍酸盐 ceLa3Ni2O7 中是否存在 d 波或 s_± 波配对仍未解决，并且其观察到的自旋顺序和磁激发与配对机制之间的关系尚不清楚。在这里，我们使用最小双层哈伯德模型的有限温度行列式量子蒙特卡罗模拟来研究强层间耦合下的配对竞争，其中层内和层间反铁磁相关性具有相当的强度。我们发现，随着空穴掺杂的增加，自旋条纹会自发形成，并伴随着主要配对对称性从 d 波到 s_± 波的交叉。交叉跟踪自旋相关性相对强度的变化，层间相关性在幅度上超过了层内相关性。与此同时，动态自旋结构因子表现出磁激发的动量依赖性重组，与波动的自旋条纹一致。我们的结果将自旋涨落结构确定为自旋条纹和配对竞争之间的关键联系，为理解 ceLa3Ni2O7 提供了最小模型视角。

articles.title: Neural Networks with Exciton-Polariton Waveguides
articles.title_zh: 具有激子极化波导的神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05846v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose and numerically study a scheme for neural networks using exciton-polariton waveguide meshes. These enable arbitrary programmable interlayer couplings suited to a restricted Boltzmann machine architecture where polariton phases act as stochastic network variables. We show that such a network can be trained using unsupervised Hebbian and anti-Hebbian updates. This allows the implementation of an associative memory, where the network recovers learned patterns from imperfect inputs.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出并数值研究了一种使用激子极化波导网格的神经网络方案。这些使得任意可编程层间耦合适合于受限玻尔兹曼机器架构，其中极化子相位充当随机网络变量。我们表明，可以使用无监督的赫布和反赫布更新来训练这样的网络。这允许实现联想记忆，网络从不完美的输入中恢复学习的模式。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出并数值研究了一种使用激子极化波导网格的神经网络方案。这些使得任意可编程层间耦合适合于受限玻尔兹曼机器架构，其中极化子相位充当随机网络变量。我们表明，可以使用无监督的赫布和反赫布更新来训练这样的网络。这允许实现联想记忆，网络从不完美的输入中恢复学习的模式。

articles.title: Floquet-Volkov spin polarization in spin-degenerate Antiferromagnets
articles.title_zh: 自旋简并反铁磁体中的 Floquet-Volkov 自旋极化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05856v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Periodic driving enables ultrafast control of electronic structures in solids through the formation of photon-dressed Floquet-Bloch states. However, the measured photoemission spectra are influenced not only by these states but also by their interference with Volkov-dressed outgoing photoelectrons. Here, we demonstrate that Floquet-Volkov interference can generate spin-polarized photoemission in a collinear antiferromagnetic Dirac model without spin-orbit coupling (SOC). An in-plane linearly polarized pump preserves PT symmetry, leaving the Floquet quasienergies spin degenerate. Under near-resonant driving, photon-dressed conduction and valence bands hybridize, producing spin-dependent relative phases that are converted into unequal spin-resolved photoemission intensities through interference between pathways reaching the same Volkov-dressed final state. We analytically identify this interference mechanism and verify it using nonequilibrium Green-function calculations under periodic driving and finite pump-probe pulses. We further demonstrate that rotating the probe polarization can suppress or reverse the spin polarization without modifying the Floquet bands. Our findings establish Floquet-Volkov interference as a route to spin-selective photoemission in driven antiferromagnets without Floquet spin splitting or SOC.
articles.abstract_zh: 周期性驱动可以通过形成光子修饰的 Floquet-Bloch 态来超快控制固体中的电子结构。然而，测量的光发射光谱不仅受到这些状态的影响，而且还受到它们对沃尔科夫装饰的出射光电子的干扰的影响。在这里，我们证明了 Floquet-Volkov 干涉可以在没有自旋轨道耦合（SOC）的共线反铁磁狄拉克模型中产生自旋偏振光电发射。面内线性极化泵浦保持 PT 对称性，使 Floquet 准能量自旋简并。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 周期性驱动可以通过形成光子修饰的 Floquet-Bloch 态来超快控制固体中的电子结构。然而，测量的光发射光谱不仅受到这些状态的影响，而且还受到它们对沃尔科夫装饰的出射光电子的干扰的影响。在这里，我们证明了 Floquet-Volkov 干涉可以在没有自旋轨道耦合（SOC）的共线反铁磁狄拉克模型中产生自旋偏振光电发射。面内线性极化泵浦保持 PT 对称性，使 Floquet 准能量自旋简并。在近共振驱动下，光子修饰的导带和价带杂交，产生自旋相关的相对相位，通过达到相同沃尔科夫修饰的最终状态的路径之间的干扰，这些相对相位转换为不相等的自旋分辨光电发射强度。我们分析地识别了这种干扰机制，并在周期性驱动和有限泵浦探测脉冲下使用非平衡格林函数计算来验证它。我们进一步证明，旋转探针偏振可以抑制或逆转自旋偏振，而不改变 Floquet 能带。我们的研究结果表明，Floquet-Volkov 干涉是在驱动反铁磁体中实现自旋选择性光电发射的一种途径，无需 Floquet 自旋分裂或 SOC。

articles.title: Temperature-Dependent Ion Dynamics in Argyrodite Superionic Conductor Li₆PS₅Cl with Fine-Tuned MACE Foundation Model
articles.title_zh: 使用微调的 MACE 基础模型研究银铜矿超离子导体 Li₆PS₅Cl 中温度相关的离子动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05946v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The rapid growth of machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIP), particularly the foundational models for materials chemistry, such as MACE, has significantly strengthened our capabilities in studying the complex dynamics of materials through statistical sampling. Here, by performing molecular dynamics with a fine-tuned MACE model, that are further combined with essential dynamics analysis, a tool that is commonly applied in (bio)molecular simulations, we examine the temperature-dependent ion dynamics in a prototypical inorganic solid superionic conductor, namely argyrodite Li₆PS₅Cl. Our analyses show clear localised phonon-like dynamics for Li⁺ ions below 500 K with trajectories lying in a low-dimensional manifold that is highly nonlinear, which is opposite to the case in the high-temperature (sim800 K) end. Between 500-700 K, the system exhibit strong competition in the dynamics between the Li⁺ and framework ions, that are reflected in both the eigenspectrum and the projected low-dimensional embeddings characterising these dynamics not showing a simple monotonic dependency upon rising temperatures, and is further supported by investigations employing Langevin dynamics that systematically examine how damping the framework motions affects the dynamics of the Li⁺ ions, thanks to the computational efficiency provided by MLIP. This work thus contributes towards the broader theoretical and data-driven framework for studying the lattice dynamics of solids.
articles.abstract_zh: 机器学习原子间势（MLIP）的快速发展，特别是材料化学的基础模型（例如 MACE），显着增强了我们通过统计采样研究材料复杂动力学的能力。在这里，通过使用微调的 MACE 模型执行分子动力学，并进一步与基本动力学分析（生物）分子模拟中常用的工具相结合，我们检查了原型无机固体超离子导体（即银汞矿 Li₆PS₅Cl）中温度依赖性离子动力学。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 机器学习原子间势（MLIP）的快速发展，特别是材料化学的基础模型（例如 MACE），显着增强了我们通过统计采样研究材料复杂动力学的能力。在这里，通过使用微调的 MACE 模型执行分子动力学，并进一步与基本动力学分析（生物）分子模拟中常用的工具相结合，我们检查了原型无机固体超离子导体（即银汞矿 Li₆PS₅Cl）中温度依赖性离子动力学。我们的分析表明，500 K 以下的 Li⁺ 离子具有清晰的局域声子动力学，其轨迹位于高度非线性的低维流形中，这与高温 (sim800 K) 端的情况相反。在 500-700 K 之间，该系统在 Li⁺ 和骨架离子之间的动力学方面表现出强烈的竞争，这反映在特征谱和表征这些动力学的投影低维嵌入中，没有表现出对温度升高的简单单调依赖性，并且由于 MLIP 提供的计算效率，采用朗之万动力学的研究进一步支持了该研究，系统地检查了骨架运动阻尼如何影响 Li⁺ 离子的动力学。因此，这项工作有助于建立更广泛的理论和数据驱动框架来研究固体晶格动力学。

articles.title: Variational Monte Carlo Study of Superconductivity in a Correlated System with Broken Inversion Symmetry
articles.title_zh: 破缺反演对称相关系统超导性的变分蒙特卡罗研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05964v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Unconventional superconductivity in systems with broken inversion symmetry has attracted considerable interest because antisymmetric spin-orbit coupling (ASOC) can strongly affect the spin structure and stability of superconducting states. In this study, we investigate superconductivity in a correlated system with the symmetry of a honeycomb network using the variational Monte Carlo method. We consider a single-band Hubbard model including an on-site Coulomb interaction U and ASOC with coupling strength λ, and compare several pairing states with different pairing symmetries. The trial wave functions are constructed from particle-number- and Gutzwiller-projected BCS states. To examine the energetic stability of each pairing state, we calculate the variational energy as a function of the gap amplitude, while optimizing the variational parameter μ and the Gutzwiller parameter g for each gap amplitude. At U/t = 10, the f-wave state has the lowest variational energy for λ/t = 0, whereas the chiral p-wave state becomes the most energetically favorable for λ/t = 0.1. These results indicate that ASOC strongly affects the competition among superconducting pairing states in the presence of strong electron correlations.
articles.abstract_zh: 反演对称性破缺系统中的非常规超导引起了人们极大的兴趣，因为反对称自旋轨道耦合（ASOC）可以强烈影响自旋结构和超导态的稳定性。在本研究中，我们使用变分蒙特卡罗方法研究具有蜂窝网络对称性的相关系统中的超导性。我们考虑单带哈伯德模型，包括现场库仑相互作用 U 和耦合强度为 λ 的 ASOC，并比较具有不同配对对称性的几种配对状态。试验波函数是根据粒子数和 Gutzwiller 投影的 BCS 状态构建的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 反演对称性破缺系统中的非常规超导引起了人们极大的兴趣，因为反对称自旋轨道耦合（ASOC）可以强烈影响自旋结构和超导态的稳定性。在本研究中，我们使用变分蒙特卡罗方法研究具有蜂窝网络对称性的相关系统中的超导性。我们考虑单带哈伯德模型，包括现场库仑相互作用 U 和耦合强度为 λ 的 ASOC，并比较具有不同配对对称性的几种配对状态。试验波函数是根据粒子数和 Gutzwiller 投影的 BCS 状态构建的。为了检查每个配对状态的能量稳定性，我们计算变分能量作为间隙幅度的函数，同时优化每个间隙幅度的变分参数 μ 和 Gutzwiller 参数 g。当 U/t = 10 时，f 波态在 λ/t = 0 时具有最低的变分能量，而手性 p 波态在 λ/t = 0.1 时变得最有利。这些结果表明，在存在强电子相关性的情况下，ASOC 强烈影响超导配对态之间的竞争。

articles.title: The quantized Hall effect knows which way the current flows: mirror covariance and rectification in a laterally asymmetric Hall bar
articles.title_zh: 量子化霍尔效应知道电流的流动方向：横向不对称霍尔条中的镜像协方差和整流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06004v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The quantized Hall effect is the textbook emblem of universality: a resistance fixed by h/e², apparently indifferent to the shape of the sample, to its edges and to the direction of the current. That indifference is only half true. The plateau value is universal; the plateau is not. In a gate-defined Hall bar with one hard and one soft edge, reversing the current moves the plateau edge, and exchanging the edges reverses the move. We identify the symmetry that forces this. Because a perpendicular field breaks time reversal, the relevant operation is the in-plane C₂ rotation; within the self-consistent screening model it gives the covariance relation R_α[B,Vcₒₙf(x),I]=R_α[B,Vcₒₙf(-x),-I], exact deep in the nonlinear regime and independent of linear response or microscopic reversibility. It predicts a rectification that is odd under exchange of the gate voltages and reverses with the magnetic field. The field-reversal test leaves the frozen lateral disorder untouched, so it holds for a single sample; it has not yet been performed. A further measurement, collapsing one incompressible strip, discriminates between co-directed and chiral pictures of the current. Self-consistent calculations show the soft-edge strip widening from 69 to 106,nm on current reversal, moving the Hall resistance from 0.940 to 0.999994,h/2e² within a bounded window in magnetic field. The effect is a gate-tunable vector-product nonreciprocity, not magnetochiral anisotropy.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子化霍尔效应是普遍性的教科书标志：由 h/e² 固定的电阻，显然与样品的形状、边缘和电流方向无关。这种冷漠只说对了一半。高原值具有普遍性；高原则不然。在具有一个硬边缘和一个软边缘的门定义霍尔条中，反转电流会移动平台边缘，而交换边缘会反转移动。我们确定了迫使这一点的对称性。由于垂直场破坏了时间反转，因此相关操作是面内 C2 旋转；
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子化霍尔效应是普遍性的教科书标志：由 h/e² 固定的电阻，显然与样品的形状、边缘和电流方向无关。这种冷漠只说对了一半。高原值具有普遍性；高原则不然。在具有一个硬边缘和一个软边缘的门定义霍尔条中，反转电流会移动平台边缘，而交换边缘会反转移动。我们确定了迫使这一点的对称性。由于垂直场破坏了时间反转，因此相关操作是面内 C2 旋转；在自洽筛选模型中，它给出了协方差关系 R_α[B,Vcₒₙf(x),I]=R_α[B,Vcₒₙf(-x),-I]，在非线性区域中精确且独立于线性响应或微观可逆性。它预测在栅极电压交换下会出现奇数整流，并随磁场反向。场反转测试未触及冻结的侧向紊乱，因此它适用于单个样本；它尚未执行。另一种测量是使一个不可压缩的条带塌陷，从而区分电流的同向图像和手性图像。自洽计算表明，在电流反转时，软边带从 69 nm 变宽至 106 nm，在磁场的有界窗口内将霍尔电阻从 0.940 移动到 0.999994 h/2e²。其效应是门可调矢量积非互易性，而不是磁手性各向异性。

articles.title: Thermodynamic signatures of the period-doubling route to chemical chaos
articles.title_zh: 化学混沌倍周期路径的热力学特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06037v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chemical reaction networks can evolve from stable oscillations to chaos through successive period doublings. We investigate general properties of entropy-production fluctuations near the onset of chaos and within the chaotic regime in reversible, well-mixed reaction networks. Near an isolated supercritical period-doubling bifurcation, we find a one-sided divergence of the diffusion constant with exponent one. For chaotic attractors satisfying the stated conditions, the entropy variance per unit volume grows exponentially when the macroscopic limit is taken first. Its exponential growth rate is 2λₘₐₓ, where λₘₐₓ is the largest Lyapunov exponent, implying a divergent diffusion constant. We also discuss the volume dependence of the fluctuations and the underlying physical mechanisms.
articles.abstract_zh: 化学反应网络可以通过连续的倍周期从稳定振荡演变成混沌。我们研究了可逆、混合良好的反应网络中混沌开始时和混沌状态内熵产生波动的一般特性。在孤立的超临界倍周期分岔附近，我们发现扩散常数与指数一的单向发散。对于满足规定条件的混沌吸引子，当首先取宏观极限时，单位体积的熵方差呈指数增长。其指数增长率为2λₘₐₓ，其中λₘₐₓ是最大的李亚普诺夫指数，意味着发散扩散常数。我们还讨论了波动的体积依赖性和潜在的物理机制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 化学反应网络可以通过连续的倍周期从稳定振荡演变成混沌。我们研究了可逆、混合良好的反应网络中混沌开始时和混沌状态内熵产生波动的一般特性。在孤立的超临界倍周期分岔附近，我们发现扩散常数与指数一的单向发散。对于满足规定条件的混沌吸引子，当首先取宏观极限时，单位体积的熵方差呈指数增长。其指数增长率为2λₘₐₓ，其中λₘₐₓ是最大的李亚普诺夫指数，意味着发散扩散常数。我们还讨论了波动的体积依赖性和潜在的物理机制。

articles.title: Spin Simulators based on Exciton-Polariton Waveguide Networks
articles.title_zh: 基于激子-极化子波导网络的自旋模拟器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06087v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Many NP-hard optimization problems can be mapped onto interacting spin systems, whose ground state encodes the optimal solution. Polaritonic implementations based on gain-dissipative dynamics have recently emerged as promising analog computing platforms owing to their intrinsic parallelism and ultrafast operation. However, existing approaches are hindered by two fundamental limitations: maintaining the homogeneous amplitudes required for faithful problem encoding remains challenging in realistic physical systems, and most architectures are restricted to nearest-neighbour interactions, severely limiting the variety of optimization problems that can be efficiently addressed. We introduce a feasible polaritonic XY simulator based on a reconfigurable waveguide platform that overcomes both limitations. Our approach guarantees amplitude homogeneity while enabling the implementa- tion of arbitrary symmetric coupling matrices, thereby allowing the direct encoding of a wide variety of XY Hamiltonians. These results establish a practical architecture for programmable polaritonic spin simulators and pave the way towards scalable optical hardware for analog optimisation.
articles.abstract_zh: 许多 NP 难优化问题可以映射到相互作用的自旋系统上，其基态编码最优解。基于增益耗散动力学的极化实现最近因其固有的并行性和超快操作而成为有前景的模拟计算平台。然而，现有的方法受到两个基本限制的阻碍：在现实的物理系统中保持忠实问题编码所需的均匀幅度仍然具有挑战性，并且大多数架构仅限于最近邻交互，严重限制了可以有效解决的优化问题的多样性。我们引入了一种基于可重构波导平台的可行极化子 XY 模拟器，克服了这两个限制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 许多 NP 难优化问题可以映射到相互作用的自旋系统上，其基态编码最优解。基于增益耗散动力学的极化实现最近因其固有的并行性和超快操作而成为有前景的模拟计算平台。然而，现有的方法受到两个基本限制的阻碍：在现实的物理系统中保持忠实问题编码所需的均匀幅度仍然具有挑战性，并且大多数架构仅限于最近邻交互，严重限制了可以有效解决的优化问题的多样性。我们引入了一种基于可重构波导平台的可行极化子 XY 模拟器，克服了这两个限制。我们的方法保证幅度均匀性，同时能够实现任意对称耦合矩阵，从而允许直接编码各种 XY 哈密顿量。这些结果为可编程极化自旋模拟器建立了实用的架构，并为用于模拟优化的可扩展光学硬件铺平了道路。

articles.title: Electrostatics of Chern junctions in a magnetic field
articles.title_zh: 磁场中陈结的静电
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06134v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electrostatic control is central to the operation of semiconductor junctions made from conventional materials. Here, we theoretically investigate the electrostatic properties of lateral junctions between two-dimensional (2D) Chern semiconductors in a perpendicular magnetic field. The spectral asymmetry of a Chern semiconductor acts as a magnetic-field-induced effective dopant density that is dependent on the Chern number. As a consequence, two regions with different Chern numbers acquire different chemical potentials at charge neutrality, leading to a built-in potential of topological origin across the junction. Using this built-in potential as a boundary condition, we solve the 2D Poisson equation to obtain the electric potential and charge density profiles, as well as the capacitance, of Chern semiconductor junctions. Our results inform the interplay between electronic topology and electrostatics in devices made from 2D materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 静电控制对于传统材料制成的半导体结的运行至关重要。在这里，我们从理论上研究了垂直磁场中二维（2D）陈半导体之间横向结的静电特性。陈半导体的光谱不对称性充当磁场感应的有效掺杂剂密度，其取决于陈数。因此，具有不同陈数的两个区域在电荷中性时获得不同的化学势，从而导致结点上产生拓扑起源的内置势。使用这个内置电势作为边界条件，我们求解二维泊松方程以获得陈半导体结的电势和电荷密度分布以及电容。我们的结果揭示了二维材料制成的设备中电子拓扑和静电之间的相互作用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 静电控制对于传统材料制成的半导体结的运行至关重要。在这里，我们从理论上研究了垂直磁场中二维（2D）陈半导体之间横向结的静电特性。陈半导体的光谱不对称性充当磁场感应的有效掺杂剂密度，其取决于陈数。因此，具有不同陈数的两个区域在电荷中性时获得不同的化学势，从而导致结点上产生拓扑起源的内置势。使用这个内置电势作为边界条件，我们求解二维泊松方程以获得陈半导体结的电势和电荷密度分布以及电容。我们的结果揭示了二维材料制成的设备中电子拓扑和静电之间的相互作用。

articles.title: Statistical mechanics and hierarchy of learnability in quantum codes: From generalized symmetries to non-Abelian topological orders
articles.title_zh: 量子代码中的统计力学和可学习性层次：从广义对称性到非阿贝尔拓扑序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06154v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Local weak measurements provide noisy information about observables encoded in a quantum code. We formulate the corresponding Bayesian inference problem for a broad class of topological stabilizer codes by mapping it to classical spin models with generalized symmetries. When the wavefunction deformation and Gaussian measurement strengths coincide, the replicated model acquires an enlarged symmetry. We use this symmetry to derive exact identities among correlators averaged over measurement records that quantify the learnability of nonlocal observables associated with fractionalized excitations. Together with correlation inequalities in the associated clean ferromagnetic models, these identities establish hierarchies of learnability: if two observables remain learnable at long distances, their product must also remain learnable. We demonstrate these relations in the rank-2 toric code and the X-cube model, whose classical descriptions exhibit modulated and subsystem symmetries, respectively. We further extend the analysis to finite group quantum double models, including non-Abelian ones. We derive exact relations between learnability and correlations in the corresponding classical models, and show that the representation structure and fusion rules of anyons impose further constraints under suitable positivity conditions. These results constrain which types of nonlocal information can be learned simultaneously, providing a guide to learning phase diagrams in quantum codes under local weak measurements.
articles.abstract_zh: 局部弱测量提供了有关量子代码中编码的可观测值的噪声信息。我们通过将其映射到具有广义对称性的经典自旋模型，为一大类拓扑稳定器代码制定了相应的贝叶斯推理问题。当波函数变形和高斯测量强度一致时，复制模型获得扩大的对称性。我们利用这种对称性来推导出测量记录上平均的相关器之间的精确恒等式，从而量化与分段激励相关的非局部可观测量的可学习性。与相关的干净铁磁模型中的相关不等式一起，这些恒等式建立了可学习性的层次结构：如果两个可观察量在长距离上保持可学习性，那么它们的乘积也必须保持可学习性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 局部弱测量提供了有关量子代码中编码的可观测值的噪声信息。我们通过将其映射到具有广义对称性的经典自旋模型，为一大类拓扑稳定器代码制定了相应的贝叶斯推理问题。当波函数变形和高斯测量强度一致时，复制模型获得扩大的对称性。我们利用这种对称性来推导出测量记录上平均的相关器之间的精确恒等式，从而量化与分段激励相关的非局部可观测量的可学习性。与相关的干净铁磁模型中的相关不等式一起，这些恒等式建立了可学习性的层次结构：如果两个可观察量在长距离上保持可学习性，那么它们的乘积也必须保持可学习性。我们在 2 阶环面码和 X 立方模型中证明了这些关系，它们的经典描述分别表现出调制对称性和子系统对称性。我们进一步将分析扩展到有限群量子双模型，包括非阿贝尔模型。我们在相应的经典模型中推导了可学习性和相关性之间的精确关系，并表明任意子的表示结构和融合规则在适当的正向条件下施加了进一步的约束。这些结果限制了可以同时学习哪些类型的非局部信息，为学习局部弱测量下量子代码中的相图提供了指导。

articles.title: Spin swapping mediated by spin-orbital textures in centrosymmetric multiorbital materials
articles.title_zh: 中心对称多轨道材料中自旋轨道纹理介导的自旋交换
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06163v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin swapping converts a primary spin current into a secondary one by interchanging its flow and spin-polarization directions, attributed to spin-orbit scattering or spin-band splitting. Here we uncover a fundamentally distinct route to spin swapping arising from the orbital degree of freedom in the spin pumping to centrosymmetric multiorbital materials without spin-band splitting. When the dynamical proximity ferromagnet injects a longitudinal spin current flowing normal to the interface, spin-orbit-entangled orbital textures redirect the injected spins into longitudinal and transverse orbital currents. Their subsequent conversion back to the spin sector generates transverse spin currents with propagation and polarization directions swapped relative to the primary spin current. The swapping efficiency achieves 50% for Ge and Si. Governed by a fourth-rank tensor constrained by crystalline symmetry and without requiring spin-orbit scattering or inversion symmetry breaking, our finding reveals spin-orbital textures as hidden intermediate channels of spin swapping with unexplored material choices and functionalities.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋交换通过交换其流动方向和自旋极化方向，将初级自旋电流转换为次级自旋电流，这归因于自旋轨道散射或自旋带分裂。在这里，我们发现了一条从根本上不同的自旋交换路径，该路径是由自旋泵浦到中心对称多轨道材料的轨道自由度引起的，而没有自旋带分裂。当动态邻近铁磁体注入垂直于界面流动的纵向自旋电流时，自旋轨道纠缠轨道纹理将注入的自旋重定向为纵向和横向轨道电流。它们随后转换回自旋扇区，产生横向自旋电流，其传播和偏振方向相对于主自旋电流交换。 Ge和Si的交换效率达到50%。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋交换通过交换其流动方向和自旋极化方向，将初级自旋电流转换为次级自旋电流，这归因于自旋轨道散射或自旋带分裂。在这里，我们发现了一条从根本上不同的自旋交换路径，该路径是由自旋泵浦到中心对称多轨道材料的轨道自由度引起的，而没有自旋带分裂。当动态邻近铁磁体注入垂直于界面流动的纵向自旋电流时，自旋轨道纠缠轨道纹理将注入的自旋重定向为纵向和横向轨道电流。它们随后转换回自旋扇区，产生横向自旋电流，其传播和偏振方向相对于主自旋电流交换。 Ge和Si的交换效率达到50%。由晶体对称性约束的四阶张量控制，并且不需要自旋轨道散射或反演对称性破缺，我们的发现揭示了自旋轨道纹理作为自旋交换的隐藏中间通道，具有未经探索的材料选择和功能。

articles.title: Quantitatively Probing the Tilt Angle Failures in 4D-STEM Polarisation Analysis
articles.title_zh: 定量探测 4D-STEM 偏振分析中的倾斜角故障
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06274v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Four-dimensional scanning transmission electron microscopy (4D-STEM) is increasingly used to map polarisation in ferroic textures such as domain walls, vortices, merons and skyrmions. These textures are accompanied by local strain, lattice rotation and misorientation, which also modulate the diffraction features used to infer polar order. Even small deviations from the zone axis can therefore produce contrast that is indistinguishable from a polarisation signal. Here we quantify the tilt sensitivity of two polarisation-sensitive signals, diffraction disc intensity and Kikuchi band intensity, in three ferroelectrics with distinct polar distortions: PbTiO3, BaTiO3 and Cu3B7O13Cl boracite. We find that tilts of only 0.01-0.05 degrees reverse most Friedel-pair disc asymmetries, and even the most robust disc pairs reverse by 0.04 degrees in BaTiO3, 0.14 degrees in PbTiO3 and 0.18 degrees in boracite, producing contrast equal and opposite to that of the polarisation. Kikuchi band contrast is the only signal that reports absolute polarity without knowledge of the specimen thickness, but it does so only up to 0.09 degrees in PbTiO3, 0.015 degrees in BaTiO3 and 0.02 degrees in boracite. From these results we define tilt tolerances for each signal and material, and propose practical criteria for distinguishing polarisation contrast from misorientation. The analysis also applies to scanning electron microscopy-based diffraction, including electron backscatter diffraction.
articles.abstract_zh: 四维扫描透射电子显微镜 (4D-STEM) 越来越多地用于绘制磁畴壁、涡旋、半子和斯格明子等铁质纹理中的偏振图。这些纹理伴随着局部应变、晶格旋转和取向错误，它们也会调制用于推断极序的衍射特征。因此，即使与区域轴的微小偏差也会产生与偏振信号无法区分的对比度。在这里，我们量化了三种具有明显极性畸变的铁电体：PbTiO3、BaTiO3 和 Cu3B7O13Cl 方硼石中两种偏振敏感信号、衍射盘强度和菊池带强度的倾斜灵敏度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 四维扫描透射电子显微镜 (4D-STEM) 越来越多地用于绘制磁畴壁、涡旋、半子和斯格明子等铁质纹理中的偏振图。这些纹理伴随着局部应变、晶格旋转和取向错误，它们也会调制用于推断极序的衍射特征。因此，即使与区域轴的微小偏差也会产生与偏振信号无法区分的对比度。在这里，我们量化了三种具有明显极性畸变的铁电体：PbTiO3、BaTiO3 和 Cu3B7O13Cl 方硼石中两种偏振敏感信号、衍射盘强度和菊池带强度的倾斜灵敏度。我们发现，仅 0.01-0.05 度的倾斜就可以逆转大多数弗里德尔对圆盘不对称性，即使是最坚固的圆盘对，BaTiO3 中也可逆转 0.04 度，PbTiO3 中逆转 0.14 度，方硼石中逆转 0.18 度，产生与偏振相同或相反的对比度。菊池带对比度是在不知道样品厚度的情况下报告绝对极性的唯一信号，但在 PbTiO3 中只能达到 0.09 度，在 BaTiO3 中只能达到 0.015 度，在方硼石中只能达到 0.02 度。根据这些结果，我们定义了每种信号和材料的倾斜容差，并提出了区分偏振对比度和定向错误的实用标准。该分析还适用于基于扫描电子显微镜的衍射，包括电子背散射衍射。

articles.title: A Construction Framework for Three-Dimensional Topological Magnetic Textures
articles.title_zh: 三维拓扑磁纹理的构建框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06293v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Three-dimensional magnetic systems offer diverse possibilities for constructing complex topological textures from simpler magnetic configurations. Here, we present different routes for constructing complex three-dimensional magnetic textures from simpler parent configurations and discuss their impact on the topology of the resulting structures. We identify four construction principles: (i) adding transverse modulations, (ii) adding structures, (iii) entangling textures (e.g. braiding, or twisting), and (iv) introducing singularities. Using the skyrmion tube as an explicit parent configuration, we show how these principles give rise to several known three-dimensional magnetic textures. We then apply the same principles to predict novel textures derived from a meron tube, which are confirmed by micromagnetic simulations to be metastable in chiral magnets. Our results establish general principles for the systematic construction and discovery of complex three-dimensional magnetic textures.
articles.abstract_zh: 三维磁系统为从更简单的磁配置构造复杂的拓扑纹理提供了多种可能性。在这里，我们提出了从更简单的父配置构造复杂的三维磁性纹理的不同路线，并讨论了它们对所得结构的拓扑的影响。我们确定了四个构造原则：（i）添加横向调制，（ii）添加结构，（iii）纠缠纹理（例如编织或扭曲），以及（iv）引入奇点。使用斯格明子管作为明确的父配置，我们展示了这些原理如何产生几种已知的三维磁性纹理。然后，我们应用相同的原理来预测源自梅隆管的新颖纹理，微磁模拟证实这些纹理在手性磁体中是亚稳态的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 三维磁系统为从更简单的磁配置构造复杂的拓扑纹理提供了多种可能性。在这里，我们提出了从更简单的父配置构造复杂的三维磁性纹理的不同路线，并讨论了它们对所得结构的拓扑的影响。我们确定了四个构造原则：（i）添加横向调制，（ii）添加结构，（iii）纠缠纹理（例如编织或扭曲），以及（iv）引入奇点。使用斯格明子管作为明确的父配置，我们展示了这些原理如何产生几种已知的三维磁性纹理。然后，我们应用相同的原理来预测源自梅隆管的新颖纹理，微磁模拟证实这些纹理在手性磁体中是亚稳态的。我们的结果为复杂三维磁性纹理的系统构建和发现建立了一般原则。

articles.title: Strain control of magneto-optical properties of ultra-thin Ni-Mn-Ga films grown by magnetron sputtering
articles.title_zh: 磁控溅射超薄 Ni-Mn-Ga 薄膜磁光特性的应变控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06326v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ultra-thin epitaxial Ni-Mn-Ga films, 10-15 nm thick, were grown by magnetron sputtering on MgO(001), either directly on the substrate or on a Cr buffer, and studied by X-ray diffraction, magnetometry, and magneto-optical Kerr effect (MOKE) spectroscopy. The films were austenitic, with the cubic cell tetragonally distorted in opposite directions. The film on bare MgO was stretched in-plane (c/a=0.989) and the film on Cr was compressed in-plane (c/a=1.021), while their unit-cell volumes differed by less than 0.3%. As the thermal expansion mismatch was expected to stretch the films in-plane in both cases, the opposite distortions were attributed to the lattice misfit. The room-temperature magnetization loops of the two films did not show significant differences, but their polar and longitudinal MOKE spectra differed in the amplitude, sign, and energy of the spectral structures over the whole 0.76-5 eV range. Magneto-optical simulations showed that the absence of the Cr buffer accounted only for the stronger low-energy polar MOKE rotation extremum of the film on MgO. We attributed the other changes to the strain-induced change of the electronic structure, consistent with theoretical predictions in which the dₓ^₂₋y^₂ and d₃z^₂₋ᵣ^₂ sub-bands of the minority-spin Ni e_g states exchange their order when the distortion changes sign. In parts of the spectrum, the two films showed Kerr rotation or ellipticity of opposite sign, so the choice of the growth template or a dynamically induced distortion can switch the sign of the magneto-optical response at a given photon energy.
articles.abstract_zh: 通过磁控溅射在 MgO(001) 上生长 10-15 nm 厚的超薄外延 Ni-Mn-Ga 薄膜（直接在衬底上或在 Cr 缓冲液上），并通过 X 射线衍射、磁力测量和磁光克尔效应 (MOKE) 光谱进行研究。这些薄膜是奥氏体的，立方晶胞在相反方向上四方扭曲。裸露 MgO 上的薄膜在面内拉伸 (c/a=0.989)，Cr 上的薄膜在面内压缩 (c/a=1.021)，而它们的晶胞体积相差不到 0.3%。
