articles.abstract_zh_full: 通过磁控溅射在 MgO(001) 上生长 10-15 nm 厚的超薄外延 Ni-Mn-Ga 薄膜（直接在衬底上或在 Cr 缓冲液上），并通过 X 射线衍射、磁力测量和磁光克尔效应 (MOKE) 光谱进行研究。这些薄膜是奥氏体的，立方晶胞在相反方向上四方扭曲。裸露 MgO 上的薄膜在面内拉伸 (c/a=0.989)，Cr 上的薄膜在面内压缩 (c/a=1.021)，而它们的晶胞体积相差不到 0.3%。由于在两种情况下热膨胀失配预计都会在平面内拉伸薄膜，因此相反的变形归因于晶格失配。两种薄膜的室温磁化环没有表现出显着差异，但它们的极向和纵向MOKE谱在整个0.76-5 eV范围内的谱结构的振幅、符号和能量方面存在差异。磁光模拟表明，缺少 Cr 缓冲剂仅导致 MgO 上的薄膜具有更强的低能极性 MOKE 旋转极值。我们将其他变化归因于应变引起的电子结构变化，这与理论预测一致，即当畸变符号改变时，少数自旋 Ni e_g 态的 dₓ²₋y² 和 d₃z²₋ᵣ² 子带会交换其顺序。在光谱的某些部分，两片薄膜显示出相反符号的克尔旋转或椭圆率，因此生长模板的选择或动态引起的畸变可以在给定的光子能量下切换磁光响应的符号。

articles.title: Hydrogen sublattice in LaH₁₂: structural stability and possible ordering motifs
articles.title_zh: LaH₁₂ 中的氢亚晶格：结构稳定性和可能的有序基序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06424v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Lanthanum polyhydrides, synthesized under extreme pressure, exhibit near-room-temperature superconductivity. Finding a precise arrangement of the hydrogen sublattice that is critical for understanding the strong electron-phonon coupling remains experimentally unresolved due to the small X-ray scattering form factor of hydrogen atoms. In this work, we attempt to computationally reconstruct hydrogen sublattices of the LaH₁₂ at 100-200 GPa combining unconstrained evolutionary searches and structure generation with fixed lanthanum sublattice. By implementing a similarity metric, we screen the computationally generated configurations against experimental powder X-ray diffraction data. We specifically identify the trigonal Rbar3-LaH₁₂ and pseudo-hexagonal C222₁-La₂H₂₄ phases, which demonstrate close agreement with the experimental X-ray diffraction data. First-principles calculations confirm the metallic and superconducting nature of these hydrides. Crucially, our lattice dynamics analysis using the stochastic self-consistent harmonic approximation (SSCHA) indicates that these structures are dynamically stable. We reveal the presence of molecular H₂ units and soft phonon modes in the trigonal LaH₁₂ that suppresses superconductivity (T_c ge 30 K), while the hydrogen clathrate network in the C222₁ phase drives strong electron-phonon interactions, yielding the coupling parameters of λapprox 1.83, ωₗₒg approx 87.5 meV and transition temperature of T_capprox 150 K at 150 GPa.
articles.abstract_zh: 在极压下合成的多氢化镧表现出接近室温的超导性。由于氢原子的 X 射线散射形状因子较小，寻找氢亚晶格的精确排列对于理解强电子声子耦合至关重要，这一问题在实验上仍未得到解决。在这项工作中，我们尝试结合无约束演化搜索和固定镧亚晶格的结构生成，在 100-200 GPa 下计算重建 LaH₁ 的氢亚晶格。通过实施相似性度量，我们根据实验粉末 X 射线衍射数据筛选计算生成的配置。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在极压下合成的多氢化镧表现出接近室温的超导性。由于氢原子的 X 射线散射形状因子较小，寻找氢亚晶格的精确排列对于理解强电子声子耦合至关重要，这一问题在实验上仍未得到解决。在这项工作中，我们尝试结合无约束演化搜索和固定镧亚晶格的结构生成，在 100-200 GPa 下计算重建 LaH₁ 的氢亚晶格。通过实施相似性度量，我们根据实验粉末 X 射线衍射数据筛选计算生成的配置。我们特别鉴定了三角 Rbar3-LaH₁ 和伪六方 C222₁-La 2H 24 相，这与实验 X 射线衍射数据非常吻合。第一性原理计算证实了这些氢化物的金属和超导性质。至关重要的是，我们使用随机自洽谐波近似（SSHA）进行的晶格动力学分析表明这些结构是动态稳定的。我们揭示了三角LaH₁₂中分子H2单元和软声子模式的存在，抑制了超导性（T_c ge 30 K），而C222₁相中的氢笼形网络驱动了强电子-声子相互作用，产生了耦合参数λapprox 1.83，ωₗₒg约87.5 meV和T_capprox 150的转变温度K 在 150 GPa 下。

articles.title: Field evolution of the multi-k magnetic states in NdB₄ revealed by neutron diffraction
articles.title_zh: 中子衍射揭示 NdB₄ 多 k 磁态的场演化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06526v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the magnetic states of the Shastry-Sutherland-lattice magnet NdB₄ using single-crystal neutron diffraction. We focus on magnetic fields applied along the tetragonal c axis, which stabilise the fractional 1/5~magnetisation plateau. In the low-temperature phase below 4.9 K, the transition into the plateau state at approximately 12 kOe is marked by a change in the propagation vectors from (1/5,0,-2/5) and its double (2/5,0,1/5) to (0,0,1/5) and (0,0,2/5). At the transition from the plateau to a nominally `field-polarised' state near 33 kOe, all magnetic reflections associated with non-integer propagation vectors disappear, whereas reflections corresponding to the k=0 component persist throughout the entire field range. We conclude that that the in-plane components survive even in the high-field phase and that the polarisation is, in fact, incomplete. The observed field dependence provides direct support for a description of NdB₄ in terms of two coupled magnetic instabilities: all-in-all-out order of the in-plane moments and a spin-density wave of the out-of-plane components.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们使用单晶中子衍射研究了 Shastry-Sutherland 晶格磁体 NdB₄ 的磁态。我们关注沿四方 c 轴施加的磁场，它稳定了分数 1/5~磁化平台。在低于 4.9 K 的低温相中，在大约 12 kOe 处向平台状态的转变以传播矢量从 (1/5,0,-2/5) 及其双倍 (2/5,0,1/5) 到 (0,0,1/5) 和 (0,0,2/5) 的变化为标志。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用单晶中子衍射研究了 Shastry-Sutherland 晶格磁体 NdB₄ 的磁态。我们关注沿四方 c 轴施加的磁场，它稳定了分数 1/5~磁化平台。在低于 4.9 K 的低温相中，在大约 12 kOe 处向平台状态的转变以传播矢量从 (1/5,0,-2/5) 及其双倍 (2/5,0,1/5) 到 (0,0,1/5) 和 (0,0,2/5) 的变化为标志。在从稳定状态过渡到 33 kOe 附近名义上的“场极化”状态时，与非整数传播矢量相关的所有磁反射都会消失，而与 k=0 分量相对应的反射在整个场范围内持续存在。我们得出的结论是，即使在高场阶段，面内分量仍然存在，并且极化实际上是不完整的。观察到的场依赖性为 NdB₄ 的两个耦合磁不稳定性的描述提供了直接支持：面内力矩的全进全出顺序和面外分量的自旋密度波。

articles.title: Stability of energy gap of macroscopic quantum matter
articles.title_zh: 宏观量子物质能隙的稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06528v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In quantum many-body physics and quantum field theory, it is often assumed that gapped systems remain gapped under sufficiently weak local perturbations. However, to what extent this assumption holds is elusive, except for some special systems. In this work, we examine the stability of energy gap of macroscopic quantum matter that is only subject to two physically natural conditions, locality and translation invariance. We first show that in any spatial dimension, there are gapped local Hamiltonians with a unique ground state and an unstable gap, i.e., they become gapless under certain arbitrarily weak local perturbation in the thermodynamic limit. We then prove that for both spin and fermionic systems in one dimension, such Hamiltonians with an unstable gap must not only break translation invariance but also be fine-tuned. We further show that in any dimension greater than one, there are fine-tuned local translation invariant Hamiltonians with a unique ground state and an unstable gap. These results greatly sharpen our understanding of the fundamental problem of the stability of quantum phases of matter. We also discuss implications of our results on, for example, anyon superconductivity and higher-form symmetries.
articles.abstract_zh: 在量子多体物理和量子场论中，通常假设有隙系统在足够弱的局部扰动下仍然保持有隙。然而，除了一些特殊的系统外，这个假设在多大程度上成立是难以捉摸的。在这项工作中，我们研究了宏观量子物质能隙的稳定性，该稳定性仅受两个物理自然条件的影响：局域性和平移不变性。我们首先证明，在任何空间维度上，都存在具有独特基态和不稳定能隙的带隙局部哈密顿量，即，它们在热力学极限内的某些任意弱局部扰动下变得无带隙。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在量子多体物理和量子场论中，通常假设有隙系统在足够弱的局部扰动下仍然保持有隙。然而，除了一些特殊的系统外，这个假设在多大程度上成立是难以捉摸的。在这项工作中，我们研究了宏观量子物质能隙的稳定性，该稳定性仅受两个物理自然条件的影响：局域性和平移不变性。我们首先证明，在任何空间维度上，都存在具有独特基态和不稳定能隙的带隙局部哈密顿量，即，它们在热力学极限内的某些任意弱局部扰动下变得无带隙。然后我们证明，对于一维的自旋和费米子系统，这种具有不稳定间隙的哈密顿量不仅必须打破平移不变性，而且还必须进行微调。我们进一步证明，在任何大于一的维度上，都存在具有独特基态和不稳定能隙的微调局部平移不变哈密顿量。这些结果极大地加深了我们对物质量子相稳定性这一基本问题的理解。我们还讨论了我们的结果对任意子超导性和更高形式对称性等的影响。

articles.title: Dynamically Reentrant Skyrmion Phase in Oscillating Magnetic Fields
articles.title_zh: 振荡磁场中的动态重入斯格明子相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06541v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We address a central open question in driven topological matter by investigating the nonequilibrium response of a two-dimensional magnet with Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions subjected to a periodically oscillating magnetic field. Using extensive Monte Carlo simulations, we uncover a dynamically reentrant skyrmion phase that emerges within a finite window of field amplitudes and bias fields, sandwiched between the conventional skyrmion and polarized ferromagnetic phases. This phase has no equilibrium counterpart and originates from an imbalance between skyrmion creation and annihilation over a single field cycle, leading to a reversal of the period-averaged topological charge. We show that the re-entrant phase exists only in the dynamic response regime where the system can follow the drive, and is suppressed at higher driving frequencies. Our results establish periodic driving as a nonequilibrium control parameter for stabilizing and reversing skyrmion topology.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们通过研究具有 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用的二维磁体在周期性振荡磁场下的非平衡响应，解决了驱动拓扑物质中的一个核心开放问题。通过广泛的蒙特卡罗模拟，我们发现了一种动态重入斯格明子相，它出现在场振幅和偏置场的有限窗口内，夹在传统斯格明子相和极化铁磁相之间。该相没有平衡对应物，源于单个场周期内斯格明子产生和湮灭之间的不平衡，导致周期平均拓扑电荷的逆转。我们表明，重入阶段仅存在于系统可以跟随驱动的动态响应区域中，并且在较高的驱动频率下被抑制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过研究具有 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用的二维磁体在周期性振荡磁场下的非平衡响应，解决了驱动拓扑物质中的一个核心开放问题。通过广泛的蒙特卡罗模拟，我们发现了一种动态重入斯格明子相，它出现在场振幅和偏置场的有限窗口内，夹在传统斯格明子相和极化铁磁相之间。该相没有平衡对应物，源于单个场周期内斯格明子产生和湮灭之间的不平衡，导致周期平均拓扑电荷的逆转。我们表明，重入阶段仅存在于系统可以跟随驱动的动态响应区域中，并且在较高的驱动频率下被抑制。我们的结果将周期性驱动确立为稳定和反转斯格明子拓扑的非平衡控制参数。

articles.title: Explicit pore pre-conditioning and inverse design of amorphous nanoporous carbon
articles.title_zh: 非晶纳米多孔碳的显式孔隙预处理与反设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06614v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Porous carbons store energy, capture gases and purify water, and their performance depends strongly on the geometry of their pores. Atomistic models mostly simulate their synthesis by molecular dynamics, with results that depend on the interatomic potential, and return the pore network as an output rather than as a specification. Here we show that the pore network can be an input: pores drawn from a target size distribution fill a prescribed volume fraction, carbon is grown around them by stochastic ring placement, and a particle swarm recovers the construction parameters from a structural fingerprint. The search reproduces the density, surface area and pore volume of a carbon produced by quenched molecular dynamics within about 5 %, together with its pore size distribution. As a stress test, it also recovers a bimodal distribution, and the search history reveals which parameters the targets constrain and flags a failed search. A short anneal completes the network, recovering the coordination of the reference while the pore size distribution keeps its shape. Molecular dynamics still supplies the local chemistry, but the pore geometry becomes a design variable for a given application.
articles.abstract_zh: 多孔碳可以储存能量、捕获气体和净化水，其性能在很大程度上取决于其孔隙的几何形状。原子模型主要通过分子动力学模拟它们的合成，其结果取决于原子间势，并将孔隙网络作为输出而不是作为规范返回。在这里，我们表明孔隙网络可以作为输入：从目标尺寸分布中提取的孔隙填充规定的体积分数，通过随机环放置在它们周围生长碳，并且粒子群从结构指纹中恢复构造参数。该搜索重现了由淬火分子动力学产生的碳的密度、表面积和孔体积（误差在 5% 左右）及其孔径分布。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多孔碳可以储存能量、捕获气体和净化水，其性能在很大程度上取决于其孔隙的几何形状。原子模型主要通过分子动力学模拟它们的合成，其结果取决于原子间势，并将孔隙网络作为输出而不是作为规范返回。在这里，我们表明孔隙网络可以作为输入：从目标尺寸分布中提取的孔隙填充规定的体积分数，通过随机环放置在它们周围生长碳，并且粒子群从结构指纹中恢复构造参数。该搜索重现了由淬火分子动力学产生的碳的密度、表面积和孔体积（误差在 5% 左右）及其孔径分布。作为压力测试，它还恢复双峰分布，搜索历史记录显示目标限制哪些参数并标记失败的搜索。短暂的退火完成了网络，恢复了参考的配位，同时孔径分布保持其形状。分子动力学仍然提供局部化学，但孔隙几何形状成为给定应用的设计变量。

articles.title: Anomalous thermal transport in isotope-enriched germanium carbide
articles.title_zh: 富同位素碳化锗中的反常热传输
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06663v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Advances in modern electronics demand the dissipation of heat fluxes approaching 1000 W cm⁻², which drives an urgent need for materials with thermal conductivity (κ) exceeding 1000 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹. Here, by solving the Boltzmann transport equation considering both three- and four-phonon interactions, we observe that isotopically pure cubic germanium carbide (GeC) exhibits a remarkable κ of 1018 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹ at room temperature, which is further corroborated by state-of-the-art machine-learning molecular dynamics simulations. Two unique mechanisms underlie this anomalously high κ: a remarkably strong isotopic enhancement effect (289%) and a surprisingly modest suppression due to four-phonon scattering (22%)-despite the presence of a wide acoustic-optical phonon gap. Moreover, we find that GeC defies the conventional Leibfried-Schlomann formula and exhibits a non-monotonic variation of κ with external hydrostatic pressure at elevated temperatures. Our findings establish isotope-enriched GeC as a material of ultrahigh κ and an ideal platform for exploring exotic phonon physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 现代电子学的进步要求热通量接近 1000 W cm⁻²，这就迫切需要导热系数 (κ) 超过 1000 W m⁻1 K⁻1 的材料。在这里，通过求解考虑三声子和四声子相互作用的玻尔兹曼输运方程，我们观察到同位素纯立方碳化锗 (GeC) 在室温下表现出 1018 W m⁻1 K⁻1 的显着 κ，这一点得到了最先进的机器学习分子动力学模拟的进一步证实。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 现代电子学的进步要求热通量接近 1000 W cm⁻²，这就迫切需要导热系数 (κ) 超过 1000 W m⁻1 K⁻1 的材料。在这里，通过求解考虑三声子和四声子相互作用的玻尔兹曼输运方程，我们观察到同位素纯立方碳化锗 (GeC) 在室温下表现出 1018 W m⁻1 K⁻1 的显着 κ，这一点得到了最先进的机器学习分子动力学模拟的进一步证实。这种异常高的 κ 背后有两种独特的机制：非常强的同位素增强效应 (289%) 和由于四声子散射而产生的令人惊讶的适度抑制 (22%)——尽管存在宽的声光声子间隙。此外，我们发现 GeC 违反了传统的 Leibfried-Schlomann 公式，并且在高温下表现出 κ 随外部静水压力的非单调变化。我们的研究结果表明，富含同位素的 GeC 是一种超高 κ 材料，也是探索奇异声子物理的理想平台。

articles.title: Millikelvin magnetometry up to 30~T using a multi-cross micro-Hall sensor
articles.title_zh: 使用多交叉微霍尔传感器进行高达 30~T 的毫开尔文磁力测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06676v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report a multi-cross micro-Hall sensor fabricated from an MBE-grown GaAs/AlGaAs heterostructure for high-sensitivity magnetometry. The device enables dc magnetization measurements at temperatures down to sim15~mK and in dc magnetic fields up to 30 T. Bulk samples with dimensions ranging from 100~μm to 1~mm can be measured with a resolution better than 1~μT with a 1~μA excitation at 13.77 Hz. Test-of-performance measurements were carried out by probing the field-dependent magnetization plateaus of the triangular-lattice quantum magnet K₂Co₂(SeO₃)₃ at 20~mK, the antiferromagnetic transition of K₃GdTe₂O₉ near 220 mK via temperature-dependent magnetization, and the quantum oscillations in a ruthenium single crystal. A simple and reliable sample-mounting setup that ensures reproducible magnetic measurements is provided.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们报告了一种由 MBE 生长的 GaAs/AlGaAs 异质结构制成的多交叉微霍尔传感器，用于高灵敏度磁力测量。该器件能够在低至 sim15~mK 的温度和高达 30 T 的直流磁场中进行直流磁化强度测量。尺寸范围从 100~μm 到 1~mm 的大块样品可以在 13.77 Hz 下以 1~μA 激励，以优于 1~μT 的分辨率进行测量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了一种由 MBE 生长的 GaAs/AlGaAs 异质结构制成的多交叉微霍尔传感器，用于高灵敏度磁力测量。该器件能够在低至 sim15~mK 的温度和高达 30 T 的直流磁场中进行直流磁化强度测量。尺寸范围从 100~μm 到 1~mm 的大块样品可以在 13.77 Hz 下以 1~μA 激励，以优于 1~μT 的分辨率进行测量。通过探测三角晶格量子磁体 K2Co2(SeO3)3 在 20~mK 下的场相关磁化平台、K3GdTe2O9 在 220 mK 附近通过温度相关磁化的反铁磁转变以及钌单晶中的量子振荡，进行了性能测试测量。提供了一种简单可靠的样品安装装置，可确保可重复的磁性测量。

articles.title: Hidden entropic order of emergent charges in a classical Ampère spin liquid
articles.title_zh: 经典安培自旋液体中涌现电荷的隐藏熵序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06795v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Classical spin liquids are characterized by an extensive number of ground-state configurations. Coulomb spin liquids have, in this ground-state manifold, a divergence-free local constraint, which gives dipolar correlations and pinch points in the structure factor. Recently, models with a complementary ground-state constraint, defined by a zero-circulation constraint (Ampère's law), have been proposed. While classical Coulomb spin liquids forbid emergent charges, their Ampère counterparts leave the charges unconstrained. Here we study an Ising Ampère model on the octochlore lattice. The ground states obey a Gauss law for an antisymmetric rank-two field, i.e., three coupled two-dimensional Gauss laws, which are expected to produce pinch points in the structure factor. Nevertheless, maximal charges, vertices with all six arrows in or out, spontaneously accumulate on one of the two sublattices of the cubic lattice, with disordered signs. This order has a purely entropic origin; it washes out the pinch-point singularities at large scales, produces no magnetic Bragg peaks, and coexists with an extensive entropy. The system enters into this sublattice long-range ordered state through a continuous transition in what seems to be the three-dimensional Ising universality class. Moreover, the state has no magnetic order; it is even under time reversal: it is a hidden, entropic order within the Ampère manifold. Thus, a system whose Gauss law would predict an algebraic spin liquid becomes, through a non-magnetic ordering transition, a partially ordered short-range spin liquid. Our study is based on a combination of the constraint-vector theory, exact bounds and enumeration, and Monte Carlo, Wang-Landau, and parallel-tempering simulations.
articles.abstract_zh: 经典自旋液体的特点是具有大量的基态构型。在这个基态流形中，库仑自旋液体具有无散度局部约束，它给出了结构因子中的偶极相关性和夹点。最近，提出了具有由零循环约束（安培定律）定义的互补基态约束的模型。虽然经典的库仑自旋液体禁止紧急电荷，但它们的安培对应物却使电荷不受限制。在这里，我们研究八氯石晶格上的伊辛安培模型。基态服从反对称二阶场的高斯定律，即三个耦合的二维高斯定律，预计它们会在结构因子中产生夹点。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 经典自旋液体的特点是具有大量的基态构型。在这个基态流形中，库仑自旋液体具有无散度局部约束，它给出了结构因子中的偶极相关性和夹点。最近，提出了具有由零循环约束（安培定律）定义的互补基态约束的模型。虽然经典的库仑自旋液体禁止紧急电荷，但它们的安培对应物却使电荷不受限制。在这里，我们研究八氯石晶格上的伊辛安培模型。基态服从反对称二阶场的高斯定律，即三个耦合的二维高斯定律，预计它们会在结构因子中产生夹点。然而，最大电荷，即所有六个箭头都进出的顶点，会自发地累积在立方晶格的两个子晶格之一上，并且符号无序。这个秩序有一个纯粹的熵起源；它在大尺度上消除了夹点奇点，不产生磁性布拉格峰，并且与广泛的熵共存。系统通过看似三维伊辛普适性类的连续转变进入这种亚晶格长程有序状态。而且，国家没有磁力秩序；即使在时间反转的情况下也是如此：它是安培流形内隐藏的熵序。因此，高斯定律预测代数自旋液体的系统通过非磁性有序转变变成部分有序的短程自旋液体。我们的研究基于约束向量理论、精确界限和枚举以及蒙特卡罗、Wang-Landau 和平行回火模拟的组合。

articles.title: Evolutionary Design of Interpretable Spatial Descriptors for Structure-Property Relationship Discovery
articles.title_zh: 用于结构-性质关系发现的可解释空间描述符的进化设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06811v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Structure property prediction is a classical task in machine learning, ranging from molecular activity and materials properties to local functional responses measured in microscopy. For image-based regression, two choices define the information available to the predictor: the size of the image neighborhood and the spatial resolution retained within it. A small neighborhood can omit relevant surrounding structure, whereas a large, finely sampled neighborhood can introduce redundant or irrelevant information. Here, we develop a framework for constructing spatial descriptors for prediction of local spectra and hysteresis loops. We benchmark regression models, use SHAP maps to examine their spatial attribution, and explore the effect of the patch size and compression to establish the relationship between predictive accuracy and descriptor dimensionality. We then use a genetic algorithm to optimize spatial partitions and the assignment of mean, minimum, and maximum pooling operations. Each retained region contributes an explicit measurement of the image, allowing the search to balance prediction error against the number of descriptor values. Cartesian and polar constructions provide complementary ways to organize this information. The resulting descriptors make it possible to examine where spatial detail is needed, where regional summaries are sufficient, and how these choices depend on the predictor and the measured response. The same approach can be used for molecules and solids once the genetic algorithm rules for these are established.
articles.abstract_zh: 结构特性预测是机器学习中的一项经典任务，范围从分子活性和材料特性到显微镜中测量的局部功能响应。对于基于图像的回归，有两种选择定义了预测器可用的信息：图像邻域的大小和其中保留的空间分辨率。小邻域可以省略相关的周围结构，而大的、精细采样的邻域可以引入冗余或不相关的信息。在这里，我们开发了一个构建空间描述符的框架，用于预测局部光谱和磁滞回线。我们对回归模型进行基准测试，使用 SHAP 图检查其空间属性，并探索补丁大小和压缩的影响，以建立预测准确性和描述符维度之间的关系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 结构特性预测是机器学习中的一项经典任务，范围从分子活性和材料特性到显微镜中测量的局部功能响应。对于基于图像的回归，有两种选择定义了预测器可用的信息：图像邻域的大小和其中保留的空间分辨率。小邻域可以省略相关的周围结构，而大的、精细采样的邻域可以引入冗余或不相关的信息。在这里，我们开发了一个构建空间描述符的框架，用于预测局部光谱和磁滞回线。我们对回归模型进行基准测试，使用 SHAP 图检查其空间属性，并探索补丁大小和压缩的影响，以建立预测准确性和描述符维度之间的关系。然后，我们使用遗传算法来优化空间分区以及均值、最小和最大池化操作的分配。每个保留区域都贡献了图像的显式测量，允许搜索平衡预测误差与描述符值的数量。笛卡尔和极坐标结构提供了组织这些信息的补充方式。由此产生的描述符使得可以检查哪里需要空间细节、哪里区域摘要就足够了，以及这些选择如何依赖于预测变量和测量的响应。一旦建立了分子和固体的遗传算法规则，相同的方法就可以用于分子和固体。

articles.title: Quantum Spin Wave Theory with Multi-Spin Interactions for Magnetic Materials Modeling
articles.title_zh: 用于磁性材料建模的多自旋相互作用的量子自旋波理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06833v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In the field of magnetism within condensed matter physics, magnetic systems are microscopically described by a spin Hamiltonian. Its parameterization is accessible through both ab initio calculations and fits to experimental data. Frequently, this is achieved via multi-stage calculations that either relate the parameters to observable material properties or map a Kohn-Sham Hamiltonian onto an effective spin model. In this realm, accurate and flexible methods are essential for simulating the physical properties of the latter. The present study focuses on one such method: spin wave theory. The approach is applied to a new formulation of the spin Hamiltonian, named polynomial localized spin model (PLSM), which includes terms of arbitrary order in the spin operators. This enables the direct application of linear spin wave theory (LSWT) to the analysis of the energy landscape and spin-wave spectrum of arbitrary collinear and non-collinear phases in any realistic magnetic material. Moreover, the classical and quantum parts of the PLSM are cleanly separated. Finally, an open-source implementation of LSWT, named Magnopy, is presented. It interfaces with modern parameterization software, supports arbitrary collinear and non-collinear systems, and is designed for both scripting and standalone use.
articles.abstract_zh: 在凝聚态物理的磁性领域中，磁系统由自旋哈密顿量在微观上描述。其参数化可通过从头计算和拟合实验数据来实现。通常，这是通过多阶段计算来实现的，这些计算要么将参数与可观察的材料特性相关联，要么将 Kohn-Sham 哈密顿量映射到有效的自旋模型上。在这个领域，准确而灵活的方法对于模拟后者的物理特性至关重要。本研究的重点是这样一种方法：自旋波理论。该方法应用于自旋哈密顿量的新公式，称为多项式局部自旋模型（PLSM），其中包括自旋算子中的任意阶项。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在凝聚态物理的磁性领域中，磁系统由自旋哈密顿量在微观上描述。其参数化可通过从头计算和拟合实验数据来实现。通常，这是通过多阶段计算来实现的，这些计算要么将参数与可观察的材料特性相关联，要么将 Kohn-Sham 哈密顿量映射到有效的自旋模型上。在这个领域，准确而灵活的方法对于模拟后者的物理特性至关重要。本研究的重点是这样一种方法：自旋波理论。该方法应用于自旋哈密顿量的新公式，称为多项式局部自旋模型（PLSM），其中包括自旋算子中的任意阶项。这使得线性自旋波理论 (LSWT) 能够直接应用于分析任何现实磁性材料中任意共线和非共线相的能量景观和自旋波谱。此外，PLSM 的经典部分和量子部分完全分离。最后，提出了 LSWT 的开源实现，名为 Magnopy。它与现代参数化软件接口，支持任意共线和非共线系统，并且设计用于脚本编写和独立使用。

articles.title: Thermally Conditioned Time-Series Forecasting of Grain Growth in Polycrystalline Materials
articles.title_zh: 多晶材料中晶粒生长的热调节时间序列预测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06843v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Grain growth during heat treatment strongly affects the microstructure of polycrystalline materials and, consequently, their mechanical properties. Although numerical methods such as front-tracking or front-capturing simulations can accurately describe grain growth, their high computational cost limits their use for long or non-isothermal thermal cycles. In previous work, grain growth was successfully predicted under isothermal conditions by treating grain size distributions as time series and forecasting their evolution using recurrent neural networks, allowing complete grain growth trajectories to be generated in seconds rather than through costly PDE-based simulations. In the present work, this forecasting framework is reformulated to handle non-isothermal conditions by explicitly incorporating thermal information into the model architecture. Grain size distributions are encoded using a convolutional neural network, thermal descriptors are embedded through a dedicated multilayer perceptron, and temporal evolution is predicted using a recurrent network. Instantaneous temperature and thermal rate are provided at each time step, allowing the model to adapt its predictions to changing thermal conditions. The framework is trained and evaluated on datasets generated from validated front-tracking simulations across a wide range of non-isothermal thermal paths. The results show that the thermally conditioned model accurately reproduces grain growth dynamics under complex thermal histories, achieving, in k-fold cross-validation over all simulations, mean relative errors of 2.99% (one-hour cycles) and 4.51% (four-hour cycles) with coefficients of determination exceeding 0.99, and mean relative errors between 1.91% and 14.66% on ten simulations following four unseen thermal histories of increasing complexity.
articles.abstract_zh: 热处理过程中的晶粒生长强烈影响多晶材料的微观结构，从而影响其机械性能。尽管前沿跟踪或前沿捕获模拟等数值方法可以准确地描述晶粒生长，但其高计算成本限制了它们在长或非等温热循环中的使用。在之前的工作中，通过将晶粒尺寸分布视为时间序列并使用循环神经网络预测其演化，成功地预测了等温条件下的晶粒生长，从而可以在几秒钟内生成完整的晶粒生长轨迹，而不是通过昂贵的基于偏微分方程的模拟。在目前的工作中，该预测框架被重新制定，通过将热信息明确地纳入模型架构来处理非等温条件。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 热处理过程中的晶粒生长强烈影响多晶材料的微观结构，从而影响其机械性能。尽管前沿跟踪或前沿捕获模拟等数值方法可以准确地描述晶粒生长，但其高计算成本限制了它们在长或非等温热循环中的使用。在之前的工作中，通过将晶粒尺寸分布视为时间序列并使用循环神经网络预测其演化，成功地预测了等温条件下的晶粒生长，从而可以在几秒钟内生成完整的晶粒生长轨迹，而不是通过昂贵的基于偏微分方程的模拟。在目前的工作中，该预测框架被重新制定，通过将热信息明确地纳入模型架构来处理非等温条件。使用卷积神经网络对粒度分布进行编码，通过专用的多层感知器嵌入热描述符，并使用循环网络预测时间演化。每个时间步骤都会提供瞬时温度和热速率，使模型能够根据不断变化的热条件调整其预测。该框架根据跨各种非等温热路径的经过验证的前向跟踪模拟生成的数据集进行训练和评估。结果表明，热调节模型准确地再现了复杂热历史下的晶粒生长动态，在所有模拟的 k 倍交叉验证中，平均相对误差为 2.99%（一小时循环）和 4.51%（四小时循环），确定系数超过 0.99，在 4 次看不见的复杂性不断增加的热历史之后的 10 次模拟中，平均相对误差在 1.91% 和 14.66% 之间。

articles.title: Longitudinal and Transverse Thermoelectric Properties in Topological Quantum Materials
articles.title_zh: 拓扑量子材料的纵向和横向热电特性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06865v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Thermoelectric materials can be topologically trivial or non-trivial, enabling reversible interconversion of heat and electricity using a solid-state technology. Incidentally, few of the first experimentally discovered 3D topological materials, namely, Bi, Sb, Sn and Pb-based chalcogenides, were long known as good thermoelectric materials. In these compounds, the heavy atoms that give rise to strong spin-orbit coupling often become essential for band inversion and non-trivial band topology. They lead to low lattice thermal conductivity, linearly dispersing Dirac-like bands induce high electrical mobility, and a band-inverted electronic structure with multiple band extrema gives rise to high Seebeck coefficients. In materials, where the applied temperature gradient induces electrical voltage (Seebeck effect) in the same direction, they are termed as longitudinal thermoelectrics. On the other hand, when the generated electrical voltage and applied thermal current remain orthogonal to each other, the materials are termed as transverse thermoelectrics. The transverse response can be driven by an additional external magnetic field (ordinary Nernst effect), intrinsic remanent magnetisation, or non-zero Berry curvature of a material, which arises from their non-trivial topology (anomalous Nernst effect). We discuss another class of quantum materials, known as goniopolar materials, that exhibit axis-dependent conduction polarity and hence transverse thermoelectric effects, which are based on mechanisms of longitudinal thermoelectric properties. In this review, we cover both types of thermoelectricity, focusing on materials that possess non-trivial topological order. We make connections between their structures, topology and transport properties and suggest tunability of thermoelectric properties going beyond conventional mechanisms such as electron-phonon interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 热电材料在拓扑上可以是平凡的，也可以是非平凡的，利用固态技术实现热和电的可逆相互转换。顺便说一句，最早通过实验发现的 3D 拓扑材料（即 Bi、Sb、Sn 和 Pb 基硫族化物）中很少有长期以来被认为是良好的热电材料。在这些化合物中，产生强自旋轨道耦合的重原子通常对于能带反转和非平凡能带拓扑至关重要。它们导致低晶格热导率，线性分散的狄拉克能带引起高电迁移率，并且具有多能带极值的能带反转电子结构产生高塞贝克系数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 热电材料在拓扑上可以是平凡的，也可以是非平凡的，利用固态技术实现热和电的可逆相互转换。顺便说一句，最早通过实验发现的 3D 拓扑材料（即 Bi、Sb、Sn 和 Pb 基硫族化物）中很少有长期以来被认为是良好的热电材料。在这些化合物中，产生强自旋轨道耦合的重原子通常对于能带反转和非平凡能带拓扑至关重要。它们导致低晶格热导率，线性分散的狄拉克能带引起高电迁移率，并且具有多能带极值的能带反转电子结构产生高塞贝克系数。在材料中，施加的温度梯度会在同一方向感应出电压（塞贝克效应），它们被称为纵向热电材料。另一方面，当产生的电压和施加的热电流保持彼此正交时，该材料被称为横向热电材料。横向响应可以由额外的外部磁场（普通能斯特效应）、固有剩磁或材料的非零贝里曲率驱动，这些曲率源自其非平凡的拓扑（反常能斯特效应）。我们讨论另一类量子材料，称为角极性材料，它表现出轴相关的传导极性，从而表现出基于纵向热电特性机制的横向热电效应。在这篇综述中，我们涵盖了两种类型的热电，重点关注具有非平凡拓扑顺序的材料。我们在它们的结构、拓扑和传输特性之间建立了联系，并提出热电特性的可调性超越了电子-声子相互作用等传统机制。

articles.title: Charged Three-Dimensional Solitons in a Ferroelectric Nematic Liquid Crystal
articles.title_zh: 铁电向列液晶中的带电三维孤子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06884v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Experimental observations and computer simulation of formation and structural properties of so far experimentally never seen electrically charged propagating 3D solitons are reported. The propagating solitons appear spontaneously without an external field in a ferroelectric nematic (NF) liquid crystal under rapid cooling from the antiferroelectric (SmZA) phase. The observed solitons propagate either parallel or antiparallel to the ferroelectric polarization and annihilate when they collide with each other. They are attributed to either positively or negatively charged propagating local polarization splay formed to screen excess negative or positive mobile charge lumps in the NF phase. The presence of mobile charge is attributed to a spatially periodic charge distribution present in the antiferroelectric phase that temporarily remains after the temperature is quenched through the antiferroelectric- ferroelectric phase transition.
articles.abstract_zh: 报道了迄今为止实验上从未见过的带电传播 3D 孤子的形成和结构特性的实验观察和计算机模拟。在从反铁电 (SmZA) 相快速冷却的情况下，在铁电向列 (NF) 液晶中，传播孤子在没有外场的情况下自发出现。观察到的孤子平行或反平行于铁电极化传播，并在彼此碰撞时湮灭。它们归因于带正电或带负电的传播局部极化展开，以筛选 NF 相中多余的负或正移动电荷块。移动电荷的存在归因于反铁电相中存在的空间周期性电荷分布，该分布在通过反铁电-铁电相变淬灭温度后暂时保留。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 报道了迄今为止实验上从未见过的带电传播 3D 孤子的形成和结构特性的实验观察和计算机模拟。在从反铁电 (SmZA) 相快速冷却的情况下，在铁电向列 (NF) 液晶中，传播孤子在没有外场的情况下自发出现。观察到的孤子平行或反平行于铁电极化传播，并在彼此碰撞时湮灭。它们归因于带正电或带负电的传播局部极化展开，以筛选 NF 相中多余的负或正移动电荷块。移动电荷的存在归因于反铁电相中存在的空间周期性电荷分布，该分布在通过反铁电-铁电相变淬灭温度后暂时保留。

articles.title: Noise-Induced Topology in Chiral Quantum Walks
articles.title_zh: 手性量子行走中的噪声诱导拓扑
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05471v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Noise typically destroys quantum coherence and washes out transport phenomena that rely on interference. Chiral quantum walks are a case in point: a particle hopping on a lattice threaded by a magnetic flux can spread asymmetrically due to interference between paths, an asymmetry that noise is expected to erase. Remarkably, we find that the most ubiquitous noise -- random fluctuations of on-site energies (dephasing) -- instead renders this asymmetry topologically robust. The density profile develops a skewness that grows in time while its center stays fixed, and in a finite chain the late-time relaxation modes pile up at one edge: a skin effect lacking the drift of conventional non-Hermitian skin effects. With multiple sites per unit cell, the dephasing strength alone can cause a topological phase transition, reversing the asymmetry. On a flux ladder with noisy rung hopping, the noise causes a drift of rung coherences, a quantum ratchet with no classical counterpart. Underlying these effects, the noise-averaged dynamics is an interacting (generically non-integrable) Lindbladian that remains analytically tractable. The modes governing late-time relaxation are bound states of the noise-induced interaction and form a band with a point gap, absent both without noise and under postselection, whose winding number fixes the direction of the asymmetry. These effects are within reach of several experimental platforms, including synthetic lattices, superconducting qubits, and optical lattices.
articles.abstract_zh: 噪声通常会破坏量子相干性并消除依赖于干扰的传输现象。手性量子行走就是一个很好的例子：在磁通量穿过的晶格上跳跃的粒子可能会由于路径之间的干扰而不对称地传播，而噪声有望消除这种不对称性。值得注意的是，我们发现最普遍的噪声——现场能量的随机波动（相移）——反而使这种不对称性在拓扑上变得鲁棒。密度分布会产生一种偏度，该偏度随着时间的推移而增长，而其中心保持固定，并且在有限链中，后期弛豫模式堆积在一个边缘：一种趋肤效应，缺乏传统非厄米趋肤效应的漂移。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 噪声通常会破坏量子相干性并消除依赖于干扰的传输现象。手性量子行走就是一个很好的例子：在磁通量穿过的晶格上跳跃的粒子可能会由于路径之间的干扰而不对称地传播，而噪声有望消除这种不对称性。值得注意的是，我们发现最普遍的噪声——现场能量的随机波动（相移）——反而使这种不对称性在拓扑上变得鲁棒。密度分布会产生一种偏度，该偏度随着时间的推移而增长，而其中心保持固定，并且在有限链中，后期弛豫模式堆积在一个边缘：一种趋肤效应，缺乏传统非厄米趋肤效应的漂移。由于每个晶胞有多个位点，仅相移强度就可以引起拓扑相变，扭转不对称性。在具有噪声梯级跳变的磁通梯上，噪声会导致梯级相干性漂移，这是一种没有经典对应物的量子棘轮。在这些效应的基础上，噪声平均动力学是一个相互作用的（一般不可积的）林布拉德，但仍然易于分析处理。控制后期弛豫的模式是噪声引起的相互作用的束缚态，并形成具有点间隙的带，在没有噪声和后选择的情况下都不存在，其缠绕数固定了不对称的方向。这些效应可以通过多个实验平台实现，包括合成晶格、超导量子位和光学晶格。

articles.title: Raychaudhuri-Ehlers Kinematics on Quantum State-Space: Caustics and Extrinsic Quantum Geometry
articles.title_zh: 量子态空间上的 Raychaudhuri-Ehlers 运动学：焦散和外在量子几何
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05499v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum mechanics is inherently geometric in that the pure states form a curved complex manifold and the Schrödinger evolution defines a Hamiltonian flow on this space. Geometry identifies constraints on flows on quantum state-space that hold independently of their microscopic realization. We uncover such universal behavior in families of geodesic paths on the quantum state-space using the Raychaudhuri-Ehlers equations. We show that the complex structure leads to tidal anisotropy in the curvature, and for Hilbert space dimension N≥3, complete point-emitted geodesic bundles necessarily develop shear and undergo direction-selective focusing at finite distance. We give these geometric results an information-theoretic interpretation in terms of fidelity susceptibility and quantum Fisher information. For ground-state manifolds constrained by physical parameters, we resolve the tidal curvature into Berry-curvature-dependent ambient tides and contributions from extrinsic bending within the full ambient state space. We further relate extrinsic bending to variations in the unitary generator of motion along intrinsic geodesics. We present exact many-body geometric results for the transverse-field XY spin chain. The product structure of the ground state leads to an exact cancellation of the ambient tide, including its Berry-curvature enhancement, by extrinsic curvature contributions. At the zero-field Ising point, we obtain exact results at finite size and show that the shear source for anisotropy-directed motion is entirely extrinsic relative to the full many-body state-space. For the metric in the thermodynamic limit, the geodesic families exhibit repeated A₂ fold catastrophes inside the ferromagnetic phase. Our framework thus separates universal state-space effects from those of physical restrictions and exposes their consequences in a paradigmatic many-body system.
articles.abstract_zh: Quantum mechanics is inherently geometric in that the pure states form a curved complex manifold and the Schrödinger evolution defines a Hamiltonian flow on this space.几何学识别了量子态空间上流动的约束，这些约束独立于其微观实现。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Quantum mechanics is inherently geometric in that the pure states form a curved complex manifold and the Schrödinger evolution defines a Hamiltonian flow on this space.几何学识别了量子态空间上流动的约束，这些约束独立于其微观实现。我们使用 Raychaudhuri-Ehlers 方程揭示了量子态空间上测地线路径族中的这种普遍行为。 We show that the complex structure leads to tidal anisotropy in the curvature, and for Hilbert space dimension N≥3, complete point-emitted geodesic bundles necessarily develop shear and undergo direction-selective focusing at finite distance.我们根据保真度敏感性和量子费希尔信息对这些几何结果进行信息论解释。 For ground-state manifolds constrained by physical parameters, we resolve the tidal curvature into Berry-curvature-dependent ambient tides and contributions from extrinsic bending within the full ambient state space.我们进一步将外在弯曲与沿内在测地线运动的单一生成器的变化联系起来。我们提出了横向场 XY 自旋链的精确多体几何结果。 The product structure of the ground state leads to an exact cancellation of the ambient tide, including its Berry-curvature enhancement, by extrinsic curvature contributions. At the zero-field Ising point, we obtain exact results at finite size and show that the shear source for anisotropy-directed motion is entirely extrinsic relative to the full many-body state-space.对于热力学极限的度量，测地线族在铁磁相内表现出重复的 A2 折叠灾难。 Our framework thus separates universal state-space effects from those of physical restrictions and exposes their consequences in a paradigmatic many-body system.

articles.title: Rotated-Frame Determinant Discovery for Ground- and Excited-State Quantum Selected Configuration Interaction
articles.title_zh: 基态和激发态量子选择配置相互作用的旋转框架行列式发现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05941v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum Selected Configuration Interaction (QSCI) constructs a variational determinant space from measurements of a prepared electronic state, but finite-shot sampling can repeatedly observe high-probability determinants, limiting efficient discovery of configurations important for an accurate selected-CI description. We introduce rotate--sample--unrotate (RSU) determinant discovery, in which the same state is sampled in complementary orbital frames and the observed rotated determinants generate a finite set of candidates in the canonical basis. The Hamiltonian is then diagonalized in an orthonormal selected-CI space without enumerating the full determinant space. State-targeted orbital frames are constructed from an initial selected-CI wavefunction and its external residual. For excited states, we combine RSU with the generative quantum eigensolver (GQE) to prepare target-specific sampling states. Candidate GQE circuits are evaluated by classical selected-CI diagonalization in finite sampled spaces, so the quantum procedure requires only state preparation and determinant sampling. For N₂, exact-state controls isolate the determinant-discovery effect: at the stretched geometry, residual-natural-orbital RSU reaches chemical accuracy with 5,000 shots, compared with 20,000 shots for conventional QSCI. The improvement persists with approximate GQE-prepared states and is also observed for target excited states. These results demonstrate improved finite-shot determinant discovery in QSCI for both ground and excited states.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子选择构型相互作用 (QSCI) 根据准备好的电子态的测量构建变分行列式空间，但有限样本采样可以重复观察高概率行列式，从而限制了对准确选择 CI 描述至关重要的配置的有效发现。我们引入了旋转-采样-不旋转（RSU）行列式发现，其中在互补轨道框架中对相同状态进行采样，并且观察到的旋转行列式在规范基础中生成一组有限的候选。然后，哈密顿量在正交选定 CI 空间中对角化，而不枚举完整的行列式空间。状态目标轨道框架是根据初始选定的 CI 波函数及其外部残差构建的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子选择构型相互作用 (QSCI) 根据准备好的电子态的测量构建变分行列式空间，但有限样本采样可以重复观察高概率行列式，从而限制了对准确选择 CI 描述至关重要的配置的有效发现。我们引入了旋转-采样-不旋转（RSU）行列式发现，其中在互补轨道框架中对相同状态进行采样，并且观察到的旋转行列式在规范基础中生成一组有限的候选。然后，哈密顿量在正交选定 CI 空间中对角化，而不枚举完整的行列式空间。状态目标轨道框架是根据初始选定的 CI 波函数及其外部残差构建的。对于激发态，我们将 RSU 与生成量子本征解算器 (GQE) 结合起来，以准备特定于目标的采样态。候选 GQE 电路通过有限采样空间中的经典选择 CI 对角化进行评估，因此量子过程仅需要状态准备和行列式采样。对于 N2，精确状态控制隔离了行列式发现效应：在拉伸几何结构下，残余自然轨道 RSU 通过 5,000 次注射达到化学精度，而传统 QSCI 为 20,000 次注射。这种改进在近似 GQE 准备态下持续存在，并且在目标激发态中也观察到了。这些结果证明了 QSCI 中基态和激发态有限发射行列式发现的改进。

articles.title: Hyperbolic Nanocavities for Single-Molecule Vibrational Strong Coupling
articles.title_zh: 用于单分子振动强耦合的双曲纳米腔
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06240v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Hyperbolic phonon polaritons (HPhPs) in low-loss anisotropic materials such as hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) provide extreme sub-diffractional field confinement in the mid-infrared, making them attractive for enhancing the interaction of light with molecular vibrations. Collective vibrational strong coupling between molecular ensembles and HPhPs has already been demonstrated in extended slabs. Reaching this regime with a single molecule, however, remains a major challenge, and would provide a platform for investigating how vacuum electromagnetic fields influence molecular dynamics and chemical reactivity. Here, we show theoretically that single-molecule vibrational strong coupling can be reached in hBN nanocavities that laterally confine HPhPs within a finite volume. Combining full-wave electromagnetic simulations with the few-mode quantization approach, we find that these nanocavities support a rich set of asymmetric resonances that strongly enhance the local spectral density, with frequencies that follow from simple HPhP ray trajectories and can be tuned through the cavity aspect ratio. We identify resonances with quality factors of about 600 and effective mode volumes of |Vₑff| sim 10⁻⁷λ³, sufficient for single-molecule strong coupling with vibrational transitions with dipole moments on the order of 1,D. These results establish hyperbolic nanocavities as a promising platform for single-molecule vibrational strong coupling and open new routes toward the local control of vibrational dynamics and molecular energy flow.
articles.abstract_zh: 六方氮化硼 (hBN) 等低损耗各向异性材料中的双曲声子极化激元 (HPhP) 在中红外区域提供极端的亚衍射场限制，使其在增强光与分子振动的相互作用方面具有吸引力。分子系综和 HPhP 之间的集体振动强耦合已经在扩展平板中得到证明。然而，用单分子达到这种状态仍然是一个重大挑战，并且将为研究真空电磁场如何影响分子动力学和化学反应性提供一个平台。在这里，我们从理论上证明，在将 HPhP 横向限制在有限体积内的 hBN 纳米腔中可以实现单分子振动强耦合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 六方氮化硼 (hBN) 等低损耗各向异性材料中的双曲声子极化激元 (HPhP) 在中红外区域提供极端的亚衍射场限制，使其在增强光与分子振动的相互作用方面具有吸引力。分子系综和 HPhP 之间的集体振动强耦合已经在扩展平板中得到证明。然而，用单分子达到这种状态仍然是一个重大挑战，并且将为研究真空电磁场如何影响分子动力学和化学反应性提供一个平台。在这里，我们从理论上证明，在将 HPhP 横向限制在有限体积内的 hBN 纳米腔中可以实现单分子振动强耦合。将全波电磁模拟与少模量化方法相结合，我们发现这些纳米腔支持一组丰富的不对称共振，这些共振极大地增强了局部谱密度，其频率遵循简单的 HPhP 射线轨迹，并且可以通过腔纵横比进行调整。我们确定了品质因数约为 600 且有效模式体积为 |Vₑff| 的共振。 sim 10⁻⁷λ³，足以实现偶极矩为 1,D 量级的振动跃迁的单分子强耦合。这些结果将双曲纳米腔确立为单分子振动强耦合的有前途的平台，并为振动动力学和分子能量流的局部控制开辟了新途径。

articles.title: Discrete Backbone Elasticity and Curvature-Dependent Torsion Statistics in Proteins
articles.title_zh: 蛋白质中的离散主干弹性和曲率相关的扭转统计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06363v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Coarse-grained models of protein conformational dynamics use C_α geometry to describe the probabilities of regular helices, ordered turns and disordered conformations. To test how much of this order arises from local chain elasticity, we connect discrete Hasimoto frame transport to neighboring bending mismatch, deriving a curvature-product torsion interaction and a six-parameter generalized von Mises density. Fitted on 194 chains from the ATLAS molecular dynamics database and tested on 1744 sequence-nonredundant proteins, this baseline reduces negative log-density loss from 1.490 to 1.160 nats, torsion-sign error from 12.26 to 2.15 percentage points, and helix-fraction error from 21.84 to 10.41 points. Ablations and circular-moment projections against reference generative models motivate extensions to anisotropic stiffness and two partition-function-weighted elastic states, further lowering test loss to 0.790 nats and helix error to 1.65 points. The fixed hierarchy also improves predictions across 72 trajectories of peptides Fs and (AAQAA)₃ and miniprotein HP35 spanning varied starting conformations and force fields. Remaining angular errors in these trajectories are associated with atomic context at shared bends, as bend-matched peptide frames adopt opposite torsion signs with distinct hydrogen-bond patterns and a proline-containing HP35 turn remains at negative torsion. Introducing a bilinearly coupled C_α--N orientation angle largely reparameterizes the existing bend-dependent harmonics, with an empirical L² Gram projection placing 96.7% to 99.6% of its added coefficient-function squared norm within the original six-function span. These results link discrete Hasimoto elasticity to statistical backbone potentials and clarify the scope and limits of local C_α geometry.
articles.abstract_zh: 蛋白质构象动力学的粗粒度模型使用 C_α 几何来描述规则螺旋、有序转弯和无序构象的概率。为了测试该顺序有多少是由局部链弹性产生的，我们将离散桥本框架传输与相邻的弯曲失配连接起来，导出曲率积扭转相互作用和六参数广义冯米塞斯密度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 蛋白质构象动力学的粗粒度模型使用 C_α 几何来描述规则螺旋、有序转弯和无序构象的概率。为了测试该顺序有多少是由局部链弹性产生的，我们将离散桥本框架传输与相邻的弯曲失配连接起来，导出曲率积扭转相互作用和六参数广义冯米塞斯密度。该基线安装在 ATLAS 分子动力学数据库中的 194 条链上，并在 1744 个序列非冗余蛋白质上进行测试，将负对数密度损失从 1.490 纳特减少到 1.160 纳特，扭转符号误差从 12.26 个百分点减少到 2.15 个百分点，螺旋分数误差从 21.84 个百分点减少到 10.41 个百分点。针对参考生成模型的消融和圆矩投影激发了各向异性刚度和两个配分函数加权弹性状态的扩展，进一步将测试损失降低至 0.790 纳特，并将螺旋误差降低至 1.65 点。固定的层次结构还改进了跨不同起始构象和力场的肽 Fs 和 (AAQAA)₃ 和微型蛋白 HP35 的 72 条轨迹的预测。这些轨迹中的剩余角度误差与共享弯曲处的原子背景相关，因为弯曲匹配的肽框架采用具有不同氢键模式的相反扭转符号，并且含有脯氨酸的 HP35 转角保持负扭转。引入双线性耦合 C_α--N 方向角很大程度上重新参数化了现有的弯曲相关谐波，并通过经验 L² Gram 投影将其添加的系数函数平方范数的 96.7% 至 99.6% 放置在原始六函数跨度内。这些结果将离散桥本弹性与统计骨干势联系起来，并阐明了局部 C_α 几何形状的范围和限制。

articles.title: Quasi-Normal Modes and thermalization in integrable Quantum Field Theories from the Thermodynamic Bethe Ansatz
articles.title_zh: 热力学 Bethe Ansatz 的可积量子场论中的准正则模式和热化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06473v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We propose a Thermodynamic Bethe Ansatz (TBA) approach for describing thermalization in integrable quantum field theories. The exponential damping and oscillations when approaching thermal equilibrium can be understood as the analogs of quasi-normal mode (QNM) frequencies of black hole perturbations within the framework of holography. Holographic intuitions and some general properties of thermal Green's functions motivate the existence of such a TBA formulation, as well as lead to the imposition of a nonstandard analytical structure on the QNM TBA, while comparison with integrable form-factor expansions fixes the remaining ingredients. We conjecture the QNM TBA to be equivalent to performing an all-order resummation of secular terms in a thermal form factor expansion of retarded 2-point correlation functions. We compare the predictions with tensor network simulations of the E8 deformation of Ising CFT at nonzero temperature. We conjecture that the QNM TBA framework should also be applicable for describing out-of-equilibrium approach to Generalized Hydrodynamics (GHD).
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种热力学 Bethe Ansatz (TBA) 方法来描述可积量子场论中的热化。接近热平衡时的指数阻尼和振荡可以理解为全息框架内黑洞扰动的准正态模式（QNM）频率的模拟。全息直觉和热格林函数的一些一般性质激发了这种 TBA 公式的存在，并导致在 QNM TBA 上强加非标准分析结构，而与可积形状因子扩展的比较则修复了其余成分。我们推测 QNM TBA 相当于在延迟 2 点相关函数的热形状因子展开中执行长期项的全阶恢复。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种热力学 Bethe Ansatz (TBA) 方法来描述可积量子场论中的热化。接近热平衡时的指数阻尼和振荡可以理解为全息框架内黑洞扰动的准正态模式（QNM）频率的模拟。全息直觉和热格林函数的一些一般性质激发了这种 TBA 公式的存在，并导致在 QNM TBA 上强加非标准分析结构，而与可积形状因子扩展的比较则修复了其余成分。我们推测 QNM TBA 相当于在延迟 2 点相关函数的热形状因子展开中执行长期项的全阶恢复。我们将预测结果与伊辛 CFT 在非零温度下 E8 变形的张量网络模拟进行了比较。我们推测 QNM TBA 框架也应该适用于描述广义流体动力学 (GHD) 的非平衡方法。

articles.title: Simulating a chiral gauge theory
articles.title_zh: 模拟手性规范理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06880v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Chiral gauge theories underlie the Standard Model, yet none has been simulated nonperturbatively. Lattice constructions that evade the Nielsen-Ninomiya obstruction entail complex fermion measures or infinite-dimensional local Hilbert spaces. Here we provide a gauge-invariant Hamiltonian lattice regularization of 1+1-dimensional abelian chiral gauge theories built from clock-and-shift qudits with Z_N gauge fields, in which the global chiral symmetry and its 't Hooft anomaly survive exactly mod N. Anomaly cancellation on the lattice lets the Gauss laws be imposed and solved exactly, reducing the theory to an unconstrained qudit chain. Using infinite matrix product states, we simulate the canonical 1+1-dimensional chiral gauge theory, the 34-50 model, and find excellent agreement with analytic predictions, showing that a finite-dimensional local Hilbert space at N=6 reproduces the expected infrared physics of the continuum 34-50 model. This provides an efficient and practical solution to the problem of simulating general abelian chiral gauge theories in 1+1 dimensions, both on classical and quantum computers.
articles.abstract_zh: 手性规范理论是标准模型的基础，但还没有一个被非微扰地模拟。避开尼尔森-二宫障碍的晶格结构需要复杂的费米子测度或无限维局部希尔伯特空间。在这里，我们提供了由具有 Z_N 规范场的时钟移位量子构建的 1+1 维阿贝尔手性规范理论的规范不变哈密顿晶格正则化，其中全局手征对称性及其 't Hooft 异常精确地存在 mod N。晶格上的异常消除可以精确地施加和求解高斯定律，从而将理论简化为无约束的量子链。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 手性规范理论是标准模型的基础，但还没有一个被非微扰地模拟。避开尼尔森-二宫障碍的晶格结构需要复杂的费米子测度或无限维局部希尔伯特空间。在这里，我们提供了由具有 Z_N 规范场的时钟移位量子构建的 1+1 维阿贝尔手性规范理论的规范不变哈密顿晶格正则化，其中全局手征对称性及其 't Hooft 异常精确地存在 mod N。晶格上的异常消除可以精确地施加和求解高斯定律，从而将理论简化为无约束的量子链。使用无限矩阵乘积态，我们模拟了规范的 1+1 维手性规范理论（34-50 模型），并发现与分析预测非常一致，表明 N=6 处的有限维局部希尔伯特空间再现了连续介质 34-50 模型的预期红外物理现象。这为在经典计算机和量子计算机上模拟 1+1 维的一般阿贝尔手性规范理论的问题提供了一种有效且实用的解决方案。

articles.title: Mean-Field Study of Normal Metal-Quantum Dot-Superconductor System in the Presence of External Magnetic Field
articles.title_zh: 外磁场存在下普通金属-量子点-超导系统的平均场研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2309.10720v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this paper, we have analyzed the spectral and transport properties of a weakly correlated single-level quantum dot hybridized with one normal conducting and another Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) superconducting lead (N-QD-S system) in the presence of an external magnetic field. We have employed Green's function equation of motion (EOM) approach within a self-consistent Hartree-Fock (HF) mean-field approximation to analyze the Hamiltonian. We studied the effect of on-dot Coulomb correlation and an external magnetic field on the sub-gap Andreev levels of a quantum dot, strongly coupled to a conventional s-wave superconductor as a function of impurity parameters. We have shown that for a finite magnetic field, the Andreev bound states (ABSs) split into a spin-up and spin-down contribution (i.e. Zeeman splitting) and cross the Fermi energy level, resulting in a quantum phase transition, which is an indication of a change in the fermion parity of the ground state. Further, within the non-linear regime, we discuss the total electrical conductance for various values of Zeeman energy and on-dot Coulomb interactions. We have compared our results with the existing experimental and theoretical results.
articles.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们分析了在存在外部磁场的情况下，弱相关单能级量子点与一种普通导体和另一种 Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) 超导引线（N-QD-S 系统）杂交的光谱和传输特性。我们在自洽 Hartree-Fock (HF) 平均场近似中采用格林函数运动方程 (EOM) 方法来分析哈密顿量。我们研究了点上库仑关联和外部磁场对量子点亚能隙安德烈夫能级的影响，量子点与传统的 s 波超导体强耦合，作为杂质参数的函数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在本文中，我们分析了在存在外部磁场的情况下，弱相关单能级量子点与一种普通导体和另一种 Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) 超导引线（N-QD-S 系统）杂交的光谱和传输特性。我们在自洽 Hartree-Fock (HF) 平均场近似中采用格林函数运动方程 (EOM) 方法来分析哈密顿量。我们研究了点上库仑关联和外部磁场对量子点亚能隙安德烈夫能级的影响，量子点与传统的 s 波超导体强耦合，作为杂质参数的函数。我们已经证明，对于有限磁场，安德烈夫束缚态（ABS）分裂成自旋向上和自旋向下贡献（即塞曼分裂）并穿过费米能级，导致量子相变，这是基态费米子宇称变化的指示。此外，在非线性范围内，我们讨论了不同塞曼能量值和点上库仑相互作用的总电导。我们将我们的结果与现有的实验和理论结果进行了比较。

articles.title: Quantum Noise Spectroscopy of Criticality in an Atomically Thin Magnet
articles.title_zh: 原子薄磁体临界的量子噪声光谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2407.05614v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The universality class of a phase transition dictates the behavior of low-frequency and long-wavelength critical fluctuations in a material. Studying these dynamics in thin magnetic insulators, however, remains challenging; an experimental probe must be sensitive to low-frequency, long-wavelength fluctuations while navigating the sample's small volume, inherent inhomogeneities, and fabrication limitations. Using nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers in diamond, we demonstrate T₂ (spin-decoherence) noise magnetometry as a direct and quantitative probe of critical dynamics in a tri-layer sample of CrSBr, a two-dimensional van der Waals magnet. We observe a sharp increase in the decoherence rate of the NV spin ensemble at the sample's critical temperature, highlighting our probe's sensitivity to critical fluctuations. We demonstrate that the behavior of the NV spin decoherence rate below the critical temperature is inconsistent with fluctuations due to XY criticality in 2D CrSBr. Next, by simulating the NV spin decoherence dynamics using noise models for an Ising-type transition and fitting to our data, we quantitatively measure the dynamical and the correlation length critical exponents (z and ν) and demonstrate that the observed fluctuations strongly deviate from those predicted by the short-range Ising universality class. Together, these observations indicate that the transition is Ising-like but modified by long-range dipolar interactions, emphasizing the importance of easy-axis anisotropy and long-range interactions for understanding magnetism in 2D CrSBr. Our work establishes T₂ noise magnetometry as a quantitative probe of critical dynamics in 2D materials, opening a new avenue for studying strongly correlated phenomena at the atomically thin limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 相变的普遍性类别决定了材料中低频和长波长临界波动的行为。然而，研究薄磁绝缘体中的这些动力学仍然具有挑战性。实验探针必须对低频、长波长波动敏感，同时应对样品的小体积、固有的不均匀性和制造限制。利用金刚石中的氮空位 (NV) 中心，我们展示了 T2（自旋退相干）噪声磁力测定法作为二维范德华磁体 CrSBr 三层样品中临界动力学的直接定量探针。我们观察到样品临界温度下 NV 自旋系综的退相干率急剧增加，突出了我们的探针对临界波动的敏感性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 相变的普遍性类别决定了材料中低频和长波长临界波动的行为。然而，研究薄磁绝缘体中的这些动力学仍然具有挑战性。实验探针必须对低频、长波长波动敏感，同时应对样品的小体积、固有的不均匀性和制造限制。利用金刚石中的氮空位 (NV) 中心，我们展示了 T2（自旋退相干）噪声磁力测定法作为二维范德华磁体 CrSBr 三层样品中临界动力学的直接定量探针。我们观察到样品临界温度下 NV 自旋系综的退相干率急剧增加，突出了我们的探针对临界波动的敏感性。我们证明了 NV 自旋退相干率低于临界温度的行为与 2D CrSBr 中 XY 临界值引起的波动不一致。接下来，通过使用伊辛型跃迁的噪声模型模拟 NV 自旋退相干动力学并拟合我们的数据，我们定量测量了动力学和相关长度临界指数（z 和 ν），并证明观察到的波动与短程伊辛普适性类预测的波动强烈偏离。总之，这些观察结果表明，转变是类似伊辛的转变，但受到长程偶极相互作用的影响，强调了易轴各向异性和长程相互作用对于理解二维 CrSBr 中磁性的重要性。我们的工作将 T2 噪声磁力测量建立为二维材料临界动力学的定量探针，为研究原子薄极限下的强相关现象开辟了一条新途径。

articles.title: Helicons in multi-Weyl semimetals
articles.title_zh: 多外尔半金属中的螺旋
articles.abstract: arXiv:2504.15426v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Helicons are low-frequency, circularly polarized transverse electromagnetic modes that propagate in three-dimensional conducting systems in the presence of a static magnetic field. Here, we investigate helicon excitations in gapless multi-Weyl semimetals (mWSMs) with topological charge (J=1,2,) and (3) using semiclassical Boltzmann transport theory. We incorporate both Berry-curvature and orbital-magnetic-moment corrections into the quasiparticle dynamics and determine the optical-conductivity tensor in the presence of a weak static magnetic field. The longitudinal conductivity is obtained analytically for single-, double and triple-Weyl systems, whereas the transverse conductivity is evaluated numerically in the low-frequency regime relevant to helicon propagation. We find that the cyclotron frequency acquires a nontrivial dependence on the topological charge and on the magnetic field. The resulting helicon dispersion retains the characteristic quadratic dependence on the wave vector, while the axion-electrodynamics contribution generates an additional linear term. We further show that the axion term lifts the degeneracy of the gapped collective modes at zero wave vector, with the resulting mode frequencies determined by the (J)-dependent plasma frequencies. These results demonstrate that the helicon response provides a probe of the distinct electrodynamic properties of multi-Weyl semimetals.
articles.abstract_zh: 螺旋是低频圆极化横向电磁模式，在存在静磁场的情况下在三维传导系统中传播。在这里，我们使用半经典玻尔兹曼输运理论研究了具有拓扑电荷 (J=1,2,) 和 (3) 的无间隙多外尔半金属 (mWSM) 中的螺旋激发。我们将贝里曲率和轨道磁矩校正合并到准粒子动力学中，并确定弱静磁场存在下的光导张量。单外尔系统、双外尔系统和三外尔系统的纵向电导率是通过分析获得的，而横向电导率是在与螺旋传播相关的低频区域中通过数值计算得到的。我们发现回旋加速器频率对拓扑电荷和磁场具有重要的依赖性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 螺旋是低频圆极化横向电磁模式，在存在静磁场的情况下在三维传导系统中传播。在这里，我们使用半经典玻尔兹曼输运理论研究了具有拓扑电荷 (J=1,2,) 和 (3) 的无间隙多外尔半金属 (mWSM) 中的螺旋激发。我们将贝里曲率和轨道磁矩校正合并到准粒子动力学中，并确定弱静磁场存在下的光导张量。单外尔系统、双外尔系统和三外尔系统的纵向电导率是通过分析获得的，而横向电导率是在与螺旋传播相关的低频区域中通过数值计算得到的。我们发现回旋加速器频率对拓扑电荷和磁场具有重要的依赖性。由此产生的螺旋色散保留了对波矢量的特征二次依赖关系，而轴子电动力学贡献生成了一个额外的线性项。我们进一步表明，轴子项提高了零波矢量处有隙集体模式的简并性，所得模式频率由依赖于 (J) 的等离子体频率决定。这些结果表明，螺旋响应提供了多外尔半金属独特电动力学特性的探针。

articles.title: Ferroelectric nematic liquid crystals: temperature-tunable electrocaloric fluids with large strength at low fields
articles.title_zh: 铁电向列液晶：低场强、温度可调的电热流体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.26386v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The electrocaloric (EC) effect offers a promising energy-efficient and clean cooling technology. We present the first direct measurements of EC temperature change in a new family of EC fluids, ferroelectric nematic liquid crystals (FNLCs), demonstrating in two such materials temperature jumps of |ΔTⱼ| ~ 0.2 K for field changes as low as ΔE ~ 0.1 V μm⁻¹. Indirect measurements of adiabatic temperature change |ΔT| confirm that these direct measurements are an underestimate and that ΔE = 2 V μm⁻¹ can induce up to |ΔT| ~ 1.6 K, yielding EC strengths |ΔT/ΔE| up to 100% higher than incumbent materials. For temperature spans of 5-10 K, we predict a coefficient of performance of ~21-40. We find |ΔT| ~ 1 K for >100 FNLCs that collectively span all temperatures between 0^circC and 100^circC. This, together with the new device concepts conceivable with fluid EC materials, offers huge potential for cooling applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 电热（EC）效应提供了一种有前途的节能和清洁冷却技术。我们首次直接测量新型 EC 流体系列——铁电向列液晶 (FNLC) 中的 EC 温度变化，证明了两种此类材料的 |ΔTⱼ| 温度跃变。对于低至 ΔE ~ 0.1 V μm⁻1 的场变化，约为 0.2 K。绝热温度变化的间接测量|ΔT|确认这些直接测量结果被低估，并且 ΔE = 2 V μm⁻¹ 可以诱导高达 |ΔT| ~ 1.6 K，产生 EC 强度 |ΔT/ΔE|比现有材料高出 100%。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电热（EC）效应提供了一种有前途的节能和清洁冷却技术。我们首次直接测量新型 EC 流体系列——铁电向列液晶 (FNLC) 中的 EC 温度变化，证明了两种此类材料的 |ΔTⱼ| 温度跃变。对于低至 ΔE ~ 0.1 V μm⁻1 的场变化，约为 0.2 K。绝热温度变化的间接测量|ΔT|确认这些直接测量结果被低估，并且 ΔE = 2 V μm⁻¹ 可以诱导高达 |ΔT| ~ 1.6 K，产生 EC 强度 |ΔT/ΔE|比现有材料高出 100%。对于 5-10 K 的温度范围，我们预测性能系数约为 21-40。我们发现|ΔT| ~ 1 K 对于 >100 个 FNLC，它们共同跨越 0^circC 和 100^circC 之间的所有温度。这与流体 EC 材料的新设备概念一起，为冷却应用提供了巨大的潜力。

articles.title: Colloquium: A critique on van der Waals and two-dimensional magnets
articles.title_zh: 座谈会：对范德华和二维磁体的批判
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.19417v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Magnetic two-dimensional (2D) crystals were isolated about a decade ago, triggering a tremendous research activity worldwide. This colloquium raises a stiff question: what is really new about them? At first sight, they seem to be purer implementations of 2D spin models than traditional systems such as ultra-thin films. Yet, they partly realized their promises so far, and whether they give fresh perspectives on long-standing predictions in statistical physics is still an open question. Undoubtedly, they are uniquely amenable to electric-field effect, susceptible to mechanical deformation, and sensitive to moirés, for example. They represent interesting platforms for exploring, challenging, or simply revisiting a wide range of phenomena in condensed matter magnetism. This colloquium intends to offer a critical, yet not necessarily skeptical, overview of the field, clarifying what we believe could be unique with 2D magnets, related quasi-2D van der Waals magnets, and their heterostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 大约十年前，磁性二维 (2D) 晶体被分离出来，引发了全球范围内的巨大研究活动。这次研讨会提出了一个棘手的问题：它们到底有什么新鲜之处？乍一看，它们似乎是比超薄膜等传统系统更纯粹的 2D 自旋模型实现。然而，到目前为止，他们部分实现了他们的承诺，他们是否对统计物理学的长期预测提供了新的视角仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。毫无疑问，它们特别容易受到电场效应的影响，容易受到机械变形的影响，并且对莫尔条纹敏感。它们代表了探索、挑战或简单地重新审视凝聚态磁性中的各种现象的有趣平台。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 大约十年前，磁性二维 (2D) 晶体被分离出来，引发了全球范围内的巨大研究活动。这次研讨会提出了一个棘手的问题：它们到底有什么新鲜之处？乍一看，它们似乎是比超薄膜等传统系统更纯粹的 2D 自旋模型实现。然而，到目前为止，他们部分实现了他们的承诺，他们是否对统计物理学的长期预测提供了新的视角仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。毫无疑问，它们特别容易受到电场效应的影响，容易受到机械变形的影响，并且对莫尔条纹敏感。它们代表了探索、挑战或简单地重新审视凝聚态磁性中的各种现象的有趣平台。本次研讨会旨在提供对该领域的批判性但不一定持怀疑态度的概述，阐明我们认为二维磁体、相关准二维范德华磁体及其异质结构的独特之处。

articles.title: Stability and mixed phases of three-component droplets in one dimension
articles.title_zh: 一维三组分液滴的稳定性和混合相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.04950v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We explore the ground state properties and excitation spectra of one-dimensional, three-component bosonic mixtures, where two majority components form a self-bound droplet coupled to a third, minority component. Within a self-consistent Lee-Huang-Yang framework, we identify distinct mixed self-bound droplet phases and characterize their phase transitions through variations of either the particle number of the majority components or the intercomponent coupling. The ensuing phases demonstrate that the minority component is untrapped, partially trapped, or fully trapped by the majority droplet species. These states are characterized by their binding energies captured by the chemical potentials and their low-amplitude excitation spectrum, including mode crossings at the particle-emission threshold. We further derive effective reduced models in the high-imbalance limit, which accurately reproduce the numerically computed ground states, while providing analytical insights into the role of quantum fluctuations. Our results establish the stability and structure of mixed droplet phases provide experimentally relevant signatures for their identification.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们探索一维三组分玻色子混合物的基态特性和激发光谱，其中两个主要组分形成与第三个少数组分耦合的自结合液滴。在自洽的 Lee-Huang-Yang 框架内，我们识别了不同的混合自结合液滴相，并通过主要组分的颗粒数或组分间耦合的变化来表征它们的相变。随后的阶段表明少数组分未被大多数液滴种类捕获、部分捕获或完全捕获。这些状态的特征在于化学势捕获的结合能和低振幅激发光谱，包括粒子发射阈值处的模式交叉。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们探索一维三组分玻色子混合物的基态特性和激发光谱，其中两个主要组分形成与第三个少数组分耦合的自结合液滴。在自洽的 Lee-Huang-Yang 框架内，我们识别了不同的混合自结合液滴相，并通过主要组分的颗粒数或组分间耦合的变化来表征它们的相变。随后的阶段表明少数组分未被大多数液滴种类捕获、部分捕获或完全捕获。这些状态的特征在于化学势捕获的结合能和低振幅激发光谱，包括粒子发射阈值处的模式交叉。我们进一步推导了高不平衡极限下的有效简化模型，该模型准确地再现了数值计算的基态，同时提供了对量子涨落作用的分析见解。我们的结果确定了混合液滴相的稳定性和结构，为它们的识别提供了实验相关的特征。

articles.title: Inverse Chiral Phonon Zeeman Effect in Noncentrosymmetric Crystals
articles.title_zh: 非中心对称晶体中的反手性声子塞曼效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.12763v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a quantized effective theory of the inverse chiral phonon Zeeman effect in noncentrosymmetric crystals. Within micropolar elasticity, coupled translational displacements and microrotations give rise to intrinsically chiral phonons, which generate an elliptically polarized internal magnetic field through dynamical piezoelectricity. Provided that electronic screening is incomplete, this field acts as an effective longitudinal Zeeman field on electronic spins, driving a Floquet response for localized states and a stationary adiabatic band splitting for itinerant electrons, leading to macroscopic spin polarization. In contrast to earlier discussions based on nearly degenerate axial optical modes or externally driven circular lattice motion, the present mechanism relies on finite-wave-number truly chiral phonons whose counter-rotating branches are intrinsically split by crystal chirality. Quantization is introduced to define the single-phonon magnetic-field scale, coherent-state enhancement, and magnetic chirality in a controlled manner. The results establish a purely lattice-driven mechanism for the inverse chiral phonon Zeeman effect in noncentrosymmetric crystals.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了非中心对称晶体中反手性声子塞曼效应的量子化有效理论。在微极性弹性内，耦合的平移位移和微旋转产生本质上的手性声子，其通过动态压电产生椭圆极化的内部磁场。如果电子屏蔽不完整，则该场充当电子自旋的有效纵向塞曼场，驱动局域态的弗洛奎特响应和流动电子的固定绝热能带分裂，导致宏观自旋极化。与早期基于近简并轴向光学模式或外部驱动的圆形晶格运动的讨论相反，本机制依赖于有限波数真正手性声子，其反向旋转分支本质上被晶体手性分裂。引入量化以受控方式定义单声子磁场尺度、相干态增强和磁手性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了非中心对称晶体中反手性声子塞曼效应的量子化有效理论。在微极性弹性内，耦合的平移位移和微旋转产生本质上的手性声子，其通过动态压电产生椭圆极化的内部磁场。如果电子屏蔽不完整，则该场充当电子自旋的有效纵向塞曼场，驱动局域态的弗洛奎特响应和流动电子的固定绝热能带分裂，导致宏观自旋极化。与早期基于近简并轴向光学模式或外部驱动的圆形晶格运动的讨论相反，本机制依赖于有限波数真正手性声子，其反向旋转分支本质上被晶体手性分裂。引入量化以受控方式定义单声子磁场尺度、相干态增强和磁手性。结果建立了非中心对称晶体中反手性声子塞曼效应的纯晶格驱动机制。

articles.title: Second law of thermodynamics in closed quantum many-body systems
articles.title_zh: 封闭量子多体系统中的热力学第二定律
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.06657v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The second law of thermodynamics for adiabatic operations -- constraints on state transitions in closed systems under external control -- is one of the fundamental principles of thermodynamics. On the other hand, it is recently established that even pure quantum states can represent thermal equilibrium. However, pure quantum states do not satisfy the second law in that they are not passive, i.e., work can be extracted from them if arbitrary unitary operations are allowed. It therefore remains unresolved how quantum mechanics can be reconciled with thermodynamics. Here, based on our key quantum-mechanical notions of thermal equilibrium and adiabatic operations, we address the emergence of the second law for adiabatic operations in the thermodynamics limit. We first introduce infinite-observable macroscopic thermal equilibrium (iMATE); a quantum state, including pure states, is in iMATE if the expectation values of all additive observables agree with their equilibrium values. We also introduce a macroscopic operation as unitary evolution generated by a time-dependent additive Hamiltonian, which is regarded as corresponding to adiabatic operations. Employing these concepts, we show that no extensive work can be extracted from any quantum state in iMATE through any macroscopic operations. Furthermore, we introduce a quantum-mechanical form of entropy density such that it agrees with thermodynamic entropy density for any quantum state in iMATE. We then prove that for any initial state in iMATE, this entropy density cannot be decreased by any macroscopic operations, followed by a time-independent relaxation process. Our theory thus proves two different forms of the second law, by adopting macroscopically reasonable classes of observables, equilibrium states, and operations. We also discuss the time scales of macroscopic operations in these results.
articles.abstract_zh: 绝热操作的热力学第二定律——外部控制下封闭系统中状态转换的约束——是热力学的基本原理之一。另一方面，最近发现即使是纯量子态也可以代表热平衡。然而，纯量子态不满足第二定律，因为它们不是被动的，即如果允许任意酉运算，则可以从中提取功。因此，如何协调量子力学与热力学仍然悬而未决。在这里，基于热平衡和绝热操作的关键量子力学概念，我们解决了热力学极限中绝热操作第二定律的出现。我们首先引入无限可观测宏观热平衡（iMATE）；
articles.abstract_zh_full: 绝热操作的热力学第二定律——外部控制下封闭系统中状态转换的约束——是热力学的基本原理之一。另一方面，最近发现即使是纯量子态也可以代表热平衡。然而，纯量子态不满足第二定律，因为它们不是被动的，即如果允许任意酉运算，则可以从中提取功。因此，如何协调量子力学与热力学仍然悬而未决。在这里，基于热平衡和绝热操作的关键量子力学概念，我们解决了热力学极限中绝热操作第二定律的出现。我们首先引入无限可观测宏观热平衡（iMATE）；如果所有加性可观测量的期望值与其平衡值一致，则量子态（包括纯态）处于 iMATE 状态。我们还引入了一种宏观操作，作为由时间相关的加性哈密顿量生成的酉演化，这被认为对应于绝热操作。利用这些概念，我们表明无法通过任何宏观操作从 iMATE 中的任何量子态中提取大量工作。此外，我们引入了熵密度的量子力学形式，使其与 iMATE 中任何量子态的热力学熵密度一致。然后我们证明，对于 iMATE 中的任何初始状态，该熵密度不能通过任何宏观操作以及随后的与时间无关的松弛过程来降低。因此，我们的理论通过采用宏观上合理的可观测量类别、平衡状态和运算，证明了第二定律的两种不同形式。我们还讨论了这些结果中宏观操作的时间尺度。

articles.title: Successive single- and double-q Γ₃ quadrupole orders on the diamond structure
articles.title_zh: 金刚石结构上连续的单 q 和双 q Γ₃ 四极级
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.04702v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate field-dependent quadrupolar ordering at the L points of the diamond-structure Brillouin zone using classical Monte Carlo simulations of an effective Γ₃ quadrupole model. We demonstrate that competition between the magnetic field and quadrupole anisotropy leads to a rich phase diagram for magnetic fields applied parallel to [001], which includes switching between a single-q state and a double-q state. We also examine the effects of a symmetry-allowed biquadratic intersite interaction, corresponding to a hexadecapole interaction, on the stability of the double-q state under a magnetic field.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们使用有效 Γ₃ 四极模型的经典蒙特卡罗模拟，研究了金刚石结构布里渊区 L 点处的场相关四极排序。我们证明，磁场和四极各向异性之间的竞争导致平行于 [001] 施加的磁场产生丰富的相图，其中包括单 q 状态和双 q 状态之间的切换。我们还研究了对称性允许的双二次位点间相互作用（对应于十六极相互作用）对磁场下双 q 态稳定性的影响。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用有效 Γ₃ 四极模型的经典蒙特卡罗模拟，研究了金刚石结构布里渊区 L 点处的场相关四极排序。我们证明，磁场和四极各向异性之间的竞争导致平行于 [001] 施加的磁场产生丰富的相图，其中包括单 q 状态和双 q 状态之间的切换。我们还研究了对称性允许的双二次位点间相互作用（对应于十六极相互作用）对磁场下双 q 态稳定性的影响。

articles.title: Deterministic Electrical Switching in Altermagnets via Surface Antisymmetry Groups
articles.title_zh: 通过表面反对称群实现交替磁体的确定性电开关
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.06537v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: A surface antisymmetry group framework is developed to establish design rules for deterministic electrical switching of the Néel vector in a film of a collinear bipartite antiferromagnet. In centrosymmetric altermagnets, where linear current-induced spin-orbit torques vanish in the bulk, staggered effective fields can nevertheless exist as a macroscopic interfacial response, whose allowed tensor form is determined by the surface antisymmetry point group for the given surface orientation. Such effective fields do not require sublattice equivalence to be broken by the surface and can arise via the Edelstein mechanism driven by sublattice-odd interfacial spin-orbit coupling. General symmetry obstructions to bipolar switching that are valid to all orders in torque angular harmonics are also derived. Separately, the structure of the spin conductivity tensor determines which surface orientations allow transverse spin current generation via the nonrelativistic spin-splitter effect. Taken together, these symmetry-enforced properties establish which surface orientations of d-wave altermagnets can serve as deterministically switchable spin current sources in spin-torque heterostructures. Because the design rules are based solely on the surface antisymmetry point group, the symmetry-allowed staggered effective fields are robust against averaging over equilibrium surface roughness.
articles.abstract_zh: 开发了表面反对称群框架，以建立共线二分反铁磁体薄膜中尼尔矢量的确定性电切换的设计规则。在中心对称交替磁体中，线性电流引起的自旋轨道扭矩在整体中消失，交错有效场仍然可以作为宏观界面响应存在，其允许的张量形式由给定表面方向的表面反对称点组决定。这种有效场不需要表面破坏亚晶格等效性，并且可以通过亚晶格奇数界面自旋轨道耦合驱动的埃德尔斯坦机制产生。还导出了对扭矩角谐波中的所有阶次都有效的双极性开关的一般对称障碍。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 开发了表面反对称群框架，以建立共线二分反铁磁体薄膜中尼尔矢量的确定性电切换的设计规则。在中心对称交替磁体中，线性电流引起的自旋轨道扭矩在整体中消失，交错有效场仍然可以作为宏观界面响应存在，其允许的张量形式由给定表面方向的表面反对称点组决定。这种有效场不需要表面破坏亚晶格等效性，并且可以通过亚晶格奇数界面自旋轨道耦合驱动的埃德尔斯坦机制产生。还导出了对扭矩角谐波中的所有阶次都有效的双极性开关的一般对称障碍。另外，自旋电导率张量的结构决定了哪些表面取向允许通过非相对论自旋分裂效应产生横向自旋电流。总而言之，这些对称性强制特性确定了 d 波交替磁体的哪些表面方向可以充当自旋扭矩异质结构中确定性可切换的自旋电流源。由于设计规则仅基于表面反对称点组，因此对称允许的交错有效场对于平均超过平衡表面粗糙度具有鲁棒性。

articles.title: Unified Theory of Spin and Orbital Inverse Faraday Effects in Rashba Metals
articles.title_zh: Rashba 金属中自旋和轨道逆法拉第效应的统一理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.13187v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The inverse Faraday effect (IFE) offers a promising route toward optical control of magnetic moments in quantum materials. Yet experiments on spin-orbit-coupled metals indicate that no single microscopic mechanism suffices, implicating orbital currents alongside spin polarization. We derive both responses in a disordered Rashba metal using quantum kinetics and diagrammatics with impurity-renormalized optical vertices, providing the first unified diagrammatic derivation of spin and orbital IFE. Treating impurity scattering consistently, our number-conserving kinetic formulation restores full phase-space derivatives and the optical magnetic field neglected in earlier treatments. We connect nonlinear orbital magnetization to absorptive linear optical conductivity, revealing that the magnetic Lorentz force supplies half the orbital response. Our unified treatment resolves both channels across the Rashba resonance: spin IFE changes sign as frequency increases, while the orbital IFE dominates, keeping the direction of the total magnetization unchanged.
articles.abstract_zh: 反法拉第效应（IFE）为量子材料中磁矩的光学控制提供了一条有前途的途径。然而，对自旋轨道耦合金属的实验表明，没有单一的微观机制足够，这意味着轨道电流与自旋极化一起存在。我们利用量子动力学和杂质重正化光学顶点图解法推导了无序 Rashba 金属中的两种响应，从而提供了自旋和轨道 IFE 的第一个统一图解推导。一致地处理杂质散射，我们的数守恒动力学公式恢复了早期处理中忽略的完整相空间导数和光磁场。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 反法拉第效应（IFE）为量子材料中磁矩的光学控制提供了一条有前途的途径。然而，对自旋轨道耦合金属的实验表明，没有单一的微观机制足够，这意味着轨道电流与自旋极化一起存在。我们利用量子动力学和杂质重正化光学顶点图解法推导了无序 Rashba 金属中的两种响应，从而提供了自旋和轨道 IFE 的第一个统一图解推导。一致地处理杂质散射，我们的数守恒动力学公式恢复了早期处理中忽略的完整相空间导数和光磁场。我们将非线性轨道磁化强度与吸收线性光导率联系起来，揭示了磁洛伦兹力提供了一半的轨道响应。我们的统一处理解决了 Rashba 共振的两个通道：自旋 IFE 随着频率增加而改变符号，而轨道 IFE 占主导地位，保持总磁化强度方向不变。

articles.title: On flat band engineering and graphene nanomesh magnonics
articles.title_zh: 平带工程和石墨烯纳米网磁振子学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.01227v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Graph-theoretic topological frustration is a peculiar situation on a finite piece of the honeycomb lattice that prevents a full pairwise coupling of the lattice sites via nearest neighbor links, even when the total number of sites is an even number and the structure possesses no sublattice imbalance. This type of frustration is inherent for organic molecules that are classified as concealed non-Kekulean hydrocarbons, representing peculiar diradicals. Here we show that this topological frustration persists in two-dimensional systems based on the honeycomb lattice. Such systems exhibit fully flat electronic energy bands located at the Fermi level. Therefore, two-dimensional ultimately flat bands can be systematically and predictably constructed for graphene monolayer nanomeshes. These systems are prone to antiferromagnetic ordering and hybrid spin-wave excitations mixing weak ferromagnetic and strong antiferromagnetic features, which could pave the way towards low-power, compact, and ultrafast organic spintronics with near room-temperature operation.
articles.abstract_zh: 图论拓扑挫败是蜂窝晶格有限块上的一种特殊情况，即使在位点总数为偶数并且结构不具有子晶格不平衡的情况下，它也会阻止晶格位点通过最近邻链接完全成对耦合。这种挫败感是有机分子所固有的，这些有机分子被归类为隐藏的非凯库列碳氢化合物，代表着特殊的双自由基。在这里，我们证明这种拓扑挫败在基于蜂窝晶格的二维系统中持续存在。此类系统表现出位于费米能级的完全平坦的电子能带。因此，可以系统地、可预测地为石墨烯单层纳米网构建二维最终平坦带。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 图论拓扑挫败是蜂窝晶格有限块上的一种特殊情况，即使在位点总数为偶数并且结构不具有子晶格不平衡的情况下，它也会阻止晶格位点通过最近邻链接完全成对耦合。这种挫败感是有机分子所固有的，这些有机分子被归类为隐藏的非凯库列碳氢化合物，代表着特殊的双自由基。在这里，我们证明这种拓扑挫败在基于蜂窝晶格的二维系统中持续存在。此类系统表现出位于费米能级的完全平坦的电子能带。因此，可以系统地、可预测地为石墨烯单层纳米网构建二维最终平坦带。这些系统易于产生反铁磁有序和混合弱铁磁和强反铁磁特征的混合自旋波激发，这可以为低功耗、紧凑和超快有机自旋电子学以及近室温操作铺平道路。

articles.title: Spin State versus Potential of Zero Charge as Predictors of Density-Dependent Oxygen Reduction in M-N-C Electrocatalysts
articles.title_zh: 自旋态与零电荷电势作为 M-N-C 电催化剂中密度相关氧还原的预测因子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.17427v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Metal-site density strongly influences oxygen reduction activity and selectivity in M-N-C electrocatalysts, but the descriptors that predict these trends remain under debate. Here, we compare spin state and the potential of zero charge (PZC) as predictors of density-dependent oxygen reduction behavior in Fe-N-C and Co-N-C catalysts. Using constrained-magnetization calculations combined with Landau analysis, we find that the ground-state magnetic moments vary only weakly across a broad range of metal-site densities, suggesting that magnetic descriptors alone cannot account for the pronounced performance changes. In contrast, explicit-solvent simulations reveal systematic density-dependent shifts in PZC, which alter the interfacial electric field and thereby modulate field-sensitive adsorption energetics of ORR intermediates. Incorporating these PZC shifts into a pH-field-coupled microkinetic model captures the density-dependent activity trends and reproduces the experimentally observed increase in two-electron selectivity at lower site densities under acidic conditions. Experimental PZC measurements further support the predicted trend. Within the investigated Co-N-C and Fe-N-C series, PZC-dependent electrostatics consistently rationalize the density-dependent ORR trends, whereas the examined magnetic descriptors show comparatively weak variation.
articles.abstract_zh: 金属位点密度强烈影响 M-N-C 电催化剂的氧还原活性和选择性，但预测这些趋势的描述符仍然存在争议。在这里，我们比较自旋态和零电荷电势 (PZC) 作为 Fe-N-C 和 Co-N-C 催化剂中密度相关氧还原行为的预测因子。使用约束磁化计算与朗道分析相结合，我们发现基态磁矩在广泛的金属位点密度范围内仅微弱变化，这表明仅磁描述符无法解释显着的性能变化。相比之下，显式溶剂模拟揭示了 PZC 中系统性的密度依赖性变化，这改变了界面电场，从而调节了 ORR 中间体的场敏感吸附能量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 金属位点密度强烈影响 M-N-C 电催化剂的氧还原活性和选择性，但预测这些趋势的描述符仍然存在争议。在这里，我们比较自旋态和零电荷电势 (PZC) 作为 Fe-N-C 和 Co-N-C 催化剂中密度相关氧还原行为的预测因子。使用约束磁化计算与朗道分析相结合，我们发现基态磁矩在广泛的金属位点密度范围内仅微弱变化，这表明仅磁描述符无法解释显着的性能变化。相比之下，显式溶剂模拟揭示了 PZC 中系统性的密度依赖性变化，这改变了界面电场，从而调节了 ORR 中间体的场敏感吸附能量。将这些 PZC 位移纳入 pH 场耦合微动力学模型可捕获密度依赖性活性趋势，并重现实验观察到的酸性条件下较低位点密度下双电子选择性的增加。实验性 PZC 测量结果进一步支持了预测的趋势。在所研究的 Co-N-C 和 Fe-N-C 系列中，依赖于 PZC 的静电始终使依赖于密度的 ORR 趋势合理化，而所检查的磁性描述符显示出相对较弱的变化。

articles.title: Shapiro steps of superfluid Fermi gases in a ring trap across the BCS--BEC crossover
articles.title_zh: 环形陷阱中超流费米气体的夏皮罗步骤跨越 BCS-BEC 交叉
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.17940v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the transport properties of a superfluid Fermi gas confined in a ring trap with a moving potential barrier across the Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) to Bose-Einstein condensate (BEC) crossover. Employing time-dependent Bogoliubov--de Gennes (BdG) equations, we simulate the dynamics of a Josephson junction biased by both DC and AC currents. Over a wide range of interaction strengths, the barrier-velocity dependence of the chemical potential difference exhibits low-order plateau structures, consistent with Shapiro steps, with fitted levels close to integer multiples of hbarω/2 within the phase-coherent regime. This factor of 1/2 reflects our convention of defining the chemical potential per single fermion in the BdG framework. Microscopic analysis reveals that these fundamental steps originate from synchronized phase slips mediated by periodic soliton generation at the barrier. Our findings clarify the role of interaction regimes in the nonequilibrium phase dynamics of ring-trapped fermionic superfluids and provide microscopic insights relevant to future studies of atomtronic systems with nontrivial topology.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了限制在环形陷阱中的超流费米气体的输运特性，该环形陷阱具有穿过巴丁-库珀-施里弗 (BCS) 到玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚态 (BEC) 交叉的移动势垒。采用与时间相关的 Bogoliubov-de Gennes (BdG) 方程，我们模拟了直流和交流电流偏置的约瑟夫森结的动力学。在广泛的相互作用强度范围内，化学势差的势垒速度依赖性表现出低阶平台结构，与夏皮罗步骤一致，在相位相干范围内拟合水平接近 hbarω/2 的整数倍。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了限制在环形陷阱中的超流费米气体的输运特性，该环形陷阱具有穿过巴丁-库珀-施里弗 (BCS) 到玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚态 (BEC) 交叉的移动势垒。采用与时间相关的 Bogoliubov-de Gennes (BdG) 方程，我们模拟了直流和交流电流偏置的约瑟夫森结的动力学。在广泛的相互作用强度范围内，化学势差的势垒速度依赖性表现出低阶平台结构，与夏皮罗步骤一致，在相位相干范围内拟合水平接近 hbarω/2 的整数倍。这个 1/2 因子反映了我们在 BdG 框架中定义每个费米子化学势的惯例。微观分析表明，这些基本步骤源于势垒处周期性孤子生成介导的同步相滑移。我们的研究结果阐明了相互作用机制在环俘获费米子超流体非平衡相动力学中的作用，并为具有非平凡拓扑的原子电子系统的未来研究提供了相关的微观见解。

articles.title: Hidden weak-pairing superconductivity of non-interacting anyons obeying 1/3 statistics
articles.title_zh: 服从 1/3 统计的非相互作用任意子的隐藏弱配对超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.19036v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We show that a non-interacting gas of charge-e/3 anyons with exchange statistics θ=-π/3 can superconduct through a hidden weak-pairing mechanism. Such an anyon gas arises naturally in doped fractional Chern insulators at filling 1/3 or 2/3, where projective lattice translations enforce three degenerate anyon pockets. Exploiting this three-pocket structure, we develop a flux-attachment construction in which the average statistical flux vanishes, thereby mapping the problem to three species of composite fermions (CFs) in zero effective magnetic field. We show that the anyon statistics itself, encoded in statistical gauge field fluctuations, supplies the pairing glue and drives the CFs into a p-ip paired state, which corresponds to a f-if physical superconductor. The CF strong-pairing phase is adiabatically connected to Laughlin's picture of anyon superconductivity, where charge-e/3 anyons bind into charge-2e/3 molecules, which then lead to superconductivity. By contrast, the more natural weak-pairing phase of CFs realizes a distinct superconducting phase - its edge is characterized by a chiral central charge c₋=-1/2, in contrast to the prediction of integer c₋ for the anyon superconductor based on Laughlin's picture, thereby resolving the discrepancy between previous theories and recent numerical results. Our theory provides a natural framework for understanding superconductivity near fractional Chern insulators, as observed in recent experiments. Finally, we discuss extensions of our theory that predict new chiral superconductors adjacent to FCIs at other fillings.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们证明，具有交换统计量 θ=-π/3 的电荷为 e/3 的任意子的非相互作用气体可以通过隐藏的弱配对机制实现超导。这种任意子气体在填充 1/3 或 2/3 的掺杂分数陈绝缘体中自然产生，其中射影晶格平移强制三个简并任意子袋。利用这种三口袋结构，我们开发了一种磁通附着结构，其中平均统计磁通消失，从而将问题映射到零有效磁场中的三种复合费米子（CF）。我们表明，以统计规范场涨落编码的任意子统计本身提供配对胶水并驱动 CF 进入 p-ip 配对状态，这对应于 f-if 物理超导体。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们证明，具有交换统计量 θ=-π/3 的电荷为 e/3 的任意子的非相互作用气体可以通过隐藏的弱配对机制实现超导。这种任意子气体在填充 1/3 或 2/3 的掺杂分数陈绝缘体中自然产生，其中射影晶格平移强制三个简并任意子袋。利用这种三口袋结构，我们开发了一种磁通附着结构，其中平均统计磁通消失，从而将问题映射到零有效磁场中的三种复合费米子（CF）。我们表明，以统计规范场涨落编码的任意子统计本身提供配对胶水并驱动 CF 进入 p-ip 配对状态，这对应于 f-if 物理超导体。 CF 强配对相与劳克林的任意子超导图绝热连接，其中电荷为 e/3 的任意子结合到电荷为 2e/3 的分子中，从而产生超导性。相比之下，CFs更自然的弱配对相实现了独特的超导相——其边缘以手性中心电荷c₋=-1/2为特征，这与基于劳克林图的任意子超导体的整数c₋的预测形成鲜明对比，从而解决了先前理论与最近数值结果之间的差异。正如最近的实验所观察到的，我们的理论为理解分数陈绝缘体附近的超导性提供了一个自然的框架。最后，我们讨论了我们的理论的扩展，该理论预测了与其他填充物中的 FCI 相邻的新手性超导体。

articles.title: High temperature Jahn-Teller distortion and short-range order in CsCuCl₃
articles.title_zh: CsCuCl₃ 中的高温 Jahn-Teller 畸变和短程有序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.28288v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: CsCuCl₃, chiral and Jahn-Teller distorted at room temperature, takes a more symmetric structure above 423 K. Describing this 'simpler' high temperature structure is far from simple and has been the subject of many, sometimes contradicting, studies. Here we reinvestigate the high temperature structure of CsCuCl₃, its thermal stability, and its effect on room temperature chirality. In situ pair distribution function data from powder neutron diffraction confirms that CsCuCl₃ is Jahn-Teller distorted both below and above T_c, and provides a quantitative view of short-range order in the high temperature structure. In situ powder x-ray diffraction shows that CsCuCl₃ does not undergo any additional structural changes above 423 K and is congruently melting. In situ single crystal x-ray diffraction experiments reveal that the phase transition induces domains of mixed handedness in originally homochiral crystals. These findings contribute to a better understanding of phase transitions in Jahn-Teller distorted compounds, and highlight the potential use of phase transitions to control chiral domains.
articles.abstract_zh: CsCuCl₃，手性和 Jahn-Teller 在室温下扭曲，在 423 K 以上具有更对称的结构。描述这种“更简单”的高温结构远非简单，并且一直是许多研究的主题，有时甚至是相互矛盾的。在这里，我们重新研究了 CsCuCl₃ 的高温结构、热稳定性及其对室温手性的影响。粉末中子衍射的原位对分布函数数据证实了 CsCuCl₃ 在低于和高于 T_c 时均发生 Jahn-Teller 畸变，并提供了高温结构中短程有序的定量视图。
articles.abstract_zh_full: CsCuCl₃，手性和 Jahn-Teller 在室温下扭曲，在 423 K 以上具有更对称的结构。描述这种“更简单”的高温结构远非简单，并且一直是许多研究的主题，有时甚至是相互矛盾的。在这里，我们重新研究了 CsCuCl₃ 的高温结构、热稳定性及其对室温手性的影响。粉末中子衍射的原位对分布函数数据证实了 CsCuCl₃ 在低于和高于 T_c 时均发生 Jahn-Teller 畸变，并提供了高温结构中短程有序的定量视图。原位粉末 X 射线衍射表明，CsCuCl₃ 在 423 K 以上不会发生任何额外的结构变化，并且会同成分熔化。原位单晶 X 射线衍射实验表明，相变在最初的纯手性晶体中引起了混合旋向域。这些发现有助于更好地理解 Jahn-Teller 扭曲化合物中的相变，并强调了相变控制手性域的潜在用途。

articles.title: Complexity of tensor network simulation for noisy quantum circuits
articles.title_zh: 噪声量子电路张量网络模拟的复杂性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00474v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We aim to rigorously address how local noise affects the classical simulability of quantum dynamics benchmarked by tensor-network methods.
