Using operator entanglement entropy (OEE) as a unifying criterion, we prove the following: (1) For single-qubit depolarizing noise, geometry-independent order1-layer and Θ(log n)-layer thresholds for fixed absolute and relative Hilbert--Schmidt error are established, beyond which polynomial bond dimension suffices; on 1D local circuits with a product initial input, whole-trajectory MPO approximations are constructed at fixed purified distance with poly(n) bond dimension. (2) For general single-qubit noise, we identify sufficient contractivity conditions for MPO approximations with constant bond dimension, in both the average and worst cases. (3) We further extend the above results to higher dimensions, yielding poly(n) average boundary-bond dimensions for projected entangled pair operators (PEPO) across every cut. Our results establish a rigorous connection between certain noise models, circuit types, and their classical simulability.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们的目标是严格解决局部噪声如何影响由张量网络方法基准测试的量子动力学的经典可模拟性。使用算子纠缠熵（ OEE ）作为统一准则，我们证明了以下内容： （ 1 ）对于单量子位去极化噪声，建立了固定绝对和相对Hilbert--Schmidt误差的几何无关序1层和θ （ log n ）层阈值，超过该阈值即可满足多项式键维数；在具有乘积初始输入的一维局部电路上，在具有poly （ n ）键维数的固定纯净距离上构造了全轨迹MPO近似。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们的目标是严格解决局部噪声如何影响由张量网络方法基准测试的量子动力学的经典可模拟性。使用算子纠缠熵（ OEE ）作为统一准则，我们证明了以下内容： （ 1 ）对于单量子位去极化噪声，建立了固定绝对和相对Hilbert--Schmidt误差的几何无关序1层和θ （ log n ）层阈值，超过该阈值即可满足多项式键维数；在具有乘积初始输入的一维局部电路上，在具有poly （ n ）键维数的固定纯净距离上构造了全轨迹MPO近似。（ 2 ）对于一般的单量子比特噪声，我们在平均和最差情况下都确定了具有恒定键维数的MPO近似的充分收缩性条件。（ 3 ）我们进一步将上述结果扩展到更高的维度，从而在每个切口上产生投影纠缠对算子（ PEPO ）的poly （ n ）平均边界键维度。我们的结果在某些噪声模型、电路类型及其经典可模拟性之间建立了严格的联系。

articles.title: Why Ammoniated Lithium Borohydrides Liquefy and Resolidify?
articles.title_zh: 为什么氨化硼氢化锂液化和再固化？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.01266v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Ammonia (NH₃) absorption drives LiBH₄· xNH₃ through a re-entrant ``solid--liquid--solid'' transition: LiBH₄·NH₃ is a well-defined solid ammoniate, compositions near LiBH₄· 2NH₃ are liquid-like or partially liquefied, whereas LiBH₄· 3NH₃ returns to a more rigid non-liquid ammoniate state. However, the microscopic origin of this unintuitive response remains a long-lasting mystery. Here, we uncover its mechanism. Cross-database analysis identifies borohydrides as a particularly state-diverse and composition-responsive material family. Structure prediction and ab initio molecular simulations reveal that increasing NH₃ loading increases the direct Li--N coordination number while progressively decreasing BH₄⁻-associated contacts in the local Li environment. Near x approx 2, these contributions are most balanced among the simulated compositions, and the sampled Li--N/NcdotsB coordination landscape is broadest. Further ammoniation produces Li--N-dominant coordination and slower BH₄⁻/NH₃ contact renewal, accompanying recovery of a more rigid ammoniate state. Pressure--composition isotherm, ¹H and ¹¹B nuclear magnetic resonance, and Raman measurements support this non-monotonic state evolution and associated BH₄⁻/NH₃ reorganization. These findings transform ammonia-induced liquefaction from an empirical phase anomaly into a competition between native-network disruption, mixed-coordination frustration, and ligand-built network reconstruction, providing a framework for chemically switching between transport-favouring fluidity and stability-favouring rigidity in hydrogen-rich materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 氨(NH ·)吸收通过凹入“固体-液体-固体”转变驱动LiBH · xNH · ： LiBH · NH ·是一种定义明确的固体氨化物， LiBH · 2NH ·附近的组合物呈液体状或部分液化，而LiBH · 3NH ·则返回到更刚性的非液体氨化状态。然而，这种不直观反应的微观起源仍然是一个长期的谜。在这里，我们揭示了它的机制。交叉数据库分析将硼氢化物确定为一种特别具有状态多样性和成分响应性的材料家族。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 氨(NH ·)吸收通过凹入“固体-液体-固体”转变驱动LiBH · xNH · ： LiBH · NH ·是一种定义明确的固体氨化物， LiBH · 2NH ·附近的组合物呈液体状或部分液化，而LiBH · 3NH ·则返回到更刚性的非液体氨化状态。然而，这种不直观反应的微观起源仍然是一个长期的谜。在这里，我们揭示了它的机制。交叉数据库分析将硼氢化物确定为一种特别具有状态多样性和成分响应性的材料家族。结构预测和从头分子模拟表明，在局部Li环境中，增加NH ”负载增加了直接Li-N配位数，同时逐渐减少了BH”相关的接触。在接近x约2的情况下，这些贡献在模拟成分中最为平衡，并且采样的Li-N/NcdotsB配位景观最为广泛。进一步氨化产生Li-N-显性配位和较慢的BH ”/NH”接触更新，伴随着更刚性的氨化状态的恢复。压力-组成等温线、¹ H和¹ ¹ B核磁共振以及拉曼测量支持这种非单调状态演变和相关的BH/NH重组。这些发现将氨诱导的液化从经验相异常转变为天然网络破坏、混合配位挫折和配体构建的网络重建之间的竞争，为富氢材料中有利于运输的流动性和有利于稳定性的刚性之间的化学转换提供了框架。

articles.title: Machine-Learning-Accelerated Metallene Stabilization from High-Throughput Sandwich Modeling
articles.title_zh: 高通量三明治建模的机器学习加速金属稳定
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.01779v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Metallenes have appealing properties, but stabilizing them in a monolayer phase poses synthesis challenges. A recent experiment showed that the van der Waals squeezing method can stabilize certain metallenes in a MoS2 sandwich. This pioneering work motivates systematic studies, but such studies are experimentally impractical, while first-principles modeling remains prohibitive. Here, using universal machine-learning interatomic potentials, we constructed 1620 metallene sandwich heterostructures containing 6 different sandwich layers and 45 metals. We performed phonon calculations, which revealed 1208 dynamically stable structures and narrowed them to 331 after structural filtering. We found that Se-based transition-metal dichalcogenides stabilize metallenes effectively. Specifically, hexagonal and buckled hexagonal crystal lattices exhibit the greatest stability. We further evaluated the thermal stability of selected heterostructures with density-functional theory molecular dynamics simulations at room temperature. By uncovering the physical and chemical factors that govern metallenes stabilization, our results provide systematic insights to guide and accelerate synthesis for future applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 金属具有吸引人的特性，但将其稳定在单层相中会带来合成挑战。最近的一项实验表明，范德华挤压法可以稳定MoS2夹层中的某些金属。这项开创性的工作激发了系统研究，但这些研究在实验上是不切实际的，而第一原理建模仍然令人望而却步。在这里，我们使用通用机器学习原子间电位，构建了1620个金属夹层异质结构，包含6个不同的夹层和45种金属。我们进行了声子计算，揭示了1208个动态稳定的结构，并在结构滤波后将其缩小到331个。我们发现硒基过渡金属二硫族化合物能有效地稳定金属。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 金属具有吸引人的特性，但将其稳定在单层相中会带来合成挑战。最近的一项实验表明，范德华挤压法可以稳定MoS2夹层中的某些金属。这项开创性的工作激发了系统研究，但这些研究在实验上是不切实际的，而第一原理建模仍然令人望而却步。在这里，我们使用通用机器学习原子间电位，构建了1620个金属夹层异质结构，包含6个不同的夹层和45种金属。我们进行了声子计算，揭示了1208个动态稳定的结构，并在结构滤波后将其缩小到331个。我们发现硒基过渡金属二硫族化合物能有效地稳定金属。具体而言，六边形和屈曲六边形晶格表现出最大的稳定性。我们进一步使用密度泛函理论分子动力学模拟在室温下评估了选定异质结构的热稳定性。通过揭示控制金属稳定性的物理和化学因素，我们的研究结果提供了系统的见解，以指导和加速未来应用的合成。

articles.title: Activity-Induced Structural and Dynamical Heterogeneity in Colloidal Gels
articles.title_zh: 胶体凝胶中活性诱导的结构和动力学异质性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.16553v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Active gels are intrinsically non-equilibrium materials whose structural and dynamical heterogeneity emerges from the interplay of attractive interactions, thermal fluctuations, and self-propulsion. We investigate a model active gel, simulated using large-scale Brownian dynamics simulations, to explore the effects of temperature T, active force strength f₀, persistence timescale τₚ, and active particle concentration ρₐ. We characterize the structure of the evolving gel network through morphological analysis, while dynamical changes are quantified by the relaxation timescale and dynamical heterogeneity (DH). We show that an optimal choice of activity parameters yields a percolating gel network with faster gelation and larger voids and clusters, enhancing mechanical stability. Conversely, the structural relaxation timescale and DH decrease with increasing activity, indicating enhanced particle rearrangements and reduced spatial correlations of mobile and immobile regions. An effective temperature (T_eff) framework for colloidal gels maps structural quantities and relaxation timescales in an active gel onto those of a passive gel. More interestingly, the growth of DH with increasing swim force can also be described by the same effective-temperature framework, in stark contrast to observations in active glasses. Our findings show that, in colloidal gels, temperature and active force compete, giving rise to similar structural ordering and, consequently, similar DH at the same T_eff. These findings highlight the crucial role of structural ordering in governing DH in active colloidal gels, as compared to active glasses.
articles.abstract_zh: 活性凝胶是本质上非平衡的材料，其结构和动态异质性来自有吸引力的相互作用、热波动和自推进的相互作用。我们研究了使用大规模布朗动力学模拟模拟的模型活性凝胶，以探索温度T、活性力强度f *、持续时间尺度τ *和活性颗粒浓度ρ *的影响。我们通过形态学分析来表征演化凝胶网络的结构，而动态变化则通过弛豫时间尺度和动态异质性（ DH ）来量化。我们表明，活性参数的最佳选择可产生具有更快凝胶化和更大空隙和簇的渗透凝胶网络，从而增强机械稳定性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 活性凝胶是本质上非平衡的材料，其结构和动态异质性来自有吸引力的相互作用、热波动和自推进的相互作用。我们研究了使用大规模布朗动力学模拟模拟的模型活性凝胶，以探索温度T、活性力强度f *、持续时间尺度τ *和活性颗粒浓度ρ *的影响。我们通过形态学分析来表征演化凝胶网络的结构，而动态变化则通过弛豫时间尺度和动态异质性（ DH ）来量化。我们表明，活性参数的最佳选择可产生具有更快凝胶化和更大空隙和簇的渗透凝胶网络，从而增强机械稳定性。相反，结构弛豫时间尺度和DH随着活性的增加而减少，这表明可移动和不可移动区域的粒子重排增强和空间相关性降低。胶体凝胶的有效温度（ T_eff ）框架将活性凝胶中的结构量和弛豫时间尺度映射到被动凝胶的结构量和弛豫时间尺度上。更有趣的是，随着游泳力的增加， DH的生长也可以用相同的有效温度框架来描述，这与活性眼镜中的观察形成鲜明对比。我们的研究结果表明，在胶体凝胶中，温度和主动力相互竞争，产生相似的结构有序性，因此在相同的T_eff下产生相似的DH。与活性眼镜相比，这些发现突出了结构有序性在活性胶体凝胶中调节DH的关键作用。

articles.title: Large-Tiny Spin-Stripe SDW Order in La₃Ni₂O₇ via ¹³⁹La-NQR Spectroscopy: Reconsideration Based on the Am2m Structure
articles.title_zh: 大-微小自旋条纹SDW顺序在La ”Ni ₂ O” via ¹ ³ ”La-NQR光谱中：基于Am2m结构的重新考虑
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20446v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The lower-symmetry Am2m structure was recently proposed as the intrinsic ambient-pressure phase of La₃Ni₂O₇ based on synchrotron x-ray diffraction, whereas earlier studies investigated its properties assuming the commonly accepted Amam structure. Here, we reexamine the crystal structure in La₃Ni₂O₇ and the spin configuration of spin-density-wave (SDW) state via ¹³⁹La nuclear quadrupole resonance (NQR). The observation of two distinct La(2) sites in the NQR spectra is naturally accounted for by the Am2m structure without any special assumptions, whereas it cannot be reconciled within the Amam framework. Within the Am2m framework, we reanalyze the spin configuration of the SDW phase and identify it as a large-tiny spin-stripe structure, arising naturally from two inequivalent Ni sites with large and tiny magnetic moments. These results establish the itinerant nature of the SDW order at ambient pressure in La₃Ni₂O₇, providing a basis for understanding its relationship to the emergence of high-T_c superconductivity under high pressure.
articles.abstract_zh: 较低对称的Am2m结构最近被提出为基于同步加速器X射线衍射的La ”Ni ₂ O”的固有环境压力相，而早期的研究则研究了其假设普遍接受的Amam结构的性质。在这里，我们通过¹ ³ ”La核四极共振（ NQR ）重新审视La” Ni ₂ O ”的晶体结构和自旋密度波（ SDW ）状态的自旋配置。NQR光谱中两个不同的La (2)位点的观测自然是由Am2m结构在没有任何特殊假设的情况下解释的，而它不能在Amam框架内调和。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 较低对称的Am2m结构最近被提出为基于同步加速器X射线衍射的La ”Ni ₂ O”的固有环境压力相，而早期的研究则研究了其假设普遍接受的Amam结构的性质。在这里，我们通过¹ ³ ”La核四极共振（ NQR ）重新审视La” Ni ₂ O ”的晶体结构和自旋密度波（ SDW ）状态的自旋配置。NQR光谱中两个不同的La (2)位点的观测自然是由Am2m结构在没有任何特殊假设的情况下解释的，而它不能在Amam框架内调和。在Am2m框架内，我们重新分析了SDW相的自旋配置，并将其识别为一个大而微小的自旋条纹结构，该结构由两个具有大而微小磁矩的不等价Ni位点自然产生。这些结果确立了SDW阶在环境压力下的流动性质，为理解其与高压下高T_c超导性的出现之间的关系提供了基础。

articles.title: Reduced Order Hysteretic Magnetization Model for Composite Superconductors
articles.title_zh: 复合超导体减阶迟滞磁化模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2409.13653v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In this paper, we propose the Reduced Order Hysteretic Magnetization (ROHM) model to describe the magnetization and instantaneous power loss of composite superconductors subject to time-varying magnetic fields. Once the parameters of the ROHM model are fixed based on reference simulations, it allows to directly compute the macroscopic response of composite superconductors without the need to solve the detailed current density distribution. It can then be used as part of a homogenization method in large-scale superconducting models to significantly reduce the computational effort compared to detailed simulations. In this contribution, we focus on the case of a strand with twisted superconducting filaments subject to a time-varying transverse magnetic field. We propose two variations of the ROHM model: (i) a rate-independent model that reproduces hysteresis in the filaments, and (ii) a rate-dependent model that generalizes the first level by also reproducing dynamic effects due to coupling and eddy currents. We then describe the implementation and inclusion of the ROHM model in a finite element framework, discuss how to deduce the model parameters, and finally demonstrate the capabilities of the approach in terms of accuracy and efficiency over a wide range of excitation frequencies and amplitudes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了还原阶滞后磁化强度（ ROHM ）模型来描述复合超导体在时变磁场作用下的磁化强度和瞬时功率损失。一旦基于参考模拟确定了ROHM模型的参数，它就可以直接计算复合超导体的宏观响应，而无需求解详细的电流密度分布。然后，它可以作为大规模超导模型中均匀化方法的一部分，与详细模拟相比，显着减少计算量。在本文中，我们重点介绍了具有扭曲超导细丝的股线受到时变横向磁场的情况。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文提出了还原阶滞后磁化强度（ ROHM ）模型来描述复合超导体在时变磁场作用下的磁化强度和瞬时功率损失。一旦基于参考模拟确定了ROHM模型的参数，它就可以直接计算复合超导体的宏观响应，而无需求解详细的电流密度分布。然后，它可以作为大规模超导模型中均匀化方法的一部分，与详细模拟相比，显着减少计算量。在本文中，我们重点介绍了具有扭曲超导细丝的股线受到时变横向磁场的情况。我们提出了罗姆模型的两种变体： （ i ）再现细丝中滞后的速率无关模型，以及（ ii ）通过再现由耦合和涡流引起的动态效应来推广第一级的速率相关模型。然后，我们描述了ROHM模型在有限元框架中的实现和包含，讨论了如何推导模型参数，并最终演示了该方法在宽激励频率和幅度范围内的精度和效率方面的能力。

articles.title: Antiferromagnetic Long-Range Order in a Lattice Fermion Model
articles.title_zh: 格子费米子模型中的反铁磁远程有序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.12421v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study a lattice fermion model with antiferromagnetic interactions on the three-dimensional cubic lattice. The hopping term of the Hamiltonian has a Weyl-type dispersion. We prove that the model has reflection positivity. Moreover, by relying on the property, we prove the existence of the antiferromagnetic long-range order at low temperatures in a strong coupling regime.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了三维立方晶格上具有反铁磁相互作用的晶格费米子模型。Hamiltonian的跳跃项具有Weyl型色散。我们证明了模型具有反射正性。此外，依靠该性质，我们证明了强耦合条件下低温下反铁磁远程有序的存在。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了三维立方晶格上具有反铁磁相互作用的晶格费米子模型。Hamiltonian的跳跃项具有Weyl型色散。我们证明了模型具有反射正性。此外，依靠该性质，我们证明了强耦合条件下低温下反铁磁远程有序的存在。

articles.title: Tree tensor network states represent low-energy states faithfully
articles.title_zh: 树张量网络状态忠实地表示低能量状态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.20215v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Extending corresponding results for matrix product states [Verstraete and Cirac, PRB 73, 094423 (2006); Schuch et al. PRL 100, 030504 (2008)], it is shown how the approximation error of tree tensor network states (TTNS) can be bounded using Schmidt spectra or Rényi entanglement entropies of the target quantum state. Conversely, one obtains bounds on TTNS bond dimensions needed to achieve a specific approximation accuracy. The result implies that efficient TTNS approximations exist if α<1 Rényi entanglement entropies for single-branch cuts obey an area law, as in ground and low-energy states of certain gapped systems on tree graphs.
articles.abstract_zh: 扩展基质产品状态的相应结果[Verstraete and Cirac, PRB 73, 094423 (2006); Schuch et al. PRL 100, 030504 (2008)] ，展示了如何使用目标量子态的施密特谱或Rényi纠缠熵来界定树张量网络状态（ TTNS ）的近似误差。相反，人们获得实现特定逼近精度所需的TTNS键尺寸的界限。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 扩展基质产品状态的相应结果[Verstraete and Cirac, PRB 73, 094423 (2006); Schuch et al. PRL 100, 030504 (2008)] ，展示了如何使用目标量子态的施密特谱或Rényi纠缠熵来界定树张量网络状态（ TTNS ）的近似误差。相反，人们获得实现特定逼近精度所需的TTNS键尺寸的界限。结果表明，如果单分支切割的α < 1 Rényi纠缠熵遵循面积定律，则存在有效的TTNS近似，如树图上某些间隙系统的地面和低能态。

articles.title: Cost scaling of MPS and TTNS simulations for 2D and 3D systems with area-law entanglement
articles.title_zh: 使用面积法则纠缠的2D和3D系统的MPS和TTNS模拟的成本缩放
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.08132v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Tensor network states are an indispensable tool for the simulation of strongly correlated quantum many-body systems. In recent years, tree tensor network states (TTNS) have been successfully used for two-dimensional systems and to benchmark quantum simulation approaches for condensed matter, nuclear, and particle physics. In comparison to the more traditional approach based on matrix product states (MPS), the graph distance of physical degrees of freedom can be drastically reduced in TTNS. Surprisingly, it turns out that, for large systems in D>1 spatial dimensions, MPS simulations of low-energy states are nevertheless more efficient than TTNS simulations. With a focus on D=2 and 3, the scaling of computational costs for different boundary conditions is determined under the assumption that the system obeys an entanglement (log-)area law, implying that bond dimensions scale exponentially in the interface area of the associated subsystems.
articles.abstract_zh: 张量网络状态是模拟强相关量子多体系统不可或缺的工具。近年来，树张量网络状态（ TTNS ）已成功用于二维系统，并为凝聚态、核和粒子物理学的量子模拟方法提供基准。与更传统的基于矩阵乘积状态（ MPS ）的方法相比， TTNS中的物理自由度图距离可以大大降低。令人惊讶的是，对于D > 1空间维的大型系统，低能态的MPS模拟仍然比TTNS模拟更有效。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 张量网络状态是模拟强相关量子多体系统不可或缺的工具。近年来，树张量网络状态（ TTNS ）已成功用于二维系统，并为凝聚态、核和粒子物理学的量子模拟方法提供基准。与更传统的基于矩阵乘积状态（ MPS ）的方法相比， TTNS中的物理自由度图距离可以大大降低。令人惊讶的是，对于D > 1空间维的大型系统，低能态的MPS模拟仍然比TTNS模拟更有效。以D = 2和3为重点，在假设系统服从纠缠（对数）面积定律的情况下确定不同边界条件的计算成本的缩放，这意味着键维度在相关子系统的界面区域中呈指数级缩放。

articles.title: Correlation-consistent Gaussian basis sets for copper solids from material-constrained atomic optimization
articles.title_zh: 来自受材料约束的原子优化的铜固体的相关一致高斯基集
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.11711v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Correlation-consistent Gaussian basis sets are central to systematic molecular quantum chemistry, but their direct use in periodic solids is often limited by severe linear dependence from diffuse atomically optimized primitives. This problem is particularly acute for metallic and metal-containing systems, where reliable complete-basis-set (CBS) extrapolation is needed for correlated-wavefunction benchmarks. We introduce material-constrained atomic optimization (MCAO), a basis-set optimization framework that preserves the atomic and correlation-consistent character of Gaussian basis sets while penalizing large overlap-matrix condition numbers in representative solids. As a proof of concept, we generate Dunning-style MCAO-cc-pVXZ basis sets (X = D, T, Q) for Cu with all-electron, scalar-relativistic all-electron, effective core potential (ECP), and pseudopotential treatments. The resulting basis sets remain numerically stable for Cu solids and surfaces while reproducing molecular Cu dimer energetics and plane-wave reference properties of bulk Cu. CBS-extrapolated random-phase approximation calculations further enable a controlled assessment of pseudopotential, relativistic, and basis-set errors in bulk Cu and CO adsorption on Cu(111), providing scalar-relativistic all-electron Gaussian-basis benchmarks for the CO adsorption puzzle.
articles.abstract_zh: 相关一致性高斯基集是系统分子量子化学的核心，但它们在周期固体中的直接使用通常受到扩散原子优化原语的严重线性依赖性的限制。对于金属和含金属的系统，这个问题尤其严重，因为相关波函数基准需要可靠的完全基集（ CBS ）外推。我们引入了受材料约束的原子优化（ MCAO ） ，这是一种基集优化框架，它保留了高斯基集的原子和相关一致性，同时惩罚了代表性固体中的大重叠矩阵条件数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 相关一致性高斯基集是系统分子量子化学的核心，但它们在周期固体中的直接使用通常受到扩散原子优化原语的严重线性依赖性的限制。对于金属和含金属的系统，这个问题尤其严重，因为相关波函数基准需要可靠的完全基集（ CBS ）外推。我们引入了受材料约束的原子优化（ MCAO ） ，这是一种基集优化框架，它保留了高斯基集的原子和相关一致性，同时惩罚了代表性固体中的大重叠矩阵条件数。作为概念证明，我们使用全电子、标量相对论全电子、有效核电位（ ECP ）和伪电位处理为Cu生成Dunning风格的MCAO-cc-pVXZ基集（ X = D、T、Q ）。所得的基准集对于Cu固体和表面保持数值稳定，同时再现本体Cu的分子Cu二聚体能量和平面波参考特性。CBS外推随机相位逼近计算进一步实现了对Cu (111)上本体Cu和CO吸附的伪电位、相对论和基准集误差的受控评估，为CO吸附谜题提供了标量相对论全电子高斯基准基准。

articles.title: Stochastic Ising networks with asymmetric and time-delayed interactions
articles.title_zh: 具有非对称和延时相互作用的随机Ising网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.15215v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Stochastic Ising networks are widely used to describe collective dynamics in complex systems and to compute, yet physical implementations of these networks often contain both asymmetric interactions and nonzero signal propagation times that fall outside conventional theories of their behavior. Here, we study stochastic Ising networks with asymmetric and time-delayed interactions motivated by experimental observations in coupled superparamagnetic tunnel junctions. Time delay fundamentally reshapes the dynamics induced by antisymmetric couplings, producing strong oscillatory temporal correlations consistent with experiment. Sufficiently long delays strongly suppress the non-uniformity of steady-state probability distributions, a behavior explained by an exponential suppression of the first-order equal-time cross-correlation between pairs of spins. Residual non-uniformity is due to the equal-time cross-correlation mediated by a third spin that contributes only at higher order in the coupling strength. These relatively featureless probability distributions coexist with pronounced delayed temporal correlations, distinguishing them from equilibrium high-temperature behavior. We further show analytically that these delay-induced near-uniform distributions emerge in a broad class of stochastic networks that lack symmetry-breaking bias fields. Introducing symmetry-breaking bias fields restores a strong dependence of the steady state on interactions with qualitatively modified behavior. Simulations of networks with five coupled spins demonstrate that these effects persist beyond minimal systems with only two spins.
articles.abstract_zh: 随机Ising网络被广泛用于描述复杂系统中的集体动力学和计算，但这些网络的物理实现通常包含非对称相互作用和非零信号传播时间，超出了其行为的传统理论。在这里，我们研究了由耦合超顺磁隧道结中的实验观测所激发的具有非对称和时间延迟相互作用的随机Ising网络。时间延迟从根本上重塑了由反对称耦合引起的动力学，产生了与实验一致的强振荡时间相关性。足够长的延迟强烈抑制了稳态概率分布的不均匀性，这种行为通过对自旋对之间的一阶等时间互相关的指数抑制来解释。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 随机Ising网络被广泛用于描述复杂系统中的集体动力学和计算，但这些网络的物理实现通常包含非对称相互作用和非零信号传播时间，超出了其行为的传统理论。在这里，我们研究了由耦合超顺磁隧道结中的实验观测所激发的具有非对称和时间延迟相互作用的随机Ising网络。时间延迟从根本上重塑了由反对称耦合引起的动力学，产生了与实验一致的强振荡时间相关性。足够长的延迟强烈抑制了稳态概率分布的不均匀性，这种行为通过对自旋对之间的一阶等时间互相关的指数抑制来解释。残余非均匀性是由于第三次自旋介导的等时间互相关，该自旋仅在耦合强度中较高阶上起作用。这些相对无特征的概率分布与明显的延迟时间相关性共存，将它们与平衡高温行为区分开来。我们进一步分析表明，这些延迟诱导的近均匀分布出现在缺乏对称打破偏置场的广泛类别的随机网络中。引入打破对称的偏置场恢复了稳态对具有定性修饰行为的相互作用的强烈依赖性。具有五个耦合自旋的网络的模拟表明，这些效应仅在两次自旋的情况下持续存在于最小系统之外。

articles.title: Quantum estimates for classical polynomial optimization
articles.title_zh: 经典多项式优化的量子估计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25445v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The problem of finding lower and upper bounds on multivariate homogeneous polynomials is both difficult and important given its applications to questions ranging from dynamical stability in complex potential landscapes to data analysis. From the standpoint of tensor eigenvalue theory, the question is equivalent to finding the smallest and the largest eigenvalues of the coefficient tensor corresponding to the given polynomial. Standard approaches outlined in the literature amount to running nonlinear iterations in search for the optimal rays along which the growth of the polynomial is fastest or slowest. Unlike the case of matrices (or their corresponding multivariate quadratic forms) convergence of such algorithms for higher-rank tensors is capricious due to the complex topography of polynomial objective functions. In this essay, a very different strategy, inspired by quantum-mechanical variational methods, is introduced for finding bounds on polynomials. The original polynomial is replaced by an operator acting in a suitably chosen (large) space of states, such that in an appropriate "classical" limit this operator approaches the original polynomial expression made of commutative variables. As a result, approximating the smallest and largest eigenvalues of the coefficient tensor, and thus finding bounds on polynomials, amounts to diagonalizing the resulting quantum operator, represented as a large matrix, and then inspecting the smallest and largest eigenvalues of this matrix. This approach is then successfully applied to standard test examples from tensor eigenvalue literature and other problems of interest in mathematical physics including Strichartz-type inequalities.
articles.abstract_zh: 考虑到多元齐次多项式的应用范围从复杂潜在景观的动态稳定性到数据分析等问题，寻找多元齐次多项式的下界和上限问题既困难又重要。从张量特征值理论的角度来看，这个问题相当于找到给定多项式对应的系数张量的最小和最大特征值。文献中概述的标准方法相当于运行非线性迭代来搜索多项式增长最快或最慢的最佳射线。与矩阵（或其相应的多元二次形式）的情况不同，由于多项式目标函数的复杂拓扑，此类算法对于高阶张量的收敛是反复无常的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 考虑到多元齐次多项式的应用范围从复杂潜在景观的动态稳定性到数据分析等问题，寻找多元齐次多项式的下界和上限问题既困难又重要。从张量特征值理论的角度来看，这个问题相当于找到给定多项式对应的系数张量的最小和最大特征值。文献中概述的标准方法相当于运行非线性迭代来搜索多项式增长最快或最慢的最佳射线。与矩阵（或其相应的多元二次形式）的情况不同，由于多项式目标函数的复杂拓扑，此类算法对于高阶张量的收敛是反复无常的。在本文中，受量子力学变分方法的启发，引入了一种非常不同的策略来寻找多项式的界限。原始多项式被在适当选择的（大）状态空间中作用的算子所取代，使得在适当的“经典”限制下，该算子接近由交换变量组成的原始多项式表达式。因此，逼近系数张量的最小和最大特征值，从而找到多项式的界限，相当于对角化所得量子算子（表示为大矩阵），然后检查该矩阵的最小和最大特征值。然后，该方法成功应用于张量特征值文献中的标准测试示例以及数学物理中其他感兴趣的问题（包括 Strichartz 型不等式）。

articles.title: Quantum Magnonics: Quantum States Generation and Applications
articles.title_zh: 量子磁学：量子态生成和应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27771v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Hybrid systems based on magnons in ferromagnetic materials, such as yttrium iron garnet, have achieved remarkable development in the last decade. These include the coupling of magnons to microwave and optical photons, superconducting qubits, phonons, spins, the center-of-mass motion of a ferromagnet, etc. Here, we review both the experimental and theoretical progress in this field, focusing on the generation of magnonic quantum states and their applications in a broad range of fields. Since the strong coupling is a prerequisite for achieving coherent quantum control of magnons and preparing magnonic quantum states, we start by introducing representative strong-coupling experiments in cavity magnonics, then review a series of protocols for creating various magnonic quantum states, such as Fock, cat, squeezed, and entangled states, and discuss their potential applications in macroscopic quantum studies, quantum information science, quantum sensing, magnonic quantum devices, dark matter detection, and so on. Finally, we summarize the review and give an outlook for the future study of quantum magnonics.
articles.abstract_zh: 基于铁磁材料（例如钇铁石榴石）磁振子的混合系统在过去十年中取得了显着的发展。其中包括磁子与微波和光学光子的耦合、超导量子位、声子、自旋、铁磁体的质心运动等。在这里，我们回顾了该领域的实验和理论进展，重点关注磁子量子态的生成及其在广泛领域中的应用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于铁磁材料（例如钇铁石榴石）磁振子的混合系统在过去十年中取得了显着的发展。其中包括磁子与微波和光学光子的耦合、超导量子位、声子、自旋、铁磁体的质心运动等。在这里，我们回顾了该领域的实验和理论进展，重点关注磁子量子态的生成及其在广泛领域中的应用。由于强耦合是实现磁子相干量子控制和制备波波子量子态的先决条件，因此我们首先介绍腔波子学中具有代表性的强耦合实验，然后回顾一系列用于创建各种波波子量子态的协议，例如福克、猫、压缩和纠缠态，并讨论它们在宏观量子研究、量子信息科学、量子传感、波波子器件、暗物质探测等方面的潜在应用。最后，我们总结了综述并对量子磁子学的未来研究进行了展望。

articles.title: Electron Kinetics in the Sheath of Atmospheric Pressure Plasmas in Helium and Helium:H₂O Vapor
articles.title_zh: 氦和氦：H2O 蒸气中大气压等离子体鞘层中的电子动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05653v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The electron energy distribution function (EEDF) plays a central role in determining the rates of electron-induced reactions in the bulk plasma, the sheath, and at the plasma-surface interface. However, the electron kinetics within the sheath and near the surface are generally not well described by conventional Boltzmann solvers, which neglect the sheath electric field and electron losses to the surface. In this study, we investigate electron kinetics in atmospheric pressure plasmas in pure helium and helium-water vapor mixtures using a hybrid model that combines a fluid description of the collisional sheath with a particle kinetic Monte Carlo model for electrons. The floating wall potential is determined taking into account electron diffusion through the sheath and the non-Maxwellian EEDF. Our results demonstrate that electron kinetics within the sheath can exhibit both local and nonlocal behavior, even at atmospheric pressure. The transition between these regimes is governed primarily by the ratio of the electron energy relaxation length to the sheath thickness. At high plasma densities, where the sheath thickness becomes smaller than the electron energy relaxation length, the EEDFs approach the nonlocal limit, exhibiting significant changes in electron kinetic energy toward the wall. The addition of water vapor reduces the energy relaxation length and shifts the electron kinetics toward the local regime. In the nonlocal regime, the electron mean kinetic energy decreases substantially toward the wall, accompanied by reductions of more than an order of magnitude in electron-impact excitation and ionization rate coefficients. These findings demonstrate that modeling of electron-induced processes in the sheath and at plasma-surface interfaces requires accounting for nonlocal electron kinetics and electron losses to the surface, even at atmospheric pressure.
articles.abstract_zh: 电子能量分布函数 (EEDF) 在确定本体等离子体、鞘层和等离子体表面界面中电子诱发反应的速率方面发挥着核心作用。然而，传统的玻尔兹曼求解器通常不能很好地描述鞘层内和表面附近的电子动力学，它忽略了鞘层电场和表面的电子损失。在这项研究中，我们使用混合模型研究了纯氦和氦-水蒸气混合物中大气压等离子体中的电子动力学，该混合模型将碰撞鞘的流体描述与电子的粒子动力学蒙特卡罗模型相结合。浮壁电势的确定考虑了电子通过鞘层的扩散和非麦克斯韦 EEDF。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电子能量分布函数 (EEDF) 在确定本体等离子体、鞘层和等离子体表面界面中电子诱发反应的速率方面发挥着核心作用。然而，传统的玻尔兹曼求解器通常不能很好地描述鞘层内和表面附近的电子动力学，它忽略了鞘层电场和表面的电子损失。在这项研究中，我们使用混合模型研究了纯氦和氦-水蒸气混合物中大气压等离子体中的电子动力学，该混合模型将碰撞鞘的流体描述与电子的粒子动力学蒙特卡罗模型相结合。浮壁电势的确定考虑了电子通过鞘层的扩散和非麦克斯韦 EEDF。我们的结果表明，即使在大气压下，鞘层内的电子动力学也可以表现出局域和非局域行为。这些状态之间的转变主要由电子能量弛豫长度与鞘层厚度的比率控制。在高等离子体密度下，当鞘层厚度变得小于电子能量弛豫长度时，EEDF 接近非局部极限，表现出朝向壁的电子动能的显着变化。水蒸气的添加减少了能量弛豫长度并将电子动力学转向局部状态。在非局域区域，电子平均动能朝着壁面大幅减小，同时电子碰撞激发和电离速率系数减小一个数量级以上。这些发现表明，即使在大气压下，对鞘层和等离子体表面界面处的电子诱导过程进行建模也需要考虑非局域电子动力学和表面电子损失。

articles.title: A physics-informed neural network method for pressure-driven turbine-blade optimization
articles.title_zh: 用于压力驱动涡轮叶片优化的物理信息神经网络方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05691v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a physics-informed method for aerodynamic shape optimisation of turbine blades, treating the flow field and blade geometry as coupled unknowns. The method translates prescribed surface-pressure distributions into geometric modifications through pressure-target continuation and alternating flow-geometry updates. A differentiable representation of the blade surfaces allows their positions and orientations to be optimised within the current flow field, followed by flow re-adaptation to the modified boundaries. The inverse formulation uses the two-dimensional steady compressible Euler equations as physics constraints and is evaluated on the LS89 turbine cascade using 28 pressure-target points derived from experimental data. Starting from a modified profile and a warm-started flow network, the final pressure-side and suction-side root-mean-square fitting errors are 1.13% and 2.21% of inlet total pressure, respectively. Independent forward verification with SharC reproduces the principal surface-pressure trends of the experimental measurements, with remaining differences near the trailing edge. These results demonstrate the translation of experimental-origin loading data into geometric blade modifications through coordinated optimisation of the flow field and moving boundaries.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们开发了一种基于物理的方法来优化涡轮叶片的空气动力学形状，将流场和叶片几何形状视为耦合未知数。该方法通过压力目标延续和交替流动几何更新将规定的表面压力分布转化为几何修改。叶片表面的可微分表示允许它们的位置和方向在当前流场内得到优化，然后流动重新适应修改后的边界。反演公式使用二维稳定可压缩欧拉方程作为物理约束，并使用从实验数据导出的 28 个压力目标点在 LS89 涡轮叶栅上进行评估。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们开发了一种基于物理的方法来优化涡轮叶片的空气动力学形状，将流场和叶片几何形状视为耦合未知数。该方法通过压力目标延续和交替流动几何更新将规定的表面压力分布转化为几何修改。叶片表面的可微分表示允许它们的位置和方向在当前流场内得到优化，然后流动重新适应修改后的边界。反演公式使用二维稳定可压缩欧拉方程作为物理约束，并使用从实验数据导出的 28 个压力目标点在 LS89 涡轮叶栅上进行评估。从修改后的剖面和热启动的流动网络开始，最终的压力侧和吸力侧均方根拟合误差分别为入口总压力的 1.13% 和 2.21%。使用 SharC 进行的独立前向验证再现了实验测量的主要表面压力趋势，但在后缘附近仍存在差异。这些结果表明，通过流场和移动边界的协调优化，可以将实验原始载荷数据转化为几何叶片修改。

articles.title: Sympathetic Cooling of Ionic Fullerenes with Ultracold Atoms to Millikelvin Temperatures
articles.title_zh: 用超冷原子交感冷却离子富勒烯至毫开尔文温度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05815v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cooling complex molecular ions to millikelvin temperatures remains a major challenge because their intricate internal structures prevent laser cooling. Here, we propose to use an ultracold gas of Cd atoms to efficiently cool C₆₀⁺ ions to average kinetic energies of approximately 20 mK, following an initial precooling stage with He buffer gas. Our approach is based on full molecular dynamics simulations using accurate ion-atom interaction potentials derived from high-level electronic structure methods. Furthermore, using a Monte Carlo approach, we predict the formation of C₆₀⁺ Coulomb crystals supported solely by collisions with the buffer gas. The probability of reaching these cold states shows a pronounced dependence on the number of trapped ions, revealing the competition between neutral-atom cooling and many-ion dynamics in radio-frequency traps.
articles.abstract_zh: 将复杂分子离子冷却至毫开尔文温度仍然是一个重大挑战，因为它们复杂的内部结构阻碍了激光冷却。在这里，我们建议使用 Cd 原子的超冷气体来有效地将 C₆₀⁺ 离子冷却到平均动能约为 20 mK，然后使用 He 缓冲气体进行初始预冷却阶段。我们的方法基于完整的分子动力学模拟，使用源自高级电子结构方法的精确离子-原子相互作用势。此外，使用蒙特卡罗方法，我们预测仅由与缓冲气体的碰撞支持的 C₆₀⁺ 库仑晶体的形成。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 将复杂分子离子冷却至毫开尔文温度仍然是一个重大挑战，因为它们复杂的内部结构阻碍了激光冷却。在这里，我们建议使用 Cd 原子的超冷气体来有效地将 C₆₀⁺ 离子冷却到平均动能约为 20 mK，然后使用 He 缓冲气体进行初始预冷却阶段。我们的方法基于完整的分子动力学模拟，使用源自高级电子结构方法的精确离子-原子相互作用势。此外，使用蒙特卡罗方法，我们预测仅由与缓冲气体的碰撞支持的 C₆₀⁺ 库仑晶体的形成。达到这些冷状态的概率显示出对捕获离子数量的明显依赖，揭示了射频陷阱中中性原子冷却和多离子动力学之间的竞争。

articles.title: Spontaneous Enhancement of Inward Impurity Pinch during Massive Impurity Injection in Tokamak Plasmas
articles.title_zh: 托卡马克等离子体中大量杂质注入期间内向杂质箍缩的自发增强
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05850v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A spontaneous enhancement of inward impurity pinch is identified prior to the fast quench under massive impurity injection on the EAST tokamak. The transition is marked by a rapid shift of the magnetic-island rotation frequency toward the electron diamagnetic direction within a few hundred microseconds. An extended KDG model shows that the impurity-induced increase in bulk ion collisionality can drive a transition across banana regime, nonlinearly modifying the parallel viscosity and producing a radial electric field excursion of approximately -10 kV/m, consistent with experiment. The associated self-organized response of the plasma flow and electrostatic potential can modify the parallel friction and further strengthen the neoclassical inward impurity pinch. Projections for ITER disruption mitigation suggest that this mechanism is expected to enhance impurity penetration, thereby improving the overall effectiveness of mitigation.
articles.abstract_zh: 在 EAST 托卡马克上大量杂质注入下快速淬火之前，发现了向内杂质箍缩的自发增强。这种转变的标志是磁岛旋转频率在几百微秒内向电子反磁方向快速转变。扩展的 KDG 模型表明，杂质引起的体离子碰撞性增加可以驱动香蕉状态的转变，非线性地修改平行粘度并产生约 -10 kV/m 的径向电场偏移，与实验一致。等离子体流和静电势的相关自组织响应可以改变平行摩擦并进一步加强新古典向内杂质箍缩。 ITER 干扰缓解的预测表明，这种机制有望增强杂质渗透，从而提高缓解的整体有效性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在 EAST 托卡马克上大量杂质注入下快速淬火之前，发现了向内杂质箍缩的自发增强。这种转变的标志是磁岛旋转频率在几百微秒内向电子反磁方向快速转变。扩展的 KDG 模型表明，杂质引起的体离子碰撞性增加可以驱动香蕉状态的转变，非线性地修改平行粘度并产生约 -10 kV/m 的径向电场偏移，与实验一致。等离子体流和静电势的相关自组织响应可以改变平行摩擦并进一步加强新古典向内杂质箍缩。 ITER 干扰缓解的预测表明，这种机制有望增强杂质渗透，从而提高缓解的整体有效性。

articles.title: Optical angular momentum and pseudospin-orbit coupling in photonic graphene
articles.title_zh: 光子石墨烯中的光学角动量和赝自旋轨道耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05944v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the dynamics of structured laser beams carrying angular momentum (AM) as they undergo conical diffraction in photonic graphene. Using a combination of numerical simulations and analytical calculations, we demonstrate a surprising result: the beam's orbital AM tracks the dynamics of the lattice pseudospin rather than the AM of its slowly varying envelope. This finding provides evidence that pseudospin behaves as a genuine form of angular momentum. Furthermore, we explore beam propagation in staggered honeycomb lattices governed by the massive Dirac equation, revealing that the orbital AM is highly sensitive to both the band gap size and the envelope's initial AM. We explain our numerical results by drawing an analogy with the orbital magnetization of electrons.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了携带角动量 (AM) 的结构化激光束在光子石墨烯中经历锥形衍射时的动力学。通过数值模拟和分析计算的结合，我们展示了一个令人惊讶的结果：光束的轨道 AM 跟踪晶格赝自旋的动力学，而不是其缓慢变化的包络线的 AM。这一发现提供了证据表明赝自旋表现为角动量的真正形式。此外，我们探索了由大狄拉克方程控制的交错蜂窝晶格中的光束传播，揭示了轨道AM对带隙尺寸和包络的初始AM高度敏感。我们通过与电子轨道磁化强度的类比来解释我们的数值结果。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了携带角动量 (AM) 的结构化激光束在光子石墨烯中经历锥形衍射时的动力学。通过数值模拟和分析计算的结合，我们展示了一个令人惊讶的结果：光束的轨道 AM 跟踪晶格赝自旋的动力学，而不是其缓慢变化的包络线的 AM。这一发现提供了证据表明赝自旋表现为角动量的真正形式。此外，我们探索了由大狄拉克方程控制的交错蜂窝晶格中的光束传播，揭示了轨道AM对带隙尺寸和包络的初始AM高度敏感。我们通过与电子轨道磁化强度的类比来解释我们的数值结果。

articles.title: Subtle Energy Corrections Reshape Condensed-Phase Property Predictions from a Machine-Learning Interatomic Potential
articles.title_zh: 微妙的能量修正重塑了机器学习原子间势的凝聚相性质预测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06109v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate reproduction of electronic-structure labels by machine-learning interatomic potentials does not necessarily ensure reliable condensed-phase properties. We investigate the effects of basis-set superposition error (BSSE) and an explicit Axilrod-Teller-Muto (ATM) three-body dispersion contribution on molecular-liquid predictions. Starting from MACELES-OFF, we fine-tune a baseline potential at the ωB97M-V/def2-TZVPD level. A separate branch learns counterpoise (CP) energy and force corrections with the baseline frozen, while a D4-parametrized ATM term is added during molecular-dynamics inference. Mean atom-normalized CP and ATM contributions are 0.222 and 0.205 meV/atom, respectively, for the analyzed SPICE2 configurations from OMol25. We compare baseline, CP-only, ATM-only, and CP + ATM variants for 39 organic liquids. Relative to baseline, the mean system-wise density changes are -1.17%, -10.38%, and -11.93% for CP-only, ATM-only, and CP + ATM, respectively; the corresponding enthalpy-of-vaporization changes are -2.79%, -14.74%, and -18.32%. For the 11 liquids with experimental self-diffusion data, the mean self-diffusion changes are +17.66%, +203.02%, and +230.36%. Both corrections thus lower density and enthalpy of vaporization while increasing molecular mobility on average. ATM dominates these changes, while CP provides a smaller contribution; their combination yields the largest average shifts. These results show that corrections with sub-meV/atom mean values on the analyzed configurations can substantially reshape the predicted structural, thermodynamic, and transport properties of molecular liquids.
articles.abstract_zh: 通过机器学习原子间势准确再现电子结构标签并不一定能确保可靠的凝聚相特性。我们研究了基组叠加误差 (BSSE) 和显式 Axilrod-Teller-Muto (ATM) 三体色散贡献对分子液体预测的影响。从 MACELES-OFF 开始，我们在 ωB97M-V/def2-TZVPD 水平上微调基线电位。一个单独的分支在基线冻结的情况下学习平衡 (CP) 能量和力校正，同时在分子动力学推理过程中添加 D4 参数化 ATM 项。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通过机器学习原子间势准确再现电子结构标签并不一定能确保可靠的凝聚相特性。我们研究了基组叠加误差 (BSSE) 和显式 Axilrod-Teller-Muto (ATM) 三体色散贡献对分子液体预测的影响。从 MACELES-OFF 开始，我们在 ωB97M-V/def2-TZVPD 水平上微调基线电位。一个单独的分支在基线冻结的情况下学习平衡 (CP) 能量和力校正，同时在分子动力学推理过程中添加 D4 参数化 ATM 项。对于来自 OMol25 的分析 SPICE2 配置，平均原子归一化 CP 和 ATM 贡献分别为 0.222 和 0.205 meV/原子。我们比较了 39 种有机液体的基线、仅 CP、仅 ATM 和 CP + ATM 变体。相对于基线，仅 CP、仅 ATM 和 CP + ATM 的平均系统密度变化分别为 -1.17%、-10.38% 和 -11.93%；相应的汽化焓变化为-2.79%、-14.74%和-18.32%。对于具有实验自扩散数据的11种液体，平均自扩散变化分别为+17.66%、+203.02%和+230.36%。因此，这两种修正都降低了蒸发的密度和焓，同时平均增加了分子迁移率。 ATM 在这些变化中占主导地位，而 CP 的贡献较小；它们的组合产生最大的平均偏移。这些结果表明，对分析的构型进行亚兆伏/原子平均值的校正可以显着重塑分子液体的预测结构、热力学和输运特性。

articles.title: First ray-tracing simulations of mode conversion using metaplectic geometrical optics
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06114v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Advanced scenarios of radiofrequency power deposition into magnetically confined fusion plasmas, particularly those using electron Bernstein waves, involve linear mode conversion (energy transfer between separate dispersion branches) in regions where the waves experience reflection. Full-wave simulations of this conversion are time-consuming, and geometrical-optics (GO) modeling is problematic because it is typically restricted to single waves and leads to spurious singularities at cutoffs. Here, we report the first reduced simulations that overcome these limitations without resorting to approximate analytical formulas for the conversion efficiency. The algorithm is based on the recently developed metaplectic geometrical optics (MGO), which eliminates GO's spurious singularities by metaplectic transformations, provided that the symplectic curvature of the rays R⁻¹ is small. To prove the concept, we simulate one-dimensional O--X mode conversion caused by the plasma-density gradient near the critical density, a problem for which an approximate analytical solution is available and can be compared with. Numerical MGO demonstrates good agreement with said theory. This opens a way for fast and accurate ray-tracing modeling of any linear mode conversion at R⁻¹ ll 1.

articles.title: BIC-Engineered Silicon Nitride Microring Resonators Enabled by an Etch-Free Laser-Writing Approach
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06167v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report the initial experimental demonstration of a complementary, etch-free approach with fewer fabrication steps, in useful SU-8 ridges written by direct ultraviolet laser lithography on an unpatterned silicon nitride film define waveguides and microring resonators. Because the nitride film is never patterned, scattering at patterned nitride sidewalls does not arise, and the remaining radiative loss is engineered by design. The guided transverse-magnetic mode lies within the continuum of transverse-electric slab modes, and we use bound states in the continuum (BICs) as a design tool to control this radiation. Coupled-mode analysis and full-vectorial simulations show that radiation from the two ridge sidewalls cancels by destructive interference at discrete widths, with a first BIC at 2.25 micron and radiation below 1 dB/cm over a 0.3 micron width window and about 200 nm of bandwidth, and that curvature confines this cancellation to discrete bands of bending radius and width. Laser-written waveguides follow the predicted width dependence of the loss, reaching approximately 1.5 dB/cm near the BIC, where non-radiative loss dominates. A microring designed on a radius-selected BIC band exhibits loaded quality factors up to 1.6 × 10⁴ and, under the over-coupled assignment supported by a coupler model, an intrinsic quality factor of 3.3 × 10⁵. Because radiation is set by a patterned low-index layer on an unetched film, the same approach could be extended to other nanostructures. Optimization of the writing conditions and materials is ongoing.

articles.title: Closed-form dyadic Green functions for transversely uniaxial bianisotropic medium with equal magnetoelectric scalars
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06172v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A transversely uniaxial bianisotropic medium with equal magnetoelectric scalars was conceived by Weiglhofer in 1994. Using the scalar factorization method, he concluded that the dyadic Green functions of this medium could not be found in closed form. That conclusion is incorrect. The essentials of the derivation are reproduced here, and closed-form expressions are given for all four dyadic Green functions of the unbounded medium, linking the electric and magnetic fields to electric and magnetic source current densities.

articles.title: SO3LR Tauri: Generally Applicable Force Fields for Reactive (Bio)Molecular Simulations Covering the Periodic Table
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06237v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine-learned force fields (MLFFs) aim to create a unified model that describes all major classes of (bio)molecules at quantum-mechanical accuracy. We present SO3LR Tauri, a family of MLFFs developed toward this goal, coupling a fast SO3krates network to explicit, physics-based interaction modules: pair-specific short-range repulsion, environment-dependent dispersion, and electrostatics, each improved beyond its original formulation. The models are trained on 148 million structures spanning 85 elements, drawn from several quantum-chemical datasets. Against coupled-cluster references, the models accurately reproduce nucleobase-pair and charged protein-ligand interactions, carbohydrate conformer ordering, and molecular dipoles. They also resolve the transition pathways of organic and enzymatic reactions. Dynamical simulations recover experimental densities of water and organic solvents, the hydration structure of mono- and divalent ions, the pKa values of amino-acid side chains, and the structure and dynamics of proteins, membranes, nucleic acids, glycoproteins, and metal-containing biomolecules, all without system-specific fitting. Released in three sizes, the models reach 0.7-3.2 μs/atom and scale to 27-84 million atoms on a single GPU. Much work remains to be done: achieving predictive accuracy for static and dynamic liquid properties, reaction barriers, coverage of chemical and conformational space, and the sampling and inference speed needed to describe biomolecular processes.

articles.title: A Design Rule for Passive Reconfigurable Microwave Devices
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06279v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Every reconfigurable microwave device places a tuning element - a varactor, a diode, transistor, microelectromechanical or phase-change switch, a ferroelectric or liquid-crystal load - inside a fixed passive network. The network can make a small change of the element produce a large change of the response, and design practice often credits it with the device's tuning capability. This paper shows that a fixed, linear, passive network cannot add to that capability. Each tuning element carries a tuning budget, a dimensionless length computed from its own impedance trajectory, and a fixed passive network can transmit that budget or lose part of it, never enlarge it. The unit of the budget is the hyperbolic distance of the Smith chart: the distance from a match is the logarithm of the voltage standing-wave ratio, and the distance between two states sets their mutual mismatch and is the logarithm of their commutation quality factor. From one inequality we derive closed-form, ready-to-use limits for analog and digital phase shifters, true-time-delay lines, switches, attenuators, vector modulators, impedance tuners, tunable filters, reconfigurable antennas, metasurface cells and multiport networks; the two-state and attenuation limits are attained by explicit circuits, and the phase limit by a constant-loss trajectory. We introduce the Λ-chart, a Smith-chart companion on which budgets and requirements are read graphically, and apply it to four published microwave case studies.

articles.title: Boundary Layers, Displacement Flow, and the High-Frequency Response of Porous Media: Beyond the Viscous and Thermal Characteristic Lengths, Order by Order
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06354v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Johnson-Koplik-Dashen viscous characteristic length Λ and its thermal analogue Λ' introduced by Champoux and Allard govern the leading O(ω⁻¹/²) boundary-layer behaviour of fluid-saturated porous media, but omit higher microgeometric effects associated with interface curvature and field gradients. We develop the asymptotic high-frequency expansions of dynamic tortuosity and dynamic compressibility beyond the leading boundary-layer terms. By resolving the oscillatory Stokes and heat conduction problems in the thin boundary-layer limit, we establish a recursive hierarchy, which can be continued to any order, defining successive microgeometric parameters, given by wall integrals. Each order requires transport equations of WKB type across the boundary layer, closed by a non-secularity condition, together with one Neumann problem for the potential displacement flow that the boundary layer induces. Applied to the values fitted on highly absorbing foams, these expressions show that the negative surface parameter is consistent with strong in-parallel disorder of the pore sizes, whereas the large positive third-order term points to strong constrictions or enlargements along part of the flow paths. The thermal parameters reduce to geometrical quantities: the integral mean curvature of the pore walls, a Willmore-type measure of their departure from umbilicity and, at the next order, this measure weighted by the mean curvature. Using the Avellaneda-Torquato relaxation-mode representation, we show that all these parameters are spectral data of the distribution of relaxation times. For isolated sharp edges across which the fluid flows, the singular terms of the formal expansion cancel, and the description persists with apparent, logarithmically varying values of the parameters.

articles.title: Microdroplet Generator Surrogate Enhancement and Inverse Design Through an Uncertainty-Guided Framework
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06464v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Microfluidic droplet generation is critical for many applications, yet efficient device design in high-dimensional parameter spaces remains computationally prohibitive due to complex multiphase flow dynamics. This work presents a unified methodology that couples adaptive surrogate enhancement with simulation-driven inverse design. High-fidelity Volume-of-Fluid simulations provide ground-truth data, while neural network ensembles predict flow regimes and droplet diameters. Ensemble-based uncertainty quantification identifies epistemic uncertainty using consensus levels for regime classification and the coefficient of variation for diameter prediction, revealing that uncertainty concentrates near regime transition boundaries where physics is highly sensitive to parameter perturbations. A physics-informed enrichment strategy targets these critical zones and addresses class imbalances by deploying additional targeted simulations and retraining the surrogates forming the ensembles. A framework that integrates Particle Swarm Optimization for constrained inverse design, balancing accuracy with predictive confidence and physical consistency is therefore proposed. Validation on independent test datasets demonstrates that the enriched ensembles achieve higher accuracy, with the fraction of predictions within the 0-3% error range on droplet diameter nearly doubling, and high-error cases (above 10%) dropping substantially. The inverse design procedure reliably identifies physically realizable configurations meeting target droplet sizes. This approach significantly reduces computational costs while ensuring reliable predictions, offering a framework with potential applicability to the optimization of a broad range of microfluidic systems.

articles.title: Exact periodic electrostatics for latent-charge machine-learning potentials
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06575v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine-learning interatomic potentials of the latent Ewald summation (LES) type learn atomic charges from energies and forces and evaluate their electrostatic energy in reciprocal space. I formulate this long-range term as a smeared Epstein-Hurwitz lattice sum and derive its exact periodic structure: a decomposition isolating a net-charge artefact and a local self-energy, an image theorem for cells of any shape, and the forces and virial. Full charge equilibration, LES with induced charges, constrained and unconstrained LES models and fixed-charge force fields follow as successive approximations of one variational problem, whose diagonal-hardness limit is a projection of the latent charges onto fixed total charge, which I call projected latent Ewald summation (pLES). Energies and forces determine the latent charges only up to a gauge, so fragment-level rather than atom-level charge quantization is the consistent target. The latent channel is guaranteed to be a dielectric only if charge is conserved locally; charges that are local functions of the environment and conserved only globally can screen like a conductor. pLES is implemented in the atomic cluster expansion and in LAMMPS, and the exact identities hold to machine precision, also for trained models. For charged NaCl clusters, pLES recovers the total charge that an unconstrained model misses by up to 1.8 e and reduces the test errors of a short-range model from 1.44 to 0.42 meV/atom and from 37 to 13 meV/Å. In two water datasets, constrained and unconstrained models learn the same latent charges up to sign and scale. In molecular dynamics of pLES water, fluctuating molecular charges dominate the screening at all accessible wavelengths; a crossover model excludes a conductor and gives a latent dielectric constant between 19 and 71; molecular charges are compensated over about 1 nm, beyond the training cells.

articles.title: Geometric Pumping of Optical Work in Coherent Wave Scattering
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06666v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Optical work exchanged between light and time-varying matter underlies a wide range of emerging photonic technologies, yet a general geometric theory describing its generation and control has been lacking. Here we establish such a theory for coherent electromagnetic scattering. We show that the net optical work accumulated during an adiabatic modulation cycle is a geometric quantity determined by the Berry curvature of the outgoing field in parameter space. Nonzero optical work can thus be generated by cyclically modulating two or more independent system parameters. In contrast to conventional adiabatic pumping between incoherent reservoirs, optical work pumping vanishes under maximally mixed illumination. Greater illumination coherence increases the maximum work attainable through wavefront shaping. For fully coherent illumination, we derive the optimal incident wavefront and modulation trajectory that maximize the optical work per cycle. Our framework unifies time-varying photonics, optomechanics, and geometric transport within a common scattering formalism.

articles.title: Report of the National Lab Accelerator Study Group for a Muon Collider
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06680v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The National Laboratory Accelerator Study Group (NLASG) was established to assess the accelerator research and development required to advance a future high-energy Muon Collider, with particular emphasis on opportunities for coordinated contributions from U.S. national laboratories. This report examines the principal accelerator subsystems, their technical maturity, and the critical challenges that must be addressed before proceeding to a technical design. Topics include the proton driver, target and capture system, muon cooling, acceleration, collider ring, and machine-detector interface. The study identifies priority R&D activities, evaluates opportunities to leverage existing laboratory capabilities and accelerator infrastructure, and outlines a staged approach to technology demonstrations and integrated system validation. Particular emphasis is placed on developing a coordinated national research strategy that complements international efforts and establishes a technically credible path toward a future Muon Collider.

articles.title: Machine Learning the Complete Active-Space Wavefunction Reconstruction
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06779v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine-learned interatomic potentials enable multireference-quality reaction dynamics but do not retain the electronic structure underlying the predicted energies and forces. Recovering this information by independently performing complete active space self-consistent field (CASSCF) calculations is both expensive and potentially inconsistent. We introduce the Complete Active-Space Wave Function Reconstruction (CAS-WR) model, which learns the geometry-dependent electronic structure from CASSCF data and reconstructs the CAS wave function without repeated orbital optimization. Combined with uncertainty-based active learning, CAS-WR is demonstrated for the Diels--Alder reaction and ceTiC+-catalyzed C--H activation. The approach enables trajectory-resolved analysis of multiconfigurational electronic structure across reactive ensembles. Preliminary applications to excited-state proton transfer and transition-metal photocatalysis suggest that CAS-WR can provide a general route toward recovering electronic structure along complex ground- and excited-state reactive dynamics.

articles.title: CMS ECAL Phase-2 upgrade: characterisation and stability analysis of a three-stage low-voltage power-conversion system
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06807v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As part of the High-Luminosity upgrade of the Large Hadron Collider, the front-end electronics of the Compact Muon Solenoid electromagnetic calorimeter barrel are being replaced. A three-stage low-voltage power-conversion system supplies the upgraded electronics. As the cascade dynamics require characterisation to ensure stable operation, interactions between the three converter stages are assessed at their two interfaces using the Nyquist criterion. A validated shunt-injection setup using a Bode 100 frequency-response analyser provides in-situ impedance measurements under load to assess the accuracy of the averaged converter models. Results show that both interfaces are stable over the evaluated configurations, with modelled minimum distances to the critical point of 0.76 and 0.79, respectively. A turn-on study identifies capacitor charging at Stage 3 as the main cause of inrush currents triggering Stage 2 overcurrent protection. Two Stage 3 board variants stagger converter enables within and between boards, keeping the measured two-tower current below 5 A, within the 8.0 A protection threshold.

articles.title: 3D Printed Monolithic Optomechanical Chassis for an Unbalanced Field-Widened Interferometer
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06898v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Additive manufacturing is increasingly being explored as an approach for producing complex structures for optical hardware. In this work, we present a fully monolithic optomechanical chassis fabricated using laser powder bed fusion additive manufacturing. The structure was fabricated from thermally stable Invar36, a low-thermal-expansion alloy that enables high dimensional stability under varying environmental conditions. Our monolithic design incorporates embedded optical mounts, flexures, and alignment features directly into the chassis geometry that exceed the practical limits of conventional subtractive manufacturing. By integrating the optomechanical support structure into a single compact unit, the system achieves a reduced footprint compared to traditional optomechanical assemblies. The results demonstrate the potential of additive manufacturing to produce lightweight, and highly customized optical systems, opening the possibility of new pathways for next-generation quantum sensors and optical instrumentation.

articles.title: The kinematic Kelvin-Helmholtz instability-driven dynamo: implications for merging compact objects
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05880v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Binary neutron star (BNS) mergers excite a Kelvin--Helmholtz instability (KHI) in the shear layer between them. It is parasitized upon by the magnetic field to form a powerful magnetic dynamo. Using a large ensemble of high-resolution visco-resistive KHI-driven dynamo simulations we construct analytical, asymptotic in Reynolds number (rmRe) models for the magnetic field growth rates and mean vertical field dynamo onset times. Our models suggest that in the rmRe gg 1 limit, the mean vertical field is seeded immediately, kinematic growth rates become asymptotic in rmRe, and the dynamo moves out of the kinematic stage on O(0.1,rmms) timescales, readily attaining magnetar-strength fields during this transition. This suggests that most global BNS merger simulations are not time-resolving the correct KHI-driven dynamo regime.

articles.title: Gravitational-Wave Microlensing as a Probe of Compact Object Population
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05947v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The abundance of compact objects ranging from stellar to intermediate masses (sim 1 - 10⁵Mₒdₒₜ) remains poorly constrained, particularly for populations such as primordial black holes and dark matter subhalos that emit little or no electromagnetic radiation. Gravitational-wave (GW) microlensing provides a complementary way to probe these populations through wave-optics effects imprinted on the GW signals, with implications for astrophysical and cosmological inference. We develop a hierarchical Bayesian framework to infer the population properties of microlenses from an ensemble of microlensed GW events, constraining the slope of the power-law lens mass function (αᵣₘ ML), the lens number density (n₀), and the fraction of dark matter in compact lenses (fᵣₘ DM). Using simulated microlensed GW signals drawn from a realistic binary black hole population, we find that sim 100 detected microlensed events are able to constrain both αᵣₘ ML and n₀, although a degeneracy between the two remains. For a low-mass-dominated lens population (αᵣₘ ML=2) with n₀=10⁶~Mpc⁻³, a three-year observation at the O4 sensitivity yields sim 130 detectable microlensed events and recovers the injected dark-matter fraction, fᵣₘ DMsimeq 1.2 × 10⁻⁴, with a 90% credible interval of 7.3 × 10⁻⁵ lesssim fᵣₘ DM lesssim 1.8 × 10⁻⁴.

articles.title: Local information processing capacity: anatomy of computation in neuromorphic systems
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05959v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Many neuromorphic systems possess rich internal computational structures shaped by their physical dynamics. However, existing metrics characterize only global computation, leaving these local structures unresolved despite their importance for system interpretation, optimization and miniaturization. Here, we introduce local information processing capacity (L-IPC), which represents individual dynamical states as vectors in an infinite-dimensional Hilbert space and decomposes their computational properties through subspace projections onto nonlinearity orders and memory steps, with the residual quantifying computational irrelevance. Applied to three systems with comparable global capacities (an echo state network, an ion-gating reservoir and a spin-wave reservoir), L-IPC reveals markedly different distributions of computation, ranging from homogeneous to spatially, temporally and spectrally structured patterns. These local profiles further guide task-specific pruning, outperforming standard approaches at the same size in the structured systems. These results establish L-IPC as a general framework for anatomizing computation and guiding task-adaptive design in neuromorphic systems.

articles.title: Ab Initio Accuracy Beyond the Cutoff: Distributed Message-Passing Equivariant Attention at Tens-of-Millions-of-Atom Scale
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06122v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Molecular dynamics predicts molecular motion from atomic forces and trajectory integration. Density functional theory (DFT) provides first-principles forces, but its O(N³) cost limits simulations to thousands of atoms; empirical force fields scale to millions but miss bond breaking and charge transfer. Equivariant message-passing Transformers learn the ab initio potential at linear cost. Stacked layers propagate information beyond a single cutoff, giving four layers a receptive field up to 23Å. At this frontier, scale is limited by communication: layers exchange boundary features across devices, force backpropagation repeats the exchange, and moving atoms change neighbor graphs and tensor shapes. We present Tessera, a distributed runtime that fixes workload shapes between rebuilds. It sorts atoms along a space-filling curve into equal-count shards, ensuring identical atom counts and tensor shapes per rank. Peer sets scale as K⁰.⁵, not K. A conservative neighbor skin preserves topology across updates, enabling each rebuild interval to replay as one CUDA Graph. Fused kernels, three-level neighbor search, and overlapped All-to-All complete it. On 512 GPUs, Tessera sustains 30.7M atoms at 89.7% weak-scaling efficiency (77--90% across three per-GPU loads); per-step time rises 1.11--1.29x as machine and problem grow 16x. Graph reuse cuts full-step time 1.87×. Across an 8× device increase, neighbor-search cost grows 1.7×, versus 3.0× for Morton order. In a live 10.24M-atom salt solution, NVE energy drift is 0.42,μeV/atom/ps over 10 ps, and structure matches a serial reference. A 10.06M-atom Norovirus capsid sustains 100 ps of NVT at approx 8 ps/day on 256 A100 GPUs. Over 200,000 steps, it has no broken bonds or anomalously close pairs and uses three compiled variants, with no graph breaks or eager fallbacks.

articles.title: Thermodynamics-Informed Learning Captures Hierarchical Hydrogen-Bond Networks in Deep Eutectic Solvents
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06590v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Deep eutectic solvents (DESs) offer a tunable platform for lignocellulose refining, but their solvation behavior depends on multicomponent hydrogen-bond networks rather than individual constituent properties. We develop TiNN, a thermodynamics-informed neural network that hierarchically represents HBA-HBD association and solute accommodation through a learned free-energy pathway. Trained on 938 records, TiNN achieves a test-set R² of 0.917 and generalizes to new HBA-HBD combinations and sparse conditions. Ablation identifies solute-specific stabilization as the largest contributor to prediction accuracy, while the importance of hydrogen-bond compatibility depends on the dissolution mechanism. Experimental measurements of glucose, xylan, and Kraft lignin in acidic, basic, and neutral DESs show that TiNN reduces the geometric mean solubility error from more than 23-fold with COSMO-RS to approximately 1.5-fold. Without training on fractionation data, TiNN also distinguishes DES formulations with high and low lignin and hemicellulose removal from corn stover. These results support chemically grounded solvent screening for lignocellulose fractionation.

articles.title: A trust layer for fast pedestal-stability surrogates: calibrated error bars, out-of-distribution alarms and few-shot recalibration
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06597v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Machine-learning surrogates of linear peeling-ballooning stability now run in milliseconds, but they are mostly deployed as point estimators: they do not say how wrong they may be, or when a query lies outside what they were trained on. For a fusion company designing a new device, every equilibrium of interest is outside the training data of existing surrogates, so this is the case that matters. We describe a model-agnostic trust layer for stability surrogates, made of conformal error bars, out-of-distribution alarms that route doubtful cases to the physics code, and recalibration from a few simulations of a new design, and we test it with pre-registered hypotheses. On a large public dataset of JET-like equilibria with ideal-MHD growth rates, the error bars hold their nominal coverage in distribution and fall short under a shift in plasma shape; a few dozen simulations of the new shape, or routing the cases the alarms flag, restore it. On resistive BOUT++ surrogates, the bars stay calibrated on held-out runs, the alarm flags tokamaks absent from training, and a scenario scan is screened in seconds instead of hours. Across equilibria from the SPARC library and the DIII-D coil set, a surrogate trained on our own graded BOUT++ labels beats the baseline on unseen equilibria, while a surrogate trained elsewhere ranks the same cases backwards and its alarm declines them. Building our own neural-operator surrogate, the harness exposed two input defects whose fix closed its gap to a simple network. For every surrogate tested, the trust layer keeps coverage near target, with a bar width set by that surrogate's own error. Not every pre-registered hypothesis held, and we report those results and the limits of all of them.

articles.title: Energy-Guided Transport for Projection-Free Physics-Informed Flow Matching
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06711v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Deep generative models, particularly Flow Matching frameworks, have emerged as powerful tools for synthesizing complex physical systems. However, standard architectures remain purely statistically driven and agnostic to the underlying governing equations, often violating fundamental physical constraints during inference. Existing zero-shot approaches designed to enforce these constraints typically rely on rigid algebraic projections. While effective for sparse boundary conditions, applying such discrete geometric corrections to dense, full-domain PDEs may disrupt the probability path, rev{potentially deviating from the learned manifold and introducing substantial computational overhead}. To address these challenges, we introduce Energy-Guided Transport, a novel training-free framework that formulates non-linear physical constraints as a smooth potential energy landscape. Rather than interrupting the ODE integration, our method applies a continuous dissipative force directly to the intermediate generative states, steering them toward the physical manifold. By evaluating this force implicitly via reverse-mode automatic differentiation, our framework preserves the natural dynamics of the flow while maintaining an efficient O(N) algorithmic complexity. We extensively evaluate our framework across various 1D and 2D physical systems, including the chaotic Navier-Stokes equations. Our method achieves stable generation without structural divergence, significantly improves the stability-accuracy trade-off compared to state-of-the-art methods, and substantially accelerates inference with respect to exact projection strategies. Code available at: https://github.com/ispamm/Projection-free-energy-guided-flow-matching.

articles.title: Linear Kelvin Wave Predictions in the z→ 0 Limit
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.14945v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Linear wave theory captures the essential physics of free-surface flows at a fraction of the computational cost of nonlinear and viscous methods, making it attractive for design, real-time control, and surrogate modeling applications. However, the Kelvin Green's function for a translating point-source generates unbounded wave energy in the z→ 0 limit, causing both numerical difficulties and physical inconsistencies. This paper develops a modified kernel for the Kelvin potential incorporating an elliptic spanwise line integration that naturally resolves this ill-posedness, yielding finite wave energy over the entire free surface. We then present a fast evaluator for both point and line kernels using contour deformation adapted to the non-analytic Kelvin phase, achieving 10⁴-10⁵ speedup over direct quadrature while preserving the wake asymptotics. Predictions on the most challenging z=0 limit demonstrate physically consistent wave patterns and wave resistance trends. An open-source Julia implementation is provided.

articles.title: Drift-React: One-step Generation of Reaction Pathways via SE(3) Drifting Fields
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.22990v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Mapping reaction pathways and transition states (TS) is fundamental to chemistry but computationally expensive at scale. The minimum energy pathway (MEP) dictates reaction rates and mechanisms, yet recovering it via electronic-structure methods requires thousands of costly force evaluations. Recent generative models accelerate TS identification but rely on iterative inference and only predict isolated saddle-point snapshots, missing the continuous reaction trajectory. We introduce Drift-React, an SE(3)-equivariant generative framework that predicts complete reaction pathways in a single forward pass from only reactant and product geometries. By shifting distribution evolution to training via a Sinkhorn-weighted drifting field, Drift-React eliminates both the iterative force evaluations of NEB-style methods and the sequential ODE/SDE integration of diffusion and flow matching models. Evaluated on the Transition1x and Halo8 datasets, our one-step model generates physically consistent MEPs that accurately capture energetic bottlenecks and enable arbitrary-resolution sampling along the reaction coordinate. For isolated TS prediction, Drift-React matches the sub-Ångström accuracy of state-of-the-art iterative models while delivering orders-of-magnitude acceleration, clearing a major computational bottleneck for large-scale reaction network exploration.

articles.title: Emergent Transfer of a Physics Foundation Model from Simulation to Laboratory Turbulence
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.01470v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Whether physics foundation models can be usefully deployed on laboratory experiments remains an open question for scientific machine learning (ML). We test this question on the Rayleigh-Taylor instability (RTI), a ubiquitous and demanding fluid instability seen from tabletop flows to supernova explosions, in which small perturbations at a density interface grow into chaotic, multiscale mixing as a lighter fluid accelerates into a heavier one. Standard ML models struggle with RTI, and despite over a century of theoretical, numerical, and experimental work, it carries an unresolved discrepancy between simulation and experiment: the late-time mixing growth rate, α, measured in most laboratory experiments (sim 0.06-0.07), is roughly three times the value from idealized direct numerical simulations (DNS, sim 0.02). The gap's origin remains debated. These properties make RTI a stringent test for a question that matters well beyond RTI: can foundation models trained only on simulations generalise to sparse, messy, and noisy laboratory settings? We finetune Walrus, a foundation model for continuum dynamics, on three or fewer DNS realizations and recover key RTI physics over long rollouts. Applied zero-shot to sliding-barrier laboratory data, the finetuned model leaves the DNS-like regime and enters the observed growth band, having never seen a single experimental sample. These results provide independent, data-driven evidence that initial conditions play a crucial role in the longstanding sim-experiment gap in α. The model also generalises zero-shot to stable stratification, a buoyancy regime absent from training, correctly slowing mixing-layer growth. Together, our results show that foundation models can generalise well beyond their training data, predicting laboratory behavior and unseen physical regimes, opening new ways to probe longstanding simulation-experiment gaps.

articles.title: Impedance of multilayer cylindrical structures with a material-filled beam region
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.16761v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Beam-coupling impedances in material media are relevant for ionization-cooling channels of a future muon collider, where the beam propagates in matter rather than vacuum. We extend the cylindrical field-matching formalism for multilayer structures to the case of a material-filled beam region surrounded by external layers with arbitrary electromagnetic properties. Relative to the vacuum formulation, the usual factor 1/γ² is replaced by the material-dependent factor F=1/ε₁-μ₁β², and the radial propagation constant is modified accordingly. Analytical expressions are obtained for the monopolar longitudinal and dipolar transverse impedances, with the surrounding structure encoded through reflection coefficients determined by field matching. The formalism reduces to the known vacuum and perfectly conducting limits in the appropriate cases. Representative calculations are presented for absorber-relevant configurations, illustrating the dependence on the material properties of both the beam region and the surrounding layers. In particular, a finite beam-region conductivity can generate a real impedance component and reverse the sign of the imaginary space-charge impedance, while sufficiently high permittivity can give rise to resonant structures associated with oscillatory radial fields. The effect of finite-conductivity surroundings is also examined, showing the approach towards the perfectly conducting limit as the external conductivity is increased. The applicability of the infinite-length approximation is also discussed by comparison with finite-length mode-matching results.

articles.title: Implementation and verification of the avalanche source in a 3D full-f particle-in-cell model of relativistic electrons for studies of tokamak disruptions
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24602v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Tokamak disruptions may lead to the acceleration of some electrons to relativistic energies. These so-called runaway electrons (REs) can multiply exponentially via knock-on collisions with thermal electrons. As the resulting RE avalanche is exponentially sensitive to the pre-disruption plasma current, multi-MA RE beams may form in large future devices, risking severe localized wall damage. In this work, an energy and momentum conserving knock-on collision operator is implemented in the 3D nonlinear MHD code JOREK for the full-f relativistic hybrid fluid-kinetic model that describes the REs using the particle-in-cell (PiC) approach both for full-orbit and drift-kinetic markers, which will enable accurate modeling of the RE phase-space dynamics in realistic 3D electromagnetic fields. Such a self-consistent treatment of the RE avalanche and competing losses in the stochastic fields of MHD-active plasmas is required to further the understanding of RE transport and phase-space dynamics in self-consistent interaction with the 3D plasma evolution, which is needed for developing reliable predictions as well as reliable mitigation methods. To make such novel high-fidelity simulations computationally viable, a resampling technique was also implemented to restrict the number of markers. The avalanche model is verified using analytical expressions from literature and applied to a JET-like termination scenario, demonstrating its applicability to realistic 3D MHD active scenarios. Future work on porting to accelerated high-performance computing systems will be needed to cross the long time scales involved, e.g., in periodic termination and re-avalanching that could occur in large devices like ITER.

articles.title: Absolute frequency measurement of the ⁴⁰Ca⁺ clock transition using a GNSS link to the SI second
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.15844v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We report the absolute frequency measurement of the 4s  ²S₁/₂↔ 3d ²D₅/₂ ⁴⁰Ca⁺ clock transition with respect to the SI second. To perform this measurement, a link between our laboratory in Innsbruck and the clocks realizing the Coordinated Universal Time at the Physikalisch-Technische Bundesanstalt (PTB) in Braunschweig was installed and characterized using the Global Navigation Satellite System GNSS. The comparison between our clock and the ones at PTB was done using the Precise Point Positioning technique. After the evaluation of the systematic shifts, the measured transition frequency is 411 042 129 776 400.4±0.6 Hz with a fractional uncertainty of 1.5 × 10⁻¹⁵. The stability of the clock measurements was also corroborated by comparing two different calcium ion clock experiments, which share the clock laser source at our institute. Furthermore, after careful evaluation of the trap-drive induced ac magnetic fields, we estimate ac Zeeman shifts on the D₅/₂ sublevels and reevaluate the Landé g-factor of the 3d ²D₅/₂ level to be g₅/₂= 1.200329(1).

articles.title: Harnessing Machine Learning for Ultrafast Science in Facility Settings: Opportunities and Challenges
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12146v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Ultrafast science is rapidly evolving from a collection of specialized laser experiments into a facility-scale, data-intensive research endeavour. High-repetition-rate femtosecond and attosecond sources, synchronized multidimensional diagnostics, and increasingly nonlinear laser-matter interactions now generate heterogeneous data streams whose volume, speed, and complexity often exceed the capacity of conventional manual workflows. This chapter examines how machine learning can become an enabling layer for next-generation ultrafast facilities, with emphasis on the Extreme Light Infrastructure (ELI) ecosystem. We discuss the scientific drivers for artificial-intelligence-assisted experimentation, propose a facility-scale digital architecture spanning acquisition, ingestion, storage, analytics, machine learning, adaptive feedback, and user interfaces, and review representative examples from ELI ALPS, ELI Beamlines, and ELI-NP.
