articles.title: Highly excited 3 Π g electronic states of the cesium dimer— Ab initio predictions and experimental observation of the 6 3 Π g state
articles.abstract: We report the results of an experimental investigation of the highly excited 6Πg3 electronic state of the Cs 2 molecule. In addition, we present ab initio potential energy curves for all Cs 2 Πg3 electronic states up to the 6s+7d limit, calculated using the pseudopotential method. Rovibrational levels of the excited triplet state were observed experimentally using the perturbation facilitated optical–optical double resonance technique, with levels of the AΣu+1∼bΠu3 mixed manifold serving as intermediate states. A progression of P and R branch probe laser resonances was detected by measuring laser-induced fluorescence to the aΣu+3 state as a function of the probe laser frequency. For select rovibrational levels of the 6Πg3 state, dispersed fluorescence to the aΣu+3 state and the AΣu+1∼bΠu3 manifold was recorded and compared with Franck–Condon factor calculations to determine the state multiplicity and vibrational numbering. Using the electric dipole selection rules and comparison with our ab initio results allowed the experimentally observed levels to be assigned to the 6Πg3 state. Term values of the 270 observed rovibrational levels of the 6Πg3 state were fit to a Dunham expansion. From the fitted Dunham constants, a potential energy curve was constructed using the Rydberg–Klein–Rees method.

articles.title: Topological Gyromorphs
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.02167v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Gyromorphs are a new class of disordered systems that combine an amorphous-like absence of translational order with quasi-long-range rotational order. Gyromorphs can outperform quasicrystals or hyperuniform arrangements in forming isotropic band gaps, suggesting an avenue to realize robust disordered topological phases. However, gyromorphs lack exact rotational symmetry, which is only realized on average, posing an obstacle for existing real-space invariants to correctly diagnose topological gyromorphs. In this work we show that gyromorphs can host higher-order topological insulating (HOTI) phases protected by average rotational symmetry, and we develop and systematically compare tools for diagnosing topological phases protected by such symmetry. We introduce symmetry indicators of the effective Hamiltonian based on average rotational symmetries which, when combined with the spectral localizer and a scattering invariant, draw a consistent topological phase diagram. Our work unlocks gyromorphs as a novel platform to study topological phases beyond crystals, quasicrystals, and amorphous materials.

articles.title: Automatic generation of exchange–correlation response kernels
articles.abstract: Computing density-functional response properties requires contracting derivatives of the exchange–correlation (xc) energy with perturbed densities on a grid. While the xc functional’s derivatives have long been available to high orders from libraries such as Libxc, the surrounding contraction layer—the chain rule that combines them with the grid-based basis-function and density data into the total xc contribution—has instead been hand-derived and hand-coded in every program, for every functional family, spin case, and property. We present libxckernel , a library that automatically generates this layer by symbolic differentiation. The xc functional’s ingredients are expressed as sesquilinear forms in the density matrix, so the xc energy can be differentiated to any order while the functional derivatives remain opaque. The basis functions and the orbital coefficients may both be complex. The chain rule then produces any xc matrix element: Fock matrices, orbital Hessians, or any other response terms of any order. Terms sharing a pattern are collapsed for efficiency. Extensible plugins emit the expressions as NumPy Einstein sums, compiled C++ kernels with C/Fortran interfaces, or host-program specific source code. libxckernel is free and open-source software under the BSD-3-Clause license, enabling rapid implementation of functionality missing from many electronic structure programs. We demonstrate it by extending Psi4 with meta-generalized gradient approximation (mGGA) response kernels for orbital stability analysis and time-dependent density-functional theory (TD-DFT), GGA and mGGA analytic nuclear Hessians, and exact quadrature grid response, as well as by extending GPAW with mGGA and triplet TD-DFT kernels and gradient-corrected kernels for periodic dielectric response.

articles.title: Global coarse-grained simulation of hierarchical self-assembly in AB n dendron-like giant molecules: Phase behavior, molecular packing, and the role of rigidity
articles.abstract: We present a global dissipative particle dynamics simulation study of hierarchical self-assembly in AB n dendron-like giant molecules, drawing upon the experimental platform where hydrophilic and hydrophobic polyhedral oligomeric silsesquioxane cages serve as the amphiphilic building blocks. Without imposing any pre-assumed structural bias, our coarse-grained model spontaneously evolves from disordered melts into lamellar, double gyroid, hexagonal cylinder, and spherical micelle phases as the number of hydrophobic peripheral units increases—a sequence that faithfully mirrors experimental observations. A key innovation lies in comparing three topologically isomeric representations of the molecular building block: a rigid cage, a flexible chain, and a ring. This systematic comparison reveals that molecular rigidity alone can significantly alter phase boundaries and reduce micelle sizes, a finding that disentangles the role of shape persistence from that of composition or molecular weight. Our simulations further uncover hidden organizational features, including ordered linker arrays within lamellar interphases and the emergence of perforated lamellar structures upon linker elongation. While complete ordering into Frank–Kasper lattices remains computationally demanding, statistical characterizations of the spherical micelles consistently recover experimental trends, affirming the predictive capacity of our approach. This work establishes global coarse-grained simulation as an effective tool for exploring the rich phase behavior of giant molecules and lays the groundwork for the modular, in silico design of programmable supramolecular materials.

articles.title: An efficient approach to estimate electronic couplings in molecular pairs using molecular orbital grids: A generalization of CubeMap
articles.abstract: Estimating electronic couplings ( V ) is essential to understanding the fundamental electron-transfer process between molecular systems and, consequently, developing computationally efficient approaches for their fast, yet accurate estimation is central to (bio)chemistry and materials science. We have recently proposed a novel and ultrafast approximation, called CubeMap [R. Rubert-Albiol et al. , J. Chem. Phys. 162 , 064105 (2025)], to evaluate V in molecular pairs. CubeMap exploits the well-known linear relationship ( V = C · S ) between V and the molecular orbital overlap integral ( S ) via a fitting constant C . Nevertheless, the original CubeMap formulation required an initial system-specific parameterization, limiting the broad and general applicability of the method for the final users. In this work, we present a significant generalization of the CubeMap method by setting a global scaling factor using a wide and diverse library (more than 80 π -conjugated molecules and 42 000 dimers). The new protocol removes the initial molecule-specific fitting, which was a computational burden, and broadens its scope for non-specialized users in a “black-box” manner. The CubeMap approach has also been extended to deal with semi-flexible molecules with minimal user input, mitigating errors arising from peripheral and/or floppy substituents. Validation across the database shows a good agreement with reference electronic structure calculations, maintaining reasonable mean absolute errors, yet with an important speed-up of up to three orders of magnitude and agreement on the resulting statistical distributions. CubeMap therefore constitutes a reliable tool for numerous evaluations of electronic couplings between molecular units and is, therefore, of great interest for large-scale simulations of charge transport.

articles.title: Defect Engineering of ZnO Nanoparticles through Wide-Range Potassium Doping: Correlation of Structural, Electrical, and Optical Properties
articles.abstract: Potassium doping provides an effective approach for tailoring the structural, electrical, and optical properties of zinc oxide (ZnO) nanoparticles; however, the influence of a broad potassium concentration range on the interrelated structure–transport–optical properties of ZnO remains insufficiently understood. In this work, Zn₁₋ₓKₓO nanoparticles with potassium concentrations of 1, 2, 3, 10, 20, and 30% were synthesized using a facile sol–gel method. The influence of potassium incorporation on the crystal structure, crystallite characteristics, temperature-dependent electrical transport, activation energy, thermal stability, and optical band-gap energy was systematically investigated. X-ray diffraction analysis confirmed the formation of the hexagonal wurtzite ZnO structure without detectable secondary crystalline phases. Increasing K concentration resulted in a progressive reduction in crystallite size from approximately 42 to 35 nm, accompanied by increases in microstrain and dislocation density, indicating enhanced lattice distortion and defect formation. All samples exhibited semiconducting behavior, with resistance decreasing and current increasing with temperature. The activation energy varied from 0.22 to 0.62 eV, demonstrating the concentration-dependent nature of thermally activated charge transport. Higher K concentrations also produced a broader temperature range of stable electrical conduction, with the 30% K-doped sample exhibiting the widest thermal stability range. Optical measurements revealed systematic band-gap narrowing from 4.06 eV for 1% K-doped ZnO to 3.88 eV for 30% K-doped ZnO. The observed simultaneous evolution of structural, electrical, and optical properties demonstrates that potassium concentration is an effective parameter for defect engineering and property tuning in ZnO nanoparticles. The systematic correlation established across the 1–30% K-doping range provides useful insights for designing ZnO-based materials for high-temperature sensing, transparent electronics, photodetection, and other optoelectronic applications.

articles.title: Integrated Multi-Port SIW Antenna with Self-Quadruplexing Capability and Circular Polarization Features for 6G Communication System
articles.abstract: A thin, small substrate integrated waveguide (SIW)-based antenna intended for quad-band operation is presented in this study. The design is straightforward and simple to use. The top surface of the SIW cavity is divided into four various radiating patches fed with a printed line. The antenna achieves peak gains of 5.12 dBi, 6.0 dBi, 5.8 dBi, and 5.55 dBi while operating 5.3 GHz, 5.7 GHz, 6.8 GHz, and 7.6 GHz. The antenna maintains isolation over 30 dB. Because of its design, each resonant frequency may be changed with a single parameter without influencing other aspects of performance. Additionally, circular polarization feature has been added to all four-operating band by loading stair shaped slot with each radiator. To confirm the findings, a prototype is built on FR-4 substrate and put through experimental testing. The antenna is ideal for 6G Communication system.

Using forced oscillations from an AC dipole, the authors directly measure chromatic amplitude detuning and a decapolar resonance driving term for the first time. They trace the discrepancy mainly to the decay of decapolar fields in the main dipoles, and show that sextupoles and octupoles also drive decapole-like resonances. Corrections derived from this work are now used in LHC operation and improve beam lifetime. [Phys. Rev. Accel. Beams 29, 113501] Published Thu Nov 05, 2026

articles.title: Exact spectral allocation in Fourier-feature neural tangent kernels
articles.title_zh: 傅里叶特征神经正切核中的精确谱分配
articles.abstract: Fourier features determine the kernel spectrum of coordinate networks, yet bandwidth and harmonic support leave the learning rates of individual frequencies unspecified. We study fixed, finite integer Fourier dictionaries on the torus. For a dot-product kernel with nonnegative summable power-series coefficients, each Fourier eigenvalue is a mixture of signed lattice-walk probabilities. This separates architecture-dependent coefficients from dictionary-dependent multiplicities and yields exact support, finite-rank approximations with trace-norm error bounds, and certified comparisons of spectral design objectives. For the two-layer bias-free rectified linear unit (ReLU) neural tangent kernel (NTK), we characterize an even-walk subgroup that can exclude frequencies inside the generated lattice and derive the leading one-dimensional spectral tail. Two dictionaries matched in cardinality, maximum frequency, and base second moment have identical leading tails but a 19.51-fold difference in their mode-9 eigenvalues; finite-network decay rates track this difference. Across three target frequencies and 108 dictionary--target pairs, spectral predictions have rank correlations of 0.977--0.992 with fitted rates. Under a four-frequency budget for twenty target modes, spectral selection reduces off-grid finite-network mean squared error (MSE) by 12.3% relative to direct top-energy selection on a mixed-spectrum signal. Fifty runs on five natural-image crops show close agreement with finite-grid MSE predictions and larger deviations in individual mode rates. These results quantify how a fixed Fourier dictionary allocates kernel mass and predicts learning in the NTK regime.
articles.abstract_zh: 傅里叶特征决定了坐标网络的核心频谱，但带宽和谐波支持使各个频率的学习率未指定。我们研究环面上的固定有限整数傅里叶字典。对于具有非负可求和幂级数系数的点积核，每个傅里叶特征值都是有符号格子行走概率的混合。这将依赖于体系结构的系数与依赖于字典的多重性分开，并产生精确的支持、具有迹范数误差界限的有限秩近似以及频谱设计目标的经过认证的比较。对于两层无偏差修正线性单元（ReLU）神经正切核（NTK），我们描述了一个偶数行走子群，它可以排除生成的晶格内的频率并导出前导一维谱尾。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 傅里叶特征决定了坐标网络的核心频谱，但带宽和谐波支持使各个频率的学习率未指定。我们研究环面上的固定有限整数傅里叶字典。对于具有非负可求和幂级数系数的点积核，每个傅里叶特征值都是有符号格子行走概率的混合。这将依赖于体系结构的系数与依赖于字典的多重性分开，并产生精确的支持、具有迹范数误差界限的有限秩近似以及频谱设计目标的经过认证的比较。对于两层无偏差修正线性单元（ReLU）神经正切核（NTK），我们描述了一个偶数行走子群，它可以排除生成的晶格内的频率并导出前导一维谱尾。基数、最大频率和基二阶矩匹配的两个字典具有相同的前导尾部，但其 9 模特征值有 19.51 倍的差异；有限网络衰减率跟踪这种差异。在三个目标频率和 108 个字典目标对中，谱预测与拟合率的等级相关性为 0.977--0.992。在二十个目标模式的四频率预算下，相对于混合频谱信号上的直接顶部能量选择，频谱选择将离网有限网络均方误差 (MSE) 降低了 12.3%。对五种自然图像作物进行的 50 次运行显示与有限网格 MSE 预测非常一致，并且各个模式速率的偏差较大。这些结果量化了固定傅里叶字典如何分配核质量并预测 NTK 体系中的学习。

articles.title: Hemispheric Geomagnetic Activity Dependence on IMF By: Evidence from the Satellite and Pre-Satellite Eras
articles.title_zh: 半球地磁活动对 IMF 的依赖性：来自卫星和前卫星时代的证据
articles.abstract: The sign of the interplanetary magnetic field (IMF) ((B_y)) is known toproduce hemispheric asymmetries in the coupled magnetosphere--ionospheresystem, but its long-term signature in hemispheric geomagnetic activityis less well established. We investigate whether IMF polarity organizesthe distribution of geomagnetic activity between the Northern andSouthern Hemispheres independently of the overall activity level.Homogeneous hemispheric ((aa)) indices are analyzed using directlymeasured IMF ((B_y)) during 1965--2010 and reconstructed IMF sectorpolarity extending back to 1868. Positive- and negative-((B_y)) days arefirst compared after matching them within 5-nT bins of overallgeomagnetic activity. As an independent control, the ((B_y)) dependenceis estimated while accounting directly for southward IMF, solar-windspeed, and long-term variations. A systematic ((B_y))-dependent hemispheric asymmetry remains under bothcontrol approaches, with the most consistent positive differences between ((B_y>0)) and ((B_y<0)) conditions occurring in May, June, and October.The seasonal organization of this hemispheric effect differs markedlyfrom the corresponding ((B_y)) dependence of overall geomagneticactivity. The latter is dominated by an annual component with aspring--autumn reversal, whereas the activity-matched hemisphericcontrast is dominated by a semiannual component with fitted maximanear May and November. Thus, the hemispheric dependence is not simplya scaled representation of the polarity-dependent seasonal modulationof total geomagnetic activity. Reconstructed IMF sector polarity shows that the principal seasonalfeatures of the activity-matched hemispheric contrast were alreadypresent during 1868--1964 and recur in the satellite-era reconstruction.The results suggest that IMF ((B_y)) provides a persistent organizationof the hemispheric distribution of geomagnetic activity, superposed onthe better-known polarity-dependent modulation of overall geomagneticactivity.

articles.abstract_zh_full: 已知行星际磁场 (IMF) ((B_y)) 的符号会在耦合的磁层-电离层系统中产生半球不对称性，但其在半球地磁活动中的长期特征尚不明确。我们研究 IMF 极性是否独立于整体活动水平来组织北半球和南半球之间的地磁活动分布。使用 1965--2010 年期间直接测量的 IMF ((B_y)) 分析均质半球 ((aa)) 指数，并重建可追溯到 1868 年的 IMF 扇区极性。在 5-nT 箱内匹配后，首先比较正负 ((B_y)) 天数总体地磁活动。作为独立控制，在直接考虑南向 IMF、太阳风速和长期变化的同时估计 ((B_y)) 依赖性。在两种控制方法下，系统性 ((B_y)) 相关的半球不对称性仍然存在，((B_y>0)) 和 ((B_y<0)) 条件之间最一致的正差异发生在 5 月、6 月和 10 月。这种半球效应的季节性组织与整体地磁活动的相应 ((B_y)) 依赖性显着不同。后者主要由具有春季-秋季反转的年度成分主导，而活动匹配的半球对比则由具有拟合最大五月和十一月的半年度成分主导。因此，半球相关性不仅仅是总地磁活动的极性相关季节性调制的缩放表示。重建的 IMF 扇区极性表明，活动匹配的半球对比的主要季节性特征在 1868--1964 年期间已经存在，并在卫星时代重建中重现。结果表明，IMF ((B_y)) 提供了地磁活动半球分布的持久组织，叠加在更广为人知的总体地磁活动的极性相关调制上。

articles.title: Study of High-Performance Protective Coatings of Bio-Based UV-Curable Castor Oil Alkyd Resins Modified by Boron
articles.title_zh: 硼改性生物基紫外光固化蓖麻油醇酸树脂高性能防护涂料的研究
articles.abstract: In this current research, castor oil based fatty amide (COFA) and monoglyceride (COMG) were synthesized separately in the laboratory and subsequently reacted with itaconic acid to produce alkyd resins named as COFAIA and COMGIA, respectively. Afterwards, a boron based triacrylate monomer, (borane-triyltris(oxy))tris(ethane-2,1-diyl) (BAM) was prepared via esterification of boric acid and hydroxyethylacrylate (HEA), in a molar ratio of 1:3 using p-toluene sulphonic acid (pTSA) as a catalyst. Structural determination of synthesized materials COFAIA, COMGIA and BAM were done by Fourier transform Infrared Spectroscopy (FTIR) and Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR).Then, using synthesized materials, various UV curable coating formulations were prepared by blending varying compositions of COFAIA or COMGIAwith BAM (0 to 5% in w/w). These compositions were coated as a film on mild steel and wood panels and cured under UV radiations. The cured coatings were evaluated for different properties by performing various tests such as cross-cut adhesion, pencil hardness, gloss test, impact resistance, scratch resistance, and stain test. Chemical resistance was evaluated by immersion method in 2N NaOH, 2N HCl, xylene, and water while anticorrosion property was determined in 3.5% NaCl solution. Thermal stability of synthesized compounds of COFAIA, COMGIA and BAM were studied by thermogravemetric analysis (TGA). Surface morphology and crystallanity of synthesized coating films were studied by scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and X-ray diffraction (XRD) analysis. Also, stain property of coatings was carried on coated wood panel. The results show that BAM incorporated UV curable films display superior performance by enhancing studied properties for their coating applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 在当前的研究中，蓖麻油基脂肪酰胺（COFA）和单甘油酯（COMG）在实验室中分别合成，随后与衣康酸反应生成醇酸树脂，分别命名为COFAIA和COMGIA。随后，以对甲苯磺酸（pTSA）为催化剂，硼酸与丙烯酸羟乙酯（HEA）以1:3的摩尔比进行酯化反应，制备了硼基三丙烯酸酯单体（硼烷-三基三（氧基））三（乙烷-2,1-二基）（BAM）。通过傅里叶变换红外光谱 (FTIR) 和核磁共振 (NMR) 对合成材料 COFAIA、COMGIA 和 BAM 进行结构测定。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在当前的研究中，蓖麻油基脂肪酰胺（COFA）和单甘油酯（COMG）在实验室中分别合成，随后与衣康酸反应生成醇酸树脂，分别命名为COFAIA和COMGIA。随后，以对甲苯磺酸（pTSA）为催化剂，硼酸与丙烯酸羟乙酯（HEA）以1:3的摩尔比进行酯化反应，制备了硼基三丙烯酸酯单体（硼烷-三基三（氧基））三（乙烷-2,1-二基）（BAM）。通过傅里叶变换红外光谱 (FTIR) 和核磁共振 (NMR) 对合成材料 COFAIA、COMGIA 和 BAM 进行结构测定。然后，使用合成材料，通过将不同成分的 COFAIA 或 COMGIA 与 BAM（0 至 5% w/w）混合来制备各种 UV 固化涂料配方。这些组合物作为薄膜涂覆在低碳钢和木板上并在紫外线辐射下固化。通过进行各种测试，如划格附着力、铅笔硬度、光泽度测试、抗冲击性、耐刮擦性和沾污性测试，评估固化涂层的不同性能。通过在2N NaOH、2N HCl、二甲苯和水中浸泡的方法评估耐化学性，并在3.5% NaCl溶液中测定防腐性能。通过热重分析（TGA）研究了合成的COFAIA、COMGIA和BAM化合物的热稳定性。通过扫描电子显微镜（SEM）和X射线衍射（XRD）分析研究了合成涂膜的表面形貌和结晶度。此外，涂层木板上还具有涂层的染色性能。结果表明，采用 BAM 的 UV 固化薄膜通过增强其涂层应用的研究性能而显示出卓越的性能。

articles.title: Solar wind electron-streaming instability dynamics with lunar magnetic anomaly
articles.title_zh: 月球磁异常的太阳风电子流不稳定性动力学
articles.abstract: We analyse the electrostatic modes triggered by the electron-streaming instabilities in the magnetised solar-wind plasmas over the lunar magnetic anomalies (LMAs). A standard normal mode analysis is applied to derive a generalised linear dispersion relation to understand the observed electrostatic modes in the Moon over the LMAs. The various excited wave modes are illustratively identified and characterised. The interaction between the electron-beam mode and the normal acoustic modes, including their branch coupling and coalescence, is examined to elucidate the origin of the electron-streaming instability. We further investigate the effects of the propagation angle (θ) variation, relative to the interplanetary magnetic field (IMF), on the instability growth rate. The stabilising effects of the IMF on the instability are investigated. The consistency of this analysis in light of the existing Kaguya observations is finally established.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们分析了月球磁异常（LMA）上空磁化太阳风等离子体中电子流不稳定性引发的静电模式。应用标准简正模分析来推导广义线性色散关系，以了解在月球上空的月球上观测到的静电模式。说明性地识别和表征了各种激发波模式。检查电子束模式和正常声学模式之间的相互作用，包括它们的分支耦合和聚结，以阐明电子流不稳定性的根源。我们进一步研究了传播角 (θ) 相对于行星际磁场 (IMF) 的变化对不稳定性增长率的影响。研究了国际货币基金组织对不稳定性的稳定作用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们分析了月球磁异常（LMA）上空磁化太阳风等离子体中电子流不稳定性引发的静电模式。应用标准简正模分析来推导广义线性色散关系，以了解在月球上空的月球上观测到的静电模式。说明性地识别和表征了各种激发波模式。检查电子束模式和正常声学模式之间的相互作用，包括它们的分支耦合和聚结，以阐明电子流不稳定性的根源。我们进一步研究了传播角 (θ) 相对于行星际磁场 (IMF) 的变化对不稳定性增长率的影响。研究了国际货币基金组织对不稳定性的稳定作用。根据现有的辉夜观测结果，这一分析的一致性最终得以确立。

articles.title: In situ acoustic manufacturing of conformal brain–computer interfaces
articles.title_zh: 共形脑机接口的原位声学制造
articles.abstract: Brain–computer interfaces are usually prefabricated and surgically implanted, creating mechanical mismatch, tissue manipulation, inflammation, and signal instability. We report AI-guided in situ ultrasound printing (AiUP), a closed-loop acoustic manufacturing strategy that prints conformal cortical electrodes directly on the dura or brain surface. AiUP integrates pressure-programmable fluorinated silk fibroin nanocages, modular conductive ultrasound-printable inks, ultrasound imaging–guided focused-ultrasound hardware, and an AI controller, EchoAgent. Nanocages collapsed at defined acoustic pressures to release crosslinkers and trigger localized, nonthermal hydrogel formation, whereas EchoAgent planned trajectories, compensated acoustic distortion, and corrected path drift. AiUP produced conductive hydrogel electrodes with ~200 μm resolution, 30 s gelation, ~20 kΩ impedance, 3-month recording stability, and enabled rodent seizure warning and pig neural decoding.
articles.abstract_zh: 脑机接口通常是预制的并通过手术植入，导致机械失配、组织操纵、炎症和信号不稳定。我们报告了人工智能引导的原位超声打印（AiUP），这是一种闭环声学制造策略，可直接在硬脑膜或大脑表面打印适形皮质电极。 AiUP 集成了压力可编程氟化丝素蛋白纳米笼、模块化导电超声打印墨水、超声成像引导聚焦超声硬件和人工智能控制器 EchoAgent。纳米笼在规定的声压下塌陷，释放交联剂并触发局部非热水凝胶形成，而 EchoAgent 则规划轨迹、补偿声学失真并纠正路径漂移。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 脑机接口通常是预制的并通过手术植入，导致机械失配、组织操纵、炎症和信号不稳定。我们报告了人工智能引导的原位超声打印（AiUP），这是一种闭环声学制造策略，可直接在硬脑膜或大脑表面打印适形皮质电极。 AiUP 集成了压力可编程氟化丝素蛋白纳米笼、模块化导电超声打印墨水、超声成像引导聚焦超声硬件和人工智能控制器 EchoAgent。纳米笼在规定的声压下塌陷，释放交联剂并触发局部非热水凝胶形成，而 EchoAgent 则规划轨迹、补偿声学失真并纠正路径漂移。 AiUP 生产的导电水凝胶电极具有约 200 μm 分辨率、30 秒凝胶化、约 20 kΩ 阻抗、3 个月记录稳定性，并实现了啮齿动物癫痫发作警告和猪神经解码。

articles.title: Verifier strength does not buy discovery quality: a pre-registered two-domain test of LLM-based automated research, with post-hoc evidence pointing to proposer-pool composition
articles.title_zh: 验证者的实力并不能买到发现的质量：基于 LLM 的自动化研究的预先注册的两域测试，事后证据表明提议者池的组成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04420v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Automated research pipelines pair an LLM proposer with a verifier on an implicit bet: discovery quality rises with verification strength. Under a pre-registered protocol we test this bet in two real-data domains -- job-shop scheduling and vehicular edge offloading on Beijing T-Drive trajectories -- across 100 matched LLM/random pairs per domain and three verifier tiers. The manipulation binds -- a 429-case mutation battery shows scores rising across tiers -- yet the paired LLM-over-random advantage does not scale with it (A, one-sided p=0.1115; D, p=0.9994), and in D shrinks under the strict tier (margin contrast -0.040, p=0.0013). The two lower gates promote identical candidates in 100/100 and 99/100 pairs, so the strict order is untestable when they coincide. Constructively, LLM proposals carry a real paired advantage over random controls, but a post-hoc union-pool analysis shows the fastest path to better discovery is widening the pool, not tightening the gate: mixing the two pools adds +1.52 holdout-value units in domain A (one-sided Wilcoxon, n=100, p=0.0002) -- evidence that pool composition, not verification strength, is the lever. Criteria, ledgers and scripts are archived on Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23308866).

articles.abstract_zh_full: 自动化研究管道将法学硕士提议者与验证者配对，进行隐式赌注：发现质量随着验证强度的提高而提高。根据预先注册的协议，我们在两个真实数据域（北京 T-Drive 轨迹上的作业车间调度和车辆边缘卸载）中测试了这一赌注，每个域有 100 个匹配的 LLM/随机对和三个验证者层。这种操作结合起来——429个案例的突变电池显示分数在各层中不断上升——但配对的LLM相对于随机的优势并没有随之扩大（A，单边p = 0.1115；D，p = 0.9994），并且在D中在严格层下缩小（边缘对比度-0.040，p = 0.0013）。两个较低的门以 100/100 和 99/100 对的方式提升相同的候选者，因此当它们重合时，严格的顺序是无法测试的。建设性地讲，LLM 提案相对于随机对照具有真正的配对优势，但事后联合池分析表明，获得更好发现的最快途径是扩大池，而不是收紧大门：混合两个池会在域 A 中增加 +1.52 个保留值单位（单边 Wilcoxon，n=100，p=0.0002）——证据表明池组成，而不是验证强度，才是杠杆。标准、账本和脚本均存档在 Zenodo 上（DOI：10.5281/zenodo.23308866）。

articles.title: Correlated quantum criticality and topological magnetoelectric response in Bi2Se3
articles.title_zh: Bi2Se3 中相关的量子临界性和拓扑磁电响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03670v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A defining feature of quantum materials is that multiple orders govern low-energy physics and are not independent. We study Bi₂Se₃ by combining DFT with a renormalized correlated honeycomb model in which frustrated magnetic order and helical topological surface states are coupled via one control parameter. The surface states map to a honeycomb Hubbard model with frustrated J₁--J₂ exchange. Exact diagonalization up to 20 sites shows the Néel structure factor and valence-bond-solid order parameter cross at J₂/J₁ approx 0.22, agreeing with QMC/DMRG, and a dynamical spin structure factor broadens near the crossover, as expected for a spinon continuum. Band inversion of the renormalized tight-binding model occurs on the same critical locus, producing jumps in the Chern number and Z₂ invariant mirrored by the skyrmion charge Q. This gives a microscopic link: Q selects the axion angle and thus the topological magnetoelectric coupling. We distinguish axion coupling, independent of skyrmion helicity, from the helicity-dependent magnetoelectric multipole coupling, whose toroidal component scales as sinγ and vanishes for Néel-type textures. We derive the Q-topological magnetoelectric energy and estimate sim 10⁻²⁰,J per skyrmion per cycle for few-tesla fields. The cycle is thermodynamically bounded: constant-θ cycles extract no net work, and efficiency is limited by axionic entropy change.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子材料的一个决定性特征是多级控制低能物理并且不是独立的。我们通过将 DFT 与重正化相关蜂窝模型相结合来研究 Bi2Se3，其中受抑磁序和螺旋拓扑表面状态通过一个控制参数耦合。表面态映射到具有受抑 J₁-J2 交换的蜂窝哈伯德模型。多达 20 个位点的精确对角化显示，Néel 结构因子和价键-固体有序参数在 J2/J1 处交叉约为 0.22，与 QMC/DMRG 一致，并且动态自旋结构因子在交叉点附近变宽，正如自旋连续体所预期的那样。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子材料的一个决定性特征是多级控制低能物理并且不是独立的。我们通过将 DFT 与重正化相关蜂窝模型相结合来研究 Bi2Se3，其中受抑磁序和螺旋拓扑表面状态通过一个控制参数耦合。表面态映射到具有受抑 J₁-J2 交换的蜂窝哈伯德模型。多达 20 个位点的精确对角化显示，Néel 结构因子和价键-固体有序参数在 J2/J1 处交叉约为 0.22，与 QMC/DMRG 一致，并且动态自旋结构因子在交叉点附近变宽，正如自旋连续体所预期的那样。重正化紧束缚模型的能带反转发生在相同的关键轨迹上，产生由斯格明子电荷 Q 镜像的陈数和 Z2 不变量的跳跃。这给出了微观联系：Q 选择轴子角度，从而选择拓扑磁电耦合。我们将独立于斯格明子螺旋性的轴子耦合与依赖于螺旋性的磁电多极耦合区分开来，后者的环形分量按 sinγ 缩放，并且对于 Néel 型纹理消失。我们推导出 Q 拓扑磁电能量，并估计几特斯拉场中每个斯格明子每个周期 sim 10⁻²⁰,J。该循环受热力学限制：恒定θ循环不提取净功，并且效率受到轴子熵变的限制。

articles.title: When do machine-learning potentials need a configuration-dependent kernel? Learning long-range interactions with Fourier neural operators
articles.title_zh: 机器学习潜力何时需要依赖于配置的内核？学习与傅立叶神经算子的远程交互
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03678v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-range interactions in machine-learning interatomic potentials are commonly treated by coupling learned sources through either a prescribed electrostatic kernel or a learned but configuration-independent one. Whether such a kernel suffices depends on the underlying screened interaction. We address this question by using Fourier neural operators (FNOs) to learn how latent source fields, built from the descriptors of a local backbone (here MACE), interact across the simulation cell. For a synthetic ionic system with tunable screening, a prescribed Coulomb kernel underestimates the long-wavelength charge fluctuations by 43% under strong screening, whereas the FNO reproduces them within 3% and recovers 95-99% of the variance of the residual left by the local backbone. A linear FNO, which learns a configuration-independent kernel, performs equally well in the homogeneous case. Under inhomogeneous screening, rearranging the remote medium modulates the coupling between distant ions, a dependence that no configuration-independent kernel can represent. Among the models tested, only the nonlinear FNO responds to this modulation, and its force errors are 27-41% lower than those of configuration-independent models. In first-principles benchmarks of liquid water, lithium lanthanum zirconate, and Au2/MgO(001), MACE-FNO is comparable to a prescribed-kernel model for the bulk systems and more accurate for the interface. It further captures the reversal of the Au2 wetting preference induced by remote Al dopants, with deviations below 5 meV per cell from density functional theory. These results indicate that a configuration-dependent kernel, as learned by FNOs, becomes necessary once the screening medium varies, even though the energy remains quadratic in the charges for a fixed medium.
articles.abstract_zh: 机器学习原子间势中的长程相互作用通常通过通过规定的静电核或学习但与配置无关的核耦合学习源来处理。这样的内核是否足够取决于底层的屏蔽交互。我们通过使用傅里叶神经算子 (FNO) 来解决这个问题，以了解根据本地骨干网（此处为 MACE）的描述符构建的潜在源场如何在模拟单元中相互作用。对于具有可调谐屏蔽的合成离子系统，规定的库仑核在强屏蔽下将长波长电荷波动低估了 43%，而 FNO 在 3% 内再现了它们，并恢复了本地主干留下的残差方差的 95-99%。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 机器学习原子间势中的长程相互作用通常通过通过规定的静电核或学习但与配置无关的核耦合学习源来处理。这样的内核是否足够取决于底层的屏蔽交互。我们通过使用傅里叶神经算子 (FNO) 来解决这个问题，以了解根据本地骨干网（此处为 MACE）的描述符构建的潜在源场如何在模拟单元中相互作用。对于具有可调谐屏蔽的合成离子系统，规定的库仑核在强屏蔽下将长波长电荷波动低估了 43%，而 FNO 在 3% 内再现了它们，并恢复了本地主干留下的残差方差的 95-99%。学习独立于配置的内核的线性 FNO 在同质情况下表现同样出色。在非均匀筛选下，重新排列远程介质会调节远程离子之间的耦合，这是任何与配置无关的内核都无法表示的依赖性。在测试的模型中，只有非线性FNO响应这种调制，其力误差比与配置无关的模型低27-41%。在液态水、锆酸锂镧和 Au2/MgO(001) 的第一性原理基准测试中，MACE-FNO 与体系统的规定内核模型相当，并且界面更准确。它进一步捕获了由远程 Al 掺杂剂引起的 Au2 润湿偏好的逆转，与密度泛函理论相比，每个细胞的偏差低于 5 meV。这些结果表明，一旦屏蔽介质发生变化，即使固定介质的能量仍然是电荷的二次方，FNO 所学到的依赖于配置的内核就变得必要。

articles.title: Collective Modes of Fractional States Beyond Landau Levels
articles.title_zh: 朗道能级以上分数态的集体模态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03805v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Collective modes provide a powerful probe into the properties and stability of topologically ordered and strongly interacting phases of matter, such as fractional quantum Hall states. Yet, the description of fractional-state excitations away from the Landau-level limit remains a formidable challenge. We develop a framework for describing collective excitations in the strong-coupling regime of coupled-wire constructions and show that they emerge as solitons and breathers of effective sine-Gordon theories. This approach provides a systematic route to studying collective modes in a broad class of fractional states. Applied to a coupled-wire construction of the fractional quantum Hall effect, the framework captures key features of the magnetoroton branch. It naturally extends to fractional Chern insulators, demonstrating that magnetoroton-like collective modes persist well beyond the Landau-level limit. We find that the magnetoroton gap increases as the Fubini-Study metric approaches the ideal (trace-condition) limit, highlighting the important role of quantum geometry in the stability of fractionalized phases and their collective excitations. The same trend favors the stability of the long-wavelength quadrupolar mode associated with the chiral graviton. Together, these results identify a distinct interplay between fractionalization and quantum geometry, and provide an analytical framework for studies of collective excitations in fractional topological matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 集体模式为拓扑有序和强相互作用的物质相（例如分数量子霍尔态）的性质和稳定性提供了有力的探索。然而，描述远离朗道能级极限的分数态激发仍然是一个艰巨的挑战。我们开发了一个框架来描述耦合线结构的强耦合机制中的集体激励，并表明它们作为有效正弦戈登理论的孤子和呼吸器出现。这种方法为研究广泛的分数状态中的集体模式提供了一条系统的途径。该框架应用于分数量子霍尔效应的耦合线结构，捕获了磁转子分支的关键特征。它自然地扩展到分数陈绝缘体，证明类似磁旋子的集体模式持续远远超出朗道能级极限。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 集体模式为拓扑有序和强相互作用的物质相（例如分数量子霍尔态）的性质和稳定性提供了有力的探索。然而，描述远离朗道能级极限的分数态激发仍然是一个艰巨的挑战。我们开发了一个框架来描述耦合线结构的强耦合机制中的集体激励，并表明它们作为有效正弦戈登理论的孤子和呼吸器出现。这种方法为研究广泛的分数状态中的集体模式提供了一条系统的途径。该框架应用于分数量子霍尔效应的耦合线结构，捕获了磁转子分支的关键特征。它自然地扩展到分数陈绝缘体，证明类似磁旋子的集体模式持续远远超出朗道能级极限。我们发现，随着富比尼研究度量接近理想（迹线条件）极限，磁转子间隙增加，突出了量子几何在分数化相及其集体激发的稳定性中的重要作用。同样的趋势有利于与手性引力子相关的长波长四极模式的稳定性。总之，这些结果确定了分数化和量子几何之间的独特相互作用，并为分数拓扑物质中集体激发的研究提供了分析框架。

articles.title: Coexisting Kondo and Weyl-like transport in kagome heavy-fermion metal, Yb_yCo₃Ge₃₋ₓSnₓ
articles.title_zh: kagome重费米子金属Yb_yCo₃Ge₃₋ₓSnₓ中共存的Kondo和类Weyl输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03822v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Strong electron correlations and topology offer complementary routes to controlling electrical conduction, as correlations can make electrons heavy (e.g. Kondo lattices) whereas topology can make them behave as massless particles (e.g. Dirac or Weyl systems), and having both in one material is rare. In Kondo lattice systems, Kondo hybridization between localized 4f and conduction electrons strongly enhances the quasiparticle mass, where in Weyl-Kondo systems these Kondo-renormalized bands form Weyl states, and simultaneous signs of both Kondo and Weyl states in one material have not been observed in transport. Here we report signs of both in the kagome metal ceYb_yCo3Ge₃₋ₓSnₓ by combining magnetotransport, heat capacity, magnetization, angle-resolved and X-ray photoemission spectroscopy, and DFT+U calculations to reveal Yb-dependent Kondo scattering developing into lattice coherence, with extrapolated Sommerfeld coefficient of approximately 2 ~JmolYb⁻¹K⁻². Transverse magnetoresistance (MR) follows single-ion Kondo scaling, whereas longitudinal transport contains an additional negative response proportional to B² and remains unsaturated up to 32 T, consistent with a chiral anomaly. These findings support a picture of Kondo and Weyl-like conduction arising from distinct electronic states without external Fermi-level tuning, suggesting a possible route to combining correlated and topological functionality in a bulk material.
articles.abstract_zh: 强电子相关性和拓扑结构提供了控制电传导的互补途径，因为相关性可以使电子变重（例如近藤晶格），而拓扑结构可以使它们表现为无质量粒子（例如狄拉克或韦尔系统），并且在一种材料中同时具有这两种情况是罕见的。在近藤晶格系统中，局域 4f 和传导电子之间的近藤杂化强烈增强了准粒子质量，其中在韦尔-近藤系统中，这些近藤重正化能带形成韦尔态，并且在传输中尚未观察到一种材料中近藤和韦尔态的同时迹象。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 强电子相关性和拓扑结构提供了控制电传导的互补途径，因为相关性可以使电子变重（例如近藤晶格），而拓扑结构可以使它们表现为无质量粒子（例如狄拉克或韦尔系统），并且在一种材料中同时具有这两种情况是罕见的。在近藤晶格系统中，局域 4f 和传导电子之间的近藤杂化强烈增强了准粒子质量，其中在韦尔-近藤系统中，这些近藤重正化能带形成韦尔态，并且在传输中尚未观察到一种材料中近藤和韦尔态的同时迹象。在这里，我们通过结合磁输运、热容、磁化、角分辨和 X 射线光电子能谱以及 DFT+U 计算，报告了 kagome 金属 ceYb_yCo3Ge₃₋ₓSnₓ 中两者的迹象，揭示了依赖于 Yb 的近藤散射发展为晶格相干性，外推索默菲尔德系数约为 2 ~JmolYb⁻1K⁻2。横向磁阻 (MR) 遵循单离子 Kondo 标度，而纵向传输包含与 B² 成比例的额外负响应，并且在高达 32 T 时保持不饱和，与手性异常一致。这些发现支持了在没有外部费米能级调谐的情况下由不同电子态产生的近藤和类韦尔传导的图像，这表明了在块体材料中结合相关和拓扑功能的可能途径。

articles.title: Lattice spin systems coupled to a compact U(1) gauge field with negative gauge coupling favoring frustration
articles.title_zh: 晶格自旋系统与紧凑的 U(1) 规范场耦合，负规范耦合有利于挫败
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03837v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the phase diagram and nature of the phase transitions of three-dimensional compact lattice Abelian Higgs models with negative gauge coupling. These models describe multicomponent complex scalar fields coupled to a compact U(1) gauge field. Negative gauge coupling favors frustrated plaquette configurations, competing with the tendency of the matter ferromagnetic-like interaction to suppress frustration. Monte Carlo simulations and finite-size scaling analyses of models with one- and two-component scalar fields of unit charge reveal a substantially richer phase structure than at nonnegative gauge coupling. For two components, the O(3) transition line associated with gauge-invariant bilinear ordering extends into the negative-coupling region, and turns into a first-order transition line with decreasing K, toward the fully-frustrated K→ -infty limit. An analogous first-order transition line is also found for the one-component scalar matter with negative gauge coupling. Both one- and two-component models exhibit two additional continuous transition lines at sufficiently large matter coupling. Their energy-cumulant scaling is consistent with three-dimensional Ising and XY critical exponents, suggesting topological transitions in the mathbb Z₂ and XY gauge universality classes, respectively. These results uncover additional phases generated by the competition between matter ordering and dynamical gauge frustration, whose physical characterization remains an open question.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了具有负规范耦合的三维紧晶格阿贝尔希格斯模型的相图和相变性质。这些模型描述了与紧凑 U(1) 规范场耦合的多分量复标量场。负规范耦合有利于受挫板配置，与物质类铁磁相互作用的趋势竞争以抑制受挫。具有单位电荷的一分量和二分量标量场的模型的蒙特卡罗模拟和有限尺寸尺度分析揭示了比非负规范耦合时更加丰富的相结构。对于两个分量，与规范不变双线性排序相关的 O(3) 过渡线延伸到负耦合区域，并变成 K 逐渐减小的一阶过渡线，朝向完全受抑 K→ -infty 极限。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了具有负规范耦合的三维紧晶格阿贝尔希格斯模型的相图和相变性质。这些模型描述了与紧凑 U(1) 规范场耦合的多分量复标量场。负规范耦合有利于受挫板配置，与物质类铁磁相互作用的趋势竞争以抑制受挫。具有单位电荷的一分量和二分量标量场的模型的蒙特卡罗模拟和有限尺寸尺度分析揭示了比非负规范耦合时更加丰富的相结构。对于两个分量，与规范不变双线性排序相关的 O(3) 过渡线延伸到负耦合区域，并变成 K 逐渐减小的一阶过渡线，朝向完全受抑 K→ -infty 极限。对于具有负规范耦合的单分量标量物质，也发现了类似的一阶过渡线。一组分和双组分模型在足够大的物质耦合下都表现出两条附加的连续转变线。它们的能量累积标度与三维 Ising 和 XY 临界指数一致，分别表明 mathbb Z2 和 XY 规范通用性类别中的拓扑转变。这些结果揭示了物质排序和动态规范挫折之间的竞争所产生的额外阶段，其物理特征仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。

articles.title: Possibility of Potts Spin-Ice in Rare Earth Twisted-Kagome Layers: an Example of DyAgGe
articles.title_zh: 稀土扭曲戈薇层中波茨旋转冰的可能性：DyAgGe 的一个例子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03842v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Three-dimensional (3D) spin-ice compounds, predominantly based on the pyrochlore or spinel structure, have been attracting considerable interest in the last two decades. A two-dimensional (2D) analogue is the spin-ice consisting of kagome planes. So far, only Ising spin ice has been discovered in any material, and only one 2D material, the kagome compound HoAgGe, has been identified as a spin ice. In this Letter, we show that another rare-earth twisted Kagome magnetic compound, DyAgGe, is in fact a Potts spin ice (or color ice), where at each site not two but four spin directions are allowed. We argue that an 8-state spin ice may also exist in this class of systems. We present a first-principles calculation of magnetic interactions in DyAgGe, and confirm the 4-state Potts structure of this material by matching our model predictions with the available experimental data.
articles.abstract_zh: 三维（3D）自旋冰化合物主要基于烧绿石或尖晶石结构，在过去二十年中引起了人们极大的兴趣。二维 (2D) 类似物是由戈薇平面组成的自旋冰。迄今为止，在任何材料中都只发现了伊辛自旋冰，并且只有一种二维材料，戈果化合物HoAgGe，被确定为自旋冰。在这封信中，我们表明另一种稀土扭曲 Kagome 磁性化合物 DyAgGe 实际上是波茨自旋冰（或彩色冰），其中每个位置允许的不是两个而是四个旋转方向。我们认为此类系统中也可能存在 8 态自旋冰。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 三维（3D）自旋冰化合物主要基于烧绿石或尖晶石结构，在过去二十年中引起了人们极大的兴趣。二维 (2D) 类似物是由戈薇平面组成的自旋冰。迄今为止，在任何材料中都只发现了伊辛自旋冰，并且只有一种二维材料，戈果化合物HoAgGe，被确定为自旋冰。在这封信中，我们表明另一种稀土扭曲 Kagome 磁性化合物 DyAgGe 实际上是波茨自旋冰（或彩色冰），其中每个位置允许的不是两个而是四个旋转方向。我们认为此类系统中也可能存在 8 态自旋冰。我们提出了 DyAgGe 中磁相互作用的第一原理计算，并通过将我们的模型预测与可用的实验数据相匹配来确认该材料的 4 态 Potts 结构。

articles.title: Liouvillian Kramers Degeneracy
articles.title_zh: 刘维尔·克拉默斯简并性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03881v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Kramers theorem generally guarantees the spectral degeneracy of time-reversal-invariant Hamiltonian operators with half-integer spin, underlying a variety of physical phenomena. Despite its fundamental significance, the Kramers degeneracy has been argued to be absent in Liouvillian superoperators acting on mixed states because of the double structure of the Hilbert space. Here, we instead demonstrate that the interplay of time-reversal symmetrydag and parity symmetry enforces the Kramers degeneracy in Liouvillians. We explicitly construct dissipative many-body models of interacting fermions and spins exhibiting the Kramers degeneracy and show that their complex spectral statistics follow those of non-Hermitian random matrices in the corresponding symplectic symmetry classes. Of the three fundamental universality classes of non-Hermitian random matrices, the symplectic class has never been realized in symmetry-resolved many-body Liouvillians. Our constructions provide its explicit realizations and spectral signatures of nonintegrability in symplectic open quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 克莱默斯定理通常保证了具有半整数自旋的时间反转不变哈密顿算子的谱简并性，这是多种物理现象的基础。尽管具有根本意义，但由于希尔伯特空间的双重结构，克莱默简并性被认为在作用于混合态的刘维尔超级算子中不存在。在这里，我们相反证明时间反演对称性和宇称对称性的相互作用强化了刘维尔式中的克莱默简并性。我们明确构建了相互作用的费米子和自旋的耗散多体模型，表现出克莱默简并性，并表明它们的复杂谱统计遵循相应辛对称类中的非厄米随机矩阵。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 克莱默斯定理通常保证了具有半整数自旋的时间反转不变哈密顿算子的谱简并性，这是多种物理现象的基础。尽管具有根本意义，但由于希尔伯特空间的双重结构，克莱默简并性被认为在作用于混合态的刘维尔超级算子中不存在。在这里，我们相反证明时间反演对称性和宇称对称性的相互作用强化了刘维尔式中的克莱默简并性。我们明确构建了相互作用的费米子和自旋的耗散多体模型，表现出克莱默简并性，并表明它们的复杂谱统计遵循相应辛对称类中的非厄米随机矩阵。在非厄米随机矩阵的三个基本普遍性类中，辛类从未在对称性解决的多体刘维尔矩阵中实现。我们的构造提供了辛开放量子系统中不可积性的显式实现和光谱特征。

articles.title: Effect of Small Particle Interactions on Assembly of Binary Colloidal Clusters
articles.title_zh: 小颗粒相互作用对二元胶体团簇组装的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03909v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A central challenge in colloidal self-assembly is understanding how interaction strength influences the competition between structural optimization and kinetic arrest during the formation of hierarchical structures. Here, we investigate the assembly process of a binary mixture of differently sized silica colloids dispersed in a near-critical water/2,6-lutidine solvent, where critical Casimir forces provide reversible and temperature tunable attractions. By systematically tuning the effective interactions between large-large (L-L), large-small (L-S), and small-small (S-S) particle pairs, we directly observe how the nucleation and growth of the binary colloid assemblies evolve in a wall-confined quasi-two-dimensional geometry when multiple pair-interactions are present. Confocal laser scanning microscopy imaging shows that combined L-L interactions and L-S interactions lead to compact L-S core-shell clusters with high shell occupancy, while the additional presence of S-S interactions suppress the shell formation and lead to extended, branched binary networks. Particle-resolved analyses of cluster growth and bond dynamics reveal that these structural transitions are governed by the motion of the small particles in the clusters changing from highly dynamic leading to structural reorganization to frozen dynamics resulting kinetic trapping. Our findings demonstrate how the interaction-governed mobility and kinetic arrest of small particles influence the growth of finite binary clusters and offers microscopic insight into the formation of binary crystals and kinetically trapped space-spanning binary colloidal networks and gels.
articles.abstract_zh: 胶体自组装的一个核心挑战是了解相互作用强度如何影响分层结构形成过程中结构优化和动力学停滞之间的竞争。在这里，我们研究了分散在近临界水/2,6-二甲基吡啶溶剂中的不同尺寸二氧化硅胶体的二元混合物的组装过程，其中临界卡西米尔力提供可逆和温度可调的吸引力。通过系统地调整大-大（L-L）、大-小（L-S）和小-小（S-S）粒子对之间的有效相互作用，我们直接观察当存在多个对相互作用时，二元胶体组件的成核和生长如何在壁限准二维几何结构中演化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 胶体自组装的一个核心挑战是了解相互作用强度如何影响分层结构形成过程中结构优化和动力学停滞之间的竞争。在这里，我们研究了分散在近临界水/2,6-二甲基吡啶溶剂中的不同尺寸二氧化硅胶体的二元混合物的组装过程，其中临界卡西米尔力提供可逆和温度可调的吸引力。通过系统地调整大-大（L-L）、大-小（L-S）和小-小（S-S）粒子对之间的有效相互作用，我们直接观察当存在多个对相互作用时，二元胶体组件的成核和生长如何在壁限准二维几何结构中演化。共焦激光扫描显微镜成像显示，L-L相互作用和L-S相互作用的结合导致了具有高壳占有率的紧凑的L-S核-壳簇，而S-S相互作用的额外存在抑制了壳的形成并导致延伸的、分支的二元网络。对簇生长和键动力学的粒子解析分析表明，这些结构转变是由簇中小颗粒的运动控制的，从导致结构重组的高度动态变化到导致动力学捕获的冻结动态。我们的研究结果证明了小颗粒的相互作用控制的迁移率和动力学停滞如何影响有限二元簇的生长，并提供了对二元晶体和动力学捕获的跨空间二元胶体网络和凝胶的形成的微观见解。

articles.title: Early-age formation of MgO-SiO₂ binders and the effect of hydromagnesite and dehydrated hydromagnesite: An in situ synchrotron X-ray diffraction and pair distribution function study
articles.title_zh: MgO-SiO2 粘结剂的早期形成以及水菱镁矿和脱水水菱镁矿的影响：原位同步加速器 X 射线衍射和对分布函数研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03929v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: MgO-SiO₂ binders are promising low-CO₂ alternatives to Portland cement that can permanently store CO₂ by incorporating magnesium carbonate phases. Adding a magnesium carbonate such as nesquehonite or hydromagnesite is known to change the initial hydration product from crystalline brucite (Mg(OH)₂) to disordered hydrous carbonate-containing brucite (HCB), yet how these binders evolve during the initial hours of reaction remains largely unknown. Here, in situ synchrotron X-ray diffraction (XRD) and pair distribution function (PDF) analysis follows an MgO-SiO₂ paste with and without hydromagnesite (HY, Mg₅(CO₃)₄(OH)₂·4H₂O) or dehydrated hydromagnesite (DHY, HY heated at 325 degC to remove water) over the first 24 h, with ex situ measurements to 42 days. Real space phase quantification reveals that magnesium-silicate-hydrate (M-S-H) is detected in the first scan (~45 min) of every paste, before formation of any brucite or HCB. The PDF results also show that in the neat MgO-SiO₂ paste, half of the M-S-H present at 42 days has formed by 24 h, while no M-S-H is detected by XRD at any age due to the intrinsic disorder present in this phase. Both carbonate sources (HY and DHY) are found to increase the extent of MgO dissolution, where no unreacted MgO is detected at 24 h in contrast with >7 days for the neat paste. However, DHY is seen to slow the initial stages of MgO dissolution (prior to ~6 h) compared with the neat paste, a period during which significant DHY rehydration is seen to occur without any HCB formation. Hence, this investigation shows that the onset of HCB precipitation in MgO-SiO₂-(D)HY paste is influenced by the hydration state of the DHY phase, where precipitation is delayed while DHY is rehydrating.
articles.abstract_zh: MgO-SiO2 粘合剂是波特兰水泥的有前途的低二氧化碳替代品，可以通过掺入碳酸镁相来永久储存二氧化碳。众所周知，添加碳酸镁（例如三水菱镁矿或水菱镁矿）会将初始水合产物从结晶水镁石 (Mg(OH)2) 转变为无序的水合碳酸镁水镁石 (HCB)，但这些粘合剂在反应的最初几个小时内如何演变仍然很大程度上未知。
articles.abstract_zh_full: MgO-SiO2 粘合剂是波特兰水泥的有前途的低二氧化碳替代品，可以通过掺入碳酸镁相来永久储存二氧化碳。众所周知，添加碳酸镁（例如三水菱镁矿或水菱镁矿）会将初始水合产物从结晶水镁石 (Mg(OH)2) 转变为无序的水合碳酸镁水镁石 (HCB)，但这些粘合剂在反应的最初几个小时内如何演变仍然很大程度上未知。在这里，原位同步加速器 X 射线衍射 (XRD) 和对分布函数 (PDF) 分析跟踪了含或不含水菱镁矿 (HY, Mg5(CO3)4(OH)2·4H2O) 或脱水水菱镁矿（DHY, HY 在 325 ℃ 下加热以除去水）的 MgO-SiO2 浆料在前 24 小时内的情况，并进行了 42 天的异位测量。真实空间相定量显示，在形成任何水镁石或 HCB 之前，在每个糊剂的第一次扫描（约 45 分钟）中检测到硅酸镁水合物 (M-S-H)。 PDF 结果还表明，在纯 MgO-SiO2 浆料中，42 天时存在的 M-S-H 的一半在 24 小时时已形成，而由于该相中存在固有无序，因此在任何年龄下 XRD 均未检测到 M-S-H。发现两种碳酸盐源（HY 和 DHY）都会增加 MgO 溶解的程度，24 小时内没有检测到未反应的 MgO，而纯糊剂的 7 天以上则没有检测到未反应的 MgO。然而，与纯糊剂相比，DHY 会减缓 MgO 溶解的初始阶段（约 6 小时之前），在此期间，会发生显着的 DHY 再水化，而不会形成任何 HCB。因此，这项研究表明，MgO-SiO2-(D)HY 浆料中 HCB 沉淀的开始受到 DHY 相水合状态的影响，其中当 DHY 重新水化时，沉淀会被延迟。

articles.title: Korringa factor in Dirac-nodal-line systems
articles.title_zh: 狄拉克节点线系统中的科林加因子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03994v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Korringa factor K(α) in the nuclear magnetic resonance studies is a widely used measure of electron-correlation effects in metals and is conventionally interpreted using the non-correlated value K(α) = 1. In Dirac-fermion systems, however, the non-correlated reference value depends on the electronic density of states (DOS) and differs from that of conventional metals. Here, we theoretically investigate the non-correlated Korringa factor K^*(α) in a Dirac nodal-line (DNL) system with finite nodal-line dispersion using a DOS-based approach. We show that K^*(α) exhibits an intrinsic temperature dependence, continuously evolving from the Dirac-fermion value of 1.71 at high temperatures to the metallic value of 1 at low temperatures. The crossover temperature is found to be proportional to the nodal-line dispersion width, identified as the characteristic energy scale governing the non-correlated Korringa factor in DNL systems. We further demonstrate that Landau quantization generates singular DOS structures that strongly enhance K^*(α), producing pronounced peaks even in the absence of electron correlations. In addition, K^*(α) exhibits two distinct types of magnetic oscillations arising from intra-level and inter-level contributions. The latter originates from the overlap of singular points belonging to positive and negative quantum-number Landau subbands at the Fermi level and represents a unique consequence of the finite energy dispersion of a DNL. These results provide a quantitative reference for interpreting NMR experiments in DNL materials and for identifying genuine correlation effects beyond DOS-induced contributions.
articles.abstract_zh: 核磁共振研究中的 Korringa 因子 K(α) 是金属中电子相关效应的广泛使用的度量，通常使用非相关值 K(α) = 1 进行解释。然而，在狄拉克费米子系统中，非相关参考值取决于电子态密度 (DOS)，并且与常规金属的电子态密度不同。在这里，我们使用基于 DOS 的方法从理论上研究了具有有限节点线色散的狄拉克节点线 (DNL) 系统中的非相关 Korringa 因子 K^*(α)。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 核磁共振研究中的 Korringa 因子 K(α) 是金属中电子相关效应的广泛使用的度量，通常使用非相关值 K(α) = 1 进行解释。然而，在狄拉克费米子系统中，非相关参考值取决于电子态密度 (DOS)，并且与常规金属的电子态密度不同。在这里，我们使用基于 DOS 的方法从理论上研究了具有有限节点线色散的狄拉克节点线 (DNL) 系统中的非相关 Korringa 因子 K^*(α)。我们证明 K^*(α) 表现出内在的温度依赖性，从高温下的狄拉克费米子值 1.71 不断演变到低温下的金属值 1。研究发现，交叉温度与节点线色散宽度成正比，节点线色散宽度被确定为控制 DNL 系统中不相关 Korringa 因子的特征能量尺度。我们进一步证明朗道量子化产生奇异的 DOS 结构，该结构强烈增强 K^*(α)，即使在没有电子相关性的情况下也会产生明显的峰值。此外，K^*(α) 表现出由层内和层间贡献引起的两种不同类型的磁振荡。后者源于属于费米能级正负量子数朗道子带的奇点的重叠，代表了 DNL 有限能量色散的独特结果。这些结果为解释 DNL 材料中的 NMR 实验以及识别 DOS 引起的贡献之外的真正相关效应提供了定量参考。

articles.title: Continuum Dirac Theory and Nonlinear Extensions of a Chain of Alternating non-linear springs: an SSH version of the Fermi-Pasta-Ulam-Tsingou model
articles.title_zh: 连续统狄拉克理论和交替非线性弹簧链的非线性扩展：Fermi-Pasta-Ulam-Tsingou 模型的 SSH 版本
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04049v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A mechanical version of the SSH model, made of equal masses joined by two alternating non-linear springs is studied in the continuum limit. Such a non-linear dimerized mechanical chain generates a nonlinear, dispersive, two-field hyperbolic system of Boussinesq type of differential equations, describing coupled acoustic and gapped optical fields. The corresponding Lagrangian density is found, revealing that the acoustic and optical degrees of freedom are coupled through a structure that is formally analogous to a synthetic spin-orbit coupling, where the spatial motion is locked to the internal sublattice degree of freedom. An emergent non-Abelian Berry connection term also appears. Some particular solitary-wave solutions are found using variational theory, as the effective optical field obeys an undamped and unforced cubic-quintic Duffing equation. Near the Brillouin-zone edge, the system becomes a nonlinear Dirac field theory of the Soler type, providing a direct mechanical realization of interacting relativistic solitons. By factoring out fast spatial oscillations, an effective Jackiw-Rebbi Hamiltonian is obtained, with topological zero modes at domain walls. These modes are akin to the electronic flat bands in moire graphene systems associated with superconductivity and charge fractionalization. Finally, we discuss the mechanical rigidity transition and its effects on the fields as the system evolves toward the fully dimerized limit, in which the zero modes are floppy modes.
articles.abstract_zh: 在连续介质极限下研究了 SSH 模型的机械版本，该模型由两个交替的非线性弹簧连接的相等质量组成。这种非线性二聚机械链生成布辛涅斯克型微分方程的非线性、色散、双场双曲系统，描述耦合的声场和间隙光场。找到了相应的拉格朗日密度，揭示了声学和光学自由度是通过一种形式上类似于合成自旋轨道耦合的结构耦合的，其中空间运动被锁定到内部亚晶格自由度。还出现了一个新兴的非阿贝尔贝里连接项。使用变分理论找到了一些特定的孤立波解，因为有效光场服从无阻尼且无受迫的三次五次杜芬方程。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在连续介质极限下研究了 SSH 模型的机械版本，该模型由两个交替的非线性弹簧连接的相等质量组成。这种非线性二聚机械链生成布辛涅斯克型微分方程的非线性、色散、双场双曲系统，描述耦合的声场和间隙光场。找到了相应的拉格朗日密度，揭示了声学和光学自由度是通过一种形式上类似于合成自旋轨道耦合的结构耦合的，其中空间运动被锁定到内部亚晶格自由度。还出现了一个新兴的非阿贝尔贝里连接项。使用变分理论找到了一些特定的孤立波解，因为有效光场服从无阻尼且无受迫的三次五次杜芬方程。在布里渊区边缘附近，系统变成索勒型非线性狄拉克场论，提供相互作用的相对论孤子的直接机械实现。通过分解快速空间振荡，获得有效的 Jackiw-Rebbi 哈密顿量，在畴壁处具有拓扑零模式。这些模式类似于莫尔石墨烯系统中与超导性和电荷分级相关的电子平带。最后，我们讨论了当系统向完全二聚极限演化时，机械刚性转变及其对场的影响，其中零模式是软盘模式。

articles.title: Resolving magnetic order and dynamics with polarized neutron scattering: a practical guide to longitudinal polarization analysis
articles.title_zh: 用极化中子散射解析磁序和动力学：纵向极化分析实用指南
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04050v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neutron scattering provides microscopic information on magnetic order and spin dynamics. Most experiments, however, use unpolarized neutrons and do not fully exploit the information carried by the neutron spin. Longitudinal polarization analysis (LPA), established in the pioneering work of Moon, Riste, and Koehler at Oak Ridge National Laboratory in the late 1960s, separates magnetic and nonmagnetic scattering contributions through their different effects on the neutron spin. In this review, we illustrate how LPA can distinguish weak magnetic scattering from nonmagnetic contributions, constrain small moment components, and resolve the spin-space anisotropy of magnetic excitations. We introduce the formalism connecting measured polarization channels to magnetic quantities and discuss scattering geometry, crystallographic projections, and corrections for finite polarization. Our aim is to provide a practical guide for neutron scatterers using LPA to determine magnetic structures and characterize spin excitations in quantum materials. We conclude with opportunities in altermagnets, unconventional superconductors, and kagome magnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 中子散射提供有关磁序和自旋动力学的微观信息。然而，大多数实验使用非极化中子，并没有充分利用中子自旋携带的信息。纵向极化分析 (LPA) 是由 Moon、Riste 和 Koehler 于 20 世纪 60 年代末在橡树岭国家实验室的开创性工作中建立的，通过磁性和非磁性散射对中子自旋的不同影响来区分它们。在这篇综述中，我们阐述了 LPA 如何区分弱磁散射和非磁贡献，约束小矩分量，并解决磁激励的自旋空间各向异性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 中子散射提供有关磁序和自旋动力学的微观信息。然而，大多数实验使用非极化中子，并没有充分利用中子自旋携带的信息。纵向极化分析 (LPA) 是由 Moon、Riste 和 Koehler 于 20 世纪 60 年代末在橡树岭国家实验室的开创性工作中建立的，通过磁性和非磁性散射对中子自旋的不同影响来区分它们。在这篇综述中，我们阐述了 LPA 如何区分弱磁散射和非磁贡献，约束小矩分量，并解决磁激励的自旋空间各向异性。我们介绍了将测量的偏振通道与磁量连接起来的形式，并讨论了散射几何、晶体学投影和有限偏振的校正。我们的目标是为中子散射体使用 LPA 确定磁性结构和表征量子材料中的自旋激发提供实用指南。我们最后总结了交流磁体、非常规超导体和戈薇磁体方面的机遇。

articles.title: Non-equilibrium orientational dynamics of pinned topological defects in two-dimensional nematic liquid crystals
articles.title_zh: 二维向列液晶中钉扎拓扑缺陷的非平衡取向动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04071v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The long-wavelength dynamics of two-dimensional (2D) nematic liquid crystals (LCs) is dominated by the motion of topological defects, which behave like interacting particles endowed with both topological charge and orientation. In experimentally relevant regimes, the translational dynamics of the defect positions can be accurately described by effective nematoelastic particle-particle interaction forces. By contrast, analogous quasistatic torque descriptions for the orientational dynamics typically fail due to a breakdown of time-scale separation, severely hindering the inverse design of texture response dynamics in nematic LCs. To overcome this obstruction, we introduce a linear phase-diffusion formulation that accurately predicts the orientational relaxation dynamics of pinned topological defects in the nonlinear 2D Landau-de Gennes theory. The broad practical potential of this approach is demonstrated by showing how it enables the inverse design of transient nematic patterns as well as the inference of hidden defect configurations from sparse measurements.
articles.abstract_zh: 二维 (2D) 向列液晶 (LC) 的长波长动力学由拓扑缺陷的运动主导，其行为就像具有拓扑电荷和取向的相互作用粒子。在实验相关的情况下，缺陷位置的平移动力学可以通过有效的线弹性粒子-粒子相互作用力来准确描述。相比之下，取向动力学的类似准静态扭矩描述通常会由于时间尺度分离的破坏而失败，严重阻碍了向列液晶中纹理响应动力学的逆向设计。为了克服这一障碍，我们引入了一种线性相扩散公式，该公式可以准确预测非线性 2D Landau-de Gennes 理论中固定拓扑缺陷的取向弛豫动力学。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 二维 (2D) 向列液晶 (LC) 的长波长动力学由拓扑缺陷的运动主导，其行为就像具有拓扑电荷和取向的相互作用粒子。在实验相关的情况下，缺陷位置的平移动力学可以通过有效的线弹性粒子-粒子相互作用力来准确描述。相比之下，取向动力学的类似准静态扭矩描述通常会由于时间尺度分离的破坏而失败，严重阻碍了向列液晶中纹理响应动力学的逆向设计。为了克服这一障碍，我们引入了一种线性相扩散公式，该公式可以准确预测非线性 2D Landau-de Gennes 理论中固定拓扑缺陷的取向弛豫动力学。该方法的广泛实际潜力通过展示它如何实现瞬态向列图案的逆设计以及从稀疏测量推断隐藏缺陷配置来证明。

articles.title: Multi-Fidelity Machine Learning for Predicting Startup Stress Growth and Strain Hardening in Wormlike Micellar Solutions
articles.title_zh: 用于预测蠕虫胶束解决方案中的启动应力增长和应变硬化的多保真机器学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04115v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Wormlike micellar solutions exhibit formulation-dependent nonlinear startup responses, including stress overshoot, undershoot, and strain hardening, making prediction across compositions and shear rates challenging. We developed a multi-fidelity machine-learning framework to predict stress-growth curves in cetylpyridinium chloride (CPyCl)-based wormlike micelles from sparse experimental measurements. The framework combines a low-fidelity analytical model describing the overall startup response with high-fidelity experimental data capturing formulation-specific nonlinear features. This approach addresses the limited and uneven coverage of salt chemistry, concentration, and shear rate without relying solely on data-intensive neural-network training. The trained model predicts complete stress-growth responses at untested shear rates and enables extraction of strain-hardening characteristics from interpolated curves. By augmenting sparse rheological measurements, the framework provides a basis for exploring relationships among formulation variables, linear viscoelastic properties, and nonlinear startup behavior, while supporting more efficient characterization of wormlike micellar solutions.
articles.abstract_zh: 蠕虫状胶束溶液表现出依赖于配方的非线性启动响应，包括应力过冲、下冲和应变硬化，使得对成分和剪切速率的预测具有挑战性。我们开发了一种多保真度机器学习框架，可以通过稀疏的实验测量来预测基于氯化十六烷基吡啶 (CPyCl) 的蠕虫状胶束的应力增长曲线。该框架结合了描述整体启动响应的低保真分析模型和捕获配方特定非线性特征的高保真实验数据。该方法解决了盐化学、浓度和剪切速率的有限且不均匀的覆盖范围，而无需仅依赖数据密集型神经网络训练。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 蠕虫状胶束溶液表现出依赖于配方的非线性启动响应，包括应力过冲、下冲和应变硬化，使得对成分和剪切速率的预测具有挑战性。我们开发了一种多保真度机器学习框架，可以通过稀疏的实验测量来预测基于氯化十六烷基吡啶 (CPyCl) 的蠕虫状胶束的应力增长曲线。该框架结合了描述整体启动响应的低保真分析模型和捕获配方特定非线性特征的高保真实验数据。该方法解决了盐化学、浓度和剪切速率的有限且不均匀的覆盖范围，而无需仅依赖数据密集型神经网络训练。经过训练的模型可以预测未经测试的剪切速率下的完整应力增长响应，并能够从插值曲线中提取应变硬化特征。通过增强稀疏流变测量，该框架为探索配方变量、线性粘弹性特性和非线性启动行为之间的关系提供了基础，同时支持更有效地表征蠕虫状胶束溶液。

articles.title: Altermagnetism-induced Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov superfluids and momentum-selective pairing channels in optical lattices
articles.title_zh: 交变磁力诱导的 Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov 超流体和光学晶格中的动量选择性配对通道
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04214v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the superfluid phases of a two-dimensional degenerate Fermi gas in an optical lattice subject to a dₓy-wave altermagnetic term that couples to the in-plane spin component. The single-particle Hamiltonian generates anisotropic Fermi surfaces for the two pseudo-spin species while maintaining zero net polarization. Using the Bogoliubov-de Gennes approach, we show that this anisotropy favors Cooper pairing at a finite center-of-mass momentum, producing a competition between Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) and Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov (FFLO) pairing and leading to FFLO superfluids. We further examine the effect of a Zeeman-induced spin polarization and find that triplet and singlet pairing channels coexist and compete, resulting in a momentum-selective pairing pattern. Remarkably, this triplet pairing emerges exclusively in the FFLO phase and is entirely absent in the BCS phase. The model is readily realizable in ultracold atoms with current experimental techniques, providing a feasible route for quantum emulation and for studying unconventional superfluid phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了光学晶格中二维简并费米气体的超流体相，该气体受到与面内自旋分量耦合的 dₓy 波交磁项的影响。单粒子哈密顿量为两个赝自旋物种生成各向异性费米表面，同时保持零净极化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了光学晶格中二维简并费米气体的超流体相，该气体受到与面内自旋分量耦合的 dₓy 波交磁项的影响。单粒子哈密顿量为两个赝自旋物种生成各向异性费米表面，同时保持零净极化。使用 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 方法，我们表明这种各向异性有利于有限质心动量下的 Cooper 配对，从而产生 Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) 和 Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov (FFLO) 配对之间的竞争，并导致 FFLO 超流体。我们进一步研究了塞曼诱导的自旋极化的影响，发现三重态和单重态配对通道共存并竞争，从而产生动量选择性配对模式。值得注意的是，这种三联体配对仅出现在 FFLO 阶段，而在 BCS 阶段完全不存在。该模型可以利用当前的实验技术在超冷原子中轻松实现，为量子仿真和非常规超流体相的研究提供了可行的途径。

articles.title: Thermally enhanced magnon-phonon resonance in van der Waals antiferromagnet FePS3
articles.title_zh: 范德华反铁磁体 FePS3 中的热增强磁振子共振
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04229v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Strong coupling between collective excitations provides a route to controlling quantum states of matter, yet its evolution under thermal fluctuations remains poorly understood. In the van der Waals antiferromagnet FePS3, strong magnon-phonon coupling is established at low temperatures. At the same time, recent terahertz experiments revealed the counterintuitive stabilization of a long-lived metastable magnetic state with an exceedingly long lifetime of 5 msec at the antiferromagnetic transition, not at the base temperature. This was attributed to a strongly coupled spin-lattice scenario, challenging the conventional wisdom that increased magnetic and thermal fluctuations near TN should be detrimental to the coherent control of a metastable phase. Thus it requires an independent examination for correct understanding. Using high-field Raman spectroscopy, we systematically investigate the temperature evolution of magnon-phonon coupling in FePS3. We observe a pronounced avoided crossing between magnon and phonon modes across a wide range of temperatures and find that the coupling strength remains remarkably robust with increasing temperatures. The zero-field magnon-phonon detuning decreases progressively with warming, driving the system toward resonance and thereby enhancing their hybridization near the transition temperature. This anomalous thermal evolution provides the crucial key to understanding the unusual terahertz-driven states recently reported in FePS3. More broadly, our results highlight van der Waals magnets as a promising platform for strong coupling among collective excitations and for controlling magnetic states through light-matter interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 集体激发之间的强耦合提供了控制物质量子态的途径，但其在热波动下的演化仍然知之甚少。在范德华反铁磁体 FePS3 中，在低温下建立了强磁振子耦合。与此同时，最近的太赫兹实验揭示了一种反直觉的长期亚稳态磁态稳定性，其在反铁磁转变时而不是在基础温度下具有 5 毫秒的超长寿命。这是由于强耦合的自旋晶格场景，挑战了传统观点，即 TN 附近增加的磁和热波动应该不利于亚稳态相的相干控制。因此，需要进行独立检查才能正确理解。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 集体激发之间的强耦合提供了控制物质量子态的途径，但其在热波动下的演化仍然知之甚少。在范德华反铁磁体 FePS3 中，在低温下建立了强磁振子耦合。与此同时，最近的太赫兹实验揭示了一种反直觉的长期亚稳态磁态稳定性，其在反铁磁转变时而不是在基础温度下具有 5 毫秒的超长寿命。这是由于强耦合的自旋晶格场景，挑战了传统观点，即 TN 附近增加的磁和热波动应该不利于亚稳态相的相干控制。因此，需要进行独立检查才能正确理解。利用高场拉曼光谱，我们系统地研究了 FePS3 中磁振子-声子耦合的温度演化。我们观察到在很宽的温度范围内明显避免了磁振子模式和声子模式之间的交叉，并发现随着温度的升高，耦合强度仍然非常强大。零场磁振子-声子失谐随着变暖而逐渐减小，驱动系统共振，从而增强它们在转变温度附近的杂化。这种反常的热演化为理解最近在 FePS3 中报道的不寻常的太赫兹驱动状态提供了关键的关键。更广泛地说，我们的结果强调了范德华磁体作为集体激发之间强耦合以及通过光-物质相互作用控制磁态的有前途的平台。

articles.title: Anomalous Hall Response and Real-Space Current Correlations in Rhombohedral Graphene
articles.title_zh: 菱面体石墨烯中的反常霍尔响应和实空间电流相关性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04312v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the anomalous Hall effect (AHE) and magnetization observed in rhombohedral graphene through real-space calculations which lead to new insights. Our calculations reveal no equilibrium loop currents of the type associated with the Haldane model of a quantum anomalous Hall insulator. Instead, the AHE arises in this instance from interference between electronic paths forming oriented closed Wilson loops of current operators in the presence of valley polarization. We show some examples of these Wilson loops. Using the fact that the added-carrier charge density resides dominantly in the top and bottom layers, we develop a real-space expansion of the surface Hamiltonian that reproduces the Hall response of the full model with good accuracy. We also predict that a smooth local potential induces equilibrium circulating currents whose strength depends on both Berry curvature and the orbital moments of states at the Fermi surface.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们通过实空间计算研究了菱面体石墨烯中观察到的反常霍尔效应（AHE）和磁化强度，从而得出新的见解。我们的计算表明，不存在与量子反常霍尔绝缘体霍尔丹模型相关的类型的平衡环路电流。相反，在这种情况下，AHE 是由于在存在谷极化的情况下形成电流算子的定向闭合威尔逊环的电子路径之间的干扰而产生的。我们展示了这些威尔逊环的一些示例。利用添加载流子电荷密度主要存在于顶层和底层的事实，我们开发了表面哈密顿量的实空间扩展，可以高精度地再现整个模型的霍尔响应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过实空间计算研究了菱面体石墨烯中观察到的反常霍尔效应（AHE）和磁化强度，从而得出新的见解。我们的计算表明，不存在与量子反常霍尔绝缘体霍尔丹模型相关的类型的平衡环路电流。相反，在这种情况下，AHE 是由于在存在谷极化的情况下形成电流算子的定向闭合威尔逊环的电子路径之间的干扰而产生的。我们展示了这些威尔逊环的一些示例。利用添加载流子电荷密度主要存在于顶层和底层的事实，我们开发了表面哈密顿量的实空间扩展，可以高精度地再现整个模型的霍尔响应。我们还预测，平滑的局部势能引起平衡环流，其强度取决于贝里曲率和费米表面状态的轨道矩。

articles.title: LaQX: A JAX Toolkit for Neural Quantum State Simulations of Lattice Quantum Many-Body Models
articles.title_zh: LaQX：用于晶格量子多体模型神经量子态模拟的 JAX 工具包
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04333v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural quantum states provide accurate variational representations for interacting lattice fermions and spins. Turning a new ansatz into a reproducible calculation, however, requires coordinated implementations of the Hamiltonian, sampling, optimization, observables, and accelerator parallelism. We present LaQX (Lattice Quantum simulation based on jaX), an open-source neural quantum state library based on JAX that organizes these components through common functional interfaces. Beyond ground-state variational Monte Carlo, LaQX supports excited-state calculations, Green's Function Monte Carlo refinement, adiabatic evolution, and real-time evolution with time-dependent variational Monte Carlo. It consolidates methods developed in recent high-accuracy neural quantum state studies of the Hubbard model and frustrated magnets, and the package has been used to investigate the triangular-lattice Hofstadter-Hubbard model. We document these capabilities with reproducible calculations for Hubbard, J₁-J₂ Heisenberg, altermagnetic Hubbard, and interacting Hofstadter models. Function-oriented modules separate the scientific components and limit the source context needed for extensions by human developers and large language models. Source code, documentation, and executable examples are available at https://github.com/bytedance/laqx.
articles.abstract_zh: 神经量子态为相互作用的晶格费米子和自旋提供了准确的变分表示。然而，将新的 ansatz 转变为可重复的计算，需要哈密顿量、采样、优化、可观测值和加速器并行性的协调实现。我们提出了 LaQX（基于 jaX 的晶格量子模拟），这是一个基于 JAX 的开源神经量子状态库，它通过通用功能接口组织这些组件。除了基态变分蒙特卡罗之外，LaQX 还支持激发态计算、格林函数蒙特卡罗细化、绝热演化以及依赖时间的变分蒙特卡罗的实时演化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 神经量子态为相互作用的晶格费米子和自旋提供了准确的变分表示。然而，将新的 ansatz 转变为可重复的计算，需要哈密顿量、采样、优化、可观测值和加速器并行性的协调实现。我们提出了 LaQX（基于 jaX 的晶格量子模拟），这是一个基于 JAX 的开源神经量子状态库，它通过通用功能接口组织这些组件。除了基态变分蒙特卡罗之外，LaQX 还支持激发态计算、格林函数蒙特卡罗细化、绝热演化以及依赖时间的变分蒙特卡罗的实时演化。它整合了最近在哈伯德模型和受抑磁体的高精度神经量子态研究中开发的方法，并且该软件包已用于研究三角晶格 Hofstadter-Hubbard 模型。我们通过哈伯德、J₁-J2 海森堡、交流哈伯德和相互作用的霍夫施塔特模型的可重复计算来记录这些功能。面向功能的模块将科学组件分开，并限制人类开发人员和大型语言模型扩展所需的源上下文。源代码、文档和可执行示例可在 https://github.com/bytedance/laqx 上获取。

articles.title: TT-SCHA for Thermodynamics of Binary Alloys
articles.title_zh: 二元合金热力学的 TT-SCHA
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04402v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The free energy of a crystal is an integral over the positions of all its atoms, in 3N dimensions. We evaluate it without random sampling for the ordered alloys B2 NiAl and gamma-TiAl with embedded-atom potentials, using a self-consistent harmonic approximation (SCHA) corrected to third order in temperature, calculated via thermal averages of tensor-train (TT) integrals built from one atom and its neighbors, which we call TT-SCHA. The result is for an infinite crystal without sampling error; its numerical error is set by the starting pivots of the interpolation (up to 9 MPa in the pressure, reduced by averaging three runs; SM Table S26). Against the molecular dynamics of 65,536 atoms (Frenkel-Ladd free energy at 600 K, integrated energy above), TT-SCHA free energy agrees to 0.13 meV per atom at 600-1000 K, using 420-500 times fewer core-seconds for one run. At zero pressure, results agree with published calculations that use the same embedded-atom potential: the published elastic constants of gamma-TiAl (to 1 GPa, by a static lattice calculation) and its thermal expansion from Monte Carlo sampling (to 0.012 percentage points).
articles.abstract_zh: 晶体的自由能是 3N 维中所有原子位置的积分。我们对具有嵌入原子势的有序合金 B2 NiAl 和 gamma-TiAl 进行了评估，无需随机采样，而是使用温度校正为三阶的自洽谐波近似 (SCHA)，通过由一个原子及其邻居构建的张量序列 (TT) 积分的热平均值计算，我们将其称为 TT-SCHA。结果是无限晶体，没有采样误差；其数值误差由插值的起始枢轴设置（压力高达 9 MPa，通过平均三次运行而减少；SM 表 S26）。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 晶体的自由能是 3N 维中所有原子位置的积分。我们对具有嵌入原子势的有序合金 B2 NiAl 和 gamma-TiAl 进行了评估，无需随机采样，而是使用温度校正为三阶的自洽谐波近似 (SCHA)，通过由一个原子及其邻居构建的张量序列 (TT) 积分的热平均值计算，我们将其称为 TT-SCHA。结果是无限晶体，没有采样误差；其数值误差由插值的起始枢轴设置（压力高达 9 MPa，通过平均三次运行而减少；SM 表 S26）。与 65,536 个原子的分子动力学（600 K 下的 Frenkel-Ladd 自由能，上面的积分能量）相比，TT-SCHA 自由能在 600-1000 K 下同意每个原子 0.13 meV，一次运行的核心秒数减少了 420-500 倍。在零压力下，结果与已发表的使用相同嵌入原子势的计算结果一致：已发表的 γ-TiAl 弹性常数（通过静态晶格计算达到 1 GPa）及其蒙特卡罗采样的热膨胀（达到 0.012 个百分点）。

articles.title: Strain-Glass Dynamics in the Superionic Conductor Na₃PS₄
articles.title_zh: 超离子导体 Na₃PS₄ 中的应变玻璃动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04547v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ionic conduction in solid-state electrolytes is conventionally described by mobile cations migrating through a static host lattice. Yet the fastest conductors are often the most disordered, and how disorder enhances transport remains unresolved at the mesoscale, inaccessible to ensemble-averaged probes. We use Bragg X-ray photon correlation spectroscopy to measure nanoscale structural dynamics of a single ball-milled Na₃PS₄ particle. We find that the cubic phase behaves as a strain glass: a frustrated configuration of three degenerate tetragonal variants with short-range order. Its domain-wall motion is stress-driven, crossing over irreversibly to thermally activated dynamics on annealing as residual milling stress is depleted. Rearrangements follow scale-free avalanche statistics, matching ferroelastic martensites but without external driving. The tetragonal polymorph shows none of these features and relaxes fifty times more slowly. These dynamics occur on timescales comparable to estimated ionic diffusion across the particle, indicating the host structure cannot be assumed static on transport-relevant timescales.
articles.abstract_zh: 固态电解质中的离子传导通常通过移动阳离子迁移穿过静态主晶格来描述。然而，最快的导体往往是最无序的，而无序如何增强传输在介观尺度上仍然悬而未决，集合平均探针无法访问。我们使用布拉格 X 射线光子相关光谱来测量单个球磨 Na₃PS₄ 颗粒的纳米级结构动力学。我们发现立方相的行为类似于应变玻璃：具有短程有序的三个简并四方变体的受挫构型。其畴壁运动是应力驱动的，随着残余铣削应力的耗尽，退火时不可逆地转变为热激活动力学。重排遵循无标度雪崩统计，匹配铁弹马氏体但没有外部驱动。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 固态电解质中的离子传导通常通过移动阳离子迁移穿过静态主晶格来描述。然而，最快的导体往往是最无序的，而无序如何增强传输在介观尺度上仍然悬而未决，集合平均探针无法访问。我们使用布拉格 X 射线光子相关光谱来测量单个球磨 Na₃PS₄ 颗粒的纳米级结构动力学。我们发现立方相的行为类似于应变玻璃：具有短程有序的三个简并四方变体的受挫构型。其畴壁运动是应力驱动的，随着残余铣削应力的耗尽，退火时不可逆地转变为热激活动力学。重排遵循无标度雪崩统计，匹配铁弹马氏体但没有外部驱动。四方多晶型物没有表现出这些特征，并且松弛速度慢五十倍。这些动力学发生的时间尺度与估计的粒子内离子扩散相当，表明主体结构在与传输相关的时间尺度上不能假设是静态的。

articles.title: Interfacial Hole Accumulation Enables Selective Free-Surface Formation in Ge-on-Si
articles.title_zh: 界面孔累积可实现硅基硅中的选择性自由表面形成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04589v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electrochemically formed two-dimensional free surfaces (2DFS) decouple Ge epilayers from the misfit-dislocation network at the Ge/Si interface, but the origin of their selectivity has remained unclear. We combine finite-volume current-distribution modelling, including charge-transfer kinetics, with a one-dimensional Poisson analysis of the p-Ge/p+-Si heterojunction. With realistic conductivities, an ohmic description would drive 77% of the anodic current through Ge, whereas hole-limited charge transfer reduces this fraction to 0.07%, independently of the electrolyte conductivity. The valence-band offset accumulates holes on the Ge side up to ~1019 cm--3 within a self-limited nanometric layer, which localizes dissolution at the interface. The model yields design rules for the doping contrast (NSi/NGe ___ 60) and the mesa width (___ 3.6λ, with λ approx 1.7 μm).
articles.abstract_zh: 电化学形成的二维自由表面（2DFS）将Ge外延层与Ge/Si界面的失配位错网络解耦，但其选择性的起源仍不清楚。我们将有限体积电流分布建模（包括电荷转移动力学）与 p-Ge/p+-Si 异质结的一维泊松分析相结合。对于实际电导率，欧姆描述将驱动 77% 的阳极电流通过 Ge，而空穴限制电荷转移将该比例降低至 0.07%，与电解质电导率无关。价带偏移在自限纳米层内在 Ge 侧累积高达约 1019 cm--3 的空穴，从而使界面处的溶解局部化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电化学形成的二维自由表面（2DFS）将Ge外延层与Ge/Si界面的失配位错网络解耦，但其选择性的起源仍不清楚。我们将有限体积电流分布建模（包括电荷转移动力学）与 p-Ge/p+-Si 异质结的一维泊松分析相结合。对于实际电导率，欧姆描述将驱动 77% 的阳极电流通过 Ge，而空穴限制电荷转移将该比例降低至 0.07%，与电解质电导率无关。价带偏移在自限纳米层内在 Ge 侧累积高达约 1019 cm--3 的空穴，从而使界面处的溶解局部化。该模型给出了掺杂对比度 (NSi/NGe ___ 60) 和台面宽度 (___ 3.6λ，其中 λ 约为 1.7 μm) 的设计规则。

articles.title: Spin-Density-Driven Hybrid Spin Splitting in Collinear Compensated Magnets
articles.title_zh: 共线补偿磁体中自旋密度驱动的混合自旋分裂
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04617v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nonrelativistic spin splitting in collinear compensated magnets is constrained by spin-group symmetry, with distinct alternating and Zeeman-type splitting typically associated with altermagnets and fully compensated ferrimagnets, respectively. From a spin-density perspective, we propose a class of hybrid compensated magnets in which alternating-like and Zeeman-type spin splitting coexist within a single collinear compensated state. Using a minimal two-sector model, we demonstrate that this coexistence arises from competition between directional sublattice dispersion and the sector-dependent energy biases arising from the same structural inequivalence. First-principles calculations provide a proof of concept in a crossed bilayer of unequal-width Janus graphene nanoribbons, where the structurally inequivalent ribbons retain approximately symmetry-related spin-density distributions. The valence and conduction sectors support direction-selective spin transport and energy-selective spin-polarized states, respectively. These results connect the spatial organization of spin density with the electronic response to structural inequivalence, providing a design principle for hybrid spin splitting in compensated magnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 共线补偿磁体中的非相对论自旋分裂受到自旋群对称性的约束，具有明显的交替和塞曼型分裂通常分别与交替磁体和完全补偿的亚铁磁体相关。从自旋密度的角度来看，我们提出了一类混合补偿磁体，其中交替型和塞曼型自旋分裂在单个共线补偿态中共存。使用最小的两扇区模型，我们证明这种共存是由于定向亚晶格色散与相同结构不等价性引起的扇区相关能量偏差之间的竞争而产生的。第一性原理计算提供了不等宽度Janus石墨烯纳米带交叉双层的概念证明，其中结构不等价的带保留了近似对称相关的自旋密度分布。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 共线补偿磁体中的非相对论自旋分裂受到自旋群对称性的约束，具有明显的交替和塞曼型分裂通常分别与交替磁体和完全补偿的亚铁磁体相关。从自旋密度的角度来看，我们提出了一类混合补偿磁体，其中交替型和塞曼型自旋分裂在单个共线补偿态中共存。使用最小的两扇区模型，我们证明这种共存是由于定向亚晶格色散与相同结构不等价性引起的扇区相关能量偏差之间的竞争而产生的。第一性原理计算提供了不等宽度Janus石墨烯纳米带交叉双层的概念证明，其中结构不等价的带保留了近似对称相关的自旋密度分布。价态和传导区分别支持方向选择性自旋输运和能量选择性自旋极化态。这些结果将自旋密度的空间组织与结构不等价的电子响应联系起来，为补偿磁体中的混合自旋分裂提供了设计原理。

articles.title: Hydrogen-induced modification of the local charge density in MnSb₂Te₄
articles.title_zh: 氢诱导改变 MnSb2Te₄ 中的局部电荷密度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04649v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the effects of ionic hydrogen (H⁺) intake on the occupied and unoccupied states of MnSb₂Te₄, a van der Waals magnetic material. Using angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) and time-resolved ARPES, combined with resonant and core level photoemission, we reveal that hydrogen binds near specific lattice sites, locally redistributing charge density and reshaping the valence band spectral weight. While the band gap and picosecond carrier dynamics show only minor changes upon hydrogenation, the conduction band exhibits a striking stoichiometry-dependent response. These findings indicate that hydrogen interacts strongly with the intrinsic defects in the lattice, acting as a selective dopant in MnSb₂Te₄. Our work provides a spectroscopic basis for using hydrogen as a tool for the control of the electronic and magnetic properties in layered 2D materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了离子氢 (H⁺) 摄入量对范德华磁性材料 MnSb2Te₄ 的占据和未占据状态的影响。利用角分辨光电子能谱 (ARPES) 和时间分辨 ARPES，结合共振和核心能级光电子发射，我们揭示了氢在特定晶格位点附近结合，局部重新分布电荷密度并重塑价带光谱权重。虽然带隙和皮秒载流子动力学在氢化时仅显示出微小的变化，但导带表现出惊人的化学计量依赖性响应。这些发现表明氢与晶格中的固有缺陷强烈相互作用，充当 MnSb2Te4 中的选择性掺杂剂。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了离子氢 (H⁺) 摄入量对范德华磁性材料 MnSb2Te₄ 的占据和未占据状态的影响。利用角分辨光电子能谱 (ARPES) 和时间分辨 ARPES，结合共振和核心能级光电子发射，我们揭示了氢在特定晶格位点附近结合，局部重新分布电荷密度并重塑价带光谱权重。虽然带隙和皮秒载流子动力学在氢化时仅显示出微小的变化，但导带表现出惊人的化学计量依赖性响应。这些发现表明氢与晶格中的固有缺陷强烈相互作用，充当 MnSb2Te4 中的选择性掺杂剂。我们的工作为使用氢作为控制层状二维材料的电子和磁性的工具提供了光谱基础。

articles.title: Statistically Robust Characterization of Polaron and Bipolaron Intrinsic Traps in Amorphous Silica Reveals the Role of Network Flexibility in Electron Localisation
articles.title_zh: 无定形二氧化硅中极化子和双极化子本征陷阱的统计稳健表征揭示了网络灵活性在电子定位中的作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04652v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Intrinsic electron localization in amorphous silica (a-SiO2) contributes to charge trapping and defect generation in silica-based electronic materials - a phenomenon that degrades logic-device performance but can be exploited for memory applications. However, the structural distribution of one- and two-electron traps remains incompletely characterized, largely because the disordered covalent network of a-SiO2 spans a vast configurational space. To address this, we perform statistical sampling to select a representative 200-model subset of defect-free bulk a-SiO2 structures from a structurally converged parent set of 2512 models, generated via classical melt-quench molecular dynamics simulations. We then characterize the intrinsic one- and two-electron traps in this subset using HSE06 density functional theory calculations. Analysis of neutral precursor sites shows that trapping propensity is not determined by a universal O-Si-O angle or Si-O bond length; it is controlled by the accessibility of the relaxed trap geometry, requiring both local strain and medium-range network flexibility. Single electrons predominantly form edge-centred polarons on distorted SiO4 tetrahedra, with occupied states 3.1-4.3 eV below the conduction band minimum. Injection of a second electron drives stronger lattice relaxation, most commonly Si-O bond elongation leading to rupture, thereby forming threefold-coordinated-Si (Si3) bipolarons and, in some cases, Si-Si-bonded bipolaron configurations. The calculated bipolaron energy ranges are consistent with optical absorption features at 3.7, 4.7, and 6.4 eV associated with intrinsic electron localization.
articles.abstract_zh: 无定形二氧化硅 (a-SiO2) 中的本征电子局域化会导致二氧化硅基电子材料中的电荷俘获和缺陷产生，这种现象会降低逻辑器件的性能，但可用于存储器应用。然而，一电子和二电子陷阱的结构分布仍未完全表征，这主要是因为a-SiO2的无序共价网络跨越了巨大的构型空间。为了解决这个问题，我们进行统计采样，从通过经典熔体淬火分子动力学模拟生成的 2512 个模型的结构收敛父集中选择具有代表性的 200 个无缺陷块状 a-SiO2 结构的模型子集。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 无定形二氧化硅 (a-SiO2) 中的本征电子局域化会导致二氧化硅基电子材料中的电荷俘获和缺陷产生，这种现象会降低逻辑器件的性能，但可用于存储器应用。然而，一电子和二电子陷阱的结构分布仍未完全表征，这主要是因为a-SiO2的无序共价网络跨越了巨大的构型空间。为了解决这个问题，我们进行统计采样，从通过经典熔体淬火分子动力学模拟生成的 2512 个模型的结构收敛父集中选择具有代表性的 200 个无缺陷块状 a-SiO2 结构的模型子集。然后，我们使用 HSE06 密度泛函理论计算来表征该子集中固有的一电子陷阱和二电子陷阱。对中性前体位点的分析表明，捕获倾向并非由通用的 O-Si-O 角度或 Si-O 键长决定；它由松弛陷阱几何结构的可访问性控制，需要局部应变和中程网络灵活性。单电子主要在扭曲的 SiO4 四面体上形成边缘中心极化子，占据态比导带最小值低 3.1-4.3 eV。第二个电子的注入会驱动更强的晶格弛豫，最常见的是 Si-O 键伸长导致断裂，从而形成三重配位的 Si (Si3) 双极化子，在某些情况下形成 Si-Si 键合的双极化子构型。计算出的双极化子能量范围与与本征电子局域化相关的 3.7、4.7 和 6.4 eV 处的光学吸收特征一致。

articles.title: Thermodynamic Evidence for Multiple Field-Induced Phases in an Anisotropic Kagome Antiferromagnet
articles.title_zh: 各向异性 Kagome 反铁磁体中多个场感应相的热力学证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04675v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Kagome antiferromagnets are predicted to host exotic field-induced phases, yet experimental identification of their thermodynamic signatures remains challenging. Here we combine specific heat (C) and ultrasound measurements up to 36 T and down to 0.5 K to map the H-T phase diagram of the anisotropic kagome magnet Y₃Cu₉(OH)₁₉Cl₈. We show that the suppression of long-range antiferromagnetic order with field at sim 15 T approximately coincides with the onset of the unconventional 1/6 (or 1/9) magnetization plateau previously observed in this system. The attenuation (and sound velocity) then intriguingly increases down to 0.5 K just at μ₀H = 15 T, and C/T becomes temperature independent.
