Collectively, these findings identify a ground state of the bilayer nickelate characterized by competing bond-diagonal interactions, spin disproportionation, and an incipient lattice instability, establishing key ingredients for understanding the mechanism of nickelate superconductivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 使用环境压力下的拉曼散射，给出了双层镍酸盐La ”Ni ₂ O”的电子、磁场和晶格激发的综合光谱图。在进入低于153 K的自旋密度波状态时， A g通道呈现出突然的电子光谱间隙，具有清晰的等弹性点。相比之下， B g和B ₂ g通道以明显的双磁通（ 2M ）激发为主，代表了初期Mottness的特征。两个通道中的这些2M信号构成了沿Ni-O键及其对角方向的两种不同平面内自旋交换相互作用的证据。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 使用环境压力下的拉曼散射，给出了双层镍酸盐La ”Ni ₂ O”的电子、磁场和晶格激发的综合光谱图。在进入低于153 K的自旋密度波状态时， A g通道呈现出突然的电子光谱间隙，具有清晰的等弹性点。相比之下， B g和B ₂ g通道以明显的双磁通（ 2M ）激发为主，代表了初期Mottness的特征。两个通道中的这些2M信号构成了沿Ni-O键及其对角方向的两种不同平面内自旋交换相互作用的证据。基于自旋波理论的计算进一步揭示了B ₂ g通道中的2M模态起源于镍轨道介导的两个键对角反铁磁相互作用之间的竞争。此外，发现低于10 meV的低能量2M激发源于独特的、较弱的自旋矩，支持自旋不成比例。同时，揭示了B g声子从280到4.5 K的异常软化，表明存在导致棋盘式呼吸调节的初期晶格不稳定性。总的来说，这些发现确定了双层镍酸盐的基态，其特征是相互竞争的键-对角线相互作用、自旋歧化和初期晶格不稳定性，为理解镍酸盐超导机制建立了关键因素。

articles.title: Unconventional magnetoelectric conductivity and electrochemical response from dipole-like sources of Berry curvature
articles.title_zh: 来自浆果曲率偶极子样源的非常规磁电导率和电化学响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.08844v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the longitudinal magnetoelectric conductivity and nonlinear electrochemical response (ECR) of three-dimensional nodal-ring semimetals, including vortex nodal-rings (VNRs) and PT-symmetric nodal-rings (PTNRs), together with three-band Hopf semimetals (HSMs), using the semiclassical Boltzmann formalism. The nodal-rings of the VNRs and PTNRs lie in the k_z=0 plane, whereas the nodal points of HSMs host isolated Berry-curvature (BC) dipoles with axes along the k_z direction. In VNRs, such dipoles may be viewed as forming a continuous distribution along the nodal-ring, connecting the two classes of systems. For collinear electric and magnetic (B) fields along the anisotropy axis boldsymbol hatz, the linear response is computed exactly and displays odd powers of B_z for a single ring or node. For a two-node HSM with oppositely-oriented BC-dipole axes, these odd terms cancel in the sum. We analyse the nonlinear ECR, described by third-rank response tensors that relate the current to the combined action of an electric field and a chemical-potential gradient. The surviving tensor components are determined by the tilt direction of the bandstructure, and we obtain explicit results for simultaneous in-plane and axial tilts. A comparison of the three systems reveals a close correspondence between the responses of VNRs and HSMs, while PTNRs behave qualitatively differently. We attribute these similarities and differences to the topology of the BC field, namely dipole-like sources in VNRs and HSMs versus the ring-confined BC structure of PTNRs.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们使用半经典玻尔兹曼形式，研究了三维节点环半金属的纵向磁电导率和非线性电化学响应（ ECR ） ，包括涡旋节点环（ VNR ）和PT对称节点环（ PTNR ） ，以及三频段霍普夫半金属（ HSM ）。VNR和PTNR的节点环位于k_z = 0平面，而HSMS的节点点托管沿k_z方向轴的孤立浆果曲率（ BC ）偶极子。在VNR中，这种偶极子可被视为沿节点环形成连续分布，连接两类系统。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用半经典玻尔兹曼形式，研究了三维节点环半金属的纵向磁电导率和非线性电化学响应（ ECR ） ，包括涡旋节点环（ VNR ）和PT对称节点环（ PTNR ） ，以及三频段霍普夫半金属（ HSM ）。VNR和PTNR的节点环位于k_z = 0平面，而HSMS的节点点托管沿k_z方向轴的孤立浆果曲率（ BC ）偶极子。在VNR中，这种偶极子可被视为沿节点环形成连续分布，连接两类系统。对于沿各向异性轴粗体符号hatz的共线电场和磁场（ B ）场，精确计算线性响应，并显示单个环或节点的B_z的奇数幂。对于具有相反方向的BC-偶极轴的双节点HSM ，这些奇项在求和中抵消。我们分析非线性ECR ，由三阶响应张量描述，该张量将电流与电场和化学势梯度的组合作用相关联。剩余张量分量由带状结构的倾斜方向决定，我们得到了平面和轴向同时倾斜的显式结果。三个系统的比较揭示了VNR和HSM的反应之间的密切对应关系，而PTNR的行为在性质上有所不同。我们将这些相似性和差异性归因于BC场的拓扑结构，即VNR和HSM中的偶极子源与PTNR的环限制BC结构。

articles.title: Loss of altermagnetic order and smooth restoration of Kramers' spin degeneracy with increasing temperature in CrSb and MnTe
articles.title_zh: CrSb和MnTe中随温度升高而变化的磁序的丧失和Kramers自旋退化的平稳恢复
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.15035v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We describe how thermally induced spin fluctuations modify the electronic structures of two prototypical altermagnets, CrSb and MnTe, via application of the disordered local moment picture. For both materials, our self-consistent, ab initio calculations demonstrate that local magnetic moments persist on Cr and Mn atoms in their paramagnetic states, necessitating a spin-polarised description of the electronic structure even above the Néel temperature, T_N. Moreover, Kramers' spin degeneracy, which is broken for both materials in their altermagnetic ground states, is shown to be smoothly restored - on the average - as the local moments thermally disorder. In metallic CrSb, this occurs at temperatures well below T_N and the signature effects of its altermagnetism are lost as the magnetic disorder induces heavy smearing of strongly dispersive electronic states around the Fermi energy. By contrast, in semiconducting MnTe, with its band gap largely unaffected by magnetic disorder, the spin degeneracy only returns at temperatures close to and above T_N. We quantify the temperature dependence of the altermagnetic order parameter and the underlying electronic structures of both materials, with implications for their spin transport and spectroscopic properties.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们描述了热诱导的自旋波动如何通过应用无序局部矩图来改变两个典型替代磁体CrSb和MnTe的电子结构。对于这两种材料，我们自洽的从头计算表明， Cr和Mn原子在顺磁状态下存在局部磁矩，需要对电子结构进行自旋极化描述，甚至高于Néel温度T_N。此外，克莱默斯的自旋退化（ Kramers 'spin degeneracy ）在两种材料的变磁基态下都被打破，平均而言，随着局部时刻的热紊乱，克莱默斯的自旋退化被平稳地恢复。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们描述了热诱导的自旋波动如何通过应用无序局部矩图来改变两个典型替代磁体CrSb和MnTe的电子结构。对于这两种材料，我们自洽的从头计算表明， Cr和Mn原子在顺磁状态下存在局部磁矩，需要对电子结构进行自旋极化描述，甚至高于Néel温度T_N。此外，克莱默斯的自旋退化（ Kramers 'spin degeneracy ）在两种材料的变磁基态下都被打破，平均而言，随着局部时刻的热紊乱，克莱默斯的自旋退化被平稳地恢复。在金属CrSb中，这发生在远低于T_N的温度下，并且其改变磁性的特征效应丢失，因为磁性紊乱导致费米能周围强色散电子态的严重涂抹。相比之下，在半导体MnTe中，其带隙基本上不受磁性紊乱的影响，自旋退化仅在接近或高于T_N的温度下返回。我们量化了两种材料的替代有序参数和基础电子结构的温度依赖性，并对其自旋传输和光谱性质产生影响。

articles.title: Direction-selective intertwined charge, orbital, and lattice orders under uniaxial strain in hole-doped manganite: La0.75Ca0.25MnO3
articles.title_zh: 掺孔锰矿中单轴应变下的方向选择性交织电荷、轨道和晶格阶数： La0.75Ca0.25MnO3
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.27979v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The complex interplay of charge, spin, orbital, and lattice degrees of freedom governs emergent phases in quantum materials, making strain a powerful control parameter. Recent advances in free-standing layer techniques have enabled extreme strains of nearly 8%, opening access to novel and often unexpected electronic and magnetic phases. Here, using a density functional theory approach, we investigate the effect of direction-selective uniaxial strain on the prototypical Jahn-Teller system La1-xCaxMnO3 (x = 0.25). We find that different strain directions stabilize qualitatively distinct structural, charge, and orbital responses, rather than merely different strengths of the same phase. In particular, extreme uniaxial strain selectively induces cooperative Jahn-Teller, breathing-like, and site-selective modulations, thereby enabling previously inaccessible intertwined orders in manganites. These results establish direction-selective uniaxial strain as a powerful and selective route for engineering emergent phases in quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 电荷、自旋、轨道和晶格自由度的复杂相互作用控制着量子材料的出现相，使应变成为一个强大的控制参数。独立层技术的最新进展使近8%的极端应变得以实现，开辟了进入新颖且通常意想不到的电子和磁相的途径。这里，使用密度泛函理论方法，我们研究了方向选择性单轴应变对原型Jahn-Teller系统La1-xCaxMnO3 （ x = 0.25 ）的影响。我们发现，不同的应变方向稳定了定性不同的结构、电荷和轨道响应，而不仅仅是同一阶段的不同强度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电荷、自旋、轨道和晶格自由度的复杂相互作用控制着量子材料的出现相，使应变成为一个强大的控制参数。独立层技术的最新进展使近8%的极端应变得以实现，开辟了进入新颖且通常意想不到的电子和磁相的途径。这里，使用密度泛函理论方法，我们研究了方向选择性单轴应变对原型Jahn-Teller系统La1-xCaxMnO3 （ x = 0.25 ）的影响。我们发现，不同的应变方向稳定了定性不同的结构、电荷和轨道响应，而不仅仅是同一阶段的不同强度。特别是，极端单轴应变选择性地诱导协同Jahn-Teller、呼吸样和位点选择性调节，从而使锰矿中以前无法接近的交织订单成为可能。这些结果确立了方向选择性单轴应变作为量子材料中工程涌出相的强大和选择性路线。

articles.title: Disentangling Spin Pumping and Two-Magnon Scattering Contributions to Gilbert Damping in YIG/V Bilayers
articles.title_zh: 解开自旋泵和双磁散射对YIG/V双层中Gilbert阻尼的贡献
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.29597v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this work, we investigate the magnetic damping and spin pumping response of YIG-based bilayers incorporating vanadium (V) as the normal metal layer via broadband ferromagnetic resonance (FMR) measurements as a function of YIG thickness. We show that the apparent enhancement of the Gilbert damping in YIG/V bilayers cannot be solely attributed to spin pumping. Instead, two-magnon scattering (TMS) plays a dominant role in governing the thickness dependence of the damping in the nanometer regime. By applying a thickness-dependent damping model that accounts for both spin pumping and two-magnon scattering contributions, we successfully disentangle the different relaxation contributions. Our analysis reveals that neglecting two-magnon scattering leads to an overestimation of the spin-pumping contribution and consequently to unphysically large values of the effective spin-mixing conductance. After isolating the intrinsic spin pumping contribution, we extract a thickness-independent effective spin-mixing conductance of guparrowdowⁿarrowₑff = 1.33 × 10¹⁸~mathrmm⁻². These findings provide a more accurate framework for quantifying spin transport parameters in FM/HM systems and emphasize the necessity of accounting for extrinsic damping mechanisms when interpreting spin pumping and inverse spin Hall effect experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们通过宽带铁磁共振（ FMR ）测量研究了结合钒（ V ）作为正常金属层的YIG基双层的磁阻尼和自旋泵浦响应，作为YIG厚度的函数。我们表明， YIG/V双层中Gilbert阻尼的明显增强不能仅归因于自旋泵。相反，双磁场散射（ TMS ）在控制纳米级阻尼的厚度依赖性方面发挥着主导作用。通过应用同时考虑自旋泵浦和双磁散射贡献的厚度相关阻尼模型，我们成功地解开了不同的弛豫贡献。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这项工作中，我们通过宽带铁磁共振（ FMR ）测量研究了结合钒（ V ）作为正常金属层的YIG基双层的磁阻尼和自旋泵浦响应，作为YIG厚度的函数。我们表明， YIG/V双层中Gilbert阻尼的明显增强不能仅归因于自旋泵。相反，双磁场散射（ TMS ）在控制纳米级阻尼的厚度依赖性方面发挥着主导作用。通过应用同时考虑自旋泵浦和双磁散射贡献的厚度相关阻尼模型，我们成功地解开了不同的弛豫贡献。我们的分析显示，忽略双磁散射会导致自旋泵浦贡献的高估，从而导致有效自旋混合电导的非物理大值。在分离出固有自旋泵的贡献后，我们提取了与厚度无关的guparrowdow的有效自旋混合电导= 1.33 × 10 ¹ ”~ mathrmm”。这些发现为量化FM/HM系统中的自旋传输参数提供了更准确的框架，并强调了在解释自旋泵和逆自旋霍尔效应实验时考虑外部阻尼机制的必要性。

articles.title: Chiral Phonons Coupled to Spin-Split Bands in Altermagnetic CrSb and MnTe
articles.title_zh: 手性声子耦合到Altermagnetic CrSb和MnTe中的自旋分裂带
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.04802v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Altermagnets exhibit momentum-dependent spin splitting without net magnetization, providing a unique platform where magnetic order, electronic structure and lattice dynamics intertwine. Here, using first-principles calculations, we demonstrate that the prototypical altermagnets CrSb and MnTe host locally chiral phonon modes carrying finite phonon angular momentum with a six-lobes f-wave texture in momentum space. Our results show that the chiral lattice motion originates from the pnictogen/chalcogen sublattice, while the altermagnetic spin splitting is generated by the magnetic transition-metal atoms, indicating that chiral lattice dynamics and altermagnetic electronic states originate from different atomic sublattices of the same crystal. In pristine compounds, at each valley, inversion symmetry suppresses the net phonon angular momentum despite local circular atomic motion. We further demonstrate that isoelectronic symmetry lowering induced by chemical substitution lifts this cancellation and generates finite valley phonon chirality, while keeping the altermagnetic nature of the compounds intact. Most importantly, we reveal that chiral phonons couple to momentum-dependent spin-split electronic bands through momentum-dependent electron-phonon interaction, producing characteristic modifications of the electronic structure, possibly accessible by photoemission experiments. Our results establish altermagnets as a promising platform for chiral phononics and spin-selective lattice control.
articles.abstract_zh: Altermagnet表现出动量依赖的自旋分裂，没有净磁化，提供了一个独特的平台，磁序、电子结构和晶格动力学交织在一起。在这里，使用第一原理计算，我们证明了原型改变磁体CrSb和MnTe在动量空间中承载有限声子角动量的局部手性声子模，具有六瓣f波纹理。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Altermagnet表现出动量依赖的自旋分裂，没有净磁化，提供了一个独特的平台，磁序、电子结构和晶格动力学交织在一起。在这里，使用第一原理计算，我们证明了原型改变磁体CrSb和MnTe在动量空间中承载有限声子角动量的局部手性声子模，具有六瓣f波纹理。我们的结果表明，手性晶格运动起源于pnictogen/chalcogen亚晶格，而altermagnetic自旋分裂是由磁性过渡金属原子产生的，这表明手性晶格动力学和altermagnetic电子态起源于同一晶体的不同原子亚晶格。在原始化合物中，在每个山谷，反转对称性抑制了净声子角动量，尽管局部环形原子运动。我们进一步证明，由化学取代引起的等电子对称性降低提升了这种抵消，并产生了有限谷声子手性，同时保持了化合物的改变磁性。最重要的是，我们揭示了手性声子通过动量依赖性电子-声子相互作用与动量依赖性自旋分裂电子带耦合，产生电子结构的特征修改，可能通过光发射实验获得。我们的研究结果确立了Altermagnets作为手性声子和自旋选择晶格控制的有前途的平台。

articles.title: Magnetic ground states of CrPS₄ and NiPS₃ monolayers from long-range exchange interactions
articles.title_zh: 来自远程交换相互作用的CrPS和NiPS单层的磁性基态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.20631v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the magnetic properties of monolayer CrPS₄ and NiPS₃ by combining first-principles calculations, second-principles spin models, and Monte Carlo simulations. Unlike conventional approaches that truncate exchange interactions after only a few shells and determine them by fitting total energies, we extract the magnetic exchange tensors directly from density functional theory using the LKAG formalism and include interactions until numerical convergence is achieved. We show that long-range exchange interactions qualitatively modify the magnetic behavior of both materials. In CrPS₄, they destabilize the previously predicted ferromagnetic ground state and stabilize a spin-spiral phase, reducing the critical temperature to about 21,K, in agreement with available experiments. The resulting magnetic phase diagram contains multiple collinear and non-collinear phases that can be tuned by temperature and external magnetic fields. In NiPS₃, the experimentally observed zigzag antiferromagnetic order only emerges when exchange interactions up to the fifth shell are included. These results demonstrate that quantitatively predictive spin models for thiophosphate monolayers require long-range exchange interactions and provide a predictive framework for accurately describing two-dimensional van der Waals magnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 通过结合第一原理计算、第二原理自旋模型和蒙特卡罗模拟，我们研究了单层CrPS和NiPS的磁性。与仅在少数壳体后截断交换相互作用并通过拟合总能量来确定它们的传统方法不同，我们使用LKAG形式直接从密度泛函理论中提取磁交换张量，并包括相互作用，直到实现数值收敛。我们表明，远程交换相互作用定性地改变了两种材料的磁性行为。在CrPS中，它们破坏了先前预测的铁磁基态并稳定了自旋螺旋相，将临界温度降低到约21 ， K ，这与现有实验一致。
authors: Herr S. J. van der Zant
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通过结合第一原理计算、第二原理自旋模型和蒙特卡罗模拟，我们研究了单层CrPS和NiPS的磁性。与仅在少数壳体后截断交换相互作用并通过拟合总能量来确定它们的传统方法不同，我们使用LKAG形式直接从密度泛函理论中提取磁交换张量，并包括相互作用，直到实现数值收敛。我们表明，远程交换相互作用定性地改变了两种材料的磁性行为。在CrPS中，它们破坏了先前预测的铁磁基态并稳定了自旋螺旋相，将临界温度降低到约21 ， K ，这与现有实验一致。生成的磁相图包含多个共线和非共线相位，可以通过温度和外部磁场进行调谐。在NiPS中，实验观察到的锯齿状反铁磁有序仅在包括交换相互作用直到第五壳时才出现。这些结果表明，硫代磷酸盐单层的定量预测自旋模型需要远距离交换相互作用，并为准确描述二维范德瓦尔斯磁体提供了预测框架。

articles.title: Chemical potentials from structure factors: II. Charged multi-component mixtures
articles.title_zh: 来自结构因素的化学势： II.带电荷的多组分混合物
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.30060v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The chemical potentials of charged multi-component mixtures are central to electrolyte thermodynamics, but remain difficult to compute from atomistic simulations. The S0 method enables computing chemical potentials of mixtures from equilibrium molecular dynamics simulations. Here we extend the S0 method to charged mixtures by combining the composition-space framework developed in Part I: Neutral Multi-component Mixtures with a Coulombic treatment of the small-wavenumber limits of static structure factors. This approach separates thermodynamically relevant neutral composition fluctuations from forbidden macroscopic charge fluctuations, and further accounts for charge-neutrality constraints. We use the method to compute the chemical potentials of multiple-halide aqueous salt solutions, elucidating the ion-specific thermodynamic effects. We also calculate the mixing free energies of molten salt mixtures, demonstrating the importance of correctly describing long-wavelength electrostatic correlations.
articles.abstract_zh: 带电荷的多组分混合物的化学势是电解质热力学的核心，但仍然难以从原子模拟中计算。S0方法能够通过平衡分子动力学模拟计算混合物的化学势。在这里，我们通过将第一部分：中性多组分混合物中开发的组成空间框架与静态结构因子的小波数极限的库仑处理相结合，将S0方法扩展到带电混合物。这种方法将热力学相关的中性成分波动与禁止的宏观电荷波动分开，并进一步解释了电荷中性约束。我们使用该方法计算多卤化物盐水溶液的化学势，阐明离子特异性热力学效应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 带电荷的多组分混合物的化学势是电解质热力学的核心，但仍然难以从原子模拟中计算。S0方法能够通过平衡分子动力学模拟计算混合物的化学势。在这里，我们通过将第一部分：中性多组分混合物中开发的组成空间框架与静态结构因子的小波数极限的库仑处理相结合，将S0方法扩展到带电混合物。这种方法将热力学相关的中性成分波动与禁止的宏观电荷波动分开，并进一步解释了电荷中性约束。我们使用该方法计算多卤化物盐水溶液的化学势，阐明离子特异性热力学效应。我们还计算了熔盐混合物的混合自由能，证明了正确描述长波长静电相关性的重要性。

articles.title: Statistical levels and spatial modes of Fock-space heterogeneity in many-body localization crossovers
articles.title_zh: 多体定位交叉中Fock空间异质性的统计水平和空间模式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.15323v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Near many-body localization crossovers, local memory fluctuates strongly among eigenstates and ensemble realizations, but the observed heterogeneity combines contributions from different statistical levels. We develop a statistical framework based on configuration-space distance distributions that uses a variance decomposition to separate fluctuations within eigenstates, between eigenstates of one sample, and between samples. Applying this framework to random-cosine and quasiperiodic-cosine Ising ensembles with the same one-site field marginal, we find that, at the exact-diagonalization sizes studied, the clearest difference occurs among disorder realizations or quasiperiodic phase samples, whereas within-eigenstate and within-sample eigenstate-to- eigenstate contributions remain broadly comparable. Spatial covariances show that random outer fluctuations have a much stronger uniform component, whereas quasiperiodic phase fluctuations are organized more strongly at finite wave number and partly cancel in the spatial average controlling the distance center. We find that, near the crossover in the random ensemble, the ensemble-averaged distance center is particularly sensitive to changes in the nominal field strength. Combined with sample-to-sample differences in the realized field amplitude, this mean response accounts for much of the sample-to-sample variation in the distance center. Analysis of half-chain entanglement further shows that its sample-to-sample fluctuations likewise reflect the combined effects of amplitude variations and its own mean response. An application to a fixed-magnetization spin chain demonstrates the framework in a constrained configuration space. Resolving both statistical level and spatial mode therefore provides a more complete picture of sample- dependent many-body memory and its configuration-space probability geometry.
articles.abstract_zh: 在多体定位交叉点附近，局部记忆在特征态和集合实现之间波动很大，但观察到的异质性结合了来自不同统计层面的贡献。我们开发了一个基于配置空间距离分布的统计框架，该框架使用方差分解来分离特征态内的波动、一个样本的特征态之间的波动以及样本之间的波动。将该框架应用于具有相同一站点场边缘的随机余弦和准周期余弦Ising集合，我们发现，在所研究的精确对角化尺寸下，最明显的差异发生在无序实现或准周期相位样本之间，而本征态内和样本内本征态到本征态的贡献仍然大致可比。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在多体定位交叉点附近，局部记忆在特征态和集合实现之间波动很大，但观察到的异质性结合了来自不同统计层面的贡献。我们开发了一个基于配置空间距离分布的统计框架，该框架使用方差分解来分离特征态内的波动、一个样本的特征态之间的波动以及样本之间的波动。将该框架应用于具有相同一站点场边缘的随机余弦和准周期余弦Ising集合，我们发现，在所研究的精确对角化尺寸下，最明显的差异发生在无序实现或准周期相位样本之间，而本征态内和样本内本征态到本征态的贡献仍然大致可比。空间协方差表明，随机外部波动具有更强的均匀分量，而准周期相位波动在有限波数处组织更强，并且在控制距离中心的空间平均值中部分抵消。我们发现，在随机集合中的交叉点附近，集合平均距离中心对标称场强的变化特别敏感。结合实现场振幅的样本间差异，这种平均响应占了距离中心样本间变化的大部分。对半链纠缠的分析进一步表明，其样本到样本的波动同样反映了幅度变化及其自身平均响应的综合影响。固定磁化自旋链的应用演示了受限配置空间中的框架。因此，解析统计级别和空间模式可以更全面地了解依赖于样本的多体存储器及其配置-空间概率几何。

articles.title: Heavy-fermion hybridization waves from Dirac spinons near a Kondo-breakdown quantum phase transition
articles.title_zh: 近藤击穿量子相变附近狄拉克旋子的重费米子杂交波
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.07146v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Motivated by the recent observation of spatially modulated screening in different paramagnetic heavy-fermion materials, we propose a theoretical mechanism for the emergence of such hybridization waves in frustrated Kondo lattices with no magnetic order. By applying both a parton mean-field theory and a perturbative calculation to a minimal Kondo-Heisenberg lattice model, we demonstrate that a heavy Fermi liquid can naturally develop hybridization waves when it approaches a quantum phase transition where Kondo screening breaks down and the local magnetic moments form a Dirac spin liquid. We relate the strength of this mechanism to a kinematic condition on the electronic and spinon band structures and show that the spatial periodicity of the ensuing hybridization wave is controlled by momenta vecQ that connect the Dirac nodes in the spinon dispersion to low-energy portions of the electronic band structure.
articles.abstract_zh: 在最近对不同顺磁重费米子材料中空间调制筛选的观察的激励下，我们提出了一种理论机制，用于在无磁序的受挫近藤晶格中出现这种杂交波。通过将部分子均值场理论和微扰计算应用于最小Kondo-Heisenberg晶格模型，我们证明了当重质费米液体接近量子相变时，它可以自然地产生杂交波，其中Kondo筛选分解，局部磁矩形成狄拉克自旋液体。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在最近对不同顺磁重费米子材料中空间调制筛选的观察的激励下，我们提出了一种理论机制，用于在无磁序的受挫近藤晶格中出现这种杂交波。通过将部分子均值场理论和微扰计算应用于最小Kondo-Heisenberg晶格模型，我们证明了当重质费米液体接近量子相变时，它可以自然地产生杂交波，其中Kondo筛选分解，局部磁矩形成狄拉克自旋液体。我们将该机制的强度与电子和自旋子带结构的运动学条件联系起来，并表明随后杂交波的空间周期性由动量vecQ控制，该动量vecQ将自旋子色散中的Dirac节点连接到电子带结构的低能部分。

articles.title: Memory-Augmented Hybrid Quantum Reservoir Computing
articles.title_zh: 内存增强混合量子水库计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2409.09886v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Reservoir computing (RC) is an effective method for predicting chaotic systems by using a high-dimensional dynamic reservoir with fixed internal weights, while keeping the learning phase linear, which simplifies training and reduces computational complexity compared to fully trained recurrent neural networks (RNNs). Quantum reservoir computing (QRC) uses the exponential growth of Hilbert spaces in quantum systems, allowing for greater information processing, memory capacity, and computational power. However, the original QRC proposal requires coherent injection of inputs multiple times, complicating practical implementation. We present a hybrid quantum-classical approach that implements memory through classical post-processing of quantum measurements. This approach avoids the need for multiple coherent input injections and is evaluated on benchmark tasks, including the chaotic Mackey-Glass time series prediction. We tested our model on two physical platforms: a fully connected Ising model and a Rydberg atom array. The optimized model demonstrates promising predictive capabilities, achieving a higher number of steps compared to previously reported approaches.
articles.abstract_zh: 储层计算（RC）是一种预测混沌系统的有效方法，它使用具有固定内部权重的高维动态储层，同时保持学习相位线性，与完全训练的循环神经网络（RNN）相比，它简化了训练并降低了计算复杂度。量子存储计算（QRC）利用量子系统中希尔伯特空间的指数增长，允许更大的信息处理、存储容量和计算能力。然而，最初的 QRC 提案需要多次一致的输入注入，使实际实施变得复杂。我们提出了一种混合量子经典方法，通过量子测量的经典后处理来实现记忆。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 储层计算（RC）是一种预测混沌系统的有效方法，它使用具有固定内部权重的高维动态储层，同时保持学习相位线性，与完全训练的循环神经网络（RNN）相比，它简化了训练并降低了计算复杂度。量子存储计算（QRC）利用量子系统中希尔伯特空间的指数增长，允许更大的信息处理、存储容量和计算能力。然而，最初的 QRC 提案需要多次一致的输入注入，使实际实施变得复杂。我们提出了一种混合量子经典方法，通过量子测量的经典后处理来实现记忆。这种方法避免了多次相干输入注入的需要，并在基准任务上进行评估，包括混沌 Mackey-Glass 时间序列预测。我们在两个物理平台上测试了我们的模型：完全连接的伊辛模型和里德堡原子阵列。优化的模型展示了有前景的预测能力，与之前报道的方法相比，实现了更多的步骤。

articles.title: Improving the Dynamic Range of Interacting Quantum Sensors via Optimized Quantum Control
articles.title_zh: 通过优化量子控制提高交互量子传感器的动态范围
articles.abstract: arXiv:2505.04958v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Interacting spin ensembles are promising platforms for quantum sensing, but spin-spin interactions can induce complex, nonmonotonic responses to external fields, limiting the dynamic range over which the fields can be estimated unambiguously. Here, we propose a quantum-circuit-learning-inspired method to improve the dynamic range of interacting quantum sensors using optimized global control fields. We consider an ensemble of dipole-coupled spins subjected to an inhomogeneous magnetic field generated by an electric current. By optimizing the global control fields applied during sensing, we train the expectation value of the collective magnetization to approximate a prescribed monotonic target function. We also introduce a penalty on the magnetization variance to account for measurement fluctuations. Numerical simulations demonstrate that the optimized control can substantially enlarge the dynamic range compared with sensing without control. We further investigate the trade-off between dynamic range and estimation uncertainty and show that the variance penalty can reduce the uncertainty at the expense of dynamic range. These results demonstrate that learning-assisted global control provides a promising approach to improving the performance of interacting quantum sensors.
articles.abstract_zh: 相互作用的自旋系综是有前途的量子传感平台，但自旋-自旋相互作用可能会引发对外部场的复杂、非单调响应，从而限制了可以明确估计场的动态范围。在这里，我们提出了一种受量子电路学习启发的方法，使用优化的全局控制场来提高交互量子传感器的动态范围。我们考虑偶极耦合自旋的集合，其受到电流产生的不均匀磁场的影响。通过优化传感过程中应用的全局控制场，我们训练集体磁化强度的期望值以近似规定的单调目标函数。我们还对磁化强度方差引入惩罚，以解决测量波动。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 相互作用的自旋系综是有前途的量子传感平台，但自旋-自旋相互作用可能会引发对外部场的复杂、非单调响应，从而限制了可以明确估计场的动态范围。在这里，我们提出了一种受量子电路学习启发的方法，使用优化的全局控制场来提高交互量子传感器的动态范围。我们考虑偶极耦合自旋的集合，其受到电流产生的不均匀磁场的影响。通过优化传感过程中应用的全局控制场，我们训练集体磁化强度的期望值以近似规定的单调目标函数。我们还对磁化强度方差引入惩罚，以解决测量波动。数值模拟表明，与无控制的传感相比，优化的控制可以显着扩大动态范围。我们进一步研究了动态范围和估计不确定性之间的权衡，并表明方差惩罚可以以牺牲动态范围为代价来降低不确定性。这些结果表明，学习辅助的全局控制为提高交互量子传感器的性能提供了一种有前途的方法。

articles.title: Forecasting Low-Dimensional Navier-Stokes equations via Multi-Dimensional Hybrid Quantum Reservoir Computing
articles.title_zh: 通过多维混合量子储层计算预测低维纳维-斯托克斯方程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.04006v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The prediction of complex dynamics remains an open problem across many domains of physics, where nonlinearities and multiscale interactions severely limit the reliability of conventional forecasting methods. Quantum reservoir computing (QRC) has emerged as a promising paradigm for information processing by exploiting the high dimensionality of the Hilbert space, where the dynamics of quantum systems take place. Here, we introduce a hybrid quantum-classical reservoir architecture capable of handling multivariate time series through quantum evolution combined with classical memory enhancement. Our model employs a five-qubit transverse-field Ising Hamiltonian with input-modulated dynamics and temporal multiplexing, enabling the encoding of input signals over multiple timescales. We apply this framework to two paradigmatic models of chaotic behavior in fluid dynamics, where multiscale dynamics and nonlinearities play a dominant role: a low-dimensional truncation of the two-dimensional Navier-Stokes equations and the Lorenz-63 system. By systematically scanning the quantum system's parameter space, we identify regions that maximize forecasting performance, as measured by the Valid Prediction Time. The observed robustness and reliable performances for both dynamical systems suggest that this hybrid quantum approach offers a flexible platform for modelling complex nonlinear time series.
articles.abstract_zh: 复杂动力学的预测仍然是物理学许多领域中的一个悬而未决的问题，其中非线性和多尺度相互作用严重限制了传统预测方法的可靠性。量子库计算（QRC）通过利用希尔伯特空间的高维性（量子系统的动力学发生在该空间中），已成为一种有前景的信息处理范例。在这里，我们引入了一种混合量子经典存储架构，能够通过量子演化与经典记忆增强相结合来处理多元时间序列。我们的模型采用具有输入调制动态和时间复用的五量子位横向场伊辛哈密顿量，从而能够在多个时间尺度上对输入信号进行编码。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 复杂动力学的预测仍然是物理学许多领域中的一个悬而未决的问题，其中非线性和多尺度相互作用严重限制了传统预测方法的可靠性。量子库计算（QRC）通过利用希尔伯特空间的高维性（量子系统的动力学发生在该空间中），已成为一种有前景的信息处理范例。在这里，我们引入了一种混合量子经典存储架构，能够通过量子演化与经典记忆增强相结合来处理多元时间序列。我们的模型采用具有输入调制动态和时间复用的五量子位横向场伊辛哈密顿量，从而能够在多个时间尺度上对输入信号进行编码。我们将此框架应用于流体动力学中混沌行为的两个范例模型，其中多尺度动力学和非线性起着主导作用：二维纳维-斯托克斯方程和 Lorenz-63 系统的低维截断。通过系统地扫描量子系统的参数空间，我们确定了使预测性能最大化的区域（通过有效预测时间来衡量）。观察到的两个动力系统的鲁棒性和可靠性能表明，这种混合量子方法为复杂的非线性时间序列建模提供了一个灵活的平台。

articles.title: Intrinsic non-Markovian magnetisation dynamics
articles.title_zh: 固有非马尔可夫磁化动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.07378v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Memory effects are widespread in complex systems while evidence of non-Markovian dynamics in fundamental physical systems has been limited to specifically engineered cases. Here we report on the experimental observation of non-Markovian magnetisation dynamics in crystalline cobalt. Intense terahertz electromagnetic driving brings the system into a non-equilibrium state, and allows us to follow its magnetisation dynamics in real time at low temperatures. The response reveals a striking multi-peaked frequency spectrum that defies conventional descriptions. Using open quantum system theory we evidence that a non-Markovian memory kernel, arising from spin-phonon bath coupling, naturally explains both the spectral structure and its temperature dependence. Theoretical prediction of the spectrum is accomplished by simulating the non-Markovian Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert equation, while analytics quantitatively determines the frequencies of three spectral peaks. The results demonstrate that intrinsic memory effects can emerge in a simple ferromagnet, opening new opportunities to explore and control non-Markovian dynamics in condensed-matter systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 记忆效应在复杂系统中广泛存在，而基本物理系统中非马尔可夫动力学的证据仅限于专门设计的案例。在这里，我们报告了结晶钴中非马尔可夫磁化动力学的实验观察。强烈的太赫兹电磁驱动使系统进入非平衡状态，使我们能够在低温下实时跟踪其磁化动态。响应揭示了令人震惊的多峰频谱，这违背了传统的描述。使用开放量子系统理论，我们证明由自旋声子浴耦合产生的非马尔可夫记忆内核自然地解释了光谱结构及其温度依赖性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 记忆效应在复杂系统中广泛存在，而基本物理系统中非马尔可夫动力学的证据仅限于专门设计的案例。在这里，我们报告了结晶钴中非马尔可夫磁化动力学的实验观察。强烈的太赫兹电磁驱动使系统进入非平衡状态，使我们能够在低温下实时跟踪其磁化动态。响应揭示了令人震惊的多峰频谱，这违背了传统的描述。使用开放量子系统理论，我们证明由自旋声子浴耦合产生的非马尔可夫记忆内核自然地解释了光谱结构及其温度依赖性。频谱的理论预测是通过模拟非马尔可夫朗道-利夫希茨-吉尔伯特方程来完成的，而分析则定量确定三个频谱峰值的频率。结果表明，简单的铁磁体中可以出现内在记忆效应，为探索和控制凝聚态系统中的非马尔可夫动力学提供了新的机会。

articles.title: Constructing Arbitrary Coherent Rearrangements in Optical Lattices
articles.title_zh: 在光学晶格中构建任意相干重排
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.04210v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Coherent control of motional degrees of freedom of ultracold atoms in optical lattices offers a promising route towards programmable quantum dynamics with massive particles. We propose and analyze a scheme for implementing coherent rearrangement of ultracold atoms, corresponding to arbitrary unitary transformations on single-particle motional states. Exploiting an analogy between dynamics in optical superlattices and discrete linear optics, we employ the Clements scheme to systematically construct any global N-dimensional single-particle unitary from tunneling and phase shifts in arrays of double wells. Tunneling is controlled globally, while local operations are achieved through site-resolved potential shifts. We numerically investigate the susceptibility of the scheme to intensity noise and addressing crosstalk. We identify key subroutines enabled by this unitary construction, including the Discrete Fourier Transform and the implementation of non-native Hamiltonians. Extending the scheme to two dimensions enables all-to-all atomic rearrangement with a circuit depth that scales sublinearly with the atom number, providing a high-density and highly scalable approach to atom rearrangement.
articles.abstract_zh: 光学晶格中超冷原子运动自由度的相干控制为大质量粒子的可编程量子动力学提供了一条有希望的途径。我们提出并分析了一种实现超冷原子相干重排的方案，对应于单粒子运动状态的任意酉变换。利用光学超晶格动力学和离散线性光学之间的类比，我们采用 Clements 方案，通过双阱阵列中的隧道和相移系统地构造任何全局 N 维单粒子酉。隧道挖掘是在全球范围内进行控制的，而本地运营则通过现场解决的潜在变化来实现。我们通过数值研究该方案对强度噪声的敏感性并解决串扰问题。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 光学晶格中超冷原子运动自由度的相干控制为大质量粒子的可编程量子动力学提供了一条有希望的途径。我们提出并分析了一种实现超冷原子相干重排的方案，对应于单粒子运动状态的任意酉变换。利用光学超晶格动力学和离散线性光学之间的类比，我们采用 Clements 方案，通过双阱阵列中的隧道和相移系统地构造任何全局 N 维单粒子酉。隧道挖掘是在全球范围内进行控制的，而本地运营则通过现场解决的潜在变化来实现。我们通过数值研究该方案对强度噪声的敏感性并解决串扰问题。我们确定了由这种酉构造启用的关键子例程，包括离散傅里叶变换和非本地哈密顿量的实现。将方案扩展到二维可以实现全原子重排，电路深度随原子数次线性缩放，从而提供高密度和高度可扩展的原子重排方法。

articles.title: Topological phase transition of deformed mathbb Z₃ toric code
articles.title_zh: 变形 mathbb Z₃ toric 码的拓扑相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.09107v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We investigate topological phase transitions in a family of deformed mathbb Z₃ toric-code wavefunctions prepared from a cluster state by local deformations and projective measurements. Their norms map to the Q=3 Potts model for single-parameter deformations and to a three-state Ashkin--Teller-like (AT₃) construction with two independent four-spin couplings in the general case. Projected entangled-pair-state (PEPS) and variational uniform matrix-product-state (VUMPS) calculations identify the toric-code (TC) phase and phases in which electric (e) anyons are confined or condensed. These phases are separated by critical structures with central charges c=4/5, 8/5, and isolated c=1 antiferromagnetic (AFM) endpoints. A normalized finite-distance e-anyon pair-state norm provides a Fredenhagen--Marcu-type check of the confinement boundary, while the topological data of the quantum double D(mathbb Z₃) imply a topological entanglement entropy γ=log3 throughout the gapped toric-code phase. Relative to the mathbb Z₂ case, the absence of sign-change folding leaves the AFM endpoints unfolded, and the extreme deformation reaches square ice with an emergent U(1) one-form symmetry, Hilbert-space fragmentation, and exact scar configurations.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一系列变形 mathbb Z₃ 环面码波函数中的拓扑相变，这些波函数是通过局部变形和投影测量从簇状态准备的。它们的范数映射到单参数变形的 Q=3 Potts 模型，以及一般情况下具有两个独立的四自旋耦合的三态 Ashkin-Teller 式 (AT₃) 结构。投影纠缠对态 (PEPS) 和变分均匀矩阵乘积态 (VUMPS) 计算可识别环面码 (TC) 相位以及电 (e) 任意子被限制或凝聚的相位。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了一系列变形 mathbb Z₃ 环面码波函数中的拓扑相变，这些波函数是通过局部变形和投影测量从簇状态准备的。它们的范数映射到单参数变形的 Q=3 Potts 模型，以及一般情况下具有两个独立的四自旋耦合的三态 Ashkin-Teller 式 (AT₃) 结构。投影纠缠对态 (PEPS) 和变分均匀矩阵乘积态 (VUMPS) 计算可识别环面码 (TC) 相位以及电 (e) 任意子被限制或凝聚的相位。这些相由具有中心电荷 c=4/5、8/5 和孤立的 c=1 反铁磁 (AFM) 端点的关键结构分隔开。归一化有限距离 e-任意子对态范数提供了限制边界的 Fredenhagen-Marcu 型检查，而量子双 D(mathbb Z₃) 的拓扑数据意味着整个有间隙环面码相的拓扑纠缠熵 γ=log3。相对于 mathbb Z2 情况，符号变化折叠的缺失使 AFM 端点展开，并且极端变形达到方形冰，并具有新兴的 U(1) 单形对称性、希尔伯特空间碎片和精确的疤痕配置。

articles.title: Quantum Matrix-Element Estimators for Spin-Coupled Generalized Valence Bond (SCGVB) Wavefunctions
articles.title_zh: 自旋耦合广义价键 (SCGVB) 波函数的量子矩阵元素估计器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.12045v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Valence-bond wavefunctions such as spin-coupled generalized valence bond (SCGVB) provide compact and chemically interpretable descriptions of strong correlation, but their nonorthogonal determinant structure makes quantum evaluation of overlaps and Hamiltonian matrix elements difficult. Here we introduce an ancilla-free, measurement-driven framework that reformulates these quantities as vacuum expectation values of Pauli-string operators, enabling evaluation with shallow circuits, local Clifford rotations, and computational-basis measurements, without controlled operations. We validate the method for H₄ along a dissociation pathway and for a 70-determinant C₂ active-valence benchmark. The reconstructed matrices agree with the classical Löwdin-based reference, while Chirgwin-Coulson weights remain chemically consistent. These results establish the proposed estimators as a low-depth, circuit-compatible formulation for evaluating SCGVB matrix elements, while making no claim of quantum computational advantage.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋耦合广义价键（SCGVB）等价键波函数提供了强相关性的紧凑且化学可解释的描述，但它们的非正交行列式结构使得重叠和哈密顿矩阵元素的量子评估变得困难。在这里，我们引入了一个无辅助、测量驱动的框架，该框架将这些量重新表述为泡利弦算子的真空期望值，从而能够使用浅电路、局部克利福德旋转和计算基础测量进行评估，而无需受控操作。我们验证了沿着解离途径的 H₄ 和 70 决定因素 C2 活性价基准的方法。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋耦合广义价键（SCGVB）等价键波函数提供了强相关性的紧凑且化学可解释的描述，但它们的非正交行列式结构使得重叠和哈密顿矩阵元素的量子评估变得困难。在这里，我们引入了一个无辅助、测量驱动的框架，该框架将这些量重新表述为泡利弦算子的真空期望值，从而能够使用浅电路、局部克利福德旋转和计算基础测量进行评估，而无需受控操作。我们验证了沿着解离途径的 H₄ 和 70 决定因素 C2 活性价基准的方法。重建的矩阵与基于 Löwdin 的经典参考一致，而 Chirgwin-Coulson 权重在化学上保持一致。这些结果将所提出的估计器确立为一种低深度、电路兼容的公式，用于评估 SCGVB 矩阵元素，同时没有声称具有量子计算优势。

articles.title: Estimating the expected output of wide random MLPs more efficiently than sampling
articles.title_zh: 比采样更有效地估计宽随机 MLP 的预期输出
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.05179v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: By far the most common way to estimate an expected loss in machine learning is to draw samples, compute the loss on each one, and take the empirical average. However, sampling is not necessarily optimal. Given an MLP at initialization, we show how to estimate its expected output over Gaussian inputs without running samples through the network at all. Instead, we produce approximate representations of the distributions of activations at each layer, leveraging tools such as cumulants and Hermite expansions. We show both theoretically and empirically that for sufficiently wide networks, our estimator achieves a target mean squared error using substantially fewer FLOPs than Monte Carlo sampling. We find moreover that our methods perform particularly well at estimating the probabilities of rare events, and additionally demonstrate how they can be used for model training. Together, these findings suggest a path to producing models with a greatly reduced probability of catastrophic tail risks.
articles.abstract_zh: 到目前为止，估计机器学习中预期损失的最常见方法是抽取样本，计算每个样本的损失，并取经验平均值。然而，采样不一定是最佳的。给定初始化时的 MLP，我们展示了如何在完全不通过网络运行样本的情况下估计其在高斯输入上的预期输出。相反，我们利用累积量和 Hermite 展开等工具生成每一层激活分布的近似表示。我们从理论上和经验上表明，对于足够宽的网络，我们的估计器使用比蒙特卡罗采样少得多的 FLOP 来实现目标均方误差。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 到目前为止，估计机器学习中预期损失的最常见方法是抽取样本，计算每个样本的损失，并取经验平均值。然而，采样不一定是最佳的。给定初始化时的 MLP，我们展示了如何在完全不通过网络运行样本的情况下估计其在高斯输入上的预期输出。相反，我们利用累积量和 Hermite 展开等工具生成每一层激活分布的近似表示。我们从理论上和经验上表明，对于足够宽的网络，我们的估计器使用比蒙特卡罗采样少得多的 FLOP 来实现目标均方误差。此外，我们发现我们的方法在估计罕见事件的概率方面表现特别好，并且还演示了如何将它们用于模型训练。总之，这些发现表明了一条生成模型的途径，大大降低了灾难性尾部风险的可能性。

articles.title: State preparation and detection for quantum simulation of particle collisions
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26142v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Simulating the real-time dynamics of particle collisions is a promising application of quantum simulators, because classical methods such as tensor networks struggle to capture the highly entangled states generated in high-energy scattering. Realizing such simulations requires both the preparation of incoming wave packets and the detection of the outgoing scattering products. In this work, we propose protocols that address both challenges on programmable analog and digital quantum simulation platforms. Our state-preparation scheme uses a weakly coupled auxiliary qubit - or, more generally, a customized local quench - to inject a single quasiparticle with well-defined momentum. Because it relies only on conservation of energy, this scheme requires no fine-tuning or prior knowledge about particle eigenstates, making it robust against errors in calibration and implementation. The momenta of scattering products are then extracted, using only local measurements, from the interference pattern that arises when particles are reflected at the system's boundary. We validate our protocols through numerical simulations, first in a simple single-particle model and subsequently in two interacting many-body systems: a Rydberg atom chain and an Ising chain in a mixed field. We demonstrate how high-energy regimes, necessary to access inelastic scattering processes, can be reached through an adiabatic ramp, and how the wave packet shape can be optimized by spatially modulating the Hamiltonian. Finally, we show how the protocol can be generalized to systems with more than one spatial dimension. Our proposal provides a versatile approach to the quantum simulation of scattering phenomena, and is compatible with several quantum simulation platforms that are already experimentally available.

articles.title: Chemical potentials from structure factors: I. Neutral multi-component mixtures
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.08357v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The chemical potentials of multi-component mixtures underlie many physical and chemical phenomena, but remain challenging to compute. The S0 method enables the computation of chemical potentials from equilibrium molecular dynamics simulations, by leveraging the thermodynamic relationship between particle number fluctuations and derivatives of chemical potentials, followed by numerical integration along different compositions. Here we generalize the S0 method from two-component mixtures to neutral multi-component mixtures. We first extend the statistical mechanical formalism to high-dimensional compositional space, and then introduce a Gaussian process integration scheme combined with active learning to efficiently integrate chemical potentials and sample diverse compositions. We use this method to compute the mixing free energies of a molten metal alloy, and the solubilities of two paracetamol polymorphs in water-ethanol solvents. The extended S0 method provides a practical and scalable route for computing chemical potentials in neutral bulk multi-component mixtures from atomistic simulations.

articles.title: Deterministic Hypergraph SYK: Melonic Dominance and Maximal Chaos Without Disorder Averaging
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.19255v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We show that the leading melonic structure of the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model can be realized by a single sparse Majorana Hamiltonian, without disorder averaging. In our deterministic hypergraph SYK model (hSYK), N Majorana fermions interact through O(dN) terms with uniform couplings, arranged on a fixed q-uniform, d-regular hypergraph. If the hypergraph is linear, has few short cycles, and is a spectral expander, then at large d the two-point function obeys the melonic Schwinger-Dyson equation site by site. The leading thermodynamics are therefore those of SYK, and at leading order in 1/d every bilocal fluctuation other than the Schwarzian is gapped. The four-point ladder splits into scrambling modes labeled by eigenvalues of the site adjacency operator. At strong coupling, the uniform mode is maximally chaotic, and a non-uniform mode grows only if its eigenvalue exceeds 1/(q-1). Exact diagonalization of single instances with Nle24 agrees with the melonic two-point function and thermodynamics more closely than dense SYK of the same size, shows Wigner-Dyson level statistics, and reproduces the predicted mode structure of out-of-time-order correlators. Numerically, random linear hypergraphs typically satisfy these conditions, and for d>q also avoid emergent symmetries. The model is a natural candidate for quantum simulation.

articles.title: Shock wave transmission across solid-water interfaces in underwater electrical foil explosions
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03657v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The transmission of shock waves generated by underwater electrical foil explosions across solid materials with varying acoustic impedances and thicknesses is investigated. Copper foils with thicknesses of 10 and 18 μm are exploded on planar substrates of aluminum, copper, and 3D-printed PLA with thicknesses up to 5 mm using a multi-gigawatt pulsed-power electrical discharge. The resulting shocks are visualized in water using high-speed shadowgraphy at 5 million frames per second, while high-resolution fiber optic hydrophone measurements provide direct quantitative measurements of shock strength after transmission through the impedance-mismatched materials. One-dimensional magnetohydrodynamic simulations are used to reproduce the foil explosion dynamics and provide insight into the thermodynamic, acoustic, and electrical properties of the foil during the explosion. The results show that shock transmission is governed not only by the impedance mismatch at the solid--water interface but also by the finite thickness and dynamic response of the supporting material. These findings provide a quantitative framework for understanding and controlling shock transmission in underwater electrical foil explosions and establish the feasibility and limitations of using solid substrates as structural supports in complex shock-generating geometries.

articles.title: Long-horizon Forecasting of Sodium-ion Battery Charge-profile Evolution and Degradation using Autoregressive Deep Sequence Models
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03672v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate long-horizon battery ageing prediction remains challenging because degradation alters not only scalar health indicators but also the shape and duration of electrochemical cycling profiles. Here, we introduce an autoregressive deep sequence-learning framework to forecast voltage-current profiles and state-of-health (SOH) evolution in NVPF/hard-carbon sodium-ion batteries. Stacked LSTM (Batt-LSTM) and hybrid CNN-LSTM (Batt-LSTM-C) models learn from voltage, current, and cycle-index sequences to generate future cycling profiles iteratively from measured data. Scheduled sampling mitigates the training-inference mismatch during autoregressive rollout, extending stable forecasting horizons from a few tens of cycles to as many as 600 cycles while preserving local waveform fidelity. Horizon-dependent benchmarking against classical machine-learning models evaluates voltage mean absolute error (MAE), global and local dynamic time warping (DTW), and SOH MAE across five forecasting horizons. Batt-LSTM with scheduled sampling achieves the lowest voltage MAE at horizons from 5,000 to 20,000 time steps. The predicted profiles also enable extraction of capacity-, resistance-, and energy-based SOH indicators, together with internal-resistance evolution. Monte Carlo dropout and deep ensembles estimate predictive spread at local profile and global degradation-trajectory scales. Fine-tuning on an independent ageing dataset improves cross-cell adaptation, with rolling-horizon updates reducing SOH prediction error to 3.844 percentage points for a 200-cycle horizon. These results show that curve-level forecasting retains diagnostically relevant electrochemical information beyond scalar SOH regression and offers a route toward uncertainty-aware, adaptive battery-health monitoring.

articles.title: A Simulation-Driven Digital Workflow Integrating Bayesian Optimization for Early-Stage Process Design: A Methyl Acetate Production Case Study
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03673v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Methyl acetate production via direct carbonylation of dimethyl ether and carbon monoxide involves strong nonlinear interactions among reactor operation, recycle structure, and energy consumption, making conventional simulation-based optimization computationally demanding. In this work, a data-driven framework integrating steady-state process simulation, surrogate modeling, and Bayesian optimization was developed for process intensification. A dataset of 2730 steady-state simulations was generated using a Python-based automated process simulation workflow and a structured design of experiments across the operating domain. Surrogate models were trained to predict carbon conversion yield (C-yield) and cost of specific energy consumption (C-SEC), with neural network-based models showing the best predictive performance and robustness. These models were integrated into a multi-objective Bayesian optimization framework to identify optimal operating regions. Results indicate that high C-yield (up to ~95%) can be achieved with reduced energy cost through lower recycle flow rates and compression demand. Pareto analysis revealed a nonlinear trade-off between C-yield and C-SEC, where further improvements near the conversion limit require disproportionately higher energy input. Validation against rigorous simulations showed deviations below 3% for C-yield and 10% for C-SEC.

articles.title: Geometry, Topology, and Confined Spectra Around Anisotropic Cosmic Strings
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03683v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study scalar, Dirac, and electromagnetic test fields on a two-parameter family of static spacetimes, labeled by an angular winding number k and an anisotropy parameter α that shortens one direction of the transverse metric relative to the other. Only the members with k=1 and α<1 are conical, as for an ordinary straight cosmic string. The remaining members are nonconical and, except in the flat cases, curved and nonvacuum. A common spin-weighted connection Laplacian organizes the local equations, while the curvature coupling, global field conditions, and constraints are fixed separately for each physical field. Explicit frame transitions remove spurious winding dependence in the flat limit. For the nonconical members of the family, isothermal coordinates yield an exact factorization of the indicial equation and determine its monodromy: the indicial exponents are independent of the anisotropy parameter, although the finite-domain eigenvalues are not. We derive variational bounds and a weak-anisotropy selection rule for the scalar spectrum. The electromagnetic equations are obtained from the four-potential in Lorenz gauge, with gauge-invariant transverse-electric (TE) and transverse-magnetic (TM) reductions and an annular transverse-electromagnetic (TEM) mode. Finite-element computations on an annulus, validated against benchmarks, are consistent with the bounds, confirm the selection rule, give MIT bag Dirac and conducting-wall Maxwell spectra, and reproduce the invariance of the transverse-electromagnetic capacity under kmapsto2-k, an exact consequence of a radial inversion of the Dirichlet energy.

articles.title: From Forecasting to Feedback: Evaluating Learned Dynamics for Tokamak Control
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03690v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Learned temporal models are moving beyond offline forecasting toward interactive environments for decision making, yet logged-trajectory accuracy need not predict closed-loop behavior under policies optimized in the learned model. This forecasting-control gap matters in tokamak magnetic control, where coupled plasma-circuit dynamics and actuator constraints can amplify errors through feedback. Using a calibrated free-boundary Grad-Shafranov solver, we collect four datasets in a 2x2 design over physics-parameter and current-reference coverage. At matched budgets of 500, 1k, 3k, and 5k rollouts, we train 16 action-conditioned Transformers; PPO policies optimized in the 5k surrogates are then evaluated without adaptation on six reference-solver conditions. Only joint-coverage D4 shows monotonically decreasing cross-condition mean error, whereas D1 improves in distribution but degrades out of distribution. Binary completion masks substantial closed-loop differences: D2-D4 each complete 83.3% of conditions, but reach on average 99.0%, 94.7%, and 90.5% of the evaluation horizon, while their worst conditions reach 94.2%, 68.2%, and 43.2%. Policies trained with action noise complete 5/24 matched conditions, compared with 19/24 under nominal training, and have a lower mean horizon-capped episode length. Based on one trained policy per configuration and one evaluation realization per condition, the results support combining prediction error, episode completion, condition-level duration, and tracking quality.

articles.title: Birefringence in non-linear electrodynamics emerging from a Lorentz-symmetry violation scenario
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03694v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this paper, we investigate the classical properties of a non-linear electrodynamics that emerges from one loop effective action for fermions coupled to an antisymmetric background tensor, that breaks the Lorentz symmetry in the model. The conservation laws are obtained through the Belinfante-Rosenfeld energy-momentum tensor in the non-linear electrodynamics that provides the energy density, the Poynting vector, the linear momentum and the stress tensor. In particular, this Lorentz symmetry violation breaks the symmetric index of the energy-momentum tensor, but it preserves the gauge invariance, as we expect. We introduce the prescription of a magnetic background field, that we consider constant and uniform. For propagation effects, the model is linearized by the magnetic background. This prescription allows us investigations of the plane wave propagation in the presence of an external magnetic field. In this context, we obtain the constitutive relations of the material medium, that behaves like an bi-anisotropic medium. Thereby, we calculate the refractive index whose one of the solutions show the total absorption of the wave in the medium. Using the wave equation for linear polarization, we investigate the birefringence phenomenon when the linear wave polarization changes with the magnetic background direction. The birefringence is so related to one of the spatial component of the LSV tensor in which we estimate through the PVLS experiment. We use one of the dispersion relations to obtain the kinematic of the Compton effect in the presence of the LSV parameter.

articles.title: All Paths All at Once: A Quantum Monte Carlo and Neural Committor Approach to Reaction Pathway Search
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03699v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Locating competing reaction pathways is difficult when potential-energy gradients are unavailable. Here we present tReax_expedition, an energy-only approach combining coupled Monte Carlo exploration, stochastic quench labelling and restrained continuation. Exploration identifies connected states, while continuation resolves candidate channels and records sampled chain maxima. Single-search benchmarks on three two-dimensional potentials recovered an intermediate and competing routes without transition-state guesses. For eight of nine gas-phase reactions on GFN2-xTB, sampled chain maxima differed from independently refined saddle energies by less than 0.76~kJ,mol⁻¹. Alanine dipeptide instead revealed incomplete conformational relaxation, showing that route connectivity can persist despite structural and energetic errors. Neural committor learning and local straddling-pair sampling connect the resulting paths to transition-region sampling, although molecular shooting diagnostics indicate limited committor calibration. These results show how energy-only exploration and continuation recover candidate pathways, while distinguishing route connectivity from geometric localization, barrier resolution and finite-temperature transition statistics.

articles.title: Stabilization of kinetic plasma instabilities via instantaneous external field control
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03720v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose an instantaneous control framework for the stabilization of kinetic plasma instabilities using external fields. The control problem is formulated as a PDE-constrained optimization that accounts for nonlinear plasma dynamics, while the control is determined at each time step to avoid global-in-time optimization. The Discretize-then-Optimize (DtO) approach is adopted, with the forward equations first discretized using a particle-in-cell (PIC) method. The subsequent control computation is derived from the discrete particle update, ensuring consistency with the forward solver. The control objective is formulated in terms of electromagnetic field energy and low-order moments rather than the full distribution function, making the optimization more amenable to practical implementation. The framework is applied to both electrostatic and electromagnetic settings and evaluated on several benchmark problems, including the two-stream, bump-on-tail, Dory--Guest--Harris, and Weibel instabilities. Across these tests, the control successfully suppresses field energy growth and keeps the distribution function close to its initial state. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed strategy in suppressing kinetic plasma instabilities.

articles.title: Isothermal-Isobaric Molecular Dynamics with a Foundation Interatomic Potential in LAMMPS across NVIDIA and Intel GPUs
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03892v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Foundation machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) offer one model for many chemistries, but their deep, globally coupled architectures do not fit the spatial decomposition that scales classical and short-ranged MLIPs. We present pair_style uma, a LAMMPS pair style that evaluates the Universal Model for Atoms (UMA) through LibTorch on NVIDIA and Intel GPUs from a single source tree. It reimplements FairChem's edge-sharded graph parallelism in C++ over exported TorchScript modules, with one MPI rank per device, NCCL or oneCCL collectives, and the whole energy and force path in double precision. The strain-gradient virial is carried through the exported modules and the cross-device reductions, so that fix npt runs on both vendors' hardware. We measure NPT capacity and cost on one 4xA100-40GB node, one 8xH200 node, and one 12-tile Intel node, and on up to 32 Intel nodes. Without activation checkpointing, one node holds NaCl cells of about 8,000 atoms (A100, 0.21 ns/day), 22,000 atoms (Intel, 0.10 ns/day), and 47,000 atoms (H200, 0.16 ns/day). Graph parallelism raises the capacity of a single device by 8.0x on H200 and 4.6x on A100. Across nodes, capacity grows to about 779,000 atoms on 32 Intel nodes, with a slower speed at 0.007 ns/day. On H200 and A100, a FLOP count of FairChem's graph-parallel predictor gives lower bounds of 31% and 51% of FP64 peak. From one omat checkpoint and with no refit, nine 100 ps NPT heating ramps (NaCl, equiatomic Pt-Ru, and equiatomic (HfNbTaTiZr)N, on all three node types) ran to completion.

articles.title: Ray propagation of circularly polarized light in an inhomogeneous medium: the optical Magnus effect from Maxwell's equations
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03914v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We derive the ray propagation of circularly polarized light in an inhomogeneous, isotropic and lossless medium, including the first correction to geometrical optics, the optical Magnus (spin Hall) effect. Starting from Maxwell's equations and the eikonal expansion to first order in 1/k₀, we show that the polarization is parallel transported along the ray, identify the Berry connection and curvature of the helicity states, and obtain a ray action in which the Berry phase appears as a correction to the optical path length. This action leads to a Hamiltonian in which the refractive index is evaluated at a position shifted by the Berry connection, mathcal H_σ(mathbf r,mathbf p)=|mathbf p|-n(mathbf r+mathbf A_σ(mathbf p)/k₀) simeq|mathbf p|-n(mathbf r)-k₀⁻¹boldsymbolnabla n·mathbf A_σ(mathbf p). In terms of the physical position, the equations of motion contain the Berry curvature as an anomalous velocity. We give the equivalent non-canonical bracket form, the gauge transformation, and the equivalent time-parametrized formulation with the Hamiltonian hbarω=hbar c|mathbf k|/n, and we state the approximations involved. The resulting ray equations are compared with analytic and numerical results. A planar interface, the helical ray in a cylindrical medium and the exact conservation of angular momentum provide checks. The formulation is set up for numerical propagation of rays in a medium with a spatially varying refractive index.

articles.title: Hydrogen Electron Cyclotron Resonance Dissociator Demonstrator for the Project 8 Experiment
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03972v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Project 8, a neutrino mass experiment, employs the novel frequency technique of cyclotron radiation emission spectroscopy (CRES) to perform a model independent measurement of neutrino mass via tritium beta decay. Our pioneering experiment will consist of a beamline that dissociates molecular tritium, surface cools atoms through accommodation, evaporatively cools and slows atoms, and traps them in a CRES resonant cavity to advance towards our sensitivity goal of 40 meV/c² for our final electron-weighted neutrino mass measurement. We are prototyping an electron cyclotron resonance (ECR) dissociator that uses a tunable 1 kW 2.45 GHz RF generator and electromagnets to ignite a hydrogen plasma in an aluminum resonant cavity. Our ECR source is designed to produce a high atom flux (~10¹⁹ atoms/second) near room temperature. We present the engineering development, gas diagnostics, and spectroscopy data from our hydrogen plasma.

articles.title: Microstrip-Line Characterization of Artificial Dielectric Materials for MRI Applications
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04051v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Artificial dielectric materials (ADMs) offer a flexible means of shaping radiofrequency fields in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). However, ADM designs based on plane-wave characterization may not directly predict their effects on RF fields in MRI. We propose a travelling-wave microstrip-line (MSL) approach to approximate the spatially nonuniform excitation experienced by dielectric pads near MRI RF coils and to guide ADM characterization and tuning against a reference dielectric. Both materials are tested under identical MSL measurement conditions, and the ADM geometry is adjusted until its reflection minimum occurs at the same frequency as that of the reference. Simulations and bench measurements show that the tuned ADM more closely matches the reference dielectric's reflection-minimum frequency than a plane-wave-based design. MRI simulations show that the tuned ADM produces a transmit magnetic-field distribution similar to that of the reference pad. Phantom images acquired at 7 T also show similar image-intensity patterns. These results demonstrate the utility of MSL response matching for guiding ADM design in the tested configuration. The proposed approach provides a practical bench-top step for assessing and tuning manufactured ADMs before MRI evaluation.

articles.title: Life Cycle Sustainability Assessment of Fossil- and Bio-Based Membrane Manufacturing
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04117v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The transition towards sustainable membrane manufacturing is challenged by its reliance on fossil-based polymers, organic solvents, and generation of large volumes of contaminated water. We combined process simulation, life cycle assessment, and Monte Carlo simulation to identify hotspots in the manufacturing of ultrafiltration hollow-fiber membranes for pharmaceutical applications and evaluate strategies to mitigate impact and reduce waste generation. Process models informed by industry input compared fossil- and bio-based membranes on a cradle-to-gate basis per square meter of membrane produced. Key environmental hotspots include polymer and bore solution preparation, driven by the contribution of polymer and solvent, accounting for 30-80% of total impacts across the categories investigated, and wastewater dilution, driven by the environmental burden of solvent-contaminated wastewater management. Under the modeled conditions, although polymer substitution can reduce environmental burdens, cellulose-based membranes show higher impacts than polysulfone membranes in at least 85% of simulations within each impact category, due to chemical-intensive cellulose modification and regeneration. In contrast, solvent recycling can mitigate solvent- and wastewater-related burdens when combined with reduced water demand, yielding climate change benefits at water demands below approximately 36 L per m2 under the modeled recovery configuration and highlighting its potential to reduce the environmental footprint of membrane manufacturing.

articles.title: Dielectric Models of Normal and Diseased Human Trabecular Bones at Microwave Frequencies
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04160v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The dielectric properties of biological tissues are used to investigate the interaction of electromagnetic (EM) fields with the human body. These properties are integrated into EM numerical simulations, such as the finite difference time domain (FDTD) method, using dielectric models such as Cole-Cole and Debye models. These computational tools are employed to study the propagation of EM waves within the human body. This paper has developed the one-pole and two-pole Cole-Cole and Debye models for the dielectric properties of normal and diseased human trabecular bone tissue at microwave frequencies (0.5-8.5 GHz). The dielectric properties of normal trabecular and cortical bone were derived based on the literature, while those of diseased human trabecular bones (osteoporotic and osteoarthritis) were acquired from a previous study conducted by the authors, which characterised the properties within the 0.5-8.5 GHz frequency range. This study has employed a weighted least squares method to optimise the one-pole and two-pole dielectric models' parameters. The accuracy of the developed dielectric models is validated by comparing the simulated results with the experimental data already published by the authors. The comparative analysis of the models demonstrated that the one-pole Cole-Cole model achieved a better fit compared to the one-pole Debye model across all bone types. Additionally, the two-pole Cole-Cole model exhibited a better fit than the two-pole Debye model. The proposed models can be used in numerical simulations to investigate the interaction of EM fields with bone tissue and develop and optimise microwave bone health monitoring and treatment techniques.

articles.title: Dynamics of Vortex Electrons in a Uniform Magnetic Field Across Nonrelativistic and Relativistic Regimes
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04162v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The dynamics of a vortex electron in a transverse uniform magnetic field involves not only the cyclotron motion of the wave packet center but also the evolution of its internal wavefunction structure. To study this process, we develop a quantum framework and investigate the dynamics of vortex electrons in both the nonrelativistic and relativistic regimes. A discrete Bessel-Gaussian initial wave packet is expanded in the basis of Dirac eigenstates to obtain the time-dependent wavefunction and to analyze its spatiotemporal evolution. In the nonrelativistic regime, the results deviate significantly from the rigid point-dipole model, as the intrinsic kinetic orbital angular momentum exhibits dynamics more complex than simple Larmor precession, owing to the nonstationary internal current distribution of the wave packet. In the relativistic regime, the nonlinear dependence of the energy levels on the quantum numbers destroys the equal spacing of the spectrum. Consequently, the relative phases among the eigenstate components of the wave packet evolve nonuniformly, resulting in wave-packet spreading and deformation, accompanied by modified intrinsic orbital angular momentum dynamics. We introduce a dimensionless parameter to quantify this relativistic dephasing, providing an approximate criterion for selecting physical parameters and evolution times to mitigate the resulting wave-packet distortion. These results clarify the limitations of the rigid point-dipole model, highlight the essential role of internal wavefunction structure, and provide theoretical guidance for understanding and manipulating relativistic vortex electrons.

articles.title: A Two-Dimensional Physics-Informed Neural Network Model of a Hall Effect Thruster Plasma: Self-Consistent Electrostatics and Physical-Consistency Diagnostics
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04194v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a two-dimensional axisymmetric physics-informed neural network (PINN) of the discharge channel of the P5 Hall thruster at 300 V and 5.4 A, which solves eleven coupled plasma fields and assimilates 145 internal probe measurements per field reconstructed from the data of Haas and Gallimore. The electric potential is obtained from Poisson's equation in charge-separation form, nₑ = nᵢ(1+eta), with eta bounded by construction, which keeps the stiff electrostatic constraint active and trainable. The reference solution agrees with the training profiles to relative L2 errors of 0.017, 0.073 and 0.205 for the potential, electron temperature and ion density, and held-out tests show the potential to be far more robust than the ion density to the withdrawal of measurement lines. We then test the solution against requirements the data fit does not reveal: global particle and current balances, the electron current implied by the momentum equation, the field-aligned electron force balance and the axial ion momentum budget. These expose a neutral inflow six times the measured flow, a bound in the potential representation, and a momentum-implied electron current, more than 99% field-aligned, exceeding the discharge current by orders of magnitude. Correcting these, with a divergence-free magnetic field fitted to measured data, uncertainty-weighted data, the electron pressure gradient and progressively imposed field-aligned and current constraints, yields a solution that conserves particles to within 3%, holds the current between 5.1 and 5.4 A and places 97% of the potential and 88% of the temperature measurements within their uncertainties. Within the tested single-velocity fluid formulation, however, the ion density, potential and ion velocity could not be matched together, and the field-aligned electron balance remains the main obstacle to electron self-consistency.

articles.title: From Sea Surface Height to Velocity - A Machine Learning Approach
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04270v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Inferring upper-ocean velocity from altimetric sea surface height (SSH) remains challenging below 50~km, scales now resolved by the Surface Water and Ocean Topography (SWOT) mission. Conventional methods rely on geostrophic or cyclogeostrophic balance. Here, we demonstrate that deep learning can predict the full velocity vector from SSH and environmental data and recover derivative-based diagnostics, including spectral energy flux. We trained a U-Net encoder--decoder on hourly fields from the pre-SWOT Cape Basin extraction of the LLC4320 ocean simulation, with 1.5-km grid spacing (11.8--15.8^circE, 41--45^circS). Inputs were SSH, sea surface temperature (SST), and wind stress; targets were horizontal velocities at the surface and 50~m, where wind influence is weaker. At 50~m, the best model achieves a speed RMSE of 0.049,mathrmm,s⁻¹, 29% lower than the geostrophic approximation. Predicted relative vorticity has a correlation of 0.93, compared with 0.75 for the geostrophic approximation. The model also recovers divergence with a correlation of 0.66, whereas geostrophic velocity is nondivergent by definition. Tests of training strategies yield four findings: SSH gradients outperform raw SSH as inputs; wind stress is the most useful covariate for total velocity prediction; SST benefits vary seasonally; and including vorticity and divergence in the loss improves accuracy. These results offer a path for transferring high-fidelity simulation physics to SWOT applications, where kilometer-scale SSH snapshots contain superposed balanced and unbalanced signals.

articles.title: Conceptual Design of Pumping Systems up to 1000 m3/s Based on Non-Evaporable Getters in a Gas-Dynamic Magnetic Trap
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04322v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Gas-Dynamic Magnetic Trap (GDMT), a new linear magnetic facility for confining high-temperature hydrogen plasma, is currently under development at the Budker Institute of Nuclear Physics (BINP SB RAS). The total hydrogen flow that must be removed from the end expanders by the vacuum system is approximately 10²² molecules/s, which corresponds to a required pumping speed on the order of 500 m3/s. Non-evaporable getters (NEG) are considered as a possible pumping method for this application. This article presents experimental studies of Ti-Zr-Al getters manufactured by Polema LLC. The pumping speed, sorption capacity, and sticking factors of the getter surface were measured. The sticking factors for hydrogen and deuterium are 2.23% and 1.54%, respectively. The getter pumping speed is maintained over 60 air-vent/reactivation cycles. Based on these results, a conceptual design of a NEG-based pumping system for the GDMT end expanders is proposed, providing a specific pumping speed of 74 m3/(m3s) for the getter panel. The proposed pumping system design and the required heating power are discussed.

articles.title: Impedance-controlled Laser Dynamics in Near-Zero Index Media
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04578v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Near-zero-index (NZI) media have been explored for controlling spontaneous emission, but their impact on stimulated emission and lasing properties remains unexplored within their different classes, i.e., epsilon-near-zero (ENZ), mu-near-zero (MNZ), or epsilon-and-mu-near-zero (EMNZ). Here, we show theoretically that lasing emission depends on the class of NZI medium and can be controlled through its impedance. The major difference, as compared to conventional laser media, arises from the incorporation of dispersive electric and magnetic properties in the derivation of the Maxwell Boch equations. In this framework, the analysis of laser rate equation reveals that the ENZ class, with high impedance, can reduce the lasing threshold through enhanced electric-field interaction. Numerical simulations further show that the NZI class also governs the spectral response: whereas ENZ and MNZ classes suffer from multimode emission, the EMNZ class preserves single-mode emission.

articles.title: Eddy currents and error fields in the toroidally segmented shell configuration aka Armadillo
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04651v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A stream function formulation for the calculation of the eddy current distribution in a toroidally segmented conducting shell (Armadillo) is presented and verified. The governing Poisson-like equation is solved spectrally via a Discrete Sine Transform, which enforces the zero-current boundary condition at each gap exactly by construction, and the related radial magnetic field at the plasma surface is obtained by Biot-Savart integration. The toroidal eddy current flows in the same direction on every sector with a cosine-like poloidal distribution, while the poloidal return current, required by current continuity, peaks near each gap and reverses sign between adjacent sectors. The scaling of both components with the number of gaps is governed by the competition between the poloidal geometric scale of the shell and the toroidal segmentation scale. The transition between the two regimes is set by the aspect ratio of the device, around eight gaps for an RFX-mod2-like geometry, as predicted by the analytical wall time model of the Armadillo configuration. At the gap, the poloidal return current produces a radial field of opposite sign to the value far from the gap; the resulting non-axisymmetric error field peaks near this transition and becomes negligible for highly segmented shells. These results provide a first characterisation of the eddy currents and error fields of the Armadillo configuration, needed for future resistive wall mode and tearing mode stability analyses.

articles.title: Observation of pseudospin-locked chiral edge transport in gyromagnetic photonic crystals
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04827v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Photonic pseudospins enable selective excitation and routing of light, but perturbations that mix opposite pseudospins can induce backscattering in helical edge channels. Here, we experimentally demonstrate pseudospin-locked chiral edge transport in gyromagnetic photonic crystals, combining pseudospin selectivity with nonreciprocal unidirectional propagation. By jointly engineering lattice deformation and magnetic bias, we control dipolar-quadrupolar band inversions and construct interfaces supporting pseudospin-selective chiral channels. Microwave near-field and transmission measurements reveal a single chiral edge branch that is selectively excited by only one source handedness and exhibits pronounced nonreciprocal transport. Extending this mechanism to multidomain structures, we combine two pseudospin channels into a common waveguide, separate them into distinct outputs, and route them through intersecting interfaces. These configurations realize a nonreciprocal photonic pseudospin multiplexer and demultiplexer, together with a waveguide crossing exhibiting average measured crosstalk of -14.1 and -15.8 dB for its two input channels. Our results present an experimental route to integrating pseudospin-selective channel control with chiral edge transport, providing a foundation for nonreciprocal photonic networks that use pseudospin to organize and route multiple wave channels.

articles.title: Modeling runaway electron mitigation via passively driven plasma instabilities in a high-current tokamak
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04906v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A critical challenge for tokamak-based fusion power plants is the formation of high-current, relativistic runaway electron (RE) beams during abrupt confinement loss events called disruptions. RE beams may significantly damage machine components if left unmitigated, jeopardizing the operational and economic viability of fusion power plants. We present the first self-consistent extended magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) computational study of RE mitigation with a passively driven RE mitigation coil (REMC) in a high-current tokamak. RE generation and transport are coupled with REMC-driven MHD activity in a 3D simulation that models the thermal and current quench phases of a mid-plane disruption, together with the vertical displacement and final termination of the plasma and RE beam on SPARC -- a high-field, high-current tokamak designed to achieve a fusion gain Q > 1. We demonstrate that REMC-driven magnetic stochasticity can reduce the RE current by over an order-of-magnitude when compared to unmitigated disruptions. The final termination is mediated via a post-thermal-quench "cold" vertical displacement of the plasma, which, together with magnetic stochasticity, increases RE losses via scrape-off once the plasma contacts the first wall. These results demonstrate a viable mechanism for RE mitigation using passively driven plasma instabilities on high-current tokamaks.

articles.title: Periodically poled lithium niobate with submicrometer periodicity using electric-field poling technique
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05009v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A series of monocrystalline lithium niobate (LN) thin films on low-resistivity silicon (LNOS) substrates, with thicknesses ranging from micrometers down to tens of nanometers, were prepared through chemical-mechanical polishing of pristine crystal films. By employing the electric-field poling technique, high-quality periodically poled lithium niobate (PPLN) structures with submicrometer periodicity were fabricated in these LNOSs, and full-thickness polarization reversal beneath the poling electrodes with a well-defined depth profile was achieved. The coercive field was found to follow the Kay-Dunn scaling law, while the lateral domain broadening generally increased with increasing film thickness, and it remained approximately constant across different electrode linewidths at a given film thickness. PPLN structures with periods ranging from 6 μm down to 200 nm were demonstrated. These findings provide guidance for poling electrode design and lateral domain broadening pre-compensation, offering a practical route toward scalable domain engineering in LN thin films with promising potential for compact and highly integrated nonlinear photonic devices.

articles.title: Exploring the World of Lipids with Machine-Learned Coarse-Grained Models
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05100v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Lipid bilayers are central to cellular organization and function, yet their atomistic modelling remains constrained by its high computational cost. While coarse-grained (CG) models can overcome this bottleneck, they are limited in accuracy due to the use of simplified functional forms based on molecular mechanics. Using a hybrid functional form combining physics-based terms with a graph neural network, we present implicit-solvent, machine-learned CG models for POPC. When trained on single-lipid data, the model recovers the atomistic conformational landscape. By adding short atomistic simulations of a small flat bilayer to the training data and combining force matching with a denoising objective, we train a model that accurately reproduces bilayer structure and dynamics, in closer agreement with the atomistic reference than existing models, like Martini3 and DryMartini. Beyond its training data, the model stabilizes curved geometries, including vesicles, and captures complex cooperative phenomena such as bilayer and vesicle self-assembly and pore sealing. While limitations remain, particularly regarding chemical transferability, our results establish machine-learned coarse-grained potentials as a promising path towards robust and accurate CG models of lipids and membranes.
