articles.title: From 4D to 2D: Efficient computation of the electron correlation energies of atoms in molecular systems
articles.abstract: The accurate modeling of (bio)molecular systems remains a major challenge in computational chemistry. In recent years, machine learning potentials (MLPs) have emerged as a promising approach, combining the efficiency of classical force fields with near quantum-mechanical accuracy. Among these, the physics-informed MLP FFLUX employs the Interacting Quantum Atoms (IQA) energy partitioning scheme to decompose molecular energies into atomic contributions derived from quantum mechanics for machine learning. However, incorporating two-electron correlation energies into IQA, and consequently into FFLUX, is currently unfeasible for larger systems en masse , due to the steep computational scaling associated with the necessary storage and evaluation of the two-particle density matrix (2PDM). In this work, we introduce a proof-of-concept workflow that employs density fitting (DF) to compress the 2PDM into a two-index representation, thereby accelerating the IQA partitioning of two-electron correlation energies. By expressing traditionally four-center electron repulsion integrals in terms of auxiliary basis functions, the DF approximation enables a size reduction of the 2PDM from O(N4) to O(NDF2), where N is the number of basis functions and N DF is the size of the auxiliary basis set. The method proposed here is demonstrated using coupled cluster singles and doubles densities. The resulting reduction in computational cost and memory requirements enables correlated IQA analyses for significantly larger systems than previously accessible. Thus, this development provides an important step toward incorporating explicit electron correlation and hence dispersion directly into FFLUX atomic ML models, thereby improving both their physical robustness and transferability. This advance will eliminate the need to artificially add empirical potentials, or a posteriori dispersion correction.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Electronic excited states and photodissociation pathways of iso-propylamine: Experimental and theoretical investigations
articles.abstract: We report for the first time absorption cross sections of iso-propylamine in the energy range of 40 000 to 80 000 cm −1 using synchrotron radiation. Quantum chemical calculations based on time-dependent density functional theory are used to conduct a detailed spectral analysis. The observed intensity profile of the room temperature absorption spectrum is well reproduced by a theoretical simulation that includes vertical excitation energies and oscillator strengths of its two stable conformers, gauche (G) and anti (A). Rydberg series that converge to the first ionization limit of iso-propylamine are assigned via quantum defect analysis. Several vibronic progressions are observed along with the Rydberg series. The dominance of progressions involving the NH 2 wagging mode observed along with the 3s Rydberg transition implies a molecular geometry change involving the NH 2 group in the excited state. This is confirmed by geometry optimization calculations, which predict a planar geometry in the excited state vis-à-vis pyramidal geometry in the ground state. The measured absorption cross sections are used to estimate the lower limit of the UV photolysis lifetime of iso-propylamine in the upper atmosphere. In addition, the photodissociation dynamics of iso-propylamine probed using potential energy scans of S 1 , T 1 , and T 2 excited states along each of the possible direct bond cleavage channels show that direct dissociation via S 1 is unlikely, and intersystem crossings may play an important role. Molecular channels involving H atom migration leading to CH 4 and NH 3 formation in both iso-propylamine and n-propylamine are investigated and compared using intrinsic reaction coordinate calculations.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: EmbASI: An extensible Pythonic framework for DFT-in-DFT and WF-in-DFT embedding
articles.abstract: High-level quantum mechanical (QM) simulations are important for understanding chemical and physical systems, but these methods scale unfavorably with system size, and this limits calculations to model representations of the real systems. To simulate realistic systems, approaches such as hierarchical quantum mechanics in quantum mechanics embedding (QM/QM) can be used to localize the accurate electronic structure methods to a region of chemical interest, with the wider environment represented using a less expensive embedding potential. However, implementing embedding procedures into established QM software packages is often challenging due to their monolithic design and complex software structure. Here, we present a modular and open-source approach that enables QM/QM embedding using established electronic structure codes with reduced development overhead. We demonstrate the new software, EmbASI, using the projection-based embedding theory scheme. Calculations performed for pentanol and organic dimers demonstrate the efficacy of the hierarchical density functional theory (DFT) embedding approach with the charge localization and partitioning procedures implemented in the wrapper environment; when using a truncated local atomic orbital basis, wavefunction-in-DFT embedding calculations demonstrate speed-ups of 32× for a 70 atom system, evaluated with RPA@PBE-in-PBE relative to a full RPA@PBE calculation, while introducing minimal errors to the total energies of the embedding simulations (<1 kJ mol −1 ). We then demonstrate capabilities for realistic extended zeolite models, achieving similar minimal errors with significant compute speed-up and memory reductions. The results demonstrate the capabilities of EmbASI for immediate applied QM/QM modeling and provide a broader foundation for multiscale QM simulations using established electronic structure infrastructure.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Excited-state intramolecular proton transfer dynamics with neural network potentials and nuclear quantum effects
articles.abstract: Excited-state intramolecular proton transfer is a prototypical ultrafast process that forms the foundation for many chemical and biological phenomena and is highly sensitive to changes in the underlying potential energy landscape. Here, we develop neural network potentials for 10-hydroxybenzo[h]quinoline that describe ground- and excited-state dynamics with near ab initio accuracy. These neural network potentials enable efficient sampling of the proton transfer coordinate and incorporation of nuclear quantum effects through path-integral molecular dynamics. The free energy profiles show that excited-state intramolecular proton transfer proceeds on a largely barrierless excited-state surface, with nuclear quantum effects reducing and smoothing the residual barrier. Non-equilibrium simulations yield an average proton transfer time of ∼11.5 fs for quantum hydrogen, consistent with experiment, and reveal a clear isotope effect, with slower dynamics for deuterium and classical nuclei. Mechanistic analysis identifies transient proton donor–acceptor contraction as the key enabling coordinate, while the proton crosses the midpoint prior to reaching the minimum of this coordinate, indicating a dynamically driven transfer. Subtle changes in the conjugated backbone precede proton transfer, reflecting early electronic reorganization and coherent coupling between proton motion and backbone vibrations. Bond-length alternation and vibrational coherence analysis reveal isotope-dependent coherence loss, with deuteration producing stronger damping and more localized proton/backbone dynamics relative to hydrogen. These results establish neural network potential-based approaches as an effective framework for simulating excited-state proton transfer with explicit nuclear quantum effects.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Neutral-to-zwitterionic transition in protonated glycine clusters drives magic number stability
articles.abstract: Molecular clusters in the gas phase often exhibit “magic numbers,” corresponding to enhanced abundances at specific cluster sizes, typically attributed to particularly stable geometric arrangements. Here, we combine electrospray ionization mass spectrometry (ESI-MS) with quantum chemical calculations to investigate the structure and stability of protonated glycine clusters. The experimental mass spectrum reveals pronounced magic numbers at cluster sizes n = 3 and n = 6. To elucidate their origin, we performed a systematic computational investigation of glycine clusters up to n = 7, including global structure searches, high-level electronic structure calculations, and thermal stability simulations. Our calculations show that clusters with n = 2, 4, and 5 are predominantly composed of canonical glycine molecules; the n = 7 clusters are composed of both neutral and zwitterionic glycine molecules, whereas the hexamer is the first cluster size for which fully zwitterionic structures become thermodynamically preferred. This neutral-to-zwitterionic transition gives rise to a highly cooperative hydrogen-bonding network and is accompanied by a pronounced increase in thermal stability, providing a natural explanation for the exceptional abundance of the hexamer. In contrast, the enhanced abundance of the trimer is consistent with kinetic stabilization under electrospray ion-source conditions rather than with the thermodynamic stability of its global free-energy minimum. These findings provide molecular-level insight into the emergence of magic numbers in glycine clusters and the onset of zwitterionic stabilization in finite molecular assemblies.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: New aspect of hydrogen sulfide dimer: CCSD(T)/CBS potential surface of antiparallel interactions
articles.abstract: The potential energy surface of the hydrogen sulfide dimer with antiparallel S–H⋯H–S orientations was investigated by high-level very accurate CCSD(T)/CBS quantum chemical calculations. More than 1300 geometries were calculated to characterize the potential energy surface. The antiparallel dimer that is minimum on the potential surface has an interaction energy of −1.57 kcal/mol, only slightly less strong than that of the classical hydrogen-bonded dimer (−1.71 kcal/mol). These data demonstrate that antiparallel interaction represents an important stabilization motif in hydrogen sulfide aggregates. Symmetry-adapted perturbation theory reveals that the interaction is governed by comparable electrostatic (47%) and dispersion (43%) contributions, in contrast to the antiparallel water dimer, where electrostatic interactions dominate. The present study provides the first detailed characterization of the antiparallel interaction in the hydrogen sulfide dimer and extends the understanding of the shallow potential energy surface of this system.

articles.abstract: High-resolution photoelectron spectra of TiO 2 − excited to its v3=1 state were obtained via slow electron velocity-map imaging of cryogenically cooled anions (cryo-SEVI). To determine the ν3 (antisymmetric stretch) anion frequency, growth and depletion of various features in the cryo-SEVI spectrum were monitored over a range of infrared (IR) excitation energies. Photoelectron scans were taken at an IR pre-excitation energy of 918 cm −1 and yielded a ∼6% depletion of features in the ground state cryo-SEVI spectra as well as new hot and sequence bands based on the 310 and 311 transitions, respectively. By monitoring hot band intensities as a function of IR laser frequency, the rotational profile of the v3=0–1 transition was mapped out and found to be centered at 914(7) cm −1 . The observed hot bands are Franck–Condon forbidden and arise from Herzberg–Teller coupling with the Ã1B2 neutral excited state, similar to what was observed in the cryo-SEVI spectra of TiO 2 − . The results from this IR cryo-SEVI experiment lay the groundwork for future investigations of larger bare and complexed transition metal–oxide clusters.

articles.title: A propagator theory of non-Gaussian diffusion and power-law relaxation in multidimensional disordered media
articles.abstract: Disordered energy environments generate spatially heterogeneous mobility and persistent deviations from Gaussian diffusion. Such systems are common, and dynamics often provide a route to understand the heterogeneity, as in solution spectroscopy. We develop a propagator theory of tagged-particle motion in multidimensional media described by spatially correlated, quenched Gaussian site-energy disorder and detailed-balance hopping dynamics. The disorder-averaged self-propagator is formulated for a specified initial ensemble, and its Fourier transform, the self-dynamic structure factor, is analyzed through a small-wavevector cumulant expansion. To describe the approach to Gaussian diffusion, we introduce a coarse-grained local-mobility field and relate the non-Gaussian parameter to the time correlation of the mobility sampled along the particle trajectory. In the homogenized diffusive regime, convolution of the spatial mobility correlation with the long-time propagator produces an algebraically decaying mobility memory. Consequently, the non-Gaussian parameter exhibits dimension-dependent long-time relaxation: ( t −1/2 ) in one dimension, [(ln t )/ t ] in two dimensions, and ( t −1 ) for (d > 2). The amplitudes retain information about energetic disorder, spatial correlations, dimensionality, and initial preparation. The theory thus connects microscopic site-energy disorder, propagator dynamics, mobility memory, and experimentally measurable non-Gaussian corrections to the self-dynamic structure factor.

articles.title: The effects of the substrate and graphene on the interfacial structures of DMSO revealed by heterodyne-detected sum frequency generation (HD-SFG) spectroscopy and molecular dynamics analysis
articles.abstract: Understanding molecular structures at electrode/electrolyte interfaces is essential for optimizing high-performance electrochemical reactions. Here, we investigated the interfacial structures of dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO), a widely used aprotic solvent, at the air/DMSO, SiO 2 /DMSO, and air/graphene/DMSO interfaces by heterodyne-detected sum frequency generation (HD-SFG) spectroscopy and molecular dynamics (MD) simulation. HD-SFG spectroscopy is an interface-selective nonlinear spectroscopic technique capable of determining the absolute orientation of interfacial molecules. To enable HD-SFG measurements at the buried SiO 2 /DMSO interface, where precise optical phase control is challenging, an octadecyltrichlorosilane self-assembled monolayer was introduced on the SiO 2 substrate as a phase reference for accurate determination of the interfacial complex susceptibility. The obtained spectra revealed that the hydrogen atoms of the methyl group preferentially orient toward the air side (CH 3 -up configuration) at the air/DMSO interface, whereas they orient toward the bulk DMSO side (CH 3 -down configuration) at the SiO 2 /DMSO interface. Furthermore, introducing graphene, an optically transparent two-dimensional carbon material relevant to practical carbon electrodes, shifts the most probable configuration at the interface: the S=O bond points toward the liquid phase, while the methyl groups orient nearly perpendicular to the surface normal. MD simulations with polarizable models well reproduced the spectral band shapes and signs, revealing the physical meaning of the signs of imaginary amplitudes in terms of orientation and local solvation effects. These results provide molecular-level insights into how the substrate and graphene affect the interfacial structures and demonstrate HD-SFG spectroscopy, combined with polarizable MD simulations, as a powerful approach for elucidating molecular-level structures at buried electrochemical interfaces for energy storage systems.

articles.title: Critical point search and linear response theory for computing electronic excitation energies of molecular systems. II. CASSCF
articles.abstract: The computation of excited states within the Complete Active Space Self-Consistent Field (CASSCF) framework remains a significant challenge in quantum chemistry, both theoretically and algorithmically. In this work, we extend the Kähler manifold formalism introduced in Paper I Grazioli et al. [J. Chem. Phys. 164 , 064101 (2026)] of this series to the CASSCF theory and draw a geometrical connection from the time-dependent CASSCF equations to state-specific and linear response methodologies for excited states. This is achieved by first investigating the underlying CASSCF manifold and identifying its Kähler structure, which is complicated by the nontrivial coupling of CI and orbital degrees of freedom. Building on these theoretical findings, we derive the CASSCF linear response equations in a straightforward manner and develop a robust state-specific method that relies solely on first-order derivatives of the CASSCF energy functional. Numerical results on representative molecular systems—water, formaldehyde, and ethylene—demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed state-specific method, while revealing the difficulty of reliable identification of excited states due to nonlinearity induced by the CASSCF theory.

articles.title: A Low-Processing Graphite–Paraffin Biocomposite with Torrefied Cagaita Biomass for Enhanced Charge Storage
articles.title_zh: 一种低加工石墨-石蜡生物复合材料，含有烘焙 Cagaita 生物质，可增强电荷存储
articles.abstract: A sustainable graphite–paraffin biocomposite was developed by directly incorporating torrefied cagaita (Eugenia dysenterica DC) pulp biomass (TBCP) into the composite matrix. The biomass was mildly treated at 250 °C for 1 h in air, without chemical activation or inert-atmosphere carbonization. Electrodes containing 0–15 wt.% TBCP were evaluated in 1.0 mol L⁻¹ NaOH, with the highest response obtained at 5 wt.% TBCP (≈13 mF cm⁻²), indicating an optimum balance between the biomass-derived contribution and preservation of the conductive graphite network. Trasatti analysis showed that TBCP increased the total accessible capacitance from 0.219 to 25.68 mF cm⁻² and the apparent electrochemical porosity from 18.6 to 91.4%. Chronoamperometric analysis further showed an increase in total apparent areal capacitance from 0.113 to 19.37 mF cm⁻², while the characteristic time of the dominant slow relaxation process decreased from 3.958 to 1.744 s. Galvanostatic measurements yielded 21.05 mF cm⁻² at 1.0 × 10⁻⁴ A. These results demonstrate that a small amount of minimally processed lignocellulosic biomass can effectively enhance charge storage in graphite-based composites, providing a simple and sustainable route to improved electrochemical performance.
articles.abstract_zh: 通过将烘焙的 cagaita（Eugenia Dysenterica DC）纸浆生物质（TBCP）直接掺入复合材料基质中，开发了一种可持续的石墨-石蜡生物复合材料。生物质在空气中于 250°C 下温和处理 1 小时，无需化学活化或惰性气氛碳化。在 1.0 mol L-1 NaOH 中对含有 0-15 wt.% TBCP 的电极进行了评估，在 5 wt.% TBCP (≈13 mF cm-2) 时获得了最高响应，表明生物质衍生的贡献和导电石墨网络的保存之间达到了最佳平衡。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通过将烘焙的 cagaita（Eugenia Dysenterica DC）纸浆生物质（TBCP）直接掺入复合材料基质中，开发了一种可持续的石墨-石蜡生物复合材料。生物质在空气中于 250°C 下温和处理 1 小时，无需化学活化或惰性气氛碳化。在 1.0 mol L-1 NaOH 中对含有 0-15 wt.% TBCP 的电极进行了评估，在 5 wt.% TBCP (≈13 mF cm-2) 时获得了最高响应，表明生物质衍生的贡献和导电石墨网络的保存之间达到了最佳平衡。 Trasatti 分析表明，TBCP 将总可用电容从 0.219 mF cm-2 增加到 25.68 mF cm-2，表观电化学孔隙率从 18.6% 增加到 91.4%。计时安培分析进一步表明，总表观面积电容从 0.113 mF cm-2 增加到 19.37 mF cm-2，而主要缓慢弛豫过程的特征时间从 3.958 s 减少到 1.744 s。恒电流测量在 1.0 × 10⁻⁴ A 下产生 21.05 mF cm⁻²。这些结果表明，少量经过最低限度加工的木质纤维素生物质可以有效增强石墨基复合材料中的电荷存储，为提高电化学性能提供了一种简单且可持续的途径。

articles.title: Design and Evaluation of Electrical Motors for Flywheel Energy Storage Systems: A Multi-Criteria Decision Framework for Optimal Selection
articles.title_zh: 飞轮储能系统电动机的设计和评估：最优选择的多标准决策框架
articles.abstract: Flywheel energy storage systems (FESSs) are considered one of the most promising options in the field of energy storage because of their high reliability, long lifetime, low maintenance requirements, and fast dynamic response to power fluctuations. The electrical machine, as the heart of FESS, plays a key role in determining its technical and economic characteristics. For this reason, the selection of a suitable structure has a direct influence on the performance, dimensions, cost, and lifetime of the FESS. Therefore, the main objective of this paper is to select the optimal structure of the electrical machine for use in FESS considering the mechanical, magnetic and thermal aspects. Subsequently, a comprehensive design algorithm is presented for various system components containing the electrical machine, bearings, cooling system, and rotating mass. Furthermore, a dedicated algorithm is developed to design the electrical machine according to the FESS application. Based on these two algorithms, thirteen different topologies of electrical machines suitable for FESS applications are designed. The Finite element analysis (FEA) is performed to extract the electromagnetic and thermal characteristics of these topologies. In this paper, two major FESS applications, namely frequency regulation in power systems and electric vehicle applications, are considered. Then, by defining a set of key criteria and applying application-specific weightings, the TOPSIS multi-criteria decision-making (MCDM) method is employed to prioritize the machine structures. The results indicate that the choice of machine topology is strongly dependent on the FESS application and no single topology can be definitively introduced as the best option.
articles.abstract_zh: 飞轮储能系统（FESS）因其可靠性高、寿命长、维护要求低以及对功率波动的快速动态响应而被认为是储能领域最有前途的选择之一。电机作为FESS的心脏，在决定其技术和经济特性方面发挥着关键作用。因此，选择合适的结构直接影响FESS的性能、尺寸、成本和寿命。因此，本文的主要目的是考虑机械、磁和热方面的因素，选择 FESS 中使用的电机的最佳结构。随后，针对包括电机、轴承、冷却系统和旋转质量的各种系统组件提出了综合设计算法。此外，还开发了专用算法来根据 FESS 应用设计电机。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 飞轮储能系统（FESS）因其可靠性高、寿命长、维护要求低以及对功率波动的快速动态响应而被认为是储能领域最有前途的选择之一。电机作为FESS的心脏，在决定其技术和经济特性方面发挥着关键作用。因此，选择合适的结构直接影响FESS的性能、尺寸、成本和寿命。因此，本文的主要目的是考虑机械、磁和热方面的因素，选择 FESS 中使用的电机的最佳结构。随后，针对包括电机、轴承、冷却系统和旋转质量的各种系统组件提出了综合设计算法。此外，还开发了专用算法来根据 FESS 应用设计电机。基于这两种算法，设计了适合 FESS 应用的 13 种不同的电机拓扑。执行有限元分析 (FEA) 以提取这些拓扑的电磁和热特性。本文考虑了 FESS 的两个主要应用，即电力系统中的频率调节和电动汽车应用。然后，通过定义一组关键标准并应用特定于应用的权重，采用 TOPSIS 多标准决策 (MCDM) 方法对机器结构进行优先级排序。结果表明，机器拓扑的选择很大程度上取决于 FESS 应用，并且没有任何单一拓扑可以明确引入为最佳选择。

articles.title: Lag-Adaptive Hierarchical Sparse Bayesian Panel VAR Modeling for High-Dimensional Time Series Systems
articles.title_zh: 高维时间序列系统的滞后自适应分层稀疏贝叶斯面板 VAR 建模
articles.abstract: High-dimensional panel vector autoregressive (PVAR) models have become increasingly important for analyzing complex dynamic interactions in multivariate time series systems. However, conventional estimation methods often suffer from overparameterization, multicollinearity, and poor forecasting performance, particularly when the number of parameters grows rapidly relative to the sample size. To address these challenges, this study proposes a Lag-Adaptive Hierarchical Sparse Bayesian Panel Vector Autoregressive (LAHS-BPVAR) model that integrates adaptive lag regularization, hierarchical global-local shrinkage, and sparse Bayesian learning within a unified framework. The proposed model introduces a novel prior covariance structure in which coefficient variances decay according to a hybrid lag-adaptive mechanism combining polynomial and exponential shrinkage, allowing automatic penalization of distant lags while preserving relevant short-run dynamics. A hierarchical sparse prior based on global-local shrinkage further enables adaptive variable selection in high-dimensional settings. Theoretical analysis establishes posterior contraction and sparse support recovery consistency under standard regularity conditions, providing formal asymptotic justification for the proposed estimator. Estimation is performed using a Gibbs sampler with Metropolis-Hastings updates for non-conjugate hyperparameters. Monte Carlo simulation results demonstrate competitive estimation and forecasting performance relative to conventional VAR, Minnesota Bayesian VAR, LASSO VAR, and standard Horseshoe Bayesian VAR. The proposed framework consistently achieves improved sparse support recovery through more effective control of false positive coefficient selection while maintaining estimation accuracy. An empirical application to Indonesian macroeconomic time series further demonstrates the practical effectiveness of the proposed framework in capturing dynamic economic relationships while maintaining model parsimony. The findings suggest that the proposed methodology provides a robust and flexible solution for high-dimensional panel time series modeling.
articles.abstract_zh: 高维面板向量自回归 (PVAR) 模型对于分析多元时间序列系统中复杂的动态相互作用变得越来越重要。然而，传统的估计方法经常面临过度参数化、多重共线性和较差的预测性能，特别是当参数数量相对于样本大小快速增长时。为了应对这些挑战，本研究提出了一种滞后自适应分层稀疏贝叶斯面板向量自回归（LAHS-BPVAR）模型，该模型将自适应滞后正则化、分层全局局部收缩和稀疏贝叶斯学习集成在统一框架内。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 高维面板向量自回归 (PVAR) 模型对于分析多元时间序列系统中复杂的动态相互作用变得越来越重要。然而，传统的估计方法经常面临过度参数化、多重共线性和较差的预测性能，特别是当参数数量相对于样本大小快速增长时。为了应对这些挑战，本研究提出了一种滞后自适应分层稀疏贝叶斯面板向量自回归（LAHS-BPVAR）模型，该模型将自适应滞后正则化、分层全局局部收缩和稀疏贝叶斯学习集成在统一框架内。所提出的模型引入了一种新颖的先验协方差结构，其中系数方差根据结合多项式和指数收缩的混合滞后自适应机制衰减，允许自动惩罚远距离滞后，同时保留相关的短期动态。基于全局局部收缩的分层稀疏先验进一步使得高维设置中的自适应变量选择成为可能。理论分析在标准规律性条件下建立了后验收缩和稀疏支持恢复一致性，为所提出的估计器提供了正式的渐近论证。使用带有 Metropolis-Hastings 更新的吉布斯采样器对非共轭超参数进行估计。蒙特卡洛模拟结果证明了相对于传统 VAR、明尼苏达贝叶斯 VAR、LASSO VAR 和标准马蹄贝叶斯 VAR 的有竞争力的估计和预测性能。所提出的框架通过更有效地控制误报系数选择，同时保持估计精度，始终如一地实现了稀疏支持恢复的改进。对印度尼西亚宏观经济时间序列的实证应用进一步证明了所提出的框架在捕捉动态经济关系同时保持模型简约性方面的实际有效性。研究结果表明，所提出的方法为高维面板时间序列建模提供了稳健且灵活的解决方案。

articles.title: Reinforcement learning for adaptive composition of quantum circuit optimisation passes
articles.title_zh: 量子电路优化通道自适应组合的强化学习
articles.abstract: Many quantum software development kits provide a suite of circuit optimisation passes. These passes have been highly optimised and tested in isolation. However, the order in which they are applied is left to the user, or else defined in general-purpose default pass sequences. While general-purpose sequences miss opportunities for optimisation which are particular to individual circuits, designing pass sequences bespoke to particular circuits requires exceptional knowledge about quantum circuit design and optimisation. Here we propose and demonstrate training a reinforcement learning agent to compose optimisation-pass sequences. In particular the agent’s action space consists of passes for two-qubit gate count reduction used in default PyTKET pass sequences. For the circuits in our diverse test set, the (mean, median) fraction of two-qubit gates removed by the agent is , compared to for the next best default pass sequence. In doing so our model demonstrates the ability to forgo reward to improve the final two-qubit gate count. Our approach clearly separates the problem of designing circuit optimisation passes from the problem of using them optimally in practice. We expect this separation of concerns to facilitate innovations in both areas.
articles.abstract_zh: 许多量子软件开发套件提供了一套电路优化通道。这些通行证经过了高度优化，并单独进行了测试。但是，它们的应用顺序留给用户，或者在通用默认传递序列中定义。虽然通用序列错过了个别电路特有的优化机会，但设计定制到特定电路的通道序列需要对量子电路设计和优化有特殊的了解。在这里，我们提出并演示如何训练强化学习代理来组合优化通过序列。特别是，代理的操作空间包括默认PyTKET传递序列中使用的双量子比特门计数减少的传递。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 许多量子软件开发套件提供了一套电路优化通道。这些通行证经过了高度优化，并单独进行了测试。但是，它们的应用顺序留给用户，或者在通用默认传递序列中定义。虽然通用序列错过了个别电路特有的优化机会，但设计定制到特定电路的通道序列需要对量子电路设计和优化有特殊的了解。在这里，我们提出并演示如何训练强化学习代理来组合优化通过序列。特别是，代理的操作空间包括默认PyTKET传递序列中使用的双量子比特门计数减少的传递。对于我们多样化测试集中的电路，与下一个最佳默认通过序列相比，代理删除的两个量子比特门的（平均值，中位数）分数为。通过这样做，我们的模型展示了放弃奖励以提高最终双量子位门计数的能力。我们的方法清楚地将电路优化传递的设计问题与在实践中优化使用电路传递的问题区分开来。我们希望这种担忧的分离能够促进这两个领域的创新。

articles.title: Learning to stabilize nonequilibrium phases of matter with active feedback using partial information
articles.title_zh: 通过使用部分信息的主动反馈，学习稳定物质的非平衡阶段
articles.abstract: Recent advances in quantum computing experiments have enabled new pathways for feedback control. Here, we investigate the role of information in interactive quantum many-body dynamics to engineer out-of-equilibrium phases of matter. To this end, we train reinforcement learning (RL) agents to prevent entanglement spreading in -dimensional stabilizer circuits with up to qubits. We find that, above an information threshold, agents learn stochastic near-optimal strategies that prevent the system from reaching volume-law entangled states and instead stabilize area-law scaling. These strategies rely on bottlenecks that divide the system and cap the entanglement in the steady state. Crucially, learned strategies are inherently out of equilibrium, require real-time active feedback, and could not be reproduced by simple human-designed control rules. This work establishes the foundations for information-driven individual control of many interacting quantum degrees of freedom, demonstrating the capabilities of RL to stabilize and uncover novel critical properties of many-body nonequilibrium steady states.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子计算实验的最新进展为反馈控制开辟了新的途径。在这里，我们研究信息在交互式量子多体动力学中的作用，以设计物质的不平衡相。为此，我们训练强化学习（ RL ）代理，以防止纠缠在高达量子比特的维度稳定器电路中扩散。我们发现，在信息阈值以上，智能体学习随机接近最优策略，防止系统达到体积律纠缠状态，而是稳定面积律缩放。这些策略依赖于分割系统并将纠缠限制在稳态的瓶颈。至关重要的是，学习策略本质上是不平衡的，需要实时的主动反馈，并且无法通过简单的人类设计的控制规则进行再现。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子计算实验的最新进展为反馈控制开辟了新的途径。在这里，我们研究信息在交互式量子多体动力学中的作用，以设计物质的不平衡相。为此，我们训练强化学习（ RL ）代理，以防止纠缠在高达量子比特的维度稳定器电路中扩散。我们发现，在信息阈值以上，智能体学习随机接近最优策略，防止系统达到体积律纠缠状态，而是稳定面积律缩放。这些策略依赖于分割系统并将纠缠限制在稳态的瓶颈。至关重要的是，学习策略本质上是不平衡的，需要实时的主动反馈，并且无法通过简单的人类设计的控制规则进行再现。这项工作为许多相互作用的量子自由度信息驱动的个体控制奠定了基础，展示了RL稳定和揭示多体非平衡稳态的新关键特性的能力。

articles.title: Weak-coupling selection and finite-torus entropy in the triangular Ising antiferromagnet
articles.title_zh: 三角Ising反铁磁体中的弱耦合选择和有限环熵
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00154v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: An antiferromagnetic second-neighbor interaction favors stripe order in the triangular-lattice Ising antiferromagnet, but uniform stripes cannot satisfy odd periodic boundaries. At each fixed odd size L≥5, we minimize this interaction over the ground states of the zero-field nearest-neighbor model on an L× L torus. We prove a minimum total interface length of 4L and classify all L²(L²-1)/2 selected states. Under the uniform measure on these states, the area fractions of the three stripe orientations approach a uniform distribution over all nonnegative triples summing to one. Thus selection reduces an exponential degeneracy to polynomial growth, while the whole-sample orientation fractions remain broadly distributed. We also derive explicit two-sided entropy-density bounds for periodic spin ground states and honeycomb dimer coverings on M× N tori, where M,N are the periods along the two primitive lattice directions. For all M,N≥3, the errors relative to the bulk residual entropy are bounded by explicit constants times min(M,N)⁻², without an aspect-ratio restriction. These bounds give finite-size accuracy guarantees and control the exponentially small fraction of unperturbed ground states that survive the selection.
articles.abstract_zh: 反铁磁第二邻域相互作用有利于三角晶格Ising反铁磁体的条纹顺序，但均匀条纹不能满足奇数周期边界。在每个固定奇数大小L ≥ 5时，我们在L × L环面上的零场最近邻模型的基态上最小化这种相互作用。我们证明了最小总接口长度为4L ，并对所有L ² (L ² -1)/2选定状态进行分类。在这些状态的均匀测度下，三个条纹取向的面积分数在所有非负三元组之和为1的情况下接近均匀分布。因此，选择减少了多项式生长的指数退化，而整个样本取向分数仍然广泛分布。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 反铁磁第二邻域相互作用有利于三角晶格Ising反铁磁体的条纹顺序，但均匀条纹不能满足奇数周期边界。在每个固定奇数大小L ≥ 5时，我们在L × L环面上的零场最近邻模型的基态上最小化这种相互作用。我们证明了最小总接口长度为4L ，并对所有L ² (L ² -1)/2选定状态进行分类。在这些状态的均匀测度下，三个条纹取向的面积分数在所有非负三元组之和为1的情况下接近均匀分布。因此，选择减少了多项式生长的指数退化，而整个样本取向分数仍然广泛分布。我们还推导了M × N tori上周期性自旋基态和蜂窝二聚体覆盖的显式双侧熵密度边界，其中M ， N是沿两个原始晶格方向的周期。对于所有M ， N ≥ 3 ，相对于本体残差熵的误差由显式常数乘以min (M, N)钚来界定，没有纵横比限制。这些界限为有限尺寸的准确性提供了保证，并控制了在选择中存活的指数小部分未受干扰的基态。

articles.title: Y2CdX4 (X = S, Se, Te) Semiconductors: A First-Principles Study of Structural, Electronic, Optical, and Energy-Related Properties
articles.title_zh: Y2CdX4 (X = S, Se, Te)半导体：结构、电子、光学和能量相关性质的第一原理研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00167v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a comprehensive density functional theory (DFT) investigation of the structural, mechanical, electronic, optical, thermoelectric, and bonding properties of Y2CdX4 (X = S, Se, Te) compounds for potential optoelectronic and energy-conversion applications. Structural optimization reveals a systematic expansion of the equilibrium lattice parameters from S to Te. The calculated bulk moduli decrease from 83 GPa for Y2CdS4 to 68 GPa for Y2CdSe4 and 54 GPa for Y2CdTe4, indicating progressive lattice softening. Electronic band-structure calculations predict indirect band gaps of 2.42, 2.08, and 1.71 eV for Y2CdS4, Y2CdSe4, and Y2CdTe4, respectively, with further narrowing upon inclusion of spin-orbit coupling. The calculated dielectric functions, refractive indices, absorption coefficients, reflectivity, optical conductivities, and electron energy-loss spectra reveal systematic changes in optical response across the chalcogen series. The absorption onset shifts toward lower photon energies, from approximately 2.4 eV in Y2CdS4 to 1.7 eV in Y2CdTe4. Thermoelectric calculations indicate promising Seebeck coefficients and power factors, with Y2CdSe4 exhibiting a favorable balance of transport properties. Charge-density distributions, electron localization functions, and Bader charge analyses suggest increasing covalent bonding contributions from sulfide to telluride. These findings highlight the potential of Y2CdX4 compounds for tunable optoelectronic and energy-conversion applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了Y2CdX4 （ X = S ， Se ， Te ）化合物的结构，机械，电子，光学，热电和键合性质的综合密度泛函理论（ DFT ）研究，用于潜在的光电子和能量转换应用。结构优化揭示了平衡晶格参数从S到Te的系统扩展。计算的体积模量从Y2CdS4的83GPa下降到Y2CdSe4的68GPa和Y2CdTe4的54GPa ，表明晶格逐渐软化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了Y2CdX4 （ X = S ， Se ， Te ）化合物的结构，机械，电子，光学，热电和键合性质的综合密度泛函理论（ DFT ）研究，用于潜在的光电子和能量转换应用。结构优化揭示了平衡晶格参数从S到Te的系统扩展。计算的体积模量从Y2CdS4的83GPa下降到Y2CdSe4的68GPa和Y2CdTe4的54GPa ，表明晶格逐渐软化。电子带结构计算预测Y2CdS4、Y2CdSe4和Y2CdTe4的间接带隙分别为2.42、2.08和1.71 eV ，包括自旋轨道耦合后进一步缩小。计算的介电函数、折射率、吸收系数、反射率、光导率和电子能量损失谱揭示了整个硫族元素系列光学响应的系统变化。吸收开始转向较低的光子能量，从Y2CdS4中的约2.4 eV转向Y2CdTe4中的1.7 eV。热电计算表明有希望的塞贝克系数和功率因数，其中Y2CdSe4表现出良好的传输特性平衡。电荷密度分布、电子定位函数和Bader电荷分析表明，硫化物对碲化物的共价键贡献增加。这些发现突出了Y2CdX4化合物在可调光电子和能量转换应用中的潜力。

articles.title: On-the-fly Δ-machine learned force fields for warm dense matter using a Yukawa reference model: Application to magnesium
articles.title_zh: 使用Yukawa参考模型实时学习温暖致密物质的Δ-机器力场：应用于镁
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00170v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a framework for on-the-fly Δ-machine learned force field (Δ-MLFF) molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of warm dense matter (WDM). In particular, we employ a Yukawa reference model that captures the dominant screened-Coulomb interactions between the ions, with its parameters fit on the fly to Kohn--Sham density functional theory (DFT) data, and an MLFF scheme based on the kernel method and Bayesian linear regression that learns the differences in the energies, atomic forces, and stresses between the Yukawa model and Kohn--Sham DFT. We verify the accuracy and performance of the formalism by comparing the predicted properties of warm dense carbon with Kohn--Sham DFT results in the literature. In so doing, we demonstrate that Δ-MLFF has significantly lower errors in the energies, atomic forces, and stresses than the standard MLFF scheme at a comparable cost, while accelerating ab initio MD simulations by up to three orders of magnitude. We apply this framework to calculate the equation of state, structure, and transport properties of magnesium at densities of 5.22 to 10.44 g/cm³ and temperatures of 600 kK to 1.5 MK. We find that the pressure, self-diffusion coefficient, and shear viscosity obey power laws in temperature and density, that the dynamic structure factor exhibits a well-defined ion-acoustic mode whose negative dispersion is characteristic of strongly coupled liquids, and that the Stokes--Einstein relation holds to within 10% over the conditions considered.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们开发了一个用于温密物质（ WDM ）的即时Δ机器学习力场（ Δ-MLFF ）分子动力学（ MD ）模拟的框架。特别是，我们使用Yukawa参考模型来捕获离子之间的主要屏蔽库仑相互作用，其参数即时拟合到Kohn-Sham密度泛函理论（ DFT ）数据，以及基于核方法和贝叶斯线性回归的MLFF方案，该方案学习Yukawa模型和Kohn-Sham DFT之间的能量、原子力和应力的差异。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们开发了一个用于温密物质（ WDM ）的即时Δ机器学习力场（ Δ-MLFF ）分子动力学（ MD ）模拟的框架。特别是，我们使用Yukawa参考模型来捕获离子之间的主要屏蔽库仑相互作用，其参数即时拟合到Kohn-Sham密度泛函理论（ DFT ）数据，以及基于核方法和贝叶斯线性回归的MLFF方案，该方案学习Yukawa模型和Kohn-Sham DFT之间的能量、原子力和应力的差异。我们通过将暖致密碳的预测性质与文献中的Kohn-Sham DFT结果进行比较来验证形式化的准确性和性能。通过这样做，我们证明，与标准MLFF方案相比， Δ-MLFF在能量、原子力和应力方面的误差显著降低，成本相当，同时从头开始将MD模拟加速高达三个数量级。我们应用此框架计算密度为5.22至10.44 g/cm ³、温度为600 kK至1.5 MK时镁的状态、结构和输运特性方程。我们发现压力，自扩散系数和剪切粘度服从温度和密度的幂律，动态结构因子表现出明确的离子声模，其负色散是强耦合液体的特征，并且斯托克斯-爱因斯坦关系在考虑的条件下保持在10 ％以内。

articles.title: Fabry-Pérot Cavity formed by Magnonic waveguide using holes and notches
articles.title_zh: 由磁波导使用孔和凹口形成的法布里-佩罗腔
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00178v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this paper, we have investigated a spin-wave-based Fabry-Pérot (FP) cavity using two air holes and notches embedded in a magnonic waveguide. Through micromagnetic simulations, we have demonstrated the spin-wave profile, as well as the transmission and reflection spectra of the FP type magnonic waveguide, by varying the distance between the center of holes and notches. We have introduced an analysis of the reflection spectra in an FP type magnonic waveguide, which is essential and considerable for the performance of magnonic integrated circuits. We have also presented a theoretical model to describe the transmission and reflection characteristics of the FP-type magnonic waveguide. Furthermore, active tuning of the resonance peak of the FP type magnonic wavguide by varying the external magnetic field has been demonstrated. Our proposed structure and its study may contribute to the development of magnonic integrated circuits for low-power computing and data processing in next-generation spintronic technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们使用嵌入在磁波导中的两个气孔和凹口研究了基于自旋波的法布里-佩罗（ FP ）腔。通过微磁模拟，我们通过改变孔和凹口中心之间的距离，演示了FP型磁波导的自旋波剖面以及透射和反射光谱。我们引入了FP型磁波导中反射光谱的分析，这对于磁集成电路的性能至关重要。我们还提出了一个理论模型来描述FP型磁波导的透射和反射特性。此外，还演示了通过改变外部磁场来主动调谐FP型磁波导的谐振峰。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在本文中，我们使用嵌入在磁波导中的两个气孔和凹口研究了基于自旋波的法布里-佩罗（ FP ）腔。通过微磁模拟，我们通过改变孔和凹口中心之间的距离，演示了FP型磁波导的自旋波剖面以及透射和反射光谱。我们引入了FP型磁波导中反射光谱的分析，这对于磁集成电路的性能至关重要。我们还提出了一个理论模型来描述FP型磁波导的透射和反射特性。此外，还演示了通过改变外部磁场来主动调谐FP型磁波导的谐振峰。我们提出的结构及其研究可能有助于下一代自旋电子技术中用于低功耗计算和数据处理的磁性集成电路的发展。

articles.title: In the age of big data and AI: do we still need chemical bonds?
articles.title_zh: 在大数据和人工智能时代：我们还需要化学键吗？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00228v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chemical bonding is the language through which chemistry rationalizes materials structure, stability, properties, and reactivity. Meanwhile, modern deep-learning models achieve remarkable predictive performance using representations based largely on compositional and structural information, raising the question of whether explicit bonding concepts remain necessary. In this work, we argue that artificial intelligence does not render chemical bonding obsolete but provides a new framework for evaluating and refining bonding concepts. We show that, through linear probing, Allegro and MACE embeddings recover bonding descriptors with (R² > 0.95), indicating that bonding emerges naturally from Allegro's and MACE's latent spaces. We also show that bonding descriptors provide information beyond bond distance in our electronic-structure-featurized MEGNet (ESF-MEGNet) model, reducing prediction error for properties including bulk and shear moduli by 15%. We discuss implications for interpretable machine learning, synthesizability prediction, and generative materials design, and suggest joint-embedding approaches for learning more general bonding representations. More broadly, we propose that chemical bonding can be understood as a learnable representation of electronic structure. From this perspective, different bonding models represent alternative compressions of the underlying electronic information and can be evaluated through their predictive power, dimensionality, and complexity. The age of machine learning shifts the focus from whether a bonding model is physically motivated to whether it captures the information required to explain and predict materials behavior. If a materials genome exists, it should be encodable through a representation of chemical bonding. If no bonding representation can capture this information, our understanding of the chemical bond may require revision.
articles.abstract_zh: 化学键合是化学使材料结构、稳定性、性能和反应性合理化的语言。与此同时，现代深度学习模型使用主要基于组成和结构信息的表示来实现显着的预测性能，这就提出了显式键合概念是否仍有必要的问题。在这项工作中，我们认为人工智能并没有使化学键合过时，而是为评估和完善键合概念提供了一个新的框架。我们表明，通过线性探测， Allegro和MACE嵌入恢复与（ R ² > 0.95 ）的键合描述符，表明键合自然地从Allegro和MACE的潜在空间中出现。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 化学键合是化学使材料结构、稳定性、性能和反应性合理化的语言。与此同时，现代深度学习模型使用主要基于组成和结构信息的表示来实现显着的预测性能，这就提出了显式键合概念是否仍有必要的问题。在这项工作中，我们认为人工智能并没有使化学键合过时，而是为评估和完善键合概念提供了一个新的框架。我们表明，通过线性探测， Allegro和MACE嵌入恢复与（ R ² > 0.95 ）的键合描述符，表明键合自然地从Allegro和MACE的潜在空间中出现。我们还表明，在我们的电子结构特征化MEGNet （ ESF-MEGNet ）模型中，键合描述符提供了超出键合距离的信息，将包括体积和剪切模量在内的属性的预测误差降低了15%。我们讨论了可解释机器学习、可合成性预测和生成材料设计的含义，并提出了学习更一般键合表示的联合嵌入方法。更广泛地说，我们提出化学键可以理解为电子结构的可学习表示。从这个角度来看，不同的键合模型代表了底层电子信息的替代压缩，可以通过其预测能力、维度和复杂性进行评估。机器学习的时代将重点从键合模型是否具有物理动机转移到它是否捕获解释和预测材料行为所需的信息。如果材料基因组存在，它应该可以通过化学键的表示进行编码。如果没有键合表示可以捕获这些信息，我们对化学键的理解可能需要修改。

articles.title: The Agentic AI Kerr Lab: LLM Agents for Kerr Microscopy Experiments with Magnetic Skyrmions
articles.title_zh: Agentic AI Kerr实验室：用于磁性Skyrmions的Kerr显微镜实验的LLM代理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00299v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetic skyrmions are topological spin textures that can be observed directly by magnetic microscopy and driven by fields and currents, which makes them a model system for fundamental physics and candidates for spintronic devices. Magneto-optical Kerr microscopy is a method to image them in real time; however, most experiments use an inefficient cycle of consecutive imaging, analysis and excitation in which every step requires the judgement of the experimentalist operating the setup. Here we present the Agentic AI Kerr Lab (AgentKerr), in which an agent based on a large language model operates this cycle automatically and efficiently on a Kerr microscope. Rather than relying on pattern detection by a language model, a convolutional neural network trained on Kerr images turns live images into skyrmion observables such as position, size and shape, on which the agent bases its decisions. The architecture lets agents operate the instruments safely, as every hardware action is checked deterministically against an action policy, independently of the agent that issues it. With no procedure given, the agent determines by itself how to create, tune and move skyrmions, and writes its own analyses. The approach can be transferred to other spin textures and points towards magnetic imaging experiments in which the researcher poses the question and the agent finds the way to realize the experiments that yield the answer.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁性斯格明子是拓扑自旋纹理，可以通过磁显微镜直接观察并由场和电流驱动，这使得它们成为基础物理的模型系统和自旋电子器件的候选者。磁光克尔显微镜是一种实时成像的方法；然而，大多数实验使用连续成像、分析和激发的低效循环，其中每一步都需要操作设置的实验人员的判断。在这里，我们介绍了 Agentic AI Kerr 实验室 (AgentKerr)，其中基于大型语言模型的代理在 Kerr 显微镜上自动高效地运行此循环。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁性斯格明子是拓扑自旋纹理，可以通过磁显微镜直接观察并由场和电流驱动，这使得它们成为基础物理的模型系统和自旋电子器件的候选者。磁光克尔显微镜是一种实时成像的方法；然而，大多数实验使用连续成像、分析和激发的低效循环，其中每一步都需要操作设置的实验人员的判断。在这里，我们介绍了 Agentic AI Kerr 实验室 (AgentKerr)，其中基于大型语言模型的代理在 Kerr 显微镜上自动高效地运行此循环。在 Kerr 图像上训练的卷积神经网络不是依赖于语言模型的模式检测，而是将实时图像转换为斯格明子可观测值，例如位置、大小和形状，代理以此为基础做出决策。该架构允许代理安全地操作仪器，因为每个硬件操作都会根据操作策略进行确定性检查，而与发出该操作的代理无关。在没有给出程序的情况下，代理自行决定如何创建、调整和移动斯格明子，并编写自己的分析。该方法可以转移到其他自旋纹理，并指向磁成像实验，在磁成像实验中，研究人员提出问题，代理找到实现产生答案的实验的方法。

articles.title: Quantum dynamics of ultrasmall magnetic skyrmions in atomic-defect landscapes
articles.title_zh: 原子缺陷景观中超小磁性斯格明子的量子动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00304v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetic skyrmions are prime candidates for future information technology, and their fate in devices is settled by the defects they encounter. In ultrathin films, skyrmions can be as small as a couple of nanometers, carrying only a few tens of magnetic moments, while atomic defects reshape their energy landscape on the atomic scale. Here, we demonstrate that such ultrasmall skyrmions can behave quantum mechanically and that their quantum dynamics is unusual. Since the gyrotropic force dominates, the two coordinates of a ferromagnetic skyrmion are canonically conjugate and the skyrmion behaves as a particle in the lowest Landau level of an effective magnetic field, with a magnetic length of 0.6~Å. Utilizing skyrmion-defect interaction profiles of Cr and Fe adatoms and dimers in PdFe/Ir(111), obtained from atomistic spin simulations parametrized from first principles, we unveil quantized gyrotropic orbits with level spacings of 20--85~μeV, bound not only by pinning defects but also, counter-intuitively, by repulsive ones. Saddle points of the energy landscape act as quantum beam splitters for skyrmions, and quantum depinning reaches rates of 1--100~Hz below the critical current. Embedded impurities, in contrast, bind the skyrmion so strongly that it ceases to behave as a rigid particle, defining a strong-coupling regime. For the Gilbert damping typical of ultrathin films, the quantized levels remain well resolved. The thermal-to-quantum crossover lies between 40 and 160~mK, which is within reach of millikelvin scanning tunneling microscopy, where tip-induced escape statistics and electron spin resonance STM can reveal the quantized gyrotropic motion of skyrmions pinned at defects crafted atom by atom.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁性斯格明子是未来信息技术的主要候选者，它们在设备中的命运取决于它们遇到的缺陷。在超薄膜中，斯格明子可以小至几纳米，仅携带几十个磁矩，而原子缺陷则在原子尺度上重塑其能量格局。在这里，我们证明了这种超小的斯格明子可以表现出量子力学，并且它们的量子动力学是不寻常的。由于回旋力占主导地位，铁磁斯格明子的两个坐标是正则共轭的，并且斯格明子表现为有效磁场最低朗道能级中的粒子，磁长度为0.6~Å。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁性斯格明子是未来信息技术的主要候选者，它们在设备中的命运取决于它们遇到的缺陷。在超薄膜中，斯格明子可以小至几纳米，仅携带几十个磁矩，而原子缺陷则在原子尺度上重塑其能量格局。在这里，我们证明了这种超小的斯格明子可以表现出量子力学，并且它们的量子动力学是不寻常的。由于回旋力占主导地位，铁磁斯格明子的两个坐标是正则共轭的，并且斯格明子表现为有效磁场最低朗道能级中的粒子，磁长度为0.6~Å。利用PdFe/Ir(111)中Cr和Fe吸附原子和二聚体的斯格明子-缺陷相互作用剖面，从第一原理参数化的原子自旋模拟中获得，我们揭示了能级间距为20--85~μeV的量子化回旋轨道，不仅受到钉扎缺陷的束缚，而且与直觉相反，还受到排斥缺陷的束缚。能量景观的鞍点充当斯格明子的量子分束器，量子脱钉达到低于临界电流1--100Hz的速率。相比之下，嵌入的杂质与斯格明子的结合非常牢固，以至于它不再表现为刚性粒子，从而定义了强耦合状态。对于超薄膜典型的吉尔伯特阻尼，量子化水平仍然得到很好的解析。热-量子交叉位于 40 至 160~mK 之间，这是毫开尔文扫描隧道显微镜所能达到的范围，其中尖端诱导逃逸统计和电子自旋共振 STM 可以揭示固定在逐个原子制造的缺陷处的斯格明子的量子化陀螺运动。

articles.title: Evidence for topological flat band magnetism in Co₃Sn₂S₂
articles.title_zh: Co₃Sn2S2 中拓扑平带磁性的证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00310v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Correlations and topology are central pillars in the study of emergent electronic phases. Topological flat bands near the Fermi level unite these concepts, providing a route towards correlated topological phenomena and unconventional magnetism. Despite theoretical predictions, momentum-resolved observation of a topological flat band at the Fermi level has remained elusive. Using angle resolved photoemission spectroscopy, we observe a flat band at the Fermi level within the topologically non-trivial electronic structure of the magnetic kagome Weyl semimetal Co₃Sn₂S₂. We further uncover a strong temperature dependence in which the flat band shifts across the Fermi level, accompanied by a reconstruction of the Fermi surface. Strikingly, this evolution occurs on the same temperature scale as previously reported anomalies in the magnetic response. Together, these results provide evidence for topological flat band magnetism in Co₃Sn₂S₂, establishing a microscopic setting in which topology, electronic correlations, and magnetism become intertwined.
articles.abstract_zh: 相关性和拓扑是新兴电子相研究的核心支柱。费米能级附近的拓扑平带将这些概念结合起来，为相关拓扑现象和非常规磁性提供了一条途径。尽管有理论预测，费米能级拓扑平带的动量分辨观测仍然难以实现。使用角分辨光电子能谱，我们在磁性 Kagome Weyl 半金属 Co₃Sn2S2 的拓扑非平凡电子结构中观察到费米能级的平带。我们进一步发现了强烈的温度依赖性，其中平带在费米能级上移动，并伴随着费米表面的重建。引人注目的是，这种演化发生在与先前报道的磁响应异常相同的温度范围内。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 相关性和拓扑是新兴电子相研究的核心支柱。费米能级附近的拓扑平带将这些概念结合起来，为相关拓扑现象和非常规磁性提供了一条途径。尽管有理论预测，费米能级拓扑平带的动量分辨观测仍然难以实现。使用角分辨光电子能谱，我们在磁性 Kagome Weyl 半金属 Co₃Sn2S2 的拓扑非平凡电子结构中观察到费米能级的平带。我们进一步发现了强烈的温度依赖性，其中平带在费米能级上移动，并伴随着费米表面的重建。引人注目的是，这种演化发生在与先前报道的磁响应异常相同的温度范围内。总之，这些结果为 Co₃Sn2S2 中的拓扑平带磁性提供了证据，建立了拓扑、电子相关性和磁性相互交织的微观环境。

articles.title: Multistable elastic pixels: nematic elasticity for non-volatile positioning of colloidal optical scatterers
articles.title_zh: 多稳态弹性像素：胶体光学散射体非挥发性定位的向列弹性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00318v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Non-volatile reconfiguration of optical devices, in which a configuration persists without continuous energy input, remains a challenge. We introduce multistable elastic pixels (MEPs), lithographically defined pores filled with a nematic liquid crystal, whose curved ends capture a scattering inclusion in one of two mechanically stable sites. Simulations and experiments show that pore geometry and homeotropic surface anchoring define the energy minima and the height of the barrier between them. This barrier far exceeds thermal energies, stabilizing a scatterer location absent an external field. Colloidal inclusions switch reversibly between sites under transient electric fields. Using arrays of static scatterers, we show that the two positional states produce distinct responses at visible wavelengths, demonstrating the potential of MEPs for reconfigurable devices and metasurfaces. Unlike phase-change and liquid-crystal-tuned approaches, which switch a material surrounding fixed scatterers, MEPs use the nematoelastic energy landscape to move the optical element itself.
articles.abstract_zh: 光学器件的非易失性重新配置（其中配置在没有连续能量输入的情况下持续存在）仍然是一个挑战。我们引入了多稳态弹性像素（MEP），这是一种光刻定义的孔，填充有向列液晶，其弯曲末端捕获两个机械稳定位点之一的散射夹杂物。模拟和实验表明，孔隙几何形状和垂直表面锚定定义了能量最小值和它们之间的势垒高度。该屏障远远超过热能，在没有外部场的情况下稳定散射体的位置。在瞬态电场下，胶体包裹体在位点之间可逆地转换。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 光学器件的非易失性重新配置（其中配置在没有连续能量输入的情况下持续存在）仍然是一个挑战。我们引入了多稳态弹性像素（MEP），这是一种光刻定义的孔，填充有向列液晶，其弯曲末端捕获两个机械稳定位点之一的散射夹杂物。模拟和实验表明，孔隙几何形状和垂直表面锚定定义了能量最小值和它们之间的势垒高度。该屏障远远超过热能，在没有外部场的情况下稳定散射体的位置。在瞬态电场下，胶体包裹体在位点之间可逆地转换。使用静态散射体阵列，我们表明两种位置状态在可见波长下产生不同的响应，证明了 MEP 在可重构设备和超表面方面的潜力。与改变固定散射体周围材料的相变和液晶调谐方法不同，MEP 使用向列弹性能量景观来移动光学元件本身。

articles.title: Quantum Dipolar Magnon Drag in Conducting Magnetic Bilayers
articles.title_zh: 导电磁性双层中的量子偶极磁振子阻力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00320v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We predict electrical drag between two electrically isolated metallic ferromagnets mediated by quantum dipolar magnon coupling. A charge current in one layer generates a nonequilibrium magnon current whose momentum is transferred across an insulating spacer through interlayer dipolar interactions. The resulting magnon current in the passive layer produces a measurable voltage through electron-magnon scattering. We show the combination of resonant quantum momentum transfer and magnetic tunability through the control of magnetization configurations distinguish quantum dipolar drag from conventional drag mechanism.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们预测了由量子偶极磁振子耦合介导的两个电隔离金属铁磁体之间的电阻力。一层中的充电电流产生非平衡磁振子电流，其动量通过层间偶极相互作用跨过绝缘间隔物转移。无源层中产生的磁振子电流通过电子磁振子散射产生可测量的电压。我们展示了通过控制磁化配置将共振量子动量转移和磁可调性相结合，将量子偶极阻力与传统阻力机制区分开来。

articles.title: Helical Magnetic Nature of β-Mn Structured CoZn Thin-Films Determined by a Bayesian Approach to Modeling Polarized Neutron Reflectivity Data
articles.title_zh: 通过贝叶斯方法对偏振中子反射率数据进行建模确定 β-Mn 结构 CoZn 薄膜的螺旋磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00390v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chiral magnetic materials can host skyrmions and hence are of interest for numerous spintronic applications including low-power storage. To reach this goal, room temperature operation and a thin film form are needed. We have studied the chiral magnetism in a β-Mn structured CoZn sputtered film, with a Curie temperature of approx 130 degC, by means of polarized neutron reflectometry (PNR) in order to reveal its magnetic field-temperature phase diagram. In bulk this material has a helimagnetic ground state. Here we use PNR data to show that the helimagnetism survives in a CoZn film only 100 nm thick, roughly half a helical period. Given the subtlety of differentiating the helical state from a uniform state with reduced interfacial magnetism, we have developed and employed a Bayesian approach that uses model selection to analyze our PNR data and to map out the field-temperature phase diagram of our thin film.
articles.abstract_zh: 手性磁性材料可以容纳斯格明子，因此对包括低功耗存储在内的众多自旋电子应用很感兴趣。为了实现这一目标，需要室温操作和薄膜形式。我们通过偏振中子反射仪（PNR）研究了居里温度约为130℃的β-Mn结构CoZn溅射薄膜的手性磁性，以揭示其磁场-温度相图。这种材料大体上具有螺旋磁基态。在这里，我们使用 PNR 数据表明，螺旋磁性在厚度仅为 100 nm（大约半个螺旋周期）的 CoZn 薄膜中仍然存在。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 手性磁性材料可以容纳斯格明子，因此对包括低功耗存储在内的众多自旋电子应用很感兴趣。为了实现这一目标，需要室温操作和薄膜形式。我们通过偏振中子反射仪（PNR）研究了居里温度约为130℃的β-Mn结构CoZn溅射薄膜的手性磁性，以揭示其磁场-温度相图。这种材料大体上具有螺旋磁基态。在这里，我们使用 PNR 数据表明，螺旋磁性在厚度仅为 100 nm（大约半个螺旋周期）的 CoZn 薄膜中仍然存在。鉴于区分螺旋态与界面磁性降低的均匀态的微妙之处，我们开发并采用了贝叶斯方法，该方法使用模型选择来分析我们的 PNR 数据并绘制薄膜的场温度相图。

articles.title: Colloidal gel morphology and phase behavior differs based on the electrostatic interaction model in concentrated electrolytes
articles.title_zh: 根据浓缩电解质中的静电相互作用模型，胶体凝胶形态和相行为有所不同
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00419v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Predicting how nanoparticles interact in concentrated electrolytes remains a central challenge in nanoscience, with implications spanning energy storage, catalysis, and soft materials design. While Derjaguin-Landau-Verwey-Overbeek (DLVO) theory provides a widely used framework for modeling colloidal interactions, its electrostatic component relies on electric double-layer (EDL) theories whose validity in ionic liquids and concentrated electrolytes is consistently debated. Experiments have revealed significant deviations from classical screening behavior, including underscreening and oscillatory charge ordering, yet the consequences of these nonclassical effects for collective nanoparticle behavior remain unresolved. Here, we demonstrate that the extended range and oscillatory nature of electrostatic screening in concentrated electrolytes predicts different phase behavior and morphology of colloidal ionogels, yielding distinct thermodynamic signatures, percolation thresholds, and amorphous network structures. Using molecular dynamics simulations with DLVO-type pair interactions parameterized by competing EDL models, we systematically compare the consequences of different screening theories on gel formation and configurations.
articles.abstract_zh: 预测纳米粒子如何在浓电解质中相互作用仍然是纳米科学的一个核心挑战，其影响涵盖能量存储、催化和软材料设计。虽然 Derjaguin-Landau-Verwey-Overbeek (DLVO) 理论为胶体相互作用建模提供了广泛使用的框架，但其静电成分依赖于双电层 (EDL) 理论，该理论在离子液体和浓缩电解质中的有效性一直存在争议。实验揭示了与经典筛选行为的显着偏差，包括筛选不足和振荡电荷排序，但这些非经典效应对集体纳米粒子行为的影响仍未解决。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 预测纳米粒子如何在浓电解质中相互作用仍然是纳米科学的一个核心挑战，其影响涵盖能量存储、催化和软材料设计。虽然 Derjaguin-Landau-Verwey-Overbeek (DLVO) 理论为胶体相互作用建模提供了广泛使用的框架，但其静电成分依赖于双电层 (EDL) 理论，该理论在离子液体和浓缩电解质中的有效性一直存在争议。实验揭示了与经典筛选行为的显着偏差，包括筛选不足和振荡电荷排序，但这些非经典效应对集体纳米粒子行为的影响仍未解决。在这里，我们证明了浓电解质中静电屏蔽的扩展范围和振荡性质预测了胶体离子凝胶的不同相行为和形态，产生了不同的热力学特征、渗滤阈值和无定形网络结构。使用通过竞争 EDL 模型参数化的 DLVO 型对相互作用的分子动力学模拟，我们系统地比较了不同筛选理论对凝胶形成和构型的影响。

articles.title: Effect of Rapid Thermal Annealing on the Superconductivity of ALD-Grown TiN thin films
articles.title_zh: 快速热退火对 ALD 生长 TiN 薄膜超导性的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00424v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Titanium nitride (TiN) is a promising superconducting material for scalable quantum technologies owing to its tunable kinetic inductance and compatibility with CMOS thin-film processing. However, the superconducting performance of atomic-layer-deposited TiN can be degraded by oxygen incorporation, off-stoichiometry, and crystallographic disorder. In this work, we investigate rapid thermal annealing (RTA) in high-purity nitrogen as a post-deposition strategy to improve polycrystalline TiN films grown by RF-biased plasma-enhanced atomic layer deposition. Grazing-incidence X-ray diffraction reveals reduced peak broadening, a smaller lattice parameter, and a stronger (111) preferred orientation with increasing annealing temperature. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy depth profiling shows reduced oxygen-related bonding and a shift toward a Ti--N-dominated chemical environment after annealing. These structural and chemical changes result in a 25% increase in the superconducting transition temperature and a significant narrowing of the transition width. Annealing also reduced the sheet resistance and the estimated sheet kinetic inductance, increased the residual resistance ratio, and improved the magnetic-field tolerance. Together, the structural, chemical, and transport results are consistent with reduced material disorder and improved superconducting uniformity. Because RTA is a relatively low thermal budget and is a semiconductor fabrication compatible process, it offers a practical route to improve the quality of ALD-grown TiN for superconducting applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 氮化钛 (TiN) 因其可调节的动感电感和与 CMOS 薄膜处理的兼容性，是一种用于可扩展量子技术的有前途的超导材料。然而，原子层沉积 TiN 的超导性能可能会因氧掺入、非化学计量和晶体无序而降低。在这项工作中，我们研究了高纯氮气中的快速热退火（RTA）作为一种后沉积策略，以改善通过射频偏置等离子体增强原子层沉积生长的多晶 TiN 薄膜。掠入射 X 射线衍射表明，随着退火温度的升高，峰展宽减少，晶格参数变小，并且 (111) 择优取向增强。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 氮化钛 (TiN) 因其可调节的动感电感和与 CMOS 薄膜处理的兼容性，是一种用于可扩展量子技术的有前途的超导材料。然而，原子层沉积 TiN 的超导性能可能会因氧掺入、非化学计量和晶体无序而降低。在这项工作中，我们研究了高纯氮气中的快速热退火（RTA）作为一种后沉积策略，以改善通过射频偏置等离子体增强原子层沉积生长的多晶 TiN 薄膜。掠入射 X 射线衍射表明，随着退火温度的升高，峰展宽减少，晶格参数变小，并且 (111) 择优取向增强。 X 射线光电子能谱深度分析显示，退火后氧相关键合减少，化学环境向 Ti-N 为主的转变。这些结构和化学变化导致超导转变温度提高 25%，转变宽度显着变窄。退火还降低了薄层电阻和估计的薄层动态电感，增加了残余电阻率，并提高了磁场耐受性。总之，结构、化学和输运结果与减少材料无序和改善超导均匀性是一致的。由于 RTA 的热预算相对较低，并且是一种与半导体制造兼容的工艺，因此它为提高超导应用 ALD 生长 TiN 的质量提供了一条实用途径。

articles.title: Validation of the five-electron pO qubit in Si using full configuration interaction
articles.title_zh: 使用全构型相互作用验证 Si 中的五电子 pO2 量子位
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00443v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The pO qubit is a recently proposed charge qubit consisting of five electrons confined in a gate-defined Si quantum dot. Because its two qubit states have no dipole moment, it couples to electric fields only through the quadrupole moment, suppressing the dominant decoherence channel of conventional charge qubits while retaining all-electrical control. The original proposal was formulated in a shell-filling picture without Coulomb interactions. In this work we perform full configuration interaction (FCI) calculations to assess the impact of the Coulomb interaction on the viability of the pO qubit. We find that the interacting eigenstates occupy orbital shells beyond the shell-filling picture, with the degree of excitation governed by the competition between valley splitting, orbital energy, and Coulomb energy scales. Additionally, we find that the ground states form degenerate doublets, but of two distinct kinds. Above a crossover near a valley splitting of EᵣₘVSapprox50~μeV the doublet is a pair of orbital angular momentum excitations with |langle L_zrangle|=1 in the lower valley, while below the crossover the doublet is a pair of single valley excitations with langle L_zrangle=0. Despite this substantial departure from the shell-filling picture, for EᵣₘVS > 50~μeV the essential features, vanishing dipole moments and nonzero quadrupole tensor between qubit states are preserved. We show that the vanishing dipole is in fact guaranteed by the symmetry properties of the five-electron Hamiltonian. The same energy scales that govern the orbital occupation also set the quadrupole tensor elements and the first excited state energy gap, both of which are in principle tunable through device engineering.
articles.abstract_zh: pO 量子位是最近提出的一种电荷量子位，由限制在栅极定义的 Si 量子点中的五个电子组成。由于它的两个量子位态没有偶极矩，因此它仅通过四极矩耦合到电场，从而抑制传统电荷量子位的主要退相干通道，同时保留全电控制。最初的提议是在没有库仑相互作用的壳填充图中制定的。在这项工作中，我们执行完整配置相互作用 (FCI) 计算，以评估库仑相互作用对 pO2 量子位可行性的影响。我们发现相互作用的本征态占据了壳填充图之外的轨道壳，激发程度由谷分裂、轨道能量和库仑能级之间的竞争决定。
articles.abstract_zh_full: pO 量子位是最近提出的一种电荷量子位，由限制在栅极定义的 Si 量子点中的五个电子组成。由于它的两个量子位态没有偶极矩，因此它仅通过四极矩耦合到电场，从而抑制传统电荷量子位的主要退相干通道，同时保留全电控制。最初的提议是在没有库仑相互作用的壳填充图中制定的。在这项工作中，我们执行完整配置相互作用 (FCI) 计算，以评估库仑相互作用对 pO2 量子位可行性的影响。我们发现相互作用的本征态占据了壳填充图之外的轨道壳，激发程度由谷分裂、轨道能量和库仑能级之间的竞争决定。此外，我们发现基态形成简并双峰，但有两种不同的类型。在 EᵣₘVSapprox50~μeV 的谷分裂附近的交叉上方，双峰是一对轨道角动量激发，在较低的谷中|langle L_zrangle|=1，而在交叉下方，双峰是一对单谷激发，langle L_zrangle=0。尽管与壳填充图有很大的不同，但对于 EᵣₘVS > 50~μeV，基本特征、量子位态之间的偶极矩消失和非零四极张量都被保留。我们证明消失偶极子实际上是由五电子哈密顿量的对称性保证的。控制轨道占据的相同能量尺度也设置了四极张量元素和第一激发态能隙，这两者原则上都可以通过设备工程进行调节。

articles.title: Physics-informed X-ray tomography of magnetization and material parameters
articles.title_zh: 磁化强度和材料参数的物理信息 X 射线断层扫描
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00528v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Three-dimensional spin textures are stabilized by microscopic interactions within their host materials. X-ray vector tomography can image these nanoscale structures, but weak magnetic contrast and a limited range of viewing angles often leave parts of the magnetization poorly determined. Here we show that a reconstruction constrained by the micromagnetic energy recovers the three-dimensional magnetization from such data and gains sensitivity to the underlying material interactions. Applied to the chiral magnet Co₈Zn₉Mn₃, the method resolves the three-dimensional helical texture even from a small fraction of the dual-axis projections typically required for a successful tomographic reconstruction, or from a single tilt axis alone. By testing which ratio of exchange to Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction in the reconstruction best reproduces the measured projections, we obtain a value for the sample that differs by about 10 % from the literature value derived from the helical winding period. Taken together, our findings suggest a way to reduce the time needed for vector tomography and to extend it to determining fundamental magnetic interactions in a material.
articles.abstract_zh: 三维自旋纹理通过其主体材料内的微观相互作用来稳定。 X 射线矢量断层扫描可以对这些纳米级结构进行成像，但弱磁对比度和有限的视角范围常常导致部分磁化强度难以确定。在这里，我们展示了受微磁能约束的重建从这些数据中恢复了三维磁化强度，并获得了对潜在材料相互作用的敏感性。应用于手性磁体 Co8Zn₉Mn₃，该方法甚至可以从成功断层扫描重建通常所需的双轴投影的一小部分或仅从单个倾斜轴解析三维螺旋纹理。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 三维自旋纹理通过其主体材料内的微观相互作用来稳定。 X 射线矢量断层扫描可以对这些纳米级结构进行成像，但弱磁对比度和有限的视角范围常常导致部分磁化强度难以确定。在这里，我们展示了受微磁能约束的重建从这些数据中恢复了三维磁化强度，并获得了对潜在材料相互作用的敏感性。应用于手性磁体 Co8Zn₉Mn₃，该方法甚至可以从成功断层扫描重建通常所需的双轴投影的一小部分或仅从单个倾斜轴解析三维螺旋纹理。通过测试重建中哪种交换与 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用的比率能够最好地再现测量的预测，我们获得了一个与螺旋缠绕周期得出的文献值相差约 10% 的样本值。总而言之，我们的研究结果提出了一种减少矢量断层扫描所需时间并将其扩展到确定材料中基本磁相互作用的方法。

articles.title: Machine Learning Aided Computational Discovery of Boride Substrates for Borophene Synthesis
articles.title_zh: 机器学习辅助计算发现用于硼烯合成的硼化物基质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00533v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Borophene, a monolayer of boron, is distinctive among two-dimensional materials owing to its unique properties, including polymorphism and potential applications in quantum technologies and energy conversion and storage. Nevertheless, its applications are hindered by the strong binding of borophene to metal substrates, which impedes the realization of freestanding borophene. Alternative substrates with tunable binding to borophene are therefore highly desirable. Since boride layers arise during borophene synthesis on metals, borides provide potential alternative substrates for borophene synthesis. In this work, we investigate the binding energies and interactions between borophene and 1356 boride surfaces for two borophene phases (v1/6 and v1/9), using density functional theory (DFT) calculations and machine learning (ML). Importantly, incorporating ML-predicted charge transfer as an input feature to a subsequent ML model enables physics-informed predictions of binding energies. Additional DFT calculations on four representative cases were performed to validate the ML predictions. SHAP analysis reveals that the majority of key descriptors are associated with delocalized electrons, highlighting the role of electronic properties in governing binding strength. Combined DFT and ML screening identifies 65 and 73 promising boride surfaces for the v1/6 and v1/9 phases, respectively. Al- and Ag-based borides, including AlB2 and AgB2, emerge as predominant candidates for both phases. The computationally predicted candidate substrates and the deduced design guidelines provide a charge-transfer-informed ML strategy for substrate selection and represent promising steps toward the experimental realization of freestanding borophene.
articles.abstract_zh: 硼烯是一种单层硼，由于其独特的性质（包括多态性以及在量子技术和能量转换和存储方面的潜在应用）而在二维材料中脱颖而出。然而，其应用受到硼烯与金属基底的强结合的阻碍，这阻碍了独立硼烯的实现。因此，非常需要与硼烯结合可调节的替代底物。由于在金属上合成硼烯期间会产生硼化物层，因此硼化物为硼烯合成提供了潜在的替代底物。在这项工作中，我们使用密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算和机器学习 (ML) 研究了两个硼烯相（v1/6 和 v1/9）的硼烯和 1356 硼化物表面之间的结合能和相互作用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 硼烯是一种单层硼，由于其独特的性质（包括多态性以及在量子技术和能量转换和存储方面的潜在应用）而在二维材料中脱颖而出。然而，其应用受到硼烯与金属基底的强结合的阻碍，这阻碍了独立硼烯的实现。因此，非常需要与硼烯结合可调节的替代底物。由于在金属上合成硼烯期间会产生硼化物层，因此硼化物为硼烯合成提供了潜在的替代底物。在这项工作中，我们使用密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算和机器学习 (ML) 研究了两个硼烯相（v1/6 和 v1/9）的硼烯和 1356 硼化物表面之间的结合能和相互作用。重要的是，将 ML 预测的电荷转移作为输入特征纳入后续 ML 模型中，可以实现结合能的物理信息预测。对四个代表性案例进行了额外的 DFT 计算，以验证 ML 预测。 SHAP 分析表明，大多数关键描述符与离域电子相关，突出了电子特性在控制结合强度中的作用。结合 DFT 和 ML 筛选，分别确定了 v1/6 和 v1/9 相的 65 个和 73 个有前景的硼化物表面。铝基和银基硼化物，包括 AlB2 和 AgB2，成为这两个相的主要候选材料。计算预测的候选底物和推导的设计指南为底物选择提供了一种基于电荷转移的机器学习策略，并代表了实验实现独立式硼烯的有希望的步骤。

articles.title: RIXS study of strain-tuned coupled valence and spin-state transition in epitaxial (Pr₀.₈₅Y₀.₁₅)₀.₇Ca₀.₃CoO₃ films
articles.title_zh: 外延 (Pr₀.₈₅Y₀.₁₅)₀.₇Ca₀.₃CoO₃ 薄膜中应变调谐耦合价态和自旋态转变的 RIXS 研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00540v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Strain-tuned (Pr₀.₈₅Y₀.₁₅)₀.₇Ca₀.₃CoO₃ thin films provide a model system for controlling coupled valence, spin-state, structural and metal-insulator transitions (VSSTs) in perovskite cobaltite materials. Here, we use Co L₂,₃ and Pr M₄,₅ X-ray Absorption Spectroscopy (XAS), along with Co L₃ edge Resonant Inelastic X-ray Scattering (RIXS), to probe the local electronic structure across the strain-controlled VSST in epitaxial (Pr,Y,Ca)CoO₃ thin films. In compressively strained films on YAlO₃ (YAO) substrates, cooling through the transition produces Pr⁴⁺-like spectral weight, suppresses Co⁴⁺-like character, and favors predominantly low-spin Co³⁺. The changes at the Pr and Co edges are quantitatively consistent with a reduction of approximately 0.15 holes per Co in the Co--O network. By contrast, tensile-strained thin films on La₀.₁₈Sr₀.₈₂Al₀.₅₉Ta₀.₄₁O₃ (LSAT) substrates have nearly temperature-independent spectra. Multiplet calculations reproduce the principal XAS lineshapes and local dd excitations at high energy loss. Additionally, low-energy RIXS intensity recovered above the transition is consistent with a combination of Co⁴⁺-like local excitations and a broader particle--hole continuum associated with the metallic phase. These results provide element-resolved evidence for charge compensation between the Pr and Co--O sublattices and support cooperative coupling among charge-transfer, spin-state, and lattice structure at the strain-controlled VSST.
articles.abstract_zh: 应变调谐 (Pr₀.₈₅Y₀.₁₅)₀.₇Ca₀.₃CoO₃ 薄膜提供了一个模型系统，用于控制钙钛矿钴矿材料中的耦合价、自旋态、结构和金属-绝缘体跃迁 (VSST)。在这里，我们使用 Co L2,₃ 和 Pr M4,5 X 射线吸收光谱 (XAS) 以及 Co L₃ 边缘共振非弹性 X 射线散射 (RIXS) 来探测外延 (Pr,Y,Ca)CoO₃ 薄膜中应变控制 VSST 上的局部电子结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 应变调谐 (Pr₀.₈₅Y₀.₁₅)₀.₇Ca₀.₃CoO₃ 薄膜提供了一个模型系统，用于控制钙钛矿钴矿材料中的耦合价、自旋态、结构和金属-绝缘体跃迁 (VSST)。在这里，我们使用 Co L2,₃ 和 Pr M4,5 X 射线吸收光谱 (XAS) 以及 Co L₃ 边缘共振非弹性 X 射线散射 (RIXS) 来探测外延 (Pr,Y,Ca)CoO₃ 薄膜中应变控制 VSST 上的局部电子结构。在 YAlO₃ (YAO) 基底上的压缩应变薄膜中，通过过渡冷却会产生类 Pr⁴⁺ 的光谱权重，抑制类 Co⁴⁺ 的特征，并有利于主要是低自旋的 Co3⁺。 Pr 和 Co 边缘的变化在数量上与 Co--O 网络中每个 Co 约 0.15 个孔的减少是一致的。相比之下，La0.18Sr0.82Al0.59Ta00.441O3 (LSAT) 基底上的拉伸应变薄膜具有几乎与温度无关的光谱。多重态计算再现了高能量损失时的主要 XAS 线形和局部 dd 激发。此外，在跃迁之上恢复的低能 RIXS 强度与类 Co⁴⁺ 局部激发和与金属相相关的更广泛的粒子-空穴连续体的组合一致。这些结果为 Pr 和 Co--O 亚晶格之间的电荷补偿提供了元素解析证据，并支持应变控制 VSST 中电荷转移、自旋态和晶格结构之间的协同耦合。

articles.title: Elucidating the topological nature of molecular beam epitaxy grown high Curie temperature (Mn1+ySb2-yTe4)x(Sb2-yMnyTe3)1-x using angle resolved photoelectron spectroscopy
articles.title_zh: 使用角分辨光电子能谱阐明高居里温度分子束外延生长 (Mn1+ySb2-yTe4)x(Sb2-yMnyTe3)1-x 的拓扑性质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00548v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) is used to elucidate the band structure of (Mn1+ySb2-yTe4)x(Sb2-yMnyTe3)1-x, a new magnetic quantum material grown using molecular beam epitaxy that has a Curie temperature (TC) above 100K, much higher than those reported for other materials of the MnxSb2-xTe4 class. Conflicting and sparse theory and experiments, as well as the complex disordered structure of the materials make it difficult to establish their topological nature. Here we explore this question by performing ARPES studies for two samples with x=0.65 and x=0.92, respectively. Images of the band structures of these two samples were acquired using photon energy dependent studies. The bulk and surface states of this complex material system, and the effects of composition on the band structure were investigated. Evidence of surface state features as well as bulk related ones were obtained, supporting their non-trivial nature. No signature of Fermi-arcs consistent with Weyl semimetals were seen. A shift in the Fermi level of the two samples due to different carrier densities allowed observation of the onset of a Dirac point in the surface states. Temperature dependent ARPES suggests possible band splitting as the materials undergo magnetic transitions, helping to understand the magnetic interactions. Our results point to their likely magnetic topological insulating nature.
articles.abstract_zh: 角分辨光电子能谱 (ARPES) 用于阐明 (Mn1+ySb2-yTe4)x(Sb2-yMnyTe3)1-x 的能带结构，这是一种使用分子束外延生长的新型磁性量子材料，其居里温度 (TC) 高于 100K，远高于报道的 MnxSb2-xTe4 类其他材料的居里温度 (TC)。理论和实验的相互冲突和稀疏，以及材料的复杂无序结构使得难以确定其拓扑性质。在这里，我们通过分别对 x=0.65 和 x=0.92 的两个样本进行 ARPES 研究来探讨这个问题。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 角分辨光电子能谱 (ARPES) 用于阐明 (Mn1+ySb2-yTe4)x(Sb2-yMnyTe3)1-x 的能带结构，这是一种使用分子束外延生长的新型磁性量子材料，其居里温度 (TC) 高于 100K，远高于报道的 MnxSb2-xTe4 类其他材料的居里温度 (TC)。理论和实验的相互冲突和稀疏，以及材料的复杂无序结构使得难以确定其拓扑性质。在这里，我们通过分别对 x=0.65 和 x=0.92 的两个样本进行 ARPES 研究来探讨这个问题。这两个样品的能带结构图像是通过光子能量依赖性研究获得的。研究了这种复杂材料系统的体态和表面态，以及成分对能带结构的影响。获得了表面态特征以及体积相关特征的证据，支持了它们的重要性质。没有看到与外尔半金属一致的费米弧特征。由于载流子密度不同而导致两个样品的费米能级发生变化，从而可以观察到表面态中狄拉克点的开始。温度相关的 ARPES 表明，当材料经历磁转变时，可能会出现能带分裂，这有助于理解磁相互作用。我们的结果表明它们可能具有磁拓扑绝缘性质。

articles.title: X-ray magnetic circular dichroism in altermagnets: insights from symmetry
articles.title_zh: 交流磁体中的 X 射线磁圆二色性：对称性的见解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00622v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets are a unique subset of antiferromagnets possessing ferromagnet-like responses that are odd in the Néel vector, making X-ray magnetic circular dichroism (XMCD) a natural probe of ground state altermagnetic order. Because the relativistic ingredient of XMCD at the L-edge is supplied predominantly by core-level spin--orbit coupling (SOC), the dichroic signal can reflect the non-relativistic order of the valence electrons. Here we develop a complete symmetry framework for XMCD in altermagnets (AMs) preserving the crystalline unit cell. We tabulate the symmetry-allowed optical Hall vector, anisotropic magnetic dipole (AMD), and underlying octupolar components for all magnetic point groups, thereby identifying the experimental geometries that maximize the XMCD signal. We show that only twelve magnetic point groups, none with a rotation axis of order three or higher, are compatible with both altermagnetism and finite XMCD. By extending the Landau theory of collinear AMs, we connect these relativistic constraints to the spin--orbit-free order. We show that the AMD is forced to vanish at zero valence SOC in conventional antiferromagnets, and that every AM sublattice structure allows the Hall vector and AMD at linear or cubic order in the Néel vector; whether the resulting XMCD is nonzero depends on the Néel vector orientation at finite SOC. The Landau theory thus fixes the Néel-vector dependence of the XMCD for all AM candidates, and separates d-wave AMs, whose signal is inherited from a non-relativistic AMD, from g- and i-wave AMs, whose signal requires valence SOC or core--valence multiplet effects. We illustrate these predictions with first-principles Bethe--Salpeter calculations of L-edge XMCD for five representative altermagnetic materials and one conventional antiferromagnet.
articles.abstract_zh: 交变磁体是反铁磁体的一个独特子集，具有类似铁磁体的响应，这些响应在尼尔矢量中是奇数，使得 X 射线磁圆二色性 (XMCD) 成为基态交变磁序的天然探针。由于XMCD在L边缘的相对论成分主要由核心级自旋轨道耦合（SOC）提供，因此二向色信号可以反映价电子的非相对论顺序。在这里，我们为交流磁体 (AM) 中的 XMCD 开发了一个完整的对称框架，以保留晶体晶胞。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 交变磁体是反铁磁体的一个独特子集，具有类似铁磁体的响应，这些响应在尼尔矢量中是奇数，使得 X 射线磁圆二色性 (XMCD) 成为基态交变磁序的天然探针。由于XMCD在L边缘的相对论成分主要由核心级自旋轨道耦合（SOC）提供，因此二向色信号可以反映价电子的非相对论顺序。在这里，我们为交流磁体 (AM) 中的 XMCD 开发了一个完整的对称框架，以保留晶体晶胞。我们将所有磁点组的允许对称性的光学霍尔矢量、各向异性磁偶极子 (AMD) 和基础八极分量制成表格，从而确定最大化 XMCD 信号的实验几何形状。我们表明，只有 12 个磁点组（没有一个具有三阶或更高阶的旋转轴）与交变磁学和有限 XMCD 兼容。通过扩展共线 AM 的朗道理论，我们将这些相对论约束与自旋轨道自由序联系起来。我们证明，在传统反铁磁体中，AMD 被迫在零价 SOC 处消失，并且每个 AM 子晶格结构都允许霍尔矢量和 AMD 在尼尔矢量中处于线性或立方阶；生成的 XMCD 是否非零取决于有限 SOC 处的 Néel 向量方向。因此，Landau 理论修复了所有候选 AM 的 XMCD 的尼尔矢量依赖性，并将 d 波 AM（其信号继承自非相对论性 AMD）与 g 波 AM 和 i 波 AM（其信号需要价态 SOC 或核心价多重态效应）分开。我们用五种代表性交变磁材料和一种传统反铁磁体的 L 边缘 XMCD 的第一原理 Bethe-Salpeter 计算来说明这些预测。

articles.title: Zeeman Spin Photocurrents without Spin Textures
articles.title_zh: 没有旋转纹理的塞曼旋转光电流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00655v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Inversion symmetry forbids bulk second-order spin photocurrents driven solely by electric-dipole coupling. We show that interference between the electric-dipole and spin Zeeman couplings of light enables Zeeman spin-shift and spin-injection currents in centrosymmetric magnets. Our microscopic theory and systematic symmetry analysis establish the allowed responses and polarization selection rules for both spin-degenerate and spin-split antiferromagnets, with and without spin--orbit coupling (SOC). In collinear magnets without SOC, spin injection vanishes, whereas a pure spin-shift current survives independently of the carrier scattering time. This response arises from transverse electronic spin coherences generated by the optical magnetic field, while the ordered moments remain collinear and fixed. Model analyses validate the mechanism, and first-principles calculations for MnF₂ predict experimentally accessible spin photocurrents. These findings establish a general framework for optical spin-current generation in centrosymmetric magnets, including a SOC-free pure-spin mechanism particularly relevant to altermagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 反演对称性禁止仅由电偶极子耦合驱动的体二阶自旋光电流。我们表明，光的电偶极子和自旋塞曼耦合之间的干扰使得中心对称磁体中能够产生塞曼自旋移位和自旋注入电流。我们的微观理论和系统对称性分析为自旋简并和自旋分裂反铁磁体（无论有无自旋轨道耦合（SOC））建立了允许的响应和极化选择规则。在没有 SOC 的共线磁体中，自旋注入消失，而纯自旋位移电流独立于载流子散射时间而存在。这种响应源自光磁场产生的横向电子自旋相干性，而有序矩保持共线且固定。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 反演对称性禁止仅由电偶极子耦合驱动的体二阶自旋光电流。我们表明，光的电偶极子和自旋塞曼耦合之间的干扰使得中心对称磁体中能够产生塞曼自旋移位和自旋注入电流。我们的微观理论和系统对称性分析为自旋简并和自旋分裂反铁磁体（无论有无自旋轨道耦合（SOC））建立了允许的响应和极化选择规则。在没有 SOC 的共线磁体中，自旋注入消失，而纯自旋位移电流独立于载流子散射时间而存在。这种响应源自光磁场产生的横向电子自旋相干性，而有序矩保持共线且固定。模型分析验证了该机制，MnF2 的第一性原理计算预测了实验上可实现的自旋光电流。这些发现为中心对称磁体中光学自旋电流的产生建立了一个通用框架，包括与交流磁体特别相关的无 SOC 纯自旋机制。

articles.title: Beyond Synthesis Conditions: Linking In-situ Growth Dynamics to Carbon Nanotube Forest Properties through Multimodal Machine Learning
articles.title_zh: 超越合成条件：通过多模态机器学习将原位生长动态与碳纳米管森林特性联系起来
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00739v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning for chemical vapor deposition (CVD) of carbon nanotubes (CNTs) has largely mapped static synthesis conditions to final properties, implicitly treating these conditions as a complete description of growth. Here, we test this assumption by integrating gas-flow conditions with in-situ time-resolve growth profiles (growth curves) of vertically aligned CNT forests. We introduce an observation-window analysis, in which prediction is evaluated as a function of observation time by providing models with the growth curve only up to progressively later times, to determine not only whether a property can be predicted, but when the necessary information becomes available during synthesis. Clustering of normalized growth curves revealed distinct growth patterns independent of final forest height. The gas conditions alone could predict the initial growth rate but not the growth lifetime and failed to capture the variation in yield (R²<0). Adding the growth curve improved yield prediction (R²~0.4-0.5), with the relevant information emerging during the intermediate and later stages of growth rather than at its onset. In contrast, density and G/D ratio, which forest height does not record, showed no consistent improvement. The maximum height and lifetime could be estimated with moderate accuracy midway through the 10-min growth. Permutation feature importance identified water vapor and H₂, both linked to catalyst activity, as the most informative gas variables. These results indicate that variation unexplained by synthesis conditions is not merely noise but reflects an evolving catalyst state, and they establish mid-growth decision points for autonomous synthesis, enabling early termination of unpromising batches and, ultimately, in-batch adjustment of growth conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 碳纳米管 (CNT) 化学气相沉积 (CVD) 的机器学习在很大程度上将静态合成条件映射到最终特性，隐含地将这些条件视为生长的完整描述。在这里，我们通过将气流条件与垂直排列的碳纳米管森林的原位时间分辨生长曲线（生长曲线）相结合来测试这一假设。我们引入了观察窗口分析，其中通过提供仅逐渐晚于时间的增长曲线的模型来评估预测作为观察时间的函数，不仅确定是否可以预测属性，还确定在合成过程中何时可以获得必要的信息。标准化生长曲线的聚类揭示了独立于最终森林高度的不同生长模式。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 碳纳米管 (CNT) 化学气相沉积 (CVD) 的机器学习在很大程度上将静态合成条件映射到最终特性，隐含地将这些条件视为生长的完整描述。在这里，我们通过将气流条件与垂直排列的碳纳米管森林的原位时间分辨生长曲线（生长曲线）相结合来测试这一假设。我们引入了观察窗口分析，其中通过提供仅逐渐晚于时间的增长曲线的模型来评估预测作为观察时间的函数，不仅确定是否可以预测属性，还确定在合成过程中何时可以获得必要的信息。标准化生长曲线的聚类揭示了独立于最终森林高度的不同生长模式。仅气体条件可以预测初始生长速率，但不能预测生长寿命，并且无法捕获产量的变化（R²<0）。添加生长曲线改善了产量预测（R²~0.4-0.5），相关信息在生长的中期和后期而不是开始时出现。相比之下，没有记录森林高度的密度和G/D比没有显示出一致的改善。在 10 分钟的生长过程中，可以以中等精度估计最大高度和寿命。排列特征重要性将水蒸气和 H2 确定为信息最丰富的气体变量，两者都与催化剂活性相关。这些结果表明，合成条件无法解释的变化不仅仅是噪音，而且反映了不断变化的催化剂状态，并且它们为自主合成建立了生长中期决策点，从而能够提前终止没有希望的批次，并最终对生长条件进行批量调整。

articles.title: IRIS: an agentic eye on symmetry-derived paths and energy landscapes of structural phase transitions
articles.title_zh: IRIS：对结构相变的对称衍生路径和能量景观的代理眼
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00761v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Structural phase transitions underpin ferroelectric and multiferroic functionality, but constructing interpretable energy landscapes remains dependent on specialist expertise. Predicting this behaviour rests on Landau free energies expanded in symmetry-adapted order parameters: their coefficients classify a transition, expose the couplings between distortions, set switching paths and barriers, and parametrize phase-field and effective-Hamiltonian models at larger scales. Obtaining these coefficients from first principles means sampling the Born--Oppenheimer energy surface along symmetry-derived structural paths, which requires crystallographic analysis, reliable structure generation and extensive computation, especially for coupled multidimensional order parameters. Here we introduce IRIS, an agentic workflow that converts plain-language requests and crystal structures into symmetry-adapted energy landscapes and fitted Landau energy models. Deterministic gates govern acceptance of structures, calculations and fits, while language models interpret requests and select constrained recovery actions. Applications across six compounds include a six-dimensional BiFeO₃ landscape that separates competition between polar and tilt amplitudes from directional locking and ranks homogeneous switching pathways. Controlled replays detected all 53 injected faults; disabling gates allowed 14 silent errors. Four prospective BaTiO₃ runs produced fitted landscapes from 96 density-functional calculations in 34 minutes total without intervening human decisions. IRIS makes physical model construction a reusable computational capability and provides a framework for scientific automation grounded in explicit verification.
articles.abstract_zh: 结构相变支撑着铁电和多铁功能，但构建可解释的能源景观仍然依赖于专业知识。预测这种行为取决于以对称适应序参数扩展的朗道自由能：它们的系数对转变进行分类，揭示畸变之间的耦合，设置切换路径和障碍，并在更大尺度上参数化相场和有效哈密尔顿模型。从第一原理获得这些系数意味着沿着对称导出的结构路径对玻恩-奥本海默能量表面进行采样，这需要晶体学分析、可靠的结构生成和广泛的计算，特别是对于耦合的多维有序参数。
