articles.abstract_zh_full: 结构相变支撑着铁电和多铁功能，但构建可解释的能源景观仍然依赖于专业知识。预测这种行为取决于以对称适应序参数扩展的朗道自由能：它们的系数对转变进行分类，揭示畸变之间的耦合，设置切换路径和障碍，并在更大尺度上参数化相场和有效哈密尔顿模型。从第一原理获得这些系数意味着沿着对称导出的结构路径对玻恩-奥本海默能量表面进行采样，这需要晶体学分析、可靠的结构生成和广泛的计算，特别是对于耦合的多维有序参数。在这里，我们介绍 IRIS，这是一种代理工作流程，可将简单语言请求和晶体结构转换为对称适应的能量景观和拟合的朗道能量模型。确定性门控制结构、计算和拟合的接受，而语言模型解释请求并选择受约束的恢复操作。六种化合物的应用包括六维 BiFeO₃ 景观，它将极性和倾斜振幅之间的竞争与方向锁定分开，并对同质开关路径进行排序。受控重放检测到所有 53 个注入故障；禁用门会导致 14 个无提示错误。四次预期的 BaTiO₃ 运行总共在 34 分钟内通过 96 次密度泛函计算生成了合适的景观，而无需干预人类决策。 IRIS 使物理模型构建成为一种可重用的计算能力，并提供了一个基于显式验证的科学自动化框架。

articles.title: Charge-Order pattern in κ-BEDT-TTF salts: A model independent, selection rule approach
articles.title_zh: κ-BEDT-TTF 盐中的电荷顺序模式：独立于模型的选择规则方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00798v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A well known vibrational selection rule is invoked to determine the charge order (CO) pattern displayed by the most interesting members of the widely studied class of κ-BEDT-TTF salts and their molecular analogues. The selection rule indicates that an easily identifiable Raman band should be present if intra-dimer charge disproportionation occurs, constituting a sort of model independent ``litmus test''. The absence of such a band in the available Raman spectra of κ-BEDT-TTF salts exhibiting static of fluctuating CO, strongly suggests that the CO pattern involves inter-dimer CO, in contrast with the universally accepted intra-dimer disprortionation. This paper therefore poses a challenge for the theoretical modeling of the concerned salts: either the lack of the Raman band sensitive to intra-dimer CO pattern is explained, or the modeling of the multivariate, unique physical properties of these κ-phase salts (spin frustration, electronic ferroelectricity etc.) has to start from the perspective of a different ground state.
articles.abstract_zh: 调用众所周知的振动选择规则来确定广泛研究的 κ-BEDT-TTF 盐类及其分子类似物中最有趣的成员所显示的电荷顺序 (CO) 模式。选择规则表明，如果发生二聚体内电荷歧化，则应出现易于识别的拉曼带，构成一种独立于模型的“石蕊测试”。 κ-BEDT-TTF 盐的可用拉曼光谱中不存在这样一条带，显示出波动 CO 的静态，强烈表明 CO 模式涉及二聚体间 CO，与普遍接受的二聚体内歧化相反。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 调用众所周知的振动选择规则来确定广泛研究的 κ-BEDT-TTF 盐类及其分子类似物中最有趣的成员所显示的电荷顺序 (CO) 模式。选择规则表明，如果发生二聚体内电荷歧化，则应出现易于识别的拉曼带，构成一种独立于模型的“石蕊测试”。 κ-BEDT-TTF 盐的可用拉曼光谱中不存在这样一条带，显示出波动 CO 的静态，强烈表明 CO 模式涉及二聚体间 CO，与普遍接受的二聚体内歧化相反。因此，本文对相关盐的理论建模提出了挑战：要么解释缺乏对二聚体内CO模式敏感的拉曼带，要么对这些κ相盐的多元、独特的物理性质（自旋挫败、电子铁电性等）进行建模必须从不同基态的角度开始。

articles.title: Three-Dimensional FDTD Simulation of Superconducting Terahertz Emitters Using an Effective Medium Approximation
articles.title_zh: 使用有效介质近似对超导太赫兹发射器进行三维 FDTD 仿真
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00840v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Compact and tunable terahertz (THz) sources with controllable polarization are sought for high-speed links, spectroscopy, and imaging. In superconducting THz emitters based on a cuprate Bi₂Sr₂CaCu₂O₈₊δ, which have the potential to satisfy such properties, modeling often relies on heavy nonlinear solvers or empirical isotropic dielectrics, obscuring anisotropy, plasma response, and bias dependence. We derive an anisotropic, dispersive effective permittivity from the Lawrence-Doniach model for a layered superconductor and implement it as a user-defined material in a commercial Finite-difference Time-domain (FDTD) solver. Simulations of two device geometries reproduce linearly polarized emission from a rectangular mesa and low-axial-ratio (near-circular) emission from a truncated square mesa. This CAD-ready workflow links superconducting theory to device design, enabling rapid searches and parameter optimization for next-generation THz sources.
articles.abstract_zh: 高速链路、光谱学和成像需要具有可控偏振的紧凑、可调谐太赫兹 (THz) 源。在基于铜酸盐 Bi2Sr2CaCu2O₈₊δ 的超导太赫兹发射器中，有可能满足这些特性，建模通常依赖于重型非线性求解器或经验各向同性电介质，从而模糊了各向异性、等离子体响应和偏置依赖性。我们从层状超导体的 Lawrence-Doniach 模型中推导出各向异性、色散的有效介电常数，并将其作为用户定义的材料在商业时域有限差分 (FDTD) 求解器中实现。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 高速链路、光谱学和成像需要具有可控偏振的紧凑、可调谐太赫兹 (THz) 源。在基于铜酸盐 Bi2Sr2CaCu2O₈₊δ 的超导太赫兹发射器中，有可能满足这些特性，建模通常依赖于重型非线性求解器或经验各向同性电介质，从而模糊了各向异性、等离子体响应和偏置依赖性。我们从层状超导体的 Lawrence-Doniach 模型中推导出各向异性、色散的有效介电常数，并将其作为用户定义的材料在商业时域有限差分 (FDTD) 求解器中实现。对两种器件几何形状的模拟再现了来自矩形台面的线偏振发射和来自截断方形台面的低轴比（近圆形）发射。这种支持 CAD 的工作流程将超导理论与设备设计联系起来，从而实现下一代太赫兹源的快速搜索和参数优化。

articles.title: High-order concentric hopfions in a helimagnet
articles.title_zh: 螺旋磁体中的高阶同心跳跃
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00858v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetic hopfions are three-dimensional topological solitons: ``knots'' in the vector field of magnetization of magnetically ordered materials, which are a key element of the three-dimensional spintronics emerging today. In this work, a simple analytical model for a new type of magnetic hopfions --- ``concentric'' ones --- is constructed and solved. Their size and equilibrium energy are estimated, their stability region on the magnetic phase diagram of a helimagnet is mapped out, and the requirements for materials admitting equilibrium concentric hopfions with high Hopf index on a uniformly magnetized background are determined.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁跳跃子是三维拓扑孤子：磁有序材料磁化矢量场中的“结”，是当今新兴的三维自旋电子学的关键元素。在这项工作中，构建并解决了一种新型磁跳子（“同心”跳子）的简单分析模型。估计了它们的尺寸和平衡能量，绘制了它们在螺旋磁体磁相图上的稳定区域，并确定了在均匀磁化背景下允许具有高Hopf指数的平衡同心hopfion的材料的要求。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁跳跃子是三维拓扑孤子：磁有序材料磁化矢量场中的“结”，是当今新兴的三维自旋电子学的关键元素。在这项工作中，构建并解决了一种新型磁跳子（“同心”跳子）的简单分析模型。估计了它们的尺寸和平衡能量，绘制了它们在螺旋磁体磁相图上的稳定区域，并确定了在均匀磁化背景下允许具有高Hopf指数的平衡同心hopfion的材料的要求。

articles.title: Efficient Interpolation of the Bethe-Salpeter Hamiltonian at Arbitrary Momenta
articles.title_zh: 任意动量下 Bethe-Salpeter 哈密顿量的高效插值
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00928v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop an efficient reciprocal-space method to reconstruct the static Bethe-Salpeter (BSE) Hamiltonian at arbitrary crystal momenta from coarse first-principles grids. Bloch states are interpolated within an optimally smooth Wannier subspace, while the screened Coulomb interaction is reconstructed from the dielectric response. This decouples the electron-hole transition momenta and transferred momentum from the underlying ab initio sampling. We benchmark the method on monolayer hBN, monolayer MoS₂, and bulk GaAs against explicit ab initio calculations, finding excellent agreement for dense-grid Bloch states, dielectric screening, and BSE optical spectra. Furthermore, our cost analysis estimates speedups of up to 22× on the grids considered here. Arbitrary transferred-momentum sampling gives direct access to the long-wavelength exciton dispersion: in hBN and MoS₂, we resolve the nonanalytic behaviour induced by long-range electron-hole exchange at momenta well below the spacing of practical uniform grids. For bulk GaAs, locally refined transition-momentum sampling yields a converged binding energy for the threefold-degenerate lowest exciton, in close agreement with experiment and reference calculations, using far fewer BSE points than conventional uniform meshes. As the present framework provides exciton energies and amplitudes at arbitrary crystal momenta, it opens the way to incorporating ab initio excitonic effects into nonlocal electron-phonon vertices and to extensions towards exciton-phonon interactions and nonequilibrium exciton dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们开发了一种有效的倒易空间方法，可以从粗糙的第一性原理网格中重建任意晶体动量下的静态 Bethe-Salpeter (BSE) 哈密顿量。布洛赫态在最佳平滑的万尼尔子空间内插值，而屏蔽库仑相互作用则根据介电响应重建。这将电子-空穴跃迁动量解耦，并从底层从头开始采样转移动量。我们针对单层 hBN、单层 MoS2 和块状 GaAs 与显式从头计算进行了基准测试，发现密集网格布洛赫态、介电屏蔽和 BSE 光谱具有极好的一致性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们开发了一种有效的倒易空间方法，可以从粗糙的第一性原理网格中重建任意晶体动量下的静态 Bethe-Salpeter (BSE) 哈密顿量。布洛赫态在最佳平滑的万尼尔子空间内插值，而屏蔽库仑相互作用则根据介电响应重建。这将电子-空穴跃迁动量解耦，并从底层从头开始采样转移动量。我们针对单层 hBN、单层 MoS2 和块状 GaAs 与显式从头计算进行了基准测试，发现密集网格布洛赫态、介电屏蔽和 BSE 光谱具有极好的一致性。此外，我们的成本分析估计此处考虑的网格的加速速度高达 22 倍。任意转移动量采样可以直接获取长波长激子色散：在六方氮化硼和二硫化钼中，我们解决了远低于实际均匀网格间距的动量下长程电子空穴交换引起的非解析行为。对于块状砷化镓，局部精化跃迁动量采样产生了三重简并最低激子的收敛结合能，与实验和参考计算非常一致，使用的 BSE 点比传统均匀网格少得多。由于本框架提供了任意晶体动量的激子能量和振幅，因此它开辟了将从头开始激子效应纳入非局域电子声子顶点以及扩展到激子-声子相互作用和非平衡激子动力学的方法。

articles.title: Melting noncoplanar order on the square-kagome lattice: Chiral, flat-band, and staggered spin liquids from projective symmetry
articles.title_zh: 方形戈薇晶格上的熔融非共面有序：来自射影对称的手性、平带和交错自旋液体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00987v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Noncoplanar magnetic orders carry a scalar spin chirality, and their melting by quantum fluctuations has been proposed as a route to chiral spin liquids. We ask what this route can produce on the square-kagome lattice, where couplings across the octagons stabilize noncoplanar cuboc and conical orders. We classify the fermionic spin liquids of this lattice by their projective symmetry groups, identify the symmetry class into which each noncoplanar order would melt, and compare candidate states with Gutzwiller-projected wave functions. A magnetic selection rule constrains the route: the chirality of every cuboc and conical order alternates in space, so a liquid that keeps the symmetry of its parent order has zero Chern number and no spontaneous thermal Hall response. A Chern state can descend only from uniformly chiral orders, and the regular ones we find need ferromagnetic bow-tie couplings. The energetics do not favor a chiral liquid either: among the projected wave functions we compare, a cuboc1-ordered state is lowest for strong cross-octagon couplings, and nonchiral states, a valence-bond crystal or a time-reversal-symmetric liquid, for weaker ones. The two inequivalent site orbits shape the spinons: a relative time-reversal sign between them pins flat bands to the Fermi level, and because the translations of p4mm are not commutators, staggered chiral liquids exist, which are absent on sixfold-symmetric lattices.
articles.abstract_zh: 非共面磁序具有标量自旋手性，并且它们通过量子涨落的熔化已被提议作为获得手性自旋液体的途径。我们询问这条路线可以在方形戈薇晶格上产生什么，其中八边形上的耦合稳定了非共面的立方体和圆锥体顺序。我们根据射影对称群对该晶格的费米子自旋液体进行分类，识别每个非共面级将熔化的对称类别，并将候选状态与古茨威勒投影波函数进行比较。磁选择规则限制了路线：每个立方和圆锥有序的手性在空间中交替，因此保持其母有序对称性的液体具有零陈数并且没有自发的热霍尔响应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非共面磁序具有标量自旋手性，并且它们通过量子涨落的熔化已被提议作为获得手性自旋液体的途径。我们询问这条路线可以在方形戈薇晶格上产生什么，其中八边形上的耦合稳定了非共面的立方体和圆锥体顺序。我们根据射影对称群对该晶格的费米子自旋液体进行分类，识别每个非共面级将熔化的对称类别，并将候选状态与古茨威勒投影波函数进行比较。磁选择规则限制了路线：每个立方和圆锥有序的手性在空间中交替，因此保持其母有序对称性的液体具有零陈数并且没有自发的热霍尔响应。陈省只能从一致的手性级下降，而我们发现的常规状态需要铁磁领结耦合。能量学也不支持手性液体：在我们比较的投影波函数中，对于强的交叉八边形耦合，立方有序态最低，而对于较弱的非手性态、价键晶体或时间反转对称液体，则最低。两个不等价位点轨道形成了自旋子：它们之间的相对时间反转符号将平带固定在费米能级上，并且由于 p4mm 的平移不是交换子，因此存在交错的手性液体，而这在六重对称晶格中是不存在的。

articles.title: Excited-state-induced nonlinearity and polarity reversals in the thermocurrent through a quantum dot
articles.title_zh: 通过量子点的热电流中激发态引起的非线性和极性反转
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.01006v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum dots are electrically tuneable thermal machines capable of both energy harvesting and cooling at the nanoscale in the cryogenic regime. At large thermal biases, their thermoelectric transport shows a complex behaviour, including additional extrema and polarity reversals in the thermocurrent. Though these asymmetries and nonlinearities directly affect rectification and power conversion, their origin has not been studied systematically. We address this through measurements and modelling of a single GaAs/AlGaAs quantum dot whose source is heated by white-noise excitation. Using Pauli master equation for sequential tunnelling through a two-level dot, retaining the full Fermi distributions of both leads, distinct tunnel rates for the two levels, and relaxation between them, we show that the excited state acts as a second transport channel which competes with the ground-state contribution. Strong excited-state coupling combined with slow relaxation produces polarity reversals in the thermocurrent; without both, the excited state yields only additional extrema and an amplitude asymmetry across the charge degeneracy point. Experimentally, as the source temperature increases, an additional extremum emerges in the thermocurrent which develops into a polarity reversal. Using the excited-state level spacing and ground-state tunnel rate obtained independently from pulsed-gate and bias spectroscopies, the model reproduces the positions of the observed extrema and their amplitudes to within a factor of about three, placing the device in the regime of slow relaxation and strong excited-state coupling. Our results establish thermocurrent line-shape as a probe of excited-state tunnelling and relaxation in quantum dots. Excited states, often treated as a minor correction, can dominate quantum-dot thermoelectric transport far from equilibrium.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子点是电可调热机器，能够在低温状态下进行纳米级能量收集和冷却。在大的热偏差下，它们的热电传输表现出复杂的行为，包括热电流中的额外极值和极性反转。尽管这些不对称性和非线性直接影响整流和功率转换，但其根源尚未得到系统研究。我们通过对单个 GaAs/AlGaAs 量子点进行测量和建模来解决这个问题，该量子点的源由白噪声激发加热。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子点是电可调热机器，能够在低温状态下进行纳米级能量收集和冷却。在大的热偏差下，它们的热电传输表现出复杂的行为，包括热电流中的额外极值和极性反转。尽管这些不对称性和非线性直接影响整流和功率转换，但其根源尚未得到系统研究。我们通过对单个 GaAs/AlGaAs 量子点进行测量和建模来解决这个问题，该量子点的源由白噪声激发加热。使用泡利主方程通过双能级点进行顺序隧道效应，保留两个引线的完整费米分布、两个能级的不同隧道速率以及它们之间的弛豫，我们表明激发态充当与基态贡献竞争的第二传输通道。强激发态耦合与缓慢弛豫相结合，会在热电流中产生极性反转；如果没有两者，激发态只会产生额外的极值和电荷简并点上的振幅不对称。实验上，随着源温度升高，热电流中会出现额外的极值，并发展成极性反转。利用独立于脉冲门和偏置光谱获得的激发态能级间距和基态隧道速率，该模型将观察到的极值位置及其振幅再现到大约三倍之内，使器件处于缓慢弛豫和强激发态耦合的状态。我们的结果将热电流线形确立为量子点中激发态隧道效应和弛豫的探针。激发态通常被视为微小的修正，它可以主导远离平衡的量子点热电传输。

articles.title: Phase-Tunable Liouvillian Topology: Dual Winding Structures and Skin Effects
articles.title_zh: 相位可调刘维尔拓扑：双绕组结构和集肤效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.01110v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Liouvillian skin effects are usually associated with dissipation whose rates favor unidirectional flow. In this work, we show that directional edge localization can emerge even when population exchange between sites is exactly balanced, with a single tunable phase parameter α deciding their direction and a dual winding structure deciding their nature. Although this number-conserving bath is known for eigenstate selection, we demonstrate here that its phase controls a steady current, which Hamiltonian hopping converts to directional edge localization. Further, we study the spectral winding structure by independently twisting the left (ket) and right (bra) vector indices of the density matrix, revealing two distinct windings whose relationship is dictated by an antiunitary mirror symmetry. Nearest-neighbor jump operators break this symmetry: both windings coincide, giving rise to a common spectral winding W₀(α)=±1, producing a unipolar skin effect in which the density accumulates at a specific edge. However, next nearest neighbor jump preserve it. The two windings are forced to be opposite, and the ket and bra are pushed to opposite edges, giving a bipolar skin effect of coherences present in eigenmodes, without edge localization of the density in the steady state. Remarkably, in a dimerized chain the phase-controlled density skin effect gives the steady-state zero modes a size-independent weight at the skin edge, accompanied by a kink at the topological transition. In addition, the relaxation time grows linearly with the system size, however at specific phases α where the jump operators are rendered Hermitian, edge-localized eigenmodes with skin character coexist with diffusive relaxation.
articles.abstract_zh: 刘维尔集肤效应通常与耗散相关，其速率有利于单向流动。在这项工作中，我们表明，即使站点之间的种群交换完全平衡，也可以出现定向边缘定位，其中单个可调相位参数 α 决定它们的方向，双缠绕结构决定它们的性质。尽管这种数守恒浴因本征态选择而闻名，但我们在此证明其相位控制稳定电流，哈密顿跳跃将其转换为定向边缘定位。此外，我们通过独立扭转密度矩阵的左（ket）和右（bra）矢量索引来研究谱绕组结构，揭示了两个不同的绕组，其关系由反酉镜像对称性决定。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 刘维尔集肤效应通常与耗散相关，其速率有利于单向流动。在这项工作中，我们表明，即使站点之间的种群交换完全平衡，也可以出现定向边缘定位，其中单个可调相位参数 α 决定它们的方向，双缠绕结构决定它们的性质。尽管这种数守恒浴因本征态选择而闻名，但我们在此证明其相位控制稳定电流，哈密顿跳跃将其转换为定向边缘定位。此外，我们通过独立扭转密度矩阵的左（ket）和右（bra）矢量索引来研究谱绕组结构，揭示了两个不同的绕组，其关系由反酉镜像对称性决定。最近邻跳跃算子打破了这种对称性：两个绕组重合，产生共同的谱绕组 W₀(α)=±1，产生单极集肤效应，其中密度在特定边缘处累积。然而，下一个最近邻跳跃会保留它。两个绕组被迫相反，并且 ket 和 bra 被推向相对的边缘，从而产生本征模中存在的相干性双极集肤效应，而在稳定状态下没有密度的边缘定位。值得注意的是，在二聚链中，相控密度趋肤效应使稳态零模式在趋肤边缘处具有与尺寸无关的权重，并伴随着拓扑转变处的扭结。此外，弛豫时间随系统尺寸线性增长，但在特定阶段 α 处，跳跃算子被渲染为埃尔米特式，具有趋肤特性的边缘局部本征模与扩散弛豫共存。

articles.title: Ab Initio strain-dependent vibrational analysis of different silicene structures for 2D devices
articles.title_zh: 二维器件不同硅烯结构的 Ab Initio 应变相关振动分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.01166v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report first-principles phonon dynamics studies in isotropically strained mono-layer silicene films of various topologies by density functional theory and density functional perturbation theory methods. The strain introduced in the sheets are of both tensile and compressive nature and its effect on the thermal transport properties are analysed using the Boltzmann Transport Equation (BTE) reported. We performed electronic and vibrational analysis of each silicene topology and concluded that hhk-silicene is a potential candidate for next generation electro-thermal devices due its molecular stability, bulk-Si like bandgap and tolerable thermal performance that can be engineered by strain. The novel hhk-silicene topology offers excellent thermal and electronic capabilities that are sensitive to strain along with the band gap following a near-linear monotonically decreasing trend making it suitable for strain-tronics applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们报告了通过密度泛函理论和密度泛函微扰理论方法对各种拓扑的各向同性应变单层硅烯薄膜进行的第一性原理声子动力学研究。片材中引入的应变具有拉伸和压缩性质，并且使用报告的玻尔兹曼传输方程（BTE）分析其对热传输特性的影响。我们对每种硅烯拓扑结构进行了电子和振动分析，并得出结论，hhk-硅烯由于其分子稳定性、类块硅带隙和可通过应变设计的可容忍热性能，是下一代电热器件的潜在候选者。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了通过密度泛函理论和密度泛函微扰理论方法对各种拓扑的各向同性应变单层硅烯薄膜进行的第一性原理声子动力学研究。片材中引入的应变具有拉伸和压缩性质，并且使用报告的玻尔兹曼传输方程（BTE）分析其对热传输特性的影响。我们对每种硅烯拓扑结构进行了电子和振动分析，并得出结论，hhk-硅烯由于其分子稳定性、类块硅带隙和可通过应变设计的可容忍热性能，是下一代电热器件的潜在候选者。新颖的 hhk-硅烯拓扑提供了出色的热和电子性能，对应变敏感，并且带隙遵循近线性单调递减趋势，使其适合应变电子学应用。

articles.title: Visualizing Anisotropic Charge Transport in CrSBr using Bias-Dependent Kelvin Probe Force Microscopy
articles.title_zh: 使用偏压相关的开尔文探针力显微镜可视化 CrSBr 中的各向异性电荷传输
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.01217v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Anisotropic semiconductors offer unique opportunities for next-generation electronics due to their direction-dependent transport. However, conventional electrical measurements provide only spatially averaged characteristics. Here, we employ bias-dependent Kelvin probe force microscopy (KPFM) to directly visualize the response of CrSBr under different electrical bias configurations. Spatially resolved KPFM maps reveal highly distinct, crystallographic-direction-dependent potential profiles. To elucidate this behavior, we employ anisotropic transport simulations that capture the charge transport and electric-field distributions in CrSBr. The close agreement between experiment and simulation provides a unified picture of anisotropic charge transport and bias-induced potential redistribution. Our experiments further reveal a boundary-associated redistribution of the transport field when bias is applied along the a-axis, suggesting a possible role of crystal boundaries in charge transport along the low-conductivity direction. This work establishes bias-dependent KPFM as a powerful platform for uncovering localized transport phenomena in low-symmetry quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 各向异性半导体由于其方向依赖的传输为下一代电子产品提供了独特的机会。然而，传统的电气测量仅提供空间平均特性。在这里，我们采用偏压相关的开尔文探针力显微镜 (KPFM) 来直接可视化 CrSBr 在不同电偏压配置下的响应。空间解析的 KPFM 图揭示了高度独特的、依赖于晶体方向的电势分布。为了阐明这种行为，我们采用各向异性传输模拟来捕获 CrSBr 中的电荷传输和电场分布。实验和模拟之间的密切一致性提供了各向异性电荷传输和偏置引起的电势重新分布的统一图像。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 各向异性半导体由于其方向依赖的传输为下一代电子产品提供了独特的机会。然而，传统的电气测量仅提供空间平均特性。在这里，我们采用偏压相关的开尔文探针力显微镜 (KPFM) 来直接可视化 CrSBr 在不同电偏压配置下的响应。空间解析的 KPFM 图揭示了高度独特的、依赖于晶体方向的电势分布。为了阐明这种行为，我们采用各向异性传输模拟来捕获 CrSBr 中的电荷传输和电场分布。实验和模拟之间的密切一致性提供了各向异性电荷传输和偏置引起的电势重新分布的统一图像。我们的实验进一步揭示了当沿 a 轴施加偏压时，传输场的边界相关重新分布，表明晶体边界在沿低电导率方向的电荷传输中可能发挥作用。这项工作将偏倚相关的 KPFM 建立为一个强大的平台，用于揭示低对称性量子材料中的局域传输现象。

articles.title: Artificial spin ice on the CaVO lattice: a tricritical bridge from square to kagome
articles.title_zh: CaVO晶格上的人工自旋冰：从方形到戈薇的三临界桥
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.01397v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Artificial spin ices (ASIs) are arrays of interacting nanomagnets in which phase transitions can be imaged and controlled. Studies of the thermodynamic have focused mainly on the square and kagome lattices, and on their variants. Here we study artificial spin ice on the CaVO lattice, formed of squares and octagons. At fixed lattice constant, the ratio r of the square and octagon link lengths tunes the interactions strongly while changing the geometry only slightly. Magnetic force microscopy and Monte Carlo simulations show a continuous bridge from square-ice-like to kagome-like behavior. At small r the system has a single ordering transition, whereas at large r it passes from a correlated paramagnet to charge order and then long-range order. The two regimes meet in a multicritical region, accurately modeled by a Blume-Capel model of the octagon toroidal moments. From this picture, we design a comparative magnetometry protocol that unambiguously separates interaction effects from single-nanomagnet effects in thermally active samples. Finally, the charge-ordered region maps onto a tunable dimer model, with a Coulomb phase and pinch points along the line between two ordered dimer phases. The CaVO ASI thus provides access to a rich phase diagram only through geometric tuning, without requiring extreme experimental conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 人造自旋冰（ASI）是相互作用的纳米磁体阵列，可以对其中的相变进行成像和控制。热力学的研究主要集中在方晶格和戈薇晶格及其变体上。在这里，我们研究了由正方形和八边形组成的 CaVO 晶格上的人造自旋冰。在固定晶格常数下，正方形和八边形链接长度的比率 r 强烈地调节相互作用，同时仅轻微改变几何形状。磁力显微镜和蒙特卡罗模拟显示了从方冰状行为到戈薇状行为的连续桥梁。在 r 较小时，系统具有单一有序转变，而在 r 较大时，系统从相关顺磁体过渡到电荷有序，然后是长程有序。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 人造自旋冰（ASI）是相互作用的纳米磁体阵列，可以对其中的相变进行成像和控制。热力学的研究主要集中在方晶格和戈薇晶格及其变体上。在这里，我们研究了由正方形和八边形组成的 CaVO 晶格上的人造自旋冰。在固定晶格常数下，正方形和八边形链接长度的比率 r 强烈地调节相互作用，同时仅轻微改变几何形状。磁力显微镜和蒙特卡罗模拟显示了从方冰状行为到戈薇状行为的连续桥梁。在 r 较小时，系统具有单一有序转变，而在 r 较大时，系统从相关顺磁体过渡到电荷有序，然后是长程有序。这两种状态在多临界区域相遇，由八边形环形矩的 Blume-Capel 模型精确建模。根据这张图片，我们设计了一种比较磁力测量协议，可以明确区分热活性样品中的相互作用效应和单纳米磁体效应。最后，电荷有序区域映射到可调二聚体模型上，具有库仑相和沿着两个有序二聚体相之间的线的夹点。因此，CaVO ASI 只需通过几何调谐即可获得丰富的相图，而不需要极端的实验条件。

articles.title: Beyond-RTA magnetoconductivity of multifold semimetals under generic orientations of electromagnetic fields
articles.title_zh: 电磁场通用方向下多重半金属的超越 RTA 磁导率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.01398v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present an exact solution of the linearised semiclassical Boltzmann equation (SBE) beyond the relaxation-time approximation for multifold semimetals under arbitrarily oriented electric and magnetic fields. The framework treats the Berry curvature, orbital magnetic moment, Lorentz-force operator, and scattering terms on equal footing. Momentum-independent scattering-amplitudes couple the Fermi-surface sheets through intranode, interband, and internode processes. The scattering kernel has a finite rank and the SBE reduces to a linear system for a few moments, which is closed by the electron-number constraint. We apply this approach to four systems involving quadratic-corrected triple-point, Weyl, and Rarita-Schwinger-Weyl nodes, including tilted triple-point nodes. We obtain analytical results at zero field and to leading orders in the magnetic field, alongside numerical solutions for the full field dependence. Our results elucidate the roles of the topological properties, Lorentz-force operator, tilt, and intra- and internode scatterings in shaping the magnetoelectric conductivity. It cures severe shortcomings of previous treatments like incomplete ansätze and incomplete treatment of the Lorentz-force operator.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了线性半经典玻尔兹曼方程（SBE）的精确解，超出了任意方向电场和磁场下多重半金属的弛豫时间近似。该框架平等对待贝里曲率、轨道磁矩、洛伦兹力算子和散射项。与动量无关的散射振幅通过节内、带间和节间过程耦合费米面片。散射核具有有限秩，并且 SBE 在一段时间内简化为线性系统，该系统由电子数约束封闭。我们将此方法应用于涉及二次校正三点、Weyl 和 Rarita-Schwinger-Weyl 节点（包括倾斜三点节点）的四个系统。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了线性半经典玻尔兹曼方程（SBE）的精确解，超出了任意方向电场和磁场下多重半金属的弛豫时间近似。该框架平等对待贝里曲率、轨道磁矩、洛伦兹力算子和散射项。与动量无关的散射振幅通过节内、带间和节间过程耦合费米面片。散射核具有有限秩，并且 SBE 在一段时间内简化为线性系统，该系统由电子数约束封闭。我们将此方法应用于涉及二次校正三点、Weyl 和 Rarita-Schwinger-Weyl 节点（包括倾斜三点节点）的四个系统。我们获得了零场和磁场主阶的分析结果，以及全场依赖性的数值解。我们的结果阐明了拓扑特性、洛伦兹力算子、倾斜以及节内和节间散射在形成磁电导率中的作用。它解决了以前治疗方法的严重缺陷，例如不完整的 ansätze 和洛伦兹力算子的不完整治疗。

articles.title: Plasmon modes in three-dimensional multifold semimetals. II. Rarita-Schwinger-Weyl and Kramers-Weyl nodes
articles.title_zh: 三维多重半金属中的等离子体激元模式。二. Rarita-Schwinger-Weyl 和 Kramers-Weyl 节点
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.01401v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate collective charge excitations in three-dimensional multifold semimetals in which multiple bands cross the Fermi level at a positive chemical potential, focusing on pseudospin-3/2 Rarita-Schwinger-Weyl semimetals and on Kramers-Weyl semimetals. Both systems host multiple concentric Fermi surfaces at positive chemical potential. Within the random-phase approximation, we analyse the density response, Drude weights, dielectric function, plasmon modes and their Landau damping, and Friedel oscillations, considering both small and arbitrary momentum transfers. In our companion work, arXiv:2610.18629, we investigated pseudospin-1 triple-point semimetals, with and without a quadratic correction to their dispersion, as well as Hopf and Weyl semimetals. Comparing these systems allows us to elucidate the distinct roles of band dispersions and eigenstates in shaping collective charge dynamics. Our results demonstrate that collective charge excitations can distinguish multifold nodes with multiple Fermi surfaces and reveal information encoded in their eigenstates beyond that contained in the single-particle dispersion.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了三维多重半金属中的集体电荷激发，其中多个能带以正化学势穿过费米能级，重点关注赝自旋 3/2 Rarita-Schwinger-Weyl 半金属和 Kramers-Weyl 半金属。两个系统都拥有多个具有正化学势的同心费米表面。在随机相位近似中，我们分析了密度响应、德鲁德权重、介电函数、等离激元模式及其朗道阻尼和弗里德尔振荡，同时考虑了小动量传递和任意动量传递。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了三维多重半金属中的集体电荷激发，其中多个能带以正化学势穿过费米能级，重点关注赝自旋 3/2 Rarita-Schwinger-Weyl 半金属和 Kramers-Weyl 半金属。两个系统都拥有多个具有正化学势的同心费米表面。在随机相位近似中，我们分析了密度响应、德鲁德权重、介电函数、等离激元模式及其朗道阻尼和弗里德尔振荡，同时考虑了小动量传递和任意动量传递。在我们的配套工作 arXiv:2610.18629 中，我们研究了赝自旋 1 三点半金属（对其色散进行或不进行二次校正）以及 Hopf 和 Weyl 半金属。比较这些系统使我们能够阐明能带色散和本征态在塑造集体电荷动力学中的独特作用。我们的结果表明，集体电荷激发可以区分具有多个费米面的多重节点，并揭示其本征态编码的信息，超出单粒子色散中包含的信息。

articles.title: Learning materials spectra across modalities and scales with structure-conditioned neural fields
articles.title_zh: 通过结构条件神经场学习跨模式和尺度的材料光谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.01417v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spectroscopic observables encode rich information about material behavior across diverse, often high-dimensional domains of energy, momentum, and other experimental coordinates, providing critical insights into the physical properties underlying material functionalities and applications. However, learning these responses directly from atomic structures remains challenging due to the complexity of both structural configurations and spectroscopic observation spaces. Here, we develop a structure-conditioned neural-field framework that learns continuous spectroscopic response functions by coupling an equivariant structural encoder with a coordinate-conditioned network. The framework accurately predicts spectroscopic observables across diverse observation domains, ranging from one-dimensional densities of states to multidimensional scattering functions. We show that fine-tuning with limited spectral supervision captures strain- and composition-dependent spectral changes, with validated transfer to alloy configurations containing hundreds of atoms and computational scalability demonstrated for configurations exceeding 10⁴ atoms. Our work establishes a versatile and computationally scalable approach to learning structure-spectroscopy relationships, providing a foundation for spectroscopic analysis and future materials characterization, inverse problems, and experimental design.
articles.abstract_zh: 光谱可观测值编码了有关跨不同的、通常是高维的能量、动量和其他实验坐标域的材料行为的丰富信息，为材料功能和应用背后的物理特性提供了重要的见解。然而，由于结构配置和光谱观察空间的复杂性，直接从原子结构学习这些响应仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们开发了一个结构条件神经场框架，通过将等变结构编码器与坐标条件网络耦合来学习连续光谱响应函数。该框架准确预测跨不同观测域的光谱可观测值，范围从一维态密度到多维散射函数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 光谱可观测值编码了有关跨不同的、通常是高维的能量、动量和其他实验坐标域的材料行为的丰富信息，为材料功能和应用背后的物理特性提供了重要的见解。然而，由于结构配置和光谱观察空间的复杂性，直接从原子结构学习这些响应仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们开发了一个结构条件神经场框架，通过将等变结构编码器与坐标条件网络耦合来学习连续光谱响应函数。该框架准确预测跨不同观测域的光谱可观测值，范围从一维态密度到多维散射函数。我们证明，通过有限的光谱监督进行微调可以捕获与应变和成分相关的光谱变化，并验证转移到包含数百个原子的合金配置，并针对超过 10⁴ 原子的配置证明计算可扩展性。我们的工作建立了一种通用且计算可扩展的方法来学习结构-光谱关系，为光谱分析和未来材料表征、反演问题和实验设计奠定了基础。

articles.title: Polarization instability of unpolarized excited states in trapped two-component Bose--Einstein condensates
articles.title_zh: 俘获二元玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚中非偏振激发态的偏振不稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.01488v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A binary Bose--Einstein condensate in an elongated trap supports unpolarized excited states, in which both components share the same spatial profile. Within mean-field theory we show that the interspecies repulsion at which these states demix rises with the excitation level. Since each component keeps its atom number, the components separate by moving in opposite directions in the trap, and demixing sets in when the interaction energy released by the separation balances its cost in kinetic and trap energy. We show that the threshold also marks the onset of an exponential, non-oscillating growth of the separation, which divides the cloud into domains of opposite polarization, with walls at the density nodes and further walls interlaced with them. In the Thomas--Fermi regime of a quasi-one-dimensional condensate the rise of the threshold follows power laws in the ratio of the trap oscillator energy to the chemical potential. The trap raises the ground-state threshold, in units of the intraspecies repulsion, by 1.82 times the square of this ratio. Each density node of an excited state near the trap center raises the threshold further by 1.24 times the cube of this ratio. Because the steps between successive levels scale as the cube of this ratio, they fall as the inverse square of the atom number, and the dependence on the excitation level is a mesoscopic effect, appreciable only when the chemical potential is no more than a few times the oscillator energy. In a hyperfine mixture of ⁸⁷Rb a Feshbach resonance tunes the interspecies repulsion across the thresholds of the lowest states.
articles.abstract_zh: 细长陷阱中的二元玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体支持非偏振激发态，其中两个分量共享相同的空间轮廓。在平均场理论中，我们表明这些状态分层时的种间排斥随着激发水平的增加而增加。由于每个组分都保持其原子序数，因此组分通过在陷阱中沿相反方向移动而分离，并且当分离释放的相互作用能平衡其动能和陷阱能的成本时，就会发生分层。我们表明，阈值还标志着分离的指数、非振荡增长的开始，它将云划分为相反极化的域，在密度节点处有壁，并且更远的壁与它们交错。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 细长陷阱中的二元玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体支持非偏振激发态，其中两个分量共享相同的空间轮廓。在平均场理论中，我们表明这些状态分层时的种间排斥随着激发水平的增加而增加。由于每个组分都保持其原子序数，因此组分通过在陷阱中沿相反方向移动而分离，并且当分离释放的相互作用能平衡其动能和陷阱能的成本时，就会发生分层。我们表明，阈值还标志着分离的指数、非振荡增长的开始，它将云划分为相反极化的域，在密度节点处有壁，并且更远的壁与它们交错。在准一维凝聚体的托马斯-费米体系中，阈值的上升遵循陷阱振荡器能量与化学势之比的幂律。该陷阱将基态阈值（以种内排斥力为单位）提高了该比率平方的 1.82 倍。陷阱中心附近激发态的每个密度节点将阈值进一步提高该比率的立方的 1.24 倍。由于连续能级之间的步长按该比率的立方缩放，因此它们以原子数的平方反比下降，并且对激发能级的依赖性是介观效应，仅当化学势不超过振荡器能量的几倍时才可察觉。在 ⁸⁷Rb 的超精细混合物中，费什巴赫共振可调节最低态阈值上的种间排斥力。

articles.title: Theoretical Prediction of Superconducting 2D Hydrogenated Janus V2CSH and Nb2CSH MXenes
articles.title_zh: 超导二维氢化 Janus V2CSH 和 Nb2CSH MXene 的理论预测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.01502v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two dimensional hydrogenated Janus MXenes represent a new frontier in superconducting materials, where asymmetric surface terminations enable tunable electronic and vibrational properties. In this work, we present the first comparative study of hydrogen or sulfur terminated V2CSH and Nb2CSH monolayers using density functional theory and density functional perturbation theory. Both compounds are structurally and thermally stable, exhibiting isotropic in plane elasticity and nonmagnetic multiband metallic states dominated by transition metal d orbitals. The asymmetric S or H terminations generate nonequivalent surface potentials and intrinsic out of plane dipoles. Electron phonon coupling constants of 0.39 (V2CSH) and 0.53 (Nb2CSH) yield superconducting transition temperatures of 2.36 K and 5.27 K, respectively, within the Allen Dynes framework. Low energy lattice vibrations, primarily involving metal and sulfur atoms, account for 77% of the coupling in both MXenes. These findings establish metal substitution as a design principle for tuning superconductivity in Janus MXenes and highlight Nb2CSH as a promising candidate for low temperature superconducting applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 二维氢化 Janus MXene 代表了超导材料的新前沿，其中不对称表面终端可实现可调谐的电子和振动特性。在这项工作中，我们首次使用密度泛函理论和密度泛函微扰理论对氢或硫封端的 V2CSH 和 Nb2CSH 单层进行比较研究。这两种化合物都具有结构和热稳定性，表现出平面弹性各向同性和以过渡金属 d 轨道为主的非磁性多带金属态。不对称的 S 或 H 终端产生不等价的表面电势和固有的面外偶极子。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 二维氢化 Janus MXene 代表了超导材料的新前沿，其中不对称表面终端可实现可调谐的电子和振动特性。在这项工作中，我们首次使用密度泛函理论和密度泛函微扰理论对氢或硫封端的 V2CSH 和 Nb2CSH 单层进行比较研究。这两种化合物都具有结构和热稳定性，表现出平面弹性各向同性和以过渡金属 d 轨道为主的非磁性多带金属态。不对称的 S 或 H 终端产生不等价的表面电势和固有的面外偶极子。在 Allen Dynes 框架内，电子声子耦合常数 0.39 (V2CSH) 和 0.53 (Nb2CSH) 分别产生 2.36 K 和 5.27 K 的超导转变温度。低能晶格振动（主要涉及金属和硫原子）占两种 MXene 中耦合的 77%。这些发现确立了金属替代作为调整 Janus MXene 超导性的设计原则，并强调 Nb2CSH 作为低温超导应用的有前途的候选者。

articles.title: Fredholm approximations to the Bethe-Salpeter equation with spherical-Bessel kernels for Wannier-Mott excitons
articles.title_zh: 对于 Wannier-Mott 激子，使用球形 Bessel 核对 Bethe-Salpeter 方程进行 Fredholm 逼近
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.01570v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a deterministic radial approximation to the static Bethe-Salpeter equation (BSE), designed for rapid preliminary screening of Wannier-Mott exciton binding across direct-gap bulk materials. The approximation replaces the electron-hole transition problem by small radial eigenvalue problems that require no stochastic sampling. Starting from the four-point BSE and its matrix representation in a Bloch electron-hole basis, we retain one valence and one conduction band in the effective-mass limit within the Tamm-Dancoff approximation. We introduce a central projection of the screened direct interaction and omit bare electron-hole exchange. The resulting model applies to spatially extended excitons whose envelopes vary slowly on the scale of the unit cell, provided that the effective-mass description and central screened interaction adequately represent the exciton of interest. A partial-wave decomposition separates the angular-momentum channels and expresses their interaction kernels as spherical-Bessel transforms of the real-space screened Coulomb interaction. Nyström discretization produces real symmetric radial matrices suitable for standard eigensolvers. Their dimension is set by the radial grid independently of the Brillouin-zone sampling used to calculate screening. We implement the formulation in the all-electron, full-potential code textttexciting. For bulk GaAs, the compact radial problem reproduces the corresponding conventional matrix-BSE binding energy within (1~meV) at matched sampling. Further refinement achieves finite-mesh stability within the same tolerance on denser screening meshes without increasing the radial matrix size.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们开发了静态 Bethe-Salpeter 方程 (BSE) 的确定性径向近似，旨在快速初步筛选跨直接带隙块体材料的 Wannier-Mott 激子结合。该近似用不需要随机采样的小径向特征值问题代替了电子-空穴跃迁问题。从四点 BSE 及其在布洛赫电子空穴基础中的矩阵表示开始，我们在 Tamm-Dancoff 近似内的有效质量极限中保留一个价态和一个导带。我们引入了屏蔽直接相互作用的中心投影，并省略了裸露的电子-空穴交换。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们开发了静态 Bethe-Salpeter 方程 (BSE) 的确定性径向近似，旨在快速初步筛选跨直接带隙块体材料的 Wannier-Mott 激子结合。该近似用不需要随机采样的小径向特征值问题代替了电子-空穴跃迁问题。从四点 BSE 及其在布洛赫电子空穴基础中的矩阵表示开始，我们在 Tamm-Dancoff 近似内的有效质量极限中保留一个价态和一个导带。我们引入了屏蔽直接相互作用的中心投影，并省略了裸露的电子-空穴交换。所得到的模型适用于空间延伸的激子，其包络线在晶胞尺度上缓慢变化，前提是有效质量描述和中心屏蔽相互作用充分代表感兴趣的激子。部分波分解分离角动量通道，并将它们的相互作用核表示为实空间屏蔽库仑相互作用的球贝塞尔变换。 Nyström 离散化产生适用于标准特征求解器的实对称径向矩阵。它们的尺寸由径向网格设置，独立于用于计算筛选的布里渊区采样。我们在全电子、全势代码 textttexciting 中实现了该公式。对于块状 GaAs，紧凑径向问题在匹配采样时重现了 (1~meV) 内相应的常规基质-BSE 结合能。进一步细化可在更密集的筛网上实现相同公差内的有限网格稳定性，而无需增加径向矩阵尺寸。

articles.title: Atomistic Insights into MOCVD Growth of GaAs using a Closed Loop Autonomous System Combining Directed Reinforcement Learning and Kinetic Monte Carlo Simulations
articles.title_zh: 使用闭环自主系统结合定向强化学习和动力学蒙特卡罗模拟对 GaAs 的 MOCVD 生长进行原子洞察
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.01646v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Conventional process optimization of the Metal-Organic Chemical Vapor Deposition (MOCVD) growth parameters to achieve high-quality thin films relies on iterative, resource-intensive experimental runs. While predictive modeling can circumvent this cost and effort, simulating thin-film growth is constrained by the vastly different length and time scales of the deposition process. While continuum (e.g., Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD)) and first-principles methods (e.g., Molecular Dynamics (MD)) struggle to balance experimental length/time scales and atomistic accuracy, Kinetic Monte Carlo (KMC) bridges this divide by resolving atomistic events whilst remaining tractable at experimental length and time scales. However, the accuracy of KMC relies on kinetic rate parameters that require costly density functional theory (DFT) calculations. In order to circumvent this, we present a framework that calibrates the rate parameters directly against experimental growth data. A forward KMC growth model is coupled in a closed loop with a Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) optimizer that navigates the high-dimensional parameter space, with the search steered by the degree of rate control of each reaction rate parameter. The approach invokes no material-specific assumptions and hence, any deposition process whose forward kinetics can be reduced to a set of rate-controlled events is amenable to the same treatment. We demonstrate it for the MOCVD of GaAs, where the calibrated model captures the characteristic temperature dependence of the measured growth rate. The framework is also able to recover the three well known kinetic regimes characterized by change in the rate determining step from precursor chemisorption to desorption. As a result, the framework converts routinely measured growth data into a mechanistically interpretable model of the deposition process.
articles.abstract_zh: 金属有机化学气相沉积 (MOCVD) 生长参数的传统工艺优化以获得高质量薄膜依赖于迭代、资源密集型实验运行。虽然预测建模可以规避这种成本和精力，但模拟薄膜生长受到沉积过程截然不同的长度和时间尺度的限制。虽然连续体（例如计算流体动力学（CFD））和第一原理方法（例如分子动力学（MD））努力平衡实验长度/时间尺度和原子精度，但动力学蒙特卡罗（KMC）通过解决原子事件来弥合这一鸿沟，同时在实验长度和时间尺度上保持易于处理。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 金属有机化学气相沉积 (MOCVD) 生长参数的传统工艺优化以获得高质量薄膜依赖于迭代、资源密集型实验运行。虽然预测建模可以规避这种成本和精力，但模拟薄膜生长受到沉积过程截然不同的长度和时间尺度的限制。虽然连续体（例如计算流体动力学（CFD））和第一原理方法（例如分子动力学（MD））努力平衡实验长度/时间尺度和原子精度，但动力学蒙特卡罗（KMC）通过解决原子事件来弥合这一鸿沟，同时在实验长度和时间尺度上保持易于处理。然而，KMC 的准确性依赖于动力学速率参数，而这些参数需要昂贵的密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算。为了避免这种情况，我们提出了一个框架，可以直接根据实验生长数据校准速率参数。前向 KMC 增长模型与蒙特卡罗树搜索 (MCTS) 优化器耦合在闭环中，该优化器导航高维参数空间，搜索由每个反应速率参数的速率控制程度控制。该方法不调用特定于材料的假设，因此，任何其正向动力学可以简化为一组速率控制事件的沉积过程都适合相同的处理。我们在 GaAs 的 MOCVD 中进行了演示，其中校准模型捕获了所测量的生长速率的特征温度依赖性。该框架还能够恢复三种众所周知的动力学状态，其特征在于速率决定步骤从前体化学吸附到解吸的变化。因此，该框架将常规测量的生长数据转换为沉积过程的机械可解释模型。

articles.title: Origin of bias-voltage-dependent transient negative capacitance in PZT ferroelectric capacitor with labyrinthine-like domains
articles.title_zh: 具有迷宫状域的 PZT 铁电电容器中偏置电压相关瞬态负电容的起源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.01697v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigated how the bias-voltage-dependent variation in the ferroelectric domain switching pathways affects the transient negative capacitance in multidomain PZT ferroelectric capacitor with labyrinthine-like domains having, primarily, 90^circ walls. Using the vector piezoresponse force microscopy, x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, and energy dispersive x-ray spectroscopy, we show that, together with strain, local variation in composition results in the formation of labyrinthine domains in epitaxial films of thickness sim1 μm. Clear signature of emergence of bias-voltage-dependent pathways could be observed in the Raman modes exhibiting splitting due to an intermediate state - different from the initial and final states - at the ``intermediate state of switching". The polarization relaxation patterns also show different states emerging depending on the bias voltage characteristics. The phase-field simulation of relaxation of ``intermediate state of switching" corroborates the experimental results and also exhibits dependence of the domain-wall area on the bias voltage and damping parameter. Combining the results of experiments and theoretical calculation, we show, therefore, that the variation of bias voltage leads to a change in the domain switching pathways and each pathway is associated with specific domain-wall area at the ``intermediate state of switching". Since, the net domain-wall area at the ``intermediate state of switching" governs the magnitude of transient negative capacitance, this work thus traces the origin of tunability of transient negative capacitance in PZT ferroelectric capacitor.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了铁电域切换路径中偏压相关的变化如何影响多域 PZT 铁电电容器的瞬态负电容，该电容器具有迷宫般的域，主要具有 90^circ 壁。使用矢量压响应力显微镜、X 射线光电子能谱和能量色散 X 射线能谱，我们表明，与应变一起，成分的局部变化导致厚度为 sim1 μm 的外延膜中形成迷宫域。在拉曼模式中可以观察到由于中间状态（不同于初始状态和最终状态）在“切换中间状态”时出现分裂的明显的偏压依赖路径的出现特征。极化弛豫模式还显示出根据偏压特性出现的不同状态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了铁电域切换路径中偏压相关的变化如何影响多域 PZT 铁电电容器的瞬态负电容，该电容器具有迷宫般的域，主要具有 90^circ 壁。使用矢量压响应力显微镜、X 射线光电子能谱和能量色散 X 射线能谱，我们表明，与应变一起，成分的局部变化导致厚度为 sim1 μm 的外延膜中形成迷宫域。在拉曼模式中可以观察到由于中间状态（不同于初始状态和最终状态）在“切换中间状态”时出现分裂的明显的偏压依赖路径的出现特征。极化弛豫模式还显示出根据偏压特性出现的不同状态。“切换中间状态”弛豫的相场模拟证实了实验结果，并且还表现出畴壁面积对偏压和阻尼参数的依赖性。因此，结合实验和理论计算的结果，我们表明，偏置电压的变化会导致畴切换路径的变化，并且每个路径都与“中间切换状态”的特定畴壁面积相关。由于“中间切换状态”的净畴壁面积控制瞬态负电容的大小，因此这项工作由此追踪了PZT铁电电容器瞬态负电容可调性的起源。

articles.title: Asymmetric Little--Parks Oscillations as a Probe of Coupled Pairing Channels in Surface-Superconducting texorpdfstringPtBi₂PtBi2
articles.title_zh: 非对称小帕克斯振荡作为表面超导中耦合配对通道的探针pdfstringPtBi2PtBi2
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.01764v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Motivated by the recent discovery of unconventional surface superconductivity in PtBi₂, we theoretically study its signatures in the Little-Parks oscillations of a narrow ring made from the same material. Using a Ginzburg-Landau model with three coupled pairing channels allowed by the trigonal crystal symmetry, we show that a fixed in-plane magnetic field can make the mean-field transition temperature asymmetric under reversal of the normal flux through the ring, while preserving periodicity in the superconducting flux quantum. The leading weak-field contribution to this asymmetry is cubic in the in-plane field strength. The flux-odd component respects the threefold crystal symmetry and changes sign when the in-plane field is rotated by π/3 at fixed magnitude. Within the homogeneous ring model, this asymmetry is absent for a single pairing channel and arises from the coupling between the three channels. Our calculations further show that increasing the in-plane magnetic field can enhance the superconducting nucleation temperature through mixing of pairing channels, illustrating magnetic control of multicomponent superconductivity in mesoscopic rings. Little-Parks interferometry with independent control of flux and field direction thus offers a mesoscopic probe of the pairing state, complementary to spectroscopic studies of the gap structure.
articles.abstract_zh: 受最近发现的 PtBi 非常规表面超导性的启发，我们从理论上研究了由相同材料制成的窄环的小帕克斯振荡特征。使用具有三角晶体对称性允许的三个耦合配对通道的金兹堡-朗道模型，我们表明固定的面内磁场可以使平均场转变温度在通过环的法向通量反转的情况下不对称，同时保持超导通量量子的周期性。对这种不对称性的主要弱场贡献是面内场强的三次方。当面内场以固定幅度旋转 π/3 时，奇通量分量遵循三重晶体对称性并改变符号。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 受最近发现的 PtBi 非常规表面超导性的启发，我们从理论上研究了由相同材料制成的窄环的小帕克斯振荡特征。使用具有三角晶体对称性允许的三个耦合配对通道的金兹堡-朗道模型，我们表明固定的面内磁场可以使平均场转变温度在通过环的法向通量反转的情况下不对称，同时保持超导通量量子的周期性。对这种不对称性的主要弱场贡献是面内场强的三次方。当面内场以固定幅度旋转 π/3 时，奇通量分量遵循三重晶体对称性并改变符号。在同质环模型中，单个配对通道不存在这种不对称性，这种不对称性是由三个通道之间的耦合引起的。我们的计算进一步表明，增加面内磁场可以通过配对通道的混合来提高超导成核温度，这说明了介观环中多组分超导性的磁控制。因此，具有独立控制通量和场方向的小帕克斯干涉测量法提供了配对状态的介观探针，与间隙结构的光谱研究互补。

articles.title: Three New Phases in the Two-Dimensional Potts Model at Complex Temperature
articles.title_zh: 复杂温度下二维 Potts 模型的三个新相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.01771v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The complex-temperature phase structure of the two-dimensional Potts model has remained largely unresolved despite decades of study. Here we determine the complex-temperature phase diagram of the 3-state Potts model, and uncover three gapless phases beyond the familiar ferromagnetic and paramagnetic phases. This is done by combining tensor-network free energies with the Poisson equation to compute the Fisher zero density in the thermodynamic limit. The resulting zero distribution unifies and revises long-standing conjectures on the zero loci, and outlines each phase. One is a non-conformal gapless phase, with an exponentially growing number of low-lying transfer-matrix levels distributed across all momentum sectors. The other two are Luttinger-liquid phases with complex-valued Luttinger parameters related by the Kramers-Wannier duality. At the antiferromagnetic critical point, the Luttinger parameter equals 3, while its limit from the adjacent Luttinger-liquid phase is 6. These findings reveal rich phase structures and unconventional critical behavior in a classical textbook model.
articles.abstract_zh: 尽管经过了数十年的研究，二维波茨模型的复杂温度相结构在很大程度上仍未得到解决。在这里，我们确定了三态 Potts 模型的复杂温度相图，并发现了除了熟悉的铁磁相和顺磁相之外的三个无间隙相。这是通过将张量网络自由能与泊松方程相结合来计算热力学极限中的费舍尔零密度来完成的。由此产生的零分布统一并修正了长期以来对零位点的猜想，并概述了每个阶段。一种是非共形无间隙相，分布在所有动量扇区的低洼转移矩阵水平数量呈指数增长。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 尽管经过了数十年的研究，二维波茨模型的复杂温度相结构在很大程度上仍未得到解决。在这里，我们确定了三态 Potts 模型的复杂温度相图，并发现了除了熟悉的铁磁相和顺磁相之外的三个无间隙相。这是通过将张量网络自由能与泊松方程相结合来计算热力学极限中的费舍尔零密度来完成的。由此产生的零分布统一并修正了长期以来对零位点的猜想，并概述了每个阶段。一种是非共形无间隙相，分布在所有动量扇区的低洼转移矩阵水平数量呈指数增长。另外两个是具有与 Kramers-Wannier 对偶相关的复值 Luttinger 参数的 Luttinger 液相。在反铁磁临界点，Luttinger 参数等于 3，而邻近 Luttinger 液相的极限为 6。这些发现揭示了经典教科书模型中丰富的相结构和非常规的临界行为。

articles.title: Stable AgBiS2 near-infrared absorbers for thin film tandem photovoltaics
articles.title_zh: 用于薄膜串联光伏发电的稳定 AgBiS2 近红外吸收剂
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.01797v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AgBiS2 has rapidly risen in efficiency as single-junction photovoltaics (PVs), but its potential for tandem PVs is unexplored. Herein, we perform optical modeling based on the experimental absorption spectrum of AgBiS2, revealing that, as the NIR sub-cell, efficiencies exceeding 47.9% are achievable in triple-junction tandems, superseding tandems using Pb/Sn perovskite NIR cells (35.9%). However, fulfilling this potential requires overcoming the limited transport properties of AgBiS2 nanocrystal films, which constrains film thicknesses to only 30-50 nm, severely restricting NIR response. A solution-phase ligand exchange process is herein developed, allowing one-step deposition of passivated AgBiS2 nanocrystals that maintain efficient charge-carrier extraction despite an order of magnitude increase in film thickness. These films enable 24.0%-efficient four-terminal tandems with visible-light-absorbing lead-halide perovskite sub-cells, and monolithic tandems successfully demonstrating voltage addition. AgBiS2 PVs have high stability, retaining >90% of the original efficiency after 3 months of storage in dry air without encapsulation. This work establishes the significant potential of AgBiS2 as a stable and scalable NIR absorber for tandem PVs.
articles.abstract_zh: AgBiS2 作为单结光伏发电 (PV) 的效率迅速提高，但其串联光伏发电的潜力尚未开发。在此，我们基于 AgBiS2 的实验吸收光谱进行光学建模，结果表明，作为近红外子电池，三结串联电池的效率可以超过 47.9%，取代使用 Pb/Sn 钙钛矿近红外电池的串联电池 (35.9%)。然而，要实现这一潜力，需要克服 AgBiS2 纳米晶体薄膜有限的传输特性，该薄膜的厚度仅限于 30-50 nm，严重限制了 NIR 响应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: AgBiS2 作为单结光伏发电 (PV) 的效率迅速提高，但其串联光伏发电的潜力尚未开发。在此，我们基于 AgBiS2 的实验吸收光谱进行光学建模，结果表明，作为近红外子电池，三结串联电池的效率可以超过 47.9%，取代使用 Pb/Sn 钙钛矿近红外电池的串联电池 (35.9%)。然而，要实现这一潜力，需要克服 AgBiS2 纳米晶体薄膜有限的传输特性，该薄膜的厚度仅限于 30-50 nm，严重限制了 NIR 响应。本文开发了一种溶液相配体交换工艺，允许一步沉积钝化的 AgBiS2 纳米晶体，尽管膜厚度增加了一个数量级，但仍能保持有效的载流子提取。这些薄膜可实现 24.0% 效率的四端串联与可见光吸收卤化铅钙钛矿子电池，并且单片串联成功地展示了电压添加。 AgBiS2 PV具有高稳定性，在干燥空气中储存3个月（无需封装）后仍能保持>90%的原始效率。这项工作确立了 AgBiS2 作为串联光伏稳定且可扩展的近红外吸收剂的巨大潜力。

articles.title: FLAKE: Friction and Lattice Analysis of Kinetics and Energetics of rigid 2D clusters on crystalline substrates
articles.title_zh: FLAKE：晶体基底上刚性二维簇的动力学和能量的摩擦和晶格分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.01805v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When a small solid island slides across a crystalline surface, the outcome (smooth flow or stick-slip, free rotation or angular locking) is controlled almost entirely by the geometric relationship between the island and the surface: their relative orientation, size and lattice symmetry. These phenomena are central to nanoscale friction, to the interpretation of colloidal monolayer experiments and to structural superlubricity. FLAKE (Friction and Lattice Analysis of Kinetics and Energetics) is a Python package for simulating the statics and Langevin dynamics of a rigid 2D cluster sliding over a periodic or quasiperiodic substrate potential. It enables fast, systematic exploration of how geometry and substrate symmetry control the energy landscape and friction, studies that are prohibitively expensive with fully atomistic simulations. FLAKE has been the primary simulation tool for three published studies on structural superlubricity and colloidal friction.
articles.abstract_zh: 当一个小的固体岛在晶体表面上滑动时，结果（平滑流动或粘滑、自由旋转或角锁定）几乎完全由岛和表面之间的几何关系控制：它们的相对方向、大小和晶格对称性。这些现象对于纳米级摩擦、胶体单层实验的解释和结构超润滑性至关重要。 FLAKE（动力学和能量的摩擦和晶格分析）是一个 Python 包，用于模拟在周期性或准周期性基底势上滑动的刚性 2D 簇的静力学和朗之万动力学。它能够快速、系统地探索几何结构和基底对称性如何控制能量景观和摩擦，而完全原子模拟的研究成本高昂。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 当一个小的固体岛在晶体表面上滑动时，结果（平滑流动或粘滑、自由旋转或角锁定）几乎完全由岛和表面之间的几何关系控制：它们的相对方向、大小和晶格对称性。这些现象对于纳米级摩擦、胶体单层实验的解释和结构超润滑性至关重要。 FLAKE（动力学和能量的摩擦和晶格分析）是一个 Python 包，用于模拟在周期性或准周期性基底势上滑动的刚性 2D 簇的静力学和朗之万动力学。它能够快速、系统地探索几何结构和基底对称性如何控制能量景观和摩擦，而完全原子模拟的研究成本高昂。 FLAKE 是三项已发表的结构超润滑性和胶体摩擦研究的主要模拟工具。

articles.title: Multipolar Anisotropy of Magnonic Orbital Pumping in d-Wave Altermagnets
articles.title_zh: d 波交变磁体中磁轨道泵浦的多极各向异性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.01848v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that antiferromagnetic magnons in d-wave altermagnets lead to orbital pumping with distinctive d-wave angular dependence on the direction of the Néel vector. We find that the anisotropy is generally much larger than that of spin pumping. We elucidate that this difference originates from the direct coupling of the orbital response to the electrical quadrupole moments induced by staggered local crystal field in an altermagnet. By symmetry analysis, we show that the anisotropy does not cancel for the two opposite-handedness antiferromagnetic magnons, suggesting that our prediction can be observed even with thermally excited magnons. We further analyze the handedness dependence for the situation with coherent magnons. These results establish multipolar anisotropy of orbital pumping as a direct dynamical signature of d-wave altermagnetic order and highlight the potential of altermagnets as a platform for magnon-driven orbitronics as well as for the interplay between magnons and electrical multipoles.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们表明，d 波交变磁体中的反铁磁磁振子会导致轨道泵浦，并且对尼尔矢量方向具有独特的 d 波角度依赖性。我们发现各向异性通常比自旋泵浦的各向异性大得多。我们阐明，这种差异源于轨道响应与交流磁体中交错局部晶体场引起的电四极矩的直接耦合。通过对称性分析，我们表明，两个相反旋向反铁磁磁振子的各向异性并没有抵消，这表明即使使用热激发磁振子也可以观察到我们的预测。我们进一步分析了相干磁振子情况下的旋手依赖性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们表明，d 波交变磁体中的反铁磁磁振子会导致轨道泵浦，并且对尼尔矢量方向具有独特的 d 波角度依赖性。我们发现各向异性通常比自旋泵浦的各向异性大得多。我们阐明，这种差异源于轨道响应与交流磁体中交错局部晶体场引起的电四极矩的直接耦合。通过对称性分析，我们表明，两个相反旋向反铁磁磁振子的各向异性并没有抵消，这表明即使使用热激发磁振子也可以观察到我们的预测。我们进一步分析了相干磁振子情况下的旋手依赖性。这些结果将轨道泵浦的多极各向异性确立为 d 波交变磁序的直接动力学特征，并突出了交变磁体作为磁振子驱动轨道电子学以及磁振子与电多极之间相互作用的平台的潜力。

articles.title: Disorder, Interactions, and the Fate of the Two-Dimensional Electron System: Wigner Crystal, Metal-Insulator Transition, and Amorphous Solid
articles.title_zh: 二维电子系统的无序、相互作用和命运：维格纳晶体、金属-绝缘体转变和非晶固体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.01899v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a unified theoretical study of the interplay between Coulomb disorder and Coulomb interactions in two-dimensional electron systems, covering the Wigner crystallization transition, the metal-insulator transition, and the crossover from a Wigner crystal to an amorphous localized solid in both zero magnetic field and the lowest Landau level. Using Hartree-Fock theory, variational Monte Carlo, and percolation and strong-localization arguments, we show that quenched charged disorder destroys true long-range Wigner crystalline order in the thermodynamic limit at any nonzero charged-impurity density, within the Imry-Ma-Larkin framework; the finite-system density image is that of an amorphous solid with crystalline coherence over at most a few lattice spacings. For the two-dimensional metal-insulator transition we show, in a controlled nonlinear-Thomas-Fermi model of long-range Coulomb disorder at setback d, that the half-depletion density of the semiclassical landscape and the Ioffe-Regel-Mott density of Born-RPA transport track each other to within a factor of order unity over the physically relevant range of impurity density and setback, with a slow nᵢ⁽⁻¹/¹⁰⁾ d⁽⁻¹/⁵⁾ spread; the agreement reflects the common energy scale E_dis ~ E_F at the transition rather than a theorem, and modest independent short-range transport channels can shift the ratio by factors of order two. The article is a theoretical study under well-defined approximations; it takes the recent scanning tunneling microscopy imaging experiments on two-dimensional electron systems and the longstanding disorder-versus-interaction debate on the two-dimensional metal-insulator transition as motivation, and leaves to the reader the comparison between its calculated signatures and the published experimental analyses.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了二维电子系统中库仑无序和库仑相互作用之间相互作用的统一理论研究，涵盖维格纳结晶转变、金属-绝缘体转变以及在零磁场和最低朗道能级下从维格纳晶体到非晶局域固体的交叉。利用 Hartree-Fock 理论、变分蒙特卡罗、渗滤和强局域化论证，我们表明，在 Imry-Ma-Larkin 框架内，猝灭带电无序在任何非零带电杂质密度下，在热力学极限下破坏了真正的长程维格纳晶序；有限系统密度图像是在最多几个晶格间距上具有晶体相干性的非晶固体的图像。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了二维电子系统中库仑无序和库仑相互作用之间相互作用的统一理论研究，涵盖维格纳结晶转变、金属-绝缘体转变以及在零磁场和最低朗道能级下从维格纳晶体到非晶局域固体的交叉。利用 Hartree-Fock 理论、变分蒙特卡罗、渗滤和强局域化论证，我们表明，在 Imry-Ma-Larkin 框架内，猝灭带电无序在任何非零带电杂质密度下，在热力学极限下破坏了真正的长程维格纳晶序；有限系统密度图像是在最多几个晶格间距上具有晶体相干性的非晶固体的图像。对于二维金属-绝缘体转变，我们表明，在挫折 d 处的长程库仑无序的受控非线性托马斯-费米模型中，半经典景观的半耗尽密度和 Born-RPA 输运的 Ioffe-Regel-Mott 密度在杂质密度和挫折的物理相关范围内的有序统一因子内相互跟踪，并且缓慢nᵢ⁽⁻1/1⁰⁾ d⁽⁻1/⁵⁾ 传播；该协议反映了过渡时的共同能量尺度 E_dis ~ E_F 而不是定理，并且适度的独立短程传输通道可以将比率改变二阶因子。本文是在明确定义的近似下进行的理论研究；它以最近二维电子系统的扫描隧道显微镜成像实验和二维金属-绝缘体转变方面长期存在的无序与相互作用争论为动力，并将其计算特征与已发表的实验分析之间的比较留给读者。

articles.title: Symmetry-Based Transport Criterion and Robust Design for RuO₂-type Altermagnets
articles.title_zh: 基于对称性的 RuO2 型交替磁体输运准则和稳健设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.01944v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnetism combines vanishing net magnetization with momentum-dependent spin splitting, enabling spin-transport functionalities without ferromagnetism. Although rutile RuO₂ has been proposed as a d-wave altermagnet, its magnetic ground state remains highly controversial. Moreover, existing transport verifications suffer from severe ambiguity due to the entanglement of spin-splitting effects and time-reversal-even spin-Hall contributions. Here, we introduce a two-pronged strategy to break the current verification impasse. First, we establish a definitive, symmetry-based transport criterion: by identifying specific crystallographic geometries where the spin-Hall background is strictly forbidden, we provide a zero-background window for unambiguous altermagnetic detection. Concurrently, to bypass the uncertain bulk energetics, we propose the RuO₂/MnO₂ superlattice as a prototypical platform to robustly enforce the d-wave altermagnetic order via interfacial magnetic proximity. Within this platform, symmetry-resolved spin-transport analysis reveals unconventional responses, including collinear spin currents enabling field-free magnetization switching and sizable spin-polarized charge currents. By combining a universal transport criterion with a robustly engineered material platform, our work transcends the debates over bulk properties, providing an actionable, definitive experimental roadmap for verifying d-wave altermagnetism.
articles.abstract_zh: 交变磁学将消失的净磁化强度与动量相关的自旋分裂相结合，无需铁磁性即可实现自旋输运功能。尽管金红石 RuO2 已被提议作为 d 波交变磁体，但其磁基态仍然存在很大争议。此外，由于自旋分裂效应和时间反转甚至自旋霍尔贡献的纠缠，现有的传输验证存在严重的模糊性。在这里，我们引入一个双管齐下的策略来打破当前的验证僵局。首先，我们建立了一个明确的、基于对称性的传输标准：通过识别严格禁止自旋霍尔背景的特定晶体几何形状，我们为明确的交变磁检测提供了一个零背景窗口。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 交变磁学将消失的净磁化强度与动量相关的自旋分裂相结合，无需铁磁性即可实现自旋输运功能。尽管金红石 RuO2 已被提议作为 d 波交变磁体，但其磁基态仍然存在很大争议。此外，由于自旋分裂效应和时间反转甚至自旋霍尔贡献的纠缠，现有的传输验证存在严重的模糊性。在这里，我们引入一个双管齐下的策略来打破当前的验证僵局。首先，我们建立了一个明确的、基于对称性的传输标准：通过识别严格禁止自旋霍尔背景的特定晶体几何形状，我们为明确的交变磁检测提供了一个零背景窗口。同时，为了绕过不确定的体能学，我们提出 RuO2/MnO2 超晶格作为原型平台，通过界面磁接近来强有力地增强 d 波交磁序。在该平台中，对称解析的自旋输运分析揭示了非常规响应，包括实现无场磁化切换的共线自旋电流和相当大的自旋极化充电电流。通过将通用传输标准与强大的工程材料平台相结合，我们的工作超越了关于块体特性的争论，为验证 d 波交变磁性提供了可行的、明确的实验路线图。

articles.title: Theory of the charge response of the boron-vacancy spin in monolayer hexagonal boron nitride
articles.title_zh: 单层六方氮化硼硼空位自旋的电荷响应理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.02137v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The boron vacancy VB⁻ in hexagonal boron nitride is a leading two-dimensional spin sensor, but the microscopic connection between nearby charge positions and its spin Hamiltonian remains poorly understood. Calculations for carbon and oxygen donors 3.85--8.08 mathringA away show that direction matters, not only distance. In the frozen lattice, reversing a carbon donor's azimuth at 4.35 mathringA (C1 to C1m) more than halves |E| and turns its axis across the mirror line. The ratio is 0.467 with the Perdew--Burke--Ernzerhof (PBE) functional, against 1 for distance alone. A field-plus-gradient model fitted to six donor configurations, including C1 but excluding C1m, predicted a ratio of 0.443 before C1m was calculated. Heyd--Scuseria--Ernzerhof hybrid statics give 0.432 and PBE relaxation 0.600. Exploratory analysis suggests why direction matters: a charge's potential differs at the three vacancy nitrogens and moves the spin of the two e' holes among them, more when the charge faces one nitrogen than the gap between two. E follows this spin imbalance through one constant, capprox8 GHz per μB, across donors and applied fields, whereas in PBE D is nearly insensitive to it. A three-site model with one fitted screening constant reproduces the frozen-lattice E to 83 MHz rms. Results are for one charge state in a free-standing monolayer; absolute |E| varies by tens of percent across approximations.
articles.abstract_zh: 六方氮化硼中的硼空位VB⁻是一种领先的二维自旋传感器，但附近电荷位置与其自旋哈密顿量之间的微观联系仍然知之甚少。对碳和氧供体 3.85--8.08 mathringA 距离的计算表明，方向很重要，而不仅仅是距离。在冻结晶格中，将碳供体的方位角反转到 4.35 mathringA（C1 到 C1m）超过一半 |E|并将其轴旋转穿过镜像线。使用 Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof (PBE) 泛函时，该比率为 0.467，而仅使用距离时该比率为 1。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 六方氮化硼中的硼空位VB⁻是一种领先的二维自旋传感器，但附近电荷位置与其自旋哈密顿量之间的微观联系仍然知之甚少。对碳和氧供体 3.85--8.08 mathringA 距离的计算表明，方向很重要，而不仅仅是距离。在冻结晶格中，将碳供体的方位角反转到 4.35 mathringA（C1 到 C1m）超过一半 |E|并将其轴旋转穿过镜像线。使用 Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof (PBE) 泛函时，该比率为 0.467，而仅使用距离时该比率为 1。适合六种供体配置（包括 C1 但不包括 C1m）的场加梯度模型在计算 C1m 之前预测比率为 0.443。 Heyd--Scuseria--Ernzerhof 混合静力学给出 0.432 和 PBE 松弛 0.600。探索性分析表明了为什么方向很重要：电荷在三个空位氮上的电势不同，并且在它们之间移动两个 e' 空穴的自旋，当电荷面对一个氮时比两个氮之间的间隙移动得更多。 E 通过一个常数（capprox8 GHz/μB）跟踪这种自旋不平衡，跨越供体和应用领域，而在 PBE 中 D 对此几乎不敏感。具有一个拟合筛选常数的三站点模型将冻结晶格 E 再现为 83 MHz rms。结果针对独立单层中的一种电荷状态；绝对|E|近似值之间存在百分之几十的差异。

articles.title: Thermodynamic Underpinnings Affecting Compressive and Tensile Plasticity in Refractory Compositionally Complex Alloys
articles.title_zh: 影响难熔成分复杂合金的压缩和拉伸塑性的热力学基础
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.02202v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Refractory compositionally complex alloys (R-CCAs) show great promise as next generation structural materials for extreme conditions, but alloys with excellent high temperature mechanical properties most often exhibit virtually zero room temperature tensile ductility, hindering potential commercial application. Several semi-empirical metrics have been employed for predicting plasticity in R-CCAs, including valence electron concentration, Pugh ratio, Rice criteria, and the D-parameter. While many currently available ductility metrics correlate very well when compressive plasticity is considered, only the density functional theory (DFT) based D-parameter shows a strong correlation in tension. A new ductility metric is developed using CALculation of PHAse Diagrams (CALPHAD) thermodynamics, Gamma, with includes the free energy difference between the body-centered cubic (BCC) and hexagonal close-packed (HCP) phases, the interfacial free energy of a (110) BCC surface, and an electronegativity-corrected lattice distortion. The Gamma parameter exhibits better correlation with tensile ductility than D-parameter and performs equally well in compression. While this improvement is modest, a thermodynamically grounded ductility metric is clearly required to capture intrinsic ductility behavior. Extrinsic contributions to brittle behavior in R-CCAs, namely interstitial oxygen content, are also briefly discussed. Combining the Gamma ductility parameter with CALPHAD-calculated oxygen solubility is proposed as a first order attempt to capture both intrinsic and extrinsic contributions to ductile behavior in R-CCAs.
articles.abstract_zh: 难熔成分复杂合金（R-CCA）作为极端条件下的下一代结构材料显示出巨大的前景，但具有优异高温机械性能的合金通常表现出几乎为零的室温拉伸延展性，阻碍了潜在的商业应用。一些半经验指标已用于预测 R-CCA 的可塑性，包括价电子浓度、Pugh 比、Rice 准则和 D 参数。虽然当前许多可用的延展性指标在考虑压缩塑性时具有很好的相关性，但只有基于密度泛函理论 (DFT) 的 D 参数显示出与张力的强相关性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 难熔成分复杂合金（R-CCA）作为极端条件下的下一代结构材料显示出巨大的前景，但具有优异高温机械性能的合金通常表现出几乎为零的室温拉伸延展性，阻碍了潜在的商业应用。一些半经验指标已用于预测 R-CCA 的可塑性，包括价电子浓度、Pugh 比、Rice 准则和 D 参数。虽然当前许多可用的延展性指标在考虑压缩塑性时具有很好的相关性，但只有基于密度泛函理论 (DFT) 的 D 参数显示出与张力的强相关性。使用相图 (CALPHAD) 热力学计算 Gamma 开发了一种新的延展性度量，其中包括体心立方 (BCC) 和密排六方 (HCP) 相之间的自由能差、(110) BCC 表面的界面自由能以及电负性校正的晶格畸变。与 D 参数相比，Gamma 参数与拉伸延展性的相关性更好，并且在压缩方面表现同样出色。虽然这种改进是有限的，但显然需要基于热力学的延展性度量来捕获内在的延展性行为。还简要讨论了 R-CCA 脆性行为的外在贡献，即间隙氧含量。建议将 Gamma 延展性参数与 CALPHAD 计算的氧溶解度相结合，作为捕获 R-CCA 延展行为的内在和外在贡献的一级尝试。

articles.title: Ferroelectric Switching in x-cut MgO-doped Thin-Film Lithium Niobate: Implications for Periodic Poling and Domain-Wall Electronics
articles.title_zh: x 切 MgO 掺杂薄膜铌酸锂中的铁电开关：对周期性极化和畴壁电子学的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.02233v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN) revives a mature ferroelectric as a wafer-scale platform for integrated photonics and, increasingly, for domain-wall electronics such as nonvolatile memories and memristors. Both applications rely on controlled ferroelectric switching, which is poorly understood in TFLN: periodic poling consistently requires electric fields above 30~kV/mm, far above the coercive fields of about 21~kV/mm and 4.5~kV/mm of bulk congruent and 5~mol% MgO-doped lithium niobate, respectively. Here, we present systematic ferroelectric hysteresis measurements on x-cut, 5~mol% MgO-doped TFLN with coplanar electrodes as used for periodic poling, combining the positive-up-negative-down (PUND) method with second-harmonic microscopy (SHM). We obtain a spontaneous polarization of (0.72±0.02)~C/m², consistent with bulk values, while the coercive field varies between 24 and 40~kV/mm with the voltage ramp rate and depends on the electrode geometry. We identify three contributions to the high coercive fields: (i) fast voltage ramps, (ii) finger electrodes, and (iii) the coplanar surface-electrode geometry. Together with bulk data, the coercive field follows a single power law of the ramp rate over five orders of magnitude, showing that the high fields are dominated by switching dynamics rather than by intrinsic thin-film properties. Moreover, the apparent internal field depends on the electrode geometry, and reverse switching leaves buried, electrically isolated domains. These results provide guidelines for scalable, fab-compatible periodic poling---one of the principal bottlenecks of TFLN device integration---and for the write and erase operation of TFLN domain-wall devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 薄膜铌酸锂 (TFLN) 复兴了成熟的铁电体，作为集成光子学的晶圆级平台，并且越来越多地用于非易失性存储器和忆阻器等域壁电子器件。这两种应用都依赖于受控铁电开关，这在 TFLN 中知之甚少：周期性极化始终需要高于 30~kV/mm 的电场，远高于块状同成分和 5~mol% MgO 掺杂铌酸锂的约 21~kV/mm 和 4.5~kV/mm 的矫顽场。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 薄膜铌酸锂 (TFLN) 复兴了成熟的铁电体，作为集成光子学的晶圆级平台，并且越来越多地用于非易失性存储器和忆阻器等域壁电子器件。这两种应用都依赖于受控铁电开关，这在 TFLN 中知之甚少：周期性极化始终需要高于 30~kV/mm 的电场，远高于块状同成分和 5~mol% MgO 掺杂铌酸锂的约 21~kV/mm 和 4.5~kV/mm 的矫顽场。在这里，我们将正上负下（PUND）方法与二次谐波显微镜（SHM）相结合，对 x 切、5~mol% MgO 掺杂 TFLN 进行系统的铁电磁滞测量，并使用共面电极进行周期性极化。我们获得了 (0.72±0.02)~C/m² 的自发极化，与体积值一致，而矫顽场随电压斜坡率在 24 至 40~kV/mm 之间变化，并取决于电极几何形状。我们确定了对高矫顽场的三个贡献：（i）快速电压斜坡，（ii）指状电极，以及（iii）共面表面电极几何形状。与大量数据一起，矫顽场遵循超过五个数量级的斜坡率的单一幂律，表明高场由开关动力学主导，而不是由固有薄膜特性主导。此外，表观内部场取决于电极的几何形状，并且反向切换会留下埋藏的电隔离域。这些结果为可扩展、晶圆厂兼容的周期性极化（TFLN 器件集成的主要瓶颈之一）以及 TFLN 畴壁器件的写入和擦除操作提供了指导。

articles.title: Topological Acoustic Metamaterials with Synthetic Magnetism: Observation of Hofstadter Spectrum and Topological Edge States
articles.title_zh: 具有合成磁性的拓扑声学超材料：霍夫施塔特谱和拓扑边缘态的观察
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.02262v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Architected materials are increasingly used to implement topological dynamics, yet realizing the gauge fields and symmetries that protect the topology with purely passive elements remains the central practical challenge. Here we turn a previously proposed theoretical strategy into an integrated platform that accepts a theoretical model as input and returns a passive acoustic metamaterial with identical dynamics. We demonstrate it experimentally on the Hofstadter model at θ = 2π/3, fabricating a spin-Chern insulator whose two sectors carry Chern numbers Cₛ = ± 1, and observe the predicted helical edge states.
articles.abstract_zh: 建筑材料越来越多地用于实现拓扑动力学，但利用纯无源元件实现保护拓扑的规范场和对称性仍然是主要的实际挑战。在这里，我们将先前提出的理论策略转变为一个集成平台，该平台接受理论模型作为输入，并返回具有相同动力学的无源声学超材料。我们在 θ = 2π/3 的 Hofstadter 模型上进行了实验证明，制造了一个自旋陈绝缘体，其两个扇区带有陈数 Cₛ = ± 1，并观察预测的螺旋边缘态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 建筑材料越来越多地用于实现拓扑动力学，但利用纯无源元件实现保护拓扑的规范场和对称性仍然是主要的实际挑战。在这里，我们将先前提出的理论策略转变为一个集成平台，该平台接受理论模型作为输入，并返回具有相同动力学的无源声学超材料。我们在 θ = 2π/3 的 Hofstadter 模型上进行了实验证明，制造了一个自旋陈绝缘体，其两个扇区带有陈数 Cₛ = ± 1，并观察预测的螺旋边缘态。

articles.title: Lattice-Induced Splitting, Connectivity, and Topology of Anyon Bands
articles.title_zh: 任意能带的晶格诱导分裂、连通性和拓扑
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.02268v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fractional Chern insulators realize fractional quantum Hall states without external magnetic fields, while their underlying lattice periodicity allows otherwise dispersionless anyons to acquire finite bandwidth. Here we show that flux--lattice commensurability can also give rise to multiple anyon bands with nontrivial topology and symmetry-protected connectivity. In multiband vortexable systems, commensurability between the lattice periodicity and the effective magnetic unit cell of fractionally charged quasiholes leads to the folding of a quasihole Landau level into multiple bands. Interactions lift their degeneracy, producing dispersive bands with Chern numbers distinct from that of the parent quasihole Landau level. We further demonstrate that these Chern numbers can be redistributed through Dirac crossings under continuous deformations that preserve exact electronic flatness, while crystalline symmetries can enforce protected band touchings. Our results establish that fractionalized excitations can exhibit the rich band topology familiar from electronic Bloch bands, opening possibilities for nontrivial anyon dynamics beyond conventional Landau-level physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 分数陈绝缘体无需外部磁场即可实现分数量子霍尔态，而其底层晶格周期性允许无色散任意子获得有限带宽。在这里，我们证明通量-晶格可通约性也可以产生具有非平凡拓扑和对称保护连通性的多个任意子带。在多带涡旋系统中，晶格周期性与分数带电准空穴的有效磁晶胞之间的可通约性导致准空穴朗道能级折叠成多个能带。相互作用提升了它们的简并性，产生了陈数的色散带，其与母体准空洞朗道能级的色散带不同。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 分数陈绝缘体无需外部磁场即可实现分数量子霍尔态，而其底层晶格周期性允许无色散任意子获得有限带宽。在这里，我们证明通量-晶格可通约性也可以产生具有非平凡拓扑和对称保护连通性的多个任意子带。在多带涡旋系统中，晶格周期性与分数带电准空穴的有效磁晶胞之间的可通约性导致准空穴朗道能级折叠成多个能带。相互作用提升了它们的简并性，产生了陈数的色散带，其与母体准空洞朗道能级的色散带不同。我们进一步证明，这些陈数可以在连续变形下通过狄拉克穿越重新分布，从而保持精确的电子平坦度，而晶体对称性可以加强受保护的能带接触。我们的结果表明，分段激励可以表现出电子布洛赫能带中常见的丰富能带拓扑结构，为超越传统朗道级物理的非平凡任意子动力学提供了可能性。

articles.title: Defect Chemistry of Hafnia-Based Ferroelectrics under Oxide-Electrode Constraints
articles.title_zh: 氧化物电极约束下氧化铪基铁电体的缺陷化学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.02317v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: HfO₂ heterostructures with La₀.₆₇Sr₀.₃₃MnO₃ (LSMO) epitaxial electrodes have attracted interest as ferroelectric systems with electrode-dependent defect chemistry. However, the formation and stability of defects under LSMO-constrained chemical conditions remain poorly understood. In this work, we use density functional theory calculations to systematically investigate oxygen vacancies and La-, Sr-, and Mn-related interstitial and substitutional defects in HfO₂ under chemical environments constrained by the LSMO electrode. We find that LSMO stability substantially narrows the accessible O chemical potential range relative to bulk HfO₂, altering the predicted defect formation energies. While La and Sr substitutional defects are governed primarily by preferred ionic valence states, oxygen vacancies and Mn substitutional defects exhibit charge states sensitive to the local atomic environment. In addition, defect-complex calculations in orthorhombic HfO₂ reveal negative binding energies, indicating favorable defect association. The La- and Mn-related defect complexes exhibit thermodynamic competition, with their relative stability depending on the Fermi level and oxygen chemical potential. Lastly, extending the analysis to Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂ and ZrO₂ reveals common oxygen-vacancy trends, while the stability of LSMO-derived defects depends more strongly on the host material and crystal phase. These results provide a thermodynamic basis for understanding how electrode-constrained chemical environments and host structures influence defect formation, charge compensation, and defect-complex stability in HfO₂-based materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 具有 La₀.₆₇Sr₀.₃₃MnO₃ (LSMO) 外延电极的 HfO2 异质结构作为具有电极依赖性缺陷化学的铁电系统引起了人们的兴趣。然而，人们对 LSMO 限制化学条件下缺陷的形成和稳定性仍然知之甚少。在这项工作中，我们使用密度泛函理论计算来系统地研究 LSMO 电极限制的化学环境下 HfO2 中的氧空位以及 La、Sr 和 Mn 相关的间隙和替代缺陷。我们发现，相对于块状 HfO2，LSMO 稳定性大大缩小了可接近的 O 化学势范围，从而改变了预测的缺陷形成能。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 具有 La₀.₆₇Sr₀.₃₃MnO₃ (LSMO) 外延电极的 HfO2 异质结构作为具有电极依赖性缺陷化学的铁电系统引起了人们的兴趣。然而，人们对 LSMO 限制化学条件下缺陷的形成和稳定性仍然知之甚少。在这项工作中，我们使用密度泛函理论计算来系统地研究 LSMO 电极限制的化学环境下 HfO2 中的氧空位以及 La、Sr 和 Mn 相关的间隙和替代缺陷。我们发现，相对于块状 HfO2，LSMO 稳定性大大缩小了可接近的 O 化学势范围，从而改变了预测的缺陷形成能。虽然 La 和 Sr 替代缺陷主要受优选离子价态控制，但氧空位和 Mn 替代缺陷表现出对局部原子环境敏感的电荷态。此外，斜方晶系 HfO2 的缺陷复合体计算显示负结合能，表明有利的缺陷关联。 La 和 Mn 相关的缺陷配合物表现出热力学竞争，其相对稳定性取决于费米能级和氧化学势。最后，将分析扩展到 Hf0.5Zr0.5O2 和 ZrO2 揭示了常见的氧空位趋势，而 LSMO 衍生缺陷的稳定性更强烈地取决于主体材料和晶相。这些结果为理解电极约束的化学环境和主体结构如何影响 HfO2 基材料中的缺陷形成、电荷补偿和缺陷复合体稳定性提供了热力学基础。

articles.title: Imaging the Current Distribution in Superconducting Transition-Edge Sensors with Scanning SQUID Microscopy
articles.title_zh: 使用扫描 SQUID 显微镜对超导跃迁边缘传感器中的电流分布进行成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.02352v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Transition-edge sensors (TESs) exploit the resistive transition of a superconductor to detect minute changes in temperature. While significant progress has been made in understanding the temperature- and current-dependent resistive transition in these devices, important aspects of TES behavior under bias remain unresolved. In particular, existing TES models largely neglect spatial variations in the superconducting state and current distribution arising from device geometry and proximity effects associated with the superconducting leads and normal metal features. Using scanning superconducting quantum interference device (SQUID) microscopy (SSM), we directly image local superconducting properties and transport current in two molybdenum-gold (MoAu) X-ray TES designs. We measure the local diamagnetic response to identify superconducting regions in devices voltage-biased within the transition and the Oersted field generated by the transport current to reconstruct the corresponding current distribution. We observe bias-dependent reconfigurations of the current distribution that track current-induced changes in superconducting regions, highlighting the importance of mesoscale spatial variations for TES device physics, operation, and design.
articles.abstract_zh: 过渡边缘传感器 (TES) 利用超导体的电阻过渡来检测温度的微小变化。虽然在了解这些器件中与温度和电流相关的电阻转变方面已经取得了重大进展，但偏压下 TES 行为的重要方面仍未得到解决。特别是，现有的 TES 模型很大程度上忽略了超导状态的空间变化以及由器件几何形状和与超导引线和正常金属特征相关的邻近效应引起的电流分布。使用扫描超导量子干涉装置 (SQUID) 显微镜 (SSM)，我们直接对两种钼金 (MoAu) X 射线 TES 设计中的局部超导特性和传输电流进行成像。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 过渡边缘传感器 (TES) 利用超导体的电阻过渡来检测温度的微小变化。虽然在了解这些器件中与温度和电流相关的电阻转变方面已经取得了重大进展，但偏压下 TES 行为的重要方面仍未得到解决。特别是，现有的 TES 模型很大程度上忽略了超导状态的空间变化以及由器件几何形状和与超导引线和正常金属特征相关的邻近效应引起的电流分布。使用扫描超导量子干涉装置 (SQUID) 显微镜 (SSM)，我们直接对两种钼金 (MoAu) X 射线 TES 设计中的局部超导特性和传输电流进行成像。我们测量局部抗磁响应，以识别跃迁内电压偏置的器件中的超导区域，以及传输电流产生的奥斯特场，以重建相应的电流分布。我们观察了电流分布的偏置相关重构，跟踪超导区域中电流引起的变化，强调了介观空间变化对于 TES 器件物理、操作和设计的重要性。

articles.title: Fermi surface and field-induced Lifshitz transition in the antiferromagnet NbMnP exhibiting an anomalous Hall effect
articles.title_zh: 反铁磁体 NbMnP 中的费米表面和场诱导的 Lifshitz 跃迁表现出反常霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.02360v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We performed Shubnikov--de Haas (SdH) oscillation measurements on the Q=0 antiferromagnet NbMnP, which exhibits a large anomalous Hall effect. The SdH frequencies observed in the low-field region up to 17.5~T are well described by first-principles band-structure calculations based on the B₃g+B₂ᵤ noncollinear magnetic structure determined by neutron diffraction. The effective masses are enhanced by approximately a factor of two relative to the calculated band masses. High-field measurements up to 41.5~T reveal a Lifshitz transition accompanied by a pronounced evolution of the SdH frequency spectrum. These results confirm that first-principles calculations provide a reliable tool for the development of functional antiferromagnetic materials, while also demonstrating that field-induced changes in the Fermi surface itself need to be taken into account in understanding their high-field magnetotransport properties.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们对 Q=0 反铁磁体 NbMnP 进行了舒布尼科夫-德哈斯 (SdH) 振荡测量，该反铁磁体表现出较大的反常霍尔效应。基于中子衍射确定的 B₃g+B2ᵤ 非共线磁结构，第一性原理能带结构计算很好地描述了在高达 17.5~T 的低场区域观测到的 SdH 频率。有效质量相对于计算的带质量大约增加了两倍。高达 41.5~T 的高场测量揭示了 Lifshitz 跃迁，并伴随着 SdH 频谱的显着演变。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们对 Q=0 反铁磁体 NbMnP 进行了舒布尼科夫-德哈斯 (SdH) 振荡测量，该反铁磁体表现出较大的反常霍尔效应。基于中子衍射确定的 B₃g+B2ᵤ 非共线磁结构，第一性原理能带结构计算很好地描述了在高达 17.5~T 的低场区域观测到的 SdH 频率。有效质量相对于计算的带质量大约增加了两倍。高达 41.5~T 的高场测量揭示了 Lifshitz 跃迁，并伴随着 SdH 频谱的显着演变。这些结果证实，第一性原理计算为功能性反铁磁材料的开发提供了可靠的工具，同时也证明了在理解其高场磁输运特性时需要考虑费米表面本身的场引起的变化。

articles.title: Full edge control of bulk energy gap in armchair graphene nanoribbons
articles.title_zh: 扶手椅石墨烯纳米带体能隙的全边缘控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.02367v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In solid-state physics, the ability to open and tune an electronic energy gap provides a direct route to controlling charge transport and accessing distinct electronic phases. In solids with physical boundaries, a bulk energy gap formed exclusively by extended bulk states is conventionally expected to be governed primarily by the interior bulk region, with only a minor contribution from the boundaries. Here we show that, in stark contrast to this conventional expectation, the bulk gap of armchair graphene nanoribbons in the N_w=3p+2 family with pinZge 0 can be fully controlled through the hoppings solely at the boundaries. This full boundary control originates from an exact cancellation between the gap contributions of long-range hoppings along and across the ribbon in the bulk region. It persists in the presence of Hubbard interactions and holds irrespective of ribbon width in this family. Our findings establish boundary dynamics as an unexpectedly powerful means of manipulating bulk electronic properties, enabling width-preserving engineering of one-dimensional (1D) band structures and topological phases, with potential applications in qubits, artificial quantum spin chains, topological quantum dots and other quantum devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 在固态物理学中，打开和调整电子能隙的能力提供了控制电荷传输和访问不同电子相的直接途径。在具有物理边界的固体中，通常预计仅由扩展的体态形成的体能隙主要由内部体区控制，而边界的贡献很小。在这里，我们表明，与这种传统期望形成鲜明对比的是，pinZge 0 的 N_w=3p+2 族中扶手椅石墨烯纳米带的体积间隙可以通过仅在边界处的跳跃来完全控制。这种完整的边界控制源于大块区域中沿带和跨带的长程跳跃的间隙贡献之间的精确抵消。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在固态物理学中，打开和调整电子能隙的能力提供了控制电荷传输和访问不同电子相的直接途径。在具有物理边界的固体中，通常预计仅由扩展的体态形成的体能隙主要由内部体区控制，而边界的贡献很小。在这里，我们表明，与这种传统期望形成鲜明对比的是，pinZge 0 的 N_w=3p+2 族中扶手椅石墨烯纳米带的体积间隙可以通过仅在边界处的跳跃来完全控制。这种完整的边界控制源于大块区域中沿带和跨带的长程跳跃的间隙贡献之间的精确抵消。它在存在哈伯德相互作用的情况下持续存在，并且无论该家族中的带宽度如何都保持不变。我们的研究结果表明，边界动力学是一种意想不到的强大手段，可以操纵体电子特性，实现一维 (1D) 能带结构和拓扑相的保宽工程，在量子位、人工量子自旋链、拓扑量子点和其他量子器件中具有潜在应用。

articles.title: Machine-Learned Interatomic Potential for the Mo-S-Al-O System
articles.title_zh: Mo-S-Al-O 系统的机器学习原子间势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.02403v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a machine-learned neuroevolution potential (NEP) for the Mo-S-Al-O system, targeting MoS₂ heteroepitaxy on c-plane sapphire, α-Al₂O₃(0001). The potential is trained on 63,611 PBE+D3 structures distilled from about 1.1 million curated density-functional-theory (DFT) configurations, using an energy-difference loss function that directly targets interfacial and orientation-dependent energies. On held-out data, the energy and force errors are 29 meV/atom and 0.23 eV/mathringA. Validated against DFT on a suite of physical properties, the NEP reproduces the lattice constants within 0.3 %, the elastic constants within 17 %, the phonon dispersions with mean deviations below 2.5%, and the surface energies within 1.3 %. At the MoS₂/sapphire interface, it reproduces the adhesion energy minimum within 0.8 %, the interfacial energy within 2.2 % and the most stable orientation of the monolayer. It preserves the DFT-predicted energetic ordering of edges, point defects (Spearman ρ = 0.995) and mirror-twin boundaries (ρ = 1.0), and reproduces tilt grain-boundary energies within 8 % (ρ = 0.98) and stacking-fault energy barriers within 14 %. The resulting potential enables future studies of the atomic-scale mechanisms of defect formation in two-dimensional heteroepitaxy.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们开发了一种适用于 Mo-S-Al-O 系统的机器学习神经进化势 (NEP)，目标是 c 面蓝宝石 α-Al2O₃(0001) 上的 MoS2 异质外延。使用直接针对界面和方向相关能量的能量差损失函数，对从约 110 万个精心设计的密度泛函理论 (DFT) 配置中提取的 63,611 个 PBE+D3 结构进行了训练。根据保留的数据，能量和力误差为 29 meV/atom 和 0.23 eV/mathringA。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们开发了一种适用于 Mo-S-Al-O 系统的机器学习神经进化势 (NEP)，目标是 c 面蓝宝石 α-Al2O₃(0001) 上的 MoS2 异质外延。使用直接针对界面和方向相关能量的能量差损失函数，对从约 110 万个精心设计的密度泛函理论 (DFT) 配置中提取的 63,611 个 PBE+D3 结构进行了训练。根据保留的数据，能量和力误差为 29 meV/atom 和 0.23 eV/mathringA。通过 DFT 对一系列物理特性进行验证，NEP 的晶格常数再现误差在 0.3% 以内，弹性常数误差在 17% 以内，声子色散的平均偏差低于 2.5%，表面能误差在 1.3% 以内。在MoS2/蓝宝石界面，它再现了0.8%以内的最小粘附能、2.2%以内的界面能以及最稳定的单层取向。它保留了 DFT 预测的边缘、点缺陷 (Spearman ρ = 0.995) 和镜像孪晶边界 (ρ = 1.0) 的能量排序，并再现了 8% 以内的倾斜晶界能量 (ρ = 0.98) 和 14% 以内的堆垛层错能垒。由此产生的潜力使得未来能够研究二维异质外延中缺陷形成的原子尺度机制。

articles.title: Observation of Superconductivity in a Cu-Rich High-Entropy Alloy
articles.title_zh: 富铜高熵合金超导性的观察
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.02469v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A Cu-rich multielement alloy containing Zn, Sn, Ag, and Au was synthesized and studied to explore its structural and physical properties. The alloy was prepared by vacuum-sealed melting of high-purity elements followed by rapid quenching in cold water. Powder X-ray diffraction confirms that the alloy crystallizes in a face-centered cubic (fcc) Cu-type structure. Field-emission scanning electron microscopy and energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDS) mapping show uniform distribution of all constituent elements. Magnetic measurements indicate the appearance of a superconducting transition at low temperature, while electrical resistivity remains metallic without reaching zero resistance. This difference between magnetic and transport behaviour suggests that the superconducting state may be limited to local or partial regions within the sample. These findings indicate that the Cu-rich multielement alloy exhibits unusual low-temperature properties and may represent a new class of compositionally complex Cu-based materials with superconducting characteristics.
articles.abstract_zh: 合成并研究了含有 Zn、Sn、Ag 和 Au 的富铜多元合金，以探索其结构和物理性能。该合金是通过真空密封熔化高纯度元素，然后在冷水中快速淬火来制备的。粉末 X 射线衍射证实该合金以面心立方 (fcc) 铜型结构结晶。场发射扫描电子显微镜和能量色散 X 射线光谱 (EDS) 图显示所有组成元素的均匀分布。磁测量表明在低温下出现超导转变，而电阻率保持金属状态而没有达到零电阻。磁性和传输行为之间的差异表明超导状态可能仅限于样品内的局部或部分区域。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 合成并研究了含有 Zn、Sn、Ag 和 Au 的富铜多元合金，以探索其结构和物理性能。该合金是通过真空密封熔化高纯度元素，然后在冷水中快速淬火来制备的。粉末 X 射线衍射证实该合金以面心立方 (fcc) 铜型结构结晶。场发射扫描电子显微镜和能量色散 X 射线光谱 (EDS) 图显示所有组成元素的均匀分布。磁测量表明在低温下出现超导转变，而电阻率保持金属状态而没有达到零电阻。磁性和传输行为之间的差异表明超导状态可能仅限于样品内的局部或部分区域。这些发现表明，富铜多元素合金表现出不寻常的低温性能，可能代表一类具有超导特性的新型成分复杂的铜基材料。

articles.title: Galilean electrodynamics fluctuation in a superfluid: from general coordinate invariance to Tkachenko mode
articles.title_zh: 超流体中的伽利略电动力学涨落：从一般坐标不变性到特卡琴科模式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.02482v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We explore coupling the Galilean electrodynamics (GED) to an s-wave superfluid. Governed by the general coordinate invariance, the proposed effective Lagrangian hosts an unconventional superfluid whose mass is shifted by the GED gauge multiplet.
