We compute its electromagnetic and gravitational responses in the linear regime. In the long-wavelength limit, we discover a vanishing pressure response, and remarkably the collective mode assumes a quadratic dispersion relation reminiscent of the Tkachenko mode in an oscillating vortex lattice in (2+1) dimensions. We further demonstrate that the soft sector of the vortex lattice model is a GED in disguise, and illustrate the relation between the gauge multiplet and the Lifshitz scalar in the lowest-Landau-level regime of the vortex lattice.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们探索将伽利略电动力学 (GED) 与 s 波超流体耦合。在一般坐标不变性的控制下，所提出的有效拉格朗日拥有一种非常规超流体，其质量由 GED 规范多重态移动。我们计算其线性状态下的电磁和重力响应。在长波长极限下，我们发现压力响应消失，并且值得注意的是，集体模式呈现二次色散关系，让人想起 (2+1) 维振荡涡旋晶格中的特卡琴科模式。我们进一步证明了涡晶格模型的软扇区是变相的 GED，并说明了涡晶格最低朗道能级区域中规范多重态与 Lifshitz 标量之间的关系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们探索将伽利略电动力学 (GED) 与 s 波超流体耦合。在一般坐标不变性的控制下，所提出的有效拉格朗日拥有一种非常规超流体，其质量由 GED 规范多重态移动。我们计算其线性状态下的电磁和重力响应。在长波长极限下，我们发现压力响应消失，并且值得注意的是，集体模式呈现二次色散关系，让人想起 (2+1) 维振荡涡旋晶格中的特卡琴科模式。我们进一步证明了涡晶格模型的软扇区是变相的 GED，并说明了涡晶格最低朗道能级区域中规范多重态与 Lifshitz 标量之间的关系。

articles.title: For any static interaction the self-energy and vertex corrections to the electron-gas polarizability combine exactly into one integrand free of the Coulomb singularity
articles.title_zh: 对于任何静态相互作用，电子-气体极化率的自能和顶点校正精确地组合成一个不受库仑奇点影响的被积函数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.02514v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The first-order corrections to the polarizability of the uniform electron gas are a self-energy insertion and a vertex correction. For the Coulomb interaction the coefficient of q² in each diverges logarithmically at small wave vector, and the two divergences have opposite signs and cancel in their sum. This Note shows that for any interaction that depends only on the momentum it transfers, the two integrands combine exactly into one before any integration is done. At zero temperature the combined integrand has no Coulomb singularity and no chemical-potential counterterm. For screened interactions, which must be integrated numerically, it should be computed in place of the two diagrams. The Note gives the derivation and its physical reason, the one term added at finite temperature, and checks for bare, Yukawa and screened interactions. With a frequency-dependent interaction the combination is no longer exact.
articles.abstract_zh: 对均匀电子气极化率的一阶修正是自能插入和顶点修正。对于库仑相互作用，每个中的 q² 系数在小波矢量处呈对数发散，并且两个发散具有相反的符号并抵消它们的总和。本注释表明，对于仅依赖于其传递的动量的任何相互作用，在完成任何积分之前，两个被积函数完全合二为一。在零温度下，组合被积函数没有库仑奇点，也没有化学势反项。对于必须进行数字积分的筛选交互，应该用它来代替两个图进行计算。该注释给出了推导及其物理原因，在有限温度下添加的一项，并检查了裸相互作用、汤川相互作用和屏蔽相互作用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对均匀电子气极化率的一阶修正是自能插入和顶点修正。对于库仑相互作用，每个中的 q² 系数在小波矢量处呈对数发散，并且两个发散具有相反的符号并抵消它们的总和。本注释表明，对于仅依赖于其传递的动量的任何相互作用，在完成任何积分之前，两个被积函数完全合二为一。在零温度下，组合被积函数没有库仑奇点，也没有化学势反项。对于必须进行数字积分的筛选交互，应该用它来代替两个图进行计算。该注释给出了推导及其物理原因，在有限温度下添加的一项，并检查了裸相互作用、汤川相互作用和屏蔽相互作用。对于频率相关的相互作用，组合不再精确。

articles.title: Topological origin of the Gutenberg-Richter law: Dynamic decoupling of fault cascades and energy dissipation
articles.title_zh: 古腾堡-里希特定律的拓扑起源：故障级联和能量耗散的动态解耦
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.02541v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Gutenberg-Richter (G-R) law is seismology's most robust empirical regularity, yet a first-principles derivation of its slope-the b-value-has remained elusive. Here, we present an analytical theory based on a finite hierarchical fault network composed of velocity-weakening asperities separated by velocity-strengthening creeping zones. By coupling network topology with fracture mechanics, we derive a generalized closed-form expression of b-value,(b=frac33+2γfraclog₁₀klog₁₀q), where k is the threshold branching ratio and q is the area amplification factor. Crucially, we reveal a dynamic decoupling between k and q governed by energy dissipation. The empirical universality of b=1 naturally emerges as the fault network self-organizes into a critical attractor (k=q) that maximizes two-dimensional spatial filling. Furthermore, grounded in Rate-and-State Friction rheology, we demonstrate that foreshock acceleration (inverse-Omori) and aftershock decay (Omori-Utsu) are dual manifestations of the similar hierarchical cascade. In the mean-field limit, these temporal exponents are decoupled from static fracture energy, revealing a profound orthogonality between time-dependent friction and static energy release. By unifying the G-R law, Bath's law, and the foreshock-aftershock asymmetry, this framework might provide a physics-based pathway for operational earthquake forecasting.
articles.abstract_zh: 古腾堡-里希特 (G-R) 定律是地震学中最稳健的经验规律，但其斜率（b 值）的第一性原理推导仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们提出了一种基于有限分层断层网络的分析理论，该网络由速度减弱的粗糙体和速度增强的蠕变区域分开组成。通过将网络拓扑与断裂力学耦合，我们推导出b值的广义闭式表达式（b=frac33+2γfraclog₁₀klog₁₀q），其中k是阈值分支比，q是面积放大因子。至关重要的是，我们揭示了 k 和 q 之间受能量耗散控制的动态解耦。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 古腾堡-里希特 (G-R) 定律是地震学中最稳健的经验规律，但其斜率（b 值）的第一性原理推导仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们提出了一种基于有限分层断层网络的分析理论，该网络由速度减弱的粗糙体和速度增强的蠕变区域分开组成。通过将网络拓扑与断裂力学耦合，我们推导出b值的广义闭式表达式（b=frac33+2γfraclog₁₀klog₁₀q），其中k是阈值分支比，q是面积放大因子。至关重要的是，我们揭示了 k 和 q 之间受能量耗散控制的动态解耦。当断层网络自组织成一个最大化二维空间填充的关键吸引子 (k=q) 时，b=1 的经验普遍性自然而然地出现。此外，基于速率和状态摩擦流变学，我们证明前震加速（逆大森）和余震衰减（大森宇）是类似分级级联的双重表现。在平均场极限下，这些时间指数与静态断裂能解耦，揭示了随时间变化的摩擦力与静态能量释放之间的深刻正交性。通过统一 G-R 定律、巴斯定律和前震-余震不对称性，该框架可能为地震预报提供基于物理的途径。

articles.title: Magnetically and electrically tunable nonlinear Hall effect in Tt-symmetric antiferromagnets
articles.title_zh: Tt 对称反铁磁体中磁电可调谐非线性霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.02567v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tt-symmetric antiferromagnets can exhibit multiferroicity with coexisting ferroelectricity and magnetic order, and thus host multiple order-parameter configurations. However, how to electrically read out these configurations is an issue meriting further investigation. Here, by combining tight-binding and first-principles calculations, we propose electrically and magnetically tunable nonlinear Hall transport in ferroelectric Tt-symmetric antiferromagnets. Model calculations show that ferroelectric switching can reverse the sign of the Berry curvature dipole (BCD), whereas the Neel vector rotation modulates its magnitude, allowing both ferroelectric and magnetic order to be reflected in the nonlinear Hall signal. First-principles calculations of the VOCl2 monolayer confirm these behaviors and predict a sizable BCD that gives rise to a potentially detectable Hall voltage. Our findings open up opportunities to integrate electrical and magnetic modulations of the nonlinear Hall effect within a single material, with potential applications in multi-state information encoding and readout in antiferromagnetic spintronics.
articles.abstract_zh: Tt对称反铁磁体可以表现出铁电性和磁序共存的多铁性，因此具有多种有序参数配置。然而，如何以电方式读出这些配置是一个值得进一步研究的问题。在这里，通过结合紧束缚和第一原理计算，我们提出了铁电 Tt 对称反铁磁体中电学和磁学可调的非线性霍尔传输。模型计算表明，铁电开关可以反转贝里曲率偶极子 (BCD) 的符号，而尼尔矢量旋转可以调制其幅度，从而允许铁电和磁序在非线性霍尔信号中反映出来。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Tt对称反铁磁体可以表现出铁电性和磁序共存的多铁性，因此具有多种有序参数配置。然而，如何以电方式读出这些配置是一个值得进一步研究的问题。在这里，通过结合紧束缚和第一原理计算，我们提出了铁电 Tt 对称反铁磁体中电学和磁学可调的非线性霍尔传输。模型计算表明，铁电开关可以反转贝里曲率偶极子 (BCD) 的符号，而尼尔矢量旋转可以调制其幅度，从而允许铁电和磁序在非线性霍尔信号中反映出来。 VOCl2 单层的第一性原理计算证实了这些行为，并预测了一个相当大的 BCD，该 BCD 会产生潜在可检测的霍尔电压。我们的研究结果为将非线性霍尔效应的电和磁调制集成在单一材料中提供了机会，并在反铁磁自旋电子学的多态信息编码和读出中具有潜在的应用。

articles.title: Collective dipole effects amplify field-driven ion transport in amorphous Li₃PO₄
articles.title_zh: 集体偶极子效应放大了非晶 Li₃PO₄ 中场驱动的离子传输
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.02617v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Amorphous solid electrolytes often outperform their crystalline counterparts, but how disorder shapes ionic transport under strong electric fields is poorly understood. We use molecular dynamics with a machine-learned interatomic potential and a machine-learned Born-effective-charge model to measure Li mobility in amorphous Li₃PO₄ and in a crystal with Li vacancies, from the linear to the strongly nonlinear regime. The amorphous phase shows a much stronger field enhancement, and we trace this to a collective dipole effect. The migrating ion carries the same charge in both phases. Alone it would not make the amorphous phase respond more strongly. What makes the difference is the environment. In the amorphous network the surrounding atoms move with the hop. Their motion makes the work the field performs vary widely between hops. Since hopping rates grow exponentially with the work, the most strongly assisted hops can dominate the drift. Disorder thus enhances field-driven transport through the environment rather than the carrier itself, a mechanism that may operate in disordered ion conductors in general.
articles.abstract_zh: 非晶固体电解质的性能通常优于晶体电解质，但人们对强电场下无序如何影响离子传输知之甚少。我们使用具有机器学习原子间势的分子动力学和机器学习的玻恩有效电荷模型来测量非晶态 Li₃PO₄ 和具有 Li 空位的晶体中的 Li 迁移率，从线性到强非线性状态。非晶相表现出更强的场增强，我们将其追溯到集体偶极子效应。迁移离子在两个相中都带有相同的电荷。单独使用它不会使非晶相响应更强烈。造成差异的是环境。在无定形网络中，周围的原子随着跳跃而移动。它们的运动使得场域所做的功在跳跃之间变化很大。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非晶固体电解质的性能通常优于晶体电解质，但人们对强电场下无序如何影响离子传输知之甚少。我们使用具有机器学习原子间势的分子动力学和机器学习的玻恩有效电荷模型来测量非晶态 Li₃PO₄ 和具有 Li 空位的晶体中的 Li 迁移率，从线性到强非线性状态。非晶相表现出更强的场增强，我们将其追溯到集体偶极子效应。迁移离子在两个相中都带有相同的电荷。单独使用它不会使非晶相响应更强烈。造成差异的是环境。在无定形网络中，周围的原子随着跳跃而移动。它们的运动使得场域所做的功在跳跃之间变化很大。由于跳跃率随着工作的进行呈指数增长，因此最强辅助的跳跃可以主导漂移。因此，无序增强了通过环境而不是载体本身的场驱动传输，这种机制通常可以在无序离子导体中起作用。

articles.title: Phonon Angular Momentum Multipoles and Nonlinear Thermal Responses
articles.title_zh: 声子角动量多极子和非线性热响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.02619v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chiral phonons carry angular momentum and couple lattice dynamics to magnetic and transport phenomena. In magnets, however, a systematic classification of momentum-space phonon angular momentum (PAM) textures and experimental signatures of the resulting thermal responses remain elusive. Here we classify the PAM textures for all 122 magnetic point groups (MPGs) using two equivalent approaches: directly solving the linear symmetry constraints on the multipole expansion coefficients and constructing the allowed textures from group-representation basis functions. Both methods yield the same fivefold classification according to the leading nonzero order: s-wave (monopole), p-wave (dipole), d-wave (quadrupole), f-wave (octupole), and g-wave (hexadecapole). We further show that a temperature gradient generates a nonequilibrium PAM density whose nth-order term in nabla T contains an energy-weighted PAM 2ⁿ-pole tensor and a kinematic remainder, thereby linking the response order and partial-wave channel through exact selection rules. Because the Berry curvature obeys the same symmetry constraints, this taxonomy is in one-to-one correspondence with Berry-curvature multipoles and their nonlinear Hall responses. We propose a cantilever torque measurement whose allowed angular harmonics are fixed by the MPG, with period 2π/n for a pure nth harmonic, providing a direct probe of the partial-wave content of PAM in both nonmagnetic and magnetic materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 手性声子携带角动量并将晶格动力学与磁和输运现象耦合。然而，在磁体中，动量空间声子角动量（PAM）纹理的系统分类和由此产生的热响应的实验特征仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们使用两种等效方法对所有 122 个磁点组 (MPG) 的 PAM 纹理进行分类：直接求解多极展开系数的线性对称约束并从组表示基函数构造允许的纹理。两种方法根据主要非零阶产生相同的五重分类：s 波（单极）、p 波（偶极）、d 波（四极）、f 波（八极）和 g 波（十六极）。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 手性声子携带角动量并将晶格动力学与磁和输运现象耦合。然而，在磁体中，动量空间声子角动量（PAM）纹理的系统分类和由此产生的热响应的实验特征仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们使用两种等效方法对所有 122 个磁点组 (MPG) 的 PAM 纹理进行分类：直接求解多极展开系数的线性对称约束并从组表示基函数构造允许的纹理。两种方法根据主要非零阶产生相同的五重分类：s 波（单极）、p 波（偶极）、d 波（四极）、f 波（八极）和 g 波（十六极）。我们进一步表明，温度梯度产生非平衡 PAM 密度，其 nabla T 中的 n 阶项包含能量加权 PAM 2ⁿ 极张量和运动学余数，从而通过精确的选择规则将响应阶次和部分波通道联系起来。由于贝里曲率遵循相同的对称约束，因此该分类法与贝里曲率多极子及其非线性霍尔响应一一对应。我们提出了一种悬臂梁扭矩测量，其允许的角谐波由 MPG 固定，纯 n 次谐波的周期为 2π/n，为非磁性和磁性材料中 PAM 的部分波含量提供直接探测。

articles.title: Competing interaction driven broad magnetic entropy distribution in triangular net compounds Ba₃RE(BO₃)₃, RE= Dy and Ho
articles.title_zh: 三角网化合物 Ba₃RE(BO₃)₃ 中竞争相互作用驱动宽磁熵分布，RE= Dy 和 Ho
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.02703v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Triangular magnetic lattices have attracted significant attention as a model platform for exploring frustrated magnetism and quantum spin liquids, particularly in rare-earth-based systems. These materials also hold considerable promise for cryogenic magnetic refrigeration. In this work, we investigate the magnetic and magnetocaloric properties of the rare-earth (RE) based compounds Ba₃RE(BO₃)₃ (RE = Dy and Ho). Polycrystalline samples synthesized via a solid-state reaction method crystallize in a hexagonal structure with the space group P6₃mc, featuring triangular nets separated by approximately 8.8~Å along the c-axis. Detailed magnetic investigation reveals a deviation from pure paramagnetic behavior at low temperatures (T < 20 K). This is further corroborated by isothermal magnetization measurements, which exhibit non-overlapping M vs. H/T plots and reduced magnetization moments, suggesting significant crystal electric field (CEF) splitting of localized f-states. For an applied magnetic field change of 70 kOe, the maximum entropy change (Relative Cooling Power) reaches 4.2 J kg⁻¹ K⁻¹ (204 J kg⁻¹) and 7.3 J kg⁻¹ K⁻¹ (230 J kg⁻¹) for the Dy- and Ho-based compounds, respectively. Overall, the positive slopes of Arrott plots, the universal scaling behaviour of Δ Sₘ/Δ Sₘmax versus reduced temperature (t), and the field exponent c of the RCP versus H curves indicate a second-order nature of entropy distribution, making them promising candidates for magnetocalorics in the millikelvin range.
articles.abstract_zh: 三角形磁晶格作为探索受挫磁性和量子自旋液体的模型平台引起了极大的关注，特别是在稀土系统中。这些材料在低温磁制冷方面也具有广阔的前景。在这项工作中，我们研究了稀土 (RE) 基化合物 Ba₃RE(BO₃)₃（RE = Dy 和 Ho）的磁性和磁热特性。通过固态反应方法合成的多晶样品结晶为空间群为 P6₃mc 的六方结构，具有沿 c 轴间隔约 8.8~Å 的三角形网。详细的磁性研究揭示了低温（T < 20 K）下纯顺磁行为的偏差。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 三角形磁晶格作为探索受挫磁性和量子自旋液体的模型平台引起了极大的关注，特别是在稀土系统中。这些材料在低温磁制冷方面也具有广阔的前景。在这项工作中，我们研究了稀土 (RE) 基化合物 Ba₃RE(BO₃)₃（RE = Dy 和 Ho）的磁性和磁热特性。通过固态反应方法合成的多晶样品结晶为空间群为 P6₃mc 的六方结构，具有沿 c 轴间隔约 8.8~Å 的三角形网。详细的磁性研究揭示了低温（T < 20 K）下纯顺磁行为的偏差。等温磁化测量进一步证实了这一点，等温磁化测量显示出不重叠的 M 与 H/T 图和减小的磁化矩，表明局部 f 态存在显着的晶体电场 (CEF) 分裂。对于 70 kOe 的外加磁场变化，Dy 基和 Ho 基化合物的最大熵变（相对冷却功率）分别达到 4.2 J kg-1 K-1 (204 J kg-1) 和 7.3 J kg-1 K-1 (230 J kg-1)。总体而言，Arrott 图的正斜率、Δ Sₘ/Δ Sₘmax 与降低温度 (t) 的通用标度行为以及 RCP 与 H 曲线的场指数 c 表明熵分布的二阶性质，使它们成为毫开尔文范围内磁热学的有希望的候选者。

articles.title: High-Entropy A-Site Disorder Enhances Oxygen Evolution Reaction Activity and Stability in Nickelate Thin Films
articles.title_zh: 高熵 A 位无序增强镍酸盐薄膜中的析氧反应活性和稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.02796v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rare-earth nickelates are among the most active oxide electrocatalysts for the oxygen evolution reaction (OER), owing to their tunable Ni-O covalency, near-unity eg occupancy, and sensitivity to A-site chemistry, oxygen stoichiometry, and epitaxial strain. Here, we use epitaxial A-site high-entropy (La0.2Pr0.2Nd0.2Sm0.2Eu0.2)NiO3 thin films to reveal how epitaxial strain influences defect formation, Ni valence, electronic structure, and OER activity in a chemically disordered rare-earth (RE) sublattice. Tensile strain promotes Ruddlesden-Popper fault formation, interrupts the corner-sharing NiO6 network, and lowers the average Ni oxidation state. Although the occupied density of states near the Fermi level remains largely unchanged, O K-edge X-ray absorption spectroscopy reveals increased low-energy unoccupied states under tensile strain. First-principles calculations suggest that tensile strain shifts RE 4f-derived states toward the Fermi level, enhancing RE 4f-O 2p-Ni 3d hybridization. These coupled structural and electronic changes lead to earlier OER onset, stronger pre-catalytic Ni redox features, and higher activity than compressively strained films and representative single-A-site nickelates. The high-entropy nickelate also shows enhanced resistance to OER-induced structural degradation compared with LaNiO3. These results suggest that A-site configurational disorder and epitaxial strain can jointly tune defect formation and rare-earth-derived electronic states, providing a route for improving perovskite oxide electrocatalysts.
articles.abstract_zh: 稀土镍酸盐是析氧反应 (OER) 中最活跃的氧化物电催化剂之一，因为它们具有可调节的 Ni-O 共价、近乎一致的占据率以及对 A 位化学、氧化学计量和外延应变的敏感性。在这里，我们使用外延 A 位高熵 (La0.2Pr0.2Nd0.2Sm0.2Eu0.2)NiO3 薄膜来揭示外延应变如何影响化学无序稀土 (RE) 亚晶格中的缺陷形成、Ni 价态、电子结构和 OER 活性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 稀土镍酸盐是析氧反应 (OER) 中最活跃的氧化物电催化剂之一，因为它们具有可调节的 Ni-O 共价、近乎一致的占据率以及对 A 位化学、氧化学计量和外延应变的敏感性。在这里，我们使用外延 A 位高熵 (La0.2Pr0.2Nd0.2Sm0.2Eu0.2)NiO3 薄膜来揭示外延应变如何影响化学无序稀土 (RE) 亚晶格中的缺陷形成、Ni 价态、电子结构和 OER 活性。拉伸应变促进 Ruddlesden-Popper 断层的形成，中断共享角的 NiO6 网络，并降低平均 Ni 氧化态。尽管费米能级附近的占据态密度基本保持不变，但 O K 边 X 射线吸收光谱揭示了拉伸应变下低能未占据态的增加。第一性原理计算表明，拉伸应变将 RE 4f 衍生态移向费米能级，从而增强 RE 4f-O 2p-Ni 3d 杂化。这些耦合的结构和电子变化导致 OER 更早开始、更强的预催化 Ni 氧化还原特性以及比压缩应变薄膜和代表性单 A 位镍酸盐更高的活性。与 LaNiO3 相比，高熵镍酸盐还表现出更强的抗 OER 引起的结构降解的能力。这些结果表明，A位构型紊乱和外延应变可以共同调节缺陷形成和稀土衍生的电子态，为改进钙钛矿氧化物电催化剂提供了一条途径。

articles.title: Cluster Condensation and Symmetry-Protected Thermal Rigidity of Bose gases on the Haldane Sphere
articles.title_zh: 霍尔丹球上玻色气体的团簇凝聚和对称保护热刚性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.02799v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that a spinless Bose gas on a Haldane sphere with a small monopole charge (q) realizes, in the lowest Landau level (LLL), an exactly solvable SU(2)-protected cluster condensate: a Hafnian condensate of two-boson singlets for (q=1), analogous to resonating-valence-bond singlet coverings, and a four-boson singlet condensate for (q=3/2). Unlike topologically protected quantum Hall states, the exactness of these states relies only on SU(2) symmetry and repulsiveness, with no pseudopotential fine-tuning. Their SU(2)-protected degeneracy renders the single-particle correlations exactly temperature-independent even as the clusters dissociate, a thermal rigidity absent in conventional Bose--Einstein condensates (BECs). Increasing the interaction drives a transition to a vortex BEC with spontaneously broken rotational symmetry.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们证明，具有小单极电荷 (q) 的 Haldane 球上的无自旋玻色气体在最低朗道能级 (LLL) 中实现了完全可解的 SU(2) 保护的团簇凝聚体：对于 (q=1) 来说是二玻色子单线态的哈夫尼凝聚体，类似于共振价键单线态覆盖物，对于对于 (q=1) 来说是四玻色子单线态凝聚体(q=3/2)。与拓扑保护的量子霍尔态不同，这些态的精确性仅依赖于 SU(2) 对称性和排斥性，没有赝势微调。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们证明，具有小单极电荷 (q) 的 Haldane 球上的无自旋玻色气体在最低朗道能级 (LLL) 中实现了完全可解的 SU(2) 保护的团簇凝聚体：对于 (q=1) 来说是二玻色子单线态的哈夫尼凝聚体，类似于共振价键单线态覆盖物，对于对于 (q=1) 来说是四玻色子单线态凝聚体(q=3/2)。与拓扑保护的量子霍尔态不同，这些态的精确性仅依赖于 SU(2) 对称性和排斥性，没有赝势微调。它们受 SU(2) 保护的简并性使得单粒子相关性完全与温度无关，即使团簇解离，这是传统玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚态 (BEC) 中不存在的热刚性。增加相互作用会驱动向旋转对称性自发破缺的涡流 BEC 的转变。

articles.title: Observing oscillations using the non-magnetic and magnetic spin Hall effect in a non-collinear antiferromagnet
articles.title_zh: 使用非共线反铁磁体中的非磁性和磁性自旋霍尔效应观察振荡
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.02804v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this study, it was observed that, in non-collinear IrMn3, both the non-magnetic spin Hall effect (NMSHE) and the magnetic spin Hall effect (MSHE) exhibit oscillations as the triangularly ordered magnetic moments of IrMn3 evolve with temperature. These oscillations are strongly influenced by the magnetic properties at the interface between IrMn3 and the adjacent material. Permalloy (Py), a ferromagnet, and platinum (Pt), a paramagnet, were employed as adjacent layers. Such experimental analyses demonstrate the pioneering nature of this phenomenon, which is validated through magnetoresistance measurements performed under different experimental conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 在这项研究中，观察到，在非共线 IrMn3 中，非磁自旋霍尔效应 (NMSHE) 和磁自旋霍尔效应 (MSHE) 都表现出振荡，因为 IrMn3 的三角有序磁矩随温度变化。这些振荡受到 IrMn3 和相邻材料之间界面处的磁性的强烈影响。采用坡莫合金（Py）（一种铁磁体）和铂（Pt）（一种顺磁体）作为相邻层。这些实验分析证明了这种现象的开创性，并通过在不同实验条件下进行的磁阻测量得到了验证。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这项研究中，观察到，在非共线 IrMn3 中，非磁自旋霍尔效应 (NMSHE) 和磁自旋霍尔效应 (MSHE) 都表现出振荡，因为 IrMn3 的三角有序磁矩随温度变化。这些振荡受到 IrMn3 和相邻材料之间界面处的磁性的强烈影响。采用坡莫合金（Py）（一种铁磁体）和铂（Pt）（一种顺磁体）作为相邻层。这些实验分析证明了这种现象的开创性，并通过在不同实验条件下进行的磁阻测量得到了验证。

articles.title: Magnetic order in Co[Cr(CN)₆]₂/₃· zH₂O and its interplay with correlated vacancy order
articles.title_zh: Co[Cr(CN)₆]2/₃·zH2O 中的磁序及其与相关空位序的相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.02820v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Prussian blue analogues (PBAs) are versatile hybrid framework materials that often exhibit local and long-range departures from their cubic parent structure, influencing their functionality. Long-range magnetic order is common in PBAs, owing to magnetic interactions between transition metal ions via bridging cyanide ligands in the structure. Here we report the magnetic structure of cobalt (II) hexacyanochromate, Co[Cr(CN)₆]₂/₃· zH₂O, determined using neutron powder diffraction. No evidence for magnetostriction at the magnetic ordering temperature is observed in contrast to the reported behaviour of a related PBA. Following experimental characterisation of the magnetic order of this PBA, we employ a simple Monte Carlo model to gain a better understanding of the relationship between hexacyanometallate vacancy distributions and magnetic ordering behaviour in these materials. This model shows that magnetic ordering is robust to the extent and nature of vacancy correlations, with only minor effects noticeable in the critical region, suggesting that PBAs with the same composition but different vacancy correlations might be expected to show similar magnetic behaviour.
articles.abstract_zh: 普鲁士蓝类似物 (PBA) 是一种多功能混合框架材料，通常表现出与其立方母体结构的局部和远距离偏离，从而影响其功能。由于过渡金属离子之间通过结构中桥接氰化物配体的磁相互作用，长程磁序在 PBA 中很常见。在这里，我们报告了使用中子粉末衍射测定的六氰基铬酸钴 (II) Co[Cr(CN)6]2/3·zH2O 的磁性结构。与相关 PBA 的报道行为相比，没有观察到磁有序温度下磁致伸缩的证据。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 普鲁士蓝类似物 (PBA) 是一种多功能混合框架材料，通常表现出与其立方母体结构的局部和远距离偏离，从而影响其功能。由于过渡金属离子之间通过结构中桥接氰化物配体的磁相互作用，长程磁序在 PBA 中很常见。在这里，我们报告了使用中子粉末衍射测定的六氰基铬酸钴 (II) Co[Cr(CN)6]2/3·zH2O 的磁性结构。与相关 PBA 的报道行为相比，没有观察到磁有序温度下磁致伸缩的证据。在对该 PBA 的磁有序进行实验表征后，我们采用简单的蒙特卡罗模型来更好地了解这些材料中六氰基金属盐空位分布与磁有序行为之间的关系。该模型表明，磁排序对于空位相关性的程度和性质而言是稳健的，在关键区域中只有轻微的影响，这表明具有相同成分但不同空位相关性的 PBA 可能会表现出类似的磁行为。

articles.title: Superinsulation, electric confinement in condensed matter
articles.title_zh: 超绝缘，凝聚态物质中的电约束
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.02841v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Superinsulation is the confining phase of condensed matter systems. It is a genuine quantum state of matter, dual to superconductivity, just as confinement in particle physics is dual to the Higgs phase. In contrast to hadron physics, the gauge field that becomes confining is not colour SU(3) but the conventional U(1) electromagnetic field. Superinsulation arises in superconductors with an emergent granular condensate when core-less XY vortices between condensate grains become tensionless, unobservable Dirac strings and magnetic monopoles are liberated and condense. This magnetic condensate confines electric fields into flux tubes, strings that generate a linear potential between Cooper pairs. These dual Abrikosov flux tubes give rise to infinite electrical resistance, persisting up to a finite deconfinement temperature. We shall review the theoretical framework of superinsulation together with its experimental validation, including the direct observation of the linear confining potential and we shall stress how phase-only approaches and disorder-based ideas for the phases around the superconductor-to-insulator transition are hard to reconcile with recent experimental observations.
articles.abstract_zh: 超绝缘是凝聚态物质系统的限制相。它是一种真正的物质量子态，与超导性具有双重性，就像粒子物理学中的限制与希格斯相具有双重性一样。与强子物理学相反，受到限制的规范场不是颜色 SU(3)，而是传统的 U(1) 电磁场。当凝聚颗粒之间的无芯 XY 涡流变得无张力、不可观测的狄拉克弦和磁单极子被释放并凝聚时，超导体中就会出现超绝缘现象，并出现颗粒凝聚。这种凝聚磁体将电场限制在通量管中，这些通量管在库珀对之间产生线性电势。这些双阿布里科索夫通量管产生无限电阻，持续到有限的解除限制温度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 超绝缘是凝聚态物质系统的限制相。它是一种真正的物质量子态，与超导性具有双重性，就像粒子物理学中的限制与希格斯相具有双重性一样。与强子物理学相反，受到限制的规范场不是颜色 SU(3)，而是传统的 U(1) 电磁场。当凝聚颗粒之间的无芯 XY 涡流变得无张力、不可观测的狄拉克弦和磁单极子被释放并凝聚时，超导体中就会出现超绝缘现象，并出现颗粒凝聚。这种凝聚磁体将电场限制在通量管中，这些通量管在库珀对之间产生线性电势。这些双阿布里科索夫通量管产生无限电阻，持续到有限的解除限制温度。我们将回顾超绝缘的理论框架及其实验验证，包括对线性限制势的直接观察，并且我们将强调超导体到绝缘体转变周围相的纯相方法和基于无序的想法如何难以与最近的实验观察相一致。

articles.title: Zero-field plasmon splitter: Controlled interaction between quantum anomalous Hall edge states
articles.title_zh: 零场等离子体分离器：量子反常霍尔边缘态之间的受控相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.02879v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The quantum anomalous Hall (QAH) effect provides chiral edge states without the need for an external magnetic field, but unlike in conventional quantum Hall systems, their trajectories cannot be readily controlled electrostatically. Here, we engineer Coulomb interactions between two spatially separated, counter-propagating QAH edge channels using a floating metallic island. Microwave measurements reveal frequency-dependent redistribution of injected edge plasmons between two output channels, demonstrating interaction-induced hybridization of the collective modes. A long-range interaction model quantitatively reproduces the response and reveals a very low plasmon velocity in the coupling region, strongly reduced by electrostatic screening. Our results establish engineered Coulomb coupling as a route to control collective excitations in QAH edge states and provide a building block for chiral plasmonic circuits and electron quantum optics in magnetic topological insulators.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子反常霍尔（QAH）效应无需外部磁场即可提供手性边缘态，但与传统的量子霍尔系统不同，它们的轨迹不能轻易地通过静电控制。在这里，我们使用浮动金属岛设计了两个空间分离、反向传播的 QAH 边缘通道之间的库仑相互作用。微波测量揭示了两个输出通道之间注入的边缘等离子体激元的频率依赖性重新分布，证明了相互作用引起的集体模式的杂交。长程相互作用模型定量地再现了响应，并揭示了耦合区域中非常低的等离激元速度，静电屏蔽大大降低了该速度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子反常霍尔（QAH）效应无需外部磁场即可提供手性边缘态，但与传统的量子霍尔系统不同，它们的轨迹不能轻易地通过静电控制。在这里，我们使用浮动金属岛设计了两个空间分离、反向传播的 QAH 边缘通道之间的库仑相互作用。微波测量揭示了两个输出通道之间注入的边缘等离子体激元的频率依赖性重新分布，证明了相互作用引起的集体模式的杂交。长程相互作用模型定量地再现了响应，并揭示了耦合区域中非常低的等离激元速度，静电屏蔽大大降低了该速度。我们的研究结果确立了工程库仑耦合作为控制 QAH 边缘态集体激发的途径，并为磁性拓扑绝缘体中的手性等离子体电路和电子量子光学提供了构建块。

articles.title: Anion Engineering Enables Concurrent Optimization of Phonon and Carrier Transport in AMg₂X₂ Zintl Thermoelectrics
articles.title_zh: 阴离子工程能够同时优化 AMg2X2 Zintl 热电材料中的声子和载流子传输
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.02961v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The simultaneous suppression of lattice heat transport and enhancement of carrier transport is central to the development of high-performance thermoelectric materials. Here, we investigate the microscopic mechanisms governing phonon and carrier transport in CaAl₂Si₂-type AMg₂X₂ (A = Ca, Sr, Ba; X = P, As, Sb, Bi) Zintl compounds using first-principles calculations, machine-learning interatomic potentials, and Boltzmann transport theory. As X changes from P to Bi, the widening phonon band gap restricts three-phonon scattering channels and increases the relative importance of four-phonon processes. In CaMg₂Bi₂ and BaMg₂Bi₂, four-phonon scattering dominates the relaxation of low-frequency heat-carrying modes at 900 K. The Bi-based series also exhibits an anomalous increase in lattice thermal conductivity from Ca to Ba despite the increasing cation mass. Mode-resolved analysis links the lower thermal conductivity of CaMg₂Bi₂ to reduced low-frequency group velocities and stronger anharmonic scattering, with Ca-related mid-frequency vibrations providing additional four-phonon scattering channels. Including both particle-like and coherent contributions, its lattice thermal conductivity reaches 0.23 W·m⁻¹K⁻¹ at 900 K. Meanwhile, the increasing covalent character of the vertical Mg-X bonds is accompanied by enhanced band-edge dispersion and reduced carrier effective masses. These electronic changes, together with conduction-band convergence, favor n-type transport and yield a predicted peak ZT of 3.68 at 900 K in CaMg₂Bi₂. These results elucidate the interplay of phonon spectral structure and higher-order anharmonicity in thermal transport, alongside the distinct electronic response to anion substitution.
articles.abstract_zh: 同时抑制晶格热传输和增强载流子传输是高性能热电材料开发的核心。在这里，我们利用第一性原理计算、机器学习原子间势和玻尔兹曼输运理论研究了 CaAl2Si2 型 AMg2X2（A = Ca、Sr、Ba；X = P、As、Sb、Bi）Zintl 化合物中控制声子和载流子输运的微观机制。当X从P变为Bi时，声子带隙变宽限制了三声子散射通道并增加了四声子过程的相对重要性。在 CaMg2Bi2 和 BaMg2Bi2 中，四声子散射在 900 K 时主导低频载热模式的弛豫。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 同时抑制晶格热传输和增强载流子传输是高性能热电材料开发的核心。在这里，我们利用第一性原理计算、机器学习原子间势和玻尔兹曼输运理论研究了 CaAl2Si2 型 AMg2X2（A = Ca、Sr、Ba；X = P、As、Sb、Bi）Zintl 化合物中控制声子和载流子输运的微观机制。当X从P变为Bi时，声子带隙变宽限制了三声子散射通道并增加了四声子过程的相对重要性。在 CaMg2Bi2 和 BaMg2Bi2 中，四声子散射在 900 K 时主导低频载热模式的弛豫。尽管阳离子质量增加，Bi 基系列还表现出从 Ca 到 Ba 的晶格热导率异常增加。模式解析分析将 CaMg2Bi2 的较低热导率与较低的低频群速度和较强的非简声散射联系起来，而与 Ca 相关的中频振动提供了额外的四声子散射通道。包括颗粒状和共格贡献，其晶格热导率在 900 K 时达到 0.23 W·m-1K-1。同时，垂直 Mg-X 键共价特性的增加伴随着带边色散的增强和载流子有效质量的降低。这些电子变化与导带会聚一起，有利于 n 型输运，并在 CaMg2Bi2 中产生 900 K 时预测的峰值 ZT 为 3.68。这些结果阐明了热传输中声子谱结构和高阶非谐性的相互作用，以及对阴离子取代的独特电子响应。

articles.title: Hidden variable Z₂ topological order in a bilayer kagomé antiferromagnet
articles.title_zh: 双层 Kagomé 反铁磁体中的隐变量 Z2 拓扑顺序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03073v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Topological orders in realistic systems are quite rare, raising one fundamental question of whether they might be harbored with hidden degrees of freedom rather than directly exposed in conventional spins or electrons. We here propose a set of hidden variables and their effective interactions in a bilayer kagomé antiferromagnet. By properly organizing four local states of the spin dimer into two pseudospin-1/2 variables (boldsymbolτ and boldsymbolμ), we identify a regime where an effective Balents-Fisher-Girvin model emerges, realizing a Z₂ topological order in the hidden boldsymbolτ sector while the auxiliary boldsymbolμ sector remains a trivial paramagnet. This hidden nature drastically alters the experimental manifestations. Physical spins map to composite objects, typically convolving fractionalized anyon continua with non-topological magnon excitations. Nevertheless, specific symmetry-selected channels, such as the longitudinal intralayer response, exclusively reveal the bare two-vison continuum without collective-mode dressing. Our findings demonstrate that the topological order could be buried in certain hidden and emergent degrees of freedom, pointing to a promising pathway for seeking elusive topological states disguised within hidden internal degrees of freedom.
articles.abstract_zh: 现实系统中的拓扑序相当罕见，这就提出了一个基本问题：它们是否可能隐藏着隐藏的自由度，而不是直接暴露在传统的自旋或电子中。我们在这里提出了一组隐藏变量及其在双层 Kagomé 反铁磁体中的有效相互作用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 现实系统中的拓扑序相当罕见，这就提出了一个基本问题：它们是否可能隐藏着隐藏的自由度，而不是直接暴露在传统的自旋或电子中。我们在这里提出了一组隐藏变量及其在双层 Kagomé 反铁磁体中的有效相互作用。通过将自旋二聚体的四个局域态适当地组织成两个赝自旋-1/2变量（boldsymbolτ和boldsymbolμ），我们确定了一种有效的Balents-Fisher-Girvin模型出现的机制，在隐藏的boldsymbolτ扇区中实现了Z2拓扑顺序，而辅助boldsymbolμ扇区仍然是一个平凡的顺磁体。这种隐藏的性质极大地改变了实验表现。物理自旋映射到复合物体，通常将分段任意子连续体与非拓扑磁振子激励进行卷积。然而，特定的对称选择通道，例如纵向层内响应，专门揭示了没有集体模式修整的裸露的双视觉连续体。我们的研究结果表明，拓扑顺序可能隐藏在某些隐藏的和涌现的自由度中，这为寻找隐藏的内部自由度中难以捉摸的拓扑状态提供了一条有希望的途径。

articles.title: Ultrafast Polar Topology Reversal via THz-Driven Inertial Switching
articles.title_zh: 通过太赫兹驱动惯性切换实现超快极性拓扑反转
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03108v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Topological polar structures in ferroelectric heterostructures offer functional states beyond ordinary domains. As polarization reversal underpins ferroelectric devices, switching between degenerate topological variants, which we refer to as topology reversal, would greatly expand the ways to control polar textures. However, polar topology reversal is challenging because it requires coordinated flipping of oppositely oriented local polarizations, a process not naturally driven by a uniform electric field. Using a multiscale modeling approach, we show that polar topology can be stabilized and reversed in a simple Pt/PbTiO₃/Pt nanocapacitor. Electrode-controlled boundary conditions drive tetragonal PbTiO₃ into competing orthorhombic- and rhombohedral-like polarization states, which form building blocks for diverse topological structures, including vortex arrays, skyrmion lattices, dipole spirals, and dipole waves. We further show that the same out-of-plane THz pulse can reversibly switch a double-mathbf q dipole wave between degenerate topological variants within a few picoseconds, while preserving its spatial modulation. This process is enabled by damping-assisted inertial switching, in which the THz pulse injects energy to drive large-angle polarization rotation across shallow barriers, while dissipation removes excess energy and traps the system in the reversed state. These results establish ferroelectric nanocapacitors as a simple platform for programmable polar topology and low-power, THz-speed control through dissipative dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 铁电异质结构中的拓扑极性结构提供了超出普通域的功能状态。由于极化反转是铁电器件的基础，简并拓扑变体之间的切换（我们称之为拓扑反转）将极大地扩展控制极性纹理的方法。然而，极性拓扑反转具有挑战性，因为它需要相反方向的局部极化的协调翻转，而这一过程并不是由均匀电场自然驱动的。使用多尺度建模方法，我们证明极性拓扑可以在简单的 Pt/PbTiO₃/Pt 纳米电容器中稳定和反转。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 铁电异质结构中的拓扑极性结构提供了超出普通域的功能状态。由于极化反转是铁电器件的基础，简并拓扑变体之间的切换（我们称之为拓扑反转）将极大地扩展控制极性纹理的方法。然而，极性拓扑反转具有挑战性，因为它需要相反方向的局部极化的协调翻转，而这一过程并不是由均匀电场自然驱动的。使用多尺度建模方法，我们证明极性拓扑可以在简单的 Pt/PbTiO₃/Pt 纳米电容器中稳定和反转。电极控制的边界条件驱动四方 PbTiO₃ 进入竞争的正交和菱面体偏振态，这些偏振态形成了不同拓扑结构的构建块，包括涡旋阵列、斯格明子晶格、偶极螺旋和偶极波。我们进一步表明，相同的面外太赫兹脉冲可以在几皮秒内在简并拓扑变体之间可逆地切换双 mathbf q 偶极子波，同时保留其空间调制。这一过程是通过阻尼辅助惯性切换实现的，其中太赫兹脉冲注入能量以驱动大角度偏振旋转穿过浅障碍，而耗散则消除多余的能量并将系统捕获在反向状态。这些结果将铁电纳米电容器建立为可编程极性拓扑和通过耗散动力学进行低功耗、太赫兹速度控制的简单平台。

articles.title: Synchronization and Spatiotemporal Phases in Driven Precessing Domain Walls
articles.title_zh: 驱动进动畴壁中的同步和时空相位
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03110v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The dynamics of extended magnetic domain walls driven by constant and alternating magnetic fields are studied using a collective coordinate u-φ model. While purely constant-field driven systems exhibit deterministic spatiotemporal chaos and roughening, the alternating component can lock the precessional frequency via Shapiro-like steps. Using linear stability analysis and Floquet theory, the phase boundaries of stable, synchronized flat wall states are mapped. By studying the nonlinear dynamics of the extended system, a rich phase diagram is identified, composed of five dynamical regimes characterized by the combination of domain wall spatial order (flat, rough, or periodic) and domain wall precession temporal order (pinned, synchronized, or unsynchronized). Notably, the macroscopic temporal order of the synchronized phases can lead to a flat domain wall or to a periodic structure dominated by a narrow band of linearly unstable modes, both with coherent precession of the domain wall magnetization, while unsynchronized phases can be flat, with coherent precession, or rough with spatiotemporal chaos and incoherent precession.
articles.abstract_zh: 使用集体坐标 u-φ 模型研究了恒定磁场和交变磁场驱动的扩展磁畴壁的动力学。虽然纯粹的恒定场驱动系统表现出确定性时空混沌和粗糙化，但交替分量可以通过类似夏皮罗的步骤锁定进动频率。使用线性稳定性分析和 Floquet 理论，绘制了稳定、同步的平坦壁态的相边界。通过研究扩展系统的非线性动力学，识别出丰富的相图，由五种动力学状态组成，其特征是畴壁空间顺序（平坦、粗糙或周期性）和畴壁进动时间顺序（固定、同步或不同步）的组合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 使用集体坐标 u-φ 模型研究了恒定磁场和交变磁场驱动的扩展磁畴壁的动力学。虽然纯粹的恒定场驱动系统表现出确定性时空混沌和粗糙化，但交替分量可以通过类似夏皮罗的步骤锁定进动频率。使用线性稳定性分析和 Floquet 理论，绘制了稳定、同步的平坦壁态的相边界。通过研究扩展系统的非线性动力学，识别出丰富的相图，由五种动力学状态组成，其特征是畴壁空间顺序（平坦、粗糙或周期性）和畴壁进动时间顺序（固定、同步或不同步）的组合。值得注意的是，同步相位的宏观时间顺序可以导致平坦的畴壁或由线性不稳定模式的窄带主导的周期性结构，两者都具有畴壁磁化的相干进动，而非同步相位可以是平坦的，具有相干进动，或者是粗糙的，具有时空混沌和不相干进动。

articles.title: Many-Body Correlations in Phase-Space Microscopes
articles.title_zh: 相空间显微镜中的多体相关性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03112v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The recently proposed "phase-space microscope" (PSM) extends quantum gas microscopes by allowing joint, single-shot measurements of position and momentum. We show that the n-body correlation functions constructed from such phase-space snapshots determine, in principle, all n-body observables of a many-body quantum state. This establishes phase-space imaging as a complete probe of strongly correlated matter, beyond what snapshots of position and momentum can provide---a limitation that goes back to a famous question posed by Pauli. Even without the full reconstruction of the density matrices, the PSM provides valuable insight into the quantum states. We demonstrate this power through several applications: witnessing entanglement hidden from both position and momentum, including between spatially separated collective degrees of freedom; resolving pairing structure across the BEC-BCS crossover, including the phase of the pair wavefunction and the reconstruction of its two-body Wigner function; probing inhomogeneous systems and preformed pairs without long-range order, relevant to the pseudogap phase; extracting the interaction energy in a magnetic field; and measurements of the local Chern marker. Furthermore, we discuss phase imprinting in the matter-wave Fourier plane as an alternative method for probing time-reversal-symmetry-broken phases such as chiral p-wave superconductors. Together, these results establish the PSM as a versatile new tool for exploring fundamental features of quantum many-body phases in strongly correlated quantum matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 最近提出的“相空间显微镜”（PSM）通过允许联合、单次测量位置和动量来扩展量子气体显微镜。我们证明，从这种相空间快照构建的 n 体相关函数原则上决定了多体量子态的所有 n 体可观测量。这将相空间成像建立为强相关物质的完整探测，超出了位置和动量快照所能提供的范围——这一限制可以追溯到泡利提出的一个著名问题。即使没有完全重建密度矩阵，PSM 也可以提供对量子态的有价值的见解。我们通过多种应用展示了这种力量：见证位置和动量隐藏的纠缠，包括空间上分离的集体自由度之间的纠缠；
articles.abstract_zh_full: 最近提出的“相空间显微镜”（PSM）通过允许联合、单次测量位置和动量来扩展量子气体显微镜。我们证明，从这种相空间快照构建的 n 体相关函数原则上决定了多体量子态的所有 n 体可观测量。这将相空间成像建立为强相关物质的完整探测，超出了位置和动量快照所能提供的范围——这一限制可以追溯到泡利提出的一个著名问题。即使没有完全重建密度矩阵，PSM 也可以提供对量子态的有价值的见解。我们通过多种应用展示了这种力量：见证位置和动量隐藏的纠缠，包括空间上分离的集体自由度之间的纠缠；解析 BEC-BCS 交叉的配对结构，包括配对波函数的相位及其二体维格纳函数的重建；探测与赝能隙相位相关的不均匀系统和没有长程有序的预成对；提取磁场中的相互作用能；以及当地陈标记的测量。此外，我们讨论了物质波傅立叶平面中的相位印记作为探测时间反转对称破缺相位（例如手征 p 波超导体）的替代方法。总之，这些结果使 PSM 成为一种多功能新工具，用于探索强相关量子物质中量子多体相的基本特征。

articles.title: Exact fermionic matrix elements from the Bethe-ansatz solution of the Richardson-Gaudin model
articles.title_zh: Richardson-Gaudin 模型的 Bethe-ansatz 解的精确费米子矩阵元素
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03141v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce an effective Hamiltonian description of mesoscopic superconducting systems based on the Bethe-ansatz solution of the Richardson--Gaudin model. Our central result is a compact determinant formula for the matrix elements of fermionic creation and annihilation operators, expressed entirely in terms of eigenvalue-based variables. This formula allows single-electron tunneling terms to be represented directly in the eigenbasis of the Richardson--Gaudin model, extending the eigenvalue-based framework beyond overlaps and previously known form factors. As a benchmark, we apply the method to a superconducting Anderson impurity model comprising a quantum dot coupled to an ultrasmall superconducting grain. The resulting low-energy description, formulated naturally in the canonical ensemble, captures even-odd effects, subgap excitations, and quantum-dot physics. The same framework gives access to observables not previously computed for such grain-dot systems in the canonical ensemble, such as the fixed-particle-number optical conductivity and flux-tunable spectra.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们基于 Richardson-Gaudin 模型的 Bethe-ansatz 解，引入了介观超导系统的有效哈密顿描述。我们的中心结果是费米子产生和湮灭算子的矩阵元素的紧凑行列式公式，完全用基于特征值的变量表示。该公式允许单电子隧道项直接在理查森-高丁模型的本征基中表示，将基于本征值的框架扩展到重叠和先前已知的形状因子之外。作为基准，我们将该方法应用于超导安德森杂质模型，该模型包含与超小型超导颗粒耦合的量子点。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们基于 Richardson-Gaudin 模型的 Bethe-ansatz 解，引入了介观超导系统的有效哈密顿描述。我们的中心结果是费米子产生和湮灭算子的矩阵元素的紧凑行列式公式，完全用基于特征值的变量表示。该公式允许单电子隧道项直接在理查森-高丁模型的本征基中表示，将基于本征值的框架扩展到重叠和先前已知的形状因子之外。作为基准，我们将该方法应用于超导安德森杂质模型，该模型包含与超小型超导颗粒耦合的量子点。由此产生的低能量描述，在规范系综中自然地表达出来，捕捉奇偶效应、亚能隙激发和量子点物理。相同的框架可以访问以前未针对规范系综中的此类粒点系统计算的可观测值，例如固定粒子数光导率和通量可调光谱。

articles.title: Enforced Gaplessness by Combining Non-Anomalous Symmetries
articles.title_zh: 通过结合非反常对称性强制无间隙
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03164v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Symmetry-enforced gaplessness is a phenomenon in which a quantum system is forced to be gapless due to its global symmetry. Previous works have mainly focused on anomalous symmetries. Another approach, using symmetry spans, which specify two embeddings of a common symmetry into two larger symmetries, was proposed by the authors. In this work, we show that a symmetry span can enforce gaplessness even when both larger symmetries are invertible and non-anomalous: each alone admits a trivially gapped phase, but because the embeddings differ by a twist associated with a symmetry-protected topological phase, the symmetry they generate admits no gapped phase with finitely many ground states. We present such a span of a finite group and U(1)² in 1+1 dimensions, with continuum realizations and a lattice Hamiltonian, with a finite-dimensional local Hilbert space and finitely many parameters, that is gapless in any region of its parameter space. We also discuss a 2+1-dimensional example and spans of only finite symmetries.
articles.abstract_zh: 对称强制无带隙是一种量子系统由于其全局对称性而被迫无带隙的现象。以前的工作主要集中在反常对称性上。作者提出了另一种方法，即使用对称跨度，将一个公共对称性的两个嵌入指定为两个更大的对称性。在这项工作中，我们证明，即使两个较大的对称性都是可逆且非反常的，对称跨度也可以强制无间隙：每个对称性都单独承认一个微不足道的带隙相，但由于嵌入因与对称性保护的拓扑相相关的扭曲而不同，因此它们生成的对称性不承认具有有限多个基态的带隙相。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对称强制无带隙是一种量子系统由于其全局对称性而被迫无带隙的现象。以前的工作主要集中在反常对称性上。作者提出了另一种方法，即使用对称跨度，将一个公共对称性的两个嵌入指定为两个更大的对称性。在这项工作中，我们证明，即使两个较大的对称性都是可逆且非反常的，对称跨度也可以强制无间隙：每个对称性都单独承认一个微不足道的带隙相，但由于嵌入因与对称性保护的拓扑相相关的扭曲而不同，因此它们生成的对称性不承认具有有限多个基态的带隙相。我们提出这样一个有限群和 1+1 维 U(1)² 的跨度，具有连续体实现和格哈密顿量，具有有限维局部希尔伯特空间和有限多个参数，在其参数空间的任何区域都是无间隙的。我们还讨论了 2+1 维示例和仅有限对称性的跨度。

articles.title: A Topology-Based Approach to Representative Volume Element Assessment in Solid Oxide Cell Anodes Using Large Volume Tomography and Persistent Homology
articles.title_zh: 使用大体积断层扫描和持久同源性的基于拓扑的方法对固体氧化物电池阳极中的代表性体积元素进行评估
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03176v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Determining the representative volume element is essential for establishing statistically meaningful microstructure-property relationships. Conventional approaches rely on the convergence of selected geometric descriptors, which may yield different estimates of the representative volume. Here, we propose a topology-based framework for assessing the representative scale of a nickel-yttria-stabilized zirconia solid oxide cell anode reconstructed using plasma focused ion beam-scanning electron microscopy (121.8 um x 83.97 um x 45.99 um). Persistent homology was used to characterize the pore network, and normalized persistence images of subvolumes were compared with those of the largest available reference volume using the L1 distance. This provides a continuous measure of topological similarity across observation scales, rather than defining representativeness through a single convergence threshold. The topological distance decreases with increasing volume and is described by empirical exponential models over the investigated range (R2 in [0.972, 0.983]). Comparison with porosity and specific surface area highlights differences in the scale-dependent behavior of geometric and topological descriptors. The framework was also tested on three independent synthetic realizations, demonstrating its potential for quantitative assessment of topological similarity in porous microstructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 确定具有代表性的体积元素对于建立具有统计意义的微观结构-性能关系至关重要。传统方法依赖于所选几何描述符的收敛性，这可能会产生对代表性体积的不同估计。在此，我们提出了一种基于拓扑的框架，用于评估使用等离子体聚焦离子束扫描电子显微镜（ 121.8 um x 83.97 um x 45.99 um ）重建的镍钇稳定氧化锆固体氧化物电池阳极的代表性尺度。使用持久同源性来表征孔隙网络，并使用L1距离将子体积的标准化持久性图像与最大可用参考体积的图像进行比较。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 确定具有代表性的体积元素对于建立具有统计意义的微观结构-性能关系至关重要。传统方法依赖于所选几何描述符的收敛性，这可能会产生对代表性体积的不同估计。在此，我们提出了一种基于拓扑的框架，用于评估使用等离子体聚焦离子束扫描电子显微镜（ 121.8 um x 83.97 um x 45.99 um ）重建的镍钇稳定氧化锆固体氧化物电池阳极的代表性尺度。使用持久同源性来表征孔隙网络，并使用L1距离将子体积的标准化持久性图像与最大可用参考体积的图像进行比较。这提供了跨观测尺度的拓扑相似性的连续度量，而不是通过单个收敛阈值来定义代表性。拓扑距离随着体积的增加而减小，并由研究范围内的经验指数模型描述（ [0.972 ， 0.983]中的R2 ）。与孔隙率和比表面积的比较突出了几何和拓扑描述符的尺度依赖性行为的差异。该框架还在三个独立的合成实现上进行了测试，证明了其在多孔微结构拓扑相似性定量评估方面的潜力。

articles.title: Pressure-correlation phase diagram unraveling quantum phase transitions in altermagnetic ϵ-FeOOH and realization of piezo-anomalous Hall effect
articles.title_zh: 压力相关相图揭示了Altermagnetic FeOOH中的量子相变以及压电异常霍尔效应的实现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03180v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We establish a pressure-correlation phase diagram that yields multiple pressure-tunable quantum phase transitions in iron oxyhydroxide (ϵ-FeOOH) across three critical pressures, Pc₁>Pc₂>Pc₃. The transitions arise from the competition among electron-correlation, crystal-field, and Hund's coupling. First-principles calculations reveal that the earlier reported high-spin (HS) to low-spin (LS) crossover at correlation-sensitive Pc₁ is accompanied by a transition from charge-transfer to Mott insulating (CTI-MI) phase, and a change in the spin-quantization axis (SQA) from haty to hatx. The HS-LS crossover and CTI-MI transition is driven by the simultaneous increase in crystal-field splitting and decrease in Hund's coupling. The critical pressure Pc₂ governing the structural transition from centrosymmetric Pnnm phase to noncentrosymmetric P2₁nm phase is found to be independent of electron-correlation. When correlation is strong, a third critical pressure (Pc₃) emerges in the lower-pressure regime of the phase diagram. Validating the recent experimental observation, Pc₃ is responsible for changing the SQA from hatz to haty. By exhibiting altermagnetism in both P2₁nm and Pnnm phases and possessing finite anomalous Hall conductivity (AHC) only for SQA along hatx and haty, ϵ-FeOOH enables a unique piezo-anomalous Hall effect where one can switch on the AHC at a lower pressure and change its direction at a higher pressure.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们建立了一个压力相关相图，该图在三个临界压力（ Pc > Pc ₂ > Pc ）下产生羟基铁（ FeOOH ）的多个压力可调量子相变。这种转变源于电子相关、晶体场和洪德耦合之间的竞争。第一原理计算表明，早期报道的相关性敏感Pc *的高自旋（ HS ）到低自旋（ LS ）交叉伴随着从电荷转移到莫特绝缘（ CTI-MI ）阶段的转变，以及自旋量子化轴（ SQA ）从HATY到HATX的变化。HS-LS交叉和CTI-MI过渡是由晶场分裂的同时增加和Hund耦合的减少所驱动的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们建立了一个压力相关相图，该图在三个临界压力（ Pc > Pc ₂ > Pc ）下产生羟基铁（ FeOOH ）的多个压力可调量子相变。这种转变源于电子相关、晶体场和洪德耦合之间的竞争。第一原理计算表明，早期报道的相关性敏感Pc *的高自旋（ HS ）到低自旋（ LS ）交叉伴随着从电荷转移到莫特绝缘（ CTI-MI ）阶段的转变，以及自旋量子化轴（ SQA ）从HATY到HATX的变化。HS-LS交叉和CTI-MI过渡是由晶场分裂的同时增加和Hund耦合的减少所驱动的。控制从中心对称Pnnm相到非中心对称P2 nm相的结构转变的临界压力Pc ₂被发现与电子相关性无关。当相关性强时，在相图的低压状态下会出现第三个临界压力（ Pc * ）。为了验证最近的实验观察结果， Pc负责将SQA从HATZ更改为HATY。通过在P2 nm和Pnnm相中表现出改变磁性，并且仅对沿着hatx和haty的SQA具有有限的异常霍尔电导率（ AHC ） ， FeOOH实现了独特的压电异常霍尔效应，在这种效应中，人们可以在较低的压力下打开AHC ，并在较高的压力下改变其方向。

articles.title: Establishing Néel order in the square-lattice antiferromagnetic Heisenberg model: a bootstrap proof
articles.title_zh: 在方格反铁磁Heisenberg模型中建立Néel阶：自举证明
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03241v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rigorously establishing spontaneous symmetry breaking (SSB) in the thermodynamic limit is generally challenging. This is exemplified by the two-dimensional (2D) S = 1/2 antiferromagnetic Heisenberg model where the existence of Néel order is not rigorously established despite overwhelming evidence from a variety of methods. We show that a bootstrap approach can be used to rigorously establish SSB and use it to prove the existence of Néel order in the 2D S = 1/2 XXZ model by deriving a strictly positive lower bound on the Néel order parameter for a set of discrete values of the anisotropy parameter Δ in the range [0,2] including the isotropic (Heisenberg) point Δ = 1. Our approach employs a generalization of the Kennedy--Lieb--Shastry inequalities, which use an infrared bound to reduce the existence of long-range order to bounds on certain finite-distance correlators. We compute these bounds for all sufficiently large systems with periodic boundary conditions using the bootstrap. An important ingredient in our proof is a novel method for obtaining exactly certified variational upper bounds on the energy density in the thermodynamic limit from matrix product states. Our approach can be readily generalized to other local lattice models for which infrared susceptibility bounds can be obtained.
articles.abstract_zh: 严格建立热力学极限的自发对称断裂（ SSB ）通常具有挑战性。二维（ 2D ） S = 1/2反铁磁Heisenberg模型就是一个例子，尽管有各种方法的压倒性证据，但Néel序的存在并未严格建立。我们表明，可以使用自举方法严格建立SSB ，并使用它来证明2D S = 1/2 XXZ模型中Néel阶的存在性，方法是导出一组各向异性参数Δ在[0,2] （包括各向同性（ Heisenberg ）点Δ = 1 ）范围内的离散值的Néel阶参数的严格正下界。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 严格建立热力学极限的自发对称断裂（ SSB ）通常具有挑战性。二维（ 2D ） S = 1/2反铁磁Heisenberg模型就是一个例子，尽管有各种方法的压倒性证据，但Néel序的存在并未严格建立。我们表明，可以使用自举方法严格建立SSB ，并使用它来证明2D S = 1/2 XXZ模型中Néel阶的存在性，方法是导出一组各向异性参数Δ在[0,2] （包括各向同性（ Heisenberg ）点Δ = 1 ）范围内的离散值的Néel阶参数的严格正下界。我们的方法采用了Kennedy-Lieb-Shastry不等式的推广，该不等式使用红外束缚来将远程秩序的存在减少到某些有限距离相关器上的边界。我们使用引导计算所有具有周期性边界条件的足够大的系统的这些边界。我们证明的一个重要因素是一种新颖的方法，用于从基质积状态获得热力学极限能量密度的精确认证变分上限。我们的方法可以很容易地推广到其他可以获得红外敏感性界限的局部晶格模型。

articles.title: Magnetic field as a tuning knob for edge mode interaction in integer quantum Hall interferometers
articles.title_zh: 磁场作为整数量子霍尔干涉仪中边模相互作用的调谐旋钮
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03284v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The quantum Hall interferometer has been shown to be a powerful tool for probing both the nature of the chiral modes present at the edges of these systems and the interactions between them. Strong inter-edge mode interactions can lead the system into a regime where the period of the interferometer signal corresponds to an insertion of a half-quantum flux h/2e, rather than the standard flux quantum h/e. Using a highly tunable bilayer graphene device, we are able to measure the prevalence of both the h/e-period and the doubled-frequency regimes as a function of magnetic field, providing insight into the microscopic nature of the doubling mechanism. Furthermore, we are able to push our device to a regime where double-frequency oscillations coexist with a superimposed period-h/e pattern associated with the inner chiral modes farther from the edge. We argue that this regime has a natural interpretation in a picture of the frequency doubling being caused by strong capacitive couplings between the edge modes.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子霍尔干涉仪已被证明是探测这些系统边缘手性模式的性质以及它们之间相互作用的强大工具。强大的边际模式相互作用可以使系统进入干涉仪信号的周期对应于半量子通量h/2e的插入，而不是标准通量量子h/e。使用高度可调的双层石墨烯器件，我们能够测量作为磁场函数的h/e周期和倍频机制的普遍性，从而深入了解倍频机制的微观性质。此外，我们能够将我们的设备推向双频振荡与与远离边缘的内部手性模式相关的叠加周期-h/e模式共存的状态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子霍尔干涉仪已被证明是探测这些系统边缘手性模式的性质以及它们之间相互作用的强大工具。强大的边际模式相互作用可以使系统进入干涉仪信号的周期对应于半量子通量h/2e的插入，而不是标准通量量子h/e。使用高度可调的双层石墨烯器件，我们能够测量作为磁场函数的h/e周期和倍频机制的普遍性，从而深入了解倍频机制的微观性质。此外，我们能够将我们的设备推向双频振荡与与远离边缘的内部手性模式相关的叠加周期-h/e模式共存的状态。我们认为，在边缘模式之间的强电容耦合引起的频率倍增的图片中，这种情况有一种自然的解释。

articles.title: Amplitude-conserving frequency demultiplexer based on a spin wave delay line
articles.title_zh: 基于自旋波延迟线的保幅频率解复用器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03423v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Propagating spin waves have emerged as promising candidates for signal processing and information transmission. We present a theoretical investigation of the generation, propagation and collection of spin-wave wave packets in micrometer-wide magnetic conduits, highlighting their potential for analogue frequency demultiplexing in space and time. We clarify the roles of the excitation duration and of the spin wave dispersion relation, as well as the influence of the spin-wave linewidth in setting the spatio-temporal evolution of propagating spin-wave wavepackets excited by Gaussian field pulses. We issue rules for the spatio-temporal separation of wavepackets that carry different frequencies. We finally propose an amplitude-conserving frequency demultiplexer based on a spin wave delay line of 60x5 μm² footprint.
articles.abstract_zh: 传播自旋波已成为信号处理和信息传输的有希望的候选者。我们对自旋波包在微米宽磁导管中的产生、传播和收集进行了理论研究，强调了它们在空间和时间上模拟频率解复用的潜力。我们阐明了激发持续时间和自旋波色散关系的作用，以及自旋波线宽在设置高斯场脉冲激发的传播自旋波波包的时空演化中的影响。我们发布了携带不同频率的波包的时空分离规则。我们最终提出了一种基于60x5μm ²占地面积的自旋波延迟线的保幅频率解复用器。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 传播自旋波已成为信号处理和信息传输的有希望的候选者。我们对自旋波包在微米宽磁导管中的产生、传播和收集进行了理论研究，强调了它们在空间和时间上模拟频率解复用的潜力。我们阐明了激发持续时间和自旋波色散关系的作用，以及自旋波线宽在设置高斯场脉冲激发的传播自旋波波包的时空演化中的影响。我们发布了携带不同频率的波包的时空分离规则。我们最终提出了一种基于60x5μm ²占地面积的自旋波延迟线的保幅频率解复用器。

articles.title: Local and itinerant orbital contributions to the gyromagnetic response of paramagnetic metals
articles.title_zh: 对顺磁金属旋磁响应的局部和巡回轨道贡献
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03426v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Orbitronics exploits orbital angular momentum to generate and manipulate angular-momentum currents for controlling magnetisation, offering new approaches to magnetic memory and logic. A quantitative description of this process requires establishing how orbital angular momentum contributes to magnetic moments and, consequently, to the gyromagnetic response that governs magnetisation dynamics. Here, we present a first-principles framework for calculating the effective gyromagnetic tensor (g') of paramagnetic metals, consistently incorporating local and itinerant orbital contributions, spin-orbit coupling, and both state- and occupation-change effects. Applying the framework to V and Pt, we find that orbital paramagnetic responses are comparable to or larger than spin contributions and substantially modify g' from the free-electron value. The atom-centered approximation can underestimate the orbital response by approximately a factor of two, while neglecting occupation changes produces significant errors in the calculated g'. Our calculated g' values for V and Pt agree with experiment, while their pronounced dependence on band filling reveals a route to engineering angular-momentum responses through electronic-structure control. The results establish the modern theory of orbital magnetism as an essential ingredient for describing gyromagnetic response and provide a framework for identifying materials with enhanced orbital functionalities.
articles.abstract_zh: Orbitronics利用轨道角动量来产生和操纵角动量电流以控制磁化，为磁记忆和逻辑提供了新的方法。对这一过程的定量描述需要确定轨道角动量如何对磁矩做出贡献，从而对支配磁化动力学的回旋磁响应做出贡献。在这里，我们提出了一个计算顺磁金属的有效旋磁张量（ g '）的第一原理框架，始终如一地结合了局部和巡回轨道贡献、自旋轨道耦合以及状态和职业变化效应。将该框架应用于V和Pt ，我们发现轨道顺磁响应与自旋贡献相当或大于自旋贡献，并从自由电子值大幅修改g'。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Orbitronics利用轨道角动量来产生和操纵角动量电流以控制磁化，为磁记忆和逻辑提供了新的方法。对这一过程的定量描述需要确定轨道角动量如何对磁矩做出贡献，从而对支配磁化动力学的回旋磁响应做出贡献。在这里，我们提出了一个计算顺磁金属的有效旋磁张量（ g '）的第一原理框架，始终如一地结合了局部和巡回轨道贡献、自旋轨道耦合以及状态和职业变化效应。将该框架应用于V和Pt ，我们发现轨道顺磁响应与自旋贡献相当或大于自旋贡献，并从自由电子值大幅修改g'。以原子为中心的近似可能将轨道响应低估约两倍，而忽略职业变化会在计算的g '中产生显著误差。我们计算的V和Pt的g'值与实验一致，而它们对带填充的明显依赖性揭示了通过电子结构控制实现工程角动量响应的途径。结果确立了轨道磁性的现代理论，作为描述旋磁响应的基本成分，并为识别具有增强轨道功能的材料提供了框架。

articles.title: Cage-enforced i-wave altermagnetism in boron-carbon clathrates
articles.title_zh: 硼碳包合物中的笼型强化i波改变磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03492v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The spin splitting of an altermagnet arises from a rotation that relates its two magnetic sublattices. In known cases it is fixed by the crystal structure. Here we show that guest-host frameworks separate the two roles. In the boron-carbon clathrates MB₃C₃ the ordered cage removes the translation between the two guest sites and enforces cubic i-wave altermagnetism, with six symmetry-enforced nodal planes, for any magnetic guest in the compensated state; strain retunes the class to d- or g-wave. We demonstrate the platform with GdB₃C₃: its compensated antiferromagnetic ground state is a narrow-gap semiconductor with spin splitting of 0.19 eV at the conduction-band edge, and its weakly pinned Néel vector switches the helicity-resolved optical response on and off according to the magnetic point group. Thermodynamic stability at high pressure and dynamical stability at ambient pressure indicate that it can be made by the route established for this family.
articles.abstract_zh: 改变磁体的自旋分裂源于与其两个磁性子网格相关的旋转。在已知情况下，它是由晶体结构固定的。在这里，我们展示了房客/体验达人框架将这两个角色分开。在硼-碳包合物中，有序的笼子移除两个访客部位之间的平移，并对处于补偿状态的任何磁性访客施加六个对称强制节点平面的立方i波改变磁性；应变将类重新调整为d-或g-波。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 改变磁体的自旋分裂源于与其两个磁性子网格相关的旋转。在已知情况下，它是由晶体结构固定的。在这里，我们展示了房客/体验达人框架将这两个角色分开。在硼-碳包合物中，有序的笼子移除两个访客部位之间的平移，并对处于补偿状态的任何磁性访客施加六个对称强制节点平面的立方i波改变磁性；应变将类重新调整为d-或g-波。我们演示了GdB · C ·的平台：其补偿的反铁磁基态是一种窄间隙半导体，在传导带边缘的自旋分裂为0.19 eV ，其弱固定的Néel矢量根据磁点群打开和关闭螺旋度分辨的光学响应。高压下的热力学稳定性和环境压力下的动力学稳定性表明，可以通过为该族建立的路线来实现。

articles.title: Polariton tweezers
articles.title_zh: Polariton镊子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03506v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The non-invasive, deterministic manipulation of charge carriers remains a fundamental challenge in solid-state quantum technologies. Here, we demonstrate the concept of dynamic polariton tweezers capable of trapping and transporting electrons across a two-dimensional electron system via the long-range electrostatic potential of dipolar (d-) exciton-polaritons. By driving a semiconductor microcavity with a specifically engineered, non-collinear three-beam optical pump with TE-polarization, we synthesize a macroscopic polariton lattice with hexagonal symmetry. The spatially periodic field of this d-polariton condensate acts as a reconfigurable trapping landscape for the electrons. We show that introducing targeted frequency detunings between the continuous-wave pumps strictly breaks the spatiotemporal symmetry of the system, converting the stationary macroscopic interference pattern into a dynamically moving conveyor belt. By precisely customizing these frequency detunings, the entire lattice - along with the electrostatically trapped electrons - can be rigidly driven in any arbitrary in-plane direction. This precise phase-matching mechanism bypasses the need for a net kinetic momentum transfer, establishing a robust, optically controlled platform for the long-range routing of charged particles and topological defects in driven-dissipative quantum fluids.
articles.abstract_zh: 对电荷载流子的非侵入性、确定性操作仍然是固态量子技术的一个基本挑战。在这里，我们演示了动态极化子镊子的概念，该镊子能够通过双极（ d- ）激子极化子的远程静电势在二维电子系统中捕获和传输电子。通过使用具有TE偏振的特殊设计的非共线三光束光泵驱动半导体微腔，我们合成了具有六边形对称性的宏观极化子晶格。这种d极化子凝聚体的空间周期场充当电子的可重构捕获景观。我们表明，在连续波泵之间引入目标频率调谐严格打破了系统的时空对称性，将静止的宏观干扰模式转换为动态移动的输送带。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对电荷载流子的非侵入性、确定性操作仍然是固态量子技术的一个基本挑战。在这里，我们演示了动态极化子镊子的概念，该镊子能够通过双极（ d- ）激子极化子的远程静电势在二维电子系统中捕获和传输电子。通过使用具有TE偏振的特殊设计的非共线三光束光泵驱动半导体微腔，我们合成了具有六边形对称性的宏观极化子晶格。这种d极化子凝聚体的空间周期场充当电子的可重构捕获景观。我们表明，在连续波泵之间引入目标频率调谐严格打破了系统的时空对称性，将静止的宏观干扰模式转换为动态移动的输送带。通过精确定制这些频率失谐，整个晶格-以及静电捕获的电子-可以在任何任意的平面内方向上刚性驱动。这种精确的相位匹配机制绕过了对净动量传递的需求，为驱动耗散量子流体中的带电粒子和拓扑缺陷的远程路由建立了一个健壮的光学控制平台。

articles.title: Multiple windows of eigenstate-selective delocalization in a non-Hermitian quasiperiodic lattice
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03562v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate localization in a non-Hermitian quasiperiodic lattice with a real quasiperiodic onsite potential of strength W and a staggered imaginary quasiperiodic modulation of strength λ. Using the inverse participation ratio (IPR), normalized participation ratio (NPR), fractal dimension D₂, transfer-matrix Lyapunov exponent, and wave-packet dynamics, we find a strongly non-monotonic and state-dependent response. At fixed λ, varying W yields two distinct delocalization windows, whereas varying λ at fixed W produces a single re-entrant delocalization window. These regimes arise within selected eigenstate sectors, where localized states coexist with extended or critical states, leading to mobility-edge-like behavior. The corresponding suppression of the Lyapunov exponent and enhancement of the dynamical RMS spreading are consistent with the IPR, NPR, and D₂ results. Finite-size scaling confirms the persistence of the re-entrant features, while the complex-energy spectrum resolves their state-selective structure. The resulting phase boundaries delineate distinct localization regimes in the (W,λ) plane. Our results show that the interplay between quasiperiodicity and a staggered non-Hermitian modulation sharing the same quasiperiodic spatial structure can generate re-entrant, state-dependent localization, with implications for localization and dynamics in non-Hermitian quasiperiodic lattices.

articles.title: Inhomogeneous Synthetic Fluxes in Optical Lattices
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03616v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Synthetic gauge fields in optical lattices are usually engineered to realize a uniform magnetic flux. Here, we propose a scheme to generate spatially inhomogeneous fluxes and demonstrate how such fluxes reshape the single-particle spectrum. Within Wannier--Stark-assisted tunneling, onsite modulation produces a plaquette flux that depends on the orientation of the static tilt, whereas laser-assisted tunneling (LAT) does not. Using LAT, two coherent Raman processes with different momentum transfers imprint a dimerized Peierls phase that alternates the flux between neighboring plaquettes of a square lattice while keeping the mean flux fixed. A bond-selective Raman phase extends the scheme to the kagome lattice, where a parameter ξ redistributes the flux between triangles and hexagons at fixed flux per unit cell. The Hofstadter--Rammal spectrum of the bipartite square lattice retains chiral symmetry for all ξ, whereas the kagome lattice lacks this symmetry, and its flux periodicity and reflection symmetries survive only at special values of ξ. As ξ is reduced, the anomalous Landau levels of the kagome singular flat band are compressed toward the flat-band energy and evolve into a degenerate zero-energy manifold at ξ=0 with compactly localized states. The dynamical structure factor, accessible through Bragg scattering, resolves this evolution as a Rydberg-like series of peaks whose spectral span tracks the width of the anomalous-level tower and vanishes as ξ→0. We discuss the frequency resolution and temperature required for its observation.

articles.title: Exhaustive Construction of Generalized Parent Hamiltonians for Matrix Product States
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00203v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Characterizing local Hamiltonians that host interesting many-body states as eigenstates has been an important problem in quantum many-body physics. For matrix product states (MPS), there is a well-known construction of parent Hamiltonians that have the MPS as the frustration-free ground state. However, recent results on quantum many-body scars have shown that such a construction does not exhaust all possible Hamiltonians that have the MPS as an eigenstate. In this work, we develop an exhaustive construction of generalized parent Hamiltonians that have a given translation-invariant MPS as an eigenstate. These go beyond the conventional projector-based construction of frustration-free parent Hamiltonians, where each local Hermitian term has the MPS as an eigenstate, by allowing non-Hermitian telescoping terms that cancel out with periodic boundary conditions (PBC). We derive a local tensor equation that establishes a correspondence between inequivalent classes of generalized parent Hamiltonians, i.e., those that cannot be related using linear combinations with frustration-free Hamiltonians, and the MPS transfer matrix spectrum. We illustrate the connection to intrinsic physical properties, including non-Abelian symmetries and zero correlation length, and further extend this construction to block-injective MPS. Our framework hence provides a systematic bridge between generalized parent Hamiltonians and the local structure of quantum states.

articles.title: Distance to integrability and complexity
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00233v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We consider nearest-neighbour interactions on spin-1/2 chains. We find the full set of integrable models of this form and apply a numerical algorithm to determine the "closest" integrable model for a given Hamiltonian. This allows us to define a model-independent distance to integrability. We show that standard measures of chaos interpolate between integrable and chaotic values with increasing values of this distance. However, there is a large variation across models and the distance to integrability provides additional information not directly provided by these diagnostics.

articles.title: VESPER: Online Learning of Free Energies with a Multi-Tempered Variational Objective
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00401v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Computing molecular free-energy landscapes over collective variables (CVs) is central to understanding molecular mechanisms, but poses a difficult learning problem without training data available a priori. Samples of the marginal CV distribution must be generated by molecular dynamics (MD), whose trajectories can remain trapped in metastable states and rarely cross the free-energy barriers governing conformational changes or chemical reactions. We introduce VESPER, which couples the generation of these samples to neural-network-driven free-energy learning: MD supplies configurations for learning, while the evolving model biases the MD to accelerate exploration and generate further training data. VESPER minimizes a single variational objective that is convex in the free energy and can combine several tempering levels, each flattening the free-energy landscape to promote barrier crossing. Every level has the same physical free energy as its minimizer, allowing data from all levels to train one shared model without reweighting. Learning uses the difference in mean parameter gradients between biased MD configurations and auxiliary walkers that explore the flattened model in CV space. We prove conditional convergence of the coupled overdamped population dynamics without replica exchange under log-Sobolev and Polyak-Lojasiewicz assumptions. VESPER matches or improves on established enhanced-sampling methods on alanine dipeptide and yields self-consistent free-energy reconstructions from three to six CVs on alanine tetrapeptide. For methane dehydrogenation on Ni(511) with a machine-learned interatomic potential, it recovers two-CV Boltzmann marginals and a reactant-to-saddle free-energy difference along a three-CV path, both qualitatively consistent with the lower-dimensional reference. It also samples RMSD-defined folded and unfolded regions of chignolin while biasing seventeen CVs.

articles.title: Ground state and excitations of the (C₂⁽¹⁾) spin chain with non-diagonal boundaries
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.01016v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Understanding boundary effects in higher-rank integrable quantum spin chains requires connecting exact spectral relations with the root configurations underlying their energies and excitations. With non-diagonal boundaries, determining these configurations remains challenging even when an exact spectral solution is available, hindering the direct extraction of thermodynamic properties. We address this problem for the rational C₂⁽¹⁾ chain by combining DMRG in the tensor-network framework with the quantum inverse scattering method. The numerically determined zeros of the fundamental and fused transfer-matrix eigenvalues reveal three bulk-string distributions, labeled by x, y, and w, together with boundary strings and additional roots. Substituting these configurations into the operator identities relating the two transfer matrices yields the ground-state energy and the surface energy in the thermodynamic limit under non-diagonal boundary conditions. The analytical surface energy agrees with the numerical results up to O(tfrac1N) corrections. From the regularity conditions of the operator identities, we derive a boundary-string selection rule and numerically identify allowed configurations beyond the ground state. For excitations preserving the boundary-string configuration, we identify three elementary hole excitations, X, Y, and W, in the x-, y-, and w-string distributions, respectively, and derive their energies. Based on the symmetry of the zero roots, we also present a bulk-excitation selection rule governing the allowed combinations of these elementary excitations in physical eigenstates. The framework developed here can therefore be used to systematically analyze boundary effects, bulk excitations, and related physical properties in other high-rank integrable quantum models with non-diagonal boundary conditions.

articles.title: Density functionals for the Pauli-Fierz Hamiltonian
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.01208v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We develop a density-functional theory for the Pauli-Fierz Hamiltonian of nonrelativistic quantum electrodynamics in the spirit of the convex-analytic formulation of Lieb. We consider finitely many electrons, subject to external scalar and vector potentials, coupled to the full continuum of massless transverse photons with an ultraviolet cutoff. The natural basic variables are the standard electron density and a combined current density, the sum of the paramagnetic current density and a field-induced current density generated by the quantized vector potential. We prove representability results for these density-current pairs and show that the mixed-state constrained-search functional attains its infimum and coincides with the Lieb functional obtained by convex conjugation. Since arbitrarily soft photons purify mixed states at a negligible energy cost without changing their density and combined current density, the pure-state Levy-Lieb functional equals the Lieb functional and is therefore convex, even though its infimum need not be attained. In addition, we establish the zero-coupling limit, which recovers the mixed-state Vignale-Rasolt functional of current-density-functional theory. Finally, we consider the long-wavelength (dipole) limit and show that the limiting functional can be written as a constrained search for the well-known length-gauge dipole Hamiltonian.

articles.title: Characterization of a hybrid superconducting RF cavity for use in axion searches
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00087v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report on the development of a hybrid superconducting radio-frequency (SRF) cavity for axion haloscopes. The Axion Dark Matter eXperiment (ADMX) Sidecar has been a program of ADMX for testing technologies with the potential for improving high frequency cavity haloscopes in the 4-6 GHz range. A replica of the Sidecar cavity, an aluminum clamshell microwave resonator loaded with a niobium tuning rod coated with Nb3Sn, was characterized in a dilution fridge through its critical temperature transitions down to 25 mK and through magnetic fields up to 6 T. The quality factor of five resonant modes of the cavity system were monitored throughout the process, including the TM010 mode used in axion searches. Distinct superconducting transitions were observed near the expected critical temperatures of Nb3Sn, pure niobium, and aluminum. The TM010 mode exhibited a factors of improvement in quality factor of 1.86 and 2.87 through the two niobium transitions, which implied the rod had a zero-field surface resistance of roughly 79% that of copper at cryogenic temperatures. Magnet tests showed a distinct superconducting transition for aluminum, and gradual degradation of quality factor expected for Nb3Sn in a mixed superconducting state. This hybrid resonator design has been integrated in the ADMX insert for performing an axion-like particle search.

articles.title: Inverse modelling of a laser-plasma accelerator
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00108v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The electron beams of a laser-plasma accelerator depend non-linearly on the laser and gas settings. This dependence is explored using particle-in-cell (PIC) simulations, and machine-learning models trained on these simulations predict the beam from the settings. Here we address the reverse problem: given a measured beam, which settings produced it? We infer three of them: the gas pressure p₁, the normalised vector potential a₀ and the nitrogen concentration cN_₂. The solution is not guaranteed to be unique. We train an ensemble of mixture density networks that, for each beam, output several possible sets of settings with their probabilities and uncertainties, and test them on simulated beams with realistic measurement noise. On average, the predictions are accurate (R² = 0.91), yet for about two-thirds of the beams the inferred distribution has two competing solutions. These share nearly the same value of a₀² p₁, which controls how strongly the laser focuses itself in the plasma and, in earlier PALLAS studies, when electrons start to be injected. Keeping this quantity fixed gives beams that are practically indistinguishable with realistic diagnostics. A forward model used as a check removes unphysical solutions but cannot choose between the two plausible ones. We then test two ways to resolve the ambiguity. Adding the full electron energy spectrum improves the mean prediction (R² = 0.94), mostly through a₀. It changes the weights of the two solutions but does not move them. A second measurement at a deliberately different plasma density is more effective. In paired PIC simulations, it reduces the error on a₀ by a factor of 2.6, whereas repeating the measurement at the same density brings almost no gain.

articles.title: A θ-implicit hybrid particle-in-cell algorithm for kinetic simulations of magnetized plasmas
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00127v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hybrid particle-in-cell (PIC) models with kinetic ions and an inertialess electron fluid are widely used to simulate magnetized plasmas at ion scales, but explicit time advances are constrained by the whistler-wave CFL condition dt propto Δ x², and the sub-cycling and artificial dissipation used to mitigate it carry accumulating costs. We present a θ-implicit hybrid PIC algorithm, implemented in the open-source GPU-capable code WarpX, in which fields and particles are advanced as a single nonlinear system solved by a particle-suppressed Jacobian-free Newton--Krylov method: the particles are nonlinearly eliminated, the electric field of the generalized Ohm's law is the sole unknown, and mass matrices remove all particle operations from the linear iterations. The electron pressure is advanced inside the nonlinear solve, and the scheme satisfies a discrete energy law whose single dissipation term vanishes at θ = 1/2 and damps only temporally under-resolved modes for θ > 1/2. The advance reproduces parallel and perpendicular wave dispersion including the ion Bernstein modes, conserves total energy to machine roundoff where the explicit advance heats secularly, does not develop the cold-beam finite-grid instability, and reproduces the m=0 instability of a Bennett pinch in RZ geometry. We conclude with 3D simulations of a field-reversed configuration initialized from a Grad--Shafranov equilibrium, comparing the explicit and implicit advances on the growth of the tilt instability and the preservation of trapped magnetic flux.

articles.title: Towards reactor-relevant electromagnetic turbulence in the MAST-U spherical tokamak
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00218v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate electromagnetic ion-scale turbulence in a high-performing H-mode plasma of the Mega Ampere Spherical Tokamak Upgrade (MAST-U) with local gyrokinetic simulations, asking whether it approaches the non-zonal transition: the nonlinear transition to a high-flux state above a critical value of q²βₑ found in simulations of STEP, where q is the safety factor and βₑ the ratio of electron thermal pressure to magnetic pressure. We examine two flux surfaces: one at t = 531,ms, close to peak normalised pressure β_N, at normalised poloidal flux ψ_N = 0.50; and one at t = 591,ms and ψ_N = 0.60, the ideal-ballooning-stable surface of largest q²βₑ inside ψ_N = 0.8 at that time. On both surfaces the dominant ion-scale instabilities are microtearing and electromagnetic ballooning-like modes, as in STEP. Without equilibrium flow shear, at least one of the surfaces lies above the large flux threshold with every set of kinetic species we simulate, with ion-scale heat fluxes far exceeding power balance, in turbulence characterised by a highly stochastic magnetic field. Strong flow shear driven by neutral-beam injection in the real experiment suppresses this turbulence and holds the plasma below the transition. When the carbon impurity is included in the simulation, the ion-scale flux is then close to power balance on both surfaces. Without rotation, gyrokinetics suggests the transition would limit the accessible profiles. This could degrade MAST-U plasma performance using heating schemes that lack a momentum source, and this will be tested in forthcoming electron Bernstein wave heating experiments.

articles.title: Low Frequency Noise Identification for the SuperCDMS Experiment using Convolutional Neural Networks
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00248v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The SuperCDMS experiment uses semiconductor crystal detectors operated at cryogenic temperatures to search for low-mass dark matter. Vibrations observed during the SuperCDMS Soudan experiment generated broadband low-frequency noise (LFN), which due to its similarity in the pulse shape to the low-energy signal events is difficult to remove. In the final low ionization threshold analysis, CDMSlite Run 3, the strong event selection criterion applied to remove LFN events also significantly reduced the ability to identify signal events in the low energy region, thus reducing the sensitivity of the experiment to low-mass dark matter. Therefore, an LFN rejection criterion using machine learning (ML) aimed to improve the signal efficiency while maintaining the signal purity has now been developed. This paper presents a new method using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), its application to the CDMSlite Run 3 dataset, and its impact on dark matter sensitivities, with further investigation through case studies.

articles.title: Animated Ultraviolet Holography via Programmable Nonlinear Phase Transfer
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00267v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Dynamic and programmable control of ultraviolet (UV) light remains challenging because of conventional high material absorption and the limited functionality of optics such as lenses, mirrors or filters, and optoelectronic devices, such as spatial phase modulators, over the UV range. Here, by employing the concept of virtual metasurfaces based on arrays of programmable optical patterns on a 600-nm-thick lithium niobate film as the nonlinear medium, we demonstrate nonlinear phase transfer, generating programmable holography in the UV range. This arrangement provides a unique platform for generating animated holograms. A spatial light modulator encodes a computer-generated phase distribution onto a longer-wavelength pump beam, while second-harmonic generation transfers the programmed spatial phase to the UV field through the quadratic nonlinear interaction. Importantly, the nonlinear film serves as a simple frequency-conversion interface, eliminating the need for nanostructure patterning or direct UV spatial modulation. By incorporating the nonlinear phase relationship into the hologram design, we experimentally reconstruct six distinct UV holographic patterns, with normalised cross-correlation values ranging from 0.68 to 0.83, demonstrating reliable UV holographic image reconstruction. As a result, the dynamic updating of the SLM enables animated UV holograms at 10 Hz, demonstrating reconfigurable UV holography using the same nonlinear film. The system also supports tunable SHG emission from 350 to 390 nm and dynamic beam steering at approximately 20 Hz. The results demonstrate the potential of virtual metasurfaces to realise software-defined UV holography by transferring spatial programming across optical frequencies. This opens new opportunities for reconfigurable short-wavelength UV beam shaping and structured illumination, without the need for UV-compatible optics or optoelectronics.

articles.title: Coherent transduction and dynamical back-action between light and millimeter waves
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00279v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electro-optic transduction can bypass the loss and noise of electronic frequency conversion at millimeter-wave frequencies by parametrically converting signals onto low-loss, low-noise optical carriers, with coupling rates that grow with frequency. Exploiting this growth, however, requires shrinking both the millimeter-wave and optical resonators while preserving their quality factors and spatial overlap, which has not yet been achieved. Here, we demonstrate a triply resonant transducer whose optical and millimeter-wave resonators have comparable dimensions and minimal mode volumes. Coupled lithium niobate Fabry-Pérot cavities, with free spectral ranges above 650 GHz and quality factors up to 10⁶, form a photonic molecule integrated with a quarter-wave gold resonator at 263 GHz. The device reaches a vacuum electro-optic coupling rate g₀/2π approx 60 kHz, six times larger than previous millimeter-wave transducers and sixty times larger than at microwave frequencies. The device optically detects room-temperature thermal millimeter-wave photons at effective occupancies below one, which also serve as a calibration tone for transduction efficiency. Coherent transduction reaches cooperativities approaching 0.3, corresponding to internal efficiencies around 67%, accompanied by electro-optic dynamical back-action that broadens or narrows the optical resonances.
