articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了自旋 1/2 蜂窝晶格 J₁-J2 海森堡反铁磁体的柱状价键固体中的三重子拓扑和热霍尔输运。由 J2^A≠ J2^B 建模的不等三角形亚晶格消除了最近邻键中心处的反演对称性，并允许面内 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) 相互作用。我们识别了两种允许对称的面内 DM 矢量图案，并给出了与包含面外磁场的键平行的图案的详细结果。在谐波键算符处理中，我们确定了三重子能带、它们的贝里曲率和陈数，以及三重子热霍尔电导率。 DM 相互作用和磁场产生非零贝里曲率，但每个孤立三倍子带的数值积分陈数消失。然而，正和负贝里曲率区域的能量依赖玻色加权在非零低温下产生有限的热霍尔响应。我们界定了稀三倍子体系，在该体系中谐波传输计算预计是可靠的。这些结果表明，消失的陈数带并不直接限制价键固体的三重子响应。我们还评论了以面外矢量模式为特征的次最近邻自旋之间的 DM 相互作用对柱状价键固相的影响。

articles.title: Efficient Simulation of Gate Leakage Currents in Ultra-scaled Transistors from First Principles
articles.title_zh: 根据第一原理对超大规模晶体管中的栅极漏电流进行有效仿真
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40929v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: To ensure high electrostatic integrity in ultra-scaled field-effect transistors (FETs), thin gate dielectric layers are typically needed, potentially giving rise to (strong) leakage currents. Being able to model this effect is therefore crucial. Here, we show how gate leakage currents can be computed at the ab initio level in WS₂-hBN FETs by extending the well-established quantum transmitting boundary method (QTBM). Two main challenges are tackled: (i) the calculation of the open boundary conditions (OBCs) for the gate contacts and (ii) the solution of the resulting sparse linear system of equations A x = b where the matrix A possesses an unstructured sparsity pattern. We demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms the state of the art and can be readily applied to simulate transistors with gate lengths exceeding 25 nm.
articles.abstract_zh: 为了确保超大规模场效应晶体管 (FET) 的高静电完整性，通常需要薄栅极介电层，这可能会产生（强）漏电流。因此，能够模拟这种效应至关重要。在这里，我们展示了如何通过扩展完善的量子传输边界方法 (QTBM) 从头开始计算 WS2-hBN FET 中的栅极漏电流。解决了两个主要挑战：(i) 栅极接触的开放边界条件 (OBC) 的计算，以及 (ii) 求解所得的稀疏线性方程组 A x = b，其中矩阵 A 具有非结构化稀疏模式。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 为了确保超大规模场效应晶体管 (FET) 的高静电完整性，通常需要薄栅极介电层，这可能会产生（强）漏电流。因此，能够模拟这种效应至关重要。在这里，我们展示了如何通过扩展完善的量子传输边界方法 (QTBM) 从头开始计算 WS2-hBN FET 中的栅极漏电流。解决了两个主要挑战：(i) 栅极接触的开放边界条件 (OBC) 的计算，以及 (ii) 求解所得的稀疏线性方程组 A x = b，其中矩阵 A 具有非结构化稀疏模式。我们证明所提出的方法优于现有技术，并且可以轻松应用于模拟栅极长度超过 25 nm 的晶体管。

articles.title: Temperature Evolution of Magnon-Polarons in the van der Waals Antiferromagnet FePS₃
articles.title_zh: 范德华反铁磁体 FePS₃ 中磁振子极化子的温度演化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40968v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnon polarons, hybrid excitations arising from magnon-phonon coupling, were investigated in the van der Waals antiferromagnet FePS3 using magneto-Raman scattering measurements at temperatures ranging from 4 K to the vicinity of the Néel temperature (T_N = 118 K). The lower Zeeman-split component of the magnon-like mode, tuned by the magnetic field toward the lower-energy phonon mode, exhibits an avoided crossing. The corresponding magnetic field decreases from approximately 13 T at 4 K to 5.6 T at 85 K, bringing the effect within reach of a standard laboratory magnet. A model of three coupled bosonic modes shows that the magnon-phonon coupling constant, approximately 2.7 cm⁻¹ at low temperatures, decreases significantly with increasing temperature, following a trend similar to the temperature-induced softening of the magnon mode. This decrease in magnon-phonon coupling is discussed in terms of a possible reduction in sublattice magnetization due to thermal fluctuations.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁振子极化子是由磁振子-声子耦合产生的混合激发，在范德华反铁磁体 FePS3 中使用磁拉曼散射测量在 4 K 到尼尔温度附近 (T_N = 118 K) 的温度范围内进行研究。类磁振模式的较低塞曼分裂分量通过磁场向低能量声子模式调谐，表现出避免交叉。相应的磁场从 4 K 时的约 13 T 减小到 85 K 时的 5.6 T，使效果达到标准实验室磁体的范围。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁振子极化子是由磁振子-声子耦合产生的混合激发，在范德华反铁磁体 FePS3 中使用磁拉曼散射测量在 4 K 到尼尔温度附近 (T_N = 118 K) 的温度范围内进行研究。类磁振模式的较低塞曼分裂分量通过磁场向低能量声子模式调谐，表现出避免交叉。相应的磁场从 4 K 时的约 13 T 减小到 85 K 时的 5.6 T，使效果达到标准实验室磁体的范围。三个耦合玻色子模式的模型表明，磁振子-声子耦合常数在低温下约为 2.7 cm -1 ，随着温度的升高而显着降低，遵循与温度引起的磁振子模式软化类似的趋势。磁振子-声子耦合的这种减少是根据热波动引起的亚晶格磁化强度的可能减少来讨论的。

articles.title: Exact Electron Dynamics in Linear and Chiral Cavities: Complete Field versus Single-Helicity Reduction
articles.title_zh: 线性和手性腔中的精确电子动力学：完整场与单螺旋简化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40986v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Can a chiral cavity turn a free electron into a Landau-like orbiting particle? We answer with exact solutions of three quadratic electron--cavity models in the dipole limit, valid at arbitrary coupling. A single linearly polarized mode dresses the electron mass, which delays its flight, slows the spreading of a wavepacket and entangles the packet with the cavity. The complete transverse field, with both circular helicities, keeps two commuting, gapless translations at any coupling, mode number and helicity splitting, so the electron stays ballistic and no synthetic magnetic field appears. Keeping a single helicity gives two inequivalent models that are not related by a gauge transformation: reducing before the Power--Zienau--Woolley transformation gives ballistic motion, whereas reducing after it gives a Landau-like crossed-quadrature Hamiltonian. They differ by a real uniform field B=sλ²/(2ω_c) (ω_c the mode frequency, λ the coupling, s=±1 the helicity). In the complete theory the frequency ω₋ₛ of the partner helicity, measured against g²=λ²/(2ω_c), decides between them: the electron is ballistic for a stiff partner, and Landau-like only at the soft-partner point, through an exact canonical reorganization that holds for the active sector but not for observables such as the electron--photon entanglement. Projecting onto one helicity after the PZW transformation is therefore not by itself a mechanism for synthetic magnetism; the mode content of the cavity is.
articles.abstract_zh: 手性空腔能否将自由电子转变为类朗道轨道粒子？我们用偶极极限下的三个二次电子腔模型的精确解来回答，在任意耦合下都有效。单一线性偏振模式修饰电子质量，从而延迟其飞行，减慢波包的传播并使波包与腔纠缠在一起。具有两个圆形螺旋性的完整横向场在任何耦合、模式数和螺旋性分裂下保持两个交换、无间隙平移，因此电子保持弹道并且不会出现合成磁场。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 手性空腔能否将自由电子转变为类朗道轨道粒子？我们用偶极极限下的三个二次电子腔模型的精确解来回答，在任意耦合下都有效。单一线性偏振模式修饰电子质量，从而延迟其飞行，减慢波包的传播并使波包与腔纠缠在一起。具有两个圆形螺旋性的完整横向场在任何耦合、模式数和螺旋性分裂下保持两个交换、无间隙平移，因此电子保持弹道并且不会出现合成磁场。保持单一螺旋度会给出两个与规范变换无关的不等价模型：在 Power-Zienau-Woolley 变换给出弹道运动之前减少，而在它给出类似朗道交叉正交哈密顿量之后减少。它们的区别在于实均匀场 B=sλ²/(2ω_c)（ω_c 模式频率，λ 耦合，s=±1 螺旋度）。在完整的理论中，根据 g²=λ²/(2ω_c) 测量的伙伴螺旋度的频率 ω₋ₛ 在它们之间做出决定：电子对于刚性伙伴是弹道的，而仅在软伙伴点上是朗道式的，通过精确的正则重组，该重组适用于活动扇区，但不适用于电子-光子纠缠等可观察量。因此，在 PZW 变换后投影到一个螺旋度本身并不是合成磁性的机制；空腔的模态含量为。

articles.title: Chirality inversion and odd transport in a suspension of living rotors
articles.title_zh: 活转子悬浮液中的手性反转和奇数传输
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41016v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chiral symmetry breaking is a defining feature of life, visible at all scales from molecules to organisms. Yet how microscopic chirality propagates to shape the macroscopic properties of living matter remains poorly understood. Here, using a new experimental system of spinning microalgae, we show that a living chiral fluid behaves fundamentally differently from an externally driven one. As their density increases, cells self-assemble hydrodynamically into small rotating clusters which merge into a percolating chiral fluid. Strikingly, microscopic and macroscopic vorticity have opposite signs: individual cells all spin clockwise, yet clusters orbit counterclockwise. Combining experiments, theory and simulations, we show that both chirality inversion and percolation are direct consequences of the cells' internally driven nature. We then show how percolation reshapes transport, with even and odd diffusivities responding differently to the emerging network topology.
articles.abstract_zh: 手性对称性破缺是生命的一个决定性特征，在从分子到生物体的各个尺度上都可见。然而，微观手性如何传播以塑造生命物质的宏观特性仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们使用一种新的旋转微藻实验系统，证明了活的手性流体的行为与外部驱动的流体有根本不同。随着密度的增加，细胞通过流体动力学自组装成小的旋转簇，并合并成渗透的手性流体。引人注目的是，微观和宏观涡旋具有相反的符号：单个细胞都顺时针旋转，而簇则逆时针旋转。结合实验、理论和模拟，我们表明手性反转和渗透都是细胞内部驱动性质的直接结果。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 手性对称性破缺是生命的一个决定性特征，在从分子到生物体的各个尺度上都可见。然而，微观手性如何传播以塑造生命物质的宏观特性仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们使用一种新的旋转微藻实验系统，证明了活的手性流体的行为与外部驱动的流体有根本不同。随着密度的增加，细胞通过流体动力学自组装成小的旋转簇，并合并成渗透的手性流体。引人注目的是，微观和宏观涡旋具有相反的符号：单个细胞都顺时针旋转，而簇则逆时针旋转。结合实验、理论和模拟，我们表明手性反转和渗透都是细胞内部驱动性质的直接结果。然后，我们展示渗透如何重塑传输，偶数和奇数扩散率对新兴网络拓扑的响应不同。

articles.title: The spin-transfer inverse Faraday effect in Au/YIG thin film bilayers
articles.title_zh: Au/YIG 薄膜双层中的自旋转移逆法拉第效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41061v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The inverse Faraday effect (IFE) (the generation of an effective magnetic field in a material upon irradiation with circularly polarized light) offers a pathway to ultrafast, non-thermal control of spin dynamics. In metallic/ferromagnetic-insulator (NM/FMI) bilayers, IFE-driven spin polarization in the metallic layer can be an alternative to generate magnon excitations in the magnetic insulator which otherwise would be inaccessible with photon energies below the insulator bandgap, but this avenue has remained mostly unexplored. In this work, we investigate the regime of spin-transfer via IFE in Au/YIG bilayers, by means of ultrafast time-resolved magneto-optical experiments. Understanding the mechanism of this spin-transfer IFE in these NM/FMI heterostructures is crucial for several reasons: it elucidates the fundamental coupling between light's angular momentum and collective spin modes at buried interfaces, it enables all-optical generation and manipulation of pure spin currents, and it paves the way toward THz-frequency spintronic devices leveraging the insulator's long magnon lifetimes.
articles.abstract_zh: 反法拉第效应 (IFE)（在圆偏振光照射下在材料中产生有效磁场）提供了一种超快、非热控制自旋动力学的途径。在金属/铁磁绝缘体 (NM/FMI) 双层中，金属层中的 IFE 驱动的自旋极化可以作为在磁绝缘体中产生磁振子激发的替代方案，否则磁绝缘体中的磁振子激发将无法通过低于绝缘体带隙的光子能量获得，但这种途径基本上尚未被探索。在这项工作中，我们通过超快时间分辨磁光实验研究了 Au/YIG 双层中通过 IFE 的自旋转移机制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 反法拉第效应 (IFE)（在圆偏振光照射下在材料中产生有效磁场）提供了一种超快、非热控制自旋动力学的途径。在金属/铁磁绝缘体 (NM/FMI) 双层中，金属层中的 IFE 驱动的自旋极化可以作为在磁绝缘体中产生磁振子激发的替代方案，否则磁绝缘体中的磁振子激发将无法通过低于绝缘体带隙的光子能量获得，但这种途径基本上尚未被探索。在这项工作中，我们通过超快时间分辨磁光实验研究了 Au/YIG 双层中通过 IFE 的自旋转移机制。了解这些 NM/FMI 异质结构中的自旋转移 IFE 机制至关重要，原因如下：它阐明了光的角动量与掩埋界面处的集体自旋模式之间的基本耦合，它实现了纯自旋电流的全光学生成和操纵，并为利用绝缘体的长磁振子寿命的太赫兹频率自旋电子器件铺平了道路。

articles.title: Frustration-Induced 1/6-Vortex-Paired Phase in a Kagome XY Model
articles.title_zh: Kagome XY 模型中挫败引起的 1/6 涡旋配对相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41161v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Geometric frustration can fractionalize vortices in two-dimensional XY systems, but a given frustrated model usually hosts only a single type of fractional vortex. Here we study a kagome XY model in which an antiferromagnetic coupling J₁ and a second-harmonic coupling K favor two competing frustrated ground-state manifolds. For K/J₁<1/9, the ground states map onto those of the kagome three-state Potts antiferromagnet and support 1/3 vortices; for K/J₁>1/9, they map onto those of the kagome Ising antiferromagnet and support 1/2 vortices. At K/J₁=1/9, the two manifolds become degenerate, and bends in the domain walls between them carry 1/6-vortex excitations. Tensor-network calculations show that a finite-temperature phase with quasi-long-range order only in e⁶ⁱθ emerges from this degenerate point, separating the 1/3- and 1/2-vortex-paired phases. This 1/6-vortex-paired phase has no counterpart in either parent manifold, showing that competing frustrated manifolds provide a route to new fractional-vortex-paired phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 几何挫败可以对二维 XY 系统中的涡流进行分数化，但给定的挫败模型通常仅包含单一类型的分数涡旋。在这里，我们研究了一个 kagome XY 模型，其中反铁磁耦合 J₁ 和二次谐波耦合 K 有利于两个竞争的受抑基态流形。对于 K/J₁1/9，它们映射到 kagome Ising 反铁磁体并支持 1/2 涡流。当 K/J₁=1/9 时，两个流形变得简并，并且它们之间的畴壁中的弯曲携带 1/6 涡旋激发。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 几何挫败可以对二维 XY 系统中的涡流进行分数化，但给定的挫败模型通常仅包含单一类型的分数涡旋。在这里，我们研究了一个 kagome XY 模型，其中反铁磁耦合 J₁ 和二次谐波耦合 K 有利于两个竞争的受抑基态流形。对于 K/J₁1/9，它们映射到 kagome Ising 反铁磁体并支持 1/2 涡流。当 K/J₁=1/9 时，两个流形变得简并，并且它们之间的畴壁中的弯曲携带 1/6 涡旋激发。张量网络计算表明，仅在 e⁶ⁱθ 中具有准长程有序的有限温度相从该简并点出现，将 1/3 和 1/2 涡旋对相分开。该 1/6 涡旋配对相在任一母流形中都没有对应物，这表明竞争受抑流形提供了通向新分数涡旋配对相的途径。

articles.title: ORCHID: Connecting Finite-Temperature Thermodynamic Evidence to Computational Materials Discovery
articles.title_zh: ORCHID：将有限温度热力学证据与计算材料发现联系起来
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41164v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Finite-temperature phase stability is essential to materials discovery, but the evidence needed to describe it remains scattered across decades of literature. ORCHID organizes this evidence around the thermodynamic states that the observations describe, using tiered agentic extraction guided by thermodynamic rules, expert supervision and explicit validation. The collection contains 73,542 values from 1,321 papers, represented with their thermodynamic states, phase identities, provenance, evidence classes and uncertainty, together with assessed phase assemblages and calculated references. A qualified subset is released in ESPEI-compatible form for CALPHAD assessment, and machine-readable access supports both human and AI-assisted reuse. Blind expert evaluation of 48 diagram fields gives 93.8% agreement, increasing to 97.9% after accounting for notation conventions. On a common formation-enthalpy benchmark, eight MLIPs show residual spreads close to their DFT reference, motivating evaluation of finite-temperature phase stability through PhaseForge. One-shot MLIP-PhaseForge descriptions of Cu-Zr recover 0.35-0.56 of observed phase occurrences at assessed field points. ORCHID-assisted refinement through PhaseForge+ recovers 9 of 13 invariant temperatures within 2 sigma and reduces held-out activity error from 5.1 to 1.7 kJ/mol. By supplying interpreted literature evidence directly to gradient-based refinement through PhaseForge+, ORCHID connects evidence recovery to programmatic CALPHAD assessment. With the initial description and fitting datasets prepared, the final Cu-Zr refinement completes in approximately 27 minutes, providing a foundation for continuously updated thermodynamic models and their use in materials discovery.
articles.abstract_zh: 有限温度相稳定性对于材料发现至关重要，但描述它所需的证据仍然分散在数十年的文献中。 ORCHID 使用由热力学规则、专家监督和显式验证指导的分层代理提取，围绕观察描述的热力学状态组织这些证据。该集合包含来自 1,321 篇论文的 73,542 个值，以热力学状态、相特性、出处、证据类别和不确定性表示，以及评估的相组合和计算的参考值。合格的子集以 ESPEI 兼容的形式发布，用于 CALPHAD 评估，机器可读的访问支持人工和人工智能辅助的重用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 有限温度相稳定性对于材料发现至关重要，但描述它所需的证据仍然分散在数十年的文献中。 ORCHID 使用由热力学规则、专家监督和显式验证指导的分层代理提取，围绕观察描述的热力学状态组织这些证据。该集合包含来自 1,321 篇论文的 73,542 个值，以热力学状态、相特性、出处、证据类别和不确定性表示，以及评估的相组合和计算的参考值。合格的子集以 ESPEI 兼容的形式发布，用于 CALPHAD 评估，机器可读的访问支持人工和人工智能辅助的重用。对 48 个图表字段的盲专家评估给出了 93.8% 的一致性，考虑到符号约定后，一致性增加到 97.9%。在常见的形成-焓基准上，八个 MLIP 显示出接近其 DFT 参考的残余展差，从而激励通过 PhaseForge 评估有限温度相稳定性。 Cu-Zr 的一次性 MLIP-PhaseForge 描述恢复了评估场点处观察到的相发生的 0.35-0.56。 ORCHID 通过 PhaseForge+ 进行辅助精炼，将 13 个恒定温度中的 9 个恢复到 2 sigma 以内，并将保留的活度误差从 5.1 kJ/mol 降低至 1.7 kJ/mol。通过 PhaseForge+ 将解释的文献证据直接提供给基于梯度的细化，ORCHID 将证据恢复与程序化 CALPHAD 评估连接起来。准备好初始描述和拟合数据集后，最终的 Cu-Zr 细化在大约 27 分钟内完成，为不断更新的热力学模型及其在材料发现中的应用奠定了基础。

articles.title: Quantum-Geometric Subgap Second-Harmonic Generation in PT-Symmetric Antiferromagnetic Insulators
articles.title_zh: PT 对称反铁磁绝缘体中的量子几何子能隙二次谐波产生
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41167v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Although quantum geometry plays an established role in electronic transport and optical responses, the contribution of the time-reversal-odd Riemannian connection to fully subgap responses remains less explored. Here we identify intrinsic second-harmonic generation in PT-symmetric antiferromagnets, predominantly governed by the real sector of the interband Hermitian connection and arising entirely from virtual interband transitions. In bilayer MnBi₂Te₄, the response persists in trivial phases but is enhanced in the layer-Chern phase and reverses sign with Néel order, offering a probe of quantum geometry and phase-sensitive readout of antiferromagnetic order without mobile carriers or real excitations.
articles.abstract_zh: 尽管量子几何在电子传输和光学响应中发挥着既定的作用，但时间反转奇数黎曼联系对完全亚能隙响应的贡献仍然很少被探索。在这里，我们确定了 PT 对称反铁磁体中固有的二次谐波产生，主要由带间埃尔米特连接的实部控制，并且完全由虚拟带间跃迁产生。在双层 MnBi2Te4 中，响应在平凡相中持续存在，但在层陈相中增强，并以尼尔阶反转符号，提供了量子几何的探测和反铁磁阶的相敏读出，无需移动载流子或实际激发。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 尽管量子几何在电子传输和光学响应中发挥着既定的作用，但时间反转奇数黎曼联系对完全亚能隙响应的贡献仍然很少被探索。在这里，我们确定了 PT 对称反铁磁体中固有的二次谐波产生，主要由带间埃尔米特连接的实部控制，并且完全由虚拟带间跃迁产生。在双层 MnBi2Te4 中，响应在平凡相中持续存在，但在层陈相中增强，并以尼尔阶反转符号，提供了量子几何的探测和反铁磁阶的相敏读出，无需移动载流子或实际激发。

articles.title: Berry curvature quadrupole induced third-order anomalous Hall effect in altermagnetic KV₂Se₂O
articles.title_zh: 贝里曲率四极杆在交变磁 KV2Se2O 中诱导三阶反常霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41274v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets combine compensated magnetic order with momentum-dependent spin splitting, providing a symmetry-rich platform for exploring nonlinear quantum-geometric transport. In the d-wave altermagnet considered here, the antiunitary symmetry operation TC₄z enforces a vanishing momentum-integrated Berry curvature, while inversion symmetry forbids a finite Berry-curvature dipole. Consequently, the Berry curvature quadrupole (BCQ) can provide a contribution to the nonlinear Hall response, scaling as τ², where τ denotes the relaxation time. We derive a gauge-covariant Wannier interpolation formula that enables efficient evaluation of the BCQ directly from first-principles Wannier tight-binding Hamiltonians. Applying this framework to KV₂Se₂O, we calculate the momentum-space distribution of the BCQ and the associated chemical potential dependent nonlinear conductivity. The momentum-resolved analysis reveals that the dominant contribution originates from spin-orbit coupling induced avoided arossings, directly linking the gap structure to the sign-changing nonlinear response. Our work establishes a general first-principles route to higher-order quantum-geometric responses in altermagnets, opening avenues for exploring nonlinear Hall effects in next-generation spintronic and magnetoelectronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 交变磁体将补偿磁序与动量相关的自旋分裂相结合，为探索非线性量子几何输运提供了一个富含对称性的平台。在这里考虑的 d 波交变磁体中，反酉对称运算 TC₄z 强制执行动量积分贝里曲率消失，而反演对称则禁止有限贝里曲率偶极子。因此，贝里曲率四极杆 (BCQ) 可以对非线性霍尔响应做出贡献，缩放为 τ²，其中 τ 表示弛豫时间。我们推导出规范协变 Wannier 插值公式，该公式能够直接从第一原理 Wannier 紧束缚哈密顿量有效评估 BCQ。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 交变磁体将补偿磁序与动量相关的自旋分裂相结合，为探索非线性量子几何输运提供了一个富含对称性的平台。在这里考虑的 d 波交变磁体中，反酉对称运算 TC₄z 强制执行动量积分贝里曲率消失，而反演对称则禁止有限贝里曲率偶极子。因此，贝里曲率四极杆 (BCQ) 可以对非线性霍尔响应做出贡献，缩放为 τ²，其中 τ 表示弛豫时间。我们推导出规范协变 Wannier 插值公式，该公式能够直接从第一原理 Wannier 紧束缚哈密顿量有效评估 BCQ。将此框架应用于 KV2Se2O，我们计算了 BCQ 的动量空间分布以及相关的化学势相关的非线性电导率。动量解析分析表明，主要贡献源于自旋轨道耦合引起的避免交叉，直接将带隙结构与符号变化的非线性响应联系起来。我们的工作建立了交流磁体中高阶量子几何响应的通用第一原理路线，为探索下一代自旋电子和磁电子器件中的非线性霍尔效应开辟了途径。

articles.title: Coordination three heals, coordination four is hard: the antiferromagnetic Potts model with a costly third state
articles.title_zh: 协调三可以治愈，协调四很难：反铁磁波茨模型具有昂贵的第三态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41277v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the ground states of the antiferromagnetic three-state Potts model in which the third state carries a single-ion energy cost D₃, on arbitrary lattices, and show that the difficulty of the ground-state problem is controlled by the maximum coordination Δ alone; on planar lattices with Δle5 it is classified completely. On lattices with coordination at most three the third state heals frustrated bonds one for one: every graph of maximum degree three other than K₄ has an independent set of sites that meets every odd cycle and whose size equals the number fr of frustrated bonds of the Ising ground state. This identity also follows from known results on the chromatic vertex stability of graphs; we give a constructive proof. Hence E₀ (D₃)=min(D₃,1) fr for all D₃, computable in polynomial time on planar lattices. In graph-theoretic terms, independent odd cycle transversal is solvable in polynomial time on planar subcubic graphs. On planar lattices with maximum coordination four, in contrast, deciding the ground-state energy is NP-complete for every fixed 0le D₃<2 and polynomial for D₃ge2. The boundary is set by a local principle: a site of coordination d in the third state relieves at most lfloor d/2rfloor frustrated bonds, so the third state is useless once D₃gelfloorΔ/2rfloor; this threshold is sharp for every Δge3 and reproduces the triangular-lattice point D₃^*=3 of the equivalent spin-1 Blume--Capel antiferromagnet. From a single Ising ground state the proof builds an exact ground state in polynomial time, which for quasicrystalline, foam-like and defective lattices with thousands of sites takes seconds to minutes.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了任意晶格上的反铁磁三态 Potts 模型的基态，其中第三态带有单离子能量成本 D₃，并表明基态问题的难度仅由最大配位 Δ 控制；在具有 Δle5 的平面晶格上，它被完全分类。在配位最多为 3 的晶格上，第三态一对一地修复受挫键：除了 K₄ 之外，每个最大度为 3 的图都有一组独立的位点，满足每个奇数循环，其大小等于伊辛基态受挫键的数量 fr。这种恒等式也可以从图的色顶点稳定性的已知结果得出；我们给出了一个建设性的证明。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了任意晶格上的反铁磁三态 Potts 模型的基态，其中第三态带有单离子能量成本 D₃，并表明基态问题的难度仅由最大配位 Δ 控制；在具有 Δle5 的平面晶格上，它被完全分类。在配位最多为 3 的晶格上，第三态一对一地修复受挫键：除了 K₄ 之外，每个最大度为 3 的图都有一组独立的位点，满足每个奇数循环，其大小等于伊辛基态受挫键的数量 fr。这种恒等式也可以从图的色顶点稳定性的已知结果得出；我们给出了一个建设性的证明。因此，对于所有 D₃，E₀ (D₃)=min(D₃,1) fr，可以在平面晶格上以多项式时间计算。在图论术语中，独立奇循环横截面可以在平面次三次图上以多项式时间求解。相反，在最大配位为 4 的平面晶格上，对于每个固定的 0le D₃<2 和 D₃ge2 的多项式，确定基态能量是 NP 完全的。边界由局部原则设定：第三状态中的配位点 d 最多可以解除 lfloor d/2rfloor 受挫键，因此一旦 D₃gelfloorΔ/2rfloor ，第三状态就没用了；该阈值对于每个 Δge3 都是尖锐的，并再现等效自旋 1 Blume-Capel 反铁磁体的三角晶格点 D₃^*=3。该证明从单个伊辛基态在多项式时间内建立了精确的基态，对于具有数千个位点的准晶、泡沫状和有缺陷的晶格来说，这需要几秒到几分钟的时间。

articles.title: Spin-conserving and spin-flip magnetic scattering in the altermagnetic spin-splitter effect
articles.title_zh: 交变自旋分裂效应中的自旋守恒和自旋翻转磁散射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41414v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Critical magnetic fluctuations scatter electrons strongly near an ordering transition, but they barely degrade the charge current, because they scatter mostly through small angles. In an altermagnet the electric field also drives a spin current, and a nearly forward spin flip moves an electron to the other spin band at almost unchanged velocity. We develop a Boltzmann theory of the spin splitter ratio that keeps the full collision operator of quasistatic magnetic fluctuations and its change with the magnetic order. Fluctuations of equal total strength give the same resistivity for every fraction of spin flips, yet they can move the spin splitter ratio in opposite directions. Spin conserving fluctuations relax the spin current at about the charge relaxation rate, whereas forward flips equalize the two spin populations at equal energy at the quasiparticle rate, which in two dimensions grows linearly with the correlation length. Energy conservation on the split bands protects the part of the spin current carried by the band shift of the occupied states at every scattering strength, and the splitting blocks forward flips once the spin Fermi lines lie farther apart than the inverse correlation length. When flips dominate, a quarter to a half of the lattice band ratio survives. The transport time approximation reproduces the initial growth of the resistivity but recovers only a quarter to a half of the initial fall of the ratio, and a disorder series at fixed reduced temperature measures this fall independent of the order amplitude.
articles.abstract_zh: 临界磁涨落会在有序跃迁附近强烈散射电子，但它们几乎不会降低充电电流，因为它们主要通过小角度散射。在交变磁体中，电场还驱动自旋电流，并且近乎正向的自旋翻转将电子以几乎不变的速度移动到另一个自旋带。我们发展了自旋分裂比的玻尔兹曼理论，该理论保持了准静态磁涨落的完全碰撞算子及其随磁序的变化。总强度相等的波动对于自旋翻转的每个部分给出相同的电阻率，但它们可以沿相反方向移动自旋分离器比率。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 临界磁涨落会在有序跃迁附近强烈散射电子，但它们几乎不会降低充电电流，因为它们主要通过小角度散射。在交变磁体中，电场还驱动自旋电流，并且近乎正向的自旋翻转将电子以几乎不变的速度移动到另一个自旋带。我们发展了自旋分裂比的玻尔兹曼理论，该理论保持了准静态磁涨落的完全碰撞算子及其随磁序的变化。总强度相等的波动对于自旋翻转的每个部分给出相同的电阻率，但它们可以沿相反方向移动自旋分离器比率。自旋守恒涨落使自旋电流以大约电荷弛豫率弛豫，而前向翻转以准粒子率以相等能量均衡两个自旋布居，其在二维中随相关长度线性增长。分裂能带上的能量守恒保护了在每个散射强度下由占据态的能带移位所携带的自旋电流的部分，并且一旦自旋费米线的距离远于逆相关长度，分裂块就会向前翻转。当翻转占主导地位时，四分之一到一半的晶格能带比得以保留。传输时间近似再现了电阻率的初始增长，但仅恢复了比率初始下降的四分之一到一半，并且固定降低温度下的无序序列测量了与阶次幅度无关的下降。

articles.title: Spin conservation protects the altermagnetic spin-splitter current from critical scattering
articles.title_zh: 自旋守恒保护交变磁自旋分离器电流免受临界散射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41419v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Near a magnetic transition, critical fluctuations scatter electrons strongly, but the charge current survives, because long wavelength fluctuations barely turn the electron velocity. In an altermagnet the electric field also drives a spin current, the spin splitter effect, and a nearly forward scattering event that flips spin moves an electron to the other spin band at almost unchanged velocity. We show that the spin current shares the protection of the charge current only when the fluctuations conserve spin. Solving the Boltzmann equation with the full collision operator, including its change with the magnetic order, we find that forward flips equalize the two spin populations at equal energy at the quasiparticle rate, which in two dimensions grows linearly with the correlation length, whereas spin conserving fluctuations relax the spin current at a rate comparable to the charge relaxation rate. Fluctuations with the same resistivity can thus move the spin splitter ratio in opposite directions. Energy conservation protects the part of the spin current that follows the band shift of the occupied states, and the splitting blocks forward flips once the spin Fermi lines lie farther apart than the inverse correlation length. A disorder series at fixed reduced temperature measures the initial fall of the ratio with the magnetic resistivity independent of the order amplitude, and the growth of this slope toward the transition identifies spin flip critical fluctuations.
articles.abstract_zh: 在磁转变附近，临界波动会强烈散射电子，但充电电流仍然存在，因为长波长波动几乎不会改变电子速度。在交变磁体中，电场还驱动自旋电流、自旋分裂器效应以及翻转自旋的近前向散射事件，使电子以几乎不变的速度移动到另一个自旋带。我们证明，只有当波动守恒自旋时，自旋电流才共享充电电流的保护。用完整的碰撞算子求解玻尔兹曼方程，包括其随磁序的变化，我们发现前向翻转使两个自旋布居在准粒子率下以相等的能量均衡，其在二维中随相关长度线性增长，而自旋守恒涨落以与电荷弛豫率相当的速率松弛自旋电流。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在磁转变附近，临界波动会强烈散射电子，但充电电流仍然存在，因为长波长波动几乎不会改变电子速度。在交变磁体中，电场还驱动自旋电流、自旋分裂器效应以及翻转自旋的近前向散射事件，使电子以几乎不变的速度移动到另一个自旋带。我们证明，只有当波动守恒自旋时，自旋电流才共享充电电流的保护。用完整的碰撞算子求解玻尔兹曼方程，包括其随磁序的变化，我们发现前向翻转使两个自旋布居在准粒子率下以相等的能量均衡，其在二维中随相关长度线性增长，而自旋守恒涨落以与电荷弛豫率相当的速率松弛自旋电流。因此，具有相同电阻率的波动可以使自旋分离器比率沿相反方向移动。能量守恒保护了跟随占据态能带移动的自旋流部分，一旦自旋费米线的距离远大于逆相关长度，分裂块就会向前翻转。固定降低温度下的无序序列测量与有序幅度无关的磁阻率之比的初始下降，并且该斜率向转变的增长确定了自旋翻转临界波动。

articles.title: Potentials of individual atoms by convergent beam electron diffraction
articles.title_zh: 通过会聚束电子衍射分析单个原子的电势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41513v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In convergent beam electron diffraction (CBED) on two-dimensional (2D) materials, the intensity distributions within the individual CBED spots map the local atomic arrangements within the probed region. In this study we demonstrate that the average intensities within the CBED spots essentially depend on the scattering parameters by a single atom, thus, offering the possibility of the direct measurement of such parameters. Scattering potential of an individual atom can be approximated by the Gaussian function and its parameters, the standard deviation and the maximal phase shift, can be recovered from the ratio of the intensities in the zero- and higher orders spots in CBED pattern. In order to demonstrate this, we simulated CBED patterns and extracted the atomic scattering parameters from such patterns. In the simulated examples, no weak phase object approximation is applied and the proposed method provides accurate results even for materials with large phase shifts up to 1.5 rad, as for example tungsten. The scattering parameters recovered from the experimental CBED patterns of graphene and twisted graphene-hBN structure show good agreement with the theoretically obtained values.
articles.abstract_zh: 在二维 (2D) 材料上的会聚束电子衍射 (CBED) 中，各个 CBED 斑点内的强度分布映射了探测区域内的局部原子排列。在这项研究中，我们证明了 CBED 斑点内的平均强度本质上取决于单个原子的散射参数，从而提供了直接测量这些参数的可能性。单个原子的散射势可以通过高斯函数来近似，其参数、标准偏差和最大相移可以从 CBED 图案中零级和高阶点的强度比来恢复。为了证明这一点，我们模拟了 CBED 图案并从这些图案中提取了原子散射参数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在二维 (2D) 材料上的会聚束电子衍射 (CBED) 中，各个 CBED 斑点内的强度分布映射了探测区域内的局部原子排列。在这项研究中，我们证明了 CBED 斑点内的平均强度本质上取决于单个原子的散射参数，从而提供了直接测量这些参数的可能性。单个原子的散射势可以通过高斯函数来近似，其参数、标准偏差和最大相移可以从 CBED 图案中零级和高阶点的强度比来恢复。为了证明这一点，我们模拟了 CBED 图案并从这些图案中提取了原子散射参数。在模拟示例中，没有应用弱相对象近似，并且即使对于相移高达 1.5 rad 的材料（例如钨），所提出的方法也能提供准确的结果。从石墨烯和扭曲石墨烯-六方氮化硼结构的实验 CBED 图案中恢复的散射参数与理论获得的值非常吻合。

articles.title: Mirror-symmetry engineering of altermagnetism based on monolayer hexagonal lattices
articles.title_zh: 基于单层六方晶格的交磁镜面对称工程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41589v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnetism (AM) is a novel collinear antiferromagnetic phase characterized by spin-polarized bands and zero net magnetization. However, realizing AM in monolayer hexagonal lattices is strongly constrained by lattice symmetry. Here, we propose a mirror-symmetry-based design principle and implementation scheme for realizing AM based on monolayer hexagonal lattices and validate it using holey graphyne (HGY) as a representative system. By examining hydrogenated nonmetal units X-H (X = B, C, N, P, and S) introduced along the mirror-symmetry axis and extending the analysis to N-F, we identify the configurations that form two antiparallel spin sublattices related by mirror reflection. The N-H structure forms a stable altermagnetic ground state, with a momentum-dependent spin splitting up to 148.2 meV. The magnetism originates from π-π superexchange interactions, and H/F functionalization stabilizes intrinsic AM by regulating the local charge distribution. Our work offers insights into the design of light-element altermagnetic materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 交变磁性（AM）是一种新型共线反铁磁相，其特征是自旋极化带和零净磁化强度。然而，在单层六方晶格中实现增材制造受到晶格对称性的强烈限制。在这里，我们提出了一种基于镜面对称的设计原理和实现方案，用于实现基于单层六方晶格的增材制造，并使用多孔石墨炔（HGY）作为代表系统进行了验证。通过检查沿镜面对称轴引入的氢化非金属单元 X-H（X = B、C、N、P 和 S）并将分析扩展到 N-F，我们确定了形成两个通过镜面反射相关的反平行自旋亚晶格的构型。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 交变磁性（AM）是一种新型共线反铁磁相，其特征是自旋极化带和零净磁化强度。然而，在单层六方晶格中实现增材制造受到晶格对称性的强烈限制。在这里，我们提出了一种基于镜面对称的设计原理和实现方案，用于实现基于单层六方晶格的增材制造，并使用多孔石墨炔（HGY）作为代表系统进行了验证。通过检查沿镜面对称轴引入的氢化非金属单元 X-H（X = B、C、N、P 和 S）并将分析扩展到 N-F，我们确定了形成两个通过镜面反射相关的反平行自旋亚晶格的构型。 N-H 结构形成稳定的交变磁基态，动量相关的自旋分裂高达 148.2 meV。磁性源自π-π超交换相互作用，H/F功能化通过调节局部电荷分布来稳定本征AM。我们的工作为轻元素交磁材料的设计提供了见解。

articles.title: Microscopic structure at the morphotropic phase boundary in lead-barium meta-niobat
articles.title_zh: 铅-钡偏铌酸锂同形相界的微观结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41601v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Lead-barium niobate Pb₁₋ₓBaₓNb₂O₆ is a tetragonal tungsten-bronze ferroelectric that exhibits enhanced functional properties near a morphotropic phase boundary separating orthorhombic and tetragonal phases. Using first-principles electronic-structure calculations combined with ab initio molecular dynamics, we investigate how Ba substitution modifies cation-site occupancy, local distortions, and polarization behavior across the solid solution. By explicitly accounting for vacancy ordering and the inequivalent A-site cages intrinsic to the tungsten-bronze framework, we identify the structural origin of the orthorhombic-to-tetragonal transition. Increasing Ba content progressively weakens the cooperative in-plane off-centering of Pb ions in the pentagonal channels and promotes out-of-plane displacements of Nb and A-site cations, leading to a rotation of the spontaneous polarization from [110] to [001]. The transition occurs near x approx 0.6, in quantitative agreement with experimental phase diagrams. These results provide a microscopic interpretation of the morphotropic phase boundary in Pb₁₋ₓBaₓNb₂O₆ and establish a clear structure-polarization relationship for tungsten-bronze ferroelectrics.
articles.abstract_zh: 铌酸铅钡 Pb₁₋ₓBaₓNb2O₆ 是一种四方钨青铜铁电体，在分离正交相和四方相的同形相边界附近表现出增强的功能特性。利用第一原理电子结构计算与从头算分子动力学相结合，我们研究了 Ba 取代如何改变固溶体中的阳离子位点占据、局部扭曲和极化行为。通过明确地考虑钨青铜框架固有的空位排序和不等价的 A 位笼，我们确定了斜方晶系到四方晶系转变的结构起源。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 铌酸铅钡 Pb₁₋ₓBaₓNb2O₆ 是一种四方钨青铜铁电体，在分离正交相和四方相的同形相边界附近表现出增强的功能特性。利用第一原理电子结构计算与从头算分子动力学相结合，我们研究了 Ba 取代如何改变固溶体中的阳离子位点占据、局部扭曲和极化行为。通过明确地考虑钨青铜框架固有的空位排序和不等价的 A 位笼，我们确定了斜方晶系到四方晶系转变的结构起源。 Ba含量的增加逐渐减弱五边形通道中Pb离子的面内协同偏心，并促进Nb和A位阳离子的面外位移，导致自发极化从[110]旋转到[001]。该转变发生在 x 约 0.6 附近，与实验相图定量一致。这些结果提供了 Pb₁₋ₓBaₓNb2O₆ 中同形相界的微观解释，并为钨青铜铁电体建立了清晰的结构-极化关系。

articles.title: Hierarchy of Electromagnetic Gauge Field Quantum Geometries
articles.title_zh: 电磁规范场量子几何的层次结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41610v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The conventional Bloch quantum geometric tensor (QGT) describes electric-dipole geometry for spatially uniform perturbations and vertical Bloch transitions. We develop a broader framework linking quantum geometry to local and nonlocal electromagnetic response in gauge-field space, placing this tensor within a hierarchy of electric and magnetic multipole quantum geometries. The intrinsic antisymmetric adiabatic response in every electromagnetic channel is a Berry curvature in the space of its conjugate fields. The field-dependent projector uniquely fixes the QGT for that channel, pairing the response curvature with a quantum metric. This construction extends to spatially nonuniform perturbations, whose finite momentum transfer induces nonvertical Bloch transitions. We explicitly construct the current--current QGT connecting Bloch states at kpmq/2, providing a unified metric and curvature description of nonlocal current response. In the doubled Brillouin zone, tangential derivatives generate conventional momentum-space QGT multipoles, whereas normal derivatives connect finite-momentum geometry to uniform electric- and magnetic-multipole-pair QGTs. We derive this connection through second order in q. The finite-momentum curvature governs the intrinsic nonlocal Hall response, while an inverse-frequency moment of symmetric optical absorption probes the index-symmetric metric sector.
articles.abstract_zh: 传统的布洛赫量子几何张量 (QGT) 描述了空间均匀扰动和垂直布洛赫跃迁的电偶极几何。我们开发了一个更广泛的框架，将量子几何与规范场空间中的局域和非局域电磁响应联系起来，将该张量置于电和磁多极量子几何的层次结构中。每个电磁通道中固有的反对称绝热响应是其共轭场空间中的贝里曲率。场相关投影仪独特地固定了该通道的 QGT，将响应曲率与量子度量配对。这种结构扩展到空间非均匀扰动，其有限动量传递引起非垂直布洛赫跃迁。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 传统的布洛赫量子几何张量 (QGT) 描述了空间均匀扰动和垂直布洛赫跃迁的电偶极几何。我们开发了一个更广泛的框架，将量子几何与规范场空间中的局域和非局域电磁响应联系起来，将该张量置于电和磁多极量子几何的层次结构中。每个电磁通道中固有的反对称绝热响应是其共轭场空间中的贝里曲率。场相关投影仪独特地固定了该通道的 QGT，将响应曲率与量子度量配对。这种结构扩展到空间非均匀扰动，其有限动量传递引起非垂直布洛赫跃迁。我们明确地构造了连接 kpmq/2 处的 Bloch 状态的电流-电流 QGT，提供了非局部电流响应的统一度量和曲率描述。在双布里渊区，切向导数生成传统的动量空间 QGT 多极子，而普通导数将有限动量几何结构连接到均匀的电和磁多极对 QGT。我们通过 q 的二阶推导出这个联系。有限动量曲率控制固有的非局部霍尔响应，而对称光学吸收的反频矩则探测折射率对称的度量扇区。

articles.title: Counting kinks and magnons with the lattice: magnetoelastic effects in Cs₂CoBr₄
articles.title_zh: 用晶格计算扭结和磁振子：Cs2CoBr₄ 中的磁致弹性效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41619v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report low-temperature dilatometry and ultrasound measurements on the frustrated quasi-one-dimensional antiferromagnet Cs₂CoBr₄ across the entire cascade of field-induced magnetic phase transitions. The whole phase diagram can be recovered from these lattice probes, with distinct anomalies observed at each phase boundary. Elongation along the principal chain axis is found to closely track magnetization throughout the phase diagram. This behavior is interpreted in terms of kinks in the Néel structure and magnons in the transverse-ordered magnetic-BEC phases, each carrying a fixed lattice distortion. A simultaneous analysis of ultrasound and striction data allows us to quantify the strength of magnetoelastic coupling.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们报告了在磁场诱导的磁相变的整个级联中，对受挫的准一维反铁磁体Cs ₂ CoBr ”进行的低温扩张测量和超声测量。可以从这些晶格探针中恢复整个相位图，并在每个相位边界处观察到明显的异常。发现沿主链轴的伸长率在整个相图中密切跟踪磁化。这种行为是根据Néel结构中的扭结和横向有序磁BEC相中的磁控子来解释的，每个磁控子都携带固定的晶格畸变。同时分析超声和严格数据使我们能够量化磁弹性耦合的强度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了在磁场诱导的磁相变的整个级联中，对受挫的准一维反铁磁体Cs ₂ CoBr ”进行的低温扩张测量和超声测量。可以从这些晶格探针中恢复整个相位图，并在每个相位边界处观察到明显的异常。发现沿主链轴的伸长率在整个相图中密切跟踪磁化。这种行为是根据Néel结构中的扭结和横向有序磁BEC相中的磁控子来解释的，每个磁控子都携带固定的晶格畸变。同时分析超声和严格数据使我们能够量化磁弹性耦合的强度。

articles.title: Spontaneous Circular Dichroism and Memory Effect from Surface Defects in Altermagnetic MnTe
articles.title_zh: 交变磁性 MnTe 表面缺陷的自发圆二色性和记忆效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41797v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnetism has emerged as a new class of magnetism with vanishing magnetization and macroscopic time reversal symmetry breaking. Hexagonal MnTe is a g-wave altermagnet with a 307 K Néel temperature, large spin splitting, and an anomalous Hall effect. However, the relationship between altermagnetism and the anomalous Hall effect in MnTe remains debated. Here, using optical magnetic circular dichroism, we observe hysteresis and a memory effect in a MnTe bulk crystal below 250 K. No hysteresis is seen after polishing the bulk crystal and in thin films. We conclude that the hysteresis in magnetic circular dichroism in the bulk crystal is from surface defects. The similar temperature dependence and a sign change between circular dichroism and the anomalous Hall effect indicate that the origin of the anomalous Hall effect in transport is likely not intrinsic.
articles.abstract_zh: Altermagnetism已经成为一种具有消失磁化和宏观时间反转对称性断裂的新型磁性。六方MnTe是一种g波改变磁体，具有307 K Néel温度、大自旋分裂和异常霍尔效应。然而， MnTe中的替代磁性与异常霍尔效应之间的关系仍然存在争议。在这里，我们使用光磁圆二色性，在250 K以下的MnTe块状晶体中观察到滞后和记忆效应。在抛光块状晶体和薄膜后没有发现滞后。我们得出结论，本体晶体中磁圆二色性的滞后是由于表面缺陷造成的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Altermagnetism已经成为一种具有消失磁化和宏观时间反转对称性断裂的新型磁性。六方MnTe是一种g波改变磁体，具有307 K Néel温度、大自旋分裂和异常霍尔效应。然而， MnTe中的替代磁性与异常霍尔效应之间的关系仍然存在争议。在这里，我们使用光磁圆二色性，在250 K以下的MnTe块状晶体中观察到滞后和记忆效应。在抛光块状晶体和薄膜后没有发现滞后。我们得出结论，本体晶体中磁圆二色性的滞后是由于表面缺陷造成的。圆二色性和异常霍尔效应之间类似的温度依赖性和符号变化表明，运输中异常霍尔效应的起源可能不是内在的。

articles.title: Fano Resonance of a Magnonic Ring Resonator with a Nano-Scatterer Embedded in a Magnonic Conduit
articles.title_zh: 嵌入在磁导管中的纳米散射体的磁环谐振器的Fano共振
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41816v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present micromagnetic simulation of a nanoscale magnonic ring resonator coupled to a magnonic waveguide, with and without a hole embedded in the waveguide (H-NRR and NRR respectively), for realizing transformation into a Fano resonance frequency spectral lineshape from a Lorentzian one. Transmission and reflection spectra of the H-NRR and NRR have been analyzed for different structural parameters (embedded hole diameter and gap between the ring and the waveguide) and material parameters (damping factor of the ring) to achieve maximum spectral transmission magnitude variation. The obtained micromagnetic simulation results are supported by an analytical model that consists of two-tracks of wave propagation, forwards and backwards. Our findings show that H-NRR system demonstrates a monotonic dependence of spectral transmission magnitude variation against the aforementioned design parameters (gap and damping) which should provide better engineering controllability and tolerance when compared with the original NRR system. Overall, our proposed structure and study may help in building unconventional magnonic integrated circuits for sensing, data processing systems and computing.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了耦合到磁波导的纳米级磁环谐振器的微磁模拟，其中在波导中嵌入和不嵌入孔（分别为H-NRR和NRR ） ，以实现从洛伦兹波导转换为Fano共振频谱线形。分析了H-NRR和NRR在不同结构参数（嵌入孔直径和环与波导之间的间隙）和材料参数（环的阻尼因子）下的透射和反射光谱，以实现最大的光谱透射幅度变化。获得的微磁仿真结果得到了一个分析模型的支持，该模型由前后波传播的双轨道组成。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了耦合到磁波导的纳米级磁环谐振器的微磁模拟，其中在波导中嵌入和不嵌入孔（分别为H-NRR和NRR ） ，以实现从洛伦兹波导转换为Fano共振频谱线形。分析了H-NRR和NRR在不同结构参数（嵌入孔直径和环与波导之间的间隙）和材料参数（环的阻尼因子）下的透射和反射光谱，以实现最大的光谱透射幅度变化。获得的微磁仿真结果得到了一个分析模型的支持，该模型由前后波传播的双轨道组成。我们的研究结果表明，与原始NRR系统相比， H-NRR系统表现出光谱透射幅度变化对上述设计参数（间隙和阻尼）的单调依赖性，这应该可以提供更好的工程可控性和容差。总体而言，我们提出的结构和研究可能有助于构建用于传感、数据处理系统和计算的非传统磁子集成电路。

articles.title: Creating functional nanostructures for vortex manipulation in superconducting Bi₂Sr₂CaCu₂O₈+x thin films via focused He ion beam irradiation
articles.title_zh: 通过聚焦He离子束照射在超导Bi ₂ Sr ₂ CaCu ₂ O ”+ x薄膜中创建用于涡旋操纵的功能性纳米结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41827v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bi₂Sr₂CaCu₂O₈₊ₓ (Bi-2212) is a highly anisotropic high-temperature superconductor exhibiting unique vortex dynamics due to its layered structure. Precise nanoscale patterning of ultrathin Bi-2212 films remains challenging, limiting controlled studies of vortex pinning. Here, we employ 30 keV focused helium ion beam (He-FIB) irradiation to fabricate periodic arrays of columnar defects with 100 nm spacings in optimally-doped Bi-2212 thin films, thereby creating artificial vortex pinning centers. Magnetotransport measurements reveal pronounced vortex matching effects, evidenced by minima in magnetoresistance and peaks in critical current at commensurate magnetic fields. The angular dependence of magnetoresistance and critical current scale with an effective magnetic field, indicating strong confinement of pancake vortices along irradiation-induced tracks. These findings demonstrate the efficacy of He-FIB nanopatterning in modulating the superconducting properties in Bi-2212 thin films, providing a platform for fundamental studies of vortex matter and advancing prospects for device applications based on this highly anisotropic superconductor.
articles.abstract_zh: Bi ₂ Sr ₂ CaCu ₂ O (Bi-2212)是一种高度各向异性的高温超导体，由于其分层结构而表现出独特的涡旋动力学。超薄Bi-2212薄膜的精确纳米级图案化仍然具有挑战性，限制了涡旋钉扎的对照研究。在这里，我们采用30 keV聚焦氦离子束（ He-FIB ）辐照，在最佳掺杂的Bi-2212薄膜中制造具有100 nm间距的柱状缺陷周期阵列，从而创建人工涡旋钉扎中心。磁力传输测量揭示了显着的涡旋匹配效应，磁阻最小值和相应磁场下临界电流的峰值就证明了这一点。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Bi ₂ Sr ₂ CaCu ₂ O (Bi-2212)是一种高度各向异性的高温超导体，由于其分层结构而表现出独特的涡旋动力学。超薄Bi-2212薄膜的精确纳米级图案化仍然具有挑战性，限制了涡旋钉扎的对照研究。在这里，我们采用30 keV聚焦氦离子束（ He-FIB ）辐照，在最佳掺杂的Bi-2212薄膜中制造具有100 nm间距的柱状缺陷周期阵列，从而创建人工涡旋钉扎中心。磁力传输测量揭示了显着的涡旋匹配效应，磁阻最小值和相应磁场下临界电流的峰值就证明了这一点。磁阻和临界电流刻度与有效磁场的角依赖性，表明煎饼涡沿辐射诱导轨迹的强烈约束。这些发现证明了He-FIB纳米图案化在调节Bi-2212薄膜超导特性方面的功效，为涡旋物质的基础研究提供了一个平台，并基于这种高度各向异性的超导体推进了器件应用的前景。

articles.title: Full-Potential Korringa Kohn Rostoker Study of Structural and Mechanical Properties in SiGeSn Alloys
articles.title_zh: SiGeSn合金组织和力学性能的全电位Korringa Kohn Rostoker研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41838v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate first-principles descriptions of open, covalently bonded crystal structures remain challenging within conventional Korringa--Kohn--Rostoker (KKR) approaches owing to the spherical approximations commonly employed for the effective crystal potential. Here, we systematically assess the recently developed full-potential KKR (KKR-FP) implementation in the open-source MuST package and demonstrate its applicability to diamond-structured group-IV semiconductors and SiGeSn alloys. Benchmark calculations for diamond-structured Si reveal substantial limitations of the conventional muffin-tin and atomic sphere approximations, whereas KKR-FP accurately reproduces the experimental equilibrium lattice parameter and bulk modulus, yielding 5.433 and 94.9 GPa. The full-potential treatment also recovers the semiconducting character of Si. Further calculations for elemental Ge and Sn establish the applicability of the approach across group-IV materials. Extending this framework to SiGeSn alloys, we investigate their composition-dependent equilibrium lattice parameters, bulk moduli, and mixing enthalpies. The calculated lattice parameters exhibit positive deviations from Vegard's law, while the bulk modulus decreases substantially with changes in alloy composition. Moreover, positive mixing enthalpies of 180.92 and 346.32 meV/atom are obtained for Si0.5Ge0.375Sn0.125 and Si0.375Ge0.25Sn0.375, respectively, indicating an energetic penalty for homogeneous alloy formation relative to the selected elemental reference states. These findings highlight the importance of nonspherical potential contributions in accurately describing open-structured semiconductors and establish KKR-FP within MuST as a promising framework for investigating the structural properties and mixing energetics of compositionally complex group-IV alloys
articles.abstract_zh: 由于有效晶势通常采用球面近似，在传统的Korringa-Kohn-Rostoker （ KKR ）方法中，对开放式共价键合晶体结构的准确第一原理描述仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们系统地评估了最近在开源MuST封装中开发的全电位KKR （ KKR-FP ）实现，并证明了其适用于金刚石结构的IV族半导体和SiGeSn合金。金刚石结构硅的基准计算揭示了传统松饼锡和原子球近似的实质性局限性，而KKR-FP准确地再现了实验平衡晶格参数和体积模量，产生5.433和94.9 GPa。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由于有效晶势通常采用球面近似，在传统的Korringa-Kohn-Rostoker （ KKR ）方法中，对开放式共价键合晶体结构的准确第一原理描述仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们系统地评估了最近在开源MuST封装中开发的全电位KKR （ KKR-FP ）实现，并证明了其适用于金刚石结构的IV族半导体和SiGeSn合金。金刚石结构硅的基准计算揭示了传统松饼锡和原子球近似的实质性局限性，而KKR-FP准确地再现了实验平衡晶格参数和体积模量，产生5.433和94.9 GPa。全电位处理也恢复了硅的半导体特性。对元素Ge和Sn的进一步计算确定了该方法在IV族材料中的适用性。将这一框架扩展到SiGeSn合金，我们研究其成分相关的平衡晶格参数、体积模量和混合焓。计算的晶格参数表现出与Vegard定律的正偏差，而本体模量随着合金成分的变化而大幅下降。此外，对于Si0.5Ge0.375Sn0.125和Si0.375Ge0.25Sn0.375 ，分别获得了180.92和346.32 meV/原子的正混合焓，这表明相对于所选择的元素参考状态，均匀合金形成的能量惩罚。这些发现强调了非球形电位贡献在准确描述开放结构半导体和在MuST中建立KKR-FP作为研究组成复杂IV族合金的结构特性和混合能量的有前途的框架的重要性

articles.title: Magnetic control of reflectionless states and an intrinsic-mode exceptional point in a magnon-phonon coupling system
articles.title_zh: 磁强子-声子耦合系统中无反射状态的磁控和固有模式的特殊点
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41851v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reflectionless states (RLs) and exceptional points (EPs) are hallmark singular responses of non-Hermitian systems, with potential applications in sensing, wave control, and energy manipulation. Yet, realizing and independently tuning these states in a compact integrated platform remains challenging. Here, we demonstrate two-dimensional magnetic control of RLs and EPs in an on-chip magnon-phonon system based on a FeGaB-32 degree-YX-LiNbO3 heterostructure. The magnetic-field magnitude tunes the magnon-phonon detuning, driving a low-loss reflection zero across the real-frequency axis and producing two field-tunable RLs with near-vanishing reflection. A closed contour of the experimentally measured complex S11 around the reflection-zero singularity accumulates a -2pi phase winding. Independently, rotating the magnetic field tunes the magnon-phonon coupling strength, driving the intrinsic magnon-phonon eigenmode spectrum across an exceptional point, identified by the exchange between real-part and imaginary-part eigenvalue splitting. A unified one-port input-output model connects the measured complex S11 response to the field-driven dynamics of the reflection zeros and the angle-tuned intrinsic magnon-phonon eigenmodes. These results establish a magnetically programmable non-Hermitian magnon-phonon platform for integrated wave control and compact vector magnetic sensing.
articles.abstract_zh: 无反射状态（ RL ）和异常点（ EP ）是非埃尔米特系统的标志性奇异响应，在传感、波控和能量操纵方面具有潜在的应用。然而，在紧凑的集成平台中实现和独立调节这些状态仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们演示了基于FeGaB-32度-YX-LiNbO3异质结构的片上倍频声子系统中RL和EP的二维磁控。磁场幅度调谐磁振子失调，驱动实频轴上的低损耗反射零，并产生两个具有近乎消失反射的场可调谐RL。实验测量的复合体S11围绕反射零奇点的闭合轮廓累积了-2pi相位绕组。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 无反射状态（ RL ）和异常点（ EP ）是非埃尔米特系统的标志性奇异响应，在传感、波控和能量操纵方面具有潜在的应用。然而，在紧凑的集成平台中实现和独立调节这些状态仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们演示了基于FeGaB-32度-YX-LiNbO3异质结构的片上倍频声子系统中RL和EP的二维磁控。磁场幅度调谐磁振子失调，驱动实频轴上的低损耗反射零，并产生两个具有近乎消失反射的场可调谐RL。实验测量的复合体S11围绕反射零奇点的闭合轮廓累积了-2pi相位绕组。独立地，旋转磁场调谐磁声耦合强度，驱动固有磁声声本征模式光谱穿过一个特殊点，通过实部和虚部特征值分裂之间的交换来识别。统一的单端口输入输出模型将测量的复杂S11响应连接到反射零点的场驱动动力学和角度调谐的固有磁声本征模态。这些结果为集成波控制和紧凑矢量磁传感建立了一个磁可编程的非埃尔米特磁声子平台。

articles.title: Generative Design and Graph Neural Network Screening of Novel Bimetallic Alloy Catalysts for the Hydrogen Evolution Reaction
articles.title_zh: 用于氢进化反应的新型双金属合金催化剂的生成设计和图形神经网络筛选
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41932v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Identifying earth-abundant catalysts for the hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) is a central challenge in scalable green hydrogen production. We present a computational pipeline that couples diffusion-based generative modelling, machine-learning force-field relaxation, and graph neural network (GNN) property prediction to discover bimetallic HER catalysts beyond the structures and stoichiometries covered by existing adsorption databases. A generative model (MatterGen) is fine-tuned on bulk alloy structures labelled with their minimum hydrogen adsorption energy and steered towards adsorption energies near zero. From the generated pool we retain the stable structures that are novel bimetallic alloys: binary compositions built from the training-set metals but at stoichiometries or structures absent from that database. Each candidate's low-index facets are ranked by a machine-learning-force-field (MatterSim) surface-energy screen, and only the most stable terminations are converted into explicit slab models with hydrogen adsorbed at all high-symmetry surface sites and relaxed with the same force field. Two GNN surrogates (MEGNet and ALIGNN), trained on a high-throughput density functional theory (DFT) dataset, then screen the resulting slab candidates. Because the two models encode the local environment through different inductive biases, we retain only the alloys on which both agree, reducing the influence of any single model. This consensus screening, combined with a MatterSim energy-difference triangulation, resulted in a shortlist of near-thermoneutral bimetallic candidates. Eight are validated with plane-wave DFT, and four of them, Pd5Au, Pt5Rh, Cu5Pt3, and Pd13Ru3, bind hydrogen within the thermoneutral window. All eight alloys are dynamically stable by phonon calculations. These four alloys are highlighted as DFT-validated bimetallic HER candidates for experimental follow-up.
articles.abstract_zh: 在可扩展的绿色氢气生产中，识别用于氢气演化反应（ HER ）的地球丰富催化剂是一项核心挑战。我们提出了一种计算流水线，将基于扩散的生成模型、机器学习力场弛豫和图形神经网络（ GNN ）属性预测相结合，以发现现有吸附数据库所涵盖的结构和化学计量之外的双金属SHER催化剂。生成模型（ MatterGen ）在标记有最小氢吸附能量的散装合金结构上进行微调，并朝向接近零的吸附能量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在可扩展的绿色氢气生产中，识别用于氢气演化反应（ HER ）的地球丰富催化剂是一项核心挑战。我们提出了一种计算流水线，将基于扩散的生成模型、机器学习力场弛豫和图形神经网络（ GNN ）属性预测相结合，以发现现有吸附数据库所涵盖的结构和化学计量之外的双金属SHER催化剂。生成模型（ MatterGen ）在标记有最小氢吸附能量的散装合金结构上进行微调，并朝向接近零的吸附能量。从生成的池中，我们保留了作为新型双金属合金的稳定结构：由训练集金属构建的二元成分，但在该数据库中不存在的化学计量或结构。每个候选人的低指数面通过机器学习力场（ MatterSim ）表面能屏幕进行排名，只有最稳定的终端被转换为显式板坯模型，在所有高对称表面位置吸附氢气，并在相同的力场下放松。在高通量密度泛函理论（ DFT ）数据集上训练的两个GNN代理（ MEGNet和ALIGNN ） ，然后筛选得到的板坯候选。由于这两个模型通过不同的感应偏置对局部环境进行编码，因此我们仅保留两者一致的合金，从而减少了任何单个模型的影响。这种共识筛选与MatterSim能量差三角测量相结合，产生了近热中性双金属候选者的入围名单。八个用平面波DFT验证，其中四个Pd5Au、Pt5Rh、Cu5Pt3和Pd13Ru3在热中性窗口内结合氢。通过声子计算，所有八种合金都是动态稳定的。这四种合金被突出显示为DFT验证的双金属SHER候选物，用于实验随访。

articles.title: Existence of the thermodynamic limit for the Hopfield model
articles.title_zh: Hopfield模型热力学极限的存在性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41938v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We prove that the quenched pressure of the Hopfield model with Ksimα N i.i.d. symmetric Rademacher patterns has a thermodynamic limit at every load αin(0,infty), finite inverse temperature and uniform external field, with no replica-symmetry, order-parameter concentration or non-condensation hypothesis required. The limit is the supremum over r of limiting pressures of mixed models with r binary patterns in a Gaussian bulk. Via the Hubbard--Stratonovich representation we extract the finitely many patterns whose hidden coordinates exceed δsqrt N; a collective interpolation replaces the other binary patterns by Gaussian ones with error O(δ²) uniform in the volume, and convex concentration on the discrete cube controls the disorder-dependent choice of retained patterns. For the mixed models we prove a Gaussian hidden-spin truncation bound uniform in the volume and in an arbitrary Ising potential, and convergence for Gaussian bulks with finitely many site-field types, reducing to results of Ho and of Chen, Ho and Issa on non-convex vector spin glasses with compact spins. For Gaussian patterns we give an alternative proof of the existence result announced by Camilli, Contucci and Mingione, extended to a uniform field and an extra binary pattern. In both cases the pressure has exponentially small deviation probabilities and converges a.s.; internal energy and entropy converge wherever the limit is differentiable. An extra binary Mattis pattern admits a scalar variational reduction. At zero field the Rademacher pressure dominates the Gaussian one with an extra binary pattern, which dominates the pure Gaussian one. No explicit formula is given. The proofs were generated through extensive interaction with the AI models Claude (Opus~5.5) and ChatGPT (Sol~6.1), based on the problem formulation and guidance of the authors.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们证明了具有Ksimα N i.i.d.对称Rademacher模式的Hopfield模型的淬火压力在每个负载αin (0, infty)、有限逆温度和均匀外场处都有热力学极限，不需要复制对称性、有序参数浓度或非缩合假设。该极限是高斯体中具有r个二进制模式的混合模型的极限压力的最大值。通过哈伯德-斯特拉托诺维奇表示，我们提取了隐藏坐标超过δsqrt N的有限图案；
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们证明了具有Ksimα N i.i.d.对称Rademacher模式的Hopfield模型的淬火压力在每个负载αin (0, infty)、有限逆温度和均匀外场处都有热力学极限，不需要复制对称性、有序参数浓度或非缩合假设。该极限是高斯体中具有r个二进制模式的混合模型的极限压力的最大值。通过哈伯德-斯特拉托诺维奇表示，我们提取了隐藏坐标超过δsqrt N的有限图案；集体插值用体积中误差为O (δ ²)均匀的高斯图案替换了其他二进制图案，离散立方体上的凸浓度控制了保留图案的无序选择。对于混合模型，我们证明了体积和任意Ising势的高斯隐自旋截尾均匀性，以及具有有限多个位域类型的高斯块的收敛性，简化为Ho和Chen、Ho和Issa在具有紧凑自旋的非凸向量自旋玻璃上的结果。对于高斯模式，我们给出了Camilli ， Contucci和Mingione宣布的存在结果的另一种证明，扩展到一个均匀场和一个额外的二进制模式。在这两种情况下，压力具有指数小的偏差概率并收敛于；内部能量和熵在极限可微的地方收敛。额外的二进制Mattis模式允许标量变分减少。在零场处， Rademacher压力以额外的二进制模式主导高斯模式，其主导纯高斯模式。未给出显式公式。这些证明是通过与AI模型Claude （ Opus~5.5 ）和ChatGPT （ Sol~6.1 ）的广泛交互生成的，基于作者的问题公式和指导。

articles.title: Thermal conductivity of Lennard-Jones fluids from equilibrium thermodynamics
articles.title_zh: 平衡热力学中Lennard-Jones流体的导热系数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41952v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We derive a general expression for the thermal conductivity of simple fluids within a thermodynamic transport theory (TTT) in which the Onsager coefficients of an interacting system are related to those of an ideal reference system through the ratio of the determinants of the Hessians of the relevant thermodynamic potential. The transported quantity is identified with an effective energy density proportional to the rms energy fluctuations of a small fluid cell. The result expresses the thermal conductivity as the product of its dilute-gas value and a function of equilibrium thermodynamic properties, namely the specific heats at constant density and at constant ρ T and the temperature derivative of the latter, with no adjustable parameters. For hard spheres, it reduces to a previously verified expression in terms of the thermodynamic factor. The theory is tested against molecular dynamics results for the Lennard-Jones (LJ) and the truncated and shifted Lennard-Jones (LJTS) fluids in the supercritical region, for densities up to ρ^*=0.8, using equations of state based on perturbation theory. For the LJTS fluid, the mean absolute percentage error is below 8% for all the temperatures considered. For the LJ fluid, the predictions are compared with those of the revised Enskog theory for Mie fluids, using the same equation of state: TTT gives smaller errors at almost all temperatures, with a significant improvement at low temperatures, where the errors are reduced approximately by a factor between two and three.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们在热力学传输理论（ TTT ）中推导出简单流体的热导率的一般表达式，其中相互作用系统的Onsager系数通过相关热力学势的Hessian决定因素的比率与理想参考系统的Onsager系数相关。运输量通过与小型流体电池的均方根能量波动成比例的有效能量密度来识别。结果将热导率表示为其稀释气体值的乘积和平衡热力学性质的函数，即恒定密度和恒定ρ T时的比热和后者的温度导数，没有可调参数。对于硬球，它在热力学因子方面简化为先前验证的表达。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们在热力学传输理论（ TTT ）中推导出简单流体的热导率的一般表达式，其中相互作用系统的Onsager系数通过相关热力学势的Hessian决定因素的比率与理想参考系统的Onsager系数相关。运输量通过与小型流体电池的均方根能量波动成比例的有效能量密度来识别。结果将热导率表示为其稀释气体值的乘积和平衡热力学性质的函数，即恒定密度和恒定ρ T时的比热和后者的温度导数，没有可调参数。对于硬球，它在热力学因子方面简化为先前验证的表达。使用基于扰动理论的状态方程，对超临界区域中密度高达ρ ^ * = 0.8的Lennard-Jones （ LJ ）流体以及截断和偏移的Lennard-Jones （ LJTS ）流体的分子动力学结果对该理论进行了测试。对于LJTS流体，对于考虑的所有温度，平均绝对百分比误差低于8%。对于LJ流体，使用相同的状态方程将预测与修订后的Mie流体Enskog理论的预测进行比较： TTT在几乎所有温度下都给出了较小的误差，在低温下有显着改善，误差大约减少了2到3倍。

articles.title: Shock Loading Accesses Reaction Pathways beyond Accelerated Thermolysis
articles.title_zh: 冲击加载超出加速热分解的反应途径
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41955v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Thermolysis and shock loading can produce similar major stable products in energetic materials, despite different chemical evolution and reaction pathways. Here, we develop EMFF-MACE, a reactive machine-learning potential for C/H/N/O energetic materials, enabling thermolysis simulations of 20 materials and shock simulations of 10 on a common potential energy surface. Comparisons at matched normalized reaction progress reveal divergent chemical states and local structural environments. Mean reaction-state similarity decreases from 94.0% at 20% progress to 25.9% at trajectory endpoints, while 47.1-92.6% of shock local environments lie outside corresponding material-specific thermolysis reference domains. Structural and reaction-network analyses reveal enhanced intermolecular reorganization and additional association and rearrangement branches under shock loading, despite partially shared early decomposition chemistry. These findings show that loading history influences the structural states and subsequent reaction pathways accessed during decomposition, rather than merely the rate of thermolysis.
articles.abstract_zh: 热解和冲击负荷可以在高能材料中产生类似的主要稳定产物，尽管化学演变和反应途径不同。在这里，我们开发了EMFF-MACE ，这是一种用于C/H/N/O高能材料的反应式机器学习潜力，可以对20种材料进行热解模拟，并在共同的势能面上进行10种材料的冲击模拟。匹配归一化反应过程的比较揭示了不同的化学状态和局部结构环境。平均反应态相似度从20%进展时的94.0%下降到轨迹终点的25.9% ，而47.1-92.6%的冲击局部环境位于相应的材料特异性热解参考域之外。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 热解和冲击负荷可以在高能材料中产生类似的主要稳定产物，尽管化学演变和反应途径不同。在这里，我们开发了EMFF-MACE ，这是一种用于C/H/N/O高能材料的反应式机器学习潜力，可以对20种材料进行热解模拟，并在共同的势能面上进行10种材料的冲击模拟。匹配归一化反应过程的比较揭示了不同的化学状态和局部结构环境。平均反应态相似度从20%进展时的94.0%下降到轨迹终点的25.9% ，而47.1-92.6%的冲击局部环境位于相应的材料特异性热解参考域之外。结构和反应网络分析揭示了在冲击加载下增强的分子间重组和额外的缔合和重排分支，尽管部分共享早期分解化学。这些发现表明，加载历史影响分解过程中的结构状态和随后的反应途径，而不仅仅是热解速率。

articles.title: Tensor cluster expansion as an efficient surrogate for multi-ACE
articles.title_zh: 张量簇扩张作为多ACE的有效替代品
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41969v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, we generalize an on-lattice tensor cluster expansion (TCE) framework to an arbitrary correlation order. We show that these generalized tensor cluster expansion features span a subspace of MACE features, suggesting that TCE features can sufficiently pre-screen MACE features for chemical diversity in alloyed transition metal dichalcogenide (TMD) monolayers. We show that, using maximum-entropy subset sampling, we can empirically recover chemical diversity from MACE features using a cheaper TCE representation. We then fine-tune a multi-ACE (MACE) potential with both subsets, and use this potential to predict temperature-dependent vibrational properties in alloyed TMD monolayers with varying chemical ordering. In our approach, TCE features can be used as cheap surrogate features for pre-screening chemically rich configurations using MACE features, allowing for the more efficient finetuning of atomic cluster expansion (ACE) potentials, thus achieving a tractable prediction of finite-temperature alloy thermodynamics on modest hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们将晶格上张量簇扩展（TCE）框架推广到任意相关阶。我们证明这些广义张量簇扩展特征跨越了 MACE 特征的子空间，这表明 TCE 特征可以充分预筛选 MACE 特征，以了解合金过渡金属二硫属化物 (TMD) 单层中的化学多样性。我们表明，使用最大熵子集采样，我们可以使用更便宜的 TCE 表示从 MACE 特征中凭经验恢复化学多样性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这项工作中，我们将晶格上张量簇扩展（TCE）框架推广到任意相关阶。我们证明这些广义张量簇扩展特征跨越了 MACE 特征的子空间，这表明 TCE 特征可以充分预筛选 MACE 特征，以了解合金过渡金属二硫属化物 (TMD) 单层中的化学多样性。我们表明，使用最大熵子集采样，我们可以使用更便宜的 TCE 表示从 MACE 特征中凭经验恢复化学多样性。然后，我们对两个子集的多 ACE (MACE) 势进行微调，并使用该势来预测具有不同化学顺序的合金 TMD 单分子层中与温度相关的振动特性。在我们的方法中，TCE 特征可以用作廉价的替代特征，使用 MACE 特征来预筛选化学丰富的配置，从而可以更有效地微调原子团簇膨胀 (ACE) 势，从而在适度的硬件上实现有限温度合金热力学的易于处理的预测。

articles.title: Solvable coupled cluster states in d=infty with prescribed momentum distribution
articles.title_zh: d=infty 中具有规定动量分布的可解耦合簇态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41976v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two of the most successful ideas in many-body theory, the exponential coupled cluster ansatz and DMFT, have to date developed separately. We establish a connection between them, by showing that the infinite dimensional limit of the hypercubic lattice allows the exact closed-form evaluation of static expectation values of coupled cluster wave functions, provided the cluster amplitudes admit a low-rank decomposition. As a result, evaluation errors -- a serious concern in conventional coupled cluster theory -- can be disentangled from limitations to expressivity of coupled cluster states. For this family of coupled cluster states, the cavity construction in d→infty exactly reduces the environment of a lattice site to a Gaussian Grassmann kernel, and irreducible diagrams for one-body expectation values are found to be site-diagonal (in analogy to the DMFT self-energy). The resulting ``impurity problem" is an integral over a finite number of Grassmann variables rather than a dynamical quantum impurity problem, so that static observables derive exactly from a static self-consistency condition: a wave function counterpart of DMFT. For the simplest case of a cluster amplitude restricted to rank-one doubles, we obtain the momentum distribution in closed form. We show that any momentum distribution can be realized by a state that is the exact and unique ground state of an explicit parent Hamiltonian with a gapless single-particle tunnelling spectrum. By construction these coupled cluster states variationally recover low order perturbation theory for the Hubbard model. Their failure in the strong coupling regime near the Mott transition diagnoses a fundamental limitation of coupled cluster doubles. Intriguingly, our family of coupled cluster wave functions includes a gapless state with zero quasiparticle weight, with a momentum distribution that is completely smooth at the Fermi energy.
articles.abstract_zh: 多体理论中最成功的两个思想，即指数耦合簇 ansatz 和 DMFT，迄今为止必须单独开发。我们通过证明超立方晶格的无限维限制允许对耦合簇波函数的静态期望值进行精确的封闭式评估，在它们之间建立了联系，前提是簇振幅允许低阶分解。因此，评估误差——传统耦合簇理论中的一个严重问题——可以摆脱耦合簇状态表达性的限制。对于这一族的耦合簇态，d→infty 中的空腔结构精确地将晶格位点的环境还原为高斯格拉斯曼核，并且发现单体期望值的不可约图是位点对角的（类似于 DMFT 自能）。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多体理论中最成功的两个思想，即指数耦合簇 ansatz 和 DMFT，迄今为止必须单独开发。我们通过证明超立方晶格的无限维限制允许对耦合簇波函数的静态期望值进行精确的封闭式评估，在它们之间建立了联系，前提是簇振幅允许低阶分解。因此，评估误差——传统耦合簇理论中的一个严重问题——可以摆脱耦合簇状态表达性的限制。对于这一族的耦合簇态，d→infty 中的空腔结构精确地将晶格位点的环境还原为高斯格拉斯曼核，并且发现单体期望值的不可约图是位点对角的（类似于 DMFT 自能）。由此产生的“杂质问题”是有限数量的格拉斯曼变量上的积分，而不是动态量子杂质问题，因此静态可观测量完全从静态自洽条件导出：DMFT的波函数对应物。对于簇振幅限制为一阶双精度的最简单情况，我们获得封闭形式的动量分布。我们证明任何动量分布都可以通过一个状态来实现，该状态是具有无间隙的显式父哈密顿量的精确且唯一的基态通过构造这些耦合簇态，可以不同地恢复哈伯德模型的低阶微扰理论。它们在莫特跃迁附近的强耦合状态中的失败诊断出耦合簇双打的基本限制，有趣的是，我们的耦合簇波函数族包括准粒子权重为零的无间隙态，其动量分布在费米能量下完全平滑。

articles.title: Current-driven transient dynamics of magnetic-octupole domain walls in noncollinear antiferromagnets
articles.title_zh: 非共线反铁磁体中磁八极畴壁的电流驱动瞬态动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.42065v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Current-driven magnetic-octupole domain walls in noncollinear antiferromagnets are promising for fast spintronic devices, yet their transient dynamics are not yet fully understood. Here, we investigate spin-orbit-torque-driven domain-wall motion in Mn₃Sn using a multipole micromagnetic framework. The three symmetry-related 60deg walls exhibit equivalent current-driven dynamics, unlike their field-driven motion. For a representative 60deg wall, the post-pulse motion is governed by relaxation of the current-induced rotation of the surrounding octupole domains, with a characteristic time of approximately 33 ps quantitatively captured by a uniform-domain analytic model. By resolving spatially nonuniform texture dynamics beyond this analytic description, the simulations further reveal an additional slow relaxation in a composite 180deg wall associated with the relative motion of its constituent walls. The post-pulse response also varies systematically with the exchange stiffness and magnetic anisotropies. These results identify distinct domain and internal-coordinate relaxation channels and establish the intrinsic time scales governing pulse-controlled positioning of magnetic-octupole domain walls in antiferromagnetic spintronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 非共线反铁磁体中电流驱动的磁八极畴壁有望用于快速自旋电子器件，但其瞬态动力学尚未完全了解。在这里，我们使用多极微磁框架研究 Mn₃Sn 中自旋轨道扭矩驱动的畴壁运动。与场驱动运动不同，三个对称相关的 60 度墙表现出等效的电流驱动动力学。对于代表性的 60 度壁，脉冲后运动由周围八极域的电流感应旋转的弛豫控制，由均匀域分析模型定量捕获的特征时间约为 33 ps。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非共线反铁磁体中电流驱动的磁八极畴壁有望用于快速自旋电子器件，但其瞬态动力学尚未完全了解。在这里，我们使用多极微磁框架研究 Mn₃Sn 中自旋轨道扭矩驱动的畴壁运动。与场驱动运动不同，三个对称相关的 60 度墙表现出等效的电流驱动动力学。对于代表性的 60 度壁，脉冲后运动由周围八极域的电流感应旋转的弛豫控制，由均匀域分析模型定量捕获的特征时间约为 33 ps。通过解决超出此分析描述的空间不均匀纹理动力学，模拟进一步揭示了复合 180 度墙中与其组成墙的相对运动相关的额外缓慢松弛。脉冲后响应也随着交换刚度和磁各向异性而系统地变化。这些结果识别了不同的域和内坐标弛豫通道，并建立了控制反铁磁自旋电子器件中磁八极域壁的脉冲控制定位的固有时间尺度。

articles.title: Drying kinematics selects open honeycomb fold networks on solvent-extracted viscoelastic thin films and gels
articles.title_zh: 干燥运动学选择溶剂萃取的粘弹性薄膜和凝胶上的开放式蜂窝折叠网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.42074v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Solvent extraction and drying of substrate-supported viscoelastic films and gels produce quasiperiodic networks of three-armed surface folds. In this Letter, we examine the physical mechanisms governing their formation, length scales, and geometric organization. We observed that swelling-induced compression in the pinned film drives localized folding of a stiffening, diffusively thickening surface skin over a drained underlayer. Combining experiments and theory, we reveal that both the pattern wavelength and fold-arm length scale with the dried-film thickness following a power-law with an exponent 5/8, with remarkably weak dependence on elastic modulus. The folds form 120-degree junctions on a triangular lattice, defining an open honeycomb network whose pitch satisfies p = sqrt(3)(aL + g), where g is the junction gap. Notably, the folds accommodate less than 0.1% of the stored compressive strain, implicating elastocapillary arrest, rather than strain relaxation, in limiting their amplitude. These findings establish distinct geometric, kinetic, and interfacial constraints governing pattern selection in drying soft solids.
articles.abstract_zh: 基底支撑的粘弹性薄膜和凝胶的溶剂萃取和干燥产生三臂表面折叠的准周期网络。在这封信中，我们研究了控制它们的形成、长度尺度和几何组织的物理机制。我们观察到，固定薄膜中膨胀引起的压缩会驱动排水底层上硬化、扩散增厚的表面皮肤的局部折叠。结合实验和理论，我们揭示了图案波长和折臂长度与干膜厚度的关系遵循指数为 5/8 的幂律，并且对弹性模量的依赖性非常弱。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基底支撑的粘弹性薄膜和凝胶的溶剂萃取和干燥产生三臂表面折叠的准周期网络。在这封信中，我们研究了控制它们的形成、长度尺度和几何组织的物理机制。我们观察到，固定薄膜中膨胀引起的压缩会驱动排水底层上硬化、扩散增厚的表面皮肤的局部折叠。结合实验和理论，我们揭示了图案波长和折臂长度与干膜厚度的关系遵循指数为 5/8 的幂律，并且对弹性模量的依赖性非常弱。这些折叠在三角形晶格上形成 120 度的连接，定义了一个开放的蜂窝网络，其节距满足 p = sqrt(3)(aL + g)，其中 g 是连接间隙。值得注意的是，这些褶皱只能容纳不到 0.1% 的存储压缩应变，这表明弹性毛细管停止，而不是应变松弛，从而限制了其振幅。这些发现建立了独特的几何、动力学和界面约束来控制干燥软固体的模式选择。

articles.title: Quantum 3xplorer: AI-Native Engine for Next-Generation Quantum Materials Modeling
articles.title_zh: Quantum 3xplorer：用于下一代量子材料建模的 AI 原生引擎
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.42108v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum-mechanical approaches, such as density functional theory (DFT), underpin much of modern computational materials science and are the primary source of data for AI-driven discovery. Yet the established electronic-structure codes today represent decades-old software architectures, making new physical models slow and costly to implement, validate, and deploy on emerging hardware. We present Quantum 3xplorer (Q3, pronounced "Quantum Explorer"), an AI-native quantum simulation engine written from scratch by AI coding agents under the direction and supervision of domain scientists. As a first and demanding validation case, we implement plane-wave pseudopotential DFT end to end: norm-conserving, ultrasoft, and projector-augmented-wave formalisms, spin polarization, DFT+U, and dispersion corrections, together with forces, stresses, structural relaxation, and electronic-structure analysis. Q3 reproduces established reference implementations, runs faster on a single core in representative benchmarks, and scales across GPU-accelerated supercomputers. It was developed in weeks rather than years. Its layered, physics-first architecture separates abstract quantum-mechanical concepts from their numerical representations, making its framework extendable beyond plane waves to other basis sets and levels of theory. Its inputs and outputs follow structured, schema-validated data standards, making every result AI-ready. Q3 is open source under Apache 2.0 and built to be reused, extended, and improved by the research community. Q3 points to a paradigm shift in how computational quantum science is done. Scientists define the physics, formulate the models, and set the criteria for validation; AI agents write, test, and optimize the code. The decades-long path from a new theory to a trusted, high-performance implementation can thus collapse to days, significantly accelerating scientific discovery.
articles.abstract_zh: 密度泛函理论 (DFT) 等量子力学方法是现代计算材料科学的基础，也是人工智能驱动发现的主要数据来源。然而，当今已建立的电子结构代码代表了几十年前的软件架构，使得新的物理模型在新兴硬件上实施、验证和部署速度缓慢且成本高昂。我们推出了 Quantum 3xplorer（Q3，发音为“Quantum Explorer”），这是一种 AI 原生量子模拟引擎，由 AI 编码代理在领域科学家的指导和监督下从头开始编写。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 密度泛函理论 (DFT) 等量子力学方法是现代计算材料科学的基础，也是人工智能驱动发现的主要数据来源。然而，当今已建立的电子结构代码代表了几十年前的软件架构，使得新的物理模型在新兴硬件上实施、验证和部署速度缓慢且成本高昂。我们推出了 Quantum 3xplorer（Q3，发音为“Quantum Explorer”），这是一种 AI 原生量子模拟引擎，由 AI 编码代理在领域科学家的指导和监督下从头开始编写。作为第一个要求严格的验证案例，我们实现了端到端的平面波赝势 DFT：范数守恒、超软和投影增强波形式、自旋极化、DFT+U 和色散校正，以及力、应力、结构松弛和电子结构分析。 Q3 重现了已建立的参考实现，在代表性基准测试中在单核上运行速度更快，并且可以跨 GPU 加速的超级计算机进行扩展。 It was developed in weeks rather than years.其分层的、物理优先的架构将抽象的量子力学概念与其数值表示分离，使其框架可以扩展到平面波之外的其他基础集和理论层次。其输入和输出遵循结构化、模式验证的数据标准，使每个结果都适合人工智能。 Q3 在 Apache 2.0 下开源，旨在供研究社区重用、扩展和改进。 Q3 指出了计算量子科学如何进行的范式转变。科学家定义物理学、制定模型并设定验证标准； AI agents write, test, and optimize the code.因此，从新理论到值得信赖的高性能实施的长达数十年的道路可以缩短到几天，从而显着加速科学发现。

articles.title: Observation of light-induced Haldane gap in graphene
articles.title_zh: 石墨烯中光诱导霍尔丹间隙的观察
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.42115v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Symmetry and topology, encoded in electronic wavefunctions, play a central role in the electronic properties and emergent phenomena of quantum materials. While these properties are conventionally determined by the equilibrium Hamiltonian, strong optical fields offer a fundamentally different route by reshaping the Hamiltonian on ultrafast timescales, turning symmetry and topology into dynamically controllable degrees of freedom. Graphene provides a paradigmatic platform for realizing this concept, where circularly polarized light has long been predicted to dynamically break time-reversal symmetry (TRS) and open a topologically nontrivial gap at the Dirac point. Despite extensive experimental efforts, direct observation of this Dirac gap-the defining spectroscopic signature of the dynamical TRS-breaking induced topological phase-has remained missing. Here we directly observe this light-induced Dirac gap in monolayer graphene. Time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy reveals that the gap emerges simultaneously with the optical field and exclusively under circularly polarized driving, directly linking its opening to dynamical TRS breaking. Together with Floquet theory, we identify the gap with a light-induced Haldane mass and reveal the associated nontrivial Floquet Berry curvature and Chern topology. By demonstrating dynamical TRS breaking in a prototypical non-magnetic material, our results establish optical driving as a route to ultrafast engineering of symmetry and topology, opening opportunities for dynamically tunable quantum matter beyond equilibrium.
articles.abstract_zh: 电子波函数中编码的对称性和拓扑结构在量子材料的电子特性和涌现现象中发挥着核心作用。虽然这些特性通常由平衡哈密顿量决定，但强光场通过在超快时间尺度上重塑哈密顿量、将对称性和拓扑转变为动态可控的自由度，提供了一条根本不同的途径。石墨烯为实现这一概念提供了一个范例平台，长期以来，人们一直预测圆偏振光会动态打破时间反转对称性（TRS），并在狄拉克点打开一个拓扑上非平凡的间隙。尽管进行了大量的实验工作，但对狄拉克能隙（动态 TRS 破坏引起的拓扑相的定义光谱特征）的直接观察仍然缺失。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电子波函数中编码的对称性和拓扑结构在量子材料的电子特性和涌现现象中发挥着核心作用。虽然这些特性通常由平衡哈密顿量决定，但强光场通过在超快时间尺度上重塑哈密顿量、将对称性和拓扑转变为动态可控的自由度，提供了一条根本不同的途径。石墨烯为实现这一概念提供了一个范例平台，长期以来，人们一直预测圆偏振光会动态打破时间反转对称性（TRS），并在狄拉克点打开一个拓扑上非平凡的间隙。尽管进行了大量的实验工作，但对狄拉克能隙（动态 TRS 破坏引起的拓扑相的定义光谱特征）的直接观察仍然缺失。在这里，我们直接观察到单层石墨烯中的光致狄拉克能隙。时间和角度分辨光电子能谱表明，间隙与光场同时出现，并且仅在圆偏振驱动下出现，直接将其打开与动态 TRS 断裂联系起来。与 Floquet 理论一起，我们识别了光诱导 Haldane 质量的间隙，并揭示了相关的非平凡 Floquet Berry 曲率和 Chern 拓扑。通过演示原型非磁性材料中的动态 TRS 破坏，我们的结果将光学驱动确立为超快对称和拓扑工程的途径，为超越平衡的动态可调谐量子物质提供了机会。

articles.title: Resolving the spinon hierarchy of the Heisenberg antiferromagnet
articles.title_zh: 解析海森堡反铁磁体的自旋层次
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.42127v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A local spin fluctuation in the spin-tfrac12 Heisenberg antiferromagnet creates an even number of fractional spinon excitations. We resolve its zero-temperature dynamical structure factor through six spinons directly in the thermodynamic limit. Beyond the established two-spinon contribution of 72.89%, the four-spinon response gives approximately 21.90% of the integrated intensity and six spinons contribute a further 4.3%, bringing the response to about 99% of both the intensity and first-frequency-moment sum rules. We derive momentum-independent first-moment fractions in the calculated sectors and a general upper-edge law Sₙsim Aₙ(k)(ωₙ,ᵤ-ω)⁽ⁿ^²⁻³⁾/² for every even n at nonzero momentum. The rapid growth of the edge exponent explains why the expanding multiparticle bandwidth carries very little high-energy weight, while higher sectors remain appreciable within the lower-sector continua.
articles.abstract_zh: spin-tfrac12 海森堡反铁磁体中的局部自旋涨落会产生偶数个分数自旋子激发。我们通过热力学极限下的六个自旋子直接求解其零温动力学结构因子。除了既定的 72.89% 的双自旋子贡献之外，四自旋子响应提供了大约 21.90% 的积分强度，六个自旋子进一步贡献了 4.3%，使响应达到强度和一阶矩总和规则的约 99%。我们推导出计算扇区中与动量无关的一阶矩分数，以及对于非零动量下每个偶数 n 的一般上边缘定律 Sₙsim Aₙ(k)(ωₙ,ᵤ-ω)⁽ⁿ^²⁻3⁾/²。
articles.abstract_zh_full: spin-tfrac12 海森堡反铁磁体中的局部自旋涨落会产生偶数个分数自旋子激发。我们通过热力学极限下的六个自旋子直接求解其零温动力学结构因子。除了既定的 72.89% 的双自旋子贡献之外，四自旋子响应提供了大约 21.90% 的积分强度，六个自旋子进一步贡献了 4.3%，使响应达到强度和一阶矩总和规则的约 99%。我们推导出计算扇区中与动量无关的一阶矩分数，以及对于非零动量下每个偶数 n 的一般上边缘定律 Sₙsim Aₙ(k)(ωₙ,ᵤ-ω)⁽ⁿ^²⁻3⁾/²。边缘指数的快速增长解释了为什么扩展的多粒子带宽携带很少的高能权重，而较高的扇区在较低扇区的连续体中仍然相当大。

articles.title: Quantum manifestations of converse symmetry breaking
articles.title_zh: 逆对称破缺的量子表现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40762v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum synchronization holds promise in advancing quantum technologies such as sensing, communication, and computation. A key challenge in this rapidly developing field is to identify mechanisms that can promote the emergence of synchronous dynamics. Here, we show that quantum synchronization can be enhanced by introducing controlled heterogeneity in the form of coupling mismatches. Using spin van der Pol oscillators as a model system, we show that this mechanism constitutes a quantum analog of the phenomenon of converse symmetry breaking previously identified in classical oscillator networks, where a synchronous state is stabilized by explicit symmetry breaking. We quantify how quantum effects modify this behavior by tuning the degree of quantumness through variations of the spin quantum number. These findings suggest that quantum synchronization can be enhanced in experiments by harnessing rather than suppressing heterogeneity.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子同步有望推动传感、通信和计算等量子技术的发展。这个快速发展领域的一个关键挑战是确定可以促进同步动力学出现的机制。在这里，我们证明可以通过引入耦合失配形式的受控异质性来增强量子同步。使用自旋范德波尔振荡器作为模型系统，我们表明这种机制构成了先前在经典振荡器网络中识别的逆对称破缺现象的量子模拟，其中同步状态通过显式对称破缺来稳定。我们通过自旋量子数的变化来调整量子度，从而量化量子效应如何改变这种行为。这些发现表明，在实验中可以通过利用而不是抑制异质性来增强量子同步。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子同步有望推动传感、通信和计算等量子技术的发展。这个快速发展领域的一个关键挑战是确定可以促进同步动力学出现的机制。在这里，我们证明可以通过引入耦合失配形式的受控异质性来增强量子同步。使用自旋范德波尔振荡器作为模型系统，我们表明这种机制构成了先前在经典振荡器网络中识别的逆对称破缺现象的量子模拟，其中同步状态通过显式对称破缺来稳定。我们通过自旋量子数的变化来调整量子度，从而量化量子效应如何改变这种行为。这些发现表明，在实验中可以通过利用而不是抑制异质性来增强量子同步。

articles.title: A Universal Approach to Hydrodynamics in Higher Dimensions via Tensor Networks
articles.title_zh: 通过张量网络实现高维流体动力学的通用方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40776v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Extracting late-time hydrodynamic transport properties directly from microscopic quantum models, especially in dimensions beyond one, is believed to be classically intractable. This owes, in part, to the extensive growth of entanglement in higher dimensions and often a mismatch between geometric and tensor network locality. Here, we extend the Density Matrix Truncation (DMT) algorithm to accurately and quantitatively predict high-temperature transport coefficients (e.g. diffusion constants) in up to three dimensions. Additionally, we demonstrate the ability to capture the slow crossover dynamics characteristic of weakly broken integrability. The intuition underlying our approach is to preserve the geometrically local information crucial for hydrodynamics throughout the time evolution, despite using a one-dimensional matrix product state ansatz for higher-dimensional calculations. Our work pushes the boundary of classical computability and opens the door to benchmarking the high-temperature, late-time dynamics of generic quantum simulators.
articles.abstract_zh: 直接从微观量子模型中提取后期流体动力输运特性，特别是在一维以上的模型中，被认为是经典的难题。这在一定程度上归因于更高维度中纠缠的广泛增长以及几何和张量网络局部性之间的不匹配。在这里，我们扩展了密度矩阵截断（DMT）算法，以准确定量地预测最多三个维度的高温传输系数（例如扩散常数）。此外，我们还展示了捕获弱破坏可积性的缓慢交叉动态特征的能力。我们方法的直觉是在整个时间演化过程中保留对流体动力学至关重要的几何局部信息，尽管使用一维矩阵乘积状态 ansatz 进行高维计算。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 直接从微观量子模型中提取后期流体动力输运特性，特别是在一维以上的模型中，被认为是经典的难题。这在一定程度上归因于更高维度中纠缠的广泛增长以及几何和张量网络局部性之间的不匹配。在这里，我们扩展了密度矩阵截断（DMT）算法，以准确定量地预测最多三个维度的高温传输系数（例如扩散常数）。此外，我们还展示了捕获弱破坏可积性的缓慢交叉动态特征的能力。我们方法的直觉是在整个时间演化过程中保留对流体动力学至关重要的几何局部信息，尽管使用一维矩阵乘积状态 ansatz 进行高维计算。我们的工作突破了经典可计算性的界限，并为通用量子模拟器的高温、后期动力学基准测试打开了大门。

articles.title: Beyond the Kubo formula: unification of adiabatic and isothermal response in quantum systems
articles.title_zh: 超越久保公式：量子系统中绝热和等温响应的统一
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40810v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The static limit of the Kubo susceptibility describes the adiabatic response of an isolated quantum system, in which energy-level occupations remain unchanged, and generally differs from the isothermal susceptibility, where these occupations readjust to thermal equilibrium. In this work, we introduce a single dynamical framework in which the adiabatic and isothermal responses arise naturally as two distinct limiting regimes. This can be done by considering explicitly an open system version of the Kubo approach in which the dissipation is governed by a typical thermalization rate of the system. By exchanging the order of the static limit and of the vanishing thermalization rate limit, the protocol yields either the adiabatic or isothermal response. This protocol has a solid physical motivation in terms of the thermalization dynamics and is valid for generic systems. We apply it to the case of the magnetic response of the electron gas and reproduce the expected results.
articles.abstract_zh: 久保磁化率的静态极限描述了孤立量子系统的绝热响应，其中能级占据保持不变，并且通常不同于等温磁化率，其中这些占据重新调整到热平衡。在这项工作中，我们引入了一个单一的动力学框架，其中绝热和等温响应作为两个不同的限制机制自然出现。这可以通过明确考虑 Kubo 方法的开放系统版本来完成，其中耗散由系统的典型热化率控制。通过交换静态极限和消失热化速率极限的顺序，该协议产生绝热或等温响应。该协议在热化动力学方面具有坚实的物理动机，并且对于通用系统有效。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 久保磁化率的静态极限描述了孤立量子系统的绝热响应，其中能级占据保持不变，并且通常不同于等温磁化率，其中这些占据重新调整到热平衡。在这项工作中，我们引入了一个单一的动力学框架，其中绝热和等温响应作为两个不同的限制机制自然出现。这可以通过明确考虑 Kubo 方法的开放系统版本来完成，其中耗散由系统的典型热化率控制。通过交换静态极限和消失热化速率极限的顺序，该协议产生绝热或等温响应。该协议在热化动力学方面具有坚实的物理动机，并且对于通用系统有效。我们将其应用于电子气磁响应的情况并重现了预期结果。

articles.title: Preparation of a Laughlin-like fractional Chern insulator on a superconducting quantum processor
articles.title_zh: 在超导量子处理器上制备类 Laughlin 分数陈绝缘体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41017v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Fractional Chern insulators (FCIs) are lattice analogues of fractional quantum Hall states, hosting topological order and fractionalized anyonic excitations. Their realization poses a demanding target for quantum simulation. Here, we realize a bosonic FCI on an IBM Nighthawk superconducting quantum processor using classically optimized variational circuits. We target a Laughlin-like state that is an exact zero-energy ground state of a long-range parent Hamiltonian on a torus, eliminating physical edges and providing a favorable geometry for accessing fractional quantum Hall physics in a small system. On a 4×4 qubit lattice, we prepare both the four-boson FCI ground state and a three-boson state hosting two quasiholes. Measurements of particle densities and correlations reproduce the characteristic structure of the target states, while reconstructed chiral magnetization currents resolve the circulating current pattern associated with the quasiholes. The preparation of these strongly correlated topological states with shallow circuits establishes a route toward the digital simulation and manipulation of fractionalized excitations, including measurements of topological invariants and anyonic braiding.
articles.abstract_zh: 分数陈绝缘体 (FCI) 是分数量子霍尔态的晶格类似物，具有拓扑序和分数任意子激发。它们的实现为量子模拟提出了一个苛刻的目标。在这里，我们使用经典优化的变分电路在 IBM Nighthawk 超导量子处理器上实现了玻色子 FCI。我们的目标是类劳克林态，它是环面上长程父哈密顿量的精确零能量基态，消除物理边缘并为在小系统中访问分数量子霍尔物理提供有利的几何结构。在 4×4 量子位晶格上，我们准备了四玻色子 FCI 基态和包含两个准空穴的三玻色子态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 分数陈绝缘体 (FCI) 是分数量子霍尔态的晶格类似物，具有拓扑序和分数任意子激发。它们的实现为量子模拟提出了一个苛刻的目标。在这里，我们使用经典优化的变分电路在 IBM Nighthawk 超导量子处理器上实现了玻色子 FCI。我们的目标是类劳克林态，它是环面上长程父哈密顿量的精确零能量基态，消除物理边缘并为在小系统中访问分数量子霍尔物理提供有利的几何结构。在 4×4 量子位晶格上，我们准备了四玻色子 FCI 基态和包含两个准空穴的三玻色子态。粒子密度和相关性的测量再现了目标态的特征结构，而重建的手性磁化电流则解析了与准空穴相关的循环电流模式。这些与浅层电路强相关的拓扑状态的制备为数字模拟和分段激励的操作建立了一条途径，包括拓扑不变量和任意子编织的测量。

articles.title: h/2e Flux Trapping without Superconductivity
articles.title_zh: h/2e 磁通捕获（无超导）
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41058v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Recently, it was shown by Komargodski and Popov [arXiv:2601.09847] that ordinary metals threaded with an Aharonov-Bohm solenoid exclusively trap either 0 or h/2e flux. The latter value is familiar in the superconducting setting, yet we find that it holds in ordinary metals as well, with no condensate or pairing necessary.
