We provide an analytic explanation for the flux trapping, and extend the results to the cases of finite temperature, time-reversal invariant potentials, and lattice regularization, where we find that the flux remains trapped at 0 and h/2e.
articles.abstract_zh: 最近，Komargodski 和 Popov [arXiv:2601.09847] 表明，与 Aharonov-Bohm 螺线管螺纹连接的普通金属只能捕获 0 或 h/2e 通量。后一个值在超导环境中很常见，但我们发现它也适用于普通金属，无需凝聚或配对。我们对通量俘获提供了分析解释，并将结果扩展到有限温度、时间反转不变势和晶格正则化的情况，我们发现通量仍然被俘获在 0 和 h/2e 处。

articles.title: Induced Lorentzian geometry from the fermionic quantum metric
articles.title_zh: 从费米子量子度量导出洛伦兹几何
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41138v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum geometry is conventionally understood in parameter or momentum space and need not be related to a geometry in configuration space. Here we show for Dirac fermions in a background electromagnetic field that an induced Lorentzian geometry is generated from the fermionic quantum metric. We study a Lorentz covariant phase space worldline path integral construction, whose application of the adiabatic theorem onto spin degrees of freedom leads to the appearance of the Berry phase at O(hbar), and the quantum metric at O(hbar²) in the worldline action. Both the Feynman and retarded/advanced propagators are examined in 3+1 and 2+1 dimensions, whose different on-shell implementations lead to related quantum metrics; QED/QED{}₃ and condensed matter Dirac theory are considered. An effective theory is found by integrating out the momenta degrees of freedom, which gives rise to an emergent Lorentzian metric in configuration space, whose perturbation to the flat metric is dependent on the quantum metric and the background field strength. Apart from the spin degrees of freedom encoded into the Berry phase, the effective theory describes a scalar particle moving in the induced quantum geometry. Phenomenological applications to the covariant geometry are further studied using spectral holonomy in a gapped 3-dimensional Dirac material.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子几何通常在参数或动量空间中理解，并且不需要与配置空间中的几何相关。在这里，我们展示了背景电磁场中的狄拉克费米子，诱导洛伦兹几何是从费米子量子度量生成的。我们研究洛伦兹协变相空间世界线路径积分构造，其将绝热定理应用到自旋自由度上导致在世界线作用中出现 O(hbar) 处的 Berry 相以及 O(hbar²) 处的量子度量。费曼传播器和延迟/高级传播器都在 3+1 和 2+1 维度上进行了检查，其不同的壳上实现导致了相关的量子度量；
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子几何通常在参数或动量空间中理解，并且不需要与配置空间中的几何相关。在这里，我们展示了背景电磁场中的狄拉克费米子，诱导洛伦兹几何是从费米子量子度量生成的。我们研究洛伦兹协变相空间世界线路径积分构造，其将绝热定理应用到自旋自由度上导致在世界线作用中出现 O(hbar) 处的 Berry 相以及 O(hbar²) 处的量子度量。费曼传播器和延迟/高级传播器都在 3+1 和 2+1 维度上进行了检查，其不同的壳上实现导致了相关的量子度量；考虑了 QED/QED{}₃ 和凝聚态狄拉克理论。通过积分自由度找到了一种有效的理论，这在配置空间中产生了一种新兴的洛伦兹度量，其对平坦度量的扰动取决于量子度量和背景场强度。除了编码到贝里相中的自旋自由度之外，有效理论还描述了在诱导量子几何中移动的标量粒子。使用带隙 3 维狄拉克材料中的谱完整性进一步研究了唯象几何在协变几何中的应用。

articles.title: Distilling Knowledge from Search: Decoder Model Factory for Quantum LDPC Codes
articles.title_zh: 从搜索中提取知识：量子 LDPC 码的解码器模型工厂
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41398v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce GraphMP, a learning-based message-passing decoder for quantum low-density parity-check codes that transfers without fine-tuning across code families, code sizes, physical error rates, and noise models. GraphMP uses local message passing to keep computation scalable as the decoding graph grows. Guided by its predictions, beam search progressively refines candidate error patterns, trading additional decoding time for lower logical error rates. We develop the decoder model factory as a paradigm for training successive models on experience generated by earlier models during decoding. Model-guided search supplies verified trajectories for knowledge distillation, folding computation spent on decoding into reusable training data. Repeated collection and distillation improve the decoder across generations and adapt its strategy as the noise changes. These results motivate a coupled quantum--classical architecture with two interacting cycles: rapid decoding protects quantum information, while slower learning renews the models from operating experience. The long-term vision is a scalable decoder model factory that produces high-performance, low-latency decoders and continually adapts them to evolving quantum hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们引入了 GraphMP，这是一种基于学习的消息传递解码器，用于量子低密度奇偶校验码，无需在代码系列、代码大小、物理错误率和噪声模型之间进行微调即可进行传输。 GraphMP 使用本地消息传递来保持计算随着解码图的增长而扩展。在其预测的指导下，波束搜索逐步完善候选错误模式，以额外的解码时间换取更低的逻辑错误率。我们开发解码器模型工厂作为一个范例，用于根据解码过程中早期模型生成的经验来训练连续模型。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们引入了 GraphMP，这是一种基于学习的消息传递解码器，用于量子低密度奇偶校验码，无需在代码系列、代码大小、物理错误率和噪声模型之间进行微调即可进行传输。 GraphMP 使用本地消息传递来保持计算随着解码图的增长而扩展。在其预测的指导下，波束搜索逐步完善候选错误模式，以额外的解码时间换取更低的逻辑错误率。我们开发解码器模型工厂作为一个范例，用于根据解码过程中早期模型生成的经验来训练连续模型。模型引导的搜索为知识蒸馏提供经过验证的轨迹，将用于解码的计算折叠为可重用的训练数据。重复的收集和蒸馏改进了各代解码器，并随着噪声的变化调整其策略。这些结果激发了具有两个相互作用周期的耦合量子经典架构：快速解码保护量子信息，而较慢的学习则根据操作经验更新模型。长期愿景是建立一个可扩展的解码器模型工厂，生产高性能、低延迟的解码器，并不断使其适应不断发展的量子硬件。

articles.title: Characterization of Phase Transitions with the Annealed Importance Sampling Algorithm
articles.title_zh: 使用退火重要性采样算法表征相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41500v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We We explore the use of the Annealed Importance Sampling (AIS) algorithm as a numerical tool to study phase transitions and critical phenomena. By mapping physical systems such as Ising and spin-glass models directly onto Restricted Boltzmann Machines (RBMs), and extending the analysis to both synthetic and trained architectures, we use a unified RBM framework to compare the performance of AIS against standard Monte Carlo methods in regimes characterized by strong fluctuations and complex energy landscapes. The unified RBM formulation allows for massively parallel sampling, offering a scalable and precise alternative to traditional Monte Carlo methods. Building on a simple, heuristic mean-field AIS initialization derived from the weights of the network, the proposed scheme enhances sampling efficiency and accuracy across all systems considered, proving its effectiveness as a tool to detect and characterize phase transitions in discrete spin and spin-like systems. Our results show that a properly initialized AIS reliably estimates thermodynamic observables, including the partition function and magnetization, while accurately detecting both paramagnetic-ferromagnetic and paramagnetic-spin-glass phase transitions across various system sizes.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们探索使用退火重要性采样（AIS）算法作为研究相变和临界现象的数值工具。通过将伊辛和自旋玻璃模型等物理系统直接映射到受限玻尔兹曼机 (RBM) 上，并将分析扩展到合成和训练架构，我们使用统一的 RBM 框架来比较 AIS 与标准蒙特卡罗方法在以强烈波动和复杂能源景观为特征的情况下的性能。统一的 RBM 公式允许大规模并行采样，为传统蒙特卡罗方法提供可扩展且精确的替代方案。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们探索使用退火重要性采样（AIS）算法作为研究相变和临界现象的数值工具。通过将伊辛和自旋玻璃模型等物理系统直接映射到受限玻尔兹曼机 (RBM) 上，并将分析扩展到合成和训练架构，我们使用统一的 RBM 框架来比较 AIS 与标准蒙特卡罗方法在以强烈波动和复杂能源景观为特征的情况下的性能。统一的 RBM 公式允许大规模并行采样，为传统蒙特卡罗方法提供可扩展且精确的替代方案。基于从网络权重导出的简单、启发式平均场 AIS 初始化，所提出的方案提高了所有考虑的系统的采样效率和准确性，证明了其作为检测和表征离散自旋和类自旋系统中相变的工具的有效性。我们的结果表明，正确初始化的 AIS 可以可靠地估计热力学可观测量，包括配分函数和磁化强度，同时准确检测各种系统尺寸的顺磁-铁磁和顺磁-自旋玻璃相变。

articles.title: eCAS: An Orbital Embedding Method for Quantum Computing
articles.title_zh: eCAS：一种用于量子计算的轨道嵌入方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41517v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Future fault-tolerant quantum computers will allow us to calculate electronic structures of atomistic systems. However, these systems will be intrinsically limited in size, requiring embedding theories for many systems because of the unfavorable scaling of the number of terms describing the electron-electron interaction in the second-quantized electronic Hamiltonian. Quantum embedding theories address this challenge by partitioning a quantum system into a region of interest, the impurity, and its (larger) complement, the environment. However, currently available quantum embedding methods place restrictive demands on near-future quantum computers, such as the need to measure reduced density matrices or the need for repeated evaluations. Here, we introduce the new orbital embedding method eCAS that steers clear of these pitfalls by constructing a multi-CAS problem, the active spaces of which are localized and can be solved independently of each other with any quantum algorithm. This also allows for the development of comparatively simple gradient expressions. eCAS leverages the Schmidt decomposition to construct initial impurity and bath orbitals and augments them with localized environment orbitals, based on a mutual correlation criterion. The mutual correlation criterion makes eCAS systematically improvable without the need for any iteratively determined quantities.
articles.abstract_zh: 未来的容错量子计算机将使我们能够计算原子系统的电子结构。然而，这些系统本质上在尺寸上受到限制，由于第二量子化电子哈密顿量中描述电子-电子相互作用的项数量的不利缩放，许多系统需要嵌入理论。量子嵌入理论通过将量子系统划分为感兴趣的区域（杂质）及其（更大的）补充区域（环境）来解决这一挑战。然而，当前可用的量子嵌入方法对不久的将来的量子计算机提出了限制性要求，例如需要测量降低的密度矩阵或需要重复评估。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 未来的容错量子计算机将使我们能够计算原子系统的电子结构。然而，这些系统本质上在尺寸上受到限制，由于第二量子化电子哈密顿量中描述电子-电子相互作用的项数量的不利缩放，许多系统需要嵌入理论。量子嵌入理论通过将量子系统划分为感兴趣的区域（杂质）及其（更大的）补充区域（环境）来解决这一挑战。然而，当前可用的量子嵌入方法对不久的将来的量子计算机提出了限制性要求，例如需要测量降低的密度矩阵或需要重复评估。在这里，我们介绍了新的轨道嵌入方法 eCAS，它通过构造多 CAS 问题来避开这些陷阱，其中的活动空间是局部的，并且可以使用任何量子算法相互独立地求解。这也允许开发相对简单的梯度表达式。 eCAS 利用施密特分解来构建初始杂质和浴轨道，并根据相互相关标准用局域环境轨道对其进行增强。互相关准则使得 eCAS 可以系统地改进，而不需要任何迭代确定的量。

articles.title: Phase transition dynamics of Abelian-Higgs vortices in the oscillating axion background
articles.title_zh: 振荡轴子背景下阿贝尔-希格斯涡旋的相变动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41575v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate the effect of an oscillating axion background on thermally induced vortex-antivortex production in the Abelian-Higgs model. Through its coupling to the gauge field, the axion sources an electromagnetic response in the presence of vortex magnetic flux, modifying the dynamics of the vortices. We study this system using Langevin lattice simulations with dissipation and stochastic noise. It is shown that the phase transition dynamics of Abelian-Higgs vortices, namely the pair creation of vortex and antivortex under thermal fluctuations, can be significantly modified in the oscillating axion background. We find that the axion background shifts the rapid increase in the vortex density to lower temperature. In particular, this transition temperature becomes smaller as the oscillation frequency of the axion increases. The temperature dependence of the correlation length is also modified. These features provide a new experimental approach for the axion dark matter using superconducting devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了阿贝尔-希格斯模型中振荡轴子背景对热致涡旋-反涡旋产生的影响。通过与规范场的耦合，轴子在涡旋磁通量存在的情况下产生电磁响应，从而改变涡旋的动力学。我们使用具有耗散和随机噪声的朗之万晶格模拟来研究该系统。结果表明，阿贝尔-希格斯涡旋的相变动力学，即热波动下涡旋和反涡旋的配对产生，可以在振荡轴子背景中显着改变。我们发现轴子背景将涡旋密度的快速增加转移到较低的温度。特别地，随着轴子的振荡频率增加，该转变温度变得更小。相关长度的温度依赖性也被修改。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了阿贝尔-希格斯模型中振荡轴子背景对热致涡旋-反涡旋产生的影响。通过与规范场的耦合，轴子在涡旋磁通量存在的情况下产生电磁响应，从而改变涡旋的动力学。我们使用具有耗散和随机噪声的朗之万晶格模拟来研究该系统。结果表明，阿贝尔-希格斯涡旋的相变动力学，即热波动下涡旋和反涡旋的配对产生，可以在振荡轴子背景中显着改变。我们发现轴子背景将涡旋密度的快速增加转移到较低的温度。特别地，随着轴子的振荡频率增加，该转变温度变得更小。相关长度的温度依赖性也被修改。这些特征为利用超导器件研究轴子暗物质提供了一种新的实验方法。

articles.title: A variational phase-field theory of cohesive fracture at finite deformation
articles.title_zh: 有限变形内聚断裂的变分相场理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41662v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This paper formulates a kinematically and variationally consistent phase-field theory for cohesive fracture at finite deformation. The theory introduces an independent compliance-damage field, which accommodates both diffuse distributions and singular concentrations. The phase-field is thereby freed from the dual burden of describing crack geometry and material degradation. A rank-one additive split of the deformation gradient makes separation explicit through independent crack-strain and reference-normal fields. All fields are governed by a single principle of minimum potential energy, which consistently couples nonlinear bulk deformation, crack separation, and crack-plane rotation. One-dimensional energy comparisons show that minimization favors Dirac-type concentration of compliance damage and crack strain. Strong displacement discontinuities thus emerge naturally at a finite phase-field length without being prescribed a priori, while the phase-field remains continuous. The concentrated energy recovers the exact bulk--interface structure of a sharp-crack cohesive zone model. General objective hyperelastic bulk potentials and admissible mixed-mode cohesive laws can therefore be prescribed independently, with the nominal traction--separation law unaffected by the bulk law or phase-field length. Diffuse damage can coexist with concentrated cracks, retaining deformation modes for bulk-energy relaxation during nucleation. Two- and three-dimensional examples validate the theory across large stretches, finite rotations, and complex crack paths. Notably, the computed near-tip Cauchy stress closely matches the analytical 1/r crack-tip asymptotic solution of Long et al. (2011) outside the cohesive zone.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对有限变形下的内聚断裂制定了运动学和变分一致的相场理论。该理论引入了一个独立的顺应性损伤场，它可以适应弥散分布和奇异集中。因此，相场摆脱了描述裂纹几何形状和材料退化的双重负担。变形梯度的一级加性分割通过独立的裂纹应变和参考法线场使分离变得明确。所有场都受最小势能的单一原理控制，该原理始终耦合非线性体变形、裂纹分离和裂纹平面旋转。一维能量比较表明，最小化有利于顺应性损伤和裂纹应变的狄拉克型集中。因此，在有限相场长度处自然出现强位移不连续性，而无需先验规定，而相场保持连续。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文针对有限变形下的内聚断裂制定了运动学和变分一致的相场理论。该理论引入了一个独立的顺应性损伤场，它可以适应弥散分布和奇异集中。因此，相场摆脱了描述裂纹几何形状和材料退化的双重负担。变形梯度的一级加性分割通过独立的裂纹应变和参考法线场使分离变得明确。所有场都受最小势能的单一原理控制，该原理始终耦合非线性体变形、裂纹分离和裂纹平面旋转。一维能量比较表明，最小化有利于顺应性损伤和裂纹应变的狄拉克型集中。因此，在有限相场长度处自然出现强位移不连续性，而无需先验规定，而相场保持连续。集中的能量恢复了锐裂纹内聚区模型的精确体界面结构。因此，一般客观的超弹性体势和允许的混合模式内聚定律可以独立规定，标称牵引力-分离定律不受体定律或相场长度的影响。扩散损伤可以与集中裂纹共存，在成核过程中保留体能量松弛的变形模式。二维和三维示例在大拉伸、有限旋转和复杂裂纹路径上验证了该理论。值得注意的是，计算出的近尖端柯西应力与 Long 等人的解析 1/r 裂纹尖端渐近解非常匹配。 （2011）在粘性区域之外。

articles.title: Control-Noise Trade-offs in Industrially Integrated {}²⁸Si/SiGe Spin-1/2 Qubits
articles.title_zh: 工业集成 {}²⁸Si/SiGe 自旋 1/2 量子位中的控制噪声权衡
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41890v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Scaling silicon spin qubits to fault-tolerant processors requires semiconductor foundry integration, yet it remains unclear how industrial fabrication and dense device integration affect qubit control and noise. Here we study {}²⁸Si/SiGe electron spin-1/2 qubits fabricated using Intel's industry-compatible 300 mm process and incorporating micromagnets for electrically driven spin resonance, using a high-performance device fabricated in the RIKEN research cleanroom as a reference. Primitive π/2-gate fidelities reach the 99.99% level in the Intel devices, which also exhibit longer idle coherence, weaker low-frequency correlations and reduced qubit-to-qubit variability across several measured characteristics. In the present Intel devices, the micromagnets are integrated inline with the back-end-of-line (BEOL) contact routing, with their separation from the quantum well set through the vertical stack design. Relative to the reference, their larger separation contributes to weaker longitudinal and transverse magnetic-field gradients. The weaker longitudinal gradient suppresses the conversion of charge noise into qubit-frequency fluctuations, whereas the weaker transverse gradient reduces electrically driven spin-resonance efficiency and makes drive-dependent errors relevant at lower Rabi frequencies. Additional BEOL routing and metal levels required for two-dimensional arrays make such placement decisions increasingly consequential when scaling. These results establish an integration-level control-noise trade-off linking micromagnet placement within densely routed layouts to achievable gate performance, while very high-fidelity operation remains possible in industrially fabricated devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 将硅自旋量子位扩展到容错处理器需要半导体铸造厂集成，但目前尚不清楚工业制造和密集设备集成如何影响量子位控制和噪声。在这里，我们研究使用英特尔行业兼容的 300 毫米工艺制造的 {}²⁸Si/SiGe 电子自旋 1/2 量子位，并结合用于电驱动自旋共振的微磁体，并使用在 RIKEN 研究洁净室中制造的高性能设备作为参考。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 将硅自旋量子位扩展到容错处理器需要半导体铸造厂集成，但目前尚不清楚工业制造和密集设备集成如何影响量子位控制和噪声。在这里，我们研究使用英特尔行业兼容的 300 毫米工艺制造的 {}²⁸Si/SiGe 电子自旋 1/2 量子位，并结合用于电驱动自旋共振的微磁体，并使用在 RIKEN 研究洁净室中制造的高性能设备作为参考。英特尔器件中的原始 π/2 门保真度达到 99.99% 的水平，这些器件还表现出更长的空闲相干性、更弱的低频相关性以及在多个测量特性中减少的量子位到量子位的变异性。在目前的英特尔设备中，微磁体与后端生产线 (BEOL) 接触布线内联集成，并通过垂直堆栈设计与量子阱分离。相对于参考，它们的较大间距导致较弱的纵向和横向磁场梯度。较弱的纵向梯度抑制了电荷噪声向量子位频率波动的转换，而较弱的横向梯度降低了电驱动的自旋共振效率，并使驱动相关的误差在较低的拉比频率下相关。二维阵列所需的额外 BEOL 布线和金属层使得此类布局决策在扩展时变得越来越重要。这些结果建立了集成级控制噪声权衡，将密集布线布局中的微磁体放置与可实现的栅极性能联系起来，同时在工业制造的设备中仍然可以实现非常高保真度的操作。

articles.title: Topologically Protected Edge States in a Single Flux Qubit
articles.title_zh: 单通量量子位中的拓扑保护边缘态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.42114v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We show that topological edge states can be realized in a simple superconducting circuit composed of an inductively shunted flux qubit. The Josephson potential of that qubit forms a honeycomb lattice similar to the case of graphene. The additional shunting element produces a quartic potential along one flux direction, which effectively creates a boundary in flux space. We map analytically the low-energy dynamics of the circuit to an extended Su--Schrieffer--Heeger (SSH) chain, in which a quartic potential is added to the usual SSH Hamiltonian. This mapping is confirmed by numerical simulations of the full superconducting circuit. We argue that chiral symmetry still holds for the edge states of the extended model around a chiral point in parameter space. Close to this point, we numerically find that edge states in our superconducting circuit are topologically protected against perturbations that obey chiral symmetry, as is the case for charge noise. Our results show that topological effects previously thought to occur in multi-qubit systems, such as protection against decoherence, can also be found in much simpler single superconducting qubits.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们证明了拓扑边缘态可以在由感应分流通量量子位组成的简单超导电路中实现。该量子位的约瑟夫森势形成类似于石墨烯的蜂窝状晶格。附加分流元件沿一个通量方向产生四次势，这有效地在通量空间中创建边界。我们通过分析将电路的低能动力学映射到扩展的 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) 链，其中将四次势添加到通常的 SSH 哈密顿量中。整个超导电路的数值模拟证实了这种映射。我们认为，手性对称性仍然适用于参数空间中手性点周围的扩展模型的边缘状态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们证明了拓扑边缘态可以在由感应分流通量量子位组成的简单超导电路中实现。该量子位的约瑟夫森势形成类似于石墨烯的蜂窝状晶格。附加分流元件沿一个通量方向产生四次势，这有效地在通量空间中创建边界。我们通过分析将电路的低能动力学映射到扩展的 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) 链，其中将四次势添加到通常的 SSH 哈密顿量中。整个超导电路的数值模拟证实了这种映射。我们认为，手性对称性仍然适用于参数空间中手性点周围的扩展模型的边缘状态。接近这一点，我们在数值上发现超导电路中的边缘态在拓扑上受到保护，免受服从手性对称性的扰动，就像电荷噪声的情况一样。我们的结果表明，以前认为发生在多量子位系统中的拓扑效应，例如防止退相干，也可以在更简单的单个超导量子位中找到。

articles.title: Baker--Akhiezer sections from Higgs bundles and Landau levels in hyperbolic band theory
articles.title_zh: Baker--双曲带理论中希格斯丛和朗道能级的阿基泽截面
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.42134v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: As observed by Kienzle and the second author, rank-two O(3)-twisted Higgs bundles on the projective line encode all hyperbolic crystals of genus two: the spectral curves are the unit cells, and the Hitchin fibers are the abelian Brillouin zones. In a uniform magnetic field of two flux quanta, the lowest Landau level is one-dimensional at every nonzero momentum, and, as found by Iengo and Li, its dimension jumps to two at the zero momentum. We identify the states of the lowest Landau level with the Baker--Akhiezer sections of the Higgs bundles, and their zeros, the vortices, with the Baker--Akhiezer divisors. A family of nonzero momenta limits to the zero momentum exactly when each of the two vortices approaches the image of the other under the spatial inversion, and the states of the jumped level are labeled by the directions of limiting. On the Higgs bundle side, the zero momentum is the point where the Hitchin fiber intersects the Hitchin section. Such a family of Higgs bundles limits to the Hitchin section, thereby crossing to a lower stratum of the BB stratification, an example of the phenomenon investigated in terms of Baker--Akhiezer divisors by the first author with Figiel and Teschner.
articles.abstract_zh: 正如 Kienzle 和第二作者所观察到的，投影线上的二级 O(3) 扭曲希格斯丛编码了所有二属双曲晶体：光谱曲线是晶胞，希钦纤维是阿贝尔布里渊区。在两个通量量子的均匀磁场中，最低的朗道能级在每个非零动量处都是一维的，并且正如 Iengo 和 Li 所发现的，它的维度在零动量处跃升至二。我们用希格斯丛的贝克-阿希泽部分来识别最低朗道能级的状态，用贝克-阿希泽除数来识别它们的零点，即涡旋。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 正如 Kienzle 和第二作者所观察到的，投影线上的二级 O(3) 扭曲希格斯丛编码了所有二属双曲晶体：光谱曲线是晶胞，希钦纤维是阿贝尔布里渊区。在两个通量量子的均匀磁场中，最低的朗道能级在每个非零动量处都是一维的，并且正如 Iengo 和 Li 所发现的，它的维度在零动量处跃升至二。我们用希格斯丛的贝克-阿希泽部分来识别最低朗道能级的状态，用贝克-阿希泽除数来识别它们的零点，即涡旋。当空间反演下两个涡旋中的每一个都接近另一个涡旋的图像时，一系列非零动量限制为零动量，并且跳跃能级的状态由限制的方向标记。在希格斯丛一侧，零动量是希钦纤维与希钦截面的相交点。这样一个希格斯丛集限制在希钦截面，从而跨越到 BB 分层的较低层，这是第一作者与 Figiel 和 Teschner 根据 Baker-Akhiezer 因子研究的现象的一个例子。

articles.title: Chiral Majorana hinge modes on a curved surface with magnetic impurities
articles.title_zh: 具有磁性杂质的曲面上的手性马约拉纳铰链模式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2310.09258v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Chiral Majorana modes, a key ingredient for topological quantum computation, arise on the surface of a three-dimensional time-reversal-invariant topological superconductor when a magnetic field induces a sign-changing surface mass. In practice, the orbital response of the superconductor tilts the surface spectrum and overwhelms the Zeeman term as the field grows. Here we show that magnetic impurities on a spherical surface can instead generate this mass term through their exchange coupling, so that only a weak field is required. The Ising surface Majorana modes mediate a ferromagnetic Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida (RKKY) interaction, derived here on the curved surface, that orders the radial impurity moments into an inversion-breaking hedgehog at zero field. An axial field instead stabilizes a domain wall across which the radial magnetization reverses sign, leaving a single chiral Majorana mode along the equator and realizing an inversion-protected second-order topological superconductor.
articles.abstract_zh: 当磁场感应出符号变化的表面质量时，手性马约拉纳模式是拓扑量子计算的关键要素，会在三维时间反转不变的拓扑超导体的表面上出现。实际上，随着场的增长，超导体的轨道响应会倾斜表面光谱并压倒塞曼项。在这里，我们证明球形表面上的磁性杂质可以通过它们的交换耦合产生该质量项，因此只需要弱场。伊辛表面马约拉纳模式介导铁磁鲁德曼-基特尔-卡苏亚-吉田 (RKKY) 相互作用，该相互作用在曲面上导出，该相互作用将径向杂质矩排列成零场反转破坏刺猬。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 当磁场感应出符号变化的表面质量时，手性马约拉纳模式是拓扑量子计算的关键要素，会在三维时间反转不变的拓扑超导体的表面上出现。实际上，随着场的增长，超导体的轨道响应会倾斜表面光谱并压倒塞曼项。在这里，我们证明球形表面上的磁性杂质可以通过它们的交换耦合产生该质量项，因此只需要弱场。伊辛表面马约拉纳模式介导铁磁鲁德曼-基特尔-卡苏亚-吉田 (RKKY) 相互作用，该相互作用在曲面上导出，该相互作用将径向杂质矩排列成零场反转破坏刺猬。相反，轴向场稳定了磁畴壁，径向磁化强度在磁畴壁上反转，沿赤道留下单一手性马约拉纳模式，并实现了反型保护的二阶拓扑超导体。

articles.title: Resonant analogue configurations in atomic condensates
articles.title_zh: 原子凝聚态中的共振模拟构型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2406.10027v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: As a contribution to a memorial volume, we provide a comprehensive discussion of resonant configurations in analogue gravity, focusing on its implementation in atomic condensates and combining review features with original insights and calculations. In particular, we jointly analyze the analogues of the Andreev and Hawking effects using a microscopic description based on the Bogoliubov approximation. We perform a detailed study of the thermality of the Andreev and Hawking spectra for canonical black-hole solutions, finding that both can be described by a gray-body distribution to a very good approximation. We contemplate several resonant scenarios whose efficiency to enhance anomalous scattering processes is compared to that of non-resonant setups. The presence of quantum signatures in analogue configurations, such as the violation of Cauchy-Schwarz inequalities or entanglement, is analyzed, observing that resonant configurations highly increase the entanglement signal, especially for the Andreev effect. We also discuss how these results have served as inspiration for the rapidly expanding field of quantum information in high-energy colliders. Finally, we study the physics of black-hole lasers as further examples of resonant analogue structures, distinguishing three stages in its time evolution. For short times, we compute the linear and non-linear spectrum for different models. For intermediate times, we generalize the current analysis of the BHL-BCL crossover. For long times, we discuss the emerging concept of spontaneous Floquet state and its potential implications.
articles.abstract_zh: 作为对纪念卷的贡献，我们对模拟重力中的共振配置进行了全面的讨论，重点关注其在原子凝聚态中的实现，并将评论特征与原始见解和计算相结合。特别是，我们使用基于博戈柳博夫近似的微观描述共同分析了安德烈夫效应和霍金效应的类似物。我们对典型黑洞解的安德烈夫和霍金光谱的热度进行了详细研究，发现两者都可以通过灰体分布来描述，达到非常好的近似。我们考虑了几种共振场景，将其增强异常散射过程的效率与非共振设置进行比较。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 作为对纪念卷的贡献，我们对模拟重力中的共振配置进行了全面的讨论，重点关注其在原子凝聚态中的实现，并将评论特征与原始见解和计算相结合。特别是，我们使用基于博戈柳博夫近似的微观描述共同分析了安德烈夫效应和霍金效应的类似物。我们对典型黑洞解的安德烈夫和霍金光谱的热度进行了详细研究，发现两者都可以通过灰体分布来描述，达到非常好的近似。我们考虑了几种共振场景，将其增强异常散射过程的效率与非共振设置进行比较。分析了模拟配置中量子特征的存在，例如柯西-施瓦茨不等式或纠缠的违反，观察到共振配置极大地增加了纠缠信号，特别是对于安德烈夫效应。我们还讨论了这些结果如何为高能对撞机中快速扩展的量子信息领域提供灵感。最后，我们研究黑洞激光器的物理学，作为共振模拟结构的进一步例子，区分其时间演化的三个阶段。在短时间内，我们计算不同模型的线性和非线性谱。对于中间时间，我们概括了 BHL-BCL 交叉的当前分析。长期以来，我们讨论自发 Floquet 状态的新兴概念及其潜在含义。

articles.title: Topological spin textures in an antiferromagnetic monolayer
articles.title_zh: 反铁磁单层中的拓扑自旋纹理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.24186v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Topological spin structures such as magnetic skyrmions are of fundamental interest and promising for various types of applications in spintronics. Skyrmions have been predicted to emerge also in antiferromagnetic materials where they exhibit superior transport properties. They were experimentally revealed in synthetic antiferromagnets, however, still remain elusive in intrinsic atomic antiferromagnets. Here, we demonstrate how topological spin structures can be stabilized in an antiferromagnetic monolayer. Using spin-polarized scanning tunneling microscopy, we observe an antiferromagnetic spin spiral in the Mn monolayer and a collinear antiferromagnetic state in the Mn double-layer on Ta(110). Near the boundary to the double-layer spin structures equivalent to half of an antiferromagnetic skyrmion form in the monolayer as revealed in combination with first-principles calculations and micromagnetic simulations. Our simulations show how the topological state in antiferromagnetic material systems can be controlled by the configuration within a lateral heterostructure, resulting in trivial non-coplanar states or antiferromagnetic skyrmions.
articles.abstract_zh: 拓扑自旋结构（例如磁性斯格明子）在自旋电子学中的各种应用中具有重要意义和前景。据预测，斯格明子也会出现在反铁磁材料中，它们表现出优异的传输特性。它们在合成反铁磁体中通过实验得到揭示，然而，在本征原子反铁磁体中仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们演示了如何在反铁磁单层中稳定拓扑自旋结构。使用自旋偏振扫描隧道显微镜，我们观察到Ta(110)上Mn单层中的反铁磁自旋螺旋和Mn双层中的共线反铁磁状态。结合第一原理计算和微磁模拟揭示，双层自旋结构的边界附近相当于单层中反铁磁斯格明子形式的一半。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 拓扑自旋结构（例如磁性斯格明子）在自旋电子学中的各种应用中具有重要意义和前景。据预测，斯格明子也会出现在反铁磁材料中，它们表现出优异的传输特性。它们在合成反铁磁体中通过实验得到揭示，然而，在本征原子反铁磁体中仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们演示了如何在反铁磁单层中稳定拓扑自旋结构。使用自旋偏振扫描隧道显微镜，我们观察到Ta(110)上Mn单层中的反铁磁自旋螺旋和Mn双层中的共线反铁磁状态。结合第一原理计算和微磁模拟揭示，双层自旋结构的边界附近相当于单层中反铁磁斯格明子形式的一半。我们的模拟显示了反铁磁材料系统中的拓扑状态如何通过横向异质结构内的配置来控制，从而产生微不足道的非共面状态或反铁磁斯格明子。

articles.title: Learning Hamiltonians for solid-state quantum simulators
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.02889v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce a generalizable framework for identifying effective Hamiltonians directly from experimental data in solid-state quantum systems. Our unsupervised autoencoder-based approach incorporates the governing physics (here, the S-matrix formalism) directly into the decoder, enabling physically meaningful Hamiltonian inference without labeled Hamiltonian parameters. Through numerical experiments on a triple quantum dot chain, we demonstrate automated characterization of programmable solid-state simulators from transport measurements. The model accurately infers Hamiltonian parameters and generalizes beyond the training domain, while exhibiting finite capacity as the parameter space becomes increasingly broad or diverse. We further demonstrate robustness to noisy measurements and show that the model can be trained on transport data generated outside the Hamiltonian family assumed by the physics decoder, while still identifying meaningful effective parameters.

articles.title: Proof-Carrying Materials: Falsifiable Safety Certificates for Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.12183v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) are deployed for high-throughput materials screening without formal reliability guarantees. We show that a single MLIP used as a stability filter misses 93% of density functional theory (DFT)-stable materials (recall 0.07) on a 25,000-material benchmark. Proof-Carrying Materials (PCM) closes this gap through three stages: adversarial falsification across compositional space, bootstrap envelope refinement with 95% confidence intervals, and Lean 4 formal certification. Auditing CHGNet, TensorNet and MACE reveals architecture-specific blind spots with near-zero pairwise error correlations (r <= 0.13; n = 5,000), confirmed by independent Quantum ESPRESSO validation (20/20 converged; median DFT/CHGNet force ratio 12x). A risk model trained on PCM-discovered features predicts failures on unseen materials (AUC-ROC = 0.938 +/- 0.004) and transfers across architectures (cross-MLIP AUC-ROC ~ 0.70; feature importance r = 0.877). In a thermoelectric screening case study, PCM-audited protocols discover 62 additional stable materials missed by single-MLIP screening - a 25% improvement in discovery yield.

articles.title: Stacking-Directed Polarization and Excitonic Engineering in MoS₂/MoSe₂ van der Waals Heterostructures
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.22014v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The stacking-dependent polarization and excitonic response of MoS₂/MoSe₂ heterostructures were investigated using GW+BSE many-body perturbation theory. While homobilayer MoS₂ exhibited a switchable interlayer dipole driven by registry-induced symmetry breaking, the MoS₂/MoSe₂ hetero-interface remained pinned by the intrinsic chemical potential mismatch between sulfur and selenium. In 2L-MoS₂/MoSe₂ trilayers, the stacking sequence enabled a deterministic control of photogenerated electrons between the central and bottom MoS₂ layers, governed by internal electric fields and quasiparticle band-edge shifts of 60--70~meV. Our calculations predicted a 36~meV interlayer excitonic shift, in remarkable agreement with recent experiments. These results elucidate the microscopic link between atomic registry and many-body interactions, establishing transition metal dichalcogenide trilayers as a potential platform for sliding ferroelectricity and programmable optoelectronic functionalities.

articles.title: Thermoelectric and Magnetic Properties in Doped Fe₂VAl within a Bipolar Random Anderson Model
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06878v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the thermoelectric and magnetic properties of Si-substituted n-type and Ti-substituted p-type Heusler alloy Fe₂VAl using the bipolar random Anderson model, which has been introduced recently to study antisite-defect effects associated with the sign change of the Seebeck coefficient in thermally quenched Fe₂VAl. Based on the electronic states of both n-type and p-type compounds, with the rigid-band shift of the Fermi energy and a temperature-dependent scattering rate taken into account, we elucidate how antisite defects simultaneously influence thermoelectric transport and local magnetic moments. We find that the magnetic moments are enhanced in n-type Fe₂VAl, whereas they are suppressed in p-type Fe₂VAl compared with the undoped compound. These contrasting magnetic responses highlight the impact of antisite spin polarization on thermoelectric properties and demonstrate the crucial role of antisite defects in realizing magneto-thermoelectric functionalities in Heusler-type alloys.

articles.title: Computing binary alloy phase diagrams with explicit configurational and vibrational entropy
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.14795v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Phase stability in multicomponent solid solutions depends on configurational entropy beyond the ideal mixing limit, but capturing it together with vibrational entropy within the same atomistic framework remains challenging. Here, we extend non-equilibrium thermodynamic integration to composition-dependent transformations through an alchemical interpolation of the interactions, combined with Monte Carlo identity exchange moves and molecular dynamics that sample the vibrational and non-ideal configurational entropy along the integration path. We apply the framework to the Au-Cu binary alloy using Atomic Cluster Expansion (ACE) potentials trained on density functional theory data using the LDA, PBE, and r2SCAN functionals, and construct composition-temperature phase diagrams directly from atomistic free energies. We find that explicit configurational sampling lowers the AuCu order-disorder transition temperature predicted by an ACE potential trained on LDA data by about 126 K, closer to the experimental value of 683 K, and substantially widens the stability range of the solid solution. At the same time, the much larger sensitivity to the exchange-correlation functional shows that this level of agreement should not be interpreted as general predictive accuracy. No single functional is uniformly accurate across the thermodynamic observables considered here, showing that functional sensitivity must be assessed alongside configurational effects when constructing atomistic phase diagrams.

articles.title: PASS: Perturbation augmented space group structure sampling for transferable Fe-O machine learning interatomic potential
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28000v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Iron (Fe) oxidation is a fundamental phenomenon that is scientifically vital and technologically significant. Despite substantial experimental efforts, accurate atomistic modelling of Fe oxidation remains elusive, which requires a reliable interatomic potential, whose development hinges on a representative first-principles training dataset. However, Fe-oxygen (O) system is known for its structural complexity, rendering the generation of high-quality first-principles dataset challenging. In this work, we propose the Perturbation Augmented Space group structure Sampling (PASS) method to generate extensive dataset for Fe-O system consisting of small-cell structures (no more than 10 atoms). Based on atomic cluster expansion (ACE) framework, we present a systematic approach to developing a transferable machine learning interatomic potential (MLIP). The accuracy and capability of the ACE potential are thoroughly validated across pure Fe and Fe-O systems through bulk, surface, and interface properties. The large-scale Fe oxidation simulations with the ACE potential capture key features of the oxidation process, including the formation of an FeO-like structure consistent with recent experimental observations. This work demonstrates that the PASS method yields an accurate and transferable MLIP that can capture the reactive complexity of oxide growth while remaining computationally practical for extended systems.

articles.title: Emergent Skyrmion Hall Effect in d-wave Altermagnets at Finite Temperature
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27107v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Altermagnets combine compensated magnetic order with unconventional symmetry-dependent responses, offering a promising platform for spintronic applications. Here, we show that a voltage-controlled magnetic-anisotropy gradient drives altermagnetic (ATM) skyrmions in a nearly rectilinear, Hall-free manner in the absence of thermal fluctuations, owing to their strongly compensated gyrotropic response. Thermal magnons qualitatively modify this behavior by increasing the longitudinal drag through magnon--skyrmion scattering and generating a transverse reaction force through handedness-dependent skew scattering. Owing to the anisotropic altermagnetic magnon band structure, the relative transport weights of the two magnon handednesses are interchanged between propagation along the x and y directions, resulting in transverse skyrmion drifts of opposite sign. By contrast, along the high-symmetry direction, the two magnon handednesses remain degenerate and their transverse contributions cancel, preserving Hall-free motion even at finite temperature. We thus uncover a thermally emergent anisotropic skyrmion Hall effect whose direction-dependent magnitude and sign originate from the intrinsic symmetry-dependent magnon spectrum, making it a generic finite-temperature dynamical feature of ATM skyrmions. Our results establish a low-power route toward electrically controlled and thermally tunable ATM skyrmion transport.

articles.title: Scalar Spin Chirality from Dissipative Pumping and Lamb-Shift Precession
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.30324v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: How electrical driving generates and reverses scalar spin chirality in an interacting system with a real Hamiltonian and no magnetic flux remains a fundamental open question. We show that dissipative tunneling prepares an orbital pseudospin, while virtual charge fluctuations generate a noncollinear Lamb field that rotates it toward the chiral direction. Bias changes their relative orientation and thereby reverses the current. This reservoir-induced orbital Hanle effect converts a nonchiral orbital polarization into scalar spin chirality. Within the ground-state space, the circulating current is determined by the scalar spin chirality. Hierarchical-equations-of-motion calculations show that the low-bias reversal survives beyond the second-order weak-coupling description, while the quadratic growth of chirality after a sudden voltage switch identifies precession. More broadly, time-reversal-odd responses can emerge in open quantum systems from the interplay between dissipative state preparation and coherent precession.

articles.title: Resolving the structural stability of the hydrogen storage borohydride NaCa(BH4)3 via data-driven screening and first-principles lattice dynamics
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02001v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Equimolar NaCa(BH₄)₃ offers a theoretical hydrogen capacity of 11.24 wt.% and a decomposition enthalpy expected to fall between those of NaBH₄ and Ca(BH₄)₂, but it has never been prepared and no crystal structure has been reported. Predictions for it have so far been built within the perovskite family that its heavier homologues adopt. Here that assumption is removed. Six candidate frameworks were assembled from three independent sources --- experimentally determined ABX₃ borohydrides, a distorted perovskite from data-driven structure prediction, and an unbiased search over a structural database in which all 2238 generated candidates were relaxed with none excluded --- and at fixed charge-neutral composition the cation arrangement of every framework was enumerated exhaustively, 420 decorations reducing to 118 symmetry-inequivalent configurations, screened with a machine-learning potential and settled from first principles. The most stable structure is not a perovskite. It is a monoclinic framework of space group Cm, reached only by the unrestricted search, at -4.185640 eV/atom, 7.67 meV/atom below the best framework available beforehand; two chemically unrelated donor prototypes converge on it to 0.076 meV/atom, and its ordered cation arrangement is the ground state of its own series. Its phonon spectrum carries no imaginary mode at any wavevector the supercell resolves exactly and its relaxed-ion elastic tensor is positive definite, whereas the orthorhombic perovskite candidate is unstable to -2.401 THz. That contrast supplies a physical reason for the reported failure to obtain this composition in perovskite form, and the simulated diffraction pattern reported here identifies the predicted framework by seven reflections that neither parent phase nor the competing framework produces.

articles.title: Reusable Operators for Irreducible Cartesian Tensor Decomposition and Coupling
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05971v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Molecular and material properties, from the polarizability to the elastic constants, are described by tensors. Their behavior under rotations is made explicit when a tensor is decomposed into irreducible parts that transform independently. In Cartesian form these parts are the symmetric and traceless irreducible Cartesian tensors (ICTs), whose decomposition and coupling underlie selection rules, orientational averages, and the use of symmetry. The decomposition is a textbook result at rank two, but higher rank and the intrinsic symmetry of physical tensors make it nontrivial. What has been lacking, unlike in the well-established spherical formalism, is a general construction for a given intrinsic symmetry, together with reusable operators that extract the ICTs and rebuild the original tensor exactly. Here, we develop such a construction and obtain these operators explicitly. These operators depend on rank and symmetry alone, and therefore each need only be built once and then applied to any tensor of that class. Building on them, we further obtain the Cartesian harmonics of a vector and the operators that couple two ICTs into a third, both central to equivariant machine learning. The construction is demonstrated on the elastic tensor, in both its second-order form of rank four and its third-order form of rank six. The ICTs of the rank-4 tensor also define a rotation- and scale-invariant measure of anisotropy, which we evaluate across the first-principles elastic tensors of crystalline materials from the Materials Project. The construction is implemented in the open-source package natto, which produces the operators in both exact symbolic and numerical form.

articles.title: Witnessing Short- and Long-Range Nonstabilizerness via the Information Lattice
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.26696v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study nonstabilizerness on the information lattice and demonstrate that noninteger local information directly indicates nonstabilizerness. For states with a clear separation of short- and large-scale information, a noninteger total information at large scales Γ serves as a witness of long-range nonstabilizerness. We propose a folding procedure to separate the global and edge-to-edge contributions to Γ. As an example we show that the ferromagnetic ground state of the spin-1/2 three-state Potts model has long-range nonstabilizerness originating from global correlations, while the paramagnetic ground state has at most short-range nonstabilizerness.

articles.title: DNNs, Dataset Statistics, and Correlation Functions
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.21715v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: This paper argues that dataset structure is important in image recognition tasks (among other tasks). Specifically, we focus on the nature and genesis of correlational structure in the actual datasets upon which DNNs are trained. We argue that DNNs are implementing a widespread methodology in condensed matter physics and materials science that focuses on mesoscale correlation structures that live between fundamental atomic/molecular scales and continuum scales. Specifically, we argue that DNNs that are successful in image classification must be discovering high order correlation functions. It is well-known that DNNs successfully generalize in apparent contravention of standard statistical learning theory. We consider the implications of our discussion for this puzzle.

articles.title: Quantum Noise Spectroscopy of Nanoscale Charge Defects in Silicon Carbide at Room Temperature
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.22521v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The nanoscale charge environment critically influences the performance of semiconductor devices, yet traditional characterization techniques usually lack the spatial resolution to resolve nanoscale charge heterogeneity and identify microscopic noise sources. Here, we address this critical gap by utilizing individual PL5 color centers in commercial silicon carbide as room-temperature, broadband (near-DC to GHz) quantum spectrometers. We report the first real-time, nanoscale observation of single-charge tunneling dynamics at room temperature in 4H-SiC by monitoring the random telegraph noise using optically detected magnetic resonance (ODMR). This capability enables an electrical noise imaging technique that shows distinct noise variations on different wafers. Employing dynamical decoupling and T₁ relaxation spectroscopy, we observe correlations of noise spectral density across frequency bands and obtain the nanoscale electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) fingerprint of spin defects in SiC. Ultimately, through surface chemical engineering, we identify the native oxide layer as the main source of resolved electromagnetic fluctuations. This work establishes a versatile atomic-scale metrology platform bridging quantum sensing and semiconductor engineering, offering critical insights for optimizing third-generation semiconductor interfaces and advancing solid-state quantum technologies.

articles.title: Lattice Realizations of Flat Gauging and T-duality Defects at Any Radius
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.09126v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We analyze non-invertible topological interfaces and defects in the two-dimensional compact boson, focusing on the more exotic ones obtained by gauging continuous symmetries with flat connections on a half-space. These include interfaces between mutually irrational radii and T-duality symmetries at arbitrary boson radius. Using the modified Villain discretization on both a Euclidean two-dimensional square lattice and a quantum one-dimensional chain, we show that all these topological interfaces survive discretization and give rise to non-compact edge modes localized at the defect sites. Such non-compact edge modes imply a continuous defect spectrum and an infinite quantum dimension. In the special case of rational radii, we show how the defect action or Hamiltonian can be modified in order to compactify the edge modes and produce more standard defects with finite quantum dimension.

articles.title: Nonlinear Dynamics of Rapidly Driven Systems
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.28996v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We consider systems characterized by the presence of a rapidly oscillating force. A general method is presented for the construction of the effective action governing the large-scale nonlinear dynamics of such systems order by order in inverse powers of the oscillation frequency ω. The explicit expression for the effective Lagrangian is derived up to cal O(1/ω⁶) next-to-next-to-leading approximation in the strong-drive regime. The general structure of the high-frequency expansion reveals a broad class of nonlinear systems whose transition curves are identical to those of the linear Mathieu equation, which enables a fully nonperturbative stability analysis in the case of strong driving and nonlinearity. The method is generalized to velocity-dependent forces and configuration space with curvature, characteristic to systems with constraints. Several applications are discussed in detail, including the dynamical magnetic trapping of electric charges.

articles.title: Toward Quantum Utility in Correlated Topological Matter: Variational Preparation of Fractional Quantum Hall Manifolds
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.11380v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We investigate the use of variational quantum algorithms to prepare and characterize fractional quantum Hall states on near-term quantum processors. Focusing on the ν=1/3 Laughlin phase described by the V₁ Haldane pseudopotential, we formulate the lowest-Landau-level problem in second quantization, and implement particle-number-preserving variational circuits combined with the variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) and variational quantum deflation (VQD). We benchmark the approach in two complementary geometries: Haldane sphere and torus shape. On the Haldane sphere, the target state is a unique zero-energy Laughlin ground state, providing a controlled test of the variational workflow and of excited-state reconstruction. On the torus, the problem retains the genuinely two-dimensional periodic character of the quantum Hall liquid and exhibits the threefold topological ground-state degeneracy expected for the ν=1/3 fractional filling factor. This feature makes the torus a more demanding benchmark than the quasi-one-dimensional cylinder or thin-torus limits commonly exploited in state-preparation quantum protocols. We benchmark the hardware-optimized variational states against exact diagonalization using energy estimates, error-mitigated observables, and subspace-containment diagnostics. Our results show that hybrid quantum algorithms can approximately reconstruct the low-energy structure of small fractional quantum Hall systems, including the topological ground-state manifold on the torus. Beyond serving as a benchmark for quantum hardware, this geometry-resolved approach provides a route toward quantum simulations of fractional Chern insulators and strongly correlated topological phases in realistic two-dimensional materials.

articles.title: Non-Clifford quantum cellular automata from invertible topological quantum field theories
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.21697v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Quantum cellular automata (QCAs) describe locality-preserving quantum dynamics and link quantum information, many-body physics, and topological quantum field theory (TQFT). Constructing a QCA from a TQFT, however, remains challenging: although a topological action yields a Hamiltonian with commuting terms that realizes the desired ground state, it does not by itself specify an automorphism of the full operator algebra. We develop a unified algebraic construction that extends such Hamiltonians to complete separator-flipper algebras on the full tensor-product Hilbert space, thereby defining the corresponding QCAs microscopically. In 3 spatial dimensions, our framework unifies all previously known QCA constructions associated with the Z₈timesZ₂ subgroup of the Witt group, including the U(1)₂ and U(1)₄ QCAs. The same algebraic structure yields new infinite families of generalized U(1)₂ and U(1)₄ non-Clifford QCAs in spatial dimensions d=4k-1. We also reformulate the 4-dimensional w₂w₃ QCA and use it to construct QCAs from TQFTs associated with arbitrary products of Stiefel--Whitney classes. For example, we explicitly construct two infinite families: w₂^nw₃^m QCAs in dimension d=2n+3m-1 and w₂w₄ₖ₋₁ QCAs in dimension d=4k. For the 5-dimensional w₃² and w₂³ QCAs, our construction gives finite-depth quantum circuits, consistent with the cobordism classification. More generally, we show that our construction yields a finite-depth quantum circuit whenever the corresponding Stiefel-Whitney number vanishes on every closed oriented manifold. Overall, these results convert invertible TQFTs into microscopic QCAs, provide higher-dimensional constructions beyond the Clifford setting, and open a systematic route to characterizing their stable structures and boundary anomalies.

articles.title: Suzuki-Trotter Decompositions and other Methods for Quantum Time Evolution
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.19184v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: (Suzuki-)Trotter decompositions, splitting methods, (Lie) product formulae... The most common numerical methods for the time evolution of quantum systems come with many names. And they are used practically everywhere with applications ranging from the solution of classical equations of motion and various Monte Carlo simulations to the real and imaginary time evolution on classical as well as quantum computers. Here we review the state of the art of said methods, focussing especially on the progress made over the last few years. We highlight recently discovered efficient time evolution algorithms and explain how best to use them in practice. A central part of this work is the estimation of error bounds that has improved greatly within the past decade. The relevance of time evolution methods for quantum computing is discussed with a focus on noisy hardware. Finally, a comprehensive overview of generalisations, related methods and alternatives to Trotterization is provided. This includes time-dependent Hamiltonian dynamics, processed methods, multi-product formulae, symplectic integrators, TDVP for tensor networks, quantum signal processing, Crouch-Grossman methods and more. The overall perspective in this work is that of a theoretical physicist. All mathematical proofs as well as some technical details are omitted for easier readability. Instead, this review serves as a hands-on guide and, of course, as a starting point for references that provide further details.

articles.title: Metadevices that compute: mathematical foundations and experimental implementations for neuromorphic nanophotonics
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40903v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Wave-based analog computing has re-emerged as a compelling alternative to digital electronics for specific linear-algebraic and machine-learning workloads, promising massively parallel, high-bandwidth, and energy-efficient information processing. Metamaterials, metasurfaces, and integrated metastructures (collectively, metadevices) now perform mathematical operations, solve integral and differential equations, multiply matrices, and implement trainable photonic neural networks directly in the wave domain. This focused review consolidates the mathematical foundations that underpin such devices, i.e., the mapping between linear operators and wave scattering, the feedback architectures that realize equation inversion, and the inverse-design and scientific machine-learning toolchains that make their synthesis and training tractable, and connects them to the rapidly growing body of experimental demonstrations, from free-space diffractive processors to reconfigurable guided-wave metastructures. We conclude with open problems and opportunities for this emerging neuromorphic nanophotonics ecosystem.

articles.title: Equipartition between Alfvénic turbulence and energetic ions as the origin of the -5 common spectrum in the heliosphere
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40925v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Suprathermal ion tails throughout the heliosphere follow a ``common spectrum,'' f(v)propto v⁻⁵. We show that scale-by-scale equipartition between strong Alfvénic turbulence and the ions it accelerates predicts both this exponent and the absolute amplitude, F(v)=B²/(16π³ mᵢ v⁵), with no free parameters. The prediction agrees within a factor of a few with ACE and Voyager 1 spectra across three decades in magnetic energy. We argue that this saturated level is reached where strong turbulence accelerates particles locally; quiet-time tails lie well below it, consistent with nonlocal acceleration.

articles.title: Characteristics of VHF and UHF band detection using Stark shifting in Rydberg-atom sensors
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40952v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a characterization of the sensitivity of broadband electric field measurements in the Very High Frequency (VHF) and Ultra High Frequency (UHF) bands using AC stark shifting of Rydberg states. The dependence of the sensitivity and dynamic range of the field measurements using nD5/2 states of cesium for principal quantum numbers n= 60, 70, 80, 90 and 100 is presented, detailing the intricacies involved. The frequencies considered for the measurement range from 50 MHz to 900 MHz for which a transverse electromagnetic (TEM) cell is used to excite the Rydberg atoms with the RF fields. The corresponding sensitivities achieved are in the (μ V/m)/sqrtHz range. A general trend of better sensitivity for higher principal quantum numbers is observed. This work paves the way for a better understanding of the AC Stark dependent field measurements using Rydberg sensors.

articles.title: Variational surface matching for multichannel molecular photoionization
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40953v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present an improved method for computing multichannel scattering states in the ASTRA{} (AttoSecond TRAnsitions) molecular ionization code. Our pole-free Galerkin method with variational surface matching (PFG-VSM) yields a boundary response that is stationary with respect to errors in the interior wave function. Compared with matching based on directly evaluated radial derivatives, this formulation yields substantially faster convergence and greater numerical stability as the number of open channels increases. Comparison with a numerical solution of the exactly separable mathrm H₂⁺ problem establishes the accuracy attainable in a hybrid Gaussian--B-spline basis for a polycentric potential, independently of many-electron close-coupling approximations. A direct comparison of the two matching prescriptions for CO demonstrates the stability of the variational formulation under radial-basis coarsening. For neon, agreement with the NewStock atomic ionization code tests the treatment of the continuum degeneracies that arise when rotational symmetry is represented in D₂ₕ. The excellent agreement with the independent XCHEM{} molecular ionization code for CO partial cross sections and molecular-frame photoelectron angular distributions, both away from and across resonances, is a strong confirmation of the correctness of both codes. A comparison for pyrazine extends this validation to a larger polyatomic target.

articles.title: Microscopic Theory of Spin-Orbit Interactions of Light
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40979v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Optical spin-orbit interactions (SOI), demonstrated experimentally in optical cavities, enable the polarization degrees of freedom of light to be described and controlled as an effective pseudospin, providing a foundation for spintronic-like control of light and the development of next-generation optical technologies. However, prior works describe this emergent effect using phenomenological models that fail to uncover its microscopic quantum origins, and as a result, a rigorous connection between material electronic structure and the optical SOI remains elusive. In this work, we address this fundamental challenge by developing a microscopic quantum theory starting from the non-relativistic quantum electrodynamical (QED) description of light-matter interactions. We show that this effect arises from virtual interactions between confined photons and material excitations. Crucially, our theoretical framework provides microscopic material-design principles for tuning the distinct components of optical SOI, which include the optical birefringence, photonic self-energies, TE-TM splitting, and optical Zeeman splitting, enabling precise engineering of effective magnetic fields, diabolical points, and pseudospin textures. We anticipate that the predictive capability of our microscopic theory will enable systematic screening and design of material systems for photonic spintronics and optical technologies.

articles.title: From proof of concept to practice: the next decade of artificial intelligence in metasurface photonics
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41000v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Over the past decade, artificial intelligence has learned to predict electromagnetic responses rapidly and generate high-performance metasurface designs. However, one question remains open: compared with conventional design workflows that contain no learned model, has it made the complete design workflow faster, and are the resulting devices better? We argue that the answer depends on the task. Reading 100 highly cited optical studies in depth, we distinguish the design tasks in which artificial intelligence is irreplaceable, clearly advantageous, or without clear advantage. In our view, the key to the next decade is not more successes in isolated tasks but making each success a foundation for the field, through shifts such as shared data, trained models, and physics written into learning. Whether artificial intelligence leaves lasting value in this field will depend on whether its benefits can be verified, its methods transferred, and its designs corrected by experiment.

articles.title: Electron Scattering with ASTRA: Helium and Molecular Hydrogen
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41026v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present an implementation of electron-impact scattering in ASTRA, a close-coupling method based on transition density matrices previously applied to molecular photoionization. The scattering states are obtained with a pole-free Galerkin method with variational surface matching, which yields the scattering matrix and the channel-resolved amplitudes for elastic and electronically inelastic integral cross sections and molecular-frame differential cross sections. For helium, ASTRA reproduces elastic and inelastic cross sections over a broad energy range, resolves the He⁻(1s2s² ²S^e) Feshbach resonance in both energy and angle, and captures the principal interference structures in the n=2 excitation angular distributions, in selected channels matching measured differential-cross-section ratios more closely than available benchmark calculations. For molecular hydrogen, target polarization and interchannel coupling are represented through additional close-coupling channels, without a fitted polarization potential or a separately constructed (N+1)-electron correlation space. Compared with the restricted-channel description, the expanded calculations substantially improve agreement with UKRmol+ for elastic and inelastic cross sections. We further report fully orientation-resolved three-dimensional molecular-frame angular distributions for state-resolved electron-impact excitation. These reveal pronounced stereodynamic effects that vanish upon orientational averaging: at 15 eV, excitation of the b³Σᵤ⁺ state is more than eight times stronger for incident momentum parallel rather than perpendicular to the molecular axis. These results connect conventional scattering benchmarks with orientation-resolved collision dynamics and open the way to larger molecular targets.

articles.title: A General-Purpose Adaptable Foundation Model for Total-Body PET Kinetic Modelling
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41093v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Voxel-level kinetic modeling in total-body dynamic positron emission tomography (TB-PET) enables precise physiological quantification but complicates parameter uncertainty estimation. While generative consistency models (CMs) can rapidly estimate Bayesian posterior distributions, they are constrained by type of tracers, kinetic models, and protocols. Training them from scratch whenever a new tracer, model or protocol is used can be computationally intensive. To address this, we introduce LoRACM, a parameter-efficient framework utilizing low-rank adaptation (LoRA) to transfer a pretrained foundation CM to novel TB-PET scenarios. We evaluated three adaptation scenarios using simulated and human data: scanner and protocol transfer for FDG two-tissue compartment modeling; FP-CIT simplified reference tissue modeling; and high-temporal-resolution FDG blood flow imaging via the adiabatic approximation to tissue homogeneity model. Each adaptation was trained in less than 3 hours on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU using 50,000 simulated pairs. In simulations, LoRACM showed strong agreement with results from Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC, which we use as reference posterior distributions), yielding median Kullback-Leibler divergences of 0.05-0.11 and median absolute percentage errors below 1.2% for each kinetic parameter of interest. In human data, LoRACM generated total-body Kᵢ maps comparable to the ones made by non-negative nonlinear least squares (NNLS) fitting and a consistency model trained from scratch. Striatal dopamine binding potential estimates predicted by LoRACM correlated with NNLS estimates (r = 0.968-0.988). LoRACM produced total-body blood flow imaging with FDG matching the one made by NNLS. These underscore the potential of adapting a pretrained CM with LoRA for fast and reliable posterior parameter inference for kinetic models across distinct TB-PET applications.

articles.title: Atomistic Emergence of Vibrational Polariton Condensation
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41133v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nonequilibrium polariton condensation is a macroscopic quantum phenomenon in which overwhelming population accumulation is observed at the band edge of the lower polariton (LP) dispersion curve under incoherent material pumping. As a promising route toward nonequilibrium Bose--Einstein condensates, its description, however, remains predominantly limited to models with phenomenological material parameters. Herein, a fully atomistic description of vibrational polariton condensation is developed by employing mesoscale cavity molecular dynamics simulations, a method which self-consistently propagates classical electromagnetic dynamics coupled to realistic molecules in a multimode Fabry--Pérot cavity. Under continuous-wave pumping, a lower polariton condensate forms when the infrared cavity is coupled to harmonic, homogeneously broadened molecular vibrations, such as the bending modes of liquid CO2 and CS2, whereas anharmonic stretching modes and liquids with fast intramolecular relaxation hardly condense. The role of libration-bending coupling for facilitating the LP condensation is further discussed. GPU-accelerated mesoscale simulations involving approximately 50 million atoms additionally provide direct two-dimensional real-space imaging of fluid-like polariton patterns during the condensation formation. Overall, this study provides key design insights into vibrational polariton condensation as a novel approach for controlling liquid-phase chemistry.

articles.title: Terminal-state theorems for a two-stage Maki--Thompson rumor model: final size, stifler composition, and non-identifiability from pooled statistics
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41206v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rumor models of the Daley--Kendall and Maki--Thompson family anchor the statistical mechanics of social contagion, yet the stifler composition a rumor leaves behind has resisted closed-form analysis. Inspired by the asymmetric two-step pairing (A2SP) process of step-growth polymerization, we import its common-factor cancellation into a minimal two-stage MT variant in which re-contacted spreaders are re-activated into a senior class at rate α k₁ rather than stifled, and obtain exact terminal-state theorems. (i) Saturation: the rumor exhausts the ignorant pool for every stifling-to-recruitment ratio μ>0, with a three-way tail classification and a logarithmically critical line at μ=1. (ii) Final size: the terminal stifler pool splits as (x₁,x₂)=(μ/(α+μ),α/(α+μ)), independent of seed size; the fingerprint inverts linearly (α=μ x₂/x₁) and matches Gillespie simulations within 0.95%. (iii) Pooled versus history-resolved: pooled statistics are exactly α-free on any static graph; only the history-resolved composition carries α. Restoring the classic teller-retires channel breaks the exact closure beyond quantified gates (contact rates of 1--3% of k₁ for spreader channels at μ≤1.5, up to 32% at μ=2), and on configuration-model networks the composition bias decays as langle krangle⁻⁰.⁷¹. An exploratory inversion of 354,930 Higgs--Twitter retweet episodes, screened by an identity check and four negative controls, yields hatα=2.21% (joint cluster-bootstrap CI [1.6%,3.0%]; approx3.7% after calibration at the matched threshold). Terminal compositions identify this effective re-activation rate, an upper bound on contact-coupled re-activation; the mechanism itself requires timing information beyond the terminal state.

articles.title: Plasmoid Instability in Inhomogeneous Current Sheets
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41241v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Plasmoid instability in inhomogeneous current sheets is investigated using electromagnetic gyrokinetic simulations of collisionless magnetic reconnection. Simulations with and without small random perturbations are compared to examine the effects of symmetry breaking and spatial inhomogeneity. The current-sheet width immediately before disruption remains close to the electron skin depth, whereas the disruption aspect ratio varies significantly between primary and later current sheets. Random perturbations also produce asymmetric plasmoid topologies in which neighboring X points no longer share a common separatrix. These results suggest that spatial inhomogeneity is an important factor in the disruption of dynamically evolving current sheets.

articles.title: Conceptual Design of a Compact Magnetic Spectrometer for Space Radiation Measurement
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41412v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present the design of COMIRA, a compact magnetic spectrometer for space radiation measurement. The spectrometer consists of four layers of scintillating fiber trackers, four layers of silicon strip trackers, one threshold Cherenkov counter, two anti-coincidence counters, and a permanent magnet. The detector has an overall dimension of approximately 12x12 cm3 and a geometrical acceptance of ~6.6 cm2sr. Based on combined measurements of charge, velocity, and rigidity (momentum/charge), it enables the simultaneous measurement of the energy spectrum, angular distribution and time evolution of individual radiation components, including electrons, positrons, protons and light nuclei over an energy range from tens of MeV to several GeV. The design can be further optimized depending on the available resources and constraints of the hosting space platform.

articles.title: Accelerating Computation and Resolving Extraneous Roots in the Kinetic Plasma Dispersion Relation Solver BO
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41450v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Kinetic dispersion relations are widely used to study waves and instabilities in space, astrophysical, and laboratory plasmas. Iterative root searches depend on initial guesses and may fail to converge or miss important branches. The BO/PDRK solvers [Comput. Phys. Commun. 244, 343-371 (2019)] use rational pole expansions to transform the nonlinear dispersion relation into a matrix eigenvalue problem, obtaining all roots of the approximated relation in one calculation. However, high cyclotron harmonics enlarge the matrix and slow computation, while extraneous roots are difficult to separate from physical modes. We develop BO-T (BO-Tian), an improved version of BO combining two methods. First, for matrix reduction, BO-T applies rank factorization to combined residue matrices, preserving the rational dispersion relation and accounting for the removed pole eigenvalues. Second, for root screening, BO-T uses contour comparison between approximate and reference kinetic dispersion matrices along a closed contour enclosing no poles. This provides a sufficient condition for preserving local root counts, with error bounds for isolated roots and criteria for growth rate signs. Benchmarks on representative electrostatic and electromagnetic cases show speedups of about 10 to 140 for matrix assembly and eigenvalue calculation, exceeding 30 in most cases with high cyclotron harmonics. Root screening recovers the main unstable branches in agreement with published and archived dispersion curves.

articles.title: A Hybrid Message-Passing and Electric-Field Representation for Electrostatic QM/MM Embedding with Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41523v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Within a hybrid quantum mechanics/molecular mechanics approach a small region of a large atomistic system is described quantum mechanically, while the rest of the system is represented by a classical force field. Despite this, the computational cost of the quantum calculation severely limits the accessible simulation and sampling time. Replacing the quantum calculation with a machine learning interatomic potential (MLIP) trained on quantum reference data can greatly increase the accessible simulation time. However, the accuracy and efficiency strongly depend on the specific way in which the MLIP incorporates information about the classical (electrostatic) environment. Here, we demonstrate that existing strategies based purely on features derived from an external electric field fail to distinguish certain environments, ultimately limiting their accuracy. As a solution, we propose an extension to the equivariant TensorNet architecture that mitigates this shortcoming by incorporating classical atoms close to the quantum region into the message-passing scheme, combined with features derived from the electric field for describing the environment farther away. We show that this combination achieves higher accuracy than either approach alone.

articles.title: AMPERe: an exactly divergence-free quadrature-by-expansion evaluator for near-surface Biot--Savart and virtual-casing fields in fusion geometries
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41544v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate magnetic-field evaluation on and near current-carrying surfaces is a recurring computational bottleneck in magnetic-confinement fusion. As targets approach the source surface, Biot--Savart and virtual-casing kernels become singular, causing standard Gauss--Legendre and upsampled trapezoidal quadratures to lose accuracy. We introduce AMPERe, a quadrature-by-expansion (QBX) evaluator for vector magnetostatic kernels on general three-dimensional, non-axisymmetric tokamak and stellarator geometries. The method develops a spherical-harmonic QBX formulation for the vector Biot--Savart and virtual-casing (Stratton--Chu) fields and expresses the resulting magnetic field as the analytic curl of a regular-solid-harmonic vector potential. This construction yields a divergence-free discrete field at every expansion order, provides analytic derivatives, and enables an a priori separation of truncation, quadrature, and geometric errors. On the rotating-ellipse benchmark of Malhotra et al. [1], QBX maintains a relative error of 2--5 x 10⁻⁶ throughout the near-surface regime at distance-independent cost, whereas upsampled trapezoidal quadrature exhibits O(1) errors and requires node counts scaling as (h/d)². AMPERe is implemented as a header-only, performance-portable Kokkos library supporting CPU and GPU backends, with target-specific and local-correction accelerations validated against the baseline. The method is further demonstrated on realistic Wendelstein 7-X configurations, including sheet-current and virtual-casing field evaluations.

articles.title: Roadmap: Image reconstruction in emission tomography for the era of fast Monte Carlo simulation
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41583v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantitative image reconstruction in positron emission tomography and single photon emission computed tomography depends on how accurately the forward model describes photon emission, transport and detection. Monte Carlo simulation is the most complete model available, yet it is mostly used as an offline reference rather than inside the reconstruction. This roadmap asks what it would take to change that. The main obstacle is not only simulation time. Iterative reconstruction requires the expectation of the measured data and the gradient of the data fidelity, whereas Monte Carlo simulation produces noisy realisations of a complete acquisition. GPU implementations, variance reduction and learned surrogate models have made simulations much faster. At the same time, modern scanners acquire ever larger data sets with larger system models, and further gains in quantitative accuracy require more detailed physics. We discuss how fast Monte Carlo simulation can improve the modelling of the system response, scatter, positron range and the joint estimation of activity and attenuation, how noisy simulations can enter reconstruction algorithms, and which computing hardware makes this feasible. Monte Carlo simulation is most valuable where analytic models fail, and most practical solutions will combine both. The most immediate benefit of fast simulators is the validation and calibration of faster analytic models, together with more accurate, absolutely quantitative scatter estimates. Key open problems are the use of noisy simulations as expectations, in particular for sparse data, the computation of gradients and adjoints, the allocation of a limited simulation budget, and the use of scattered events as a source of information rather than a nuisance. Faster simulators are necessary but not sufficient, and progress requires simulators and reconstruction methods to be developed together.

articles.title: Magnetic scattering experiments with an ultrashort pulsed soft X-ray source using iLGADs
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41611v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Inverse Low Gain Avalanche Diode (iLGAD) sensors developed at the Paul Scherrer Institute (PSI) in collaboration with the Fondazione Bruno Kessler (FBK) have demonstrated an excellent Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) and Quantum Efficiency (QE) in the soft X-ray range. In the current batch, single-photon detection is achievable at 400 eV with an SNR > 5, while the QE surpasses 85 % at 250 eV. Combined with the high frame rates of CMOS readout ASIC, iLGAD sensors make the hybrid pixel detectors excellent candidates for time-resolved magnetic Small Angle X-ray Scattering (mSAXS) experiments in the soft X-ray energy range. In this contribution, we evaluated ILGAD sensors bump-bonded to 25 μm pitch charge-integrating MÖNCH chips at a laser-driven soft X-ray source. During the experiments, we measured energy-dispersed radiation between 600 eV and 1500 eV. These measurements were performed for the iLGAD sensor, as well as for the standard silicon sensor. Using the high-precision electronic trigger of the X-ray source, we were able to synchronise the detector with the X-ray source delivering few-picosecond pulses and optimise the timing parameters for the acquisition. Finally, we successfully performed the mSAXS experiment probing the magnetic domain pattern of a FeGd heterostructure, demonstrating better performance than a MÖNCH detector with a standard silicon sensor. ILGAD sensors achieved a significantly higher photon detection efficiency and, consequently, a higher sensitivity compared to standard silicon sensors under the same conditions, particularly for the lower-energy Fe L3 edge.

articles.title: An approximate separation of the electron and positron degrees of freedom in the Dirac-Heisenberg-Wigner formalism
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41623v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Here we study the quantum relativistic phase-space description of the Dirac field referred to as the Dirac--Heisenberg--Wigner (DHW) formalism. By applying a systematic expansion procedure in weak electromagnetic fields (compared to the Schwinger critical field) and slow temporal and long spatial scales (compared to the Compton scales), the 16 scalar phase-space functions of the DHW equations can be reduced to 8 scalars. By making a further change of variables, the equations can be interpreted as four evolution equations for the electron degrees of freedom and four for the positron degrees of freedom. We refer to these equations as the weakly coupled electron-positron (WCEP) limit of the DHW equations. Unlike the case after a Foldy--Wouthuysen transformation has been made, the electron and positron degrees of freedom remain weakly coupled. Naturally, further approximations can be made on the 4+4 equations so that only 4 equations for one particle species remain. Importantly, the expansion scheme can be carried out to all orders, in which case the reduced 4+4 model, contrary to other reduced models, will cover most quantum relativistic effects. Specifically, this includes vacuum polarization, a phenomenon that otherwise has been added phenomenologically, but here appears naturally as a feature of the general expansion scheme.

articles.title: Stabilization of counter propagating currents by energy conservation in collisions
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41748v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Current filamentation generates magnetic fields and shapes electron transport in dense plasmas, where collisions can either suppress or enhance its growth. Here we show that conserving electron kinetic energy in a collisional model can change both the dominant instability and its characteristic wavelength.
