Execution-guided repair further improves task success, reaching 49.1% and 47.2% for Claude Opus 4.6 and GPT-5.5 after three rounds, respectively.

articles.title: SimXAI: A Simple Drop-in Layer Increases Interaction Quality and Understanding in Conversational XAI
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41856v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Conversational explainable AI (ConvXAI) agents often use GUS-style architectures with separate modules for intent recognition, dialogue management, and template-based response generation. While faithful to the underlying XAI methods, these pipelines are hard to adapt and often struggle with context-dependent follow-up questions. We present SimXAI, a lightweight LLM-centric conversational layer that replaces these modules with a single tool-calling LLM that bridges access to existing XAI resources. Rather than a standalone agent, SimXAI serves as a modular interface that enables conversational access to external XAI resources. We further introduce an evaluation suite for single- and multi-turn parsing, faithfulness, and contextualization. Across existing and new datasets, SimXAI achieves strong function-selection accuracy and high faithfulness while better handling context-dependent requests. In a user study replacing only the conversational layer of TalkToModel, a representative GUS-based agent, users completed tasks more accurately and in fewer turn. Overall, SimXAI improves GUS-based design while preserving faithfulness and improving conversational quality.

articles.title: Assessment of Selected Commercial Feed Brands on Nutrient Utilization and Carcass Yield of Broiler Chickens
articles.abstract: This study evaluated the growth performance, carcass characteristics, ileal nutrient digestibility, and economic efficiency of broiler chickens fed a self-formulated diet versus four commercial feed brands. A total of 250 unsexed Arbor Acre broilers were randomly assigned to five dietary treatments (T1: self-formulated; T2: Hybrid; T3: Breedwell/New Hope; T4: Ultima; T5: Tops/Capsfeed) in a completely randomized design, each with four replicates. Growth performance, carcass yield, ileal digestibility (using chromic oxide as a marker), and cost of production were assessed over a 56-day period. Results showed that final weight, daily weight gain, and feed conversion ratio (FCR) were significantly (P<0.05) influenced by diet. Birds fed the T4 diet exhibited the fastest daily weight gain (56.90 g/d) and the best FCR (1.42), while those on the T1 diet had the lowest final weight and poorest FCR. However, birds on the T3 diet showed the highest final live weight (3.37 kg) and superior ileal digestibility for dry matter (62.96%), crude protein (70.00%), and ether extract (81.04%). Carcass parameters, including slaughter weight (1.94–3.37 kg), carcass weight (1.46–2.65 kg), and dressing percentage (75.12–78.53%), were also significantly (P<0.05) affected, with T3 and T5 generally yielding the highest values. Economically, the T4 diet was the most cost-effective, with the lowest feed cost per kilogram of weight gain (₦233.34), resulting in the highest cost savings. Principal Component Analysis (PCA) revealed a clear distinction between the self-formulated diet (T1), which was associated with higher ash and fibre retention, and the commercial diets (T2-T5), which were linked to enhanced protein and fat utilization. The study concludes that while the T4 diet was the most economically efficient and promoted the best FCR, the T3 diet excelled in overall weight gain and nutrient digestibility. The choice of feed should therefore be guided by specific production goals, whether maximizing growth, feed efficiency, or economic returns.

articles.title: Spatiotemporal correlation of rainfall intensity and subsurface acoustic emission parameters for landslide initiation
articles.abstract: Rainfall-induced landslides pose severe geohazards in monsoon-dominated mountain regions. This study presents a coupled rainfall–acoustic emission (AE) monitoring system deployed at a landslide-prone slope near Narendra Nagar, Uttarakhand, India (Lesser Himalaya). AE signals were recorded from active hollow aluminium waveguides installed through mapped shear zones, synchronized with sub-minute rainfall data from an Automatic Weather Station. Analysis of 4,884 one-minute windows over the 2025 monsoon season revealed: (i) a site-specific critical rainfall intensity threshold of 2 mm/min (r = 0.70, p < 0.001); (ii) a non-monotonic AE energy response with an energy minimum attributed to capillary suction strengthening under partial saturation, the first field-scale documentation of this phenomenon; (iii) an actionable early warning window of 12–35 minutes; (iv) an adaptive windowing algorithm showing intensity-dependent optimal accumulation windows (1 min at > 4 mm/min, 60 min at < 1 mm/min); and (v) a dual-criterion (rainfall + AE) warning system that reduces false alarms by a factor of three compared to rain-only thresholds. A site-specific intensity–duration threshold (I = 0.088D⁰.36) was derived from 51 AE-confirmed rainfall events. These results demonstrate the feasibility of physics-based, multi-criterion AE-driven landslide early warning in complex Himalayan terrain.

articles.title: Effect of zeolite and microsilica on the strength of SCC concrete containing PP fibers
articles.abstract: Recent advances in concrete technology have resulted in the development of self-compacting concrete (SCC), a highly flowable concrete capable of consolidating under its own weight without the need for external vibration. Pozzolanic materials containing reactive silica (SiO₂) possess limited intrinsic cementitious properties; however, when incorporated as finely divided particles into cementitious systems, they react with calcium hydroxide (CH) generated during cement hydration, producing additional cementitious compounds that enhance the microstructure and overall performance of concrete. The present study investigates the combined influence of natural zeolite, microsilica, and polypropylene (PP) fibers on both the fresh and hardened properties of SCC. Concrete mixtures were proportioned according to established mix design procedures and prepared under controlled laboratory conditions. Natural zeolite was used as a partial cement replacement at levels ranging from 0 to 20% by weight of cement, while PP fibers were incorporated at volumetric contents between 0 and 0.2%; microsilica was maintained at 6.25% of the total binder content in all mixtures. Fresh concrete performance was assessed through slump flow, T₅₀₀, V-funnel, and L-box tests to evaluate flowability, viscosity, and passing ability. The hardened properties were examined using compressive strength, splitting tensile strength, flexural strength, and water absorption tests. The experimental results demonstrated that mixtures without PP fibers consistently exhibited the lowest compressive strength at all curing ages. The highest compressive strength was obtained with a PP fiber dosage of 0.1% by volume, resulting in an average improvement of approximately 11% compared with fiber-free mixtures. In addition, replacing 10% of cement with natural zeolite provided the optimum performance, increasing compressive strength by nearly 13% relative to the control mixture.

articles.title: Dynamic Analysis and Reliability Prediction of Wind Turbine Gearbox Under Uncertain Excitation Conditions
articles.abstract: Wind turbine drivetrains experience variable aerodynamic loads, which can significantly impact their dynamic response and reliability. This study investigates how uncertainty in wind speed and inflow angle propagates from aerodynamic loading to gearbox failure risk and drivetrain dynamics. A blade-element aerodynamic model will be coupled with a probabilistic torque-based limit-state formulation. This will be done using first- and second-order reliability methods and Monte Carlo simulation for reliability assessment. The resulting critical aerodynamic conditions will be applied to a five-inertia torsional model that represents a multistage gearbox with a planetary stage, two parallel gear stages, and flexible shafts. We hypothesize that aerodynamic uncertainty is the only factor that significantly influences failure probability, and that critical aerodynamic conditions produce increased torsional and speed fluctuations in the drivetrain.

articles.title: Novel Mathematical Model for Natural Dispersion of Oil Spill on Dyanmic Sea
articles.abstract: Natural dispersion is an important weathering process that controls the transfer of oil from the sea surface into the water column. However, conventional dispersion models have limited capability to represent the combined effects of dynamic wave breaking, whitecap coverage, turbulence, oil properties, and droplet formation. The present study develops an energy-constrained natural-dispersion model in which whitecap coverage defines the dynamically active slick area and a wave-breaking energy-transfer efficiency determines the fraction of turbulent energy available for creation of new oil–water interfacial area. The proposed framework introduces whitecap coverage to represent the dynamically active fraction of the oil slick and an energy-transfer efficiency factor to account for the portion of wave-breaking energy available for droplet generation. The model also explicitly considers the interfacial energy required to create new oil–water surface area and couples turbulent energy dissipation with oil viscosity, interfacial tension, and droplet size. This provides a mechanistic relationship between sea-state forcing, wave breaking, useful dispersion energy, droplet generation, water-column entrainment, and subsequent resurfacing. The proposed approach provides an improved physical representation of natural oil dispersion under variable sea conditions and offers a basis for more realistic prediction of oil behavior during marine spill events.

articles.title: Formability and Microstructure of Dissimilar Aluminium Tailor-Welded Blanks (TWBs) Joined using Friction Stir and Gas Tungsten Arc Welding
articles.abstract: In this study, to evaluate the performance of different welding techniques in joining dissimilar aluminum alloys, known as the Tailor Welded Blank (TWB) concept, and to investigate their resulting mechanical properties and microscopic structures, three aluminium alloys—AA3105, AA5052, and AA1200—were investigated. These alloys were joined as multi-material dissimilar blanks using Gas Tungsten Arc Welding (GTAW) and Friction Stir Welding (FSW). By conducting Nakazima formability tests on the welded specimens, forming limit diagrams (FLD) were extracted. The FLD indicated that, across the strain paths examined, the FSW joints generally showed higher forming-limit strains and a broader safe-forming region than the corresponding GTAW joints. FSW 1–5 displayed the greatest formability, while AA5052 exhibited the lowest overall forming ability. The improved formability of the FSW joints suggests the feasibility of solid-state welding for producing dissimilar aluminium sheets that will undergo subsequent forming operations. The FSW 1–5 joint exhibited approximately 152% higher displacement capacity than the corresponding TIG joint during Nakazima testing.

articles.title: Simultaneously carbonized and sulfonated mango seed husk as a solid acid catalyst for the esterification of oleic acid with methanol
articles.abstract: The Philippines has mandated an increase in biodiesel blending from B2 (2%) to B5 (5%) under the Biofuels Act of 2006, increasing the demand for efficient and sustainable catalysts for biodiesel production. Although homogeneous catalysts are widely used, they are economically impractical since it is difficult to recover, expensive, and not reusable. This study investigated mango seed husk (MSH) as a carbon-based precursor for a solid acid catalyst (MSH-SAC) for biodiesel production through heterogeneous esterification. Nine MSH-SAC samples were synthesized using a full factorial design with varying synthesis temperatures (100, 150, and 200°C) and times (4, 5, and 6 h) through simultaneous sulfonation and carbonization. Catalytic performance was evaluated in the esterification of oleic acid with methanol at 65°C for 6 h, using a 10:1 methanol-to-oil molar ratio and 8 wt% catalyst loading. Esterification conversions ranged from approximately 61% to 84%. Catalysts synthesized at 150°C for 4 and 5 h achieved the highest conversion of 84%. The 150°C, 4 h catalyst retained approximately 78% of its initial activity after four reuse cycles, demonstrating promising stability and reusability.

articles.title: The ranking of W-temper and warm forming of solution-treated AA7075 sheet reverses with strain path
articles.abstract: This study ranks W-temper and warm forming of solution-treated AA7075 sheet over seven strain paths rather than by one formability number. Nakajima blanks 16–100 mm wide were formed at 28°C after quenching and at 100–180°C after cooling from solution treatment. A finite element model and a plane-strain localisation analysis used the measured hardening laws and forming limit curves. The ranking of the routes reversed with strain path. On average, blanks 16–52 mm wide fractured 10.6–30.3% lower after warm forming than in the W temper, whereas blanks 86–100 mm wide fractured 5.7–30.1% higher. The width at which the routes swapped rank fell from 79.4 mm at 100°C to 52.7 mm at 160°C, with a tie over 50–74 mm at 180°C. The model reproduced all 42 heights within 7.35% and the reversal. At 100–140°C the plane-strain limit fell 41–58% below the limit that strain hardening allows, so deformation localised early. After paint bake, W-temper deformation gave up to 195.8 HV, against 172.6 HV for warm deformation. The strain path of the critical feature, rather than a single formability number, should therefore decide between W-temper and warm forming of solution-treated AA7075 sheet.

articles.title: Thiolate addition to withaferin A: a GFN2-xTB and DFT study of site-selective glutathione conjugation
articles.abstract: Withaferin A (WFA), the major steroidal lactone of Withania somnifera, alkylates cysteine residues in vimentin, Hsp90 and IKKβ. Glutathione (GSH), the cell’s most abundant thiol, serves as the initial step in detoxifying electrophiles. The carbon that interacts with it determines both the rate of clearance and the extent to which a compound remains to alkylate proteins. It is unquantified at any of WFA’s four electrophilic carbons: the ring-A enone (C3), the side-chain lactone (C24) and the epoxide carbons (C5, C6). This study computes conformer-ensemble free energies with GFN2-xTB in implicit water with quasi-RRHO corrections, scans the C–S approach coordinate at each site, and recalibrates with M06-2X single point calculations on truncated models. Nucleophiles were modelled as thiolates and adducts as anions; the isolable species is the neutral protonated conjugate. Addition is most exergonic at C3-α (ΔG = − 11.7 kcal mol⁻¹), then C6 (− 8.9), C5 (− 8.3) and C24 (+ 0.2 to − 4.4). Site-specific DFT corrections invert this ordering toward the epoxides. A def2-TZVP check shifts every correction by about + 7.8 kcal mol⁻¹, removing the sign difference between reaction classes but, because it is uniform, leaving the ranking intact: the inversion is robust to basis set though the corrections are not. No Hessian-verified saddle was located, so no activation energy is reported; C3 has no interior scan maximum whereas both methods place one at the epoxide, supporting kinetic control without establishing it. The methanethiolate probe reproduced glutathionate’s site preference but inverted its facial preference, α by 7.0 against β by 13.3 kcal mol⁻¹, so minimal-thiol screening ranks sites dependably, faces unreliably.

articles.title: Blocked Drains and Rising Waters: Solid Waste Mismanagement as a Driver of Urban Flood Risk in Nigeria
articles.abstract: Urban flooding is a recurrent natural disaster in Nigeria, displacing millions of people and causing major economic losses. This scoping review examines solid waste mismanagement as a driver of urban flood risk in Nigerian cities. The review followed the Arksey and O’Malley framework and was reported using the PRISMA-ScR checklist. A total of 100 studies were synthesised narratively, guided by the Pressure and Release (PAR) model. Findings show that only 20 to 30% of municipal solid waste is collected nationally. Uncollected waste, especially plastics and sachet water bags, blocks drainages at surfaces, inlets and channels. This reduces hydraulic capacity and amplifies flooding across Nigerian cities. Weak enforcement, fragmented governance and poor funding aggravates this problem. Consequences include property loss, livelihood disruption and outbreaks of cholera and typhoid. However, none of the reviewed study isolated waste as a measured hydraulic variable in flood models. The review concludes that drainage investment alone cannot reduce flood risk without waste governance reform. Hence, extended producer responsibility, wider collection coverage, routine desilting and coupled waste-hydraulic modelling are recommended. Without implementing all of these, Nigeria as a country will not be able to achieve SDGs 6, 11 and 13.

articles.title: Projected Disc-type Phase-change Memory for Analog In-Memory Computing
articles.abstract: Resistive memory technologies offer a compelling advantage for in-memory computing. However, realizing a device architecture that simultaneously achieves high computational precision, efficiency, and density has remained elusive due to inherent trade-offs among these performance metrics. Here, we introduce a compact phase-change memory device architecture that combines an ultra-confined active switching volume for enhanced electro-thermal efficiency with a non-insulating thin film that suppresses temporal conductance fluctuations. We analytically model and back-end integrate these devices into crossbar arrays. Even with conventional, undoped phase-change materials, the device architecture enables a computational precision approaching 6 bits, low conductance values below 50 μS with an adequate conductance window, and a viable pathway toward sub-100 μA programming currents under nominal operating voltages.

articles.title: Cosmological Acceleration from Scale-Space Metric Enthalpy Degradation: A Thermodynamically Consistent Resolution to the Dark Energy Problem
articles.abstract: The cosmological constant problem and the late-time accelerated expansion of the universe are re-examined from the perspective of non-equilibrium continuum mechanics and horizon thermodynamics. Rather than postulating an ad hoc vacuum energy density Λ or an empirical scalar field, we formulate cosmic expansion within a scale-space boundary framework where the irreversible conversion of coherent hydrodynamic work into boundary entropy generates an effective dissipative enthalpy drag. While standard relativistic viscous approaches typically introduce empirical constitutive power laws that result in severe cosmological age deficits (t0 ≪ 13.8 Gyr) and suppress linear perturbation growth (fσ8), our framework derives dissipative pressure from a first-principles scale-space action principle. The resulting dynamical system possesses a stable fixed-point attractor governed by dimensionless parameters (τ˜, x0) that naturally preserves the radiation and dust-dominated epochs before locking into a late-time de Sitter asymptotic phase. We perform complete numerical quadratures verifying that the expansion trajectory yields an age of the universe t0 = 13.78 Gyr and transition redshift zt ≈ 0.62, in strict agreement with observational constraints, while the restriction of dissipation to boundary horizon scales guarantees standard sub-horizon Jeans gravitational collapse.

articles.title: Resource map of quantum reservoir computing against tuned classical baselines
articles.abstract: Quantum reservoir computing promises an exponentially large feature map at no training cost, but reported advantages rest on classical baselines of unmatched size or tuning, on exact expectation values, or on resource counts that omit measurement. Here we introduce a benchmark protocol that charges shots, experiment restarts and readout size together and apply it to 3451 exactly simulated cells (57 quantum reservoirs, 49 tasks) against three tuned classical reservoir families. No classical- or quantum-input task yields a win in both accuracy and resource scaling; the only winning cells are Forrelation estimators on oracle pairs drawn fresh at every step with no exposed structure, which beat every implemented classical estimator in every seed from field sizes of 16 thousand, with a matching classical query budget growing as the square root of the field size. Few-photon Kerr dynamics beats its mean-field twin only until the twin is tuned, spin readouts pay up to three orders of magnitude in shot noise where quadrature readouts pay threefold, and every structured oracle family falls to a classical shortcut. Quantum reservoir advantage therefore lives in the input access model, not in the reservoir; we give the superconducting-circuit parameters at which the protocol can be run.

articles.title: Spectral origin and decoupling cost of non-Markovian ergotropy revivals in quantum batteries
articles.abstract: Because every quantum battery is an open system, environmental memory (non-Markovianity) has been widely proposed to revive the extractable work, or ergotropy, that dissipation destroys. These predictions rest on rotating-wave, zero-temperature or second-order treatments and evaluate the ergotropy of a still-coupled battery, leaving open whether the revival is physical and how much of it can be withdrawn. We address both questions with numerically exact hierarchical equations of motion, extended to time-dependent system–bath coupling, for single and collective qubit batteries in structured baths. The revival is physical but stems from spectral weight at the battery frequency, not from memory: baths with long memory but no such weight store less work than a Markovian bath. Disconnecting the battery costs work, which we obtain in closed form. In second-order theory a revival yields net work only if it exceeds the system–bath binding energy, a bound that a smooth coupling ramp lasting a few battery periods nearly reaches, whereas a fast local unitary avoids disconnection. In circuit quantum electrodynamics, these predictions are testable with 0.2–1 ns coupling ramps and qubit readout alone. The figure of merit of an open quantum battery is therefore set by how its energy is withdrawn.

Hwang, Colin Ophus, and Alfred Zong The authors have developed Bend Contour Electron Tomography (BCET), a computational framework that turns conventional electron microscope images into quantitative maps of morphology and strain tensors in ultrathin materials, which are essential for understanding and designing their mechanical, magnetic, and optical properties. Rather than scanning a sample point-by-point, BCET analyzes full-field images by decoding bend contours created as electrons scatter through a deformed crystal. Combining images acquired at different viewing angles then allows the reconstruction of both the membrane shape and its local strain. BCET offers an accessible route to efficiently mapping nanoscale deformation and, ultimately, tracking how ultrathin materials respond dynamically to light, heat, and applied forces. [Phys. Rev. articles.title: Machine-learning-assisted tracking of magnetic objects using quantum diamond magnetometry
articles.abstract: Author(s): Fernando Meneses, Christopher T.-K. Lew, Anand Sivamalai, Andy Sayers, Brant C. Gibson, Andrew D. Greentree, Lloyd C. L. Hollenberg, and David A. Simpson Remote magnetic tracking is crucial for navigation in GPS-denied environments, but real-world signals are often too weak, noisy, and complex to model reliably. The authors combine quantum diamond magnetometry with a deep-learning algorithm trained solely on experimental data to track an elevator in an urban setting. They show that full-vector magnetic inputs over short time windows yield robust centimeter-scale accuracy across arbitrary sensor frames despite strong noise, with model training requiring less than an hour. This model-free approach provides a practical route to deploying quantum magnetometry for real-time tracking in complex environments. [Phys. Rev. Applied 26, 054003] Published Mon Nov 02, 2026

articles.abstract: Author(s): Sergei Starikov, Yury Lysogorskiy, Minaam Qamar, Anton Bochkarev, Matous Mrovec, and Ralf Drautz This study investigates the atomic-scale structure and stability of Guinier-Preston I (GP-I) zones in Al-Zn-Mg alloys. Large-scale simulations combine molecular dynamics and Monte Carlo techniques using a newly developed atomic cluster expansion (ACE) interatomic potential. Annealing of supersaturated solid solutions leads to the formation of nearly spherical GP-I zones composed of ordered Mg-Zn building blocks, with Zn atoms frequently shifting toward interstitial positions. articles.title: Coherent ultrafast excitonic oscillations in monolayer WS₂
articles.abstract: Author(s): Jorge Cervantes-Villanueva, Alberto García-Cristóbal, Davide Sangalli, and Alejandro Molina-Sánchez Ultrashort laser pulses offer a route to controlling quantum coherence in atomically thin semiconductors. Using first-principles simulations, the authors investigate coherent excitonic oscillations in monolayer tungsten disulfide. They reveal how coupling between excitonic states shapes these oscillations and how an additional resonance modifies their dynamics. Building on this microscopic understanding, they propose a sequence of laser pulses that generates and regenerates coherent oscillations on demand. The results connect the microscopic physics of interacting excitons with an optical control scheme, suggesting opportunities for ultrafast optical switching and future devices that use quantum coherence to manipulate and process information in solid-state materials. articles.abstract: Author(s): Yue Jiang, Shizai Chu, Xiaoru Zhang, Qicheng Zhang, Vincent Kerler, Keji Lai, and A. T. Charlie Johnson Topological phononic systems could enable backscattering-resistant control of mechanical waves for filters and interconnects in wireless and quantum technologies, but they are limited to low frequencies. The authors realize a gigahertz quantum spin Hall effect in nanoelectromechanical phononic crystals. They resolve the opposite handedness of the counterpropagating pseudospin branches in real space, and demonstrate a helical edge channel traversing two 120° corners without measurable loss. This brings topological phononics into the gigahertz regime, opening opportunities for robust phonon manipulation in integrated gigahertz circuits on a CMOS-compatible piezoelectric platform. [Phys. articles.title: Delocalized relativistic effects: Unraveling cooperative and anticooperative mechanisms
articles.abstract: The term “relativistic effects” originates from the history of quantum mechanics and refers to the discrepancies between values calculated by models that consider relativity and those that do not. We introduce a methodology that opens up the possibility of analyzing the mechanisms by which relativistic effects combine in molecular structures containing multiple heavy elements. Through an n -body decomposition of relativistic effects, the individual contributions of each heavy element are revealed, along with collective contributions that can be either cooperative or anticooperative. Illustrations are given of the effects of spin–orbit coupling on total energy, electron density, and the intricate mechanisms by which these effects are transferred through space to the molecular electrostatic potential or the strength of intermolecular interactions. Near a heavy atom, such properties can be significantly more affected by the spin–orbit coupling effects produced by other distant heavy atoms, not bonded to the atom of interest or to each other. For molecular properties, it is shown that the influence of collective components (two-body, three-body, etc.) account for about one-tenth of the total effect of spin–orbit coupling.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: On-surface regioselective cyclodehydrogenation of 1,3,6,8-tetra-o-tolylpyrene on Au(111)
articles.abstract: On-surface reactions have emerged as a powerful strategy for engineering covalent nanoarchitectures with potential applications in electronics, optoelectronics, spintronics, and photovoltaics. Despite their expansion into various product categories, reactions involving methyl-phenyl functional groups remain limited due to cyclization competition between the methyl and benzene groups. Here, we investigate the regioselective cyclodehydrogenation of a pyrene core decorated with methyl-phenyl on an Au(111) substrate. Using bond-resolution scanning tunneling microscopy, we identify four cyclization pathways originating from the external methyl-phenyl groups in combination with the internal aryl group, yielding five products with diverse magnetic ground states. Statistical analysis indicates that closed-shell structures with methyl groups distributed clockwise or anticlockwise dominate (>60%), revealing a preferred configuration on the Au(111) surface. This selectivity is attributed to the cooperative influence of the underlying Au(111) template, which directs the cyclization pathways. Our study promotes the development of on-surface synthesis by elucidating substrate-templated regioselective behavior during competitive methyl–phenyl cyclodehydrogenation and establishing an atomically precise approach for fabricating non-benzenoid carbon nanostructures.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Möbius-inspired signed inverse-power representations for pair-potential reconstruction, design, and RDF-driven inversion
articles.abstract: Analytic pair potentials provide microscopic models for classical liquids, soft matter, and coarse-grained simulations. We develop a Möbius-inspired signed inverse-power representation for pair-potential reconstruction, potential-shape design, and radial distribution function (RDF)-driven inversion. The strict form uses the Möbius sequence as an arithmetic baseline. The extended form is a general signed integer inverse-power expansion with a continuous overall amplitude. It exactly represents the Lennard-Jones interaction and approximates attractive Yukawa and Morse potentials over specified radial intervals. Potential and force diagnostics establish the limits of short-range and long-range extrapolation. The same representation generates several prescribed interaction shapes and supports discrete inversion searches using shell-averaged force responses with a coordinate-derived finite-box boundary contribution. Six benchmarks span dilute and dense Lennard-Jones states and two temperatures of a repulsive Yukawa system. Independent Monte Carlo simulations reproduce their principal RDF features and selected local structural distributions, while resolving energy and pressure differences. Joint block resampling quantifies competition between nearby analytic forms. A frozen Yukawa approximation also retains close pair structure in one cross-temperature test, with measurable thermodynamic discrepancies. The results support explicit analytic pair models within stated radial and thermodynamic domains and identify the sampling and physical limitations of their structural interpretation.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: NEVPT2 multiple spawning molecular dynamics simulations for uracil
articles.abstract: The quasidegenerate n -electron valence state second-order perturbation theory (QD-NEVPT2) for complete active space reference wavefunctions has been implemented in the OpenMolcas package. The implementation utilizes the efficient formulation of Kollmar et al. for the electronic energy, which is extended here to the calculation of analytic derivatives. To demonstrate its utility, the method is applied to classical and non-adiabatic molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of uracil. The non-adiabatic MD simulations describe the ultrafast deactivation of the initially excited bright ππ * state through the S 2 /S 1 conical intersection, demonstrating the applicability of the method to photochemical processes. Furthermore, a machine learning-based analysis of the trajectory data extracts key geometrical parameters that are associated with the magnitude of the time-derivative coupling. These results highlight the effectiveness of this QD-NEVPT2 implementation for studying excited-state dynamics.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Accurate ab initio structure and vibration–rotation dynamics of the beryllium dimer
articles.abstract: The accurate potential energy function of the beryllium dimer in its ground electronic state has been obtained. The valence-electron correlation energy was calculated using the coupled-cluster approach, up to the CCSDTQ level of approximation (equivalent in this case to the full-configuration-interaction level of theory) with the augmented correlation-consistent basis sets as large as aug-cc-pV10Z. The core-electron correlation effects were estimated up to the CCSDTQ level using the core–valence basis sets as large as aug-cc-pCV7Z. The scalar relativistic, adiabatic, and non-adiabatic effects on spectroscopic constants of Be 2 were also discussed. In particular, the adiabatic binding energy D e of Be 2 was predicted without invoking any extrapolation procedures to be 935 cm −1 , with an uncertainty of ±2 cm −1 . The vibrational term values and the effective rotational constants of Be 2 were predicted to be within the corresponding experimental error bars.

articles.title: Spin controlled transport switching with negative differential resistance in a chiral molecular device
articles.abstract: Manipulating electron transport through spin control is fundamental to molecular spintronics. We show that adjusting the crystal field and oxidation state of a magnetic center embedded in a chiral framework allows accurate regulation of transport across spin states ranging from S = 0 to 2. Our results reveal pronounced current drops (up to 70%) during spin transitions and the appearance of negative differential resistance (NDR), arising from bias-driven realignment of the highest occupied molecular orbitals and accompanying shifts in the transmission spectrum. We further show that asymmetric coupling to the environment, in particular through a CO axial ligand, leads to current rectification and robust NDR under reverse bias. In addition, Fe(III) junctions exhibit remarkable spin-filtering capabilities, with the S = 3/2 state achieving a spin polarization exceeding 0.95 at low bias, highlighting a versatile strategy for molecular spin-state engineering.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Millimeter-wave spectroscopy of vdW bands of He–HCN near the dissociation limit and the determination of the intermolecular potential
articles.abstract: Transitions to the internal rotation second excited state ( j = 2) and the intermolecular stretching first excited state ( v s = 1) of He–HCN, located close to the dissociation limit (by 0.2633 and 0.1759 cm −1 lower than the limit, respectively), were observed by millimeter-wave spectroscopy using the supersonic jet technique. The observed transition frequencies were fitted, together with those of the internal rotation fundamental band ( j = 1 − 0), to the effective Hamiltonian with the intermolecular potential V ( R , θ ) expanded with the asymptotic long-range potential coefficients c n , l . The potential energy surface has a global minimum at the linear configuration (He⋯H–C–N) with a depth ( D e ) of 30.150 cm −1 and a saddle point at the anti-linear configuration (He⋯N–C–H) located 9.014 cm −1 higher than the global minimum. The predissociation lifetimes of the quasi-bound states ( τ = 0.16–0.29 μ s) were derived from the line broadening of the observed transitions and agreed well with the calculated results with the radial probability density outside the centrifugal barrier.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Dual-channel range-separated local hybrid functionals beyond the zero-sum game
articles.abstract: A dual-channel range-separated local hybrid (RS2LH) framework has been developed. It uses two local mixing functions (LMFs) for the coordinate-space mixing of short- and long-range semi-local and exact exchange-energy densities. Previous range-separated local hybrids with strong-correlation corrections (scRSLH) can be reformulated as RS2LH. We start from an existing scRSLH, retain the human-designed Padé-form sc-contributions, but replace a t-LMF by a neural network (n-LMF). This gives the ω LH26nP composite model which, in contrast to previous scRSLH functionals, does not require a calibration function to deal with the gauge issue. We then proceed to the first explicit RS2LH, ω LH26n, where two n-LMFs are explicitly trained on weak- and strong-correlation as well as fractional-charge training data. ω LH26nP and ω LH26n are evaluated on a wide range of data, including GMTKN55 and W4-17RE main-group energetics, organometallic transition-metal test sets, spin-restricted covalent bond dissociation as a measure for strong correlation, but also on diverse quasiparticle energies. Both functionals perform excellently for main-group energy benchmarks but show limited transferability to transition-metal energetics. While ω LH26nP also performs excellently for molecular quasiparticle energies comparable to previous RSLH functionals, and also for spin-restricted bond dissociation, the explicit ω LH26n RS2LH shows larger deviations. It is shown that the available training energy data are adequate for the SR-LMF but insufficient to give the correct asymptotic potential via the LR-LMF. The composite approach of ω LH26nP benefits from the pre-designed strong-correlation features and the resulting excellent quasiparticle energies. The deep-neural-network DM21 functional performs worse than ω LH26n; its fractional-charge training data alone are clearly insufficient to obtain accurate quasiparticle energies.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: PPDS-Net: A Physical-Prior-Guided Dual-Stream Network for Non-contact Fish Weight Estimation from Single-View 3D Point Clouds
articles.abstract: Accurate, noninvasive estimation of fish weight is critical for biomass assessment, feeding management, and health monitoring in precision aquaculture. In underwater scenes, however, freely swimming fish undergo nonrigid deformation, adopt variable postures, and often yield sparse or noisy point clouds, which limits the robustness of existing vision-based methods. This study develops PPDS-Net, a physical-prior-guided dual-stream feature fusion network for end-to-end sturgeon weight estimation from single-view point clouds. A mask-guided single-view 3D reconstruction strategy is first used to suppress background interference and generate high-quality fish point clouds from RGB-D data. An implicit geometric stream based on point-cloud learning is then fused with an explicit physical stream composed of four morphological priors: raw point count, sampling-density ratio, spatial dispersion, and topological skeleton length. To embed morphological constraints into feature learning, the framework further introduces physical-attention modulation and physical-consistency loss. Experiments using 4,175 RGB-D samples from 86 sturgeon show that the proposed method achieves an MAE of 118.31 g and a Pearson correlation coefficient of 0.9563. Compared with the baseline PointNet + + model, the proposed framework substantially improves prediction accuracy and reduces the number of epochs required to reach the 200 g error threshold from 191 to 8. PPDS-Net also retains stable performance under highly sparse point-cloud conditions. These results demonstrate that integrating physical priors with deep point-cloud learning provides an accurate, robust, and interpretable approach for underwater fish weight estimation.

articles.title: trans-Resveratrol and ε-viniferin recovery from grapevine pruning residues: process optimization and varietal screening towards industrial valorisation
articles.abstract: Vine shoots are abundant viticultural by-products and promising renewable sources of high value stilbenoids for sustainable biorefinery applications. Stilbenoids are phytoalexins bearing phenolic moieties produced by Vitaceae under biotic and abiotic stress, and endowed with nutraceutical, cosmeceutical, and agrochemical potential. This study optimized the recovery of trans-resveratrol and ε-viniferin from vine shoots using Box–Behnken response surface methodology by evaluating extraction time (t), solvent mixture (S), and matrix-to-solvent ratio (R) as initial step of the circular economy task of European LIFE - Natural Agro project. The optimized conditions were then applied to conventional solid–liquid extraction (SLE), ultrasound-assisted extraction (UAE), and Soxhlet extraction. The optimal conditions were 100% ethanol, R = 0.12 g mL⁻¹, and t = 35 min. Although Soxhlet extraction gave the highest extraction yield (EY%), UAE produced the most stilbene-enriched extract, with 9.50 mg g⁻¹ dry extract of trans-resveratrol and 25.66 mg g⁻¹ dry extract of ε-viniferin, while reducing extraction time and prolonged thermal exposure. The optimized UAE protocol was subsequently applied to grapevine varieties from Italy, Portugal, and France, revealing marked genotype-dependent differences in stilbene composition. ε-Viniferin was generally more abundant than trans-resveratrol, and Pinot Meunier, Grechetto Gentile, Moscato, and Moscatel Graudo were identified as promising raw materials, depending on the target compound. Spectrophotometric assays further confirmed variety-dependent differences in antioxidant activity, total phenolic content, and total flavonoid content. Overall, the proposed UAE strategy offers a simple, food-grade, and scalable approach for valorising vine-pruning residues as sources of bioactive ingredients.

articles.title: Preparation of a high specificity imidacloprid monoclonal antibody and its application in homogeneous fluorescence immunoassay based on hydrogel beads assembling CdSe/ZnS quantum dots
articles.abstract: The risk associated with imidacloprid (IMI) residues necessitates the development of highly sensitive detection methods for ensuring food safety. In this study, IMI-hapten is synthesized via the reaction of IMI with β-mercaptopropionic acid, and used to prepare immunogen, coating antigen, and IMI monoclonal antibody (IMI-mAb). An indirect competitive enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ic-ELISA) is established, yielding a half-maximal inhibitory concentration (IC50) of 0.34 µg L-1 and a limit of detection (LOD) of 0.04 µg L-1. To further enhance sensitivity and analytical efficiency, fluorescent hydrogel beads are engineered by embedding CdSe/ZnS quantum dots (QDs) into biocompatible chitosan hydrogel matrices. A homogeneous fluorescence immunoassay is subsequently established, relying on the competitive interaction between an antigen-conjugated quenching probe (AgNPs@IMI-OVA) and an antibody-labeled signal probe, which modulates the fluorescence intensity accordingly. Compared with conventional ELISA, this assay exhibits remarkable superiority, which achieves a LOD of 5.62×10− 4 µg L-1 (representing over a 70‑fold enhancement), eliminates tedious washing steps, and completes the entire assay within 20 min. Validation using spiked fruit and vegetable samples confirms the method’s high specificity and reliability, demonstrating its great potential for the rapid screening of IMI residues in agro-products.

articles.title: Local alternatives to Becke weights for molecular quadrature
articles.abstract: Most density functional theory (DFT) calculations employ Becke’s methodology to partition the space in and around an n -atom molecule into n overlapping quasi-atomic regions. In this way, a single molecular integral for the energy (or other property) is reduced to a sum of n atomic integrals, each of which can then be approximated using a local grid in spherical polar coordinates. Unfortunately, the formal cost of Becke’s partition is O ( n 2 N ), where N is the total number of grid points, and this can become a computational bottleneck when applied to large molecules. We propose two modifications of Becke’s approach, each of which is formally exact and depends only on knowledge of the Delaunay neighbors of each nucleus. The two modifications can be used separately to produce schemes whose costs are O ( nN ) or together to produce a scheme whose cost is only O ( N ). Numerical tests for a variety of molecules and atomic grids suggest that the O ( N ) scheme should be implemented in all DFT software packages.

articles.title: Two-state resonance narrowing model and verification of organic molecule emission spectra
articles.abstract: Electron–vibrational coupling theory quantitatively describes organic molecular spectra and is key to understanding spectral broadening. However, organic molecular vibrational modes are discrete, high-frequency, and multimode-coupled; a unified framework that condenses mode-resolved information into a single, physically meaningful descriptor remains lacking. To this end, we employ the two-state resonance (TSR) model to construct a unified framework in which the resonance coefficient c 2 is a core descriptor for the charge-reorganization response of a molecule along the neutral–zwitterionic coordinate; in the presence of an external polarizing field such as a solvent field, it also reflects sensitivity to solvation perturbations. For typical heteroatom narrowband emitters, fitting FWHM against TSR parameters enables estimation of the limit and guides the design of high-color-purity emitters.

A value of 2.5 ± 1.3 × 10 −11 cm 3 s −1 is reported along with a lower limit on the product branching fraction for associative ionization (as opposed to quenching) of 0.5 and likely much larger, >0.9.

articles.title: Integrated Valorisation of Spartium junceum into a Bioactive Cellulose Acetate/Halloysite Nanofibrous Wound Dressing with Sustained Antioxidant Availability and Enhanced Fibroblast Migration
articles.abstract: An integrated cascade-valorisation strategy was developed to convert Spartium junceum (Spanish broom) flower biomass into a cellulose acetate/halloysite nanotube (CA/HNT) nanofibrous wound-dressing platform. Volatile constituents were first recovered by steam distillation, and the residual aqueous phase was then partitioned sequentially with hexane and chloroform; the exhausted lignocellulosic biomass was subsequently converted to cellulose and then to cellulose acetate. The synthesised cellulose acetate had a degree of substitution of 2.66 ± 0.04 (n = 3). GC–MS identified chemically distinct major constituents in each fraction, with linoleic acid methyl ester (51.02%) dominant in the hexane fraction and 1,4-benzenedicarboxylic acid dimethyl ester (29.37%) and palmitic acid methyl ester (25.10%) dominant in the chloroform fraction. A 12% (w/v) CA formulation containing 3 wt% extract-loaded HNT produced homogeneous, bead-free nanofibers with diameters of approximately 130–200 nm (mean ≈ 173 nm, measured from SEM micrographs). FTIR, XRD, and DSC confirmed successful acetylation and formation of the composite nanofibrous matrix. The dressing showed balanced water-management behaviour, was non-cytotoxic to L929 fibroblasts by ISO 10993-5, and increased scratch closure to 97.2% at 48 h versus 64.8% for untreated controls. CUPRAC measurements showed antioxidant activity in the release medium for up to 48 h, peaking at 0.055 mM Trolox equivalents at 2 h. Together, these findings demonstrate the feasibility of coupling renewable cellulose-acetate production with phytochemical recovery and nanofiber fabrication in a single biomass-valorisation platform.

articles.abstract: As quantum computers grow more ambitious, many researchers believe the best way forward is to build them in multiple interconnected parts. In these modular designs, separate quantum processors are linked so they can work together as one larger machine. For this to happen, however, connections must carry fragile quantum information without destroying it.

articles.title: From Enterprise Institutional Documents to Editable Process Models: A Hybrid LLM-Rule-Engine Architecture for Enterprise Governance
articles.title_zh: 从企业制度文档到可编辑流程模型：企业治理的混合法学硕士-规则-引擎架构
articles.abstract: Enterprise institutional documents encapsulate substantial process‑oriented management knowledge. Transforming them into structured editable process models constitutes a foundational task for business process management (BPM) and governance‑risk‑compliance (GRC) digitalization. However, manual process modeling is time-consuming, inconsistent across practitioners, and difficult to maintain, while existing automated approaches—whether rule-based methods grounded in traditional natural language processing (NLP) or recent large language model (LLM) generation methods—cannot simultaneously satisfy the dual requirements of semantic understanding accuracy and output format conformance, and typically lack deep integration with enterprise approval systems. Following the design‑science‑research (DSR) paradigm, this paper proposes, implements, and deploys a hybrid LLM and rule‑engine architecture (LRHA) for automatically generating organization‑compliant editable process models from enterprise institutional documents. The architecture decomposes the transformation task into six stages—text parsing, element extraction, logic modeling, rule matching, JSON generation, and draft output—with the LLM handling the first three stages that rely on semantic understanding and the rule engine handling the latter three stages that rely on deterministic constraints, thereby separating semantic interpretation from format enforcement. For Chinese enterprise institutional texts, we derive a set of “textual cue to process element” mapping rules and define a JointJS-oriented process model representation specification together with ten executable quality validation rules. Distinct from generic text-to-BPMN methods, LRHA provides native support for enterprise governance capabilities at the architectural level, including institutional‑text ambiguity resolution, compliance constraint validation, asynchronous integration with existing approval OA systems, version traceability, and audit trail preservation. The system has been deployed in production within the risk control information system of a large energy enterprise group, achieving end-to-end automated integration with the group’s OA system through asynchronous task interfaces (task submission, status query, multi-file download, and proactive callback), underpinned by HMAC signature verification and idempotency mechanisms. Case evaluation shows that for complex processes with over 40 nodes and edges, manual modeling work is reduced from several days to approximately 20 minutes, requiring only minor manual fine‑tuning. Large‑scale quantitative benchmark evaluation remains as future work. This paper makes four contributions: (1) it proposes and validates the division of labour and collaboration mechanism between LLMs and rule engines in automated process model generation; (2) it constructs a mapping rule system and executable quality validation specification tailored to Chinese enterprise institutional texts; (3) it natively implements enterprise‑governance‑oriented architectural capabilities for institutional‑text ambiguity resolution, compliance constraint validation, OA‑system integration, version traceability, and audit‑trail preservation; and (4) it reports the complete deployment pathway and engineering experience of the hybrid architecture within an enterprise information system, offering a replicable reference paradigm for similar organizations.
articles.abstract_zh: 企业制度文件包含了大量面向流程的管理知识。将它们转换为结构化可编辑流程模型构成了业务流程管理 (BPM) 和治理风险合规性 (GRC) 数字化的基本任务。然而，手动流程建模耗时、从业者之间不一致且难以维护，而现有的自动化方法——无论是基于传统自然语言处理（NLP）的基于规则的方法还是最近的大语言模型（LLM）生成方法——无法同时满足语义理解准确性和输出格式一致性的双重要求，并且通常缺乏与企业审批系统的深度集成。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 企业制度文件包含了大量面向流程的管理知识。将它们转换为结构化可编辑流程模型构成了业务流程管理 (BPM) 和治理风险合规性 (GRC) 数字化的基本任务。然而，手动流程建模耗时、从业者之间不一致且难以维护，而现有的自动化方法——无论是基于传统自然语言处理（NLP）的基于规则的方法还是最近的大语言模型（LLM）生成方法——无法同时满足语义理解准确性和输出格式一致性的双重要求，并且通常缺乏与企业审批系统的深度集成。本文遵循设计科学研究（DSR）范式，提出、实施和部署混合法学硕士和规则引擎架构（LRHA），用于从企业机构文档自动生成组织兼容的可编辑流程模型。该架构将转换任务分解为六个阶段：文本解析、元素提取、逻辑建模、规则匹配、JSON 生成和草稿输出，LLM 处理依赖于语义理解的前三个阶段，规则引擎处理依赖于确定性约束的后三个阶段，从而将语义解释与格式执行分开。针对中国企业制度文本，我们推导了一套“文本线索到流程元素”的映射规则，并定义了面向JointJS的流程模型表示规范以及十个可执行的质量验证规则。与通用的文本到 BPMN 方法不同，LRHA 在架构层面为企业治理能力提供原生支持，包括机构文本歧义解决、合规性约束验证、与现有审批 OA 系统的异步集成、版本可追溯性和审计跟踪保存。该系统已在某大型能源企业集团风控信息系统中投入生产，通过异步任务接口（任务提交、状态查询、多文件下载、主动回调），通过HMAC签名验证和幂等机制，实现与集团OA系统的端到端自动化集成。案例评估表明，对于超过40个节点和边的复杂流程，手动建模工作从几天减少到大约20分钟，只需要少量的手动微调。大规模的定量基准评估仍是未来的工作。本文有四个贡献：（1）提出并验证了法学硕士和规则引擎在自动化流程模型生成中的分工和协作机制； （2）构建适合中国企业制度文本的映射规则体系和可执行的质量验证规范； (3) 原生实现面向企业治理的架构能力，用于解决机构文本歧义、合规约束验证、OA系统集成、版本可追溯和审计跟踪保存； (4)报告了企业信息系统内混合架构的完整部署路径和工程经验，为类似组织提供可复制的参考范例。

articles.title: Eichhornia crassipes management in a eutrophic reservoir: Cover reduction, rapid recolonization, and cyanobacterial dynamics
articles.title_zh: 富营养化水库中的Eichhornia crassipes管理：覆盖减少，快速再定植和蓝藻动力学
articles.abstract: Mechanical harvesting is widely used to control Eichhornia crassipes in reservoirs, yet its performance is judged by biomass removed rather than the reduction and stabilization of plant cover. We integrated a 129 month Sentinel-1 time series derived using U-Net segmentation with harvesting records and water quality monitoring to evaluate harvest campaigns, recurrent expansion and phytoplankton responses in a 177 ha eutrophic tropical urban reservoir. Harvesting effort was not proportional to cover change: campaigns with comparable biomass removal produced contrasting outcomes. Cover reductions were followed by recolonization, with the two fastest episodes doubling reservoir scale cover in 19 and 20 days. Expansion was fastest after low cover phases and declined as open water surface became occupied, whereas harvesting imposed a weaker constraint on cover gain. At the reservoir outlet, higher cover was associated with lower cyanobacterial density and dominance during the dry season, while chlorophyll-a remained unrelated to cover. Station specific Random Forest models interpreted with explainable AI (SHAP) retained true color and macrophyte cover as main predictors of cyanobacterial density. These findings distinguish three dimensions often conflated in macrophyte management: operational effort, spatial outcome and ecological state. Harvested biomass should therefore be treated as an effort metric, whereas net cover change, residual cover and rebound provide direct measures of management performance. Combining deep learning satellite mapping, operational records, explainable machine learning and in situ monitoring can support adaptive harvesting, but durable control will also require reductions in nutrient and suspended solid loads.
articles.abstract_zh: 机械收获被广泛用于控制水库中的Eichhornia crassipes ，但其性能是通过去除生物量而不是减少和稳定植被来判断的。我们将使用U-Net分割得出的129个月Sentinel-1时间序列与收获记录和水质监测相结合，以评估177公顷富营养热带城市水库的收获活动、反复扩张和浮游植物反应。收获努力与覆盖变化不成比例：具有可比生物质去除的活动产生了对比的结果。覆盖率降低后进行了重新定植，最快的两次发作分别在19天和20天内使水库规模覆盖率翻了一番。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 机械收获被广泛用于控制水库中的Eichhornia crassipes ，但其性能是通过去除生物量而不是减少和稳定植被来判断的。我们将使用U-Net分割得出的129个月Sentinel-1时间序列与收获记录和水质监测相结合，以评估177公顷富营养热带城市水库的收获活动、反复扩张和浮游植物反应。收获努力与覆盖变化不成比例：具有可比生物质去除的活动产生了对比的结果。覆盖率降低后进行了重新定植，最快的两次发作分别在19天和20天内使水库规模覆盖率翻了一番。在低覆盖阶段之后，膨胀最快，并且随着开放水面被占用而下降，而收获对覆盖增益施加了较弱的限制。在水库出口，较高的覆盖率与旱季期间较低的蓝藻密度和优势相关，而叶绿素-a与覆盖率无关。使用可解释的人工智能（ SHAP ）解释的特定站点随机森林模型保留了真实颜色和大型植物覆盖，作为蓝藻密度的主要预测因子。这些发现区分了大植物管理中经常混淆的三个维度：操作努力、空间结果和生态状态。因此，收获的生物质应被视为努力指标，而净覆盖率变化、剩余覆盖率和反弹提供了管理绩效的直接衡量标准。结合深度学习卫星测绘、运营记录、可解释的机器学习和原位监测可以支持自适应收获，但持久的控制也需要减少营养和悬浮固体负荷。

articles.title: What a radical-pair quantum reservoir would require: readable capacity, no quantum advantage, and a nuclear-register criterion
articles.title_zh: 自由基对量子库需要什么：可读能力，没有量子优势，以及核寄存器标准
articles.abstract: Whether the electron--nuclear spin coherence behind radical-pair magnetoreception could also support biological emphcomputation has been conjectured for decades but never made quantitative. We treat a cryptochrome-type radical pair as a reservoir computer, solving the radical-pair master equation with electronic decoherence and driving it as a real turnover does---by the birth of a spin-correlated pair whose singlet character encodes the input. Three results follow, none of them the expected one. The reservoir is emphreadable by ordinary chemistry: the nuclear polarisation the product carries away gives an out-of-sample information-processing capacity of 4.7 against its own memoryless floor of 2.0, with no spectroscopy. There is no quantum advantage: a classical network matched channel-for-channel exceeds the five-spin reservoir by 49--123%. And the memory horizon is set not by the microsecond pair lifetime but by the turnover interval, because the nuclear register survives recombination in the diamagnetic product---so the binding constraint is chemical rather than temporal, namely that the emphsame register be reused between turnovers. Predicting the register's relaxation instead of assuming it makes that constraint testable: at the geomagnetic field a proton on the intact protein relaxes in milliseconds, not seconds, capping the horizon below the neural band unless the register's dipolar vector reorients about two and a half times faster than the protein (τᵣₘ ₑfflesssim6~ns). What survives is a smaller claim on firmer ground: a criterion whose two constants can be measured in vitro, in place of one whose central relaxation time was never measured at all.
articles.abstract_zh: 自由基对磁感受背后的电子-核自旋相干性是否也可以支持生物计算已经被推测了几十年，但从未进行过定量。我们将隐色素型自由基对视为贮存计算机，通过电子退相干解决自由基对主方程，并像真正的周转一样驱动它--通过自旋相关对的诞生，其单重字符对输入进行编码。接下来是三个结果，但没有一个是预期的结果。储层可由普通化学物质进行强化：产品带走的核极化使其无记忆底板2.0的样本外信息处理能力为4.7 ，没有光谱。没有量子优势：经典的网络匹配通道对通道超出五自旋储层49--123%。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自由基对磁感受背后的电子-核自旋相干性是否也可以支持生物计算已经被推测了几十年，但从未进行过定量。我们将隐色素型自由基对视为贮存计算机，通过电子退相干解决自由基对主方程，并像真正的周转一样驱动它--通过自旋相关对的诞生，其单重字符对输入进行编码。接下来是三个结果，但没有一个是预期的结果。储层可由普通化学物质进行强化：产品带走的核极化使其无记忆底板2.0的样本外信息处理能力为4.7 ，没有光谱。没有量子优势：经典的网络匹配通道对通道超出五自旋储层49--123%。记忆视界不是由微秒对的寿命设定，而是由周转间隔设定，因为核寄存器在反磁性产物中的重组中幸存下来--所以结合约束是化学的而不是时间的，即在周转之间重复使用emphsame寄存器。预测寄存器的松弛而不是假设它使该约束可检验：在地磁场中，完整蛋白质上的质子在毫秒而不是几秒钟内松弛，将视界限制在神经带下方，除非寄存器的偶极向量比蛋白质重新定向的速度快约2.5倍（ τβfflesssim6 ~ ns ）。幸存下来的是在更坚实的基础上提出了一个更小的主张：一种标准，其两个常数可以在体外测量，而不是从未测量过中心弛豫时间的标准。

articles.title: GC-MS chemoprofiling, chemotaxonomic differentiation and PASS online prediction of biological activities of essential oils from five Kenyan Hypericum species
articles.title_zh: 五种肯尼亚金丝桃属植物精油生物活性的GC-MS化学分析、化学分裂和通过在线预测
articles.abstract: Hypericum species are potential sources of essential oils. Whereas there exists reported work on volatile constituents of Hypericum essential oils (Eos) from other parts of the world, the species of Hypericums in Kenya remain largely unexplored. The current study assessed the chemical variability of Eos from five Hypericum species collected in Kenya using multivariate chemometric approaches. Eos were extracted by hydrodistillation and analyzed using gas chromatography–mass spectrometry (GC–MS). Further, prediction of activity spectra for substances was done. After data cleaning, including merging duplicate compounds, removing absent compounds, and autoscaling, a dataset of 113 compounds was subjected to principal component analysis (PCA), Pearson correlation analysis, hierarchical cluster analysis, phytochemical class profiling, diversity indices, Venn analysis, and discriminating-compound assessment. The volatile profiles showed clear interspecific variation. Sesquiterpenes predominated in Hypericum kiboense, Hypericum roeperianum, Hypericum peplidifolium, and Hypericum scioanum, whereas Hypericum revolutum contained a stronger monoterpene component dominated by α-pinene (43.04%) and caryophyllene (19.40%). Characteristic major constituents included valencene in H. kiboense (28.77%), 6-hydroxy-1-phenylhexane-1,3-dione in H. roeperianum (11.73%), caryophyllene in H. peplidifolium (15.06%), and caryophyllene oxide in H. scioanum (10.68%). The first two principal components explained 68.2% of total variation and clearly separated the species. Correlation analysis revealed generally weak similarities among species, except for the strong relationship between H. peplidifolium and H. scioanum (r = 0.81). Cluster analysis identified three major chemotypic groups. Diversity metrics further highlighted substantial differences in richness, evenness, and overall diversity among species. The five Hypericum species possess distinct but partially overlapping volatile oil fingerprints and are not chemically interchangeable. The results provide a valuable foundation for chemotaxonomy, quality control, and future bioactivity-guided investigations. The predicted biological activity profile showed that antieczematic activity had the highest number of occurrences across the investigated Hypericum essential oils, followed by antineoplastic and apoptosis agonist activities. The ranking table further showed that some less frequent activities, such as spasmolytic urinary activity and mucomembranous protection, had high weighted mean Pa scores, suggesting strong but more narrowly distributed predicted bioactivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 金丝桃属植物是精油的潜在来源。虽然有来自世界其他地区的关于金丝桃精油（ Eos ）挥发性成分的报道，但肯尼亚的金丝桃种类在很大程度上仍未被探索。目前的研究使用多变量化学计量学方法评估了在肯尼亚采集的五种金丝桃属植物的Eos的化学变异性。通过加氢蒸馏提取Eos ，并使用气相色谱-质谱（ GC–MS ）进行分析。此外，还对物质的活性光谱进行了预测。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 金丝桃属植物是精油的潜在来源。虽然有来自世界其他地区的关于金丝桃精油（ Eos ）挥发性成分的报道，但肯尼亚的金丝桃种类在很大程度上仍未被探索。目前的研究使用多变量化学计量学方法评估了在肯尼亚采集的五种金丝桃属植物的Eos的化学变异性。通过加氢蒸馏提取Eos ，并使用气相色谱-质谱（ GC–MS ）进行分析。此外，还对物质的活性光谱进行了预测。在数据清理（包括合并重复化合物、去除缺失化合物和自动缩放）后，对113种化合物的数据集进行主成分分析（ PCA ）、Pearson相关分析、分层聚类分析、植物化学分类分析、多样性指数、Venn分析和鉴别化合物评估。挥发性剖面显示出明显的种间变化。倍半萜类以金丝桃属（ Hypericum kiboense ）、黑金丝桃属（ Hypericum roeperianum ）、金丝桃属（ Hypericum peplidifolium ）和金丝桃属（ Hypericum scioanum ）为主，而金丝桃属（ Hypericum revolutum ）含有更强的单萜类成分，以α-菠萝烯（ α-pinene ， 43.04% ）和丁香烯（ caryophyllene ， 19.40%特征性主要成分包括H. kiboense中的valencene （ 28.77% ）、H. roeperianum中的6-羟基-1-苯基己烷-1,3-二酮（ 11.73% ）、H. peplidifolium中的丁香烯（ 15.06% ）和H.scioanum （ 10.68 ％ ） ，前两个主要成分解释了总变异的68.2 ％ ，并清楚地分离了物种。相关性分析显示，物种间相似性普遍较弱，但辣椒与小球藻之间的相似性较强（ r = 0.81 ）。聚类分析确定了三个主要的化疗组。多样性指标进一步突出了物种之间丰富性、均匀性和整体多样性的显著差异。五种金丝桃属植物具有不同但部分重叠的挥发性油指纹，并且在化学上不可互换。这些结果为趋化细胞学、质量控制和未来的生物活性指导研究提供了宝贵的基础。预测的生物活性曲线显示，在所研究的金丝桃精油中，抗血吸虫活性的发生次数最多，其次是抗肿瘤和凋亡激动剂活性。排名表进一步显示，一些不太频繁的活动，如溶痉尿活动和粘膜保护，具有较高的加权平均Pa评分，这表明预测的生物活性较强但分布较窄。

articles.title: Comparative performance analysis of direct-coupled DC and variable-frequency AC photovoltaic water pumping systems under tropical climatic conditions
articles.title_zh: 热带气候条件下直耦直流和变频交流光伏抽水系统性能比较分析
articles.abstract: Rural tropical areas often lack grid access and increasingly rely on photovoltaic water pumping. This study numerically compares two architectures under identical conditions (PV array, motor pump, hydraulic system, and demand): a direct-coupled DC system and a variable-frequency AC system with MPPT. Simulations use Typical Meteorological Year data (2005–2023) from four Cameroon sites, Meskine, Agola, Mbé, and Soa, at a 1-min time step. The PV generator is modeled with a single-diode model, the DC branch includes electromechanical motor dynamics, while the AC branch uses a quasi-steady power transfer model with an adaptive perturb-and-observe MPPT. Results show that the AC annual pumped volume exceeds DC at three sites: +18.9% at Meskine, + 24.3% at Agola, and + 7.8% at Mbé. At Soa, no AC gain was observed (− 1.8%, not significant). This ranking follows the local climate and is mirrored in energy efficiency, temperature-corrected Performance Ratio, and operating time. Decomposing the AC gain shows that it stems mainly from better utilization of photovoltaic power through MPPT, which captures 84–87% of the theoretical potential at high-insolation sites versus 66% at Mbé, rather than from a faster restart response at the temporal resolution considered. AC superiority is therefore not universal but climate-dependent, which argues for a site-specific assessment before any technological choice is made. An explicit limitation of this study is that the irradiance time series, available hourly and then extrapolated to one-minute steps, cannot resolve sub-hourly transients.
articles.abstract_zh: 农村热带地区往往缺乏电网接入，越来越依赖光伏抽水。本研究在相同条件下（光伏阵列、电机泵、液压系统和需求）对两种架构进行了数值比较：直接耦合直流系统和带MPPT的变频交流系统。模拟使用喀麦隆四个站点Meskine、Agola、Mbé和Soa的典型气象年数据（ 2005-2023 ） ，时间步长为1分钟。光伏发电机采用单二极管模型建模，直流分支包括电机电机动力学，而交流分支使用具有自适应扰动和观测MPPT的准稳态功率传递模型。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 农村热带地区往往缺乏电网接入，越来越依赖光伏抽水。本研究在相同条件下（光伏阵列、电机泵、液压系统和需求）对两种架构进行了数值比较：直接耦合直流系统和带MPPT的变频交流系统。模拟使用喀麦隆四个站点Meskine、Agola、Mbé和Soa的典型气象年数据（ 2005-2023 ） ，时间步长为1分钟。光伏发电机采用单二极管模型建模，直流分支包括电机电机动力学，而交流分支使用具有自适应扰动和观测MPPT的准稳态功率传递模型。结果显示，三个地点的交流年抽水量超过了直流： Meskine为+18.9% ， Agola为+24.3% ， Mbé为+7.8%。在SOA时，未观察到AC增益（ -1.8 ％ ，不显著）。该排名跟随当地气候，反映在能源效率、温度校正的性能比和运行时间上。分解交流增益表明，它主要源于通过MPPT更好地利用光伏电力， MPPT在高绝缘场地捕获了84-87 ％的理论电位，而在Mbé捕获了66 ％的理论电位，而不是在考虑的时间分辨率下更快的重启响应。因此，交流优势不是普遍的，而是取决于气候的，这要求在做出任何技术选择之前进行特定地点的评估。本研究的一个显而易见的局限性是，辐照时间序列，每小时可用，然后外推到一分钟的步长，无法解决每小时的瞬变。

articles.title: Development and Experimental Validation of a Dual-Input Dual-Output DC-DC Converter for PV–Battery Hybrid Energy Systems
articles.title_zh: 用于光伏电池混合能源系统的双输入双输出DC-DC转换器的开发和实验验证
articles.abstract: Due to the inherently fluctuating nature of renewable energy sources, their output current and voltage exhibit significant intermittency, rendering them insufficient for standalone sustainable power delivery. To address this, hybrid systems combining renewables with auxiliary storage or generation units are commonly deployed. This study introduces an innovative dual-input dual-output (DIDO) DC-DC converter configuration utilizing a T-source impedance network. In the proposed setup, a photovoltaic (PV) array and a battery storage unit serve as the dual input ports. The converter is controlled such that the battery compensates for any power deficits when the PV output falls short of the load requirements, whereas excess PV generation is directed to charge the battery during surplus periods. The mathematical model and operational modes of the converter are thoroughly analyzed. Additionally, the Hill Climbing algorithm is implemented to realize Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) for the PV system. The feasibility of the design is assessed through MATLAB/Simulink simulations and verified experimentally using a hardware prototype under diverse operating scenarios.
articles.abstract_zh: 由于可再生能源的固有波动性，其输出电流和电压表现出明显的间歇性，使其不足以实现独立的可持续电力输送。为了解决这个问题，通常会部署将可再生能源与辅助存储或发电机组相结合的混合系统。本研究引入了一种利用T源阻抗网络的创新双输入双输出（ DIDO ） DC-DC转换器配置。在建议的设置中，光伏（ PV ）阵列和电池存储单元充当双输入端口。转换器受到控制，以便当光伏输出低于负载要求时，电池补偿任何功率缺陷，而多余的光伏发电则用于在剩余期间为电池充电。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由于可再生能源的固有波动性，其输出电流和电压表现出明显的间歇性，使其不足以实现独立的可持续电力输送。为了解决这个问题，通常会部署将可再生能源与辅助存储或发电机组相结合的混合系统。本研究引入了一种利用T源阻抗网络的创新双输入双输出（ DIDO ） DC-DC转换器配置。在建议的设置中，光伏（ PV ）阵列和电池存储单元充当双输入端口。转换器受到控制，以便当光伏输出低于负载要求时，电池补偿任何功率缺陷，而多余的光伏发电则用于在剩余期间为电池充电。对变频器的数学模型和工作模式进行了全面分析。此外，还实施了爬坡算法，以实现光伏系统的最大功率点跟踪（ MPPT ）。通过MATLAB/Simulink仿真评估设计的可行性，并在不同操作场景下使用硬件原型进行实验验证。

articles.title: Modeling of Rayleigh-type waves in a viscoelastic piezoelectric fiber-reinforced composite layered Structure
articles.title_zh: 粘弹性压电纤维增强复合材料层状结构中瑞利型波的建模
articles.abstract: The propagation of Rayleigh-type surface waves in a viscoelastic piezoelectric fiber-reinforced composite (VRFRC) layer bonded to an isotropic elastic half-space through a mechanically imperfect interface is investigated. Both constituents of the composite are dissipative: the PZT fibers are treated as viscoelastic piezoelectric solids and the epoxy matrix as a viscoelastic dielectric, each described by Kelvin–Voigt elements acting on the stress–strain and on the electric field–electric displacement pairs, so that every phase, and the homogenized composite, is passive. The complex , frequency-dependent effective constants are obtained by introducing the complex constituent constants into the strength-of-materials/rule-of-mixtures (SM/RM) relations through the elastic–viscoelastic correspondence principle. The imperfect bond is represented by normal and tangential linear-slip conditions, the upper surface is traction-free and electrically open, and the metallic substrate grounds the interface. An exact 8 × 8 complex dispersion relation is derived and solved, without any small-loss approximation, for the phase velocity and the normalized attenuation of the fundamental mode. The results show that the fiber volume fraction controls the dispersion through the layer stiffness and piezoelectric stiffening, the viscous relaxation times of the matrix (chiefly η c,q 33 and η c,q 44) control the attenuation while leaving the phase velocity almost unchanged, fiber viscoelasticity becomes significant only at high fiber content, and interfacial compliance, in particular the normal compliance, lowers the phase velocity and the attenuation in the dispersive range. Mode shapes, particle orbits, the electric potential distribution and a velocity-based electromechani-cal coupling measure are also analysed; the group velocity shows a pronounced Airy-phase minimum that is sensitive to the fiber content and the bond quality, and the velocity-based coupling measure K 2 = 2(c open − c short)/c open reaches about 3.3% for fiber-rich layers.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究了粘弹性压电纤维增强复合材料（ VRFRC ）层中瑞利型表面波通过机械不完美界面结合到各向同性弹性半空间上的传播。复合材料的两种成分都是耗散的： PZT纤维被处理为粘弹性压电固体，环氧基体被处理为粘弹性电介质，各自由作用于应力应变和电场-电位移对的开尔文-沃伊特元素描述，因此每个相和均匀化复合材料都是被动的。复杂、频率相关的有效常数是通过弹性-粘弹性对应原理将复杂成分常数引入材料强度/混合规则（ SM/RM ）关系中获得的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 研究了粘弹性压电纤维增强复合材料（ VRFRC ）层中瑞利型表面波通过机械不完美界面结合到各向同性弹性半空间上的传播。复合材料的两种成分都是耗散的： PZT纤维被处理为粘弹性压电固体，环氧基体被处理为粘弹性电介质，各自由作用于应力应变和电场-电位移对的开尔文-沃伊特元素描述，因此每个相和均匀化复合材料都是被动的。复杂、频率相关的有效常数是通过弹性-粘弹性对应原理将复杂成分常数引入材料强度/混合规则（ SM/RM ）关系中获得的。不完美结合以法向和切向线性滑移条件表示，上表面无牵引且电开口，金属基底接地界面。推导并求解了相位速度和基模归一化衰减的精确8 × 8复色散关系，无需任何小损耗近似。结果表明，纤维体积分数通过层刚度和压电刚度控制色散，基体的粘性弛豫时间（主要是η c ， q 33和η c ， q 44 ）控制衰减，同时保持相速度几乎不变，纤维粘弹性仅在高纤维含量时才变得显著，并且界面顺应性，特别是正常顺应性，降低了相速度和色散中的衰减范围，还分析了模态形状、粒子轨道、电位分布和基于速度的机电耦合度量；群速度显示出对纤维含量和键质量敏感的明显的空气相最小值，而基于速度的耦合度量K 2 = 2 （ c开− c短路）/c开路对于富纤维层达到约3.3%。

articles.title_zh: 阿尔及利亚半干旱流域灌溉水质指数 (IWQI) 绘图和水化学聚类的机器学习和 GIS 集成框架
articles.abstract: In the Ain Temouchent region, surface water is severely limited, leaving groundwater as the primary source for both domestic supply and agricultural irrigation. This study evaluates the suitability of El Melah watershed groundwater for irrigation by computing the Irrigation Water Quality Index (IWQI) following the Meireles approach, mapping its spatial distribution through GIS, and complementing the analysis with two machine learning methods: (i) a Random Forest (RF) model with Leave-One-Out Cross-Validation (LOOCV) and SHAP explainability analysis to identify the dominant drivers of IWQI degradation; and (ii) K-means and hierarchical clustering to delineate hydrochemical facies and provide a statistically grounded alternative to the conventional Wilcox diagram. Salinity is elevated throughout the study area (EC: 1,034–5,010 µS cm⁻¹). The RF model achieved LOOCV R² = 0.61, with Na⁺ and EC confirmed as the dominant IWQI degradation drivers by SHAP analysis. Hierarchical clustering resolved three hydrochemical facies: a Ca²⁺-HCO₃⁻ continental group, a Na⁺-Cl⁻ evaporite-influenced group, and a seawater-intrusion group, all confirmed as statistically distinct by one-way ANOVA (p < 0.05). Overall, groundwater quality in the watershed ranges from moderate to severe restriction for irrigation use, with the northern sector most critically affected by marine infiltration.
articles.abstract_zh: 在 Ain Temouchent 地区，地表水严重有限，地下水成为家庭供应和农业灌溉的主要来源。本研究通过按照 Meireles 方法计算灌溉水质指数 (IWQI)、通过 GIS 绘制其空间分布并用两种机器学习方法补充分析来评估 El Melah 流域地下水的灌溉适宜性：(i) 具有留一交叉验证 (LOOCV) 的随机森林 (RF) 模型和 SHAP 可解释性分析，以确定 IWQI 退化的主要驱动因素；
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在 Ain Temouchent 地区，地表水严重有限，地下水成为家庭供应和农业灌溉的主要来源。本研究通过按照 Meireles 方法计算灌溉水质指数 (IWQI)、通过 GIS 绘制其空间分布并用两种机器学习方法补充分析来评估 El Melah 流域地下水的灌溉适宜性：(i) 具有留一交叉验证 (LOOCV) 的随机森林 (RF) 模型和 SHAP 可解释性分析，以确定 IWQI 退化的主要驱动因素； (ii) K 均值和层次聚类来描绘水化学相并提供传统 Wilcox 图的统计替代方案。整个研究区域的盐度升高（EC：1,034–5,010 µS cm⁻1）。 RF 模型实现了 LOOCV R² = 0.61，SHAP 分析确认 Na⁺ 和 EC 是 IWQI 退化的主要驱动因素。层次聚类解析了三个水化学相：Ca2+-HCO3⁻大陆组、Na⁺-Cl⁻蒸发岩影响组和海水入侵组，所有这些都通过单向方差分析证实在统计上不同（p < 0.05）。总体而言，该流域的地下水质量对灌溉用途有中度到严重的限制，其中北部地区受海洋渗透的影响最为严重。

articles.title: UTe₂ reveals two flavors of superconductivity under extreme pressure
articles.title_zh: UTe2 揭示了极压下两种超导特性
articles.abstract: Quantum researchers are searching for a topological superconductor—a material that, if discovered, would allow major advances in quantum computing by combining two distinct "flavors" of superconductivity.
