articles.title: Audience evaluation of heritage-derived cultural-creative products: a multilevel analysis of rater-level and product-level variance
articles.title_zh: 受众对遗产文创产品的评价：评价者层面和产品层面方差的多层次分析
articles.abstract: Studies of heritage-derived cultural-creative products often interpret audience ratings as differences between products, yet each rating also reflects the person who gives it. This study examined how these two sources of variance contribute to evaluations of six designs derived from the Wa jicong top, a spinning top from Yunnan, China. Each of 228 respondents rated two randomly assigned designs, giving 456 evaluations. Crossed random-effects models estimated the rater and product shares of each response, and within-rater and between-rater analyses separated two kinds of association among evaluative judgements. Raters accounted for 81.6% of the variance in design perception, 81.8% in perceived cultural authenticity and 56.1% in aesthetic evaluation. Average differences between products accounted for less than 1% of each judgement; these shares were similar under alternative sample screenings. Cultural familiarity, measured through self-rated knowledge of the source culture and interest in ethnic styling, explained 7.2% to 22.8% of rater-level variance. The ranking of products on authenticity also varied with familiarity. Of the descriptive perceptions, dynamism showed the clearest product difference (product share 4.9%), although its observed ordering did not follow the designs' intended static and dynamic forms. The three evaluative judgements were strongly associated between raters. Within raters, no association between authenticity and aesthetic evaluation was detected, including after correction for measurement error. The indirect association of design perception with aesthetic evaluation through authenticity was 0.31 between raters and 0.00 within them. In this design system, evaluative scores primarily distinguished audience members. Repeated-stimulus studies should report how variance divides between raters and products and distinguish within-rater from between-rater associations before interpreting pooled coefficients.
articles.abstract_zh: 对源自遗产的文化创意产品的研究通常将观众评分解释为产品之间的差异，但每个评分也反映了给出评分的人。本研究探讨了这两种方差来源如何影响对源自中国云南的陀螺陀螺的六种设计的评估。 228 名受访者每人对两个随机分配的设计进行评分，共给出 456 项评价。交叉随机效应模型估计了每个响应的评估者和产品份额，评估者内部和评估者之间的分析区分了评估判断之间的两种关联。评估者在设计感知方面占81.6%，在文化真实性方面占81.8%，在审美评价方面占56.1%。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对源自遗产的文化创意产品的研究通常将观众评分解释为产品之间的差异，但每个评分也反映了给出评分的人。本研究探讨了这两种方差来源如何影响对源自中国云南的陀螺陀螺的六种设计的评估。 228 名受访者每人对两个随机分配的设计进行评分，共给出 456 项评价。交叉随机效应模型估计了每个响应的评估者和产品份额，评估者内部和评估者之间的分析区分了评估判断之间的两种关联。评估者在设计感知方面占81.6%，在文化真实性方面占81.8%，在审美评价方面占56.1%。产品间平均差异占每次判断的比例小于1%；这些份额在替代样本筛选下是相似的。文化熟悉度（通过自评对源文化的了解和对民族风格的兴趣来衡量）解释了评分者水平差异的 7.2% 至 22.8%。产品的真实性排名也因熟悉程度而异。在描述性感知中，活力显示出最明显的产品差异（产品份额为 4.9%），尽管其观察到的顺序并不遵循设计预期的静态和动态形式。这三个评估判断在评估者之间密切相关。在评估者内部，没有检测到真实性和审美评价之间的关联，包括在校正测量误差之后。设计感知与通过真实性进行的审美评价的间接关联度在评分者之间为 0.31，在评分者内部为 0.00。在这个设计体系中，评价分数主要区分观众成员。重复刺激研究应报告方差如何在评估者和产品之间划分，并在解释汇总系数之前区分评估者内部和评估者之间的关联。

articles.title: Low-Pressure Investment Casting of Ductile Iron: Effect of Controlled Filling on Graphite Morphology and Fracture Mechanisms
articles.title_zh: 球墨铸铁低压熔模铸造：控制填充对石墨形态和断裂机制的影响
articles.abstract: This study investigates the effect of low-pressure investment casting (LPIC), a novel process, on the integrity and mechanical properties of ductile iron castings in comparison with conventional gravity investment casting (GIC). Although investment casting is widely used for high-precision components, its application to ductile iron remains limited by turbulence-induced defects and insufficient control of solidification conditions. To eliminate compositional variability, EN-GJS-500 ductile iron castings were produced by both processes from a single melt and evaluated by tensile, Charpy impact and hardness testing, light microscopy and scanning electron microscopy (SEM) of the fracture surfaces. Compared with GIC, LPIC increased the ultimate tensile strength by approximately 22% (from 564 to 687 MPa) and the elongation by approximately 52%, whereas the yield strength and hardness remained comparable. The impact strength decreased by approximately 29%, although with considerably lower scatter. The LPIC castings exhibited a higher nodule count, a smaller mean nodule diameter (28 µm vs. 51 µm) and a more homogeneous graphite distribution. Fractography revealed a transition in the dominant fracture mechanism from graphite nodule fracture in GIC to matrix-controlled failure in LPIC. These findings suggest that the benefits of LPIC extend beyond a reduced defect population and include a modification of the graphite–matrix interaction and load transfer. The combination of laminar filling and pressure-assisted solidification is considered to reduce bifilm formation and enhance feeding. LPIC therefore represents a promising route for improving the performance of ductile iron investment castings in demanding engineering applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了低压熔模铸造（LPIC）这一新工艺与传统重力熔模铸造（GIC）相比对球墨铸铁件完整性和机械性能的影响。尽管熔模铸造广泛用于高精度部件，但其在球墨铸铁中的应用仍然受到湍流引起的缺陷和凝固条件控制不足的限制。为了消除成分变化，EN-GJS-500 球墨铸铁铸件采用两种工艺从单一熔体生产，并通过拉伸、夏比冲击和硬度测试、光学显微镜和断口扫描电子显微镜 (SEM) 进行评估。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本研究探讨了低压熔模铸造（LPIC）这一新工艺与传统重力熔模铸造（GIC）相比对球墨铸铁件完整性和机械性能的影响。尽管熔模铸造广泛用于高精度部件，但其在球墨铸铁中的应用仍然受到湍流引起的缺陷和凝固条件控制不足的限制。为了消除成分变化，EN-GJS-500 球墨铸铁铸件采用两种工艺从单一熔体生产，并通过拉伸、夏比冲击和硬度测试、光学显微镜和断口扫描电子显微镜 (SEM) 进行评估。与 GIC 相比，LPIC 的极限抗拉强度提高了约 22%（从 564 MPa 增加到 687 MPa），伸长率提高了约 52%，而屈服强度和硬度仍保持可比性。冲击强度下降了约 29%，但分散性明显降低。 LPIC 铸件表现出更高的结核数量、更小的平均结核直径（28 µm 与 51 µm）以及更均匀的石墨分布。断口分析揭示了主要断裂机制从 GIC 中的石墨结核断裂到 LPIC 中的基体控制失效的转变。这些发现表明，LPIC 的好处不仅仅限于减少缺陷数量，还包括改变石墨-基体相互作用和负载转移。层流填充和压力辅助凝固的结合被认为可以减少双膜形成并增强补缩。因此，LPIC 代表了在要求严格的工程应用中提高球墨铸铁熔模铸件性能的一条有前途的途径。

articles.title: Reconstructed Reality: Enabling Teleportation-Based Locomotion in Immersive Telepresence
articles.title_zh: 重建现实：在沉浸式远程呈现中实现基于隐形传送的运动
articles.abstract: High latency and virtual reality (VR) sickness hinders the mass adoption of telepresence or teleoperated systems utilizing head-mounted displays (HMDs). In immersive telepresence scenarios that use 360 degree cameras to present the remote environment, latencies of up to seconds are expected. Such delays make traditional continuous manual control of these systems difficult. In addition, due to the use of HMDs, users of these systems are prone to VR sickness. We present a novel method to enable an improved telepresence locomotion experience under these constraints. The paper first recounts a previously published article of a prototype design, and then integrates new findings of a realistic use-case, replicating and extending these findings. We conclude that it is highly beneficial to use teleportation through a real-time 3D reconstructed virtual environment as an interface to a physical environment (VEIPE) in embodied immersive telepresence, relative to a standard joystick-based continuous control method.
articles.abstract_zh: 高延迟和虚拟现实 (VR) 不适阻碍了利用头戴式显示器 (HMD) 的远程呈现或远程操作系统的大规模采用。在使用 360 度摄像头呈现远程环境的沉浸式远程呈现场景中，预计延迟可达数秒。这种延迟使得这些系统的传统连续手动控制变得困难。此外，由于头显的使用，这些系统的用户很容易出现VR晕眩症。我们提出了一种新颖的方法，可以在这些限制下改善远程呈现运动体验。该论文首先回顾了之前发表的原型设计文章，然后整合了实际用例的新发现，复制和扩展了这些发现。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 高延迟和虚拟现实 (VR) 不适阻碍了利用头戴式显示器 (HMD) 的远程呈现或远程操作系统的大规模采用。在使用 360 度摄像头呈现远程环境的沉浸式远程呈现场景中，预计延迟可达数秒。这种延迟使得这些系统的传统连续手动控制变得困难。此外，由于头显的使用，这些系统的用户很容易出现VR晕眩症。我们提出了一种新颖的方法，可以在这些限制下改善远程呈现运动体验。该论文首先回顾了之前发表的原型设计文章，然后整合了实际用例的新发现，复制和扩展了这些发现。我们得出的结论是，相对于标准的基于操纵杆的连续控制方法，通过实时 3D 重建虚拟环境作为物理环境 (VEIPE) 的接口来使用远程传送是非常有益的。

articles.title: The general Stokes’ theorem as the mechanism for synchronizing 2s2p electrons within a neon atom
articles.title_zh: 作为氖原子内 2s2p 电子同步机制的斯托克斯一般定理
articles.abstract: Points, arcs, surfaces, and solids are four orthogonal space dimensions of a sphere. When they are applied to the description of the atomic structure of a neon shell, we draw the conclusion that both full-fledged 2px electronic orbitals manifest as two diametric points; both 2py orbitals take the shape of two semicircular arcs; both 2pz orbitals spread over two hemispherical surfaces; and both 2s orbitals form a solid spherical layer. The electrons transform from one type of orbitals to another cyclically following dynamic calculus of spherical quantities rather than linear algebra of physical quantities. Such dimensional transformations entail a fresh approach to solving harmonic oscillation equations and lead to the discovery of the synchronization mechanism for 2s2p electrons by Green’s theorem, Stokes’ theorem, and Gauss’s theorem. We make fine geometrical distinctions between 2px, 2py, and 2pz electronic orbitals, which are backwards compatible with those in quantum mechanics. Electronic orbitals are characterized from geometry, trigonometry, dynamic calculus, and vector integral calculus in a coherent manner. Their elegant coordination mechanism is a great benefit of 2p orbitals anisotropy in the four-dimensional space gradients, furnishing strong evidence of the quaternity theory for a neon atom, and providing a sharp insight into the mechanisms that regulate the biosphere on the earth and the immune system of a human body.
articles.abstract_zh: 点、弧、面和实体是球体的四个正交空间维度。当它们应用于氖壳原子结构的描述时，我们得出的结论是，两个成熟的 2px 电子轨道都表现为两个直径点；两个 2py 轨道均呈两个半圆弧形状；两个 2pz 轨道分布在两个半球形表面上；两个 2s 轨道形成实心球层。电子遵循球面量的动态演算而不是物理量的线性代数，循环地从一种类型的轨道转变为另一种类型的轨道。这种维度变换需要一种解决简谐振动方程的新方法，并通过格林定理、斯托克斯定理和高斯定理发现了 2s2p 电子的同步机制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 点、弧、面和实体是球体的四个正交空间维度。当它们应用于氖壳原子结构的描述时，我们得出的结论是，两个成熟的 2px 电子轨道都表现为两个直径点；两个 2py 轨道均呈两个半圆弧形状；两个 2pz 轨道分布在两个半球形表面上；两个 2s 轨道形成实心球层。电子遵循球面量的动态演算而不是物理量的线性代数，循环地从一种类型的轨道转变为另一种类型的轨道。这种维度变换需要一种解决简谐振动方程的新方法，并通过格林定理、斯托克斯定理和高斯定理发现了 2s2p 电子的同步机制。我们对 2px、2py 和 2pz 电子轨道进行了精细的几何区分，这些电子轨道与量子力学中的电子轨道向后兼容。电子轨道以几何学、三角学、动力学微积分和矢量积分微积分的相干方式来表征。它们优雅的配位机制得益于四维空间梯度中2p轨道各向异性的巨大优势，为氖原子四元理论提供了有力的证据，并为地球生物圈和人体免疫系统的调节机制提供了敏锐的洞察。

articles.title: Synergistic Fire Protection and Water Resistance of Intumescent Coatings via Surface- Engineered Shell-Derived Biogenic Inorganic Particles
articles.title_zh: 通过表面工程贝壳衍生的生物无机颗粒实现膨胀型涂料的协同防火和耐水性
articles.abstract: Steel-structure intumescent fire-retardant coatings suffer from poor water resistance and weak high-temperature char layers. Herein, shell-derived biogenic inorganic particles (SBIPs) were surface-functionalized with KH-550 and incorporated as a bio-based synergistic filler into silicone-acrylic/epoxy waterborne intumescent coatings (IFR-EP/SAE). Characterizations including combustion simulation, thermogravimetry, limiting oxygen index (LOI), cone calorimetry, SEM, and Raman spectroscopy were performed to investigate interfacial compatibility, fire protection, thermal stability, water-aging resistance, and char evolution. KH-550 functionalization improved SBIP–matrix compatibility, while a distinct biphasic concentration-dependent effect on flame retardancy was observed, with 3 wt.% SE-SBIPs showing optimal performance. Compared with the blank control, the addition amount of 3 wt. % reduced the peak back-side steel temperature to 289.27°C, increased the LOI to 42.5%, and raised the initial rapid thermal-degradation temperature from 304 to 363°C. After 48 h water immersion, it maintained favorable flame-retardant and smoke-suppression performance, with reduced peak heat-release rate and total smoke release. Raman analysis showed a decreased ID/IG ratio from 1.36 to 1.07, indicating enhanced char graphitization. This work provides a sustainable strategy for developing durable bio-based fire-protective coatings.
articles.abstract_zh: 钢结构膨胀型防火涂料存在耐水性差、高温炭层薄弱的问题。在此，利用 KH-550 对壳源性生物无机颗粒 (SBIP) 进行表面功能化，并将其作为生物基协同填料掺入有机硅-丙烯酸/环氧水性膨胀涂料 (IFR-EP/SAE) 中。进行了包括燃烧模拟、热重分析、极限氧指数 (LOI)、锥形量热法、SEM 和拉曼光谱在内的表征，以研究界面相容性、防火性、热稳定性、耐水老化性和炭演化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 钢结构膨胀型防火涂料存在耐水性差、高温炭层薄弱的问题。在此，利用 KH-550 对壳源性生物无机颗粒 (SBIP) 进行表面功能化，并将其作为生物基协同填料掺入有机硅-丙烯酸/环氧水性膨胀涂料 (IFR-EP/SAE) 中。进行了包括燃烧模拟、热重分析、极限氧指数 (LOI)、锥形量热法、SEM 和拉曼光谱在内的表征，以研究界面相容性、防火性、热稳定性、耐水老化性和炭演化。 KH-550 功能化改善了 SBIP 与基质的相容性，同时观察到对阻燃性的明显双相浓度依赖性影响，其中 3 wt.% SE-SBIP 显示出最佳性能。与空白对照相比，添加量为3重量％。 ％将背面钢的峰值温度降低至289.27°C，将LOI提高至42.5%，并将初始快速热降解温度从304°C提高至363°C。水浸泡48小时后，仍保持良好的阻燃抑烟性能，峰值放热率和总排烟量降低。拉曼分析显示 ID/IG 比率从 1.36 降低至 1.07，表明炭石墨化增强。这项工作为开发耐用的生物基防火涂料提供了可持续的策略。

articles.title: A study of particle behaviour in dynamic extracellular environments using nanoparticles as model nanoscale probes
articles.title_zh: 使用纳米粒子作为模型纳米级探针研究动态细胞外环境中的粒子行为
articles.abstract: Quantifying nanoparticle behaviour in complex biological environments is essential for understanding transport and interactions within heterogeneous living systems. Fluorescent labelling is commonly used to visualise nanoparticles; however, surface modification by fluorescent probes can alter nanoparticle interactions and obscure native behaviour. Therefore, accessible label-free methods are needed to characterise nanoparticle dynamics under biologically relevant conditions. In this study, an optical caustics-based microscopy technique was used to track the motion of 100 nm gold nanoparticles in the extracellular space above human mesenchymal stem cell (hMSC) monolayers. Nanoparticle trajectories were analysed using diffusion coefficients, anomalous diffusion exponents, and convex hull metrics to quantify transport behaviour. Results demonstrated that the local extracellular environment significantly influences nanoparticle dynamics. In the presence of fetal bovine serum, nanoparticle diffusion rates changed significantly after one hour of exposure to the hMSC layer. Surface charge, protein content, and particle localisation relative to cells also had a marked effect on mobility. Comparison with idealised Brownian transport predictions showed that the living extracellular environment behaves as a dynamic and evolving transport medium that modifies nanoparticle movement. These findings highlight the sensitivity of nanoscale transport to local biological conditions and establish a label-free framework for investigating nanoparticle dynamics in heterogeneous biological systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 量化复杂生物环境中纳米粒子的行为对于理解异质生命系统内的运输和相互作用至关重要。荧光标记通常用于可视化纳米颗粒；然而，荧光探针的表面修饰可以改变纳米粒子的相互作用并掩盖天然行为。因此，需要可用的无标记方法来表征生物学相关条件下的纳米颗粒动力学。在这项研究中，使用基于光学焦散的显微镜技术来跟踪 100 nm 金纳米颗粒在人间充质干细胞 (hMSC) 单层上方细胞外空间中的运动。使用扩散系数、异常扩散指数和凸包度量来分析纳米颗粒轨迹，以量化传输行为。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量化复杂生物环境中纳米粒子的行为对于理解异质生命系统内的运输和相互作用至关重要。荧光标记通常用于可视化纳米颗粒；然而，荧光探针的表面修饰可以改变纳米粒子的相互作用并掩盖天然行为。因此，需要可用的无标记方法来表征生物学相关条件下的纳米颗粒动力学。在这项研究中，使用基于光学焦散的显微镜技术来跟踪 100 nm 金纳米颗粒在人间充质干细胞 (hMSC) 单层上方细胞外空间中的运动。使用扩散系数、异常扩散指数和凸包度量来分析纳米颗粒轨迹，以量化传输行为。结果表明，局部细胞外环境显着影响纳米颗粒动力学。在存在胎牛血清的情况下，纳米粒子扩散速率在暴露于 hMSC 层一小时后显着变化。表面电荷、蛋白质含量和相对于细胞的颗粒定位也对迁移率有显着影响。与理想化布朗运输预测的比较表明，活的细胞外环境表现为动态且不断变化的运输介质，可以改变纳米颗粒的运动。这些发现强调了纳米级运输对局部生物条件的敏感性，并建立了用于研究异质生物系统中纳米颗粒动力学的无标记框架。

articles.title: Purification, Characterization, and Green Synthesis of ZnO Nanoparticles Using Purified Lignin Peroxidase from Fusarium odoratissimum for Environmental Remediation
articles.title_zh: 使用从臭镰刀菌中纯化的木质素过氧化物酶进行环境修复的ZnO纳米颗粒的纯化、表征和绿色合成
articles.abstract: The present study investigated agro-residue-induced production, purification, and application of ligninolytic peroxidase from Fusarium odoratissimum for enzyme-assisted zinc oxide nanoparticle (ZnO NP) synthesis. Among the tested lignin-rich agro-residues, wheat straw supported the highest enzyme production, reaching 0.18 µmol min− 1 on day 4. The enzyme was purified through sequential purification steps, resulting in an 18.55-fold increase in specific activity, with a final specific activity of 13.14 U mg− 1 and 17.73% recovery. The purified enzyme was subsequently employed as a defined protein preparation for ZnO NP synthesis. The synthesized ZnO NPs were characterized using UV–Vis spectroscopy, FTIR, FESEM, EDS, dynamic light scattering, zeta potential analysis, particle-size analysis, and XRD. The characterization results supported the formation of crystalline ZnO nanoparticles and the association of surface functional groups with the nanoparticles. EDS analysis showed Zn and O contents of 82.66 and 17.34 wt%, respectively. The ZnO NPs demonstrated concentration- and contact-time-dependent treatment efficiency toward Dikrong River water, achieving approximately 96.8% BOD and 55.0% COD removal at the highest tested dose. The nanoparticles also exhibited radical-scavenging activity in ABTS and DPPH assays, with greater apparent activity than the extracellular enzyme extract under the tested conditions. Overall, the findings highlight a waste-induced, defined purified-enzyme approach in which agro-residue-supported production and purification of the ligninolytic peroxidase constitute the experimental basis for downstream ZnO nanoparticle synthesis and environmental application.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究研究了从Fusarium odoratissimum中农业残留诱导的木质素溶解过氧化物酶的生产、纯化和应用，用于酶辅助氧化锌纳米颗粒（ ZnO NP ）的合成。在测试的富含木质素的农业残留物中，小麦秸秆支持最高的酶产生，在第4天达到0.18 µmol min − 1。通过连续纯化步骤纯化酶，比活性提高18.55倍，最终比活性为13.14 U mg − 1 ，回收率为17.73%。随后将纯化的酶用作用于ZnO NP合成的定义的蛋白质制剂。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本研究研究了从Fusarium odoratissimum中农业残留诱导的木质素溶解过氧化物酶的生产、纯化和应用，用于酶辅助氧化锌纳米颗粒（ ZnO NP ）的合成。在测试的富含木质素的农业残留物中，小麦秸秆支持最高的酶产生，在第4天达到0.18 µmol min − 1。通过连续纯化步骤纯化酶，比活性提高18.55倍，最终比活性为13.14 U mg − 1 ，回收率为17.73%。随后将纯化的酶用作用于ZnO NP合成的定义的蛋白质制剂。使用UV–Vis光谱、FTIR、FESEM、EDS、动态光散射、zeta电位分析、粒度分析和XRD对合成的ZnO NP进行表征。表征结果支持结晶ZnO纳米颗粒的形成以及表面官能团与纳米颗粒的关联。EDS分析表明， Zn和O含量分别为82.66和17.34 wt %。ZnO NP表现出对Dikrong河水的浓度和接触时间依赖性处理效率，在最高测试剂量下实现约96.8%的BOD和55.0%的COD去除。纳米颗粒在ABTS和DPPH测定中也表现出自由基清除活性，在测试条件下比胞外酶提取物具有更大的表观活性。总体而言，研究结果强调了一种废物诱导的、定义的纯化酶方法，其中木质素溶解过氧化物酶的农业残留支持生产和纯化构成了下游ZnO纳米颗粒合成和环境应用的实验基础。

articles.title: A flexible and resource-efficient quantum network enabled by integrated photonics
articles.title_zh: 由集成光子学实现的灵活且资源高效的量子网络
articles.abstract: Quantum key distribution (QKD) is evolving toward large-scale metropolitan networks that interoperate with modern communication infrastructures. Although wavelength division multiplexing (WDM) architectures hold great promise for high secure-key throughput and multi-user access, existing implementations suffer from security vulnerabilities introduced by trusted nodes, limited topological flexibility, and high resource overhead. Here, we experimentally demonstrate a flexible and resource-efficient mode-pairing QKD network enabled by integrated photonics, which natively supports trusted-node-free networking. Each user employs a Hz-level ultra-narrow-linewidth hybrid-integrated laser chip paired with a high-speed thin-film lithium niobate modulator chip for quantum state preparation, while a silicon-based wavelength-selective switch chip is deployed at the detection center. By introducing a novel global network-management strategy, the network fully decouples conventional physical-topology connections from resource-allocation constraints, allowing dynamic adaptation to time-varying communication demands and dynamic user access/leave. It achieves secure key sharing among all users with at most three distinct wavelengths and ((N)) Bell-state measurement units, delivering superior flexible scalability and resource-efficient full-connectivity compared with conventional WDM architectures. In a proof-of-principle three-user network, we achieve secure-key generation over both symmetric and asymmetric metropolitan hundred-kilometer-scale fiber-link configurations. Further point-to-point tests verify secure-key generation over 300 km with the asymptotic key rate exceeding the repeaterless bound. By combining photonic integrated circuits with a favorable network-management strategy, this work provides a chip-scale pathway toward compact, low-cost, and scalable large-scale metropolitan quantum networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子密钥分发（ QKD ）正在向与现代通信基础设施互操作的大型城域网发展。尽管波分复用（ WDM ）架构对高安全密钥吞吐量和多用户访问有很大的希望，但现有的实现方式存在受信任节点引入的安全漏洞、有限的拓扑灵活性和高资源开销。在这里，我们通过实验演示了由集成光子学实现的灵活且资源高效的模式配对QKD网络，该网络本地支持无信任节点网络。每个用户采用Hz级超窄线宽混合集成激光芯片与高速薄膜铌酸锂调制器芯片配对进行量子态制备，同时在检测中心部署硅基波长选择开关芯片。

articles.title: Mastering Baghchal by Self-Play with Deep Reinforcement Learning
articles.title_zh: 通过深度强化学习自学掌握巴格查尔语
articles.abstract: Baghchal is a two-player asymmetric board game of Nepali origin. In the gameplay, four tigers attempt to capture goats while twenty goats seek to immobilize the tigers. Baghchal has received limited attention in the deep reinforcement learning (RL) literature despite its strategic complexity, perfect information structure, and cultural significance. We present a systematic investigation of four deep reinforcement learning algorithms, viz. Deep Q-Network (DQN), REINFORCE, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), and MuZero. These algorithms are applied to both sides of asymmetric gameplay through self-play training in Baghchal. Each of these algorithms is evaluated in terms of win rate, draw rate, average captures, training convergence, and computational cost. In our experimental results, MuZero achieves the highest performance in both roles, attaining 86% Tiger win rate and 62% Goat win rate. This is attributed to its model-based planning via Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS). PPO emerges as the most practical algorithm as it offers competitive performance across both asymmetric roles at substantially lower computational overhead than the rest of the algorithms, including MuZero. While analyzing emergent strategic behavior of these algorithms, a model-based approach, viz. MuZero, excels at long-horizon planning, whereas value-based methods, viz. DQN, exhibit a strong preference for the Tiger role due to its denser reward signal.

articles.title: Interpolation of unitaries with time-dependent Hamiltonians via deep learning
articles.title_zh: 通过深度学习对与时间相关的哈密顿量进行酉插值
articles.abstract: Quantum systems governed by time-dependent Hamiltonians pose significant challenges for the accurate computation of their unitary time-evolution operators. In this work, we introduce a deep learning approach based on physics-informed neural networks to estimate these operators over the full time domain, either by predicting the time-evolution operator directly or by predicting an effective Hamiltonian from which that operator is computed. Unitarity is imposed as a constraint in the first case, and holds by construction in the second, where a propagation layer based on the second-order Magnus expansion or Trotterization maps the predicted Hamiltonian to the evolution operator. The model is trained on characterization data from a small number of times, generated numerically here but standing in for measurements on a system whose Hamiltonian is unknown to the model. The loss combines three contributions: agreement with pairs of input and evolved states, agreement with the evolution operator at the sampled times when it is available, and a unitarity constraint that requires no measured data. Systems of 2 to 8 qubits are considered, with a Hamiltonian containing all non-identity Pauli components up to 6 qubits, used as a baseline test against random dense matrices, and physically motivated nearest-neighbor Ising and Heisenberg models beyond. Across all system sizes, and using a limited number of sampled times, a statistical analysis over independent Hamiltonian realizations gives mean gate fidelities close to with low variability. Comparable fidelities are obtained when the model is trained from state data alone, without providing the evolution operator at any sampled time during training. Once trained, the model interpolates the evolution operator with inference times to lower than those of a numerical interpolation baseline based on geodesic interpolation, depending on system size and propagation method. These results support the use of the approach for data-driven simulation and identification of quantum dynamical systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 由时间相关哈密顿量控制的量子系统对其酉时间演化算子的精确计算提出了重大挑战。在这项工作中，我们引入了一种基于物理信息神经网络的深度学习方法，通过直接预测时间演化算子或通过预测计算该算子的有效哈密顿量来估计全时域上的这些算子。在第一种情况下，幺正性被强加为约束，并在第二种情况下通过构造而成立，其中基于二阶马格努斯展开或 Trotterization 的传播层将预测的哈密顿量映射到演化算子。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由时间相关哈密顿量控制的量子系统对其酉时间演化算子的精确计算提出了重大挑战。在这项工作中，我们引入了一种基于物理信息神经网络的深度学习方法，通过直接预测时间演化算子或通过预测计算该算子的有效哈密顿量来估计全时域上的这些算子。在第一种情况下，幺正性被强加为约束，并在第二种情况下通过构造而成立，其中基于二阶马格努斯展开或 Trotterization 的传播层将预测的哈密顿量映射到演化算子。该模型根据少量的特征数据进行训练，这些数据在此处以数字方式生成，但代表模型未知哈密顿量的系统的测量。该损失结合了三个贡献：与输入和演化状态对的一致性、在可用时的采样时间与演化算子的一致性，以及不需要测量数据的幺正性约束。考虑 2 到 8 个量子位的系统，其中哈密顿量包含最多 6 个量子位的所有非同一性泡利分量，用作针对随机密集矩阵的基线测试，以及物理激励的最近邻伊辛和海森堡模型。在所有系统尺寸中，并使用有限数量的采样次数，对独立哈密顿量实现的统计分析给出了接近于低变异性的平均门保真度。当仅根据状态数据训练模型而无需在训练期间的任何采样时间提供演化算子时，可以获得可比的保真度。经过训练后，模型会根据系统规模和传播方法对演化算子进行插值，其推理时间低于基于测地线插值的数值插值基线。这些结果支持使用该方法进行数据驱动的模拟和量子动力系统的识别。

articles.title: Optimizing the non-Clifford-count in unitary synthesis using reinforcement learning
articles.title_zh: 使用强化学习优化酉综合中的非 Clifford 计数
articles.abstract: In this paper we study the potential of using reinforcement learning (RL) in order to synthesize quantum circuits, while optimizing the T-count and CS-count, of unitaries that are exactly implementable by the Clifford+T and Clifford+CS gate sets, respectively. We have designed our RL framework to work with channel representation of unitaries, that enables us to perform matrix operations efficiently, using integers only. We have also incorporated pruning heuristics and a canonicalization of operators, in order to reduce the search complexity. As a result, compared to previous works, we are able to implement significantly larger unitaries, in less time, with much better success rate and improvement factor. Our results for Clifford+T synthesis on two qubit unitaries achieve close-to-optimal decompositions for up to 100 T gates, 5 times more than previous RL algorithms and to the best of our knowledge, the largest instances achieved with any method to date. Our RL algorithm is able to recover previously-known optimal linear complexity algorithm for T-count-optimal decomposition of 1 qubit unitaries. We illustrate significant reduction in the asymptotic T-count estimate of important primitives like controlled cyclic shift (43%), controlled adder (14.3%) and multiplier (14%), without adding any extra ancilla. For 2-qubit Clifford+CS unitaries, our algorithm achieves a linear complexity, something that could only be accomplished by a previous algorithm using representation.
articles.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们研究了使用强化学习 (RL) 来合成量子电路的潜力，同时优化分别由 Clifford+T 和 Clifford+CS 门集精确实现的酉式的 T 计数和 CS 计数。我们设计了 RL 框架来处理酉的通道表示，这使我们能够仅使用整数高效地执行矩阵运算。我们还结合了修剪启发法和运算符规范化，以降低搜索复杂性。因此，与以前的工作相比，我们能够在更短的时间内实现更大的酉，并具有更高的成功率和改进系数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在本文中，我们研究了使用强化学习 (RL) 来合成量子电路的潜力，同时优化分别由 Clifford+T 和 Clifford+CS 门集精确实现的酉式的 T 计数和 CS 计数。我们设计了 RL 框架来处理酉的通道表示，这使我们能够仅使用整数高效地执行矩阵运算。我们还结合了修剪启发法和运算符规范化，以降低搜索复杂性。因此，与以前的工作相比，我们能够在更短的时间内实现更大的酉，并具有更高的成功率和改进系数。我们在两个量子位酉上进行 Clifford+T 综合的结果实现了多达 100 个 T 门的接近最优分解，比之前的 RL 算法多了 5 倍，并且据我们所知，这是迄今为止使用任何方法实现的最大实例。我们的 RL 算法能够恢复先前已知的最佳线性复杂度算法，用于 1 量子位酉的 T 计数最佳分解。我们展示了重要原语的渐近 T 计数估计的显着减少，如受控循环移位 (43%)、受控加法器 (14.3%) 和乘法器 (14%)，而无需添加任何额外的辅助。对于 2 量子位 Clifford+CS 酉，我们的算法实现了线性复杂度，这只能通过以前使用表示的算法来完成。

articles.title: Differentiable control of laser–plasma experiments with conditional diffusion models
articles.title_zh: 使用条件扩散模型对激光等离子体实验进行微分控制
articles.abstract: Tuning a laser–wakefield accelerator to a desired electron energy spectrum is normally done by scanning the machine one setting at a time, which consumes scarce beam time and expert attention. We address the inverse problem directly, recovering the experimental settings that produce a target spectrum. To do so we train a conditional diffusion model, built on the Elucidating the Design Space of Diffusion-Based Models (EDM) framework, on measured electron spectra from the ALFA beamline, conditioned on laser energy, gas-jet backing pressure, and gas-valve opening time. Because EDM samples by integrating a probability-flow ordinary differential equation, the map from settings to spectrum is differentiable end to end, and the settings themselves can be treated as free variables and optimized by backpropagation through the sampler. We propose and evaluate a three-stage strategy, BO L-BFGS RAdam, in which Bayesian optimization provides a global warm start across flat regions, L-BFGS exploits local curvature, and a final stochastic phase relaxes the solution away from sharp, bin-aligned minima. Against seven alternative single- and multi-stage strategies, this ordering recovers the target settings with the lowest mean squared error. We position this as a tool for differentiable inverse design in experiment planning, complementary to particle-in-cell simulation rather than a substitute for it.
articles.abstract_zh: 将激光尾场加速器调整到所需的电子能谱通常是通过一次扫描一个设置来完成的，这会消耗宝贵的光束时间和专家的注意力。我们直接解决逆问题，恢复产生目标光谱的实验设置。为此，我们训练了一个条件扩散模型，该模型建立在阐明基于扩散的模型的设计空间 (EDM) 框架的基础上，以 ALFA 光束线测量的电子光谱为基础，以激光能量、气体喷射背压和气阀打开时间为条件。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 将激光尾场加速器调整到所需的电子能谱通常是通过一次扫描一个设置来完成的，这会消耗宝贵的光束时间和专家的注意力。我们直接解决逆问题，恢复产生目标光谱的实验设置。为此，我们训练了一个条件扩散模型，该模型建立在阐明基于扩散的模型的设计空间 (EDM) 框架的基础上，以 ALFA 光束线测量的电子光谱为基础，以激光能量、气体喷射背压和气阀打开时间为条件。由于 EDM 通过积分概率流常微分方程进行采样，因此从设置到频谱的映射是端到端可微分的，并且设置本身可以视为自由变量，并通过采样器的反向传播进行优化。我们提出并评估了一种三阶段策略 BO L-BFGS RAdam，其中贝叶斯优化提供了跨平坦区域的全局热启动，L-BFGS 利用局部曲率，最后的随机阶段使解决方案松弛，远离尖锐的、箱对齐的最小值。与七种替代的单阶段和多阶段策略相比，这种排序以最低均方误差恢复目标设置。我们将其定位为实验规划中可微逆设计的工具，是对细胞内粒子模拟的补充而不是替代。

articles.title: Tuning La0.7Sr0.3MnO3 magnetic anisotropy via interfacial coupling in homometallic trilayers
articles.title_zh: 通过同金属三层中的界面耦合调节 La0.7Sr0.3MnO3 磁各向异性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.37736v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work we explore the complex magnetic behaviour of SrMnO3/La0.7Sr0.3MnO3/SrMnO3 trilayers combining magneto-optic Kerr effect (MOKE) and magneto-resistance measurements. The interplay of structural and orbital reconstruction and the competition of ferromagnetism/antiferromagnetism at the interfaces is responsible of a variety of complex magnetic properties, highlighting the use of heterostructures as an effective strategy to tune and control magnetic behaviour. We demonstrate the possibility to tune the magnetic properties of a ferromagnetic La0.7Sr0.3MnO3 (LSMO) layer, embedded in two homometallic antiferromagnetic layers (SrMnO3, SMO), by properly varying the role of interfaces using two different LSMO thickness values. Spin reorientation of the LSMO magnetic easy axis away from its room temperature orientation was observed below 125 K, due to the predominance of exchange interaction at the interface over the substrate-induced magnetic anisotropy, in agreement with established models for homometallic manganite heterostructures. The competition of super-exchange and exchange interactions at the interface results in a highly frustrated interfacial spin glass state, resulting in 20-fold enhancement of the coercive field and exchange bias. The modification of the magnetocrystalline anisotropy driven by the interfacial effects leads to a change in the anisotropic magneto-resistance response of the system, which dominates the low temperature behaviour.
articles.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们结合磁光克尔效应 (MOKE) 和磁阻测量，探索了 SrMnO3/La0.7Sr0.3MnO3/SrMnO3 三层的复杂磁性行为。结构和轨道重构的相互作用以及界面处铁磁性/反铁磁性的竞争导致了各种复杂的磁特性，凸显了使用异质结构作为调整和控制磁行为的有效策略。我们证明了通过使用两种不同的 LSMO 厚度值适当改变界面的作用，可以调整嵌入两个同金属反铁磁层（SrMnO3，SMO）中的铁磁 La0.7Sr0.3MnO3 (LSMO) 层的磁性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这项工作中，我们结合磁光克尔效应 (MOKE) 和磁阻测量，探索了 SrMnO3/La0.7Sr0.3MnO3/SrMnO3 三层的复杂磁性行为。结构和轨道重构的相互作用以及界面处铁磁性/反铁磁性的竞争导致了各种复杂的磁特性，凸显了使用异质结构作为调整和控制磁行为的有效策略。我们证明了通过使用两种不同的 LSMO 厚度值适当改变界面的作用，可以调整嵌入两个同金属反铁磁层（SrMnO3，SMO）中的铁磁 La0.7Sr0.3MnO3 (LSMO) 层的磁性。在低于 125 K 的温度下观察到 LSMO 磁易轴的自旋重新取向远离其室温取向，这是由于界面处的交换相互作用在基底引起的磁各向异性上占主导地位，这与同金属锰矿异质结构的已建立模型一致。界面处超交换和交换相互作用的竞争导致高度受挫的界面自旋玻璃态，导致矫顽力场和交换偏压增强20倍。由界面效应驱动的磁晶各向异性的改变导致系统的各向异性磁阻响应的变化，这主导了低温行为。

articles.title: Approaching Landauer's limit in a single superconducting vortex memory bit
articles.title_zh: 在单个超导涡旋存储位中接近兰道尔极限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.37753v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This work investigates the energy required to manipulate a memory bit using a superconducting vortex confined in a nanoscale double-well pinning potential. In the experiments, various double-well systems subjected to sinusoidal forces is explored, and the effects of both driving force and frequency is analyzed. Results reveal characteristic stochastic resonance behavior for weak drives and adiabatic manipulation at strong, low-frequency drives. Although our experimental method requires a steady sinusoidal drive incompatible with Landauer's erasure protocol, our numerical analysis demonstrates that the work required for such bit manipulation (erasure) is within an order of magnitude of Landauer's limit (k_B T ln 2) at 4.2 K. These findings open possibilities for creating highly efficient memory elements that could be integrated with cryogenic quantum circuits or function as topological quantum computing qubits; thereby contributing to memory devices with lower energy consumption and mitigating the escalating global energy demand in the computing industry.
articles.abstract_zh: 这项工作研究了使用限制在纳米级双阱钉扎势中的超导涡流来操纵存储位所需的能量。在实验中，探索了受到正弦力作用的各种双井系统，并分析了驱动力和频率的影响。结果揭示了弱驱动的特征随机共振行为和强低频驱动的绝热操纵。尽管我们的实验方法需要与 Landauer 擦除协议不兼容的稳定正弦驱动，但我们的数值分析表明，这种位操作（擦除）所需的工作量在 4.2 K 时 Landauer 极限 (k_B T ln 2) 的一个数量级内。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 这项工作研究了使用限制在纳米级双阱钉扎势中的超导涡流来操纵存储位所需的能量。在实验中，探索了受到正弦力作用的各种双井系统，并分析了驱动力和频率的影响。结果揭示了弱驱动的特征随机共振行为和强低频驱动的绝热操纵。尽管我们的实验方法需要与 Landauer 擦除协议不兼容的稳定正弦驱动，但我们的数值分析表明，这种位操作（擦除）所需的工作量在 4.2 K 时 Landauer 极限 (k_B T ln 2) 的一个数量级内。这些发现为创建高效存储元件提供了可能性，这些元件可以与低温量子电路集成或用作拓扑量子计算量子位；从而有助于降低存储设备的能耗，并缓解计算行业不断增长的全球能源需求。

articles.title: Meta-Altermagnetism and Enhanced Spin-Splitting
articles.title_zh: 元交变磁性和增强的自旋分裂
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.37754v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets are collinear magnets with zero net magnetization and spin-split electronic bands. Here, we explore whether altermagnetism can exhibit a discontinuous jump, a phenomenon we refer to as meta-altermagnetism. We show that meta-altermagnetism can emerge in 2D systems when magnetic-order-induced band reconstruction drives spin-split van Hove singularities (vHSs) across the Fermi level. Using mean-field theory for an extended t-J model on a two-sublattice square lattice including anisotropic hopping integral, we find that a first-order meta-altermagnetic transition produces an intermediate altermagnetic regime with reduced staggered magnetization but strongly enhanced magnetic octupole and time-reversal-odd spin-splitter conductivity. We further show that the first-order transition line terminates at a quantum critical endpoint, giving rise to a rich phase diagram as the chemical potential and anisotropic hopping strength are varied. Our results identify the spin split vHSs as a route to enhancing spin-splitter effect for spintronic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 交替磁体是具有零净磁化强度和自旋分裂电子带的共线磁体。在这里，我们探讨交变磁性是否可以表现出不连续的跳跃，我们将这种现象称为元交变磁性。我们证明，当磁序诱导能带重建驱动费米能级上的自旋分裂范霍夫奇点（vHS）时，二维系统中可能会出现元交变磁性。利用平均场理论对包含各向异性跳跃积分的二亚晶格方格上的扩展 t-J 模型进行分析，我们发现一阶元交变磁跃迁产生了一种中间交变磁态，其交错磁化强度降低，但磁八极子和时间反转奇数自旋分裂器电导率大大增强。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 交替磁体是具有零净磁化强度和自旋分裂电子带的共线磁体。在这里，我们探讨交变磁性是否可以表现出不连续的跳跃，我们将这种现象称为元交变磁性。我们证明，当磁序诱导能带重建驱动费米能级上的自旋分裂范霍夫奇点（vHS）时，二维系统中可能会出现元交变磁性。利用平均场理论对包含各向异性跳跃积分的二亚晶格方格上的扩展 t-J 模型进行分析，我们发现一阶元交变磁跃迁产生了一种中间交变磁态，其交错磁化强度降低，但磁八极子和时间反转奇数自旋分裂器电导率大大增强。我们进一步表明，一阶跃迁线终止于量子临界端点，随着化学势和各向异性跳跃强度的变化，产生丰富的相图。我们的结果表明，自旋分裂 vHS 是增强自旋电子应用中自旋分裂效应的一种途径。

articles.title: MoireKP: An Automated Workflow for Symmetry-Constrained Moiré Continuum Models
articles.title_zh: MoireKP：对称约束莫尔连续体模型的自动化工作流程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.37760v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: First-principles Hamiltonians contain the electronic information needed to study moiré materials, but their size makes subsequent calculations costly. We present MoireKP, an automated workflow for constructing compact continuum models from localized-orbital ab initio Hamiltonians. The workflow constructs a valley-resolved truncated atomic-plane-wave (TAPW) Hamiltonian, selects a low-energy basis, and projects the crystal-symmetry operations into this basis. These representations determine the symmetry-allowed Hamiltonian terms, whose coefficients are obtained by projecting the low-energy effective Hamiltonian onto the corresponding operator basis. The model dimension, localized reference states, and harmonic cutoff can be selected automatically or specified by the user. This Hamiltonian-based construction retains wave-function information within the selected low-energy subspace. We apply the workflow to AA-stacked twisted bilayer MoTe₂, AB-stacked twisted bilayer ZrS₂, and A--AB twisted trilayer MoTe₂, covering K, M, and Γ valleys. All models reproduce TAPW band energies within 3.0 meV in the target windows along high-symmetry k paths.
articles.abstract_zh: 第一性原理哈密顿量包含研究莫尔材料所需的电子信息，但其尺寸使得后续计算成本高昂。我们提出了 MoireKP，这是一种自动化工作流程，用于从局域轨道从头算哈密顿量构建紧凑连续介质模型。该工作流程构建谷解析截断原子平面波 (TAPW) 哈密顿量，选择低能量基础，并将晶体对称运算投影到该基础中。这些表示确定了允许对称的哈密顿项，其系数是通过将低能有效哈密顿量投影到相应的算子基础上获得的。模型尺寸、局部参考状态和谐波截止可以自动选择或由用户指定。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 第一性原理哈密顿量包含研究莫尔材料所需的电子信息，但其尺寸使得后续计算成本高昂。我们提出了 MoireKP，这是一种自动化工作流程，用于从局域轨道从头算哈密顿量构建紧凑连续介质模型。该工作流程构建谷解析截断原子平面波 (TAPW) 哈密顿量，选择低能量基础，并将晶体对称运算投影到该基础中。这些表示确定了允许对称的哈密顿项，其系数是通过将低能有效哈密顿量投影到相应的算子基础上获得的。模型尺寸、局部参考状态和谐波截止可以自动选择或由用户指定。这种基于哈密顿量的构造保留了所选低能子空间内的波函数信息。我们将该工作流程应用于 AA 堆叠扭曲双层 MoTe 2、AB 堆叠扭曲双层 ZrS 2 和 A--AB 扭曲三层 MoTe 2，覆盖 K、M 和 γ 谷。所有模型都沿着高对称性 k 路径在目标窗口中再现 3.0 meV 以内的 TAPW 带能量。

articles.title: Field theory of competing phases in the interacting Kitaev chain
articles.title_zh: 相互作用的基塔耶夫链中竞争相的场论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.37761v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the interacting Kitaev chain with nearest-neighbor interactions and finite chemical potential using a combination of bosonization and density-matrix renormalization-group calculations. Focusing away from special exactly solvable lattice limits, we develop a continuum field-theoretic description of the generic finite-density interacting regime, where doping nonperturbatively modifies the competition between superconducting pairing and commensurate charge ordering. We show that the phase diagram consists of an intermediate incommensurate Luttinger liquid between the topological superconducting and commensurate charge-density-wave Mott phases, as well as a trivial band-insulating regime at large chemical potential. The commensurate--incommensurate and incommensurate--topological-superconducting phase boundaries are governed by Pokrovsky--Talapov and Berezinskii--Kosterlitz--Thouless criticality, respectively. We analyze the interacting topological superconducting regime and its boundary excitations. At the semiclassical level, and explicitly in the free-fermion boundary theory, the topological phase supports exponentially localized Majorana edge modes at interfaces between topological and trivial regions. We also construct a dual continuum fermionic representation in which this topological bulk sector is described instead by conventional symmetry breaking. This gives a continuum version of the SPT--SSB correspondence between different fermionic representations. Overall, our results provide an analytical description of one-dimensional interacting topological superconductors, from the competition between topology and commensurability and the resulting quantum criticality to the dual symmetry-breaking description of the topological phase.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们结合玻色子化和密度矩阵重整化群计算来研究具有最近邻相互作用和有限化学势的相互作用的基塔耶夫链。远离特殊的精确可解晶格极限，我们开发了通用有限密度相互作用机制的连续场论描述，其中掺杂非微扰地改变了超导配对和相应电荷排序之间的竞争。我们证明相图由拓扑超导相和相称电荷密度波莫特相之间的中间不相称卢廷格液体以及大化学势下的平凡带绝缘区域组成。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们结合玻色子化和密度矩阵重整化群计算来研究具有最近邻相互作用和有限化学势的相互作用的基塔耶夫链。远离特殊的精确可解晶格极限，我们开发了通用有限密度相互作用机制的连续场论描述，其中掺杂非微扰地改变了超导配对和相应电荷排序之间的竞争。我们证明相图由拓扑超导相和相称电荷密度波莫特相之间的中间不相称卢廷格液体以及大化学势下的平凡带绝缘区域组成。相称——不相称和不相称——拓扑超导相边界分别由 Pokrovsky-Talapov 和 Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless 临界性控制。我们分析了相互作用的拓扑超导状态及其边界激励。在半经典水平上，并且明确地在自由费米子边界理论中，拓扑相支持拓扑区域和平凡区域之间的界面处的指数局域马约拉纳边缘模式。我们还构造了一个双连续谱费米子表示，其中该拓扑体扇区通过传统的对称破缺来描述。这给出了不同费米子表示之间的 SPT-SSB 对应的连续体版本。总的来说，我们的结果提供了对一维相互作用拓扑超导体的分析描述，从拓扑和可通约性之间的竞争以及由此产生的量子临界性到拓扑相的双对称破缺描述。

articles.title: Spin Space Symmetry Without Spin Space Groups
articles.title_zh: 没有自旋空间群的自旋空间对称性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.37770v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin space groups provide a complete symmetry classification of magnetic structures in the non-relativistic limit and have become an increasingly useful language for organizing magnetic phases and their physical properties. Each spin space group with a given parent space group is specified, up to spin-only symmetries, by a real representation of that space group acting in spin space. We argue that working directly with this representation not only avoids the construction and identification of the group, but also organizes and simplifies the resulting symmetry constraints on allowed responses. Determining the presence or absence of magnetic compensation, piezomagnetism, spin and charge transport, the Edelstein effect, and momentum-space spin textures becomes an ordinary problem in the representation theory of space groups. The resulting conditions reduce to overlaps between the three exterior powers of the defining representation and multipole representations of the point group. Several physically distinct responses then reduce to the same condition on the defining representation. For example, a p-wave spin texture and the time-even Edelstein effect are allowed under the same condition, as are piezomagnetism and a d-wave spin texture in compensated order. The wave-vector content of the exterior powers gives a further hierarchy of selection rules: depending on the relevant power, a uniform response requires one, two, or three ordering wave vectors to sum to a reciprocal lattice vector. These rules can exclude many responses before point-group symmetry is considered. We illustrate the approach with examples drawn from a wide variety of materials hosting collinear, coplanar and non-coplanar magnetic order. Finally, we discuss extensions of these results to magnetic space groups, connections to Landau theories of collinear order, and the characterization of odd-parity magnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋空间群提供了非相对论极限下磁结构的完整对称分类，并且已成为组织磁相及其物理性质的越来越有用的语言。具有给定父空间群的每个自旋空间群都由作用于自旋空间的空间群的实数表示指定，直至仅自旋对称性。我们认为，直接使用这种表示不仅避免了群体的构建和识别，而且还组织和简化了对允许响应的对称约束。确定磁补偿、压磁性、自旋和电荷输运、埃德尔斯坦效应和动量空间自旋纹理是否存在成为空间群表示论中的一个常见问题。由此产生的条件减少为定义表示的三个外部幂与点群的多极表示之间的重叠。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋空间群提供了非相对论极限下磁结构的完整对称分类，并且已成为组织磁相及其物理性质的越来越有用的语言。具有给定父空间群的每个自旋空间群都由作用于自旋空间的空间群的实数表示指定，直至仅自旋对称性。我们认为，直接使用这种表示不仅避免了群体的构建和识别，而且还组织和简化了对允许响应的对称约束。确定磁补偿、压磁性、自旋和电荷输运、埃德尔斯坦效应和动量空间自旋纹理是否存在成为空间群表示论中的一个常见问题。由此产生的条件减少为定义表示的三个外部幂与点群的多极表示之间的重叠。然后，几个物理上不同的响应会减少到定义表示上的相同条件。例如，在相同条件下允许p波自旋织构和时间均匀埃德尔斯坦效应，以及补偿顺序中的压磁和d波自旋织构。外部功率的波矢量内容给出了选择规则的进一步层次：根据相关功率，统一响应需要一个、两个或三个有序波矢量求和为倒格矢量。在考虑点群对称性之前，这些规则可以排除许多响应。我们通过从具有共线、共面和非共面磁序的各种材料中提取的示例来说明该方法。最后，我们讨论这些结果对磁性空间群的扩展、与共线序朗道理论的联系以及奇宇称磁体的表征。

articles.title: Evidence for a charged vortex lattice in an exciton superfluid
articles.title_zh: 激子超流体中带电涡旋晶格的证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.37781v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Lattices of quantized vortices are a defining property of rotating superfluids and of type-II superconductors in magnetic fields. Realizing an analogous vortex lattice in an exciton superfluid-formed from bound electron-hole pairs-has remained challenging because excitons are electrically neutral. Building on previous theoretical studies of the low-energy excitations in an exciton superfluid, recent theory has predicted that in a strong magnetic field, a weakly charged exciton superfluid can stabilize a vortex-antivortex lattice arising from the mutual repulsion of fractionally charged vortex cores. Here we report evidence for this predicted vortex lattice in a bilayer exciton condensate by imaging its charged vortices with the scanning tunnelling microscope. The condensate forms between Landau levels of two graphene layers separated by a thin hexagonal boron nitride barrier in a perpendicular magnetic field. We find that the vortex lattice periodicity scales with the total excess charge and is insensitive to its distribution between the two layers, in quantitative agreement with theoretical predictions. Our observations provide evidence for phase coherence in an exciton superfluid system.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子化涡旋晶格是旋转超流体和磁场中 II 型超导体的一个定义属性。在由束缚电子空穴对形成的激子超流体中实现类似的涡旋晶格仍然具有挑战性，因为激子是电中性的。基于先前对激子超流体中低能激发的理论研究，最近的理论预测，在强磁场中，弱带电激子超流体可以稳定由分数带电涡旋核相互排斥而产生的涡旋-反涡旋晶格。在这里，我们通过使用扫描隧道显微镜对双层激子凝聚体的带电涡流进行成像，报告了双层激子凝聚体中这种预测涡旋晶格的证据。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子化涡旋晶格是旋转超流体和磁场中 II 型超导体的一个定义属性。在由束缚电子空穴对形成的激子超流体中实现类似的涡旋晶格仍然具有挑战性，因为激子是电中性的。基于先前对激子超流体中低能激发的理论研究，最近的理论预测，在强磁场中，弱带电激子超流体可以稳定由分数带电涡旋核相互排斥而产生的涡旋-反涡旋晶格。在这里，我们通过使用扫描隧道显微镜对双层激子凝聚体的带电涡流进行成像，报告了双层激子凝聚体中这种预测涡旋晶格的证据。在垂直磁场中，两个石墨烯层的朗道能级之间形成了冷凝物，这两个石墨烯层被薄的六方氮化硼势垒隔开。我们发现涡旋晶格周期性与总过剩电荷成比例，并且对其在两层之间的分布不敏感，这与理论预测在数量上一致。我们的观察结果为激子超流体系统中的相位相干性提供了证据。

articles.title: Parity-Resolved Many-Body Kinetics of a Topological Qubit under Nonequilibrium Phonon Pulses
articles.title_zh: 非平衡声子脉冲下拓扑量子位的宇称解析多体动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.37793v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Phonon bursts from ionizing radiation cause correlated errors in superconducting quantum processors. We study prescribed nonequilibrium phonon pulses in a Majorana qubit formed by two 2,mum proximitized nanowires. Combining the lattice Lutchyn--Oreg model, microscopic electron--phonon coupling, and parity-resolved many-body dynamics, we track excitation, relaxation, and logical coherence. Without quasiparticle escape, recombination restores the initial Majorana occupations in about 130 ns, while phonons exchanged during excitation and recovery can retain logical-state information, leaving permanent coherence loss. For mirror-symmetric wires, the fractional coherence loss per wire is 0.75--1.0 times the excitation probability averaged over the two logical states, even at zero Majorana splitting; breaking mirror symmetry can suppress dephasing at small splitting. Factorized Boltzmann kinetics neglects quasiparticle correlations and overestimates residual parity flips. At equal deposited energy density, phonon spectra yield different excitation probabilities and coherence losses. Comparisons with Kitaev chains matched to the wire's gap and Majorana decay length reveal that low electron density suppresses excitation by energetic phonons, whereas hard-wall boundaries in a high-density control increase excitation efficiency by a factor of 5×10⁴ relative to the wire for pulses centered at 1 meV. Magnetic-field and chemical-potential tuning yield different phonon sensitivities at the same bulk gap through changes in spin and electron--hole structure. Including hybrid states' semiconductor weights reduces near-threshold excitation rates fourfold when the tunnel coupling equals the parent superconducting gap. Our framework connects phonon spectra to leakage, poisoning, and coherence loss to guide Majorana-device design.
articles.abstract_zh: 电离辐射产生的声子爆发会导致超导量子处理器中的相关误差。我们研究了由两条 2,mum 邻近纳米线形成的马约拉纳量子位中规定的非平衡声子脉冲。结合晶格 Luutchyn-Oreg 模型、微观电子声子耦合和宇称解析多体动力学，我们跟踪激发、弛豫和逻辑相干性。如果没有准粒子逃逸，重组会在大约 130 ns 内恢复初始的马约拉纳占位，而在激发和恢复过程中交换的声子可以保留逻辑状态信息，从而留下永久性的相干性损失。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电离辐射产生的声子爆发会导致超导量子处理器中的相关误差。我们研究了由两条 2,mum 邻近纳米线形成的马约拉纳量子位中规定的非平衡声子脉冲。结合晶格 Luutchyn-Oreg 模型、微观电子声子耦合和宇称解析多体动力学，我们跟踪激发、弛豫和逻辑相干性。如果没有准粒子逃逸，重组会在大约 130 ns 内恢复初始的马约拉纳占位，而在激发和恢复过程中交换的声子可以保留逻辑状态信息，从而留下永久性的相干性损失。对于镜像对称线，每根线的分数相干损耗是两个逻辑状态上平均激励概率的 0.75--1.0 倍，即使在马约拉纳分裂为零的情况下也是如此；打破镜像对称性可以抑制小分裂时的相移。分解玻尔兹曼动力学忽略了准粒子相关性并高估了剩余奇偶校验翻转。在相同的沉积能量密度下，声子谱产生不同的激发概率和相干损失。与与导线间隙和马约拉纳衰变长度匹配的基塔耶夫链的比较表明，低电子密度抑制高能声子的激发，而高密度控制中的硬壁边界相对于以 1 meV 为中心的脉冲的导线，将激发效率提高了 5×10⁴ 倍。磁场和化学势调谐通过自旋和电子空穴结构的变化在相同的体能隙处产生不同的声子灵敏度。当隧道耦合等于母体超导能隙时，包括混合态的半导体权重可将近阈值激发速率降低四倍。我们的框架将声子谱与泄漏、中毒和相干性损失联系起来，以指导马约拉纳器件的设计。

articles.title: Gæ{}niceN: a minimal model to relax magnetization states self-consistently in general artificial spin ices
articles.title_zh: Gæ{}niceN：在一般人造自旋冰中自洽松弛磁化状态的最小模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.37889v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Artificial spin ices are geometric arrangement of nanomagnets that exhibit reconfigurable magnetization states and GHz dynamics. Their investigation in the GHz regime is challenging because of the existence of multiple modes and the impact of magnetization deviations at the edges of the nanomagnets. A minimal model to capture such dynamics require three macrospins per nanomagnet, an approach that was implemented for generic artificial spin ices in the tool Gaenice. Here, we use the Gaenice framework to realize a relaxation method to stabilize magnetization states self-consistently, called GaeniceN. We implement the dissipative component of the Landau-Lifshitz equation in an iterative approach to efficiently converge to the relaxed state. As an example, we find our approach to correctly predict the transition between phases in a pyramid ASI subject to a low-magnitude external field by computing the system's average energy. Because they are rooted on the same framework, GaeniceN produces the initial condition needed for Gaenice to compute dynamics such as ferromagnetic resonance or band structures. Combined, these tools will be able to aid in the design of artificial spin ices with applications in magnonics.
articles.abstract_zh: 人造自旋冰是纳米磁体的几何排列，表现出可重新配置的磁化状态和 GHz 动力学。由于存在多种模式以及纳米磁体边缘磁化偏差的影响，他们在 GHz 范围内的研究具有挑战性。捕获这种动力学的最小模型需要每个纳米磁体三个宏自旋，这种方法已在 Gaenice 工具中用于通用人造自旋冰。在这里，我们使用Gaenice框架实现了一种自洽稳定磁化态的弛豫方法，称为GaeniceN。我们以迭代方法实现 Landau-Lifshitz 方程的耗散分量，以有效地收敛到松弛状态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 人造自旋冰是纳米磁体的几何排列，表现出可重新配置的磁化状态和 GHz 动力学。由于存在多种模式以及纳米磁体边缘磁化偏差的影响，他们在 GHz 范围内的研究具有挑战性。捕获这种动力学的最小模型需要每个纳米磁体三个宏自旋，这种方法已在 Gaenice 工具中用于通用人造自旋冰。在这里，我们使用Gaenice框架实现了一种自洽稳定磁化态的弛豫方法，称为GaeniceN。我们以迭代方法实现 Landau-Lifshitz 方程的耗散分量，以有效地收敛到松弛状态。作为一个例子，我们发现我们的方法可以通过计算系统的平均能量来正确预测金字塔 ASI 中受低强度外场影响的阶段之间的转变。因为它们植根于相同的框架，GaeniceN 产生了 Gaenice 计算铁磁共振或能带结构等动力学所需的初始条件。结合起来，这些工具将能够帮助设计人造旋转冰及其在磁振子学中的应用。

articles.title: Planar energetics do not determine twin persistence in nanocrystalline aluminium
articles.title_zh: 平面能量学不能决定纳米晶铝中的孪生持久性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.37925v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Planar energetics are the standard descriptors of twinnability in face-centred cubic metals and the usual validation targets for interatomic potentials. Here we show that they do not determine whether deformation twins persist in nanocrystalline aluminium. Two machine-learned potentials reproducing the same zero-load slip curves and closely spaced layered energy surfaces predict, from a common separated-fault precursor under identical loading, retained twin coverage of 64% and 14%. The divergence traces to forces within distorted partial cores acting along the trailing translation that would remove an outer fault. Planar energetics do set the margin: an outer fault more than halves the incremental barrier for middle-plane shear, yet twin completion and fault removal remain separated by only 10--21 mJ mtextsuperscript-2. Whether an assembled twin persists is decided instead by the orientation of local traction relative to the full-slip bisector and by the arrival order of partial-slip fronts from the grain-boundary network.
articles.abstract_zh: 平面能量学是面心立方金属孪生性的标准描述符，也是原子间势的常用验证目标。在这里，我们表明他们不能确定变形孪晶是否存在于纳米晶铝中。两个机器学习势再现相同的零负载滑移曲线和紧密间隔的层状能量表面，根据相同负载下的常见分离断层前兆，预测保留的孪生覆盖率分别为 64% 和 14%。这种分歧归因于扭曲的部分核心内沿着尾部平移作用的力，这将消除外部断层。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 平面能量学是面心立方金属孪生性的标准描述符，也是原子间势的常用验证目标。在这里，我们表明他们不能确定变形孪晶是否存在于纳米晶铝中。两个机器学习势再现相同的零负载滑移曲线和紧密间隔的层状能量表面，根据相同负载下的常见分离断层前兆，预测保留的孪生覆盖率分别为 64% 和 14%。这种分歧归因于扭曲的部分核心内沿着尾部平移作用的力，这将消除外部断层。平面能量学确实设定了界限：外部断层超过了中面剪切增量障碍的一半以上，但孪生完井和断层去除仍然仅相距 10--21 mJ mtextsuperscript-2。组合孪生体是否持续存在取决于局部牵引力相对于全滑移平分线的方向以及来自晶界网络的部分滑移前沿的到达顺序。

articles.title: From a Lifshitz Transition to Spin-Density-Wave Order: Sr₂RuO₄ under Uniaxial Strain
articles.title_zh: 从 Lifshitz 跃迁到自旋密度波序：单轴应变下的 Sr2RuO₄
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38025v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In recent years, the effects of uniaxial strain on Sr₂RuO₄ have been extensively investigated, revealing a pronounced enhancement of the superconducting critical temperature accompanied by experimental indications of an emergent magnetically ordered state. In this Letter, we study the impact of strain on the spectral and magnetic properties of this material within an advanced many-body theoretical framework. We find that strain induces an anisotropic Lifshitz transition, which enhances the electron scattering rate along the elongation axis while simultaneously promoting coherent Fermi-liquid behavior in the perpendicular direction, in close agreement with experimental observations. Taking into account this anisotropic behavior allows us to capture the magnetic instability leading to a finite-temperature ordered state at large strain values. Our analysis further reveals that the magnetic response is dominated by two competing wave vectors associated with distinct nesting vectors: one within the γ sheet and the other between the α and β sheets of the Fermi surface. Both wave vectors can stabilize magnetic order, with their competition depending sensitively on the coherence of the respective Fermi surface sheets.
articles.abstract_zh: 近年来，单轴应变对 Sr2RuO4 的影响得到了广泛的研究，揭示了超导临界温度的显着提高，同时实验表明出现了磁有序态。在这封信中，我们在先进的多体理论框架内研究了应变对该材料的光谱和磁性特性的影响。我们发现应变会引起各向异性的利夫席兹跃迁，这会增强沿伸长轴的电子散射率，同时促进垂直方向的相干费米液体行为，这与实验观察结果非常一致。考虑到这种各向异性行为，我们可以捕获导致大应变值下有限温度有序状态的磁不稳定性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 近年来，单轴应变对 Sr2RuO4 的影响得到了广泛的研究，揭示了超导临界温度的显着提高，同时实验表明出现了磁有序态。在这封信中，我们在先进的多体理论框架内研究了应变对该材料的光谱和磁性特性的影响。我们发现应变会引起各向异性的利夫席兹跃迁，这会增强沿伸长轴的电子散射率，同时促进垂直方向的相干费米液体行为，这与实验观察结果非常一致。考虑到这种各向异性行为，我们可以捕获导致大应变值下有限温度有序状态的磁不稳定性。我们的分析进一步表明，磁响应由与不同嵌套矢量相关的两个竞争波矢量主导：一个在 γ 片内，另一个在费米表面的 α 和 β 片之间。两个波矢量都可以稳定磁序，它们的竞争敏感地取决于各自费米表面片的相干性。

articles.title: Coherent control and high purity single-photon emission from telecom quantum dots on metamorphic InGaAs
articles.title_zh: 变质 InGaAs 上电信量子点的相干控制和高纯度单光子发射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38060v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Semiconductor quantum dots emitting in the telecommunication O- and C-bands are promising candidates as single-photon sources for fiber-based quantum communication. In this work, we show how coherent quasi-resonant and phonon-assisted excitation help reveal the intrinsic optical properties of InAs quantum dots embedded in relaxed InGaAs matrices on top of metamorphic InGaAs layers for achieving emission in the telecom bands. By systematically comparing excitation schemes, we separate excitation-induced effects from intrinsic emitter properties. This allows us to observe linewidths as narrow as 21 μeV, the disappearance of slow decay channels, and single-photon purity reaching second-order autocorrelation values in the order of 10⁻². Photoluminescence excitation reveals higher excited states, enabling coherent control of trion transitions and the observation of Rabi-like oscillations in both telecom bands. These results confirm the promising potential of these quantum dots for applications in quantum technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 在电信 O 和 C 波段发射的半导体量子点是基于光纤的量子通信的单光子源的有希望的候选者。在这项工作中，我们展示了相干准谐振和声子辅助激发如何帮助揭示嵌入变质 InGaAs 层顶部松弛 InGaAs 矩阵中的 InAs 量子点的固有光学特性，以实现电信频段的发射。通过系统地比较激发方案，我们将激发引起的效应与固有发射极特性分开。这使我们能够观察到窄至 21 μeV 的线宽、慢衰减通道的消失以及达到 10² 量级的二阶自相关值的单光子纯度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在电信 O 和 C 波段发射的半导体量子点是基于光纤的量子通信的单光子源的有希望的候选者。在这项工作中，我们展示了相干准谐振和声子辅助激发如何帮助揭示嵌入变质 InGaAs 层顶部松弛 InGaAs 矩阵中的 InAs 量子点的固有光学特性，以实现电信频段的发射。通过系统地比较激发方案，我们将激发引起的效应与固有发射极特性分开。这使我们能够观察到窄至 21 μeV 的线宽、慢衰减通道的消失以及达到 10² 量级的二阶自相关值的单光子纯度。光致发光激发揭示了更高的激发态，从而能够对三重子跃迁进行相干控制，并在两个电信频段观察到类拉比振荡。这些结果证实了这些量子点在量子技术中应用的巨大潜力。

articles.title: Crystoria: A Large-Scale Crystal Dataset Linking Thermodynamic and Dynamical Stability for Materials AI
articles.title_zh: Crystoria：连接材料 AI 热力学和动态稳定性的大型晶体数据集
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38195v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large-scale crystal databases have transformed materials discovery by making millions of structures and thermodynamic properties accessible to materials informatics. Yet dynamical stability remains sparsely characterized at a comparable scale because its evaluation is substantially more computationally demanding than conventional structure and energy calculations. This mismatch creates a critical gap between the rapidly expanding crystal-structure space and the physical information available for materials research and machine learning. Here we introduce Crystoria, a large-scale crystal dataset designed to bring dynamical stability to the scale of modern materials data. We construct Crystoria by systematically curating low-energy and metastable inorganic crystals, standardizing their structural identities, and combining machine-learning-accelerated structural relaxation with phonon-based dynamical screening. The resulting dataset contains 2,649,640 crystal structures, spanning 89 elements, 219 of the 230 space groups, and primitive cells containing 1-48 atoms. Among them, 1,793,353 structures (67.68%) are classified as dynamically stable, revealing substantial variation in dynamical stability across chemical and crystallographic space. By bringing dynamical stability to the scale of millions of crystal structures, Crystoria provides a physically grounded foundation for materials artificial intelligence (AI) and enables systematic exploration of the dynamical crystal landscape.
articles.abstract_zh: 大规模晶体数据库使材料信息学能够获取数以百万计的结构和热力学性质，从而改变了材料的发现。然而，动态稳定性在可比较的规模上仍然很少被表征，因为它的评估比传统的结构和能量计算对计算的要求更高。这种不匹配在快速膨胀的晶体结构空间与可用于材料研究和机器学习的物理信息之间造成了严重的差距。在这里，我们介绍 Crystoria，一个大型晶体数据集，旨在为现代材料数据规模带来动态稳定性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 大规模晶体数据库使材料信息学能够获取数以百万计的结构和热力学性质，从而改变了材料的发现。然而，动态稳定性在可比较的规模上仍然很少被表征，因为它的评估比传统的结构和能量计算对计算的要求更高。这种不匹配在快速膨胀的晶体结构空间与可用于材料研究和机器学习的物理信息之间造成了严重的差距。在这里，我们介绍 Crystoria，一个大型晶体数据集，旨在为现代材料数据规模带来动态稳定性。我们通过系统地构建低能和亚稳态无机晶体，标准化其结构特性，并将机器学习加速的结构弛豫与基于声子的动态筛选相结合来构建 Crystoria。生成的数据集包含 2,649,640 个晶体结构，涵盖 89 个元素、230 个空间群中的 219 个，以及包含 1-48 个原子的原始晶胞。其中，1,793,353 个结构（67.68%）被归类为动态稳定结构，揭示了化学和晶体空间动态稳定性的显着变化。通过为数百万个晶体结构带来动态稳定性，Crystoria 为材料人工智能 (AI) 提供了物理基础，并能够系统地探索动态晶体景观。

articles.title: Influences of N₂ flow rate on the superconducting properties and dimensionality of epitaxial TiN thin films
articles.title_zh: N2流量对外延TiN薄膜超导性能和尺寸的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38250v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: TiN thin films have received great attention in the field of superconducting quantum computing due to their low loss characteristics derived from stable chemical and thermal properties, as well as excellent electrical conductivity. In this study, TiN thin films with a thickness of 35 nm were epitaxially grown on MgO substrates using the DC reactive magnetron sputtering technique. The crystal structure, film thickness, and surface morphology of the thin films were characterized. The films exhibit a very flat surface with a root mean square roughness of only a few tenths of a nanometer. The influences of nitrogen (N₂) flow rate on the surface morphology, superconducting transition temperature (T_c), residual resistivity ratio (RRR), normal-state resistivity (ρₙ), upper critical field, and superconducting dimensionality were investigated systematically. The experimental results show that the TiN film deposited with a N₂ flow rate of 1.5 sccm exhibits optimal performance, including the highest T_c (4.93 K), the largest RRR, the lowest ρₙ, and the lowest slope of the out-of-film upper critical field near Tc. Moreover, it is found that the background vacuum inside the growth chamber has a significant impact on the superconducting properties of TiN films, and the degradation of vacuum degree can lead to the decrease of T_c. The upper critical field reveals a significant anisotropic feature. Importantly, the in-film upper critical field data demonstrates that the optimization of sample quality leads to deviation from two-dimensional superconducting behavior, which provides a new perspective on the influencing factors of superconducting dimensionality beyond the thickness of films. The present results provide useful references for a comprehensive understanding of the relationship between growth parameters and the superconducting properties of thin films.
articles.abstract_zh: TiN薄膜因其稳定的化学和热性能以及优异的导电性而具有低损耗特性，在超导量子计算领域受到了极大的关注。在本研究中，采用直流反应磁控溅射技术在 MgO 衬底上外延生长厚度为 35 nm 的 TiN 薄膜。对薄膜的晶体结构、薄膜厚度和表面形貌进行了表征。这些薄膜具有非常平坦的表面，均方根粗糙度仅为十分之几纳米。系统研究了氮气(N2)流量对表面形貌、超导转变温度(T_c)、残余电阻率(RRR)、常态电阻率(ρₙ)、上临界场和超导维数的影响。
articles.abstract_zh_full: TiN薄膜因其稳定的化学和热性能以及优异的导电性而具有低损耗特性，在超导量子计算领域受到了极大的关注。在本研究中，采用直流反应磁控溅射技术在 MgO 衬底上外延生长厚度为 35 nm 的 TiN 薄膜。对薄膜的晶体结构、薄膜厚度和表面形貌进行了表征。这些薄膜具有非常平坦的表面，均方根粗糙度仅为十分之几纳米。系统研究了氮气(N2)流量对表面形貌、超导转变温度(T_c)、残余电阻率(RRR)、常态电阻率(ρₙ)、上临界场和超导维数的影响。实验结果表明，N2流量为1.5 sccm沉积的TiN薄膜表现出最佳性能，包括最高的T_c（4.93 K）、最大的RRR、最低的ρₙ以及Tc附近膜外上临界场斜率最小。此外，研究发现生长室内的背景真空对TiN薄膜的超导性能有显着影响，真空度的降低会导致T_c下降。上临界场显示出显着的各向异性特征。重要的是，膜内上临界场数据表明，样品质量的优化导致了二维超导行为的偏差，这为研究薄膜厚度之外的超导维度影响因素提供了新的视角。本研究结果为全面理解薄膜生长参数与超导性能之间的关系提供了有益的参考。

articles.title: Finite-Temperature Magnetism and Longitudinal Spin Transport in Compensated Half-Metal Ferrimagnets with Near-Zero Magnetization
articles.title_zh: 近零磁化强度补偿半金属亚铁磁体中的有限温度磁性和纵向自旋输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38302v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fully compensated ferrimagnets, characterized by nearly vanishing magnetic moments at zero temperature, perfect spin-polarized electronic structures, and ultrafast spin dynamics, represent a highly promising materials platform for next-generation spintronic devices. By minimizing stray magnetic fields and reducing switching currents, FCFs enable a viable path toward high-speed, low-power spintronic devices. In this work, we present a systematic investigation of the electronic structure, finite-temperature magnetism, and spin-dependent transport properties of the Heusler-type fully compensated half-metallic ferrimagnet Mn3Al in magnetic tunnel junctions. We demonstrate that Mn3Al is a half-metallic FCF with 100% spin polarization and fully compensated magnetization at 0 K. Combining density functional theory with Monte Carlo simulations, we characterize its finite-temperature magnetic properties and show that Mn3Al exhibits a net magnetization below 11.6 emu/cc at 300 K, confirming the robustness of its nearly compensated ferrimagnetic order at room temperature. Furthermore, we predict that the Mn3Al/MgO/Mn3Al MTJ yields a giant tunneling magnetoresistance effect at 0 K, which remains as high as 232% at 300 K. Our results establish Mn3Al and related half-metallic FCFs as excellent candidates for magnetoresistance-based spintronic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 完全补偿的亚铁磁体具有零温度下几乎消失的磁矩、完美的自旋极化电子结构和超快自旋动力学，代表了下一代自旋电子器件的非常有前途的材料平台。通过最大限度地减少杂散磁场和降低开关电流，FCF 为高速、低功耗自旋电子器件开辟了一条可行的道路。在这项工作中，我们对磁隧道结中 Heusler 型全补偿半金属亚铁磁体 Mn3Al 的电子结构、有限温度磁性和自旋相关输运特性进行了系统研究。我们证明了 Mn3Al 是一种半金属 FCF，在 0 K 下具有 100% 自旋极化和完全补偿的磁化强度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 完全补偿的亚铁磁体具有零温度下几乎消失的磁矩、完美的自旋极化电子结构和超快自旋动力学，代表了下一代自旋电子器件的非常有前途的材料平台。通过最大限度地减少杂散磁场和降低开关电流，FCF 为高速、低功耗自旋电子器件开辟了一条可行的道路。在这项工作中，我们对磁隧道结中 Heusler 型全补偿半金属亚铁磁体 Mn3Al 的电子结构、有限温度磁性和自旋相关输运特性进行了系统研究。我们证明了 Mn3Al 是一种半金属 FCF，在 0 K 下具有 100% 自旋极化和完全补偿的磁化强度。将密度泛函理论与蒙特卡罗模拟相结合，我们表征了其有限温度磁特性，并表明 Mn3Al 在 300 K 时表现出低于 11.6 emu/cc 的净磁化强度，证实了其近补偿亚铁磁序在室温下的鲁棒性。此外，我们预测 Mn3Al/MgO/Mn3Al MTJ 在 0 K 时产生巨大的隧道磁阻效应，在 300 K 时仍高达 232%。我们的结果表明 Mn3Al 和相关的半金属 FCF 是基于磁阻的自旋电子应用的优秀候选者。

articles.title: First-Principles Identification of Higher-Order Configurational Energy Terms and Their Magnetic-State Dependence in Lithium-Rich Oxyfluorides: From QUBO to HUBO
articles.title_zh: 富锂氟氧化物中高阶构型能量项及其磁态依赖性的第一性原理识别：从 QUBO 到 HUBO
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38321v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, we use spin-polarized density functional theory (DFT) to identify substantial third-order, nonadditive configurational energy contributions in lithium-rich oxyfluorides that quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) models cannot represent. We test the extension from QUBO to higher-order unconstrained binary optimization (HUBO) in two disordered-rocksalt cathode materials, Li₂MnO₂F (LMOF) and Li₂Mn₀.₅Ti₀.₅O₂F (LMTiOF), using composition-preserving DFT energy maps. Using fixed-geometry energy maps, we show that cubic HUBO captures nonadditive contributions absent from QUBO models and substantially reduces fitting errors in both materials. Direct DFT energy differences confirm third-order nonadditivity, while comparisons of magnetic initializations reveal a strong dependence of the LMTiOF contribution on the converged electronic state. These results support the inclusion of higher-order terms when modeling configurational energetics and highlight the need to account for magnetic-state dependence in constructing DFT energy maps. The extracted terms describe effective couplings among composition-preserving exchange variables, rather than uniquely identified microscopic three-atom interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们使用自旋极化密度泛函理论（DFT）来识别富锂氟氧化物中大量的三阶非加性构型能量贡献，这是二次无约束二元优化（QUBO）模型无法表示的。我们使用成分保持 DFT 能量图，在两种无序岩盐阴极材料 Li2MnO2F (LMOF) 和 Li2Mn₀.₅Ti₀.₅O2F (LMTiOF) 中测试从 QUBO 到高阶无约束二元优化 (HUBO) 的扩展。使用固定几何能量图，我们表明立方 HUBO 捕获了 QUBO 模型中缺少的非加性贡献，并大大减少了两种材料的拟合误差。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这项工作中，我们使用自旋极化密度泛函理论（DFT）来识别富锂氟氧化物中大量的三阶非加性构型能量贡献，这是二次无约束二元优化（QUBO）模型无法表示的。我们使用成分保持 DFT 能量图，在两种无序岩盐阴极材料 Li2MnO2F (LMOF) 和 Li2Mn₀.₅Ti₀.₅O2F (LMTiOF) 中测试从 QUBO 到高阶无约束二元优化 (HUBO) 的扩展。使用固定几何能量图，我们表明立方 HUBO 捕获了 QUBO 模型中缺少的非加性贡献，并大大减少了两种材料的拟合误差。直接 DFT 能量差异证实了三阶非加和性，而磁性初始化的比较揭示了 LMTiOF 贡献对收敛电子态的强烈依赖性。这些结果支持在构型能量学建模时包含高阶项，并强调在构建 DFT 能量图时需要考虑磁态依赖性。提取的术语描述了保持组成的交换变量之间的有效耦合，而不是唯一确定的微观三原子相互作用。

articles.title: Strain-overlap and surface-confinement engineering in AlScN/YIG magnetoacoustic devices
articles.title_zh: AlScN/YIG 磁声器件中的应变重叠和表面限制工程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38399v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We establish AlScN/YIG/GGG as an integrated piezoelectric-magnetic heterostructure for electrically generating surface acoustic waves (SAWs) and coupling them to spin waves in monocrystalline YIG. Combining electrical transmission measurements of interdigital-transducer delay lines with finite-element simulations, we identify the excited modes as Rayleigh-type SAWs whose surface confinement varies strongly with AlScN thickness. The resulting changes in the strain field within YIG directly modify the magnetoelastic coupling. Using the simulated complex strain components and an effective-driving-field model, we calculate the relative SAW attenuation for several AlScN thicknesses and wavelengths. The calculations qualitatively reproduce the measurements: at all investigated wavelengths, thinner AlScN layers yield stronger relative attenuation. Experimentally, the attenuation approaches 70dB/mm for a 54.5nm-thick AlScN layer at a wavelength of 1.2μm. However, the strongest relative attenuation does not maximize the detectable signal. Instead, the absolute field-induced transmission change peaks at an AlScN thickness of approximately 100nm, with the precise optimum depending on the acoustic wavelength. These results identify the AlScN thickness as a key design parameter for balancing magnetoelastic attenuation and pure SAW transmission in AlScN/YIG devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们将 AlScN/YIG/GGG 建立为集成压电磁异质结构，用于产生表面声波 (SAW) 并将其耦合到单晶 YIG 中的自旋波。将叉指换能器延迟线的电传输测量与有限元模拟相结合，我们将激发模式识别为瑞利型 SAW，其表面限制随 AlScN 厚度的变化而强烈变化。由此产生的 YIG 内应变场变化直接改变了磁弹性耦合。使用模拟的复杂应变分量和有效驱动场模型，我们计算了几种 AlScN 厚度和波长的相对 SAW 衰减。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们将 AlScN/YIG/GGG 建立为集成压电磁异质结构，用于产生表面声波 (SAW) 并将其耦合到单晶 YIG 中的自旋波。将叉指换能器延迟线的电传输测量与有限元模拟相结合，我们将激发模式识别为瑞利型 SAW，其表面限制随 AlScN 厚度的变化而强烈变化。由此产生的 YIG 内应变场变化直接改变了磁弹性耦合。使用模拟的复杂应变分量和有效驱动场模型，我们计算了几种 AlScN 厚度和波长的相对 SAW 衰减。计算定性地再现了测量结果：在所有研究的波长下，较薄的 AlScN 层会产生更强的相对衰减。实验表明，54.5nm 厚的 AlScN 层在 1.2μm 波长下的衰减接近 70dB/mm。然而，最强的相对衰减并不能最大化可检测信号。相反，绝对场引起的传输变化在 AlScN 厚度约为 100 nm 时达到峰值，精确的最佳值取决于声波波长。这些结果将 AlScN 厚度确定为平衡 AlScN/YIG 器件中磁致弹性衰减和纯 SAW 传输的关键设计参数。

articles.title: Layer-Parity Control of the Superconducting Diode Effect in Monolayer NbSe₂
articles.title_zh: 单层 NbSe2 超导二极管效应的层宇称控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38449v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The superconducting diode effect is often associated with finite-momentum pairing, although model studies indicate that rectification reflects the asymmetry of the free energy about its minimum rather than the equilibrium pair momentum itself. Using a Wannier-based, self-consistent finite-mathbf Q Bogoliubov-de Gennes approach with a Fermi-surface-adaptive quadrature that converges the critical currents, we show that the layer parity and orientation of magnetic proximity select the diode response of monolayer NbSe₂. For in-plane exchange, the equilibrium pair momentum mathbf Qᵣₘ ₑq and the diode efficiency are both linear in the layer-odd exchange contrast: parallel proximity on the two Se sublayers is reciprocal, and antiparallel proximity doubles the response. An out-of-plane component separates the two observables. It leaves mathbf Qᵣₘ ₑq nearly unchanged but, through pair breaking, suppresses the efficiency by more than an order of magnitude and, at low temperature, reverses it. Purely out-of-plane exchange, for which C₃ symmetry forbids a helical term, keeps mathbf Qᵣₘ ₑq=0 yet produces a trigonal diode effect, controlled by the layer-even exchange and larger than the in-plane one above 0.65~meV at low temperature. Magnetic layer parity thus selects between a helical and a trigonal diode channel. The trigonal channel is an intrinsic, symmetry-allowed contribution to the field-free rectification reported in NbSe₂/CrBr₃ and predicts that two-sided out-of-plane proximity cancels it when antiparallel and, at the same exchange per layer, enhances it about fourfold when parallel, in the computed range.
articles.abstract_zh: 超导二极管效应通常与有限动量配对相关，尽管模型研究表明整流反映了自由能关于其最小值的不对称性，而不是平衡对动量本身的不对称性。使用基于 Wannier 的自洽有限数学 bf Q Bogoliubov-de Gennes 方法以及收敛临界电流的费米表面自适应求积法，我们证明了层奇偶性和磁接近方向选择了单层 NbSe2 的二极管响应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 超导二极管效应通常与有限动量配对相关，尽管模型研究表明整流反映了自由能关于其最小值的不对称性，而不是平衡对动量本身的不对称性。使用基于 Wannier 的自洽有限数学 bf Q Bogoliubov-de Gennes 方法以及收敛临界电流的费米表面自适应求积法，我们证明了层奇偶性和磁接近方向选择了单层 NbSe2 的二极管响应。对于面内交换，平衡对动量 mathbf Qᵣₘ ₑq 和二极管效率在奇数层交换对比中都是线性的：两个 Se 子层上的平行接近是倒数的，反平行接近使响应加倍。平面外分量将两个可观察量分开。它使 mathbf Qᵣₘ ₑq 几乎保持不变，但通过对破坏，将效率抑制了一个数量级以上，并且在低温下将其逆转。纯面外交换，由于 C₃ 对称性禁止螺旋项，保持 mathbf Qᵣₘ ₑq=0，但产生三角二极管效应，受层偶交换控制，在低温下比面内交换大 0.65~meV 以上。因此，磁性层奇偶校验在螺旋二极管沟道和三角形二极管沟道之间进行选择。三角通道是一种内在的、对称性允许的对 NbSe2/CrBr3 中报告的无场整流的贡献，并预测当反平行时，两侧平面外接近会抵消它，并且在每层相同的交换下，在计算范围内，当平行时将其增强约四倍。

articles.title: Coherent Electronic Lensing in Proximitized Graphene
articles.title_zh: 邻近石墨烯中的相干电子透镜
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38476v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spatially resolved control of coherent electron transport offers a route to understanding and engineering interference phenomena in hybrid superconducting devices. Here, we use Scanning Gate Microscopy (SGM) to investigate Fabry-Pérot (FP) interference in the n-p-n cavity of a ballistic graphene Josephson junction. Spatial maps of the superconducting switching current and normal-state conductance reveal circular interference fringes arising from two distinct effects of the SGM tip potential. A global shift of the Fermi wave vector modulates the FP resonances of the cavity, while a local perturbation produces additional oscillations that persist at fixed Fermi wave vector as the tip bias is varied. An analytical model identifies the origin of this local response with coherent electron lensing, in which the tip modifies the phase accumulated along interfering trajectories. The measured fringe patterns in the switching current indicate that this mechanism affects superconducting transport, consistent with tip-induced shifts of the resonance conditions for Andreev bound states. These results establish SGM as a tunable local lens for controlling interference in superconducting ballistic graphene devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 相干电子传输的空间分辨控制为理解和设计混合超导器件中的干扰现象提供了一条途径。在这里，我们使用扫描门显微镜（SGM）来研究弹道石墨烯约瑟夫森结的 n-p-n 腔中的法布里-珀罗（FP）干涉。超导开关电流和正常状态电导的空间图揭示了由 SGM 尖端电势的两种不同效应引起的圆形干涉条纹。费米波矢量的全局偏移调制腔的 FP 共振，而局部扰动会产生额外的振荡，随着尖端偏置的变化，这些振荡持续在固定的费米波矢量处。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 相干电子传输的空间分辨控制为理解和设计混合超导器件中的干扰现象提供了一条途径。在这里，我们使用扫描门显微镜（SGM）来研究弹道石墨烯约瑟夫森结的 n-p-n 腔中的法布里-珀罗（FP）干涉。超导开关电流和正常状态电导的空间图揭示了由 SGM 尖端电势的两种不同效应引起的圆形干涉条纹。费米波矢量的全局偏移调制腔的 FP 共振，而局部扰动会产生额外的振荡，随着尖端偏置的变化，这些振荡持续在固定的费米波矢量处。分析模型通过相干电子透镜识别了这种局部响应的起源，其中尖端修改了沿着干涉轨迹累积的相位。测量的开关电流中的条纹图案表明这种机制影响超导输运，与尖端引起的安德烈夫束缚态共振条件的变化一致。这些结果使 SGM 成为一种可调谐局部透镜，用于控制超导弹道石墨烯器件中的干扰。

articles.title: Strain-Induced BCC-to-FCC Transformation in Tungsten Uncovered by Molecular Dynamics Simulations with Machine Learning Potentials
articles.title_zh: 具有机器学习潜力的分子动力学模拟揭示了钨中应变诱导的 BCC 到 FCC 转变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38477v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Polymorphic transformations occur in a minority of metals. Tungsten is not one of them. This observation does not rule out its intrinsic phase transition possibility, but may be due to inaccessible thermodynamic and mechanical conditions in conventional experiments. Herein, we investigate the body centered cubic (BCC) to face centered cubic (FCC) transformation in tungsten via a rigorously validated machine learning potential (MLP) molecular dynamics (MD) approach. Our simulations demonstrate that strain induced BCC to FCC transformation indeed occurs in tungsten. The FCC phase exceeds 20 at.% at low temperature and in the presence of dislocations. In the perfect crystal moderate temperatures favor phase transformation kinetics. Structural analysis confirms the transformation following the Bain and Nishiyama Wassermann orientation relationship. These results establish the viability of strain induced polymorphic transformation in tungsten and provide a critical guideline for the experimental production of duplex tungsten with enhanced ductility addressing a longstanding challenge in tungsten material engineering for high-temperature structural applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 少数金属会发生多晶型转变。钨不是其中之一。这一观察结果并不排除其固有的相变可能性，但可能是由于常规实验中无法达到的热力学和机械条件所致。在此，我们通过经过严格验证的机器学习势 (MLP) 分子动力学 (MD) 方法研究了钨中的体心立方 (BCC) 到面心立方 (FCC) 的转变。我们的模拟表明，应变诱导的 BCC 到 FCC 转变确实发生在钨中。在低温且存在位错的情况下，FCC 相超过 20 at.%。在完美的晶体中，适度的温度有利于相变动力学。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 少数金属会发生多晶型转变。钨不是其中之一。这一观察结果并不排除其固有的相变可能性，但可能是由于常规实验中无法达到的热力学和机械条件所致。在此，我们通过经过严格验证的机器学习势 (MLP) 分子动力学 (MD) 方法研究了钨中的体心立方 (BCC) 到面心立方 (FCC) 的转变。我们的模拟表明，应变诱导的 BCC 到 FCC 转变确实发生在钨中。在低温且存在位错的情况下，FCC 相超过 20 at.%。在完美的晶体中，适度的温度有利于相变动力学。结构分析证实了遵循 Bain 和 Nishiyama Wassermann 取向关系的转变。这些结果确立了钨中应变诱导多晶型转变的可行性，并为具有增强延展性的双相钨的实验生产提供了关键指导，解决了高温结构应用钨材料工程中长期存在的挑战。

articles.title: Reciprocal transverse Seebeck and Peltier effects in MoSi2
articles.title_zh: MoSi2 中的相互横向塞贝克效应和珀耳帖效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38506v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Transverse thermoelectric conversion, in which charge and heat currents are interconverted in orthogonal directions, has recently attracted increasing attention as an alternative to conventional longitudinal thermoelectric conversion. Although transverse Seebeck effect has been investigated in various materials, its reciprocal process, transverse Peltier effect, remains much less explored, and direct comparison of the two effects in the same homogeneous material is still limited. Here, we experimentally investigate both transverse Seebeck and Peltier effects in a single crystal of MoSi2, an axis-dependent conduction polarity material in which the sign of the Seebeck coefficient varies depending on the crystallographic axis. Multi-terminal voltage measurement determines the direction of the induced internal electric field and establishes the transverse Seebeck response. We also directly visualize the transverse temperature modulation consistent with the corresponding transverse Peltier effect by using lock-in thermography under an applied ac current. These results establish reciprocal transverse thermoelectric conversion in a homogeneous nonmagnetic single crystal without engineered interfaces.
articles.abstract_zh: 横向热电转换（其中电荷和热流在正交方向上相互转换）作为传统纵向热电转换的替代方案最近引起了越来越多的关注。尽管横向塞贝克效应已在各种材料中进行了研究，但其交互过程，横向珀尔帖效应，仍然很少被研究，并且在同一均质材料中直接比较这两种效应仍然有限。在这里，我们通过实验研究了 MoSi2 单晶中的横向塞贝克效应和珀耳帖效应，MoSi2 是一种轴相关的传导极性材料，其中塞贝克系数的符号根据晶轴而变化。多端子电压测量确定感应内部电场的方向并建立横向塞贝克响应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 横向热电转换（其中电荷和热流在正交方向上相互转换）作为传统纵向热电转换的替代方案最近引起了越来越多的关注。尽管横向塞贝克效应已在各种材料中进行了研究，但其交互过程，横向珀尔帖效应，仍然很少被研究，并且在同一均质材料中直接比较这两种效应仍然有限。在这里，我们通过实验研究了 MoSi2 单晶中的横向塞贝克效应和珀耳帖效应，MoSi2 是一种轴相关的传导极性材料，其中塞贝克系数的符号根据晶轴而变化。多端子电压测量确定感应内部电场的方向并建立横向塞贝克响应。我们还通过在施加的交流电流下使用锁定热成像技术，直接可视化与相应的横向珀耳帖效应一致的横向温度调制。这些结果在均匀非磁性单晶中建立了相互横向热电转换，无需设计界面。

articles.title: Giant piezomagnetic response driven by spin reorientation in the topological Kagome magnet TbMn6Sn6
articles.title_zh: 拓扑 Kagome 磁体 TbMn6Sn6 中自旋重定向驱动的巨压磁响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38528v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Achieving a large strain response to a small magnetic-field variation remains a challenge in magnetomechanical materials, particularly in topological systems where the coupling between spin reconstruction and lattice deformation remains unclear. Here, we report an anomalous magnetostrictive response associated with field-induced spin reorientation in the topological Kagome magnet TbMn6Sn6. Below its spin-reorientation temperature of 310 K, an in-plane magnetic field induces an abrupt increase in magnetostriction, which exceeds 120 ppm at 240 K. This transition produces a giant differential piezomagnetic coefficient of approximately 5000 ppm T-1, far exceeding the values reported for other topological magnetic materials and commercial FeGa alloys, and placing TbMn6Sn6 among the most field-sensitive magnetostrictive materials. The field position of this peak agrees with the anomalies in magnetization and magnetotransport, demonstrating that the large differential response is tied to field-induced spin reorientation. Thermal expansion also changes across the spin-reorientation boundary. Raman measurements reveal corresponding anomalies in phonon energy and linewidth, indicating that the reorientation modifies the lattice dynamics. The combined results support a mechanism in which competing magnetic anisotropies of the Tb and Mn sublattices, coupled through Tb-Mn exchange, create magnetic configurations with different equilibrium strains. This finding establishes spin reorientation as a route to giant piezomagnetic responses in topological magnets and provides a basis for magnetomechanical sensing and switching near room temperature.
articles.abstract_zh: 在磁力材料中实现对小磁场变化的大应变响应仍然是一个挑战，特别是在自旋重构和晶格变形之间的耦合仍不清楚的拓扑系统中。在这里，我们报告了拓扑 Kagome 磁体 TbMn6Sn6 中与场诱导自旋重定向相关的反常磁致伸缩响应。在 310 K 的自旋重定向温度以下，面内磁场会引起磁致伸缩突然增加，在 240 K 时磁致伸缩超过 120 ppm。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在磁力材料中实现对小磁场变化的大应变响应仍然是一个挑战，特别是在自旋重构和晶格变形之间的耦合仍不清楚的拓扑系统中。在这里，我们报告了拓扑 Kagome 磁体 TbMn6Sn6 中与场诱导自旋重定向相关的反常磁致伸缩响应。在 310 K 的自旋重定向温度以下，面内磁场会引起磁致伸缩突然增加，在 240 K 时磁致伸缩超过 120 ppm。这种转变产生约 5000 ppm T-1 的巨大微分压磁系数，远远超过其他拓扑磁性材料和商用 FeGa 合金的报告值，并使 TbMn6Sn6 成为对场最敏感的磁致伸缩材料之一。该峰的场位置与磁化和磁输运的异常一致，表明大的微分响应与场诱导的自旋重新取向有关。热膨胀也会在自旋重定向边界上发生变化。拉曼测量揭示了声子能量和线宽的相应异常，表明重新取向改变了晶格动力学。综合结果支持了一种机制，其中 Tb 和 Mn 子晶格的竞争磁各向异性通过 Tb-Mn 交换耦合，产生具有不同平衡应变的磁性构型。这一发现确立了自旋重新取向作为拓扑磁体中巨大压磁响应的途径，并为室温附近的磁力传感和切换提供了基础。

articles.title: Nonreciprocal Floquet tunneling dynamics of spin-orbit-coupled bosonic atoms in a non-Hermitian double-well potential
articles.title_zh: 非厄米双阱势中自旋轨道耦合玻色原子的非互易 Floquet 隧道动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38597v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The stable tunneling dynamics in non-Hermitian quantum systems is one of the fundamental issues in the study of quantum transport. Nonreciprocal coupling, as another crucial manifestation of non-Hermiticity, exerts significant regulatory effects on the stability of quantum devices and on spin tunneling dynamics. Here we place spin-orbit-coupled bosonic atoms in a double-well potential with gain and loss, and investigate the effect of nonreciprocal coupling on the system dynamics. Through an analytical analysis of the Floquet states and the quasi-energy spectrum under periodic driving, we obtain the PT-symmetry phase diagram of the system. We further explore the synergistic regulation mechanism of several factors---including the strength of nonreciprocal coupling, the non-Hermitian strength arising from gain-loss, and the periodic driving---on stable spin-flip tunneling. The results show that precise manipulation of nonreciprocity and gain-loss can substantially enlarge the stable parameter region.
