In nonreciprocal systems with balanced gain and loss, the continuity or discreteness of the stable parameter region is determined by the parity of the driving-frequency ratio Ω/ω, and the spin-flip tunneling can be precisely controlled through the parameters λ and 2ε/ω. For the unbalanced gain-loss scenario, the equilibrium conditions for achieving stable spin-flip tunneling under different parities of Ω/ω are further provided. These findings offer a new theoretical approach for realizing robust spin-flip tunneling, provide guiding significance for the study of quantum-state transport in non-Hermitian ultracold atomic systems, and also serve as a reference for the experimental design of novel spin-based quantum devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 非厄米量子系统中的稳定隧道动力学是量子输运研究的基本问题之一。非互易耦合作为非厄米性的另一个重要表现，对量子器件的稳定性和自旋隧道动力学具有重要的调节作用。在这里，我们将自旋轨道耦合的玻色原子置于具有增益和损耗的双阱势中，并研究非互易耦合对系统动力学的影响。通过对周期驱动下Floquet态和准能谱的解析分析，得到了系统的PT对称相图。我们进一步探讨了非互易耦合强度、增益损失产生的非厄米强度以及周期性驱动等多种因素对稳定自旋翻转隧道效应的协同调节机制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非厄米量子系统中的稳定隧道动力学是量子输运研究的基本问题之一。非互易耦合作为非厄米性的另一个重要表现，对量子器件的稳定性和自旋隧道动力学具有重要的调节作用。在这里，我们将自旋轨道耦合的玻色原子置于具有增益和损耗的双阱势中，并研究非互易耦合对系统动力学的影响。通过对周期驱动下Floquet态和准能谱的解析分析，得到了系统的PT对称相图。我们进一步探讨了非互易耦合强度、增益损失产生的非厄米强度以及周期性驱动等多种因素对稳定自旋翻转隧道效应的协同调节机制。结果表明，精确控制不可逆性和增益损失可以显着扩大稳定参数区域。在增益和损耗平衡的不可逆系统中，稳定参数区域的连续性或离散性由驱动频率比Ω/ω的奇偶性决定，并且可以通过参数λ和2ε/ω精确控制自旋翻转隧道效应。对于不平衡增益损失场景，进一步提供了在不同Ω/ω奇偶性下实现稳定自旋翻转隧道的平衡条件。这些发现为实现鲁棒的自旋翻转隧道效应提供了新的理论方法，对非厄米超冷原子系统中量子态输运的研究具有指导意义，也为新型自旋量子器件的实验设计提供了参考。

articles.title: High-Performance Nuclear Demagnetization Refrigerator Reaching 50 μK
articles.title_zh: 达到50μK的高性能核消磁制冷机
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38622v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Research in the deep sub-mK regime around 0.1 mK may open new opportunities in condensed matter physics in light of recent rapid progress in quantum technologies and quantum materials. Here, we report the design and performance of a nuclear demagnetization system that provides efficient access to the deep sub-mK regime for a wide range of experiments, using a standard wet dilution refrigerator with a medium-sized copper nuclear stage. We show that the temperature measured by a Pt NMR thermometer reaches 50 μK and that the refrigerator can maintain 100 μK for more than ten days. Remarkably, even with only 12 hours of precooling, the refrigerator cools into the deep sub-mK regime and can maintain 100 μK for more than three days, providing sufficient time for sample measurements. Numerical analyses indicate that the copper nuclear-spin system is cooled to about 18 μK, whereas a local heat leak to the thermometer limits the thermometer temperature to about 50 μK. These features establish the system as a practical platform for efficient experiments in the deep sub-mK regime.
articles.abstract_zh: 鉴于近期量子技术和量子材料的快速进展，0.1 mK 左右的深亚 mK 范围的研究可能会为凝聚态物理带来新的机遇。在这里，我们报告了核退磁系统的设计和性能，该系统使用带有中型铜核阶段的标准湿稀释制冷机，为各种实验提供有效进入深亚 mK 状态的途径。我们证明，Pt NMR 温度计测量的温度达到 50 μK，并且冰箱可以保持 100 μK 十天以上。值得注意的是，即使仅预冷 12 小时，冰箱也能冷却至深亚 mK 状态，并可维持 100 μK 超过三天，为样品测量提供了充足的时间。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 鉴于近期量子技术和量子材料的快速进展，0.1 mK 左右的深亚 mK 范围的研究可能会为凝聚态物理带来新的机遇。在这里，我们报告了核退磁系统的设计和性能，该系统使用带有中型铜核阶段的标准湿稀释制冷机，为各种实验提供有效进入深亚 mK 状态的途径。我们证明，Pt NMR 温度计测量的温度达到 50 μK，并且冰箱可以保持 100 μK 十天以上。值得注意的是，即使仅预冷 12 小时，冰箱也能冷却至深亚 mK 状态，并可维持 100 μK 超过三天，为样品测量提供了充足的时间。数值分析表明，铜核自旋系统被冷却至约 18 μK，而温度计的局部热泄漏将温度计温度限制在约 50 μK。这些功能使该系统成为在深度 sub-mK 体系中进行高效实验的实用平台。

articles.title: Topology of Wannierizable Insulators
articles.title_zh: 可瓦尼尔化绝缘体的拓扑
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38626v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the freedom in choosing Wannier centers and the associated symmetry representations in noninteracting Wannierizable insulators. We compare Wyckoff deformations of atomic configurations with symmetry-preserving adiabatic deformations of occupied states, both with and without adding common occupied atomic orbitals. Explicit examples show that stable Wyckoff equivalence and adiabatic equivalence at fixed filling do not imply each other. In spinless Fm'm'm', an Euler class distinguishes stably Wyckoff-equivalent configurations. In spinless Poverline1', adiabatically equivalent configurations remain distinct under stable Wyckoff deformations. We also classify when stable Wyckoff and stable adiabatic equivalence coincide. They agree in two or fewer dimensions and in three-dimensional spinful systems. For three-dimensional spinless systems, Chern insulator pumps give additional equivalences in 134 magnetic space groups. These groups preserve spacetime orientation and have a point whose site-symmetry group contains 222, overline1', or overline4'.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了选择万尼尔中心的自由度以及非相互作用万尼尔化绝缘体中相关的对称表示。我们将原子构型的威科夫变形与占据态的保对称绝热变形进行比较，无论是否添加共同占据原子轨道。明确的例子表明，固定填充时的稳定威科夫等价和绝热等价并不相互暗示。在无自旋 Fm'm'm' 中，欧拉类区分稳定的威科夫等价构型。在无自旋 Poverline1' 中，绝热等效构型在稳定的威科夫变形下仍然不同。我们还对稳定威科夫和稳定绝热等价一致时进行分类。它们在二维或更少维度以及三维旋转系统中是一致的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了选择万尼尔中心的自由度以及非相互作用万尼尔化绝缘体中相关的对称表示。我们将原子构型的威科夫变形与占据态的保对称绝热变形进行比较，无论是否添加共同占据原子轨道。明确的例子表明，固定填充时的稳定威科夫等价和绝热等价并不相互暗示。在无自旋 Fm'm'm' 中，欧拉类区分稳定的威科夫等价构型。在无自旋 Poverline1' 中，绝热等效构型在稳定的威科夫变形下仍然不同。我们还对稳定威科夫和稳定绝热等价一致时进行分类。它们在二维或更少维度以及三维旋转系统中是一致的。对于三维无旋转系统，陈绝缘体泵在 134 个磁空间群中给出了额外的等价性。这些组保留时空方向，并且有一个点，其位点对称组包含 222、overline1' 或 overline4'。

articles.title: Uniaxial strain tuning of functional properties in antiferroelectric PbZrO3 membrane capacitors
articles.title_zh: 反铁电 PbZrO3 薄膜电容器功能特性的单轴应变调谐
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38627v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Lead zirconate (PbZrO3, PZO) is a prototypical antiferroelectric (AFE) system promising for applications such as energy storage and neuromorphic computing. However, in conventional thin-film architectures, its functional potential is often limited by substrate clamping. Although emerging freestanding membrane techniques offer an approach to release this clamping and enable dynamic strain engineering, a systematic understanding of how external strain modulates the switching between AFE and ferroelectric (FE) states is missing. In this study, we investigate the uniaxial strain effects on PZO membrane capacitors transferred onto flexible substrates via a gold-bonding method. We demonstrate that in-plane dynamic strain modulates the AFE-FE switching and functional properties. Corroborated by atomistic simulations, we reveal that the strain-dependent evolution arises from the superposition of the intrinsic strain dependence of specific domain orientation variants and extrinsic strain-induced redistribution of the relative population of different domain variants. These findings provide a predictive understanding of uniaxial strain tuning of AFE-FE switching in PZO, and pave the way for exploiting the functional potential of freestanding antiferroelectric membranes.
articles.abstract_zh: 锆酸铅（PbZrO3，PZO）是一种典型的反铁电（AFE）系统，有望用于能量存储和神经形态计算等应用。然而，在传统的薄膜架构中，其功能潜力通常受到基板夹持的限制。尽管新兴的独立式膜技术提供了一种释放这种钳位并实现动态应变工程的方法，但仍缺乏对外部应变如何调节 AFE 和铁电 (FE) 状态之间切换的系统理解。在这项研究中，我们研究了通过金键合方法转移到柔性基板上的 PZO 薄膜电容器的单轴应变效应。我们证明面内动态应变可调节 AFE-FE 切换和功能特性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 锆酸铅（PbZrO3，PZO）是一种典型的反铁电（AFE）系统，有望用于能量存储和神经形态计算等应用。然而，在传统的薄膜架构中，其功能潜力通常受到基板夹持的限制。尽管新兴的独立式膜技术提供了一种释放这种钳位并实现动态应变工程的方法，但仍缺乏对外部应变如何调节 AFE 和铁电 (FE) 状态之间切换的系统理解。在这项研究中，我们研究了通过金键合方法转移到柔性基板上的 PZO 薄膜电容器的单轴应变效应。我们证明面内动态应变可调节 AFE-FE 切换和功能特性。通过原子模拟证实，我们揭示了应变依赖性演化是由特定域方向变体的内在应变依赖性和外在应变引起的不同域变体相对群体的重新分布的叠加而产生的。这些发现提供了对 PZO 中 AFE-FE 切换的单轴应变调谐的预测性理解，并为开发独立式反铁电膜的功能潜力铺平了道路。

articles.title: Amorphous selenium-alloyed TeOx thin-film solar cells
articles.title_zh: 非晶硒合金TeOx薄膜太阳能电池
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38643v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tellurium dioxide (TeO₂) is a wide-bandgap oxide with attractive processing versatility and emerging p-type semiconducting behaviour, making it a promising material system for optoelectronic and photovoltaic applications. However, TeO₂-derived thin films prepared by scalable manufacturing processes, such as vacuum sublimation, can contain residual metallic Te⁰ species that introduce trap states, limit hole transport, and promote carrier recombination. Here, we demonstrate a selenium alloying strategy to control the defect chemistry of vacuum-sublimed TeOₓ films. TeO₂:Se powder mixtures (90:10~wt%) were thermally evaporated and subsequently annealed in air at 225~^circC for up to 9~h, yielding amorphous TeOₓ:Se films with an optical bandgap of 0.98~eV under optimised conditions. Structural, chemical, optical, and electrical analyses show that prolonged annealing promotes Se redistribution, suppresses residual Te⁰ to approximately 0.4%, reduces the film's surface roughness, and shifts the valence-band edge. To evaluate the potential of TeOₓ:Se for photovoltaic applications, we fabricated thin-film solar cells with an ITO/ZnO/TeOₓ:Se/MoOₓ/Ag architecture. Devices based on an 80~nm TeOₓ:Se active layer annealed for 9~h exhibit optimal performance, with broadband photocurrent generation from 300 to 1000~nm, yielding an open-circuit voltage of 0.50~V, a short-circuit current density of 8.50~mA~cm⁻², a fill factor of 0.44, and a maximum power conversion efficiency of approximately 1.87%. These results establish selenium-alloyed TeOₓ as a viable oxide-derived absorber for thin-film photovoltaics and highlight chemical-state control as an effective route for improving photovoltaic performance.
articles.abstract_zh: 二氧化碲 (TeO2) 是一种宽带隙氧化物，具有有吸引力的加工多功能性和新兴的 p 型半导体行为，使其成为光电和光伏应用的一种有前景的材料系统。然而，通过可扩展的制造工艺（例如真空升华）制备的 TeO2 衍生薄膜可能含有残留的金属 Te⁰ 物质，这些物质会引入陷阱态、限制空穴传输并促进载流子复合。在这里，我们展示了一种硒合金化策略来控制真空升华 TeOₓ 薄膜的缺陷化学。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 二氧化碲 (TeO2) 是一种宽带隙氧化物，具有有吸引力的加工多功能性和新兴的 p 型半导体行为，使其成为光电和光伏应用的一种有前景的材料系统。然而，通过可扩展的制造工艺（例如真空升华）制备的 TeO2 衍生薄膜可能含有残留的金属 Te⁰ 物质，这些物质会引入陷阱态、限制空穴传输并促进载流子复合。在这里，我们展示了一种硒合金化策略来控制真空升华 TeOₓ 薄膜的缺陷化学。将TeO 2 :Se粉末混合物(90:10~wt%)热蒸发，随后在225℃下在空气中退火长达9~h，在优化条件下产生光学带隙为0.98~eV的非晶TeO 3 :Se薄膜。结构、化学、光学和电学分析表明，延长退火可促进 Se 重新分布，将残留 Te⁰ 抑制至约 0.4%，降低薄膜的表面粗糙度，并移动价带边缘。为了评估 TeOₓ:Se 在光伏应用中的潜力，我们制造了具有 ITO/ZnO/TeOₓ:Se/MoOₓ/Ag 架构的薄膜太阳能电池。基于退火9~h的80~nm TeOₓ:Se有源层的器件表现出最佳性能，宽带光电流产生范围为300~1000~nm，开路电压为0.50~V，短路电流密度为8.50~mA~cm-2，填充因子为0.44，最大功率转换效率约为1.87%。这些结果表明，硒合金TeOₓ是一种可行的薄膜光伏氧化物吸收剂，并强调化学态控制是提高光伏性能的有效途径。

articles.title: Symmetries and Propagation of Surface Plasmon Polaritons in Axion Electrodynamics
articles.title_zh: 轴子电动力学中表面等离子体激元的对称性和传播
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38692v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Surface plasmon polaritons at the interface between a conductor governed by axion electrodynamics and an ordinary dielectric are studied using a general phenomenological model, in which the macroscopic response is described by an axial vector  G , responsible for the anomalous Hall effect, and a pseudoscalar  W , accounting for the chiral magnetic effect. We extend the analysis of the chiral magnetic effect in the planar geometry, address its role in the cylindrical one and, in both geometries, discuss the case in which the two effects coexist. We find an upper bound on  W , a nonreciprocity requiring both effects and the absence of freely propagating modes, depending on the orientation of  G , for the planar interface, and, for the cylindrical one, a novel coupling between the linear and orbital angular momenta of the modes, which already arises from the chiral magnetic effect alone and persists when the anomalous Hall effect is also present. The exact eigenmodes of the axion medium are derived, and the symmetries and propagation features of the surface modes are made explicit by analytical and asymptotic evaluation of the dispersion relations.
articles.abstract_zh: 使用一般唯象模型研究了受轴子电动力学控制的导体与普通电介质之间界面处的表面等离子体激元，其中宏观响应由轴向矢量 G 和赝标量 W 描述，其中轴向矢量 G 负责反常霍尔效应，赝标量 W 负责手性磁效应。我们扩展了平面几何中手性磁效应的分析，解决了其在圆柱几何中的作用，并在两种几何中讨论了两种效应共存的情况。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 使用一般唯象模型研究了受轴子电动力学控制的导体与普通电介质之间界面处的表面等离子体激元，其中宏观响应由轴向矢量 G 和赝标量 W 描述，其中轴向矢量 G 负责反常霍尔效应，赝标量 W 负责手性磁效应。我们扩展了平面几何中手性磁效应的分析，解决了其在圆柱几何中的作用，并在两种几何中讨论了两种效应共存的情况。我们找到了 W 的上限，即一种非互易性，需要效应和不存在自由传播模式，具体取决于 G 的方向，对于平面界面，对于圆柱界面，模式的线性和轨道角动量之间存在一种新颖的耦合，这种耦合已经单独由手性磁效应产生，并且当反常霍尔效应也存在时仍然存在。推导了轴子介质的精确本征模，并通过色散关系的解析和渐近评估明确了表面模的对称性和传播特征。

articles.title: Large connectivity expansion of Ising Spin Glasses on random graphs
articles.title_zh: 伊辛旋转玻璃在随机图上的大连通性扩展
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38724v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We compute a high-connectivity analytical expansion for Ising spin glasses on sparse random graphs. We expand the cavity equations around the fully-connected mean-field limit, focusing on the critical behavior of the system: our approach allows us to compute the de Almeida-Thouless line of mean-field finitely-connected systems in the temperature T--magnetic field H plane, by means of closed analytical equations. The exact cavity solution of such systems can only be obtained by solving numerically iterative equations, so our approach brings a notable computational advantage. On the theoretical side, we are able to identify three sources of corrections to the fully-connected mean-field solution: i) the non-Gaussianity of the cavity fields, ii) the statistical correlation between the cavity fields and their fluctuations, and iii) the corrections to the cavity filter functions. These corrections are treated using two different expansions: a non-uniform expansion, where we expand all three contributions around the mean-field solution, and a uniform expansion, where we only expand the statistics but leave the cavity filters untouched. The former allows for a direct comparison with the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick model but fails at low temperatures, as a consequence of the de Almeida-Thouless line diverging in the zero-temperature limit. On the other hand, the uniform expansion describes with good accuracy the critical behavior of the system. We also extend these results to the T = 0 limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们在稀疏随机图上计算伊辛自旋玻璃的高连通性分析展开式。我们围绕全连通平均场极限展开腔方程，重点关注系统的临界行为：我们的方法允许我们通过闭合解析方程计算温度 T-磁场 H 平面中平均场有限连通系统的 de Almeida-Thouless 线。此类系统的精确腔解只能通过求解数值迭代方程来获得，因此我们的方法带来了显着的计算优势。在理论方面，我们能够确定全连接平均场解的三个校正源：i）腔场的非高斯性，ii）腔场及其波动之间的统计相关性，以及iii）对腔滤波器函数的校正。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们在稀疏随机图上计算伊辛自旋玻璃的高连通性分析展开式。我们围绕全连通平均场极限展开腔方程，重点关注系统的临界行为：我们的方法允许我们通过闭合解析方程计算温度 T-磁场 H 平面中平均场有限连通系统的 de Almeida-Thouless 线。此类系统的精确腔解只能通过求解数值迭代方程来获得，因此我们的方法带来了显着的计算优势。在理论方面，我们能够确定全连接平均场解的三个校正源：i）腔场的非高斯性，ii）腔场及其波动之间的统计相关性，以及iii）对腔滤波器函数的校正。这些校正使用两种不同的扩展进行处理：非均匀扩展，我们扩展平均场解周围的所有三个贡献，以及均匀扩展，我们仅扩展统计数据，但保持空腔滤波器不变。前者可以与 Sherrington-Kirkpatrick 模型进行直接比较，但在低温下会失败，因为 de Almeida-Thouless 线在零温度限制下发散。另一方面，均匀展开非常准确地描述了系统的关键行为。我们还将这些结果扩展到 T = 0 极限。

articles.title: A Luminescent Organic Triradical as an Optically Addressable Qudit
articles.title_zh: 发光有机三自由基作为光学可寻址 Qudit
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38762v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Luminescent molecular trityl radicals provide options for optically-addressable electron spins and are promising for quantum sensing. Here, we present a luminescent triradical comprising three trityl groups covalently attached to a central phenyl ring. We find two distinct photoluminescence bands at 633 nm and 690 nm with different temporal evolutions, which we attribute to excited quartet and doublet states respectively. The ground state quartet is 1 meV (11.5K) lower in energy than the doublet, resulting in near-equal population of doublets and quartets at room temperature. We demonstrate optically initialized spin polarization, coherent control of the ground state quartet, and optical readout. Potential for optical quantum sensing is shown via optically detected magnetic resonance at room temperature and magneto-photoluminescence up to 3% at 5 mT. This material is a candidate optically addressable molecular qudit, providing opportunities to leverage larger state spaces than qubit systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 发光分子三苯甲基自由基为光学可寻址电子自旋提供了选择，并且有望用于量子传感。在这里，我们提出了一种发光三自由基，包含三个共价连接到中心苯环的三苯甲基。我们在 633 nm 和 690 nm 处发现了两个不同的光致发光带，具有不同的时间演化，我们分别将其归因于激发四重态和双重态。基态四重态的能量比双重态低 1 meV (11.5K)，导致室温下双重态和四重态的数量几乎相等。我们演示了光学初始化的自旋偏振、基态四重态的相干控制和光学读出。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 发光分子三苯甲基自由基为光学可寻址电子自旋提供了选择，并且有望用于量子传感。在这里，我们提出了一种发光三自由基，包含三个共价连接到中心苯环的三苯甲基。我们在 633 nm 和 690 nm 处发现了两个不同的光致发光带，具有不同的时间演化，我们分别将其归因于激发四重态和双重态。基态四重态的能量比双重态低 1 meV (11.5K)，导致室温下双重态和四重态的数量几乎相等。我们演示了光学初始化的自旋偏振、基态四重态的相干控制和光学读出。通过室温下光学检测的磁共振和 5 mT 下高达 3% 的磁光致发光显示了光学量子传感的潜力。这种材料是候选的光学可寻址分子量子，提供了利用比量子位系统更大的状态空间的机会。

articles.title: Autonomous Quantum Measurement with Agentic AI
articles.title_zh: 使用代理 AI 进行自主量子测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38850v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum materials exhibit diverse electronic and functional phenomena, but their characterization requires extensive experimental expertise, iterative decision-making and accumulated laboratory knowledge that is difficult to document and transfer. Here we introduce Quantum Agent (QUANTA), an agentic artificial intelligence (AI) framework for autonomous quantum-materials characterization. Using a widely adopted Physical Property Measurement System (PPMS) as an experimental platform, QUANTA combines retrieval augmentation using scientific literature, experimental protocols and prior measurements with specialized agents for experimental planning, troubleshooting, and data interpretation. A separate deterministic control layer validates instrument actions. Guided by incoming data, QUANTA evaluates measurement quality, revises experimental plans and selects subsequent measurements. We demonstrate these capabilities through transport measurements of the topological Weyl semimetal TaP, as well as investigations of nonlinear responses in magnetic material Co2MnGa. These results establish QUANTA as a generalizable framework for evidence-driven, safeguarded and closed-loop quantum-materials characterization.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子材料表现出多种电子和功能现象，但其表征需要广泛的实验专业知识、迭代决策和积累的实验室知识，而这些知识难以记录和转移。在这里，我们介绍量子代理 (QUANTA)，这是一种用于自主量子材料表征的代理人工智能 (AI) 框架。 QUANTA 使用广泛采用的物理特性测量系统 (PPMS) 作为实验平台，将使用科学文献、实验方案和先前测量的检索增强与用于实验规划、故障排除和数据解释的专用代理相结合。单独的确定性控制层验证仪器操作。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子材料表现出多种电子和功能现象，但其表征需要广泛的实验专业知识、迭代决策和积累的实验室知识，而这些知识难以记录和转移。在这里，我们介绍量子代理 (QUANTA)，这是一种用于自主量子材料表征的代理人工智能 (AI) 框架。 QUANTA 使用广泛采用的物理特性测量系统 (PPMS) 作为实验平台，将使用科学文献、实验方案和先前测量的检索增强与用于实验规划、故障排除和数据解释的专用代理相结合。单独的确定性控制层验证仪器操作。在传入数据的指导下，QUANTA 评估测量质量、修改实验计划并选择后续测量。我们通过拓扑外尔半金属 TaP 的输运测量以及磁性材料 Co2MnGa 中非线性响应的研究来展示这些功能。这些结果将 QUANTA 确立为证据驱动、受保护和闭环量子材料表征的通用框架。

articles.title: Learning Between the Lines: Interaction Interpolation in a Multi Element Machine Learning Interatomic Potential
articles.title_zh: 字里行间的学习：多元素机器学习原子间势中的交互插值
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38876v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The continuous development of machine learning inter-atomic potentials (MLIAPs)has greatly accelerated materials research in recent years. However, the need to con- struct custom MLIAPs for each unique problem remains a bottleneck which raises the question of the transferability of MLIAPs. While foundation MLIAPs can achieve transferability due to the broad coverage of chemical space represented in their training sets, their size and computational cost limits their routine use. We address this gap by developing a lightweight general-purpose MLIAP for metal alloys spanning twelve elements (Al, Sc, Ti, V, Cu, Zn, Zr, Nb, Mo, Hf, Ta, W). Here, we utilize a step-wise active learning (AL) approach to develop a compact yet diverse dataset and model that generalizes well by interpolating from previously seen interactions. The resulting potentials transfer effectively to unseen, higher body-order alloys systems, requiring only unary and binary training data to capture ternary and quaternary systems. The model also transfers well to new elements via an alchemical extrapolation within the network, requiring only unary data for the new element and its alloys. These findings suggest that MLIAPs trained on targeted, diversity-driven datasets provide transferability at a relatively low computational cost, offering a practical path toward general-purpose, resource-efficient MLIAPs for materials modeling.
articles.abstract_zh: 近年来，机器学习原子间势（MLIAP）的不断发展极大地加速了材料研究。然而，为每个独特问题构建定制 MLIAP 的需求仍然是一个瓶颈，这引发了 MLIAP 的可转移性问题。虽然基础 MLIAP 由于其训练集中所代表的化学空间的广泛覆盖而可以实现可转移性，但它们的大小和计算成本限制了它们的常规使用。我们通过开发一种适用于十二种元素（Al、Sc、Ti、V、Cu、Zn、Zr、Nb、Mo、Hf、Ta、W）金属合金的轻质通用 MLIAP 来解决这一差距。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 近年来，机器学习原子间势（MLIAP）的不断发展极大地加速了材料研究。然而，为每个独特问题构建定制 MLIAP 的需求仍然是一个瓶颈，这引发了 MLIAP 的可转移性问题。虽然基础 MLIAP 由于其训练集中所代表的化学空间的广泛覆盖而可以实现可转移性，但它们的大小和计算成本限制了它们的常规使用。我们通过开发一种适用于十二种元素（Al、Sc、Ti、V、Cu、Zn、Zr、Nb、Mo、Hf、Ta、W）金属合金的轻质通用 MLIAP 来解决这一差距。在这里，我们利用逐步主动学习（AL）方法来开发一个紧凑而多样化的数据集和模型，通过从以前看到的交互中进行插值来很好地概括。由此产生的电势有效地转移到看不见的、更高体序的合金系统，只需要一元和二元训练数据来捕获三元和四元系统。该模型还通过网络内的炼金术外推法很好地转移到新元素，只需要新元素及其合金的一元数据。这些发现表明，在有针对性的、多样性驱动的数据集上训练的 MLIAP 以相对较低的计算成本提供可转移性，为实现通用、资源高效的材料建模 MLIAP 提供了一条实用途径。

articles.title: Collective sliding relaxor ferroelectricity across thousand-layer van der Waals superstructures
articles.title_zh: 跨越千层范德华上层结构的集体滑动弛豫铁电性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38928v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Relaxor ferroelectrics are among the most important electromechanical materials owing to their exceptionally large electrostrictive responses. However, conventional relaxor behavior is generally associated with chemical complexity and structural disorder, where local compositional fluctuations generate polar nanoregions, making the microscopic origin of this behavior difficult to control and engineer. Here we report sliding relaxor ferroelectricity (S-RFE), a previously unknown relaxor state in which engineered stacking-phase heterogeneity enables cooperative interlayer sliding to generate collective relaxor behavior. Through stacking-phase engineering in rhombohedral boron nitride, we create sliding domains that act as structural analogues of polar nanoregions and cooperatively align under an electric field through interlayer sliding. This collective state produces reversible electromechanical deformation of up to approximately -1.6% with negligible hysteresis in approximately 300-nm-thick crystals, corresponding to approximately 1000 atomic layers. The resulting electrostriction coefficient (Q₃₃ of approximately 1200,m⁴C⁻²) exceeds those of most crystalline electrostrictors by orders of magnitude. Unlike conventional relaxors, whose electromechanical response is often suppressed by dipolar freezing at low temperatures, S-RFE remains active down to 1.6 K and maintains giant electromechanical functionality. Our results establish sliding relaxor ferroelectricity as a new route to relaxor behavior and reveal how atomic-scale interlayer motion can be amplified into collective mesoscale functionality across approximately one thousand layers, providing a materials-by-design platform for electromechanical, photonic, and quantum technologies based on van der Waals materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 驰豫铁电体因其异常大的电致伸缩响应而成为最重要的机电材料之一。然而，传统的弛豫行为通常与化学复杂性和结构无序相关，其中局部成分波动产生极性纳米区域，使得这种行为的微观起源难以控制和工程设计。在这里，我们报告了滑动弛豫铁电（S-RFE），这是一种以前未知的弛豫状态，其中工程堆叠相异质性使得层间协同滑动能够产生集体弛豫行为。通过菱面体氮化硼的堆叠相工程，我们创建了滑动域，其充当极性纳米区域的结构类似物，并通过层间滑动在电场下协同排列。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 驰豫铁电体因其异常大的电致伸缩响应而成为最重要的机电材料之一。然而，传统的弛豫行为通常与化学复杂性和结构无序相关，其中局部成分波动产生极性纳米区域，使得这种行为的微观起源难以控制和工程设计。在这里，我们报告了滑动弛豫铁电（S-RFE），这是一种以前未知的弛豫状态，其中工程堆叠相异质性使得层间协同滑动能够产生集体弛豫行为。通过菱面体氮化硼的堆叠相工程，我们创建了滑动域，其充当极性纳米区域的结构类似物，并通过层间滑动在电场下协同排列。这种集体状态在约 300 nm 厚的晶体（相当于约 1000 个原子层）中产生高达约 -1.6% 的可逆机电变形，且滞后可忽略不计。由此产生的电致伸缩系数（Q₃₃ 约为 1200,m⁴C-²）比大多数晶体电致伸缩器的电致伸缩系数高出几个数量级。与传统的弛豫器不同，传统的弛豫器的机电响应通常会在低温下被偶极冻结所抑制，而 S-RFE 在低至 1.6 K 的温度下仍保持活性，并保持巨大的机电功能。我们的研究结果将滑动弛豫铁电性确立为弛豫行为的新途径，并揭示了如何将原子尺度的层间运动放大为跨越约一千层的集体介观尺度功能，从而为基于范德华材料的机电、光子和量子技术提供了材料设计平台。

articles.title: Development and application of a machine learning potential for diamond surfaces and their sliding interfaces with silicon nitride and silica: effect of passivation, orientation and load
articles.title_zh: 金刚石表面及其与氮化硅和二氧化硅滑动界面的机器学习潜力的开发和应用：钝化、取向和负载的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38937v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Friction and wear of diamond are controlled by its surface chemistry, which determines whether covalent bonds form across the sliding interface. First-principles simulations have explored the role of surface orientation and passivation, but are limited to a few hundred atoms and tens of picoseconds. To bridge this gap, we develop a reactive machine learning interatomic potential for the C/H/N/O/Si chemical space, covering diamond, silicon nitride, silicon oxide, their surfaces, interfaces, and environmental molecules. The potential is trained on a large dataset of diverse structures and is tested on multiple physical properties, including ab initio reaction barriers on diamond surfaces, and structural/mechanical properties of amorphous Si₃N₄ and SiO₂. We then simulate sliding of diamond-Si₃N₄ interfaces with four surface orientations, clean and H/OH-passivated terminations, and normal loads from 0.1 to 23 GPa. We identify two different regimes: one where sliding is localized at the interface, and shear stress is proportional to the interfacial bond density, and another where shear is distributed inside the softer material, and adhesion due to full interfacial bonding dominates. These results show how passivation, surface orientation and load together determine interfacial bonding and friction, with implications for the environmental sensitivity of diamond wear. More broadly, the potential enables reactive simulations of diamond, silicon nitride and silica with near-ab initio accuracy at length and time scales beyond first-principles methods, providing a useful tool for future studies of wear at plowing asperities, chemical-mechanical polishing, and properties of amorphous ceramic films.
articles.abstract_zh: 金刚石的摩擦和磨损由其表面化学控制，这决定了滑动界面上是否形成共价键。第一原理模拟探索了表面取向和钝化的作用，但仅限于几百个原子和几十皮秒。为了弥补这一差距，我们开发了 C/H/N/O/Si 化学空间的反应式机器学习原子间势，涵盖金刚石、氮化硅、氧化硅及其表面、界面和环境分子。该潜力在不同结构的大型数据集上进行了训练，并在多种物理特性上进行了测试，包括金刚石表面上的从头算反应势垒以及非晶 Si₃N₄ 和 SiO2 的结构/机械特性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 金刚石的摩擦和磨损由其表面化学控制，这决定了滑动界面上是否形成共价键。第一原理模拟探索了表面取向和钝化的作用，但仅限于几百个原子和几十皮秒。为了弥补这一差距，我们开发了 C/H/N/O/Si 化学空间的反应式机器学习原子间势，涵盖金刚石、氮化硅、氧化硅及其表面、界面和环境分子。该潜力在不同结构的大型数据集上进行了训练，并在多种物理特性上进行了测试，包括金刚石表面上的从头算反应势垒以及非晶 Si₃N₄ 和 SiO2 的结构/机械特性。然后，我们模拟具有四个表面方向、清洁和 H/OH 钝化终端以及 0.1 至 23 GPa 的法向载荷的金刚石-Si₃N₄ 界面的滑动。我们确定了两种不同的状态：一种是滑动集中在界面处，剪切应力与界面键合密度成正比，另一种是剪切力分布在较软的材料内部，并且由于完全界面键合而产生的粘附力占主导地位。这些结果表明钝化、表面取向和载荷如何共同决定界面结合和摩擦，并对金刚石磨损的环境敏感性产生影响。更广泛地说，这种潜力使得金刚石、氮化硅和二氧化硅的反应模拟能够在长度和时间尺度上以接近从头开始的精度超出第一原理方法，为未来研究犁耕粗糙度磨损、化学机械抛光和非晶陶瓷薄膜的性能提供了有用的工具。

articles.title: Coexistence of superconductivity and magnetic order in BaFe₂S₃: evidence for orbital-selective delocalization
articles.title_zh: BaFe2S₃ 中超导性和磁序的共存：轨道选择性离域的证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38966v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding how superconductivity emerges from correlated electronic states is a central challenge in condensed matter physics. The quasi-one-dimensional spin-ladder compound bfs serves as a unique platform to study this interplay, as it lacks the two-dimensional square lattice characteristic of most iron-based superconductors. Here, we combine high-pressure x-ray and neutron diffraction, x-ray emission spectroscopy, and electrical transport to map its structural, magnetic, and electronic evolution into the superconducting regime. We revisedobserve a striking pressure-induced decoupling: while the long-range stripe-type antiferromagnetic order remains remarkably robust under pressure up to the onset of superconductivity, the local iron magnetic moment is suppressed by nearly 80%. This dichotomy revisedpoints to an orbital-selective mechanism, where specific Fe 3d electrons remain localized to sustain magnetism while others delocalize to form the itinerant and superconducting state. revised{Superconductivity emerges while long-range magnetic order is still present, revealing that the two coexist in bfs, which we attribute to} the selective response of multiorbital electronic degrees of freedom.
articles.abstract_zh: 了解超导性如何从相关电子态中产生是凝聚态物理学的一个核心挑战。准一维自旋梯复合 bfs 是研究这种相互作用的独特平台，因为它缺乏大多数铁基超导体的二维方晶格特征。在这里，我们结合高压 X 射线和中子衍射、X 射线发射光谱和电输运，将其结构、磁性和电子演化映射到超导状态。我们修正观察到了惊人的压力引起的解耦：虽然长程条带型反铁磁序在压力下直到超导开始时仍然非常稳健，但局部铁磁矩被抑制了近 80%。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 了解超导性如何从相关电子态中产生是凝聚态物理学的一个核心挑战。准一维自旋梯复合 bfs 是研究这种相互作用的独特平台，因为它缺乏大多数铁基超导体的二维方晶格特征。在这里，我们结合高压 X 射线和中子衍射、X 射线发射光谱和电输运，将其结构、磁性和电子演化映射到超导状态。我们修正观察到了惊人的压力引起的解耦：虽然长程条带型反铁磁序在压力下直到超导开始时仍然非常稳健，但局部铁磁矩被抑制了近 80%。这种二分法修正指向轨道选择机制，其中特定的 Fe 3d 电子保持局域化以维持磁性，而其他电子则离域形成流动和超导状态。修改后的超导性在长程磁序仍然存在的情况下出现，揭示了两者在bfs中共存，我们将其归因于多轨道电子自由度的选择性响应。

articles.title: Magnetism in a homometallic square-planar Cu(II)₄Cu(II) metallacrown
articles.title_zh: 同质金属方形平面 Cu(II)₄Cu(II) 金属冠中的磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38989v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The well-established homometallic metallacrown Cu(II)[12-MC_Cu(II)N(Shi)-4]²⁻, comprising four square-planarly arranged Cu(II) ions surrounding a slightly off-plane central Cu(II) ion, provides an excellent platform for investigating magnetism in exchange-coupled Cu(II) clusters both by experimental and ab initio numerical methods. In the present work, sterically bulky substituents are introduced into the salicylhydroxamate ligand to obtain a modified derivative, Cu(II)[12-MC_textCu(II)N(L)-4]²⁻ (Cu₄Cu), thereby effectively suppressing intermolecular magnetic interactions and enabling a detailed investigation of its intrinsic ground-state spin structure and exchange interactions. Static magnetization reveals competing antiferromagnetic exchange interactions of J₁=-8.1(2) THz (-33.5(8) meV) between the central and the peripheral sites and J₂=-4.40(12) THz (-18.2(5) meV) between neighboring sites on the ring of the metallacrown, which are corroborated by ab initio broken symmetry-based density functional theory (DFT). These couplings yield an S=1/2 ground state for Cu₄Cu at low temperatures, for which X-band and high-frequency/high-field electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) precisely determine the g-factors gₓ = 2.028, g_y = 2.056, and g_z = 2.222 close to axial anisotropy and in agreement with our DFT results. The ground-state spin-configuration is characterized by dₓy-character of the unoccupied states. Furthermore, our magnetization data evidence thermal transitions across a doublet-to-quartet gap of Δ₁/₂→₃/₂ = 4.8(4) THz which is also indicated by the emergence of an excited-state EPR signal.
articles.abstract_zh: 成熟的同金属金属冠 Cu(II)[12-MC_Cu(II)N(Shi)-4]²⁻ 由四个方形平面排列的 Cu(II) 离子组成，围绕着一个稍微偏离平面的中心 Cu(II) 离子，为通过实验和从头算数值方法研究交换耦合 Cu(II) 团簇中的磁性提供了一个极好的平台。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 成熟的同金属金属冠 Cu(II)[12-MC_Cu(II)N(Shi)-4]²⁻ 由四个方形平面排列的 Cu(II) 离子组成，围绕着一个稍微偏离平面的中心 Cu(II) 离子，为通过实验和从头算数值方法研究交换耦合 Cu(II) 团簇中的磁性提供了一个极好的平台。在本工作中，将空间大的取代基引入水杨基异羟肟酸配体中，得到修饰衍生物Cu(II)[12-MC_textCu(II)N(L)-4]²⁻(Cu₄Cu)，从而有效抑制分子间磁相互作用，并能够详细研究其固有的基态自旋结构和交换相互作用。静态磁化揭示了中心和外围位点之间的 J₁=-8.1(2) THz (-33.5(8) meV) 和金属冠环上相邻位点之间的 J2=-4.40(12) THz (-18.2(5) meV) 的竞争性反铁磁交换相互作用，这些相互作用得到了从头开始基于破缺对称的密度泛函理论 (DFT) 的证实。这些耦合在低温下产生 Cu₄Cu 的 S=1/2 基态，其中 X 波段和高频/高场电子顺磁共振 (EPR) 精确确定 g 因子 gₓ = 2.028、g_y = 2.056 和 g_z = 2.222 接近轴向各向异性，与我们的 DFT 结果一致。基态自旋构型的特征在于未占据态的 dₓy 特征。此外，我们的磁化数据证明了跨越 Δ1/2→3/2 = 4.8(4) THz 的双重态到四重态间隙的热转变，激发态 EPR 信号的出现也表明了这一点。

articles.title: A rhombic spin-1 interpretation of a room-temperature GaN emitter
articles.title_zh: 室温 GaN 发射极的菱形自旋 1 解释
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39081v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Single defects in GaN show optically detected magnetic resonance at room temperature. In the more abundant class, a minimal S=3/2 model leaves a gapprox 4 line unexplained. For one defect, this line lies near the sum of the two outer lines, consistent with transitions among three shared levels. A rhombic S=1 model reproduces the three line positions with rms errors of 8.1-9.8 MHz. The tested second-order S=3/2 fits containing all three transitions and the published minimal model do not reproduce these positions. A ladder fitted to the strong lines remains viable if the gapprox 4 line is a separate transition near the sum of the outer two. An unresolved frequency-window shift prevents the existing data from establishing the S=1 assignment uniquely. We propose a zero-field sweep that directly tests the isolated S=1 assignment.
articles.abstract_zh: GaN 中的单缺陷在室温下显示出光学检测到的磁共振。在更丰富的类别中，最小的 S=3/2 模型留下了无法解释的gapprox 4 线。对于一个缺陷，这条线位于两条外部线的总和附近，与三个共享级别之间的过渡一致。菱形 S=1 模型再现了 3 个线位置，均方根误差为 8.1-9.8 MHz。测试的二阶 S=3/2 拟合包含所有三个转换，并且已发布的最小模型不会重现这些位置。如果gapprox 4线是靠近外部两条线之和的单独过渡，则适合强线的梯子仍然可行。
articles.abstract_zh_full: GaN 中的单缺陷在室温下显示出光学检测到的磁共振。在更丰富的类别中，最小的 S=3/2 模型留下了无法解释的gapprox 4 线。对于一个缺陷，这条线位于两条外部线的总和附近，与三个共享级别之间的过渡一致。菱形 S=1 模型再现了 3 个线位置，均方根误差为 8.1-9.8 MHz。测试的二阶 S=3/2 拟合包含所有三个转换，并且已发布的最小模型不会重现这些位置。如果gapprox 4线是靠近外部两条线之和的单独过渡，则适合强线的梯子仍然可行。未解决的频率窗口偏移会阻止现有数据唯一地建立 S=1 分配。我们提出了一种零场扫描，可以直接测试孤立的 S=1 分配。

articles.title: The End of Chaos at the Ideal Glass Transition
articles.title_zh: 理想玻璃化转变中混沌的终结
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39098v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The ideal glass transition has often been associated with the extrapolated vanishing of configurational entropy S_c, yet how this thermodynamic criterion is reflected in microscopic dynamics remains unclear. Here, we show that the vanishing of deterministic chaos quantified by the maximum Lyapunov exponent λₘₐₓ provides such a dynamical signature. Using molecular dynamics simulations across diverse model glass-forming liquids in two and three dimensions, we show that λₘₐₓ follows an approximate scaling λₘₐₓ propto (T-Tλ)¹/² and extrapolates to zero at a temperature Tλ consistent with the Kauzmann temperature TK. Furthermore, we establish the quantitative relation λₘₐₓ² propto T S_c, directly linking chaotic dynamics to configurational entropy. By demonstrating that λₘₐₓ² propto σ_K², where σ_K² is the variance of local potential energy landscape curvature fluctuations, we connect the suppression of chaos directly to landscape geometry. These results provide a unified thermodynamic, dynamical, and geometric framework for glass formation, identifying the ideal glass transition as the endpoint of chaotic exploration of the energy landscape.
articles.abstract_zh: 理想的玻璃化转变通常与构型熵 S_c 的外推消失有关，但这种热力学标准如何反映在微观动力学中仍不清楚。在这里，我们证明了由最大李雅普诺夫指数 λₘₐₓ 量化的确定性混沌的消失提供了这样的动态特征。使用二维和三维不同模型玻璃形成液体的分子动力学模拟，我们表明 λₘₐₓ 遵循近似缩放 λₘₐₓ propto (T-Tλ)1/2，并在与考兹曼温度 TK 一致的温度 Tλ 下外推至零。此外，我们建立了定量关系 λₘₐₓ² propto T S_c，直接将混沌动力学与构型熵联系起来。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 理想的玻璃化转变通常与构型熵 S_c 的外推消失有关，但这种热力学标准如何反映在微观动力学中仍不清楚。在这里，我们证明了由最大李雅普诺夫指数 λₘₐₓ 量化的确定性混沌的消失提供了这样的动态特征。使用二维和三维不同模型玻璃形成液体的分子动力学模拟，我们表明 λₘₐₓ 遵循近似缩放 λₘₐₓ propto (T-Tλ)1/2，并在与考兹曼温度 TK 一致的温度 Tλ 下外推至零。此外，我们建立了定量关系 λₘₐₓ² propto T S_c，直接将混沌动力学与构型熵联系起来。通过证明 λₘₐₓ² propto σ_K²（其中 σ_K² 是局部势能景观曲率波动的方差），我们将混沌的抑制直接与景观几何联系起来。这些结果为玻璃形成提供了统一的热力学、动力学和几何框架，将理想的玻璃化转变确定为能源景观混沌探索的终点。

articles.title: Berry curvature dipole circuit quantum electrodynamics
articles.title_zh: 贝里曲率偶极子电路量子电动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39186v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum three-wave mixing is an important resource in superconducting quantum circuits. The traditional implementation uses Josephson junction arrays and is activated by magnetic flux. Here we introduce the Berry curvature dipole (BCD) quantum circuit element, which achieves quantum three-wave mixing without breaking time-reversal symmetry. This quantum three-wave mixing results from the BCD nonlinear Hall effect in noncentrosymmetric quantum materials taken to a dissipationless, quantum coherent few-photon regime. We show how nonlinear Hall materials can be integrated to superconducting microwave circuits to accomplish multiphoton vacuum Rabi splittings and dynamical stabilization of bosonic Schrödinger cat states. Such BCD circuit quantum electrodynamics are a concrete exemplar of a physical resource for quantum information processing enabled by nonlinear response in quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子三波混频是超导量子电路的重要资源。传统的实现方式使用约瑟夫森结阵列并由磁通量激活。这里我们介绍贝里曲率偶极子（BCD）量子电路元件，它在不破坏时间反转对称性的情况下实现了量子三波混频。这种量子三波混合是由处于无耗散、量子相干少光子状态的非中心对称量子材料中的 BCD 非线性霍尔效应产生的。我们展示了如何将非线性霍尔材料集成到超导微波电路中，以实现多光子真空拉比分裂和玻色薛定谔猫态的动态稳定。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子三波混频是超导量子电路的重要资源。传统的实现方式使用约瑟夫森结阵列并由磁通量激活。这里我们介绍贝里曲率偶极子（BCD）量子电路元件，它在不破坏时间反转对称性的情况下实现了量子三波混频。这种量子三波混合是由处于无耗散、量子相干少光子状态的非中心对称量子材料中的 BCD 非线性霍尔效应产生的。我们展示了如何将非线性霍尔材料集成到超导微波电路中，以实现多光子真空拉比分裂和玻色薛定谔猫态的动态稳定。这种 BCD 电路量子电动力学是通过量子材料中的非线性响应实现量子信息处理的物理资源的具体范例。

articles.title: Local Josephson response near nonmagnetic impurities and vortices in a two-orbital s± superconductor
articles.title_zh: 双轨道 s± 超导体中非磁性杂质和涡流附近的局部约瑟夫森响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39192v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the local Josephson response near nonmagnetic impurities and vortices in a self-consistent two-orbital s± superconductor. For a local s-wave tip that couples equally to the two orbitals, anomalous spectral contributions of opposite sign nearly cancel in the clean sample. Nonmagnetic impurities redistribute these contributions and can reverse the local coupling without a corresponding π phase shift of the bond pair fields. Negative coupling appears at off-center sites at weaker impurity potentials than at the impurity site. The impurity-induced change is concentrated at lower quasiparticle energies, while states over a broader energy range contribute to the total clean and impurity couplings. In zero field, the coupling also changes sign as the tip gap is varied, and increasing the tunneling strength can reverse the m=1 sine component of the current without changing the sample state. At the chosen coherence-peak energy, increasing impurity strength mainly changes the relative intensities of existing quasiparticle-interference features. In a self-consistent two-vortex state, the Josephson response develops a spatially varying phase relative to the condensate. The response and condensate share the winding close to each core, while larger loops enclose additional winding of the Josephson response. The local Josephson sign and phase reflect the anomalous spectrum and the tip--sample coupling.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了自洽双轨道 s± 超导体中非磁性杂质和涡流附近的局部约瑟夫森响应。对于与两个轨道同等耦合的局部 s 波尖端，相反符号的异常光谱贡献在干净的样本中几乎被抵消。非磁性杂质重新分配这些贡献，并且可以反转局部耦合，而无需键对场的相应 π 相移。负耦合出现在杂质电势弱于杂质位点的偏离中心位点。杂质引起的变化集中在较低的准粒子能量处，而更广泛的能量范围内的状态有助于总的清洁和杂质耦合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了自洽双轨道 s± 超导体中非磁性杂质和涡流附近的局部约瑟夫森响应。对于与两个轨道同等耦合的局部 s 波尖端，相反符号的异常光谱贡献在干净的样本中几乎被抵消。非磁性杂质重新分配这些贡献，并且可以反转局部耦合，而无需键对场的相应 π 相移。负耦合出现在杂质电势弱于杂质位点的偏离中心位点。杂质引起的变化集中在较低的准粒子能量处，而更广泛的能量范围内的状态有助于总的清洁和杂质耦合。在零场中，耦合也会随着尖端间隙的变化而改变符号，并且增加隧道强度可以反转电流的 m=1 正弦分量而不改变样品状态。在选定的相干峰值能量下，增加杂质强度主要改变现有准粒子干涉特征的相对强度。在自洽的双涡旋状态下，约瑟夫森响应相对于冷凝物形成空间变化的相位。响应和冷凝共用靠近每个磁芯的绕组，而较大的环路则包围约瑟夫森响应的附加绕组。局部约瑟夫森符号和相位反映了反常光谱和尖端-样品耦合。

articles.title: Nodal magnon spin current at an antiferromagnet/altermagnet junction
articles.title_zh: 反铁磁体/交变磁体结处的节点磁振子自旋电流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39206v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the thermally driven magnon spin current across a junction between a d-wave altermagnet (AM) and a ferromagnet (FM) or an antiferromagnet (AFM). The current consists of a component independent of the interface angle and an angularly dependent component with the d-wave form. For a sublattice-symmetric interface, the two junctions behave oppositely under reversal of the altermagnetic domain: in the FM/AM junction the angularly dependent component is odd and cancels on averaging over the domains, whereas in the AFM/AM junction the angularly independent component vanishes by symmetry and the angularly dependent component survives the domain average at a fixed Néel vector of the AFM. Both follow from a selective tunneling: a pair of spins bonded across the interface transmits magnons when the spins are parallel and not when antiparallel, which makes the AFM/AM junction a magnon valve: the configuration in which the bonded spins are antiparallel blocks the current up to the sublattice admixture of the magnons. The anisotropic tunneling is detectable as the sign reversal of the current between the interfaces normal to [310] and [130], and the valve reads the Néel vector of the altermagnet relative to that of the antiferromagnet through the magnitude of the current at a fixed interface.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了 d 波交变磁体 (AM) 和铁磁体 (FM) 或反铁磁体 (AFM) 之间结点处的热驱动磁振子自旋电流。电流由与界面角度无关的分量和具有 d 波形式的角度相关分量组成。对于亚晶格对称界面，两个结在交变磁畴反转时表现相反：在 FM/AM 结中，角度相关分量是奇数，并且在域上求平均时抵消，而在 AFM/AM 结中，角度无关分量因对称性而消失，角度相关分量在 AFM 的固定 Néel 向量处保留域平均值。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了 d 波交变磁体 (AM) 和铁磁体 (FM) 或反铁磁体 (AFM) 之间结点处的热驱动磁振子自旋电流。电流由与界面角度无关的分量和具有 d 波形式的角度相关分量组成。对于亚晶格对称界面，两个结在交变磁畴反转时表现相反：在 FM/AM 结中，角度相关分量是奇数，并且在域上求平均时抵消，而在 AFM/AM 结中，角度无关分量因对称性而消失，角度相关分量在 AFM 的固定 Néel 向量处保留域平均值。两者都源于选择性隧道效应：当自旋平行时，跨界面键合的一对自旋会传输磁振子，而当自旋平行时则不会，这使得 AFM/AM 结成为磁振子阀：键合自旋反平行的配置会阻止电流到达磁振子的亚晶格混合。各向异性隧道效应可检测为垂直于 [310] 和 [130] 的界面之间电流的符号反转，并且阀通过固定界面处的电流大小读取交变磁体相对于反铁磁体的尼尔矢量。

articles.title: Metastability, collective excitations, and traveling states of one-dimensional spin-orbit-coupled quantum droplets
articles.title_zh: 一维自旋轨道耦合量子液滴的亚稳态、集体激发和行进态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39361v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the static and traveling droplet phases of spin-orbit coupled, one-dimensional Bose-Bose mixtures with a Lee-Huang-Yang correction. For the static droplets, employing a variational analysis for an infinitely extended mixture, we show that the system can feature two ground-state droplet phases: a stripe droplet phase up to a critical Rabi coupling strength, at which it undergoes a first-order transition to a zero-momentum droplet phase. The variational results for the ground-state properties are shown to be in good agreement with numerical solutions for droplets in the thermodynamic limit as well as finite-size droplets in the "flat-top regime". For finite-size droplets, the stripe phase can feature multiple stationary states with different numbers of peaks in their stripe density patterns. The calculation of the excitation spectrum for these stationary states confirms their stability. To study the moving droplets, we investigate the ground-state phases of the system in the droplet's comoving frame. We show that in the comoving frame, droplets acquire a finite longitudinal magnetization. As a consequence, the phase diagram features two distinct phases: a traveling stripe droplet and a plane-wave droplet. The real-time evolution of these droplets in the space-fixed frame, complemented by the Bogoliubov analysis in the comoving frame, illustrates the stability of these traveling droplet phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们通过 Lee-Huang-Yang 校正研究了自旋轨道耦合的一维 Bose-Bose 混合物的静态和行进液滴相。对于静态液滴，采用对无限扩展混合物的变分分析，我们表明该系统可以具有两个基态液滴相：条纹液滴相达到临界拉比耦合强度，在该强度下它经历一阶过渡到零动量液滴相。基态性质的变分结果与热力学极限液滴以及“平顶状态”中有限尺寸液滴的数值解非常一致。对于有限尺寸的液滴，条纹相可以具有多个稳态，其条纹密度图案中具有不同数量的峰值。这些稳态的激发光谱的计算证实了它们的稳定性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过 Lee-Huang-Yang 校正研究了自旋轨道耦合的一维 Bose-Bose 混合物的静态和行进液滴相。对于静态液滴，采用对无限扩展混合物的变分分析，我们表明该系统可以具有两个基态液滴相：条纹液滴相达到临界拉比耦合强度，在该强度下它经历一阶过渡到零动量液滴相。基态性质的变分结果与热力学极限液滴以及“平顶状态”中有限尺寸液滴的数值解非常一致。对于有限尺寸的液滴，条纹相可以具有多个稳态，其条纹密度图案中具有不同数量的峰值。这些稳态的激发光谱的计算证实了它们的稳定性。为了研究移动的液滴，我们研究了液滴共移框架中系统的基态相。我们表明，在共动框架中，液滴获得有限的纵向磁化强度。因此，相图具有两个不同的相：行进的条纹液滴和平面波液滴。这些液滴在空间固定坐标系中的实时演化，辅以共动坐标系中的 Bogoliubov 分析，说明了这些行进液滴相的稳定性。

articles.title: Graphene Islands as a Platform for Band-Structure Engineering
articles.title_zh: 石墨烯岛作为带结构工程的平台
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39428v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multilayer graphenes have emerged as a versatile avenue towards exploring novel electronic phases of matter. Recently, nanoscale multilayer graphene islands have been realized experimentally, where the island is less than 50 nm in diameter and distinct in layer configuration from the contact portion of the same graphene sheets, the latter of which act as leads for transport probes. Here, we theoretically investigate how the proximity between these islands and their chemically identical environment modifies the electronic structure. Within the tight-binding approximation, we find that the proximity effect is enhanced by the closely matched momenta between both parts, creating an unusually strong band renormalization which persists as the island size is increased, and only limited by the coherence length. An effective single-unit-cell Hamiltonian to capture these modifications is derived, expressed in terms of interlayer hopping parameters that scale with the relative island area. We predict a substantially altered low-energy density of states for 3- and 4-layer graphene islands, demonstrating the tunability of the electronic structure by spatial size.
articles.abstract_zh: 多层石墨烯已成为探索物质的新型电子相的通用途径。最近，纳米级多层石墨烯岛已通过实验实现，该岛的直径小于50纳米，并且在层结构上与相同石墨烯片的接触部分不同，后者充当传输探针的引线。在这里，我们从理论上研究了这些岛之间的邻近性及其化学相同的环境如何改变电子结构。在紧束缚近似中，我们发现邻近效应通过两个部分之间紧密匹配的动量而增强，从而产生异常强的能带重整化，该重整化随着岛尺寸的增加而持续存在，并且仅受相干长度的限制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多层石墨烯已成为探索物质的新型电子相的通用途径。最近，纳米级多层石墨烯岛已通过实验实现，该岛的直径小于50纳米，并且在层结构上与相同石墨烯片的接触部分不同，后者充当传输探针的引线。在这里，我们从理论上研究了这些岛之间的邻近性及其化学相同的环境如何改变电子结构。在紧束缚近似中，我们发现邻近效应通过两个部分之间紧密匹配的动量而增强，从而产生异常强的能带重整化，该重整化随着岛尺寸的增加而持续存在，并且仅受相干长度的限制。导出了捕获这些修改的有效单晶胞哈密顿量，以随相对岛面积缩放的层间跳跃参数表示。我们预测 3 层和 4 层石墨烯岛的低能量态密度会发生显着变化，这证明了电子结构随空间尺寸的可调性。

articles.title: Predicting unstable planar fault energies in multicomponent alloys from pure elemental components
articles.title_zh: 从纯元素成分预测多元合金中不稳定的平面故障能量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39495v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The unstable planar fault energies (UPFEs) govern slip and twinning but are not experimentally measurable. Using EAM potentials complemented by DFT, we investigate their temperature and compositional dependence and their relationship with the shear modulus. For pure fcc elements with low stacking fault energies (SFEs), UPFEs are substantially less temperature-sensitive than SFEs. The reported linear relationship between UPFEs and the product of shear modulus and Burgers vector (μ bₚ) holds for close-packed elements and solid solutions, but deviates for intermetallics and non-close-packed elements. In the Co-Cr-Fe-Mn-Ni system, binary alloys show composition-dependent deviations, while the correlation strengthens with increasing chemical complexity. Furthermore, μ bₚ of multicomponent alloys linearly correlates with the composition-weighted elemental μ bₚ (R²=0.95), despite a systematic negative deviation. This provides a simple, computationally inexpensive route for estimating μ bₚ and screening UPFEs directly from pure elemental constituents.
articles.abstract_zh: 不稳定平面断层能（UPFE）控制滑移和孪生，但无法通过实验测量。使用由 DFT 补充的 EAM 势，我们研究了它们的温度和成分依赖性以及它们与剪切模量的关系。对于具有低堆垛层错能 (SFE) 的纯 fcc 元件，UPFE 的温度敏感性远低于 SFE。所报告的 UPFE 与剪切模量和 Burgers 矢量 (μ bₚ) 的乘积之间的线性关系对于密排元素和固溶体成立，但对于金属间化合物和非密排元素则存在偏差。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 不稳定平面断层能（UPFE）控制滑移和孪生，但无法通过实验测量。使用由 DFT 补充的 EAM 势，我们研究了它们的温度和成分依赖性以及它们与剪切模量的关系。对于具有低堆垛层错能 (SFE) 的纯 fcc 元件，UPFE 的温度敏感性远低于 SFE。所报告的 UPFE 与剪切模量和 Burgers 矢量 (μ bₚ) 的乘积之间的线性关系对于密排元素和固溶体成立，但对于金属间化合物和非密排元素则存在偏差。在 Co-Cr-Fe-Mn-Ni 体系中，二元合金表现出与成分相关的偏差，而相关性随着化学复杂性的增加而增强。此外，尽管存在系统性负偏差，但多组分合金的 μ bₚ 与成分加权元素 μ bₚ (R²=0.95) 呈线性相关。这提供了一种简单且计算成本低廉的途径，用于估计 μ bₚ 并直接从纯元素成分中筛选 UPFE。

articles.title: Thermalization-Controlled Superconducting Diode-Like Transport in Disordered Molybdenum and NbN Thin Films
articles.title_zh: 无序钼和 NbN 薄膜中热化控制的类超导二极管输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39523v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Superconducting diode effects are characterized by direction-dependent critical currents in the superconducting state. Here, we investigate diode-like transport in 128-nm-thick Mo thin film deposited on Si_SiO2 substrate by DC magnetron sputtering. The thin film exhibit a superconducting transition temperature TC of 5.8 K. Pronounced current-direction asymmetry and hysteresis are observed in current-voltage characteristics measured in a closed-cycle refrigerator. In contrast, the same thin film exhibits a substantially more symmetric response in a 14T cryogenic system with improved sample thermalization. We attribute this strong dependence on the measurement environment to electrothermal effects arising from current-induced Joule heating and finite thermal relaxation. As the current approaches the superconducting-to-resistive switching condition, the emergence of a resistive component leads to a rapid increase in Joule heating, raising the sample temperature and modifying the switching condition. Conversely, during the resistive-to-superconducting transition, residual heating and finite thermal relaxation reduce the switching current. Since P is equal to I2R it is independent of current polarity, the observed asymmetry is not associated with polarity-dependent Joule heating but with the interplay of thermal relaxation, sweep history, and thermal boundary conditions. The suppression of the asymmetry under improved thermalization, together with similar behavior observed in NbN reference films, indicates that the apparent diode-like response is strongly influenced by electrothermal effects. These results highlight the need to distinguish thermal switching and hysteresis from intrinsic nonreciprocal superconductivity when identifying superconducting diode effects in transport measurements.
articles.abstract_zh: 超导二极管效应的特点是超导状态下的方向相关的临界电流。在这里，我们研究了通过直流磁控溅射沉积在 Si_SiO2 衬底上的 128 nm 厚 Mo 薄膜中的类二极管输运。该薄膜的超导转变温度TC为5.8 K。在闭路制冷机中测量的电流-电压特性中观察到明显的电流方向不对称性和滞后现象。相比之下，相同的薄膜在 14T 低温系统中表现出更加对称的响应，并且样品热化得到改善。我们将这种对测量环境的强烈依赖性归因于电流感应焦耳热和有限热弛豫产生的电热效应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 超导二极管效应的特点是超导状态下的方向相关的临界电流。在这里，我们研究了通过直流磁控溅射沉积在 Si_SiO2 衬底上的 128 nm 厚 Mo 薄膜中的类二极管输运。该薄膜的超导转变温度TC为5.8 K。在闭路制冷机中测量的电流-电压特性中观察到明显的电流方向不对称性和滞后现象。相比之下，相同的薄膜在 14T 低温系统中表现出更加对称的响应，并且样品热化得到改善。我们将这种对测量环境的强烈依赖性归因于电流感应焦耳热和有限热弛豫产生的电热效应。当电流接近超导到电阻的切换条件时，电阻分量的出现导致焦耳热迅速增加，从而提高样品温度并改变切换条件。相反，在电阻到超导的转变过程中，残余热量和有限的热弛豫会降低开关电流。由于 P 等于 I2R，它与电流极性无关，因此观察到的不对称性与极性相关的焦耳热无关，而是与热弛豫、扫描历史和热边界条件的相互作用有关。在改进的热化作用下对不对称性的抑制，以及在 NbN 参考薄膜中观察到的类似行为，表明明显的类似二极管的响应受到电热效应的强烈影响。这些结果突出表明，在识别传输测量中的超导二极管效应时，需要将热切换和磁滞与固有的不可逆超导区分开来。

articles.title: Multiple Current Enhancement Regimes and Interaction Induced Re-entrant Transport in a Quasiperiodic Hubbard Ring with Antiferromagnetic Order
articles.title_zh: 反铁磁序准周期哈伯德环中的多种电流增强机制和相互作用诱导的重入输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39529v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate persistent charge and spin currents in a one-dimensional quantum ring threaded by an Aharonov-Bohm (AB) flux, considering generalized Aubry-André-Harper (AAH) modulation with staggered onsite energies and antiferromagnetic (AFM) ordering in both the noninteracting and interacting regimes, with the latter treated using a self-consistent Hartree-Fock mean field theory (MFT). At half filling, two distinct current-enhancement peaks emerge as the modulation strength increases, with quasiperiodic hopping modulation playing a crucial role in establishing the two-peak structure within a restricted parameter regime. Spin-resolved bond-current profiles reveal a switch in the dominant spin contribution between the two peaks, while the inverse participation ratio (IPR) and flux-dependent spin-resolved ground-state energies provide complementary insights into the spatial characteristics of the eigenstates and their spin-dependent flux sensitivity. At quarter filling, the spin current exhibits a single enhancement peak, in contrast to the two-peak response observed at half filling. The Hubbard interaction affects the two half-filled peaks differently: it suppresses the primary peak, whereas the secondary peak exhibits a nonmonotonic, re-entrant response, with the current recovering at finite interaction strength. The interacting results are further characterized through the Drude weight, and comparisons with exact diagonalization (ED) and density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG) calculations for a finite half-filled system support the reliability of the MFT description. Our findings elucidate how quasiperiodic modulation, AFM order, band filling, and electronic correlations collectively govern the magnitude and spin-resolved character of persistent currents, giving rise to multiple enhancement regimes and interaction-induced re-entrant behavior.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了由阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆 (AB) 通量穿过的一维量子环中的持久电荷和自旋电流，考虑了非相互作用和相互作用状态下具有交错现场能量和反铁磁 (AFM) 排序的广义奥布里-安德烈-哈珀 (AAH) 调制，后者使用自洽 Hartree-Fock 平均场理论 (MFT) 进行处理。在半填充时，随着调制强度的增加，出现两个不同的电流增强峰，准周期跳跃调制在受限参数范围内建立双峰结构中发挥着至关重要的作用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了由阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆 (AB) 通量穿过的一维量子环中的持久电荷和自旋电流，考虑了非相互作用和相互作用状态下具有交错现场能量和反铁磁 (AFM) 排序的广义奥布里-安德烈-哈珀 (AAH) 调制，后者使用自洽 Hartree-Fock 平均场理论 (MFT) 进行处理。在半填充时，随着调制强度的增加，出现两个不同的电流增强峰，准周期跳跃调制在受限参数范围内建立双峰结构中发挥着至关重要的作用。自旋分辨键电流分布揭示了两个峰之间的主导自旋贡献的转变，而逆参与比（IPR）和通量相关的自旋分辨基态能量提供了对本征态的空间特征及其自旋相关通量敏感性的补充见解。在四分之一填充时，自旋电流表现出单个增强峰，与在半填充时观察到的双峰响应相反。哈伯德相互作用对两个半填充峰的影响不同：它抑制主峰，而次峰表现出非单调的重入响应，电流在有限的相互作用强度下恢复。交互结果通过 Drude 权重进一步表征，并且与有限半填充系统的精确对角化 (ED) 和密度矩阵重整化群 (DMRG) 计算的比较支持了 MFT 描述的可靠性。我们的研究结果阐明了准周期调制、AFM 阶数、能带填充和电子相关性如何共同控制持续电流的幅度和自旋分辨特征，从而产生多种增强机制和相互作用引起的重入行为。

articles.title: Edge-Plasmon-Induced Magnetization in Higher Chern Insulators
articles.title_zh: 高陈绝缘体中的边缘等离子体感应磁化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39555v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Higher Chern insulators host multiple dissipationless chiral edge states, one per unit of Chern number. We study the collective plasmon modes of these edge states at a domain wall between Chern numbers C and -C, using a semiclassical model with Coulomb interactions. The plasmon dispersion is linear at long wavelengths, with a velocity that increases linearly with C. As in conventional two-dimensional metals, the edge plasmon generates an elliptically polarized electric field that decays into the bulk and drives electrons in circular orbits, producing a static orbital magnetization (inverse Faraday effect). For topological edge plasmons, the magnetization has a nontrivial spatial profile set by two competing length scales: the finite extent of the edge states and the plasmon wavelength. At fixed edge-charge amplitude, it grows strongly with C. At the domain wall, it approaches a finite plateau at low frequency and decays as 1/ω² at high frequency. Its temperature dependence is nonmonotonic, with a maximum at an intermediate temperature. These results show how the Chern number controls plasmon-induced magnetization, in contrast to conventional edge plasmons.
articles.abstract_zh: 较高的陈绝缘体具有多个无耗散手征边缘态，每单位陈数一个。我们使用具有库仑相互作用的半经典模型研究了陈数 C 和 -C 之间的畴壁处这些边缘态的集体等离子体激元模式。等离激元色散在长波长下呈线性，速度随 C 线性增加。与传统的二维金属一样，边缘等离激元产生椭圆极化电场，该电场衰减到块体中并驱动圆形轨道上的电子，产生静态轨道磁化（反法拉第效应）。对于拓扑边缘等离子体激元，磁化强度具有由两个相互竞争的长度尺度设置的重要空间轮廓：边缘态的有限范围和等离子体激元波长。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 较高的陈绝缘体具有多个无耗散手征边缘态，每单位陈数一个。我们使用具有库仑相互作用的半经典模型研究了陈数 C 和 -C 之间的畴壁处这些边缘态的集体等离子体激元模式。等离激元色散在长波长下呈线性，速度随 C 线性增加。与传统的二维金属一样，边缘等离激元产生椭圆极化电场，该电场衰减到块体中并驱动圆形轨道上的电子，产生静态轨道磁化（反法拉第效应）。对于拓扑边缘等离子体激元，磁化强度具有由两个相互竞争的长度尺度设置的重要空间轮廓：边缘态的有限范围和等离子体激元波长。在固定边缘电荷幅度下，它随 C 强烈增长。在畴壁处，它在低频下接近有限平台，在高频下以 1/ω² 衰减。 Its temperature dependence is nonmonotonic, with a maximum at an intermediate temperature.这些结果表明，与传统的边缘等离子体激元相比，陈数如何控制等离子体激元引起的磁化。

articles.title: Spin-Polarized Weyl Fermions and Unconventional Spin Transport
articles.title_zh: 自旋极化韦尔费米子和非常规自旋输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39604v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large and electrically controllable spin splitting in nonmagnetic materials is highly desirable for condensed-matter physics and spintronics, enabling strongly spin-polarized quasiparticles and unconventional spin transport as well as their electrical control. Here, we establish a general framework for critical spin-polarized Weyl fermions in two-dimensional (2D) nonmagnetic systems. We predict the α-Bi-like Group-V puckered-layer family of 2D ferroelectrics as a material platform combining critical spin-Weyl fermions, giant spin splitting, and electrically switchable nonlinear and spin transport. Our calculations reveal exchange-scale spin splitting induced by spin-orbit coupling and a p-wave spin texture in the BiAs monolayer. Moreover, BiAs hosts four critical spin-Weyl points, each formed within a single-spin channel. The nearly quantized langle S_zrangle is protected by an emergent S_z-conservation symmetry in the low-energy limit. The spin-Weyl cones also give rise to unconventional spin-transport phenomena, including a purely out-of-plane Edelstein response and a pronounced spin Nernst effect. Ferroelectric reversal further enables electrical switching of the p-wave spin texture and inversion-odd responses, while the tunability of these properties through composition, strain, and magnetic field is also systematically demonstrated across the entire family. These results establish both a general nonmagnetic framework and a promising material platform for exploring critical spin-Weyl physics, nonlinear Hall phenomena, and unconventional spin transport.
articles.abstract_zh: 非磁性材料中的大的电控自旋分裂对于凝聚态物理和自旋电子学来说是非常理想的，它能够实现强自旋极化的准粒子和非常规自旋输运及其电控制。在这里，我们建立了二维（2D）非磁性系统中临界自旋极化韦尔费米子的通用框架。我们预测 α-Bi 类 V 族褶皱层家族的二维铁电体将成为结合临界自旋外尔费米子、巨型自旋分裂以及电可切换非线性和自旋输运的材料平台。我们的计算揭示了由自旋轨道耦合引起的交换尺度自旋分裂和 BiAs 单层中的 p 波自旋纹理。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非磁性材料中的大的电控自旋分裂对于凝聚态物理和自旋电子学来说是非常理想的，它能够实现强自旋极化的准粒子和非常规自旋输运及其电控制。在这里，我们建立了二维（2D）非磁性系统中临界自旋极化韦尔费米子的通用框架。我们预测 α-Bi 类 V 族褶皱层家族的二维铁电体将成为结合临界自旋外尔费米子、巨型自旋分裂以及电可切换非线性和自旋输运的材料平台。我们的计算揭示了由自旋轨道耦合引起的交换尺度自旋分裂和 BiAs 单层中的 p 波自旋纹理。此外，BiAs 拥有四个关键的自旋韦尔点，每个点都在单自旋通道内形成。近量子化的 langle S_zrangle 受到低能极限下的新兴 S_z 守恒对称性的保护。自旋外尔锥体还引起非常规的自旋输运现象，包括纯粹的面外埃德尔斯坦响应和明显的自旋能斯特效应。铁电反转进一步实现了 p 波自旋纹理和反转奇响应的电切换，而这些特性通过成分、应变和磁场的可调性也在整个系列中得到了系统地证明。这些结果建立了一个通用的非磁性框架和一个有前途的材料平台，用于探索临界自旋韦尔物理、非线性霍尔现象和非常规自旋输运。

articles.title: Ultrasound-Assisted Facile Nanoconfinement of Luminescent Guests in Zirconium Metal-Organic Frameworks
articles.title_zh: 超声辅助轻松纳米限制锆金属有机框架中的发光客体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39622v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: An accelerated sonochemical route for fabricating luminescent guest-MOF (LG@MOF) composites is demonstrated, for which light-emitting molecules are nanoconfined within porous zirconium-based hosts using probe ultrasonication rather than conventional bath sonication. Ultrasonication enables the rapid synthesis of crystalline UiO-66 and UiO-67 nanocrystals within 10 minutes, with material yields of up to 92%, and facile in situ guest encapsulation within 1 hour, hence notably faster than the traditional 24-hour solvothermal route. Using UiO-66 and the larger-pore UiO-67 as porous hosts, tuneable single- and dual-guest fluorescent host-guest systems incorporating Rhodamine B (RB) and Fluorescein (F) were achieved. Photophysical characterisation showed broadband emission, tuneable colours, high quantum yield and improved lifetime, highlighting the synergy between sonochemical conditions, structural defects, and photophysical behaviour. Additionally, the sonochemically prepared LG@UiO particles show well-defined crystal facets and potential as photoactive thin films for solid-state lighting, demonstrating their promise as a tuneable light source for optical sensing and nanophotonics.
articles.abstract_zh: 展示了一种用于制造发光客体 MOF (LG@MOF) 复合材料的加速声化学路线，其中使用探针超声处理而不是传统的水浴超声处理将发光分子纳米限制在多孔锆基主体内。超声处理能够在10分钟内快速合成结晶UiO-66和UiO-67纳米晶，材料收率高达92%，并在1小时内轻松进行原位客体封装，因此明显比传统的24小时溶剂热路线更快。使用 UiO-66 和较大孔径的 UiO-67 作为多孔主体，实现了结合罗丹明 B (RB) 和荧光素 (F) 的可调谐单客体和双客体荧光主客体系统。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 展示了一种用于制造发光客体 MOF (LG@MOF) 复合材料的加速声化学路线，其中使用探针超声处理而不是传统的水浴超声处理将发光分子纳米限制在多孔锆基主体内。超声处理能够在10分钟内快速合成结晶UiO-66和UiO-67纳米晶，材料收率高达92%，并在1小时内轻松进行原位客体封装，因此明显比传统的24小时溶剂热路线更快。使用 UiO-66 和较大孔径的 UiO-67 作为多孔主体，实现了结合罗丹明 B (RB) 和荧光素 (F) 的可调谐单客体和双客体荧光主客体系统。光物理表征显示出宽带发射、可调谐颜色、高量子产率和延长的寿命，突出了声化学条件、结构缺陷和光物理行为之间的协同作用。此外，声化学制备的 LG@UiO 颗粒显示出明确的晶面和作为固态照明光活性薄膜的潜力，证明了它们作为光学传感和纳米光子学的可调光源的前景。

articles.title: Origin and photoluminescence of a shallow hydrogen-related donor in silicon
articles.title_zh: 硅中浅层氢相关供体的起源和光致发光
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39623v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Paramagnetic color centers in silicon are being investigated recently for use in quantum technologies. While the origin of most of the prominent photoluminescence (PL) lines are well understood, that is not the case for those connected to hydrogen, even though it is almost always present in silicon, e.g., shallow hydrogen-related donors (SHDs), but their atomic structure remains elusive. Recent experiments suggested connection between the SHDs and the so-called X and the Bᵢ (or Xᵢ) PL-lines. An SHD, termed the MT2 center, was tentatively assigned to a bistable, negative-U defect, arising due to the interaction of hydrogen with the self-interstitial complex I₄. Using high-level density functional theory calculations, we investigate the interaction of hydrogen with self-interstitial complexes In. A shallow effective-mass-theory donor arises when hydrogen attacks a Si-Si bond in Iₙ, inserting itself as a bond-center interstitial (IₙHBC) in an exothermic reaction. We demonstrate this in the case of a single self-interstitial and of a complex of four. The latter I₄H_BC complex shows electronic, spin and PL properties remarkably close to MT2. We find that hydrogen in the presence of I₄ follows the same behavior as in pristine silicon, i.e., it is a negative-U bistable defect, only detectable under illumination. In the I₄HBC complex, H can hop via photo-assisted mechanism between equivalent BC sites of the I₄ complex, leading to a motional averaged tetragonal symmetry as experimentally observed for MT2. The zero-phonon line is distinct from the X-line (attributed to the bare I₄ complex), and falls well into the range of the Xᵢ lines. Our results identify the I₄H complex as a prototype for a class of SHDs, inferring that similar SHDs may arise, with the Xᵢ lines as their PL fingerprints, when H attacks Iₙ clusters.
articles.abstract_zh: 最近正在研究硅中的顺磁性色心在量子技术中的应用。虽然大多数突出的光致发光（PL）谱线的起源已广为人知，但与氢有关的谱线却并非如此，尽管它几乎总是存在于硅中，例如浅氢相关供体（SHD），但它们的原子结构仍然难以捉摸。最近的实验表明 SHD 与所谓的 X 和 Bᵢ（或 Xᵢ）PL 线之间存在联系。称为 MT2 中心的 SHD 暂时被指定为双稳态负 U 缺陷，该缺陷是由于氢与自填隙复合物 I₄ 的相互作用而产生的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 最近正在研究硅中的顺磁性色心在量子技术中的应用。虽然大多数突出的光致发光（PL）谱线的起源已广为人知，但与氢有关的谱线却并非如此，尽管它几乎总是存在于硅中，例如浅氢相关供体（SHD），但它们的原子结构仍然难以捉摸。最近的实验表明 SHD 与所谓的 X 和 Bᵢ（或 Xᵢ）PL 线之间存在联系。称为 MT2 中心的 SHD 暂时被指定为双稳态负 U 缺陷，该缺陷是由于氢与自填隙复合物 I₄ 的相互作用而产生的。利用高水平密度泛函理论计算，我们研究了氢与自填隙配合物 In 的相互作用。当氢攻击 Iₙ 中的 Si-Si 键时，就会产生浅有效质量理论供体，并在放热反应中将自身作为键中心间隙原子 (IₙHBC) 插入。我们在单个自填隙性和四个自填隙性复合体的情况下证明了这一点。后者的 I₄H_BC 配合物显示出与 MT2 非常接近的电子、自旋和 PL 特性。我们发现，在 I₄ 存在的情况下，氢遵循与原始硅中相同的行为，即，它是负 U 双稳态缺陷，只能在光照下检测到。在 I₄HBC 复合物中，H 可以通过光辅助机制在 I₄ 复合物的等效 BC 位点之间跳跃，从而产生运动平均四方对称性，如 MT2 实验观察到的那样。零声子线与 X 线（归因于裸 I₄ 复合体）不同，并且很好地落在 Xᵢ 线的范围内。我们的结果将 I₄H 复合体识别为一类 SHD 的原型，推断当 H 攻击 Iₙ 簇时，可能会出现类似的 SHD，以 Xᵢ 线作为其 PL 指纹。

articles.title: Non-Volatile Memory Devices for Neuromorphic Computing
articles.title_zh: 用于神经形态计算的非易失性存储设备
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39625v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This chapter explores the critical role of emerging non-volatile memory (eNVM) devices in advancing neuromorphic computing. Inspired by the human brain's remarkable ability to perform complex tasks like pattern recognition and adaptation, neuromorphic computing offers immense potential for implementing complex neural networks (NNs) in real hardware. Despite ongoing research into the brain's complexities, its fundamental operation relies on neurons (processing units communicating via electrochemical signals) and synapses (junctions between neurons). The modifiable strength of the synapse is key to learning and memory functionality, allowing the brain to adapt and rewire itself. For dense and low-power circuits in neuromorphic computing, these eNVM devices are ideal due to their synaptic-like behavior and non-volatile information storage. Properties such as conductance modulation of these devices emulate synaptic plasticity, which is crucial for learning, and their scalability makes them promising for large-scale neuromorphic architectures. This chapter will delve into the various types of eNVM devices such as resistive RAM (ReRAM), phase-change memory (PCM), spintronics-based memory devices, and their applications in neuromorphic computing, discussing their challenges and opportunities, and highlighting recent advances in their integration within neuromorphic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本章探讨了新兴的非易失性存储器（eNVM）设备在推进神经形态计算方面的关键作用。受人脑执行模式识别和适应等复杂任务的非凡能力的启发，神经形态计算为在实际硬件中实现复杂的神经网络 (NN) 提供了巨大的潜力。尽管对大脑复杂性的研究正在进行中，但其基本运作依赖于神经元（通过电化学信号进行通信的处理单元）和突触（神经元之间的连接）。突触的可改变强度是学习和记忆功能的关键，使大脑能够适应和重新布线。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本章探讨了新兴的非易失性存储器（eNVM）设备在推进神经形态计算方面的关键作用。受人脑执行模式识别和适应等复杂任务的非凡能力的启发，神经形态计算为在实际硬件中实现复杂的神经网络 (NN) 提供了巨大的潜力。尽管对大脑复杂性的研究正在进行中，但其基本运作依赖于神经元（通过电化学信号进行通信的处理单元）和突触（神经元之间的连接）。突触的可改变强度是学习和记忆功能的关键，使大脑能够适应和重新布线。对于神经形态计算中的密集和低功耗电路，这些 eNVM 设备由于其类似突触的行为和非易失性信息存储而成为理想选择。这些设备的电导调制等特性可以模拟突触可塑性，这对于学习至关重要，而且它们的可扩展性使它们有望用于大规模神经形态架构。本章将深入研究各种类型的 eNVM 设备，例如电阻式 RAM (ReRAM)、相变存储器 (PCM)、基于自旋电子学的存储设备及其在神经形态计算中的应用，讨论它们的挑战和机遇，并重点介绍它们在神经形态系统中集成的最新进展。

articles.title: High-Field Heat Capacity of Atacamite Cu₂Cl(OH)₃ for H parallel b axis: From Antiferromagnetic Order to Correlated Disorder
articles.title_zh: H 平行 b 轴的氯铜矿 Cu2Cl(OH)₃ 的高场热容：从反铁磁序到相关无序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39669v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present the heat capacity of the frustrated sawtooth-chain compound atacamite Cu₂Cl(OH)₃ in high magnetic fields up to 35 T for H parallel b axis. We clearly observe the change from antiferromagnetic long-range order, indicated by a sharp transition anomaly shifted to lower temperatures when increasing field, to a field-induced spin-liquid-like state with the absence of any transition anomaly. Here, in highest magnetic fields above 32 T a broad anomaly is present which is shifted to higher temperatures as the field is increased. The low-temperature heat capacity in the high-field region can be described well by an exponential behavior indicating a thermal activation over a spin gap. The findings are consistent with our scenario for the high-field state in atacamite for H parallel c axis, where we proposed the sawtooth chains to decouple into two spin subsystems, basal and apical spin sites, leading to a partially polarized state with M sim M_sat/2.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们展示了受挫锯齿链化合物氯铜矿 Cu2Cl(OH)3 在 H 平行 b 轴高达 35 T 的高磁场中的热容量。我们清楚地观察到从反铁磁长程有序的变化（由增加磁场时急剧转变异常转向较低温度所表明）到场诱导的自旋液体状态的变化，而没有任何转变异常。这里，在高于 32 T 的最高磁场中，存在广泛的异常现象，随着磁场的增加，该异常现象会转移到更高的温度。高场区域的低温热容可以通过指数行为来很好地描述，该指数行为表明自旋间隙上的热激活。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们展示了受挫锯齿链化合物氯铜矿 Cu2Cl(OH)3 在 H 平行 b 轴高达 35 T 的高磁场中的热容量。我们清楚地观察到从反铁磁长程有序的变化（由增加磁场时急剧转变异常转向较低温度所表明）到场诱导的自旋液体状态的变化，而没有任何转变异常。这里，在高于 32 T 的最高磁场中，存在广泛的异常现象，随着磁场的增加，该异常现象会转移到更高的温度。高场区域的低温热容可以通过指数行为来很好地描述，该指数行为表明自旋间隙上的热激活。这些发现与我们对氯铜矿中 H 平行 c 轴的高场态的设想一致，其中我们提出锯齿链解耦成两个自旋子系统，即基底和顶端自旋位点，从而导致 M sim M_sat/2 的部分极化态。

articles.title: Exceptional Superconducting Interfaces between Graphene and Atomic Chains in A15-MoRe
articles.title_zh: A15-MoRe 中石墨烯和原子链之间的卓越超导界面
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39694v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Realizing highly transparent and magnetic-field-resilient superconducting contacts is a critical bottleneck for the advancement of two-dimensional (2D) quantum devices. Molybdenum-rhenium (MoRe) alloys have been empirically favored as they uniquely yield ballistic, highly transparent contacts to graphene that survive in high-magnetic-field regimes; however, the microscopic origin of this anomalous transparency has remained a long-standing puzzle. Here, we resolve this paradox by revealing that pristine graphene/MoRe interfaces are governed by the classical A15 superconducting phase. Combining low-temperature transport, X-ray diffraction, and atomic-resolution electron microscopy, we demonstrate that as-deposited MoRe spontaneously forms the A15 phase in direct contact with graphene, whereas thermal annealing triggers a phase transition to a hexagonal close-packed (hcp) structure that severely degrades the Josephson transparency. Crucially, the one-dimensional (1D) transition-metal atomic chains unique to the A15 structure exhibit a near-perfect lattice match (mismatch < 1%) with graphene edges. First-principles calculations further prove that the d-orbitals of these historically renowned 1D chains possibly hybridize with graphene's Dirac cone near the K point. These findings not only uncover the structural and electronic origins of optimal MoRe contacts but also establish A15-phase superconductors as a geometrically ideal, universal platform for realizing robust quantum electronics based on 2D materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 实现高度透明和磁场弹性的超导接触是二维（2D）量子器件发展的关键瓶颈。钼铼（MoRe）合金在经验上受到青睐，因为它们独特地与石墨烯产生弹道、高度透明的接触，并且可以在高磁场条件下生存；然而，这种异常透明度的微观起源仍然是一个长期存在的谜团。在这里，我们通过揭示原始石墨烯/MoRe界面受经典A15超导相控制来解决这个悖论。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 实现高度透明和磁场弹性的超导接触是二维（2D）量子器件发展的关键瓶颈。钼铼（MoRe）合金在经验上受到青睐，因为它们独特地与石墨烯产生弹道、高度透明的接触，并且可以在高磁场条件下生存；然而，这种异常透明度的微观起源仍然是一个长期存在的谜团。在这里，我们通过揭示原始石墨烯/MoRe界面受经典A15超导相控制来解决这个悖论。结合低温传输、X射线衍射和原子分辨率电子显微镜，我们证明沉积态MoRe自发形成与石墨烯直接接触的A15相，而热退火会触发相变到六方密堆积（hcp）结构，从而严重降低约瑟夫森透明度。至关重要的是，A15 结构特有的一维 (1D) 过渡金属原子链与石墨烯边缘表现出近乎完美的晶格匹配（失配 < 1%）。第一原理计算进一步证明，这些历史上著名的一维链的 d 轨道可能与石墨烯的狄拉克锥在 K 点附近杂交。这些发现不仅揭示了最佳 MoRe 接触的结构和电子起源，而且还将 A15 相超导体确立为几何理想的通用平台，用于实现基于 2D 材料的稳健量子电子学。

articles.title: Pulse Laser Deposited GaFeO3 Thin Film Grown on FTO: Correlated Ferroic Orders and Strong Magnetodielectric Coupling at Room Temperature
articles.title_zh: FTO 上生长的脉冲激光沉积 GaFeO3 薄膜：室温下相关铁序和强磁电耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39696v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Room-temperature single-phase multiferroics exhibiting coupled ferroelectric and magnetic order are promising candidates for next-generation magnetoelectric memory and spintronic technologies. Here, we report the growth of approximately 100.6 nm thick polycrystalline orthorhombic GaFeO3 thin films on fluorine-doped tin oxide-coated glass (FTO) substrates by pulsed laser deposition. Core-level X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy reveals a reduced Fe2+ concentration and suppressed oxygen-vacancy formation, contributing to reduced leakage current and improved ferroelectric characteristics. The films exhibit robust ferrimagnetism and ferroelectricity at room temperature, confirming the coexistence of ferroic orders within a single phase. Piezoresponse Force Microscopy further demonstrates reversible local polarization switching, accompanied by an asymmetric butterfly loop with coercive voltages of -0.31 V and +1.07 V. The films also exhibit a high relative dielectric constant of approximately 1700 with a relatively low dielectric loss tangent of approximately 2.83 at 1 MHz. Moreover, a significant magnetodielectric coefficient of approximately 2.3% is observed under a relatively small magnetic field of only 0.1 kOe, highlighting strong magnetoelectric coupling. These results establish GaFeO3 thin films as a promising platform for room-temperature multifunctional devices, mainly low-field magnetoelectric memory and spintronic architectures.
articles.abstract_zh: 表现出耦合铁电和磁序的室温单相多铁性材料是下一代磁电存储器和自旋电子技术的有希望的候选者。在这里，我们报道了通过脉冲激光沉积在氟掺杂氧化锡涂层玻璃（FTO）基板上生长约 100.6 nm 厚的多晶正交 GaFeO3 薄膜。核心级 X 射线光电子能谱显示 Fe2+ 浓度降低并抑制氧空位形成，有助于减少漏电流并改善铁电特性。这些薄膜在室温下表现出强大的亚铁磁性和铁电性，证实了单相中铁序的共存。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 表现出耦合铁电和磁序的室温单相多铁性材料是下一代磁电存储器和自旋电子技术的有希望的候选者。在这里，我们报道了通过脉冲激光沉积在氟掺杂氧化锡涂层玻璃（FTO）基板上生长约 100.6 nm 厚的多晶正交 GaFeO3 薄膜。核心级 X 射线光电子能谱显示 Fe2+ 浓度降低并抑制氧空位形成，有助于减少漏电流并改善铁电特性。这些薄膜在室温下表现出强大的亚铁磁性和铁电性，证实了单相中铁序的共存。压电响应力显微镜进一步证明了可逆的局部偏振切换，并伴有矫顽电压为-0.31 V和+1.07 V的不对称蝶形环路。这些薄膜还表现出约1700的高相对介电常数，以及在1 MHz时约2.83的相对较低的介电损耗角正切。此外，在仅 0.1 kOe 的相对较小的磁场下观察到约 2.3% 的显着磁介电系数，突出了强磁电耦合。这些结果使 GaFeO3 薄膜成为室温多功能器件（主要是低场磁电存储器和自旋电子结构）的有前途的平台。

articles.title: Sign reversal of ST-FMR signals in CoFeB/Pt explained by contributions beyond spin-orbit torque
articles.title_zh: CoFeB/Pt 中 ST-FMR 信号的符号反转可通过自旋轨道扭矩之外的贡献来解释
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39749v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin-orbit torques (SOT) provide an efficient route for electrical control of magnetization and is of central interest for low-power magnetic memory applications. Spin-torque ferromagnetic resonance (ST-FMR) is a widely used technique to quantify SOT efficiencies. However, the rectified voltage measured in ST-FMR can contain contributions that are not directly related to SOTs, which affects the accuracy of the extracted torque efficiencies. This may contribute to the large variation of reported SOT efficiencies in literature. In this study, we investigate the damping-like torque efficiencies in CoFeB/Pt heterostructures as a function of Pt thickness. Conventional ST-FMR analysis yields an apparent sign reversal of the extracted efficiency at a Pt thickness of approximately 10 nm. By combining complementary measurement geometries and analysis approaches, we separate the torque-induced signal from additional voltage contributions that share the same angular dependence. Our results show that non-torque voltage contributions can produce an apparent sign reversal in conventional ST-FMR analysis, highlighting the need to distinguish SOT-induced signals from parasitic contributions and we show how to reliably determine the SOT efficiencies.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋轨道扭矩（SOT）为磁化的电控制提供了一种有效的途径，并且是低功耗磁存储器应用的核心关注点。自旋矩铁磁共振 (ST-FMR) 是一种广泛使用的量化 SOT 效率的技术。然而，ST-FMR 中测量的整流电压可能包含与 SOT 不直接相关的贡献，这会影响提取的扭矩效率的准确性。这可能导致文献中报道的 SOT 效率存在巨大差异。在本研究中，我们研究了 CoFeB/Pt 异质结构中的类阻尼扭矩效率与 Pt 厚度的函数关系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋轨道扭矩（SOT）为磁化的电控制提供了一种有效的途径，并且是低功耗磁存储器应用的核心关注点。自旋矩铁磁共振 (ST-FMR) 是一种广泛使用的量化 SOT 效率的技术。然而，ST-FMR 中测量的整流电压可能包含与 SOT 不直接相关的贡献，这会影响提取的扭矩效率的准确性。这可能导致文献中报道的 SOT 效率存在巨大差异。在本研究中，我们研究了 CoFeB/Pt 异质结构中的类阻尼扭矩效率与 Pt 厚度的函数关系。传统的 ST-FMR 分析在 Pt 厚度约为 10 nm 时产生明显的提取效率符号反转。通过结合互补的测量几何结构和分析方法，我们将扭矩感应信号与具有相同角度依赖性的附加电压贡献分开。我们的结果表明，非扭矩电压贡献可以在传统 ST-FMR 分析中产生明显的符号反转，强调需要区分 SOT 感应信号和寄生贡献，并且我们展示了如何可靠地确定 SOT 效率。

articles.title: High-temperature expansion of the inverse-square Ising chain in a magnetic field: exact coefficients and finite-size reconstruction
articles.title_zh: 磁场中平方反比伊辛链的高温膨胀：精确系数和有限尺寸重构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39815v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The one-dimensional Ising chain with inverse-square interactions is a paradigmatic long-range system: it exhibits the unusual Thouless transition, with a discontinuity in the spontaneous magnetization, yet its full field-dependent thermodynamics remains unknown in closed form. We develop the high-temperature expansion of its free energy while retaining the dependence on a uniform magnetic field at every order. We prove that, after a natural rescaling of the coupling, each coefficient is a rational polynomial in the squared hyperbolic tangent of the reduced field. Remarkably, at each order n the field-dependent free-energy coefficient of a finite, periodically repeated ring is an exact polynomial of degree at most n in L⁻². The infinite-chain coefficient is its constant term and can therefore be reconstructed from n+1 finite rings without numerical extrapolation. Using this reconstruction, we determine the full field-dependent expansion through order 26: 26 polynomials containing 377 rational coefficient entries. We further derive exact formulas, valid at every order, for the coefficients of the two highest powers of the field variable using matching determinants and a cycle-Laplacian reduction. These results reveal an unexpected algebraic structure in the microscopic thermodynamics of the inverse-square chain and provide high-order information about its magnetic response.
articles.abstract_zh: 具有平方反比相互作用的一维伊辛链是一个典型的长程系统：它表现出不寻常的 Thouless 转变，自发磁化强度不连续，但其完全依赖于场的热力学在封闭形式中仍然未知。我们开发了其自由能的高温膨胀，同时保留了每个阶对均匀磁场的依赖性。我们证明，在耦合的自然重新调整之后，每个系数都是简化场的平方双曲正切的有理多项式。值得注意的是，在每个 n 阶，有限周期性重复环的场相关自由能系数是 L⁻² 中次数最多为 n 的精确多项式。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 具有平方反比相互作用的一维伊辛链是一个典型的长程系统：它表现出不寻常的 Thouless 转变，自发磁化强度不连续，但其完全依赖于场的热力学在封闭形式中仍然未知。我们开发了其自由能的高温膨胀，同时保留了每个阶对均匀磁场的依赖性。我们证明，在耦合的自然重新调整之后，每个系数都是简化场的平方双曲正切的有理多项式。值得注意的是，在每个 n 阶，有限周期性重复环的场相关自由能系数是 L⁻² 中次数最多为 n 的精确多项式。无限链系数是其常数项，因此可以从 n+1 个有限环重建而无需数值外推。使用此重建，我们通过 26 阶确定完全场相关展开：包含 377 个有理系数项的 26 个多项式。我们进一步使用匹配行列式和循环拉普拉斯约简，针对场变量的两个最高幂的系数导出在每个阶都有效的精确公式。这些结果揭示了平方反比链的微观热力学中意想不到的代数结构，并提供了有关其磁响应的高阶信息。

articles.title: Steering interfacial molecular structures by substrate-molecule charge transfer
articles.title_zh: 通过底物分子电荷转移控制界面分子结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39822v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Intermixed self-assembled monolayers (SAMs) provide a powerful approach for tuning inorganic-organic interfaces, but their local structure and energetics often remain elusive. Here, an intermixed stripe phase of fullerene C₆₀ and Zn(II)-5,10,15,20-tetrakis(4-aminophenyl)porphyrin (Zn-TAPP) on a Ag(111) surface is identified, establishing a direct link between molecular assembly and charge transfer. Scanning tunnelling spectroscopy (STS) and Kelvin probe force spectroscopy (KPFS) have been used to map electronic states and local contact potential differences (LCPD). Compared to close-packed C₆₀ islands, the stripe phase exhibits a larger interfacial dipole and increased occupation of previously unoccupied C₆₀ states, consistent with enhanced charge transfer from Ag(111) to C₆₀. Analysis indicates that larger C₆₀ spacing in the stripe geometry reduces Coulomb repulsion, stabilizing the intermixed phase and enhancing charge transfer with respect to close-packed domains. These results provide direct evidence of charged C₆₀ molecules in stripe structures and guidelines for engineering intermixed SAMs with tailored interfacial electronic properties.
articles.abstract_zh: 混合自组装单层（SAM）为调节无机-有机界面提供了一种强大的方法，但它们的局部结构和能量通常仍然难以捉摸。在这里，鉴定出了 Ag(111) 表面上富勒烯 C60 和 Zn(II)-5,10,15,20-四(4-氨基苯基)卟啉 (Zn-TAPP) 的混合条纹相，建立了分子组装和电荷转移之间的直接联系。扫描隧道光谱（STS）和开尔文探针力光谱（KPFS）已用于绘制电子态和局部接触电位差（LCPD）。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 混合自组装单层（SAM）为调节无机-有机界面提供了一种强大的方法，但它们的局部结构和能量通常仍然难以捉摸。在这里，鉴定出了 Ag(111) 表面上富勒烯 C60 和 Zn(II)-5,10,15,20-四(4-氨基苯基)卟啉 (Zn-TAPP) 的混合条纹相，建立了分子组装和电荷转移之间的直接联系。扫描隧道光谱（STS）和开尔文探针力光谱（KPFS）已用于绘制电子态和局部接触电位差（LCPD）。与密堆积的C60岛相比，条带相表现出更大的界面偶极子和对先前未占据的C60态的占据增加，这与从Ag(111)到C60的电荷转移增强一致。分析表明，条带几何形状中较大的 C60 间距减少了库仑斥力，稳定了混合相并增强了密堆积域的电荷转移。这些结果提供了条带结构中带电 C₆₀ 分子的直接证据，并为设计具有定制界面电子特性的混合 SAM 提供了指导。

articles.title: Epitaxial Magnon Junctions with Y3Fe5O12/Gd3Ga5O12/Pt-nanoparticles/Y3Fe5O12
articles.title_zh: Y3Fe5O12/Gd3Ga5O12/Pt 纳米颗粒/Y3Fe5O12 外延磁振子结
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39841v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The excitation, propagation, manipulation, and detection of magnons lie at the core of magnonics. Among various device architectures, high-quality magnon junctions with a ferromagnetic insulator (FI)/antiferromagnetic insulator (AFI)/ferromagnetic insulator (FI) configuration are predicted to exhibit a near-100% magnon junction ratio (MJR), making them promising candidates for high-performance non-volatile memory applications. Yttrium iron garnet (Y3Fe5O12, YIG) is widely employed as the FI material in such structures for its exceptionally low magnetic damping. However, in previously reported magnon junctions, the epitaxial relationship between the two YIG layers is often disrupted by lattice-mismatched AFI spacers. Although this leads to distinct coercivities, it simultaneously degrades the crystalline quality of the top YIG layer, thereby limiting the magnontransmission efficiency. Here, an epitaxial magnon junction is demonstrated incorporating a hybrid Gd3Ga5O12 (GGG)/Pt-nanoparticles spacer that maintains coherent epitaxy while enabling an antiparallel magnetic configuration. Compared with nickel oxide-based magnon junctions, the coercivity-tuned top YIG layer in our structure exhibits superior crystalline quality and much lower magnetic damping. A clear magnon junction effect is observed with a 43% MJR achieved. The interlayer coupling between the two ferrimagnetic insulators is found to enhance the MJR. These results offer valuable insights for the development of advanced magnon-based spintronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁振子的激发、传播、操纵和检测是磁振子学的核心。在各种器件架构中，具有铁磁绝缘体 (FI)/反铁磁绝缘体 (AFI)/铁磁绝缘体 (FI) 配置的高质量磁振子结预计将表现出接近 100% 的磁振子结比 (MJR)，使其成为高性能非易失性存储器应用的有希望的候选者。钇铁石榴石（Y3Fe5O12，YIG）因其极低的磁阻尼而被广泛用作此类结构中的FI材料。然而，在之前报道的磁振子结中，两个 YIG 层之间的外延关系经常被晶格不匹配的 AFI 间隔物破坏。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁振子的激发、传播、操纵和检测是磁振子学的核心。在各种器件架构中，具有铁磁绝缘体 (FI)/反铁磁绝缘体 (AFI)/铁磁绝缘体 (FI) 配置的高质量磁振子结预计将表现出接近 100% 的磁振子结比 (MJR)，使其成为高性能非易失性存储器应用的有希望的候选者。钇铁石榴石（Y3Fe5O12，YIG）因其极低的磁阻尼而被广泛用作此类结构中的FI材料。然而，在之前报道的磁振子结中，两个 YIG 层之间的外延关系经常被晶格不匹配的 AFI 间隔物破坏。虽然这会导致明显的矫顽力，但同时会降低顶部 YIG 层的晶体质量，从而限制磁振子传输效率。在这里，外延磁振子结被证明包含混合 Gd3Ga5O12 (GGG)/Pt 纳米颗粒间隔物，可保持相干外延，同时实现反平行磁性配置。与基于氧化镍的磁振子结相比，我们结构中矫顽力调节的顶部 YIG 层表现出优异的晶体质量和低得多的磁阻尼。观察到明显的磁振子结效应，MJR 达到 43%。研究发现两个亚铁磁绝缘体之间的层间耦合可以增强 MJR。这些结果为先进的基于磁振子的自旋电子器件的开发提供了宝贵的见解。

articles.title: Quantum Hamiltonian time crystals from covariant quantum Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert relaxation
articles.title_zh: 来自协变量子 Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert 弛豫的量子哈密顿时间晶体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39886v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Classical Hamiltonian time crystals are constrained energy minima that move along symmetry orbits at frequencies set by Lagrange multipliers.
