We construct quantum counterparts by minimizing the energy over density matrices with fixed spectrum and charge expectations. A symmetry-covariant quantum Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert equation selects them as periodic attractors, preserving the spectrum and fixing the multipliers dynamically. A chiral spin trimer motivated by Cu₃ molecular magnets realizes this motion at a prepared magnetization, without a Zeeman term.
articles.abstract_zh: 经典哈密顿时间晶体是受限能量最小值，以拉格朗日乘数设定的频率沿对称轨道移动。我们通过最小化具有固定光谱和电荷期望的密度矩阵的能量来构造量子对应物。对称协变量子朗道-利夫希茨-吉尔伯特方程选择它们作为周期性吸引子，保留频谱并动态固定乘数。由 Cu₃ 分子磁体驱动的手性自旋三聚体在准备好的磁化强度下实现了这种运动，无需塞曼项。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 经典哈密顿时间晶体是受限能量最小值，以拉格朗日乘数设定的频率沿对称轨道移动。我们通过最小化具有固定光谱和电荷期望的密度矩阵的能量来构造量子对应物。对称协变量子朗道-利夫希茨-吉尔伯特方程选择它们作为周期性吸引子，保留频谱并动态固定乘数。由 Cu₃ 分子磁体驱动的手性自旋三聚体在准备好的磁化强度下实现了这种运动，无需塞曼项。

articles.title: Ensemble-dependent effect of disorder on multicritical points in a system with long-range interactions
articles.title_zh: 无序对长程相互作用系统中多临界点的系综依赖性影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39929v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce two variants of the Blume--Emery--Griffiths model with long-range, mean-field-like interactions and quenched disorder. Although the two variants are described by different Hamiltonians, they yield the same free energy. Moreover, both Hamiltonians lead to the same average energy and hence to the same microcanonical entropy. The canonical and microcanonical phase boundaries differ markedly, and so does the multicritical behaviour of the two ensembles. In the microcanonical ensemble, tricritical points appear for any fraction of active spins, whereas in the canonical ensemble they emerge only when this fraction is sufficiently large. At lower fractions, canonical critical endpoints arise instead. We also report the formation of gaps in the entropy as a function of magnetization, another manifestation of ensemble inequivalence.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们引入了 Blume-Emery-Griffiths 模型的两种变体，具有长程、类平均场相互作用和猝灭无序。尽管这两种变体由不同的哈密顿量描述，但它们产生相同的自由能。此外，两个哈密顿量都导致相同的平均能量，因此导致相同的微正则熵。正则相界和微正则相界显着不同，两个系综的多临界行为也有显着差异。在微正则系综中，三临界点出现在活跃自旋的任何部分，而在正则系综中，只有当该部分足够大时，它们才会出现。在较低的分数下，会出现典型的关键终点。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们引入了 Blume-Emery-Griffiths 模型的两种变体，具有长程、类平均场相互作用和猝灭无序。尽管这两种变体由不同的哈密顿量描述，但它们产生相同的自由能。此外，两个哈密顿量都导致相同的平均能量，因此导致相同的微正则熵。正则相界和微正则相界显着不同，两个系综的多临界行为也有显着差异。在微正则系综中，三临界点出现在活跃自旋的任何部分，而在正则系综中，只有当该部分足够大时，它们才会出现。在较低的分数下，会出现典型的关键终点。我们还报告了作为磁化强度函数的熵间隙的形成，这是系综不等价的另一种表现。

articles.title: Monte Carlo simulation of mixed spin-orbit ordering
articles.title_zh: 混合自旋轨道排序的蒙特卡罗模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39943v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The effect of a magnetic field on the thermodynamic properties of the Kugel-Khomskii model with maximal entanglement using the quasi-classical Monte Carlo method with the heat bath algorithm. The temperature dependencies of single-site correlators show that the application of a magnetic field results in non-zero magnetization and the simultaneous appearance of an orbital ordering at the same point in the Brillouin zone where a non-zero spin-orbit correlator exists.
articles.abstract_zh: 使用准经典蒙特卡罗方法和热浴算法，研究磁场对具有最大纠缠的 Kugel-Khomskii 模型热力学性质的影响。单点相关器的温度依赖性表明，磁场的应用会导致非零磁化，并且在布里渊区中存在非零自旋轨道相关器的同一点同时出现轨道排序。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 使用准经典蒙特卡罗方法和热浴算法，研究磁场对具有最大纠缠的 Kugel-Khomskii 模型热力学性质的影响。单点相关器的温度依赖性表明，磁场的应用会导致非零磁化，并且在布里渊区中存在非零自旋轨道相关器的同一点同时出现轨道排序。

articles.title: Confinement Controlled Phase-Pure 2D Layered Perovskites for Band-Edge Engineering
articles.title_zh: 约束控制相-用于带边工程的纯2D层状钙钛矿
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39974v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Controlling the number n of connected octahedra layers in two-dimensional metal halide perovskites enables fine control of the semiconductor band gap that is highly advantageous for optoelectronic and light emission applications. Phase purity in terms of n is crucial towards narrow emission bands and the design of band structure alignment for charge carrier funneling. We present a simple and scalable synthesis method using cesium and butylammonium as A-cations to fabricate microcrystal powders of 2D lead bromide perovskites that results in samples with very high n-phase purity. The obtained microcrystals show a sharp onset in absorbance and single narrow emission peak in UV-blue spectral range, and we confirm their structure and composition with X-ray diffraction and energy dispersive spectroscopy. We show that we can tailor the spectral absorption of microcrystals samples by controlled mixing of the n-phase pure powders, and we demonstrate this capability with spectral photocurrent measurements using pellets pressed from pure and mixed powders. Both the spectral and dynamic response of the photocurrent of the pellets depend strongly on the composition of the powders, highlighting the design potential of our approach towards band-edge engineering.
articles.abstract_zh: 控制二维金属卤化物钙钛矿中连接的八面体层的数量n可以精细控制半导体带隙，这对于光电和发光应用非常有利。就n而言，相纯度对于窄发射带和电荷载流子漏斗的带结构对齐设计至关重要。我们提出了一种简单且可扩展的合成方法，该方法使用铯和丁铵作为A-阳离子来制造2D溴化铅钙钛矿的微晶粉末，从而产生具有非常高n相纯度的样品。获得的微晶在紫外-蓝光谱范围内具有明显的吸光度起始和单个窄发射峰，我们通过X射线衍射和能量色散光谱确认其结构和组成。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 控制二维金属卤化物钙钛矿中连接的八面体层的数量n可以精细控制半导体带隙，这对于光电和发光应用非常有利。就n而言，相纯度对于窄发射带和电荷载流子漏斗的带结构对齐设计至关重要。我们提出了一种简单且可扩展的合成方法，该方法使用铯和丁铵作为A-阳离子来制造2D溴化铅钙钛矿的微晶粉末，从而产生具有非常高n相纯度的样品。获得的微晶在紫外-蓝光谱范围内具有明显的吸光度起始和单个窄发射峰，我们通过X射线衍射和能量色散光谱确认其结构和组成。我们表明，我们可以通过控制n相纯粉末的混合来定制微晶样品的光谱吸收，我们通过使用纯粉末和混合粉末压制的颗粒进行光谱光电流测量来证明这种能力。颗粒光电流的光谱和动态响应都很大程度上取决于粉末的成分，突出了我们对带边工程方法的设计潜力。

articles.title: Evidence for an effective gauge field in flakes of superconducting 4Hb-TaS2
articles.title_zh: 超导4Hb-TaS2薄片中有效仪表场的证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39979v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding the normal state of unconventional superconductors is central to uncovering the origin of superconductivity itself. Unconventional superconductivity often emerges from correlated electronic states characterized by intertwined symmetry-breaking orders. A striking example is 4Hb-TaS2, whose superconducting state exhibits a remarkable range of phenomena, including an unusual magnetic memory effect. Previous experiments showed that magnetic memory can be encoded above Tc and later revealed through spontaneous vortices below Tc, suggesting time-reversal symmetry breaking. However, since memory and vorticity are intertwined, this prevents establishing whether the effect results from trapped flux, weak conventional magnetism, or a true hidden electronic order. Here, we show that magnetic memory persists in the vortex-free Meissner regime of exfoliated 4Hb-TaS2 flakes, where it appears as a stable remanent modification of the superconducting screening response. Our results rule out explanations based on trapped vortices. Furthermore, the spatial profile of the flux generated by trained samples at zero field is inconsistent with conventional weak magnetism, suggesting a hidden electronic phase that imprints an effective flux on the superconducting condensate.
articles.abstract_zh: 了解非常规超导体的正常状态对于揭示超导本身的起源至关重要。非常规超导性通常来自以相互交织的对称打破秩序为特征的相关电子状态。一个引人注目的例子是4Hb-TaS2 ，其超导状态表现出一系列显着的现象，包括不寻常的磁记忆效应。以前的实验表明，磁记忆可以在Tc以上编码，后来通过Tc以下的自发涡旋揭示，这表明时间反转对称性断裂。然而，由于记忆和涡度交织在一起，这阻止了确定该效应是由捕获通量、弱常规磁性还是真正的隐藏电子秩序引起的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 了解非常规超导体的正常状态对于揭示超导本身的起源至关重要。非常规超导性通常来自以相互交织的对称打破秩序为特征的相关电子状态。一个引人注目的例子是4Hb-TaS2 ，其超导状态表现出一系列显着的现象，包括不寻常的磁记忆效应。以前的实验表明，磁记忆可以在Tc以上编码，后来通过Tc以下的自发涡旋揭示，这表明时间反转对称性断裂。然而，由于记忆和涡度交织在一起，这阻止了确定该效应是由捕获通量、弱常规磁性还是真正的隐藏电子秩序引起的。在这里，我们表明磁记忆持续存在于剥落的4Hb-TaS2薄片的无涡旋Meissner区，在那里它表现为超导筛选响应的稳定剩余修饰。我们的结果排除了基于陷阱涡流的解释。此外，训练样品在零磁场处产生的通量的空间轮廓与传统的弱磁性不一致，这表明隐藏的电子相在超导冷凝物上印下了有效的通量。

articles.title: Magnetotransport experiments on side-contacted topological insulator three-terminal Josephson junctions
articles.title_zh: 侧接触拓扑绝缘子三端约瑟夫森结的磁传输实验
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40083v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multiterminal Josephson junctions have recently attracted substantial attention. The ability to study Andreev bound states in a multi-phase parameter space opens up exciting avenues for generating topologically non-trivial phases in superconducting devices. A particularly interesting case is the trijunction based on a topological insulator (TI), which is predicted to host Majorana zero modes for suitable phase configurations (Fu and Kane, PRL 2008). Here we turn to the platform of the side-contacted TI trijunction and present experimental evidence for a multiterminal Josephson effect. We study the transport properties and find typical features of a two-dimensional critical current contour (CCC) as well as bias regimes in which only a single junction remains dissipationless. We pay particular attention to these features and study the effects of magnetic fields on single junctions within the trijunction, where, depending on the field direction, the supercurrents show Fraunhofer patterns, SQUID oscillations, or a monotonic decay. We find good agreement with semiclassical simulations for a single TI junction that take into account the top and bottom surface states. We observe pronounced non-convex shape deformations of the CCC under perpendicular magnetic fields that reflect the flux buildup in the loop formed by our trijunctions and provide a simple model sufficient to explain the observed effect. Our results provide the foundations for future studies of Majorana zero modes on this platform.
articles.abstract_zh: 多端约瑟夫森结最近引起了广泛关注。在多相参数空间中研究Andreev束缚态的能力为在超导器件中产生拓扑非平凡相开辟了令人兴奋的途径。一个特别有趣的情况是基于拓扑绝缘体（ TI ）的三结，预计它将为合适的相位配置提供Majorana零模（ Fu和Kane ， PRL 2008 ）。在这里，我们转向侧接触TI三结的平台，并提供多端约瑟夫森效应的实验证据。我们研究传输特性，并发现二维临界电流轮廓（ CCC ）的典型特征以及仅单个结保持不耗散的偏置机制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多端约瑟夫森结最近引起了广泛关注。在多相参数空间中研究Andreev束缚态的能力为在超导器件中产生拓扑非平凡相开辟了令人兴奋的途径。一个特别有趣的情况是基于拓扑绝缘体（ TI ）的三结，预计它将为合适的相位配置提供Majorana零模（ Fu和Kane ， PRL 2008 ）。在这里，我们转向侧接触TI三结的平台，并提供多端约瑟夫森效应的实验证据。我们研究传输特性，并发现二维临界电流轮廓（ CCC ）的典型特征以及仅单个结保持不耗散的偏置机制。我们特别关注这些特征，并研究磁场对三结内单个结的影响，其中，根据场方向，超电流显示弗劳恩霍夫模式、鱿鱼振荡或单调衰变。我们发现与考虑顶面和底面状态的单个TI结的半经典模拟有很好的一致性。我们观察到CCC在垂直磁场下明显的非凸形变形，这些变形反映了由我们的三连结形成的环路中的通量积聚，并提供了一个简单的模型，足以解释观察到的效果。我们的结果为将来在此平台上研究Majorana零模式奠定了基础。

articles.title: Static Response of the Strongly Coupled Electron Gas from Diffusion Monte Carlo
articles.title_zh: 来自扩散蒙特卡罗的强耦合电子气体的静态响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40093v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The local field factor G(q) of the HEG describes how exchange and correlation modify the response to a static perturbation, and enters dielectric screening, effective electron--electron interactions, and the xc kernel of TDDFT. Accurate zero-temperature data for G(q), however, remain limited to metallic densities, rₛ≤10. In this work, we present diffusion Monte Carlo calculations of the static density response function χ(q) and of G(q) for 2≤ rₛ≤100, and describe and discuss the methodological steps that enabled these calculations. We show how optimization of the perturbing potential in the trial wave function has an important effect, as a poor choice can reverse the sign of the response. A closed-form expression is provided for its optimal value, together with the density dependence of the linear-response window. We further show that backflow correlations leave χ(q) unchanged and that G(q) depends only weakly on system size even at very low density, so that Slater--Jastrow wave functions and modest system sizes suffice. Together, these results provide a practical guide for future QMC calculations of response properties of the electron gas and real materials. Our results agree with previous DMC data at metallic densities for q>k_F, and extend them below k_F. They also agree with diagrammatic QMC at rₛ=2. At lower densities, our results show that G(q) develops a nonmonotonic structure at intermediate-q, where the response approaches that of the noninteracting gas. Quantitative agreement is seen with finite-temperature path integral Monte Carlo, suggesting that the previously reported finite-temperature structure is inherited from the ground state. Using a parametrization of G(q) that reproduces our data throughout the liquid phase, we relate this structure to short-range order in the pair correlation function and the static structure factor.
articles.abstract_zh: HEG的局部场因子G (q)描述了交换和相关性如何修改对静态扰动的响应，并进入介电屏蔽、有效的电子-电子相互作用以及TDDFT的xc核。然而， G (q)的准确零温数据仍然局限于金属密度， r_≤ 10。在这项工作中，我们提出了静态密度响应函数χ (q)和G (q)的扩散蒙特卡罗计算，并描述和讨论了实现这些计算的方法步骤。我们展示了试验波函数中扰动势的优化是如何产生重要影响的，因为错误的选择可以逆转响应的符号。提供了一个闭式表达式的最优值，以及线性响应窗口的密度依赖性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: HEG的局部场因子G (q)描述了交换和相关性如何修改对静态扰动的响应，并进入介电屏蔽、有效的电子-电子相互作用以及TDDFT的xc核。然而， G (q)的准确零温数据仍然局限于金属密度， r_≤ 10。在这项工作中，我们提出了静态密度响应函数χ (q)和G (q)的扩散蒙特卡罗计算，并描述和讨论了实现这些计算的方法步骤。我们展示了试验波函数中扰动势的优化是如何产生重要影响的，因为错误的选择可以逆转响应的符号。提供了一个闭式表达式的最优值，以及线性响应窗口的密度依赖性。我们进一步表明，回流相关性保持χ (q)不变，即使在非常低的密度下， G (q)对系统尺寸的依赖也很小，因此Slater-Jastrow波函数和适度的系统尺寸就足够了。总之，这些结果为未来电子气体和实际材料响应性质的QMC计算提供了实用指南。我们的结果与先前在金属密度下q > k_F的DMC数据一致，并将其扩展到k_F以下。它们也与r_= 2的示意性QMC一致。在较低的密度下，我们的结果表明G （ q ）在中间q处形成非单调结构，其中响应接近非相互作用气体的响应。有限温度路径积分Monte Carlo的定量一致性表明，之前报道的有限温度结构继承自基态。使用G (q)的参数化，在整个液相中再现我们的数据，我们将这种结构与对相关函数和静态结构因子中的短程顺序相关联。

articles.title: Adiabatic Variational Principle: Born-Oppenheimer Theory for Emergent Electronic-Order Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 绝热变分原理：新兴电子秩序动力学的天生奥本海默理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40117v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent advances in microscopic many-body methods have enabled increasingly accurate descriptions of equilibrium quantum states, yet large-scale simulations of emergent-order dynamics typically rely on phenomenological equations with prescribed free-energy functionals. We introduce the Adiabatic Variational Principle (AVP), a framework for deriving order-parameter dynamics directly from an interacting many-body Hamiltonian. When microscopic relaxation is fast compared with order-parameter evolution, the many-body state follows the collective configuration adiabatically, in analogy with the Born--Oppenheimer separation of electronic and nuclear motion. This assumption makes explicit the adiabatic closure implicit in conventional phase-field descriptions. Each instantaneous order-parameter configuration then defines a constrained quasi-stationary many-body state, and the Lagrange multipliers enforcing these constraints directly provide the thermodynamic forces driving the collective evolution. Nonlinear Mori--Zwanzig projection theory further connects the reversible dynamics to the microscopic algebra of the collective variables and relates dissipation and fluctuations to the eliminated degrees of freedom. Applications to charge- and spin-density-wave dynamics recover Allen--Cahn domain growth, resolve evolving domain networks together with their microscopic electronic structure, and yield generalized Landau--Lifshitz dynamics for itinerant magnetism. The AVP thus provides a solver-independent microscopic foundation for phase-field-like simulations of the nonequilibrium dynamics of emergent electronic order.
articles.abstract_zh: 微观多体方法的最新进展使平衡量子态的描述越来越准确，但大规模的出现级动力学模拟通常依赖于具有规定自由能函数的现象学方程。我们引入了绝热变分原理（ AVP ） ，这是一个直接从相互作用的多体哈密顿导出阶参数动力学的框架。当微观松弛与有序参数演化相比较快时，多体状态绝热地遵循集体结构，类似于电子和核运动的Born-Oppenheimer分离。这一假设明确了传统相场描述中隐含的绝热闭包。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 微观多体方法的最新进展使平衡量子态的描述越来越准确，但大规模的出现级动力学模拟通常依赖于具有规定自由能函数的现象学方程。我们引入了绝热变分原理（ AVP ） ，这是一个直接从相互作用的多体哈密顿导出阶参数动力学的框架。当微观松弛与有序参数演化相比较快时，多体状态绝热地遵循集体结构，类似于电子和核运动的Born-Oppenheimer分离。这一假设明确了传统相场描述中隐含的绝热闭包。然后，每个瞬时有序参数配置定义了一个受约束的准平稳多体状态，执行这些约束的拉格朗日乘法器直接提供驱动集体进化的热力学力。非线性Mori-Zwanzig投影理论进一步将可逆动力学与集体变量的微观代数联系起来，并将耗散和波动与消除的自由度联系起来。电荷和自旋密度波动力学的应用恢复了Allen-Cahn畴生长，解析了演变的畴网络及其微观电子结构，并产生了广义的Landau-Lifshitz流动磁力学。因此， AVP为涌现电子秩序的非平衡动力学的相场模拟提供了独立于求解器的微观基础。

articles.title: Investigation of perovskite related oxides: structural and magnetic properties
articles.title_zh: 钙钛矿相关氧化物的研究：结构和磁性能
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40139v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Perovskites exist in varied structures and show structure dependent magnetic properties which is of great interest in the field of multiferroics, magnetocaloric and spintronic devices. Here we intend to study the various rare-earth(R) and transition metal (TM) ion interactions depending on their structures. Different Curie temperature, spinglass transition and spin reorientation transitions were observed depending on the degree of interactions and structural properties. It is interesting to study the role of orbital interactions, disorder in magnetic transitions leading to change in superexchange and double exchange interaction. On substitution at A-site or B-site results in change in magnetic interactions, as well as creates structural distortions. We also obtained results where the spin interaction of the transition metal and rare-earth interaction, magnetic anisotropy, orientations of orbitals, disorder induced interactions were observed.
articles.abstract_zh: 钙钛矿存在于各种结构中，并显示出结构相关的磁性，这在多铁性、磁热和自旋电子器件领域非常有趣。在这里，我们打算研究各种稀土（ R ）和过渡金属（ TM ）离子相互作用，具体取决于它们的结构。根据相互作用程度和结构特性，观察到不同的居里温度、弹簧跃迁和自旋重定向跃迁。研究轨道相互作用、导致超交换和双交换相互作用变化的磁跃迁中的障碍的作用是有趣的。在A位或B位替换时，会导致磁相互作用发生变化，并产生结构扭曲。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 钙钛矿存在于各种结构中，并显示出结构相关的磁性，这在多铁性、磁热和自旋电子器件领域非常有趣。在这里，我们打算研究各种稀土（ R ）和过渡金属（ TM ）离子相互作用，具体取决于它们的结构。根据相互作用程度和结构特性，观察到不同的居里温度、弹簧跃迁和自旋重定向跃迁。研究轨道相互作用、导致超交换和双交换相互作用变化的磁跃迁中的障碍的作用是有趣的。在A位或B位替换时，会导致磁相互作用发生变化，并产生结构扭曲。我们还获得了观察到过渡金属与稀土相互作用、磁各向异性、轨道取向、无序诱导相互作用的结果。

articles.title: Spin-Orbit Coupling Response Theory within the Oriented Spin Space Group Framework
articles.title_zh: 定向自旋空间组框架内的自旋轨道耦合响应理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40149v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin-orbit coupling (SOC) plays a pivotal role in a broad range of phenomena in condensed matter physics. The recently developed spin space group theory offers a new perspective for characterizing the fundamental symmetry-breaking features of SOC-related phenomena, yet its full potential remains to be explored. Here, we provide a general framework that relates the SOC-induced symmetry breaking to modifications of physical properties and emergence of new physical effects. This approach incorporates the recently developed oriented spin space group (OSSG) formalism, which can explicitly describe the symmetry reduction induced by SOC. By parameterizing the SOC Hamiltonian using a SOC tensor that connects real and spin spaces, an expansion in terms of the SOC components can be constructed for the response tensor describing any physical quantity. This framework determines not only whether a SOC-induced response is symmetry allowed, but also the lowest order in SOC at which it emerges and its dependence on magnetic anisotropy. As representative applications, we analyze the magnetoelectric coupling in Type-II multiferroics and show that magnetically induced electric polarization in different systems can be the result of SOC effects of different orders, and can exhibit varying characteristics of magnetic anisotropy. We further apply this theory to the anomalous Hall effect and spin magnetization in antiferromagnets, demonstrating that their distinct transformation properties under the OSSG allow a large anomalous Hall response to coexist with weak spin magnetization. A high-throughput analysis of materials in the MAGNDATA database identifies several symmetry-based material classes favorable for this coexistence. Overall, the proposed framework provides a unified symmetry description of SOC-induced phenomena and offers a systematic way for the identification of SOC-driven functional materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋轨道耦合（ SOC ）在凝聚态物理学的广泛现象中起着关键作用。最近发展的自旋空间群理论为表征SOC相关现象的基本对称性突破特征提供了一个新的视角，但其全部潜力仍有待探索。在这里，我们提供了一个通用框架，将SOC诱导的对称性破坏与物理性质的修改和新物理效应的出现联系起来。这种方法结合了最近开发的面向自旋空间群（ OSSG ）形式，它可以明确地描述由SOC引起的对称性减少。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋轨道耦合（ SOC ）在凝聚态物理学的广泛现象中起着关键作用。最近发展的自旋空间群理论为表征SOC相关现象的基本对称性突破特征提供了一个新的视角，但其全部潜力仍有待探索。在这里，我们提供了一个通用框架，将SOC诱导的对称性破坏与物理性质的修改和新物理效应的出现联系起来。这种方法结合了最近开发的面向自旋空间群（ OSSG ）形式，它可以明确地描述由SOC引起的对称性减少。通过使用连接实空间和自旋空间的SOC张量参数化SOC Hamiltonian ，可以为描述任何物理量的响应张量构建SOC分量方面的扩展。该框架不仅决定了SOC诱导的响应是否允许对称，而且还决定了SOC中出现的最低顺序及其对磁各向异性的依赖性。作为代表性的应用，我们分析了II型多铁性体中的磁电耦合，并表明不同系统中的磁感应电极化可能是不同阶数的SOC效应的结果，并且可以表现出不同的磁各向异性特性。我们进一步将该理论应用于反铁磁体中的异常霍尔效应和自旋磁化，证明它们在OSSG下的独特变换特性允许大异常霍尔响应与弱自旋磁化共存。MAGNDATA数据库中材料的高通量分析确定了几种有利于这种共存的基于对称性的材料类别。总体而言，所提出的框架提供了SOC诱导现象的统一对称描述，并为识别SOC驱动的功能材料提供了系统的方法。

articles.title: Coexistence of Superconductivity and Chern insulators with |C| ≥ 1 in twisted rhombohedral bilayer-trilayer graphene
articles.title_zh: 扭曲菱形双层三层石墨烯中超导电性和Chern绝缘体与| C | ≥ 1共存
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40170v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rhombohedral multilayer graphene (RMG) has been demonstrated as a promising platform for investigating strongly correlated phases of matter. Here, we observe a coexistence of superconductivity and Chern insulators in a twisted rhombohedral bilayer-trilayer graphene moiré superlattice. Superconductivity, evidenced by a sharp transition with a critical temperature of ~180 mK, nonlinear I-V with a BKT temperature of 135 mK, and a signature of phase-sensitive interference patterns, emerges from a symmetry-breaking Fermi surface near v = -2 and D = 0, and it survives at a large in-plane magnetic field up to 2 T, strongly deviating from the Pauli limit. Moreover, we observe a strong modulation of the Ginzburg-Landau coherence length from 467 nm to 145 nm as the in-plane magnetic field increases from 0 to 2 T, whereas the critical current Ic barely changes. Unlike previous studies in RMG, we observe a competition between superconductivity and a correlated insulator at v = -2, monitored by displacement fields and twist angles. Note that we also observe integer Chern insulators with C = 1, 3, and -3 at v = 1/2, 1, and 3, respectively, for large D > 0 in the same superconducting device. The observations establish twisted rhombohedral graphene multilayers as a fascinating system to investigate unconventional superconductivity, high Chern number topology, and their interplay.
articles.abstract_zh: 菱形多层石墨烯（ RMG ）已被证明是研究物质强相关相的有前途的平台。在这里，我们观察到超导体和Chern绝缘体在扭曲的菱形双层三层石墨烯莫尔超晶格中的共存。超导性，由临界温度约为180 mK的急剧转变， BKT温度为135 mK的非线性I-V和相敏干涉图案的特征证明，从v = -2和D = 0附近的对称破坏费米面出现，并且在高达2 T的大平面内磁场下存活，强烈偏离泡利极限。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 菱形多层石墨烯（ RMG ）已被证明是研究物质强相关相的有前途的平台。在这里，我们观察到超导体和Chern绝缘体在扭曲的菱形双层三层石墨烯莫尔超晶格中的共存。超导性，由临界温度约为180 mK的急剧转变， BKT温度为135 mK的非线性I-V和相敏干涉图案的特征证明，从v = -2和D = 0附近的对称破坏费米面出现，并且在高达2 T的大平面内磁场下存活，强烈偏离泡利极限。此外，我们观察到Ginzburg-Landau相干长度从467 nm到145 nm的强调制，因为平面内磁场从0增加到2 T ，而临界电流Ic几乎没有变化。与以前的RMG研究不同，我们观察到超导电性和v = -2的相关绝缘体之间存在竞争，通过位移场和扭转角进行监测。请注意，在同一超导器件中，对于大D > 0 ，我们还在v = 1/2、1和3处分别观察到C = 1、3和-3的整数Chern绝缘体。这些观察结果建立了扭曲的菱形石墨烯多层，作为一个有趣的系统来研究非常规超导性、高Chern数拓扑及其相互作用。

articles.title: Cage-related crystal-field effects in the paramagnetic range of PrB₆
articles.title_zh: PrB顺磁范围内与笼相关的晶场效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40176v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: New insights into the paramagnetic range of PrB₆ below 50 K are revealed through specific-heat, thermal-expansion and magnetic measurements. The latent heats of the two successive magnetic transitions, together with an improved description of the lattice contribution, enable a detailed determination of the thermal variation of the magnetic entropy. Immediately above the first-order magnetic ordering temperature (T_N = 6.7 K), the magnetic entropy per Pr³⁺ is close to that of a doublet, instead of the triplet crystal-field ground state identified by inelastic neutron scattering. Temperatures in excess of 30 K are required to reach the entropy of the threefold-degenerate ground state. This is reminiscent of the CeB₆ case and, similarly, strongly suggests a dynamical splitting of the crystal-field ground state within the boron cage. Further evidence of this splitting is provided by the analysis of the low-temperature paramagnetic susceptibility, which resembles that of a non-magnetic ground state. In addition, a large thermal-expansion anomaly is observed below 20 K, consistent with the expected centrifugal Jahn-Teller effect.
articles.abstract_zh: 通过比热、热膨胀和磁测量揭示了对50 K以下顺磁范围PrB的新见解。两个连续磁跃迁的潜热，以及对晶格贡献的改进描述，使得能够详细确定磁熵的热变化。紧接在一阶磁有序温度（ T_N = 6.7 K ）之上， Pr ³的磁熵接近于双峰的磁熵，而不是非弹性中子散射识别的三重态晶体场基态。需要超过30 K的温度才能达到三重退化基态的熵。这让人想起CeB案例，同样，强烈暗示硼笼内晶场基态的动态分裂。通过对类似于非磁性基态的低温顺磁敏感性的分析，提供了这种分裂的进一步证据。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通过比热、热膨胀和磁测量揭示了对50 K以下顺磁范围PrB的新见解。两个连续磁跃迁的潜热，以及对晶格贡献的改进描述，使得能够详细确定磁熵的热变化。紧接在一阶磁有序温度（ T_N = 6.7 K ）之上， Pr ³的磁熵接近于双峰的磁熵，而不是非弹性中子散射识别的三重态晶体场基态。需要超过30 K的温度才能达到三重退化基态的熵。这让人想起CeB案例，同样，强烈暗示硼笼内晶场基态的动态分裂。通过对类似于非磁性基态的低温顺磁敏感性的分析，提供了这种分裂的进一步证据。此外，在20 K以下观察到一个大的热膨胀异常，与预期的离心Jahn-Teller效应一致。

articles.title: Néel vector switching by magnetization-dependent layer-resolved spin-orbit torque
articles.title_zh: 通过磁化相关层解析的自旋轨道扭矩进行尼尔矢量切换
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40215v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Layer-resolved spin-orbit torques offer a route to controlling antiferromagnetic order through local spin-charge conversion. First-principles calculations show that the layer-resolved spin Hall conductivity of the antiferromagnetic topological insulator mathrmMnBi₂Te₄ consists of a magnetization-independent spin Hall term plus two spin anomalous Hall terms that are even in the Néel vector yet evolve with the local magnetic order, while local inversion asymmetry differentiates surface and inner layers. This response enables reversible, field-free switching of the Néel vector in finite-septuple-layer films. Although the magnetization-independent spin Hall term alone can reverse the order, the spin anomalous Hall terms provide magnetization-dependent feedback that redistributes the layer-resolved torques and reshapes the switching trajectory, offering a route to tailoring current-driven switching through layer and interface engineering.
articles.abstract_zh: 层解析的自旋轨道扭矩提供了一种通过局部自旋电荷转换来控制反铁磁序的途径。第一原理计算表明，反铁磁拓扑绝缘体 mathrmMnBi2Te₄ 的层分辨自旋霍尔电导率由一个与磁化无关的自旋霍尔项和两个自旋反常霍尔项组成，这两个自旋反常霍尔项在 Néel 矢量中均匀分布，但随局部磁序演化，而局部反演不对称性区分了表面层和内层。这种响应能够在有限七层薄膜中实现尼尔矢量的可逆、无场切换。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 层解析的自旋轨道扭矩提供了一种通过局部自旋电荷转换来控制反铁磁序的途径。第一原理计算表明，反铁磁拓扑绝缘体 mathrmMnBi2Te₄ 的层分辨自旋霍尔电导率由一个与磁化无关的自旋霍尔项和两个自旋反常霍尔项组成，这两个自旋反常霍尔项在 Néel 矢量中均匀分布，但随局部磁序演化，而局部反演不对称性区分了表面层和内层。这种响应能够在有限七层薄膜中实现尼尔矢量的可逆、无场切换。尽管与磁化无关的自旋霍尔项本身就可以反转顺序，但自旋反常霍尔项提供了磁化相关的反馈，可以重新分配层解析扭矩并重塑开关轨迹，从而提供了通过层和界面工程定制电流驱动开关的途径。

articles.title: Stabilizing fluctuating Cooper pairs with a terahertz resonator
articles.title_zh: 使用太赫兹谐振器稳定波动的库珀对
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40222v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Coupling quantum materials to electromagnetic cavities or resonators without external driving has gained prominence as a new control mechanism. Here we develop an equilibrium theory of a mesoscopic, disordered two-dimensional superconductor coupled to a subwavelength terahertz resonator, focusing on the interplay between superconducting phase fluctuations in the sample and electromagnetic fluctuations of the resonator. Modeling the resonator as a lumped-element circuit, we show that the coupling enhances, rather than suppresses, the superconducting transition temperature T_c. When the sample is smaller than the Pearl length, phase fluctuations near the Berezinskii--Kosterlitz--Thouless (BKT) transition strongly amplify this enhancement. Crucially, the resistive quasiparticle response of the sample must be included in the analysis: at low frequencies the superfluid shunts the normal-fluid channel, reducing the total sample impedance. For representative parameters, a 1 ,mum × 1 ,mum, 8 nm-thick disordered film, we find a relative T_c enhancement of about 1%, an order of magnitude larger than the 0.1%  obtained when phase fluctuations are neglected. These results identify superconductors with soft phase fluctuations as promising platforms for equilibrium control with terahertz resonators.
articles.abstract_zh: 在没有外部驱动的情况下将量子材料耦合到电磁腔或谐振器已成为一种新的控制机制。在这里，我们发展了介观无序二维超导体与亚波长太赫兹谐振器耦合的平衡理论，重点关注样品中超导相位涨落与谐振器电磁涨落之间的相互作用。将谐振器建模为集总元件电路，我们表明耦合增强而不是抑制超导转变温度 T_c。当样本小于 Pearl 长度时，Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless (BKT) 转变附近的相位波动会强烈放大这种增强。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在没有外部驱动的情况下将量子材料耦合到电磁腔或谐振器已成为一种新的控制机制。在这里，我们发展了介观无序二维超导体与亚波长太赫兹谐振器耦合的平衡理论，重点关注样品中超导相位涨落与谐振器电磁涨落之间的相互作用。将谐振器建模为集总元件电路，我们表明耦合增强而不是抑制超导转变温度 T_c。当样本小于 Pearl 长度时，Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless (BKT) 转变附近的相位波动会强烈放大这种增强。至关重要的是，样品的电阻准粒子响应必须包含在分析中：在低频下，超流体分流正常流体通道，从而降低总样品阻抗。对于代表性参数，1 ,mum × 1 ,mum, 8 nm 厚的无序薄膜，我们发现相对 T_c 增强约为 1%，比忽略相位波动时获得的 0.1% 大一个数量级。这些结果将具有软相位波动的超导体确定为太赫兹谐振器平衡控制的有前途的平台。

articles.title: Chiral superconductivity on a closed Klein bottle: a chirality wall and its Majorana seam spectrum
articles.title_zh: 封闭克莱因瓶上的手性超导：手性墙及其马约拉纳接缝光谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40251v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study a spinless π-flux lattice superconductor whose normal-state momentum-space fundamental domain is a Klein bottle. Within this model, a glide lift and a hidden antiunitary symmetry independently force the Bogoliubov--de Gennes (BdG) Chern number to vanish. A diagonal pairing breaks the antiunitary obstruction exactly when its real part is nonzero; this is necessary, not sufficient, for a chiral phase. We derive explicit Pfaffians determining Chern parity and identify three analytic families of gap closings in a real-pairing section. For a chiral state on a closed real-space Klein bottle, the prescribed pairing and gluing produce a Δ C=2 chirality wall. A translation-invariant unfolding resolves two co-propagating Majorana branches. Their finite-size levels depend on circumference and holonomy; the near-zero pair is lifted at first order by allowed local seam perturbations. A cut-cylinder control has the same low-energy channel count, so gluing reconnects existing gapless content. We also distinguish literal gluing from deck projection: particle--hole symmetry exchanges the deck eigenblocks, precluding their interpretation as independent BdG quotient Hamiltonians. The contribution is a model-specific account of pairing compatibility and closed-surface seam spectra. The energy cost is evaluated for a fixed pairing background; neither a protected zero mode nor a self-consistent wall solution is claimed.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一种无自旋 π 通量晶格超导体，其常态动量空间基本域是克莱因瓶。在该模型中，滑翔升力和隐藏的反酉对称性独立地迫使 Bogoliubov-de Gennes (BdG) 陈数消失。当对角线配对的实部非零时，它恰好打破了反酉障碍；对于手性相来说，这是必要的，但还不够。我们推导了确定陈宇称的显式普法夫式，并确定了实配对部分中间隙闭合的三个分析族。对于封闭实空间克莱因瓶上的手性状态，规定的配对和粘合会产生 Δ C=2 手性墙。平移不变展开解决了两个共同传播的马约拉纳分支。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了一种无自旋 π 通量晶格超导体，其常态动量空间基本域是克莱因瓶。在该模型中，滑翔升力和隐藏的反酉对称性独立地迫使 Bogoliubov-de Gennes (BdG) 陈数消失。当对角线配对的实部非零时，它恰好打破了反酉障碍；对于手性相来说，这是必要的，但还不够。我们推导了确定陈宇称的显式普法夫式，并确定了实配对部分中间隙闭合的三个分析族。对于封闭实空间克莱因瓶上的手性状态，规定的配对和粘合会产生 Δ C=2 手性墙。平移不变展开解决了两个共同传播的马约拉纳分支。它们的有限大小水平取决于周长和完整性；近零对通过允许的局部接缝扰动在一阶提升。切割圆柱体控制具有相同的低能量通道数，因此粘合可以重新连接现有的无间隙内容。我们还区分了字面粘合和甲板投影：粒子-空穴对称性交换了甲板本征块，排除了它们作为独立 BdG 商哈密顿量的解释。其贡献是对配对兼容性和闭合表面接缝光谱的模型特定说明。针对固定配对背景评估能量成本；既没有提出受保护的零模式，也没有提出自洽的墙解决方案。

articles.title: Large Magnetocaloric Effect and Adiabatic Temperature Change in the Tellurate: Gd2TeO6
articles.title_zh: 碲酸盐中的大磁热效应和绝热温度变化：Gd2TeO6
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40296v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the structural, magnetic, thermodynamic, and magnetocaloric properties of polycrystalline Gd2TeO6, a rare-earth tellurate unexplored for cryogenic magnetic refrigeration. Powder X-ray diffraction confirms single-phase orthorhombic symmetry (P212121), featuring two crystallographically distinct seven-coordinate Gd sites. Magnetization measurements reveal no conventional long-range magnetic ordering down to 2 K, although low-field magnetic irreversibility emerges below approximately 4 K. Curie-Weiss analysis yields a Weiss temperature of -1.25 K, indicating weak predominantly antiferromagnetic interactions. The magnetization reaches approximately 97% of the theoretical saturation moment at 7 T with negligible hysteresis. Heat-capacity measurements reveal no sharp zero-field anomaly above 2 K, while a broad field-induced maximum indicates redistribution of low-energy magnetic entropy. Debye-Einstein analysis separates the lattice and magnetic contributions. At 2.5 K, the maximum magnetic entropy changes (-DeltaSM) reach 21.40, 48.51, and 54.81 J kg-1 K-1 for field changes of 0-2, 0-5, and 0-7 T, respectively. The corresponding volumetric entropy change reaches 400.50 mJ cm-3 K-1. Measurements up to 14 T yield (-DeltaSM) = 63.51 J kg-1 K-1, approaching the theoretical limit of 64.25 J kg-1 K-1. The estimated adiabatic temperature change is approximately 22.7 K for 0-7 T. First-principles calculations with GGA+U approximation reveal competing antiferromagnetic states, highlighting Gd2TeO6 as a promising candidate for cryogenic magnetocaloric applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了多晶 Gd2TeO6（一种尚未开发用于低温磁制冷的稀土碲酸盐）的结构、磁性、热力学和磁热特性。粉末 X 射线衍射证实了单相正交对称性 (P212121)，具有两个晶体学上不同的七配位 Gd 位点。磁化测量表明，低至 2 K 时不存在传统的长程磁序，尽管在大约 4 K 以下出现低场磁不可逆性。居里-魏斯分析得出 -1.25 K 的魏斯温度，表明主要是弱反铁磁相互作用。磁化强度在 7 T 时达到理论饱和力矩的约 97%，磁滞可以忽略不计。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了多晶 Gd2TeO6（一种尚未开发用于低温磁制冷的稀土碲酸盐）的结构、磁性、热力学和磁热特性。粉末 X 射线衍射证实了单相正交对称性 (P212121)，具有两个晶体学上不同的七配位 Gd 位点。磁化测量表明，低至 2 K 时不存在传统的长程磁序，尽管在大约 4 K 以下出现低场磁不可逆性。居里-魏斯分析得出 -1.25 K 的魏斯温度，表明主要是弱反铁磁相互作用。磁化强度在 7 T 时达到理论饱和力矩的约 97%，磁滞可以忽略不计。热容测量显示 2 K 以上没有明显的零场异常，而宽阔的场感应最大值表明低能磁熵的重新分布。德拜-爱因斯坦分析将晶格和磁的贡献分开。在 2.5 K 时，对于 0-2、0-5 和 0-7 T 的磁场变化，最大磁熵变 (-DeltaSM) 分别达到 21.40、48.51 和 54.81 J kg-1 K-1。相应的体积熵变达到400.50 mJ cm-3 K-1。测量高达 14 T 产量 (-DeltaSM) = 63.51 J kg-1 K-1，接近 64.25 J kg-1 K-1 的理论极限。 0-7 T 的估计绝热温度变化约为 22.7 K。使用 GGA+U 近似的第一原理计算揭示了竞争的反铁磁态，突出 Gd2TeO6 作为低温磁热应用的有前途的候选者。

articles.title: Soliton-Lattice Origin of Incommensurability in High-Pressure Antimony
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40399v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The microscopic origin of incommensurability in host-guest crystals remains unresolved. Here we show that the high-pressure antimony host-guest phase Sb-II is a soliton lattice, where localized guest-host misregistries decorate a commensurate 4/3 reference structure. First-principles calculations reveal a corrugated and hysteretic registry landscape, motivating a Frenkel-Kontorova description that accounts for soliton-lattice approximants of the form (4n+1)/(3n+1). Machine-learning-potential calculations of these approximants show an energetically preferred soliton spacing, and their localized misregistry cores are also verified by first-principles relaxations. At finite temperature, the thermally broadened soliton lattice appears as an atomic density wave along the guest chains, consistent with experimental diffraction. This soliton-registry picture provides a microscopic mechanism for host-guest incommensurability in Sb-II.

articles.title: Light-induced chiral altermagnets from conventional antiferromagnets
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40410v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets combine compensated collinear magnetic order with momentum-dependent nonrelativistic spin splitting, offering new opportunities for spintronic applications. Here, we propose a route to optically induce altermagnetism through coherent lattice control. Using symmetry analysis, we identify phonon distortions that lift the spin degeneracy of conventional antiferromagnets while preserving the rotational symmetries connecting opposite-spin sublattices. Among these, geometric chiral phonons provide a particularly appealing pathway, linking the emergence of altermagnetism to structural chirality. Taking Fe₂TeO₆ as a prototype, we demonstrate that a linearly polarized mid-infrared pulse can drive a structural instability through negative biquadratic coupling between an infrared-active phonon and an optically silent, symmetry-breaking mode. First-principles-based lattice dynamics reveal the emergence of a transient chiral distortion, while electronic-structure calculations establish that the light-induced structure exhibits nonrelativistic spin splitting characteristic of altermagnetism. Our results establish a symmetry-guided pathway toward the ultrafast optical control of altermagnetic states through nonlinear phononics.

articles.title: Micromagnetic Lagrangian and Hamiltonian Normal-Mode Formulation of Cavity Magnon-Photon Interactions
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40416v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate magnon-photon interactions in a resonant cavity starting from the coupled Maxwell and Landau-Lifshitz equations linearized about an arbitrary micromagnetic ground state. By introducing an electric vector potential and a suitable interaction Lagrangian, the formulation avoids the cancellation of large magnetostatic contributions that arises in the conventional magnetic-vector-potential description and becomes inaccurate under modal truncation. The magnetization and cavity fields are expanded in the normal modes of the uncoupled magnetic and electromagnetic subsystems, with coupling coefficients given by overlap integrals of the corresponding eigenfunctions. The resulting multimode Lagrangian has a noncanonical structure due to the gyrotropic terms, and the corresponding Hamiltonian formulation is obtained using the Faddeev-Jackiw approach. The radiative magnon-photon interaction is encoded in the resulting Poisson-bracket structure, while the cavity-induced modification of the magnetostatic field enters explicitly in the Hamiltonian. The coupled system is diagonalized through a generalized Bogoliubov transformation, yielding canonical polariton variables that provide a natural basis for quantization. Application to a perpendicularly magnetized YIG disk in a rectangular microwave cavity shows hybridization between the cavity mode and several magnetostatic modes, together with appreciable cavity-wall-induced frequency shifts when the sample is placed close to the conducting walls.

articles.title: Seeding and Amplification of Chaos in Long-Range Interacting Spin Chains
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40417v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Truncating weak interactions is a natural simplification of a many-body Hamiltonian, but the validity of this approximation need not be uniform in distance and time. In a chaotic system, a weak long-range coupling can seed a small disturbance far from its source, after which the local dynamics can amplify that disturbance exponentially. We study this mechanism in an infinite-temperature classical Heisenberg spin chain with a dominant nearest-neighbor exchange and a weak interaction tail. Using a classical decorrelator, we compare exponentially and power-law decaying tails over several decades in interaction strength. For exponentially decaying interactions, the long-distance front remains ballistic when the tail is sufficiently shallow, with a velocity controlled by the competition between the spatial decay of the seed and the local chaotic growth. For sufficiently rapid exponential decay, the nearest-neighbor front, which is defined by an intrinsic butterfly velocity v_b, is recovered within the accessible space-time window. For power-law interactions, the arrival time is logarithmic in distance for all exponents studied, corresponding to an exponentially expanding spatial front; the power-law exponent controls the coefficient of this logarithm. We interpret both behaviors using a seeding-and-amplification picture in which long-range couplings generate weak disturbances throughout the chain whose growth is governed primarily by the local nearest-neighbor dynamics. In this picture, the overall strength of the tail primarily controls when the long-range front becomes visible, while its spatial decay controls the propagation law. Thus a weak interaction tail can leave conventional spin-dynamical observables essentially unchanged while qualitatively altering the long-distance propagation of decorrelation.

articles.title: Electric field control of anisotropic spin traffic between spin-filtering and magnon-scattering in a layered antiferromagnet
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40423v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Layered A-type antiferromagnetic (AFM) semiconductors offer a unique platform for spintronic devices by combining robust magnetism with gate-tunable semiconducting properties. We present a dual-gate field-effect transistor based on CrSBr, a layered A-type AFM with pronounced transport anisotropy and complex spin dynamics. Our device provides independent control over carrier density and displacement field. Systematic transport measurements reveal that the displacement field, rather than doping, predominantly governs the sign and magnitude of magnetoresistance ratio (MRR). We identify the origins of both negative and positive MRR components and connect them to interlayer and intralayer spin-dependent transport mechanisms. We interpret these findings with ab initio calculations and an effective spin-circuit model that reproduces the anisotropic magnetotransport. Our results identify the displacement field as an efficient electrical control parameter of spin transport in CrSBr and suggest that multi-gate architectures could provide similar control in other layered antiferromagnetic semiconductors.

articles.title: Time Reflection-Refraction Crossover at Topological Kramers Edge States
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40442v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Time-reversal symmetry protects helical edge states against static nonmagnetic backscattering. We show that spatially uniform temporal modulation produces a time reflection-refraction crossover within the same quantum spin Hall phase while preserving time-reversal symmetry of the instantaneous Hamiltonian. A finite gap to the bulk and an edge splitting that vanishes at the Kramers crossing allow the modulation to suppress bulk excitation while remaining nonadiabatic between the edge channels. Virtual transitions through bulk states enable coherent conversion between counter-propagating edge channels at fixed crystal momentum. Near the crossing, qT governs the leading crossover dynamics for a fixed ramp shape, where q is the momentum offset and T the ramp duration. Coherent interference can suppress and restore reflection as the ramp slows. In the adiabatic limit, two initially time-reversed wave packets follow their respective propagation branches and acquire equal geometric displacements. Their group-velocity contributions cancel, isolating the contribution from the Berry curvature to be directly observable. Temporal modulation thus controls protected states and quantum geometry along a topological edge.

articles.title: Variational wavefunctions for ideal anyon gas: superfluid and skyrmion Hall crystal
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40657v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The ground state of an ideal gas of anyons with statistical angle θin(0,π) is a long-standing open problem, with renewed interest from the recent observations of fractional Chern insulators. In this work we construct variational wavefunctions that build in the exact anyon statistics and combine theory-guided composite-boson, composite-fermion and parton wavefunctions with neural-network correlations on the sphere. For spinless and SU(2) semions we confirm the paired anyon superfluid, well below the best crystal states. At θ=π/3 liquids and crystals are closer in energy for the spinless case. For θ=π/3 anyons with SU(3) flavor, we find two candidates. One is a skyrmion Hall crystal, in which the anyons form an integer quantum Hall state in the effective magnetic field from the spin texture. The other is a chiral color superconductor of six-anyon clusters, the color-flavor-locked pairing descendant of a holon metal with SU(3) color gauge symmetry and SU(3) flavor symmetry; its wavefunction is a hyperdeterminant rather than a product of parton determinants. Within our variational ansatz the color superconductor has better energy than both crystals and the color-flavor locked phases with U(1)² and Z₃ gauge groups. For twisted MoTe₂ this suggests that the reentrant integer quantum anomalous Hall phase is the skyrmion Hall crystal of the doped anyons, and that the observed superconductivity may be the color superconductor, which can undergo a transition to an f+if BCS superconductor with a jump of the chiral central charge by 3.

articles.title: Universal Critical Jump for Inverse-Square Ising Ferromagnets
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.36131v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: For every translation-invariant ferromagnetic Ising chain with n²Jₙ→ B>0, we prove 2β_cBm_c²=1, without restrictions on the finite core or the tail convergence rate. The proof bounds the energy of macroscopic interfaces and rules them out if the critical product exceeds one. Despite the nonzero jump, connected susceptibility is infinite both at criticality and in a neighboring ordered interval. At the critical coupling, the excess magnetization decays more slowly than any positive power of the field as the field tends to zero. We also prove the jump relation in continuous time, for a positive-Stieltjes class of Ohmic spin-boson models.

articles.title: Interpretable neural equation learning for high-dimensional materials data
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.37880v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Equation learning seeks to discover compact, interpretable equations from data using various machine-learning techniques. However, few workflows discover and interpret learned equations in sparse, high-dimensional materials datasets. We present nn-EQL, an equation-learning framework that generates candidate equations through iterative training, pruning, and retraining of a neural network with customizable, user-specified neuron-level activation functions. Candidate equations are ranked using a minimum description length (MDL)-inspired score, balancing error and sparsity, and diagnosed to assess term-wise contributions, input-scaled sensitivities, and uncertainties. We demonstrate nn-EQL on standard AI-Feynman benchmarks as well as multiscale high-dimensional materials datasets such as finite-element simulations of heterogeneous materials, and high-throughput experimental thin-film deposition data. nn-EQL integrates with tabular data and high-dimensional data via standard encoder models, learning equations and providing insight into learned terms. Looking forward, integrating physically interpretable representations, multimodal and multi-fidelity data, and adaptive data acquisition could enable equation learning to formulate and test mechanistic hypotheses.

articles.title: Sample Complexity for Generative Learning of Quantum Measurement Data
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38028v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Generative learning of a quantum measurement distribution from finite data requires choosing a model capacity that balances representation accuracy against estimation cost. We develop a bias-variance framework that decomposes the expected population Kullback-Leibler error at model capacity s and sample size N as mathcal E(s,N)=B(s)+V(s,N), with representation bias B and a variance term V capturing the mean estimation error. In the well-sampled regime, V(s,N)simeq[NC(s)]⁻¹, and exponential or algebraic laws for B and C yield four scaling templates for the optimal error, from inverse powers of N to inverse powers of ln N. For local autoregressive models, the context radius sets the model capacity, and B is the summed conditional mutual information lost by truncating the context. For a smoothed histogram learner, we derive an exact finite-sample estimation cost that accounts for rarely observed contexts and recovers the parameter-count law in the well-sampled regime. For transverse-field Ising Born distributions, the independently evaluated bias and estimation cost predict both the optimal context radius and the optimal error. In the well-sampled regime, the estimation cost grows exponentially with context radius. Its competition with approximately exponential bias decay in the gapped regimes predicts power-law error decay in N, while algebraic bias decay at criticality predicts asymptotic inverse-power decay in ln N. Bulk-site results are consistent with the corresponding finite-sample predictions. These results connect the structure of quantum measurement distributions to the model capacity justified by finite data.

articles.title: Drift-induced nonreciprocity in image-polariton-mediated dipole emission
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38348v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Electrical current bias offers a magnet-free route to nonreciprocal light propagation at the nanoscale. Here, we theoretically explore drift-induced nonreciprocity in graphene heterostructures containing hexagonal boron nitride (hBN), where graphene plasmons interact with hBN phonon polaritons in the infrared. Both the random-phase approximation and the Boltzmann transport equation are used to characterize the nonlocal optical response of drift-biased graphene. We compare graphene on hBN with an image-polaritonic structure comprising graphene, a thin hBN spacer, and a gold substrate. Carrier drift produces pronounced directional shifts of the polariton dispersion, while coupling to hBN phonon polaritons strongly modifies the nonreciprocal response. In the image-polaritonic structure, the graphene polaritons become up to twice as confined while retaining a comparable Fizeau shift. The nonreciprocal polariton dispersion produces directional near-field emission and nonreciprocal dipole-dipole interactions, the latter quantified through the cross density of optical states, reaching a left-right dissymmetry of up to ~40%. Our results identify image polaritons in drift-biased graphene as a compact, electrically tunable platform for directional coupling between quantum emitters at the nanoscale.

articles.title: Exploring Fractional Quantum Hall States with Deep Learning: From Abelian to Non-Abelian Phases
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38533v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Fractional quantum Hall systems host strongly correlated topological phases with potential applications in topological quantum computation, yet identifying their microscopic ground states remains challenging because competing phases are often nearly degenerate and Landau-level mixing is difficult to treat. Here, we introduce a symmetry-adapted neural-network wavefunction that describes Abelian and non-Abelian states while incorporating all Landau levels. The method accurately captures composite-fermion liquids and the emergence of Wigner crystallization at low filling. When the first Landau level is partially filled, finite-size overlaps and entanglement spectra provide evidence consistent with bar2k1k⁺¹-type parton phases at ν=4/3 and 7/5, while the ν=3/2 state exhibits anti-Pfaffian-like entanglement structure. These results demonstrate that neural-network wavefunctions offer a flexible framework for studying competing topological orders in fractional quantum Hall systems.

articles.title: The Effective Field Theory Origin of the Fuzzy Sphere Method
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38702v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Fuzzy sphere Hamiltonians for (2+1)D conformal field theories are usually written directly on the lowest Landau level. We introduce a framework organizing them as descendants of local ``mother theories'' on S²×mathbb R. We start with the example of Ising mother theory built from two charged Dirac fermions coupled to a real mediator φ. Integrating out φ and the higher Landau levels produces the fuzzy Hamiltonian, while integrating out the fermions gives a conventional local φ effective field theory flowing to the Ising point. Mild modifications of the same theory reach the Gaussian point (tricritical route) and the Lee-Yang continuation. Exploring the space of mother theories, we next promote φ to a complex field Φ and construct a new example, whose descendant is an easy-plane ferromagnet on the fuzzy sphere. Its spontaneous symmetry breaking phase gives a pseudo-Goldstone relativistic scalar, similar to the model introduced by Y.-C. He, while its critical point is non-relativistic, providing the first example of z=2 scaling on the fuzzy sphere. Remarkably, it admits exact one-magnon solutions, and the z=2 critical point can be found analytically. We then outline a rich landscape of further applications of our approach.

articles.title: Generating Multipartite Entanglement via Structured-Bath Engineering
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38807v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present how to dissipatively prepare genuinely multipartite-entangled steady states with mutually independent local reservoirs by harnessing an Abelian strong symmetry and temporal bath correlations. In interacting Ising chains, we demonstrate that, for a broad class of system-environment couplings, flat baths exponentially erase Ising-axis correlations. Structured baths overcome this obstruction by converting temporal bath correlations into classical spatial correlations. Strong symmetry then promotes these correlations to the quantum domain, enabling global multipartite entanglement. Within weak-coupling theory, we obtain exact steady states despite the generator's nonquadratic nature: strong symmetry reduces their construction to a classical problem for arbitrary Ising couplings. This reduction reveals an exact connection between classical distinguishability and entanglement. We then show how to engineer the bath spectrum to increase the correlation length and enable the preparation of GHZ-like states from separable initial conditions. We test the mechanism beyond the analytical regime using exact Markovian embeddings and tensor-network simulations. Our approach is particularly suited to superconducting and trapped-ion platforms, and we propose a concrete implementation for the latter using sympathetically cooled motional modes.

articles.title: Generalized Symmetries of QED₄ on Non-Spin Manifolds
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38907v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Generalized symmetries are sensitive to the tangential structure of spacetime. We study this interplay for massless QED on oriented non-spin four-manifolds, where the photon becomes a spin^c connection and the path integral sums over spin^c structures. The shifted flux quantization extends the magnetic 1-form symmetry into a w₂-twisted 1-form symmetry: its 2π rotation acts as a gravitational sign, fixed by the normal bundle of the surface the operator wraps. The obstruction to treating it as an ordinary magnetic 1-form symmetry is an order-two mixed magnetic-gravitational anomaly, which is classified by reduced oriented bordism and detected on the Wu manifold. In a fixed spin^c sector, this anomaly is removable by a counterterm, so it is a property of the sum over spin^c structures. We discuss its consequences for gapped, Coulomb, and Higgs phases. The chiral anomaly is governed by the index of the spin^c Dirac operator, so rational chiral defects carry gravitational as well as electromagnetic responses. A spin^c Hall topological field theory cancels the electromagnetic part but leaves a framing anomaly. At the level of anomaly inflow, this is canceled for every rational angle by stacking a neutral, generally noninvertible Witten-Reshetikhin-Turaev layer. The same framing subtlety affects the chiral defects of QED on curved spin manifolds. The complex projective plane illustrates each of these features explicitly.

articles.title: Where the Error Lives: Spectral Representations of Learned Kohn-Sham Hamiltonians
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.37843v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Kohn-Sham density functional theory (DFT) is the standard method for computing the electronic structure of molecules and materials, but its self-consistent-field (SCF) iterations make it expensive for large systems and high-throughput screening. Machine-learned Hamiltonian models offer a shortcut: an equivariant network predicts the Kohn-Sham Hamiltonian matrix in one forward pass, and diagonalizing the prediction yields orbital energies, the HOMO-LUMO gap, molecular orbitals and the electron density. These models are trained to match the reference matrix entry by entry, yet a small entry-wise error does not guarantee accurate eigenvalues or eigenvectors. Two physics-informed alternatives go partway: a recently proposed wavefunction-alignment loss adds a spectral penalty without diagonalizing the prediction, and matching the electron density of the diagonalized prediction supervises it directly. Neither is complete: by representing the prediction error in the eigenbasis of the reference Hamiltonian, we show that each sees only part of the error, and that shifting the predicted orbital energies leaves the electron density exactly unchanged. The same analysis identifies a complete training signal: the cumulative local density of states (cumulative LDOS), the number of electrons at each point in space with energy below a given threshold. The cumulative LDOS is a single physical observable that contains the electron density as a special case, responds to every component of the error, determines the Hamiltonian uniquely, and yields gradients that do not vanish for large orbitalenergy errors. Fine-tuning three Hamiltonian networks on QH9 in this way, which we call FermiScope, reduces the HOMO-LUMO gap error without increasing the element-wise error. The gains carry over to out-of-distribution and molecular-dynamics splits, where the wavefunction-alignment loss helps less.

articles.title: Automated identification of quasi-BIC modes in disordered resonator chains using spatial field envelopes and resonance descriptors
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.37967v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Structural disorder turns bound states in the continuum (BICs) into quasi-BIC resonances and mixes them with spectrally close eigenmodes, so the target mode must be identified anew in every disorder realization. We develop an automated procedure for this task and test it on a chain of 50 ceramic disks, where disorder reorders the standing-wave eigenmodes at the edge of the BIC band: at disorder amplitude σ=0.05, the highest-quality-factor (Q) mode is the target in only 45% of realizations, and above σapprox0.06 the highest-frequency mode is no longer the target. The target is identified from the spatial envelope of its field and its resonance parameters by an ensemble of a convolutional--recurrent neural network and two gradient-boosted decision-tree models. On 299 held-out realizations, the ensemble selects the target in 82.6% of cases, against 60.9% and 49.5% for the highest-frequency and highest-Q rules, and in 69.5% of cases for σge0.09, where the best of these rules reaches 57.6%. The mean Q of the selected modes follows that of the manually labeled modes (langle Qrangleproptoσk, k=-0.80±0.05 versus -0.86±0.04). After adaptation on 50 labeled realizations, the workflow identifies the quasi-BIC of a Ge₂Sb₂Te₅ bar metasurface in 98--100% of labeled cases, including a lossy phase where Q does not distinguish the mode.

articles.title: Transition from laser Raman to Bernstein scattering in magnetized plasmas
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38093v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When a laser backscatters from an external perpendicular magnetic field, stimulated Raman scattering transitions to stimulated Bernstein scattering, which we show using kinetic theory and particle-in-cell simulations. For low field strengths, the magnetic field acts as an electron detrapping mechanism, suppressing nonlinear effects of Raman scattering. At stronger fields, when the electron cyclotron frequency ωce becomes non-negligible compared to the plasma frequency ωpe, the Raman resonance splits into discrete resonances mediated by electron Bernstein waves (EBWs). Raman scattering ceases to exist between the EBW resonances, which are narrower and stronger than the Raman resonance they replace. The replacement is sensitive to angle: When the magnetic field is away from perpendicular by an angle α gtrsim ωce/ωpe, the damping of EBW resonances blends them back into a broad single Raman peak. Our results demonstrate that strong magnetic fields, either spontaneously generated or externally imposed in high-energy-density experiments, fundamentally change laser-plasma interactions in a way that has no analog in unmagnetized plasmas, with implications for field diagnostics, plasma photonics, and inertial confinement fusion.

articles.title: A fully convolutional neural network to classify UXOs using multicomponent electromagnetic induction data
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38177v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Unexploded ordnance (UXO) clearance relies on electromagnetic induction (EMI) methods to detect and classify buried and submerged metallic objects, but the standard classification workflow requires physics-based inversion and manual expert review. We present a fully convolutional neural network (CNN) that classifies UXO directly from multicomponent time-domain EMI data, bypassing the inversion step entirely. The CNN uses a segmentation-like architecture that preserves the spatial dimensions of the input and outputs a high-resolution classification map suitable for generating a diglist. Two CNNs are used in sequence: the first detects anomalies due to metallic objects and characterizes the spatially correlated noise present in the preprocessed field data; the second performs multi-class classification using synthetic training data augmented with that noise. A physics-based parameterization of the clutter class is used to train the network to discriminate clutter from UXO across a broad range of object types. We validate this approach on two field datasets acquired with the UltraTEMA-4 system at the Sequim Bay marine test site. On a calibration grid with 21 seeded objects, the CNN detects all UXOs and discriminates two out of four clutter objects. On an independent blind grid with 35 seeded objects (17 UXOs, 18 clutter), the CNN detects and classifies all UXOs and achieves a false-positive count comparable to that of the physics-based inversion approach. We see the two methods as complementary: once trained, the CNN classifies rapidly and with minimal supervision, making it well suited as a fast first-pass tool or as an independent check on physics-based results.

articles.title: Uncertainty-Driven Self-Refinement of Adaptive Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Fitting Nonadiabatic Potential Energy Surface
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38227v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, we propose an uncertainty-driven self-refinement learning method using adaptive Chebyshev-polynomial-based Kolmogorov-Arnold networks (ChebyKANs) to build potential energy surface (PES). Unlike conventional approaches, our method employs a main-model-plus-residual-model architecture for automatic sampling based on a hybrid criterion, where sampling and fitting are decoupled. To benchmark our method, the non-adiabatic two-state PES of the H + H₂ system is constructed using a database computed at the multireference configuration interaction (MRCI) level with a rather large active space. Our calculations show that the proposed architectural design makes the efficiency gain, and that KAN offers enhanced interpretability over conventional neural network (NN) fitting methods through its mathematically well-understood basis functions. Furthermore, the present calculations accurately reproduce all important conformations on the PES, including the transition state and the conical intersection. Then, the multi-configurational time-dependent Hartree (MCTDH) method reproduces the non-adiabatic dynamics with results in close agreement with previously reported findings.

articles.title: The Alpha--Omega Problem in the Assessments of Atmospheric Power
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38522v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Atmospheric power is commonly assessed with two Lorenz-cycle formulations treated as equivalent: the αω formulation, yielding gas expansion power W_ω, and the v·nabla z formulation, yielding kinetic-energy generation by horizontal pressure gradients, W_K. We show that, for a statistically stationary global moist atmosphere, W_ω=W_K+W_P+Wᵣₘ ₙₕ, where W_P is the power of lifting precipitating water and Wᵣₘ ₙₕ is power associated with departures from gas-phase hydrostatic balance. Since W_Psimeq1 W m⁻² globally, equality would require Wᵣₘ ₙₕsimeq-W_P<0, so the associated vertical force imbalance would have to do negative work globally. Using six-hourly ERA5, JRA-3Q, and MERRA-2 fields for 2025, we find that resolved W_ω varies by a factor of 1.7 (1.9--3.2 W m⁻²), versus 1.2 for W_K (2.4--2.8 W m⁻²). Zonal-mean αω profiles have area-weighted contributions near ±50 W m⁻², making global W_ω a cancellation residual, whereas v·nabla z profiles vary much less with latitude. The difference W_ω-W_K ranges from -0.61 to +0.87 W m⁻². Thus reanalysis-derived W_ω cannot provide an independent constraint on atmospheric power. Two treatments of the omitted surface layer give cross-reanalysis mean W_K of 2.8 and 3.1 W m⁻², with corrected values spanning 2.6--3.5 W m⁻². Both exceed the observation-based Lorenz available-potential-energy generation estimate of 1.2 W m⁻². Assuming Wᵣₘ ₙₕ≥0, adding W_Psimeq1 W m⁻² gives total atmospheric power of about 3.8--4.1 W m⁻², motivating investigation of additional power-generation mechanisms.

articles.title: Extending the limits of rotationally resolved mid-IR spectroscopy: an accurate model of trioxane derived from combining Fourier transform and sub-Doppler measurements
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38565v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: 1,3,5-Trioxane, a polyoxymethylene (POM) molecule relevant to prebiotic chemistry and astrophysics, exhibits a dense rovibrational spectrum that challenges high-resolution spectroscopic characterization. Here, we report an extensive study of its ν 5 CO symmetric stretching mode (960-1000 cm -1 ) by combining broadband high-resolution FTIR spectroscopy (0.001 cm -1 resolution, >2000 transitions) with SI-traceable sub-Doppler saturated absorption measurements using frequency-stabilized CO 2 lasers and a frequency-comb-referenced quantum cascade laser. The latter achieve lineposition uncertainties as low as 40 kHz, revealing inaccuracies in the FTIR frequency scale. A frequency-scale correction is determined by maximizing the global consistency of the complete spectroscopic data set. A global least-squares Hamiltonian fit combining the calibrated FTIR data, the SI-traceable sub-Doppler measurements and previously reported millimeter-wave rotational transitions yields a refined spectroscopic model. The resulting analysis significantly improves the precision of the rotational, quartic, and sextic constants for both the ground and ν 5 excited vibrational states. This work extends mid-infrared frequency metrology to the largest molecule studied to date (12 atoms), providing a dense set of reference transitions for frequency calibration around 970 cm -1 . The resulting spectroscopic parameters reach relative uncertainties as low as 3.7 x 10 -10 for the band origin, making them valuable for molecular databases used in astrophysics and atmospheric physics, as well as for precision measurements in fundamental physics. Additionally, the observed line shapes indicate the absence of significant intramolecular vibrational energy redistribution (IVR) within the investigated energy range, while a few discrepancies in the Hamiltonian fit suggest the onset of weak perturbations, demonstrating the sensitivity of the present approach to probe subtle intramolecular couplings in complex polyatomic spectra. Q P (31,10) 28 967 426 394.

articles.title: Emergence of Zonal Flows in an Imbalanced Point-Vortex System
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38612v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Motivated by experiments on rotating Bose-Einstein condensates, we investigate the statistical mechanics and the non-equilibrium dynamics of an imbalanced gas of oppositely signed Onsager point vortices confined in a disk. To model external forcing and dissipation, we supplement their Hamiltonian dynamics with an annihilation-reinjection (AR) mechanism that preserves the imbalance: oppositely signed vortices are annihilated when they approach closer than a distance representing the healing length, and are subsequently reintroduced into the domain at random locations. At positive energies, the system self-organizes into a large-scale coherent dipole at low imbalance and into a zonal flow at higher imbalance. While AR breaks energy and angular momentum conservation, we argue that the vortex gas evolves quasi-adiabatically through the equilibrium phase space. We capture the topological transition between dipolar and zonal flows both from a statistical and a hydrodynamical perspective. In particular, the bifurcation reflects a non-trivial equilibrium diagram in terms of energy e, angular momentum μ, and vortex imbalance η. We characterize this phase diagram in the "strong mixing'' regime studied by linearizing the Joyce-Montgomery mean-field theory about the weakly non-uniform state. We show that the linear theory is surprisingly relevant for the numerical simulations with AR and suggest that the selection between the dipolar and the zonal configurations in the (e,μ,η) phase space is driven by a hydrodynamical shear instability.

articles.title: Light and charge yields from nuclear recoils in noble liquids: From sub-keV energies to 1 MeV
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38718v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a first-principles study of total quanta and charge recombination in noble liquids, based on a solution of Lindhard's integro-differential equation for atomic motion with electronic straggling and detailed modeling of inter-atomic potentials. We introduce the electronic scaling length ξₑ as a fundamental parameter related to a physical observable of the system. We study the energy and electric-field dependence of the exciton-to-ion ratio for nuclear recoils based on the Bates-Griffing process and semiclassical atomic interactions. The resulting light and charge yields are expressed through the recombination probability in the Thomas-Imel box model using the calculated parameter ξₑ and one fitted constant. We compare our model with recent measurements of the electric-field dependence of the box size in LAr and LXe and provide a physical explanation for this behavior. Our model extends to sub-keV energies and provides a consistent description of available data from a few keV to 1 MeV, yielding better overall agreement with existing LAr data than NEST and offering predictions for LXe.

articles.title: Regional accuracy of physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) for recirculation in a deep lid-driven cavity
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38814v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Deep lid-driven cavities contain strong motion beneath the lid and much weaker recirculation at depth, so agreement in bulk velocity is an incomplete assessment of a computed flow. We examine data-free physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) for steady, two-dimensional incompressible flow in a cavity of depth-to-width ratio five at Reynolds numbers 100, 250, 500 and 1000. An established hard-constrained streamfunction formulation is combined with prescribed regional collocation, transferred initialization, and selected residual-scaling and envelope variants. Independent spectral/hp calculations with the same Gaussian-regularized lid provide the reference fields. For a cavity of depth-to-width ratio D/W=5 at Reynolds numbers Re=100, 250, 500, and 1000, evaluation on a common 121×605 grid gives interior relative velocity discrepancies of 5.130%--7.850%. Over the same cases, floor-region relative velocity discrepancies remain below 5%, with absolute RMS discrepancies ranging from 1.255×10⁻¹⁰U to 2.332×10⁻⁹U, where U is the lid-velocity scale. In a separate 161×801 assessment at Rey=1000, the refined workflow lowers interior velocity discrepancy from 5.624% to 2.658% and gauge-aligned pressure RMS discrepancy from 2.793×10⁻³ to 1.167×10⁻³ρ U². The improvements compare accumulated training workflows and do not isolate regional sampling. Configuration rankings depend on both region and observable. These finite-budget comparisons establish where the retained workflows agree with the reference and where rotational-field discrepancies remain substantial.

articles.title: Diffusion model for fast alpha-particle transport in Magneto-Inertial Fusion plasmas
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38839v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A diffusion model is developed to describe fast alpha-particle transport and confinement in dense magnetized DT fusion plasmas, tailored to Magneto-Inertial Fusion conditions. The model, derived from the Fokker-Planck kinetic equation using the Chapman-Enskog approximation, includes dynamic Coulomb friction from electrons and ions. This approach improves upon earlier heuristic model [Liberman and Velikovich, J. Plasma Phys. 31, 369 (1984)], which, while valid in the ignition range near 5 keV, lacks accuracy at the higher temperatures ~20 keV required for high-gain Magnetized Liner Inertial Fusion (MagLIF). This paper provides explicit analytic formulas for all transport coefficients and characterizes the relationship between the alpha-particle pressure gradient and the associated Ampère force in magnetized plasmas, which are both relevant for MagLIF at high temperatures.

articles.title: PolyDiscover: an integrated trust-aware platform for multi-objective polymer discovery and simulation validation
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38843v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Data-driven polymer discovery remains fragmented across databases, models, screening, literature, and simulations. We present PolyDiscover, a platform unifying multi-source property lookup, graph-neural-network prediction, trust-aware multi-objective screening, literature extraction, generative candidate exploration, and automated handoff to molecular-dynamics validation. Building on published ADEPT-PolyGraphMT, it harmonizes experimental, molecular-dynamics, density-functional-theory, and group-contribution data spanning 28 properties across about 13,000 real and one million virtual polymers. Its engine combines feasibility filtering and exact Pareto ranking with a trust score integrating similarity to known polymers, physical consistency, predictive uncertainty, and synthesizability, followed by diversity-aware shortlisting. Two case studies on lightweight, thermally stable structural materials and thermally stable electrical insulators, using monomer HOMO-LUMO gap as an insulation proxy, reduced a million-polymer search space to 30 chemically diverse candidates per task. Higher-fidelity molecular-dynamics and density-functional-theory calculations, interpreted after correcting systematic density underestimation by the molecular-dynamics protocol, showed retention of targeted property combinations. Ablation showed that trust-aware ranking shifted about one fifth of each shortlist toward more synthesizable chemistry closer to known polymers. A constrained natural-language interface translated a free-text request into a validated specification matching expert screening exactly, while staged literature evidence corroborated high glass-transition temperatures in polyimide-dominated shortlists against published experiments. PolyDiscover offers a traceable route from design intent to simulation-validated candidates, easing exploration of polymer chemical space.

articles.title: The Ensemble Ghost Interaction in Fractional-Occupation Hartree-Fock: Occupation Covariance, Pair Rank, and Prescribed Ensembles of Determinants
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38873v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fractional Occupation Number unrestricted Hartree-Fock (FON-UHF) evaluates the UHF functional on a density matrix with non-integer occupations. Sector-Averaged UHF (SA-UHF) averages the energies of a prescribed ensemble of determinants, possibly from different particle-number sectors, on common orbitals. The two differ by the ensemble ghost interaction G. We show that, for two determinants, the numbers of spin-orbitals gained and lost between them classify G before any calculation. G vanishes on every orbital set at pair rank one, has a fixed sign at pair rank two and whenever two or more spin-orbitals are only gained or only lost, and otherwise has an orbital-dependent sign. For larger ensembles, G vanishes on every orbital set when all pair covariances of the occupations vanish, and in the complete-basis limit only then. The same pairs add a covariance term to the orbital gradient and give the error of the chemical potential estimated from the ensemble Fock matrix. We implemented both methods in the eT program. The calculations give G = 0.24 Hartree at half transfer for the hexaamminecobalt(III/II) couple, 78-84% of the FON-UHF penalty for a fraction shared between the degenerate frontier orbitals of benzene, and the limit 1/(4R) for a hole shared between two stacked ethylene molecules.

articles.title: Inherent Failure Modes of Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Buoyancy-Driven Flow: Role of Non-Dimensionalization in Network Training
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38889v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the influence of non-dimensionalization on the trainability and accuracy of physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) for buoyancy-driven flows. Using a differentially heated square cavity at Pr=0.71 and Ra=10³--10⁵, we compare thermal-diffusive and free-fall velocity scalings under identical training conditions. The free-fall scaling, with a unit buoyancy coefficient, achieves errors below 1.1% in the mean Nusselt number for Rale10⁴, whereas the diffusive scaling, with a buoyancy coefficient of Ra,Pr, produces errors of 157--650% and diverges at Ra=10⁵. We identify a coefficient-induced gradient imbalance, with the dominant buoyancy-related contribution to the loss gradient scaling as (Ra,Pr)², and confirm it through direct gradient measurements. Neither sparse-data supervision nor adaptive loss weighting resolves the training difficulties under the tested conditions. For unsteady convection, the free-fall PINN accurately predicts long-time heat transfer but fails to capture the transient Nusselt-number overshoot. These findings establish non-dimensionalization as an important design consideration for improving PINN trainability in buoyancy-driven flows.

articles.title: Options for heating, fueling, and current drive in MANTA, a high-field negative triangularity fusion pilot plant
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38899v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, we assess how the performance of MANTA, a high-field, highly radiative, negative triangularity tokamak concept, depends on pellet fueling, ion cyclotron resonant frequency (ICRF) heating, and lower hybrid current drive (LHCD) schemes. Negative triangularity (NT) has been gaining momentum in the fusion community as a naturally, robustly ELM-free regime that is capable of power plant level performance. The MANTA device has been the subject of previous works regarding the whole-device design, power handling and divertor assessments, and core transport optimizations. Informed by these previous studies, we assess whether changes to the original MANTA heating and current drive scheme can positively affect performance, both in terms of lowering scrape-off layer power (improving power-handling, a primary benefit of NT) and maximizing plasma gain to levels necessary for an attractive fusion pilot plant. In this work, we find that the MANTA concept can yield improved performance in terms of plasma gain and scrape-off layer power by simultaneously going to lower input power and higher seeded impurity fraction. Also, we find that increasing the fueling magnitude can increase fusion power while minimally impacting scrape-off layer power. Performance can also be improved by optimizing the ICRF design; decreasing the minority ion fraction, decreasing the toroidal mode number of the injected wave, and switching from a helium-3 minority ion to a hydrogen-1 minority ion all result in increases to fusion power. The additional inboard space afforded by the NT geometry provides an opportunity for wave launch to be moved to the inboard side. This is beneficial for LHCD access and results in a wide range of potential current profiles in the edge, with the total driven current due to 25 MW of LHCD reaching up to 1.2 MA, or about 12% of the total current.
