The photograph sedimentation test was employed to assess the longer-term stability and suspension of all particles, and the results revealed surprising stability up to 7 weeks after preparation. Following the confirmation of the experimental analytical correlation, different test runs for MMO/EG@DW-based THN were conducted through a circular geometry heat exchanger in turbulent regions. A prominent enhancement in CHTC and Nusselt numbers was recorded on average and locally against varying Reynolds (Re) numbers from 5849 to 24544. The 0.1 wt.% concentration contributed a higher enhancement of 3120 W m−2 K−1 in CHTC of the MMO/EG@DW based THN with a slight increase in applied pumping power, which is due to the use of EG with DW. Further, the study stated that all the positive parameters at all Reynolds ranges and wt.% concentrations of MMO/EG@DW based THN offered the possible use of mixed metal oxides hybrid/composite aqueous suspension, together as an alternative working liquid in varying thermal management systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 使用两步探针超声处理，在乙二醇和蒸馏水（EG@DW，50:50）混合物中合成均匀且分散良好的混合金属氧化物（MMO），并制备基于 MMO/EG@DW 的三元杂化纳米流体（THN），以评估 ZnO、Al2O3 和 TiO2 的热物理、流体动力学和对流传热系数（CHTC）特性。圆形几何热交换器承受 10092.41 W m-2 的恒定热通量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 使用两步探针超声处理，在乙二醇和蒸馏水（EG@DW，50:50）混合物中合成均匀且分散良好的混合金属氧化物（MMO），并制备基于 MMO/EG@DW 的三元杂化纳米流体（THN），以评估 ZnO、Al2O3 和 TiO2 的热物理、流体动力学和对流传热系数（CHTC）特性。圆形几何热交换器承受 10092.41 W m-2 的恒定热通量。所有具有不同尺寸和形态的金属氧化物均以相同的 33.3% 重量计，并以四种不同的浓度分散在 EG@DW 基础液中：0.025 wt.%、0.05 wt.%、0.075 wt.% 和 0.1 wt.%，以获得分散良好的混合纳米流体。进行 FESEM、UV-vis 和 wt.% 吸光度表征，以观察所有颗粒的均匀分散情况。在 20°C 至 45°C 的不同温度和不同的 wt.% 浓度下评估动态/运动粘度、密度和导热率。当所有金属氧化物一起负载在 EG@DW 基础液中时，所有参数均得到显着改善。采用照片沉降测试来评估所有颗粒的长期稳定性和悬浮性，结果显示制备后长达 7 周的稳定性令人惊讶。在确认实验分析相关性后，通过圆形几何热交换器在湍流区域对基于 MMO/EG@DW 的 THN 进行了不同的测试运行。与从 5849 到 24544 的不同雷诺 (Re) 数相比，平均和局部记录了 CHTC 和努塞尔数的显着增强。0.1 wt.% 浓度使基于 MMO/EG@DW 的 THN 的 CHTC 更高地增强了 3120 W m−2 K−1，并且施加的泵浦功率略有增加，这是由于使用了 EG 和 DW。此外，该研究表明，基于 THN 的 MMO/EG@DW 的所有雷诺范围和重量％浓度下的所有正参数提供了混合金属氧化物杂化/复合水悬浮液的可能使用，以及作为不同热管理系统中的替代工作液体。

articles.title: Root Class-Specific Phosphorus Dynamics and Antioxidant Defense Responses in Contrasting Chinese Fir Clones Under Phosphorus Deficiency
articles.title_zh: 缺磷条件下对比杉木无性系根系特异性磷动态和抗氧化防御反应
articles.abstract: Aims Phosphorus (P) deficiency is a serious constraint on the productivity of forest plantations, especially in Chinese fir (Cunninghamia lanceolata). This study aims to determine how P availability affects root class-specific P acquisition, antioxidant responses, and physiological adaptations in two contrasting Chinese fir clones (020 and 061) across three harvesting periods. Methods Seedlings were grown in P-deficient (P0) and P-replete (P1) conditions, and P dynamics and antioxidant responses were determined across root orders, shoots, and needles. Results Generally, P concentration and accumulation increased with harvesting time and were significantly higher in P-replete conditions, with clone-061 being the better P acquirer than clone-020. P concentration and accumulation differed significantly among root classes, indicating functional specialization in P acquisition and distribution. P uptake and translocation were highest during early harvestings, while P use efficiency was higher at later growth stages. Under P deficiency, the activities of antioxidant enzymes, such as superoxide dismutase, peroxidase, and catalase, increased with harvesting time, especially in clone-061, and the malondialdehyde content decreased with harvesting time and remained comparatively lower in clone-061, indicating reduced oxidative damage. According to principal component analysis, both P acquisition and antioxidant enzyme activity were positively associated with antioxidant responses and negatively associated with malondialdehyde in a distinct, root-class-specific manner. Conclusions Overall, clone-061 exhibited superior P acquisition, utilization efficiency, and antioxidant capacity, highlighting its greater adaptation to phosphorus-limited environments. These findings reveal root-specific P-use strategies and support selecting P-efficient Chinese fir genotypes for sustainable plantation management.
articles.abstract_zh: 磷（P）缺乏严重限制了人工林的生产力，特别是杉木（Cunninghamia lanceolata）。本研究旨在确定磷有效性如何影响两个对比杉木无性系（020 和 061）在三个收获期的根类特异性磷获取、抗氧化反应和生理适应。方法 幼苗在缺磷 (P0) 和磷充足 (P1) 条件下生长，并测定根序、芽和针叶的磷动态和抗氧化反应。结果 一般来说，磷浓度和积累量随着收获时间的延长而增加，并且在磷充足的条件下显着更高，克隆 061 是比克隆 020 更好的磷获取者。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磷（P）缺乏严重限制了人工林的生产力，特别是杉木（Cunninghamia lanceolata）。本研究旨在确定磷有效性如何影响两个对比杉木无性系（020 和 061）在三个收获期的根类特异性磷获取、抗氧化反应和生理适应。方法 幼苗在缺磷 (P0) 和磷充足 (P1) 条件下生长，并测定根序、芽和针叶的磷动态和抗氧化反应。结果 一般来说，磷浓度和积累量随着收获时间的延长而增加，并且在磷充足的条件下显着更高，克隆 061 是比克隆 020 更好的磷获取者。不同根系的磷浓度和积累差异显着，表明磷获取和分配的功能专业化。磷的吸收和转运在收获初期最高，而磷的利用效率在生长后期较高。缺磷条件下，抗氧化酶（如超氧化物歧化酶、过氧化物酶和过氧化氢酶）的活性随着收获时间的延长而增加，特别是在clone-061中，丙二醛含量随着收获时间的延长而下降，在clone-061中保持相对较低，表明氧化损伤减少。根据主成分分析，磷获取和抗氧化酶活性均与抗氧化反应呈正相关，并以独特的、根类特异性的方式与丙二醛呈负相关。结论 总体而言，clone-061 表现出优异的磷获取、利用效率和抗氧化能力，突显其对磷限制环境的更强适应能力。这些发现揭示了根系特异性磷利用策略，并支持选择磷高效杉木基因型进行可持续人工林管理。

articles.title: Temporally Coherent Hierarchical Distance Queries for Deformable Triangle Meshes
articles.title_zh: 可变形三角形网格的时间相干分层距离查询
articles.abstract: Signed-distance queries on deformable triangle meshes are fundamental operations that are repeatedly performed in a wide range of applications, including collision handling, surface tracking, physically based simulation, and geometric processing. However, in dynamic environments where a mesh continuously deforms over time, reconstructing a static hierarchy at every frame or updating all bounding volumes can incur substantial computational cost, while conventional distance-query acceleration structures do not fully exploit such temporal coherence. In this paper, we propose a temporally coherent hierarchical distance-query method for deformable triangle meshes. The proposed method maintains an anisotropic temporal bound for each hierarchy node to account for local deformation and selectively refreshes the stored reference bound only for nodes whose deformation magnitude exceeds a prescribed threshold, thereby preserving the tightness of the temporal bounds. In addition, nearest-triangle information from the previous frame is retained as a compact persistent seed and re-evaluated on the deformed geometry of the current frame to obtain a tight initial distance upper bound. A stackless traversal is then performed using conservatively expanded hierarchical bounds to compute the exact nearest triangle and signed distance. This temporal-coherence-based hierarchy reuse and selective refresh strategy effectively reduces the cost of repeated distance queries while preserving accuracy under continuous mesh deformation. Experimental results show that, under identical distance-field resolutions and deformation conditions, the proposed method produces signed-distance values that agree with those of the baseline within numerical precision while improving distance-query performance by up to approximately 2.5× in the evaluated tests. The proposed method can therefore be effectively applied to a broad range of real-time graphics and simulation applications that require repeated distance computations on dynamic and deformable geometry.
articles.abstract_zh: 可变形三角形网格上的符号距离查询是在各种应用中重复执行的基本操作，包括碰撞处理、表面跟踪、基于物理的模拟和几何处理。然而，在网格随时间不断变形的动态环境中，在每一帧重建静态层次结构或更新所有包围体可能会产生大量的计算成本，而传统的距离查询加速结构并没有充分利用这种时间相干性。在本文中，我们提出了一种用于可变形三角形网格的时间相干分层距离查询方法。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 可变形三角形网格上的符号距离查询是在各种应用中重复执行的基本操作，包括碰撞处理、表面跟踪、基于物理的模拟和几何处理。然而，在网格随时间不断变形的动态环境中，在每一帧重建静态层次结构或更新所有包围体可能会产生大量的计算成本，而传统的距离查询加速结构并没有充分利用这种时间相干性。在本文中，我们提出了一种用于可变形三角形网格的时间相干分层距离查询方法。所提出的方法为每个层次结构节点维护各向异性时间边界以考虑局部变形，并且仅针对变形幅度超过规定阈值的节点选择性地刷新存储的参考边界，从而保持时间边界的紧密性。此外，来自前一帧的最近三角形信息被保留为紧凑的持久种子，并在当前帧的变形几何结构上重新评估以获得严格的初始距离上限。然后使用保守扩展的层次边界执行无堆栈遍历，以计算精确的最近三角形和有符号距离。这种基于时间一致性的层次结构重用和选择性刷新策略有效地降低了重复距离查询的成本，同时在连续网格变形下保持精度。实验结果表明，在相同的距离场分辨率和变形条件下，该方法产生的带符号距离值在数值精度内与基线一致，同时在评估测试中将距离查询性能提高了约2.5倍。因此，所提出的方法可以有效地应用于需要对动态和可变形几何体进行重复距离计算的广泛实时图形和模拟应用。

articles.title: Observation-Based Initialization for Inverse Modeling of Atmospheric Temperature with Rossby-Constrained Transport
articles.title_zh: 基于观测的初始化，用于罗斯贝约束传输的大气温度反演
articles.abstract: We consider a finite-dimensional inverse problem for atmospheric temperature transport from sparse satellite observations. A spectral stream function with Rossby dispersion defines the horizontal velocity, and a convection--diffusion equation maps its parameters to temperature measurements. The main methodological component is a regularized construction of the initial temperature and compatible latitudinal boundary values from the preceding day's observations. A bounded latitude coordinate, a low-order background, and two longitudinal harmonics provide a smooth periodic initial field without using the assimilation day's temperatures. Continuous piecewise-linear finite elements, implicit Euler stepping, and streamline upwind/Petrov--Galerkin stabilization solve the forward problem. An adaptive artificial bee colony algorithm identifies 28 flow parameters under a shared perturbation-speed constraint. For 105 nighttime Aura Microwave Limb Sounder measurements on 6 March 2011, the fine-mesh root-mean-square discrepancy is 5.129 K and the Pearson correlation is 0.660. The corresponding linear-initialization experiment gives 6.127 K and 0.373, respectively. The root-mean-square discrepancy therefore decreases by 16.3%. A static evaluation of the new initial field gives a correlation of 0.549, providing a reference for assessing the additional improvement obtained with optimized transport. The results support observation-based initialization for temperature reconstruction within the considered model and motivate further evaluation of predictive performance and flow identifiability.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们考虑稀疏卫星观测的大气温度传输的有限维反问题。具有罗斯贝色散的谱流函数定义了水平速度，对流扩散方程将其参数映射到温度测量。主要方法组成部分是根据前一天的观测对初始温度和兼容的纬度边界值进行正规化构建。有界纬度坐标、低阶背景和两个纵谐波提供了平滑的周期性初始场，而无需使用同化日的温度。连续分段线性有限元、隐式欧拉步进和流线迎风/Petrov-Galerkin 稳定解决了前向问题。自适应人工蜂群算法在共享扰动速度约束下识别 28 个流动参数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们考虑稀疏卫星观测的大气温度传输的有限维反问题。具有罗斯贝色散的谱流函数定义了水平速度，对流扩散方程将其参数映射到温度测量。主要方法组成部分是根据前一天的观测对初始温度和兼容的纬度边界值进行正规化构建。有界纬度坐标、低阶背景和两个纵谐波提供了平滑的周期性初始场，而无需使用同化日的温度。连续分段线性有限元、隐式欧拉步进和流线迎风/Petrov-Galerkin 稳定解决了前向问题。自适应人工蜂群算法在共享扰动速度约束下识别 28 个流动参数。对于 2011 年 3 月 6 日的 105 次夜间 Aura 微波临边探测仪测量，细网格均方根差异为 5.129 K，皮尔逊相关性为 0.660。相应的线性初始化实验分别给出 6.127 K 和 0.373。因此，均方根差异减少了 16.3%。新初始场的静态评估给出了0.549的相关性，为评估优化传输所获得的额外改进提供了参考。结果支持基于观测的初始化，以在所考虑的模型内进行温度重建，并激发对预测性能和流动可识别性的进一步评估。

articles.title: Residual-Guided Adaptive Pressure Bases for Dimension-Reduced FLIP Projection
articles.title_zh: 用于降维 FLIP 投影的剩余引导自适应压力底座
articles.abstract: We present a residual-guided adaptive pressure basis for dimension-reduced FLIP liquid simulation. Uniform dimension reduction lowers the cost of the pressure Poisson solve, but aggressive coarsening can under-represent localized pressure variation near impacts, thin sheets, and complex free surfaces. Our method augments the coarse surface-aware pressure basis only in regions predicted to require additional representation capacity. The selection criterion combines the fine-grid residual of the reduced pressure solution with free-surface curvature and local velocity variation. To avoid a same-frame refinement re-solve, the filtered residual from the previous time step is used as a temporal predictor, while the geometric and kinematic indicators respond to newly formed structures. The resulting adaptive system requires a single reduced pressure solve per time step. Comparisons with uniform dimension reduction and full-resolution projection show lower pressure approximation error and post-projection divergence than uniform reduction with only a modest increase in pressure degrees of freedom and computation time. The same formulation is evaluated in both 2D and 3D FLIP simulations.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种用于降维 FLIP 液体模拟的残余引导自适应压力基础。均匀降维可降低压力泊松求解的成本，但激进的粗化可能无法充分表示冲击、薄片和复杂自由表面附近的局部压力变化。我们的方法仅在预计需要额外表示能力的区域中增强粗略的表面感知压力基础。选择标准将减压解的细网格残差与自由表面曲率和局部速度变化相结合。为了避免同帧细化重新求解，前一时间步的过滤残差被用作时间预测器，而几何和运动学指标响应新形成的结构。由此产生的自适应系统需要每个时间步进行一次减压求解。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种用于降维 FLIP 液体模拟的残余引导自适应压力基础。均匀降维可降低压力泊松求解的成本，但激进的粗化可能无法充分表示冲击、薄片和复杂自由表面附近的局部压力变化。我们的方法仅在预计需要额外表示能力的区域中增强粗略的表面感知压力基础。选择标准将减压解的细网格残差与自由表面曲率和局部速度变化相结合。为了避免同帧细化重新求解，前一时间步的过滤残差被用作时间预测器，而几何和运动学指标响应新形成的结构。由此产生的自适应系统需要每个时间步进行一次减压求解。与均匀降维和全分辨率投影的比较表明，与均匀降维相比，压力近似误差和投影后发散更低，压力自由度和计算时间仅略有增加。在 2D 和 3D FLIP 模拟中评估相同的配方。

articles.title: Yes, Trees are the Solution for Thermal Comfort and Environmental Quality in Equatorial Public Squares
articles.title_zh: 是的，树木是赤道公共广场热舒适和环境质量的解决方案
articles.abstract: Unregulated urban expansion can diminish green spaces and alter microclimatic conditions, thereby compromising thermal comfort and the quality of life for the population. In this context, urban forestry plays a pivotal role in mitigating warming effects within urban environments. The present study aimed to analyze the influence of urban tree canopy cover on surface temperature and thermal comfort in urban squares within the municipality of Santarém, Pará state, Brazil. To this end, in situ measurements of surface temperature were conducted using an infrared thermometer, alongside assessments of thermal stress and perceived temperature using a heat stress meter equipped with the Wet-Bulb Globe Temperature (WBGT) index. Data were collected in both tree-shaded and unshaded areas across seven city squares at 08:00, 13:00, and 18:00. The results demonstrated that the afternoon period exhibited the highest mean values for surface temperature (40.1°C), thermal stress (31.6°C), and perceived temperature (48.3°C). Areas lacking tree canopy cover recorded higher surface temperatures (39.7°C), elevated thermal stress (30.5°C), and greater perceived temperatures (45.4°C) compared to tree-shaded areas. Among the evaluated sites, Liberdade Square presented the highest mean surface temperature (40.8°C), while São Raimundo and Três Poderes squares recorded the highest values for thermal stress (31.2°C) and perceived temperature (48.6°C). We conclude that the presence of tree canopy cover significantly contributes to lowering surface temperatures and improving thermal comfort conditions, thereby highlighting the critical role of urban forestry in urban planning and the enhancement of urban environmental quality.
articles.abstract_zh: 不受监管的城市扩张会减少绿地面积并改变小气候条件，从而损害热舒适度和人们的生活质量。在此背景下，城市林业在缓解城市环境变暖效应方面发挥着关键作用。本研究旨在分析城市树冠覆盖对巴西帕拉州圣塔伦市城市广场表面温度和热舒适度的影响。为此，使用红外温度计对表面温度进行原位测量，同时使用配备湿球温度 (WBGT) 指数的热应力计评估热应力和感知温度。数据采集时间为 08:00、13:00 和 18:00，在七个城市广场的树荫和非树荫区域收集数据。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 不受监管的城市扩张会减少绿地面积并改变小气候条件，从而损害热舒适度和人们的生活质量。在此背景下，城市林业在缓解城市环境变暖效应方面发挥着关键作用。本研究旨在分析城市树冠覆盖对巴西帕拉州圣塔伦市城市广场表面温度和热舒适度的影响。为此，使用红外温度计对表面温度进行原位测量，同时使用配备湿球温度 (WBGT) 指数的热应力计评估热应力和感知温度。数据采集时间为 08:00、13:00 和 18:00，在七个城市广场的树荫和非树荫区域收集数据。结果表明，下午时段的表面温度（40.1°C）、热应力（31.6°C）和感知温度（48.3°C）的平均值最高。与树荫区域相比，缺乏树冠覆盖的区域的表面温度更高（39.7°C），热应力更高（30.5°C），感知温度更高（45.4°C）。在评估地点中，自由广场的平均表面温度最高（40.8°C），而圣雷蒙多（São Raimundo）和特雷斯波德雷斯（Três Poderes）广场的热应力（31.2°C）和感知温度（48.6°C）最高。我们的结论是，树冠覆盖的存在显着有助于降低地表温度和改善热舒适条件，从而凸显了城市林业在城市规划和提高城市环境质量中的关键作用。

articles.title: Hybrid Token Optimization for Text-to-Image Person Re-identification
articles.title_zh: 用于文本到图像人员重新识别的混合令牌优化
articles.abstract: Text-to-image person re-identification (TIReID) enables natural-language search over pedestrian image collections. Although dual-grained methods combine global and local matching, recent dual-grained pipelines use encoder-produced global tokens for coarse matching and attention-ranked local tokens for fine-grained matching. This interface leaves global representations without complementary priors, local evidence dependent on a single ranking cue, and image--text sequence asymmetry insufficiently addressed. To address these limitations, we propose Hybrid Token Optimization (HTO), a parameter-efficient, role-aware framework at the encoder--matcher interface. HTO comprises two coordinated components. Dictionary Prior Enhancement uses modality-specific dictionaries, cross-attention, and conservative residual blending to refine global-token representations. Spatial-Energy Heterogeneous Token Selection combines attention-based saliency, a feature-norm cue, and an adaptive minimum-coverage constraint to broaden local-token coverage in both modalities. Both components leave the established matching heads unchanged and operate during both training and inference, while the auxiliary losses are used only for training. Under a fixed-seed protocol, HTO yields Rank-1 point-estimate gains of 0.45, 0.40, and 2.25 percentage points over the reproduced baseline on CUHK-PEDES, ICFG-PEDES, and RSTPReid, respectively. It increases the parameter count by less than 0.4% and is also compatible with Test-Time Human-Centered Interaction. These results suggest that role-aware token-interface refinement can improve fine-grained cross-modal retrieval without redesigning the matcher.
articles.abstract_zh: 文本到图像行人重新识别 (TIReID) 支持对行人图像集进行自然语言搜索。尽管双粒度方法结合了全局和局部匹配，但最近的双粒度管道使用编码器生成的全局标记进行粗匹配，并使用注意力排序的局部标记进行细粒度匹配。该界面留下了没有互补先验的全局表示、依赖于单个排名线索的局部证据以及未充分解决图像-文本序列不对称性。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了混合令牌优化（HTO），这是编码器-匹配器接口处的参数高效、角色感知框架。 HTO 由两个协调组成部分组成。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 文本到图像行人重新识别 (TIReID) 支持对行人图像集进行自然语言搜索。尽管双粒度方法结合了全局和局部匹配，但最近的双粒度管道使用编码器生成的全局标记进行粗匹配，并使用注意力排序的局部标记进行细粒度匹配。该界面留下了没有互补先验的全局表示、依赖于单个排名线索的局部证据以及未充分解决图像-文本序列不对称性。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了混合令牌优化（HTO），这是编码器-匹配器接口处的参数高效、角色感知框架。 HTO 由两个协调组成部分组成。字典先验增强使用特定于模态的字典、交叉注意力和保守残差混合来细化全局令牌表示。空间能量异构令牌选择结合了基于注意力的显着性、特征规范线索和自适应最小覆盖约束，以扩大两种模式中的本地令牌覆盖范围。这两个组件都保持已建立的匹配头不变，并在训练和推理期间运行，而辅助损失仅用于训练。在固定种子协议下，HTO 的 Rank-1 点估计增益分别比 CUHK-PEDES、ICFG-PEDES 和 RSTPReid 的复制基线高 0.45、0.40 和 2.25 个百分点。它增加了不到 0.4% 的参数数量，并且还兼容测试时以人为中心的交互。这些结果表明，角色感知令牌接口细化可以改进细粒度的跨模式检索，而无需重新设计匹配器。

articles.title: Effect of HIP and Laser Shock Peening Sequence on the Fatigue Behavior of Laser Powder Bed Fused Ti6Al4V
articles.title_zh: HIP 和激光冲击强化序列对激光粉床电熔 Ti6Al4V 疲劳行为的影响
articles.abstract: The fatigue performance of laser powder bed fused Ti-6Al-4V is influenced by process-induced defects, surface condition and the stress state generated by manufacturing and post-processing. This study examined whether reversing the order of hot isostatic pressing (HIP) and laser shock peening (LSP) altered the fatigue response of a deliberately defect-rich LPBF condition. Specimens were subjected to LSP followed by HIP or HIP followed by LSP. X-ray computed tomography was used to quantify the internal defect populations, stress-life testing was conducted between 210 and 380 MPa at R = 0 and 50 Hz, and scanning electron microscopy was used to examine post-test surface features associated with crack initiation. The two hybrid routes exhibited similar defect counts and mean sphericity values, while the HIP + LSP condition contained the largest measured defect and the greatest detected defect volume. Nevertheless, HIP + LSP produced the stronger fatigue response, including two right-censored run-outs at 106 cycles, compared with no run-outs for LSP + HIP. The CT descriptors therefore did not account for the observed sequence effect. The results are consistent with, but do not directly prove, the hypothesis that applying LSP after HIP preserves the beneficial final surface state generated by peening, whereas subsequent HIP exposure may modify or relax part of that state. Because residual stress was not measured, this mechanism is presented as a literature-supported interpretation rather than a measured causal relationship. The findings demonstrate that post-processing order can influence fatigue performance even when conventional CT defect metrics do not indicate a superior internal defect population.
articles.abstract_zh: 激光粉床熔融Ti-6Al-4V的疲劳性能受到工艺缺陷、表面状况以及制造和后加工产生的应力状态的影响。本研究检验了颠倒热等静压 (HIP) 和激光冲击强化 (LSP) 的顺序是否会改变故意富含缺陷的 LPBF 条件下的疲劳响应。对样品进行 LSP 后 HIP 或 HIP 后 LSP。 X 射线计算机断层扫描用于量化内部缺陷数量，在 R = 0 和 50 Hz 下进行 210 至 380 MPa 的应力寿命测试，并使用扫描电子显微镜检查与裂纹萌生相关的测试后表面特征。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 激光粉床熔融Ti-6Al-4V的疲劳性能受到工艺缺陷、表面状况以及制造和后加工产生的应力状态的影响。本研究检验了颠倒热等静压 (HIP) 和激光冲击强化 (LSP) 的顺序是否会改变故意富含缺陷的 LPBF 条件下的疲劳响应。对样品进行 LSP 后 HIP 或 HIP 后 LSP。 X 射线计算机断层扫描用于量化内部缺陷数量，在 R = 0 和 50 Hz 下进行 210 至 380 MPa 的应力寿命测试，并使用扫描电子显微镜检查与裂纹萌生相关的测试后表面特征。两种混合路线表现出相似的缺陷计数和平均球形度值，而HIP + LSP条件包含最大的测量缺陷和最大的检测到的缺陷体积。尽管如此，HIP + LSP 产生了更强的疲劳反应，包括 106 个循环时的两次右删失跳动，而 LSP + HIP 则没有跳动。因此，CT 描述符没有考虑观察到的序列效应。结果与以下假设一致，但没有直接证明：在 HIP 后应用 LSP 保留了喷丸产生的有益的最终表面状态，而随后的 HIP 暴露可能会改变或松弛该状态的一部分。由于未测量残余应力，因此该机制是作为文献支持的解释而不是测量的因果关系提出的。研究结果表明，即使传统 CT 缺陷指标并未表明内部缺陷数量较多，后处理顺序也会影响疲劳性能。

articles.title: Development of a Water Infrastructure Sustainability Index (WISI): An Integrated Framework for Assessing Resilience, Circular Economy, and Long-Term Sustainability
articles.title_zh: 制定水基础设施可持续性指数（WISI）：评估复原力、循环经济和长期可持续性的综合框架
articles.abstract: Wastewater treatment plants are often assessed by compliance and cost, which leaves energy, carbon, resource recovery, asset condition, climate exposure and digital capability outside a single view. We reformulate the conceptual Water Infrastructure Sustainability Index (WISI) as a computable index for wastewater treatment plants. WISI v1.1 combines seven dimensions (technical performance, water, energy, circular economy, carbon, asset resilience, digital intelligence) through 22 normalised indicators and weighted arithmetic aggregation. The reformulation corrects inverted indicator directions, removes undefined and non-applicable indicators, and limits double counting by assigning each physical flow to one dimension. Because no complete operational dataset was available, we tested the index on 40 synthetic plants, with 50 replicate datasets, using Monte Carlo weight perturbation, varying weight distributions, and alternative model structures. Rankings were stable under moderate weight uncertainty (median Spearman ρ = 0.98 for Dirichlet κ = 50) and fell to 0.87 only when weights were nearly random (κ = 3); aggregation rule changed rankings most (ρ = 0.95 for geometric aggregation). Nominal weights did not match effective influence: technical performance, with the largest weight (0.20), accounted for about 7–8% of index variance. Class bands from the earlier framework placed a median of 70% of synthetic plants in the lowest class; data-derived bands were uncertain by about five score points. A feasibility check on two operating plants showed that routine laboratory data cover only 3 of the 22 indicators.
articles.abstract_zh: 废水处理厂通常根据合规性和成本进行评估，这使得能源、碳、资源回收、资产状况、气候暴露和数字能力处于单一视图之外。我们重新制定了概念性水基础设施可持续性指数（WISI），作为废水处理厂的可计算指数。 WISI v1.1通过22个标准化指标和加权算术聚合，结合了七个维度（技术性能、水、能源、循环经济、碳、资产弹性、数字智能）。重新制定纠正了倒置的指标方向，删除了未定义和不适用的指标，并通过将每个物理流分配到一个维度来限制重复计算。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 废水处理厂通常根据合规性和成本进行评估，这使得能源、碳、资源回收、资产状况、气候暴露和数字能力处于单一视图之外。我们重新制定了概念性水基础设施可持续性指数（WISI），作为废水处理厂的可计算指数。 WISI v1.1通过22个标准化指标和加权算术聚合，结合了七个维度（技术性能、水、能源、循环经济、碳、资产弹性、数字智能）。重新制定纠正了倒置的指标方向，删除了未定义和不适用的指标，并通过将每个物理流分配到一个维度来限制重复计算。由于没有完整的操作数据集，我们使用蒙特卡洛权重扰动、不同的权重分布和替代模型结构，在 40 种合成植物上测试了该指数，并使用 50 个复制数据集。在中等权重不确定性下，排名保持稳定（狄利克雷 κ = 50 时，斯皮尔曼中位数 ρ = 0.98），仅当权重接近随机时（κ = 3），排名才降至 0.87；聚合规则对排名变化最大（几何聚合时ρ = 0.95）。名义权重与有效影响力不匹配：权重最大（0.20）的技术表现约占指数方差的7-8%。早期框架中的类别带将 70% 的合成植物置于最低类别；数据得出的条带不确定约五个分数。对两家运营工厂的可行性检查表明，常规实验室数据仅涵盖 22 项指标中的 3 项。

articles.title: Path Planning of Surgical Robot for Minimally Invasive Surgery on Riemannian Manifold
articles.title_zh: 黎曼流形微创手术机器人路径规划
articles.abstract: Robotic surgery for minimally invasive surgery can reduce the surgeon’s workload by autonomously guiding robotic forceps. Movement of the robot is restricted around a fixed insertion port. The robot often encounters angle limitations during operation. Also, the surface of the abdominal cavity is non-concave, making it computationally expensive to find the desired path. In this work, to solve these problems, we propose a method for path planning in joint space by transforming the position into a Riemannian manifold. An edge cost function is defined to search for a desired path in the joint space and reduce the range of motion of the joints. We found that the organ is mostly non-concave, making it easy to find the optimal path using gradient descent method. Experimental results demonstrated that the proposed method reduces the range of joint angle movement compared to calculations in position space.
articles.abstract_zh: 微创手术的机器人手术可以通过自动引导机器人钳来减少外科医生的工作量。机器人的运动被限制在固定插入端口周围。机器人在运行过程中经常会遇到角度限制。此外，腹腔的表面是非凹面的，这使得找到所需路径的计算成本很高。在这项工作中，为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种通过将位置转换为黎曼流形来在关节空间中进行路径规划的方法。定义边缘成本函数以在关节空间中搜索所需路径并减少关节的运动范围。我们发现器官大多是非凹的，使得使用梯度下降法很容易找到最佳路径。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 微创手术的机器人手术可以通过自动引导机器人钳来减少外科医生的工作量。机器人的运动被限制在固定插入端口周围。机器人在运行过程中经常会遇到角度限制。此外，腹腔的表面是非凹面的，这使得找到所需路径的计算成本很高。在这项工作中，为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种通过将位置转换为黎曼流形来在关节空间中进行路径规划的方法。定义边缘成本函数以在关节空间中搜索所需路径并减少关节的运动范围。我们发现器官大多是非凹的，使得使用梯度下降法很容易找到最佳路径。实验结果表明，与位置空间中的计算相比，该方法减少了关节角度运动的范围。

articles.title: Regulation, function and evolutionary structure of St18, encoding a Zinc-Finger Transcription Factor, in the oligodendrocyte lineage
articles.title_zh: 少突胶质细胞谱系中编码锌指转录因子的 St18 的调节、功能和进化结构
articles.abstract: Myelinating oligodendrocytes are first observed during evolution in vertebrates above jawless fishes. Oligodendrocyte progenitor cells (OPCs) undergo extensive transcriptional and morphological remodelling to initiate differentiation and myelination. We report that the zinc-finger transcription factor St18 (aka Myt3) is upregulated during the OPC-to–newly formed oligodendrocyte (NFOL) transition. Single-nucleus RNA-sequencing (snRNA-seq) performed after lysolecithin-induced demyelination of the mouse spinal cord revealed that St18 was acutely upregulated in remyelinating OPCs. In primary rat OPC cultures, St18 overexpression promoted differentiation, whereas OPC conditional St18 knockout delayed developmental myelination in the mouse brain. Chromatin accessibility profiling identified candidate cis-regulatory elements for oligodendroglial St18 expression activated by core oligodendrocyte transcription factors, including SOX10, KLF9/13, and MYRF, and we confirmed that St18 expression in OPCs is Sox10-dependent in vivo. Phylogenetic analysis suggests that St18 arose via duplication of Myt1 in early jawed vertebrates, coinciding with the emergence of myelinating oligodendrocytes. These findings define St18 as a transcriptional marker of NFOLs and OLs and provide insight into the evolutionary regulation of central nervous system myelination.
articles.abstract_zh: 髓鞘少突胶质细胞在进化过程中首先在无颌鱼类以上的脊椎动物中观察到。少突胶质祖细胞 (OPC) 经历广泛的转录和形态重塑以启动分化和髓鞘形成。我们报告说，锌指转录因子 St18（又名 Myt3）在 OPC 向新形成的少突胶质细胞 (NFOL) 转变过程中上调。溶血卵磷脂诱导小鼠脊髓脱髓鞘后进行的单核 RNA 测序 (snRNA-seq) 表明，St18 在髓鞘再生 OPC 中急剧上调。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 髓鞘少突胶质细胞在进化过程中首先在无颌鱼类以上的脊椎动物中观察到。少突胶质祖细胞 (OPC) 经历广泛的转录和形态重塑以启动分化和髓鞘形成。我们报告说，锌指转录因子 St18（又名 Myt3）在 OPC 向新形成的少突胶质细胞 (NFOL) 转变过程中上调。溶血卵磷脂诱导小鼠脊髓脱髓鞘后进行的单核 RNA 测序 (snRNA-seq) 表明，St18 在髓鞘再生 OPC 中急剧上调。在原代大鼠 OPC 培养物中，St18 过度表达促进分化，而 OPC 条件性 St18 敲除则延迟小鼠大脑中髓鞘形成的发育。染色质可及性分析确定了由核心少突胶质细胞转录因子（包括 SOX10、KLF9/13 和 MYRF）激活的少突胶质细胞 St18 表达的候选顺式调控元件，并且我们证实 OPC 中的 St18 表达在体内是 Sox10 依赖性的。系统发育分析表明，St18 是通过早期有颌脊椎动物中 Myt1 的复制而产生的，与髓鞘化少突胶质细胞的出现同时发生。这些发现将 St18 定义为 NFOL 和 OL 的转录标记，并为中枢神经系统髓鞘形成的进化调控提供了见解。

articles.title: A Drude-Augmented Kramers–Kronig Framework for Predicting Optical Properties of Substitutionally Doped Low-Dimensional Semiconductors: Application to (8,0) SiC Nanotubes
articles.title_zh: 用于预测替代掺杂低维半导体光学特性的 Drude 增强 Kramers-Kronig 框架：在 (8,0) SiC 纳米管中的应用
articles.abstract: We present a generalizable computational framework that combines a Kramers--Kronig transformation with a Drude free-carrier term to predict the optical and dielectric properties of substitutionally doped low-dimensional semiconductors. The framework is designed as a fast-screening alternative to full density functional theory (DFT) calculations, requiring only three physically transparent input parameters: the effective bandgap energy, the peak absorption energy, and the static dielectric constant. For metallic dopants, a Drude term is added with plasma frequency and scattering rate taken from optical fits of post-transition metals. The framework is validated against published first-principles DFT results for Al-, N-, and P-doped SiC nanotubes and against spectroscopic ellipsometry data for bulk 3C-SiC and 4H-SiC, showing good quantitative agreement. As a demonstration, we apply the framework to 15 dopant configurations of the pristine zigzag (8,0) silicon carbide nanotube (SiCNT), covering Group~III (B, Al, Ga, In, Tl), Group~V (N, P, As, Sb, Bi), and Group~VII (F, Cl, Br, I) elements. The framework captures the p-type to plasmonic transition in the Group~III series (absorption onset shifts from 2.0~eV to 1.0~eV), the monotonic bandgap narrowing in the Group~V series (sim3.7~eV for N to sim1.2~eV for Bi), and the systematic redshift in the halogen series (1.85~eV for pristine to 1.43 ± 0.20~eV for Cl). The framework provides a reproducible, computationally inexpensive route to optical property prediction for doped low-dimensional systems and yields quantitative guidelines for UV photodetectors, visible-range photocatalysts, infrared sensors, and broadband plasmonic devices. Complete Python source code, material parameter database, and figure generation scripts are provided for full reproducibility.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个通用的计算框架，它将 Kramers--Kronig 变换与 Drude 自由载流子项相结合，以预测替代掺杂的低维半导体的光学和介电性质。该框架被设计为全密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算的快速筛选替代方案，仅需要三个物理透明的输入参数：有效带隙能量、峰值吸收能量和静态介电常数。对于金属掺杂剂，添加了德鲁德项以及从后过渡金属的光学拟合中获取的等离子体频率和散射率。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一个通用的计算框架，它将 Kramers--Kronig 变换与 Drude 自由载流子项相结合，以预测替代掺杂的低维半导体的光学和介电性质。该框架被设计为全密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算的快速筛选替代方案，仅需要三个物理透明的输入参数：有效带隙能量、峰值吸收能量和静态介电常数。对于金属掺杂剂，添加了德鲁德项以及从后过渡金属的光学拟合中获取的等离子体频率和散射率。该框架根据已发表的 Al、N 和 P 掺杂 SiC 纳米管的第一原理 DFT 结果以及块体 3C-SiC 和 4H-SiC 的光谱椭圆光度数据进行了验证，显示出良好的定量一致性。作为演示，我们将该框架应用于原始锯齿形 (8,0) 碳化硅纳米管 (SiCNT) 的 15 种掺杂剂配置，涵盖 III 族（B、Al、Ga、In、Tl）、V 族（N、P、As、Sb、Bi）和 VII 族（F、Cl、Br、I）元素。该框架捕获了第~III族系列中的p型到等离激元转变（吸收起始位移从2.0~eV到1.0~eV）、第~V族系列中的单调带隙变窄（N的sim3.7~eV到Bi的sim1.2~eV），以及卤素系列中的系统红移（原始的1.85~eV到1.43 ± Cl 为 0.20~eV）。该框架为掺杂低维系统的光学特性预测提供了一种可重复的、计算成本低廉的途径，并为紫外光电探测器、可见光范围光催化剂、红外传感器和宽带等离子体设备提供了定量指南。提供完整的 Python 源代码、材料参数数据库和图形生成脚本，以实现完全的可重复性。

articles.title: Synthesis and Structural Characterization of Some D-panthenol Cocrystals using Carboxylic acid as Coformers
articles.title_zh: 以羧酸为共形成物的一些 D-泛醇共晶的合成和结构表征
articles.abstract: D-Panthenol (provitamin B5) is a pharmaceutically and cosmetically important active ingredient whose solid-state application is constrained by pronounced hygroscopicity and limited crystallinity. In this study, cocrystals of D-panthenol were designed and synthesized with three carboxylic acid coformers oxalic acid, isophthalic acid (2:1), and trimesic acid via slow solvent evaporation from methanol/ethanol solution, and the resulting solid forms were characterized by UV–Visible and Fourier Transform Infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy. UV–Visible spectroscopy revealed a consistent bathochromic (red) shift in the absorption maximum (λmax), rising from 210 nm in pure D-panthenol to 214 nm in the oxalic acid cocrystal (Dp–OX), 217 nm in the isophthalic acid cocrystal (Dp–ISO, 2:1), and 222 nm in the trimesic acid cocrystal (Dp–Trim). The magnitude of the shift scaled with coformer aromaticity and hydrogen-bonding capacity, and the aromatic coformers additionally introduced secondary absorption bands at 244, 273, and 302 nm (Dp–ISO) and 258, 283, and 320 nm (Dp–Trim), consistent with supplementary π→π* transitions. These electronic changes were corroborated by FTIR spectroscopy, which showed systematic shifts in the O–H stretch (3454–3464 cm⁻¹), C = O stretch (1737–1741 cm⁻¹), N–H/C = C bend (1637–1641 cm⁻¹), and C–O stretch (1111–1127 cm⁻¹) regions relative to pure D-panthenol. Because no new absorption bands emerged in any spectrum, the observed shifts are attributed to intermolecular hydrogen bonding rather than covalent modification, confirming that D-panthenol's molecular identity was preserved in all three cocrystals. Together, the UV–Visible and FTIR results provide convergent spectroscopic evidence that cocrystallization with carboxylic acid coformers systematically perturbs the electronic and vibrational environment of D-panthenol through non-covalent supramolecular interactions, supporting cocrystal engineering as a viable route to modified D-panthenol solid forms for pharmaceutical application.
articles.abstract_zh: D-泛醇（维生素原 B5）是一种药学和美容学上重要的活性成分，其固态应用受到明显的吸湿性和有限的结晶度的限制。在本研究中，通过从甲醇/乙醇溶液中缓慢蒸发溶剂，设计并合成了三种羧酸共聚体草酸、间苯二甲酸（2:1）和均苯三酸的D-泛醇共晶，并通过紫外-可见光和傅里叶变换红外（FTIR）光谱对所得固体形式进行了表征。
articles.abstract_zh_full: D-泛醇（维生素原 B5）是一种药学和美容学上重要的活性成分，其固态应用受到明显的吸湿性和有限的结晶度的限制。在本研究中，通过从甲醇/乙醇溶液中缓慢蒸发溶剂，设计并合成了三种羧酸共聚体草酸、间苯二甲酸（2:1）和均苯三酸的D-泛醇共晶，并通过紫外-可见光和傅里叶变换红外（FTIR）光谱对所得固体形式进行了表征。紫外-可见光谱显示最大吸收 (λmax) 出现一致的红移（红色）偏移，从纯 D-泛醇中的 210 nm 上升到草酸共晶 (Dp-OX) 中的 214 nm、间苯二甲酸共晶 (Dp-ISO, 2:1) 中的 217 nm 以及均苯三酸共晶中的 222 nm （Dp-修剪）。位移的幅度与共聚体芳香性和氢键能力成比例，并且芳香共聚体还在 244、273 和 302 nm (Dp–ISO) 以及 258、283 和 320 nm (Dp–Trim) 处引入了次级吸收带，与补充 π→π* 跃迁一致。这些电子变化得到了 FTIR 光谱的证实，结果显示 O-H 拉伸 (3454-3464 cm-1)、C-=O 拉伸 (1737-1741 cm-1)、N-H/C-= C 弯曲 (1637-1641 cm-1) 和 C-O 拉伸 (1111-1127 cm-1) 发生系统性变化。 cm-1) 区域相对于纯 D-泛醇。由于任何光谱中都没有出现新的吸收带，因此观察到的变化归因于分子间氢键而不是共价修饰，从而证实了 D-泛醇的分子特性在所有三种共晶体中均得以保留。紫外-可见光和 FTIR 结果共同提供了收敛的光谱证据，表明与羧酸共形成物的共结晶通过非共价超分子相互作用系统地扰乱了 D-泛醇的电子和振动环境，支持共晶工程作为药物应用中改性 D-泛醇固体形式的可行途径。

articles.title: Latitudinal contrast in the equatorial Atlantic influence on Nigerian August rainfall
articles.title_zh: 赤道大西洋纬度对比对尼日利亚八月降雨的影响
articles.abstract: The influence of the equatorial Atlantic on West African monsoon rainfall is well established for the region as a whole, but its variation with latitude and month within Nigeria has not been quantified. Satellite rainfall estimates and sea-surface temperatures for 1981 to 2025 were used to compare a southern (4 to 8°N) and a northern (10 to 14°N) band after removing El Niño–Southern Oscillation and linear-trend effects. In a pre-specified analysis of June to August rainfall, one standard deviation of warming in an equatorial Atlantic temperature index (ATL3) was associated with 56.5 mm more rainfall in the south and 3.2 mm in the north, a difference of 53.3 mm (95% interval 19.5 to 87.1 mm). An exploratory monthly analysis located the contrast in August, the month of the southern little dry season (49.0 mm; 26.2 to 68.7 mm), and it was confirmed in an independent period, 1951 to 1980, with rain-gauge data and criteria fixed beforehand (35.9 mm; 20.0 to 52.2 mm). The August contrast persisted when the datasets, band definitions, linear trend and other ocean basins were changed. It corresponded to 12 to 23% of local rainfall south of 8.5°N and fell to near zero north of 10°N, and reanalysis data showed stronger moisture convergence over the southern band. The full-season contrast was less robust, and May temperatures gave no forecast skill. The signal of an ocean basin can therefore differ markedly within one country and one month, which region-wide seasonal indices conceal.
articles.abstract_zh: 赤道大西洋对西非季风降雨的影响在整个地区已得到证实，但尼日利亚境内其随纬度和月份的变化尚未量化。在消除厄尔尼诺-南方涛动和线性趋势影响后，使用 1981 年至 2025 年的卫星降雨估计和海面温度来比较南部（4 至 8°N）和北部（10 至 14°N）带。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 赤道大西洋对西非季风降雨的影响在整个地区已得到证实，但尼日利亚境内其随纬度和月份的变化尚未量化。在消除厄尔尼诺-南方涛动和线性趋势影响后，使用 1981 年至 2025 年的卫星降雨估计和海面温度来比较南部（4 至 8°N）和北部（10 至 14°N）带。在对 6 月至 8 月降雨量的预先指定分析中，赤道大西洋温度指数 (ATL3) 变暖的一个标准差与南部降雨量增加 56.5 毫米和北部降雨量增加 3.2 毫米相关，相差 53.3 毫米（95% 区间为 19.5 至 87.1 毫米）。一项探索性月度分析确定了 8 月的对比，即南方小旱季的月份（49.0 毫米；26.2 至 68.7 毫米），并在 1951 年至 1980 年的一个独立时期内通过事先确定的雨量计数据和标准（35.9 毫米；20.0 至 52.2 毫米）得到了证实。当数据集、波段定义、线性趋势和其他海洋盆地发生变化时，八月的对比仍然存在。它相当于北纬 8.5°以南当地降雨量的 12% 至 23%，而北纬 10°以北则降到接近零，再分析数据显示，南部带的水分辐合更强。全季对比不那么强烈，五月气温也没有给出预报技巧。因此，一个海洋盆地的信号在一个国家和一个月内可能存在显着差异，而区域范围内的季节性指数掩盖了这一点。

articles.abstract: We present quantum scattering calculations of CO 2 –He state-to-state integral cross sections for 25 transition sets, covering pure rotational transitions within and rovibrational transitions between: the ground state 00 0 0, the bend fundamental 01 1 0, the bending overtone 02 2 0, and the Fermi doublet states 10 0 0(1) and 10 0 0(2). Exact coupled-channel (CC) and coupled-states approximation (CSA) calculations are performed using a new five-dimensional potential energy surface. The calculations cover collision energies from 20 to 5220 cm −1 , sufficient to obtain converged rate coefficients over 100–800 K, and include initial rotational states for each transition up to at least j = 35. We present an energy-grid algorithm for rovibrational quantum scattering calculations that minimizes the number of separate calculations required. The resulting cross sections exhibit a dominant Δ j = 0 propensity and parity-dependent patterns. For the benchmark 00 0 0, j ′ ← 01 1 0, j transition, thermally averaged rate coefficients reproduce available experimental data. A comparison between the CC and CSA cross sections shows that for vibrational quenching transitions, the CSA cross sections increasingly deviate from the CC results with increasing initial rotational state j . Calculated integral cross sections cover collision energies and rotational states needed to derive rate coefficients for radiative transfer modeling of mid-infrared CO 2 spectra from environments that are not in local thermal equilibrium. The computationally simpler CO 2 –He system allows the methodology and approximations to be tested at high collision energies and rotational states, helping assess their suitability for the more complex and astrochemically important CO 2 –H 2 system.

articles.title: Position-and conformation-dependent effects of fluorination on the structure and methyl internal rotation of methyl benzoates
articles.abstract: The effects of fluorination on molecular structure and internal dynamics were investigated in monofluorinated methyl benzoates (methyl 2-fluorobenzoate, methyl 3-fluorobenzoate, and methyl 4-fluorobenzoate) using high-resolution rotational spectroscopy in combination with quantum-chemical calculations. Two conformers were identified for methyl 2-fluorobenzoate, whereas only one conformer each was observed for the 3- and 4-fluorinated species. All observed conformers exhibited A / E torsional splittings arising from internal rotation of the ester methyl rotor and were analyzed using the XIAM code. The experimentally derived barriers V 3 lie in the range of 425–460 cm −1 , exhibiting both position- and conformation-dependent behavior. The syn conformer of methyl 2-fluorobenzoate exhibits the largest barrier, whereas the barriers for anti -methyl 2-fluorobenzoate, anti- methyl 3-fluorobenzoate, and methyl 4-fluorobenzoate are close to that of methyl benzoate. Quantum-chemically predicted equilibrium structures indicate that the structural perturbations induced by fluorination are primarily localized near the substitution site. In the syn conformer of methyl 2-fluorobenzoate, the shorter F⋯H CH3 distance places the negative electrostatic region around fluorine closer to the positively polarized methyl hydrogen atoms. This proximity is consistent with enhanced local interactions that may contribute to its larger torsional barrier. These results demonstrate that the effect of fluorination on methyl internal rotation depends not only on the substitution position but also on the conformer-specific spatial arrangement of fluorine relative to the ester methyl rotor.

articles.title: Structure–flexibility relationships at low dielectric dialkyl ester liquid surfaces of DES, DEO, DEA, and DBS: A vibrational spectroscopy and MD simulations study
articles.abstract: Dialkyl esters, such as dibutyl sebacate (DBS), diethyl sebacate (DES), and diethyl adipate (DEA), are attractive, less-toxic alternatives to phthalate plasticizers, yet a mechanistic understanding of their behavior at soft interfaces, where wetting, adhesion, and physicochemical interactions are governed, remains limited. Resolving molecular orientation and organization at liquid–air interfaces is challenging with conventional techniques. Here, we combine sum frequency generation (SFG) vibrational spectroscopy with complementary infrared, Raman measurements, and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to elucidate the interfacial structure of low-dielectric esters [DBS, DES, DEA, and diethyl oxalate (DEO)]. SFG reveals that terminal methyl group orientations vary substantially across the series, with DES exhibiting a pronounced tilt toward the surface plane relative to DBS, DEA, and DEO. The analysis of CH 2 /CH 3 symmetric stretching intensity ratios indicates a higher population of gauche conformations and increased conformational disorder at the DES interface despite its shared sebacate backbone with DBS. MD simulations support these observations, showing differences in alkyl chain ordering, flexibility, and carbonyl–carbonyl separation, and yielding tilt angles broadly consistent with experiment for DES while highlighting sensitivity in SFG-derived values to optical and hyperpolarizability assumptions. Notably, the CH 3 Fermi resonance ratio and surface tension follow similar trends (DES > DEA > DBS ≈ DEO) across the dialkyl ester series, linking enhanced conformational flexibility and intermolecular packing heterogeneity at the molecular scale to macroscopic interfacial properties. These results enhance our understanding of soft low-dielectric liquid interfaces more broadly.

articles.title: Hybrid mechanics of coupled qubits
articles.abstract: We find that a technique analogous to hybrid mechanics previously developed for Gaussian coherent states and molecular vibrations, can be extended to SU(2) coherent states describing coupled qubits. This formulation reveals a sparse structure of the propagator, leading to a computationally efficient scheme while maintaining numerical accuracy. As a result, the method enables simulations of larger qubit systems on classical computers. In particular, we demonstrate accurate real-time propagation for systems of up to 21 qubits, which would be computationally demanding using straightforward quantum-dynamics approaches.

articles.title: Third-order size-consistent Brillouin–Wigner perturbation theory
articles.abstract: Low-order Rayleigh–Schrödinger perturbation theory with Møller–Plesset partitioning is size-consistent but not regular, and for this reason, the third-order variant, MP3, is not commonly used in computational quantum chemistry. Recently, it has become clear how to modify Brillouin–Wigner perturbation theory at second order to be both size-consistent and regular, by using a non-Møller–Plesset partitioning to define BWs2. In this work, a solution is presented for the problem of defining an iterative third-order generalization, iBWs3, that is, size-consistent, regular, and exact for the electron correlation of two electrons in two orbitals. iBWs3 can be seen as a scaled symmetrized version of coupled cluster theory with doubles including only the linear and the mosaic quadratic terms, thus with the same compute scaling. An implementation and a series of tests on restricted orbital dissociations and relative energies are reported.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Chiral vibrational modes and vibrational circular dichroism
articles.abstract: The recent interest in chiral phonons in a variety of physical phenomena and their hypothesized role in the chiral-induced spin selectivity effect [Fransson, Phys. Rev. Res. 5 , L022039 (2023)] call for further investigation into the chirality of molecular vibrations. Although molecular chirality has conventionally been quantified using structural properties, recent work has highlighted the role of dynamical response properties as chirality metrics. In this work, we examine an inter-atom helicity pseudoscalar as a complementary measure of vibrational chirality, associated with the vibrational circular dichroism (VCD) intensity in the fixed partial charge (FPC) approximation. This pseudoscalar is translationally and rotationally invariant, can distinguish between opposite enantiomers and, unlike the atomic pseudoscalar measure considered in our earlier work [Abraham and Nitzan, Phys. Rev. Lett. 133 , 268001 (2024)], does not rely on a predefined symmetry axis. For a twisted ethane model as well as several small molecules, this pseudoscalar correlates well with structural descriptors based on the continuous chirality measure. Overall, our results support response-based metrics as a physically meaningful and practically useful characterization of vibrational chirality. Importantly, while the FPC-based VCD estimate provides a useful quantifier of vibrational chirality, we show that it is a rather poor predictor of the actual molecular VCD response because the latter is strongly influenced by the (vibrational configuration-dependent) molecular electronic response.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Composition-dependent thermal and ionic conduction in NASICONs: Insights from molecular dynamics simulations
articles.abstract: The ongoing quest to optimize solid-state batteries in terms of sustainability, cost, and efficiency has shifted the focus to sodium-based battery materials. This study investigates the thermal and ionic conductivities of crystalline sodium superionic conductors of the type Na 1+ x Zr 2 Si x P 3− x O 12 ( x = 0, 1.5, 1.6, 2.0, 2.4, 2.5, 2.8, 3.0) using molecular dynamics simulations. Thermal conductivities are calculated using the Green–Kubo approach at temperatures of 150, 300, 623, and 900 K. Furthermore, sodium ion diffusion constants are derived from mean-square displacements. The highest thermal conductivity is obtained for x = 0 at all temperatures. For all stoichiometries, thermal conductivity decreases with increasing temperature. Among all fractional stoichiometries, the activation barrier for ion diffusion is found to be lowest for x = 2.8. The influence of ion diffusion on thermal conductivity is shown to be negligible by artificially altering the activation barrier. However, we demonstrate that the standard Green–Kubo method strongly overestimates thermal conductivity in stoichiometries with high ionic diffusivity because of spurious convective heat flux contributions. Taking into account only the conductive part of the heat flux yields reliable results that match those from nonequilibrium simulations, cepstral analysis accounting for sodium ion mass flux, and experiments. The underlying thermal transport mechanism is analyzed using the theory of Allen and Feldman for disordered solids. The dominant transport mechanism across all investigated temperatures and stoichiometries is found to be the diffusive propagation of delocalized, non-plane-wave-like vibrational modes called diffusons. However, in the end members at 150 K, competing mechanisms are also likely to occur.

articles.title: Dipole moment of the YbOH molecule
articles.abstract: The YbOH molecule is a sensitive system to use in searches for fundamental symmetry violations. Its molecular-frame permanent and transition dipole moments are of key importance for preparing and interpreting experiments. We calculate these quantities for the lowest bending vibrational modes of the ground electronic state. A high-level coupled cluster method for electronic structure calculations, together with averaging over vibrational states, was employed to obtain accurate values.

articles.title: Generalized vibrational perturbation theory in curvilinear internal coordinates: Theory and applications
articles.abstract: Second-order vibrational perturbation theory (VPT2) is widely employed for the calculation of anharmonic vibrational properties thanks to its favorable balance between accuracy and computational cost. However, the presence of strong vibrational resonances requires dedicated treatments beyond standard perturbative approaches. In this work, a generalized VPT2 framework based on curvilinear internal coordinates is developed. Closed-form expressions are derived for the interaction terms associated with Fermi and Darling–Dennison resonances, including 1–1, 2–2, and 1–3 couplings. In contrast to conventional Cartesian-coordinate formulations, the present treatment accounts for additional kinetic-energy contributions arising from the non-diagonal form of the vibrational kinetic-energy operator. The resulting methodology has been implemented in a general computational engine and has been validated through applications to representative molecular systems. The importance of the variational treatment of resonances is highlighted through the investigation of selected case studies, while the flexibility of the proposed framework is demonstrated through its combination with dual-level schemes employing different electronic-structure methods for harmonic and anharmonic contributions. The present work extends the applicability of perturb-then-diagonalize approaches in curvilinear coordinates and provides an efficient route toward accurate anharmonic calculations for medium- and large-sized molecular systems.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Real-space vs interelectronic exchange mixing for the prediction of low-lying Rydberg excitations within time-dependent density functional theory
articles.abstract: Low-lying Rydberg excitations are a challenge for linear-response time-dependent density functional theory because many functionals substantially underestimate their energies due to self-interaction error. The established remedy is range separation, which switches to full exact exchange (EXX) at large interelectronic distances. Local hybrid functionals instead control the EXX admixture through a real-space local mixing function (LMF), and range-separated local hybrids (RSLHs) combine both mixing schemes. Here, we analyze the two mixing coordinates by evaluating 87 Rydberg (3s and 3p) and 75 valence excitation energies from the QUEST database. A benchmark of 18 functionals shows that range-separated hybrids, some local hybrids, and RSLHs describe these states with comparable accuracy, with the best of each class reaching Rydberg mean absolute errors (MAEs) of 0.14–0.20 eV, but differences in their other ingredients prevent attributing this accuracy to either scheme. We therefore scan the LMF prefactor b and the range-separation parameter ω for a curated subset. A full-range EXX admixture, supplied through the LMF or a global fraction, describes these states more accurately than pure range separation (best Rydberg MAEs of 0.12 vs 0.20 eV). For RSLHs, the global Rydberg optimum lies at ω = 0, so range separation offers no further gain once real-space mixing is optimized. Real-space mixing incurs smaller barrier-height penalties when Rydberg-optimal parameters are transferred to ground-state properties, and a small ω can reconcile Rydberg and atomization-energy accuracy in LSDA-based RSLHs. For future RSLHs, we recommend encoding low-lying Rydberg states in the LMF, leaving the range-separation parameter for properties requiring long-range EXX, notably charge-transfer excitations.

articles.title: A Corrosion-to-CFD Framework for Quantifying Surface-Roughness Effects on a 316L Stainless-Steel Centrifugal Pump in Saline Service
articles.abstract: Corrosion roughening of wetted pump surfaces may shift the near-wall shear, turbulence, secondary flow, and hydraulic-loss balances in a centrifugal pump. The traceability of the temporal evolution of the corrosion state to a level of a pump CFD is proven to be elusive for saline service centrifugal pumps. In one previous experimental case, a pump built of 316L SS was exposed for 200 h to 30-ppt synthetic seawater, exhibiting a development of the electrical-input pump efficiency, flow rate, and head, respectively from 70.6, to 58.0, 1.50, to 1.38, and 12.0, to 10.7 m. Arithmetic surface roughness, Ra, in turn, developed from 0.8, to 3.4, and the RMS vibration from 0.20, to 0.75 mm/s [1]. Applying the current framework, one treats these Ra growths as exposure-indexed surface-condition descriptors instead of direct measurements of every wetted pump wall. The framework seeks a reproducible corrosion-to-CFD pathway through five exposure-indexed states, S0-S4. The modeling safeguard differentiates between the acquired values of Ra from the corresponding values of equivalent sand-grain roughness, ks, as ks = Ra, with as an uncertain, pump-specific factor as opposed to a universal constant. The proposed CFD modeling method includes three-dimensional, incompressible RANS with SST k-2 and k- 2 turbulence models, rotating/stationary interfaces, mesh- and time-step verification, multi-point characteristic-curve generation, roughness transfer sensitivity testing, and local roughness regime evaluations. The key endpoint is the head loss, which future CFD simulations can attribute to roughness alone with, thus enabling an estimation of the roughness-induced head loss percentage of the 1.30-m head decline. The residual loss will be assigned to other degradation mechanisms, e.g., clearance or wear ring gaps, leakage, pitting, geometry distortion, and unbalanced impeller. No solver-dependent CFD results are included, as the original pump CAD geometry and CFD were not available. The paper is therefore formulated as a methodology.

articles.title: Power Grid Operational Risk Assessment Based on Source-Grid Multi- dimensional Feature Fusion and Multi-gate Mixture-of-Experts Model
articles.title_zh: 基于源网多维特征融合和多门混合专家模型的电网运行风险评估
articles.abstract: With the increasing penetration of renewable energy, the stochasticity of wind and photovoltaic (PV) outputs and complex power-flow constraints impose higher requirements on the spatiotemporal identification of power grid balance operation risks. Existing risk assessment methods often overlook the spatiotemporal coupling and dynamic characteristics of the system and rely heavily on wind/PV data-driven approaches, causing the assessed risk distribution to deviate from actual operation results; neural networks also suffer from poor interpretability. Therefore, this paper proposes a power grid operational risk assessment method based on a multi-gate mixture-of-experts (MMoE) model. First, a two-stage dispatch model driven by empirical forecast error distributions is established to simulate actual dispatch errors and generate risk labels. Second, an MMoE model integrating source-side and schedule-side tabular features, grid-side topology features, and historical temporal features is constructed, and task-specific gating networks are used for joint prediction. Meanwhile, the gating weights and graph attention coefficients of the model provide adaptive interpretability analysis for balancing risks. The determination accuracies for curtailment and security of supply events are 92.7% and 84.2%, respectively, with false-alarm rates of 4.8% and 21.0%.Results for a representative operating interval demonstrate risk-association interpretation based on gating weights and graph attention coefficients, achieving high-accuracy risk prediction and causal tracing.
articles.abstract_zh: 随着可再生能源渗透率的不断提高，风电、光伏出力的随机性和复杂的潮流约束对电网平衡运行风险的时空识别提出了更高的要求。现有的风险评估方法往往忽视系统的时空耦合和动态特性，严重依赖风电/光伏数据驱动的方法，导致评估的风险分布与实际运行结果存在偏差；神经网络还存在可解释性差的问题。因此，本文提出一种基于多门混合专家（MMoE）模型的电网操作风险评估方法。首先，建立由经验预测误差分布驱动的两阶段调度模型来模拟实际调度误差并生成风险标签。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 随着可再生能源渗透率的不断提高，风电、光伏出力的随机性和复杂的潮流约束对电网平衡运行风险的时空识别提出了更高的要求。现有的风险评估方法往往忽视系统的时空耦合和动态特性，严重依赖风电/光伏数据驱动的方法，导致评估的风险分布与实际运行结果存在偏差；神经网络还存在可解释性差的问题。因此，本文提出一种基于多门混合专家（MMoE）模型的电网操作风险评估方法。首先，建立由经验预测误差分布驱动的两阶段调度模型来模拟实际调度误差并生成风险标签。其次，构建了集成源端和调度端表格特征、网格端拓扑特征和历史时间特征的MMoE模型，并使用特定于任务的门网络进行联合预测。同时，模型的门控权重和图注意力系数为平衡风险提供了自适应可解释性分析。限电事件和安全供电事件的判定准确率分别为92.7%和84.2%，误报率分别为4.8%和21.0%。代表性运行区间的结果证明了基于门控权重和图关注系数的风险关联解释，实现了高精度的风险预测和因果追踪。

articles.title: Development and Field Validation of an IoT-Based Smart Beehive Monitoring System for Precision Apiculture
articles.title_zh: 基于物联网的精准养蜂智能蜂箱监控系统的开发和现场验证
articles.abstract: Even though honey bee colonies are experiencing record losses, the majority of beekeepers continue to conduct laborious, time-consuming manual hive inspections hence need for continuous, non-invasive, and cost-effective monitoring technologies that can support timely beekeeping decisions. The Bee-Hive Project, a low-cost solar-powered Internet of Things (IoT) system for ongoing smart hive monitoring, is the subject of this paper's case study. A conventional embedded-systems design cycle was employed during the development process, encompassing requirements specification, architectural design, component selection, bench prototyping, PCB manufacturing, mechanical integration, firmware creation, and field validation. The system is configured with a five-stage data path (Fig. 1). An Arduino MKR WAN 1310 interrogates multiple sensors within the hive. The microcontroller transmits the data via a LoRaWAN uplink after encoding it into a compact binary payload. The Arduino MKR WAN 1310 is surrounded by sensors for temperature, humidity and weight. Data is sent via LoRaWAN to The Things Stack and subsequently to the Ubidots and BEEP cloud platforms for alerting and visualization. A LoRaWAN gateway acquires the uplink, subsequently transmitting it to The Things Stack (TTN), a LoRaWAN network server, where the binary payload is decoded into designated fields via a bespoke decoder function. The weatherproof solar-powered enclosure and custom printed circuit board were constructed and put through a two-week field test. In addition to discussing the advantages and disadvantages of the system in light of the precision-beekeeping literature, the paper reports on the design, implementation, and field results. The proposed system successfully enabled real-time hive monitoring by transmitting environmental, weight, and battery data at ten-minute intervals, demonstrating a low-cost, solar-powered, weather-resistant IoT solution for precision beekeeping in off-grid environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 尽管蜂群正在遭受创纪录的损失，但大多数养蜂人仍在进行费力、耗时的手动蜂巢检查，因此需要持续、非侵入性且具有成本效益的监测技术来支持及时的养蜂决策。 Bee-Hive 项目是一种低成本太阳能物联网 (IoT) 系统，用于持续智能蜂巢监控，是本文案例研究的主题。开发过程中采用了传统的嵌入式系统设计周期，包括需求规范、架构设计、组件选择、工作台原型设计、PCB 制造、机械集成、固件创建和现场验证。该系统配置有五级数据路径（图1）。

articles.title: Can gravitational fields break and reconnect? Einstein's equations suggest they can
articles.title_zh: 引力场可以破裂并重新连接吗？爱因斯坦的方程表明他们可以
articles.abstract: More than a century after Einstein first devised the equations that describe gravity, physicists are still finding new ways of interpreting them. Luca Comisso, an associate research scientist in Columbia University's departments of Astronomy and Physics and the Columbia Astrophysics Laboratory, and Felipe A. Asenjo of Universidad Adolfo Ibáñez in Chile, recently found a new way of looking at Einstein's equations that reveals a striking analogy with "magnetic reconnection" in plasmas, which occurs when magnetic field lines break and reconnect, powering explosive phenomena such as solar flares.
articles.abstract_zh: 在爱因斯坦首次设计描述引力方程一个多世纪后，物理学家仍在寻找解释它们的新方法。哥伦比亚大学天文学和物理系以及哥伦比亚天体物理实验室的副研究科学家卢卡·科米索（Luca Comisso）和智利阿道夫·伊巴涅斯大学的费利佩·A·阿森霍（Felipe A. Asenjo）最近发现了一种看待爱因斯坦方程的新方法，该方程揭示了与等离子体中“磁重联”的惊人类比，磁力重联发生在磁场线断裂和重新连接时，为太阳耀斑等爆炸现象提供动力。

articles.title: Against all expectations, researchers control the magnetic core of a single atom
articles.title_zh: 出乎意料的是，研究人员控制了单个原子的磁芯
articles.abstract: Researchers at Delft University of Technology (the Netherlands) have succeeded in controlling the magnetism in the nucleus of a single atom with radio waves. This came as a surprise: until now, physicists believed that this nuclear spin could not be manipulated directly. The discovery could open up new possibilities for storing and reading quantum information. The research is published in the journal Nature Communications.

articles.title: Learnable coarsening for two-phase flow in porous media
articles.title_zh: 多孔介质中两相流的可学习粗化
articles.abstract: Hydrodynamic simulations of multi-phase flow in porous media are essential for oil production forecasting but require significant computational resources. Traditional approaches lead to high memory and time demands, restricting multi-scenario analysis. We propose a learnable coarsening algorithm based on graph neural networks (GNNs) with node aggregation for 2D two-phase flow modeling. The coarsened grid adapts to the reservoir geometry, its properties, and production data. Our algorithm is integrated with a graph-based finite volume method (FVM) solver, differentiable Voronoi tessellation, and a fully implicit upwind scheme. The unstructured computational grid is modeled as a graph with cell centers, adjacency edges, and a rich set of node features: coordinates, permeability, masks, distances to wells, permeability gradients, and wells influence potential. GNN produces soft assignments for probabilistic clustering, preserving wells and sensors. Training employs an FVM solver with physics-informed loss matching saturation and production rate time series at wells, promoting grid uniformity. Extending our prior works, our method enables coarsening by 10 times with relative error of about 1%–2%, accurately reproducing saturation fields, oil production, and water breakthrough on synthetic and realistic permeability fields.
articles.abstract_zh: 多孔介质中多相流的流体动力学模拟对于石油产量预测至关重要，但需要大量的计算资源。传统方法会导致较高的内存和时间需求，限制了多场景分析。我们提出了一种基于图神经网络（GNN）的可学习粗化算法，具有用于二维两相流建模的节点聚合。粗化网格适应储层几何形状、其性质和生产数据。我们的算法与基于图的有限体积法 (FVM) 求解器、可微分 Voronoi 曲面细分和完全隐式迎风方案集成。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多孔介质中多相流的流体动力学模拟对于石油产量预测至关重要，但需要大量的计算资源。传统方法会导致较高的内存和时间需求，限制了多场景分析。我们提出了一种基于图神经网络（GNN）的可学习粗化算法，具有用于二维两相流建模的节点聚合。粗化网格适应储层几何形状、其性质和生产数据。我们的算法与基于图的有限体积法 (FVM) 求解器、可微分 Voronoi 曲面细分和完全隐式迎风方案集成。非结构化计算网格被建模为具有单元中心、邻接边和一组丰富的节点特征的图：坐标、渗透率、掩模、到井的距离、渗透率梯度和井影响潜力。 GNN 为概率聚类、保留井和传感器生成软分配。训练采用 FVM 求解器，该求解器具有物理信息损失匹配井的饱和度和生产率时间序列，从而提高网格均匀性。扩展我们之前的工作，我们的方法可以粗化10倍，相对误差约为1%–2%，准确地再现合成和实际渗透率场的饱和度场、石油产量和见水情况。

articles.title: Robust high-fidelity three-qubit gates design for superconducting quantum computers via model-free reinforcement learning
articles.title_zh: 通过无模型强化学习为超导量子计算机设计鲁棒的高保真三量子位门
articles.abstract: Multi-qubit gates are crucial to realizing quantum algorithms. Direct implementation of these gates will facilitate a reduction in circuit depth. However, existing model-based methods rely on precise characterization of the system Hamiltonian as well as execution of the control fields, which present challenges in obtaining high fidelity multi-qubit gates. In this paper, we exploit the bang–bang control protocol and model-free reinforcement learning to realize several kinds of three-qubit gates for superconducting quantum computers with tunable/fixed frequency qubits, including the iToffoli gate, the parity check gate and the CCZ gate. The simulation results show that the fidelity of each gate can achieve 99.2% with the Adam gradient descent optimizer. Moreover, the proposed method is robust against random noise in the control pulse. Gate fidelity can be maintained over 95% even in the case of Gaussian noise with variance of 0.3. Besides, the impacts of parameter iterative optimization strategies are also analyzed.
articles.abstract_zh: 多量子位门对于实现量子算法至关重要。直接实现这些门将有助于减少电路深度。然而，现有的基于模型的方法依赖于系统哈密顿量的精确表征以及控制场的执行，这对获得高保真多量子位门提出了挑战。在本文中，我们利用bang-bang控制协议和无模型强化学习，为具有可调谐/固定频率量子位的超导量子计算机实现了几种三量子位门，包括iToffoli门、奇偶校验门和CCZ门。仿真结果表明，采用Adam梯度下降优化器，每个门的保真度可以达到99.2%。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多量子位门对于实现量子算法至关重要。直接实现这些门将有助于减少电路深度。然而，现有的基于模型的方法依赖于系统哈密顿量的精确表征以及控制场的执行，这对获得高保真多量子位门提出了挑战。在本文中，我们利用bang-bang控制协议和无模型强化学习，为具有可调谐/固定频率量子位的超导量子计算机实现了几种三量子位门，包括iToffoli门、奇偶校验门和CCZ门。仿真结果表明，采用Adam梯度下降优化器，每个门的保真度可以达到99.2%。此外，所提出的方法对于控制脉冲中的随机噪声具有鲁棒性。即使在方差为0.3的高斯噪声情况下，门保真度也能保持在95%以上。此外，还分析了参数迭代优化策略的影响。

articles.title: Machine learning enabled design of sustainable alloys considering real world constraints
articles.title_zh: 机器学习支持考虑现实世界限制的可持续合金设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35946v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Designing sustainable alloys must reconcile high performance with real-world constraints, including feedstock scarcity and variability, processing and energy requirements, regulatory thresholds, and economic limitations. Addressing these constraints reaches far beyond today's conventional performance-focused frameworks. It needs to consider not only complex property-processing-performance trade-offs but also sustainable production pathways. Here, we propose a physics-informed ensemble (PIE) learning framework that integrates fundamental structure-property relationships with processing routes and sustainability criteria for mechanism-based alloy design. It predicts properties from composition-microstructure relationships and infers processing routes under sustainability constraints, establishing an interdisciplinary approach to identifying sustainable alloy solutions. We validate the approach for Mg alloys, a lightweight yet energy-intensive metallic material class, considering performance, cost, and carbon emissions. Trained on a benchmark dataset, the PIE model systematically explores plausible alloy compositions and microstructures to construct a digital library of millions of candidate alloys. From this space, we identify two sustainable Mg alloy solutions that overcome the conventional performance-cost-emission trade-off: a rare-earth-containing alloy increases yield and tensile strength by 72.8 percent and 61.1 percent, respectively, over alloys from the same family at comparable cost and emissions; and a rare-earth-free alloy reduces cost and carbon emissions by 40.4 percent and 88.9 percent, respectively, relative to its primary-feedstock counterpart, without compromising mechanical performance. This work introduces a general, physics-informed, and quantifiable framework for designing sustainable alloys under real-world constraints.
articles.abstract_zh: 设计可持续合金必须协调高性能与现实世界的限制，包括原料稀缺性和可变性、加工和能源要求、监管阈值和经济限制。解决这些限制远远超出了当今传统的以性能为中心的框架的范围。它不仅需要考虑复杂的财产-加工-性能权衡，还需要考虑可持续的生产途径。在这里，我们提出了一种物理信息集成（PIE）学习框架，它将基本结构-性能关系与基于机制的合金设计的加工路线和可持续性标准相结合。它根据成分-微观结构关系预测性能，并推断可持续性约束下的加工路线，建立跨学科方法来识别可持续合金解决方案。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 设计可持续合金必须协调高性能与现实世界的限制，包括原料稀缺性和可变性、加工和能源要求、监管阈值和经济限制。解决这些限制远远超出了当今传统的以性能为中心的框架的范围。它不仅需要考虑复杂的财产-加工-性能权衡，还需要考虑可持续的生产途径。在这里，我们提出了一种物理信息集成（PIE）学习框架，它将基本结构-性能关系与基于机制的合金设计的加工路线和可持续性标准相结合。它根据成分-微观结构关系预测性能，并推断可持续性约束下的加工路线，建立跨学科方法来识别可持续合金解决方案。我们验证了镁合金（一种轻质但能源密集型金属材料类别）的方法，同时考虑了性能、成本和碳排放。 PIE 模型在基准数据集上进行训练，系统地探索合理的合金成分和微观结构，以构建包含数百万种候选合金的数字库。从这个领域，我们确定了两种可持续的镁合金解决方案，克服了传统的性能-成本-排放权衡：与成本和排放相当的同类合金相比，含稀土合金的产量和抗拉强度分别提高了 72.8% 和 61.1%；与主要原料相比，不含稀土的合金可分别降低成本和碳排放 40.4% 和 88.9%，且不会影响机械性能。这项工作介绍了一个通用的、基于物理的、可量化的框架，用于在现实世界的限制下设计可持续合金。

articles.title: Bayesian Inference in Partially Observed Critical Systems
articles.title_zh: 部分观测关键系统中的贝叶斯推理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35973v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We ask how much of a large random system must be observed before a global average can be inferred with controlled uncertainty. For the random transposition shuffle, a conjugate Bayesian estimator of the average displacement, computed from m uniformly sampled cards, has relative uncertainty 1/sqrt2m, independent of the deck size n. The law of total variance exposes a second error, the floor Rₙ, which arises because the observed configuration is a single draw from equilibrium: no relative tolerance below κsqrtRₙ can be certified, even by a census. For the shuffle we derive Rₙ=(2n²+7)/bigl(5(n-1)²(n+1)bigr) and show that the posterior remains calibrated. At the critical point of the two-dimensional Ising model the floor of the energy vanishes, whereas that of the magnetisation stays near 0.072; its mean-field limit is sqrt2-1. For correlated fields read by sensor networks, the usual 95% interval covers the ensemble mean in 7% of cases. Bounding the floor from one realisation, as in single-chain Monte Carlo diagnostics, requires an assumption on the decay of correlations.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们问，在以受控不确定性推断全局平均值之前，必须观察大型随机系统的多少。对于随机换位洗牌，根据 m 张均匀采样的牌计算出的平均位移的共轭贝叶斯估计量具有相对不确定性 1/sqrt2m，与牌组大小 n 无关。总方差定律揭示了第二个误差，即下限 Rₙ，这是因为观察到的配置是从平衡中得出的单次误差：即使通过人口普查，也无法证明低于 κsqrtRₙ 的相对容差。对于洗牌，我们得出 Rₙ=(2n²+7)/bigl(5(n-1)²(n+1)bigr) 并表明后验保持校准。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们问，在以受控不确定性推断全局平均值之前，必须观察大型随机系统的多少。对于随机换位洗牌，根据 m 张均匀采样的牌计算出的平均位移的共轭贝叶斯估计量具有相对不确定性 1/sqrt2m，与牌组大小 n 无关。总方差定律揭示了第二个误差，即下限 Rₙ，这是因为观察到的配置是从平衡中得出的单次误差：即使通过人口普查，也无法证明低于 κsqrtRₙ 的相对容差。对于洗牌，我们得出 Rₙ=(2n²+7)/bigl(5(n-1)²(n+1)bigr) 并表明后验保持校准。在二维伊辛模型的临界点，能量下限消失，而磁化强度保持在 0.072 附近；其平均场极限为 sqrt2-1。对于传感器网络读取的相关字段，通常 95% 的区间覆盖 7% 情况下的整体平均值。正如在单链蒙特卡罗诊断中一样，从一种实现中限制下限需要对相关性衰减做出假设。

articles.title: Emergent Fermi Surfaces in Periodically Driven Bose Gases
articles.title_zh: 周期性驱动玻色气体中的涌现费米表面
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.36038v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that the steady state of a periodically driven Bose gas coupled to a thermal bath features emergent Fermi surfaces both in its high temperature and Bose-Einstein-condensate (BEC) states. These emergent Fermi surfaces are non-analyticities in the occupation function as a function of momentum arising from the lack of detailed balance of collisions away from equilibrium. They are stronger in the BEC than in the normal gas, and can be more robust against finite temperature smearing than the usual equilibrium Fermi surfaces of Fermi gases. We also show that they give rise to analogous rich phenomena, such as Friedel oscillations in the density correlations and quantum oscillations in response to applied magnetic fields controlled by their areas, albeit with marked quantitative differences. Our results establish non-equilibrium conditions as a promising alternative pathway to achieve the long-sought-after emergence of Fermi surfaces in bosonic system. We outline strategies to experimentally discover these exotic states in ultra-cold atomic clouds.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们证明了与热浴耦合的周期性驱动玻色气体的稳态在高温状态和玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚（BEC）状态下都具有费米面的涌现特征。这些新兴的费米面在作为动量函数的占据函数中是非解析性的，这是由于缺乏远离平衡的碰撞的详细平衡而产生的。它们在 BEC 中比在普通气体中更强，并且比费米气体的通常平衡费米面更能抵抗有限温度拖尾。我们还表明，它们会产生类似的丰富现象，例如密度相关性中的弗里德尔振荡和响应于由其区域控制的施加磁场的量子振荡，尽管存在明显的数量差异。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们证明了与热浴耦合的周期性驱动玻色气体的稳态在高温状态和玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚（BEC）状态下都具有费米面的涌现特征。这些新兴的费米面在作为动量函数的占据函数中是非解析性的，这是由于缺乏远离平衡的碰撞的详细平衡而产生的。它们在 BEC 中比在普通气体中更强，并且比费米气体的通常平衡费米面更能抵抗有限温度拖尾。我们还表明，它们会产生类似的丰富现象，例如密度相关性中的弗里德尔振荡和响应于由其区域控制的施加磁场的量子振荡，尽管存在明显的数量差异。我们的结果确立了非平衡条件作为一种有前途的替代途径，以实现玻色子系统中长期以来寻求的费米表面的出现。我们概述了通过实验发现超冷原子云中这些奇异状态的策略。

articles.title: Phase Transitions in Mismatched Bayesian Inference for the Ising Model
articles.title_zh: Ising 模型的不匹配贝叶斯推理中的相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.36041v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bayesian inference with a mismatched model can develop an overconfident phase, characterized by posterior agreement without faithful reconstruction of the true state. We study Bayesian inference from noisy bond measurements of an Ising model in its paramagnetic phase, with true inverse temperature β and measurement-noise strength Δ, while inference assumes corresponding parameters β_Q and Δ_Q. Using replica field theory, we analytically show that the overconfidence phase can occur when inference underestimates the measurement noise (Δ_Q < Δ) or assumes a lower prior temperature than the true one (β_Q > β). An exact change of variables maps the problem to a correlated random-bond Ising model, where the informative, uninformative, and overconfident phases correspond to ferromagnetic, paramagnetic, and spin-glass phases, respectively. We further perform Monte Carlo simulations of the mapped model in three dimensions and establish a finite overconfident region between the informative and uninformative phases, consistent with our analytical prediction. Finally, we show that the true model parameters can be inferred directly from the measurement records, providing a natural route to calibrating the inference model.
articles.abstract_zh: 使用不匹配模型的贝叶斯推理可能会发展出过度自信的阶段，其特征是后验一致而没有忠实地重建真实状态。我们研究了顺磁相伊辛模型的噪声键测量的贝叶斯推理，具有真实的逆温度 β 和测量噪声强度 Δ，而推理假设相应的参数 β_Q 和 Δ_Q。使用复制场理论，我们分析表明，当推理低估测量噪声 (Δ_Q β) 时，就会出现过度自信阶段。变量的精确变化将问题映射到相关随机键伊辛模型，其中信息性、非信息性和过度自信相分别对应于铁磁相、顺磁相和自旋玻璃相。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 使用不匹配模型的贝叶斯推理可能会发展出过度自信的阶段，其特征是后验一致而没有忠实地重建真实状态。我们研究了顺磁相伊辛模型的噪声键测量的贝叶斯推理，具有真实的逆温度 β 和测量噪声强度 Δ，而推理假设相应的参数 β_Q 和 Δ_Q。使用复制场理论，我们分析表明，当推理低估测量噪声 (Δ_Q β) 时，就会出现过度自信阶段。变量的精确变化将问题映射到相关随机键伊辛模型，其中信息性、非信息性和过度自信相分别对应于铁磁相、顺磁相和自旋玻璃相。我们进一步在三个维度上对映射模型进行蒙特卡罗模拟，并在信息阶段和非信息阶段之间建立一个有限的过度自信区域，这与我们的分析预测一致。最后，我们表明可以直接从测量记录推断出真实的模型参数，为校准推断模型提供了自然的途径。

articles.title: A Hybrid Brownian Dynamics-kinetic Monte Carlo Framework for Coupled Magnetic and Rotational Dynamics of Nanoparticles
articles.title_zh: 用于纳米颗粒耦合磁和旋转动力学的混合布朗动力学-动力学蒙特卡罗框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.36102v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Simulating the coupled magnetic and rotational dynamics of suspended magnetic nanoparticles (MNPs) over experimentally relevant timescales remains computationally demanding, particularly under low-frequency alternating magnetic fields. Here, we develop a hybrid Brownian Dynamics--kinetic Monte Carlo (BD--kMC) framework that combines thermally activated magnetic switching with particle rotation while retaining local fluctuations of the magnetic moment. These fluctuations are incorporated through Metropolis Monte Carlo (MC) sampling, allowing the moment to depart from the energy minima and thereby capturing the thermally averaged anisotropy torque that governs particle rotation. To preserve the distinction between local fluctuations and magnetic reversals, a barrier-trapping criterion confines MC trial moves to the current energy well, leaving thermally activated switching to the kMC process. For non-interacting single-domain MNPs, comparison with stochastic Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert (LLG) simulations demonstrates agreement in the equilibrium torque and stationary easy-axis orientation, including the field-driven transition from predominantly perpendicular to parallel alignment. The resulting BD--kMC framework provides an efficient approach to coupled magnetic and Brownian Dynamics, reducing the computational cost of exploring the long timescales relevant to low-frequency magnetic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 在实验相关时间尺度上模拟悬浮磁性纳米颗粒 (MNP) 的耦合磁性和旋转动力学仍然需要大量计算，特别是在低频交变磁场下。在这里，我们开发了一种混合布朗动力学-动力学蒙特卡罗（BD--kMC）框架，该框架将热激活磁开关与粒子旋转相结合，同时保留磁矩的局部波动。这些波动通过 Metropolis Monte Carlo (MC) 采样纳入，允许力矩偏离能量最小值，从而捕获控制粒子旋转的热平均各向异性扭矩。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在实验相关时间尺度上模拟悬浮磁性纳米颗粒 (MNP) 的耦合磁性和旋转动力学仍然需要大量计算，特别是在低频交变磁场下。在这里，我们开发了一种混合布朗动力学-动力学蒙特卡罗（BD--kMC）框架，该框架将热激活磁开关与粒子旋转相结合，同时保留磁矩的局部波动。这些波动通过 Metropolis Monte Carlo (MC) 采样纳入，允许力矩偏离能量最小值，从而捕获控制粒子旋转的热平均各向异性扭矩。为了保持局部波动和磁反转之间的区别，势垒捕获标准将 MC 试验限制在当前能量井中，而将热激活切换到 kMC 过程。对于非相互作用的单域 MNP，与随机 Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert (LLG) 模拟的比较表明平衡扭矩和固定易轴方向一致，包括从主要垂直到平行排列的场驱动转变。由此产生的 BD-kMC 框架提供了一种耦合磁和布朗动力学的有效方法，降低了探索与低频磁应用相关的长时间尺度的计算成本。

articles.title: Physical structure as an organizing principle for universal Hamiltonian learning
articles.title_zh: 物理结构作为通用哈密顿学习的组织原则
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.36135v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Density functional theory (DFT) gives the electronic structure of materials, but its cost limits large-supercell calculations and materials screening. Machine-learned Hamiltonians bypass the self-consistent cycle but are usually system-specific; universal ones could cover new compositions and disordered solids. Such models must generalize across chemistry and keep downstream properties physical, while staying inexpensive for large cells. Here we introduce UniTB, a universal E(3) equivariant Hamiltonian representation framework that integrates physical priors rooted in density-functional tight-binding theory with deep learning. UniTB's network, which corrects a prior Hamiltonian, generalizes across chemistry through a mixture of experts routed by that prior and a charge-equilibration head as in self-consistent-charge tight binding. A projection bounds band shifts from the prior, suppressing spurious states and keeping downstream properties physical. We provide the fastest SO(2) tensor-product GPU kernels for the network. The variant UniTB-Flash assembles its prior from two-center tables at O(N) cost for N atoms, against O(Nlog N) on a grid. Trained on 29,242 crystals, UniTB reaches a 0.48 meV matrix-element error on nonmagnetic test crystals spanning 68 elements. Without amorphous training data, both models agree with DFT optics and conductivity of amorphous Ge-Sb-Te. UniTB-Flash ranks candidates with no significant difference from UniTB, whose property values are more accurate; together they screen 16,195 crystals for five application domains of industrial relevance.
articles.abstract_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）给出了材料的电子结构，但其成本限制了大型超晶胞计算和材料筛选。机器学习的哈密顿量绕过了自洽循环，但通常是特定于系统的；通用的可以涵盖新的组合物和无序固体。此类模型必须能够推广到整个化学领域，并保持下游物理特性，同时保持大电池的廉价性。在这里，我们介绍 UniTB，一个通用的 E(3) 等变哈密顿表示框架，它将植根于密度泛函紧束缚理论的物理先验与深度学习相结合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 密度泛函理论（DFT）给出了材料的电子结构，但其成本限制了大型超晶胞计算和材料筛选。机器学习的哈密顿量绕过了自洽循环，但通常是特定于系统的；通用的可以涵盖新的组合物和无序固体。此类模型必须能够推广到整个化学领域，并保持下游物理特性，同时保持大电池的廉价性。在这里，我们介绍 UniTB，一个通用的 E(3) 等变哈密顿表示框架，它将植根于密度泛函紧束缚理论的物理先验与深度学习相结合。 UniTB 的网络纠正了先前的哈密顿量，通过由先前的哈密顿量和电荷平衡头路由的专家混合来概括整个化学，就像自洽电荷紧密结合一样。投影限制了先前的能带偏移，抑制了杂散状态并保持了下游特性的物理性。我们为网络提供最快的 SO(2) 张量积 GPU 内核。变体 UniTB-Flash 以 N 原子的 O(N) 成本从两个中心表组装其先验，相对于网格上的 O(Nlog N)。在 29,242 个晶体上进行训练后，UniTB 在跨越 68 个元件的非磁性测试晶体上达到了 0.48 meV 矩阵元件误差。在没有非晶训练数据的情况下，两个模型都符合非晶 Ge-Sb-Te 的 DFT 光学和电导率。 UniTB-Flash对候选者进行排名与UniTB没有显着差异，其属性值更准确；他们共同筛选了 16,195 种晶体，用于五个工业相关应用领域。

articles.title: Anisotropic Structural and Magnetic Response in Sm₂Ir₈Al₃₁: Al-Sublattice Reconstruction upon Sm Substitution
articles.title_zh: Sm2Ir₈Al₃₁ 中的各向异性结构和磁响应：Sm 取代后的 Al 亚晶格重构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.36140v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chemical pressure plays a critical role in determining the crystal structures and physical properties of intermetallic compounds. Here, we report the synthesis, crystal structure, and physical properties of Sm₂Ir₈Al₃₁, a structural analog of UIr₄Al₁₅, in which the smaller 5f uranium atoms are replaced by larger 4f samarium atoms. Single-crystal X-ray diffraction reveals a tetragonal sqrt2×sqrt2×1 superstructure with space group Pbar42₁m, derived from a UIr₄Al₁₅-like average structure with space group P4₂/nmc. Comparison with UIr₄Al₁₅ shows that chemical pressure from U-to-Sm substitution produces a strongly anisotropic structural response rather than a uniform expansion of the Ir-Al framework. While one Ir coordination environment undergoes only modest changes, the other exhibits substantial local rearrangement. The Al sublattice primarily accommodates these structural distortions, with selected Al sites showing positional splitting, anisotropic atomic displacement ellipsoids, and partial occupancies, resulting in an Al-rich composition of approximately Sm₂Ir₈Al₃₁. Magnetic susceptibility measurements reveal a direction dependence, including a broad anomaly near 50 K for selected magnetic-field orientations. However, the absence of corresponding anomalies in heat capacity, electrical resistivity, and lattice parameters suggests that this feature is more consistent with an anisotropic magnetic crossover than a bulk thermodynamic phase transition. These results highlight how chemical substitution at the f-element site can induce Al-sublattice reconstruction and modify the magnetic response within a closely related Ir-Al structural framework.
articles.abstract_zh: 化学压力在确定金属间化合物的晶体结构和物理性质方面起着至关重要的作用。在这里，我们报道了 Sm2Ir8Al31 的合成、晶体结构和物理性质，Sm2Ir8Al31 是 UIr4Al15 的结构类似物，其中较小的 5f 铀原子被较大的 4f 钐原子取代。单晶X射线衍射揭示了空间群为Pbar42₁m的四方sqrt2×sqrt2×1超结构，源自空间群为P42/nmc的UIr4Al15类平均结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 化学压力在确定金属间化合物的晶体结构和物理性质方面起着至关重要的作用。在这里，我们报道了 Sm2Ir8Al31 的合成、晶体结构和物理性质，Sm2Ir8Al31 是 UIr4Al15 的结构类似物，其中较小的 5f 铀原子被较大的 4f 钐原子取代。单晶X射线衍射揭示了空间群为Pbar42₁m的四方sqrt2×sqrt2×1超结构，源自空间群为P42/nmc的UIr4Al15类平均结构。与 UIr4Al15 的比较表明，U 到 Sm 取代的化学压力产生了强烈的各向异性结构响应，而不是 Ir-Al 骨架的均匀膨胀。虽然一种 Ir 配位环境仅经历了适度的变化，但另一种则表现出大量的局部重排。 Al 亚晶格主要适应这些结构畸变，选定的 Al 位点表现出位置分裂、各向异性原子位移椭球和部分占据，从而形成大约 Sm2Ir8Al31 的富铝成分。磁化率测量揭示了方向依赖性，包括所选磁场方向在 50 K 附近的广泛异常。然而，热容量、电阻率和晶格参数中不存在相应的异常，这表明该特征与各向异性磁交叉比体热力学相变更一致。这些结果强调了 f 元素位点的化学取代如何诱导 Al 亚晶格重建并改变密切相关的 Ir-Al 结构框架内的磁响应。

articles.title: Learning the Chronology of Materials Discovery for Synthesizability Prediction
articles.title_zh: 了解材料发现的年表以预测可合成性
