articles.title: How can digital and AI-enabled behaviour change interventions be evaluated while they are changing? HUMMBER: identifying what changed, for whom, why and with what effect
articles.abstract: Background Digital behaviour change interventions (DBCIs), including AI-enabled DBCIs, can change during use and scale-up as users and implementation circumstances also change. Within a focused exploratory evidence map, we did not identify a reusable method connecting longitudinal change, affected people, circumstances, explanations, component comparisons, evidence limits and human decision authority.Methods We aimed to specify HUMMBER (Human-centred, User-informed, Multimethod Micro-randomised Behaviour Evaluation and Response) as a reusable method for ongoing evaluation and to examine selected proposed functions in a hypothetical synthetic scale-up demonstration. HUMMBER is organised around six procedural questions and a version-controlled Application Specification. Optional software supports recording, allocation and analysis without interpreting evidence or authorising action. In a wholly synthetic 26-week scale-up demonstration using a 600-person mixed cohort and five 1,200-person scenarios, we examined: (1) What changed? through longitudinal trajectories with similar final outcomes; (2) For whom? through support opportunity, burden and missingness across groups; (3) Under what circumstances? through assessment timing, information and burden; (4) What might explain the change? by updating possible explanations as evidence accumulated; (5) Did a component make a difference? through prespecified valid randomised comparisons of next-week engagement; and (6) What can evaluators conclude? through evidence-status rules, sensitivity analysis and Monte Carlo checks.Results (1) Known synthetic change patterns remained descriptively distinguishable despite similar final maintenance (68.5%-74.4%). (2) Limited digital access reduced opportunities to receive the eligible support options (34.3% vs 72.7%) and increased missing data (8.4% vs 4.2%), without a programmed difference in support effect. (3) Participant-selected timing produced the greatest useful information per active participant minute in synthetic units. (4) Accumulating evidence assigned the highest probability to the programmed explanation for most synthetic participants, even from misleading starting assumptions. (5) Technical assistance (+ 23.2 percentage points; 95% CI 15.5 to 30.8), goal problem-solving (+ 13.5; 5.9 to 21.1) and flexible timing (+ 14.6; 6.4 to 22.7) improved next-week engagement. (6) The prespecified evidence-status rules limited or withheld conclusions when evidence was insufficient, comparisons unavailable, effects changed over time or missingness threatened interpretation.Conclusions HUMMBER, specified with transdisciplinary author-team input including a consumer perspective and designed for co-design in live applications, is a proposed human-governed framework for traceable evaluation of DBCIs that change during use and scale-up. In this wholly synthetic proof of concept, the synthetic implementation demonstrated computational feasibility and bounded inference under the documented demonstration conditions, not real-world effectiveness. Prospective testing should include participatory co-design, adaptive and agentic AI-enabled interventions and live governance processes.

articles.title: Collective Optical Excitations and Photoexcited-Carrier Dynamics in the Na 20 @C 240 Core-Shell Nanostructure
articles.title_zh: Na 20 @C 240 核壳纳米结构中的集体光激发和光激发载流子动力学
articles.abstract: Finite metal clusters and fullerene cages lie between molecular and classical plasmonic regimes, where collective polarization, discrete electron-hole transitions, and orbital hybridization coexist. We use adiabatic real-time time-dependent density functional theory to examine the optical response and post-pulse electronic dynamics of isolated Na20, isolated C240, and the Na20@C240 core-shell model. The isolated Na20 calculation exhibits a dominant dipole-active feature at 2.73 eV with coherent contributions from several off-resonant electron-hole transitions and a dipole-like induced density. We interpret it as a finite-size plasmon-like resonance with mixed and potentially fragmented character, rather than as a classical localized surface plasmon. The C240 cage supports several mixed molecular-polarization resonances, with the clearest plasmon-like signature among the examined modes at 5.59 eV. In the composite, the shell polarization is antiphase with the Na-centered response at 2.73 eV and suppresses the net dipole, whereas the 5.70 eV response is predominantly an in-phase, shell-localized polarization. Time-dependent energy decompositions show coherent redistribution from collective Coulomb-driven motion toward resonant electron-hole channels, accompanied by finite-system beating and recurrence. Hot-carrier distributions are concentrated mainly on C240 at the end of the propagation. It should be noted that these quantities are internal descriptors within a frozen-ion mean-field simulation of a closed quantum system, and do not correspond to extractable carrier yields or irreversible lifetimes.
articles.abstract_zh: 有限金属簇和富勒烯笼位于分子和经典等离子体状态之间，其中集体极化、离散电子空穴跃迁和轨道杂化共存。我们使用绝热实时瞬态密度泛函理论来研究孤立 Na20、孤立 C240 和 Na20@C240 核壳模型的光学响应和脉冲后电子动力学。孤立的 Na2O 计算显示出 2.73 eV 处的主要偶极子活性特征，并具有来自几个非共振电子空穴跃迁和类偶极子感应密度的相干贡献。我们将其解释为具有混合和潜在碎片特征的有限尺寸的类等离子体共振，而不是经典的局域表面等离子体。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 有限金属簇和富勒烯笼位于分子和经典等离子体状态之间，其中集体极化、离散电子空穴跃迁和轨道杂化共存。我们使用绝热实时瞬态密度泛函理论来研究孤立 Na20、孤立 C240 和 Na20@C240 核壳模型的光学响应和脉冲后电子动力学。孤立的 Na2O 计算显示出 2.73 eV 处的主要偶极子活性特征，并具有来自几个非共振电子空穴跃迁和类偶极子感应密度的相干贡献。我们将其解释为具有混合和潜在碎片特征的有限尺寸的类等离子体共振，而不是经典的局域表面等离子体。 C240 笼支持多种混合分子极化共振，在 5.59 eV 的检查模式中具有最清晰的类等离激元特征。在复合材料中，壳层极化与 2.73 eV 处的 Na 中心响应反相，并抑制净偶极子，而 5.70 eV 响应主要是同相、壳层局部极化。与时间相关的能量分解显示出从集体库仑驱动的运动到谐振电子空穴通道的相干重新分布，并伴随着有限系统的跳动和递归。热载流子分布主要集中在传播末端的 C240 上。应该注意的是，这些量是封闭量子系统的冻结离子平均场模拟中的内部描述符，并不对应于可提取的载流子产率或不可逆寿命。

articles.title: Training Data Selection for Weakly-Supervised Lunar Traversability Estimation: A Cross-Domain Study
articles.title_zh: 弱监督月球可穿越性估计的训练数据选择：跨领域研究
articles.abstract: This paper examines how weakly supervised traversability estimation models generalize across domains in the context of lunar robotics. Because annotated lunar datasets are scarce, models must be trained on Earth-based data and transferred to environments with significantly different visual and physical characteristics. We adopt a pairwise, weakly supervised learning framework in which relative traversability annotations provide a lightweight alternative to dense labeling while preserving the continuous nature of terrain assessment. We conduct a systematic cross-domain evaluation over seven datasets spanning synthetic simulations, terrestrial analogs, lunar analog facilities, and real lunar mission imagery (Chang'e 3/4), using the Human Disagreement Rate (HDR) metric. Our results reveal a consistent ranking of training sources: lunar analog facilities transfer most reliably to real lunar imagery, while visual and morphological similarity to the target domain proves a stronger predictor of transfer quality than dataset realism or domain category. Notably, strong in-domain performance does not predict cross-domain generalization, exposing a fundamental limitation of standard evaluation protocols for space-graded perception systems. We further show that this ranking is stable across HDR thresholds, and that introducing limited target-domain data monotonically improves transfer performance while preserving the initial source ranking. Overall, this study provides an empirical basis for training data selection in lunar traversability applications and argues for cross-domain evaluation as a standard component of the verification and validation pipeline for planetary surface perception systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了弱监督可遍历性估计模型如何在月球机器人背景下跨领域推广。由于带注释的月球数据集稀缺，因此必须根据地球数据对模型进行训练，并将其转移到视觉和物理特征显着不同的环境中。我们采用成对的弱监督学习框架，其中相对可遍历性注释提供了密集标记的轻量级替代方案，同时保留了地形评估的连续性。我们使用人类不一致率 (HDR) 指标，对涵盖合成模拟、陆地模拟、月球模拟设施和真实月球任务图像（嫦娥 3/4）的七个数据集进行了系统的跨领域评估。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文研究了弱监督可遍历性估计模型如何在月球机器人背景下跨领域推广。由于带注释的月球数据集稀缺，因此必须根据地球数据对模型进行训练，并将其转移到视觉和物理特征显着不同的环境中。我们采用成对的弱监督学习框架，其中相对可遍历性注释提供了密集标记的轻量级替代方案，同时保留了地形评估的连续性。我们使用人类不一致率 (HDR) 指标，对涵盖合成模拟、陆地模拟、月球模拟设施和真实月球任务图像（嫦娥 3/4）的七个数据集进行了系统的跨领域评估。我们的结果揭示了训练源的一致排名：月球模拟设施最可靠地传输到真实的月球图像，而与目标域的视觉和形态相似性证明比数据集真实性或域类别更能预测传输质量。值得注意的是，强大的域内性能并不能预测跨域泛化，暴露了空间分级感知系统标准评估协议的根本局限性。我们进一步表明，该排名在 HDR 阈值范围内是稳定的，并且引入有限的目标域数据单调地提高了传输性能，同时保留了初始源排名。总体而言，这项研究为月球可穿越性应用中的训练数据选择提供了经验基础，并主张将跨域评估作为行星表面感知系统验证和验证管道的标准组成部分。

articles.title: Observation of gapped Dirac magnons in a Co bilayer grown on Ru(0001)
articles.title_zh: 在Ru (0001)上生长的Co双层中间隙狄拉克磁控子的观察
articles.abstract: Author(s): Khalil Zakeri, Arthur Ernst, and Christopher Hins Long celebrated in graphene, Dirac physics inspires the search for similar phenomena in magnonic systems. Here, the authors experimentally demonstrate that magnons in an epitaxial Co bilayer on Ru(0001) exhibit Dirac properties near the Brillouin zone corner. Remarkably, the substrate does not destroy the essential physics; despite breaking sublattice symmetry and opening a gap, local valley topology remains intact. Beyond opening possibilities for discovering Dirac magnons in other ultrathin 3 d magnetic films, these findings hold promise for on-chip magnonic applications. [Phys. Rev. B 114, L200405] Published Tue Oct 27, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 作者： Khalil Zakeri ， Arthur Ernst和Christopher Hins Long在石墨烯中庆祝，狄拉克物理学激发了在强子系统中寻找类似现象的灵感。在这里，作者通过实验表明， Ru （ 0001 ）上的外延Co双层中的磁子在布里渊区角附近表现出狄拉克性质。值得注意的是，基板不会破坏基本的物理特性；尽管打破了亚晶格对称性并开辟了缝隙，但局部谷拓扑仍然完好无损。除了在其他超薄3d磁性薄膜中发现狄拉克磁子之外，这些发现还为片上磁子应用带来了希望。

articles.abstract: Nature Chemistry, Published online: 27 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41557-026-02273-9 The isolation of oxoboranes featuring a genuine B–O triple bond is challenging owing to the instability of the B≡O linkage. articles.title: On the Doppler Effect in Static Materials: Vortices and Black, White and Worm-Hole Like Wave Trajectories

articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33141v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate the Doppler effect in a static material. The effect is achieved with a network of thin waveguides whose lengths depend on the direction of travel, chosen to simulate the compression and expansion of the wave experienced by a source travelling with velocity v. Each edge of length ell becomes a pair of waveguides of lengths ell/(1mp v/c), one for each direction of travel. On a lattice this gives the field pattern of a moving source. To demonstrate the effect, we design a vortex, an analogue black hole and wormhole.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们在静态材料中演示了多普勒效应。使用长度取决于行进方向的薄波导网络来实现该效果，选择该网络来模拟以速度v行进的源所经历的波的压缩和扩展。长度ell的每条边变成长度ell/(1mp v/c)的一对波导，每个行进方向一个。在网格上，这给出了移动源的场图案。为了证明这种效果，我们设计了一个涡旋、一个模拟黑洞和虫洞。

articles.title: Cooperation of itinerant and localized physics in the magnetic phase diagram of 214 Ruddlesden-Popper iridates
articles.title_zh: 214 Ruddlesden-Popper虹膜磁相图中流动和局部物理学的合作
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33196v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The 5d⁵ Ruddlesden-Popper iridates Sr₂IrO₄ and Ba₂IrO₄ have attracted considerable attention as spin-orbit entangled analogues of the cuprates, yet the origin of their antiferromagnetic insulating state, of Slater or of Mott-Heisenberg type, remains debated. We find that both materials sit in an intermediate regime in which itinerant and localized electrons cooperate in stabilizing the antiferromagnetic order, with Ba₂IrO₄ slightly more correlated than Sr₂IrO₄. We obtain this by computing, within dynamical mean-field theory, the interaction-temperature phase diagram of a realistic three-orbital t₂g Hubbard model with spin-orbit coupling. Our study shows that neither the behavior of the gap across the Néel temperature nor the spin-polaron features of the spectral function unambiguously identify the cooperative regime, whereas the two-peak structure of the optical conductivity is reproduced only there and therefore constitutes a reliable fingerprint. By placing both compounds in a common phase diagram, our results reconcile seemingly contradictory experimental and theoretical reports, and provide a unified framework for future studies of the 214 iridates and of other spin-orbit coupled correlated materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 作为铜酸盐的自旋轨道纠缠类似物， Ruddlesden-Popper虹膜Sr ₂ IrO和Ba ₂ IrO引起了广泛的关注，但它们的反铁磁绝缘状态，即Slater或Mott-Heisenberg类型的起源仍然存在争议。我们发现，两种材料都处于一种中间状态，其中流动电子和局部电子在稳定反铁磁秩序方面进行合作， Ba ₂ IrO ”的相关性略高于Sr ₂ IrO”。我们通过在动态平均场理论中计算具有自旋-轨道耦合的现实三轨道t ₂ g哈伯德模型的相互作用-温度相图来获得这一点。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 作为铜酸盐的自旋轨道纠缠类似物， Ruddlesden-Popper虹膜Sr ₂ IrO和Ba ₂ IrO引起了广泛的关注，但它们的反铁磁绝缘状态，即Slater或Mott-Heisenberg类型的起源仍然存在争议。我们发现，两种材料都处于一种中间状态，其中流动电子和局部电子在稳定反铁磁秩序方面进行合作， Ba ₂ IrO ”的相关性略高于Sr ₂ IrO”。我们通过在动态平均场理论中计算具有自旋-轨道耦合的现实三轨道t ₂ g哈伯德模型的相互作用-温度相图来获得这一点。我们的研究表明，无论是跨Néel温度的间隙行为还是光谱函数的自旋-极化子特征，都不能明确地识别合作机制，而光导率的双峰结构仅在那里再现，因此构成了可靠的指纹。通过将两种化合物放在一个共同的相图中，我们的结果调和了看似矛盾的实验和理论报告，并为未来对214种虹膜酸盐和其他自旋轨道耦合相关材料的研究提供了一个统一的框架。

articles.title: Orbital Hall response of spin-1 fermions with a curved central band
articles.title_zh: 具有弯曲中心带的自旋-1费米子的轨道霍尔响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33211v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the orbital Hall effect in a three-band system described by a low-energy Hamiltonian containing both linear and quadratic momentum-dependent contributions. The linear term lifts the degeneracy between the dispersive bands, providing a minimal setting to study orbital transport in a multiband system with a curved central band. Within a quantum kinetic approach, we derive the intrinsic orbital Hall response and analyze its microscopic origin in terms of interband coherence induced by an external electric field. We show that the orbital Hall conductivity arises from the interplay between the momentum-dependent orbital character of the eigenstates and transitions between different bands. The spin-1 structure provides a particularly transparent platform in which the contributions associated with different interband channels can be identified separately. We further show that the differential orbital Hall response provides a direct probe of the low-energy structure, exhibiting distinct scaling singularities associated with the linear and quadratic bands, respectively, while remaining independent of the ultraviolet cutoff. Our results establish a connection between the multiband quantum geometry of spin-1 fermions and their transverse orbital response, and provide a simple framework for investigating orbital transport beyond two-band models.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了由低能量哈密顿量描述的三波段系统中的轨道霍尔效应，该低能量哈密顿量同时包含线性和二次动量相关的贡献。线性项提升了色散带之间的退化，为研究具有弯曲中心带的多频带系统中的轨道传输提供了最小的设置。在量子动力学方法中，我们推导出内在轨道霍尔响应，并根据外部电场引起的带间相干性分析其微观起源。我们表明，轨道霍尔电导率源于本征态的动量依赖轨道特性与不同波段之间的跃迁之间的相互作用。自旋-1结构提供了一个特别透明的平台，其中可以单独识别与不同带间信道相关联的贡献。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了由低能量哈密顿量描述的三波段系统中的轨道霍尔效应，该低能量哈密顿量同时包含线性和二次动量相关的贡献。线性项提升了色散带之间的退化，为研究具有弯曲中心带的多频带系统中的轨道传输提供了最小的设置。在量子动力学方法中，我们推导出内在轨道霍尔响应，并根据外部电场引起的带间相干性分析其微观起源。我们表明，轨道霍尔电导率源于本征态的动量依赖轨道特性与不同波段之间的跃迁之间的相互作用。自旋-1结构提供了一个特别透明的平台，其中可以单独识别与不同带间信道相关联的贡献。我们进一步表明，微分轨道霍尔响应提供了对低能结构的直接探测，分别表现出与线性和二次带相关的明显缩放奇点，同时保持独立于紫外线截止。我们的结果建立了自旋-1费米子的多频带量子几何与其横向轨道响应之间的联系，并为研究超出双频带模型的轨道运输提供了一个简单的框架。

articles.title: Winding-Controlled Topological Descendants of Antialtermagnets
articles.title_zh: 反终磁体绕组控制拓扑后代
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33252v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Odd-parity spin splitting constrains magnetic band crossings but does not determine their topological descendants. We show that the Chern contribution of an isolated inverted sector is controlled by the phase winding of its transverse mass pair: when the masses and tangential velocities reverse together, contributions from successive Dirac points add rather than cancel. This distinguishes topological winding from the polynomial degree labeling the magnetic parent. For specified complementary masses, periodic tetragonal h- and hexagonal j-wave models host eight and twelve same-chirality Weyl points on a momentum plane, with gapped-slice Chern numbers |C|=4 and 6, respectively. A microscopic four-band p-wave model identifies an antiunitary obstruction to first-order transverse masses and demonstrates a symmetry-broken C=1 phase at quarter filling. First-principles calculations for the proposed coplanar spin-vortex texture of LaMnAu₅ reveal the h-wave nodal pattern, its anisotropic spin--orbit reconstruction, and a mirror-channel spectral response that reverses under opposite spin rotations. Together, these results distinguish the symmetry of an odd-parity magnetic parent from the mass structure controlling the topology of its descendants.
articles.abstract_zh: 奇偶性自旋分裂限制了磁带交叉，但不确定其拓扑后代。我们表明，孤立倒置扇区的Chern贡献由其横向质量对的相位绕组控制：当质量和切向速度一起反转时，连续狄拉克点的贡献增加而不是抵消。这区分了拓扑绕组与标记磁母体的多项式次数。对于指定的互补质量，周期四边形h波和六边形j波模型在动量平面上分别具有8个和12个相同手性Weyl点，间隙层Chern数| C | = 4和6。微观四波段p波模型识别一阶横向肿块的抗单位阻塞，并显示四分之一填充时的对称断裂C = 1相。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 奇偶性自旋分裂限制了磁带交叉，但不确定其拓扑后代。我们表明，孤立倒置扇区的Chern贡献由其横向质量对的相位绕组控制：当质量和切向速度一起反转时，连续狄拉克点的贡献增加而不是抵消。这区分了拓扑绕组与标记磁母体的多项式次数。对于指定的互补质量，周期四边形h波和六边形j波模型在动量平面上分别具有8个和12个相同手性Weyl点，间隙层Chern数| C | = 4和6。微观四波段p波模型识别一阶横向肿块的抗单位阻塞，并显示四分之一填充时的对称断裂C = 1相。提出的LaMnAu共面自旋涡纹理的第一原理计算揭示了h波节点模式、其各向异性自旋轨道重建以及在相反自旋旋转下反转的镜像通道光谱响应。这些结果共同将奇偶校验磁性母体的对称性与控制其后代拓扑的质量结构区分开来。

articles.title: Unified First-Principles Theory of Finite-Wave-Vector Photocurrents in Crystals
articles.title_zh: 晶体中有限波矢量光电流的统一第一原理理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33264v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spatially structured light carries independent phase and envelope variations in addition to its polarization and frequency. We develop a first-principles theory of second-order dc photocurrents (especially shift and injection) that resolves how these optical degrees of freedom drive distinct dc responses in crystals. The second-order dc response couples two optical field components at the same frequency but with generally different wave vectors. Expanding the response to first order in these wave vectors identifies two rank-four material tensors: ξ, which couples to the optical phase gradient and contains the plane-wave photon-drag limit, and ζ, which couples to the intensity gradient and describes a spatially varying dc current. Wannier-interpolated calculations for monolayer GeS show symmetry-allowed finite-wave-vector responses that survive at a centrosymmetric structure where conventional bulk photovoltaic effect vanishes. For a Gaussian beam with a uniform phase gradient, the phase-gradient contribution drives current in the same direction on both sides of the beam center, whereas the intensity-gradient contribution drives currents in opposite directions, showing that distinct photocurrent patterns can be selected through the wavefront and envelope of light. A multipolar analysis further resolves the optical corrections into electric-quadrupole, orbital magnetic-dipole, and band-dispersion contributions. Together, these results show how the spatial structure of light can serve as an independent control variable for nonlinear photocurrent generation and provide a first-principles route to predict this response in real materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 空间结构光除了其偏振和频率外，还具有独立的相位和包络变化。我们开发了一个二阶直流光电流（特别是移位和注入）的第一原理理论，该理论解决了这些光学自由度如何驱动晶体中不同的直流响应。二阶直流响应以相同的频率耦合两个光场分量，但通常具有不同的波矢量。在这些波矢量中扩展对一级的响应可以识别出两个等级为四的材料张量：与光学相位梯度耦合并包含平面波光子阻力极限的钚，以及与强度梯度耦合并描述空间变化的直流电流的ζ。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 空间结构光除了其偏振和频率外，还具有独立的相位和包络变化。我们开发了一个二阶直流光电流（特别是移位和注入）的第一原理理论，该理论解决了这些光学自由度如何驱动晶体中不同的直流响应。二阶直流响应以相同的频率耦合两个光场分量，但通常具有不同的波矢量。在这些波矢量中扩展对一级的响应可以识别出两个等级为四的材料张量：与光学相位梯度耦合并包含平面波光子阻力极限的钚，以及与强度梯度耦合并描述空间变化的直流电流的ζ。单层GeS的Wannier插值计算显示，对称允许的有限波矢量响应在传统的体积光伏效应消失的中心对称结构下存活。对于具有均匀相位梯度的高斯光束，相位梯度贡献驱动光束中心两侧相同方向的电流，而强度梯度贡献驱动相反方向的电流，表明可以通过光的波前和包络选择不同的光电流模式。多极分析进一步将光学校正分解为电四极子、轨道磁偶极子和带色散贡献。这些结果共同展示了光的空间结构如何作为非线性光电流产生的独立控制变量，并提供了一条在实际材料中预测这种响应的第一原理路线。

articles.title: Exploring Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures for Self-Supervised Representation Learning of Powder X-ray Diffraction Patterns
articles.title_zh: 探索用于粉末X射线衍射图案自监督表示学习的联合嵌入式预测架构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33310v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Powder X-ray diffraction (XRD) is the primary high-throughput method for resolving crystal structures, a cornerstone of materials science. As high-throughput synthesis and self-driving laboratories advance, automated XRD pattern analysis has become vital for accelerating materials discovery. However, traditional matrix factorization methods fail when lattice variations cause non-linear peak shifts. At the same time, supervised learning approaches face a combinatorial explosion when handling multi-phase mixtures. To overcome these challenges, we adopt a self-supervised Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) to learn representation embeddings from 1D diffraction patterns. By optimizing a masked self-prediction loss directly within the latent space, the framework captures high-level crystallographic semantics. Downstream evaluations show that lightweight attentive probes trained on frozen JEPA representations achieve space group classification and lattice parameter estimation accuracy close to much larger supervised vision transformers. Furthermore, latent probing reveals that the learned representation space naturally organizes physical transformations, isolating smooth trajectories for peak broadening. Interestingly, decoding along latent paths between single-phase crystal representations yields realistic multi-phase mixture patterns, demonstrating an emergent continuous structure learned without explicit multi-phase supervision.
articles.abstract_zh: 粉末X射线衍射（ XRD ）是解析晶体结构的主要高通量方法，是材料科学的基石。随着高通量合成和自动驾驶实验室的进步，自动化XRD模式分析已成为加速材料发现的关键。然而，当晶格变化导致非线性峰值偏移时，传统的矩阵分解方法失败。同时，监督学习方法在处理多相混合时面临组合爆炸。为了克服这些挑战，我们采用自我监督的联合嵌入预测架构（ JEPA ） ，从一维衍射图案中学习表示嵌入。通过直接在潜在空间内优化掩蔽自预测损失，该框架捕获了高级晶体语义。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 粉末X射线衍射（ XRD ）是解析晶体结构的主要高通量方法，是材料科学的基石。随着高通量合成和自动驾驶实验室的进步，自动化XRD模式分析已成为加速材料发现的关键。然而，当晶格变化导致非线性峰值偏移时，传统的矩阵分解方法失败。同时，监督学习方法在处理多相混合时面临组合爆炸。为了克服这些挑战，我们采用自我监督的联合嵌入预测架构（ JEPA ） ，从一维衍射图案中学习表示嵌入。通过直接在潜在空间内优化掩蔽自预测损失，该框架捕获了高级晶体语义。下游评估表明，在冷冻JEPA表示上训练的轻量级专注探针实现了接近更大的监督视觉变换器的空间组分类和晶格参数估计精度。此外，潜探测显示，学习的表示空间自然地组织物理变换，隔离平滑轨迹以进行峰值扩展。有趣的是，单相晶体表征之间沿着潜在路径的解码产生了逼真的多相混合模式，展示了在没有明确多相监督的情况下学习到的新出现的连续结构。

articles.title: OpenFerro: a unified framework for mesoscale ferroic dynamics and enhanced sampling
articles.title_zh: OpenFerro ：中尺度铁系动力学和增强采样的统一框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33335v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Modeling ferroic materials requires connecting microscopic fluctuations to collective dynamics over mesoscales. We introduce OpenFerro, a unified lattice-field dynamics framework that combines flexible Hamiltonians, automatic differentiation, parallel execution, and enhanced sampling. The same framework can simulate ferroelectric domain motion, magnetic disordering, and coupled spin-lattice thermodynamics. On four graphics processors, a bulk BaTiO₃ benchmark with long-range dipolar interaction reaches 840³ unit cells, representing 3 billion atoms through the retained lattice variables. We simulate polarization textures in a PbTiO₃/SrTiO₃ superlattice spanning 0.8~mum laterally and a BaTiO₃ nanoparticle 200~nm in diameter, retaining unit-cell resolution. We also demonstrate enhanced-sampling simulations that reconstruct the polarization free-energy surface of bulk BaTiO₃ without a prescribed polynomial form. With moderate computational resources, OpenFerro achieves atomistic-resolution simulations at mesoscopic scales traditionally studied with continuum models.
articles.abstract_zh: 建模铁系材料需要将微观波动与中尺度上的集体动力学联系起来。我们引入了OpenFerro ，这是一个统一的格场动力学框架，结合了灵活的哈密顿函数、自动微分、并行执行和增强的采样。相同的框架可以模拟铁电畴运动、磁无序和耦合自旋晶格热力学。在四个图形处理器上，具有远程双极性相互作用的批量BaTiO基准达到840 ³个单位单元，通过保留的晶格变量表示30亿个原子。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 建模铁系材料需要将微观波动与中尺度上的集体动力学联系起来。我们引入了OpenFerro ，这是一个统一的格场动力学框架，结合了灵活的哈密顿函数、自动微分、并行执行和增强的采样。相同的框架可以模拟铁电畴运动、磁无序和耦合自旋晶格热力学。在四个图形处理器上，具有远程双极性相互作用的批量BaTiO基准达到840 ³个单位单元，通过保留的晶格变量表示30亿个原子。我们模拟了横向跨度为0.8~mum的PbTiO/SrTiO超晶格和直径为200 ~ nm的BaTiO纳米颗粒的极化纹理，保持了单元格分辨率。我们还演示了增强采样模拟，该模拟在没有规定多项式形式的情况下重建本体BaTiO的极化自由能表面。凭借适度的计算资源， OpenFerro在传统上用连续统模型研究的介观尺度上实现了原子分辨率模拟。

articles.title: Charge state and hydration of vacancies in silicon and silicon carbide in contact with water: A grand-canonical first-principles stability map
articles.title_zh: 与水接触的碳化硅和碳化硅中空位的电荷状态和水合：一个宏观经济的第一原理稳定性图
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33469v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The state of a vacancy in a semiconductor is normally described by the Fermi level alone. In wet-etched, electrochemically processed, or humid silicon and silicon carbide, a vacancy also takes up hydrogen and oxygen from water, in amounts set by pH and electrode potential. We treat both effects together by minimizing the grand potential of a vacancy complex over its charge state and hydrogen/oxygen content. The result is a stability map in Fermi level and hydrogen chemical potential, which the computational hydrogen electrode relates to pH and potential. We parameterize it with spin-polarized density functional theory in 64-atom cells, including the vibrational free energy of bound H and O, for the silicon vacancy, its H, O, and OH complexes, and both vacancies of 3C-SiC. Hydrogen binds cooperatively to the silicon vacancy, which goes directly from bare to fully passivated VH₄. In contact with water the bare vacancy is never the lowest-energy state. Near neutral pH it binds oxygen from water as the A center, the paramagnetic hydroxyl complex forms below about pH 5 at zero bias, and full passivation to VH₄ requires cathodic bias. In PBE the Fermi level barely moves these boundaries, because the acceptor levels lie at or above the conduction-band edge. In SiC the first hydrogen binds to the silicon vacancy by 1.97 eV but is unbound at the carbon vacancy (the Z₁/₂ center), so hydrogen from water alone should not passivate it except under cathodic bias.
articles.abstract_zh: 半导体中空位的状态通常仅由费米能级描述。在湿法蚀刻、电化学处理或潮湿的硅和碳化硅中，空位也会从水中吸收氢和氧，其量由pH和电极电位设定。我们通过最小化空位复合物在其电荷状态和氢/氧含量上的巨大潜力来共同对待这两种效应。结果是费米能级和氢化学势的稳定图，计算氢电极与pH和电势有关。我们用64个原子单元的自旋极化密度泛函理论将其参数化，包括结合H和O的振动自由能、硅空位、其H、O和OH络合物以及3C-SiC的两个空位。氢气与硅空位协同结合，直接从裸露到完全钝化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 半导体中空位的状态通常仅由费米能级描述。在湿法蚀刻、电化学处理或潮湿的硅和碳化硅中，空位也会从水中吸收氢和氧，其量由pH和电极电位设定。我们通过最小化空位复合物在其电荷状态和氢/氧含量上的巨大潜力来共同对待这两种效应。结果是费米能级和氢化学势的稳定图，计算氢电极与pH和电势有关。我们用64个原子单元的自旋极化密度泛函理论将其参数化，包括结合H和O的振动自由能、硅空位、其H、O和OH络合物以及3C-SiC的两个空位。氢气与硅空位协同结合，直接从裸露到完全钝化。与水接触时，裸露的空位从来都不是最低能量的状态。在接近中性pH的情况下，它将水中的氧结合为A中心，顺磁性羟基络合物在零偏压下在pH 5以下形成，并且完全钝化到VH需要阴极偏压。在PBE中，费米能级几乎不会移动这些边界，因为受体能级位于或高于传导带边缘。在碳化硅中，第一个氢气与硅空位结合1.97 eV ，但在碳空位（ Z/₂中心）处不受束缚，因此除非在阴极偏置下，否则仅来自水的氢气不应钝化它。

articles.title: Large spin large deviations for interacting particle systems
articles.title_zh: 相互作用粒子系统的大自旋大偏差
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33523v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a novel framework for analyzing the sample-path large deviations of interacting particle systems directly on a lattice by considering a large-spin limit (s → infty). Through an appropriate scaling of variables, the process concentrates around its deterministic trajectory, governed by the lattice diffusion equation. We quantify the exponential cost of observing atypical trajectories by explicitly computing the path-space large deviation rate function from the scaled microscopic generator, based on a theory due to Feng and Kurtz. The rate function is described in terms of a Hamiltonian on a lattice in terms of classical spin variables. Notably, for our main model, the symmetric harmonic process, the corresponding Hamiltonian is identified with the classical integrable non-compact Ishimori spin chain. Furthermore, we show that our large spin large deviation theory is fully consistent with traditional Macroscopic Fluctuation Theory (MFT), smoothly recovering the standard MFT Hamiltonian in the spatial continuous limit. We also perform a Poisson-noise Martin--Siggia--Rose (MSR) computation to derive the non-linear lattice Hamiltonian directly from microscopic dynamics, use a relative entropy argument to obtain the density-current action, and establish the lattice fluctuation theorem alongside its symmetry origin. Overall, our framework provides a naturally regularized, lattice analogue of MFT that circumvents spatial ultraviolet singularities and possible continuous density blow-ups. We also apply our new scheme to partial symmetric exclusion process, symmetric inclusion processes, Brownian energy process and integrable heat conduction model, showing how their large-deviation Hamiltonians relate to classical compact and non-compact spin chains.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新颖的框架，通过考虑大自旋极限（s→infty）来直接分析晶格上相互作用的粒子系统的样本路径大偏差。通过适当调整变量，该过程集中在由晶格扩散方程控制的确定性轨迹上。基于 Feng 和 Kurtz 的理论，我们通过显式计算缩放微观发生器的路径空间大偏差率函数来量化观察非典型轨迹的指数成本。速率函数用经典自旋变量的晶格上的哈密顿量来描述。值得注意的是，对于我们的主要模型，对称调和过程，相应的哈密顿量用经典的可积非紧 Ishimori 自旋链来识别。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种新颖的框架，通过考虑大自旋极限（s→infty）来直接分析晶格上相互作用的粒子系统的样本路径大偏差。通过适当调整变量，该过程集中在由晶格扩散方程控制的确定性轨迹上。基于 Feng 和 Kurtz 的理论，我们通过显式计算缩放微观发生器的路径空间大偏差率函数来量化观察非典型轨迹的指数成本。速率函数用经典自旋变量的晶格上的哈密顿量来描述。值得注意的是，对于我们的主要模型，对称调和过程，相应的哈密顿量用经典的可积非紧 Ishimori 自旋链来识别。此外，我们表明我们的大自旋大偏差理论与传统的宏观涨落理论（MFT）完全一致，在空间连续极限下平滑地恢复标准MFT哈密顿量。我们还执行泊松噪声 Martin-Siggia-Rose (MSR) 计算，直接从微观动力学导出非线性晶格哈密顿量，使用相对熵论证来获得密度-电流作用，并沿着其对称性原点建立晶格涨落定理。总体而言，我们的框架提供了一种自然正则化的 MFT 晶格模拟，可以规避空间紫外线奇点和可能的连续密度爆炸。我们还将我们的新方案应用于部分对称排斥过程、对称包含过程、布朗能量过程和可积热传导模型，展示了它们的大偏差哈密顿量与经典紧致和非紧自旋链的关系。

articles.title: First-order magnetostructural transition in Ni-Mn-Sn powder - A matter of particle and grain size
articles.title_zh: Ni-Mn-Sn 粉末中的一阶磁结构转变 - 颗粒和晶粒尺寸的问题
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33556v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In Ni-Mn-based Heusler alloys, the magnetocaloric effect originates from a first-order magnetostructural transition (FOMST). However, the influence of particle and grain size on thermal hysteresis, transition width, and nucleation and growth mechanism remains poorly understood, as mechanical grinding can introduce residual stresses and processing-induced defects. In this study, we examined the size dependence of the FOMST in gas-atomized Ni-Mn-Sn powder by combining microstructural characterization with temperature-dependent XRD, magnetometry, calorimetry and single-particle measurements, enabling decoupling of size dependence from processing-related influences. We observed a pronounced size dependence of the transition ranges (Ms-Mf) and (Af-As), which decrease with decreasing particle size and approach zero for single-crystalline particles below ~20-30 micrometer. The thermal hysteresis decreases with increasing particle size, reaching a lower limit of 17 K for large polycrystalline particles above 100 micrometer. EBSD reveals a nearly constant grain size, implying a transition from polycrystalline to single-crystalline particles as particle size decreases. In polycrystalline particles, multiple grains transform gradually over an extended temperature interval because grain boundaries act as barriers to the progression of transformation. In contrast, single-grain particles lack preferred nucleation sites, resulting in larger hysteresis, while the absence of barriers to transformation propagation causes the entire particle to transform in a narrow range. These results demonstrate that the size dependence of the FOMST is governed by the interplay between particle size, grain boundaries, and the free particle surface.
articles.abstract_zh: 在 Ni-Mn 基 Heusler 合金中，磁热效应源自一阶磁结构转变 (FOMST)。然而，颗粒和晶粒尺寸对热滞后、过渡宽度以及成核和生长机制的影响仍然知之甚少，因为机械研磨会引入残余应力和加工引起的缺陷。在这项研究中，我们通过将微观结构表征与温度相关的 XRD、磁力测定、量热法和单颗粒测量相结合，研究了气雾化 Ni-Mn-Sn 粉末中 FOMST 的尺寸依赖性，从而能够将尺寸依赖性与加工相关的影响解耦。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在 Ni-Mn 基 Heusler 合金中，磁热效应源自一阶磁结构转变 (FOMST)。然而，颗粒和晶粒尺寸对热滞后、过渡宽度以及成核和生长机制的影响仍然知之甚少，因为机械研磨会引入残余应力和加工引起的缺陷。在这项研究中，我们通过将微观结构表征与温度相关的 XRD、磁力测定、量热法和单颗粒测量相结合，研究了气雾化 Ni-Mn-Sn 粉末中 FOMST 的尺寸依赖性，从而能够将尺寸依赖性与加工相关的影响解耦。我们观察到过渡范围 (Ms-Mf) 和 (Af-As) 具有明显的尺寸依赖性，随着粒径的减小而减小，对于低于约 20-30 微米的单晶颗粒，过渡范围接近于零。热滞后随着颗粒尺寸的增加而减小，对于大于 100 微米的大多晶颗粒达到 17 K 的下限。 EBSD 显示出几乎恒定的晶粒尺寸，这意味着随着粒径的减小，从多晶颗粒转变为单晶颗粒。在多晶颗粒中，多个晶粒在较长的温度间隔内逐渐转变，因为晶界充当转变进展的障碍。相比之下，单晶颗粒缺乏优选的成核位点，导致较大的滞后，而缺乏相变传播的障碍导致整个颗粒在较窄的范围内相变。这些结果表明，FOMST 的尺寸依赖性受颗粒尺寸、晶界和自由颗粒表面之间相互作用的控制。

articles.title: Exact Magnetic Confinement of a Doped Hole by Kinetic Frustration
articles.title_zh: 通过动力学抑制对掺杂空穴进行精确磁约束
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33585v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We establish an exact mechanism of magnetic confinement driven purely by kinetic frustration. In a finite open sawtooth U=infty Hubbard chain of L unit cells doped with one hole, the ground state at magnetization M contains M polarized triplet dimers surrounding a connected singlet region of length ellᵣₘ ₛ=L-M. A magnetic field selects M and hence the confinement length. The hole forms a standing wave in the singlet region with exponential tails in the triplet background. Confinement requires neither disorder nor an exchange-generated string tension: destructive interference between direct and apex-mediated hopping makes the triplet bonds reflecting. At t₂/t₁=[2+4cos(π/(ellᵣₘ ₛ+2))]⁻¹/², they become perfectly reflecting, producing a position-degenerate compact localized state. At every fixed field 0

articles.title: Co layer Thickness Driven Structural Evolution and Magnetic Behaviour of Co/Ir/Co Trilayers
articles.title_zh: Co层厚度驱动的Co/Ir/Co三层结构演化和磁性行为
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33595v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ferromagnetic heavy-metal (FM/HM) trilayer heterostructures provide a versatile platform for investigating the interplay between structural and magnetic properties. In this study, we investigate the effect of Co-layer thickness on the structural and magnetic properties of sputter-deposited Co(tCₒ)/Ir(5,nm)/Co(tCₒ) varying from 2 to 10 nm. Structural characterization using grazing-incidence X-ray diffraction (GIXRD) and high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM) reveals a nanocrystalline structure, with the crystallite size increasing with Co-layer thickness. Furthermore, X-ray reflectivity (XRR) reveals a thickness-dependent variation in interface morphology, with the interface roughness ratio reaching a maximum at tCₒ = 4 nm. Temperature-dependent zero-field-cooled and field-cooled (ZFC-FC) magnetization measurements reveal thickness-dependent characteristic temperatures and multiple relaxation regimes in selected samples, indicating complex thermally activated magnetic behaviour. In contrast, field-dependent hysteresis measurements reveal that the saturation magnetization increases with Co-layer thickness, whereas the coercivity exhibits a pronounced non-monotonic variation, with enhanced values at intermediate thicknesses. Moreover, low-temperature hysteresis loops display thickness-dependent exchange-bias-like shifts, particularly for tCₒ = 2-4 nm. These findings highlight the strong influence of Co-layer thickness on the structural and magnetic properties of Co/Ir/Co trilayers.
articles.abstract_zh: 铁磁重金属 (FM/HM) 三层异质结构为研究结构和磁性之间的相互作用提供了一个多功能平台。在本研究中，我们研究了 Co 层厚度对溅射沉积 Co(tCₒ)/Ir(5,nm)/Co(tCₒ) 结构和磁性能的影响，厚度范围为 2 至 10 nm。使用掠入射 X 射线衍射 (GIXRD) 和高分辨率透射电子显微镜 (HRTEM) 进行的结构表征揭示了纳米晶体结构，微晶尺寸随着 Co 层厚度的增加而增加。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 铁磁重金属 (FM/HM) 三层异质结构为研究结构和磁性之间的相互作用提供了一个多功能平台。在本研究中，我们研究了 Co 层厚度对溅射沉积 Co(tCₒ)/Ir(5,nm)/Co(tCₒ) 结构和磁性能的影响，厚度范围为 2 至 10 nm。使用掠入射 X 射线衍射 (GIXRD) 和高分辨率透射电子显微镜 (HRTEM) 进行的结构表征揭示了纳米晶体结构，微晶尺寸随着 Co 层厚度的增加而增加。此外，X 射线反射率 (XRR) 揭示了界面形态随厚度的变化，界面粗糙度比在 tCₒ = 4 nm 时达到最大值。温度相关的零场冷却和场冷却 (ZFC-FC) 磁化测量揭示了所选样品中厚度相关的特征温度和多个弛豫状态，表明复杂的热激活磁行为。相反，场相关磁滞测量表明，饱和磁化强度随着Co层厚度的增加而增加，而矫顽力表现出明显的非单调变化，在中间厚度处值增强。此外，低温磁滞回线显示出与厚度相关的交换偏置样变化，特别是在 tCₒ = 2-4 nm 时。这些发现强调了Co层厚度对Co/Ir/Co三层结构和磁性能的强烈影响。

articles.title: Second-Harmonic Bulk Response of Fractional Quantum Hall Fluids
articles.title_zh: 分数量子霍尔流体的二次谐波体响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33606v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a bulk description for the second-harmonic Hall response of fractional quantum Hall fluids with broken inversion and rotational symmetries, distinct from edge theories based on nonlinear edge-mode dispersion. By projecting a tilted massive Dirac model onto a single low-energy band, we construct a composite-boson Chern--Simons theory for the lowest Landau level that retains projection-induced nonlinear electromagnetic couplings. The nonlinear Hall resistivity vanishes in the dc limit, while its finite-frequency response retains the characteristic filling-factor dependence ρ⁽²⁾TLLproptoν⁻², where ν is the Landau-level filling factor. At low frequency, its real and imaginary parts scale as (ω/ω_c)² and ω/ω_c, respectively, where ω_c is the cyclotron frequency, and the response is strongly anisotropic with respect to the crystalline tilt axis. Notably, the Kohn-mode resonances present in the second-order conductivity cancel in the nonlinear Hall resistivity. These results establish finite-frequency nonlinear transport as a bulk probe of fractional quantum Hall fluids without requiring nonlinear edge-mode dispersion.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们对具有破缺反转和旋转对称性的分数量子霍尔流体的二次谐波霍尔响应进行了整体描述，这与基于非线性边缘模式色散的边缘理论不同。通过将倾斜的大规模狄拉克模型投影到单个低能带上，我们构建了最低朗道能级的复合玻色子陈-西蒙斯理论，该理论保留了投影引起的非线性电磁耦合。非线性霍尔电阻率在直流极限下消失，而其有限频率响应保留了特征填充因子依赖性 ρ⁽²⁾TLLproptoν⁻²，其中 ν 是朗道级填充因子。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们对具有破缺反转和旋转对称性的分数量子霍尔流体的二次谐波霍尔响应进行了整体描述，这与基于非线性边缘模式色散的边缘理论不同。通过将倾斜的大规模狄拉克模型投影到单个低能带上，我们构建了最低朗道能级的复合玻色子陈-西蒙斯理论，该理论保留了投影引起的非线性电磁耦合。非线性霍尔电阻率在直流极限下消失，而其有限频率响应保留了特征填充因子依赖性 ρ⁽²⁾TLLproptoν⁻²，其中 ν 是朗道级填充因子。在低频下，其实部和虚部分别缩放为 (ω/ω_c)² 和 ω/ω_c，其中 ω_c 是回旋加速器频率，并且响应相对于晶体倾斜轴具有强烈的各向异性。值得注意的是，二阶电导率中存在的科恩模式谐振抵消了非线性霍尔电阻率。这些结果将有限频率非线性传输建立为分数量子霍尔流体的体探针，而不需要非线性边缘模式色散。

articles.title: Perpendicular Anisotropy and g-Factor of Sputtered Ni Films on Si(111) Studied by Angle-Dependent Ferromagnetic Resonance
articles.title_zh: 通过角度相关铁磁共振研究 Si(111) 上溅射 Ni 薄膜的垂直各向异性和 g 因子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33637v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ni films with thicknesses of 312 and 1011,Å{} were grown on Si(111) by dc magnetron sputtering at room temperature and studied by atomic force microscopy, grazing-incidence X-ray diffraction, X-ray reflectivity, magnetometry and angle-dependent ferromagnetic resonance. Both films are polycrystalline fcc Ni with smooth surfaces, a bulk-like (111) lattice spacing and a saturation magnetization of approx480,emu,cm⁻³, and both are magnetized in plane. The angular dependence of the resonance field, from the film plane to the film normal, is described by a uniaxial anisotropy model with first- and second-order terms. From this model, g = 2.160±0.005 and 2.101±0.014 and effective perpendicular anisotropies of (6.0±0.4)×10⁵ and (4.5±0.6)×10⁵,erg,cm⁻³ were obtained for the thinner and thicker film, respectively. The conventional analysis of only the in-plane and perpendicular resonances gives g-factors that are lower by 0.02--0.04. The perpendicular linewidths give upper limits for the Gilbert damping of α le 0.030 and le 0.038.
articles.abstract_zh: 在室温下通过直流磁控溅射在 Si(111) 上生长厚度为 312 和 1011,Å{} 的 Ni 薄膜，并通过原子力显微镜、掠入射 X 射线衍射、X 射线反射率、磁力测量和角度相关铁磁共振进行研究。两种薄膜均为多晶面心立方镍，具有光滑的表面、块状（111）晶格间距和约480,emu,cm³的饱和磁化强度，并且两者均在平面内磁化。从薄膜平面到薄膜法线的共振场的角度依赖性由具有一阶和二阶项的单轴各向异性模型描述。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在室温下通过直流磁控溅射在 Si(111) 上生长厚度为 312 和 1011,Å{} 的 Ni 薄膜，并通过原子力显微镜、掠入射 X 射线衍射、X 射线反射率、磁力测量和角度相关铁磁共振进行研究。两种薄膜均为多晶面心立方镍，具有光滑的表面、块状（111）晶格间距和约480,emu,cm³的饱和磁化强度，并且两者均在平面内磁化。从薄膜平面到薄膜法线的共振场的角度依赖性由具有一阶和二阶项的单轴各向异性模型描述。根据该模型，对于较薄的薄膜和较厚的薄膜，分别获得了 g = 2.160±0.005 和 2.101±0.014，有效垂直各向异性分别为 (6.0±0.4)×10⁵ 和 (4.5±0.6)×10⁵,erg,cm-3。仅对面内和垂直共振进行的常规分析给出的 g 因子低 0.02--0.04。垂直线宽给出了吉尔伯特阻尼的上限 α le 0.030 和 le 0.038。

articles.title: Effect of niobium doping on the local structure and oxidation state of Co atoms in SrTiO₃
articles.title_zh: 铌掺杂对SrTiO₃中Co原子局部结构和氧化态的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33680v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: XAFS spectroscopy combined with first-principles calculations are used to study SrTiO₃ samples simultaneously doped with cobalt and niobium. It is shown that additional doping of the samples with Nb donors results in a decrease in the oxidation state of cobalt atoms to +2, which is accompanied by an increase in the Co--O distance to the nearest oxygen atoms, in agreement with first-principles calculations. The impurity Co atoms are shown to occupy Ti sites and are on-center. The suppression of the oxygen-vacancy formation upon doping SrTiO₃(Co) with niobium was revealed. First-principles calculations indicate that the Coulomb interaction of ions with local electric fields generated by non-isoelectronic Nb impurities plays a decisive role in the local distortions of atomic positions observed around the cobalt atom in the unit cell. The possibility of controlling the magnetic moment of Co atoms by intentional change in the lattice parameter is demonstrated.
articles.abstract_zh: XAFS 光谱与第一原理计算相结合，用于研究同时掺杂钴和铌的 SrTiO₃ 样品。结果表明，用 Nb 供体对样品进行额外掺杂会导致钴原子的氧化态降低至 +2，同时 Co--O 与最近氧原子的距离增加，这与第一原理计算一致。杂质 Co 原子显示占据 Ti 位点并且位于中心。揭示了用铌掺杂 SrTiO3(Co) 可以抑制氧空位的形成。第一性原理计算表明，离子与非等电子铌杂质产生的局部电场的库仑相互作用对于在晶胞中钴原子周围观察到的原子位置的局部畸变起着决定性作用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: XAFS 光谱与第一原理计算相结合，用于研究同时掺杂钴和铌的 SrTiO₃ 样品。结果表明，用 Nb 供体对样品进行额外掺杂会导致钴原子的氧化态降低至 +2，同时 Co--O 与最近氧原子的距离增加，这与第一原理计算一致。杂质 Co 原子显示占据 Ti 位点并且位于中心。揭示了用铌掺杂 SrTiO3(Co) 可以抑制氧空位的形成。第一性原理计算表明，离子与非等电子铌杂质产生的局部电场的库仑相互作用对于在晶胞中钴原子周围观察到的原子位置的局部畸变起着决定性作用。证明了通过有意改变晶格参数来控制 Co 原子磁矩的可能性。

articles.title: Aging dynamics and generalized superposition principles in carbon black-carboxymethylcellulose hydrogels
articles.title_zh: 炭黑-羧甲基纤维素水凝胶的老化动力学和广义叠加原理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33682v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Aqueous dispersions of hydrophobic carbon black (CB) particles can be stabilized by carboxymethylcellulose (CMC), forming CB-CMC hydrogels whose microstructure is controlled by the relative CB-to-polymer content. At low CMC content, CB particles form a percolated, electrically conductive network, whereas at higher polymer content, CB particles act as isolated physical crosslinkers within an electrically insulating polymer matrix [see Legrand et al., Macromolecules 56, 2298-2308 (2023)]. Combining rheology and electrical impedance spectroscopy, we show that these two regimes exhibit markedly different aging dynamics. Conductive hydrogels exhibit logarithmic elastic recovery associated with a percolated CB network, whereas insulating hydrogels exhibit a combination of logarithmic and power-law stiffening, accompanied by dielectric polarization associated with confined ionic motion. The insulating hydrogels further exhibit a time-aging superposition principle, as their viscoelastic spectra measured in a time-resolved fashion can collapse onto a single master curve. Under steady shear, the viscoelastic response measured perpendicular to the flow also obeys a time--shear-rate superposition principle. Remarkably, the scaling between the shift factors under shear is reminiscent of critical-gel behavior, unlike that observed during aging at rest. Finally, time-resolved rheo-USAXS measurements performed during shear-rate cycles reveal structural rearrangements of CB particles and clusters that correlate with rheological hysteresis. These results provide a microstructural basis for understanding the nonlinear rheology of insulating CB-CMC hydrogels and establish generalized superposition principles as a unifying framework for their aging and flow behavior.
articles.abstract_zh: 疏水性炭黑 (CB) 颗粒的水分散体可以通过羧甲基纤维素 (CMC) 稳定，形成 CB-CMC 水凝胶，其微观结构由 CB 与聚合物的相对含量控制。在低 CMC 含量下，CB 颗粒形成渗透的导电网络，而在较高聚合物含量下，CB 颗粒在电绝缘聚合物基质内充当隔离的物理交联剂 [参见 Legrand 等人, Macromolecules 56, 2298-2308 (2023)]。结合流变学和电阻抗光谱，我们发现这两种状态表现出明显不同的老化动力学。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 疏水性炭黑 (CB) 颗粒的水分散体可以通过羧甲基纤维素 (CMC) 稳定，形成 CB-CMC 水凝胶，其微观结构由 CB 与聚合物的相对含量控制。在低 CMC 含量下，CB 颗粒形成渗透的导电网络，而在较高聚合物含量下，CB 颗粒在电绝缘聚合物基质内充当隔离的物理交联剂 [参见 Legrand 等人, Macromolecules 56, 2298-2308 (2023)]。结合流变学和电阻抗光谱，我们发现这两种状态表现出明显不同的老化动力学。导电水凝胶表现出与渗透CB网络相关的对数弹性恢复，而绝缘水凝胶则表现出对数和幂律硬化的组合，并伴有与受限离子运动相关的介电极化。绝缘水凝胶进一步表现出时间老化叠加原理，因为以时间分辨方式测量的它们的粘弹性光谱可以折叠到单个主曲线上。在稳定剪切下，垂直于流动测量的粘弹性响应也遵循时间剪切速率叠加原理。值得注意的是，剪切下位移因子之间的缩放让人想起临界凝胶行为，这与静息老化期间观察到的情况不同。最后，在剪切速率循环期间进行的时间分辨流变 USAXS 测量揭示了与流变滞后相关的 CB 颗粒和簇的结构重排。这些结果为理解绝缘 CB-CMC 水凝胶的非线性流变学提供了微观结构基础，并建立了广义叠加原理作为其老化和流动行为的统一框架。

articles.title: Scattering and Schmid-Bulgadaev Transition in Qubits Based on Josephson Junction Chains
articles.title_zh: 基于约瑟夫森连接链的量子位中的散射和施密德-布尔加达耶夫跃迁
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33814v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A Josephson junction subject to an ohmic dissipative environment undergoes a zero-temperature quantum phase transition called Schmid-Bulgadaev transition form an insulating state to a superconducting state upon increasing the impedance of the environment above the resistance quantum. Superconducting qubits based on Josephson junction chains represent a system where it is possible to dynamically explore both sides of this transition by probing the scattering of individual plasma modes of the junction chain on a SQUID at the boundary which was achieved in recent experiments. Here, we provide a theoretical analysis of the scattering in the system paying special attention to the non-perturbative superconducting regime. We find that in this regime, a specific diagrammatic resummation must be performed in order to correctly account for fluctuation renormalization of the SQUID's potential. We find analytic expressions for the modes' frequency shifts and quality factors which together provide a full description of scattering. We argue that the non-perturbative nature of the superconducting phase manifests itself through a power-law dependence of the frequency shifts on the SQUID flux and through non-monotonous dependence of the quality factors on the mode frequency. Our predictions may be readily verified in modern low-temperature experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 处于欧姆耗散环境的约瑟夫森结会经历称为施密德-布尔加达耶夫转变的零温度量子相变，当环境阻抗增加到电阻量子以上时，从绝缘态到超导态。基于约瑟夫森连接链的超导量子位代表了一个系统，在该系统中，可以通过探测边界处 SQUID 上连接链的各个等离子体模式的散射来动态探索这种转变的两侧，这是在最近的实验中实现的。在这里，我们对系统中的散射进行了理论分析，特别关注非微扰超导状态。我们发现，在这种情况下，必须执行特定的图解恢复，以便正确解释 SQUID 电势的波动重整化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 处于欧姆耗散环境的约瑟夫森结会经历称为施密德-布尔加达耶夫转变的零温度量子相变，当环境阻抗增加到电阻量子以上时，从绝缘态到超导态。基于约瑟夫森连接链的超导量子位代表了一个系统，在该系统中，可以通过探测边界处 SQUID 上连接链的各个等离子体模式的散射来动态探索这种转变的两侧，这是在最近的实验中实现的。在这里，我们对系统中的散射进行了理论分析，特别关注非微扰超导状态。我们发现，在这种情况下，必须执行特定的图解恢复，以便正确解释 SQUID 电势的波动重整化。我们找到了模式频移和品质因数的解析表达式，它们共同提供了散射的完整描述。我们认为，超导相的非微扰性质通过频移对 SQUID 通量的幂律依赖性以及品质因数对模式频率的非单调依赖性来体现。我们的预测很容易在现代低温实验中得到验证。

articles.title: Emergent parafermions with tunable localization in a quantum circuit network
articles.title_zh: 量子电路网络中具有可调谐定位的涌现参数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33815v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: noindent Quantum circuit simulators with hybrid metal-semiconductor dots provide a versatile platform to realize Kondo anyons. These arise at critical points driven by frustrated Kondo screening of dot charge degrees of freedom and have been demonstrated experimentally in linear circuits of one or two dots. Here we study a triangular triple dot device, where geometric frustration gives rise to an emergent Z₃ parafermion shared among the three dots. We show that the parafermion can be tunably relocated to any pair of dots by applying gate voltages, and is supported in both the weak-tunneling `Kondo limit' and the strong transmission `quasiballistic' regime. The critical states survive strong coupling to external leads and other dots, establishing the basis for a scalable and reconfigurable network architecture in which non-Abelian excitations can be realized and manipulated.
articles.abstract_zh: 具有混合金属-半导体点的 noindent 量子电路模拟器为实现近藤任意子提供了一个多功能平台。这些现象出现在点电荷自由度受挫的近藤屏蔽驱动的关键点上，并已在一两个点的线性电路中通过实验得到证明。在这里，我们研究了一个三角形三点装置，其中几何挫败产生了三个点之间共享的新兴 Z₃ 平副子。我们表明，通过施加栅极电压，平费米子可以可调地重新定位到任何一对点，并且在弱隧道“近藤极限”和强传输“准弹道”体系中得到支持。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 具有混合金属-半导体点的 noindent 量子电路模拟器为实现近藤任意子提供了一个多功能平台。这些现象出现在点电荷自由度受挫的近藤屏蔽驱动的关键点上，并已在一两个点的线性电路中通过实验得到证明。在这里，我们研究了一个三角形三点装置，其中几何挫败产生了三个点之间共享的新兴 Z₃ 平副子。我们表明，通过施加栅极电压，平费米子可以可调地重新定位到任何一对点，并且在弱隧道“近藤极限”和强传输“准弹道”体系中得到支持。临界状态能够承受与外部引线和其他点的强耦合，为可扩展和可重新配置的网络架构奠定了基础，在该架构中可以实现和操纵非阿贝尔激励。

articles.title: Annealing-atmosphere control of paramagnetic defects in ZnO microparticles
articles.title_zh: ZnO 微粒中顺磁性缺陷的退火气氛控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33870v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, we used temperature-dependent electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) spectroscopy to reveal the effect of high-temperature annealing in N2 and air on paramagnetic and electronic properties of ZnO microparticles. EPR spectral simulations have shown that N2 annealing produces Zni, VO+, and shallow-donor centers, whereas Zni, VO+, and Hi-related centers are observed after annealing the ZnO microparticles in an air atmosphere. The resolved paramagnetic centers exhibit distinctly different behavior over 5-297 K. The shallow-donor and Hi signals are rapidly quenched below approximately 50 K, while the Zni contribution shows a nonmonotonic temperature dependence. In contrast, the VO+ signal persists up to room temperature and increases with temperature, consistent with charge redistribution among donor-related defects involving deep oxygen-vacancy states. The cavity Q-factor generally decreases with increasing temperature for both annealed samples, indicating atmosphere-dependent changes in the microwave losses. These results show that the annealing atmosphere controls the paramagnetic defect population, the temperature dependence of donor-related centers, and the associated electronic response of ZnO microparticles.
articles.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们使用温度依赖性电子顺磁共振（EPR）光谱来揭示氮气和空气中的高温退火对ZnO微粒的顺磁和电子性质的影响。 EPR光谱模拟表明，N2退火产生Zn、VO+和浅施主中心，而ZnO微粒在空气气氛中退火后观察到Zn、VO+和Hi相关中心。解析的顺磁中心在 5-297 K 范围内表现出明显不同的行为。浅施主和 Hi 信号在大约 50 K 以下迅速淬灭，而 Zni 贡献显示出非单调温度依赖性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这项工作中，我们使用温度依赖性电子顺磁共振（EPR）光谱来揭示氮气和空气中的高温退火对ZnO微粒的顺磁和电子性质的影响。 EPR光谱模拟表明，N2退火产生Zn、VO+和浅施主中心，而ZnO微粒在空气气氛中退火后观察到Zn、VO+和Hi相关中心。解析的顺磁中心在 5-297 K 范围内表现出明显不同的行为。浅施主和 Hi 信号在大约 50 K 以下迅速淬灭，而 Zni 贡献显示出非单调温度依赖性。相比之下，VO+ 信号一直持续到室温，并随着温度的升高而增加，这与涉及深氧空位态的供体相关缺陷之间的电荷重新分布一致。对于两个退火样品，腔体 Q 因子通常随着温度的升高而降低，这表明微波损耗的变化取决于大气。这些结果表明，退火气氛控制着顺磁缺陷群、供体相关中心的温度依赖性以及 ZnO 微粒的相关电子响应。

articles.title: TCSP3.0: Template-Based Crystal Structure Prediction with Coefficient-Preserving Element Substitution and Structural Diversity
articles.title_zh: TCSP3.0：基于模板的晶体结构预测，具有保留系数的元素替换和结构多样性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34029v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Template-based crystal structure prediction (CSP) transfers a known crystal structure to a new composition by element substitution, so its accuracy depends on retrieving suitable templates, mapping elements and ranking the resulting candidates correctly. Auditing the original TCSP2.0 implementation on the T180 benchmark, we found that 469 of its 2,347 selected structures (20%) have the wrong composition, caused by element mappings that ignore stoichiometric coefficients and by sequential text substitution that cascades or corrupts element symbols. We propose TCSP3.0, which enforces coefficient-preserving mappings, substitutes species simultaneously on parsed structures and validates every candidate's composition and cell. It further adds periodic-number retrieval, soft oxidation-state evidence, radius-compatibility scoring, structural deduplication, and ORB-v3 machine-learning-potential relaxation and energy ranking of its candidates, as used by deep generative CSP baselines. TCSP3.0 achieves Top-1 and Top-20 match rates of 72.2% and 90.6% on T180, compared with 28.3% and 45.6% for TCSP2.0, and a Top-20 match rate of 74.0% on a new 800-target benchmark (T800). On T180 it also outperforms PNcsp+ and deep generative models CrystalFlow and MaskGXT (Top-1 72.2% versus at most 63.9%). Even without relaxation, TCSP3.0 reaches 67.8% at Top-1 and 90.6% at Top-20 in a median of 28 s per target on two CPU cores, about ten times faster than CrystalFlow. Paired ten-arm ablations on T180 and T800 show that most of the improvement comes from the correctness fixes; structural deduplication significantly improves the Top-5 match rate, embedding-based retrieval is required for coverage, and the remaining scoring features have small or null effects.
articles.abstract_zh: 基于模板的晶体结构预测（CSP）通过元素替换将已知的晶体结构转移到新的成分，因此其准确性取决于检索合适的模板、映射元素并对所得候选正确排序。在 T180 基准上审核原始 TCSP2.0 实现，我们发现 2,347 个选定结构中有 469 个 (20%) 具有错误的组成，这是由忽略化学计量系数的元素映射以及级联或破坏元素符号的顺序文本替换引起的。我们提出 TCSP3.0，它强制保留系数映射，在解析的结构上同时替换物种并验证每个候选的组成和细胞。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于模板的晶体结构预测（CSP）通过元素替换将已知的晶体结构转移到新的成分，因此其准确性取决于检索合适的模板、映射元素并对所得候选正确排序。在 T180 基准上审核原始 TCSP2.0 实现，我们发现 2,347 个选定结构中有 469 个 (20%) 具有错误的组成，这是由忽略化学计量系数的元素映射以及级联或破坏元素符号的顺序文本替换引起的。我们提出 TCSP3.0，它强制保留系数映射，在解析的结构上同时替换物种并验证每个候选的组成和细胞。它还添加了周期数检索、软氧化态证据、半径兼容性评分、结构重复数据删除以及 ORB-v3 机器学习潜力松弛和其候选者的能量排名，如深层生成 CSP 基线所使用。 TCSP3.0 在 T180 上实现了 72.2% 和 90.6% 的 Top-1 和 Top-20 匹配率，而 TCSP2.0 的匹配率为 28.3% 和 45.6%，在新的 800 目标基准 (T800) 上实现了 74.0% 的 Top-20 匹配率。在 T180 上，它的性能也优于 PNcsp+ 和深度生成模型 CrystalFlow 和 MaskGXT（Top-1 72.2% vs 最多 63.9%）。即使不放松，TCSP3.0 在两个 CPU 内核上每个目标的中位数为 28 秒时，在 Top-1 中达到 67.8%，在 Top-20 中达到 90.6%，大约比 CrystalFlow 快十倍。 T180 和 T800 上的配对十臂消融表明，大部分改进来自正确性修复；结构去重显着提高了Top-5匹配率，覆盖需要基于嵌入的检索，其余评分特征影响较小或为零。

articles.title: Field misalignment effect on the in-plane magnetoresistance in the high-temperature superconductor FeSe/SrTiO3
articles.title_zh: 场失准对高温超导体 FeSe/SrTiO3 面内磁阻的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34168v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The azimuthal angular dependence of the in-plane magnetoresistance provides a powerful probe for detecting rotational symmetry breaking in superconductors, which has significant implications for understanding the superconducting pairing symmetry and the intertwined orders. However, in two-dimensional or layered superconductors with strong anisotropy between in-plane and out-of-plane critical fields, measuring the in-plane magnetoresistance is particularly challenging as it is extremely sensitive to the field misalignment. Here we perform systematic electrical transport measurements on ultrathin FeSe films grown on SrTiO3 substrates. By remounting the same FeSe film to change the field misalignment, two qualitatively different angular dependences of the in-plane magnetoresistance are observed in the superconducting transition region, indicating the extreme sensitivity of the measurement to field misalignment. The observed anisotropic in-plane magnetoresistance can be well captured by our geometric model considering the field misalignment effect. Our work provides a practical framework for disentangling the misalignment effect and investigating the in-plane rotational symmetry breaking in two-dimensional or layered superconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 面内磁阻的方位角依赖性为检测超导体中的旋转对称性破缺提供了强大的探针，这对于理解超导配对对称性和交织顺序具有重要意义。然而，在面内和面外临界场之间具有强各向异性的二维或层状超导体中，测量面内磁阻尤其具有挑战性，因为它对场失准极其敏感。在这里，我们对 SrTiO3 基底上生长的超薄 FeSe 薄膜进行系统的电传输测量。通过重新安装相同的 FeSe 薄膜来改变场失准，在超导过渡区域观察到面内磁阻的两种性质不同的角度依赖性，表明测量对场失准的极端敏感性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 面内磁阻的方位角依赖性为检测超导体中的旋转对称性破缺提供了强大的探针，这对于理解超导配对对称性和交织顺序具有重要意义。然而，在面内和面外临界场之间具有强各向异性的二维或层状超导体中，测量面内磁阻尤其具有挑战性，因为它对场失准极其敏感。在这里，我们对 SrTiO3 基底上生长的超薄 FeSe 薄膜进行系统的电传输测量。通过重新安装相同的 FeSe 薄膜来改变场失准，在超导过渡区域观察到面内磁阻的两种性质不同的角度依赖性，表明测量对场失准的极端敏感性。考虑到场失准效应，我们的几何模型可以很好地捕获观察到的各向异性面内磁阻。我们的工作提供了一个实用的框架，用于解开错位效应并研究二维或层状超导体中的面内旋转对称性破缺。

articles.title: Spin and Charge Photocurrents from Electric-Magnetic Dipole Interference in Centrosymmetric Crystals
articles.title_zh: 中心对称晶体中电磁偶极子干涉产生的自旋和电荷光电流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34222v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A common view regarding even-order nonlinear optical (NLO) effects, such as second-harmonic generation and the bulk photovoltaic effect, is that the breaking of inversion symmetry is necessary. However, this view relies on the assumption that light interacts with materials solely through its electric field. Here, we demonstrate that interference between the electric and magnetic components of the same light field can induce even-order NLO effects even in centrosymmetric materials. Using charge and spin photocurrents as prototypical examples, we present a unified microscopic theory showing how such electric-magnetic dipole interference (EMDI) drives NLO responses in inversion-symmetric crystals. Bilinear in both electric and magnetic fields, these responses scale linearly with light intensity. Combining symmetry analysis with first-principles calculations, we decompose the EMDI-induced photocurrents into shift-like and injection-like contributions and classify their dependence on crystal symmetry, time-reversal symmetry, and light polarization. Notably, we reveal that these EMDI-induced responses in centrosymmetric materials are weaker than conventional responses in non-centrosymmetric materials roughly by a factor of fine structure constant α approx [10⁻³--10⁻²] . Nevertheless, they remain well within experimental reach. Our work thus unlocks NLO functionalities in centrosymmetric materials for e.g., materials characterization, photonics and optoelectronics. This is vital given that many functionally importantly materials, such as cubic Si and cubic SrTiO₃, possess inversion symmetry.
articles.abstract_zh: 关于偶次非线性光学（NLO）效应（例如二次谐波产生和体光伏效应）的普遍观点是，打破反演对称性是必要的。然而，这种观点依赖于光仅通过其电场与材料相互作用的假设。在这里，我们证明即使在中心对称材料中，同一光场的电和磁分量之间的干扰也可以引起偶数阶 NLO 效应。使用电荷和自旋光电流作为典型例子，我们提出了一个统一的微观理论，展示了这种电磁偶极子干涉（EMDI）如何驱动反演对称晶体中的 NLO 响应。在电场和磁场中都是双线性的，这些响应随光强度线性变化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 关于偶次非线性光学（NLO）效应（例如二次谐波产生和体光伏效应）的普遍观点是，打破反演对称性是必要的。然而，这种观点依赖于光仅通过其电场与材料相互作用的假设。在这里，我们证明即使在中心对称材料中，同一光场的电和磁分量之间的干扰也可以引起偶数阶 NLO 效应。使用电荷和自旋光电流作为典型例子，我们提出了一个统一的微观理论，展示了这种电磁偶极子干涉（EMDI）如何驱动反演对称晶体中的 NLO 响应。在电场和磁场中都是双线性的，这些响应随光强度线性变化。将对称性分析与第一原理计算相结合，我们将 EMDI 引起的光电流分解为类位移和类注入贡献，并将它们对晶体对称性、时间反转对称性和光偏振的依赖性进行分类。值得注意的是，我们发现中心对称材料中的这些 EMDI 引起的响应比非中心对称材料中的传统响应弱，大约弱一个精细结构常数 α 的因子，大约为 [10⁻3--10⁻2]。尽管如此，它们仍处于实验范围之内。因此，我们的工作解锁了中心对称材料中的 NLO 功能，例如材料表征、光子学和光电子学。鉴于许多功能重要的材料（例如立方硅和立方 SrTiO₃）具有反演对称性，这一点至关重要。

articles.title: Tuning from intrinsic to disorder-dominated quantum states in a kagome antiferromagnet
articles.title_zh: Kagome 反铁磁体中从本征量子态调整为无序主导量子态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34230v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The spin-1/2 kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet (AFM) provides a paradigmatic platform for realizing quantum spin-liquid (QSL) and magnetization-plateau states. Experimental progress, however, has been hindered by structural disorder, whose effects on these quantum states remain elusive. A key experimental challenge is therefore to connect intrinsic and disorder-dominated regimes through controlled disorder and identify emergent degrees of freedom associated with disorder. Here we introduce controlled point defects through electron irradiation into the spin-1/2 kagome AFM YCu3(OH)6.5Br2.5 (YCOB) and track the resulting evolution of its low-energy magnetic states. High-field magnetic torque measurements reveal that the 1/9 and 1/3 magnetization plateaus are strongly suppressed by only ~0.05% irradiation-induced defects, demonstrating that these delicate quantum many-body states are extraordinarily fragile against dilute disorder. Moreover, the irradiation induces a sign reversal of the magnetic torque only at low temperatures and low fields, indicating the emergence of correlated defect-induced moments rather than isolated free spins. Remarkably, the characteristic scaling of the magnetic specific heat, absent in pristine YCOB, progressively emerges with increasing disorder. These findings establish dilute disorder as an effective tuning parameter that drives the kagome AFM from intrinsic quantum states toward a disorder-dominated regime. The contrasting responses further identify pristine YCOB as an exceptionally clean kagome AFM for accessing intrinsic quantum states.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋 1/2 kagome 海森堡反铁磁体 (AFM) 为实现量子自旋液体 (QSL) 和磁化平台态提供了一个范例平台。然而，实验进展受到结构紊乱的阻碍，结构紊乱对这些量子态的影响仍然难以捉摸。因此，一个关键的实验挑战是通过受控的无序将内在的和无序主导的机制联系起来，并确定与无序相关的新兴自由度。在这里，我们通过电子辐照将受控点缺陷引入自旋 1/2 kagome AFM YCu3(OH)6.5Br2.5 (YCOB) 中，并跟踪其低能磁态的演化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋 1/2 kagome 海森堡反铁磁体 (AFM) 为实现量子自旋液体 (QSL) 和磁化平台态提供了一个范例平台。然而，实验进展受到结构紊乱的阻碍，结构紊乱对这些量子态的影响仍然难以捉摸。因此，一个关键的实验挑战是通过受控的无序将内在的和无序主导的机制联系起来，并确定与无序相关的新兴自由度。在这里，我们通过电子辐照将受控点缺陷引入自旋 1/2 kagome AFM YCu3(OH)6.5Br2.5 (YCOB) 中，并跟踪其低能磁态的演化。高场磁扭矩测量表明，1/9 和 1/3 磁化平台仅被大约 0.05% 的辐照引起的缺陷强烈抑制，这表明这些微妙的量子多体态对于稀无序而言非常脆弱。此外，辐照仅在低温和低场下才会引起磁矩的符号反转，这表明出现了相关的缺陷诱发矩，而不是孤立的自由自旋。值得注意的是，原始 YCOB 中不存在的磁比热的特征缩放随着无序性的增加而逐渐出现。这些发现将稀无序性确定为有效的调谐参数，可驱动 kagome AFM 从固有量子态转向无序主导状态。对比响应进一步确定原始 YCOB 是一种异常干净的 kagome AFM，用于访问内在量子态。

articles.title: Andreev Reflection at a Graphene Normal-Superconductor Interface: A Lattice-Continuum Comparison
articles.title_zh: 石墨烯法向超导体界面处的安德烈耶夫反射：晶格连续体比较
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34270v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We compare quadratic continuum and nearest-neighbour tight-binding models of Andreev reflection at a clean graphene normal-superconductor interface. For abrupt changes in chemical potential and pairing potential, with unchanged hopping, the lattice model yields four independent boundary conditions. Its reflection probabilities agree with independent Kwant calculations to numerical precision for the channels examined. We investigate trigonal warping and its effect on the relation between momentum and group velocity. For (μ_N,μ_S,Δ₀,E)/t₀=(0.5,1,0.1,0.05), the Andreev-reflection probability for the ξ=+1 valley peaks at 19.9^circ in the lattice model, versus 3.4^circ in the quadratic continuum model. These parameters lie outside the expected validity regime of the low-energy approximation. As all energy scales are reduced at fixed ratios, the central angular response and conductance become more consistent with lattice results. The quadratic continuum boundary problem also requires short-wavelength auxiliary modes outside the validity range of the valley expansion. Thus, differences cannot be attributed to bulk dispersion alone. A small excitation energy relative to chemical potential does not ensure continuum validity; relevant energy scales, modes in both regions, and interface matching assumptions must also be considered.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们比较了干净石墨烯法向超导体界面上安德烈夫反射的二次连续谱和最近邻紧束缚模型。对于化学势和配对势的突然变化，在跳跃不变的情况下，晶格模型产生四个独立的边界条件。其反射概率与所检查通道的数值精度的独立 Kwant 计算一致。我们研究三角扭曲及其对动量和群速度之间关系的影响。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们比较了干净石墨烯法向超导体界面上安德烈夫反射的二次连续谱和最近邻紧束缚模型。对于化学势和配对势的突然变化，在跳跃不变的情况下，晶格模型产生四个独立的边界条件。其反射概率与所检查通道的数值精度的独立 Kwant 计算一致。我们研究三角扭曲及其对动量和群速度之间关系的影响。对于 (μ_N,μ_S,Δ₀,E)/t₀=(0.5,1,0.1,0.05)， xi=+1 谷的 Andreev 反射概率在晶格模型中的 19.9^circ 处达到峰值，而在二次连续介质模型中为 3.4^circ。这些参数位于低能量近似的预期有效性范围之外。由于所有能量尺度以固定比率减小，中心角响应和电导变得与晶格结果更加一致。二次连续边界问题还需要谷扩展有效范围之外的短波长辅助模式。因此，差异不能仅归因于体积分散。相对于化学势而言较小的激发能并不能确保连续体有效性；还必须考虑相关的能量尺度、两个区域的模式以及界面匹配假设。

articles.title: Interfacial Orbital Rashba Edelstein Effect Identified in CoO/Cu/Pt Trilayers
articles.title_zh: CoO/Cu/Pt 三层膜中的界面轨道 Rashba Edelstein 效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34292v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the generation of orbital angular momentum currents at engineered Cu-oxide interfaces using CoO/Cu/Pt thin-film trilayers. Angular-dependent magnetoresistance measurements on samples with varying Cu interlayer thickness reveal systematic changes in both longitudinal and transverse resistance components, including a sign inversion of the signal. By systematically varying the Cu interlayer thicknesses, we disentangle the spin and orbital contributions to the magnetoresistive response. Our results show that large orbital currents originate from the interfacial orbital Rashba-Edelstein effect due to the presence of the Cu-O bonds at the CoO/Cu interface. Unlike previously studied CoO/Cu bilayers that rely on uncontrolled natural oxidation, our trilayer geometry enables reproducible and stable orbital-current generation at ambient conditions. Our results identify Cu-oxide interfaces as efficient sources of orbital angular momentum and clarify the microscopic mechanism underlying orbital current generation. Consequently, this work establishes a well-defined materials platform for all-orbitronic devices that does not require relativistic spin-orbit coupling or orbital-spin interconversion processes.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了使用 CoO/Cu/Pt 薄膜三层在工程铜氧化物界面处轨道角动量电流的产生。对具有不同铜夹层厚度的样品进行与角度相关的磁阻测量揭示了纵向和横向电阻分量的系统变化，包括信号的符号反转。通过系统地改变铜夹层厚度，我们解开了自旋和轨道对磁阻响应的影响。我们的结果表明，由于 CoO/Cu 界面处存在 Cu-O 键，大轨道电流源自界面轨道 Rashba-Edelstein 效应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了使用 CoO/Cu/Pt 薄膜三层在工程铜氧化物界面处轨道角动量电流的产生。对具有不同铜夹层厚度的样品进行与角度相关的磁阻测量揭示了纵向和横向电阻分量的系统变化，包括信号的符号反转。通过系统地改变铜夹层厚度，我们解开了自旋和轨道对磁阻响应的影响。我们的结果表明，由于 CoO/Cu 界面处存在 Cu-O 键，大轨道电流源自界面轨道 Rashba-Edelstein 效应。与之前研究的依赖于不受控制的自然氧化的 CoO/Cu 双层不同，我们的三层几何结构能够在环境条件下产生可重复且稳定的轨道电流。我们的结果将铜氧化物界面确定为轨道角动量的有效来源，并阐明了轨道电流产生的微观机制。因此，这项工作为全轨道电子器件建立了一个明确的材料平台，不需要相对论自旋轨道耦合或轨道自旋互变过程。

articles.title: Controllable charge-spin conversion in sliding multiferroic metal Fe3GaTe2
articles.title_zh: 滑动多铁金属 Fe3GaTe2 中的可控电荷自旋转换
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34295v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Controlling charge--spin conversion within a single magnetic material is important for compact spintronic devices. Using first-principles calculations, symmetry analysis, and Wannier-based linear response, we study the Edelstein and spin Hall responses of sliding-ferroelectric bilayer ceFe3GaTe2. Two degenerate ground states with opposite interlayer sliding vectors and out-of-plane dipole moments are separated by a calculated switching barrier of about 16.3~meV per unit cell. Magnetization orientation determines the allowed current-induced spin components, while ferroelectric switching induces component-selective sign reversals governed by M_zmathcal T for in-plane magnetization and by M_z for out-of-plane magnetization. The Edelstein response is strongly energy dependent, with spin accumulation approaching 2~hbar for mathbf mparallel+y under a reference field of 1~V/Å. Momentum-resolved analysis links the TR-even and TR-odd Edelstein responses to Γ-centered constant-energy contours and localized interband features, respectively. Spin-conductivity contributions show the opposite momentum-space character, with broad sign-competing spin Berry curvature for TR-even and narrow Fermi-surface contours for TR-odd. The transverse spin Hall conductivity reaches sim10³,(hbar/e)(S/cm) and depends strongly on ferroelectric state and magnetization direction. Magnetization rotations in the xy and xz planes reveal symmetry-allowed higher angular harmonics in both spin accumulation and spin-current responses. These results establish sliding-ferroelectric bilayer ceFe3GaTe2 as a tunable platform for reconfigurable spin accumulation and spin-current generation.
articles.abstract_zh: 控制单一磁性材料内的电荷-自旋转换对于紧凑型自旋电子器件非常重要。利用第一性原理计算、对称性分析和基于 Wannier 的线性响应，我们研究了滑动铁电双层 ceFe3GaTe2 的 Edelstein 和自旋霍尔响应。具有相反层间滑动矢量和面外偶极矩的两个简并基态被计算出的每晶胞约 16.3~meV 的转换势垒分开。磁化方向决定了允许的电流感应自旋分量，而铁电切换会引起分量选择性符号反转，其由面内磁化的 M_zmathcal T 和面外磁化的 M_z 控制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 控制单一磁性材料内的电荷-自旋转换对于紧凑型自旋电子器件非常重要。利用第一性原理计算、对称性分析和基于 Wannier 的线性响应，我们研究了滑动铁电双层 ceFe3GaTe2 的 Edelstein 和自旋霍尔响应。具有相反层间滑动矢量和面外偶极矩的两个简并基态被计算出的每晶胞约 16.3~meV 的转换势垒分开。磁化方向决定了允许的电流感应自旋分量，而铁电切换会引起分量选择性符号反转，其由面内磁化的 M_zmathcal T 和面外磁化的 M_z 控制。 Edelstein 响应强烈依赖于能量，在 1~V/Å 的参考场下，对于 mathbf mparallel+y，自旋累积接近 2~hbar。动量解析分析将 TR 偶数和 TR 奇数 Edelstein 响应分别与以 Γ 为中心的恒定能量轮廓和局部带间特征联系起来。自旋电导率贡献显示出相反的动量空间特征，对于TR偶数具有宽的符号竞争自旋贝里曲率，对于TR奇数具有窄的费米表面轮廓。横向自旋霍尔电导率达到 sim103,(hbar/e)(S/cm)，并且强烈依赖于铁电态和磁化方向。 xy 和 xz 平面中的磁化旋转揭示了自旋累积和自旋电流响应中允许对称的更高角谐波。这些结果将滑动铁电双层 ceFe3GaTe2 确立为可重构自旋积累和自旋电流生成的可调平台。

articles.title: Edelstein Effect in Ferromagnetic Monolayers Fe3GaTe2 and Fe3GeTe2
articles.title_zh: 铁磁单层 Fe3GaTe2 和 Fe3GeTe2 中的埃德尔斯坦效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34296v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Edelstein effect enables intrinsic current-induced spin polarization in noncentrosymmetric van der Waals magnets. Here, we compare the Edelstein responses of monolayer ceFe3GaTe2 and ceFe3GeTe2 using first-principles Wannier-based linear-response calculations. Despite sharing the same noncentrosymmetric D₃ₕ symmetry and selection rules, the two materials show markedly different time-reversal-even and -odd spin accumulations in magnitude, sign, and energy dependence. Strong responses occur mainly near -0.4~eV in ceFe3GaTe2 and +0.4~eV in ceFe3GeTe2. At the intrinsic Fermi level, atom-resolved analysis shows that Ga-to-Ge substitution reverses the even contribution of the inequivalent Fe3 site for both in-plane magnetization directions and enhances its negative odd contribution, reorganizing the cancellation among atomic sites. Momentum-resolved calculations link the hole-side response of ceFe3GaTe2 to a few large Γ-centered Fermi contours, whereas the electron-side response of ceFe3GeTe2 involves dense Fe-3d bands with strong interband contributions. The even response arises from incomplete cancellation of opposite-sign intraband Fermi-surface contributions, while the odd response originates from interband coherence between closely spaced states. Magnetization rotation reveals symmetry-constrained angular dependences with higher-order harmonics, especially in the xz plane, while biaxial strain causes substantial amplitude changes and sign reversals. These results show how crystal symmetry, electronic structure, magnetization orientation, and lattice deformation govern the intrinsic Edelstein effect in ceFe3XTe2 (X=Ga,Ge).
articles.abstract_zh: 埃德尔斯坦效应能够在非中心对称范德华磁体中实现本征电流诱导的自旋极化。在这里，我们使用基于 Wannier 的第一原理线性响应计算来比较单层 ceFe3GaTe2 和 ceFe3GeTe2 的 Edelstein 响应。尽管具有相同的非中心对称 D₃ₕ 对称性和选择规则，但这两种材料在幅度、符号和能量依赖性方面表现出明显不同的时间反转偶数和奇数自旋累积。强响应主要发生在ceFe3GaTe2 的-0.4~eV 附近和ceFe3GeTe2 的+0.4~eV 附近。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 埃德尔斯坦效应能够在非中心对称范德华磁体中实现本征电流诱导的自旋极化。在这里，我们使用基于 Wannier 的第一原理线性响应计算来比较单层 ceFe3GaTe2 和 ceFe3GeTe2 的 Edelstein 响应。尽管具有相同的非中心对称 D₃ₕ 对称性和选择规则，但这两种材料在幅度、符号和能量依赖性方面表现出明显不同的时间反转偶数和奇数自旋累积。强响应主要发生在ceFe3GaTe2 的-0.4~eV 附近和ceFe3GeTe2 的+0.4~eV 附近。在本征费米能级，原子分辨分析表明，Ga-Ge 取代逆转了不等价 Fe3 位点对两个面内磁化方向的偶数贡献，并增强了其负奇数贡献，从而重新组织了原子位点之间的抵消。动量解析计算将 ceFe3GaTe2 的空穴侧响应与一些大的 Γ 中心费米等值线联系起来，而 ceFe3GeTe2 的电子侧响应涉及具有强带间贡献的密集 Fe-3d 能带。偶响应源于异号带内费米面贡献的不完全抵消，而奇响应源于紧密间隔状态之间的带间相干性。磁化旋转揭示了高阶谐波的对称约束角度依赖性，尤其是在 xz 平面中，而双轴应变会导致大幅振幅变化和符号反转。这些结果显示了晶体对称性、电子结构、磁化方向和晶格变形如何控制 ceFe3XTe2 (X=Ga,Ge) 中的固有埃德尔斯坦效应。

articles.title: Crystal-surface polarity enables nonreciprocal transport in a centrosymmetric kagome magnet
articles.title_zh: 晶体表面极性使得中心对称戈薇磁体中的不可逆传输成为可能
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34312v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Every crystal surface breaks inversion symmetry even when the bulk is centrosymmetric, creating an intrinsic boundary polarity (mathbfP). Here we show that this polarity enables zero-field nonreciprocal transport in the centrosymmetric kagome magnets TbMn₆Sn₆₋ₓInₓ. In symmetric TbMn₆Sn₄.₄In₁.₆ microdevices, opposing side surfaces exhibit second-harmonic longitudinal resistances of comparable magnitude and opposite sign. Reversing the spontaneous magnetization (mathbfM) reverses both signals, whereas rotating mathbfM so that the toroidal moment mathbfP × mathbfM has no component along the current suppresses the response. In pristine TbMn₆Sn₆, the signal switches off across the spin-reorientation transition, providing a chemically ordered control of the same symmetry relation. Spatial potential mapping indicates that the nonlinear boundary contribution is distinct from the bulk linear conduction. Spin-orbit-coupled surface states associated with topological bands may enhance the effect. Crystal-surface polarity therefore offers a broadly applicable route to zero-field rectification in centrosymmetric magnetic conductors around room temperature.
articles.abstract_zh: 即使块体是中心对称的，每个晶体表面也会打破反演对称性，从而产生固有的边界极性（mathbfP）。在这里，我们证明这种极性能够在中心对称 kagome 磁体 TbMn₆Sn₆₋ₓInₓ 中实现零场非互易输运。在对称的 TbMn6Sn4.4In1.6 微型器件中，相对的侧面表现出大小相当、符号相反的二次谐波纵向电阻。反转自发磁化 (mathbfM) 会反转两个信号，而旋转 mathbfM 以使环形力矩 mathbfP × mathbfM 沿电流没有分量，从而抑制响应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 即使块体是中心对称的，每个晶体表面也会打破反演对称性，从而产生固有的边界极性（mathbfP）。在这里，我们证明这种极性能够在中心对称 kagome 磁体 TbMn₆Sn₆₋ₓInₓ 中实现零场非互易输运。在对称的 TbMn6Sn4.4In1.6 微型器件中，相对的侧面表现出大小相当、符号相反的二次谐波纵向电阻。反转自发磁化 (mathbfM) 会反转两个信号，而旋转 mathbfM 以使环形力矩 mathbfP × mathbfM 沿电流没有分量，从而抑制响应。在原始的 TbMn₆Sn₆ 中，信号在自旋重定向跃迁过程中关闭，从而提供相同对称关系的化学有序控制。空间势映射表明非线性边界贡献与体线性传导不同。与拓扑带相关的自旋轨道耦合表面态可能会增强这种效果。因此，晶体表面极性为室温附近中心对称磁导体的零场整流提供了广泛适用的途径。

articles.title: Phase fluctuations dominated superconductivity in a thick Granular Boron-Doped Diamond film
articles.title_zh: 相涨落主导了厚粒状掺硼金刚石薄膜的超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34319v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the superconducting properties of a 1.2-μm-thick granular boron-doped diamond film, where tightly packed grains form a disordered network of Josephson junctions. The film exhibits a sharp superconducting transition at a critical temperature, T_c ~ 3 K. Its transport properties are well described by the Ambegaokar-Halperin theory of phase fluctuations. Direct measurements of the penetration depth using a two-coil mutual inductance technique reveal classic phase-fluctuation-dominated behavior: below T_c, the superfluid density (nₛ) varies linearly over a wide temperature range - a hallmark of thermal phase fluctuations - before crossing over to a T² dependence at ultra-low temperatures. Both the large low-temperature penetration depth, λ(0) ~ 8.8 μm, and the slope of the linear ns variation in the thermal regime reveal a remarkably low superfluid stiffness in the range of 0.5-0.8 K. These results establish granular boron-doped diamond films as an excellent model system for investigating the role of long-wavelength phase fluctuations in three-dimensional superconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了 1.2 微米厚的颗粒状硼掺杂金刚石薄膜的超导特性，其中紧密堆积的晶粒形成了约瑟夫森结的无序网络。该薄膜在临界温度 T_c ~ 3 K 下表现出急剧的超导转变。其输运特性可以通过相涨落的 Ambegaokar-Halperin 理论很好地描述。使用两线圈互感技术直接测量穿透深度揭示了经典的相位涨落主导行为：低于 T_c，超流体密度 (nₛ) 在较宽的温度范围内线性变化（这是热相位涨落的标志），然后在超低温下转变为 T2 依赖性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了 1.2 微米厚的颗粒状硼掺杂金刚石薄膜的超导特性，其中紧密堆积的晶粒形成了约瑟夫森结的无序网络。该薄膜在临界温度 T_c ~ 3 K 下表现出急剧的超导转变。其输运特性可以通过相涨落的 Ambegaokar-Halperin 理论很好地描述。使用两线圈互感技术直接测量穿透深度揭示了经典的相位涨落主导行为：低于 T_c，超流体密度 (nₛ) 在较宽的温度范围内线性变化（这是热相位涨落的标志），然后在超低温下转变为 T2 依赖性。较大的低温穿透深度，λ(0) ~ 8.8 μm，以及热状态中线性 ns 变化的斜率都揭示了 0.5-0.8 K 范围内的超流体刚度非常低。这些结果将粒状硼掺杂金刚石薄膜建立为研究三维超导体中长波长相位涨落作用的优秀模型系统。

articles.title: Transition Metal-Anchored Newly Synthesized Aza-Triphenylene Monolayer for Efficient Hydrogen Evolution Reaction: Insights from DFT
articles.title_zh: 用于高效析氢反应的过渡金属锚定新合成氮杂苯并菲单层：DFT 的见解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34354v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: First-principles calculations were employed to explore the hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) activity in two-dimensional aza-triphenylene monolayers functionalized with transition metals. Among the various metals studied, Co, Ru, and Y demonstrate outstanding catalytic efficacy, lowering the hydrogen adsorption free energy from -0.78 eV for pure aza-triphenylene to 0.05, 0.20, and 0.06 eV, respectively. Volcano plot analysis corroborates their enhanced HER activity. Ab initio molecular dynamics simulations confirm thermal stability, while the electronic structure and charge transfer analysis reveal the strong catalyst-surface interaction. Metal decoration also improves the carrier mobility, particularly for Ru-functionalized aza-triphenylene. The climbing-image nudged elastic band calculations for Co-functionalized aza-triphenylene exhibit activation barriers of 1.61, 2.29, and 5.88 eV for the Volmer, Heyrovsky, and Tafel reactions, respectively, highlighting a preferred Volmer-Heyrovsky route with the Heyrovsky being the rate-determining step. These findings highlight the potential of transition-metal-functionalized aza-triphenylene as a promising platform for developing efficient HER electrocatalysts.
articles.abstract_zh: 采用第一原理计算来探索过渡金属功能化的二维氮杂苯并菲单层中的析氢反应（HER）活性。在所研究的各种金属中，Co、Ru 和 Y 表现出出色的催化功效，分别将纯氮杂苯并菲的氢吸附自由能从 -0.78 eV 降低到 0.05、0.20 和 0.06 eV。火山图分析证实了它们增强的 HER 活性。从头算分子动力学模拟证实了热稳定性，而电子结构和电荷转移分析揭示了强烈的催化剂-表面相互作用。金属装饰还可以提高载流子迁移率，特别是对于钌官能化的氮杂苯并菲。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 采用第一原理计算来探索过渡金属功能化的二维氮杂苯并菲单层中的析氢反应（HER）活性。在所研究的各种金属中，Co、Ru 和 Y 表现出出色的催化功效，分别将纯氮杂苯并菲的氢吸附自由能从 -0.78 eV 降低到 0.05、0.20 和 0.06 eV。火山图分析证实了它们增强的 HER 活性。从头算分子动力学模拟证实了热稳定性，而电子结构和电荷转移分析揭示了强烈的催化剂-表面相互作用。金属装饰还可以提高载流子迁移率，特别是对于钌官能化的氮杂苯并菲。共官能化氮杂苯并菲的爬升图像微移弹性带计算显示，Volmer、Heyrovsky 和 Tafel 反应的活化势垒分别为 1.61、2.29 和 5.88 eV，突出显示了首选的 Volmer-Heyrovsky 路线，其中 Heyrovsky 是速率决定步骤。这些发现凸显了过渡金属功能化氮杂苯并菲作为开发高效 HER 电催化剂的有前途的平台的潜力。

articles.title: Phase field dislocation dynamics prediction of stacking fault widths in Cu-Al Alloys using generalised stacking fault energy from DFT and interatomic potentials
articles.title_zh: 使用 DFT 和原子间势的广义堆垛层错能量预测铜铝合金堆垛层错宽度的相场位错动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34420v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The equilibrium width of intrinsic stacking faults is an important material parameter affecting key deformation phenomena. Here, we perform a comparative assessment of γ-surfaces generated using MD -- with a classical embedded-atom potential (ZW) and a machine-learned Gaussian Approximation Potential (GAP) -- and density functional theory (DFT), for Cu-Al alloys of varying Al content, and incorporate them as an energy term in PFDD simulations to obtain the equilibrium SFW. All three methods reproduce the lattice parameter and elastic moduli of Cu and Cu-Al alloys in reasonable agreement with each other and with experimental measurements from literature, but the MD-derived γ-surfaces, for both ZW and GAP, deviate substantially from DFT at the seven characteristic points, with the largest discrepancies at T and T₁. When incorporated into PFDD, the DFT-derived γ-surfaces successfully predict an equilibrium SFW that increases with Al content and agrees well with standalone MD measurements and experimental values for pure Cu, whereas the MD-derived γ-surfaces do not yield an accurate SFW within PFDD, as the altered generalized stacking fault energy landscape causes the dissociating partials to become pinned soon after separation. These results show that DFT-derived γ-surfaces remain the more reliable route to alloy SFW prediction, and interatomic potentials must capture the shear path accurately to enable robust, efficient MD-PFDD modelling of stacking faults in alloys.
articles.abstract_zh: 本征堆垛层错的平衡宽度是影响关键变形现象的重要材料参数。在这里，我们对不同 Al 含量的铜铝合金使用 MD（具有经典嵌入原子势 (ZW) 和机器学习的高斯近似势 (GAP)）和密度泛函理论 (DFT) 生成的 γ 表面进行比较评估，并将它们作为能量项纳入 PFDD 模拟中以获得平衡 SFW。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本征堆垛层错的平衡宽度是影响关键变形现象的重要材料参数。在这里，我们对不同 Al 含量的铜铝合金使用 MD（具有经典嵌入原子势 (ZW) 和机器学习的高斯近似势 (GAP)）和密度泛函理论 (DFT) 生成的 γ 表面进行比较评估，并将它们作为能量项纳入 PFDD 模拟中以获得平衡 SFW。所有三种方法都再现了铜和铜铝合金的晶格参数和弹性模量，彼此相当一致，并且与文献中的实验测量结果一致，但 ZW 和 GAP 的 MD 导出的 γ 表面在七个特征点上与 DFT 存在很大偏差，其中在 T 和 T₁ 处差异最大。当合并到PFDD中时，DFT衍生的γ表面成功地预测了平衡SFW，该平衡SFW随着Al含量的增加而增加，并且与纯Cu的独立MD测量和实验值非常吻合，而MD衍生的γ表面在PFDD中不能产生准确的SFW，因为改变的广义堆垛层错能量景观导致解离部分在分离后很快被钉扎。这些结果表明，DFT 衍生的 γ 表面仍然是合金 SFW 预测的更可靠途径，并且原子间势必须准确捕获剪切路径，才能对合金中的堆垛层错进行稳健、高效的 MD-PFDD 建模。

articles.title: Matter that learns what matters
articles.title_zh: 学习重要的事情
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34428v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Can a material learn what deserves its attention? We show that it can in a model optical network, in which action outcomes train a persistent record in each link. The record biases whether a source is consulted and sets how strongly it changes a stored answer, so useful sources gain attention and influence without being identified in advance. The network's experience thus shapes the information available for its future learning. Resonant readouts make this learning fragile: reinforcement can carry a record past resonance, where it persists but its influence weakens. We derive bounds within which relevant signals guide the answer, irrelevant signals are rejected and stored answers remain open to revision. These bounds guide a learning rule that limits reinforcement as records form; in simulations, it acquires useful records and keeps them functional. When relevance changes, an obsolete record can block its own replacement. A local state that strengthens negative writing after unsuccessful actions releases obsolete records and completes the learning sequence more often. How a memory is read should decide how it is written.
articles.abstract_zh: 材料能学到什么值得关注吗？我们证明它可以在模型光网络中，其中动作结果在每个链路中训练持久记录。该记录会影响是否查阅某个来源，并设置它改变存储的答案的强度，因此有用的来源无需提前识别即可获得关注和影响力。因此，网络的经验塑造了可供未来学习使用的信息。共振读数使这种学习变得脆弱：强化可以将记录传递到共振之外，共振虽然持续存在，但影响力减弱。我们得出界限，在该界限内，相关信号指导答案，不相关信号被拒绝，并且存储的答案仍然可以修改。这些界限指导着限制强化作为记录形式的学习规则；
