The induced response emerges below the spin-reorientation transition near 48 K, linking its enhancement to the reconstructed low-temperature electronic state. Theoretical calculations identify quantum-geometric contributions to the nonlinear conductivity and reproduce the observed response symmetry. These results demonstrate how strong higher-order nonlinearity can amplify an effective second-order response, providing a route to electrically tunable nonlinear transport in correlated materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 非线性电传输能够实现电磁信号的转换和检测，支持无线能量收集、传感和频率转换。实现大响应和电可调性仍然是材料的核心挑战。在这里，我们利用巨大的三阶非线性来放大和电控制相关极性金属 Ca3Ru2O7 中的二次谐波输运。在交流激励上叠加直流偏置可将二次谐波信号增强一个数量级以上。偏置控制感应响应的极性，并激活零偏置时对称性禁止的通道。横向和纵向分量都与交流激励成二次方关系，并且在直流偏置中是奇数，其角度依赖性与三阶电导率一致。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非线性电传输能够实现电磁信号的转换和检测，支持无线能量收集、传感和频率转换。实现大响应和电可调性仍然是材料的核心挑战。在这里，我们利用巨大的三阶非线性来放大和电控制相关极性金属 Ca3Ru2O7 中的二次谐波输运。在交流激励上叠加直流偏置可将二次谐波信号增强一个数量级以上。偏置控制感应响应的极性，并激活零偏置时对称性禁止的通道。横向和纵向分量都与交流激励成二次方关系，并且在直流偏置中是奇数，其角度依赖性与三阶电导率一致。基础三次谐波电场响应度在 3 K 时达到 4.5 × 10-6 m2V-2，提供了强非线性的定量测量。诱导响应出现在 48 K 附近的自旋重定向跃迁下方，将其增强与重建的低温电子态联系起来。理论计算确定了量子几何对非线性电导率的贡献，并重现了观察到的响应对称性。这些结果证明了高阶非线性可以如何放大有效的二阶响应，从而为相关材料中的电可调非线性输运提供了途径。

articles.title: Retention-constrained fine-tuning of a pre-trained aluminium MACE potential for non-equilibrium defect dynamics and plasticity
articles.title_zh: 针对非平衡缺陷动力学和塑性的预训练铝 MACE 电位的保留约束微调
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35653v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Adapting a pre-trained machine-learning interatomic potential for non-equilibrium defect dynamics and plasticity requires improving defect accuracy without degrading the near-equilibrium elastic and vibrational response. Here we achieve this balance for the aluminium MACE potential QP17 by integrating conditional readout uncertainty, iterative full-parameter updates and protocol-compatible relative-energy anchoring. Sensitivities over 144 linear readout weights guide acquisition, with within-batch covariance updates and evolving neural representations. After four active-learning rounds (32 acquired configurations and 400 gradient updates), force-uncertainty acquisition reduces mean development force error from 22.43 to 21.52 meV/Angstrom, outperforming random sampling (22.70), geometry-diversity selection (22.46) and uniform training across all 104 candidate labels (22.71) under the same update budget. All three force-uncertainty runs satisfy bulk-mechanical retention criteria: historical relative-energy error decreases from 0.375 to 0.207 meV/atom, while harmonic phonon root-mean-square drift remains below 0.05 THz. Matched objective ablations reveal that relative-energy anchoring suppresses harmonic drift. Out-of-sample evaluations across planar faults, twin boundaries and grain boundaries demonstrate transferable gains in defect energies and deviatoric stresses, even though virial stresses are never fitted. A closed-loop molecular dynamics and density functional theory (MD-DFT) pilot confirms that automated acceptance gating intercepts updates that violate historical elastic-group energy or vibrational tolerances. Together, these components establish a retention-constrained fine-tuning protocol for improving plastic-deformation observables while preserving the tested bulk mechanical response.
articles.abstract_zh: 针对非平衡缺陷动力学和塑性调整预先训练的机器学习原子间势需要在不降低近平衡弹性和振动响应的情况下提高缺陷精度。在这里，我们通过集成条件读数不确定性、迭代全参数更新和协议兼容的相对能量锚定来实现铝 MACE 势 QP17 的平衡。超过 144 个线性读出权重的灵敏度指导采集，并具有批内协方差更新和不断发展的神经表示。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 针对非平衡缺陷动力学和塑性调整预先训练的机器学习原子间势需要在不降低近平衡弹性和振动响应的情况下提高缺陷精度。在这里，我们通过集成条件读数不确定性、迭代全参数更新和协议兼容的相对能量锚定来实现铝 MACE 势 QP17 的平衡。超过 144 个线性读出权重的灵敏度指导采集，并具有批内协方差更新和不断发展的神经表示。经过四轮主动学习（32 次获取配置和 400 次梯度更新）后，力不确定性获取将平均开发力误差从 22.43 减少到 21.52 meV/Angstrom，在相同更新预算下优于随机采样 (22.70)、几何多样性选择 (22.46) 和所有 104 个候选标签 (22.71) 的统一训练。所有三个力不确定度运行都满足体机械保留标准：历史相对能量误差从 0.375 meV/atom 减少到 0.207 meV/atom，而谐波声子均方根漂移保持在 0.05 THz 以下。匹配的客观消融表明相对能量锚定抑制谐波漂移。跨平面断层、孪晶界和晶界的样本外评估表明，即使从未拟合维里应力，缺陷能量和偏应力也可转移。闭环分子动力学和密度泛函理论 (MD-DFT) 试验证实，自动接受门控会拦截违反历史弹性群能量或振动容差的更新。这些组件共同建立了一个保留约束的微调协议，用于改善塑性变形可观测值，同时保留测试的整体机械响应。

articles.title: Local Broadband Gigahertz Spectroscopy via SQUID-on-Tip DC Readout
articles.title_zh: 通过 SQUID-on-Tip DC 读数进行局部宽带千兆赫光谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35737v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Superconducting microwave circuits are shaped by their local electromagnetic environment, yet standard microwave measurements do not resolve the local fields and device features that govern their behavior. Here, we combine microwave spectroscopy, nanoscale magnetic sensing, and topographic imaging in a single tapping-mode SQUID-on-tip microscope. The nonlinear Josephson response converts local GHz excitations into Shapiro steps, enabling quantitative measurements of microwave frequency signals and their excitation strength using only DC readout. Applied to a superconducting coplanar waveguide resonator, local spectroscopy reproduces the power-dependent resonance and nonlinear bifurcation observed in microwave transmission measurements. Spatially resolved measurements map the microwave response while simultaneously recording topography and static magnetic features, including vortices and Meissner screening currents. Electromagnetic simulations reveal how coupling through the superconducting probe leads limits spatial resolution and guides localized detector designs. Together, these capabilities establish a platform for correlating microwave circuit dynamics with the local structural and magnetic environment of superconducting devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 超导微波电路由其局部电磁环境决定，但标准微波测量无法解析控制其行为的局部场和设备特征。在这里，我们将微波光谱、纳米级磁传感和形貌成像结合在单敲击模式尖端 SQUID 显微镜中。非线性约瑟夫森响应将局部 GHz 激励转换为夏皮罗阶跃，从而仅使用直流读数即可定量测量微波频率信号及其激励强度。应用于超导共面波导谐振器，局部光谱再现了微波传输测量中观察到的功率相关谐振和非线性分岔。空间分辨测量绘制微波响应图，同时记录地形和静磁特征，包括涡流和迈斯纳屏蔽电流。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 超导微波电路由其局部电磁环境决定，但标准微波测量无法解析控制其行为的局部场和设备特征。在这里，我们将微波光谱、纳米级磁传感和形貌成像结合在单敲击模式尖端 SQUID 显微镜中。非线性约瑟夫森响应将局部 GHz 激励转换为夏皮罗阶跃，从而仅使用直流读数即可定量测量微波频率信号及其激励强度。应用于超导共面波导谐振器，局部光谱再现了微波传输测量中观察到的功率相关谐振和非线性分岔。空间分辨测量绘制微波响应图，同时记录地形和静磁特征，包括涡流和迈斯纳屏蔽电流。电磁模拟揭示了通过超导探针引线的耦合如何限制空间分辨率并指导局部探测器设计。这些功能共同建立了一个平台，用于将微波电路动力学与超导器件的局部结构和磁性环境相关联。

articles.title: Growth Phase Map of α and beta Tantalum as a Function of Growth Temperature and Oxygen Partial Pressure
articles.title_zh: α 和 β 钽的生长相图作为生长温度和氧分压的函数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35768v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tantalum thin films are used in low-loss superconducting quantum circuits, yet the growth conditions governing selection of α-Ta(110), α-Ta(111), and metastable β-Ta on c-plane sapphire remain uncertain. We deposited 100 nm Ta films by dc magnetron sputtering on Al₂O₃(0001) at 300-900 ^circC while varying the O₂ partial pressure from a 5.5×10⁻¹¹ Torr ultrahigh-vacuum baseline to 2.23×10⁻⁴ Torr. Absorption-corrected X-ray diffraction texture coefficients were used to construct a ternary phase-orientation growth map in terms of temperature and the oxygen-to-Ta impingement flux ratio (2ΦO_₂/ΦTₐ≤4.8×10⁻⁶ to 19). Without added oxygen, α-Ta(110) dominated at every temperature. At an O₂ pressure of only 2.5×10⁻⁹ Torr (2ΦO_₂/ΦTₐ=2.2×10⁻⁴), α-Ta(111) accounted for 98-99% of the normalized texture weight from 300 to 700 ^circC, decreasing to 65% at 900 ^circC. Substantial β-Ta formed only at the highest oxygen dose, dominating at 300 ^circC and disappearing at 900 ^circC. The apparent β(001)/α(110) selection energy of 1.07±0.16 eV is comparable to the activation energy for oxygen diffusion in Ta, consistent with oxygen transport influencing phase selection. Oxygen also produced orientation-dependent changes in crystallite size and microstrain. These findings establish oxygen-controlled processing windows for phase- and orientation-selective growth of Ta films for superconducting devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 钽薄膜用于低损耗超导量子电路，但控制 c 面蓝宝石上 α-Ta(110)、α-Ta(111) 和亚稳态 β-Ta 的生长条件仍不确定。我们在 300-900 ^circC 温度下，通过直流磁控溅射在 Al2O3(0001) 上沉积 100 nm Ta 薄膜，同时将 O2 分压从 5.5×10⁻11 Torr 超高真空基线更改为 2.23×10⁻4 Torr。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 钽薄膜用于低损耗超导量子电路，但控制 c 面蓝宝石上 α-Ta(110)、α-Ta(111) 和亚稳态 β-Ta 的生长条件仍不确定。我们在 300-900 ^circC 温度下，通过直流磁控溅射在 Al2O3(0001) 上沉积 100 nm Ta 薄膜，同时将 O2 分压从 5.5×10⁻11 Torr 超高真空基线更改为 2.23×10⁻4 Torr。利用吸收校正的X射线衍射织构系数构建了温度和氧与Ta冲击通量比（2ΦO₂/ΦTₐ≤4.8×10 -6 至19）的三元相取向生长图。在不添加氧气的情况下，α-Ta(110) 在每个温度下都占主导地位。在 O2 压力仅为 2.5×10⁻⁹ Torr（2ΦO₂/ΦTₐ=2.2×10⁻⁴）时，α-Ta(111) 占归一化织构权重的 98-99%，从 300 到 700 ^circC，在 900 ^circC 时下降到 65%。大量的 β-Ta 仅在最高氧气剂量下形成，在 300 ^circC 时占主导地位，并在 900 ^circC 时消失。 1.07±0.16 eV 的表观 β(001)/α(110) 选择能与氧在 Ta 中扩散的活化能相当，与影响相选择的氧传输一致。氧气还会导致微晶尺寸和微应变发生方向相关的变化。这些发现为超导器件的 Ta 薄膜的相和取向选择性生长建立了氧控制处理窗口。

articles.title: The fate of s± superconductivity in the bilayer nickelate La₃Ni₂O₇
articles.title_zh: 双层镍盐La₃Ni2O₇中s±超导性的命运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35814v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Motivated by the recent measurement of high-temperature superconductivity in the bilayer nickelate system La₃Ni₂O₇ in the bulk as well as thin film samples, we seek to understand the role of the interlayer coupling in this system in dictating the pairing symmetry. Many proposals posit the existence of an s_± superconducting phase in close competition with the mroe conventional cuprate-like d-wave state in both weak- and strong-coupling theories. However, at least in the latter, the effects of Coulomb repulsion and the double occupancy constraint have been largely neglected. In this manuscript, we propose a mean-field fractionalization treatment that captures the full SU(2) particle-hole symmetry of the t-J model at half-filling, and show how a systematic treatment of this new symmetry leads to an added Coulomb pseudopotential constraint - one that is absent in the usual U(1) treatment. We then apply this new fractionalization scheme to a simplified bilayer t-J model of La₃Ni₂O₇, showing how the Coulomb pseudopotential suppresses the existence of s_± symmetry in favor of d-wave pairing.
articles.abstract_zh: 受最近在块体和薄膜样品中对双层镍酸盐系统 La₃Ni2O₇ 高温超导性的测量的启发，我们试图了解该系统中层间耦合在决定配对对称性方面的作用。许多提议都认为，在弱耦合和强耦合理论中，s_±超导相的存在与传统的类铜酸盐 d 波态存在密切竞争。然而，至少在后者中，库仑斥力和双人占用约束的影响在很大程度上被忽略了。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 受最近在块体和薄膜样品中对双层镍酸盐系统 La₃Ni2O₇ 高温超导性的测量的启发，我们试图了解该系统中层间耦合在决定配对对称性方面的作用。许多提议都认为，在弱耦合和强耦合理论中，s_±超导相的存在与传统的类铜酸盐 d 波态存在密切竞争。然而，至少在后者中，库仑斥力和双人占用约束的影响在很大程度上被忽略了。在这篇手稿中，我们提出了一种平均场分式处理，可以捕获半填充时 t-J 模型的完整 SU(2) 粒子空穴对称性，并展示对这种新对称性的系统处理如何导致增加的库仑赝势约束——通常的 U(1) 处理中不存在的库仑赝势约束。然后，我们将这种新的分级方案应用于 La₃Ni2O₇ 的简化双层 t-J 模型，显示库仑赝势如何抑制 s_± 对称性的存在，有利于 d 波配对。

articles.title: Collinear and Coplanar Altermagnetism in a Penrose Quasicrystal
articles.title_zh: 彭罗斯准晶体中的共线和共面交变磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35855v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We generalize the previous group-theory based classification of collinear magnetism in the quasicrystal (QC) to general magnetic states. Taking the Penrose lattice as an example, we find that all magnetic states belonging to 2D irreducible representations (IRRPs) of the D₅ point group, including collinear states and coplanar ones, correspond to altermagnetism (AM). Unlike conventional collinear AM wherein zero magnetism is protected by, e.g. rotation or mirror reflection, which globally flip the spin in the magnetic pattern, the zero magnetism in these 2D-IRRP states is instead protected by a special group-theory-orthogonality theorem that basis functions belonging to different IRRPs are always mutually orthogonal. Taking the single-orbital Penrose-Hubbard as an example, our linear-response theory based calculations show that the largest portion of the parameter space is occupied by these 2D-IRRP states, and our further Ginzburg-Landau theory based analysis reveals that the polarization directions of the two basis magnetic states in the 2D IRRPs can be either parallel or perpendicular, leading to collinear or coplanar magnetic states. The special group-theory-orthogonality compensation mechanism and the absence of the PT symmetry finally leads to AM states, which are to be verified by the spin split in the spin-dependent angle-resolved-photoemission-spectrum and the spin conductance. These intriguing collinear and coplanar AM can also emerge in other QCs.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们将先前基于群论的准晶体（QC）共线磁性分类推广到一般磁态。以彭罗斯晶格为例，我们发现所有属于D₅点群的二维不可约表示（IRRP）的磁态，包括共线态和共面态，都对应于交变磁性（AM）。与传统的共线 AM 不同，其中零磁性受到保护，例如旋转或镜面反射会全局翻转磁性图案中的自旋，这些 2D-IRRP 状态中的零磁性反而受到特殊群论正交定理的保护，该定理属于不同 IRRP 的基函数始终相互正交。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们将先前基于群论的准晶体（QC）共线磁性分类推广到一般磁态。以彭罗斯晶格为例，我们发现所有属于D₅点群的二维不可约表示（IRRP）的磁态，包括共线态和共面态，都对应于交变磁性（AM）。与传统的共线 AM 不同，其中零磁性受到保护，例如旋转或镜面反射会全局翻转磁性图案中的自旋，这些 2D-IRRP 状态中的零磁性反而受到特殊群论正交定理的保护，该定理属于不同 IRRP 的基函数始终相互正交。以单轨道彭罗斯-哈伯德为例，我们基于线性响应理论的计算表明，参数空间的最大部分被这些2D-IRRP态占据，并且我们进一步基于Ginzburg-Landau理论的分析表明，2D IRRP中两个基本磁态的极化方向可以是平行或垂直的，从而导致共线或共面磁态。特殊的群论正交性补偿机制和PT对称性的缺失最终导致AM态，这将通过自旋相关角分辨光电子能谱中的自旋分裂和自旋电导来验证。这些有趣的共线和共面 AM 也可以出现在其他 QC 中。

articles.title: Study of localization properties under subsystem periodic driving
articles.title_zh: 子系统周期驱动下的定位特性研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33189v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Periodic driving provides a powerful route for controlling localization and engineering effective Hamiltonians in quantum systems. A localized one-dimensional Aubry-André chain can be driven into a fully delocalized phase when the entire system is driven below a critical frequency. Here, we ask whether such delocalization can be achieved by driving only a part of the system. We address this question using a two-leg ladder comprising an Aubry-André chain coupled to a periodically driven clean tight-binding chain. Exact numerical calculations show that, starting from a localized static ladder, subsystem driving below a critical frequency cannot achieve complete delocalization. Instead, a mixed phase emerges, with localized and delocalized states coexisting and the fraction of delocalized states varying nonmonotonically with the driving frequency. This behavior can be understood using local effective Hamiltonians. Although these effective Hamiltonians are derived analytically in the high-frequency regime, they can nevertheless predict the localization transition occurring in the moderate-frequency regime. In fact, by quantifying the emergent nonlocality of the Floquet Hamiltonian, we show that these effective Hamiltonians provide a valid description up to a crossover frequency that is lower than the critical frequency associated with the localization transition. Our results demonstrate an alternative route to Floquet engineering, in which the transport properties of a quantum lattice system can be modified by driving only a subsystem.
articles.abstract_zh: 周期性驱动为控制量子系统中的局域化和设计有效的哈密顿量提供了强大的途径。当整个系统被驱动到低于临界频率时，局域一维奥布里-安德烈链可以被驱动进入完全离域阶段。在这里，我们询问是否可以通过仅驱动系统的一部分来实现这种离域化。我们使用两腿梯子来解决这个问题，该梯子包括奥布里-安德烈链和周期性驱动的清洁紧束缚链。精确的数值计算表明，从局部静态阶梯开始，低于临界频率驱动的子系统无法实现完全离域。相反，出现了混合相，局域和离域状态共存，并且离域状态的比例随驱动频率非单调变化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 周期性驱动为控制量子系统中的局域化和设计有效的哈密顿量提供了强大的途径。当整个系统被驱动到低于临界频率时，局域一维奥布里-安德烈链可以被驱动进入完全离域阶段。在这里，我们询问是否可以通过仅驱动系统的一部分来实现这种离域化。我们使用两腿梯子来解决这个问题，该梯子包括奥布里-安德烈链和周期性驱动的清洁紧束缚链。精确的数值计算表明，从局部静态阶梯开始，低于临界频率驱动的子系统无法实现完全离域。相反，出现了混合相，局域和离域状态共存，并且离域状态的比例随驱动频率非单调变化。这种行为可以使用局部有效哈密顿量来理解。尽管这些有效的哈密顿量是在高频区域中分析得出的，但它们仍然可以预测在中频率区域中发生的局域化转变。事实上，通过量化 Floquet 哈密顿量的新兴非定域性，我们表明这些有效的哈密顿量提供了低于与局域化转变相关的临界频率的交叉频率的有效描述。我们的结果展示了 Floquet 工程的另一种途径，其中量子晶格系统的传输特性可以通过仅驱动子系统来修改。

articles.title: Autonomous atomistic-continuum coupling through uncertainty-aware active learning
articles.title_zh: 通过不确定性感知主动学习实现自主原子连续耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33272v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We develop an uncertainty-aware surrogate modeling approach for coupling an atomistic kinetic Monte Carlo (KMC) surface-chemistry solver with a continuum multi-species fluid dynamics solver across disparate physical length and time scales. The surrogate model predicts boundary mass fluxes for six species and their uncertainties, which the continuum solver monitors to automatically trigger additional KMC simulations when new training data are needed. This enables efficient multiscale coupling and maintains a user-specified level of accuracy. We demonstrate the approach for reactive halide-perovskite vapor deposition, which involves a multi-species vapor jet impinging on a reactive substrate. The KMC solver uses a DFT-calibrated energetics model that we construct as part of this work and provides net deposition and desorption rates for six species. With a conservative uncertainty threshold, the surrogate-coupled approach reproduces cumulative mass fluxes of the directly coupled approach with errors typically within 10-20%, while capturing the non-monotonic dependence of net deposition on species partial pressure. Importantly, the results show that detailed crystal structure need not be explicitly represented to predict quantities exchanged between atomistic and continuum solvers; species-resolved mass fluxes provide a sufficiently low-dimensional representation of the atomistic response. For this accuracy target, the autonomous online-learning approach reduces the number of required atomistic simulations by two to three orders of magnitude relative to direct multiscale coupling.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们开发了一种不确定性感知代理建模方法，用于将原子动力学蒙特卡罗（KMC）表面化学求解器与跨不同物理长度和时间尺度的连续多物种流体动力学求解器耦合。替代模型预测六种物质的边界质量通量及其不确定性，连续介质求解器会对其进行监控，以便在需要新的训练数据时自动触发额外的 KMC 模拟。这可以实现高效的多尺度耦合并保持用户指定的精度水平。我们演示了反应性卤化物-钙钛矿气相沉积方法，该方法涉及多物质蒸气射流撞击反应性基材。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们开发了一种不确定性感知代理建模方法，用于将原子动力学蒙特卡罗（KMC）表面化学求解器与跨不同物理长度和时间尺度的连续多物种流体动力学求解器耦合。替代模型预测六种物质的边界质量通量及其不确定性，连续介质求解器会对其进行监控，以便在需要新的训练数据时自动触发额外的 KMC 模拟。这可以实现高效的多尺度耦合并保持用户指定的精度水平。我们演示了反应性卤化物-钙钛矿气相沉积方法，该方法涉及多物质蒸气射流撞击反应性基材。 KMC 求解器使用我们在这项工作中构建的 DFT 校准能量学模型，并提供六种物质的净沉积和解吸速率。在保守的不确定性阈值下，替代耦合方法再现了直接耦合方法的累积质量通量，误差通常在 10-20% 之内，同时捕获了净沉积对物质分压的非单调依赖性。重要的是，结果表明，不需要明确表示详细的晶体结构来预测原子解算器和连续解算器之间交换的量；物种分辨的质量通量提供了原子响应的足够低维的表示。对于这个精度目标，自主在线学习方法相对于直接多尺度耦合将所需的原子模拟数量减少了两到三个数量级。

articles.title: Ubiquity of ocular resonances in scattering phenomena
articles.title_zh: 散射现象中普遍存在眼共振
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33319v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We demonstrate how quantum mechanical scattering off a potential with a characteristic surface generically leads to a family of resonances in the complex momentum plane clustered near a roughly eye-shaped curve centered on the origin and formed by anti-Stokes lines. A particularly interesting class are potentials that are more singular than 1/r² at short distance, where the scattering surface is the separatrix between captured and deflected classical trajectories. These resonances have been recently shown to play an important role in low energy nucleon scattering, and can be related to ``creeping waves'' familiar from classical diffractive scattering and analyzed by means of Regge poles.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们演示了具有特征表面的势的量子力学散射通常如何导致复杂动量平面中的一系列共振，这些共振聚集在以原点为中心并由反斯托克斯线形成的大致眼形曲线附近。一个特别有趣的类别是在短距离上比 1/r² 更奇异的势，其中散射表面是捕获的经典轨迹和偏转的经典轨迹之间的分界线。这些共振最近被证明在低能核子散射中发挥着重要作用，并且可以与经典衍射散射中熟悉的“爬行波”相关，并通过雷格极点进行分析。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们演示了具有特征表面的势的量子力学散射通常如何导致复杂动量平面中的一系列共振，这些共振聚集在以原点为中心并由反斯托克斯线形成的大致眼形曲线附近。一个特别有趣的类别是在短距离上比 1/r² 更奇异的势，其中散射表面是捕获的经典轨迹和偏转的经典轨迹之间的分界线。这些共振最近被证明在低能核子散射中发挥着重要作用，并且可以与经典衍射散射中熟悉的“爬行波”相关，并通过雷格极点进行分析。

articles.title: A neural accelerated surface-roughness-based Discrete Element Method (SR-DEM) for modeling granular systems
articles.title_zh: 用于建模颗粒系统的基于神经加速表面粗糙度的离散元方法 (SR-DEM)
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33363v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The Discrete Element Method (DEM) is an indispensable tool for modeling and understanding the basic mechanical behaviors of (dry) granular media, a class of disordered material systems of significant interest to multiple scientific domains from (geo-)physics to (chemical) engineering. At the core of all present DEM frameworks is a phenomenological friction law--commonly chosen to be of the Amontons-Coulomb type--that models the frictional interaction among constituent grains. Here, inspired by research in the tribology community, we present an alternative, fundamentally different framework, termed surface-roughness-based DEM (SR-DEM), in which contact friction is handled in a more physics-based manner. In this framework, instead of using a friction law, we explicitly resolve the surface topography of each grain and let friction emerge from collective frictionless interactions of surface asperities. In essence, we trade phenomenology for physics at the cost of an increased computational demand. To mitigate the cost, we introduce an FE²-like algorithm and a feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM)-based neural network surrogate, both of which are parallelized on GPU to accelerate contact computation. Crucially, using this framework in 2D, we (1) demonstrate the possibility of recovering a two-body-based Amontons-Coulomb-type friction behavior using a simple representation of surface topography, and (2) identify many-body-based frictional behaviors--more specifically, the angle of repose values--that cannot always be captured by current DEM frameworks under the same level of model complexity. We conclude by discussing future directions for SR-DEM, as well as exciting new opportunities it could unlock for a wide range of emerging applications, including (designing) suspension rheology and metamaterial mechanics.
articles.abstract_zh: 离散元法 (DEM) 是建模和理解（干）颗粒介质基本力学行为不可或缺的工具，颗粒介质是一类无序材料系统，对（地球）物理到（化学）工程等多个科学领域具有重要意义。所有现有 DEM 框架的核心是唯象摩擦定律（通常选择阿蒙顿-库仑类型），用于模拟组成颗粒之间的摩擦相互作用。在这里，受到摩擦学界研究的启发，我们提出了一种完全不同的替代框架，称为基于表面粗糙度的 DEM (SR-DEM)，其中接触摩擦以更基于物理的方式处理。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 离散元法 (DEM) 是建模和理解（干）颗粒介质基本力学行为不可或缺的工具，颗粒介质是一类无序材料系统，对（地球）物理到（化学）工程等多个科学领域具有重要意义。所有现有 DEM 框架的核心是唯象摩擦定律（通常选择阿蒙顿-库仑类型），用于模拟组成颗粒之间的摩擦相互作用。在这里，受到摩擦学界研究的启发，我们提出了一种完全不同的替代框架，称为基于表面粗糙度的 DEM (SR-DEM)，其中接触摩擦以更基于物理的方式处理。在这个框架中，我们不使用摩擦定律，而是明确地解析每个颗粒的表面形貌，并让摩擦从表面粗糙体的集体无摩擦相互作用中产生。本质上，我们用现象学换取物理学，但代价是计算需求的增加。为了降低成本，我们引入了类似 FE² 的算法和基于特征线性调制 (FiLM) 的神经网络代理，两者都在 GPU 上并行化以加速接触计算。至关重要的是，在 2D 中使用该框架，我们 (1) 证明了使用表面形貌的简单表示来恢复基于两体的阿蒙顿-库仑型摩擦行为的可能性，以及 (2) 识别基于多体的摩擦行为（更具体地说，是休止角值），而当前的 DEM 框架在模型复杂度相同的情况下无法始终捕获这些行为。最后，我们讨论了 SR-DEM 的未来方向，以及它可以为各种新兴应用带来的令人兴奋的新机遇，包括（设计）悬浮流变学和超材料力学。

articles.title: Path space large deviation on a lattice for interacting particle systems
articles.title_zh: 相互作用粒子系统的晶格上的路径空间大偏差
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33524v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate the path space large deviation principle (LDP) for a class of interacting particle systems on a fixed finite discrete torus. As an illustrative example, we use the partial exclusion process with maximal occupation of s particles. We first verify the standard Kurtz-type law of large numbers for the original and tilted processes, thereby identifying the deterministic flows around which the large deviations are formulated. We then establish the path space LDP, with speed s, and identify the associated rate function in variational form as the Legendre transform of a nonlinear Hamiltonian. The proof relies on martingale techniques, exponential tightness, and a change-of-measure argument based on exponential tilting, which renders atypical trajectories typical under a modified dynamics. We also explain how the same strategy extends to further interacting particle systems. The inclusion process illustrates the conservative non-compact finite-jump case. The harmonic process is qualitatively different: a single transition may move a variable number of particles, and the limiting Hamiltonian is logarithmic with a non-trivial domain. This places the harmonic process outside the usual finite-reaction framework for density-dependent Markov jump processes. Finally, we discuss continuous-state energy-exchange models, such as the Brownian energy process and an integrable heat-conduction model, to indicate how the same Hamiltonian large-deviation formalism appears beyond discrete-state particle systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了固定有限离散环上一类相互作用粒子系统的路径空间大偏差原理（LDP）。作为说明性示例，我们使用最大占用 s 粒子的部分排除过程。我们首先验证原始过程和倾斜过程的标准库尔兹型大数定律，从而识别出大偏差所围绕的确定性流。然后，我们建立速度为 s 的路径空间 LDP，并将变分形式的相关速率函数识别为非线性哈密顿量的勒让德变换。该证明依赖于鞅技术、指数紧度和基于指数倾斜的测量参数变化，这使得非典型轨迹在修改后的动力学下变得典型。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了固定有限离散环上一类相互作用粒子系统的路径空间大偏差原理（LDP）。作为说明性示例，我们使用最大占用 s 粒子的部分排除过程。我们首先验证原始过程和倾斜过程的标准库尔兹型大数定律，从而识别出大偏差所围绕的确定性流。然后，我们建立速度为 s 的路径空间 LDP，并将变分形式的相关速率函数识别为非线性哈密顿量的勒让德变换。该证明依赖于鞅技术、指数紧度和基于指数倾斜的测量参数变化，这使得非典型轨迹在修改后的动力学下变得典型。我们还解释了相同的策略如何扩展到进一步相互作用的粒子系统。包含过程说明了保守的非紧凑有限跳跃情况。调和过程在本质上是不同的：单个跃迁可以移动可变数量的粒子，并且极限哈密顿量是具有非平凡域的对数。这将调和过程置于密度相关马尔可夫跳跃过程的通常有限反应框架之外。最后，我们讨论连续状态能量交换模型，例如布朗能量过程和可积热传导模型，以表明相同的哈密顿大偏差形式主义如何出现在离散状态粒子系统之外。

articles.title: Axion Quasibound States in the Continuum and Their Enhanced Axion Nonlinearity
articles.title_zh: 连续体中的轴子准束缚态及其增强的轴子非线性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34195v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Dynamical axion quasiparticles (DAQs) in condensed-matter systmes have emerged as a fascinating platform for exploring axion physics and nonlinear optical phenomena. However, the amplitude of the coherent oscillating θ field is even smaller than that of the static counterpart, making the experimental observation of DAQs particularly challenging. Here, we introduce symmetry-sensitive bound states in the continuum (BICs) physics to enable the all-optical detection of DAQs and enhance DAQ-mediated second-harmonic generation (SHG). Specifically, we uncover that DAQs induce optical shear that breaks the C₂z symmetry of metagratings without geometric engineering, thereby converting symmetry-protected BICs into axion quasi-BICs (qBICs). In this context, the evolution of the quality factor and topological charge in momentum space, together with the appearance of optical resonances in far field associated with axion qBICs, offers achiral optical signatures for DAQ detection beyond the widely used Kerr and Faraday effects. Furthermore, by exploiting axion qBICs in the critical coupling regime to enhance fundamental optical field, we show that the SHG efficiency can be enhanced more than 10⁵-fold compared to bulk axion materials, achieving a conversion efficiency exceeding 10⁻⁶~W⁻¹. The SHG is governed by the magnetoelectric coupling, which differs from that in conventional SHG materials. Our findings establish a new approach for probing DAQs via achiral optical effects, while providing a versatile route for reconfigurable photonics and terahertz nonlinear optics.
articles.abstract_zh: 凝聚态系统中的动态轴子准粒子（DAQ）已成为探索轴子物理和非线性光学现象的迷人平台。然而，相干振荡 θ 场的振幅甚至比静态对应物的振幅还要小，这使得 DAQ 的实验观察特别具有挑战性。在这里，我们在连续介质 (BIC) 物理中引入对称敏感束缚态，以实现 DAQ 的全光学检测并增强 DAQ 介导的二次谐波生成 (SHG)。具体来说，我们发现 DAQ 会产生光学剪切，无需几何工程即可打破元光栅的 C2z 对称性，从而将对称保护的 BIC 转换为轴子准 BIC（qBIC）。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 凝聚态系统中的动态轴子准粒子（DAQ）已成为探索轴子物理和非线性光学现象的迷人平台。然而，相干振荡 θ 场的振幅甚至比静态对应物的振幅还要小，这使得 DAQ 的实验观察特别具有挑战性。在这里，我们在连续介质 (BIC) 物理中引入对称敏感束缚态，以实现 DAQ 的全光学检测并增强 DAQ 介导的二次谐波生成 (SHG)。具体来说，我们发现 DAQ 会产生光学剪切，无需几何工程即可打破元光栅的 C2z 对称性，从而将对称保护的 BIC 转换为轴子准 BIC（qBIC）。在这种情况下，动量空间中品质因数和拓扑电荷的演变，以及与轴子 qBIC 相关的远场光学共振的出现，为 DAQ 检测提供了超越广泛使用的克尔和法拉第效应的非手性光学特征。此外，通过在临界耦合状态下利用轴子qBIC来增强基本光场，我们发现与块状轴子材料相比，SHG效率可以提高10⁵倍以上，实现超过10⁻⁶~W⁻1的转换效率。二次谐波由磁电耦合控制，这与传统二次谐波材料不同。我们的研究结果建立了一种通过非手性光学效应探测 DAQ 的新方法，同时为可重构光子学和太赫兹非线性光学提供了通用途径。

articles.title: MatOS: An Agent Operating System for Materials Research
articles.title_zh: MatOS ：一种用于材料研究的代理操作系统
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34203v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Materials research relies on scattered and growing data, knowledge, and simulation tools, and a single study often spans multi-day workflows across literature analysis, computation, and experiment. Large language model agents can now retrieve materials data, operate simulation codes, and close design-synthesis-characterization loops with autonomous laboratories. However, extending these agents with new capabilities, keeping long-running tasks on track, and letting them learn from past tasks and user feedback remain difficult. Here we present MatOS, an agent operating system for materials research with three core components: (1) a layered scientific asset graph that organizes data, knowledge, tools, skills, roles, and workflows as reusable assets; (2) a stateful adaptive workflow that runs tasks as explicit execution graphs with scientific checks, so that they can be resumed and traced; and (3) evidence-driven asset evolution, which revises these assets from execution records and user feedback. On ResearchClawBench, MatOS improves on the previously best-performing agent by 11.15% with the same base model and extends the cost-score Pareto frontier. With a common base model, it outperforms Codex CLI and Claude Code, exceeding Codex CLI by 2.13% on MatTools and 4.17% on SciAgentGym. In eight research cases, MatOS narrowed more than 30 million candidate structures to 97 solid-electrolyte candidates, identified 89 halide variants with higher computed conductivity than their parent structures, linked the force errors of 11 pretrained interatomic potentials to local atomic environments, and supported two new methods that reduce errors by 3.1% and 13.6% relative to their baselines. These results show that organizing research capabilities as reusable, evolving assets enables agents to carry out long, multistage materials studies. Code is available at https://github.com/DingyangLyu/MatOS.

articles.abstract_zh_full: 材料研究依赖于分散且不断增长的数据、知识和模拟工具，一项研究通常跨越文献分析、计算和实验等多天的工作流程。大型语言模型代理现在可以检索材料数据，操作模拟代码，并与自主实验室关闭设计-合成-表征循环。然而，用新功能扩展这些代理、让长时间运行的任务保持在正轨上并让它们从过去的任务和用户反馈中学习仍然很困难。在这里，我们介绍 MatOS，一个用于材料研究的代理操作系统，具有三个核心组件：（1）分层科学资产图，将数据、知识、工具、技能、角色和工作流程组织为可重用资产； （2）有状态的自适应工作流程，将任务作为具有科学检查的显式执行图来运行，以便可以恢复和跟踪它们； (3) 证据驱动的资产演变，根据执行记录和用户反馈修改这些资产。在 ResearchClawBench 上，MatOS 使用相同的基础模型比之前表现最佳的智能体提高了 11.15%，并扩展了成本分数 Pareto 前沿。凭借通用的基础模型，它的性能优于 Codex CLI 和 Claude Code，在 MatTools 上超过 Codex CLI 2.13%，在 SciAgentGym 上超过 Codex CLI 4.17%。在 8 个研究案例中，MatOS 将超过 3000 万个候选结构缩小为 97 个固体电解质候选，识别了 89 个卤化物变体，其计算电导率高于其母体结构，将 11 个预训练原子间势的力误差与局部原子环境联系起来，并支持两种新方法，相对于其基线，误差分别减少了 3.1% 和 13.6%。这些结果表明，将研究能力组织为可重复使用、不断发展的资产，使代理商能够进行长期、多阶段的材料研究。代码可在 https://github.com/DingyangLyu/MatOS 获取。

articles.title: kstress: a LAMMPS package for calculating the 2D wavevector-dependent stress tensor and its anisotropy in amorphous solids
articles.title_zh: kstress：用于计算非晶固体中二维波矢相关应力张量及其各向异性的 LAMMPS 软件包
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34206v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The stress tensor resolved in wavevector qvec and time t, σαβ(qvec,t), gives access to the elastic moduli of amorphous solids as a function of the probed length scale, and to the long-range stress correlations that distinguish an amorphous solid from a liquid. Its evaluation requires the contribution of every interacting pair and therefore an interface to the force loop of the molecular dynamics code. In the current work, we present: i) an optimized implementation of the LAMMPS~citelammps module for calculating σαβ(qvec,t), in which trigonometric functions are calculated only for the basic wavevectors and, in addition, all the relevant wavevectors are supplied as an explicit list rather than generated as a full grid, so that only the wavevectors of interest are computed and stored, and ii) a validation protocol for the code illustrated for a two-dimensional polydisperse Lennard-Jones (2DpLJ) glass-forming liquid. Based on these technical achievements we elucidated how the affine moduli for the 2DpLJ model depend on the norm q of the wavevector. In particular, we demonstrate that the longitudinal affine modulus shows a minimum near q_max corresponding to the main peak of the structure factor. Our data also point to the peaks in the q-dependencies of vibrational frequencies well below q_max for both transverse and longitudinal modes. The potential relevance of this feature to the ``boson peak'' is discussed as well.
articles.abstract_zh: 以波矢量 qvec 和时间 t 解析的应力张量 σαβ(qvec,t) 可以获取作为探测长度尺度函数的非晶固体弹性模量，以及区分非晶固体和液体的长程应力相关性。它的评估需要每个相互作用对的贡献，因此需要与分子动力学代码的力环的接口。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 以波矢量 qvec 和时间 t 解析的应力张量 σαβ(qvec,t) 可以获取作为探测长度尺度函数的非晶固体弹性模量，以及区分非晶固体和液体的长程应力相关性。它的评估需要每个相互作用对的贡献，因此需要与分子动力学代码的力环的接口。在当前的工作中，我们提出：i）用于计算 σαβ（qvec，t） 的 LAMMPS~citelammps 模块的优化实现，其中仅计算基本波矢量的三角函数，此外，所有相关波矢量都作为显式列表提供，而不是作为完整网格生成，以便仅计算和存储感兴趣的波矢量，以及 ii）二维多分散 Lennard-Jones 所示代码的验证协议(2DpLJ) 玻璃形成液体。基于这些技术成果，我们阐明了 2DpLJ 模型的仿射模量如何取决于波矢的范数 q。特别是，我们证明纵向仿射模量在与结构因子主峰相对应的 q_max 附近显示出最小值。我们的数据还表明，横向和纵向模式的振动频率的 q 依赖性峰值远低于 q_max。还讨论了该特征与“玻色子峰”的潜在相关性。

articles.title: Boundary-condition independence of infinite-chain ground states in the S=1 J-D antiferromagnetic chain
articles.title_zh: S=1 J-D 反铁磁链中无限链基态的边界条件独立性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34330v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Extending the analytic machinery and using the numerical inputs from OpenAI's proofs of the Haldane gap, we study infinite-chain ground states of the S=1 J-D antiferromagnetic model H=sumⱼ{boldsymbol Sⱼ·boldsymbol Sⱼ₊₁+D(Sⱼmathrm z)²} for sufficiently small |D|. We consider two finite-volume settings: periodic chains with an even number of sites, and open chains with an odd number of sites and the same positive magnetic field in the mathrm z direction at both endpoints. We prove that the ground states in each setting have an infinite-chain limit along the full sequence, without passing to a subsequence, and that the two limiting states coincide. Convergence is uniform in D on a fixed neighborhood of zero. The common limit is a symmetric locally-unique gapped ground state, and its local expectation values depend continuously on D. These conclusions concern the two specified constructions, not uniqueness among all infinite-chain ground states. They provide the input for the study of a topological phase transition in a forthcoming revision of our companion paper. The author formulated the problem and proposed the basic strategy. ChatGPT Astra made substantial contributions to the inductive estimates and to completing the proof.
articles.abstract_zh: 扩展解析机械，并使用OpenAI的Haldane间隙证明的数值输入，我们研究了足够小的| D |的S = 1 J-D反铁磁模型H = sumbₒₗdₛyₘbₒₗ S_· bₒₗdₛyₘbₒₗ S_₊ D ₍S_ₘₐₜₕᵣₘ z₎_²的无限链基态。我们考虑两个有限体积设置：具有偶数个位点的周期链，以及在两个端点的mathrm z方向上具有奇数个位点和相同正磁场的开放链。我们证明了每个设置中的基态沿着整个序列具有无限链极限，而不传递给子序列，并且两个极限状态重合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 扩展解析机械，并使用OpenAI的Haldane间隙证明的数值输入，我们研究了足够小的| D |的S = 1 J-D反铁磁模型H = sumbₒₗdₛyₘbₒₗ S_· bₒₗdₛyₘbₒₗ S_₊ D ₍S_ₘₐₜₕᵣₘ z₎_²的无限链基态。我们考虑两个有限体积设置：具有偶数个位点的周期链，以及在两个端点的mathrm z方向上具有奇数个位点和相同正磁场的开放链。我们证明了每个设置中的基态沿着整个序列具有无限链极限，而不传递给子序列，并且两个极限状态重合。在零的固定邻域上，收敛在D中是均匀的。公共极限是对称局部唯一间隙基态，其局部期望值连续依赖于D。这些结论涉及两个指定的构造，而不是所有无限链基态之间的唯一性。它们为我们即将出版的伴随论文的拓扑相变研究提供了投入。笔者制定了问题，并提出了基本策略。ChatGPT Astra为归纳估计和完成证明做出了重大贡献。

articles.title: Wave Is All You Need: A Quantum Language Model Based on Fully Connected Quantum Boltzmann Machine
articles.title_zh: Wave 就是你所需要的：基于全连接量子玻尔兹曼机的量子语言模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34492v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This work proposes a self-attention mechanism based on the fully connected quantum Boltzmann machine (FC-QBM), and further constructs a fully connected quantum Boltzmann machine language model (FC-QBM-LM) using the mechanism as the core engine. By performing unitary evolution on semantic quantum states, the mechanism implicitly implements positional encoding and self-attention computation, eliminating the need to decompose continuous semantic streams into discrete matrices for explicit matrix multiplication, with the measurement results naturally satisfying the normalization condition. Specifically, this work rigorously derives the computational principle of the self-attention mechanism based on FC-QBM, and demonstrates that this mechanism is mathematically equivalent to the classical self-attention mechanism. The mathematical principles governing the training and generation of FC-QBM-LM are thoroughly derived, and the two corresponding algorithms are subsequently developed. An 8-qubit FC-QBM-LM is finally constructed and trained on the corpus of Tang poetry. Under the 8-qubit setting, the quantum layer implements the entire positional encoding and self-attention computation pipeline with only 44 parameters. In the noiseless scenario, the model exhibits favorable convergence. Furthermore, the quantum circuit proposed in this work, which terminates with Y-axis rotation gates, achieves better convergence than the counterpart terminating with X-axis rotation gates. Under the small-sample regime and across eight distinct noise intensity levels, the model demonstrates strong noise robustness, retaining over 99% of its noiseless convergence performance. Experiments on five-character quatrain generation reveal that the model preliminarily exhibits three core capabilities: associative and divergent thinking, content generation across imagery and human-aligned word ordering.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于全连接量子玻尔兹曼机（ FC-QBM ）的自注意机制，并以该机制为核心引擎，进一步构建了全连接量子玻尔兹曼机语言模型（ FC-QBM-LM ）。该机制通过对语义量子态进行单一进化，隐式实现位置编码和自注意力计算，无需将连续语义流分解为离散矩阵进行显式矩阵乘法，测量结果自然满足归一化条件。具体地说，本工作严格推导了基于FC-QBM的自我注意机制的计算原理，并证明了该机制在数学上等价于经典的自我注意机制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文提出了一种基于全连接量子玻尔兹曼机（ FC-QBM ）的自注意机制，并以该机制为核心引擎，进一步构建了全连接量子玻尔兹曼机语言模型（ FC-QBM-LM ）。该机制通过对语义量子态进行单一进化，隐式实现位置编码和自注意力计算，无需将连续语义流分解为离散矩阵进行显式矩阵乘法，测量结果自然满足归一化条件。具体地说，本工作严格推导了基于FC-QBM的自我注意机制的计算原理，并证明了该机制在数学上等价于经典的自我注意机制。详细推导了FC-QBM-LM训练和生成的数学原理，并随后开发了两种相应的算法。最终在唐诗语料库上构建并训练了一个8量子比特的FC-QBM-LM。在8量子位设置下，量子层仅用44个参数实现整个位置编码和自注意力计算流水线。在无噪声场景下，模型表现出良好的收敛性。此外，本文提出的以Y轴旋转栅极终止的量子电路比以X轴旋转栅极终止的量子电路具有更好的收敛性。在小样本状态下，在八个不同的噪声强度水平上，该模型表现出强大的噪声鲁棒性，保留了99%以上的无噪声收敛性能。五字四列生成实验表明，该模型初步表现出三种核心能力：联想和发散思维、跨图像的内容生成和人类对齐的单词排序。

articles.title: Physical Adjoint Learning in Wave Systems with Asymmetric Couplings
articles.title_zh: 具有非对称耦合的波浪系统中的物理伴随学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34815v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Developing self-optimizing physical systems that learn directly from their response to external stimuli offers a promising route toward adaptive and intelligent machines. A key ingredient is the ability to evaluate optimization gradients within the physical hardware, bypassing the need for accurate numerical models. In wave systems, in-situ adjoint methods provide this capability by exploiting reciprocity to physically realize the adjoint dynamics. However, this approach generally breaks down in nonreciprocal systems, where the adjoint field cannot be directly accessed through the original device. Here, we develop an in-situ adjoint optimization framework that extends physical gradient computation to wave systems with asymmetric couplings through computationally low-cost similarity transformations between the forward and transposed operators. We utilize available degrees of freedom like tailored injected excitations, targeted measurements, and tunable parameters, to enable adjoint field reconstruction through forward experiments on the same physical platform. We demonstrate the versatility of the protocol through broadband transmission and isolation, coherent perfect absorption, programmable wavefront shaping, and spatially selective sensing. Our results provide a route to self-optimization in complex nonreciprocal wave systems through efficient physical gradient-based learning. The number of experiments required by the protocol does not increase with the number of optimization parameters, and the method remains applicable even when parts of the system are completely inaccessible.
articles.abstract_zh: 开发能够直接从对外部刺激的反应中学习的自我优化物理系统，为自适应和智能机器提供了一条有希望的途径。一个关键因素是能够在物理硬件内评估优化梯度，而无需精确的数值模型。在波浪系统中，原位伴随方法通过利用互易性来物理地实现伴随动力学来提供这种能力。然而，这种方法在非互易系统中通常会失效，其中不能通过原始设备直接访问伴随场。在这里，我们开发了一个原位伴随优化框架，通过正演算子和转置算子之间的计算低成本相似性转换，将物理梯度计算扩展到具有非对称耦合的波浪系统。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 开发能够直接从对外部刺激的反应中学习的自我优化物理系统，为自适应和智能机器提供了一条有希望的途径。一个关键因素是能够在物理硬件内评估优化梯度，而无需精确的数值模型。在波浪系统中，原位伴随方法通过利用互易性来物理地实现伴随动力学来提供这种能力。然而，这种方法在非互易系统中通常会失效，其中不能通过原始设备直接访问伴随场。在这里，我们开发了一个原位伴随优化框架，通过正演算子和转置算子之间的计算低成本相似性转换，将物理梯度计算扩展到具有非对称耦合的波浪系统。我们利用定制的注入激励、有针对性的测量和可调参数等可用的自由度，通过在同一物理平台上的正向实验实现伴随场重建。我们通过宽带传输和隔离、相干完美吸收、可编程波前整形和空间选择性传感证明了该协议的多功能性。我们的研究结果通过有效的基于物理梯度的学习，为复杂非互易波动系统中的自我优化提供了一条途径。方案所需的实验数量不会随着优化参数数量的增加而增加，即使系统的某些部分完全无法访问，该方法仍然适用。

articles.title: Maximization of nuclear fusion reactivity via optimal energy distributions
articles.title_zh: 通过最优能量分布最大化核聚变反应性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35507v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate the optimization of nuclear fusion reactivity relative to the choice of energy probability distribution. A single Maxwell-Boltzmann (MB) distribution is found to be optimal in the region where reactivity is a concave function of the average available kinetic energy, specifically near the reactivity peak. Conversely, in regions where the reactivity curve is convex, optimization is achieved through a bimodal MB distribution. We then discuss our results in the context of three classes of generalized energy distributions (superstatistics), which are modeled as a continuum of MB distributions. As expected, in all cases examined, the reactivity gains provided by superstatistics are bounded by the proposed optimal distribution. Finally, we apply these findings to deuterium-deuterium and deuterium-tritium fusion processes using empirical parametrizations of their respective cross sections. For both reactions, employing optimal bimodal MB distributions at low average energies-of particular interest for magnetically confined plasmas-yields a reactivity enhancement of approximately a factor of 2.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了核聚变反应性相对于能量概率分布选择的优化。单一Maxwell-Boltzmann （ MB ）分布在反应性是平均可用动能的凹函数，特别是在反应性峰值附近的区域是最优的。相反，在反应曲线呈凸形的区域，通过双峰MB分布实现优化。然后，我们在三类广义能量分布（超统计学）的背景下讨论我们的结果，这些能量分布被建模为MB分布的连续统。正如预期的那样，在所有检查的情况下，超统计学提供的反应性增益都受到所提出的最优分布的限制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了核聚变反应性相对于能量概率分布选择的优化。单一Maxwell-Boltzmann （ MB ）分布在反应性是平均可用动能的凹函数，特别是在反应性峰值附近的区域是最优的。相反，在反应曲线呈凸形的区域，通过双峰MB分布实现优化。然后，我们在三类广义能量分布（超统计学）的背景下讨论我们的结果，这些能量分布被建模为MB分布的连续统。正如预期的那样，在所有检查的情况下，超统计学提供的反应性增益都受到所提出的最优分布的限制。最后，我们使用各自横截面的经验参数化将这些发现应用于氘-氘和氘-氚融合过程。对于这两种反应，在低平均能量下采用最佳的双峰MB分布-特别是磁限制等离子体-可产生约2倍的反应性增强。

articles.title: Quantum state revivals, time quasicrystals, and entanglement steering in a Fibonacci-driven central-spin model
articles.title_zh: 斐波那契驱动的中心自旋模型中的量子态复苏、时间准晶体和纠缠转向
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35555v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Motivated by the search for non-equilibrium phases of matter beyond the Floquet paradigm, we propose a route to realize perfect revivals and time quasicrystals (TQCs) in a Fibonacci-driven central-spin model with Ising interactions between the central and satellite spins in the absence of disorder. We analytically demonstrate that when the interaction strength, λ is tuned to 2 m π, no entanglement is generated between the central and satellite spins at stroboscopic times, independent of the strength of the transverse driving field and the drive sequence. This leads to indefinitely long-lived quasiperiodic oscillations in satellite spin magnetization. Furthermore, for initial states with a definite bath magnetization, no entanglement is generated when the transverse driving field, θ is tuned to π for any value of  λ, and the satellite spin magnetization oscillations exhibit period-3 revivals at Fibonacci times. Examining the robustness of these oscillations away from this fine-tuned limit, we identify a parameter regime where the quasiperiodic response does not decay over the timescales probed, giving rise to a long-lived π-pulse-proximate TQC regime. We further show that at special Clifford points, the system exhibits perfect quasiperiodic oscillations of the satellite spin magnetization, with a parity-dependent Fourier response. This response persists over the timescales probed, even away from the Clifford points for an even number of satellite spins, leading to the formation of a Clifford-proximate TQC. Finally, we demonstrate that at this Clifford points, the system is steered along an entangled trajectory, leading to the dynamical generation of Bell-cat and spin-cat states. These states exhibit magnetization of collective spin fluctuates quadratically with the number of satellite spins, thereby enabling Heisenberg-limited metrology.
articles.abstract_zh: 在寻找Floquet范式之外的物质非平衡相的激励下，我们提出了一种在斐波那契驱动的中心自旋模型中实现完美复苏和时间准晶（ TQC ）的路线，该模型在没有混乱的情况下在中心和卫星自旋之间具有Ising相互作用。我们通过分析证明，当相互作用强度λ被调谐到2 m π时，在频闪时间中心自旋和卫星自旋之间不会产生纠缠，这与横向驱动场的强度和驱动序列无关。这导致卫星自旋磁化的无限长寿命准周期振荡。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在寻找Floquet范式之外的物质非平衡相的激励下，我们提出了一种在斐波那契驱动的中心自旋模型中实现完美复苏和时间准晶（ TQC ）的路线，该模型在没有混乱的情况下在中心和卫星自旋之间具有Ising相互作用。我们通过分析证明，当相互作用强度λ被调谐到2 m π时，在频闪时间中心自旋和卫星自旋之间不会产生纠缠，这与横向驱动场的强度和驱动序列无关。这导致卫星自旋磁化的无限长寿命准周期振荡。此外，对于具有确定的槽磁化的初始状态，当横向驱动场时不会产生纠缠，对于任何λ值， θ被调谐到π ，并且卫星自旋磁化振荡在斐波那契时刻表现出周期-3的复苏。检查这些振荡远离这个微调极限的鲁棒性，我们确定了一个参数方案，其中准周期响应不会在所探测的时间尺度上衰减，从而产生长寿命的π脉冲近似TQC方案。我们进一步表明，在特殊的Clifford点，该系统表现出卫星自旋磁化的完美准周期振荡，具有奇偶相关傅里叶响应。这种反应在探测的时间尺度上持续存在，甚至远离克利福德点进行偶数次卫星自旋，从而形成克利福德近似TQC。最后，我们证明在这个Clifford点上，系统沿着纠缠轨迹被引导，导致Bell-cat和spin-cat状态的动态生成。这些状态表现出集体自旋随卫星自旋次数平方波动的磁化，从而实现了海森堡极限测量。

articles.title: Parametrically Enhanced Ergotropy and Charging Power in a Three-Mode Bosonic Quantum Battery
articles.title_zh: 三模玻色子量子电池中的参数增强的Ergotropy和充电功率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35734v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum batteries are quantum systems that potentially serve as fuel for other quantum devices by receiving and supplying energy. In this work, we propose a theoretical scheme to enhance ergotropy and charging power of quantum Battery in the system under consideration through squeezed light. Moreover, The system comprises a coherently driven charger cavity, a strongly dissipative auxiliary cavity acting as a mediator, and an energy--storage battery cavity. Quantum nonreciprocity and directional energy flow are established via destructive quantum interference between the direct coupling path and the loss--engineered indirect path. A degenerate optical parametric amplifier integrated into the charger cavity acts as an active, phase--sensitive energy source that injects two--photon quantum excitations and anomalous correlations. Using a strictly open--quantum--system framework derived directly from the Lindblad master equation, we obtain the full expectation--value dynamics and stationary states. We show that active parametric driving drastically increases the stored energy and peak charging power while maintaining nonreciprocal energy trapping in the battery. We achieve a multi-order-of-magnitude boost in the battery's stored energy, charging power, and ergotropy. We also analyze the effects of pure dephasing on the charging power, ergotropy, and extractable work quality.. Although two--photon pumping introduces photon--number fluctuations that slightly lower the fractional ergotropy ratio cal Wᵣₘ B/cal Eᵣₘ B, the absolute extractable work remains substantially elevated compared to unassisted configurations.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子电池是量子系统，可能通过接收和供应能量作为其他量子设备的燃料。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种理论方案，通过挤压光增强所考虑系统中量子电池的向人性和充电功率。此外，该系统包括相干驱动的充电器空腔、充当中介体的强耗散辅助空腔和储能电池空腔。量子非互易性和定向能量流是通过直接耦合路径和损耗工程间接路径之间的破坏性量子干涉来建立的。集成到充电器腔中的退化光学参量放大器充当有源、相位敏感的能量源，注入两个光子量子激发和异常相关性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子电池是量子系统，可能通过接收和供应能量作为其他量子设备的燃料。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种理论方案，通过挤压光增强所考虑系统中量子电池的向人性和充电功率。此外，该系统包括相干驱动的充电器空腔、充当中介体的强耗散辅助空腔和储能电池空腔。量子非互易性和定向能量流是通过直接耦合路径和损耗工程间接路径之间的破坏性量子干涉来建立的。集成到充电器腔中的退化光学参量放大器充当有源、相位敏感的能量源，注入两个光子量子激发和异常相关性。使用直接从Lindblad主方程导出的严格开放的量子系统框架，我们获得了完整的期望值-值动态和平稳状态。我们表明，主动参数驱动大大增加了存储能量和峰值充电功率，同时保持了电池中的非互易能量捕获。我们在电池的存储能量、充电功率和向人性方面实现了多量级的提升。我们还分析了纯减相对充电功率、向人性和可提取工作质量的影响。虽然双光子泵浦引入了光子数波动，略微降低了分数向人比，称为W_B/cal E_B ，但与无辅助配置相比，绝对可提取工作仍然大大提高。

articles.title: Spin-hydrodynamics in graphene and thermovortical magnetization
articles.title_zh: 石墨烯中的自旋流体动力学和热涡旋磁化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2409.07764v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We examine the framework of relativistic spin hydrodynamics in the context of the Dirac quasiparticle fluid in graphene. We develop a spin-hydrodynamic model for a (2+1)-dimensional system of fermions under the condition of small spin polarization. Our analysis confirms that thermal vorticity, which satisfies the global equilibrium condition, is also a solution to the spin-hydrodynamic equations. Additionally, we calculate the magnetization of the system in global equilibrium and introduce a novel phenomenon - thermovortical magnetization - resulting from thermal vorticity, which can be experimentally observed in graphene.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们在石墨烯中的狄拉克准粒子流体的背景下研究相对论自旋流体动力学的框架。我们开发了小自旋极化条件下费米子(2 +1)维系统的自旋流体动力学模型。我们的分析证实，满足全局平衡条件的热涡度也是自旋流体动力学方程的解。此外，我们计算了全局平衡中系统的磁化强度，并引入了一种新的现象-热涡旋磁化-由热涡旋引起，可以在石墨烯中进行实验观察。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们在石墨烯中的狄拉克准粒子流体的背景下研究相对论自旋流体动力学的框架。我们开发了小自旋极化条件下费米子(2 +1)维系统的自旋流体动力学模型。我们的分析证实，满足全局平衡条件的热涡度也是自旋流体动力学方程的解。此外，我们计算了全局平衡中系统的磁化强度，并引入了一种新的现象-热涡旋磁化-由热涡旋引起，可以在石墨烯中进行实验观察。

articles.title: Spin-phase transition in an array of quantum rings controlled by cavity photons
articles.title_zh: 由腔光子控制的量子环阵列的自旋相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2411.13176v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We model a spin-phase transition in a two-dimensional square array, or a lateral superlattice, of quantum rings in an external perpendicular homogeneous magnetic field. The electron system is placed in a circular cylindrical far-infrared photon cavity with a single circularly symmetric photon mode. Our numerical results reveal that the spin ordering of the two-dimensional electron gas in each quantum ring can be influenced or controlled by the electron-photon coupling strength and the energy of the photons. The Coulomb interaction between the electrons is described by a spin-density functional approach, but the para- and the diamagnetic electron-photon interactions are modeled via a configuration interaction formalism in a truncated many-body Fock-space, which is updated in each iteration step of the density functional approach. In the absence of external electromagnetic pulses this spin-phase transition is replicated in the orbital magnetization of the rings. The spin-phase transition can be suppressed by a strong electron-photon interaction. In addition, fluctuations in the spin configuration are found in dynamical calculations, where the system is excited by a time-dependent scheme specially fit for emphasizing the diamagnetic electron-photon interaction.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们在外部垂直均匀磁场中对量子环的二维方阵或横向超晶格中的自旋相变进行建模。电子系统被放置在具有单个圆形对称光子模式的圆柱形远红外光子腔中。我们的数值结果表明，每个量子环中二维电子气体的自旋顺序可以受到电子-光子耦合强度和光子能量的影响或控制。电子之间的库仑相互作用是通过自旋密度泛函方法描述的，但对位和反磁性电子-光子相互作用是通过截断的多体Fock空间中的配置相互作用形式来建模的，该形式在密度泛函方法的每个迭代步骤中更新。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们在外部垂直均匀磁场中对量子环的二维方阵或横向超晶格中的自旋相变进行建模。电子系统被放置在具有单个圆形对称光子模式的圆柱形远红外光子腔中。我们的数值结果表明，每个量子环中二维电子气体的自旋顺序可以受到电子-光子耦合强度和光子能量的影响或控制。电子之间的库仑相互作用是通过自旋密度泛函方法描述的，但对位和反磁性电子-光子相互作用是通过截断的多体Fock空间中的配置相互作用形式来建模的，该形式在密度泛函方法的每个迭代步骤中更新。在没有外部电磁脉冲的情况下，这种自旋相变在环的轨道磁化中被复制。自旋相变可以通过强电子-光子相互作用来抑制。此外，在动力学计算中发现自旋配置的波动，其中系统由特别适合强调抗磁电子-光子相互作用的时间依赖方案激发。

articles.title: Robust spin splitting and fermiology in the layered altermagnet CoNb4Se8
articles.title_zh: 层状Altermagnet CoNb4Se8中的强大自旋分裂和表观表征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2502.20010v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Altermagnetism defies conventional classifications of collinear magnetic phases, combining compensated magnetization with momentum-dependent, nonrelativistic spin splitting. While altermagnetic band splitting has been established in three-dimensional compounds such as MnTe and CrSb, layered altermagnets remain far less explored spectroscopically. Here, combining termination-resolved micro-ARPES, fine photon-energy mapping, spin-ARPES and density functional theory, we map the three-dimensional fermiology of the layered g-wave altermagnet CoNb₄Se₈, obtained by ordered Co intercalation of 2H-NbSe₂. We resolve the spin-split branches of the altermagnetic pairs directly in the raw photoemission spectra and, with spin-ARPES at these experimentally identified momenta, show the reversal of the spin polarization at opposite momenta and between two regions of the sample, consistent with opposite time-reversal domains, and its absence along the symmetry-protected nodal Γ--K direction. We further report a weak low-temperature anomaly near T₀approx50 to 60 K, detected by magnetometry, temperature-dependent micro-ARPES and ultrafast reflectivity, whose microscopic origin remains open. These results provide a momentum-resolved benchmark of the electronic structure of a layered altermagnet.
articles.abstract_zh: Altermagnetism违背了共线磁相的传统分类，将补偿磁化与动量相关的非相对论自旋分裂相结合。虽然在MnTe和CrSb等三维化合物中已经建立了改变磁带分裂，但层状改变磁体在光谱学上的探索仍然少得多。这里，结合终端分辨微ARPES、精细光子能量映射、自旋ARPES和密度泛函理论，我们绘制了通过2H-NbSe ₂的有序Co插层获得的层状g波改变磁体CoNb ”Se”的三维费米学。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Altermagnetism违背了共线磁相的传统分类，将补偿磁化与动量相关的非相对论自旋分裂相结合。虽然在MnTe和CrSb等三维化合物中已经建立了改变磁带分裂，但层状改变磁体在光谱学上的探索仍然少得多。这里，结合终端分辨微ARPES、精细光子能量映射、自旋ARPES和密度泛函理论，我们绘制了通过2H-NbSe ₂的有序Co插层获得的层状g波改变磁体CoNb ”Se”的三维费米学。我们直接在原始光发射光谱中解析了变磁对的自旋分裂分支，并在这些实验识别的动量下使用自旋-ARPES ，显示了样品相反时刻和两个区域之间的自旋极化的反转，与相反的时间反转域一致，并且沿着对称保护的节点Γ-K方向不存在。我们进一步报告了在T约50至60 K附近的弱低温异常，通过磁强计，温度依赖性微ARPES和超快反射率检测到，其微观起源仍然开放。这些结果为分层变磁体的电子结构提供了动量分辨基准。

articles.title: Revealing the proton slingshot mechanism in solid acid electrolytes through machine learning molecular dynamics
articles.title_zh: 通过机器学习分子动力学揭示固体酸电解质中的质子弹弓机制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2503.15389v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In solid acid electrolytes CsH₂PO₄ and CsHSO₄, the origin of fast proton conduction has long been debated, attributed either to local proton hopping or to polyanion rotation. However, the precise role of polyanion rotation and its interplay with proton hopping remained unresolved. Nanosecond-scale molecular dynamics simulations, driven by equivariant neural network force fields, reveal a nuanced proton slingshot mechanism: protons are first carried by rotating polyanions, followed by O-H bond reorientation, and the combined motion enables long-range jumps. This mechanism challenges the conventional revolving paddlewheel model, revealing long-range transport arises from significant O-H bond reorientation assisted by only limited polyanion rotation. Despite their structural similarity, CsH₂PO₄ and CsHSO₄ exhibit qualitatively different transport behavior, governed by their distinct proton concentrations. In CsH₂PO₄, two rotation rates with different activation energies emerge, while CsHSO₄ displays a single-rate process with faster productive polyanion dynamics. The higher proton concentration in CsH₂PO₄ frustrates PO₄ rotation, resulting in slower dynamics than for SO₄ in CsHSO₄. In CsH₂PO₄, we further identify a unique correlation between oxygen sharing and proton transport, arising from the extra proton per polyanion. Together, our findings establish a unified framework linking polyanion rotation, proton coordination, and long-range transport, and suggest that tuning proton concentration could accelerate rotation and enhance conductivity.

articles.title: Time-reversal symmetry breaking and inherent Josephson diodes in a multi-component order parameter superconductor
articles.abstract: arXiv:2504.19361v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Spontaneous time-reversal symmetry breaking is a defining feature of unconventional superconductivity and a prerequisite of the technologically relevant superconducting diode effect. However, its realization remains rare and exclusive to proximity-engineered weak links. Here we examine an alternative pathway to spontaneous time-reversal symmetry breaking by examining junctions that appear in single-crystal microstructures of the unconventional superconductor Sr₂RuO₄, lacking external superconducting proximity. We interpret the Josephson coupling as superconducting domains of a multi-component order parameter based on a plethora of anomalous effects - including a field-free Josephson diode effect, fractional Shapiro steps, magnetic interference patterns deviating from the conventional flux quantum periodicity, and bias current-programmable bistable states. These microscopic devices corroborate earlier bulk probes of time-reversal symmetry breaking, giving a renewed impulse to the long-debated pairing symmetry of Sr₂RuO₄. Our results highlight superconducting domain walls as a platform for functional Josephson devices and the study of fundamental symmetry breaking.

articles.title: Electronic structure, excitonic optical response, and defect stability of RbTlCl3 from first-principles
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.16264v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a many-body ab initio study of the electronic structure, optical properties, excitonic effects, and defect stability of RbTlCl3. Density functional theory and many-body methods are used to investigate the properties with and without spin-orbit coupling (SOC). The indirect band gaps obtained using PBE-GGA are 0.94 and 0.95 eV with and without SOC, respectively. Optical spectra are calculated using the independent-particle approximation (IPA), IPA with scissor correction (IQPA), random-phase approximation (RPA) with local-field effects (LFEs), and the Bethe-Salpeter equation (BSE). The maximum imaginary dielectric function is approximately 7 at 2 eV within IQPA and decreases to 5.7 when LFEs are included. BSE calculations yield a peak value of approximately 10.8 at 1.6 eV, revealing strong excitonic effects. Four prominent bright bound excitons exhibit binding energies of 315-365 meV. The main bright exciton is localized in reciprocal space and delocalized in real space. The spectroscopic limited maximum efficiency is estimated to be 15.4% for a 0.5-micrometer-thick film. The absence of imaginary phonon frequencies and the existence of a thermodynamically stable region indicate dynamical and thermodynamic stability. Chemical-potential analysis identifies the chlorine vacancy as the most stable neutral defect under chlorine-poor conditions and the thallium vacancy under chlorine-rich conditions. These findings establish RbTlCl3 as a promising theoretical candidate for photovoltaic applications and provide insights into excitonic effects in inorganic perovskites.

articles.title: Subspace-Protected Topological Phases and Bulk-Boundary Correspondence
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.20908v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: While tremendous research has revealed that symmetry enriches topological phases of matter, more general principles that protect topological phases have yet to be explored. In this Letter, we elucidate the roles of subspaces in free-fermionic topological phases. A subspace property for Hamiltonians enables us to define new topological invariants. It results in peculiar topological boundary phenomena, i.e., the emergence of an unpaired zero mode or zero-winding skin modes, characterizing subspace-protected topological phases. We establish and demonstrate the bulk-boundary correspondence in subspace-protected topological phases. We further discuss the interplay of the subspace property and internal symmetries. Toward application, we also propose possible platforms possessing the subspace property.

articles.title: Web of Non-invertible Dualities for (2+1) Dimensional Models with Subsystem Symmetries
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.18969v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We extend non-invertible duality concepts from one-dimensional systems to two spatial dimensions by constructing a web of non-invertible dualities for lattice models with subsystem symmetries. For the Z₂ × Z₂ subsystem symmetry on the square lattice, we build two complementary dualities: a map that sends spontaneous subsystem symmetry-broken (SSSB) phases to the trivial phase (the analogue of the Kramers-Wannier (KW) duality in 1+1D), and a generalized subsystem Kennedy-Tasaki (KT) transformation that maps SSSB phases to subsystem symmetry-protected topological (SSPT) phases while leaving the trivial phase invariant. These dualities are boundary-sensitive. On open lattices, both subsystem KW and KT transformations act as unitary, invertible operators. In particular, the KT map not only matches the bulk Hamiltonians of the dual phases but also carries the spontaneous ground-state degeneracy of the SSSB phase onto the protected boundary degeneracy of the SSPT phase. On closed manifolds, however, both maps become intrinsically non-unitary and non-invertible when restricted to the original Hilbert space. We demonstrate this non-invertibility via ground-state degeneracy matching (in two copies of the Xu-Moore/Ising-plaquette model), analysis of symmetry-twist sectors mapping, and the fusion algebra of the duality operator. Enlarging the Hilbert space to include twisted sectors allows the subsystem KW map to be formulated as a projective unitary preserving quantum transition probabilities, consistent with generalized Wigner-theorem-based constructions. We also show that the KT map faithfully transmits the algebraic content of bulk and edge invariants diagnosing strong SSPT order: although strictly local SSPT repair operators map to highly nonlocal objects in the dual SSSB phase, the essential commutation algebra and the bulk-edge correspondence remain intact.

articles.title: Altermagnetic Signatures and Topological Textures in Ultrathin Multiferroic BiFeO₃
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.09970v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Magnetoelectric multiferroics promise low-power switching, nonvolatile memory, and signal transduction, yet practical deployment requires ultrathin films where polar and magnetic order often degrade. Uncompensated bound charge drives depolarization in ferroelectrics, while off-stoichiometry, reduced anisotropy, and charge transfer can produce magnetic dead layers. Here, we realize a multiferroic phase of BiFeO₃ with no dead layer, revealing signatures of emergent altermagnetism in the ultrathin limit. First-principles calculations, symmetry analysis, atomic-resolution imaging, and magnetic imaging show that short-circuit electrostatic boundary conditions and epitaxial strain drive a continuous, thickness-induced phase transition accompanied by multiferroic topological textures. At four unit cells, these boundary conditions stabilize a collinear monoclinic phase with d-wave altermagnetic order, supported by magnetic circular dichroism and spin-resolved photoemission measurements. These results establish a pathway to stabilize unconventional multiferroicity at device-relevant thicknesses, reframing scaling limits for oxide electronics.

articles.title: Coulomb Interaction and Density-Independent Exciton-Scattering Processes in Atomically Thin Semiconductors
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.13763v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In quantum-kinetic approaches to the dynamics of Coulomb-bound many-body correlations such as excitons, trions, biexcitons or higher-order correlations, a detailed knowledge of the many-body Coulomb Hamiltonian serving as a starting point is important. In this manuscript, the second-quantized description of the Coulomb interaction between Bloch electrons in a Heisenberg-equation-of-motion approach in atomically thin semiconductors is derived and reviewed. Emphasis is put on a discussion of Umklapp processes and the dielectric screening including all local-field effects. A link between ab initio methods of screening and few-band models in effective-mass approximations for the quantum kinetics is established and important Coulomb scattering processes contributing to the exciton energy landscape and density-independent exciton scattering are discussed.

articles.title: Optimality and annealing path planning of dynamical analog solvers
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.13778v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Recently proposed analog solvers based on dynamical systems, such as Ising machines, are promising platforms for large-scale combinatorial optimization. Yet, given the heuristic nature of the field, there is very limited insight on optimality guarantees of the solvers, as well as how parameter schedules shape dynamics and outcomes. Here, we develop a dynamical mean-field framework to analyze Ising-machine dynamics for finding the ground state energy of the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick(SK) model of spin glasses and identify mechanisms that enable rapid convergence to provenly near-optimal energies. For a fixed target energy density Ec, we show that solutions are typically reached within O(1) matrix vector multiplications, indicating constant time complexity. We further delineate theoretical limitations arising from different parameter-scheduling trajectories and demonstrate a pronounced benefit of temperature-only annealing for the Coherent Ising Machine. Building on these insights, we propose a general framework for designing optimized parameter schedules, thereby improving the practical effectiveness of Ising machines for complex optimization tasks. The superior performance of the dynamical solvers is illustrated by the attainment of the ground state energy of the SK model.

articles.title: Coexistence of Ferromagnetic and Overscreened Kondo Effects in a Single Molecule
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.07174v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The quest for quantum ground states beyond the Fermi-liquid paradigm remains a central challenge in many-body physics. The ferromagnetic Kondo effect is an intriguing variant of the Kondo effect in which an asymptotically free spin gives rise to singular Fermi-liquid behavior. Despite its theoretical importance, this regime has eluded experimental observation owing to subtle spectroscopic signatures, small energy scales, and symmetry constraints in nanostructures. Here, we demonstrate the coexistence of ferromagnetic and overscreened Kondo effects within a molecular spin system---a triangulene dimer comprising spin-1 and spin-1/2 units adsorbed on a metal surface. Low-temperature scanning tunneling spectroscopy reveals signatures of singular Fermi-liquid behavior, supported by many-body calculations. The molecular design provides control over spin configuration and coupling asymmetry, allowing distinct regimes within the same platform. Our results establish a strategy for realizing non-Fermi-liquid physics at the atomic scale and demonstrate that ferromagnetic Kondo behavior can be deliberately engineered in molecular systems.

articles.title: Transport and Phase competition in three-dimensional Hubbard-Holstein model at half-filling
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.18219v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the magnetotransport properties of the one-band Hubbard-Holstein model at half-filling in three dimensions (3D) using exact diagonalization based semi-classical Monte Carlo simulations with phonons treated in the adiabatic limit. The low-temperature electronic correlation U vs electron-phonon coupling V phase diagram reveals two insulating phases--antiferromagnetic (AF-I) and charge-ordered (CO-I)--separated by a first-order transition, with no metallic phase observed at their intersection, indicating robustness of these phases in 3D. For U sim bandwidth, the V vs temperature T phase diagram exhibits multiple phases including AF-I, CO-I, Mott-Hubbard insulator, bipolaronic insulator, and two bipolaronic metallic states. Several first-order transitions occur near V sim 3.75. Above the ordering temperature, the density of states shows universal behavior dominated by electronic contribution, while susceptibility and DOS analyses reveal pseudogap features. Magnetic and transport properties along the phase boundary highlight strong proximity effects between competing phases, suggesting routes for tuning correlated materials and emergent electronic states.

articles.title: Intrinsic i-wave altermagnetism in 2D graphene superlattices
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.19661v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Altermagnets feature unconventional magnetism due to their momentum-dependent spin splitting purely driven by magnetic order, for which a variety of transition-metal-based d-wave altermagnets have been proposed. However, carbon-based altermagnets in graphene structures remain elusive, even though magnetism in graphene nanostructures has been widely demonstrated. Here, we establish a symmetry-guided design principle to engineer i-wave altermagnets in graphene antidot superlattices and demonstrate the emergence of altermagnetic states in specific monolayer and bilayer graphene superlattices. By combining first principles methods and atomistic tight binding models, we show the appearance of an interaction-induced i-wave altermagnetic splitting, stemming from the intrinsic magnetic instability of 2D graphene antidot superlattices. Our work establishes a strategy to engineer i-wave altermagnetism in a graphene platform, putting forward a carbon-based platform for altermagnetic spintronics.

articles.title: The Kubo-Thermalization Correspondence
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.06666v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum thermalization describes how interacting quantum systems relax toward thermal equilibrium, a central problem in modern physics. Yet most experimental information on many-body systems comes from short-time transition spectroscopy, typically interpreted within Kubo's linear-response framework. These perspectives-long-time equilibration versus short-time response-seem fundamentally disconnected. Here we establish an exact link between them: the emphKubo-Thermalization correspondence, which connects long-time thermalized magnetization under weak driving to short-time linear-response spectra for a spin coupled to a thermal bath. The correspondence holds even when the steady state differs substantially from the initial state and when each regime is individually difficult to describe theoretically. We experimentally confirm the correspondence using effective spin-1/2 impurities realized with ultracold fermions in two internal states coupled to a Fermi sea. Our results provide a rare exact statement about quantum thermalization and offer a novel route to infer thermalization dynamics from equilibrium response measurements in strongly interacting quantum systems, independent of microscopic details of the system--bath coupling.

articles.title: Loss Factor of Axisymmetric and Rectangular Tapered Collimators from Optical to Inductive Regimes
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33336v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, we investigate the loss factor of axisymmetric and rectangular tapered collimators over a broad range of bunch lengths and geometrical parameters using the electromagnetic simulation codes ECHO and GdfidL. The calculations are performed for Gaussian bunches of rms length σₛ, with the collimator geometry characterized by the minimum and maximum apertures b and d, taper length L, and chamber width W for rectangular structures. For short bunches and tapered collimators with d-b>b, we extend the phenomenological formula previously obtained for axisymmetric to rectangular tapered collimators, describing the dependence of the loss factor on bunch length and taper geometry through an arctangent function of the scaling parameter μ d²/(σₛ L). We demonstrate that this parameter is related to a Fresnel number and, by combining diffraction theory with the electrodynamics of the beam-induced image charge, analytically explain the factor of two between the coefficients μ=0.2 and μ=0.4 for axisymmetric and rectangular collimators, respectively. The resulting expression is applicable to rectangular collimators with W/(2d) ≥ 1.8, extending its validity beyond the idealized flat geometry. For longer bunches, we identify the transition from the optical to the inductive regime and derive an analytical expression for the loss factor based on the cutoff wavenumber of the lowest relevant electromagnetic mode.

articles.title: A Novel Linked-Mirror Device for Fusion
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33529v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We design a novel linked-mirror device (LMD) with a magnetic well using the near-axis expansion (NAE) method. The design consists of two parallel straight mirror sections connected at both ends by three-dimensional stellarator-like magnetic fields , thereby eliminating the end-loss problem of a single magnetic mirror. By designing appropriate three-dimensional magnetic fields, we obtain an LMD configuration with a magnetic well, ensuring stability against interchange modes. The existence of finite-beta equilibria of the LMD is demonstrated by numerical solutions of the 3D equilibrium code GVEC. This design is potentially a novel solution to magnetic confinement for fusion reactors.

articles.title: Long-Baseline Phase-Coherent Microwave Reception Using Rydberg Atoms
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33552v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A long baseline phase-coherent microwave receiver is demonstrated using a remotely interrogated cesium Rydberg atom sensor over an 8 m free-space optical link. A 3.989 GHz local oscillator (LO) is intensity-modulated onto an 852 nm optical probe and recovered remotely for atomic superheterodyne detection. A 509 nm coupling laser establishes a Rydberg electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT) system addressing the 6S1/2 to 6P3/2 to 56D5/2 ladder, with microwave coupling to 57P3/2. A test signal offset by 5 kHz generates an optically detected intermediate-frequency (IF) response returned to the reference station for centralized coherent acquisition. This eliminates independent remote oscillators, electronic IF acquisition, and distributed clock synchronization. Over 10 min, the differential phase between remote and local reference exhibits a standard deviation of 0.476 deg and a minimum overlapping phase Allan deviation of 0.048 deg at approximately 200 s averaging. Following optical-link interruption, the differential phase recovers without recalibration, with a measured pre- and post-interruption difference of 0.01 deg. These results demonstrate phase coherent remotely interrogated atomic microwave reception with reduced instrumentation, supporting future distributed interferometry, multistatic radar, and coherent sensor arrays.

articles.title: Accelerating high-fidelity gyrokinetic fusion simulations with iGENE
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33561v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present the latest version of iGENE, a differentiable implementation of the local (flux-tube) gyrokinetic code GENE, now fully rewritten in JAX. iGENE features a multispecies, collisional, fully electromagnetic nonlinear gyrokinetic model while preserving end-to-end differentiability. The code is verified against GENE for linear ITG, TEM and KBM physics and for nonlinear turbulent fluxes with adiabatic and kinetic electrons. Forward-mode derivatives of the linear growth rate agree with finite differences for all five parameters tested, resolving the 30--50% discrepancy in hats and ϵ reported for the earlier TensorFlow version. All collectives are native JAX operations, and the code strong-scales from 2 to 32 H100 GPUs with 86% parallel efficiency. We then assess three routes to a shorter time to solution. Custom CUDA FFT kernels operating in bfloat16 are up to 3.97× faster than fp32 cuFFT on the transforms, and on a single H100 iGENE is 2.63× faster per time step than single-precision GENE. Multi-rate sub-cycling of the parallel dynamics yields a further 1.89× speedup with kinetic electrons. Finally, a Hermite-Laguerre velocity-space representation is implemented, offering tunable fidelity.

articles.title: Triple Decomposition of Field Gradient Tensors in Space Plasmas
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33563v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Characterizing local topology in magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) turbulence is fundamental to understanding energy dissipation, intermittency, and coherent structures in space plasmas. Classical double decomposition of velocity (Aᵢⱼ) and magnetic (Zᵢⱼ) field gradient tensors into symmetric strain and anti-symmetric rotation components conflates rigid-body rotation with planar sliding shear. Here, we extend the real-Schur-based Triple Decomposition framework to MHD flows, rigorously isolating irrotational normal strain (N, M), residual pure shear (H, K), and true rigid-body rotation (R, B). Applying this method to high-resolution NASA-MMS multi-spacecraft observations in the solar wind and Earth's magnetosheath reveals distinct topological signatures. Solar wind dynamics are predominantly strain-dominated due to spherical radial expansion, whereas magnetosheath turbulence is overwhelmingly shear-dominated, driven by boundary interactions. Crucially, cross-term contributions (2RH and 2KB) are suppressed to le 7% across both plasma regimes, contrasting sharply with neutral fluid turbulence (sim 13%). This suppression is driven by background magnetic-field-induced anisotropy (k_perp gg k_parallel), which confines shearing motions perpendicular to the primary rotation axes. By cleanly separating genuine vortex cores from current sheets and shear layers, the Triple Decomposition provides an objective framework for characterizing plasma turbulence and analyzing data from future multi-spacecraft missions.

articles.title: Deep-Microscopic Photonic Bandstructure of a Two-Dimensional Honeycomb Lattice
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33709v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Conventional descriptions of light in materials rely on macroscopic models that average the optical response over the microscopic lattice structures. These models are deployed in the semi-classical limit, where the collective local response over many lattice sites is adequate. However, they fail to capture the full spatial dispersion, which requires a lattice-resolved description of light. We address this limitation by formulating a deep-microscopic nonlocal theory of the photon based on the Maxwell Hamiltonian and its characteristic equation. The solution reveals the full spatial dispersion in the form of deep-microscopic photonic bandstructure, and corresponding real-space Bloch field textures. We demonstrate our theory for a two-dimensional (2D) tight-binding model of a gapped honeycomb lattice. Our framework thus extends photons to the same microscopic footing as electrons or phonons, providing a unified route to studying topology, dissipation, and quantum fluctuations of light in dispersive materials.

articles.title: A Differentiable Framework for Inverse Identification of Heterogeneous Cohesive Laws
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33711v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This work develops a differentiable finite element framework based on an intrinsic cohesive-zone formulation for identifying traction-separation laws from global force-displacement histories and spatially sparse strain measurements. The framework employs physics-constrained neural networks to represent flexible, thermodynamically structured cohesive laws, with sensitivities computed through automatic differentiation and a discrete adjoint that accounts for the history-dependent evolution of interfacial damage. To enable identification of spatially heterogeneous cohesive behavior, we extend learned constitutive priors to irreversible interfacial damage by constructing a shared, low-dimensional family of cohesive laws from representative traction-separation histories. This representation exploits common constitutive structure and parameter sharing to reduce the number of unknowns and regularize the inverse problem, while allowing local cohesive behavior to vary spatially through latent coordinates. Numerical investigations involving double-cantilever beams and fiber-matrix composites demonstrate that accurate reproduction of global force-displacement responses does not necessarily imply accurate recovery of the underlying cohesive laws. Incorporating spatially resolved strain measurements substantially improves constitutive identification, even when the admissible responses are constrained by a learned prior. Comparisons with conventional bilinear cohesive models and Bayesian optimization further illustrate the benefits of the learned constitutive representation and adjoint-based identification for high-dimensional inverse problems.

articles.title: Polarized X-rays from table-top free-electron-driven van der Waals crystals
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33774v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Polarized X-rays are essential for polarization-sensitive techniques such as X-ray absorption near-edge structure (XANES) spectroscopy, magnetic microscopy, and fluorescence imaging. These techniques are crucial in the study of molecular and material dynamics, which are in turn central to driving the global transition to clean energy and sustainability through research in photovoltaics, catalysis and optoelectronics.
