articles.abstract_zh: 使用第一原理计算，我们表明，由于界面电荷转移和八面体倾斜的相互作用，(LaVO₃)ₙ/(LaNiO₃)ₘ超晶格中出现了交变磁性，其中(n,m) = (1,1)、(2,2)和(2,4)。电荷转移驱动系统朝 V⁴⁺ 和 Ni2⁺ 配置方向发展，将顺磁性镍酸盐层转变为磁活性亚晶格。由此产生的 C 型反铁磁序与 a^-b^+c⁻ 或 a^-b^-c⁻ 八面体倾斜相结合，仅通过非对称操作链接相反自旋子晶格，从而产生没有自旋轨道耦合的 d 波自旋分裂。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 使用第一原理计算，我们表明，由于界面电荷转移和八面体倾斜的相互作用，(LaVO₃)ₙ/(LaNiO₃)ₘ超晶格中出现了交变磁性，其中(n,m) = (1,1)、(2,2)和(2,4)。电荷转移驱动系统朝 V⁴⁺ 和 Ni2⁺ 配置方向发展，将顺磁性镍酸盐层转变为磁活性亚晶格。由此产生的 C 型反铁磁序与 a^-b^+c⁻ 或 a^-b^-c⁻ 八面体倾斜相结合，仅通过非对称操作链接相反自旋子晶格，从而产生没有自旋轨道耦合的 d 波自旋分裂。在 DFT+U 中，绝缘 (LVO)1/(LNO)1 超晶格中的分裂达到 118 meV，大约是块状 LaVO3 计算值的两倍，并且随着镍酸盐层变厚而减小。我们的研究结果表明，这种分裂是由 V 和 Ni 亚晶格主持的，其近一半的重量通过 p-d 共价键分布在氧 2p 态上。因此，界面电荷转移成为氧化物异质结构中工程交变磁性的设计原理。

articles.title: Nonlinear Canonical Transformations for Studying Spin-1/2 Hamiltonians
articles.title_zh: 用于研究自旋 1/2 哈密顿量的非线性正则变换
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30403v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Strongly correlated quantum systems, including frustrated spin lattices, remain challenging for conventional coupled-cluster methods because their ground states often exhibit strong multireference character and symmetry breaking. Although multireference and symmetry-projected coupled-cluster theories are promising, they are not yet black-box methods and require system-specific development. The XXZ and J₁-J₂ spin models provide demanding benchmarks. Spin-BCS-based coupled-cluster methods may require high excitation ranks to recover the exact ground-state physics in strongly correlated regimes. We introduce a nonlinear spin-fermion-spin (SFS) transformation designed to map a strongly correlated spin Hamiltonian into a new spin Hamiltonian whose ground state is more accurately described at the mean-field level. For a representative SFS transformation, we identify a compact Clifford circuit that maps transformed product states to circuit-dressed, generally entangled states in the original representation. The transformed Hamiltonian can then be treated using broken-symmetry mean-field theory and post-mean-field methods. Benchmarks for the XXZ and J₁-J₂ Hamiltonians show that spin mean-field theory in the transformed representation reduces the energy error relative to conventional spin-BCS mean field. The spin-BCS-based coupled-cluster calculations for the one-dimensional XXZ model provide substantially improved accuracy relative to the corresponding untransformed methods. In 2D, the accuracy of the transformed mean-field solutions depends on the site ordering and boundary conditions, as nonlocal strings can appear. These results show that exact transformations of operator representations can serve as many-body preconditioners for mean-field and low-rank coupled-cluster approximations to strongly correlated spin systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 强相关的量子系统，包括受挫自旋晶格，对于传统的耦合簇方法来说仍然具有挑战性，因为它们的基态通常表现出强烈的多参考特征和对称性破缺。尽管多参考和对称投影耦合簇理论很有前景，但它们还不是黑盒方法，需要针对特定系统进行开发。 XXZ 和 J1-J2 旋转模型提供了严格的基准。基于自旋 BCS 的耦合簇方法可能需要高激发等级才能恢复强相关状态下的精确基态物理。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 强相关的量子系统，包括受挫自旋晶格，对于传统的耦合簇方法来说仍然具有挑战性，因为它们的基态通常表现出强烈的多参考特征和对称性破缺。尽管多参考和对称投影耦合簇理论很有前景，但它们还不是黑盒方法，需要针对特定系统进行开发。 XXZ 和 J1-J2 旋转模型提供了严格的基准。基于自旋 BCS 的耦合簇方法可能需要高激发等级才能恢复强相关状态下的精确基态物理。我们引入了一种非线性自旋-费米子-自旋（SFS）变换，旨在将强相关的自旋哈密顿量映射到新的自旋哈密顿量，其基态在平均场水平上得到更准确的描述。对于代表性的 SFS 变换，我们确定了一个紧凑的 Clifford 电路，它将变换后的乘积状态映射到原始表示中的电路修饰的、通常纠缠的状态。然后可以使用破缺对称平均场理论和后平均场方法来处理变换后的哈密顿量。 XXZ 和 J1-J2 哈密顿量的基准表明，变换表示中的自旋平均场理论相对于传统的自旋 BCS 平均场减少了能量误差。相对于相应的未转换方法，一维 XXZ 模型的基于自旋 BCS 的耦合簇计算提供了显着提高的精度。在二维中，变换后的平均场解的精度取决于位点排序和边界条件，因为可能会出现非局部字符串。这些结果表明，算子表示的精确变换可以作为强相关自旋系统的平均场和低秩耦合簇近似的多体预处理器。

articles.title: Microstructural Generative Inverse Models for Additive Manufacturing Digital Twins
articles.title_zh: 增材制造数字孪生的微观结构生成逆模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30404v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Metal additive manufacturing (AM) offers substantial advantages to the fabrication of complex structural components, but its widespread adoption is slowed due to complexities in the process-structure-property relations which is the cause for uncertainty and drives risk. Accurately quantifying these complex relations solely via experimental workflows is time consuming and costly. Integrated computational materials and engineering (ICME) frameworks address this challenge by leveraging advanced computational tools, such as crystal plasticity finite element models (CPFEM), to predict critical mechanical properties directly from microstructural data. However, these frameworks require a large datasets that are often difficult to obtain, and their predictive accuracy depends on the availability of realistic AM microstructure representations. Generative deep learning models are a promising approach towards synthesizing AM microstructures which contain complex morphological and crystallographic features. Denoising diffusion probabilistic models (DDPMs), in particular, show a strong potential to capture the inherent complexities of AM structures. In this work, we demonstrate that DDPMs can reliably synthesize digital-twin orientation-imaging micrographs, and we support this claim with quantitative evidence of the fidelity of the generated samples. Additionally, we establish a classifier-free guidance framework for solving complex inverse problems such as property-to-structure and process-to-structure mappings, and we showcase a potential application on a qualification-relevant uncertainty quantification problem. Our work highlights the potential of AI-based generative modeling as a key component of computational frameworks for accelerating AM materials qualification and certification.
articles.abstract_zh: 金属增材制造 (AM) 为复杂结构部件的制造提供了巨大的优势，但由于工艺-结构-性能关系的复杂性，导致了不确定性并增加了风险，因此其广泛采用速度缓慢。仅通过实验工作流程准确量化这些复杂关系既耗时又昂贵。集成计算材料和工程 (ICME) 框架通过利用先进的计算工具（例如晶体塑性有限元模型 (CPFEM)）直接从微观结构数据预测关键机械性能来应对这一挑战。然而，这些框架需要大量的数据集，而这些数据集通常很难获得，并且它们的预测准确性取决于真实的增材制造微观结构表示的可用性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 金属增材制造 (AM) 为复杂结构部件的制造提供了巨大的优势，但由于工艺-结构-性能关系的复杂性，导致了不确定性并增加了风险，因此其广泛采用速度缓慢。仅通过实验工作流程准确量化这些复杂关系既耗时又昂贵。集成计算材料和工程 (ICME) 框架通过利用先进的计算工具（例如晶体塑性有限元模型 (CPFEM)）直接从微观结构数据预测关键机械性能来应对这一挑战。然而，这些框架需要大量的数据集，而这些数据集通常很难获得，并且它们的预测准确性取决于真实的增材制造微观结构表示的可用性。生成深度学习模型是合成包含复杂形态和晶体学特征的增材制造微结构的一种有前途的方法。去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）尤其显示出捕获增材制造结构固有复杂性的强大潜力。在这项工作中，我们证明 DDPM 可以可靠地合成数字孪生定向成像显微照片，并且我们用生成样本保真度的定量证据来支持这一说法。此外，我们建立了一个无分类器的指导框架，用于解决复杂的逆问题，例如属性到结构和过程到结构的映射，并且我们展示了在与资格相关的不确定性量化问题上的潜在应用。我们的工作强调了基于人工智能的生成模型作为加速增材制造材料资格和认证的计算框架的关键组成部分的潜力。

articles.title: Nonlinear and Chaotic Dynamics of Two Dipolar-Coupled Anisotropic Spins under Periodic Excitation
articles.title_zh: 周期性激励下两个偶极耦合各向异性自旋的非线性和混沌动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30414v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the non-linear magnetization dynamics of two identical anisotropic macrospins coupled by dipolar interaction and subjected to periodic transverse excitation. The coupled Landau- Lifshitz-Gilbert equations are solved numerically using a fourth-order Runge-Kutta method. By combining bifurcation diagrams, local-maxima analysis, Lyapunov exponents, and two-dimensional stability maps, we characterize how dipolar coupling, transverse driving amplitudes, and uniaxial anisotropy govern the long-time dynamics. The results reveal a non-monotonic reorganization of dynamical regimes, with alternating intervals of enhanced and suppressed instability. Analysis of symmetric and antisymmetric coordinates distinguishes the collective and relative spin responses, while Fourier spectra and three-dimensional trajectories provide complementary frequency-domain and geometrical characterizations. Simultaneous positivity of the two largest Lyapunov exponents identifies parameter regions consistent with hyperchaotic dynamics. Finally, analytical linearization and ferromagnetic-resonance calculations reveal the distinct coupling dependence of the collectivemode frequencies and clarify the limitations of the linearized description beyond the stability thresholds of the collinear reference state. These findings establish a unified framework for understanding the interplay of dipolar coupling, anisotropy, and periodic excitation in the non-linear dynamics of a minimal interacting-spin system.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了两个相同的各向异性宏自旋通过偶极相互作用耦合并受到周期性横向激励的非线性磁化动力学。使用四阶龙格-库塔方法对耦合的 Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert 方程进行数值求解。通过结合分岔图、局部最大值分析、Lyapunov 指数和二维稳定性图，我们描述了偶极耦合、横向驱动振幅和单轴各向异性如何控制长期动力学。结果揭示了动态状态的非单调重组，具有增强和抑制不稳定性的交替间隔。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了两个相同的各向异性宏自旋通过偶极相互作用耦合并受到周期性横向激励的非线性磁化动力学。使用四阶龙格-库塔方法对耦合的 Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert 方程进行数值求解。通过结合分岔图、局部最大值分析、Lyapunov 指数和二维稳定性图，我们描述了偶极耦合、横向驱动振幅和单轴各向异性如何控制长期动力学。结果揭示了动态状态的非单调重组，具有增强和抑制不稳定性的交替间隔。对称和反对称坐标的分析区分集体和相对自旋响应，而傅里叶谱和三维轨迹提供互补的频域和几何特征。两个最大李雅普诺夫指数同时为正值，确定了与超混沌动力学一致的参数区域。最后，分析线性化和铁磁共振计算揭示了集体模式频率的明显耦合依赖性，并澄清了超出共线参考状态的稳定性阈值的线性化描述的局限性。这些发现建立了一个统一的框架，用于理解最小相互作用自旋系统的非线性动力学中偶极耦合、各向异性和周期性激励的相互作用。

articles.title: Design of Nuclear and Magnetic Scattering Length Density Profiles
articles.title_zh: 核和磁散射长度密度分布的设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30416v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The scattering length density (SLD) profile of a sample can be deliberately designed to enhance the information of interest obtained from neutron reflectometry. Here, we demonstrate this approach using amorphous FeₓCoyAl₈Zr₂ thin films. Four samples, each comprising ten repetitions of an AlZr spacer layer and a magnetic layer, were prepared with magnetic-layer compositions of Fe₈₀Co₁₀Al₈Zr₂, Fe₇₀Co₂₀Al₈Zr₂, Fe₆₀Co₃₀Al₈Zr₂, and Fe₄₅Co₄₅Al₈Zr₂, and characterised using X-ray and polarised neutron reflectometry. Across the series, the nuclear SLD of the FeCoAlZr alloy decreases approximately linearly from 7.14 × 10⁻⁶ to 4.63 × 10⁻⁶ mathringA⁻² with increasing Co content, while the magnetic SLD is approximately 4.3-4.5 × 10⁻⁶ mathringA⁻². These results demonstrate that the nuclear and magnetic contributions can be controlled largely independently, with composition primarily tuning the nuclear SLD and the applied magnetic field offering, in principle, additional control of the magnetic contribution.
articles.abstract_zh: 可以故意设计样品的散射长度密度 (SLD) 分布，以增强从中子反射计获得的感兴趣信息。在这里，我们使用非晶 FeₓCoyAl₈Zr2 薄膜演示了这种方法。制备四个样品，每个样品包括十个重复的AlZr间隔层和磁性层，其磁性层组合物为Fe 80 Co 10 Al 8 Zr 2 、Fe 70 Co 20 Al 8 Zr 2 、Fe 60 Co 30 Al 8 Zr 2 和Fe 45 Co 45 Al 8 Zr 2 ，并且使用 X 射线和偏振中子反射计进行表征。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 可以故意设计样品的散射长度密度 (SLD) 分布，以增强从中子反射计获得的感兴趣信息。在这里，我们使用非晶 FeₓCoyAl₈Zr2 薄膜演示了这种方法。制备四个样品，每个样品包括十个重复的AlZr间隔层和磁性层，其磁性层组合物为Fe 80 Co 10 Al 8 Zr 2 、Fe 70 Co 20 Al 8 Zr 2 、Fe 60 Co 30 Al 8 Zr 2 和Fe 45 Co 45 Al 8 Zr 2 ，并且使用 X 射线和偏振中子反射计进行表征。在整个系列中，随着 Co 含量的增加，FeCoAlZr 合金的核 SLD 从 7.14 × 10⁻⁶ 近似线性减小到 4.63 × 10⁻⁶ mathringA⁻²，而磁性 SLD 约为 4.3-4.5 × 10⁻⁶ mathringA⁻²。这些结果表明，核和磁贡献可以在很大程度上独立控制，成分主要调整核 SLD 和施加的磁场，原则上提供对磁贡献的额外控制。

articles.title: Spin polarization in a chiral ladder: elastic and inelastic environments
articles.title_zh: 手性阶梯中的自旋极化：弹性和非弹性环境
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30419v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study how the transport window and environmental reinjection determine the spin polarization transmitted through a minimal two-leg chiral ladder. The model contains time-reversal-invariant helical spin--orbit coupling, spin-independent interchain hopping, and nonmagnetic contacts with two orbital modes per lead. Sublattice symmetry makes the coherent spin-transmission kernel exactly odd in energy. A window centered on the symmetry point therefore gives zero integrated spin current, whereas a displaced window selects an uncanceled spectral interval. The resulting polarization reverses between enantiomers and vanishes in the decoupled-chain, zero-spin--orbit, and equivalent-strand limits of this model. We compare uniform absorption, energy-resolved elastic probes, and thermalized voltage probes at the same finite bias, including reinjection whenever probes are present. Charge conservation alone does not prohibit enhancement of the integrated spin signal: the elastic-probe response can increase at finite bias even where its linear-response counterpart decreases. Thermalized probes can also lift the centered-window zero that elastic probes preserve. Absorption and reinjection also change the transmitted charge, so enhancement of spin current and enhancement of normalized polarization must be distinguished. Static onsite disorder produces sample-dependent fluctuations; its signed ensemble mean is reported with uncertainty and is not forced to vanish in a displaced window. These results identify the energy interval and reservoir prescription that must be controlled when interpreting dephasing trends in minimal models relevant to chirality-induced spin selectivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了传输窗口和环境再注入如何确定通过最小两腿手性梯传输的自旋极化。该模型包含时间反转不变的螺旋自旋轨道耦合、自旋无关的链间跳跃以及每导联具有两种轨道模式的非磁性接触。亚晶格对称性使得相干自旋传输核的能量恰好为奇数。因此，以对称点为中心的窗口给出零积分自旋电流，而移位的窗口选择未消除的光谱间隔。由此产生的极化在对映体之间反转，并在该模型的解耦链、零自旋轨道和等效链极限中消失。我们在相同的有限偏置下比较均匀吸收、能量分辨弹性探针和热化电压探针，包括探针存在时的重新注入。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了传输窗口和环境再注入如何确定通过最小两腿手性梯传输的自旋极化。该模型包含时间反转不变的螺旋自旋轨道耦合、自旋无关的链间跳跃以及每导联具有两种轨道模式的非磁性接触。亚晶格对称性使得相干自旋传输核的能量恰好为奇数。因此，以对称点为中心的窗口给出零积分自旋电流，而移位的窗口选择未消除的光谱间隔。由此产生的极化在对映体之间反转，并在该模型的解耦链、零自旋轨道和等效链极限中消失。我们在相同的有限偏置下比较均匀吸收、能量分辨弹性探针和热化电压探针，包括探针存在时的重新注入。电荷守恒本身并不能阻止积分自旋信号的增强：即使其线性响应对应物减少，弹性探针响应也可以在有限偏置下增加。热化探头还可以提升弹性探头保留的中心窗口零位。吸收和再注入也会改变传输的电荷，因此必须区分自旋电流的增强和归一化极化的增强。静态现场无序产生与样本相关的波动；其带符号的系综平均值的报告具有不确定性，并且不会被迫在移位的窗口中消失。这些结果确定了在解释与手性诱导的自旋选择性相关的最小模型中的相移趋势时必须控制的能量间隔和储层处方。

articles.title: Finite-width altermagnetic quantum rings: angular-channel hybridization and Aharonov--Bohm physics
articles.title_zh: 有限宽度交变磁量子环：角通道杂化和阿哈罗诺夫--玻姆物理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30536v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study a finite-width two-dimensional quantum ring with a quadratic d-wave altermagnetic term, Tan--Inkson confinement, a perpendicular magnetic field, and independently tunable Aharonov--Bohm (AB) flux. The altermagnetic interaction mixes m and m±2 angular channels while preserving their parity. Circular symmetry renders the crystal orientation spectrally irrelevant and makes the two spin blocks exactly isospectral. The resulting same-parity anticrossings are resolved at low filling, and multichannel mixing is found near the Fermi level of highly occupied rings. Independent converged calculations for Nₑ=1400 and 1800 establish the reconstructed Fermi edge and magnetic response in a finite field window and the persistent current over a full AB flux period. The analytic conventional reference separates radial-subband depopulation (dHvA-type cycles) from finer finite-ring shell oscillations; we do not assign a global Fourier spectrum to unverified altermagnetic field scans. The few-electron thermal response is obtained from an exact fixed-particle-number canonical partition function, avoiding finite-system errors of a fixed-mean-number approximation. The circular model supports an equilibrium charge current but no persistent spin current.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个有限宽度的二维量子环，具有二次 d 波交变磁项、Tan-Inkson 约束、垂直磁场和独立可调的 Aharonov-Bohm (AB) 通量。交变磁相互作用混合了 m 和 m±2 角通道，同时保留了它们的奇偶性。圆对称性使得晶体取向在光谱上无关，并使两个自旋块完全等光谱。由此产生的同宇称反交叉在低填充下得到解决，并且在高占据环的费米能级附近发现多通道混合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了一个有限宽度的二维量子环，具有二次 d 波交变磁项、Tan-Inkson 约束、垂直磁场和独立可调的 Aharonov-Bohm (AB) 通量。交变磁相互作用混合了 m 和 m±2 角通道，同时保留了它们的奇偶性。圆对称性使得晶体取向在光谱上无关，并使两个自旋块完全等光谱。由此产生的同宇称反交叉在低填充下得到解决，并且在高占据环的费米能级附近发现多通道混合。 Nₑ=1400 和 1800 的独立收敛计算建立了有限场窗口中的重构费米边和磁响应以及整个 AB 磁通周期内的持续电流。解析传统参考将径向子带减少（dHvA 型循环）与更精细的有限环壳振荡分开；我们不会为未经验证的交变磁场扫描分配全局傅里叶谱。少电子热响应是从精确的固定粒子数正则配分函数获得的，避免了固定平均数近似的有限系统误差。圆形模型支持平衡充电电流，但不支持持续自旋电流。

articles.title: Field-free superconducting diode and tunable vortex dynamics in NbN/FePt stripe-domain heterostructures
articles.title_zh: NbN/FePt 条带域异质结构中的无场超导二极管和可调谐涡旋动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30556v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate reconfigurable, field-free superconducting diode behavior in NbN/FePt and NbN/AlN/FePt heterostructures with remanent stripe domains in the FePt layer. NbN films 10 nm thick are capped either directly with FePt or through a thin AlN spacer, which reduces electronic proximity effects while preserving magnetic coupling through stray fields. At zero applied magnetic field, the superconducting diode efficiency reaches approximately 50--60% in NbN/FePt when the stripes are perpendicular to the current and is strongly reduced when they are parallel. The diode effect persists in NbN/AlN/FePt with efficiencies reaching approximately 35--40%, supporting a magnetic origin of the nonreciprocity. We interpret the response as asymmetric vortex transport in the remanent magnetic landscape, with preferential edge vorticity and a Lorentz force that favors inward flux injection or outward motion depending on current polarity. Under applied perpendicular magnetic fields, the interplay between the external field and the magnetic stray fields modifies the flux-flow instability and the apparent instability velocity inferred from transport, with values below those reported for bare NbN films. These results show that stripe-domain ferromagnetic overlayers provide a reconfigurable route to control superconducting nonreciprocity and flux-flow stability in NbN-based heterostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们展示了 NbN/FePt 和 NbN/AlN/FePt 异质结构中的可重构、无场超导二极管行为，并在 FePt 层中具有剩余条带域。 10 nm 厚的 NbN 薄膜直接用 FePt 覆盖或通过薄的 AlN 间隔物覆盖，这减少了电子邻近效应，同时保持通过杂散场的磁耦合。在零外加磁场下，当条带垂直于电流时，NbN/FePt 中的超导二极管效率达到约 50--60%，而当条带平行时，效率会大大降低。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们展示了 NbN/FePt 和 NbN/AlN/FePt 异质结构中的可重构、无场超导二极管行为，并在 FePt 层中具有剩余条带域。 10 nm 厚的 NbN 薄膜直接用 FePt 覆盖或通过薄的 AlN 间隔物覆盖，这减少了电子邻近效应，同时保持通过杂散场的磁耦合。在零外加磁场下，当条带垂直于电流时，NbN/FePt 中的超导二极管效率达到约 50--60%，而当条带平行时，效率会大大降低。 NbN/AlN/FePt 中持续存在二极管效应，效率达到约 35--40%，支持非互易性的磁起源。我们将响应解释为剩磁景观中的不对称涡流输运，具有优先边缘涡度和洛伦兹力，有利于根据电流极性向内通量注入或向外运动。在施加垂直磁场下，外部场和杂散场之间的相互作用改变了磁通流不稳定性和从传输推断的表观不稳定性速度，其值低于裸 NbN 薄膜报道的值。这些结果表明，条带域铁磁覆盖层提供了一种可重构的途径来控制 NbN 基异质结构中的超导非互易性和磁通流稳定性。

articles.title: Decoding Composition-Structure-Performance Relations in Sodium Layered Oxide Positive Electrode Materials
articles.title_zh: 解读钠层状氧化物正极材料的成分-结构-性能关系
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30591v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Layered sodium transition-metal (TM) oxides, NaₓTMO₂, are among the most promising sodium-ion positive electrode materials, yet their Na/vacancy orderings, layer stacking sequences, and cooperative Jahn--Teller distortions are known only for a few single-TM compounds. We compile the Na/vacancy orderings reported in earlier studies into a single library of 41 unique orderings and apply this uniformly to five single-TM and all ten NaₓTM₀.₅TM'₀.₅O₂ oxides (TM = Ti, Mn, Fe, Co, Ni), screening more than 120,000 structures with machine-learning interatomic potentials prior to 1,025 accurate first-principles calculations. The phase diagrams explain the observed O3/P3/O1 sequences and voltages, and the O3-to-P3 competition hinges on ordering energies of a few meV per atom that scalar descriptors, such as the cationic potential and the interlayer-slab distance, miss. Our extensive analysis reveals that the redox couples form a nearly partner-independent ladder, Ti³⁺/⁴⁺ < Mn³⁺/⁴⁺ < Co³⁺/⁴⁺ < Ni²⁺/³⁺ < Fe³⁺/⁴⁺, explaining pristine charge transfer and the oxidation sequence. Van Vleck analysis of every TMO₆ octahedron reveals that TM mixing suppresses the cooperative Jahn--Teller distortions of Mn³⁺ and Ni³⁺ through charge transfer to Jahn--Teller-inactive states or dilution of Jahn--Teller-active centers. We formulate an energy-density-versus-strain map that yields a design rule: a high-voltage couple without Jahn--Teller strain, which Mn⁴⁺/Ni²⁺ charge transfer realizes in NaₓMn₀.₅Ni₀.₅O₂, the most practical composition. We release the ordering-resolved dataset as a training set for subsequent training of accurate machine-learning interatomic potentials.
articles.abstract_zh: 层状钠过渡金属 (TM) 氧化物 NaₓTMO2 是最有前途的钠离子正极材料之一，但其 Na/空位排序、层堆叠顺序和协同 Jahn-Teller 畸变仅在少数单 TM 化合物中为人所知。我们将早期研究中报告的Na/空位排序编译成包含41种独特排序的单一库，并将其统一应用于五个单TM和所有十个NaₓTM₀.₅TM'₀.₅O2氧化物（TM = Ti、Mn、Fe、Co、Ni），在1,025次准确的第一原理计算之前筛选了超过120,000个具有机器学习原子间势的结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 层状钠过渡金属 (TM) 氧化物 NaₓTMO2 是最有前途的钠离子正极材料之一，但其 Na/空位排序、层堆叠顺序和协同 Jahn-Teller 畸变仅在少数单 TM 化合物中为人所知。我们将早期研究中报告的Na/空位排序编译成包含41种独特排序的单一库，并将其统一应用于五个单TM和所有十个NaₓTM₀.₅TM'₀.₅O2氧化物（TM = Ti、Mn、Fe、Co、Ni），在1,025次准确的第一原理计算之前筛选了超过120,000个具有机器学习原子间势的结构。相图解释了观察到的 O3/P3/O1 序列和电压，并且 O3 到 P3 的竞争取决于每个原子几 meV 的有序能量，而标量描述符（例如阳离子势和层间板距离）错过了这一点。我们的广泛分析表明，氧化还原对形成了一个几乎与伙伴无关的梯子，Ti³⁺/⁴⁺ < Mn³⁺/⁴⁺ < Co³⁺/⁴⁺ < Ni²⁺/³⁺ < Fe³⁺/⁴⁺，解释了原始电荷转移和氧化顺序。 Van Vleck 对每个 TMO₆ 八面体的分析表明，TM 混合通过电荷转移到 Jahn-Teller 非活性状态或稀释 Jahn-Teller 活性中心来抑制 Mn3+ 和 Ni3⁺ 的协同 Jahn-Teller 畸变。我们制定了能量密度与应变图，得出了一个设计规则：没有 Jahn-Teller 应变的高压电偶，Mn⁴⁺/Ni2⁺ 电荷转移在最实用的组合物 NaₓMn₀.₅Ni₀.₅O2 中实现。我们发布了排序解析的数据集作为训练集，用于后续精确机器学习原子间势的训练。

articles.title: Hierarchical Reduction of Invariant Subspaces: From Fragmentation to Many-Body Scars
articles.title_zh: 不变子空间的分层约简：从碎片到多体疤痕
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30597v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate a hierarchy of invariant Hilbert-space structures connecting Hilbert-space fragmentation, partial solvability, and quantum many-body scars. For spin chains with fragmented spin-1/2 subspaces and their local deformations, we show, using the spin-1 XXC chain as a representative example, how successive local deformations reduce extensive irreducible-string fragmentation through an implicitly embedded spin-1/2 invariant space and ultimately to a single scar tower, connecting the XXC, perturbed XXC, and spin-1 XY scar models. Through the intermediate embedded space, local dynamics couples states from distinct frozen irreducible-string sectors and selects a new decomposition into representations, from which smaller invariant spaces can be retained. We also establish a rigidity constraint on isolating nonsymmetric towers and a constructive correspondence that transfers a reduction between locally realizable representations of the embedded dynamics. The latter demonstrates that the reduction hierarchy can be transferred through a unitary transformation within the embedded subspace, yielding an exact scar tower built on a Néel reference state without requiring unitary equivalence of the full Hamiltonians.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了连接希尔伯特空间碎片、部分可解性和量子多体疤痕的不变希尔伯特空间结构的层次结构。对于具有碎片自旋 1/2 子空间及其局部变形的自旋链，我们使用 spin-1 XXC 链作为代表性示例，展示了连续局部变形如何通过隐式嵌入的 spin-1/2 不变空间并最终形成单个疤痕塔来减少广泛的不可约弦碎片，从而连接 XXC、扰动 XXC 和 spin-1 XY 疤痕模型。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了连接希尔伯特空间碎片、部分可解性和量子多体疤痕的不变希尔伯特空间结构的层次结构。对于具有碎片自旋 1/2 子空间及其局部变形的自旋链，我们使用 spin-1 XXC 链作为代表性示例，展示了连续局部变形如何通过隐式嵌入的 spin-1/2 不变空间并最终形成单个疤痕塔来减少广泛的不可约弦碎片，从而连接 XXC、扰动 XXC 和 spin-1 XY 疤痕模型。通过中间嵌入空间，局部动力学将来自不同冻结不可约弦扇区的状态耦合起来，并选择新的分解表示，从中可以保留更小的不变空间。我们还建立了对隔离非对称塔的刚性约束，以及在嵌入式动力学的局部可实现表示之间传递减少的建设性对应关系。后者证明了约简层次可以通过嵌入子空间内的酉变换来转移，从而产生建立在尼尔参考状态上的精确疤痕塔，而不需要完整哈密顿量的酉等价。

articles.title: Strain-induced structural transformations in hexagonal monolayer boron nitride. A density functional study
articles.title_zh: 六方单层氮化硼中应变诱导的结构转变。密度泛函研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30598v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work we theoretically study the structural transformations occurring in monolayer hexagonal boron nitride (h-BN) subjected to strong deformations. The first-principle computer simulations are based on the density functional theory employing the pseudopotentials with the exchange-correlation energy given in Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof form. Depending on the direction and the type of the strain, the simulations reveal different types of structural transformations in two-dimensional (2D) h-BN associated with the elastic failure. It is found that, under certain shear strains, there can form an ordered 2D orthorhombic phase with the 2D layer space symmetry pmmm. Thermal stability of the latter up to ~900 K is demonstrated by first-principle Born-Oppenheimer molecular dynamics. The examination of electronic structure indicates that, in contrast to the conventional h-BN, which is an insulator with the wide band gap, the predicted orthorhombic phase is expected to be a semiconductor with the narrow band gap of ~ 0.65 eV.
articles.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们从理论上研究了单层六方氮化硼（h-BN）在强烈变形下发生的结构转变。第一原理计算机模拟基于密度泛函理论，采用赝势以及以 Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof 形式给出的交换相关能量。根据应变的方向和类型，模拟揭示了与弹性失效相关的二维 (2D) h-BN 中不同类型的结构转变。研究发现，在一定的剪切应变下，可以形成二维层空间对称性pmmm的有序二维斜方相。第一原理 Born-Oppenheimer 分子动力学证明了后者高达约 900 K 的热稳定性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这项工作中，我们从理论上研究了单层六方氮化硼（h-BN）在强烈变形下发生的结构转变。第一原理计算机模拟基于密度泛函理论，采用赝势以及以 Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof 形式给出的交换相关能量。根据应变的方向和类型，模拟揭示了与弹性失效相关的二维 (2D) h-BN 中不同类型的结构转变。研究发现，在一定的剪切应变下，可以形成二维层空间对称性pmmm的有序二维斜方相。第一原理 Born-Oppenheimer 分子动力学证明了后者高达约 900 K 的热稳定性。电子结构的检查表明，与传统的h-BN（具有宽带隙的绝缘体）相比，预测的斜方相有望成为具有约0.65 eV的窄带隙的半导体。

articles.title: How good are universal MLIPs for alloys? A benchmark is only as trustworthy as its controls
articles.title_zh: 适用于合金的通用 MLIP 效果如何？基准仅与其控制一样值得信赖
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30641v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Universal machine-learned interatomic potentials (uMLIPs) are ranked by their formation-energy error against a DFT database, as if that database were ground truth, but independent DFT databases disagree. We benchmark fourteen uMLIPs on 1.45 million ordered intermetallics against AFLOW, which none trained on, and compare every energy and stability error with that disagreement. For half the structures, AFLOW, Alexandria, and OQMD differ by less than 6-8 meV/atom, but a minority differ by far more, raising the average to 16-30. That disagreement sets a floor on any model's measurable error. Re-referenced, the best uMLIP agrees with AFLOW as closely as Alexandria does, and the next four sit 2-7 meV/atom above the floor. Once broken elemental references are screened, the energy and stability rankings agree almost everywhere. Three apparent model failures shrink or vanish under the right control: poorly correlated shear moduli, thousands of "bad" DFT references, and the leader's inflated lead.
articles.abstract_zh: 通用机器学习原子间势（uMLIP）根据 DFT 数据库的形成能量误差进行排名，就好像该数据库是真实的，但独立的 DFT 数据库不同意。我们将 145 万个有序金属间化合物的 14 个 uMLIP 与 AFLOW 进行了比较（没有经过任何训练），并将每个能量和稳定性误差与该分歧进行比较。对于一半的结构，AFLOW、Alexandria 和 OQMD 的差异小于 6-8 meV/原子，但少数结构的差异要大得多，将平均值提高到 16-30。这种分歧为任何模型的可测量误差设定了底限。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通用机器学习原子间势（uMLIP）根据 DFT 数据库的形成能量误差进行排名，就好像该数据库是真实的，但独立的 DFT 数据库不同意。我们将 145 万个有序金属间化合物的 14 个 uMLIP 与 AFLOW 进行了比较（没有经过任何训练），并将每个能量和稳定性误差与该分歧进行比较。对于一半的结构，AFLOW、Alexandria 和 OQMD 的差异小于 6-8 meV/原子，但少数结构的差异要大得多，将平均值提高到 16-30。这种分歧为任何模型的可测量误差设定了底限。重新参考，最好的 uMLIP 与 AFLOW 的一致性与 Alexandria 的一致，接下来的四个位于地板上方 2-7 meV/atom。一旦筛选出损坏的元素参考，能量和稳定性排名几乎在所有地方都一致。在正确的控制下，三个明显的模型故障会缩小或消失：相关性较差的剪切模量、数千个“不良”DFT 参考以及领先者的膨胀领先优势。

articles.title: From phase analysis to phase tracking: a robust approach to atomic-scale strain mapping
articles.title_zh: 从相分析到相跟踪：原子尺度应变映射的稳健方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30665v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Atomic-scale strain governs the electronic, ferroic and mechanical properties of materials, and atomic-resolution microscopy measures it most directly. Geometric phase analysis (GPA) is the standard tool, but it fails when a Bragg reflection moves outside its fixed Fourier aperture under large strain or rotation, or in misoriented grains. Here we introduce geometric phase tracking analysis (GPTA), whose Fourier aperture tracks the Bragg reflection at each pixel in real space. A narrow aperture can therefore reject noise without losing a displaced reflection. On 13,795 simulated and experimental atomic-resolution images under various imaging conditions, GPTA reduces GPA's failure rate from 27% to 11.5% with up to 335 times better accuracy. It also gives strain and dislocation maps across grains, resistance to dynamical-scattering extinction, and a confidence map, capabilities that GPA lacks. Tracking the aperture combines reciprocal-space dose efficiency with real-space spatial resolution and extends atomic-scale strain metrology to beam-sensitive materials and challenging imaging conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 原子尺度应变控制材料的电子、铁性和机械性能，而原子分辨率显微镜最直接地测量它。几何相位分析 (GPA) 是标准工具，但当布拉格反射在大应变或旋转下或在定向错误的晶粒中移动到其固定傅里叶孔径之外时，它就会失败。这里我们引入几何相位跟踪分析（GPTA），其傅里叶孔径跟踪真实空间中每个像素的布拉格反射。因此，窄孔径可以抑制噪声而不丢失移位的反射。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 原子尺度应变控制材料的电子、铁性和机械性能，而原子分辨率显微镜最直接地测量它。几何相位分析 (GPA) 是标准工具，但当布拉格反射在大应变或旋转下或在定向错误的晶粒中移动到其固定傅里叶孔径之外时，它就会失败。这里我们引入几何相位跟踪分析（GPTA），其傅里叶孔径跟踪真实空间中每个像素的布拉格反射。因此，窄孔径可以抑制噪声而不丢失移位的反射。在各种成像条件下的 13,795 张模拟和实验原子分辨率图像中，GPTA 将 GPA 的失败率从 27% 降低到 11.5%，准确度提高了 335 倍。它还提供了跨晶粒的应变和位错图、对动态散射消光的抵抗力以及置信度图，这些都是 GPA 所缺乏的功能。跟踪孔径将倒易空间剂量效率与实空间空间分辨率相结合，并将原子级应变计量扩展到光束敏感材料和具有挑战性的成像条件。

articles.title: Impact of localized 4f magnetism on Berry curvature and the intrinsic anomalous Hall effect in CeRu₂Si₂
articles.title_zh: 局域 4f 磁力对贝里曲率的影响以及 CeRu2Si2 中固有的反常霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30684v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The intrinsic anomalous Hall effect (AHE), originating from Berry curvature, has been extensively studied in f-electron systems, including Ce-based compounds. However, how the magnetism of localized f electrons affect the intrinsic AHE remains unclear. Here, we investigate this issue in CeRu₂Si₂ by calculating the intrinsic anomalous Hall conductivity (AHC) for several occupied Ce-4f states using first-principles LDA+U calculations combined with Wannier interpolation method. We find that the intrinsic AHC remains finite even when the Ce-4f states are localized and do not contribute directly to the Fermi surface, and that its magnitude depends on which Ce-4f state is occupied. We show that localized 4f-electron magnetism induces exchange splitting in the conduction bands, generating Berry curvature in specific regions near the Fermi surface. This mechanism enables conduction bands that are derived from nonmagnetic orbitals and form the Fermi surface to contribute to the intrinsic AHE, suggesting a route to realizing large intrinsic AHE in f-electron materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 源自贝里曲率的本征反常霍尔效应 (AHE) 已在 f 电子系统（包括 Ce 基化合物）中得到广泛研究。然而，局域 f 电子的磁性如何影响本征 AHE 仍不清楚。在这里，我们通过使用第一性原理 LDA+U 计算结合 Wannier 插值法计算几个占据的 Ce-4f 态的本征反常霍尔电导率 (AHC)，研究了 CeRu2Si2 中的这个问题。我们发现，即使 Ce-4f 态局域化并且不直接影响费米面，本征 AHC 仍然是有限的，并且其大小取决于占据哪个 Ce-4f 态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 源自贝里曲率的本征反常霍尔效应 (AHE) 已在 f 电子系统（包括 Ce 基化合物）中得到广泛研究。然而，局域 f 电子的磁性如何影响本征 AHE 仍不清楚。在这里，我们通过使用第一性原理 LDA+U 计算结合 Wannier 插值法计算几个占据的 Ce-4f 态的本征反常霍尔电导率 (AHC)，研究了 CeRu2Si2 中的这个问题。我们发现，即使 Ce-4f 态局域化并且不直接影响费米面，本征 AHC 仍然是有限的，并且其大小取决于占据哪个 Ce-4f 态。我们表明，局域 4f 电子磁力会引起导带中的交换分裂，从而在费米表面附近的特定区域产生贝里曲率。这种机制使得源自非磁轨道并形成费米表面的导带有助于本征 AHE，这为在 f 电子材料中实现大本征 AHE 提供了一条途径。

articles.title: Ferroelastic Reversal Magnon Thermal Hall Effect in a Fully Compensated Ferrimagnet
articles.title_zh: 全补偿亚铁磁体中的铁弹性反转磁振子热霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30733v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnons offer a charge-neutral channel for spin and heat transport, yet reversible and nonvolatile control of their thermal Hall response poses a fundamental challenge in systems with zero net magnetization. Here, we establish ferroelastic switching as an effective route to manipulate magnonic transverse responses in fully compensated ferrimagnets. A minimal Heisenberg-Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya model reveals that ferroelastic switching can re-orientate the lattice anisotropy, which reconstructs the chirality-resolved magnon bands and Berry curvature distribution. Consequently, the two orthogonal fully compensated ferrimagnetic variants related by [C2||C4z] exhibit magnon thermal Hall responses with opposite signs, whereas the response vanishes in the intermediate altermagnetic phase. First-principles calculations further identify monolayer V2SSe as a promising material candidate for realizing the proposed ferroelastic control of transverse magnon transport. Remarkably, ferroelastic switching drives a dual magnonic-electronic band reconstruction, enabling nonvolatile reversal of the magnon thermal Hall effect while producing anisotropic orbital Hall responses and distinct magneto-optical spectra as complementary transport and optical fingerprints. Our findings establish ferroelasticity as an effective route to nonvolatile magnon control and multichannel state identification in zero net magnetization systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁振子为自旋和热传输提供了电荷中性通道，但对其热霍尔响应的可逆和非易失性控制对净磁化强度为零的系统提出了根本性挑战。在这里，我们将铁弹切换作为操纵完全补偿亚铁磁体中的磁角横向响应的有效途径。最小的 Heisenberg-Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 模型表明，铁弹性切换可以重新定向晶格各向异性，从而重建手性分辨的磁振子带和贝里曲率分布。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁振子为自旋和热传输提供了电荷中性通道，但对其热霍尔响应的可逆和非易失性控制对净磁化强度为零的系统提出了根本性挑战。在这里，我们将铁弹切换作为操纵完全补偿亚铁磁体中的磁角横向响应的有效途径。最小的 Heisenberg-Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 模型表明，铁弹性切换可以重新定向晶格各向异性，从而重建手性分辨的磁振子带和贝里曲率分布。因此，由 [C2||C4z] 相关的两个正交完全补偿的亚铁磁变体表现出具有相反符号的磁振子热霍尔响应，而该响应在中间交磁相中消失。第一原理计算进一步确定单层 V2SSe 作为实现所提出的横向磁振子输运铁弹性控制的有前途的候选材料。值得注意的是，铁弹性开关驱动双磁电子能带重建，实现磁振子热霍尔效应的非易失性逆转，同时产生各向异性轨道霍尔响应和独特的磁光光谱作为互补的传输和光学指纹。我们的研究结果表明，铁弹性是零净磁化系统中非易失性磁振子控制和多通道状态识别的有效途径。

articles.title: Anyon Chern bands of opposite sign and reversed drift
articles.title_zh: 具有相反符号和反向漂移的任何陈省身带
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30743v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The elementary charged excitations of fractional quantum Hall states are anyons. Without continuous translation symmetry, they acquire a dispersion and richer dynamics. We study the Laughlin quasihole at filling 1/3 in a periodically modulated magnetic field, a common model of fractional Chern insulators in two-dimensional materials. From the microscopic wave functions, we derive the commutator of its guiding-center coordinates, set by a many-body Berry curvature that governs its wave packets. A modulation with two flux quanta per unit cell splits the quasihole band into bands with Chern numbers 6 and -3; such opposite signs are generic as long as a weak modulation opens a gap between the anyon bands. In the C=-3 band, the quasihole drifts against EtimesB, although the magnetic field has the same sign everywhere. Perturbation theory in the modulation explains these results, and large-scale Monte Carlo calculations confirm them. Anyon bands thus acquire their own topology, which controls anyon motion and may shape the phases of itinerant anyons.
articles.abstract_zh: 分数量子霍尔态的基本带电激发是任意子。如果没有连续的平移对称性，它们就会获得分散性和更丰富的动态。我们研究了周期性调制磁场中填充 1/3 时的劳克林准空穴，这是二维材料中分数陈绝缘体的常见模型。从微观波函数中，我们推导出其引导中心坐标的换向器，该坐标由控制其波包的多体贝里曲率设置。每个晶胞有两个通量量子的调制将准空穴带分成陈数为 6 和 -3 的带；只要弱调制在任意子带之间打开间隙，这种相反的符号就是通用的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 分数量子霍尔态的基本带电激发是任意子。如果没有连续的平移对称性，它们就会获得分散性和更丰富的动态。我们研究了周期性调制磁场中填充 1/3 时的劳克林准空穴，这是二维材料中分数陈绝缘体的常见模型。从微观波函数中，我们推导出其引导中心坐标的换向器，该坐标由控制其波包的多体贝里曲率设置。每个晶胞有两个通量量子的调制将准空穴带分成陈数为 6 和 -3 的带；只要弱调制在任意子带之间打开间隙，这种相反的符号就是通用的。在 C=-3 频段，准空穴相对于 EtimesB 漂移，尽管磁场到处都有相同的符号。调制中的扰动理论解释了这些结果，大规模蒙特卡罗计算证实了这些结果。因此，任意子带获得了自己的拓扑，该拓扑控制任意子运动并可以塑造流动任意子的相位。

articles.title: Coulomb-Driven Electronic Textures in Lightly Hole-Doped Cuprates
articles.title_zh: 轻孔掺杂铜酸盐中库仑驱动的电子纹理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30766v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Motivated by recent experiments on Ca₂CuO₂Cl₂, we present a comprehensive study of the interplay between dopants and localized Zhang-Rice singlets in lightly hole-doped cuprates. Owing to the poorly screened Coulomb potential, the interactions between dopants and localized Zhang-Rice singlets favor asymmetric electronic configurations characterized by effective electric "dipoles". Using the MPS-based Lanczos method, we show that these localized holes give rise to in-gap bound states within the charge-transfer gap. When tunneling matrix-element effects are included, the bound states exhibit a characteristic 4a₀ × 2a₀ internal structure, consistent with experimental observations. Our results suggest that Coulomb interactions between dopants and localized Zhang-Rice singlets, together with tunneling matrix-element effects, provide a microscopic mechanism for the observed 4a₀ electronic structures.
articles.abstract_zh: 受最近 Ca2CuO2Cl2 实验的启发，我们对轻空穴掺杂铜酸盐中掺杂剂与局域张-莱斯单线态之间的相互作用进行了全面研究。由于库仑势屏蔽不良，掺杂剂和局域张-莱斯单线态之间的相互作用有利于以有效电“偶极子”为特征的不对称电子构型。使用基于 MPS 的 Lanczos 方法，我们表明这些局部空穴会在电荷转移间隙内产生间隙内束缚态。当包括隧道矩阵元效应时，束缚态表现出特征性的 4a₀ × 2a₀ 内部结构，与实验观察结果一致。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 受最近 Ca2CuO2Cl2 实验的启发，我们对轻空穴掺杂铜酸盐中掺杂剂与局域张-莱斯单线态之间的相互作用进行了全面研究。由于库仑势屏蔽不良，掺杂剂和局域张-莱斯单线态之间的相互作用有利于以有效电“偶极子”为特征的不对称电子构型。使用基于 MPS 的 Lanczos 方法，我们表明这些局部空穴会在电荷转移间隙内产生间隙内束缚态。当包括隧道矩阵元效应时，束缚态表现出特征性的 4a₀ × 2a₀ 内部结构，与实验观察结果一致。我们的结果表明，掺杂剂和局域Zhang-Rice单线态之间的库仑相互作用，以及隧道基体元素效应，为观察到的4a₀电子结构提供了微观机制。

articles.title: Thermal expansion mechanisms, heat transport, and band-gap renormalization in strongly anharmonic Rb₂SO₄, Rb₂Ca₂(SO₄)₃, and Ba₃Lu(BO₃)₃ from machine-learned interatomic potentials
articles.title_zh: 根据机器学习的原子间势研究强非谐 Rb2SO4、Rb2Ca2(SO4)3 和 Ba₃Lu(BO3)3 的热膨胀机制、热传输和带隙重正化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30918v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rb₂SO₄, Rb₂Ca₂(SO₄)₃, and Ba₃Lu(BO₃)₃ are structurally complex materials whose thermal expansion has been interpreted, on the basis of high-temperature x-ray diffraction, in terms of specific polyhedral rearrangements. We study their lattice dynamics and its consequences for thermal and electronic properties using molecular dynamics with actively learned moment tensor potentials trained on density-functional theory data. The anharmonicity measure σ^A (compares the anharmonic contribution to the interatomic forces with the total forces acting on atoms) reaches approx0.3-0.5 for β-Rb₂SO₄, Rb₂Ca₂(SO₄)₃, and Ba₃Lu(BO₃)₃ and approx0.75 for orientationally disordered α-Rb₂SO₄, and the imaginary harmonic modes of Rb₂Ca₂(SO₄)₃ and α-Rb₂SO₄ are stabilized at finite temperature. The simulations reproduce the measured thermal expansion and support the mechanisms proposed from diffraction: expansion along c in β-Rb₂SO₄ arises from both elongation and straightening of corrugated Rb chains, BO₃ reorientation accompanies the anisotropic expansion of Ba₃Lu(BO₃)₃, and bending of polyhedral linkages limits expansion along the weakly expanding directions and in cubic Rb₂Ca₂(SO₄)₃. Green-Kubo lattice thermal conductivities differ by more than an order of magnitude between compounds with comparable σ^A, showing that the anharmonicity measure alone does not determine heat transport. Phonon-induced band-gap renormalization, including lattice thermal expansion, reaches 2.7 and 1.7 eV at 1250 K in Rb₂Ca₂(SO₄)₃ and Ba₃Lu(BO₃)₃ and 1.4 eV at 650 K in β-Rb₂SO₄, with zero-point renormalizations of 0.64, 0.70, and 0.31 eV for β-Rb₂SO₄, Rb₂Ca₂(SO₄)₃, and Ba₃Lu(BO₃)₃, respectively.
articles.abstract_zh: Rb2SO4、Rb2Ca2(SO4)3 和 Ba3Lu(BO3)3 是结构复杂的材料，其热膨胀已在高温 X 射线衍射的基础上根据特定的多面体重排进行了解释。我们使用分子动力学研究它们的晶格动力学及其对热和电子性质的影响，并使用密度泛函理论数据训练的主动学习矩张量势。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Rb2SO4、Rb2Ca2(SO4)3 和 Ba3Lu(BO3)3 是结构复杂的材料，其热膨胀已在高温 X 射线衍射的基础上根据特定的多面体重排进行了解释。我们使用分子动力学研究它们的晶格动力学及其对热和电子性质的影响，并使用密度泛函理论数据训练的主动学习矩张量势。对于 β-Rb2SO4、Rb2Ca2(SO4)3 和 Ba₃Lu(BO3)3，非谐性测度 σ^A（将原子间作用力的非谐性贡献与作用在原子上的总力进行比较）达到约 0.3-0.5，对于取向无序的 α-Rb2SO4，非谐性测度约为 0.75，虚部谐波模式为Rb2Ca2(SO4)3和α-Rb2SO4在有限温度下稳定。模拟再现了测得的热膨胀并支持衍射提出的机制：β-Rb2SO4中沿c的膨胀是由波纹Rb链的伸长和拉直引起的，BO3重新取向伴随着Ba3Lu(BO3)3的各向异性膨胀，多面体连接的弯曲限制了沿弱膨胀方向和立方体Rb2Ca2(SO4)3的膨胀。 Green-Kubo 晶格热导率在具有可比 σ^A 的化合物之间相差超过一个数量级，这表明非谐性测量本身并不能决定热传输。声子引起的带隙重整化（包括晶格热膨胀）在 Rb2Ca2(SO4)3 和 Ba3Lu(BO3)3 中在 1250 K 下达到 2.7 和 1.7 eV，在 β-Rb2SO4 中在 650 K 下达到 1.4 eV，零点重整化分别为 0.64、0.70 和β-Rb2SO4、Rb2Ca2(SO4)3 和 Ba3Lu(BO3)3 分别为 0.31 eV。

articles.title: Piezo-Kerr effect in altermagnets and noncollinear antiferromagnets
articles.title_zh: 交流磁体和非共线反铁磁体中的压电克尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30929v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Symmetry is usually viewed as a constraint on physical responses, but it can also be used to design the fields that control them. Here, we adopt the representation-matching principle used to identify conjugate fields of order parameters and apply it to response tensors. A linear coupling, the key ingredient for sign-switching control, is symmetry-allowed when a component (or a combination of components) of the control field and the selected response component share the same irreducible representation of the magnetic point group (MPG) of the system. Applied to the magneto-optical Kerr effect, this principle yields a piezo-Kerr effect, in which specific strain combinations activate a Kerr response forbidden in the unstrained state. Enumerating all 122 MPGs, we identify 16 groups in which the unstrained Kerr response is forbidden while a linear strain-induced contribution is allowed. These groups are realized by altermagnets and noncollinear antiferromagnets with symmetry-enforced vanishing net magnetization. The active strain channels and the associated first-order sign reversals follow directly from symmetry. First-principles calculations for bulk MnTe₂ and CoF₂, and Cr₂Se₂O and Cr₂Te₂O monolayers confirm these predictions. In these materials, the Kerr rotation vanishes without strain, whereas 0.5-3% strain produces rotations ranging from tens to hundreds of millidegrees, and reversing the matched strain channel reverses the Kerr sign. These results establish a general route to large and switchable Kerr responses emerging from symmetry-forbidden states in compensated magnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 对称性通常被视为对物理响应的约束，但它也可以用于设计控制它们的场。在这里，我们采用表示匹配原理来识别阶次参数的共轭场并将其应用于响应张量。当控制场的一个分量（或分量的组合）和选定的响应分量共享系统磁点组（MPG）的相同不可约表示时，线性耦合是符号切换控制的关键要素，是允许对称的。应用于磁光克尔效应时，该原理会产生压电克尔效应，其中特定的应变组合激活在无应变状态下禁止的克尔响应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对称性通常被视为对物理响应的约束，但它也可以用于设计控制它们的场。在这里，我们采用表示匹配原理来识别阶次参数的共轭场并将其应用于响应张量。当控制场的一个分量（或分量的组合）和选定的响应分量共享系统磁点组（MPG）的相同不可约表示时，线性耦合是符号切换控制的关键要素，是允许对称的。应用于磁光克尔效应时，该原理会产生压电克尔效应，其中特定的应变组合激活在无应变状态下禁止的克尔响应。枚举所有 122 个 MPG，我们确定了 16 个组，其中禁止无应变克尔响应，而允许线性应变引起的贡献。这些组是通过具有对称强制消失净磁化的交变磁体和非共线反铁磁体来实现的。主动应变通道和相关的一阶符号反转直接遵循对称性。对块体 MnTe2 和 CoF2、Cr2Se2O 和 Cr2Te2O 单层的第一性原理计算证实了这些预测。在这些材料中，克尔旋转在没有应变的情况下消失，而 0.5-3% 的应变会产生数十到数百毫度的旋转，并且反转匹配的应变通道会反转克尔符号。这些结果建立了从补偿磁体的对称禁止态中产生大的、可切换的克尔响应的一般途径。

articles.title: Active phase separation from concentration-dependent diffusion in chemical networks
articles.title_zh: 化学网络中浓度依赖性扩散的主动相分离
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30958v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Active phase separation in living systems is ubiquitous, yet the microscopic origins of the non-equilibrium terms in active field theories remain largely unknown. Here, starting from stochastic mass-conserving reaction-diffusion dynamics of two interacting chemical species, we perform a systematic slow-mode reduction and derive the complete Active Model B+ field theory, with all phenomenological coefficients expressed in terms of microscopic parameters. We identify concentration-dependent diffusivities and asymmetric inter-species chemotactic couplings as the minimal microscopic ingredients generating the genuinely non-equilibrium coefficient responsible for microphase separation, cluster phases, and arrested coarsening. Our framework recovers the equilibrium limit consistently and is validated by stochastic numerical simulations. These results establish a direct, bottom-up link between the architecture of chemical reaction networks and the universality class of their emergent large-scale dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 生命系统中的主动相分离无处不在，但主动场论中非平衡项的微观起源仍然很大程度上未知。在这里，从两种相互作用的化学物质的随机质量守恒反应扩散动力学出发，我们进行了系统的慢模式还原，并推导出完整的主动模型 B+ 场论，其中所有唯象系数都以微观参数表示。我们将浓度依赖性扩散率和不对称种间趋化耦合确定为产生真正非平衡系数的最小微观成分，该系数负责微相分离、簇相和抑制粗化。我们的框架一致地恢复了平衡极限，并通过随机数值模拟进行了验证。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 生命系统中的主动相分离无处不在，但主动场论中非平衡项的微观起源仍然很大程度上未知。在这里，从两种相互作用的化学物质的随机质量守恒反应扩散动力学出发，我们进行了系统的慢模式还原，并推导出完整的主动模型 B+ 场论，其中所有唯象系数都以微观参数表示。我们将浓度依赖性扩散率和不对称种间趋化耦合确定为产生真正非平衡系数的最小微观成分，该系数负责微相分离、簇相和抑制粗化。我们的框架一致地恢复了平衡极限，并通过随机数值模拟进行了验证。这些结果在化学反应网络的架构与其新兴的大规模动力学的普遍性类别之间建立了直接的、自下而上的联系。

articles.title: Nitrogen vacancy cluster-mediated ferroelectric domain growth in wurtzite AlN
articles.title_zh: 氮空位簇介导的纤锌矿 AlN 中铁电畴的生长
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31084v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Aluminum nitride-based ferroelectrics combine high remanent polarization, thermal stability, weak size effects, a wide bandgap and back-end process compatibility, making them promising for high density non-volatile memory. However, their high coercive field (E_c) and unclear polarization switching mechanism limit further applications. Theoretical predictions indicate preferential reversed domain growth along the polar axis, whereas experiments show nearly isotropic growth or preferential growth perpendicular to this axis. Here, we combine density functional theory, Deep Potential molecular dynamics and experimental characterization to determine how nitrogen vacancies (V_N) regulate domain growth and E_c. In ideal crystal, strong lattice coupling along the polar axis drives preferential domain growth in this direction. V_N locally weakens this coupling and promotes polarization nucleation. The spatial distribution of V_N and the temporal sequence of vacancy induced switching jointly determine the direction and morphology of reversed domain growth. We further show that scandium doping promotes V_N formation, thereby enhancing defect mediated nucleation and reducing E_c. These findings establish a multiscale mechanism governing thin-film domain-growth kinetics and macroscopic E_c, reconciling experimental observations with ideal crystal simulations and providing defect engineering principles for low-voltage, reliable and scalable ferroelectric devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 氮化铝基铁电体结合了高剩余极化、热稳定性、弱尺寸效应、宽带隙和后端工艺兼容性，使其有望用于高密度非易失性存储器。然而，它们的高矫顽场（E_c）和不清楚的偏振切换机制限制了进一步的应用。理论预测表明沿极轴优先反向域生长，而实验显示近各向同性生长或垂直于该轴的优先生长。在这里，我们结合密度泛函理论、深势分子动力学和实验表征来确定氮空位 (V_N) 如何调节域生长和 E_c。在理想晶体中，沿极轴的强晶格耦合驱动沿该方向的择优生长。 V_N 局部削弱了这种耦合并促进极化成核。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 氮化铝基铁电体结合了高剩余极化、热稳定性、弱尺寸效应、宽带隙和后端工艺兼容性，使其有望用于高密度非易失性存储器。然而，它们的高矫顽场（E_c）和不清楚的偏振切换机制限制了进一步的应用。理论预测表明沿极轴优先反向域生长，而实验显示近各向同性生长或垂直于该轴的优先生长。在这里，我们结合密度泛函理论、深势分子动力学和实验表征来确定氮空位 (V_N) 如何调节域生长和 E_c。在理想晶体中，沿极轴的强晶格耦合驱动沿该方向的择优生长。 V_N 局部削弱了这种耦合并促进极化成核。 V_N的空间分布和空位引起的切换的时间顺序共同决定了反向域生长的方向和形态。我们进一步表明，钪掺杂促进了 V_N 的形成，从而增强了缺陷介导的成核并降低了 E_c。这些发现建立了控制薄膜畴生长动力学和宏观 E_c 的多尺度机制，将实验观察与理想晶体模拟相协调，并为低压、可靠和可扩展的铁电器件提供缺陷工程原理。

articles.title: Interaction-enhanced antiferromagnetic correlations in a Kondo ladder with a gapped band structure
articles.title_zh: 具有带隙结构的近藤梯中相互作用增强的反铁磁相关性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31142v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate magnetic correlations in the two-leg Kondo-Hubbard ladder using the density-matrix renormalization group method. We focus on a parameter regime in which the noninteracting electronic system has a narrow indirect band gap. In this regime, there is no Fermi surface, and the conventional Fermi-surface-based Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida picture is not directly applicable; magnetic correlations between localized spins become weaker as the noninteracting band gap increases. We find that a moderate on-site Coulomb interaction enhances the antiferromagnetic correlations between localized spins. This enhancement, which is also seen in the staggered magnetization induced by a pinning field at the edges, occurs for both ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic Kondo couplings. Our results show that electron-electron interactions can enhance magnetic correlations between localized spins even when the underlying noninteracting electronic structure is gapped, suggesting an interaction-driven route to magnetic instabilities in narrow-gap Kondo-lattice systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们使用密度矩阵重整化群方法研究两腿 Kondo-Hubbard 梯中的磁相关性。我们重点关注非相互作用电子系统具有窄间接带隙的参数范围。在这个体系中，不存在费米面，传统的基于费米面的Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida图不能直接适用；随着非相互作用带隙的增加，局部自旋之间的磁相关性变得更弱。我们发现适度的现场库仑相互作用增强了局部自旋之间的反铁磁相关性。这种增强在铁磁和反铁磁近藤耦合中都会出现，在边缘钉扎场引起的交错磁化强度中也可以看到。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用密度矩阵重整化群方法研究两腿 Kondo-Hubbard 梯中的磁相关性。我们重点关注非相互作用电子系统具有窄间接带隙的参数范围。在这个体系中，不存在费米面，传统的基于费米面的Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida图不能直接适用；随着非相互作用带隙的增加，局部自旋之间的磁相关性变得更弱。我们发现适度的现场库仑相互作用增强了局部自旋之间的反铁磁相关性。这种增强在铁磁和反铁磁近藤耦合中都会出现，在边缘钉扎场引起的交错磁化强度中也可以看到。我们的结果表明，即使底层的非相互作用电子结构有间隙，电子-电子相互作用也可以增强局部自旋之间的磁相关性，这表明窄间隙近藤晶格系统中存在一种由相互作用驱动的导致磁不稳定性的途径。

articles.title: Anomalous polar chains in halide perovskites
articles.title_zh: 卤化物钙钛矿中的异常极性链
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31184v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Local polar distortions, their collective ordering, and their field-driven reversal have been studied extensively in ferroelectric perovskites for decades. Here we identify an unusual behavior in the ferroelectric halide perovskite CsGeBr3 using large-scale molecular dynamics with first-principles-trained interatomic potentials. In its nominally cubic phase the Ge off-centering forms one-dimensional polar chains that extend over at least tens of nanometers and relax on nanosecond timescales, four orders of magnitude slower than in BaTiO3 and PbTiO3, with CsSnBr3 in between. The cubic CsGeBr3 phase is a dynamically disordered state in which oppositely polarized chains flip throughout the crystal, and a long-lived one-dimensional local polarization coexists with zero net polarization. A simple three-dimensional perovskite thus hosts long-ranged one-dimensional polar correlations with remarkably slow dynamics. In the ferroelectric phase the same chains set a one-dimensional switching mechanism, in which the polarization reverses chain by chain.
articles.abstract_zh: 几十年来，人们对铁电钙钛矿中的局部极性扭曲、它们的集体排序以及它们的场驱动反转进行了广泛的研究。在这里，我们利用大规模分子动力学和第一性原理训练的原子间势，发现了铁电卤化物钙钛矿 CsGeBr3 的异常行为。在其名义上的立方相中，Ge 偏心形成一维极性链，延伸至少数十纳米并在纳秒时间尺度上弛豫，比 BaTiO3 和 PbTiO3 慢四个数量级，CsSnBr3 位于其间。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 几十年来，人们对铁电钙钛矿中的局部极性扭曲、它们的集体排序以及它们的场驱动反转进行了广泛的研究。在这里，我们利用大规模分子动力学和第一性原理训练的原子间势，发现了铁电卤化物钙钛矿 CsGeBr3 的异常行为。在其名义上的立方相中，Ge 偏心形成一维极性链，延伸至少数十纳米并在纳秒时间尺度上弛豫，比 BaTiO3 和 PbTiO3 慢四个数量级，CsSnBr3 位于其间。立方 CsGeBr3 相是一种动态无序状态，其中相反的极化链在整个晶体中翻转，并且长寿命的一维局部极化与零净极化共存。因此，简单的三维钙钛矿具有长程一维极相关性，并且动力学非常慢。在铁电相中，相同的链设置了一维切换机制，其中极化逐链反转。

articles.title: Mn-deficient Ni-Mn-Ga alloys: phase transitions, magnetic properties, and disappearance of martensitic transformation
articles.title_zh: 缺锰 Ni-Mn-Ga 合金：相变、磁性能和马氏体转变消失
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31206v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Composition gradients formed during directional solidification are generally considered undesirable in Ni-Mn-Ga magnetic shape-memory alloys. However, these gradients offer a highly effective platform for systematically investigating composition-property relationships under identical growth and heat-treatment conditions. To exploit this approach, one Mn-deficient and two near-stoichiometric Ni-Mn-Ga oligocrystals were grown by optical zone remelting and characterized by X-ray fluorescence mapping, optical microscopy, X-ray diffraction, low-field magnetic measurements, and vibrating-sample magnetometry. The ingots contained elongated grains and axial compositional gradients, primarily associated with the redistribution of Mn and Ga, whereas Ni remained relatively uniformly distributed. The martensitic and premartensitic transformation temperatures generally increased with increasing Mn content. Neither transformation was detected between 10 and 400 K in specimens containing 20.5-22.0 at.% Mn, all of which had e/a < 7.40. In contrast, both transformations were observed in the investigated specimens containing at least 22.1 at.% (e/a ≥ 7.46). This abrupt change may indicate a possible electron-concentration threshold for the occurrence of these transformations. Saturation magnetization increased with Mn content up to 25.8 at.%, reaching 96.9 A m²/kg at 10 K and 71.2 A m²/kg at 300 K. Post-growth annealing increased the transition temperatures and changed the low-field magnetic response. The results indicate that composition-gradient oligocrystals serve as an effective platform for investigating the relationships between composition, structure, and magnetic properties in Ni-Mn-Ga alloys with the same processing history.
articles.abstract_zh: 在 Ni-Mn-Ga 磁性形状记忆合金中，定向凝固过程中形成的成分梯度通常被认为是不受欢迎的。然而，这些梯度为系统地研究相同生长和热处理条件下的成分-性能关系提供了一个高效的平台。为了利用这种方法，通过光学区域重熔生长了一种缺锰和两种接近化学计量的 Ni-Mn-Ga 寡晶，并通过 X 射线荧光测绘、光学显微镜、X 射线衍射、低场磁测量和振动样品磁力测定进行了表征。铸锭含有细长晶粒和轴向成分梯度，主要与锰和镓的重新分布有关，而镍则保持相对均匀的分布。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在 Ni-Mn-Ga 磁性形状记忆合金中，定向凝固过程中形成的成分梯度通常被认为是不受欢迎的。然而，这些梯度为系统地研究相同生长和热处理条件下的成分-性能关系提供了一个高效的平台。为了利用这种方法，通过光学区域重熔生长了一种缺锰和两种接近化学计量的 Ni-Mn-Ga 寡晶，并通过 X 射线荧光测绘、光学显微镜、X 射线衍射、低场磁测量和振动样品磁力测定进行了表征。铸锭含有细长晶粒和轴向成分梯度，主要与锰和镓的重新分布有关，而镍则保持相对均匀的分布。马氏体和预马氏体转变温度通常随着锰含量的增加而增加。在含有 20.5-22.0 at.% Mn 的样品中，在 10 到 400 K 之间均未检测到任何转变，所有样品的 e/a < 7.40。相比之下，在所研究的至少含有 22.1 at.% (e/a ≥ 7.46) 的样品中观察到这两种转变。这种突然的变化可能表明发生这些转变的可能的电子浓度阈值。饱和磁化强度随 Mn 含量增加至 25.8 at.% 而增加，在 10 K 时达到 96.9 A m²/kg，在 300 K 时达到 71.2 A m²/kg。生长后退火提高了转变温度并改变了低场磁响应。结果表明，成分梯度寡晶是研究具有相同加工历史的 Ni-Mn-Ga 合金成分、结构和磁性能之间关系的有效平台。

articles.title: Scalable Neural Wave Functions via Information Mixing and Hierarchical Network Architectures
articles.title_zh: 通过信息混合和分层网络架构实现可扩展的神经波函数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30257v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Numerically simulating quantum many-body systems is one of the central challenges in modern physics, as the exponential growth of the Hilbert space with system size renders large-scale exact solutions intractable. Over the past decade, generative artificial neural networks have emerged as powerful wave function ansätze that have powered advances in finding ground state representations, reconstructing quantum states from data, and modeling dynamics in quantum many-body systems. While recurrent neural networks (RNNs) are computationally efficient, the recurrent nature can limit their capacity to capture long-range correlations. Transformer models with their underlying self-attention mechanism excel at capturing these long-range correlations, but incur increased computational requirements, restricting applications to small physical systems. In this work, we address these limitations by exploring the multi-layer perceptron (MLP) mixer model as a wave function ansatz. By mixing information globally and locally through the system via a computationally lightweight mixing strategy, this architecture promises to combine the ability to capture long-range correlations with low computational costs. We benchmark the model on finding ground state representations of two-dimensional quantum many-body systems in various phases of matter and investigate the behavior of representational accuracy and computational efficiency for different physical system sizes. By comparing its performance to RNNs and transformer models with single-site and patched input definitions, we demonstrate that the MLP mixer architecture performs competitively with state-of-the-art network models. We further show that a hierarchical combination of this model with the transformer model outperforms other state-of-the-art architectures for large-scale quantum systems, opening new avenues for investigating quantum phases of matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 数值模拟量子多体系统是现代物理学的核心挑战之一，因为希尔伯特空间随系统尺寸呈指数增长，使得大规模精确解决方案变得棘手。在过去的十年中，生成人工神经网络已经成为强大的波函数分析，推动了寻找基态表示、从数据重建量子态以及量子多体系统动力学建模方面的进步。虽然循环神经网络 (RNN) 的计算效率很高，但循环性质会限制其捕获远程相关性的能力。具有底层自注意力机制的 Transformer 模型擅长捕获这些远程相关性，但会增加计算要求，从而限制了小型物理系统的应用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 数值模拟量子多体系统是现代物理学的核心挑战之一，因为希尔伯特空间随系统尺寸呈指数增长，使得大规模精确解决方案变得棘手。在过去的十年中，生成人工神经网络已经成为强大的波函数分析，推动了寻找基态表示、从数据重建量子态以及量子多体系统动力学建模方面的进步。虽然循环神经网络 (RNN) 的计算效率很高，但循环性质会限制其捕获远程相关性的能力。具有底层自注意力机制的 Transformer 模型擅长捕获这些远程相关性，但会增加计算要求，从而限制了小型物理系统的应用。在这项工作中，我们通过探索作为波函数模拟的多层感知器（MLP）混合器模型来解决这些限制。通过计算轻量级混合策略，通过系统全局和本地混合信息，该架构有望将捕获远程相关性的能力与低计算成本结合起来。我们对模型进行基准测试，以寻找二维量子多体系统在物质各个相中的基态表示，并研究不同物理系统大小的表示准确性和计算效率的行为。通过将其性能与具有单站点和修补输入定义的 RNN 和 Transformer 模型进行比较，我们证明 MLP 混合器架构的性能与最先进的网络模型具有竞争力。我们进一步表明，该模型与变压器模型的分层组合优于大规模量子系统的其他最先进的架构，为研究物质的量子相开辟了新途径。

articles.title: Delta-Doped GeV⁻ in diamond with isotope resolvable optical spectra
articles.title_zh: 金刚石中 Delta 掺杂 GeV⁻ 的同位素可分辨光谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30375v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Group IV color centers in diamond -- silicon, germanium, tin, and lead-vacancy centers -- are a promising platform for quantum networking. Typical Group-IV creation utilizes ion implantation during diamond growth that leaves the color centers with a broad depth distribution and damage-induced strain inhomogeneity. Deterministic placement and damage reduction in Group IV generation are essential for improving this platform. In this letter, we report on the localization of germanium-vacancy (GeV⁻) to a < 10 nm layer via the timed injection of GeH₄ during microwave plasma chemical vapor deposition. In this layer we have realized 17 ppm of Ge and a strain-free environment for the GeV⁻. Subsequent electron irradiation and annealing have generated a sheet density of 0.12 GeV⁻/μm². The minimal damage from color center generation mitigates spectral inhomogeneity and allows spectral resolution of isotopic clusters, with the best cluster having an inhomogeneous distribution of 2.14 GHz and an average linewidth of 47 ± 11 MHz. Our study gives insight into formation dynamics of GeV⁻ in delta-doped systems and estimates our vacancy to GeV⁻ yield to be ≥ 90%, establishing an athermal nearest-neighbor formation model. We further characterized the spin T₂^* and set a lower bound of 730 ns, limited by a paramagnetic defect.
articles.abstract_zh: 钻石中的 IV 族色心——硅、锗、锡和铅空位中心——是一个有前途的量子网络平台。典型的 IV 族制造在钻石生长过程中利用离子注入，使色心具有较宽的深度分布和损伤引起的应变不均匀性。第四组生成中的确定性放置和损伤减少对于改进该平台至关重要。在这封信中，我们报告了在微波等离子体化学气相沉积过程中通过定时注入 GeH₄ 将锗空位 (GeV⁻) 定位到 < 10 nm 的层。在这一层中，我们实现了 17 ppm 的 Ge 和 GeV⁻ 的无应变环境。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 钻石中的 IV 族色心——硅、锗、锡和铅空位中心——是一个有前途的量子网络平台。典型的 IV 族制造在钻石生长过程中利用离子注入，使色心具有较宽的深度分布和损伤引起的应变不均匀性。第四组生成中的确定性放置和损伤减少对于改进该平台至关重要。在这封信中，我们报告了在微波等离子体化学气相沉积过程中通过定时注入 GeH₄ 将锗空位 (GeV⁻) 定位到 < 10 nm 的层。在这一层中，我们实现了 17 ppm 的 Ge 和 GeV⁻ 的无应变环境。随后的电子辐照和退火产生了 0.12 GeV-/μm2 的片密度。色心生成造成的最小损害可减轻光谱不均匀性，并实现同位素簇的光谱分辨率，最佳簇具有 2.14 GHz 的不均匀分布和 47 ± 11 MHz 的平均线宽。我们的研究深入了解了 δ 掺杂系统中 GeV⁻ 的形成动力学，并估计空位到 GeV⁻ 的产率≥ 90%，建立了非热最近邻形成模型。我们进一步表征了自旋 T2^* 并设置了 730 ns 的下限，受顺磁缺陷的限制。

articles.title: Monodromy Defects of 3D Wilson-Fisher Criticality on the Fuzzy Sphere
articles.title_zh: 模糊球上3D Wilson-Fisher临界值的单向缺陷
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31269v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Monodromy (twist) line defects arise as the boundaries of topological symmetry surfaces, which are among the simplest non-trivial conformal defects with direct realizations as magnetic vortex in quantum magnets, as Wilson and t Hooft lines of gauge theories, and as the replica twist operators in quantum information theory. However, their interacting dynamics remains difficult to characterize non-perturbatively. Here we design a way to realize the monodromy boundary conditions in the fuzzy-sphere regularization by threading a symmetry-selective Aharonov-Bohm flux through the two poles of the sphere. We apply this construction to the Z₂ twist of the 3D Ising conformal field theory (CFT), π-twist of the 3D O(2) CFT and three inequivalent monodromies of O(3) (centre twist, z-axis π-twist and the reflection). For each defect, we extract the low-lying defect spectrum together with bulk-to-defect and defect-defect operator product expansion coefficients, which characterize the operators living on the defect line, their mutual interactions, and how they couple to the surrounding critical bulk. Among the low-lying defect primaries resolved in our spectra, we find no relevant scalar perturbation that preserves all the symmetries of the corresponding defect. The relevant deformations identified in our calculations break at least one preserved symmetry, providing evidence that these monodromy defects are stable against symmetry-preserving relevant perturbations. These results establish a systematic set of non-perturbative conformal data for monodromy defects beyond the Ising twist. Our construction therefore turns the symmetry flux into a tunable knob of the fuzzy-sphere regularization, opening a route to exploring the response of critical matter to distinct defects.
articles.abstract_zh: 单向（扭曲）线缺陷作为拓扑对称面的边界出现，是最简单的非平凡共形缺陷之一，可以直接实现为量子磁体中的磁涡流、规范理论中的威尔逊线和霍夫特线以及量子信息论中的复制扭曲算子。然而，它们的相互作用动态仍然难以非扰动地表征。在这里，我们设计了一种通过将对称选择性阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆通量穿过球体的两个极点来实现模糊球正则化中的单向边界条件的方法。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 单向（扭曲）线缺陷作为拓扑对称面的边界出现，是最简单的非平凡共形缺陷之一，可以直接实现为量子磁体中的磁涡流、规范理论中的威尔逊线和霍夫特线以及量子信息论中的复制扭曲算子。然而，它们的相互作用动态仍然难以非扰动地表征。在这里，我们设计了一种通过将对称选择性阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆通量穿过球体的两个极点来实现模糊球正则化中的单向边界条件的方法。我们将此构造应用于 3D 伊辛共形场论 (CFT) 的 Z2 扭曲、3D O(2) CFT 的 π 扭曲和 O(3) 的三个不等价单峰（中心扭曲、z 轴 π 扭曲和反射）。对于每个缺陷，我们提取低位缺陷谱以及块体到缺陷和缺陷到缺陷算子乘积展开系数，这些系数描述了缺陷线上的算子、它们的相互作用以及它们如何与周围的临界块体耦合。在我们的光谱中解析的低位缺陷原色中，我们没有发现相关的标量扰动可以保留相应缺陷的所有对称性。我们的计算中确定的相关变形破坏了至少一种保留的对称性，提供了证据表明这些单向缺陷对于保留对称性的相关扰动是稳定的。这些结果为伊辛扭曲之外的单峰缺陷建立了一组系统的非微扰共形数据。因此，我们的构造将对称通量转变为模糊球正则化的可调旋钮，开辟了一条探索关键物质对不同缺陷的响应的途径。

articles.title: Quantum Fokker-Planck solvers as trainable generative models
articles.title_zh: 量子福克-普朗克求解器作为可训练的生成模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31330v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We develop and analyze generative models based on quantum solvers of stochastic differential equations. Unlike the common approach based on layered variational quantum circuits with parameterized rotations, we parameterize the potential of a Langevin process. The associated Fokker-Planck (FP) equations are Hermitianized and solved using a linear combination of cosine operators implemented through quantum singular value transformation. By encoding the square root of the stationary density, the model enables sampling through computational-basis measurements and is efficiently controlled by coefficients of the block-encoded diagonal potential. We train the proposed model to match empirical distributions within the family described by FP equations, demonstrating parameter recovery for multivariate probability distributions. Crucially, the model remains trainable at scale. Sample-efficient and convex optimization for in-distribution targets arises from a physics-informed inductive bias and holds regardless of the dimensionality of the problem. We provide circuit constructions and efficient block encodings of the main components of the algorithm and analyze resource requirements. Our approach frames quantum generative learning as quantum model discovery and provides a foundation for extending this framework to high-dimensional, strongly correlated scientific data.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们开发和分析基于随机微分方程的量子求解器的生成模型。与基于具有参数化旋转的分层变分量子电路的常见方法不同，我们对朗之万过程的潜力进行参数化。相关的福克-普朗克 (FP) 方程经过厄米化并使用通过量子奇异值变换实现的余弦算子的线性组合进行求解。通过对稳态密度的平方根进行编码，该模型能够通过计算基础测量进行采样，并通过块编码对角势的系数进行有效控制。我们训练所提出的模型以匹配 FP 方程描述的族内的经验分布，展示多元概率分布的参数恢复。至关重要的是，该模型仍然可以大规模训练。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们开发和分析基于随机微分方程的量子求解器的生成模型。与基于具有参数化旋转的分层变分量子电路的常见方法不同，我们对朗之万过程的潜力进行参数化。相关的福克-普朗克 (FP) 方程经过厄米化并使用通过量子奇异值变换实现的余弦算子的线性组合进行求解。通过对稳态密度的平方根进行编码，该模型能够通过计算基础测量进行采样，并通过块编码对角势的系数进行有效控制。我们训练所提出的模型以匹配 FP 方程描述的族内的经验分布，展示多元概率分布的参数恢复。至关重要的是，该模型仍然可以大规模训练。分布内目标的样本效率和凸优化源于物理信息的归纳偏差，并且无论问题的维数如何都成立。我们提供算法主要组件的电路结构和高效块编码，并分析资源需求。我们的方法将量子生成学习框架为量子模型发现，并为将该框架扩展到高维、强相关的科学数据提供了基础。

articles.title: Orbital-coherence memory in electrical transport and its self-consistent Maxwell response
articles.title_zh: 电传输中的轨道相干记忆及其自洽麦克斯韦响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31390v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: An internal electronic coherence changes electrical transport only when it feeds back on the physical current. We develop a reduced description of this feedback and distinguish its exact consequences from the assumptions required for a microscopic realization. An opposite-parity two-orbital Hamiltonian identifies a current-coupled orbital force. Under an explicitly stated moment closure and collision ansatz, it yields a passive three-state response with an exponentially damped oscillatory memory. The resulting conductivity redistributes a fixed optical weight and predicts a nonmonotonic dependence of dc conduction on coherence damping at fixed remaining parameters. The orbital reduction constrains the coupling and internal frequency through a shared bare splitting, providing a test beyond unconstrained spectral fitting. A charge-conserving spatial extension couples to Maxwell equations through a positive energy balance and separates the constitutive response from longitudinal collective and transverse electromagnetic modes. We formulate complex-conductivity and transmission tests, including the limits of parameter identification over a finite bandwidth. The model supplies a conditional connection between orbital dynamics, transport memory, and electromagnetic observables; conductivity alone does not establish a uniquely quantum mechanism, and a material-specific collision calculation and closure-error assessment remain necessary.
articles.abstract_zh: 内部电子相干性仅在反馈物理电流时才会改变电传输。我们对这种反馈进行了简化的描述，并将其确切后果与微观实现所需的假设区分开来。相反宇称双轨道哈密顿量确定了电流耦合轨道力。在明确规定的力矩闭合和碰撞模拟下，它产生具有指数阻尼振荡记忆的被动三态响应。由此产生的电导率重新分配固定的光学权重，并预测固定剩余参数下直流传导对相干阻尼的非单调依赖性。轨道缩减通过共享的裸分裂来限制耦合和内部频率，从而提供超越无约束频谱拟合的测试。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 内部电子相干性仅在反馈物理电流时才会改变电传输。我们对这种反馈进行了简化的描述，并将其确切后果与微观实现所需的假设区分开来。相反宇称双轨道哈密顿量确定了电流耦合轨道力。在明确规定的力矩闭合和碰撞模拟下，它产生具有指数阻尼振荡记忆的被动三态响应。由此产生的电导率重新分配固定的光学权重，并预测固定剩余参数下直流传导对相干阻尼的非单调依赖性。轨道缩减通过共享的裸分裂来限制耦合和内部频率，从而提供超越无约束频谱拟合的测试。电荷守恒空间延伸通过正能量平衡耦合到麦克斯韦方程，并将本构响应与纵向集体和横向电磁模式分开。我们制定复杂的电导率和传输测试，包括有限带宽上参数识别的限制。该模型提供了轨道动力学、传输记忆和电磁可观测量之间的条件联系；仅靠电导率并不能建立独特的量子机制，并且仍然需要针对特定材料的碰撞计算和闭合误差评估。

articles.title: Macroscopic Nuclear Resonance Energy Transfer Mediated by Coherent Magnons
articles.title_zh: 相干磁振子介导的宏观核共振能量转移
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31507v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Phonon-mediated nuclear Resonance Energy Transfer (RET) in metal deuterides is severely constrained by inertial rest-mass dilution, lattice fracture limits, and thermal nuclear spin cancellation. Extending the generalized nuclear Dicke model to Ferromagnetic Resonance (FMR) magnons eliminates mass dilution via hyperfine-amplified M1 coupling while unlocking relativistic Dirac M2 coupling via Overhauser spin polarization. We derive a Suhl-clamped FMR scaling law predicting 14.2 MeV (Pd-106) and 11.4 MeV (Ni-58) breakup neutrons, 19.9 MeV alpha particles, and reconciled sub-keV fusion anomalies.
articles.abstract_zh: 金属氘化物中声子介导的核共振能量转移（RET）受到惯性静止质量稀释、晶格断裂极限和热核自旋抵消的严重限制。将广义核迪克模型扩展到铁磁共振 (FMR) 磁振子，可以通过超精细放大 M1 耦合消除质量稀释，同时通过 Overhauser 自旋极化解锁相对论狄拉克 M2 耦合。我们推导出 Suhl 钳位 FMR 标度定律，预测 14.2 MeV (Pd-106) 和 11.4 MeV (Ni-58) 破裂中子、19.9 MeV α 粒子和协调的亚 keV 聚变异常。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 金属氘化物中声子介导的核共振能量转移（RET）受到惯性静止质量稀释、晶格断裂极限和热核自旋抵消的严重限制。将广义核迪克模型扩展到铁磁共振 (FMR) 磁振子，可以通过超精细放大 M1 耦合消除质量稀释，同时通过 Overhauser 自旋极化解锁相对论狄拉克 M2 耦合。我们推导出 Suhl 钳位 FMR 标度定律，预测 14.2 MeV (Pd-106) 和 11.4 MeV (Ni-58) 破裂中子、19.9 MeV α 粒子和协调的亚 keV 聚变异常。

articles.title: Screening strongly correlated materials in solid oxide cells with quantum simulation
articles.title_zh: 通过量子模拟筛选固体氧化物电池中的强相关材料
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31591v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We develop an end-to-end framework for assessing a quantum-computing application in industrial materials science: the screening of strongly correlated oxygen-electrode materials for SOFCs and SOECs. We formulate the materials problem in terms of interface observables including oxygen-vacancy formation energies, vacancy migration barriers, and electronic conductivity. We describe how these observables can be obtained using a diagrammatic GW-based embedding, either GW+DMFT or self-energy embedding theory (SEET), applied to a DFT-screened shortlist. The atomistic electrode/electrolyte interface defines the electronic structure problem from which the correlated impurity models are constructed. Quantum impurity solvers would provide the finite-temperature impurity Green's functions required by the embedding. The computational challenges that classical solvers may encounter as the interacting active space grows, together with the polynomial scaling of quantum Hamiltonian simulation for efficiently represented discretized models, open an opportunity for quantum advantage. We identify the benchmarks needed to assess this opportunity through convergence of vacancy and migration energetics and comparison with the best applicable classical solvers. We provide illustrative logical qubit counts and identify the thermal state preparation, simulation, measurement, and repeated-solve costs needed for a complete resource assessment. We connect microscopic observables to macroscopic engineering metrics using a continuum model for mixed ionic--electronic conducting oxygen electrodes that couples oxygen surface exchange, solid-state oxygen transport, electrode microstructure, and finite electrode thickness. Finally, we estimate the potential worldwide business value of improved electrode materials under SOFC and SOEC deployment scenarios informed by public technical targets and electrolyser deployment data.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们开发了一个端到端框架，用于评估工业材料科学中的量子计算应用：筛选用于 SOFC 和 SOEC 的强相关氧电极材料。我们根据界面可观测量来制定材料问题，包括氧空位形成能、空位迁移势垒和电子电导率。我们描述了如何使用基于图解 GW 的嵌入（GW+DMFT 或自能嵌入理论 (SEET)）来获得这些可观测值，并将其应用于 DFT 筛选的候选列表。原子电极/电解质界面定义了构建相关杂质模型的电子结构问题。量子杂质求解器将提供嵌入所需的有限温度杂质格林函数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们开发了一个端到端框架，用于评估工业材料科学中的量子计算应用：筛选用于 SOFC 和 SOEC 的强相关氧电极材料。我们根据界面可观测量来制定材料问题，包括氧空位形成能、空位迁移势垒和电子电导率。我们描述了如何使用基于图解 GW 的嵌入（GW+DMFT 或自能嵌入理论 (SEET)）来获得这些可观测值，并将其应用于 DFT 筛选的候选列表。原子电极/电解质界面定义了构建相关杂质模型的电子结构问题。量子杂质求解器将提供嵌入所需的有限温度杂质格林函数。随着相互作用的活动空间的增长，经典求解器可能遇到的计算挑战，以及有效表示离散模型的量子哈密顿模拟的多项式缩放，为量子优势提供了机会。我们通过空缺和迁移能量学的融合以及与最适用的经典求解器的比较来确定评估这一机会所需的基准。我们提供说明性逻辑量子位计数，并确定完整资源评估所需的热态准备、模拟、测量和重复求解成本。我们使用混合离子-电子传导氧电极的连续体模型将微观可观测值与宏观工程指标联系起来，该模型耦合了氧表面交换、固态氧传输、电极微观结构和有限电极厚度。最后，我们根据公共技术目标和电解槽部署数据估计了 SOFC 和 SOEC 部署场景下改进电极材料的潜在全球商业价值。

articles.title: Onsager Algebras and Lattice Fermions
articles.title_zh: Onsager 代数和格子费米子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31653v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the exact Onsager algebra of free lattice fermions in staggered, Wilson, and overlap incarnations, working in both Hamiltonian and Euclidean formulations in four spacetime dimensions. In each case, we show that the exact lattice algebra emanates the full chiral symmetry of the low-energy theory: if there are N massless Dirac fermions in the continuum, the Onsager algebra reduces to a U(2N) chiral symmetry. The details of which generators are quantised or ultra-local differ between formulations. There is also a trade-off between the locality of generators and the maximum compact subgroup of the Onsager algebra.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究交错、威尔逊和重叠形式的自由晶格费米子的精确 Onsager 代数，在四个时空维度上使用哈密顿和欧几里得公式。在每种情况下，我们都证明了精确的晶格代数体现了低能理论的完整手性对称性：如果连续体中有 N 个无质量狄拉克费米子，则 Onsager 代数可简化为 U(2N) 手性对称性。哪些生成器是量化的或超局部的，其细节在不同的公式中是不同的。生成元的局域性和 Onsager 代数的最大紧子群之间也存在权衡。
