The law of the profile carries the full distance of the reflection walk on (:Oleft(dright)) and equilibrates only after Porod’s (:fracd2logd). We give exact second moments of the trace and an explicit second-moment lower bound for the law of the profile. All checkable statements are verified numerically. Mathematics Subject Classification (2020). Primary 15A66; Secondary 15A15, 33C45, 60B15, 60J10.

articles.title: Low-temperature sintering and thermal-aging reliability of nano-silver joints on cyanate ester composite substrates
articles.abstract: Direct nano-silver sintering on cyanate ester composite substrates provides a promising route for integrating power chips with lightweight, thermally stable, and low-dielectric polymer composites. In this study, power chips were directly bonded onto fiber-reinforced cyanate ester composite substrates by low-temperature nano-silver sintering. Ag particles coalesced on the composite surface and formed a mechanically bonded heterogeneous interface. The joint achieved a maximum shear strength of 11.5 MPa, while the sintered Ag layer exhibited a porosity of 10.1% after sintering at 15 MPa for 15 min, while the porosity decreased to 6.5% at 20 MPa. After high-temperature aging for 600 h, the shear strength remained at 9.3 MPa, respresenting a decrease of only approximately 19%. The failure mode progressively shifted from separation at the Ag/composite interface to cracking and delamination within the composite substrate. These results demonstrate the feasibility of low-temperature nano-silver bonding on non-metallized cyanate ester composites and identify substrate thermal degradation as the principal limitation on long-term joint reliability.

articles.title: Reservoir Adaptability of Alkali-Free Flooding Systems in Medium- and Low-Permeability Reservoirs: An Integrated Evaluation Based on Multipoint Pressure Measurements and Microscopic Visualization
articles.abstract: Alkali/surfactant/polymer (ASP) ternary flooding systems, which are applied in medium- and high-permeability reservoirs, are associated with severe corrosion, leading to increasing attention to alkali-free chemical flooding systems. Reservoir development targets, however, have gradually shifted from medium- and high-permeability reservoirs to medium- and low-permeability reservoirs characterized by strong intralayer heterogeneity, low permeability, and complex pore structures. The reservoir adaptability and oil-displacement performance of alkali-free chemical flooding systems currently used in medium- and high-permeability reservoirs remain unclear under medium- and low-permeability conditions. In this study, two alkali-free chemical flooding systems were formulated: a surfactant/polymer binary system (SP) and a surfactant/salt/polymer ternary system (SSP), with partially hydrolyzed polyacrylamide (HPAM) used as a reference. Their physicochemical properties were characterized by measurements of interfacial tension and viscosity, together with static adsorption and emulsification tests. Reservoir adaptability was evaluated by combining multipoint pressure-measurement experiments using 50, 100, and 150 mD cores with 100 mD microscopic visualization displacement experiments; oil-displacement performance was subsequently determined by 100 mD Berea core flooding experiments. The physicochemical-property tests showed that, compared with the SP system, the SSP system exhibited lower interfacial tension and greater emulsion stability. Multipoint pressure measurements indicated that the SSP system exhibited good injectivity in 100–150 mD cores, but upstream-section plugging occurred at 50 mD; by contrast, the SP system showed relatively poor injectivity at all tested permeabilities. Microscopic visualization at 100 mD showed that the SSP system formed a more continuous oil-water displacement front and produced a more uniform sweep pattern, without the pronounced inlet emulsification plugging observed for the SP system. In the Berea core flooding experiments, the SSP system achieved the highest total oil recovery factor of 55%, compared with 48% for the SP system and 47% for the HPAM system. The combined use of multipoint pressure measurements and microscopic visualization provides an experimental basis for screening alkali-free flooding systems, identifying injection-related plugging, and evaluating reservoir adaptability in medium- and low-permeability reservoirs.

articles.title: Reliability-Adjusted Profitability of a Rural PV-Wind Hybrid Mini-Grid: Reconciling Dispatch Uncertainty with Discounted Cash-Flow Analysis in the Niger Sahel
articles.abstract: Background Rural PV-wind hybrid mini-grids are routinely assessed for profitability under an assumption of uninterrupted dispatch that a full annual simulation may not support. This study tests that assumption for a 38.5 kW photovoltaic-wind hybrid mini-grid designed for Tafaghatt, a rural village in Niger's Maradi region, by carrying two dispatch estimates of the same configuration, one built on representative days and one on a full stochastic year, through a single 15-year discounted cash-flow model. Sized against a surveyed demand of 160 kWh/day, it pairs 28.5 kWp of photovoltaics and a 10 kW turbine with 240 kWh of lithium iron phosphate storage, and delivers an estimated 64,123 kWh/year at an assumed tariff of 350 F CFA/kWh, consistent with prevailing off-grid rural tariff practice.Results Total investment is 120,000,000 F CFA, of which only 19.3% covers generation equipment. The base case returns a levelized cost of 306 F CFA/kWh generated, a net present value of 21,586,792 F CFA at a 10% real discount rate, an internal rate of return of 13.07% and a discounted payback in year 11. Little of this survives the quantities the study does not observe. Normalized to energy delivered rather than generated, the levelized cost rises to 336 F CFA/kWh, and to 395 F CFA/kWh under the companion study's 15.0% annual loss-of-power-supply probability, where the net present value turns negative (− 16,968,806 F CFA) and the return falls to 7.42%. Repricing the battery bank at the published lithium-ion benchmark, or lowering collection to 85%, each turns it negative on its own. At constant capacity, demand growth adds nothing: the plant already sells all it generates.Conclusions Bankability rests on three quantities the design study did not measure: storage cost, dispatch reliability and revenue collection. All three are measurable before an investment decision, and an assessment that reports the span between two dispatch readings, rather than a verdict with a caveat attached, is what a financier or regulator needs. For comparable Sahelian schemes the scope for improvement lies in the non-generation cost bundle and in a tariff calibrated against measured willingness to pay rather than cost recovery alone.

articles.title: Reconfigurable high-power Kerr optical parametric oscillators with sub-hertz linewidths
articles.abstract: Integrated coherent light sources combining broad wavelength tunability, narrow-linewidth, and high output power are essential for precision spectroscopy, coherent communications, and quantum information processing, yet remain challenging to realize simultaneously. Kerr microresonator optical parametric oscillators (OPOs) provide coherent wavelength access beyond conventional gain media, but their oscillating signal-idler pairs are typically fixed by the dispersion and loss of the fabricated resonator, while pump-noise transfer and nonlinear mode competition limit coherence and power scaling. Here, we demonstrate post-fabrication reconfiguration of Kerr OPOs through coherent feedback enabled by mode-selective sideband self-injection locking, without the need for resonator redesign. By tuning the relative effective gain of competing parametric channels, coherent feedback makes a selected signal-idler pair dominant over the free-running state. At a fixed pump wavelength, our method enables stepwise sideband selection across 1.27 THz and continuous tuning over 202.17 GHz, while joint tuning of the pump and feedback-selected sideband extends the accessible span beyond 23 nm. The same feedback reduces the intrinsic linewidth of the selected sideband to sub-hertz, corresponding to a ~ 30,000-fold reduction from the free-running OPO and suppresses cluster-comb formation to deliver more than 42 mW on-chip sideband power. Our work establishes coherent feedback as a new control degree of freedom for reconfiguring nonlinear oscillation states in integrated Kerr photonics.

articles.title: Determination and Comparison of Critical Surface Tension of Glass and PTFE Surfaces Using the Zisman Method and ImageJ-Based Contact Angle Analysis
articles.abstract: Wettability is a basic surface property that controls adhesion, coating, printing, and self cleaning applications. In this study, the wettability of two contrasting reference surfaces— glass (hydrophilic, high-energy) and polytetrafluoroethylene, PTFE (hydrophobic, low-energy)— was quantitatively characterised using the Zisman method. A series of liquids of known surface tension (γLV), including ethanol, ethylene glycol, formamide, glycerol, and deionised water, were deposited as sessile droplets on each surface, and the equilibrium contact angle (θ) was measured from droplet-profile images using the open-source image analysis software ImageJ. The cosine of the contact angle was plotted against γLV for each surface, and linear regression was used to extrapolate the critical surface tension (γc)—the surface tension at which cosθ = 1. The extrapolated γc for PTFE was approximately 18.9 mN/m, consistent with literature values for PTFE. For glass, the apparent γc was approximately 39.8 mN/m (with the completely wetting ethanol point excluded from the fit); this value is lower than the ranges reported in the literature for glass and is discussed in Section 3. The results indicate that the combination of ImageJ-based contact angle analysis and the classical Zisman approach provides a low-cost and accessible method for estimating the critical surface tension of low-energy surfaces such as PTFE, while the value obtained for glass should be regarded as an apparent value specific to the slides and conditions used.

articles.title: Performance and Action Mechanisms of Polymer Relative Permeability Modifiers with Different Molecular Structures
articles.abstract: In this study, four relative permeability modifiers (RPMs) with distinct molecular structures—partially hydrolyzed polyacrylamide (HPAM), cationic RPM (RPM-I), hydrophobically associating RPM (RPM-II), and cationic hydrophobically associating RPM (RPM-III)—were synthesized using acrylamide, acrylic acid, 2-acrylamido-2-methylpropanesulfonic acid, cationic monomers and hydrophobically associating monomers as feedstocks. Their structures were verified to match the designed configurations via FT-IR and 1H NMR. Combining macroscopic core flooding evaluation with microscopic characterizations including hydrodynamic size measurement, desorption resistance assay and cryo-SEM, this study systematically elucidates how molecular structures affect injectivity and oil stabilization & water control performance.The results demonstrate that Cationic groups anchor polymer chains onto pore walls via electrostatic interactions: anchored chains extend in water flow to obstruct aqueous seepage, and contract in oil flow to release flow paths. However, excessive surface chain density restricts conformational space, hindering full opening of oil flow paths. Hydrophobically associating groups strengthen intermolecular interactions and reduce wall adsorption, lowering surface chain density to enable sufficient chain contraction. Nevertheless, free chains tend to form “molecular clusters” that migrate to pore constrictions and cause plugging. RPM-III functionalized with both groups delivers optimal overall performance (λ=0.26, NW=68.72%, NO=14.48%), integrating superior injectivity, selective water control and long-term stability. Its injectivity greatly outperforms RPM-I (λ=3.82), and its efficacy and durability markedly surpass RPM-II (NW=46.61%, NO=29.52%).This study clarifies the synergistic regulation mechanism of the two functional groups, providing experimental evidence for molecular design and performance optimization of RPM systems.

articles.title: Anomalous Thermal Conductivity Reversal Driven by a Fluctuating Charge Density Wave
articles.abstract: For more than a century, the lattice thermal conductivity of crystalline solids has been known to decrease with increasing temperature, as the phonons that carry heat scatter more strongly via Umklapp processes. Here we report a pronounced violation of this rule in the layered charge-density-wave (CDW) metal 2H-TaSe₂. Its in-plane thermal conductivity is strongly nonmonotonic: it peaks sharply at the 122 K ordering transition, collapses to a deep minimum near 210 K, and then anomalously reverses, rising with temperature to at least 350 K. Such a high-temperature reversal, in which a crystal conducts heat more efficiently as it is heated, is rare in crystalline solids. Its thermal conductivity minimum lies deep in the disordered phase well above the ordering transition, unlike the weak, transition-centered anomalies of other charge-density-wave systems, pointing to heat conduction governed by fluctuating rather than established order. Combining inelastic X-ray scattering, selected-area electron diffraction, and synchrotron X-ray diffraction, we attribute the reversal to phonons scattering off persistent, fluctuating charge order that survives more than 150 K above the long-range transition, to at least 300 K. A phenomenological phonon–CDW scattering model, tied directly to the measured diffraction linewidth and intensity, quantitatively reproduces the entire nonmonotonic curve. We also reveal that the charge order melts not abruptly but through a fluctuation- and defect-driven, weak first-order process, leaving short-range correlations far above the transition. This work establishes fluctuating charge order as a sensitive control knob for thermal transport in quantum materials and thermal conductivity as a powerful probe of the hidden charge order.

articles.title: Trustworthy Swarm Intelligence for Green IoT: Communication-Efficient and Safe Multi-Agent Synchronization across the Cloud-Edge Continuum
articles.abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) applications require seamless multi-agent synchronization for successful deployment of swarm intelligence. Traditional distributed consensus algorithms usually involve frequent and high-speed state exchanges which consume a lot of bandwidth and drain the energy resources of resource-limited edge devices. A dynamic environment with uncertainties, decentralized synchronization can result in safety issues and unpredictable collision risks. To solve these key issues, in this paper, the authors present ET-S3, a novel Event-Triggered Safe Swarm Synchronization framework designed for Green IoT ecosystems over the Cloud-Edge Continuum. In ET-S3, the event-triggering mechanism is dynamic, and calculates an adaptive transmission threshold, which is inversely proportional to how much energy is left in the node's battery, to drastically reduce redundant state broadcasts. To ensure operation safety, consensus policy is coupled with a Control Barrier Function (CBF) safety shield solved online Quadratic Programming (QP) to guarantee no spatial convergence violation (0.0%). Through extensive experiments with N = 100 dynamic agents, we show that ET-S3 can save 81.8% on total communication payload and achieve more than an 80% increase in average battery lifespan over some standard periodic consensus protocols, while maintaining a sub-150 ms synchronization latency.

articles.title: Foundry-Fabricated Silicon Nitride Grating Arrays with Uniform Power Distribution at Visible Wavelengths
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30387v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multiplexed optical biosensors are widely deployed to read out many biological targets in parallel. However, their channel count and integration density are limited by the photonic network that delivers light to individual sensing sites. Existing on-chip networks have been largely developed for phased arrays and image projection, where performance is assessed through an aggregate radiation pattern rather than the local intensity at each output. In this Letter, we demonstrate a novel bus-and-tap network architecture for massively parallel multiplexed optical delivery. The network uses cascaded directional couplers with individually designed interaction lengths, allowing for arbitrary, user-defined illumination patterns not possible with conventional binary tree architectures. We experimentally validated our proposed architecture with 46 visible-wavelength grating emitter channels designed for uniform illumination at 40 μm pitch in a commercial 300-mm silicon nitride foundry process, achieving an emitted-intensity coefficient of variation of 9.3% at 530 nm, and 8.8% under band-integrated illumination from 550 nm to 650 nm. These results provide a route to scalable visible-light delivery for sensing, imaging, neural interfaces, and parallel optical addressing in quantum systems.

articles.title: An enhanced adaptive finite element method with linear scaling for 3D Hartree–Fock equation
articles.abstract: The Hartree–Fock equation serves as a fundamental theoretical tool in quantum chemistry and condensed matter physics for describing the ground–state electronic structure of multi–electron systems. Despite its significance, the numerical solution faces challenges due to its complex mathematical structure. This paper presents an efficient adaptive finite element method for solving the 3D Hartree–Fock equation, incorporating three acceleration techniques: a multilevel correction scheme, a two-level nested self-consistent field iteration, and a density fitting strategy. The method aims to enhance computational efficiency, reduce memory consumption, and improve the parallel scalability. By reformulating the problem into a sequence of large-scale boundary value problems and small-scale eigenvalue problems, our algorithm drastically reduces computational load and storage demands. Notably, it achieves linear computational complexity O ( NN k ), with the coefficient depending on the number of wavefunctions N rather than the correction space dimension N H , representing a significant improvement over the O (( N + N H ) N k ) complexity in prior work [Xu et al. , J. Chem. Phys. 164 , 074111 (2026)] that proposed a simplified multilevel correction algorithm (yielding up to fivefold speedup in numerical simulations). Furthermore, the correction process is tailored for each wavefunction independently, endowing it with substantial potential for parallel computation. Numerical experiments conducted on various molecular systems demonstrate the superior precision, efficiency, and memory savings of the proposed algorithm compared to the direct adaptive finite element method.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Quenched fluctuation-induced force arising from polarization disorder
articles.abstract: We investigate the zero-temperature behavior of the fluctuation force induced by the quenched disorder of electric dipoles frozen randomly into a material. Examples of such materials include relaxor ferroelectrics. In terms of the setup and geometry, we focus on a layered system comprising two coplanar semi-infinite slabs separated by a distance ℓ , as well as a system comprising a neutral atom in the vacuum located at a distance ℓ above the surface of a semi-infinite slab. For both systems, we consider the cases where the quenched random dipolar disorder occurs inside the bulk as well as on the surface of the slabs. In all of these cases, we find that the bulk (surface) dipolar disorder-induced force grows with the mean square quenched electric dipole moment per unit volume (area). The bulk (surface) dipolar disorder-induced pressure between two semi-infinite single-layered slabs decays with ℓ −3 ( ℓ −4 ), whereas the bulk (surface) dipolar disorder-induced force on an atom in the vacuum near a slab containing the disorder decays with ℓ −4 ( ℓ −5 ). We also find that the quenched dipolar disorder-induced force between two coplanar slabs can be repulsive in a three-layered dielectric system that obeys a zero-frequency analog of the Dzyaloshinskii–Lifshitz–Pitaevskii condition and serves to enhance the “nanolevitation effect” if the latter is present in the disorder-free system.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Q-Chem/CP2K software interface for projection-based, pseudoperiodic wavefunction-in-DFT embedding
articles.abstract: We report an implementation of projection-based quantum embedding that combines periodic density functional theory in the CP2K code with correlated wavefunction calculations in the Q-Chem program. Using this interface, correlated wavefunction methods can be applied to a subset of molecular orbitals, selected in an automated manner based on a user-defined list of nuclei, with an embedding potential that provides electronic coupling to the remaining orbitals that comprise the environment. Our implementation uses exact projection, without the need for any level-shift operator, and is “pseudoperiodic” in the sense that periodic boundary effects are implicit in the orbitals used in the (non-periodic) wavefunction calculation. Convergence tests demonstrate that computed properties are faithful to the corresponding periodic quantities, provided that the high-level subsystem is spatially localized and small, relative to the periodic simulation cell. Spectroscopic examples for aqueous chromophores demonstrate converged results using a very limited subset of water molecules in the simulation cell, decoupling the choice of excited-state method and basis set from the functional that is used to propagate ground-state ab initio molecular dynamics. Solvatochromic shifts for aqueous uracil are converged using equation-of-motion coupled-cluster theory, without the need for solvent molecules in the wavefunction calculation, and the embedded calculation captures solvent effects that are absent in gas-phase “microhydration” studies. Additional applications include adsorption of CO on a slab model of Si(100) and bond dissociation in a one-dimensional periodic polymer. In both of the latter cases, the system/environment partition crosses a covalent bond; these applications demonstrate that pseudoperiodic embedding can be applied to realistic systems in materials science.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Singlet and triplet excitations in C 5 F 10 O induced by electrons and photons: Spectroscopy and dynamics
articles.abstract: C 5 F 10 O [heptafluoroisopropyl(trifluoromethyl)ketone] has emerged as a promising alternative to sulfur hexafluoride for the use in gas-insulated switchgears. Despite its technological relevance, its interactions with low-energy electrons remain largely unexplored. Electron impact can populate both singlet and triplet electronically excited states, potentially initiating dissociation pathways that yield toxic or technologically undesirable products. Here, we combine vacuum-ultraviolet (VUV) absorption spectroscopy, electron energy loss spectroscopy (EELS), and theoretical modeling to characterize the electronically excited states of C 5 F 10 O and the dynamics initiated by these excitations. We report the first VUV absorption spectrum of C 5 F 10 O and directly compare it to EELS recorded at multiple scattering angles and residual energies. The spectra are compared with high-level ab initio calculations. To obtain the inelastic electron scattering cross sections, we use our implementation of the Born approximation coupled with the algebraic diagrammatic construction of the second order method. An ad hoc extension of this approach is introduced to account for the exchange-mediated spin-forbidden transitions in the spectra of backscattered electrons. Finally, nonadiabatic molecular dynamics coupled with time-dependent density functional theory is used to identify reaction channels initiated in different singlet and triplet excited states. Overall, we provide a state-resolved framework to study electronic excitation and subsequent reactivity, with implications for plasma modeling and the design of next-generation high-voltage insulation media.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Mapping spatially heterogeneous phase transitions in two-dimensional perovskite single crystals by low-frequency Raman microspectroscopy
articles.abstract: Structural phase transitions in two-dimensional (2D) lead halide perovskites are intimately linked to their physicochemical and optoelectronic properties, yet the spatial heterogeneity of these transitions within individual crystals remains poorly understood. Here, we employed temperature-dependent low-frequency Raman (LFR) microspectroscopy to elucidate the structural phase transitions of 2D perovskites with different alkyl-chain lengths of the organic cations: BA 2 PbI 4 , HA 2 PbI 4 , and OA 2 PbI 4 , where BA, HA, and OA denote butylammonium, hexylammonium, and octylammonium, respectively. The temperature-dependent evolution of lattice phonon modes provides a direct and sensitive spectroscopic probe of structural transformations, enabling us to distinguish among the phase transition behaviors of these three perovskites. By leveraging LFR imaging, we revealed pronounced spatial heterogeneity in the order-to-disorder phase transition occurring at ∼36–37 °C in a single OA 2 PbI 4 microcrystal. Mapping the intensity of a characteristic lattice phonon band at 22 cm −1 revealed substantial variations in the phase transition temperature across the crystal, suggesting the presence of distinct microdomains within a single crystal. This spatial heterogeneity may arise from local variations in the intrinsic defect density. Our results demonstrate that temperature-dependent LFR microspectroscopy offers a powerful means of visualizing spatially heterogeneous phase transitions and provides new insight into the local structural landscape of 2D perovskites.

articles.title: Light Martini water accelerates sampling in coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations
articles.abstract: Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of slow biomolecular processes, such as exploration of the conformational ensembles of intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs), are computationally demanding. Although coarse-grained (CG) models can substantially speed up the simulations compared to all-atom MD, the sampling challenge can still be significant for large systems and long time scales. Here, we present light Martini water , a low-viscosity water model that accelerates sampling in MD simulations with the Martini CG force field. We systematically reduced the mass of the Martini water beads and verified stable, accurate integration of the equations of motion with 20 fs time steps, as typically used in Martini simulations. Light Martini water has a reduced mass of 20 amu (compared to 72 amu in the standard water model), yielding up to a 2.68-fold increase in the sampling rate of IDP chain reconfiguration in water and a 16% increase in the lateral diffusion of lipids in a palmitoyloleoylphosphatidylcholine bilayer. Equilibrium properties remained unaffected by the mass scaling, and the speedup was achieved without compromising simulation accuracy. The water model is trivial to implement, has no computational overhead, and should be universally applicable to Martini simulations.

articles.title: Low-energy electron attachment, autodetachment, and electron-induced processes in the smallest helicene molecules
articles.abstract: Free low-energy (0–14 eV) electron attachment and electron-triggered processes in the gas-phase carbohelicene molecules containing five and six ortho-fused benzene rings are studied using dissociative electron attachment spectroscopy under single-collision conditions. The long-lived molecular negative ions (MNIs) are the most abundant species detected in the negative ion mass spectra of both compounds. Their electron detachment times are measured to be 50–70 μ s. On this basis, the adiabatic electron affinity of [6]helicene is estimated to be 0.81 eV in excellent agreement with the B3LYP/6-31+G(d) value (0.79 eV). The most intriguing finding is a sharp increase in the electron detachment time of [5]helicene MNI observed in the range 0.25–0.5 eV that contradicts the obvious tendency of electron detachment times to decrease as incident electron energy rises. This unusual effect is explained by the formation of the most stable re-arranged planar MNI, which loses its initial chirality, a process being supposed to be possible only in [5]helicene MNI initially formed through the π 3 * shape resonance. The present findings can be of importance to understanding the spin-filtering effects produced by helical molecules since transmission of low-energy photoelectrons through ordered enantiopure molecular layers can be considered as the formation of the temporary negative ion states and their decay by electron detachment.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: The collective role of bending, stretching, and polydispersity in microtubule mechanics and hydrodynamics
articles.abstract: Microtubules (MTs) organize into various structures by modulating their physico-chemical and electro-mechanical properties. Their size and flexibility are crucial for maintaining the cell’s mechanical strength and its ability to respond to external forces. Translational and rotational diffusion enhance MTs’ capacity to locate and bind to targets. In addition, cells regulate asymmetric MT length growth and polydispersity to maintain proper cytoskeletal organization in response to functional demands. Therefore, understanding these properties accurately is essential for grasping their critical roles in cellular functions. In this study, we develop a comprehensive framework to characterize the collective effects of hydrodynamic interactions, polydispersity, bending, and stretching on the hydrodynamic and mechanical properties of MT solutions. The approach integrates dynamic light scattering (DLS), a reliable sample preparation protocol, and an optimized scattering theory for polydisperse semiflexible polymers, yielding accurate, reproducible results from autocorrelation functions measured under conditions that simulate the physiological environment. Overall, the approach offers an alternative to conventional post-analysis DLS tools for analyzing experimental autocorrelation data in filamentous systems with variable stiffness and length and under various intracellular conditions, thereby providing a close relationship among the biophysical parameters describing filaments, their surrounding environment, and their influence on the complex and dynamic behavior of these systems.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Assessment of particle-density transformation functions for the optimal determination of the configurational entropy of mixing in molecular liquids
articles.abstract: We critically investigate implementation details of our recently developed approach for the calculation of the configurational entropy of mixing for multicomponent molecular liquids based on atomistic molecular dynamics simulations. In particular, we study the influence of the choice of the function that serves as a transformation from atomic coordinates to a smooth particle density on the numerical results for the entropy of mixing. We find that several common functions perform very well, yielding virtually the same numerical entropy results. A certain care is required for the choice of the central parameter of these functions, which controls the specific width of the spatial broadening for each particle. Our findings confirm the broad applicability of our computational approach for the configurational entropy of mixing for molecular liquids and provide a solid basis for choosing the correct numerical broadening parameters.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Revisiting triplet correlation functions of classical fluids
articles.abstract: Wertheim’s perturbation theory proposes that the thermodynamic properties of an associating tangential-core chain fluid can be recast in terms of the structural properties of the non-bonded state. In this context, triplet correlation functions (TCFs), in addition to the radial distribution function (RDF), help to explain angular effects and branching in non-linear molecules. Nonetheless, unlike the RDF, computing TCFs via molecular simulation requires building a sophisticated framework to obtain accurate data at minimal computational cost. Furthermore, available simulation data and correlations for simple fluids are either outdated or scarce. In this work, we focus on the classical pure hard-sphere fluid and provide extensive datasets of TCFs for some representative geometries found in alkane isomers. We revisit the general algorithm for computing volume elements in distance histograms and present the open-source Monte Carlo code ENIG3 to efficiently calculate these structural observables for simple fluids (e.g., hard, square-well, and Mie spheres). Finally, contact values are correlated following a semiempirical approach, and we report accurate closed-form expressions readily to be incorporated into Wertheim’s solutions.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Structural transition in one-dimensional water unveils the origin of multifurcated hydrogen bond weakening
articles.abstract: Water confined to low dimensions exhibits even more anomalous behavior than bulk water. Since these anomalies are primarily dictated by hydrogen bonds (hbs), we investigate hb behavior in quasi-one-dimensional water chains using density functional theory. We show that a water chain with two molecules per unit cell transforms from a single-file (low-linear-density) to a double-file (high-linear-density) structure under uniaxial compression. Furthermore, we show that repulsive interactions emerge when hbs become multifurcated. These additional repulsive forces weaken the hbs and play a crucial role in driving the structural transition. We demonstrate that the many-body interactions associated with hb cooperativity, as well as the repulsive forces from multifurcated hbs, are captured by classical dipole–dipole interactions. This indicates that both hb cooperativity and the weakening of multifurcated hbs are classical electrostatic phenomena, even though quantum effects dictate the strength of the effective dipoles involved. Finally, we discuss how these results provide insights for understanding the flow mechanism of water along pores of sub-nanometer diameter and aid in developing a simple, universal water model.

articles.title: One-pot synthesis of carbon nanotube/graphene composite phase change materials based on Pickering emulsion for solar thermal storage
articles.title_zh: 基于Pickering乳液的碳纳米管/石墨烯复合相变材料的一锅合成用于太阳能储热
articles.abstract: The practical deployment of phase change materials (PCMs) is frequently constrained by two intrinsic drawbacks. respectively low thermal conductivity and susceptibility to leakage during solid–liquid phase change. To address these issues, this study reports the synthesis of composite PCMs comprising hexadecanol encapsulated within a three-dimensional carbon nanotube (CNT)/reduced graphene oxide (RGO) network, fabricated via a one-pot Pickering emulsion method using graphene oxide (GO) as the stabilizer. The resulting CNT/RGO scaffold concurrently enhances thermal transport and structural integrity. Specifically, the thermal conductivity of the composite reaches 125.40% of that of pristine hexadecanol, while the latent heat capacity is substantially retained. Furthermore, the composite exhibits improved photothermal conversion efficiency. These characteristics render the developed material a promising candidate for solar thermal storage applications .

articles.title: QPotatoNet-A Hybrid Quantum Transformer Context for Haplotype-Aware Genomic Prediction and Accelerated Polyploid Potato Breeding
articles.title_zh: QPotatoNet-用于单倍体感知基因组预测和多倍体马铃薯加速育种的混合量子变压器环境
articles.abstract: Genomic selection has revolutionized the pace of crop breeding, but the cultivated potato (Solanum tuberosum, 2n = 4x = 48) still stands as a challenge: the accuracy of linear models like GBLUP, and of conventional deep learning is reduced by autotetrasomic inheritance, double-reduction, complex non-additive gene action, and small training populations. Approach: Results: We present QPotatoNet, a hybrid quantum–Transformer model that integrates a dosage-aware genomic Transformer encoder and a haplotype-block encoder with an 8-qubit variational quantum layer via cross-attention.tetrasomic SNP dosages and LD-defined phased haplotypes are simultaneously tokenized and processed to simultaneously predict genomic-estimated breeding values (GEBVs) for eight key agronomic traits. Results. On a 3,012-clone tetraploid panel (21,432 SNP loci), QPotatoNet attained a mean prediction accuracy of r = 0.734 across eight traits, improving on the best deep-learning baseline by 9.2% and on GBLUP by 22.6% on average, with the largest gains for low-heritability and non-additive traits. The variational quantum layer and the haplotype encoder led to the largest improve of accuracy in both cases when the ablation was executed. Conclusions. Through the integration of tetrasomic dosage structure and haplotype context into a quantum-enhanced attention mechanism, QPotatoNet closes the polyploid predictive gap and provides a feasible way for potato breeding cycle reduction.

articles.title: Structural, Electrical and Optical Properties of Zno and Zno:co Nanostructures Thin Films for Optoelectronic Applications
articles.title_zh: 用于光电应用的Zno和Zno: co纳米结构薄膜的结构、电气和光学性质
articles.abstract: This study comparatively evaluates the influence of Co incorporation on these properties in films deposited onto glass, titanium and Silicon substrates by DC magnetron co-sputtering. Structural, compositional, morphological, optical, and electrical characteristics were investigated using X-ray diffraction (XRD), Raman, Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS), scanning electron microscopy (SEM) with energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDX), Ultraviolet–Visible–Near-Infrared (UV–Vis–NIR) spectroscopy, current/voltage (I-V) measurements, cycling-endurance tests, and temperature dependent conductivity analysis. The hexagonal wurtzite structure was retained after Co incorporation, but diffraction-peak shifts are evidenced, vibrational-band modifications, and a rougher granular morphology indicated lattice perturbation and increased local disorder. XPS measurements support the presence of cobalt as a dilute dopant in the ZnO-based film. Also, the optical band gap narrowed from 3.16 eV to 2.70 eV and the estimated film thickness from 100.57 to 93.04 nm, using an iterative Bhattacharyya method. The ZnO:Co device exhibited a wider separation between the high and low resistance states (HRS/LRS) and bipolar resistive switching and a thermally activated transport, with SET and RESET transitions near − 0.9 V and + 0.5 V, respectively although progressively increase of resistive levels during the endurance tests. A thermally activated transport mechanism at high temperatures was shown, with an activation energy of 44.7 meV for ZnO and 242.91 meV for ZnO:Co. These results demonstrate that dilute Co incorporation simultaneously modifies the structural, optical, and electrical response of ZnO thin films, offering a promising pathway for the design of multifunctional optoelectronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究通过直流磁控管共溅射，对比评估了共掺杂对沉积在玻璃、钛和硅衬底上的薄膜的这些性能的影响。使用X射线衍射（ XRD ）、拉曼、傅里叶变换红外光谱（ FTIR ）、X射线光电子能谱（ XPS ）、扫描电子显微镜（ SEM ）和能量色散X射线光谱（ EDX ）、紫外-可见-近红外（ UV–Vis–NIR ）光谱、电流/电压（ I-V ）测量、循环耐久性测试和温度相关电导率分析，研究了结构、成分、形态、光学和电学特性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本研究通过直流磁控管共溅射，对比评估了共掺杂对沉积在玻璃、钛和硅衬底上的薄膜的这些性能的影响。使用X射线衍射（ XRD ）、拉曼、傅里叶变换红外光谱（ FTIR ）、X射线光电子能谱（ XPS ）、扫描电子显微镜（ SEM ）和能量色散X射线光谱（ EDX ）、紫外-可见-近红外（ UV–Vis–NIR ）光谱、电流/电压（ I-V ）测量、循环耐久性测试和温度相关电导率分析，研究了结构、成分、形态、光学和电学特性。六方纤锌矿结构在Co掺入后保留，但衍射峰位移被证明，振动带修饰和更粗糙的粒状形态表明晶格扰动和局部紊乱增加。XPS测量支持钴作为稀释掺杂剂存在于ZnO基薄膜中。此外，使用迭代Bhattacharyya方法，光学带隙从3.16 eV缩小到2.70 eV ，估计膜厚从100.57到93.04 nm。ZnO: Co器件在高阻态和低阻态（ HRS/LRS ）以及双极电阻开关和热激活输运之间表现出更宽的间隔，设定和复位跃迁分别接近− 0.9 V和+ 0.5 V ，尽管在耐久性测试期间电阻水平逐渐增加。显示了高温下的热激活传输机制， ZnO的激活能为44.7 meV ， ZnO: Co的激活能为242.91 meV。这些结果表明，稀释Co的掺入同时改变了ZnO薄膜的结构、光学和电响应，为多功能光电器件的设计提供了有希望的途径。

articles.title: Dynamical Tunneling Blockade in Layer-Pseudospin Ferromagnets
articles.title_zh: 层伪自旋铁磁体的动态隧道阻塞
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28760v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Double-layer systems with narrow or flat electronic bands may exhibit spontaneous interlayer coherence, described by a layer-pseudospin ferromagnetic order parameter. In modern realizations of layer-pseudospin ferromagnets, the electrons carry additional valley degeneracies, endowing each layer with a valley-pseudospin degree of freedom. We study their nonequilibrium steady states driven by a static interlayer voltage bias in the presence of interlayer tunneling. While in the low-bias regime, the system is in a static state with parallel valley pseudospins between the two layers, we show that in the high-bias regime, the dynamical precession of the layer-pseudospin stabilizes the valley pseudospins in the antiparallel configuration, strongly suppressing the interlayer tunneling. This dynamical tunneling blockade leads to an absence of ac current and a sharp drop of the dc tunneling current to a tiny value, in stark contrast to conventional quantum Hall double layers.
articles.abstract_zh: 具有窄或扁平电子带的双层系统可以表现出由层-伪旋铁磁有序参数描述的自发层间相干性。在层伪自旋铁磁体的现代实现中，电子携带额外的谷退化，赋予每层谷伪自旋自由度。我们研究了在层间隧穿存在时由静态层间电压偏置驱动的非平衡稳态。在低偏压状态下，系统处于静态，两层之间有平行谷伪旋，我们表明，在高偏压状态下，层伪旋的动态进动稳定了反平行配置的谷伪旋，强烈抑制了层间隧穿。这种动态隧道阻塞导致没有交流电流，直流隧道电流急剧下降到很小的值，与传统的量子霍尔双层形成鲜明对比。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 具有窄或扁平电子带的双层系统可以表现出由层-伪旋铁磁有序参数描述的自发层间相干性。在层伪自旋铁磁体的现代实现中，电子携带额外的谷退化，赋予每层谷伪自旋自由度。我们研究了在层间隧穿存在时由静态层间电压偏置驱动的非平衡稳态。在低偏压状态下，系统处于静态，两层之间有平行谷伪旋，我们表明，在高偏压状态下，层伪旋的动态进动稳定了反平行配置的谷伪旋，强烈抑制了层间隧穿。这种动态隧道阻塞导致没有交流电流，直流隧道电流急剧下降到很小的值，与传统的量子霍尔双层形成鲜明对比。

articles.title: Paramagnetic phase of MnTe₂: complete one phonon Raman spectrum
articles.title_zh: MnTe ₂的顺磁相：完成一个声子拉曼光谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28844v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this study we present a complete first-order Raman scattering spectrum of paramagnetic phase of MnTe₂- a material, where new type of spin texture induced by noncoplanar antiferromagnetic ordering below the Néel temperature (T_N approx 90 K) gives rise to unconventional scenario of magnetism. Basic properties of all five phonon modes (A_g, E_g and three T_g) predicted by the group theory have been successfully approached through polarization, excitation and temperature dependent measurements. In particular, the ever-missing phonon mode of T_g symmetry has been unambiguously resolved in the room temperature Raman spectrum at approximately 107 cm⁻¹, just 1.5 cm⁻¹ higher in frequency compared to the E_g mode. Density functional theory calculations reproduce the observed Raman-active phonon spectrum and support the assignment of all five first-order Raman modes, including the near-degeneracy of the E_g and one of the T_g vibrations. The calculations further reveal a dense manifold of low-energy antiferromagnetic spin configurations, separated from the ground state by only a few meV per formula unit. Furthermore, strong signals of inelastically scattered light from the paramagnetic (PM) phase of MnTe₂ were acquired with long wavelength excitations, i.e. 633 nm and 785 nm, revealing the 2A_g overtone at approx. 360 cm⁻¹. The enhanced absorption of the light in the near infrared range could be a putative reason behind the anomalous angular dependence of scattered intensity of the highest frequency T_g phonon mode (183 cm⁻¹) measured in PM MnTe₂ with parallelly aligned polarizers. Finally, upon cooling just below the T_N, the measured properties of phonons remained basically unperturbed by the incipient long-range antiferromagnetic ordering.
articles.abstract_zh: 在本研究中，我们提出了MnTe ₂ （一种材料）顺磁相的完整一阶拉曼散射光谱，其中由低于Néel温度（ T_N约90 K ）的非共平面反铁磁有序引起的新型自旋织构产生了非常规的磁性场景。群论预测的所有五种声子模态（ A_g、E_g和三种T_g ）的基本特性已通过极化、激发和温度相关测量成功接近。特别是，在室温拉曼光谱中， T_g对称的不断丢失的声子模态已被明确地分辨为约107 cm 1 ，与E_g模态相比，频率仅高出1.5 cm 1。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在本研究中，我们提出了MnTe ₂ （一种材料）顺磁相的完整一阶拉曼散射光谱，其中由低于Néel温度（ T_N约90 K ）的非共平面反铁磁有序引起的新型自旋织构产生了非常规的磁性场景。群论预测的所有五种声子模态（ A_g、E_g和三种T_g ）的基本特性已通过极化、激发和温度相关测量成功接近。特别是，在室温拉曼光谱中， T_g对称的不断丢失的声子模态已被明确地分辨为约107 cm 1 ，与E_g模态相比，频率仅高出1.5 cm 1。密度泛函理论计算再现了观察到的拉曼激活声子谱，并支持所有五个一阶拉曼模式的分配，包括E_g的近退化和T_g振动之一。计算进一步揭示了低能量反铁磁自旋配置的密集歧管，每个公式单位仅与基态隔开几个meV。此外，通过长波长激发（即633 nm和785 nm ）获得了来自MnTe ₂顺磁（ PM ）相的非弹性散射光的强信号，揭示了约360 cm的2A_g泛音¹。近红外范围内光的吸收增强可能是偏振片平行排列的PM MnTe ₂中测量的最高频率T_g声子模态（ 183 cm恤¹ ）的散射强度异常角依赖性背后的一个推测原因。最后，在刚刚低于T_N的冷却时，声子的测量特性基本上不受初期远程反铁磁有序的干扰。

articles.title: Two quantum skyrmions form a magnon Josephson junction
articles.title_zh: 两个量子skyrmions形成一个磁子约瑟夫森结
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28854v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two quantum skyrmions in a frustrated spin-1/2 magnet bind into a molecule, and the molecule acts as a magnon Josephson junction: the relative helicity θ and the number n of magnons transferred between them obey H=E_Cn²-Wcosθ. DMRG on the J₁--J₂ triangular lattice gives E_C as the curvature of the skyrmion energy at its natural size of seven flipped spins, and the measured helicity coherence fixes Wsimeq0.02J₁, half the skyrmion--antiskyrmion tunnel splitting and independent of the anisotropy. Two helicity qubits side by side are thus strongly coupled by their own interaction.
articles.abstract_zh: 沮丧的自旋-1/2磁铁中的两个量子skyrmion结合成一个分子，该分子充当一个磁子约瑟夫森结：它们之间转移的相对螺旋度θ和磁子数n服从H = E_Cn ² -Wcosθ。三角格上的DMRG在其七次翻转的自然尺寸下给出了E_C作为skyrmion能量的曲率，并且测量的螺旋相干性修复了Wsimeq0.02J ，一半的skyrmion-antiskyrmion隧道分裂并且独立于各向异性。因此，两个螺旋量子位通过它们自己的相互作用而强烈耦合。

articles.title: Ultrafast and Anisotropic Exciton Transport in Layered NbOI₂
articles.title_zh: 分层NbOI ₂中的超快和各向异性激子传输
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28877v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ferroelectric layered semiconductors provide a unique platform for exploring coupled excitonic and electronic phenomena in reduced dimensions. Here, exciton transport in layered NbOI₂ is investigated using transient absorption microscopy. Ultrafast and strongly anisotropic exciton diffusion is observed. The diffusion coefficient of about 160 cm² s⁻¹ along the nonpolar crystal axis is among the highest reported for van der Waals semiconductors. The transport exhibits an approximately twofold in-plane anisotropy between the polar and nonpolar directions, reflecting the intrinsic low-symmetry crystal structure of NbOI₂. The environmental stability of NbOI₂ is further investigated, and fabrication and encapsulation conditions required to achieve long-term sample stability are identified. These results establish NbOI₂ as a promising platform for studying anisotropic exciton transport and highlight the critical role of interface protection in air-sensitive van der Waals materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 铁电层状半导体为探索缩小尺寸的耦合激子和电子现象提供了一个独特的平台。在这里，使用瞬态吸收显微镜研究层状NbOI ₂中的激子传输。观察到超快和强各向异性激子扩散。范德华半导体沿非极性晶轴的扩散系数约为160平方厘米。该输运在极性和非极性方向之间表现出大约两倍的平面内各向异性，反映了NbOI ₂的固有低对称晶体结构。进一步研究了NbOI ₂的环境稳定性，并确定了实现长期样品稳定性所需的制造和封装条件。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 铁电层状半导体为探索缩小尺寸的耦合激子和电子现象提供了一个独特的平台。在这里，使用瞬态吸收显微镜研究层状NbOI ₂中的激子传输。观察到超快和强各向异性激子扩散。范德华半导体沿非极性晶轴的扩散系数约为160平方厘米。该输运在极性和非极性方向之间表现出大约两倍的平面内各向异性，反映了NbOI ₂的固有低对称晶体结构。进一步研究了NbOI ₂的环境稳定性，并确定了实现长期样品稳定性所需的制造和封装条件。这些结果使NbOI ₂成为研究各向异性激子传输的有希望的平台，并突出了界面保护在空气敏感范德华材料中的关键作用。

articles.title: Josephson effect in symmetry-mismatched van der Waals hybrid junctions of NbSe2-Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+x and NbSe2-Bi2Sr2-xLaxCuO6+y
articles.title_zh: NbSe2-Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8 + x与NbSe2-Bi2Sr2-xLaxCuO6 + y对称不匹配范德华混合结中的Josephson效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29021v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Coupling superconductors of different symmetries may lead to emergent quantum phenomena but experimental studies on heterojunctions made of lattice-mismatched crystals are scarce. Here, we fabricate Josephson junction by van der Waals stacking NbSe2 flakes on freshly cleaved surfaces of Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+x or Bi2Sr2-xLaxCuO6+y. We obtain pronounced Josephson currents across the heterojunctions at temperatures below 7 K. The Josephson coupling strength, characterized by the product of the critical Josephson current I_c and the normal state resistance Rₙ, can reach about 0.3 mV, much exceeding the values previously reported in Pb-Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+x or Nb-Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+x junctions. Microwave irradiation induces integer Shapiro steps. We also observe the Fraunhofer diffraction pattern by applying an in-plane magnetic field. We compare our results with the theoretical calculations that take into account the coherent tunneling and the order parameter mixing. Our work demonstrates the hybrid junctions as a distinctive platform for addressing pairing symmetry and emergent quantum phenomena.
articles.abstract_zh: 不同对称性的耦合超导体可能导致出现量子现象，但由晶格不匹配的晶体组成的异质结的实验研究很少。在这里，我们通过在Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8 + x或Bi2Sr2-xLaxCuO6 + y的新鲜裂解表面上堆叠NbSe2薄片来制造Josephson结。我们在低于7 K的温度下获得跨异质结的显著约瑟夫森电流。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 不同对称性的耦合超导体可能导致出现量子现象，但由晶格不匹配的晶体组成的异质结的实验研究很少。在这里，我们通过在Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8 + x或Bi2Sr2-xLaxCuO6 + y的新鲜裂解表面上堆叠NbSe2薄片来制造Josephson结。我们在低于7 K的温度下获得跨异质结的显著约瑟夫森电流。约瑟夫森耦合强度的特点是临界约瑟夫森电流I_c和正常状态电阻R_c的乘积，可达到约0.3 mV ，远远超过先前在Pb-Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8 + x或Nb-Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8 + x结中报告的值。微波辐射诱导整数Shapiro步骤。我们还通过施加平面内磁场来观察Fraunhofer衍射图。我们将我们的结果与考虑相干隧道和有序参数混合的理论计算进行比较。我们的工作展示了混合结作为解决配对对称性和涌现量子现象的独特平台。

articles.title: Characterizing universal topological phases beyond spatial embedding
articles.title_zh: 表征空间嵌入之外的通用拓扑相位
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29022v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Although Hamiltonians govern wave-matter interactions, conventional characterizations of topological phases of matter require more than the Hamiltonian alone, relying on global invariants defined on closed reciprocal-space manifolds or local commutation relations with position operators. This spatial dependence precludes a unique characterization of topological phases on an abstract platform, whose Hamiltonian can be defined independently of its spatial embedding. Here we establish a framework for characterizing universal topological phases, grounded in the invariance of topological features under arbitrary Hamiltonian-preserving deformations. We construct a Hamiltonian-based spatial embedding that groups a system's constituents according to their connectivity. This embedding, which reproduces the results of conventional topological diagnostics in established systems, enables a coherent extension of topological phases to complex networks using the Hamiltonian alone, further highlighting exceptional robustness in small-world networks. Our results reshape the conceptual foundations of topological physics by decoupling topological characterization from prescribed physical platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 尽管汉密尔顿定律支配波-物质相互作用，但物质拓扑相位的传统表征需要的不仅仅是汉密尔顿定律，它依赖于在闭逆空间流形上定义的全局不变量或与位置算子的局部换向关系。这种空间依赖性排除了在抽象平台上对拓扑相位的独特表征，其哈密顿量可以独立于其空间嵌入进行定义。在这里，我们建立了一个表征通用拓扑相位的框架，其基础是任意汉密尔顿保留变形下拓扑特征的不变性。我们构造了一个基于汉密尔顿的空间嵌入，根据系统的连通性对系统的成分进行分组。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 尽管汉密尔顿定律支配波-物质相互作用，但物质拓扑相位的传统表征需要的不仅仅是汉密尔顿定律，它依赖于在闭逆空间流形上定义的全局不变量或与位置算子的局部换向关系。这种空间依赖性排除了在抽象平台上对拓扑相位的独特表征，其哈密顿量可以独立于其空间嵌入进行定义。在这里，我们建立了一个表征通用拓扑相位的框架，其基础是任意汉密尔顿保留变形下拓扑特征的不变性。我们构造了一个基于汉密尔顿的空间嵌入，根据系统的连通性对系统的成分进行分组。这种嵌入在已建立的系统中再现了传统拓扑诊断的结果，使拓扑相位能够连贯地扩展到仅使用Hamiltonian的复杂网络，进一步突出了小世界网络的卓越鲁棒性。我们的研究结果通过将拓扑特征与规定的物理平台分离，重塑了拓扑物理学的概念基础。

articles.title: Ubiquitous topological materials protected by hidden partial symmetries
articles.title_zh: 由隐藏的部分对称性保护的无处不在的拓扑材料
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29028v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Symmetries play a crucial role in protecting the topological phases of insulators, ensuring the robustness of their surface states against perturbations. Traditionally, these symmetries have to be obeyed by the system as a whole, which is a rather strong constraint. In this work, we demonstrate that topological effects can also be realized through a substantially weaker form of symmetry that we coin emphpartial latent symmetries. For these, invariance is required only at certain energy scales of an effective Hamiltonian, rather than for the object as a whole. Applying this idea, we construct weak-symmetry versions of the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger and Benalcazar-Bernevig-Hughes models. These weak-symmetry models behave in many aspects just like their conventional brethren---in particular, they host robust edge states---, though the corresponding topological invariants are only emphapproximately quantized. We conclude this work by experimentally realizing Hermitian and non-Hermitian versions of such approximate topological insulators and probe their edge states. Overall, given the ubiquity of symmetry in all areas of physics and engineering, we foresee our work to serve as a cornerstone for exploring how conventional, strong symmetry requirements can be replaced by weak-symmetry ones.
articles.abstract_zh: 对称性在保护绝缘体的拓扑相位方面起着至关重要的作用，确保其表面状态的鲁棒性免受扰动。传统上，这些对称性必须由整个系统服从，这是一个相当强的约束。在这项工作中，我们证明了拓扑效应也可以通过一种实质上较弱的对称形式来实现，我们创造了局部潜伏对称。对于这些，不变性仅在有效哈密顿函数的某些能量尺度上是必需的，而不是对于整个物体。应用这一思想，我们构建了Su-Schrieffer-Heeger和Benalcazar-Bernevig-Hughes模型的弱对称版本。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对称性在保护绝缘体的拓扑相位方面起着至关重要的作用，确保其表面状态的鲁棒性免受扰动。传统上，这些对称性必须由整个系统服从，这是一个相当强的约束。在这项工作中，我们证明了拓扑效应也可以通过一种实质上较弱的对称形式来实现，我们创造了局部潜伏对称。对于这些，不变性仅在有效哈密顿函数的某些能量尺度上是必需的，而不是对于整个物体。应用这一思想，我们构建了Su-Schrieffer-Heeger和Benalcazar-Bernevig-Hughes模型的弱对称版本。这些弱对称模型在许多方面表现得就像它们的传统兄弟一样--特别是，它们承载了稳健的边缘状态--尽管相应的拓扑不变量仅被近似量化。我们通过实验实现这种近似拓扑绝缘体的埃尔米特和非埃尔米特版本并探测其边缘状态来结束这项工作。总体而言，鉴于对称性在物理和工程的所有领域无处不在，我们预计我们的工作将成为探索如何用弱对称性取代传统的强对称性要求的基石。

articles.title: The Spectroscopic Atlas of Excitonic Complexes in hBN-Encapsulated S-TMD Monolayers: From Excitons to Oxcitons and Beyond
articles.title_zh: HBN封装的S-TMD单层中激子复合物的光谱图谱：从激子到激子及其他
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29081v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) encapsulation has transformed the optical spectroscopy of semiconducting transition-metal dichalcogenide monolayers (MLs) by suppressing extrinsic disorder and enabling the resolution of an increasingly complex hierarchy of excitonic states. This Review provides a spectroscopy-oriented framework for understanding and identifying excitonic complexes in hBN-encapsulated Mo- and W-based MLs and their alloys. The discussion covers bright and dark excitons, Rydberg states, charged excitons, biexcitons, phonon-assisted replicas, and higher-order Fermi-sea many-body states, including hexcitons and oxcitons, with an emphasis on the experimental signatures that distinguish them. Particular attention is given to the combined use of photoluminescence and absorption-related spectroscopy, electrostatic gating, polarization analysis, excitation-power and temperature dependences, magnetic fields, and time-resolved measurements to establish microscopic assignments. The role of alloying as an additional degree of freedom for engineering the excitonic hierarchy, spin-valley configuration, and magneto-optical response is also highlighted. By organizing the rapidly expanding phenomenology around experimentally accessible fingerprints rather than individual material systems, this Review aims to provide a practical and broadly applicable guide for identifying, comparing, and engineering excitonic states in high-quality two-dimensional semiconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 六方氮化硼（ hBN ）封装通过抑制外在紊乱并实现日益复杂的激子态层次结构的分辨率，改变了半导体过渡金属二硫族化物单层（ ML ）的光谱。本综述提供了一个面向光谱学的框架，用于理解和识别hBN封装的Mo-和W基ML及其合金中的激子复合物。讨论涉及明暗激子、Rydberg状态、带电激子、双激子、声子辅助复制品和高阶费米海多体状态，包括六激子和氧激子，重点是区分它们的实验特征。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 六方氮化硼（ hBN ）封装通过抑制外在紊乱并实现日益复杂的激子态层次结构的分辨率，改变了半导体过渡金属二硫族化物单层（ ML ）的光谱。本综述提供了一个面向光谱学的框架，用于理解和识别hBN封装的Mo-和W基ML及其合金中的激子复合物。讨论涉及明暗激子、Rydberg状态、带电激子、双激子、声子辅助复制品和高阶费米海多体状态，包括六激子和氧激子，重点是区分它们的实验特征。特别注意结合使用光致发光和吸收相关光谱、静电选通、极化分析、激发功率和温度依赖性、磁场和时间分辨测量来建立微观分配。还强调了合金化作为工程激子层次结构、自旋谷配置和磁光响应的额外自由度的作用。通过围绕实验可访问的指纹而不是单个材料系统组织快速扩展的现象学，本综述旨在为识别、比较和工程高质量二维半导体中的激子态提供实用且广泛适用的指南。

articles.title: Algebraic criteria for complete relaxation in autonomous and periodically driven open quantum systems
articles.title_zh: 自主和周期驱动的开放量子系统中完全松弛的代数标准
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29084v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We derive sufficient criteria that guarantee convergence of open quantum system dynamics to a unique long-time state independent of the initial conditions. We refer to this behavior as complete relaxation. Focusing on systems described by Gorini-Kossakowski-Sudarshan-Lindblad (GKSL) master equations on finite-dimensional Hilbert spaces, our approach uses only elementary mathematical arguments. For autonomous systems, we recover three previously derived relaxation criteria, which can be expressed as algebraic conditions on the Lindblad operators and the Hamiltonian entering the GKSL equation. For periodically driven systems, we obtain a new criterion involving a similar algebraic condition and a local continuity requirement on the time-dependent GKSL generator. This result implies an earlier criterion for complete relaxation formulated in Ref. [J. Phys. A 52, 43LT01 (2019)]. We also discuss implications of our approach for periodically modulated classical master equations, as well as extensions to driven systems without a periodicity constraint.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们推导出足够的标准，保证开放量子系统动力学收敛到独立于初始条件的独特长时间状态。我们将这种行为称为完全放松。我们的方法侧重于Gorini-Kossakowski-Sudarshan-Lindblad （ GKSL ）主方程组在有限维希尔伯特空间上描述的系统，仅使用基本的数学参数。对于自治系统，我们恢复了三个先前导出的松弛标准，可以表示为Lindblad算子的代数条件和进入GKSL方程的Hamiltonian。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们推导出足够的标准，保证开放量子系统动力学收敛到独立于初始条件的独特长时间状态。我们将这种行为称为完全放松。我们的方法侧重于Gorini-Kossakowski-Sudarshan-Lindblad （ GKSL ）主方程组在有限维希尔伯特空间上描述的系统，仅使用基本的数学参数。对于自治系统，我们恢复了三个先前导出的松弛标准，可以表示为Lindblad算子的代数条件和进入GKSL方程的Hamiltonian。对于周期驱动系统，我们获得了一个新的标准，涉及相似的代数条件和时间相关GKSL生成器的局部连续性要求。这一结果意味着参考文献中制定的完全放松的早期标准。[J. Phys.A 52, 43LT01 (2019)]。我们还讨论了我们的方法对周期调制经典主方程的影响，以及对没有周期性约束的驱动系统的扩展。

articles.title: Magnetization and Josephson current coupling drives the Josephson diode effect in FeTe0.55Se0.45 van der Waals junctions
articles.title_zh: 磁化和约瑟夫森电流耦合驱动FeTe0.55Se0.45 van der Waals结中的约瑟夫森二极管效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29124v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Josephson diode effect (JDE) reflects symmetry breaking in the current-phase relation (CPR) of Josephson junctions, yet establishing its microscopic origin is often challenging. We investigate the mechanism of the JDE in van der Waals Josephson junctions based on FeTe0.55Se0.45, a platform where superconductivity, topology, and magnetism may coexist at the interface. Our devices exhibit a robust zero-field diode response with asymmetric switching currents. Magnetic-field measurements reveal a hysteretic Fraunhofer pattern and magnetic-resonance-induced voltage feature, evidencing interfacial magnetism coupled to the Josephson current. Microwave response further shows half-integer Shapiro steps with asymmetric evolution, demonstrating contributions from both a second harmonic and a magnetization-induced phase shift in CPR. Numerical simulations combining magnetization dynamics and Josephson phase dynamics reproduce these features, confirming that the JDE originates from interfacial coupling between magnetization and Josephson current. This work provides a transport-based route to pinpoint the microscopic mechanism of the JDE, establishing a platform for exploring magnetically active interfacial superconductivity, and enables the design of nonreciprocal superconducting devices in clean, interface-engineered van der Waals systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 约瑟夫森二极管效应（ JDE ）反映了约瑟夫森结的电流-相位关系（ CPR ）中的对称性断裂，但确定其微观起源往往具有挑战性。我们基于FeTe0.55Se0.45研究了JDE在范德华约瑟夫森结中的机制， FeTe0.55Se0.45是一个超导、拓扑和磁性可能共存于界面的平台。我们的器件具有强大的零场二极管响应和非对称开关电流。磁场测量揭示了滞后弗劳恩霍夫图案和磁共振诱导电压特征，证明了与约瑟夫森电流耦合的界面磁性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 约瑟夫森二极管效应（ JDE ）反映了约瑟夫森结的电流-相位关系（ CPR ）中的对称性断裂，但确定其微观起源往往具有挑战性。我们基于FeTe0.55Se0.45研究了JDE在范德华约瑟夫森结中的机制， FeTe0.55Se0.45是一个超导、拓扑和磁性可能共存于界面的平台。我们的器件具有强大的零场二极管响应和非对称开关电流。磁场测量揭示了滞后弗劳恩霍夫图案和磁共振诱导电压特征，证明了与约瑟夫森电流耦合的界面磁性。微波响应进一步显示了具有不对称演化的半整数Shapiro步骤，证明了心肺复苏中二次谐波和磁化诱导的相移的贡献。结合磁化动力学和约瑟夫森相位动力学的数值模拟再现了这些特征，证实了JDE起源于磁化与约瑟夫森电流之间的界面耦合。这项工作提供了一种基于传输的路线来精确定位JDE的微观机制，为探索磁性活性界面超导性建立了一个平台，并使清洁的界面工程范德瓦尔斯系统中的非互易超导器件的设计成为可能。

articles.title: Valence-Driven Structural Transformation and Phase Coexistence in Chemically Substituted EuPd2Si2
articles.title_zh: 化学取代的EuPd2Si2中价驱动的结构转变和相共存
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29180v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: EuPd2Si2 serves as an ideal system to probe the interplay between lattice dynamics and electronic instabilities through its tunable valence transition, responsive to temperature, pressure, and magnetic field. Here, we focus on investigating the origin of the temperature-induced europium valence instability in pristine EuPd2Si2, alloyed EuPd2Si1.95Ge0.05, and EuPd2Si1.9Ge0.1 and its correlation with structural responses. Compared with the parent compound EuPd2Si2 which exhibits the europium valence transition at Tv = 143 K, magnetic susceptibility measurements reveal a systematic shift in Tv with Ge substitution, decreasing to 87 K for EuPd2Si1.95Ge0.05. Temperature-dependent synchrotron X-ray diffraction confirms phase coexistence between Eu2+Pd2Si2-xGex and Eu3+Pd2Si2-xGex phases across the valence transition for all samples measured (x = 0, 0.05, 0.10). The pronounced increase in the full width at half maximum (FWHM) well above Tv reflects the gradual nature of the transformation and highlights the role of structural strain in stabilizing the coexisting phases, supporting the presence of a phase-segregated ground state, in contrast to a homogeneous intermediate-valence or mixed-valence state. The variation in Tv across different compositions correlates with changes in lattice parameters, highlighting the robust coupling between the structural and electronic degrees of freedom. The phase diagram suggests an inverse linear relationship between the lattice parameter and Tv, suggesting a possible predictive framework for estimating transition temperatures in other chemically substituted variants of this family.

articles.title: Disorder-Mediated Magnetism in Transition-Metal Dichalcogenide Monolayers: XS₂ and XSe₂ (X = Ti, V, Co, Mo, and Ru)
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29235v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetism in transition-metal dichalcogenide monolayers has attracted considerable attention, yet its nature remains elusive, particularly in monolayer 1T-VSe₂. Our first-principles calculations show that Stoner instability can drive ferromagnetism in XS₂ and XSe₂ monolayers (X = Ti, V, Co, Mo, and Ru), associated with a reduced density of states at the Fermi level. We demonstrate that mixing nonmagnetic Ti, Co, Mo, and Ru disulfides or diselenides can induce magnetism. Conversely, mixing magnetic VS₂ or VSe₂ with other compounds can completely suppress magnetism. Both scenarios can lower the total energy. Moreover, substituting a small number of V atoms with Co defects can also disrupt ferromagnetism in 1T-V(S,Se)₂. Even in pristine 1T-VSe₂, we find ferrimagnetic configurations with reversed local V moments that are nearly degenerate with the ferromagnetic state. Their competition may contribute to the suppression of long-range ferromagnetic order. This reduced energy penalty for magnetic and structural disorder arises from a suppressed density of states at the Fermi level, resembling the mechanism underlying the Peierls transition. Electronically driven energy lowering near the Fermi level may therefore be widespread among transition-metal dichalcogenide monolayers in various forms.

articles.title: Chirality, Klein duality, and the stability of Kitaev spin liquids on the star lattice
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29278v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The star lattice hosts the Yao-Kivelson chiral spin liquid, an exactly solvable Kitaev spin liquid that breaks time reversal spontaneously and is non-Abelian or Abelian depending on the ratio of its two couplings. A density-matrix renormalization group study found that an added Heisenberg exchange leaves it a wide stability window for ferromagnetic but only a narrow one for antiferromagnetic Kitaev coupling. Using projective symmetry groups (PSGs) of fermionic partons, we show that the chirality is not a peculiarity of the solvable point: whenever the π spin rotations act on the partons as in the exact solution (spin-gauge locking), a time-reversal-symmetric mean-field state has no amplitude on the triangles, at any range, so a Kitaev-type spin liquid on this lattice must break time reversal. The Abelian and non-Abelian liquids of both signs share a single chiral PSG, within which their transition is a band inversion. The Klein duality, which reverses the Heisenberg coupling, permutes the PSGs and leaves exactly the locked ones unchanged; a Z₂ spin-liquid phase mapped onto itself is therefore locked and, if it spans a connected range of couplings, contains a Kitaev point. Unprojected mean-field theory in Kitaev's Majorana representation treats both signs alike. Exact second-order perturbation theory about the Kitaev points locates the asymmetry: the triangles respond identically for both signs, whereas on the bonds between triangles the two off-diagonal Heisenberg terms create the same four visons and interfere constructively for antiferromagnetic and almost destructively for ferromagnetic coupling, admixing a low-energy four-vison state 82 times more strongly on the antiferromagnetic side. The PSG results rest on a classification of 352 Z₂ PSGs with spin-orbit-coupled amplitudes, which also identifies the fermionic partners of the known Schwinger-boson spin liquids.

articles.title: Ab Initio Approach for Quantum Magnets with Coupled Cluster and Transcorrelation
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29324v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The nearest-neighbour exchange coupling J₁ is the simplest ingredient of model Hamiltonians used to understand magnetism in real materials. Nevertheless, its ab initio determination requires a high-level correlation treatment and a large basis for wave function expansion. Here we compute J₁ for five oxygen-bridged spin-1/2 quantum magnets --- Sr₂CuO₃, La₂CuO₄, NdNiO₂, ZnCu₃(OH)₆Cl₂, and Li₂CuO₂ --- spanning bridging angles from 180^circ to 94^circ and the crossover from antiferromagnetic to ferromagnetic coupling, using embedded-cluster methodology. To describe the open-shell singlets we use 2-determinant coupled cluster with single and double excitations, which recovers the orbital-breathing enhancement of superexchange from a minimal reference. Basis-set errors are found to be large: extrapolation to the complete basis-set (CBS) limit shifts J₁ by up to 50 meV from bases of double-ζ quality. Transcorrelated Hamiltonians reproduce the CBS estimates with modest basis set sizes, yielding an excellent accuracy against experiment at highly affordable cost. These results are the first application of transcorrelated methods in strongly correlated solid-state systems, and establish transcorrelation as a powerful theory in computational research of materials.

articles.title: Quantics tensor trains for multiloop functional renormalization group in multiorbital impurity models
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29341v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The full frequency dependence of electronic interactions is central to dynamical correlations, but its numerical cost restricts multiorbital calculations. We formulate the multiloop functional renormalization group directly in the quantics tensor train representation, retaining all three independent vertex frequencies over broad ranges without an explicit high-frequency parametrization. Analytical tensor operators perform frequency transformations and internal summations without dense vertex intermediates. Multiloop corrections improve agreement of vertices and responses with independent references and reproduce the low-energy numerical renormalization group self-energy. Lower-temperature calculations resolve a quadratic frequency contribution to the analytically continued scattering rate. A degenerate two-orbital impurity exhibits distinct spin, orbital, and charge responses at fixed Hund coupling. In a compensated altermagnetic environment, an orbital-level splitting induces a local spin response despite zero magnetization of the unperturbed impurity. Increasing Hund coupling suppresses the orbital response while increasing its spin polarization. Renormalized one-particle propagation alone does not reproduce this strong polarization dependence. These results extend compressed multiloop calculations to dynamical correlations in multiorbital environments.

articles.title: Hybridization-Induced Enhancement of the Thermoelectric Response in the Kagome Material CsCr₆Sb₆
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29366v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Flat bands in kagome lattices provide a prominent route to strongly correlated electronic states. Here we report charge and thermal transport measurements on single crystals of CsCr₆Sb₆, a kagome Kondo system arising from the hybridization between flat and dispersive bands. The Seebeck coefficient and Nernst signal increase rapidly below T_Fsim70 K, concomitant with the emergence of short-range antiferromagnetic correlations and flat-band resonance. The Nernst coefficient in the intermediate-temperature range of sim30-80 K further follows the universal scaling reported for prototypical heavy-fermion compounds, consistent with the development of strongly renormalized quasiparticles associated with hybridization. Both the Seebeck and Nernst responses reach extrema at a lower temperature Tₚsim20-25 K, where phonon drag and correlated quasiparticles may both contribute. These results reveal a hybridization-induced enhancement of the thermoelectric response and establish CsCr₆Sb₆ as a kagome platform for probing flat-band-derived Kondo physics through thermoelectric transport.

articles.title: First-principles modeling of ordering in Fe-rich Fe-Si alloys
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29386v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The atomic ordering in Fe-rich Fe-Si alloys strongly influences their magnetic properties and mechanical behavior. While general features of long-range atomic ordering are known from the experimentally established phase diagram in this composition range, detailed atomic configurations and driving forces behind them remain speculative. Here, we address this gap by using effective cluster interactions (ECI) obtained from density functional theory (DFT) calculations and subsequent statistical thermodynamics modeling to unravel the interplay between magnetism, composition, and temperature in body-centered cubic (bcc) Fe-Si alloys up to 20 at% Si. Our analysis reveals that the ordering behavior is governed by a strong coupling between magnetic order, lattice expansion, and Si concentration, with specific ECI shells switching sign or magnitude as the magnetic state changes, which is reflected in the phase equilibria and ordering behavior of Fe-Si alloys. In particular, we demonstrate that D0₃ ordering is, in fact, primary in the totally ordered ferromagnetic state, while the B2 type of ordering is promoted in the paramagnetic state at elevated temperatures. The temperature-dependent evolution of these ordering patterns, obtained from Monte Carlo simulations based on the magnetically resolved ECIs, reproduces the experimentally observed phase equilibria and short-range order characteristics. By explicitly linking the magnetic state with the effective interactions and macroscopic phase behavior, this work establishes a predictive framework for an ab initio-based description of ordering in Fe-rich Fe-Si alloys and highlights the decisive role of magnetism in ordering phenomena in this system.

articles.title: Super-tetragonal ferroelectric barium titanate through anionic overstoichiometry
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29401v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ferroelectric oxides, characterized by an electrical polarization that is switchable with an electric field, are an appealing class of materials for energy-efficient computing, electronics, and photonics. In thin films, the properties of ferroelectrics are commonly tuned using substrate-imposed epitaxial strain, an approach limited to biaxial strain states and a finite number of available substrates. Here, we demonstrate that is is possible to move beyond conventional epitaxial growth by using pulsed laser deposition under highly non-equilibrium conditions. Specifically, we show that this unconventional processing route allows us to stabilize a super-tetragonal phase of ferroelectric BaTiO₃. The key to this stabilization lies in the insertion of surplus oxygen atoms into the unit cell, resulting in peroxide bond formation that give rise to an aspect ratio of as high as 1.08. Notably, this super-tetragonal phase exhibits an enhanced ferroelectric polarization, reduced coercivity, lower leakage currents, and increased cycling endurance compared to conventional bulk-like BaTiO₃ films. These results, thus, showcase the potential of non-equilibrium growth for defect engineering to obtain emergent phases in complex oxides and tune their physical properties in thin films expanding the scope of traditional epitaxy.

articles.title: Microscopic origin of field-induced multiferroicity in Ni3TeO6
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29420v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The continued demand for smaller, faster, and more energy-efficient technologies has driven condensed-matter research towards materials combining multiple responses within a single phase. Particularly interesting examples are multiferroic materials featuring cross-couplings between order parameters. Ni3TeO6 is a prominent member of this material class, exhibiting a hysteresis-free transition under magnetic field which simultaneously affects the magnetic structure, electric polarization, and phonon frequencies. Here, we uncover the microscopic origin of this multiferroic transition using a combination of neutron scattering techniques. We establish the presence of a finite Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya exchange term giving rise to non-reciprocal, chiral spin waves which soften in magnetic field. Their condensation alters the magnetic structure which controls the electric polarization and drives an ionic displacement, thereby coupling the magnetic, electric, and lattice degrees of freedom. Our study demonstrates that neutron scattering is a powerful technique to elucidate microscopic interactions in multiferroic materials, informing the design of next-generation electronic devices.

articles.title: Two-dimensional structures formed by pair potentials: An analytical and numerical study
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29421v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding the thickness dependence of the excess energy of thin films and identifying the deviation from the scaling law that holds for thicker films are crucial for predicting the formation of two-dimensional (2D) materials derived from nonlayered structures, commonly referred to as non-van der Waals (non-vdW) 2D materials. Here, we analytically study the excess energy of thin films as a function of the number of layers N, assuming pair potentials. We show that the 1/N scaling law of the excess energy breaks down in the monolayer limit when the interatomic interactions are long-ranged. The analytical results are confirmed by numerical simulations using the Lennard-Jones and Morse potentials. The present work suggests that non-vdW 2D structures can be formed by pair potentials alone.

articles.title: From hard-core to soft-core bosons in a shell trap
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29440v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the low-temperature states of a system of spinless bosons trapped in a broad spherical shell. In our virtual (path-integral Monte Carlo) experiments, we specifically examine how the equilibrium structure and overall superfluidity of the system are affected by a change of the interparticle-potential core from hard to increasingly soft. In this manner we bridge the gap between the behaviors of two species of bosons: Helium-like atoms, which self-assemble into ordinary crystalline solids, and Rydberg-dressed atoms, which in simulation form cluster (super)solids. We also vary the particle mass, i.e., the quantumness of the system, so as to modify the relative stability of ``solid'' and fluid states. We thus find a whole spectrum of (finite-size) phases with a curved structure, including multilayer and cluster phases, as well as superfluids and single layer supersolids. In particular, we confirm that supersolids only occur in the presence of clusters. By considering three system sizes (from 60 to 180 particles), but rescaling the trap radius so that the density stays fixed, we verify that supersolid states only exist in the same range of particle masses. Our model serves as a platform to test how emergent properties are modified, in spherical geometry, in the crossover from atoms to dressed atoms.

articles.title: Suppressing Majorana Hybridization in Atomically Assembled Cr Chains on Bi2Pd
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29446v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetic-atom chains on superconductors can host Majorana zero modes, but in finite chains the two end modes generally hibridize and split away from zero energy. We show that Cr chains assembled atom-by-atom on the Bi-terminated surface of Bi2Pd enter a short-localization-length Shiba chain regime wthat strongly suppreesses this finite-size hybridization. Scanning tunneling spectroscopy reveals a chaing-leght-driven closing and reopening of the in-gap spectrum, followed by zero-bias modes localized at the chains ends. Green-function calculations reproduce the evolution and show an exchange of electorn-holec haracter across the transition. From the residual splitting we extract a localization length of about three atomic sites, explaining the stability of the zero-energy modes in experimentally accessible chains.

articles.title: Room-temperature near-infrared optical readout of triplet spin states integrated in carbon nanotubes towards quantum sensing
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29447v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Optically addressable electron spin qubits that function at room temperature and under ambient conditions are essential for advancing quantum sensing. Solid state defect platforms offer robust spin-photon interfaces but lack precise defect positioning and electronic tunability. Molecular spin qubits enable bottom up chemical design yet suffer from limited photostability. Here, we introduce para-halophenyl (-Cl, -Br and -I) quantum defects in (6,5) single wall carbon nanotubes that trap triplet excitons with a spin-photon interface that is operable under ambient, room temperature conditions. These defects were shown to emit in the near infrared within the biological transparency window, and their placement on the nanotube surface provides nanoscale proximity to target environments. The deep optical traps formed by the defects yield exceptional photostability. Here, we demonstrate optical initialization and readout of these triplet states at room temperature, provide proof of principle sensing of paramagnetic molecules, and highlight potential for on chip detection.
