Together, these results establish SWCNT defects as a promising new platform for future quantum sensing.

articles.title: Chiral-Nematic Lattice Instability in Charge Density Wave of 1T-TiSe2
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29448v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chiral charge-density waves (CDWs) are a rare form of electronic order with handedness, enabling novel couplings among light, lattice, and topology in quantum materials. Yet the microscopic origin of chirality has remained elusive, even in the prototypical chiral CDW system 1T-TiSe2. Using ab initio calculations, we investigate the structural stability and electronic structure of competing CDW models in 1T-TiSe2. We show that a chiral monoclinic (C2) structure is stabilized by the cooperative condensation of multiple phonon modes and reproduces the chiral topography and energy gap observed experimentally. We further find an exceptionally soft potential landscape around this energy-minimized structure, along the direction that removes the remaining rotational symmetry, allowing the lattice to fluctuate through fully asymmetric configurations while its average structure remains chiral. This dynamical chiral CDWnaturally reconciles the chiral domains seen by time-averaged topographic probes with the complete loss of symmetry detected by bulk spectroscopy, and clarifies how chiral CDWs emerge from the interplay of lattice instability and fluctuation.

articles.title: Higher-order Angular Momentum Transport of Alteraxial Phonons in 2D Magnets
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29453v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The coupling between lattice vibrations and magnetic order in two-dimensional (2D) magnets gives rise to a variety of physical phenomena, among which magnetic effects of axial phonons carrying phonon angular momentum (PAM) have attracted considerable interest. However, a systematic classification of axial phonons in 2D magnets that covers their multipolar patterns and the resulting transport manifestations remains largely unexplored. Here, based on symmetry analysis, we classify all 2D magnetic point groups by their long-wavelength PAM wave patterns. Beyond the s-wave axial phonon, we identify alteraxial phonons with p-, d-, f-, g-, and i-wave multipolar textures, characterized by 1, 2, 3, 4, and 6 zero-PAM nodal lines, respectively. We then develop a theory of nonlinear PAM transport driven by a temperature gradient and derive two selection rules: a parity selection rule that determines whether the response occurs at even or odd orders, and an angular-harmonic selection rule that fixes the lowest allowed order for each wave pattern. The multipolar PAM patterns and selection rules are exemplified by two effective lattice models realizing f-wave and d-wave PAM patterns, respectivley. The angular dependence of the nonlinear PAM current reflects the underlying multipolar PAM texture, offering a signature for experiments. Our results establish a symmetry-guided framework for detecting and utilizing higher-order PAM textures in 2D magnets.

articles.title: Large anisotropic magnetoresistance in paramagnetic Fe-doped Ta4SiTe4
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29463v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large anisotropic magnetoresistance (AMR) usually relies on magnetic ordering, which fixes a preferred moment orientation and couples it to charge transport. Here, we demonstrate that pronounced AMR can instead arise from the anisotropic magnetic-field-induced polarization of dilute local moments in paramagnetic Fe-doped Ta4SiTe4, a quasi-one-dimensional van der Waals narrow-gap semiconductor. Magnetization measurements reveal Curie-like paramagnetism down to 2 K, with the c axis as the magnetic easy axis. The magnetization is described by an effective S = 1/2 model with an anisotropic g-factor ratio of g_c/g_ab = 1.43(1). With the electrical current applied along the c axis, the Fe-doped sample exhibits a large negative magnetoresistance for B//c and only a weak positive response for B//ab, whereas the undoped sample shows little magnetoresistance for either field orientation. The resulting AMR ratio reaches -33% at 8 K and 10 T and exhibits a nonmonotonic temperature dependence qualitatively captured by a minimal spin-disorder model. These results show that engineering the local environment of dilute magnetic ions provides a route to large paramagnetic AMR without long-range magnetic order, extending the materials design space for AMR beyond magnetically ordered systems.

articles.title: On thermal Hall effect in boson systems
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29482v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We theoretically discuss the thermal Hall effect (THE) in boson systems keeping in mind possible applications to magnetically ordered insulators with skyrmion lattice ground state. The magnon spectrum of such systems may undergo a topological transition upon the variation of magnetic field, and THE could be a tool to confirm this phenomenon. We rederive formulas, suitable for our purposes, and find expressions which have a different temperature dependence of THE as compared to previously reported results. Particularly, in presence of anomalous terms in magnon Hamiltonian the thermal Hall conductivity has a small but finite residual 1/T contribution. Such contribution may become sizable at very low temperatures and resembles Meissner effect in superconducting metals.

articles.title: Quantum Interference Enhanced Rectification in Mesoscopic Nanowires
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29484v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nanoscale nonreciprocal elements are needed to control signal flow in scalable quantum technologies, but existing nonreciprocal components are often bulky. Here, we show that a strongly nonreciprocal current-voltage relation can arise entirely from coherent elastic scattering in a mesoscopic Rashba nanowire with gate-defined scatterers. We first identify the symmetry constraints that enforce reciprocal transmission in a phase coherent conductor even when inversion and time-reversal symmetry are broken. We then show how gates that are capacitively coupled to the leads, together with a magnetic scatterer or transverse subband mixing, can remove these constraints. In the weak-scattering regime, nonreciprocal conductance originates from interference between distinct backscattering paths. In the strong-scattering regime, nonreciprocity can be resonantly enhanced by the hybridization of the transmitting channel with bound states that arise from a higher transverse subband or spin-split band. In this regime, we find that a bias-induced change in the gate potentials of about one percent can produce an order-unity diode response, i.e., electrons are transmitted almost as in a clean wire for one bias polarity, whereas for the other polarity the current is strongly suppressed.

articles.title: Splitting Probability in Monitored Quantum Dynamics
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29547v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We consider a continuous-time quantum walk stroboscopically subjected to projective measurements on two distinct targets with sampling time period τ. We construct a general renewal framework for the first-detection amplitude at each target, from which we obtain the associated splitting probabilities. For Hamiltonians with reflection symmetry, we further show that each dual-target first-detection amplitude can be viewed as an interference effect between a pair of single-target first-detection amplitudes. This formulation yields exact expressions for the splitting probabilities and gives special sampling times at which they undergo pointwise discontinuous jumps due to a form of ergodicity breaking associated with dark states. As an illustrative example, we apply the framework to a one-dimensional tight-binding lattice chain with nearest-neighbor hopping, and study the splitting probabilities as functions of the initial position and sampling time. Below a critical sampling time, 0<τ < τ_c where τ_c = 2 π / Δ E with Δ E being the energy bandwidth, the splitting probabilities for large system sizes become equal to 1/2, independent of the initial position, as long as this position does not coincide with target sites. Above the critical sampling time, τ ≥ τ_c, the splitting probabilities deviate from 1/2 and develop oscillations as a function of initial position. The wavenumber associated with these oscillations is Q=2sin⁻¹(rτ_c/τ), where r is a positive integer. We also explore the effects of relative phase and spatial separation between different components of a coherent initial state on the splitting probabilities. Finally, we study how a finite number of measurements modifies the splitting probabilities and broadens the resonances at special sampling times.

articles.title: Perpendicular Magnetization from Crystallite Boundaries in Polycrystalline Antiferromagnetic γ-FeMn
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29614v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Single-crystalline noncollinear antiferromagnets, such as Mn₃Sn, are actively explored as memory media, but they generally require high-temperature growth that is incompatible with industrial-scale device fabrication. Here, we show that polycrystalline films of antiferromagnetic γ-FeMn, grown at room temperature, develop a perpendicular magnetization and an anomalous Hall effect, opening an industrially compatible route to antiferromagnetic memory. While conventional noncollinear antiferromagnets demand near-perfect crystal order, γ-FeMn films derive their memory-enabling properties from crystal defects, particularly boundaries separating nanoscale crystallites. When the crystallite size D falls below approx 30 nm, a field-switchable magnetization emerges and increases with the boundary density propto 1/D. This magnetization is accompanied by a room-temperature anomalous Hall conductivity exceeding 10 S/cm, comparable to that of single-crystalline Mn₃Sn. Our systematic experimental results, including scanning magnetometry, indicate uncompensated spin moments in the boundaries coupled to the compensated antiferromagnetism within the crystallites. We further find that the perpendicular easy axis of the magnetization is stabilized by residual strain within the γ-FeMn film. Our findings in manufacturing-friendly polycrystalline γ-FeMn redefine crystal defects as enablers, rather than impediments, for scalable antiferromagnetic memory.

articles.title: Symmetry-Based Parameter Efficient Low-Rank Fine-Tuning for High-Throughput Calculation of Lattice Thermal Conductivity
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29634v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate and efficient prediction of lattice thermal conductivity (LTC) is essential for developing materials for thermoelectric, microelectronic, and photovoltaic applications. Here, we present a methodology for high-throughput calculation of LTC across large datasets of compounds sharing a common crystal symmetry. Our approach combines fine-tuning of the MatterSim 1M universal machine-learned interatomic potential with LTC calculations based on the solution of the Boltzmann transport equation. We introduce a symmetry-based few-shot fine-tuning strategy (SBFS-FT) based on low-rank adaptation. In this approach, MatterSim 1M is fine-tuned on a small, carefully selected set of compounds that share a common crystal symmetry. The resulting potential is then applicable for accurate LTC calculations for compounds with this crystal symmetry, even if they were not included in the fine-tuning set. We tested our methodology on datasets of half-Heusler compounds (space group 216), materials with space group 225, and spinels (space group 227). We demonstrated that LTC calculations with MatterSim 1M fine-tuned using SBFS-FT exhibited a mean absolute relative difference from the reference results (obtained using moment tensor potentials and polyMLPs) 2-3 times smaller than that achieved with the non-fine-tuned MatterSim 1M potential. Moreover, the accuracy of LTC calculations with MatterSim 1M after SBFS-FT was comparable to that achieved using the MatterSim 1M potentials individually fine-tuned for each compound. Importantly, SBFS-FT enabled generation of the potential suitable for accurate LTC calculations across large compound datasets substantially faster than fine-tuning of MatterSim 1M for each compound individually, reducing the computational time by approximately a factor of 5-7 for a dataset of 100 compounds.

articles.title: Confirmation of complex non-collinear Fe(II) spin ordering in the iron oxychalcogenide La₂O₂Fe₂OSe₂ by broad range ¹³⁹La-NQR
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29635v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The transition metal oxychalcogenide La₂O₂Fe₂OSe₂ exhibits a non-collinear spin-ice like antiferromagnetic ordering below T_N approx  90 K due to complex magnetic exchange interactions and axial single-ion anisotropy of Fe²⁺ spins. The magnetic structure was deduced/determined from combined ⁵⁷Fe Mössbauer spectroscopy and ¹³⁹La-NMR on polycrystalline specimen. In this work, we present zero-field ¹³⁹La-NQR investigations on polycrystalline La₂O₂Fe₂OSe₂ in a broad frequency and temperature range between 2.8 - 20 MHz and 4.2 - 100 K. The measured resonances at ν_Q, 2 , ν_Q, and 3 , ν_Q are fully consistent with the previous NMR studies and also with the magnetic structure. A substantial modification of the electric field gradient at the La-position below T_N is inconsistent with the current investigations.

articles.title: Effect of Annealing on Maze Domains in Topological Insulator - Magnetic Multilayer Heterostructures
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29694v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Combining topological insulators with chiral magnetic multilayers offers the opportunity to greatly enhance the spin-orbit torque (SOT) driven manipulation of hosted spin textures, however this also exposes devices to the often poor temperature stability of the commonly used, Bi₂X₃-based (X is a chalcogenic element), topological insulator films. In this work we demonstrate through in-situ-annealing and polarised neutron reflectometry that the multilayer at a Bi₂Se₃ interface remains magnetically robust up to a temperature of 350 cⁱrcC: even as the Bi₂Se₃ epilayer structurally deteriorates. Through x-ray photoemission electron microscopy, an intermediate annealing temperature of sim 200 cⁱrcC was found to improve the domain ordering of the multilayer, allowing for field-induced skyrmion nucleation, all whilst sustaining minimal damage to the topological insulator

articles.title: Hydrodynamics of microalgae in sea spray
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29719v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Airborne transmission of biological matter is likely to cause numerous respiratory distress in coastal populations during certain harmful algal blooms. While we know that dissolved algal toxins aerosolize, the contribution of particle-associated toxins is still unknown. The observation of microalgae in the atmosphere suggests that cells or cell debris could be a carrier. Exchange of particulate matter between ocean and atmosphere is driven by sea spray: microplastics and bacteria aerosolize in jet droplets, following the bursting of air bubbles. However, current models for particle capture only consider surface effects, which fail to explain how large microalgal cells (5-50 um) can be entrapped in jet drops (100-800 um). Here, we demonstrate with a variety of species that microalgae are consistently captured in jet drops, and derive a new particle capture model based on the hydrodynamics of the jet. Using the enrichment factor, which measures the increase in concentration in the first jet drop relative to the bulk, we uncover two regimes. The transition between regimes strongly depends on cell size. In addition, we highlight the dynamics of particles within the jet and derive an enrichment model based on hydrodynamics rather than surface considerations. This work widens and generalizes established results on bacterial and microplastic entrapment in jet drops, resolving discrepancies found in the literature. Finally, we demonstrate that sea spray can aerosolize toxic Ostreopsis cf. ovata cells. This reveals a potential particulate pathway for airborne toxicity during harmful algal blooms and raises the question of the relative contribution of particles to that of dissolved toxins.

articles.title: Intertwined complex orbital order and ferrimagnetism in honeycomb molybdate Fe₂Mo₃O₈
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29729v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Motivated by the recent experimental interest in honeycomb molybdates A₂Mo₃O₈, we return and develop the minimal models to capture the essential physics for Fe₂Mo₃O₈. It is pointed out that, the magnetism in these materials arises from the mutual induction between the spin-orbit coupling of the tetrahedral sublattice with active orbitals and the superexchange with the spins from the octahedral sublattice. Essentially, the superexchange between the tetrahedral and octahedral sublattices directly drives the ferrimagnetism, and the residual spin-orbit coupling on the tetrahedral sublattice induces the complex orbital order. The hybrid magnon-phonon excitations are further explored together with their resulting Berry curvatures and thermal Hall effect. We discuss the experimental relevance with Fe₂Mo₃O₈, and the framework can be extended to FeNiMo₃O₈, Ni₂Mo₃O₈ and other isostructural magnets.

articles.title: Framework to identify defect-insensitive electron transport in topological semimetals
articles.title_zh: 识别拓扑半金属中缺陷不敏感电子传输的框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29848v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Topological semimetals are of increasing interest to replace conventional metals for interconnects in future semiconductor chips, due to their potential to exhibit decreasing resistivity with reducing wire dimensions and a lower sensitivity to electron scattering at defects. First-principles evaluation of promising topological semimetals for interconnects typically employ non-equilibrium Green's functions (NEGF) techniques to estimate defect scattering, but such calculations for specific defect geometries are difficult to systematize and compare between disparate materials. Here, we develop an NEGF-based approach to systematically and rapidly evaluate the defect sensitivity of electron transport in materials without depending on material-specific defect geometries. Specifically, we analyze the eigen-spectrum of the transmission matrix for an incoherent ensemble of all-possible single-atom vacancy defects, which clearly reveals eigenvalues close to 1 for defect-insensitive transport modes. Applied to the leading candidates, we show that this robustness to defect scattering is extremely sensitive to surface orientation and Fermi level for each material. We find nearly-perfect insensitivity to defects only for wavevectors with single transport modes within specific Fermi level ranges in CoSi(001) and PtAl(001). Importantly, we also find high insensitivity for certain non-isolated modes in NbAs that emerge specifically due to spin-orbit coupling; these modes could not be identified previously as they were buried in the total transmission. These non-isolated modes have been buried in previous studies of total transmission, and can now be directly compared to other materials due to our standardization of defect-creation. This technique improves the state-of-the-art NEGF method and enables unbiased evaluation of future topological semimetal candidates for nanoscale interconnects.
articles.abstract_zh: 拓扑半金属在未来半导体芯片中替代传统金属互连的兴趣日益浓厚，因为它们有可能随着导线尺寸的减小而表现出电阻率降低的潜力，并且对缺陷处的电子散射具有较低的敏感性。对用于互连的有前途的拓扑半金属的第一性原理评估通常采用非平衡格林函数（NEGF）技术来估计缺陷散射，但这种针对特定缺陷几何形状的计算很难系统化并在不同材料之间进行比较。在这里，我们开发了一种基于 NEGF 的方法，可以系统、快速地评估材料中电子传输的缺陷敏感性，而不依赖于材料特定的缺陷几何形状。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 拓扑半金属在未来半导体芯片中替代传统金属互连的兴趣日益浓厚，因为它们有可能随着导线尺寸的减小而表现出电阻率降低的潜力，并且对缺陷处的电子散射具有较低的敏感性。对用于互连的有前途的拓扑半金属的第一性原理评估通常采用非平衡格林函数（NEGF）技术来估计缺陷散射，但这种针对特定缺陷几何形状的计算很难系统化并在不同材料之间进行比较。在这里，我们开发了一种基于 NEGF 的方法，可以系统、快速地评估材料中电子传输的缺陷敏感性，而不依赖于材料特定的缺陷几何形状。具体来说，我们分析了所有可能的单原子空位缺陷的不相干系综的传输矩阵的特征谱，这清楚地揭示了缺陷不敏感传输模式的特征值接近 1。应用于主要候选材料，我们表明这种对缺陷散射的鲁棒性对每种材料的表面取向和费米能级极其敏感。我们发现，CoSi(001) 和 PtAl(001) 中特定费米能级范围内的单一传输模式波矢对缺陷几乎完全不敏感。重要的是，我们还发现 NbAs 中某些非孤立模式具有高度不敏感性，这些模式是由于自旋轨道耦合而出现的。这些模式以前无法识别，因为它们隐藏在总传输中。这些非隔离模式已被隐藏在之前的总传输研究中，由于我们对缺陷产生的标准化，现在可以直接与其他材料进行比较。该技术改进了最先进的 NEGF 方法，并能够对未来纳米级互连的拓扑半金属候选物进行公正的评估。

articles.title: Robust Anomalous Hall Effect in Epitaxial Cubic D0₃-Fe₃Ge Nanoplates Grown by Chemical Vapor Deposition
articles.title_zh: 化学气相沉积生长的外延立方 D0₃-Fe₃Ge 纳米板中的鲁棒反常霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29858v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The iron-based ferromagnetic materials have emerged as a promising system for spintronics due to their high Curie temperatures and significant anomalous Hall effect (AHE) driven by Berry curvature. While there have been investigations into the epitaxial growth of non-layered iron-based ferromagnetic materials, the realization of high-quality single crystal thin films continues to be a formidable obstacle. Meanwhile, the issues such as grain boundary scattering further hinder their characterization and application. Here, we report the first chemical vapor deposition (CVD) synthesis of single-crystalline cubic D0₃-Fe₃Ge nanoplates. This compound represents a substantial departure from the conventional hexagonal phases typically observed in the Fe-Ge system. Structural characterizations confirm the cubic lattice and stoichiometric purity of the crystals. Structural analysis identifies a strong epitaxial effect, resulting in a giant compressive strain of ~4.16% at the interface that relaxes gradually toward the surface. The second-harmonic generation (SHG) signals might further reveal that such interfacial strain disrupted the inherent centro-symmetry of the cubic phase. SQUID magnetometry shows robust room-temperature ferromagnetism and clear magnetic anisotropy. Magneto-transport measurements reveal a robust AHE that remains stable at temperatures far exceeding room temperature. The scaling observed between the anomalous Hall resistance and longitudinal resistance strongly suggests that this effect is dominated by the intrinsic Berry curvature mechanism. Furthermore, density functional theory (DFT) calculations reveal that the huge epitaxial strain induces band reconstructions and creates dense spin-orbit coupling gaps near the Fermi level, effectively doubling the anomalous Hall conductivity to match our experimental observations.
articles.abstract_zh: 铁基铁磁材料由于其高居里温度和由贝里曲率驱动的显着反常霍尔效应（AHE）而成为自旋电子学的有前途的系统。尽管人们对非层状铁基铁磁材料的外延生长进行了研究，但高质量单晶薄膜的实现仍然是一个巨大的障碍。同时，晶界散射等问题进一步阻碍了它们的表征和应用。在这里，我们报告了单晶立方 D0₃-Fe₃Ge 纳米板的首次化学气相沉积 (CVD) 合成。这种化合物与 Fe-Ge 系统中通常观察到的传统六方相有很大不同。结构表征证实了晶体的立方晶格和化学计量纯度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 铁基铁磁材料由于其高居里温度和由贝里曲率驱动的显着反常霍尔效应（AHE）而成为自旋电子学的有前途的系统。尽管人们对非层状铁基铁磁材料的外延生长进行了研究，但高质量单晶薄膜的实现仍然是一个巨大的障碍。同时，晶界散射等问题进一步阻碍了它们的表征和应用。在这里，我们报告了单晶立方 D0₃-Fe₃Ge 纳米板的首次化学气相沉积 (CVD) 合成。这种化合物与 Fe-Ge 系统中通常观察到的传统六方相有很大不同。结构表征证实了晶体的立方晶格和化学计量纯度。结构分析发现了强烈的外延效应，导致界面处产生约 4.16% 的巨大压缩应变，并逐渐向表面松弛。二次谐波产生（SHG）信号可能进一步揭示这种界面应变破坏了立方相固有的中心对称性。 SQUID 磁力测量显示出强大的室温铁磁性和明显的磁各向异性。磁输运测量揭示了强大的 AHE，在远超过室温的温度下仍保持稳定。在反常霍尔电阻和纵向电阻之间观察到的缩放强烈表明这种效应是由固有的贝里曲率机制主导的。此外，密度泛函理论（DFT）计算表明，巨大的外延应变会引起能带重建，并在费米能级附近产生密集的自旋轨道耦合间隙，有效地使反常霍尔电导率加倍，以匹配我们的实验观察结果。

articles.title: From Traveling Waves to Synthetic Gauge Fields: A Field-Free Route to Superconducting Diode Effect
articles.title_zh: 从行波到合成规范场：超导二极管效应的无场途径
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29865v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The superconducting diode effect requires the forward and reverse bias currents to differ, a scenario achieved via inversion and time-reversal symmetries broken together. The latter, and the more crucial one, is inevitably achieved by a magnetic field. Here, we show that a spatio-temporally driven chemical potential of the form, μⱼ(t)=μ+Vcos(ω t+kd j), achieves both at once. Applied to a helical Shiba chain, the drive transmutes a traveling Peierls phase via generating an odd-in-momentum term, equivalent to an imaginary next-nearest-neighbour Haldane-like hopping in real space. Remarkably, the protocol is spin-blind, which renders the time-reversal breaking via a synthetic gauge flux rather than an effective Zeeman field. The rectification is odd in the drive wavevector, with exact zeros at kd=nπ and an analytical optimum at kd=2π/3. It is however, even in the exchange coupling, J and persists even at J=0. Furthermore, the rectification scales inversely with the pair-breaking gap, yielding approximately 50% rectification in the topological phase and 10% in the trivial phase. Symmetry breaking is thus drive-controlled, allowing it to be switched on, tuned, and reversed without an external magnetic field.
articles.abstract_zh: 超导二极管效应要求正向和反向偏置电流不同，这是通过反转和时间反转对称性一起破坏来实现的情况。后者，也是更重要的一个，不可避免地要通过磁场来实现。在这里，我们证明了时空驱动的化学势 μⱼ(t)=μ+Vcos(ω t+kd j) 形式可以同时实现这两个目标。应用于螺旋柴犬链时，该驱动器通过生成奇数动量项来转变行进的 Peierls 相位，相当于真实空间中想象的次近邻 Haldane 式跳跃。值得注意的是，该协议是自旋盲的，它通过合成规范通量而不是有效的塞曼场来实现时间反转破坏。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 超导二极管效应要求正向和反向偏置电流不同，这是通过反转和时间反转对称性一起破坏来实现的情况。后者，也是更重要的一个，不可避免地要通过磁场来实现。在这里，我们证明了时空驱动的化学势 μⱼ(t)=μ+Vcos(ω t+kd j) 形式可以同时实现这两个目标。应用于螺旋柴犬链时，该驱动器通过生成奇数动量项来转变行进的 Peierls 相位，相当于真实空间中想象的次近邻 Haldane 式跳跃。值得注意的是，该协议是自旋盲的，它通过合成规范通量而不是有效的塞曼场来实现时间反转破坏。驱动波矢量中的整流是奇数，在 kd=nπ 处精确为零，在 kd=2π/3 处具有分析最佳值。然而，即使在交换耦合中，J 和 甚至在 J=0 时仍然存在。此外，校正与断对间隙成反比，在拓扑阶段产生约 50% 的校正，在平凡阶段产生约 10% 的校正。因此，对称性破缺是由驱动控制的，无需外部磁场即可开启、调谐和反转。

articles.title: Automated Materials Data and Knowledge Extraction using Machine Learning and Large Language Models
articles.title_zh: 使用机器学习和大型语言模型自动提取材料数据和知识
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29895v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Over the past decade, substantial efforts have been devoted to developing machine learning (ML) methods for extracting materials data and, where possible, materials knowledge directly from the scientific literature. This review traces the evolution of these methods from heuristic, rule-based pipelines through natural language processing (NLP) models and transformer-based encoders to, lastly, large language models (LLMs) and agentic systems capable of extracting materials information across multiple modalities, including text, tables, and figures. Beside construction of large, queryable materials databases and knowledge graphs that support downstream materials discovery, we discuss how these advances have enabled new capabilities, such as, generic question answering across materials science, AI co-scientists and chatbots for research assistance, and closed-loop optimization and discovery when integrated with autonomous laboratories. We critically assess the datasets generated using these approaches, their extraction accuracy and computational costs, and the respective strengths and limitations of different methodologies, and even provide practical guidelines for developing more reliable and scalable materials data extraction pipelines. Finally, we identify key open challenges, including the extraction of full materials structure-property-processing-performance tetrahedron at the sample level, the scarcity of reliable benchmark datasets for systematic evaluation, and the resolution of non-standard materials terminology across different document modalities.
articles.abstract_zh: 在过去的十年中，人们致力于开发机器学习 (ML) 方法，以直接从科学文献中提取材料数据（如果可能）和材料知识。本综述追溯了这些方法的演变，从启发式、基于规则的管道，到自然语言处理 (NLP) 模型和基于转换器的编码器，最后到大型语言模型 (LLM) 和能够跨多种模式（包括文本、表格和图形）提取材料信息的代理系统。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在过去的十年中，人们致力于开发机器学习 (ML) 方法，以直接从科学文献中提取材料数据（如果可能）和材料知识。本综述追溯了这些方法的演变，从启发式、基于规则的管道，到自然语言处理 (NLP) 模型和基于转换器的编码器，最后到大型语言模型 (LLM) 和能够跨多种模式（包括文本、表格和图形）提取材料信息的代理系统。除了构建支持下游材料发现的大型可查询材料数据库和知识图之外，我们还讨论了这些进步如何实现新功能，例如跨材料科学的通用问答、用于研究协助的人工智能联合科学家和聊天机器人，以及与自主实验室集成时的闭环优化和发现。我们严格评估使用这些方法生成的数据集、它们的提取精度和计算成本，以及不同方法各自的优点和局限性，甚至为开发更可靠和可扩展的材料数据提取管道提供实用指南。最后，我们确定了关键的开放挑战，包括在样本水平上提取完整的材料结构-性能-加工-性能四面体、缺乏用于系统评估的可靠基准数据集，以及跨不同文档模式的非标准材料术语的解决。

articles.title: Stabilizing and detecting electron fractionalization in the Hofstadter-Hubbard model
articles.title_zh: 稳定和检测 Hofstadter-Hubbard 模型中的电子分裂
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29916v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Motivated by the recent progress in correlated Chern insulator physics in moiré systems, we investigate the half-filled triangular-lattice Hofstadter--Hubbard model and its electron fractionalization. Among various competing non-magnetic states, increasing the orbital flux stabilizes and broadens the U(1)₂ chiral spin liquid phase in the Mott regime. In this exotic regime, the electron is fractionalized into gapped spinons and gapped chargons, whose effective bands are linked to the orbital flux. The convolution of the narrow spinon bands with the gapped chargon excitations produces rich and discernible structures in the electron spectral function and the density of states. These results not only identify the orbital flux as a control parameter for the detailed patterns of electron fractionalization and the nature of the Mott transition, but also provide the key spectral characteristics for the angle-resolved photoemission and scanning tunneling studies of the relevant systems, linking the free-particle band topology to intrinsic topological order in the correlated regime.
articles.abstract_zh: 受莫尔系统中相关陈绝缘体物理最新进展的推动，我们研究了半填充三角晶格 Hofstadter-Hubbard 模型及其电子分裂。在各种竞争的非磁性状态中，增加轨道通量可以稳定并拓宽莫特体系中的 U(1)2 手性自旋液相。在这种奇异的状态下，电子被分成有隙自旋子和有隙电荷，其有效能带与轨道通量相关。窄自旋子带与带隙电荷激发的卷积在电子谱函数和态密度中产生丰富且可辨别的结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 受莫尔系统中相关陈绝缘体物理最新进展的推动，我们研究了半填充三角晶格 Hofstadter-Hubbard 模型及其电子分裂。在各种竞争的非磁性状态中，增加轨道通量可以稳定并拓宽莫特体系中的 U(1)2 手性自旋液相。在这种奇异的状态下，电子被分成有隙自旋子和有隙电荷，其有效能带与轨道通量相关。窄自旋子带与带隙电荷激发的卷积在电子谱函数和态密度中产生丰富且可辨别的结构。这些结果不仅将轨道通量确定为电子分裂详细模式和莫特跃迁性质的控制参数，而且还为相关系统的角分辨光发射和扫描隧道研究提供了关键的光谱特征，将自由粒子能带拓扑与相关区域中的固有拓扑顺序联系起来。

articles.title: Electronic, structural and magnetic properties of goldene nanoribbons
articles.title_zh: 金色纳米带的电子、结构和磁性特性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30010v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recently, two-dimensional goldene, a single-atomic-layer gold sheet, has been experimentally realized and is expected to be a promising material for next-generation devices, offering new possibilities beyond three-dimensional bulk gold. Because quasi-one-dimensional derivatives can exhibit properties markedly different from their two-dimensional counterparts, we investigate the stability, electronic, and magnetic properties of goldene-based nanoribbons (GOLDNRs) using first-principles computational methods. Our findings demonstrate that the electronic structure of these nanoribbons depends strongly on both edge chirality and ribbon width. Depending on the boundary configuration, the systems can exhibit semiconducting behavior with electronic band gaps of approximately 0.77 eV and 0.04 eV, or retain metallic characteristics. Additionally, the edge regions act as electronically active sites that may significantly enhance chemical reactivity relative to the central regions. As the ribbon width increases, the metallic characteristics of the infinite goldene sheet are progressively recovered, while the influence of quantum confinement and edge effects on the central region diminishes. These results provide important insights into tailoring the physical properties of goldene through lateral confinement, highlighting its potential for applications in nanoscale field-effect transistors, spintronic devices, and catalysis.
articles.abstract_zh: 最近，二维金（一种单原子层金片）已通过实验实现，有望成为下一代器件的有前途的材料，提供超越三维块状金的新可能性。由于准一维导数可以表现出与其二维对应物明显不同的特性，因此我们使用第一原理计算方法研究了金基纳米带（GOLDNR）的稳定性、电子和磁性。我们的研究结果表明，这些纳米带的电子结构强烈依赖于边缘手性和带宽度。根据边界配置，系统可以表现出电子带隙约为 0.77 eV 和 0.04 eV 的半导体行为，或保留金属特性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 最近，二维金（一种单原子层金片）已通过实验实现，有望成为下一代器件的有前途的材料，提供超越三维块状金的新可能性。由于准一维导数可以表现出与其二维对应物明显不同的特性，因此我们使用第一原理计算方法研究了金基纳米带（GOLDNR）的稳定性、电子和磁性。我们的研究结果表明，这些纳米带的电子结构强烈依赖于边缘手性和带宽度。根据边界配置，系统可以表现出电子带隙约为 0.77 eV 和 0.04 eV 的半导体行为，或保留金属特性。另外，边缘区域充当电子活性位点，相对于中心区域可以显着增强化学反应性。随着带宽度的增加，无限金色片的金属特性逐渐恢复，而量子限制和边缘效应对中心区域的影响逐渐减弱。这些结果为通过横向限制调整goldene的物理性质提供了重要的见解，突出了其在纳米级场效应晶体管、自旋电子器件和催化方面的应用潜力。

articles.title: Liouvillian Non-Invertible Symmetry
articles.title_zh: 刘维尔不可逆对称性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23111v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Non-invertible symmetries extend conventional symmetries beyond group-like transformations and play an important role in quantum field theory and many-body physics. However, a general framework of non-invertible symmetries in open quantum systems is still lacking. Here, we formulate a general Liouville-space duality framework that extends Hilbert-space non-invertible dualities to open quantum systems. The resulting defect relates Liouvillians with dual Hamiltonian and dissipative parameters and becomes an exact symmetry at self-duality. We apply this framework to the periodic transverse-field Ising chain with two collective Lindblad channels exchanged by Kramers--Wannier (KW) duality. A strong Z₂ symmetry divides Liouville space into four parity sectors, while the defect acts nontrivially only in the even-even sector. At self-duality, the KW defect imposes a momentum-resolved selection rule on Liouvillian Jordan blocks. Modes with different Liouville momenta or KW-defect eigenvalues cannot form a common exceptional Jordan block. For a three-site chain, a global Rényi-2 KW asymmetry dynamically identifies the self-dual conditions. At the same time, the spectral structure exhibits both a semisimple degeneracy and a self-dual exceptional point with a perturbation-selective response. These results extend non-invertible dualities to Markovian quantum dynamics and establish a symmetry-based selection rule for Liouvillian Jordan structures.
articles.abstract_zh: 不可逆对称性将传统对称性扩展到类群变换之外，并在量子场论和多体物理学中发挥着重要作用。然而，开放量子系统中不可逆对称性的通用框架仍然缺乏。在这里，我们制定了一个通用的刘维尔空间对偶框架，将希尔伯特空间不可逆对偶性扩展到开放量子系统。由此产生的缺陷将刘维尔方程与对偶哈密顿量和耗散参数联系起来，并成为自对偶性的精确对称性。我们将此框架应用于周期性横向场伊辛链，该链具有由克莱默斯-万尼尔（KW）对偶性交换的两个集体 Lindblad 通道。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 不可逆对称性将传统对称性扩展到类群变换之外，并在量子场论和多体物理学中发挥着重要作用。然而，开放量子系统中不可逆对称性的通用框架仍然缺乏。在这里，我们制定了一个通用的刘维尔空间对偶框架，将希尔伯特空间不可逆对偶性扩展到开放量子系统。由此产生的缺陷将刘维尔方程与对偶哈密顿量和耗散参数联系起来，并成为自对偶性的精确对称性。我们将此框架应用于周期性横向场伊辛链，该链具有由克莱默斯-万尼尔（KW）对偶性交换的两个集体 Lindblad 通道。强 Z2 对称性将刘维尔空间分为四个宇称扇区，而缺陷仅在偶偶扇区中发挥作用。在自对偶性中，KW 缺陷对刘维尔乔丹块施加了动量解决的选择规则。具有不同刘维尔动量或 KW 缺陷特征值的模态不能形成共同的异常乔丹块。对于三站点链，全局 Rényi-2 KW 不对称性动态识别自对偶条件。同时，谱结构表现出半简单简并性和具有微扰选择性响应的自对偶例外点。这些结果将不可逆对偶性扩展到马尔可夫量子动力学，并为刘维尔乔丹结构建立了基于对称性的选择规则。

articles.title: Tunable flat bands from a parent chiral Hamiltonian
articles.title_zh: 来自父手性哈密顿量的可调平带
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28848v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Systems with flat bands are interesting as they potentially host many exotic quantum phenomena that would be hard to observe in usual systems with dispersive bands. Multiple approaches were developed to construct flat band systems, with most of them requiring fine-tuning and/or solving a challenging inverse-eigenvalue problem. In this article we work with an idea that uses a parent bipartite system to generate a family of flat bands by means of Hilbert space projections. This method is largely free from fine-tuning constraints and allows us to identify conditions for a Hamiltonian to guarantee flat bands at desired energies, with desired degree of degeneracy. We also show that one can control the touching points of the flat band with dispersive bands at any desirable point in the Brillouin zone. In the process, we identify perturbations that preserve the flat bands or split them controllably. This approach provides easy tunability in designing flat band systems with desired properties.
articles.abstract_zh: 具有平带的系统很有趣，因为它们可能存在许多奇异的量子现象，而这些现象在具有色散带的普通系统中很难观察到。人们开发了多种方法来构建平带系统，其中大多数需要微调和/或解决具有挑战性的反特征值问题。在本文中，我们的想法是使用父二分系统通过希尔伯特空间投影生成一系列平带。这种方法在很大程度上不受微调约束的影响，使我们能够确定哈密顿量的条件，以保证在所需能量和所需简并度下实现平带。我们还表明，可以在布里渊区的任何所需点控制平带与色散带的接触点。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 具有平带的系统很有趣，因为它们可能存在许多奇异的量子现象，而这些现象在具有色散带的普通系统中很难观察到。人们开发了多种方法来构建平带系统，其中大多数需要微调和/或解决具有挑战性的反特征值问题。在本文中，我们的想法是使用父二分系统通过希尔伯特空间投影生成一系列平带。这种方法在很大程度上不受微调约束的影响，使我们能够确定哈密顿量的条件，以保证在所需能量和所需简并度下实现平带。我们还表明，可以在布里渊区的任何所需点控制平带与色散带的接触点。在此过程中，我们确定了保留平坦带或可控地分裂平坦带的扰动。这种方法在设计具有所需特性的平带系统时提供了简单的可调性。

articles.title: Higher-Order Flatband-Touching Points Mediate Unconventional Bulk-Boundary Correspondence
articles.title_zh: 高阶平带接触点介导非常规体边界对应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29251v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The bulk-boundary correspondence establishes a fundamental connection between bulk band topology and the emergence of boundary states, underpinning topological phenomena across electronic, acoustic, photonic, and many other wave systems. A broad class of singular flatband systems, however, exhibits an unconventional form of bulk-boundary correspondence, in which robust boundary modes (RBMs) originate from flatband-touching points (FBTPs) and the real-space topology associated with incomplete sets of compact localized states (CLSs), rather than conventional momentum-space bulk topological invariants. To date, experimental studies of such boundary modes have been limited to systems hosting lower-order FBTPs. Here, we experimentally demonstrate unconventional bulk-boundary correspondence in a photonic cross-bedded Kagome-like lattice featuring a higher-order FBTP formed by the touching of two degenerate flatbands and a dispersive band. Using continuous-wave laser writing, we observe shape-preserving propagation of both bulk CLSs and boundary RBMs. Remarkably, unlike previously reported flatband systems, the RBMs retain their boundary localization under input-field perturbations involving both singular and nonsingular CLSs, revealing an unconventional boundary response associated with the higher-order FBTP in this lattice. Our results establish the Kagome-like lattice as a new platform for exploring flatband physics and unconventional bulk-boundary correspondence, with potential applications in wave localization, flatband lasers, and other emerging topological photonic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 体边界对应关系在体带拓扑和边界态的出现之间建立了基本联系，支撑了电子、声学、光子和许多其他波系统的拓扑现象。然而，一大类奇异平带系统表现出一种非常规形式的体边界对应，其中鲁棒边界模式（RBM）源自平带接触点（FBTP）和与不完整的紧凑局域态（CLS）集相关的实空间拓扑，而不是传统的动量空间体拓扑不变量。迄今为止，此类边界模式的实验研究仅限于托管低阶 FBTP 的系统。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 体边界对应关系在体带拓扑和边界态的出现之间建立了基本联系，支撑了电子、声学、光子和许多其他波系统的拓扑现象。然而，一大类奇异平带系统表现出一种非常规形式的体边界对应，其中鲁棒边界模式（RBM）源自平带接触点（FBTP）和与不完整的紧凑局域态（CLS）集相关的实空间拓扑，而不是传统的动量空间体拓扑不变量。迄今为止，此类边界模式的实验研究仅限于托管低阶 FBTP 的系统。在这里，我们通过实验证明了光子交叉层状 Kagome 晶格中的非常规体边界对应，该晶格具有由两个简并平带和色散带接触形成的高阶 FBTP。使用连续波激光写入，我们观察到体 CLS 和边界 RBM 的保形传播。值得注意的是，与之前报道的平带系统不同，RBM 在涉及奇异和非奇异 CLS 的输入场扰动下保留了其边界定位，揭示了与该晶格中高阶 FBTP 相关的非常规边界响应。我们的研究结果将类 Kagome 晶格建立为探索平带物理和非常规体边界对应的新平台，在波局域化、平带激光器和其他新兴拓扑光子器件中具有潜在应用。

articles.title: Boundary exceptional point driven chiral switch of topological edge states
articles.title_zh: 边界异常点驱动的拓扑边缘态手性开关
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29316v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We theoretically investigate the interplay of topology and localized non-Hermiticity in a finite Su-Schrieffer-Heeger chain characterized by non-Hermitian potentials at its boundaries. By tuning the boundary gain and loss parameters, we exploit the finite-size hybridization of two mid-gap topological edge states to analytically derive the exact coordinates of boundary-induced exceptional points (EPs), Γᵣₘ EP=± i vN/wN⁻¹, at which these states undergo coalescence. We demonstrate that dynamically encircling these boundary EPs facilitates a robust, chiral edge state-transfer protocol. Depending on the orientation of the encircling loop, this protocol allows a topological edge state localized at one boundary to be either transferred to the opposite edge with perfect fidelity or returned to its starting position through a double switching process. Importantly, since the non-Hermiticity remains strictly confined to the boundaries, this chiral transport occurs without affecting the energy spectrum of the bulk bands. These results establish a minimal framework for a large-scale topological chiral switch that is experimentally verifiable and capable of being controlled through boundary non-Hermitian driving.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们从理论上研究了有限 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger 链中拓扑和局域非厄米性的相互作用，其边界处具有非厄米势。通过调整边界增益和损耗参数，我们利用两个中带隙拓扑边缘态的有限尺寸混合来分析导出边界引起的异常点（EP）的精确坐标， еᵣₘ EP=± i vN/wN⁻1，在该坐标上这些态发生合并。我们证明，动态包围这些边界 EP 可以促进稳健的手性边缘状态转移协议。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们从理论上研究了有限 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger 链中拓扑和局域非厄米性的相互作用，其边界处具有非厄米势。通过调整边界增益和损耗参数，我们利用两个中带隙拓扑边缘态的有限尺寸混合来分析导出边界引起的异常点（EP）的精确坐标， еᵣₘ EP=± i vN/wN⁻1，在该坐标上这些态发生合并。我们证明，动态包围这些边界 EP 可以促进稳健的手性边缘状态转移协议。根据环绕环的方向，该协议允许位于一个边界的拓扑边缘状态以完美的保真度转移到相对的边缘，或者通过双切换过程返回到其起始位置。重要的是，由于非厄米性仍然严格限制在边界内，因此这种手性传输的发生不会影响体带的能谱。这些结果为大规模拓扑手性开关建立了一个最小框架，该框架可通过实验验证并能够通过边界非厄米驱动进行控制。

articles.title: Compositional neural networks for multimodal X-ray and neutron scattering inversion
articles.title_zh: 用于多模态 X 射线和中子散射反演的组合神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29362v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: X-ray and neutron scattering are indispensable for structural characterization across condensed-matter physics and materials science. Yet, because scattering experiments generally record intensities without phase information, distinct structures can yield similar scattering patterns, rendering the corresponding inverse problems non-unique. This ambiguity can be reduced by combining complementary measurements, but their integration into machine-learning frameworks remains challenging. Here we introduce a modular framework for probabilistic multi-measurement analysis based on prior-amortized flow matching. Single-observation posterior estimators are trained separately for individual observation types or physical probes and combined only at inference time through a compositional sampler. This late fusion approach allows pretrained single-observation models to be reused without dedicated joint retraining. As a case in point, we consider reflectometry, which provides depth-resolved, nanometer-scale information about thin films and interfaces. Our single-observation demonstrations span X-ray, time-of-flight neutron and polarized neutron reflectometry. In separate co-refinement studies, task-matched estimators enable homogeneous composition across multiple neutron contrasts and heterogeneous multimodal composition of X-ray and neutron measurements. Together, these results establish compositional flow matching as a modular approach to uncertainty-aware inversion and co-refinement, with potential applicability to other scattering problems in which multiple observations constrain a common physical structure while retaining measurement-specific parameters.
articles.abstract_zh: X 射线和中子散射对于凝聚态物理和材料科学的结构表征是不可或缺的。然而，由于散射实验通常记录没有相位信息的强度，不同的结构可以产生相似的散射图案，从而使得相应的反演问题不唯一。通过组合互补测量可以减少这种模糊性，但将它们集成到机器学习框架中仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们介绍一个基于先验摊销流量匹配的概率多测量分析的模块化框架。单观测后验估计器针对各个观测类型或物理探针单独进行训练，并仅在推理时通过组合采样器进行组合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: X 射线和中子散射对于凝聚态物理和材料科学的结构表征是不可或缺的。然而，由于散射实验通常记录没有相位信息的强度，不同的结构可以产生相似的散射图案，从而使得相应的反演问题不唯一。通过组合互补测量可以减少这种模糊性，但将它们集成到机器学习框架中仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们介绍一个基于先验摊销流量匹配的概率多测量分析的模块化框架。单观测后验估计器针对各个观测类型或物理探针单独进行训练，并仅在推理时通过组合采样器进行组合。这种后期融合方法允许重复使用预训练的单观察模型，而无需专门的联合再训练。作为一个恰当的例子，我们考虑反射测量法，它提供有关薄膜和界面的深度分辨纳米级信息。我们的单次观测演示涵盖 X 射线、飞行时间中子和偏振中子反射计。在单独的协同细化研究中，任务匹配的估计器可以实现跨多个中子对比的均匀成分以及 X 射线和中子测量的异构多模态成分。总之，这些结果将成分流匹配建立为不确定性感知反演和协同细化的模块化方法，并具有对其他散射问题的潜在适用性，在其他散射问题中，多个观测值约束共同的物理结构，同时保留特定于测量的参数。

articles.title: Hierarchical Response Theory of Electronegativity from Atomic Mean Inner Potential
articles.title_zh: 原子平均内势电负性的层次响应理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29765v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Electronegativity, introduced by Pauling nearly a century ago, remains chemistry's most widely used yet conceptually ambiguous quantity: is it a fixed atomic constant, or does it depend on chemical environment? We resolve this debate by recasting electronegativity as a continuous response function rooted in the Atomic Mean Inner Potential (AMIP), a quantum-mechanical observable accessible through first-principles calculation and, ultimately, electron holography. Expanding the AMIP with respect to fractional electron removal defines a hierarchy of physically distinct coefficients: the static electronegativity χ₀, the Electrostatic Rigidity R---whose sign indicates whether an atom hardens or softens upon oxidation---and the Electrostatic Anharmonic Modulus A. A logarithmic-derivative decomposition links these coefficients to two competing microscopic channels, electronic screening loss and geometric volume collapse, whose balance governs the response of all 102 elements. This competition produces a systematic dichotomy between softening main-group elements and hardening d-block elements, two scaling laws within the transition series (closed-shell stiffening and principal quantum softening), and two anomalies: a pronounced exchange-driven effect at half-filled d⁵ configurations and a near-perfect cancellation in Ce. It also resolves the long-standing Cs--Fr controversy, identifying Fr as a critical element whose near-boundary response is amplified fivefold by relativistic contraction of the 7s orbital. The framework reproduces the classical Allen, Pauling, and Mulliken scales as well as Lewis acidity trends, and makes three falsifiable experimental predictions. It transforms electronegativity from a lookup-table number into a predictive, hierarchically structured quantum descriptor.
articles.abstract_zh: 鲍林在近一个世纪前提出的电负性仍然是化学中使用最广泛但概念上模糊的量：它是一个固定的原子常数，还是取决于化学环境？我们通过将电负性重新定义为植根于原子平均内势（AMIP）的连续响应函数来解决这一争论，原子平均内势是一种可通过第一原理计算和最终电子全息术获得的量子力学可观测值。就分数电子去除而言，扩展 AMIP 定义了物理上不同系数的层次结构：静态电负性 χ₀、静电刚性 R（其符号表示原子在氧化时是否变硬或变软）以及静电非谐波模量 A。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 鲍林在近一个世纪前提出的电负性仍然是化学中使用最广泛但概念上模糊的量：它是一个固定的原子常数，还是取决于化学环境？我们通过将电负性重新定义为植根于原子平均内势（AMIP）的连续响应函数来解决这一争论，原子平均内势是一种可通过第一原理计算和最终电子全息术获得的量子力学可观测值。就分数电子去除而言，扩展 AMIP 定义了物理上不同系数的层次结构：静态电负性 χ₀、静电刚性 R（其符号表示原子在氧化时是否变硬或变软）以及静电非谐波模量 A。对数导数分解将这些系数与两个相互竞争的微观通道（电子屏蔽损耗和几何体积塌陷）联系起来，其平衡控制着所有 102 个元素的响应。这种竞争产生了软化主族元素和硬化 d 区元素之间的系统二分法、过渡级数内的两个标度定律（闭壳强化和主量子软化）以及两个异常：半填充 d⁵ 配置下的明显交换驱动效应和 Ce 中近乎完美的抵消。它还解决了长期存在的 Cs-Fr 争议，将 Fr 确定为一种关键元素，其近边界响应因 7s 轨道的相对论收缩而放大了五倍。该框架再现了经典的艾伦、鲍林和马利肯量表以及刘易斯酸度趋势，并做出了三个可证伪的实验预测。它将电负性从查找表数字转换为预测性的、分层结构的量子描述符。

articles.title: High-fidelity and robust controlled-Z gates for superconducting transmon qubits. I. Intrinsic errors and decoherence
articles.title_zh: 用于超导传输量子位的高保真且稳健的受控 Z 门。 I. 固有误差和退相干
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30056v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computing requires quantum gates that combine short duration, high fidelity, and robustness to noise. As quantum processors scale, robustness becomes increasingly important because exhaustive characterization and frequent recalibration of individual gates become impractical. We present a comprehensive optimal-control framework for controlled-Z (CZ) gates between directly coupled, frequency-tunable transmons that systematically accounts for intrinsic Hamiltonian errors and realistic decoherence mechanisms, including energy relaxation and dephasing. Using smooth, single-shot flux pulses, we obtain 12-ns CZ gates---close to the theoretical speed limit of 11.6 ns---with intrinsic errors suppressed to the 2×10⁻⁵ level. We construct dephasing noise models, calibrated against published experimental measurements, that capture fast dephasing from room-temperature control electronics and slow dephasing from 1/f flux noise. Using these models, we identify dephasing sweet spots that suppress sensitivity to dephasing noise. We further exploit transmon asymmetry as a design parameter to access distinct noise-resilient operating regimes. These results establish an experimentally applicable framework for balancing gate speed, fidelity, and noise robustness while reducing characterization and recalibration overhead.
articles.abstract_zh: 容错量子计算需要结合短持续时间、高保真度和抗噪声鲁棒性的量子门。随着量子处理器规模的扩大，鲁棒性变得越来越重要，因为对各个门进行详尽的表征和频繁的重新校准变得不切实际。我们提出了一个用于直接耦合、频率可调传输器之间的受控 Z (CZ) 门的综合最优控制框架，该框架系统地解释了固有的哈密顿误差和现实的退相干机制，包括能量弛豫和移相。使用平滑的单次磁通脉冲，我们获得了 12 ns CZ 门——接近 11.6 ns 的理论速度极限——内在误差被抑制到 2×10⁻⁵ 水平。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 容错量子计算需要结合短持续时间、高保真度和抗噪声鲁棒性的量子门。随着量子处理器规模的扩大，鲁棒性变得越来越重要，因为对各个门进行详尽的表征和频繁的重新校准变得不切实际。我们提出了一个用于直接耦合、频率可调传输器之间的受控 Z (CZ) 门的综合最优控制框架，该框架系统地解释了固有的哈密顿误差和现实的退相干机制，包括能量弛豫和移相。使用平滑的单次磁通脉冲，我们获得了 12 ns CZ 门——接近 11.6 ns 的理论速度极限——内在误差被抑制到 2×10⁻⁵ 水平。我们构建了移相噪声模型，根据已发表的实验测量值进行校准，捕获室温控制电子设备的快速移相和 1/f 磁通噪声的慢移相。使用这些模型，我们确定了抑制移相噪声敏感性的移相最佳点。我们进一步利用传输不对称性作为设计参数来访问不同的抗噪声操作机制。这些结果建立了一个实验适用的框架，用于平衡门速度、保真度和噪声鲁棒性，同时减少表征和重新校准开销。

articles.title: A linear, second-order, unconditionally energy-stable scalar-auxiliary-variable scheme for the CHQ viscoelastic phase-separation model
articles.title_zh: CHQ 粘弹性相分离模型的线性二阶无条件能量稳定标量辅助变量格式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30077v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The CHQ model describes viscoelastic phase separation in a polymer--solvent mixture: a Cahn--Hilliard equation for the polymer volume fraction φ is two-way coupled, through a phase-dependent cross-diffusion flux, to a damped relaxation equation for a scalar bulk elastic stress q. We propose a scalar-auxiliary-variable (SAV) time discretisation of this system, combining the SAV reformulation of the double-well potential with a second-order backward differentiation formula (BDF2) and a second-order extrapolation of all phase-dependent mobilities: a linear, computationally cheaper complement to the reference scheme's fully nonlinear Newton solve. The resulting method is (i) linear at every time step, with a coupling structure we prove has exactly one solution at every step, for every choice of time-step size; (ii) mass conserving, exactly, as an algebraic identity of the discrete equations themselves (the only drift ever seen numerically traces to the finite tolerance of the iterative linear solver, not a failure of the conservation property); and (iii) unconditionally stable for a modified discrete energy, via an exact one-step energy--dissipation identity. We show the energy identity extends to this filtered variant as well, with two explicit extra non-negative terms. Hence, the scheme actually producing the physics results is itself provably stable for the same energy. A Fourier--Galerkin implementation verifies that the energy identity holds at every time step to within floating-point round-off. It also confirms second-order temporal accuracy, including in the steep-interface regime, and agreement with an independently implemented nonlinear Newton--BDF2 solver. Compared with that independent nonlinear Newton--BDF2 solver, at equal grid resolution, the SAV method uses 2.5--3.0× fewer linear-solver iterations and 1.7--2.0× less wall-clock time.
articles.abstract_zh: CHQ 模型描述了聚合物-溶剂混合物中的粘弹性相分离：聚合物体积分数 φ 的 Cahn--Hilliard 方程通过与相相关的交叉扩散通量双向耦合到标量体弹性应力 q 的阻尼松弛方程。我们提出了该系统的标量辅助变量（SAV）时间离散化，将双阱势的 SAV 重构与二阶后向微分公式（BDF2）以及所有相位相关迁移率的二阶外推相结合：对参考方案的完全非线性牛顿解的线性、计算成本更低的补充。
articles.abstract_zh_full: CHQ 模型描述了聚合物-溶剂混合物中的粘弹性相分离：聚合物体积分数 φ 的 Cahn--Hilliard 方程通过与相相关的交叉扩散通量双向耦合到标量体弹性应力 q 的阻尼松弛方程。我们提出了该系统的标量辅助变量（SAV）时间离散化，将双阱势的 SAV 重构与二阶后向微分公式（BDF2）以及所有相位相关迁移率的二阶外推相结合：对参考方案的完全非线性牛顿解的线性、计算成本更低的补充。由此产生的方法（i）在每个时间步长都是线性的，我们证明对于每个时间步长大小的选择，每个步骤都有一个耦合结构； (ii) 质量守恒，确切地说，作为离散方程本身的代数恒等式（唯一在数值上看到的漂移归因于迭代线性求解器的有限公差，而不是守恒性质的失败）； (iii) 通过精确的一步能量耗散恒等式，对于修改后的离散能量无条件稳定。我们展示了能量恒等式也扩展到了这个过滤变体，有两个明确的额外非负项。因此，实际产生物理结果的方案本身对于相同的能量来说是稳定的。傅里叶-伽辽金实现验证了能量恒等式在每个时间步长都保持在浮点舍入范围内。它还证实了二阶时间精度，包括在陡峭界面区域，并与独立实现的非线性牛顿 BDF2 求解器一致。与独立的非线性牛顿-BDF2求解器相比，在相同的网格分辨率下，SAV方法使用的线性求解器迭代次数减少了2.5--3.0×，挂钟时间减少了1.7--2.0×。

articles.title: Reducing strain fluctuations in quantum dot devices by gate-layer stacking
articles.title_zh: 通过栅层堆叠减少量子点器件中的应变波动
articles.abstract: arXiv:2312.09235v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Nanofabricated metal gate electrodes are commonly used to confine and control electrons in electrostatically defined quantum dots. However, these same gates impart strain-induced potential fluctuations that can potentially impair device functionality. Here we investigate strain fluctuations in Si/SiGe heterostructures, caused by (i) lattice mismatch, (ii) materials-dependent thermal contraction, and (iii) depositional stress in the metal gates.By simulating gate geometries, ranging from simple to realistically complicated, we identify two opposing effects in overlapping gate structures: (a) gate-driven behavior arising from isolated gates vs (b) oxide-driven behavior arising from the thin oxides separating the gates in an overlapping geometry. These limiting behaviors induce strains of opposite sign, pointing towards the possibility of suppressing strain fluctuations through careful design. Here, we demonstrate in numerical models, a nearly total suppression of short-range strain fluctuation through device optimization. These results suggest that strain fluctuations should not pose an insurmountable challenge to qubit uniformity, provided that oxide and overlapping gate thicknesses can be tuned.
articles.abstract_zh: 纳米制造的金属栅电极通常用于限制和控制静电定义的量子点中的电子。然而，这些相同的栅极会产生应变引起的电位波动，这可能会损害器件的功能。在这里，我们研究了 Si/SiGe 异质结构中的应变波动，这些波动是由 (i) 晶格失配、(ii) 材料相关的热收缩和 (iii) 金属栅极中的沉积应力引起的。通过模拟从简单到实际复杂的栅极几何形状，我们确定了重叠栅极结构中的两种相反的影响：(a) 由隔离栅极引起的栅极驱动行为与 (b) 由重叠几何结构中分隔栅极的薄氧化物引起的氧化物驱动行为。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 纳米制造的金属栅电极通常用于限制和控制静电定义的量子点中的电子。然而，这些相同的栅极会产生应变引起的电位波动，这可能会损害器件的功能。在这里，我们研究了 Si/SiGe 异质结构中的应变波动，这些波动是由 (i) 晶格失配、(ii) 材料相关的热收缩和 (iii) 金属栅极中的沉积应力引起的。通过模拟从简单到实际复杂的栅极几何形状，我们确定了重叠栅极结构中的两种相反的影响：(a) 由隔离栅极引起的栅极驱动行为与 (b) 由重叠几何结构中分隔栅极的薄氧化物引起的氧化物驱动行为。这些限制行为会引起符号相反的应变，表明可以通过仔细的设计来抑制应变波动。在这里，我们在数值模型中演示了通过器件优化几乎完全抑制短程应变波动。这些结果表明，只要可以调整氧化物和重叠栅极的厚度，应变波动就不会对量子位均匀性构成不可克服的挑战。

articles.title: Field-Induced Weyl-Like Crossings and Longitudinal Magnetoconductivity in Dirac Systems
articles.title_zh: 狄拉克系统中的场感类韦尔交叉和纵向磁导率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2402.16859v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the field-induced separation of effective Weyl-like crossings and the associated longitudinal magnetoconductivity in Dirac systems using a finite-temperature quantum electrodynamics response-function approach. Starting from the one-loop photon polarization tensor in a magnetized fermionic medium, we identify a longitudinal electromagnetic mode associated with a nonvanishing pseudoscalar invariant bf E·bf B. We use this response to construct an effective low-energy Dirac model in which the two chiral sectors undergo opposite momentum shifts. Within this description, we derive an analytical expression for the longitudinal magnetoconductivity without introducing an independent phenomenological internode relaxation time. The chiral contribution contains an explicit B² prefactor, while its coefficient depends on the magnetic field and temperature through Landau-level thresholds and Fermi-Dirac occupation factors. The resulting conductivity exhibits a nonmonotonic magnetic-field dependence and an inverse-temperature regime under appropriate conditions. These results provide a connection, within the proposed effective model, between the longitudinal electromagnetic response, field-induced Weyl-like crossings, and longitudinal magnetotransport.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们使用有限温度量子电动力学响应函数方法研究了狄拉克系统中有效类外尔交叉的场致分离和相关的纵向磁导率。从磁化费米子介质中的单环光子偏振张量开始，我们识别了与非零赝标量不变量 bf E·bf B 相关的纵向电磁模式。我们使用这种响应构建了一个有效的低能狄拉克模型，其中两个手征扇区经历相反的动量位移。在这个描述中，我们推导了纵向磁导率的解析表达式，而不引入独立的现象学节间弛豫时间。手性贡献包含明确的 B² 前因子，而其系数通过朗道能级阈值和费米-狄拉克占据因子取决于磁场和温度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用有限温度量子电动力学响应函数方法研究了狄拉克系统中有效类外尔交叉的场致分离和相关的纵向磁导率。从磁化费米子介质中的单环光子偏振张量开始，我们识别了与非零赝标量不变量 bf E·bf B 相关的纵向电磁模式。我们使用这种响应构建了一个有效的低能狄拉克模型，其中两个手征扇区经历相反的动量位移。在这个描述中，我们推导了纵向磁导率的解析表达式，而不引入独立的现象学节间弛豫时间。手性贡献包含明确的 B² 前因子，而其系数通过朗道能级阈值和费米-狄拉克占据因子取决于磁场和温度。由此产生的电导率在适当的条件下表现出非单调的磁场依赖性和反温度状态。这些结果在所提出的有效模型内提供了纵向电磁响应、场感应类韦尔交叉和纵向磁输运之间的联系。

articles.title: Comment on "InAs-Al hybrid devices passing the topological gap protocol", Microsoft Quantum, Phys. Rev. B 107, 245423 (2023)
articles.title_zh: 对“通过拓扑间隙协议的 InAs-Al 混合器件”的评论，Microsoft Quantum，Phys。修订版 B 107, 245423 (2023)
articles.abstract: arXiv:2502.19560v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The topological gap protocol (TGP) is presented as "a series of stringent experimental tests" for the presence of topological superconductivity and associated Majorana zero modes. Here, we show that the TGP, "passed" by Microsoft Quantum [PRB 107, 245423 (2023)], lacks a consistent definition of "gap" or "topological", and even utilises different code when applied to theoretical simulations compared to experimental data. Furthermore, the outcome of the TGP is sensitive to the choice of magnetic field range, bias voltage range, data resolution, and cutter voltage pair (junction transparency) -- data parameters that, in PRB 107, 245423 (2023), vary significantly, even for measurements of the same device. As a result, the core claims of PRB 107, 245423 (2023) are based on unexplained measurement choices and inconsistent definitions. In particular, this means the claim by Microsoft Quantum in PRB 107, 245423 (2023) that their devices have a "high probability of being in the topological phase" is not reliable and should be revisited. In light of this, subsequent studies that are based on tuning up devices via the TGP should also be revisited.
articles.abstract_zh: 拓扑间隙协议（TGP）被描述为针对拓扑超导性和相关马约拉纳零模式的存在的“一系列严格的实验测试”。在这里，我们表明 Microsoft Quantum“通过”的 TGP [PRB 107, 245423 (2023)] 缺乏“间隙”或“拓扑”的一致定义，甚至在应用于理论模拟与实验数据时使用不同的代码。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 拓扑间隙协议（TGP）被描述为针对拓扑超导性和相关马约拉纳零模式的存在的“一系列严格的实验测试”。在这里，我们表明 Microsoft Quantum“通过”的 TGP [PRB 107, 245423 (2023)] 缺乏“间隙”或“拓扑”的一致定义，甚至在应用于理论模拟与实验数据时使用不同的代码。此外，TGP 的结果对磁场范围、偏置电压范围、数据分辨率和切割电压对（结透明度）的选择很敏感，这些数据参数在 PRB 107、245423 (2023) 中也有很大差异，即使对于同一设备的测量也是如此。因此，PRB 107, 245423 (2023) 的核心主张基于无法解释的测量选择和不一致的定义。特别是，这意味着 Microsoft Quantum 在 PRB 107, 245423 (2023) 中声称其设备“处于拓扑阶段的可能性很高”的说法并不可靠，应重新审视。有鉴于此，基于通过 TGP 调整设备的后续研究也应该重新审视。

articles.title: Spatiotemporal spin transport from first principles
articles.title_zh: 从第一原理出发的时空自旋输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2505.07745v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Manipulating spin for quantum information and spintronic devices requires quantitative prediction of quantum transport over long time and length scales. We introduce a computational framework for first-principles density-matrix quantum transport within the Wigner function formalism that facilitates spin dynamics and transport simulations, while accounting for electron-phonon scattering at device length scales. This allows us to elucidate the impact of realistic spin-orbit fields, such as Rashba and persistent spin helix, on coherent spin transport in several materials, as well as the transition to incoherent transport with increasing strength of electron-phonon scattering. We identify three distinct regimes of incoherent spin transport corresponding to the free induction decay, Dyakonov-Perel and Elliott-Yafet regimes of spin relaxation, and find a scattering-strength-independent spin diffusion length within the Dyakonov-Perel regime. With applied magnetic fields, spin transport in this regime is sensitive to scattering strength and leads to asymmetric Hanle curves that probe the internal spin-orbit field of the material.
articles.abstract_zh: 操纵量子信息和自旋电子器件的自旋需要对长时间和长度尺度上的量子输运进行定量预测。我们在维格纳函数形式中引入了第一原理密度矩阵量子输运的计算框架，该框架促进了自旋动力学和输运模拟，同时考虑了器件长度尺度上的电子声子散射。这使我们能够阐明现实的自旋轨道场（例如 Rashba 和持久自旋螺旋）对几种材料中相干自旋输运的影响，以及随着电子声子散射强度的增加而向非相干输运的转变。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 操纵量子信息和自旋电子器件的自旋需要对长时间和长度尺度上的量子输运进行定量预测。我们在维格纳函数形式中引入了第一原理密度矩阵量子输运的计算框架，该框架促进了自旋动力学和输运模拟，同时考虑了器件长度尺度上的电子声子散射。这使我们能够阐明现实的自旋轨道场（例如 Rashba 和持久自旋螺旋）对几种材料中相干自旋输运的影响，以及随着电子声子散射强度的增加而向非相干输运的转变。我们确定了与自由感应衰变相对应的三种不同的非相干自旋输运机制，即自旋弛豫的 Dyakonov-Perel 机制和 Elliott-Yafet 机制，并在 Dyakonov-Perel 机制内找到了与散射强度无关的自旋扩散长度。在施加磁场的情况下，这种状态下的自旋输运对散射强度敏感，并导致不对称的汉勒曲线，从而探测材料的内部自旋轨道场。

articles.title: Pseudomagnetic focusing of valley-polarized beams in strained graphene
articles.title_zh: 应变石墨烯中谷偏振光束的赝磁聚焦
articles.abstract: arXiv:2505.21056v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In addition to spin, the low-energy charge carriers in graphene have two inequivalent valley flavors K and K' related by time-reversal symmetry, which can potentially serve as carriers for additional information. One promising route of controlling the valley degree of freedom relies on strain-induced pseudomagnetic fields, which couple with opposite signs to the two valleys. In this work, we theoretically investigate quantum transport in strained graphene devices that host tailored pseudomagnetic field profiles for valley manipulation. We focus on experimentally feasible geometries and propose transverse pseudomagnetic focusing in a bent graphene ribbon as an efficient method for generating valley-polarized currents, even in presence of disorder. Our work highlights pseudomagneto-transport in graphene as a viable tool for valleytronic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 除了自旋之外，石墨烯中的低能电荷载流子还具有通过时间反转对称性相关的两种不等价的谷味 K 和 K'，它们可以作为附加信息的载流子。控制谷自由度的一种有前途的途径依赖于应变引起的赝磁场，该磁场与两个谷的符号相反。在这项工作中，我们从理论上研究了应变石墨烯器件中的量子传输，这些器件具有用于谷操纵的定制赝磁场分布。我们专注于实验上可行的几何形状，并提出弯曲石墨烯带中的横向赝磁聚焦作为产生谷极化电流的有效方法，即使存在无序。我们的工作强调石墨烯中的赝磁输运作为谷电子应用的可行工具。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 除了自旋之外，石墨烯中的低能电荷载流子还具有通过时间反转对称性相关的两种不等价的谷味 K 和 K'，它们可以作为附加信息的载流子。控制谷自由度的一种有前途的途径依赖于应变引起的赝磁场，该磁场与两个谷的符号相反。在这项工作中，我们从理论上研究了应变石墨烯器件中的量子传输，这些器件具有用于谷操纵的定制赝磁场分布。我们专注于实验上可行的几何形状，并提出弯曲石墨烯带中的横向赝磁聚焦作为产生谷极化电流的有效方法，即使存在无序。我们的工作强调石墨烯中的赝磁输运作为谷电子应用的可行工具。

articles.title: Controlling energy delivery with bistable nanostructures
articles.title_zh: 用双稳态纳米结构控制能量输送
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.14266v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Countless biological processes are fueled by energy-rich molecules like ATP and GTP that supply energy with extreme efficiency. However, designing similar energy-delivery schemes from the bottom up, essential for the development of powered nanostructures and other emphde novo machinery, presents a significant challenge: how can an energy-rich structure be stable in solution yet still deliver this energy at precisely the right time? In this paper, we present a purely physical mechanism that solves this challenge, facilitating energy transfer akin to ATP hydrolysis, yet occurring between synthetic nanostructures without any biochemical interactions. This targeted energy delivery is achieved by exploiting a differentiable state-based model to balance the energy profiles that govern the structural transitions in the two nanostructures, creating a coupled relaxation pathway with minimal barriers that facilitates energy delivery. We verify the effectiveness and robustness of this mechanism through Langevin Dynamics simulations, demonstrating that a bath of the high-energy structures can systematically and repeatedly drive the target structure out of equilibrium, enabling it to perform tasks. As the mechanism operates only through explicit physical forces without any biochemistry or internal state variables, our results present generic and far-reaching design principles, setting the stage for the next generation of synthetic nanomachines.
articles.abstract_zh: 无数的生物过程都是由 ATP 和 GTP 等富含能量的分子提供动力，这些分子能够以极高的效率提供能量。然而，自下而上设计类似的能量传输方案对于动力纳米结构和其他新能源机械的发展至关重要，这提出了一个重大挑战：富含能量的结构如何在溶液中保持稳定，同时仍然在准确的时间传输这种能量？在本文中，我们提出了一种解决这一挑战的纯物理机制，促进类似于 ATP 水解的能量转移，但发生在合成纳米结构之间，没有任何生化相互作用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 无数的生物过程都是由 ATP 和 GTP 等富含能量的分子提供动力，这些分子能够以极高的效率提供能量。然而，自下而上设计类似的能量传输方案对于动力纳米结构和其他新能源机械的发展至关重要，这提出了一个重大挑战：富含能量的结构如何在溶液中保持稳定，同时仍然在准确的时间传输这种能量？在本文中，我们提出了一种解决这一挑战的纯物理机制，促进类似于 ATP 水解的能量转移，但发生在合成纳米结构之间，没有任何生化相互作用。这种有针对性的能量传递是通过利用可微分的基于状态的模型来平衡控制两个纳米结构中的结构转变的能量分布来实现的，从而创建一个具有最小障碍的耦合弛豫路径，以促进能量传递。我们通过 Langevin Dynamics 模拟验证了该机制的有效性和鲁棒性，证明高能结构浴可以系统地、反复地驱动目标结构脱离平衡，使其能够执行任务。由于该机制仅通过明确的物理力进行操作，而没有任何生物化学或内部状态变量，因此我们的结果提出了通用且影响深远的设计原则，为下一代合成纳米机器奠定了基础。

articles.title: Electronic crystals and quasicrystals in semiconductor quantum wells: an AI-powered discovery
articles.title_zh: 半导体量子阱中的电子晶体和准晶体：人工智能驱动的发现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.10909v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The homogeneous electron gas is a cornerstone of quantum condensed matter physics, providing the foundation for developing density functional theory and understanding electronic phases in semiconductors. However, theoretical understanding of strongly-correlated electrons in realistic semiconductor systems remains limited. In this work, we develop a neural network based variational approach to study quantum wells in three dimensional geometry for a variety of electron densities and well thicknesses. Starting from first principles, our unbiased AI-powered method reveals metallic and crystalline phases with both monolayer and bilayer charge distributions. In the emergent bilayer, we discover a new quantum phase of matter: the electronic quasicrystal.
articles.abstract_zh: 均质电子气是量子凝聚态物理学的基石，为发展密度泛函理论和理解半导体中的电子相奠定了基础。然而，对现实半导体系统中强相关电子的理论理解仍然有限。在这项工作中，我们开发了一种基于神经网络的变分方法来研究各种电子密度和阱厚度的三维几何中的量子阱。从第一原理开始，我们的无偏人工智能驱动方法揭示了具有单层和双层电荷分布的金属相和结晶相。在出现的双层中，我们发现了一种新的物质量子相：电子准晶体。

articles.title: Josephson Oscillation and Nonlinear Self-Trapping in Quasi-one-dimensional Quantum Liquid
articles.title_zh: 准一维量子液体中的约瑟夫森振荡和非线性自陷
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.00674v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this article, we study the two-mode method to analyze the Josephson oscillation for a trapped binary Bose-Einstein condensate while taking into account the beyond mean-field and three body interactions. For this purpose, we use the archetypal model of double well potential and study the Josephson oscillation and self-trapping phases in quasi-one dimension. Additionally, our analysis provides quantitative discussion on the effect of asymmetry and dimension. We further corroborate our findings with Bogoliubov quasi-particle method and notice the existence of roton-like mode.
articles.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们研究了双模式方法来分析捕获的二元玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚态的约瑟夫森振荡，同时考虑到超平均场和三体相互作用。为此，我们使用双阱势的原型模型，研究准一维的约瑟夫森振荡和自陷相。此外，我们的分析还提供了关于不对称性和尺寸影响的定量讨论。我们用 Bogoliubov 准粒子方法进一步证实了我们的发现，并注意到类旋子模式的存在。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在本文中，我们研究了双模式方法来分析捕获的二元玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚态的约瑟夫森振荡，同时考虑到超平均场和三体相互作用。为此，我们使用双阱势的原型模型，研究准一维的约瑟夫森振荡和自陷相。此外，我们的分析还提供了关于不对称性和尺寸影响的定量讨论。我们用 Bogoliubov 准粒子方法进一步证实了我们的发现，并注意到类旋子模式的存在。

articles.title: Finite-time Polytropic Steering Reveals Non-monotonic Irreversibility
articles.title_zh: 有限时间多方转向揭示非单调不可逆性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.13765v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: How irreversibility evolves from slow to fast driving is a central question in nonequilibrium thermodynamics. While near-equilibrium theory predicts increasing irreversibility with driving speed, the corresponding crossover far from equilibrium is not generally resolved within a unified control framework. Here we introduce polytropic steering, in which a prescribed relation between the ensemble energy and a time-dependent control parameter continuously organizes finite-time processes between isothermal and adiabatic limits. A Fokker-Planck formulation makes the construction applicable to general confining potentials, and yields closed-form thermodynamic expressions for a harmonic trap. We find a non-monotonic irreversibility: the entropy generation decreases in both the quasistatic and fast-driving limits and exhibits a maximum at an intermediate protocol duration. The resulting most-irreversible timescale quantifies the competition between thermal relaxation and external driving. We verify the persistence of this behavior in an anharmonic optical-lattice potential and demonstrate how the same steering principle controls power-efficiency trade-offs in finite-time Brownian engines.
articles.abstract_zh: 不可逆性如何从慢速驱动演变为快速驱动是非平衡热力学的核心问题。虽然近平衡理论预测不可逆性随着行驶速度的增加而增加，但相应的远离平衡的交叉通常不会在统一的控制框架内得到解决。在这里，我们引入多方转向，其中系综能量和时间相关控制参数之间的规定关系连续组织等温和绝热极限之间的有限时间过程。福克-普朗克公式使该结构适用于一般限制势，并产生谐波陷阱的封闭式热力学表达式。我们发现了一种非单调不可逆性：熵的产生在准静态和快速驱动极限下均减少，并在中间协议持续时间内表现出最大值。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 不可逆性如何从慢速驱动演变为快速驱动是非平衡热力学的核心问题。虽然近平衡理论预测不可逆性随着行驶速度的增加而增加，但相应的远离平衡的交叉通常不会在统一的控制框架内得到解决。在这里，我们引入多方转向，其中系综能量和时间相关控制参数之间的规定关系连续组织等温和绝热极限之间的有限时间过程。福克-普朗克公式使该结构适用于一般限制势，并产生谐波陷阱的封闭式热力学表达式。我们发现了一种非单调不可逆性：熵的产生在准静态和快速驱动极限下均减少，并在中间协议持续时间内表现出最大值。由此产生的最不可逆的时间尺度量化了热弛豫和外部驱动之间的竞争。我们验证了这种行为在非谐波光学晶格势中的持久性，并演示了相同的转向原理如何控制有限时间布朗发动机中的功率效率权衡。

articles.title: Orientational frustration drives enhanced diffusion of anisotropic particles in a liquid labyrinth
articles.title_zh: 方向挫败促进各向异性粒子在液体迷宫中的增强扩散
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.23340v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Transport of nanoscale objects in complex, structured environments plays a key role in a wide range of processes, from biomolecular dynamics in extracellular spaces to transport in porous materials such as filters and catalysts. While anomalous diffusion is well established, how particle anisotropy governs transport under geometric constraints remains unclear. Here we use 3D single-particle tracking to investigate the diffusion of stiff one-dimensional carbon nanotubes in a continuous soft matter network of interconnected chambers and constrictions. Transport is anomalous and antipersistent, with strong length dependent confinement and trapping, consistent with obstructed diffusion. Unexpectedly, however, escape from confinement is poorly sensitive to nanotube length as opposed to what would be expected of pore mediated transport. Despite a tenfold length increase and significantly enhanced trapping, escape time increased by only ~1.4. Single-particle orientational tracking reveals the origin of this weak scaling. Indeed, long nanotube, i.e. those with length comparable to the chamber dimensions, dynamically align with constrictions enabling efficient, geometry-assisted escape that offsets increased confinement while shorter nanotubes need to screen the volume to find their escape path. These results uncover an alignment-mediated transport mechanism that decouples confinement strength from escape kinetics, distinct from pore-mediated transport mechanisms, establishing a quantitative framework for anisotropic diffusion in complex environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 纳米级物体在复杂、结构化环境中的传输在多种过程中发挥着关键作用，从细胞外空间的生物分子动力学到过滤器和催化剂等多孔材料中的传输。虽然反常扩散已得到充分证实，但粒子各向异性如何在几何约束下控制输运仍不清楚。在这里，我们使用 3D 单粒子跟踪来研究刚性一维碳纳米管在互连室和收缩的连续软物质网络中的扩散。运输是异常的和反持久的，具有强烈的长度依赖性限制和捕获，与受阻的扩散一致。然而，出乎意料的是，与孔介导的运输所预期的相反，逃离限制对纳米管长度的敏感性很差。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 纳米级物体在复杂、结构化环境中的传输在多种过程中发挥着关键作用，从细胞外空间的生物分子动力学到过滤器和催化剂等多孔材料中的传输。虽然反常扩散已得到充分证实，但粒子各向异性如何在几何约束下控制输运仍不清楚。在这里，我们使用 3D 单粒子跟踪来研究刚性一维碳纳米管在互连室和收缩的连续软物质网络中的扩散。运输是异常的和反持久的，具有强烈的长度依赖性限制和捕获，与受阻的扩散一致。然而，出乎意料的是，与孔介导的运输所预期的相反，逃离限制对纳米管长度的敏感性很差。尽管长度增加了十倍并且捕获显着增强，但逃逸时间仅增加了约 1.4。单粒子定向跟踪揭示了这种弱尺度的起源。事实上，长纳米管，即长度与腔室尺寸相当的纳米管，动态地与收缩对齐，从而实现高效、几何辅助的逃逸，从而抵消增加的限制，而较短的纳米管需要筛选体积以找到其逃逸路径。这些结果揭示了一种排列介导的传输机制，该机制将限制强度与逃逸动力学解耦，与孔介导的传输机制不同，为复杂环境中的各向异性扩散建立了定量框架。

articles.title: Thermodynamic origin of entropy-assisted stabilization in multicomponent rock-salt oxides
articles.title_zh: 多组分岩盐氧化物中熵辅助稳定的热力学起源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00753v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: High entropy oxides are commonly associated with high configurational entropy (Δ Scₒₙf≥ 1.61R) corresponding to five equimolar cations occupying a crystallographic sublattice. However, recent experimental observations indicate that medium-entropy compositions may also exhibit entropy-stabilized rock-salt phases, raising an important question regarding the minimum entropy required for phase stabilization. In this work, we employ a first-principles thermodynamic framework to investigate the stability of rock-salt oxides containing two to five principal cations components analogous to (Ni₀.₈Cu₀.₂)O, (Ni₀.₆Cu₀.₂Zn₀.₂)O, (Ni₀.₄Cu₀.₂Zn₀.₂Co₀.₂)O, (Ni₀.₂Cu₀.₂Zn₀.₂Co₀.₂Mg₀.₂)O. Density functional theory, MCSQS-based structural modeling, and finite-temperature Gibbs free-energy analysis are combined to quantify the roles of enthalpy mixing (Δ Hₘᵢₓ), configurational (Δ Scₒₙf), vibrational (Δ Sᵥᵢb), electronic and magnetic (Δ Sₘₐg) contributions towards (Δ Sₑₗₑc) entropy change in governing phase stability. The results show that Δ Scₒₙf alone is not a universal descriptor of phase stability. While the two-cation system is enthalpy-stabilized but three-, four- and five-cation systems become thermodynamically stable at high-temperature due to entropy-driven reduction of the Gibbs free energy. These findings demonstrate that single-phase rock-salt oxides are not restricted to the conventional high-entropy limit and that medium-entropy compositions can also be stabilized under suitable thermodynamic conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 高熵氧化物通常与高构型熵（ΔScₒₙf≥1.61R）相关，对应于占据晶体亚晶格的五个等摩尔阳离子。然而，最近的实验观察表明，中等熵成分也可能表现出熵稳定的岩盐相，这就提出了关于相稳定所需的最小熵的重要问题。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 高熵氧化物通常与高构型熵（ΔScₒₙf≥1.61R）相关，对应于占据晶体亚晶格的五个等摩尔阳离子。然而，最近的实验观察表明，中等熵成分也可能表现出熵稳定的岩盐相，这就提出了关于相稳定所需的最小熵的重要问题。在这项工作中，我们采用第一原理热力学框架来研究含有两到五种主要阳离子成分的岩盐氧化物的稳定性，这些阳离子成分类似于 (Ni₀.₈Cu₀.2)O、(Ni₀.₆Cu₀.2Zn₀.2)O、(Ni₀.₄Cu₀.2Zn₀.2Co0.2)O、 (Ni0.2Cu0.2Zn0.2Co0.2Mg0.2)O。密度泛函理论、基于 MCSQS 的结构建模和有限温度吉布斯自由能分析相结合，量化了混合焓 (Δ Hₘᵢₓ)、构型 (Δ Scₒₙf)、振动 (Δ Sᵥᵢb)、电子和磁 (Δ Sₘₐg) 对 (Δ Sₑₗₑc) 熵变的贡献控制相位稳定性。结果表明，单独的 Δ Scₒₙf 并不是相位稳定性的通用描述符。虽然二阳离子系统是焓稳定的，但三阳离子、四阳离子和五阳离子系统由于吉布斯自由能的熵驱动减少而在高温下变得热力学稳定。这些发现表明，单相岩盐氧化物并不局限于传统的高熵极限，并且中等熵成分也可以在合适的热力学条件下稳定。

articles.title: Precipitation strengthening as a collective multi-dislocation phenomenon
articles.title_zh: 降水强化是一种集体多位错现象
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.14890v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Precipitation strengthening is a cornerstone of physical metallurgy, delivering otherwise unattainable combinations of strength and ductility. The approach relies on nanoscale precipitates that impede the motion of dislocations, the primary carriers of metal plasticity. Historically, precipitation strengthening has been rationalized via two idealized, limiting mechanisms: dislocations either cut through or bow around precipitates. However, under many technologically relevant conditions, multiple dislocations can interact with a precipitate at the same time, potentially giving rise to distinct precipitate-dislocation dynamics that in situ experiments are yet to fully resolve. Here, using large-scale atomistic simulations (100 million atoms) that capture these dynamics, we demonstrate that in this regime, the cutting-versus-bowing dichotomy is incomplete: strengthening arises as an emergent phenomenon driven by concurrent multi-dislocation interactions. These interactions simultaneously induce dislocation accumulation at interfaces, storage within precipitates, and precipitate-mediated multiplication inside the matrix. Our findings establish a distinct mechanistic regime of precipitation strengthening beyond traditional models and provide a quantitative foundation for predicting its behavior.
articles.abstract_zh: 沉淀强化是物理冶金的基石，可提供其他方式无法实现的强度和延展性组合。该方法依赖于阻碍位错运动的纳米级沉淀物，位错是金属塑性的主要载体。从历史上看，沉淀强化是通过两种理想化的限制机制来合理化的：位错要么穿过沉淀物，要么在沉淀物周围弯曲。然而，在许多技术相关条件下，多个位错可以同时与沉淀物相互作用，可能会产生独特的沉淀物-位错动力学，而原位实验尚未完全解决这一问题。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 沉淀强化是物理冶金的基石，可提供其他方式无法实现的强度和延展性组合。该方法依赖于阻碍位错运动的纳米级沉淀物，位错是金属塑性的主要载体。从历史上看，沉淀强化是通过两种理想化的限制机制来合理化的：位错要么穿过沉淀物，要么在沉淀物周围弯曲。然而，在许多技术相关条件下，多个位错可以同时与沉淀物相互作用，可能会产生独特的沉淀物-位错动力学，而原位实验尚未完全解决这一问题。在这里，使用捕捉这些动态的大规模原子模拟（1亿个原子），我们证明了在这种情况下，切割与弯曲二分法是不完整的：强化是由并发的多位错相互作用驱动的一种新兴现象。这些相互作用同时引起界面处的位错积累、沉淀物内的存储以及基质内沉淀物介导的增殖。我们的研究结果建立了超越传统模型的独特降水强化机制机制，并为预测其行为提供了定量基础。

articles.title: Observation and Control of Spontaneous Magnon Emission from Spin Ensembles in 2D Hexagonal Boron Nitride
articles.title_zh: 二维六方氮化硼中自旋系综自发磁振子发射的观测与控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20996v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Hybrid systems consisting of color centers and magnetic materials provide an appealing solid-state platform for advancing the burgeoning quantum technological revolution. Exploring novel coupling mechanisms between optically active spin defects and quantum degrees of freedom is directly relevant in this context. Here, we report observation and control of spontaneous magnon emission from boron-vacancy centers in 2D hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) to a proximal ferrimagnet in the near-zero temperature limit. The spontaneous magnon emission process is overshadowed by thermal magnon effect as temperature increases, reflecting the crossover from a spontaneous-emission-dominated magnon reservoir to a thermally occupied spin bath where absorption and stimulated processes restore balance. By increasing the spin defect density, we further present that spontaneous magnon emission into a common spin bath could help establish magnon-mediated correlations in dense hBN spin ensembles. Our results are quantitatively captured by theoretical modeling, bringing insights into understanding qubit-magnon coupling, correlated spin dynamics, and many-body physics of color centers in the quantum regime.
articles.abstract_zh: 由色心和磁性材料组成的混合系统为推动新兴的量子技术革命提供了一个有吸引力的固态平台。探索光学活性自旋缺陷和量子自由度之间的新颖耦合机制与此背景直接相关。在这里，我们报告了在接近零温度极限下从二维六方氮化硼（hBN）中的硼空位中心到近端亚铁磁体的自发磁振子发射的观察和控制。随着温度升高，自发磁振子发射过程被热磁振子效应所掩盖，反映了从自发发射主导的磁振子库到热占据旋转浴的交叉，其中吸收和受激过程恢复平衡。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由色心和磁性材料组成的混合系统为推动新兴的量子技术革命提供了一个有吸引力的固态平台。探索光学活性自旋缺陷和量子自由度之间的新颖耦合机制与此背景直接相关。在这里，我们报告了在接近零温度极限下从二维六方氮化硼（hBN）中的硼空位中心到近端亚铁磁体的自发磁振子发射的观察和控制。随着温度升高，自发磁振子发射过程被热磁振子效应所掩盖，反映了从自发发射主导的磁振子库到热占据旋转浴的交叉，其中吸收和受激过程恢复平衡。通过增加自旋缺陷密度，我们进一步提出，自发磁振子发射到公共旋转浴中可以帮助在致密六方氮化硼自旋系综中建立磁振子介导的相关性。我们的结果通过理论模型定量捕获，为理解量子位-磁振子耦合、相关自旋动力学和量子体系中色心的多体物理提供了见解。

articles.title: A Combined Tight Binding with Machine Learning Potential Model for Magnesium Compounds
articles.title_zh: 镁化合物的紧结合与机器学习潜力模型相结合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25853v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a model for magnesium-based systems that combines density functional tight binding (DFTB) with MACE, a machine learning interatomic potential (DFTB+MACE). In this model, the conventional repulsive potential, pair potential, is replaced by a many-body MACE potential. The MACE component of the model is trained on the difference between density functional theory (DFT) energies and forces and the corresponding DFTB values, but neglecting the pair potential contribution. Using this model we performed structural relaxation of MgO-CO2 adsorption systems, molecular dynamics calculations of water clusters and phonon spectrum calculations of stable fcc-MgO and metastable bcc-MgO structures. We compare the performance of our model with a pure MACE model and with DFT. We demonstrate that the DFTB+MACE model achieves improved accuracy relative to DFTB with a pair potential, in many cases with only a moderate increase in computational cost. In addition, it can provide electronic structures that most of the machine learning potentials cannot. The training dataset, originally developed for MACE, may not fully represent all regions of the potential surface we may encounter during simulations. Expanding the dataset for a wider potential surface is expected to further enhance predictive accuracy of DFTB+MACE model. Overall, the resulting DFTB+MACE framework enables simulations at length and time scales beyond the reach of first-principles methods while retaining an explicit description of electronic structures, making it particularly attractive for studying charge-transfer in materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种基于镁的系统模型，该模型将密度泛函紧结合 (DFTB) 与 MACE（一种机器学习原子间势 (DFTB+MACE)）相结合。在此模型中，传统的排斥势、对势被多体 MACE 势所取代。该模型的 MACE 组件根据密度泛函理论 (DFT) 能量和力之间的差异以及相应的 DFTB 值进行训练，但忽略了对的潜在贡献。使用该模型，我们进行了 MgO-CO2 吸附系统的结构弛豫、水簇的分子动力学计算以及稳定 fcc-MgO 和亚稳态 bcc-MgO 结构的声子谱计算。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种基于镁的系统模型，该模型将密度泛函紧结合 (DFTB) 与 MACE（一种机器学习原子间势 (DFTB+MACE)）相结合。在此模型中，传统的排斥势、对势被多体 MACE 势所取代。该模型的 MACE 组件根据密度泛函理论 (DFT) 能量和力之间的差异以及相应的 DFTB 值进行训练，但忽略了对的潜在贡献。使用该模型，我们进行了 MgO-CO2 吸附系统的结构弛豫、水簇的分子动力学计算以及稳定 fcc-MgO 和亚稳态 bcc-MgO 结构的声子谱计算。我们将模型的性能与纯 MACE 模型和 DFT 进行比较。我们证明，相对于具有配对潜力的 DFTB，DFTB+MACE 模型实现了更高的准确性，在许多情况下，计算成本仅略有增加。此外，它还可以提供大多数机器学习潜力无法提供的电子结构。最初为 MACE 开发的训练数据集可能无法完全代表我们在模拟过程中可能遇到的潜在表面的所有区域。扩展数据集以获得更广泛的潜在表面预计将进一步提高 DFTB+MACE 模型的预测准确性。总体而言，由此产生的 DFTB+MACE 框架能够在超出第一性原理方法范围的长度和时间尺度上进行模拟，同时保留对电子结构的明确描述，使其对于研究材料中的电荷转移特别有吸引力。

articles.title: Entropy functional theory for inhomogeneous fluids
articles.title_zh: 非均匀流体的熵泛函理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.28240v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present an exact variational scheme for the physics of inhomogeneous classical fluids in thermal equilibrium. A joint metadensity minimization principle is proven for the one-body density and the global interparticle distance distribution. The theory bypasses the inhomogeneous two-body density and thus remains computationally simple. A universal excess entropy functional accounts for all many-body correlations in arbitrary pairwise interacting systems.
